60003.description:
It has been quite some time since we faced such a large number of Scourge. We were ill-prepared for an assault of this scale.

While we managed to escort many to safety, there are some who were wounded in the chaos.

Search the training grounds for any survivors from the onslaught.

We need all the help we can get.
60003.title: A Valiant Effort
60003.objectives: Rescue 6 Wounded Valiants from the training grounds.
60003.completion: We'll see to it they receive proper attention.

60004.description:
It has been quite some time since we faced such a large number of Scourge. We were ill-prepared for an assault of this scale.

While we managed to escort many to safety, there are some who were wounded in the chaos.

Search the training grounds for any survivors from the onslaught.

We need all the help we can get.
60004.title: A Valiant Effort
60004.objectives: Rescue 6 Wounded Valiants from the training grounds.
60004.completion: We'll see to it they receive proper attention.

60005.description:
The Temple of Courage must not fall!

All kyrian learn to fight in its hallowed halls. Not only to protect Bastion, but to ensure their own safety when retrieving souls from across the veil. 

Travel there at once. Seek out Thanikos, the Paragon of Courage's loyal hand.
60005.title: Imminent Danger
60005.objectives: Seek out Thanikos at Xandria's Vigil.
60005.completion: Not quite the army I hoped would come, but I welcome your blade by my side.

60006.description:
In a fair fight our warriors could stand against countless swarms of these Maldraxxi.

This was no fair fight, outsider.

They came without warning. Without cause. We were caught unprepared.

They must not be allowed to encroach any further. This stops here.
60006.title: Now or Never
60006.progress: We will not go down without a fight.
60006.completion: We have bought a staging ground, but much remains to be done.

60007.description:
I can rebuild this colossus's core systems, but a few things are beyond repair. Thankfully there were enough centurions present here that I believe we can improvise.

Replacements are in order!

I require an Anima Conflux to charge its systems, some Eternity Plating to protect its core, and an Archonic Resonator to make it go boom!

I'll take care of the rest. Quickly, now!
60007.title: Stay Scrappy
60007.objectives: Recover the Anima Conflux, Eternity Plating, and Archonic Resonator.
60007.completion: That was fast! Well done, well done indeed!

60008.description:
We will show these Maldraxxi insurgents the price for their betrayal.

The northern grounds have been taken by the House of Constructs, home to Maldraxxus' most resilient warriors.

They have earned no mercy this day, and we will give them none. We will carve through them side by side until this sacred ground is cleansed.
60008.title: Rip and Tear
60008.progress: This is what must be done.
60008.completion: You fight with the poise of a true kyrian, outsider.

60009.description:
Some of our brethren are still alive in there!

While many were lost in the initial assault, they seem keen on taking any survivors prisoner. I know not what they intend, but given their mastery of corpses we must assume the worst.

Some have already been taken to their necropolis above, but others remain in cages on the ground. Free all you can.
60009.title: Fight Another Day
60009.progress: The kyrian leave none behind on the field of battle.
60009.completion: You are a true ally, outsider. Thank you.

70221.completion:
Hey there {NAME}! The Artisan's Consortium would like to thank you for everything you've done for us. We'd like to give you some Artisan's Mettle free of charge.

Maybe use it to fill some recrafting orders for us!
70221.title: Show Your Mettle

70355.completion:
Welcome to the Dragon Isles! You seem like a skilled alchemist. Perhaps you would be interested to learn my draconic methodologies?

I can teach you everything I know about alchemy. I am sure you will learn something new.
70355.title: Dragon Isles Alchemy

72459.description:
I will be honest with you, {NAME}.

It has been such a long time since we dealt with the black dragonflight that I could not quite tell you much about them. I do know that they are strong warriors, brave protectors of us all.

Rusziona is still quite young, but perhaps we should see how well she does with battle? Take her to practice on some ducks in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Let us see her baseline.
72459.title: What's a Duck?
72459.objectives: Kill 5 Bluebill Waddlers in Primordial Vale with Rusziona.
72459.progress: How did Rusziona fare with the ducks?
72459.completion:
She what?!

<Agapanthus holds his head in his hand and lets out a big sigh.>

You know? That was insensitive of me. I should know better.

I think we need to go back to the drawing board.

70932.description:
To many, meat is essential for any true meal. But what is the essential for any true meat dish?

Spice!!

A spice that surpasses all others in terms of flavor, texture, and rarity lies within these Isles. Unfortunately, it can only be found on elementals that dwell in the depths of the Obsidian Stronghold. It's an area currently occupied by the Djaradin.

Perhaps you can consult with a peculiar troll I met while passing through there. I believe his name was... Griftah.
70932.title: The Life of Spice
70932.objectives: Speak with Griftah at the Obsidian Throne.

68083.description:
Return to the Teerai and tell them that not even I can train Taivan to be a hunter. He simply does not have it in him.

He is the most un-ferocious bakar I have ever seen, and I bet he would even try to make friends with the wild game if we let him! Hah!
68083.completion:
Taivan just returned. They could not have trained him so quickly could they? No... I suppose not.

<She sighs deeply and looks at Taivan.>

He doesn't seem to be taking it well, either. I have one more idea, and if this doesn't work, we will have to make some difficult decisions.
68083.title: Try Again, Taivan!
68083.objectives: Return to Healer Selbekh in Maruukai and deliver the bad news.

70050.description:
So the handsome fellas are sendin' ye on a wee adventure, eh?

That's fine. The expedition won't be able to set sail until someone gets those elemental storms under control anyway.

Check-in with Storm Hunter William. He's leading the expedition efforts to investigate the storms and can outfit ye with whatever gear you need.

I'll coordinate the rest of the preparations here while ye have all the fun out there.

Ye'll owe me one, though!
70050.completion:
If you're heading into those storms, you're going to need all the help you can get.

Lucky for you, I've been stocking up on storm-chasing gear for years.

Take a look, and see what fits.
70050.title: Chasing Storms
70050.objectives: Speak with Storm Hunter William in Stormwind Harbor.

70244.description:
For thousands of years, the Teerai have guarded the Horn of Drusahl, our most sacred relic. By sacking this village, Balakar has betrayed everything it means to be Maruuk. There can be no redemption for him now.

We must retake the Horn before Balakar can destroy it and rescue any Teerai who yet live. I am going with you to personally bring that false Khan to justice. The Nokhud will know the wrath of the Khanam Matra!
70244.progress: There is no time to lose! We must re-take the village and defend the Horn of Drusahl!
70244.completion: What are they doing to Ohn'ahra? Balakar and Koroleth will pay dearly for this!
70244.title: Nokhud Can Come of This
70244.objectives: Enter the village with Khanam Matra Sarest and reclaim it from the Nokhud.

70650.description:
You have proven yourself well so far, and though I have great faith you are worthy of the Engine I still must challenge you as is my designation. 

Go to the Waking Shores and find my statue and you shall receive further instructions.
70650.completion: <This once majestic and imposing statue now lies in ruin.>
70650.title: In Tyr's Footsteps: The Waking Shores
70650.objectives: Find the Third Challenge of Tyr in the Waking Shores.

70930.description:
Today is a celebration of tea - brewed, iced, and otherwise! Extravagant little cakes and biscuits too.

But there is a rare ingredient of the Isles I feel could add a whole new dimension of flavor! Deep within the crawler-infested domain of the Shiverweb Vale is a bush laden with the most wondrously uplifting leaf: Coldsnap Sagittate.

The Dragonscale Expedition was exploring that area recently. Perhaps one of them could assist?
70930.title: All Tea, No Shadeleaf
70930.objectives: Speak with Lilial Dawnburst in Shiverweb Vale.

71152.description:
Now that we've accessed the override consoles, we should be able to get past that barrier.

I'll meet ye back in the main hall and we'll see this through!
71152.completion: All that hard work is about to pay off, {NAME}.
71152.title: Back to the Main Hall
71152.objectives: Rendezvous with Toddy in the main hall.

72338.progress: Find me a Greater Obsidian key, and we shall unlock the full potential of the Obsidian Citadel.
72338.completion: This key will allow us to access more of the Citadel's lost secrets.
72338.title: Greater Obsidian Key

72483.description:
Ah, the Ohn'ahran Plains. Wide open spaces, gusting winds, endless vistas... and more race courses!

Just as in the Waking Shores, if you find any of my bronze colleagues, speak to them about their race course.
72483.completion:
Excellent flying, {NAME}! Your control of your drake shows how far you have come as a dragonrider. 

And such speed! I trust now you know how truly freeing it is to fly like a dragon!

Now! There are more places to see and more races to run. Next stop: the Azure Span!
72483.title: The Ohn'ahran Plains Tour
72483.objectives: Fly each of the race courses in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

72705.title: Wild Preserve Slalom - Reverse

72911.description:
While you and Ebyssian were away, I had an epiphany.

That corrupted caldera is at the center of the Zaqali elder's slumbering prison and their war camps. Whatever is located within is the key to what the Primalists are planning.

It is lightly guarded as well. Only a Primalist and a Zaqali priest. If we take them out, we can discover what I believe will be the truth behind all of this.
72911.completion:
<Ebyssian looks between Sabellian and the caldera, his breath unsteady.>

What... What has Fyrakk done?
72911.title: Take Out the Head
72911.objectives: Kill Shrinekeeper Qanosh and Earthrender Ku'siva.

60013.description:
I have deduced by the urgency in your collective voices that you wish to leave.

I will expedite your exit. There is a transport pad in the antechamber. I will ensure that the chamber is sealed once again on your exit.

Please accompany me.
60013.completion: We must hurry. The Archon must know what transpired here.
60013.title: Leave it to Mnemis
60013.objectives: Use the Transport Pad in the Vault of the Archon.

60020.description:
I'm impressed you made it this far. But don't get too full of yourself.

Most of the fodder you plowed your way through were amateurs at best. Only one combatant will leave this arena a champion.

Each of the five... uh, three houses has fighters in the field. Most merely seek to test their own limits or earn a bit of favor. Only a few have a real chance at claiming victory.

Seek out those challengers if you wish to claim true glory this day.
60020.completion: Still walking on two legs? My hopes for you are rising.
60020.title: An Opportunistic Strike

60021.description:
Now you're starting to show potential! I'm guessing your name was well known on whatever mortal world you hail from.

But don't rest on your laurels. The harder you fight, the harder others will strive to strike you down. That's the Maldraxxi way!

Nothing wins the favor of the crowd like taking down a former champion. Two are in attendance today, attempting to recapture their past glories.

Slaughter them!
60021.completion:
Good, the crowd's on your side.

Now there's just one last test.
60021.title: Champion the Cause
60021.objectives: Slay Champion Rin'mar and Champion Gutrend.

60041.description:
We need to get to work, every soul here needs a body.

We have the parts to build a body for Chordy. Chordy is a great scavenger, rebuilding him could allow us to find more construct parts easier.

Would you help me to rebuild him?
60041.progress: It will be nice to have Chordy back to his old self!
60041.completion: We were successful, Chordy is whole again!
60041.title: Build-A-Bomination
60041.objectives: Help Rathan to create a new construct body for Chordy.

60042.description:
Chordy is just the first success, there will be many more!

As free souls show up here, speak with them and take their requests for new construct bodies. We'll soon have lots of new constructs to work on!
60042.completion: So many powerful souls, we must get to work immediately.
60042.title: May I Take Your Order?
60042.objectives: Take the construct requests from the souls present.

60043.description:
Our forces above cannot fully descend upon this area while the Margrave's crystals cover the sky in destructive blasts.

The Margrave's foul butchers work even now to extract the remaining anima from the kyrian they abducted in their assault on Bastion. We must advance at once.

I shall imbue you with the flames of courage so that you may mark the crystals. Once marked, I will destroy them from afar.
60043.completion: You have done a great service here.
60043.title: Justice from Above

60044.description:
We can't advance with those juggernauts bombarding our position! I led a strike against the nearest one, but conventional weapons do nothing against their imbued hides.

Thankfully, I have an idea.

Your runeblade can't deal with them as it stands, but if you could purge Gharmal's empowered masses and absorb their essence into the blade...
60044.completion: This may not work... but it may also be our only chance at victory.
60044.title: Charging The Blade
60044.objectives: Charge your runeblade by killing enemy constructs in the Stitchyard.

60048.description:
With the proper resources we can build a force of construct warriors greater than anything ever seen in the Shadowlands.

Visit Arkadia Moa and see if you can secure the resources we need.
60048.completion: You have acquired all the resources we needed.
60048.title: Stitching Time

60049.description:
I suppose I should commend you. You certainly exceeded my expectations.

Rathan can be sentimental, but he is right. This place can be our new home, and here we can construct new bodies for the souls you freed.

Inform Baroness Draka that she has earned the allegiance of Princess Emeni and the constructs of Butchers Block! We stand ready for whenever she has need of our strength.
60049.completion:
Well done. Emeni and her constructs will make for powerful allies.

They will, however, need your assistance to reach their full potential.
60049.title: At Your Service
60049.objectives: Check in with Baroness Draka back in the Seat of The Primus.

60050.description:
The Ashbringer and your fellow Maldraxxi need reinforcements at the western gate. They are barely holding on!

Xandria and my kin will reinforce our position here and push forward towards Gharmal. We must make haste to Mograine--without both flanks, we cannot hope to achieve victory.
60050.completion: I am glad Kynthia found you so quickly.
60050.title: Trouble on the Western Front
60050.objectives: Fly with Kynthia to report to Alexandros at the Stitchyard.

60051.description:
If we wish to get a travel network up and running, we'll need a master mirror maker in our employ. 

I've heard rumors that one such tradesman has landed himself in the Ember Ward. I am sure it won't take much cajoling to convince him to join our ranks. 

Head back into the Ember Ward and find this master mirror maker.
60051.completion: Please do excuse my appearance. I assure you, this is not my normal attire.
60051.title: A Master of Their Craft
60051.objectives: Find Laurent in the Ember Ward.

60052.description:
The House of Rituals occupies the southern half of the temple. Unlike the constructs, their key advantage in battle is their endless army of risen fighters.

Thankfully, the Archonic Resonator we recovered will take care of it.

As we carve our way through their forces, blast their corpses with the resonator. Its energy will sunder their souls, preventing them from being raised to fight again.
60052.progress: We must ensure our foe stays dead, or our efforts will be futile.
60052.completion: The Resonator is working at full capacity and our foes are dispatched. Excellent.
60052.title: Double Tap
60052.objectives: Use the Archonic Resonator to sunder 12 House of Rituals soldiers' corpses.

60053.description:
This Anima Conflux is completely drained of anima! Just a heavy hunk of metal!

Not your fault, of course. Not at all. But we need to charge it!

The Maldraxxi have extractors. Big green crystals, can't miss them. They're using it to drain anima from fallen kyrian. Very bad!

We can use them to charge the conflux, then our colossus here will be functional again!
60053.completion: Not fully charged, but close enough! May have to disable a few safety features...
60053.title: Clear as Crystal
60053.objectives: Drain Necrotic Extractors to empower the Anima Conflux.

60054.description:
If the necromancer's brood descends upon us fully before the colossus is charged, we will perish. There is no question.

We must keep his attention until Mikanikos's work is complete.

He believes that the day is already won -- that we are pawns to be toyed with. We can use his hubris to our advantage to buy precious seconds.

May it be enough.
60054.completion: Our only move now is forward, outsider.
60054.title: The Final Countdown
60054.objectives: Delay Amarth the Harvester until the Colossus is fully charged.

60055.description:
I know not what awaits us across the chasm, outsider. By the Archon's grace I hope that my Paragon yet lives, but I fear the worst.

We will face this great unknown together, as we have the rest of Maldraxxus's horrors. To be kyrian is to follow the path, no matter how dire the circumstances.

Whatever happens, know that you have earned my undying respect this day.
60055.title: A Time for Courage
60055.objectives: Confront Amarth the Harvester with Thanikos.

60056.description:
Maldraxxus must answer for their crimes against Bastion. There shall be justice!

Let us go to Oribos and speak with the Tal-Inara, the Honored Voice. We will tell her what has transpired this day. Tell her that the kyrian will not stand idle against this aggression.

Artemede will inform the Archon. My brothers and sisters will surely prepare for war.

That must not come to pass.
60056.progress: You looked troubled, outsider. What ails your mortal frame?
60056.completion: I know why you have come. This kyrian has explained much.
60056.title: Follow the Path
60056.objectives: Inform Tal-Inara in Oribos of Maldraxxus's attack on Bastion.

60057.description:
Xandria, the mighty Paragon of Courage, is the finest warrior among all the ascended. But even she may be overwhelmed by the strongest of Maldraxxus' forces.

Your fate is intertwined with hers, now. You must gather your allies and plunge into the Necrotic Wake to ensure both Amarth and Nalthor do not make it back to the safety of their realm.

May the Archon guide your blade into their hearts.
60057.completion: Word has spread throughout Bastion of your actions at the Temple of Courage, {NAME}. Xandria sent word that you were to be amply rewarded for your heroism.
60057.title: Necrotic Wake: A Paragon's Plight
60057.objectives: Defeat Amarth the Harvester and Nalthor the Rimebinder in the Necrotic Wake.

60060.description:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and Pridefall Hamlet. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.
60060.completion: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.
60060.title: Mirror Attunement: Pridefall Hamlet
60060.objectives: Enter the mirror in Pridefall Hamlet.

60061.description:
We are the heart of silk production in Ardenweald, but we can't do our work! 

Our grove has been completely taken over by spriggans and these strange shapeshifting... things.

The silkstriders who spin the silk are very delicate creatures. They need peace and calm, and a little music to keep them happy! But with all these monsters all over the place, they're super stressed out.

Please, can you get in there and eliminate these hooligans, and see if you can help get us up and running again?
60061.progress: We need to get silk production running again, for Ardenweald!
60061.completion: Thank you! We are so grateful for your help with slaying those cretins, and rescuing our people.
60061.title: Tough as Silk
60061.objectives: Slay attackers, save caretakers, and hatch silkstrider larvae in the Gossamer Cliffs.

60062.description:
<The harp lies broken, with pieces missing.

Perhaps you can find more pieces, and get someone to repair it.>
60062.progress: I lost my harp! It was taken and broken by those terrible creatures.
60062.completion: You found my harp! And the missing pieces. Just one moment, and I can fix it.
60062.title: The Shattered Harp
60062.objectives: Find pieces of the broken harp.

60063.description:
There, the harp is fixed. I am too injured to take it to the silkstriders, but you are strong. You can help them.

Our precious silkstriders are all across the cliffs. When you find one, play the harp for them, and they will give you fresh silk. Make sure that there is nothing nearby to stress them out first though!

If you find yourself in need of a way to move about swiftly, just take a Silk Shooter there, next to me. Aim it where you want to go, and it will shoot silk to pull you there!
60063.progress: Were you able to help the poor silkstriders calm down, and get their silk?
60063.completion: Wonderful job! I'm sure the silkstriders appreciated the song you played. You look like someone who appreciates the fine arts.
60063.title: A Song for Silkstriders
60063.objectives: Collect silk from the silkstriders by playing the harp for them.

60064.description:
We have to find Ol' Gertie! She is the broodmother of the silkstriders, and is our most reliable producer. We cannot lose her.

But I cannot get to her and see if she is all right. She is usually at the top of the cliffs, at the highest point. Can you get up there, and make sure that she is safe?

If she is not... then may justice fall swift and hard on the perpetrator.
60064.progress: Have you found Ol' Gertie? Is she safe?
60064.completion:
<Ol' Gertie lies dead of fear. 

But this little silkstrider larvae wiggles happily at you.>
60064.title: Save Ol' Gertie

60065.description: <Gertie Jr. looks up at you with hope. Perhaps you can help get her to safety.>
60065.completion:
Ol' Gertie is... dead?

But you found her baby! Thank you, thank you so much for bringing her safely out of there!
60065.title: Thread of Hope

60066.description:
It's clear that we may not be able to consistently supply Ardenweald with silk. But there is something that will help.

Take Gertie Jr. and the silk you collected from the other silkstriders back to the Heart of the Forest. There, she will be safe, and perhaps grow up into a silkstrider as grand and beautiful as her mother!
60066.completion:
Thank you for this silk! But... I see you brought something extra as well.

This little silkstrider will be safe now. I swear it.
60066.title: Silk for Ardenweald
60066.objectives: Bring Gertie Jr. to the Heart of the Forest.

60067.description:
Draka stands ready to unleash the power of the necropolis upon Gharmal. We need only buy her time to focus its weaponry.

What we do now, we do for all of us. Bastion and Maldraxxus have both lost much to these fiends.

Gharmal will not be defeated easily... but united, our forces will finally bring them to justice!
60067.title: Pursuit of Justice

60092.description:
<The object before you is emblazoned with runes, written in the language of domination. One of these runes reacts to your presence, lighting up with a bluish-gray light.>

<It beckons you to touch it.>    
        See if you've already completed this by typing:

        /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(60092))
            WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(60092))");
60092.title: Skoldus Hall
60092.objectives: Enter Skoldus Hall and defeat its warden.

60096.title: Wrath of the Lich King: To Northrend!
60096.objectives: Take a ship to Northrend.You can board the ship to Borean Tundra in Stormwind Harbor, or the ship to Howling Fjord in Wetlands.

60098.description:
Our forces have control of the House of Constructs, thanks to your intervention.

Now, all that remains is to vanquish their treacherous leader--Margrave Gharmal.

This battle has been long in the making, $p. I am at your side without hesitation.

Let us confront this monster. We will join Xandria to see Gharmal slain.
60098.title: The End is Now
60098.objectives: Meet with Xandria near the central chamber of the House of Constructs.

60107.title: The Winding Halls

60108.description:
The Drust encroach upon the Grove of Awakening, {NAME}!

We must fly in defense of Ardenweald!
60108.completion:
Well done, huntsman.

You have saved Ardenweald from the Drust, and in so doing, protected countless other realms from their darkness.
60108.title: Drust and Ashes
60108.objectives: Defend the Grove of Awakening from the Drust and slay Gorak Zhar.

60110.description:
I feel like you could use a little help, Maw Walker. There is knowledge I have which could make you more useful to the Necrolords.

So just this once... I will teach you something and you won't even have to lose a limb.

Soulbind with me and we'll see if you can learn anything.
60110.completion: Now you can try to live up to my example.
60110.title: Never Had a Friend Like Me

60111.description:
When you first arrived I was uncertain of your potential. The Primus demands such perfection in his work... and you are far from perfect.

I see now that you bring new knowledge and ideas to our house. Your actions make us stronger. The Primus would be proud of you and wish for us all to learn from you. 

I am ready now to know your ways.

Let me soulbind with you now, so we can grow stronger together.
60111.completion: Our shared knowledge will benefit all of Maldraxxus.
60111.title: Forging A Friendship

60112.description:
I fear if our presence is known, so too is the presence of our comrades.

We must develop a contingency. With the foundry on such high alert, we cannot sneak about undetected.

Unless, of course, you were to provide a distraction. Perhaps thinning their numbers would suffice.
60112.completion: He ought to be here... but he isn't.
60112.title: Cut to the Bone
60112.objectives: Eliminate 5 Ossein Workers and 10 Violent Animates.

60113.description:
Champion,

A matter of great urgency has arisen--one that requires your immediate attention.

Due to the sensitive nature of recent events, I must withhold further details until we meet.

We have much to discuss. King Greymane and I await your arrival at Lion's Rest.
60113.completion:
I knew you would not hesitate to answer the call, {NAME}.

I will be brief.
60113.title: An Urgent Request
60113.objectives: Report to Genn Greymane at Lion's Rest in Stormwind City.

60114.description:
Gharmal's rocs dominate the skies above, striking at our forces as we advance. We cannot move the necropolis into position until they are cleared out!

I would slaughter them myself, but the cowards remain out of reach, and I am not constructed for flight.

You, however, seem slight enough of build. Take my riding hook and latch onto a roc. 

Once you are atop of one, beat it to a pulp. Worry about the landing later.
60114.completion: I could hear their cries from here. Nice work!
60114.title: Aerial Advantage
60114.objectives: Grapple 6 Battlesewn Rocs out of the sky.

60115.description:
Champion,

A matter of great urgency has arisen--one that requires your immediate attention.

Due to the sensitive nature of recent events, I must withhold further details until we can speak in person.

There is much to discuss. Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron awaits your arrival in Orgrimmar.
60115.completion:
It has been some time since I last stood here, staring into the distance...

How could this have happened?

I'm afraid I have difficult news to share with you, {NAME}.
60115.title: An Urgent Request
60115.objectives: Report to Lor'themar Theron atop Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

60116.description:
The very heart of the Alliance is under attack.

The undead Scourge is swarming in numbers not seen since the return of Arthas Menethil. Amidst the chaos, something... terrible has happened.

What I am about to share with you has not yet been revealed to our allies. They will be told in due time, but I needed to speak to you directly before word gets out.

Allow me to explain.
60116.completion:
We must find a way to rescue Anduin and the others. But in this moment, the safety of our citizens and our allies is our highest priority.

As such, I have reached out to those experienced in dealing with threats of this nature.
60116.title: Cause for Distraction
60116.objectives: Speak with Genn Greymane at Lion's Rest in Stormwind City.

60117.description:
The Scourge's unbound hunger has been unleashed. It's only a matter of time before those monsters swarm our streets.

We need expertise in dealing with this menace. The death knights of the Ebon Blade have stepped forward to aid us, but even they can't do this alone.

The Argent Crusade has answered the call. I need you to work with them to keep our people safe, {NAME}.

I have sent word of your arrival to their commander. He awaits you at their camp just inside the city gates.
60117.completion:
Ah, I was told to expect the arrival of a seasoned {class}.

Let's get to work.
60117.title: Return of the Crusade
60117.objectives: Speak with Commander Gregor in the Trade District of Stormwind City.

60120.title: Burning Crusade: To Outland!

60123.title: Burning Crusade: To Outland!

60125.description:
Please come to Stormwind Keep immediately for a briefing with King Varian Wrynn.

We have received word of a conflict in the seas to the south, and we need the help of an experienced {class} to assist in the investigation.
60125.title: Mists of Pandaria: To Pandaria!
60125.objectives: Report to Rell Nightwind in Stormwind.

60127.description:
You or I could wield these sinstones directly, but I much prefer to use stone fiends for such tasks.

Exceptional results, no personal risk.

Unfortunately, my stone fiend did not return from its last errand.

Speak with Cryptkeeper Kassir in the archives above. He is loyal to the Accuser and will loan us his stone fiend.
60127.completion:
<Cryptkeeper Kassir grins.>

So you finally listened to the Accuser, eh?

Better late than never.
60127.title: Missing Stone Fiend

60128.description:
Do not mind Temel. His zeal for heralding sins is powerful, but he is still a stone fiend. He will obey.

Give Archivist Fane my regards.
60128.completion: Temel has told me quite the tale of your previous adventures together, Maw Walker.
60128.title: Ready to Serve

60132.title: Constellan Writs and Stygia

60139.description:
<Bolvar studies the objects you acquired from the brokers in Torghast.>

I sense Lady Proudmoore's magic upon this debris. And these notes describe methods to contain her power.

<The Highlord focuses on the items, peering into the darkness.>

By the Light! They are tormenting her with white-hot fires. Though her will is strong, there is only so much any mortal can endure.

I will modify Ve'nari's Attuned Shard using the items you returned.

You must find her, $p. Before it is too late.
60139.progress: You must find Jaina Proudmoore in Torghast.
60139.completion:
Two of Azeroth's architects of peace have been recovered.

Two remain captive.
60139.title: Torment Chamber: Jaina

60145.description:
This "win the spirit of the people" operation is noble and good. 

However, we must set our sights on cutting down our foe's tools. Third Talon Vartox, the leader of this incursion, also serves as the top stoneborn at the Tithelord's estate.

If we strike her down here, the Tithelord will be left exposed for our attack.
60145.completion: Excellent. Now he is left without his key defense.
60145.title: Third Talon Vartox

60146.description:
Using the totem you recovered, I will alter the Attuned Shard to guide you to Thrall's location.

<Bolvar hands you the crystalline object.>

Take care. You know the torments Baine and Lady Proudmoore endured in that accursed place. Thrall's confinement will be no less harrowing.

Beware. The deeper you journey into the Tower of the Damned, the closer you get to the Jailer himself.

Free Thrall, {NAME}... before all hope is lost.
60146.progress: All our allies must be saved, {NAME}.
60146.completion:
You have braved torments beyond most mortals' understanding, {NAME}.

Well done indeed.
60146.title: Torment Chamber: Thrall
60146.objectives: Rescue Thrall from Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

60147.description:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and The Eternal Terrace. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.
60147.completion: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.
60147.title: Mirror Attunement: The Eternal Terrace
60147.objectives: Enter the mirror in The Eternal Terrace.

60148.description:
A living mortal ... incredible!

Forgive my astonishment. I am Kah-Delen, an overseer of the Arbiter's attendants here in the Eternal City of Oribos.

You stand within the heart of the Shadowlands. While we are accustomed to receiving souls from all manner of worlds within the mortal realm, never before has one arrived that is quite so ... corporeal.

Answer honestly, mortal. Did you truly escape the Maw?
60148.progress: So where did you come from stranger?
60148.completion: Finally, the Purpose may be guiding us again.
60148.title: No Place for the Living
60148.objectives: The Overseers want to know more about how you escaped the Maw.

60149.description:
I am Tal-Inara, Honored Voice of the Arbiter. I speak for she who is ever silent.

The Arbiter watches over Oribos. She blesses us with her wisdom. Every mortal soul that enters the Shadowlands passes before her for judgment.

In the merest fraction of a moment, she sees every glory, every folly, every joy, every regret. With this knowledge, she chooses an ideal afterlife for that soul.

At least, she did. Not long ago, catastrophe struck, and ...

Come. Some things are better seen than explained.
60149.completion: We may find a shared cause in the Purpose. It has sent you to us.
60149.title: Audience with the Arbiter
60149.objectives: The Voice of the Arbiter wishes you to join them in the Arbiter's chamber.

60150.description:
It is disappointing that you were unable to stir the Arbiter, but we must not give up hope.

Your continued presence in the Shadowlands may help our cause. Perhaps your efforts would benefit from creating a tether to the mortal plane.

The map table in this chamber was put in place long ago by the First Ones, the wise architects of all you see.

If you have a memento from your homeworld, place it there. The table's magic can establish a connection.
60150.completion:
{NAME}! I am relieved you survived that realm of darkness.

I am eager to hear the tale.
60150.title: Tether to Home
60150.objectives: Affix the Helm of Domination fragment to the console.

60151.description:
The Helm fragment connected us while you were in the Maw. As if through a darkened pane of glass, I saw glimpses of what you endured. The terrors you faced.

At least the heroes of Azeroth yet live. They must be saved.

By affixing the Helm here, you gave us a tether to Azeroth that served to bring a few of us across the veil. But you, and other heroes who join us, require a stronger connection.

Our acolytes can open portals back. No doubt these attendants will be particular about their placement.
60151.progress: Have you helped the acolytes open the portals yet?
60151.completion: Your path and the Purpose are now entwining.
60151.title: A Doorway Through the Veil

60152.description:
You should become familiar with the Eternal City and how best to navigate it.

We, the attendants, serve Oribos as its caretakers. 

Everything you see here is done in service to the Purpose. In this time of chaos and drought, we must adapt our perspective. It seems we are to serve the Purpose in a new way.

You mortals are not the only visitors here. Others have come as well.

Like you, the brokers are not of Oribos. They are congenial and willing to aid you. Usually for a price.
60152.progress: Have you concluded your tour yet?
60152.completion:
We hope you are comfortable here, {NAME}.

Consider these ancient facilities to be at your disposal.
60152.title: The Eternal City
60152.objectives: Tour the Eternal City of Oribos.

60153.description:
Come to pay old Marasmius a visit? I have a special task for you.

One of my shoots has found a strange place, a place even I've never seen before.

I'm not entirely sure what's in there or if it's even safe. But that's what my trusty mushroomancers are for!

What do you say, {NAME}? Up for an adventure?
60153.progress: Keep your guard up. It could lead anywhere!
60153.completion: It's a good thing you were there. The gorm have been very hungry lately, and I do not appreciate being nibbled on. Never been my thing!
60153.title: Into the Unknown

60154.description:
As I sat upon the Frozen Throne all those years, {NAME}, I could peer into the Shadowlands. Brief glimpses, clouded and uncertain. Sights both wondrous and terrible.

We must work together to make sense of what has happened. To prevent the Maw from consuming all of reality.

Whatever Sylvanas and the Jailer want, we must stop them. But we cannot do so alone.

Perhaps Tal-Inara can put us on the path to find answers.
60154.progress: Let us align your path to the Purpose.
60154.completion: Your path and that of the Purpose are becoming one.
60154.title: Understanding the Shadowlands

60156.description:
Within the Arbiter's Chamber are gateways to the infinite realms of the Shadowlands. As each soul was judged, a gateway would be opened to the appropriate afterlife. 

But since the... incident, all gateways have remained closed. Dormant.

We dare not use the Arbiter's sacred chamber for so mundane a purpose as travel. But here in the upper ring of the city, gateways can be configured for your needs.

Before us stands the means to activate a gateway. Together we can channel the anima to power it.
60156.progress: Your destiny and the Purpose are being drawn together.
60156.completion: Purpose be praised! Your path becomes clearer.
60156.title: The Path to Bastion

60158.description:
Our arrangement has been quite lucrative. Reliable associates like yourself can be so hard to find.

I believe I can entrust you with a task I would usually perform on my own.

While working with the tracking runes you retrieved for me earlier, I detected a device of broker origin nearby. It must have been brought into the Maw by the captured expedition.

Please examine it and prepare it for transport back to the refuge. I will join you shortly.

This could be a valuable discovery.
60158.completion:
It seems our partnership has become rather permanent. Cartel Ve will not rest until we are both eliminated.

I suppose now would be the time to share one of my most important rules with you.
60158.title: Rule 7: Betrayal is Inevitable
60158.objectives: Recover the broker device outside of Perdition Hold.

60159.description:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and the Halls of Atonement. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.
60159.completion: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.
60159.title: Mirror Attunement: Halls of Atonement
60159.objectives: Enter the mirror in the Halls of Atonement.

60160.description:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and The Banewood. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.
60160.completion: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.
60160.title: Mirror Attunement: The Banewood
60160.objectives: Enter the mirror in The Banewood.

60162.description:
Quite the surprise to find this beast so hale and hearty. It seems to have taken a liking to you.

If you're ever going to be as great as one of the Dawntrackers, you must learn how to handle multiple pets.

Allow me to show you how.
60162.progress: Be sure to dismiss your pet before we get started. Oh, and if it's injured, use Revive Pet to bring it back.
60162.completion:
I don't believe there is anything left to teach you, {NAME}. 

Now you must go forth and find more beasts to tame and call your own.

If you ever need to store or retrieve your pets, speak with me or any other stable masters you encounter in your travels.
60162.title: The Art of Taming
60162.objectives: Learn how to dismiss, tame, and stable pets from Mithran Dawntracker.

60164.description:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and Dominance Keep. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.
60164.completion: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.
60164.title: Mirror Attunement: Dominance Keep
60164.objectives: Enter the mirror in Dominance Keep.

60165.description:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and Feeders' Thicket. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.
60165.completion: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.
60165.title: Mirror Attunement: Feeders' Thicket
60165.objectives: Enter the mirror in Feeders' Thicket.

60168.description:
I'm quite surprised to find this beast still alive and kicking. It appears to like you.

Before we finish, you had better learn how to wrangle multiple pets.

I'll give you one last lesson.
60168.progress: Make sure to dismiss your pet before we get started. Oh, and if it's injured, use Revive Pet to bring it back.
60168.completion:
Excellent work, {NAME}. There's nothing left for me to teach you.

Gather as many wild beasts as you'd like. Just make sure not to lose focus on the ogres who are trying to kill us.
60168.title: The Art of Taming
60168.objectives: Learn how to dismiss, tame, and stable pets from Austin Huxworth.

60169.description:
The Scourge's attack was as sudden as it was unexpected. Truth be told, they caught us unawares.

Through swift action, we were able to rally our defenses... though not before the tournament grounds were overrun.

We must secure the area before we can mount a counteroffensive.

Vanquish these monsters in the name of the Light!
60169.completion: It appears we are making headway.
60169.title: Securing the Area
60169.objectives: Remove 12 Scourge from the Argent Tournament Grounds.

60172.description: Dropping out of the sky is a key part of this playtest, so enjoy the ride.
60172.title: This Quest is Temporary
60172.objectives: Speak with Draedan to enter the Maw.

60174.description:
This island has foul necromancy here in addition to the shadow magic. The Light can only just reach this place.

Call upon its Divine Shield to step through the barrier before us unharmed and destroy this vile altar.

Show the darkness on this island that you are protected by the Light's embrace.
60174.progress: Do you require aid? Use Divine Shield to safely cross pass the necrotic barrier.
60174.completion:
You have done well, {NAME}. Dispel this foul magic wherever you encounter it.

My task has been fulfilled. The Light calls to me. 

Good luck, and remember that the Light's warmth will always embrace you.
60174.title: The Divine's Shield

60175.description:
I'm a simple mushroom with simple pleasures, {NAME}. And what's simpler than a nice, hearty meal?

Don't look so surprised. I need to eat just like anyone else! How else do you think I grew so big? Nice, tasty compost, that's how!

Back in my day, I had the pick of Ardenweald for where to feed. Now, not so much.

I've had a hankering for some of the loam that used to be around Tirna Noch. I haven't had shoots out there in a long time. Could you bring me some?
60175.progress: Tirna Noch is a beautiful tree located east of Hibernal Hollow. You can't miss it.
60175.completion: Mmmm, it smells just like how I remember it! Maybe a little stale, but you won't hear me complaining about a job well done!
60175.title: A Taste of Tirna Noch
60175.objectives: Collect 6 Leafy Loam in Tirna Noch.

60176.description:
Unfortunately the Lord Chamberlain's gift isn't sufficient to cover the entire tithe we're expected to provide the Tithelord, but it will make a good start.

The loss of the tithe convoy is a terrible blow to our village. Our little community is already suffering greatly from the drought and the need to meet the Tithelord's demands. Still we must all do our part.

We have little time to accomplish this task. Can you help? Get the tithe from villagers and scour the area for every forgotten drop.
60176.completion: I was not sure this task was possible. Very impressive work.
60176.title: Bring Out Your Tithe
60176.objectives: Collect anima from the village for the tithe.

60177.description:
If you ask me, the attack on our convoy is suspicious. I told Mistress Mihaela that there must be a traitor in the village, but she isn't concerned. It's understandable. She's got to worry about gathering a new tithe.

I've taken it upon myself to figure this out and I could use your help. I'm making discreet inquiries but I can't be seen speaking with the help. That's where you come in. You can be my assistant sleuth.
60177.progress: Have you identified the traitor yet?
60177.completion: Well, isn't that interesting information you've dug up.
60177.title: Reason for the Treason
60177.objectives: Speak with the "help" in the village to find clues leading to the identity of the traitor.

60178.description:
Ilka and Samu argued, you say? And you found a coded message indicating that the tithe was going to be sent out soon. Those are helpful clues that will allow me to put the puzzle together. 

It's clear to me now who betrayed the village and what we need to do about it! You deliver invitations to a meeting to our suspects and I'll prepare to reveal the traitor.
60178.progress: The Master knows what's best for us. We must do our part.
60178.completion: Nice that it all worked out in the end. Thanks for the unintentional help.
60178.title: And Then There Were None
60178.objectives: Gather the suspects and meet Lajos in the large crypt.

60179.description:
<A tablet sits embedded in the ground near a broken armor display.

The runes on the epitaph conjure images of an ancient warrior in your mind. Clearly Maldraxxus honors the history of those who claimed great victories here.

Similar memorials seem to be spread throughout the trench. Perhaps they can offer more insight into the denizens of this realm.>
60179.completion:
Many strive for greatness in Maldraxxus. Few truly achieve infamy.

Let us see if our names will one day be remembered.
60179.title: Memory of Honor

60180.description:
<The Vault-Keeper examines you.>

You appear to carry a signature unique to one of the Paragons. If you know which Paragon, simply peer into their Soul Mirror to examine the memory of your choice.

If you require anything else, you need only speak.
60180.progress: Did you find the memory you seek?
60180.completion: I hope your experience was satisfactory.
60180.title: A Paragon's Reflection

60181.description:
These would-be recruits seek a way to prove themselves. Let us give them the chance.

The specter known as Malifis has grown in strength by consuming our anima reserves. In this time of drought, we cannot afford to lose any of our most precious resource. 

This threat needs to be dealt with immediately.

Use this horn to signal the scavengers we've recruited. Let us see how well they fight under our banner!
60181.progress: Take care, our quarry is formidable.
60181.completion:
A threat removed for the House of the Chosen, and new recruits that show potential.

Good work.
60181.title: Trench Warfare
60181.objectives: Use the Baron's Warhorn to defeat Malifis.

60183.description:
We must move quickly! That anima will be key in fueling these citizens for the fight ahead.

Deathfang is ready to ride.
60183.completion:
An excellent display of the strength of Sinfall, {NAME}. 

Let us continue, shall we?
60183.title: After Them!
60183.objectives: Board Deathfang and ride with Baroness Draka to stop the carriage.

60184.description:
Maintaining the portal between our sanctum and the Zerekriss is a difficult task. With enough resources, we could make it permanent and become the unstoppable force my baroness wishes us to be.

She has asked much of you, as have I. But this work will make your name a legend among the Maldraxxi, as my baroness's has become.

Help to empower us, and you will be empowered in turn.
60184.completion: You do not cease to impress.

60188.description:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?
60188.progress: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.
60188.completion:
That was real nice of you. Not too many people take care of us old folks around here.

She even gave you silk! How nice. Here, why don't you take it? I certainly don't need it.
60188.title: Go Beyond!

60189.description:
The time has come. The Wild Hunt has driven the Drust back to their stronghold at the edge of Ardenweald.

Their scouts report that Gorak Zhar herself is among them. This may be our only opportunity to fully purge the minions of Thros from this realm.

Lord Herne awaits your arrival at the battlefront. Go with haste, {NAME}.
60189.completion:
Good. You are here.

We are now ready to end the Drust's invasion once and for all.
60189.title: We Strike Now
60189.objectives: Meet Lord Herne outside of Darkreach.

60190.description:
The Drust have inflicted enormous loss on this forest and its denizens, {NAME}. It is time we put an end to their atrocities.

We will drive the Drust from their enclave and close their gateway into Ardenweald. With you as our vanguard, victory is assured.

I will make my way into the heart of their camp. Find me once you have routed their forces.
60190.completion:
Well fought. The Wild Hunt will deal with the rest as necessary. There is one more foe for us to vanquish.

Are you prepared?
60190.title: Assault on Darkreach
60190.objectives: Assault the Drust forces within Darkreach.

60191.description:
Ingra Drif, the Drust captain, has been spotted inside Darkreach. This is our chance to destroy him for good.

I know him and his cruelty all too well, {NAME}. Whatever you do to him, it's better than what he deserves.
60191.completion:
Good. The Drust have been dealt a significant blow.

The spirits of those lost to Ingra Drif's treachery can at last be at peace.
60191.title: Ingra Drif

60192.description:
Those sneaky Drust are protecting Gorak Zhar with their evil magic!

I can sense several foul runes that are scattered across Darkreach. If you destroy them, we can easily shatter the barrier around that nasty Gorak Zhar.

Hurry! I will meet you inside the enemy camp.
60192.completion: Ha! There's nothing left to protect her now. Let's finish this!
60192.title: Their Last Line of Defense

60193.description:
Thanks to your efforts, the shield that protects our prey has been made brittle as a dried leaf.

Our hunt is all but complete. 

Come, let us put an end to the vile Gorak Zhar.
60193.completion:
Oh, Ara'lon... even after all he endured, he found a way to smile again... only to...

<Lady Moonberry wipes her eyes.>

There will be time for tears later. We still need to stop the Drust. For Ara'lon... and the forest he fought to protect.
60193.title: Unmasked

60194.description:
I fear Lord Herne will have further need of our aid before this night is over.

Come, I'll put some wings on you. We'll have to fly if we want to keep up with him.
60194.completion: Damn the Drust! This was all a diversion!
60194.title: The Call of the Hunt
60194.objectives: Speak to Lord Herne in Ardenweald.

60195.description:
All these souls deserve a new construct, and when rebuilt any of them will make a valuable addition to our forces.

We must start somewhere. 

You should be able to find Malleable Flesh through out the Shadowlands. A few of the other parts may be harder to locate.

Collect parts and use the Abominable Stitching Table to build another construct.
60195.progress: Remember, you can find parts from almost anything in Maldraxxus.
60195.completion: So many powerful souls, this new additional shall bolster our forces greatly!
60195.title: Build One More

60215.description:
Did you see that giant mechanical monstrosity just walking around in the dunes outside? How about the icky shadowy Sha of Anger? Or that big frost giant in the north? Yeah, they aren't native to this area. 

They tell me the timeways are screwy around this time of year. They have asked me to organize a clean-up crew.

Would you be up to the challenge? If you like this challenge, I have another for you as well.
60215.completion: Thanks for taking out Doomwalker, let's hope that doesn't happen again! It will though!
60215.title: Timely Gate Crashers
60215.objectives: Defeat Doomwalker, Sha of Anger, and Archavon the Stone Watcher in Tanaris.

60217.description:
Your cleansing is complete, and you are whole.

Our plan was a success. Undergoing such a rite, so soon after your arrival, has attracted Kalisthene's attention once more. 

Now is our opportunity to request an audience with the Archon.

Stand before her and be proud of what you have accomplished. No matter what happens now, you have done all that any aspirant could hope to.
60217.completion: You are worthy of Bastion's grace, {NAME}. May it serve you well.
60217.title: The Archon's Answer
