60230.description:
News of our work here has spread, new souls have arrived seeking to join us!

Take their requests for new construct bodies. We'll see if we can build them new constructs too!
60230.completion: So many souls, we have much work to do!
60230.title: More the Merrier
60230.objectives: Take the construct requests from the souls present.

60236.description:
I would be most honored to attend Prince Renathal's Ember Court.

I prefer to wear my official signet ring for such prestigious occasions. It was given to me by the Accuser herself when I was first charged with my duties.

However, the Lord Chamberlain's goons have stolen it once more.

They hide their ill-gotten gains inside of these crypts... But I have no idea which one houses my ring.

It may take some time to find Atonement Crypt Keys, but any venthyr here in the halls could have one.
60236.progress: Desired objects tend to be in the last place we look, do they not? Perhaps we shall be fortunate this time.
60236.completion:
My most gracious gratitudes to you, Maw Walker!

<Cryptkeeper puts the ring into his pocket and pats it comfortably.>

Now I may attend the Ember Court in my finest appearance.

I do hope the Accuser will be performing rituals there...
60236.title: RSVP: Cryptkeeper Kassir

60237.description:
Once, long ago, I journeyed to Ardenweald to assist in putting down a threat now long forgotten.

I remember that while there, I saw small creatures taking tiny clusters of anima--animacones, the fae called them--and buried them under the soil.

If those clusters are still there, we must gather them for ourselves!

I should be able to unearth any of the animacones we encounter. Let's go hunt for them!
60237.completion: Thank you, Maw Walker. This extra anima will tremendously aid our efforts.
60237.title: Old Stomping Grounds
60237.objectives: Collect 15 Lost Animacones. Use Toothpick's World Shaker to unearth them.

60242.description:
We of the brokers place value on things that may seem strange to an outsider like yourself. Objects that are unusual or one-of-a-kind are things we may find more valuable than others.

So let us make a deal, hm? Should you find yourself in possession of one such object, I will offer a trade for something you may find more valuable.

I hear that the forces of Maldraxxus have made an attack on Bastion. Such things rarely happen without objects of power in tow, no?
60242.progress: Have you found any objects of interest?
60242.completion:
Ah, quite a find, we rarely get a glimpse into the mechanisms by which the House of Rituals enact their dark designs. I am eager to delve into this tome, purely in the interests of knowledge of course.

You may choose from some of our procured items as a reward.
60242.title: Trading Favors: Necrotic Wake
60242.objectives: Obtain Nalthor's Phylactery Instructions from Nalthor the Rimebinder in the Necrotic Wake.

60243.description:
The generals of Revendreth are outfitted with only the finest arms and armor, procured by Sire Denathrius in his unquenchable appetite for power. In terms of profitable trades and exchanges, he has been a shrewd partner in trade to us.

It would please me greatly to see the return of some relics that were traded in a way that benefited him far more than us. There are few things more insulting to my kind.
60243.progress: What have you brought before me?
60243.completion:
Yes, yes this is exactly what I was speaking about. The foolish generals of Revendreth would use this medallion to orient themselves during travel in unknown areas, but their ambitions were small.

For my people, who have traveled beyond the known lands, such a thing is invaluable when attempting to chart a way to return.

We will make great use of this, it is good to see it returned. Here, a prize for you.
60243.title: Trading Favors: Sanguine Depths
60243.objectives: Obtain a Medallion of Orientation from General Kaal in the Sanguine Depths.

60244.description:
The mechanisms by which each land of the Shadowlands operates are quite intriguing. Yet, I have always held a particular fascination with the venthyr of Revendreth.

How they siphon souls of their sins, storing them in strange stones, and dredge up minions from the muck that surrounds them -- it is all quite novel.

They keep their secrets close at hand, however, and will not willingly part with information. I offer trades for any of their tomes you might come into possession of.
60244.progress: Have you found something of interest?
60244.completion:
A tome from Revendreth? Yes, let me see.

It chronicles the alchemical formulae necessary to form the dredger pools, and various recipes for forming and utilizing the little creatures. They are quite a curiosity, as much a minion as a reagent.

I will gladly take this off of your hands in exchange for a trade. Here, choose.
60244.title: Trading Favors: Halls of Atonement
60244.objectives: Obtain the Tome of Dredger Alchemy from Lord Chamberlain in the Halls of Atonement.

60245.description:
Mueh'zala is an ancient and primitive creature that commands a place known as De Other Side. Little is known about this land, as we are not permitted to visit. We have sent many offers of trade, yet there has never been a reply. 

A pity, as the few that have escaped Mueh'zala's clutches claim his domain to be a place of many oddities.

We would never ask you to venture into such danger. There is, however, a standing offer of trade for things procured from Mueh'zala's grasp.
60245.progress: You have the stench of death about you.
60245.completion:
Oh, this is quite a find, is it not? Something from De Other Side. We so rarely get to glimpse such things, I shall study this with interest. It would appear to be from a forgotten, primitive race that worshipped Mueh'zala.

A reward, of course, is in order. Make your choice.
60245.title: Trading Favors: De Other Side
60245.objectives: Obtain a Golden Death Mask from Mueh'zala in De Other Side.

60246.description:
The gorm devour anything in their path when left unchecked. We have sold more than a few of them as both pets and weapons. You do not want to see what a world looks like when they are introduced to it and allowed to infest.

Or perhaps, mhm, you do? For some, that is entertainment.

It is difficult for us to explore Ardenweald with things as they are at this time. A fat, healthy gorm larva would fetch a fine price on the markets. I trust my meaning is understood?
60246.completion:
Oh, what is this? It is so bulbous and squirming, it must be close to the next molting. I am something of an amateur gorm-breeder myself, and will find a proper place to raise this one. 

You may trust that I intend to destroy no worlds, I give you my word.

Now, I must tend to him, gather something from our stocks on your way out.
60246.title: Trading Favors: Tirna Scithe
60246.objectives: Obtain an Engorged Gorm Larva from Tred'ova in the Mists of Tirna Scithe.

60247.description:
Grandmaster Vole runs the arena in Maldraxxus, where the champions of each of the houses compete for glory. Naturally, prizes are often awarded to the victors. 

Those of our kind do not often participate in such battles. To find such a prize for sale by one of us would be quite unusual indeed.

I trust I need say no more? Let us keep this transaction between us, and I will be happy to part with some valuable goods.
60247.progress: Six, seven, eight... oh, yes? Do you have an offer of trade? I have much more inventory to catalogue.
60247.completion:
Quite interesting, these coins are only granted to champions of the Maldraxxus arena after a certain amount of time in service. Purely ceremonial, they are worthless to most, but priceless to those that value ceremony. 

You may take something with you in compensation.
60247.title: Trading Favors: Theater of Pain
60247.objectives: Obtain a Champion's Coin from Mordretha in the Theater of Pain.

60248.description:
Is is such a shame what happened to poor Margrave Stradama. Just between us, she was once one of our most favored trading partners. When things get lost in Maldraxxus they tend to end up at the bottom of her blighted pools.

You would not, perhaps, be interested in continuing this relationship on her behalf? We would, of course, compensate you quite well.

I am sure she has little use for these possessions in her current state.
60248.completion:
Oh my, this is quite a find. It is a catalogue of some of Stradama's procured objects, hidden away within her pools of plague. We will make good use of this, to be sure. 

Choose something to take with you, you have earned it.
60248.title: Trading Favors: Plaguefall
60248.objectives: Obtain one of Stradama's Lost Ledgers from Margrave Stradama in Plaguefall.

60249.description:
The Kyrians of Bastion serve a unique role in the Shadowlands, ferrying mortal souls from their realms to ours. They are able to do so in great numbers, it would seem, in times of crisis or devastation.

We would like to know more about their travels to the realms beyond. 

Surely one of them has brought something back from another land? They are, after all, so very interested in memories.
60249.completion:
A strange bauble, likely from another world. Yet, why would the paragon have brought this with her? 

Perhaps when carrying the soul of a child, as a reminder of something she had thought lost within herself? I will ponder this.

You may choose a reward from our stores.
60249.title: Trading Favors: Spires of Ascension
60249.objectives: Obtain a Strange Doll from Devos, Paragon of Doubt in the Spires of Ascension.

60250.description:
The Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus is a brutal place, where only the strongest survive. 

With the houses so fiercely in competition with one another, it is considered a great point of pride to house a champion with a winning record.

As such, the house lords often outfit their contenders with powerful arms, armor, and trinkets. Often these are storied items that have been passed down through many battles.

I would very much like to see such an item.
60250.progress: Were you victorious, or have you come to tend to your wounds?
60250.completion:
The fools, giving away an object such as this as a mere trinket to be used in battle. Do they not know of its significance? Clearly not.

Let me explain.

There is much we do not understand about the workings of this world. This city, Oribos, is made of a strange ore that we have not found anywhere else. Who made this place, and why?

Relics of similar make like this are all that we have to tie together the threads of mystery.

We thank you for this gift. Please, take a treasure.
60250.title: A Valuable Find: Theater of Pain
60250.objectives: Obtain the Ring of Otherworldly Metal from Mordretha in the Theater of Pain.

60251.description:
Life in Maldraxxus is one of constant warfare, the great houses in perpetual competition with one another. Every once in a great while, a house lord obtains an item or piece of knowledge of such rarity that it tips the scales in their favor.

It is possible, even probable, that this was the cause of the fate that befell the House of Plagues.

I do not need to tell you how valuable such a rarity would be to us, do I?
60251.progress: Yes? I am quite busy here.
60251.completion:
I can only decipher a few words of this missive, give me a moment.

It appears to be a warning from the Margrave to another lord of Maldraxxus, or perhaps another place.

I see mention of the Primus, and discussion of his fate. Or someone else's? It is hard to tell. It appears to point to a location, but I cannot understand the description of the location.

This may be more valuable than you know for the fate of the Shadowlands. Choose a reward, I will continue my work on this.
60251.title: A Valuable Find: Plaguefall
60251.objectives: Obtain A Slimy Correspondence from Margrave Stradama in Plaguefall.

60253.description:
Once in a rare while, we find ourselves in possession of an object of exceptionally cryptic origin. These objects allow us a brief glimpse into the realms beyond our comprehension. 

It may seem to you that I speak in riddles, yet so much of this realm is shrouded in mystery, even to us.

There are others that have sought to unravel the history of this realm. Should you happen upon one of their works, I will offer you a trade of exceptional value.
60253.completion:
What sort of tome is this? May I leaf through it for a moment?

Well then, this is quite a find. It represents many years cataloguing everything Nalthor knew about the origins of our world. The many curiosities of this place, from Zovaal's domain in the Maw, to the function of this strange city of Oribos.

It is surmised that they all tie together.

I shall devour it with glee. Come, you may take one of our most prized possessions for it.
60253.title: A Valuable Find: Necrotic Wake
60253.objectives: Obtain "The Origin of Death" from Nalthor the Rimebinder in the Necrotic Wake.

60254.description:
The gorm are indiscriminate in what they consume, so long as it does not contain anima. A gorm queen that has lived for many generations may have any number of indestructible artifacts lodged within her belly. For this reason, sifting through a queen's carcass is not unlike treasure hunting for us.

One of the largest queens is currently consuming Tirna Scithe. She surely is bloated with valuables. Should you come upon anything particularly unusual, know that we will compensate you in kind.
60254.progress: You look as if you have been sifting through gorm carcass, or perhaps that is simply what you always look like?
60254.completion:
We have found only a few objects similar to this in all of our time here, that I am aware of. Whether it belonged to a race of creature or automatons that came before us, or they still exist somewhere, we do not know.

The metallic fragments of this piece appear similar in design to the walls that surround us here in Oribos, yet we have never seen something like this moving around in the city.

I will add it to the cache of relics related to these mysteries. Take a suitable reward with you.
60254.title: A Valuable Find: Tirna Scithe
60254.objectives: Obtain the Unusual Automaton Parts from Tred'ova in the Mists of Tirna Scithe.

60255.description:
Mueh'zala has been around for many generations, how many exactly we cannot say. His domain is a land of mystery to us all. 

But we are a people of probabilities and margins. A creature of that age, with such power, and the many ancient souls within his domain, has a great chance to be in possession of a relic of unfathomable rarity.

<The light around Ta'lan's head flares brightly for a moment. He seems... excited?>

Slay the foolish creature, bring me his secrets, I will reward you handsomely!
60255.progress: Have you brought something of interest?
60255.completion:
This mask is similar in features to some of the automaton parts we have found in our time here in the Shadowlands. Perhaps it belonged to an ancient civilization? The information we have is scattered and incomplete.

Any further pieces you may find of this sort will help us unravel these great mysteries. There seems to be a greater design to this place than we can see, yet so much of it eludes us.

I will take it off of your hands, in exchange you make take one of our most valuable pieces.
60255.title: A Valuable Find: De Other Side
60255.objectives: Obtain a Strange Ritual Mask from Mueh'zala in De Other Side.

60256.description:
The aristocracy of Revendreth trade in decadent and priceless shows of status with one another, but rarely with our kind.  Often they will travel with a piece or two affixed to their garb as a show of status.

Now, many of their kind have sided with Sire Denathrius and against the denizens of the Shadowlands. They must, of course, be stopped. 

Of course.

Yet should you, in the process of doing so, relieve them of some of these possessions, know that I will trade generously.
60256.completion:
Now this is quite a find. A functional piece of the mysterious machinery that can be found around the Shadowlands.

Look at how intricate the weaving of the golden orb is, how the energy seems to be contained from somewhere within, yet in a construct that is almost beyond imagining. What could have made such an object? Where are they now?

We shall begin to investigate with fervor. Do drop in if you find anything similar, and take a reward before you go.
60256.title: A Valuable Find: Halls of Atonement
60256.objectives: Obtain the Golden Orb of Energy from Lord Chamberlain in the Halls of Atonement.

60257.description:
General Kaal has slain many foes, and in a bag at her side, she holds the skulls of those she considers her most precious kills. Not all of them, of course, have skulls --  it is a bag of eclectic contents.

Contained within, we have heard, is the head of one of our kind. We do not know to whom it might belong, for we do not often find ourselves running afoul of the venthyr.

Such a strange mystery must be solved. I will, of course, provide great compensation.
60257.completion:
This... is not what I expected.

It is similar in appearance to our people, yet so very different. Are there others of our kind out there? Who are they, and where do they reside? Why have they not made contact with us? Or are they hiding themselves purposefully?

Is this a history we knew but have forgotten? I have so many questions.

I thank you for this, it is quite meaningful to us. Please, take a relic of power from the treasury.
60257.title: A Valuable Find: Sanguine Depths
60257.objectives: Obtain an Ancient Broker Headpiece from General Kaal in the Sanguine Depths.

60264.description:
I knew when you helped me in the Etheric Vault, that you were a just and worthy leader.

I have come here to offer you my help and services in your efforts to bring Maldraxxus back into balance.

Please, build a construct for me, and allow me to help you as you have helped me.
60264.progress: Are you willing to do this?
60264.completion: Miru is a very old soul and a survivor. We would be well aided by building him a construct.
60264.title: Soul Survivor

60265.description:
From the desk of the Tithelord:

All supply carriages must re-route to Stonevigil for collection assistance. Once complete, you may resume your regularly scheduled routes.
60265.completion:
Well done.

We will bleed this miscreant "Harvester" dry.
60265.title: Disrupting the Chain
60265.objectives: Destroy the Darkhaven and Manor carriages in Stonevigil Overlook.

60267.description:
<As you stare at the object you've found, you sense it may lead you to another part of this wretched tower.

Perhaps Ve'nari may know more of its purpose.>
60267.progress: <The lock appears to be sturdy, yet old and untouched. Dust has collected considerably upon it.>
60267.completion: <As you place the key into the device, it shudders for a moment and begins to unlock.>
60267.title: Prison of the Forgotten
60267.objectives: Take the object back to Ve'nari.

60268.description:
Who... who are you? Have you come to extract more of my memories?

I'm afraid there aren't any useful ones left, save for the memories of my imprisonment.

Or perhaps you're here for something else?
60268.progress: What do you want of me?
60268.title: Deep Within
60268.objectives: Speak with the prisoner and learn of his situation.

60269.description:
If you can retrieve my memories, I can help you. At least I believe I can.

Then, perhaps, we can help each other.
60269.progress: Have you found what was taken from me?
60269.completion:
It's been an age since I knew anything other than the contours of this hellish prison.

Thank you, mortal. Now to aid you.
60269.title: Reawakening
60269.objectives: Find a stolen memory of the Runecarver.

60270.description:
Yes... I begin to remember. Power. Power with a purpose. That is what I can offer.

Runes. Runes are the key. I've recalled some of them, but to infuse them into your equipment, I require my hands.

Well, one hand would suffice. Both would be better.

Find a way to free me from my bonds, mortal. Then I can offer the power you seek. After that, freedom... and perhaps the downfall of the one who bound me.
60270.title: A Damned Pact
60270.objectives: Discover a way to break the Runecarver free from his chains.

60271.description:
First you'll need a vessel to house anima and a way to expel it. I happen to possess such a device, which I'll be pleased to give to you.

For a price, of course.

You recall Zovaal's Cauldron, I trust? The denizens there were forged in unholy fire. Assuming their anima is of a similar nature, it should be able to melt even the metals of the tower.

With my device and their anima, I believe you can achieve your goal, Maw Walker.
60271.progress: Were you able to acquire the anima?
60271.completion:
Your success continues to impress, Maw Walker.

Though I admit, such feats are becoming less unexpected as I come to know you more.
60271.title: A Grave Chance
60271.objectives: Purchase an Anima Supricifer from Ve'nari and recover 5 Molten Anima.

60272.description:
This ought to be enough to break the bonds that hold your newfound ally.

<Ve'nari pauses for a moment.>

Before you do so, I offer a word of warning.

No creature imprisoned in that place should be trusted. Tread carefully, mortal. 

After all, it would be a shame to lose so valuable a business partner.
60272.progress: It's good to remember something new again.
60272.completion:
Freedom. Of a sort. Yes... this is good. You have my thanks.

What was it you wanted? Ah, power. Yes. Very well, then.
60272.title: The Weak Link

60274.description:
Welcome, friend. 

I can see by your garb that you must have quite a storied history. Many unique relics befitting of one that has traveled the worlds and vanquished many foes.

There are those of us that find great value in such things, and would willingly part with our own valuables for a taste of what you may find. 

Let your curiosity guide you to the dark hallway across from the cookpots in the next room. Down there, you will find answers.
60274.completion:
Ah, you must have been sent by Ta'rela. We have need of your services.

Trust me, we will make it more than worth your while.
60274.title: Trading Favors
60274.objectives: Report to Finder Ta'sul in Oribos.

60275.description:
WARNING!

Shrouded patrols have increased throughout the Ember Ward. By order of Enforcer Kristof, all who are found near the asylum will be forced to endure the Light. 

Use extreme caution when venturing beyond our sanctuary. Even the shadows are not safe so long as Kristof remains in power.  

A reward awaits whoever is able to rid the ward of this tyrant. 

- Dispatcher Raluca
60275.completion: No tears will be shed over the loss of such a miscreant. Coin is not abundant in this ward, but take this, the owner is long gone and it will fetch a fair price.
60275.title: WANTED: Enforcer Kristof

60276.description:
Be advised:

Summoner Marcelis and his cohorts are dabbling in dangerous magics. They are calling forth ashen elementals to ravage these Light-scorched lands. 

We cannot let such acts continue. 

Any who can are urged to put an end to this madness. 

- Dispatcher Raluca
60276.progress: You'll get your reward when you slay Marcelis, and not a moment sooner.
60276.title: WANTED: Summoner Marcelis

60277.description:
Attention all workers: 

We got ourselves a problem down in the thicket. 

A golem is trekking through the worksite, causing all sorts of trouble. 

Grab a rock and get to throwin'. The dredger that takes it out gets the rest of the day off. 

- Foreman Scug
60277.completion: You did it then? Fair enough. Now we can all get back to work.
60277.title: WANTED: Aggregate of Doom
60277.objectives: Find and slay the Aggregate of Doom.

60278.description:
Loyal Citizens of Revendreth: 

Duke Anton and his decrepit house are relics of noble venthyr society. 

His attempts to tarnish my name are laughable at best. 

It is time someone rid us of Duke Anton's presence for good.

I shall offer double whatever pathetic sum he can muster. 

Sincerely, 

Lord Darion of House Redelav
60278.completion: House Redelav sure has deep pockets. But you've earned it, I suppose.
60278.title: WANTED: Duke Anton
60278.objectives: Find and slay Duke Anton of House Briarbane.

60279.description:
Notice to all: 

A lingering menace lurks in the Endmire, dangerously close to Darkhaven's border. 

If alone in your travels, take care to avoid this monstrosity, lest it make you meet your true death.

Those with a sense of adventure and a well-armed brigade might manage to slay this beast. If so, a reward will await you upon your return. 

Sincerely, 

Taskmaster Gavril
60279.progress: There's no shame in turning down the bounty. Not everyone has what it takes to slay a devourer.
60279.completion: You have done Darkhaven a great service by slaying that beast.
60279.title: WANTED: The Pale Doom
60279.objectives: Find and slay The Pale Doom within the Endmire.

60280.description:
To Whom it May Concern: 

Lord Darion of House Redelav thinks that he can buy his place in society. 

He flaunts his wealth, using it to win favor of other lords and ladies. Is there no price on decency? 

This is not the way the noble houses of Revendreth should conduct themselves. 

I implore you to find Lord Darion and help him meet his true death. 

The honor of House Briarbane rests in your capable hands.

Warmest Regards, 

Duke Anton of House Briarbane
60280.completion: Hopefully this means House Briarbane will stop their whining.
60280.title: WANTED: Lord Darion
60280.objectives: Find and slay Lord Darion of House Redelav.

60281.description:
I've discovered that one of the Jailer's inquisitors is attempting to devise a method to track my movements.

Clearly, that is a problem for me... and by extension, it is a problem for you.

The inquisitor has risen to the top of my list of potential threats. In the past, I would have had to deal with him myself. But now... I have a business partner.

Put an end to him, yes? And if you can, determine exactly how he intended to track me.
60281.progress: Have you learned anything of Inquisitor Devaki's tracking methods?
60281.completion:
Fine work. This should keep the both of us safe from the Mawsworn. 

I will hold onto the sphere that you found for the purpose of study.

Don't you have other matters to attend to?
60281.title: Rule 4: Make A List
60281.objectives: Kill Inquisitor Devaki and find out how he is trying to track Ve'nari.

60283.progress:
We have conjured Visectus to lead our attack, but we need your help to prepare it properly.

We require more Anima-bound Wraps to strengthen the summons.
Anima-bound Wraps (5)

60284.description:
You have proven yourself a useful associate, {class}. In thanks, I have crafted a cypher that will allow you to venture further into the Maw.

But... it is experimental in nature. You will have to test it in the field. And I have just the test in mind.

Cartel Ve has foolishly sent more agents into the Maw. They were captured and taken to Perdition Hold. I must know why.

Breach the fortress and learn what has become of the captive brokers. Nothing is more valuable than knowledge of your enemy's plans.
60284.progress: What have you discovered, Maw Walker?
60284.completion:
The Beastwarrens, you say... I wonder what they are plotting...

Such an embarrassment that they were discovered and captured in the first place. It seems Cartel Ve has become quite careless in my absence.

You have my gratitude for your assistance, as always. I will inform you when I have need of your services again.
60284.title: Rule 5: Be Audacious
60284.objectives: Investigate the increased activity within Perdition Hold.

60285.description:
I have made a startling discovery, {NAME}. 

Do you recall how the captured agents of my cartel were taken to the Beastwarrens? 

The Mawsworn seem to think they possess a means of tracking me. And now, strange new runes empower the Jailer's hounds.

Clearly, we cannot have that.

This new cypher will grant you solace from the screeching in the Beastwarrens. Brave its caverns and secure those runes for inspection.

If we are to counter their effects, I must know how they work.
60285.completion:
Interesting... runes that can detect brokers by using our extracted essence.

Let us hope you were able to stop any further production. I will keep these for study.

At some point, you will certainly need to walk the nightmarish plains of the Beastwarrens again. My cypher will continue to allow you to do so.
60285.title: Rule 6: Concealment is Everything
60285.objectives: Retrieve 15 Broker Hunting Runes from The Beastwarrens.

60287.description:
Many doomed souls suffer within the Maw. You must be careful if you do not wish to join them.

Your Soulkeeper can hold a small number of souls until you return to your covenant. But that will be of little benefit if you do not survive this place yourself.

There is a substance, stygia, that is found on some creatures within the Maw. The stronger the soul, the more stygia they have.

Collect some of it for me and I can fashion it into many things you will find quite useful.
60287.progress: I will gladly assist you in the acquisition of survival tools... provided you bring me the stygia.
60287.completion:
You seem to have a knack for drawing the Jailer's attention.

This changes the terms of our arrangement.
60287.title: Rule 1: Have an Escape Plan

60289.description:
Before you leave this cursed realm, there is one final task you must complete for me.

The Mawsworn regularly transfer souls to various blocks of Torghast from many different areas in the Maw.

I happen to know of one such area. Place this beacon there so I may be informed when the next transfer happens.

And if you are seen by the enemy... well, you are known for your prowess in combat, yes?
60289.progress: I will have opportunities for trade in the future, Maw Walker. I am certain our paths will cross again.
60289.completion:
One of your associates was taken into Torghast? 

It sounds as if he put up quite the fight. Perhaps he could also prove useful... if he were to be rescued.
60289.title: Rule 3: Trust is Earned
60289.objectives: Place a Signaling Beacon in Cocyrus.

60291.description:
There's work that needs doing 'round here. Mmmm hmmm.

Spotted a big ol' carcass nearby. I aim to salvage it for parts. 

Figure you could come along, help me drag it to Rathan. He'd like that. Mmmm hmmm. 

Reckon I could even carry you there and back. You don't look too big.

Ready to get going?
60291.progress: Did you bring back the carcass?
60291.completion:
<Rathan gives Flytrap an apprehensive look.>

That's... that's great!

Thank you both for bringing back these resources!

<Rathan flashes you a nervous smile.>
60291.title: Corpse Run
60291.objectives: Return the Bone Carcass to Rathan at Butcher Block.

60292.description:
I found this scroll while you were cleansing the temple.

These are dire words, and I suspect it only gets worse. Collect more of these scrolls so I can determine just what these so-called Forsworn want.
60292.completion:
These words...

It is as I suspected.

<Eridia stares grimly ahead.>
60292.title: Dangerous Discourse

60296.description:
You have made great strides with our pride. I hope you found value and fulfillment in working with the larion.

The time to meet with Pelodis has come. You must decide whose way of life is more rewarding, and which you would prefer to pursue.
60296.progress: The pack has welcomed you, {NAME}. I hope that you feel it.
60296.title: Pride or Unit
60296.objectives: Meet with Pelodis and Nemea, then pick a side.

60313.description:
That was a narrow escape.

But I believe this presents an opportunity to finally turn the tide of this strife and defeat the Fearstalker. Meet me at Dredhollow: the abandoned hunting lodge of the Fearstalker.  

We must take separate paths. The Fearstalker will soon be after us again.
60313.completion:
I am glad you made it here alive.

General Draven has informed me of a plan that might just work.
60313.title: Dredhollow

60315.description:
Thief! Pilferer! Menace!

The insidious menace known as Gorgebeak threatens our harvest of ambrosi for tribute to our great Archon. She must be stopped!

If any are willing to take on this foul fowl, I have tracked her nest to the western edges of Firstborne's Bounty. Proof of her demise shall be amply rewarded.

--Gerdus
60315.progress: What business have you with this simple tender?
60315.completion: Our harvest is saved! Oh thank you, brave adventurer, our tribute may be saved yet!
60315.title: WANTED: Gorgebeak
60315.objectives: Collect Gorgebeak's Bill for Gerdus in Firstborne's Bounty.

60316.description:
Praetor broken! At Aspirant's Crucible. Attacking everybody!

Something wrong. Maybe changed?

Simo not know how to fix. Tried everything!

Must destroy!
60316.completion: Oh! Broke praetor is gone? Sad. So sad. But thank you-hoo!
60316.title: WANTED: Altered Sentinel
60316.objectives: Destroy the Altered Sentinel for Forgehand Simo in Aspirant's Rest.

60338.description:
The warning you received from the Primus needs to reach the Winter Queen of Ardenweald, {NAME}. The Eternal Ones must stand together against the coming darkness.

The Winter Queen oversees the cycle between Death and Life. In her forest slumber ancient spirits of nature that must be reborn.

I fear the anima drought will have taken an especially grim toll upon her realm. 

The night fae can lead you to the Queen. Bring her this message, and she will know what needs to be done.
60338.completion:
We haven't seen anyone come through the gateway in a very long time! Certainly not someone like you.

What brings you to Ardenweald?
60338.title: Journey to Ardenweald
60338.objectives: Travel to Ardenweald and find someone to take you to the Winter Queen.

60339.description:
Prince Renathal is prepared to host today's Ember Court whenever you're ready, Maw Walker.

Be sure to talk to the rest of the staff to finalize the guest list and amenities before we open the court.

Remember, we're trying to impress the guests and convince them that we know what we're doing, so make sure you choose amenities that'll make the guests happy!

Talk to Lady Ilinca if you have any questions about guests.

Once everything's ready, talk to me and I'll open the court!
60339.progress: I can't wait to see who attends today's court!
60339.completion:
Now THAT was a court to remember!

How are you going to top that next week?
60339.title: The Ember Court
60339.objectives: Finalize your guest and amenity selections for the Ember Court, then do your best to impress the guests.

60340.description:
When I was imprisoned in the Etheric Vault, the anima scroungers would come to steal what little strength my soul still had. I swore I'd have revenge upon them should I ever escape.

Now, with my blade hands... it's time for my revenge! 

I've seen anima scroungers near the House of Constructs. I want their leader dead and the anima they took from me recovered!
60340.completion: Guillotine can be vicious, but sometimes that's exactly what the situation demands.
60340.title: Hands on Approach
60340.objectives: Slay Wurtzog Soultap and recover 12 anima traces.

60341.description:
Let's make a deal, {NAME}. I'll seek out the Winter Queen on your behalf if you complete a few of my duties in my stead. The Queen isn't the only one who's been kept busy by the drought!

First, you're going to help my fellow fae here with their spriggan problem. Boot their leader off that poor moth! Featherlight will tell you where to go after that. 

We'll reunite in Tirna Vaal if you survive.

Oh, and I would stay on the path if I were you. Ardenweald can be dangerous for the unwary!
60341.progress: Not bad! Not bad at all!
60341.completion: If you can handle the spriggans, then perhaps I can give you some of the more interesting items on Lady Moonberry's agenda. Excellent!
60341.title: First on the Agenda

60342.description:
Idle hands are a wasted opportunity. I need to keep my hands busy, or else these blades wouldn't be worth anything!

I hear there's a devourer in Revendreth that's as tall as a house. Let's show the other constructs a thing or two by taking that monster out!
60342.completion:
Good work, both of you! 

Guillotine's efforts have not gone unnoticed. I've seen the others redouble their efforts to follow her example.

Thank you both, again.
60342.title: Cut 'Em Down to Size
60342.objectives: Slay Charthox in the Dredgewood of Revendreth.

60343.description:
The warchief will be waiting for our mission report from Exile's Reach. I must deliver it at once.

For now, Cork Fizzlepop will show you around the city. Orgrimmar has much to offer, so explore it as you see fit.

I'll send for you once I've given my report to the warchief.
60343.completion:
Hey, {NAME}! Long time no see, am I right?

Warlord Grimaxe asked me to show you the sights. Let's go!
60343.title: Welcome to Orgrimmar
60343.objectives: Meet with Cork Fizzlepop at the city gate.

60344.description:
Orgrimmar's a big city. Way too big to explore on foot. Warlord Grimaxe has arranged for you to receive a mount to help you get around.

She said to speak with Rohaka at the stables... but I can't seem to remember the way there.

Don't worry, {NAME}! All we need to do is ask a guard for directions. If you ever need help finding something, the city guards will show you where to go.

Let's ask a nearby guard for directions to the stable master. Then we can be on our way!
60344.progress: Welcome to the stables, {class}. I've been expecting you.
60344.completion: Warlord Grimaxe instructed me to give you a mount, but there's something we need to do first.
60344.title: Finding Your Way
60344.objectives: Speak with Rohaka Tuskmaul at the stables.

60346.description:
Hey, {NAME}! Have you decided on a combat specialization yet?

Since you're a {class}, you already know about the different classes available to adventurers. But did you know that there are also areas of specialization within each class?

Choosing a specialization is an important decision. Your specialty determines your combat role in a party, as well as the kinds of weapons and abilities that you will use.

Let's go speak with Telotha Pinegrove to learn more about specializations!
60346.progress: Greetings. Have you come to learn about combat specializations?
60346.completion:
Excellent choice of specialization, {NAME}.

Feel free to test out your new abilities on the training dummies outside on the upper level of the building.
60346.title: What's Your Specialty?
60346.objectives: Speak with Telotha Pinegrove to learn about combat specializations.

60358.description:
Took our gildenite! Stole it! Stole it and took it away!

<Sika's feathers ruffle.>

Need it, need it to make armor! Weapons!

Can't make armor without gildenite!

<Sika moves her arms as if explaining how armor is made.>

You understand? Yes? Why you still here?
60358.title: Gildenite Grab
60358.objectives: Collect 3 Gildenite from rare monsters and treasure chests in Bastion.

60359.description:
I don't know about you, but I'm in the mood for some good ol' fashioned recreation!

Why don't we head over to The Wyvern's Tail and cool off with a few pints of Cobo Cola?

While we're there, speak with Innkeeper Nufa to make The Wyvern's Tail your new home. That way, if you ever find yourself stranded without a flight master nearby, you can use your hearthstone to return to the inn.

Not only is it faster than a wyvern, but you'll save yourself some dough in the process!
60359.progress: How can I help you today, {class}? Are you looking for a place to stay?
60359.completion: As long as The Wyvern's Tail is your home, you can find a warm fire here when you return.
60359.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
60359.objectives: Speak with Innkeeper Nufa to make The Wyvern's Tail your home.

60360.description:
I've been looking for you all over Orgrimmar, {NAME}.

Warlord Grimaxe has delivered her mission report to the warchief. The Horde has need of you once again.

I was ordered to find you and deliver the message without delay. It has been an honor to fight alongside you, {NAME}.

Lok-tar ogar!
60360.completion: Good, you're here. The warchief wishes to speak with you.
60360.title: An Urgent Meeting
60360.objectives: Speak with Warlord Breka Grimaxe at Grommash Hold.

60361.description:
The warchief has requested to meet with you in person.

Lady Sylvanas was impressed with the prowess and courage you displayed during our mission to Exile's Reach. 

Now that you've arrived, I will make the introduction.
60361.completion: The Dark Lady has placed her trust in us. We will not fail her, {NAME}.
60361.title: Battle for Azeroth: Mission Statement
60361.objectives: Attend the war meeting in Grommash Hold.

60362.description:
Kul Tiras is the greatest naval power in Azeroth, and a former ally. But we've had little contact with them since Jaina's father, Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, was defeated at Theramore.

Many have criticized Jaina's decision that day, saying she believed so deeply in the promise of peace between the Alliance and Horde that she betrayed her own father.

Perhaps she feels the time has come to atone for this.

Loath as I am to put Jaina in harm's way... Kul Tiras must join the Alliance.

Good luck.
60362.title: Blank
60362.objectives: Speak with Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Stormwind Harbor.

60363.description:
Hshh... the golden ore, we need it.

Golden ore of Bastion. Make their armor with it. 

We need, many uses. Armors, weapons, trinkets and rings. Many uses.

Travel to Bastion. The eyes have shown me stores of it, stolen and hidden throughout their lands.

They do not use it. We will. Go now.
60363.title: Gildenite Grab
60363.objectives: Collect 3 Gildenite from rare monsters and treasure chests in Bastion.

60364.description:
Our allies in Bastion are in possession of a special ore known as gildenite. A golden metal used for many things in their lands, it is also useful to us.

Once upon a time, we would have traded for it. Now, we have little to trade, and they have little to give.

Yet it is a necessary component to focus our magics, capable of harnessing magical energy and amplifying it.

Should you come across any in your travels, liberate it, and return it to me. I shall use what we need, and share the remainder.
60364.title: Gildenite Grab
60364.objectives: Collect 3 Gildenite from rare monsters and treasure chests in Bastion.

60365.description:
The golden ore known as gildenite is found only in Bastion. Used to make many of their own armors, it is useful to us all. We harden our own armors and weapons with it, and it holds magical charge well.

Our stores are nearly depleted, and we have little to trade, but our needs are great.

Let us reflect. 

In Bastion, there are those that have turned their backs on their own people.

We may relieve these deceivers of their gildenite without remorse.
60365.title: Gildenite Grab
60365.objectives: Collect 3 Gildenite from rare monsters and treasure chests in Bastion.

60366.description:
The Cloudfeather matriarch, Darkwing, has fallen to a great and terrible sickness. She has grown aggressive, dominating her children and driving them to violence.

Darkwing must be slain if her flock is to ever return to the Archon's grace.

Please use the attached whistle to call her to her nest. I shall consider one of her crown feathers sufficient proof of the deed.

--Eumelia, Stable Master
60366.progress: Until Darkwing rests at last I fear her brood will know no peace.
60366.completion: You have my gratitude for restoring balance to these fascinating creatures. We all have our part to play.
60366.title: WANTED: Darkwing
60366.objectives: Collect an Umbral Plume from Darkwing in Greatwing Roost for Eumelia.

60369.description:
The shapers of our lands cultivate a very special form of wood we call wealdwood.

It contains the essence of Ardenweald, of the plants and animals that make up our soil and our air. It can be enchanted with powerful magics, and it will not burn.

It is the basis of our arms and armor, and in these dark days, it is a target of our enemies.

They steal and hoard it, out there in the wilds. 

Find them, and return our treasures to us.
60369.title: A Wealth of Wealdwood
60369.objectives: Collect 3 Wealdwood from rare monsters and treasure chests in Ardenweald.

60370.description:
In Ardenweald, the shapers form boughs into a magical form of wood. Wealdwood, an enchanted substance used for many sorcerous purposes, is a key component in our rituals.

Without it, our magics pale in comparison to those of our enemies.

Yet in these times, Ardenweald is beset by many foes. They steal the supplies of the Night Fae and scurry off into the dark places.

Travel to those places, and return to us once you have brought atonement to these vile creatures.
60370.title: A Wealth of Wealdwood
60370.objectives: Collect 3 Wealdwood from rare monsters and treasure chests in Ardenweald.

60371.description:
The eyes have shown me supplies, in Ardenweald. Hidden in the boughs, hidden from us, but they cannot hide from the eyes.

They do not use it, not as we would. We must use it. It is ours to take.

Kshhhh... bring it to us, the shaped wood. Many uses, very magical. Holds magic as a pitcher holds slime, fills with it.

Need it for our sorcerers. Cannot win in battle without our magic. Must win, no other way.
60371.title: A Wealth of Wealdwood
60371.objectives: Collect 3 Wealdwood from rare monsters and treasure chests in Ardenweald.

60372.description:
Ardenweald in trouble! We in trouble too! No Ardenweald, no wealdwood.

wealdwood magical, help us make many thing.

You find some? Bring to Sika? Yes? Hoo?

Yes. 

<Sika writes your name on a scroll and underlines it twice, then shows it to you.>

See?
60372.title: A Wealth of Wealdwood
60372.objectives: Collect 3 Wealdwood from rare monsters and treasure chests in Ardenweald.

60373.description:
There is a dark, evil vine that grows in Revendreth, known as sorrowvine.

They say it feeds off of the anguish of the souls as they are broken.

Regardless of its origins, it is used in many of our potions and spells. It contains a powerful magic, likely a product of its origin.

Revendreth has little opportunity to trade with us these days. Should you find any of these vines, I will gladly accept them.
60373.title: A Source of Sorrowvine
60373.objectives: Collect 3 Sorrowvine from rare monsters and treasure chests in Revendreth.

60374.description:
The denizens of Maldraxxus are used to a life of battle, and in doing so, find themselves in possession of so very many bones.

They form their armors out of a cultivated form of bone we call bonemetal. Harder than most metals, yet pliable, it can be forged into a variety of shapes without losing its strength.

We have many uses for it, both as a means of attachment, and when ground up, as a reagent.

We cannot ask them for resources now, but if you find any, I would use it.
60374.title: Bonemetal Bonanza
60374.objectives: Collect 3 Bonemetal from rare monsters and treasure chests in Maldraxxus.

60375.description:
Maldraxxus no longer answers our calls, and the houses are in disarray.

Yet we have need of them. Once, they supplied us with bonemetal, a strong yet malleable material useful for many armors.

There are those in Maldraxxus that hoard the material, seeking to profit from the chaos.

They must atone for these sins.
60375.title: Bonemetal Bonanza
60375.objectives: Collect 3 Bonemetal from rare monsters and treasure chests in Maldraxxus.

60376.description:
Ksh-ksh-ksh... you are needed.

So many betrayers in our lands, many deaths, much armor destroyed. 

Need to rebuild.

The eyes have shown me stores of bonemetal, hoarded by our foes.

Bring them to me.
60376.title: Bonemetal Bonanza
60376.objectives: Collect 3 Bonemetal from rare monsters and treasure chests in Maldraxxus.

60377.description:
<Sika is studying a scroll.>

No bonemetal! Again, out of bonemetal!

<Sika throws a pile of scrolls into the air.>

Hoo! Where you come from?

Oh, OH. bonemetal! You get? Get from Maldraxxus. Help us out!

<Sika points in the direction of Maldraxxus.>

That way!
60377.title: Bonemetal Bonanza
60377.objectives: Collect 3 Bonemetal from rare monsters and treasure chests in Maldraxxus.

60378.description:
Sorrowvine grows only here, in the lowlands of Revendreth. It has power contained within the leaves and seeds, perhaps a byproduct of the cleansing of sins.

We use it for many things, from potions to venoms. It is a versatile reagent.

Our stores are low, and we have little ability to forage these days with the forces of our enemies bearing down on us.

As you travel our lands, should you come upon any, we would make good use of it.
60378.title: A Source of Sorrowvine
60378.objectives: Collect 3 Sorrowvine from rare monsters and treasure chests in Revendreth.

60379.description:
Kshh... need you today. Stores of sorrowvine getting low, need it for our venoms.

Revendreth does not answer our calls. The eyes show me conflict and strife in their lands.

This matters little to us.

Shh... travel there, find their vines, return to me.
60379.title: A Source of Sorrowvine
60379.objectives: Collect 3 Sorrowvine from rare monsters and treasure chests in Revendreth.

60380.description:
Need sorrowvine! Please help!

Revendreth not sending us supplies, not answering Sika! Can't make potions now. What we do?

<Sika seems to have just remembered that you were there.>

You go! 

<Sika pushes you.> 

Go go!
60380.title: A Source of Sorrowvine
60380.objectives: Collect 3 Sorrowvine from rare monsters and treasure chests in Revendreth.

60381.description:
Today, we must turn our gaze inward. We are beset by foes here, in Ardenweald, from all sides.

Travel our lands, weapon in hand, and bring hope and victory with you. Bring aid to those in need, and remind them that we are here for them, and Ardenweald will not fall.

Remind them that our great purpose will be fulfilled, and we will not let the groves wither.

You, Maw Walker, will unite us today.
60381.progress: Have you brought hope and faith to our people today?
60381.completion: Our bonds are stronger, our roots grow deeper, due to your actions this day. We will hold strong against the onset of foes that plague us, as groves weave together in defense, thanks to you.
60381.title: Aiding Ardenweald

60382.description:
We do not turn out backs on our allies, even when we face darkness here in Ardenweald.

In Revendreth, they battle against the forces of Sire Denathrius, who has proven himself a false leader.

We cannot allow those that make Sinfall their home to lose hope.

Travel to Revendreth and supply aid to them. Show them that we will not let them falter, that we are stronger together.
60382.progress: How goes the battle in Revendreth?
60382.completion: As we aid our allies, we all remember the bonds that forge us together in our world. Together, we will overcome, and only together, will the Shadowlands function once more.
60382.title: Aiding Revendreth

60383.description:
Maldraxxus defends us from forces that threaten the Shadowlands, or at least, they once did.

Now they are plagued by infighting and an imbalance in power.

We have few allies there, but those that remain, we must maintain.

Go there, give them aid, and help them reunite the houses such that the armies of the undying may defend us once more.

Without them, we are but one invasion from complete annihilation.
60383.progress: Have you aided the forces of Maldraxxus?
60383.completion: We are now one step closer to reforging the army that will defend our worlds. This is a good thing you have done today.
60383.title: Aiding Maldraxxus

60384.description:
The denizens of Bastion have long served the Shadowlands with faith and honor. Without them, souls would not arrive for us to nurture, and our lands would wither and die.

We cannot allow them to fall, for without Bastion, we are lost.

Travel to the golden fields, weapon in hand, and provide aid to our besieged allies. We will show them that in these dark times, they are not alone.
60384.completion: Even in dark times, we cannot allow others to be alone with their troubles. It is only when we stand together that the Shadowlands can become whole again.
60384.title: Aiding Bastion

60385.description:
The dark lands of Revendreth, ruled over by the traitor Denathrius, pose a great risk to us, and a great opportunity for training.

Come here, trainee! Today, you hunt with the Maw Walker. Should you return to me, we will celebrate, with a hunt.

For tomorrow, we hunt.
60385.completion: I smell a group of successful hunters, good. Each successful hunt brings us one step closer to a trained hunting pack.
60385.title: Training in Revendreth
60385.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Revendreth with your trainee.

60386.description:
The forces of Maldraxxus are some of the most highly trained and well-regimented in all of the Shadowlands. Once, they defended us all, now we must fend for ourselves.

There is little better place for our trainees to gain real combat and strategy experience than on their blood-soaked battlefields.

Take this one with you on your travels today, so that they may see what real combat looks like.
60386.progress: Do you return with a trainee, or a coward?
60386.completion: There is little better than real combat experience to train our next generation of hunters. Thank you for keeping this one alive.
60386.title: Training in Maldraxxus
60386.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Maldraxxus with your trainee.

60387.description:
Our hunters do not have the time for proper training, and so we must train them in the field.

Our allies in Bastion are in desperate need of support, and I wish one of the trainees to accompany you in this endeavor.

Do you hear that, trainee? Today, you accompany the Maw Walker!

Maw Walker, do not go easy on this one.
60387.progress: I hope that today's trainee survived the trip, but I am not overly confident.
60387.completion: Good, a tired trainee is a trainee that has seen combat and gained many experiences. You have done well with this one.
60387.title: Training in Bastion
60387.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Bastion with your trainee.

60388.description:
Get up, trainee, you must get up!

Look at this one! Needs much more training before we stand a fighting chance against our enemies. 

We have precious little time to build combat prowess these days, with so many foes at our backs.

Take this one with you today, show them the ways of battle, and keep them safe from overwhelming odds. It is the only way we will make enough progress.
60388.completion: You have done well, we will allow them to rest a moment. Today they have learned that even in the calmest meadow, there is always danger.

60389.description:
Ay there, ya got a moment?

Lotta things going on down in Ardenweald. Bad stuff, bugs and things. Look delicious, but probably give me ol' stomach a nasty one.

We're lookin' pretty solid here today, ya see? Probably could use a hand down there. Maybe they give us a hand in return, see? 

Do I gotta spell it out for you? Get on over there, ya big goof.
60389.completion: Ain't never been a friend to no Night Fae, but maybe it's about time we went lookin' for more allies. Gotta start somewhere, I suppose.
60389.title: Aiding Ardenweald

60390.description:
We are attacked by enemies on all sides, Maw Walker. 

And Ardenweald faces a similar threat.

It is in our best strategic interests to forge lasting alliances with those outside of Maldraxxus. Though we may be under assault, we are still the strongest military might in the Shadowlands. Under our protection, they will thrive and grow, and in turn, provide us with aid in our times of need.

Together, we are strong. This is the doctrine of the phalanx, and it will be ours as well.
60390.progress: Have you secured allies in Ardenweald?
60390.completion: Stability in Ardenweald will serve us as we move against the enemy. This was a solid strategic choice, Maw Walker.
60390.title: Aiding Ardenweald

60391.description:
Ardenweald has long been one of our closest companions in the shepherding and nurturing of souls. Now they are beset by many foes, and we will not allow them to fall!

Make haste to their forested lands, and with the blessing of the Archon upon you, serve a glorious purpose. Stand with them in their time of need, a gilded shield, a reminder that they are not alone!

Bastion stands with them, and with us, they will never falter!
60391.progress: Have you served in Ardenweald today?
60391.completion: Today we are blessed that the Maw Walker has brought our divine purpose to Ardenweald! Our allies rejoice in your victories!
60391.title: Aiding Ardenweald

60392.description:
In our own golden hills, evil abounds. We will not allow it to take root and fester!

Raise your voice, Maw Walker, and shout to the foes of Bastion! We are coming for them!

With haste, now, seek out those in need of your might. Bring the sharpened blade of faith to bear against doubt and uncertainty. Crush despair with a gilded fist, and let it know the vengeance of the Archon!

For Bastion!
60392.progress: Do the hills echo with the cries of your victories, Maw Walker?
60392.completion: The hills speak of your faith and honor, our forces radiate with each victory! Glory to Bastion, glory to the Archon, glory to the Maw Walker!
60392.title: Aiding Bastion

60393.description:
The kyrians of Bastion serve a unique purpose in the Shadowlands, and without them we will be unable to replenish our forces. Should we wish to stand triumphant in Maldraxxus, we must extend some of our might to aid them.

Travel to Bastion and provide support, so as to stabilize their situation. In doing so, we will secure the future of our armies and cut off the supply to our enemies.

War is not always fought on the battlefield, but often in the means of replenishment.
60393.progress: Have you secured the situation in Bastion?
60393.completion: We are one step closer to returning our supply of souls to a functioning form, Maw Walker. This is an important advancement in the war for Maldraxxus.
60393.title: Aiding Bastion

60394.description:
If'n the kyrians of Bastion don't get souls to the Shadowlands, we got no one to join up, and no anima to gain in them sinstones. Be in a bad place, you know, now and in the future, if things ever bother to get better.

We got things figured out here today. Head on over to them golden hills of Bastion and give 'em a hand. Bet they pay us back some day. They're all about honor an' stuff.

<Rendle wipes his nose loudly.>
60394.completion:
Always wanted to eat a steward, never got the chance to. Really wonder what they taste like. 

Was a good thing you did for them, anyway. Just got some idle musings I do.
60394.title: Aiding Bastion

60395.description:
In the fetid wastes of Maldraxxus, we yet find allies. Their sacred duty, to defend the Shadowlands, has not been forgotten by all.

We must take flight, now, to stand side by side with our bone-bound brethren. Shoulder to shoulder, hand in hand, we will push back those that would sow chaos and discord.

A spear of gold and bone we will form! And thrust it into the heart of evil!

Go now, Maw Walker, as the tip of the spear, to glorious battle!
60395.progress: Have you pierced the heart of evil in Maldraxxus?
60395.completion: Glorious! The gilded halls of Bastion stand firm with our allies in Maldraxxus, may they never wane in their battle for righteousness!
60395.title: Aiding Maldraxxus

60396.description:
The allies we have here in Maldraxxus may be few, but we cannot turn our backs on them. Every hand we pull out of darkness and into our fold, is a hand that can hold a weapon or wand.

Walk our lands, find those seeking aid, and provide it. Crush our enemies, and show them that we are at once everywhere. Make them fear you.

Fear is the seed that breeds doubt, and doubt is the root that crumbles empires.
60396.completion: Our rival houses will think twice before stepping foot outside of their strongholds again. Blood and glory to you, Maw Walker.
60396.title: Aiding Maldraxxus

60397.description:
Once was a time that those bony lot in Maldraxxus were the defenders o' all of us here in the Shadowlands. Now they spend their time destroyin' what little they got left.

All's I know is that if things keep up like this, one big ol' swath of devourers could sweep in and wipe us all out.

Get over there and help them good ones keep the peace, maybe they help us out some day, too.
60397.completion: Maybe things get a bit more stable down there in Maldraxxus, now. Would do us all a lot o' good.
60397.title: Aiding Maldraxxus

60398.description:
Our allies in Revendreth are all that stem the tide of Denathrius's forces from overtaking the rest of the Shadowlands. 

Once, we would be charged with righting this wrong, but our armies have dwindled with the actions of our rival houses.

Today, you will be the messenger from Maldraxxus, carrying a message of justice in the name of the great cycle of which we all take part.

It is your Primus-given duty to aid Sinfall against those that seek to break the cycle.
60398.progress: Have you broken the forces of Denathrius?
60398.completion: With your aid, we have once again been able to perform our sacred duties in defense of the Shadowlands. Little by little, we right the wrongs that have sent us awry, that the cycle can begin anew.
60398.title: Aiding Revendreth

60399.description:
Oi there, got somethin' for you to do today.

Lots of problems outside of Sinfall, there are. Big problems, little problems, all sorts of problems.

We're not gonna make much headway against Denathrius with his lot at our heels all the time, ay?

Get out there an' get some muck on your boots.
60399.completion: Ya did a good thing today, an' we're safer for it. Never been one to give a compliment, me, but today I gotta say ya did a good one.
60399.title: Aiding Revendreth

60400.description:
Take flight to Revendreth, where those that are loyal to the Shadowlands are under siege from the forces of Sire Denathrius.

We cannot allow them to fall. Without the aid of Sinfall, the forces of Revendreth will grow unchecked, and their dark alliance with the Jailer will threaten us all.

We of Bastion will not allow this to happen! Raise your swords, ready your shields, take wing and bring the glory of Bastion to Revendreth!
60400.completion: Even those that are far from our lands are necessary allies in these dark times. With faith and honor we will serve them, and the Shadowlands, until evil clips our wings!
60400.title: Aiding Revendreth

60401.description:
I have another trainee for you to look after, they need some training on the battlefield. Take them out to, oh, let's say Ardenweald. 

<Sakaa waves her hand vaguely in the direction of Ardenweald.>

Plenty of things to maim over there, maybe they learn a thing or two about wood.

<Sakaa smirks.>
60401.completion:
Oh, well, good job carting this one around, then. Hope they didn't give you any trouble.

Maybe a little trouble would be acceptable.
60401.title: Training in Ardenweald
60401.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Ardenweald with your trainee.

60402.description:
Look at this lot! Bones and gristle, all of them. Need some meat on their bones and some training in their heads.

Take this trainee out and get them some real combat experience.

Ardenweald's a good spot, plenty of things to fight there. Learn some new tactics, get them used to the chaos of battle, all that stuff.
60402.completion: Good, good, I can already see this one's learned a thing or two today. I'll take it from here.
60402.title: Training in Ardenweald
60402.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Ardenweald with your trainee.

60403.description:
It is our great duty to take our aspiring warriors and train them in combat. 

Today, this is your trainee. Take them to Ardenweald, show them what it means to be in the glorious service of the Archon. Defend our allies, and bring faith to their lands.

Teach them the ways of battle and honor.
60403.completion: You have returned with your charge intact, most benevolent. Carry the lessons of the teacher with you.
60403.title: Training in Ardenweald
60403.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Ardenweald with your trainee.

60404.description:
What better place to stretch our wings than right here on our own fields?

Take one of our trainees out with you today, show them the ways of combat in Bastion against the growing threats we face here.

Part of their training will be courage when facing off against those they thought their brethren.

It has been known to break hearts and ranks before.
60404.completion: Let this one rest, now. Facing threats from within, let alone against ones you once considered kin and ally, can take a mighty toll.
60404.title: Training Our Forces
60404.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Bastion with your trainee.

60405.description:
Useless minions, the lot of them. All of this fodder needs to get trained.

Here, take this one with you today. Get them away from me, go to... Bastion. Yeah, Bastion, far away from me.

Plenty of things to test them against, there. 

If you get them killed, I don't want to hear it.
60405.progress: Any luck with this sad lot?
60405.completion: Well well well, kind of surprised you managed to make it back with your trainee intact. Guess you're a better instructor than I gave you credit for. Going to keep that in mind.
60405.title: Training in Bastion
60405.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Bastion with your trainee.

60406.description:
I have yet another minion, er, recruit that needs training.

Take them on out to the fertile fields of Bastion. There is plenty to learn over there that they won't find around these parts, perhaps it will help them grow into a better soldier. 

Maybe you pick up some new tricks while you're out there, too.
60406.completion: Thank you for showing them around today. There's plenty to learn still, though.
60406.title: Training in Bastion
60406.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Bastion with your trainee.

60407.description:
Our aspiring warriors must be trained in the thick of battle, in the harshest conditions, for wars do not happen lightly, and never will it give them pause for breath.

Take this one to Maldraxxus--the heart of the armies of the Shadowlands resides there. It is a land in chaos and turmoil, filled with fallen champions and gladiators.

There, they will face true challenges, and return with great knowledge.
60407.progress: Has your trainee survived the fields of battle?
60407.completion: Ah, good, you returned with your trainee intact. Truthfully, each time we send them on such an errand, it is a game of chance. It is good you were with them.
60407.title: Training in Maldraxxus
60407.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Maldraxxus with your trainee.

60408.description:
Our armies are nothing without some combat training, but every time we send them out, they come back as a pile of bones and meat.

Take a trainee out and pit them against the forces of the other houses. Just don't get them killed, alright? Not all the way killed. A little killed is fine.
60408.completion: By my bones, you came back and your trainee isn't a pile of mush. Can't believe my eye sockets.
60408.title: Training Our Forces
60408.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Maldraxxus with your trainee.

60409.description:
Another trainee needs some looking after, if you don't mind.

Maldraxxus is a place of constant battle, and probably the best place to take them. They've got to learn about war and strategy and, you know, all that.

Just throw them in the arena or something. 'Sink or swim' is an effective training strategy.
60409.progress: Could really go for a nap I could.
60409.completion: Your trainee's looking a little roughed up, but none the worse for wear. Probably learned a thing or two.
60409.title: Training in Maldraxxus
60409.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Maldraxxus with your trainee.

60410.description:
I have yet more troops for you to train, and there are plenty of things to do right here in our domain. 

Take them out and give them a good, solid, and probably bloody taste of what we're up against.

Now, if you get them killed? That's none of my business.

<Sakaa sips a thick and sweet-smelling beverage.>
60410.progress: Did you manage to bring them back alive?
60410.completion: Well, it looks like you drilled some good experience into this one today. Only a few broken bones!
60410.title: Training Our Forces
60410.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Revendreth with your trainee.

60411.description:
Lousy, useless, bunch of bones. This army's less of an army than it is a bunch of dead meat walking.

Do me a favor, take out this trainee and head over to Revendreth. Give them some good battle training against some of our enemies, a little taste of strategy and tactics and maybe getting hit in the face with a little magic.

Won't do us any good unless we find a way to train them that doesn't end up in a bunch of dead minions.
60411.progress: Well? You bring back a pile of bones or a trainee?
60411.completion: Looks like this one's got a bit more in the head now, maybe they'll survive beyond a battle now.
60411.title: Training in Revendreth
60411.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Revendreth with your trainee.

60412.description:
A trainee is in need of your guiding hand.

Take them to Revendreth, where you will find the armies of Denathrius thirsting for our demise. Wade in to battle with them against our mighty foes.

Return victorious, as their shield and mentor, so that our armies will be bolstered this day.
60412.completion: Another glorious day of training in the name of the Archon! We will let this one rest now, to train another day.
60412.title: Training in Revendreth
60412.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests in Revendreth with your trainee.

60414.description:
The Brokers are odd characters, but useful. They can find many things across the vast realms of the Shadowlands that we cannot. 

We have relied upon them to bring us useful materials for many years, but these days, we have little to trade.

They value a currency of their own making, coins of brokerage, as a general means of trade.

If you find any in your travels, I would appreciate a handful, as it would allow me to procure some rare and necessary items.
60414.completion: Oh, this is quite a find. These will allow me to procure some rather rare ingredients and materials, and with them, we may turn the tide against our foes. Well done.
60414.title: Rare Resources
60414.objectives: Collect 3 Coins of Brokerage from rare monsters and treasure chests in the Shadowlands.

60415.description:
Hello! Yes! Hello.

Brokers, you know them? 

<Sika does her best attempt at looking like a broker. It is not convincing.>

Trade many things with us. Things we no get. Things we want.

Need coins. Clink clink!

<Sika makes a circle with her finger feathers.>

Find them everywhere, bring them to Sika!
60415.progress: Bring coins to Sika? Need trade with brokers. You know this?
60415.completion:
Coins! Coins for Sika! Happy Sika, happy friends. Can buy many things, strange things, you no understand, is ok.

<Sika takes the coins and waves at you.>
60415.title: Rare Resources
60415.objectives: Collect 3 Coins of Brokerage from rare monsters and treasure chests in the Shadowlands.

60416.description:
Kh-kh-kh... the brokers, they go to many places. Many places we cannot. The eyes cannot follow them.

Find many secrets, they do. Bring us supplies, strange and rare.

Need things to trade. Need broker coins.

They trade with all. Find coins in all lands. Slay those that hold them, bring the coins to me. 

You may eat their corpses, I will not judge. Just need coins.
60416.progress: Bring me coins? Coins for brokers. Many uses. You see?
60416.completion: The clink of the coins is the sound of secrets being revealed. Many uses, many things I will purchase. More powerful will we become, due to this. A good find.
60416.title: Rare Resources
60416.objectives: Collect 3 Coins of Brokerage from rare monsters and treasure chests in the Shadowlands.

60417.description:
The brokers are an enigmatic group. We know little about them, save that they can travel to many lands in the Shadowlands that we cannot. How they do this, we are not sure.

They are willing partners in trade, though, and through them we have acquired many rare and valuable resources that cannot be found elsewhere.

They hold in high regard a currency of their own creation, you may find such coins in your travels. 

I will gladly take them off of your hands to bolster our supplies.
60417.progress: Have you found any of the broker's coins?
60417.completion:
This small handful of coins will purchase many things of use to us. I will contact them directly.

Thank you, Maw Walker.
60417.title: Rare Resources
60417.objectives: Collect 3 Coins of Brokerage from rare monsters and treasure chests in the Shadowlands.

60418.description:
Our allies in Bastion are absolutely necessary for the Shadowlands to function at all. They alone can bring us the souls we need to keep the cycle moving. 

If they fall to darkness, it's only a matter of time before we, too, dwindle and fade.

They are beset by all manner of problems. We have to get over there and help them!
60418.completion: I've gotten word from our Kyrian allies that you did them a great service! Thank you!
60418.title: A Call to Bastion

60419.description:
They say that all of the Shadowlands is a stage, and right now, I think we're in a tragedy! 

All throughout Ardenweald, we are under attack. They seek our anima and the souls that we protect.

If the cycle stops here, so many great souls will be lost... forever.

There's no time to waste, we need your help! Defend Ardenweald!
60419.progress: Are things improving in the glades?
60419.completion:
I've heard many tales of your greatness, the Winter Queen is quite pleased! 

Please take this, and keep up the fight!
60419.title: Troubles at Home

60420.description:
I'm glad you're here! We've got some problems in Maldraxxus.

The forces of Maldraxxus are the defenders of the Shadowlands. They've always managed to balance one another out, like actors on a stage, never stealing too much of the spotlight. 

But now, some of the houses have overthrown the balance, and seek to conquer the rest of us!

Our allies there need our help! Aid them however you can.
60420.completion:
The houses of Maldraxxus are once again in balance, and not a threat to us... for now at least. 

You did great!
60420.title: A Call to Maldraxxus

60421.description:
Oh, I'm glad you're here, we've got a problem!

Our friends in Revendreth are struggling under the rule of Sire Denathrius. He was always a cruel leader, and now he's thrown in his lot with the Jailer! 

If Denathrius's control of Revendreth isn't broken, he'll come for us next...

Let's do whatever we can to help them out!
60421.completion: Ha, take that Denathrius. He won't be allowed to rule the Shadowlands if you have anything to say about it!
60421.title: A Call to Revendreth

60422.description:
We cannot stand alone. If one section of the Shadowlands falls, we will all be in danger.

The great soul-trees of Ardenweald are under assault from many foes that seek to harness their power.

We must aid our allies in the Night Fae, and punish their enemies for these transgressions.

We are stronger together.
60422.completion: You have secured our alliance with the Night Fae, and in doing so, we hold a stronger position across the Shadowlands.
60422.title: A Call to Ardenweald

60423.description:
Ardenweald was once a place of peace and regrowth, now beset by dark forces from all sides. 

Maldraxxus alone is responsible for challenging those that would disrupt the cycle.

Take our banners, steady your weapons, and bring war to Ardenweald.

For the Shadowlands.
60423.completion:
The cycle will continue, as we have willed it to be so. 

With every foe you slay, the name of Maldraxxus is spoken with glory and purpose.
60423.title: A Call to Ardenweald

60424.description:
Ardenweald is one of our closest allies, and to them we ferry some of the most powerful souls.

Should the weald fall, the devastation that would be unleashed could destroy us all.

We must aid the Winter Queen. It is the will of the Archon.

Go now, and provide support to the Night Fae.
60424.completion:
Our allies in Ardenweald have sent word of your many deeds. You have shown once more that the Kyrian will fight for the Shadowlands and our allies, no matter the cost. 

Courage and wisdom to you.
60424.title: A Call to Ardenweald

60425.description:
Sometimes we must look inward to find true darkness. Here, in Bastion, where once there was harmony, now we face many foes.

Today, we root them out.

Head into the golden fields, with your weapon in hand. Cleanse us of these foul creatures, aid our forces when they have need of you.

In the name of the Archon.
60425.completion:
The bells chime in the distance, heralding your return. A glorious sound.

You have performed a great service today, and truly secured your place among us.

Hail, victor!
60425.title: Troubles at Home

60426.description:
We, the defenders of the Shadowlands, will never let a great foe go unchallenged.

The Kyrians of Bastion have long served all denizens of the Shadowlands by ferrying souls. We would be lost without their services.

Now, they too are under attack from within. We must defend them in their time of need.

Go now, and bring glory in the name of the Primus.
60426.progress: Are the golden fields bathed in blood?
60426.completion:
We will always rise to the defense of the Shadowlands, even if we are weakened from within. 

You have shown that no foe is too far to escape the reach of Maldraxxus.
60426.title: A Call to Bastion

60427.description:
The denizens of Bastion are a key component to the cycle of power here in the Shadowlands. Without them, we cannot replenish our ranks, and the forces of the Jailer will grow ever stronger.

They have their own troubles in these times, as well. Today, we must look without, and aid our allies.

Travel to the golden fields, and rid them of their foes. 

Only with allies do we stand a chance against Denathrius.
60427.completion: The Archon has sent word of your deeds, and agreed to support us in the battles to come. We will fix this broken cycle, with steps such as this leading the way.
60427.title: A Call to Bastion

60430.description:
The forces of Maldraxxus have long defended the Shadowlands from threats outside of our lands.

Now, they face their greatest threats from within. The balance of power between the houses is broken. It has led them to assault us, and others.

Their problems are many, our solutions are just. 

Travel to Maldraxxus and slay those that would do the Shadowlands harm, providing shelter to your allies when you find them.
60430.completion: With the houses of betrayal brought to their knees, you have brought us one step closer to peace. The Archon thanks you for your service to the Shadowlands.
60430.title: A Call to Maldraxxus

60431.description:
The forces of Maldraxxus were once intended to defend the Shadowlands against threats from beyond. They are all but broken, now.

The houses are in disarray, infighting with one another. We have few allies there, and those that have sided with us are bruised and beaten.
