Go now, aid them, and slay their foes. Bring balance back to Maldraxxus, and in turn, will they aid us.
60431.completion: The warriors of Maldraxxus speak your name, a great victory to have achieved this day. The balance of power will be restored one day, and our alliances will pay dividends.
60431.title: A Call to Maldraxxus

60432.description:
There are many tasks that need your attention outside of the walls of Sinfall.

Our closest allies are under assault from all sides, and the forces of Denathrius are unrelenting.

Take your weapon and steel yourself. Today, we defend Revendreth, and in doing so, further bulwark ourselves against our enemies.

We will take back what is ours.
60432.completion: We are more secure in our position due to your actions today. Revendreth will not fall to the sway of Denathrius, not as long as we hold firm.
60432.title: Troubles at Home

60433.description:
We fight not only for might and glory, but for the greater good of the Shadowlands. It is our calling to bring war upon those that would disrupt the flow of souls.

There is one such betrayer - Sire Denathrius.

Bring the vengeance of Maldraxxus down upon his foul crown. 

Slay his allies, serve his foes, end his reign in carnage.
60433.progress: How fares the battle for Revendreth?
60433.completion:
Denathrius did not expect us to rally so quickly, to serve our great purpose in the cycle. 

He underestimated our house for the last time, and has paid the price in blood.
60433.title: A Call to Revendreth

60434.description:
We all serve the greater purpose here, even those in Revendreth that we may not agree with. We take souls to them in need of a harsher form of cleansing, and it is just.

Yet Sire Denathrius has gone too far, and now seeks to control all of the Shadowlands.

We have friends there, amongst the Venthyr. Aid them, and put their enemies to rest.

The Word of the Archon is with you.
60434.completion:
The crimes of Sire Denathrius could not go unpunished, and you have meted out a proper response today. 

<Polemarch Adrestes bows his head in your direction.>
60434.title: A Call to Revendreth

60435.description:
We never truly counted the forces of Denathrius as our allies, and now he has shown his true colors.

Over many years, he has built an army. One capable of destroying any other land, provided we were divided, and not united. He has empowered monstrous creations and broken them to his will.

What better way to secure our allies and test our strength, than to eliminate his most fervent champions.

Go now, and hunt.
60435.completion:
The generals that serve our enemies in Revendreth will think twice before attempting to control the Shadowlands. 

We have aided unlikely allies, and forged true bonds with Revendreth today, and it is thanks to you.
60435.title: Challenges in Revendreth
60435.objectives: Complete the Destroy the Dominant World Quest, the Sanguine Depths Dungeon, or the Halls of Atonement Dungeon in Revendreth.

60436.description:
Maldraxxus is a land of conflict and strife. There is little better place than to test yourself against the might of the Shadowlands.

There, you will find warriors that are bred on combat, honed by the sword and hammer, tested in arenas and battlegrounds.

Crash into them like the felling of a great branch, let them see the might of Ardenweald is no less terrifying.
60436.completion:
In a land of champions and war, you have proven your worth. Few can claim to have taken on the greatest defenders of the Shadowlands and survived, yet here you stand, a monument to the strength of the Night Fae. 

May it never wane.
60436.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
60436.objectives: Complete the Chosen Champions World Quest, the Theater of Pain Dungeon, or the Plaguefall Dungeon in Maldraxxus.

60437.description:
Bastion has long been one of our closest allies, and a key to the inner workings of the Shadowlands. We cannot abide dysfunctions in the passage of souls.

They are beset by a host of issues brought on by dissension in their ranks. Every day, doubt gnaws at their forces, bleeding away their hope, and plunging us further into chaos.

Doubt is a powerful foe, and not easily dispatched. Keep your wits about you and crush these dark thoughts.
60437.progress: Have you aided the denizens of Bastion?
60437.completion: You have shown courage in the face of great doubt. There are many kinds of strength, and you have shown that you possess one that goes beyond the blade and bow.
60437.title: Challenges in Bastion
60437.objectives: Complete the Disloyal Denizens World Quest, the Spires of Ascension Dungeon, or the Necrotic Wake Dungeon in Bastion.

60438.description:
The Wild Hunt count as our prey the most dangerous creatures in the weald. Here, you may test yourself against challenges the likes of which you may not have faced in your previous life.

In our current state, my gravest concern is with Tirna Scithe. Once full of life, it is now overtaken by multitudes of foul creatures. They siphon its power, and though we may never regain the glade, we must not allow this to continue.

Take on this trial, and put an end to the invaders of Tirna Scithe.
60438.completion: A quiet has overtaken the glade, the leaves no longer rustle in anguish. This is your doing, and we will not forget this kindness.
60438.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
60438.objectives: Complete the Terrors in Tirna Scithe World Quest, the Mists of Tirna Scithe Dungeon, or De Other Side Dungeon in Ardenweald.

60439.description:
Our close companions in Ardenweald face challenges unlike any that have previously plagued their peaceful glades.

Ready your weapons, for now is the time that the golden shields of Bastion shine. Now is the time to take flight into the weald and show courage in the face of darkness.

It is not always about us, you see. True courage means fighting for others when necessary, even against overwhelming odds and the most vile of evils.

Light shines only in darkness.
60439.completion: I have received word of your great deeds in Ardenweald. They are thankful for your service, and you have proven your courage tenfold today.
60439.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
60439.objectives: Complete the Terrors in Tirna Scithe World Quest, the Mists of Tirna Scithe Dungeon, or De Other Side Dungeon in Ardenweald.

60440.description:
Looking to prove yourself? I hear there are powerful creatures invading Ardenweald. Sounds like a challenge, no?

So ready your weapon and get out there! What better place to prove your might?

Smash them to pieces, in the name of Maldraxxus!
60440.completion:
It is a shame your job was completed so quickly. So many foes, so little time!

You are a good addition to our forces, I really enjoy all of this slaying.
60440.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
60440.objectives: Complete the Terrors in Tirna Scithe World Quest, the Mists of Tirna Scithe Dungeon, or De Other Side Dungeon in Ardenweald.

60441.description:
Ardenweald was once a place of peace and regrowth, but no longer.

Foes assault the weald from all sides, dark creatures that serve no masters.

They will not be exempted from the hand of justice. We will bring the trials of Revendreth to bear upon them.

They will see what we do to those that must be broken.

I accuse these souls of sins against the Shadowlands. Mete out justice in the name of Revendreth.
60441.completion:
Those that have no masters have learned a lesson today.

We are their masters, in the end.
60441.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
60441.objectives: Complete the Terrors in Tirna Scithe World Quest, the Mists of Tirna Scithe Dungeon, or De Other Side Dungeon in Ardenweald.

60442.description:
Sometimes we need look no further than our own golden hills to find a suitable challenge.

Doubt has crept into the minds of some of the most stoic shieldbearers of the Kyrian people. It has poisoned them against us, and in doing so, harmed the ability of the Shadowlands to heal from this blight.

We must stand against them, now. 

It will not be easy, but things that are worth fighting for rarely are.
60442.progress: Have you seen the face of doubt and shown it certainty?
60442.completion: You have uprooted the seeds of doubt and crushed them with certainty. May their doubts now be about only their own dark paths.
60442.title: Challenges in Bastion
60442.objectives: Complete the Disloyal Denizens World Quest, the Spires of Ascension Dungeon, or the Necrotic Wake Dungeon in Bastion.

60443.description:
We consider the denizens of Bastion to be allies of a sort. Without their service, we would have no souls, and without souls, we could not raise armies, and without armies, we could not smash our fists against one another in the glorious theatre of battle!

<Grandmaster Volo laughs and smashes his weapon around.>

We must aid them against their foes, or else the arena will sit barren, and we can't have that!

Find their greatest enemies and turn their bones into golden dust.
60443.completion: You return victorious, atop a mountain of bloody feathers! Ha ha! Glorious!
60443.title: Challenges in Bastion
60443.objectives: Complete the Disloyal Denizens World Quest, the Spires of Ascension Dungeon, or the Necrotic Wake Dungeon in Bastion.

60444.description:
Our allies in Bastion have long served the cycle of the Shadowlands, delivering souls in need of our services.

Yet, within their ranks, doubt has grown and festered. If this continues, we will all pay.

Their loss of focus shall not be allowed to continue. We will punish their wandering hearts.

I accuse these souls of sins against the Shadowlands. Mete out justice in the name of Revendreth.
60444.completion: The sins of the doubtful have been purged.
60444.title: Challenges in Bastion
60444.objectives: Complete the Disloyal Denizens World Quest, the Spires of Ascension Dungeon, or the Necrotic Wake Dungeon in Bastion.

60445.description:
The purpose of Maldraxxus is to raise the most competent and confident warriors that the Shadowlands has ever seen, to create the perfect army in order to defend us against threats from the outer worlds.

Here, you will find some of your greatest challenges.

Seek out the champions of the strongest houses, stand against them, and let them see your might.
60445.completion: You stand alone atop a pile of bones, as a true master of combat. You have shown yourself a real Necrolord today!
60445.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
60445.objectives: Complete the Chosen Champions World Quest, the Theater of Pain Dungeon, or the Plaguefall Dungeon in Maldraxxus.

60446.description:
Those of Maldraxxus are the chosen warriors of the Shadowlands, charged with defending us against threats from other worlds.

For many years, a careful balance has been maintained between the houses. Now, there are those that have broken this balance, and we are all left weakened and defenseless.

They must pay for these transgressions.

I accuse these souls of sins against the Shadowlands. Mete out justice in the name of Revendreth.
60446.completion: Let this be a lesson to them, Revendreth will not stand by and let the balance be disturbed.
60446.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
60446.objectives: Complete the Chosen Champions World Quest, the Theater of Pain Dungeon, or the Plaguefall Dungeon in Maldraxxus.

60447.description:
In Maldraxxus, the House of the Chosen have taken control of large swaths of land, upsetting the balance of power amongst the houses. To them flock the most seasoned gladiators and warriors.

What better place to test yourself?

Head into the land of bones and blood, and stand against their most powerful minions. Prove true what you know to be inside of yourself.
60447.progress: Have you found the truth in courage?
60447.completion: The mightiest gladiators have fallen to your hand, and in doing so, you have shown that we, too, will defend the Shadowlands if necessary. Let this be a lesson to them.

60448.description:
Those that have taken up arms against us in the name of Sire Denathrius and the Jailer have turned their backs on us all.

Some are mere pawns in this game, others command them. Those that lead the charge of this crisis bear the greatest responsibility. 

They are the mightiest of Denathrius's allies, and they must be brought to justice.

I accuse these souls of sins against the Shadowlands. Mete out justice in the name of Revendreth.

60449.description:
I've never really trusted the Venthyr of Revendreth. Maybe it's those long coats they wear, or maybe it's those pointy teeth, but something about them creeps me out.

Their leader, Denathrius, has sided with the Jailer against the rest of us, so I guess I was right.

I want you to find his most powerful allies in Revendreth and smash them to a bloody pulp. Send him a message from Maldraxxus.
60449.progress: You didn't let them bite you, right?
60449.completion:
I have heard of your bloody exploits in Revendreth, and I am pleased. 

Did you bring me back any of their teeth? No? Well, maybe next time.
60449.title: Challenges in Revendreth
60449.objectives: Complete the Destroy the Dominant World Quest, the Sanguine Depths Dungeon, or the Halls of Atonement Dungeon in Revendreth.

60450.description:
Challenging oneself is a necessary part of ascension, for what is courage in the face of normalcy? 

In this current state of unrest, opportunities abound to prove ourselves. Consider it the gilded lining to a tarnished shield.

None more so than in Revendreth, where Sire Denathrius has consolidated power and influence, and seeks to overthrow the natural order of the Shadowlands.

And here is where you must challenge yourself today.
60450.progress: Have you proven your worth in Revendreth?
60450.completion: Even so far from our fields, you stood strong against the evils you found, unflinching. This is true courage.
60450.title: Challenges in Revendreth
60450.objectives: Complete the Destroy the Dominant World Quest, the Sanguine Depths Dungeon, or the Halls of Atonement Dungeon in Revendreth.

60454.description:
We have been able to do little to stem the flood of souls into the maw, until now. You, Maw Walker, have the power to put a stop to this.

We know little about the Jailer's lands, save that he is powerful beyond imagining.

I ask something of you today that I would not place upon anyone else. You must travel to his lands, and do what you can to slow the growth of his forces.

We must buy more time.
60454.completion:
You have shown us many things we could not see ourselves, and now perhaps we can begin to formulate a plan. 

You have done us a great service today.
60454.title: Storm the Maw
60454.objectives: Kill 3 rare or special encounter bosses in The Maw.

60455.description:
We cannot allow the Jailer to grow in power. You alone can take the battle to his lands, and you must do so, or we will all fall.

Return to his lands, Maw Walker. He has already shown his hand, and we know he grows in power with each passing day.

His forces must be slowed, make what progress you can.
60455.completion:
He has seen you, and you are now marked. Wear this as a badge of honor. None other could have done what you did.

He is not afraid, yet, but he will be.
60455.title: Storm the Maw
60455.objectives: Kill 3 rare or special encounter bosses in The Maw.

60456.description:
We know little about the maw, Maw Walker. Only you have the power to traverse those lands and return.

What I am about to ask of you I would not dare ask of another.

We cannot allow the Jailer to grow in power. You must travel to the Maw and take the battle to his lands.

Make what progress you can, we must slow down his forces however possible.
60456.completion:
We have learned much from your travels into the Maw, and we shall plan for the future.

There was no other way to slow the Jailer's consolidation of power, you have done us a great service, Maw Walker.
60456.title: Storm the Maw
60456.objectives: Kill 3 rare or special encounter bosses in The Maw.

60457.description:
So many souls that should have been nurtured here have been lost to the Maw, it pains me to think of it.

Maw Walker, we ask you now to do that which we cannot. Traverse the Jailer's domain, walk his barren fields, climb his accursed tower.

Bring us that which we lack.
60457.progress: Have you recovered the Anima Embers?
60457.completion: You have done us a great service today, Maw Walker. We shall use these to nourish what we can.
60457.title: Anima Salvage
60457.objectives: Gather 150 Anima Embers from Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

60458.description:
When we ferried souls to the Arbiter, we never thought this would happen. We watched in despair as they were cast into the Maw, one by one, then by the hundreds and thousands.

Souls that have been devoured, consumed, their anima lost to us. Return to us what you can.
60458.progress: Have you secured the lost Anima Embers?
60458.completion: While it is not the same as returning the souls, their power shall not go to waste. You have my thanks.
60458.title: Anima Salvage
60458.objectives: Gather 150 Anima Embers from Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

60459.description:
The Arbiter has done us a great disservice. Our armies dwindle in number as souls are cast into the Maw instead of taking their place on the battlefields of Maldraxxus.

The Undying Army must not be snuffed out. If the Shadowlands are to survive, we must be able to supply our troops.

Travel now into the Maw, Maw Walker, and enter Torghast. Return with Anima Embers to help kindle our supplies.
60459.progress: Have you brought Anima Embers for our stockpiles?
60459.completion: The armies of the undying will not fall today, Maw Walker. You emerge victorious once more in the face of great power, impressive.
60459.title: Anima Salvage
60459.objectives: Gather 150 Anima Embers from Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

60460.description:
Revendreth is not a place that many souls choose to go, but it is a place that they must go. Here, their sins are laid bare before them, and they are broken and re-formed to function in our society.

This is a necessary part of the cycle.

Yet now, the cycle is broken, and are unable to serve our great purpose.

In order for us to do our work we require Anima. Travel to Torghast, Maw Walker, gather that which we can not. Without it, we wither and fade.
60460.progress: Have you brought the Anima Embers to us?
60460.completion: These Anima Embers will serve us well, Maw Walker.
60460.title: Anima Salvage
60460.objectives: Gather 150 Anima Embers from Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

60462.description:
Maw Walker!

The Anima Reservoir is nearly depleted. Without more anima, the groves shall soon wither and die.

Search the realms for additional nourishment and deliver it to the sanctum.

Ardenweald cannot continue without your aid!
60462.title: Anima Appeal
60462.objectives: Deposit 600 anima in the Anima Reservoir at the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.

60463.description:
Maw Walker!

Our anima stores have run low, and soon we will have nothing to sate our thirst...

Seek out additional sources of anima amongst the realms of the Shadowlands and deliver it to the sanctum.

These are dire circumstances. Our fate is in your hands.
60463.title: Anima Appeal
60463.objectives: Deposit 600 anima in the Anima Reservoir at Sinfall in Revendreth.

60464.description:
Maw Walker!

Our anima reserves are nearly depleted. Without an additional supply of anima, our mission of conquest will be lost!

Scour the realms for all the anima you can gather and deliver it here to the sanctum.

Victory depends on your success!
60464.title: Anima Appeal
60464.objectives: Deposit 600 anima in the Anima Reservoir at Seat of the Primus in Maldraxxus.

60465.description:
Maw Walker!

Our supply of anima is dwindling and the reservoir is nearly depleted. We must replenish our reserves before it is too late!

Search the realms for all the anima you can gather and deliver it to the sanctum.

Time is short. Move swiftly, {class}.
60465.title: Anima Appeal
60465.objectives: Deposit 600 anima in the Anima Reservoir at Elysian Hold in Bastion.

60466.description:
You there! Might I ask your help?

I must confess, with the lack of new souls arriving, our supplies have dwindled. We lack the means to clothe arrivals in proper kyrian attire.

Before the forging of the centurions, aspirants trained against the native wildlife. Perhaps there is another way these beasts can prove useful.

If you collect materials from the cloudstriders and larions nearby, we can use them to ensure our new arrivals look the part.

Oh, and some thread from Mirene, if you would!
60466.completion: These are perfect! Go in service, always.
60466.title: The Old Ways
60466.objectives: Collect an Elysian Thread, 4 Cloudstrider Pelts, and 12 Larion Plumes.

60467.description: <Sabina is unresponsive. Her exposed flesh cracked and blistered. Perhaps something with a pungent aroma will rouse her.>
60467.completion:
<Sabina begins to stir. >

Are... are they back? Help... help me.
60467.title: A Rousing Aroma
60467.objectives: Collect 4 Pungent Swarmer Toxin from Ravenous Swarms.

60468.description:
I do not know how long it's been since my captors left me here, but the Light has... taken its toll. 

You must help me escape. The key to my shackles should be hidden nearby. Perhaps among the rubble? That's likely where I'd hide something small.
60468.completion: This looks like it could fit.
60468.title: Rubble Rummaging
60468.objectives: Find a Shackle Key among the rubble within Ashen Traverse.

60469.description:
I cannot recollect what happened. Perhaps the Light has burdened my memory? Who knows how long I've been out here...

The last thing I remember before things went dark... my companions and I had finally found refuge in the shadows. I worry for their well-being. 

So long as my assailants remain at large, my companions could be in danger. Will you find them and ensure they're still safe in the shadows?
60469.completion: They've perished? Are you sure? Who could have done something so cruel...
60469.title: Safe in the Shadows
60469.objectives: Find out what happened to Sabina's companions.

60470.description:
Release me. Please, you must do so. I cannot linger in the Light any longer. 

This unease, it's so... familiar, but it will pass. I will feel myself once again, once I have returned to the shade.

I'll stay as still as silence while you work the lock.
60470.title: Setting Sabina Free

60480.description:
Oi! You.

Not sure what landed you in the Endmire but I need your help.

See these torches? It's my gig to keep 'em lit. But it ain't like they runnin' on flint n' tinder.

My stash of infused rubies got hauled off by some devourers when my back was turned. Can ya find 'em before we both get ate by one of these horrors?
60480.progress: Just going to be clear on this: I... HATE... THIS... GIG.
60480.completion:
Much obliged. These torches keep the effects of the Endmire at bay. Even scares away the devourers for the moment. Only lasts so long though. 

I miss the good ol' days of only having to worry about manifestations down here.
60480.title: The Endmire

60482.description:
After the destruction of our house, the spiders in this area become increasingly hostile. They expand their domain, and prey upon the few survivors that live here. 

There are weapons we could use to help protect ourselves, but they lie hidden within the Sightless Hold, webbed over by the weavers that inhabit it now.

Journey to the hold, use my sightless vision to see the weapons and recover what you can.
60482.completion: You can kill more of them if you want.
60482.title: See With My Eyes

60487.description:
Well... You don't look like the rest of 'em, do you?

<Chiselgrump shrugs.>

Doesn't bother me. Keep my head down and do my job, making sure these sinstones stay in good shape.

Keep breaking my tools, though.

Bring me some more chisels and I'll teach you an old dredger construction trick.
60487.completion:
Yeah, these'll last me awhile.

Alright, I'll show you the trick to making a barricade quickly...
60487.title: It Used to Be Quiet Here

60489.description:
With the anima you collected, we can once again start up the Path of Ascension.

The eternal training ground of the kyrian, the Path is an ancient tradition and favored amongst many of the kyrian, aspirant and ascended alike.

The Hands of Courage, Apolon and Artemede, have stepped up to lead this tradition. Once you herald the Path's rebirth, speak to them to learn more.
60489.completion: By your hand, the coliseum is powered by anima once more. Glory awaits you and your allies in the Path of Ascension!
60489.title: The Path of Ascension

60492.description:
Though the path you follow is not that of a traditional ascended, it is a kyrian path all the same.

To follow it is to bask in the footsteps of the innumerable lives before us, forever in service to a good far greater than we can achieve alone.

To join us amidst such strife is an accomplishment worthy of recognition. Our Archon has called all among us to join her in welcoming you to our ranks.
60492.progress: This is the final step of joining our ranks. Should you have second thoughts, have them now.
60492.completion: May this be but the beginning.
60492.title: A Proper Reception

60493.description:
Before your soulbinds step foot in the coliseum, you must challenge your first opponent.

There is a tradition to this, as with all things. You will need to gather specific items, then bring them back here to fashion armaments to help execute your challenge.

In the case of your first challenge, you will find the materials throughout Bastion. Return to me once you have collected everything, then we will continue.
60493.progress: Though the Path of Ascension leads to glory, participants must remember to stay humble and grounded in the tradition.
60493.completion: You have taken the first steps. A commendable feat!
60493.title: Humble Gatherer

60494.description:
With the materials you gathered, you are now ready to craft your lure.

Report to Dactylis. She will be able to help you craft not only this, but many more items of all kinds later.

Once you craft your lure, return to me and I will give you your next instruction.
60494.progress: Inspired by the Collectors, we must take the time to craft by hand. Through crafting we practice patience, diligence, and humility.
60494.completion: Every time you craft, a piece of yourself is imbued in whatever you create.
60494.title: Your Friend, Dactylis
60494.objectives: Speak to Dactylis to craft 2 Overcharged Goliath Cores and 1 Soul Mirror.

60495.description:
The opponents you train against in the coliseum are not physical beings, but rather manifestations of such.

Your first opponent is one you and your soulbinds have met numerous times before -- the Ascended Kalisthene.

Asking another kyrian to be your opponent in the Path is a great honor, as it tells them that you have much to learn from them.

Go to Aspirant's Awakening and use the cores to summon Kalisthene by calling back to your first introduction. It is as ceremony states.
60495.completion: Kalisthene will train your friends well.
60495.title: A Suitable Opponent

60496.description:
The time of your challenge has come!

As you are not a being of Bastion, you shall act as a tactician for your soulbinds. You have developed mighty bonds between each other... let us see how they handle the coliseum.

Let me know when you are ready to begin. Show us the merit of your bonds!
60496.progress: This is just the first of many challenges ahead of you, {NAME}. Remember to stay humble.
60496.completion:
A lesson in humility. But not one without purpose.

This blueprint will serve you well.
60496.title: Into the Coliseum
60496.objectives: Speak to Artemede to challenge the Path of Ascension.

60497.description:
Sometimes, sheer force of will is not enough. A piece of equipment can save your life.

This blueprint you found can teach you to craft your first piece of equipment.

Bring it over to Dactylis. She will be able to aid you in this as well.
60497.progress: Welcome back. How may I aid you?
60497.completion: Ah, a new blueprint! Let us get started, yes?
60497.title: Herald's Footpads
60497.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Herald's Footpads to Dactylis.

60498.description:
These new footpads can give Pelagos the edge he may need to defeat Kalisthene.

Return to the Path, {NAME}. Equip Pelagos with these footpads and overcome your opponent.

It may take a few tries, but all trials do.

Go in service, and in glory!
60498.completion: More trials lie ahead, {NAME}. Your future experience with the Path of Ascension is yours to guide!
60498.title: Overcoming the Trial
60498.objectives: Defeat Kalisthene in the Path of Ascension.

60500.description:
Our attempts at a parley were met with skepticism, at best. Acquiring the medallions may take more work than originally intended. However, not all hope is lost. 

I do believe that we can win over many of the Harvesters, and for those we cannot, a more direct approach will need to be taken. 

Lord Chamberlain falls into this latter category. His medallion must be taken by force.
60500.completion: With this, we are one step closer to realizing the revitalization of Revendreth.
60500.title: Halls of Atonement: Medallion of Pride
60500.objectives: Recover the Medallion of Pride from Lord Chamberlain within the Halls of Atonement.

60501.description:
<Energies of death and innervation struggle to free themselves from the blade and consume you to your very core.>

<The bonds of warding placed on this blade by Prince Renathal will not hold for long. It should be taken to Sinfall where more permanent arrangements have been made for this prisoner.>
60501.completion:
Denathrius once served a noble cause. His charismatic leadership and understanding of the dark desires were instrumental in the redemption of more souls than your world has known.

Perhaps in time, he could be this again. If the right lessons were to remind him of his true purpose.
60501.title: Redemption for the Redeemer
60501.objectives: Deliver Remornia to General Draven on the edge of Sinfall.

60502.description:
There are whispers of a prisoner within these depths that may be of use to our cause. 

Whether this information can be relied upon is unknown. It is just as likely to be a trap, but still, we must investigate. 
We cannot afford to ignore an opportunity such as this. 

Venture into the Sanguine Depths and recover this valuable prisoner.
60502.completion: This naaru shall prove an invaluable ally.
60502.title: Sanguine Depths: An Ally Within
60502.objectives: Recover the valuable prisoner from within the Sanguine Depths.

60504.description:
To bond souls is but the first step. You must now explore its potential.

Just as Pelagos will gain strength from you, so too shall you grow from him. As your bond grows over time you will touch deeper into one another's souls, and so your strength shall increase. 

All you must do is place your hand upon the Forge of Bonds to augment your bond. There is no price to pay--the only limitation is your connection to our sacred covenant.
60504.progress: This device is merely a pathway to the strength that lies within you both.
60504.completion: May you prove worthy allies to one another in the trials to come.
60504.title: Strengthen the Bond
60504.objectives: Activate a Soulbind Power using the Forge of Bonds.

60505.description:
When our house fell in ruins, Manipulator Zalisar seized the opportunity to reform the house under his leadership. He found few followers and soon vanished into the ruins nearby. 

He has begun to manipulate the spiders and train them to be his soldiers. Spiders under his control have begun to prey upon our forces. We need to deal with this threat before it grows any worse.

I need you eliminate Manipulator Zalisar and his spider forces.
60505.completion: Your help is always welcome, Maw Walker.
60505.title: Spider's Lair
60505.objectives: Slay 8 Razorweb Weavers and Manipulator Zalisar.

60506.description:
It is time to hunt our final prey, the Accuser.

Anima drought or not, her sycophantic adherence to sacred "rituals" flies in the face of the Master's will. I can't wait to see the fear in her eyes.
60506.completion: We meet again. Under dire circumstances I fear.
60506.title: The Accuser

60508.description:
In my visions, I witnessed Tyrande cutting through an endless storm of malevolent, nightmarish beings.

Up ahead... is that...? Yes. I believe it is the very place I saw.

Come. It may hold a clue as to where my mother has gone.
60508.completion:
Some vile force in this place intends to stop us from finding Tyrande.

If experience serves, that means we must be on the right track.
60508.title: On the Trail
60508.objectives: Look for signs of Tyrande Whisperwind.

60509.description:
Right. So, 'em devourers are going to start creepin' out of the Endmire soon. 

And with the anima drought puttin' the squeeze to the fangs... well... we ain't gettin' help from them until it's too late.

Us dredgers could use someone in your line of work. Professional destroyer as it were. 

If you can spare the time, meet me out at the Dredgewood. We'll scoop up a couple of lads and see if we can't make a stand.
60509.completion: I see you decided to get your hands dirty and join us gents in the labor pool.
60509.title: Not My Job

60510.description:
Though we have stopped the creation of more juggernauts, one of their most vile creations yet draws breath. It was born of one of the most pained souls they took from my temple in Bastion.

As I flew above their ranks I could hear their surgeons chanting its name above the din of combat--Woeblade. It is an affront to all the kyrian stand for, an atrocity beyond any other.

Mark it with the flames of courage when you engage, and we will help you destroy it.
60510.completion: May our victory bring them peace.
60510.title: Descended

60514.description:
To be a hopebreaker is to conquer all prey, not just souls.

The Banewood is home to many dangerous creatures: deathwalkers, fearspinners, and the horrifying doomfangs. If you wish to really master the art of the hunt, you should be able to defeat these foes.

Bring me trophies as proof of your conquests. Then, you may just earn my respect.
60514.progress: Have you conquered the creatures of the Banewood?
60514.completion:
<Constantin examines what you have brought him>

Well done. You may make a fine hopebreaker yet.
60514.title: Hunting Trophies
60514.objectives: Collect 3 Doomfang Skulls, 3 Pristine Deathwalker Paws, and 3 Prized Fearspinner Fangs.

60517.description: This vessel appears to be brimming with anima. It is certainly tolls collected from denizens traveling by this crossroads. I am sure with all that is going on, Mistress Mihaela in Darkhaven would appreciate these tolls brought to her to cover the Village Ward's obligations.
60517.completion: What is this? The road tolls! Varaboss, that conniving fiend, never did master his greed. Your kind prefers this precious metal as recompense I believe.
60517.title: The Toll of the Road

60519.description:
Zephyrs herald the Queen's arrival. Hushed silence descends upon the grove.

Wait, watch, and speak when the time has come.
60519.progress: The Queen shoulders so much because of this drought. But she is powerful, and I know we will make it through.
60519.completion:
Gone so soon... the forest must be in even more dire straits than I realized.

<Moonberry looks crestfallen for a moment before resolutely setting her hands on her hips.>

Well, then we'll just have to help ease the Queen's burden. Then she'll have the time to grant you an audience!
60519.title: Audience with the Winter Queen
60519.objectives: Speak to Moonberry and await the Winter Queen's arrival.

60520.description:
Oh, this isn't good. As soon as you left, the spirit's nightmares spilled out all over Tirna Vaal. 

I've done everything to try to soothe her. I've tried singing to her, I've tried telling her stories, but nothing I do seems to calm her.

Please, would you confront and dispel her nightmares? That might be the only thing that will work.
60520.completion:
There, that seems to have calmed her. I can feel her dreams begin to ease.

You really do have a knack for this!

But I'm worried that we're only buying time, and we need to do something more drastic.
60520.title: Nightmares Manifest
60520.objectives: Confront the wildseed's nightmares in Tirna Vaal.

60521.description:
You've done so much, but the Queen's focus is still divided across the forest.

If you want to deliver your message, then we need to help lessen her burden.

Let's start with the Wild Hunt. They are the protectors of Ardenweald, and dealing with the threat of the masked fae has stretched them thin.

Seek out Hunt-Captain Korayn at Glitterfall Basin. Last I heard, her hunting party could use reinforcements.

And don't let her ferocity put you off. She's quite nice as long as you're not her prey!
60521.completion:
Lady Moonberry said she would be sending a strong hand to help secure this grove.

Now, how are you in a fight?
60521.title: Call of the Hunt
60521.objectives: Seek out Hunt-Captain Korayn in Glitterfall Basin.

60522.description:
We of the Wild Hunt are always prepared to return to the cycle in defense of Ardenweald.

I must move on, and so should you. I advise you to return to Droman Tashmur in Tirna Vaal. Others will need your help.

Here, take this. It is a gift and a thank you.

Helping each other is the only way to survive this drought.
60522.completion:
Oh, you have a spirit cradle! That will be quite useful, indeed.

Assuming we can calm this chaos, of course. The wildseed you bonded with is having intense nightmares... and they're manifesting all over the grove!
60522.title: Return to Tirna Vaal

60530.description:
Some force here seeks to keep us from finding Tyrande.

The trail of bodies seems to go into this... stream of souls. 

I suggest we split up. I will follow along the bank of the river. You enter its current and follow the trail.

Should you need me, I will be close at hand.

We will find Tyrande, no matter where this course leads.
60530.completion: Tyrande must see reason. She cannot save the kaldorei if she remains lost within this darkness.
60530.title: The Sea of Souls
60530.objectives: Follow the trail of corpses to Tyrande Whisperwind.

60563.description:
We infuse wildseeds with anima from the animacones we collect in the surrounding area.

But the caretakers are missing, and we have wildseeds in need of an anima infusion.

This is an absolute mess that must be corrected before the Winter Queen arrives!

I've already gathered a basket of animacones. Can you use them to infuse a few of the wildseeds?

I'll show you how it's done, but then I have to look for the missing caretakers.
60563.completion:
Fine work. We mustn't stop tending to the wildseeds that the Winter Queen has chosen to be saved.

Now, perhaps you can lend me a hand with another matter.
60563.title: Tending to Wildseeds
60563.objectives: Collect basket of animacones, then use them on 4 wildseeds.

60566.description:
I am afraid that you must endure the next stretch of the stroll without me, $p.

While my compatriots and I have secured access to the elevator that shall carry us up to Sinfall, we are unable to utilize it.

The Master has redirected a massive beam of Light directly onto the elevator's landing.

Venthyr that get close are obliterated.

Dredgers sent up never return.

We need someone who can walk in the Light to discover what is happening up there.

Lady Sybille will show you the way.
60566.completion:
<Breakfist is badly injured.>

Too many... couldn't make it...
60566.title: Into the Light
60566.objectives: Take the elevator up to Sinfall and investigate the area.

60567.description:
Things are chaotic here in the Tranquil Pools. I'd be devastated if the Winter Queen saw this.

This is meant to be a peaceful place where we give anima to wildseeds.

But with the current drought, starving beasts have encroached on the pools and are trying to feed on the anima themselves.

Sadly, we need to put them down... or else they may endanger the spirits within the wildseeds.
60567.progress: I hate having to do this, but if it's a choice between sparing the beasts and saving the wildseeds, I have to choose the wildseeds.
60567.completion:
Normally, I wouldn't require help from whatever race you are.

Ah... my apologies. That was rude.

Please understand that Ardenweald is home to souls from across all of the mortal realm. It's hard for me to keep track of every race that arrives here.
60567.title: Shooing Wildlife

60572.description:
With all of the anima you recovered from Tirna Noch, it is only a matter of time before my grove becomes the target of every anima-seeking enemy of Ardenweald.

I hope Dreamweaver knows what he is doing with this ritual.

Proceed quickly. Speak with Dreamweaver, and see what needs to be done to aid the spirit within the wildseed.
60572.completion:
You're ready to begin preparing for the ritual? Wonderful.

I am also ready!
60572.title: For the Sake of Spirit
60572.objectives: Speak with Dreamweaver to prepare the ritual.

60575.description:
The local flora have gone somewhat wild during this anima drought.

It seems they swallowed most of the young fae who were tending to the wildseeds here.

At least now we know where they've been.

Oh, don't worry. This isn't the first time this has happened. We can last quite a while inside those plants.

Take my dagger. Use it to cut through the shrubbery and free the other wildseed tenders.
60575.completion:
Great work. This should help get the Tranquil Pools back to normal.

I admit, I had thought the worst when I couldn't find any of the tenders. I'm glad they were only eaten by the local vegetation.
60575.title: Belly Full of Fae
60575.objectives: Free 16 Wildseed Tenders from inside Devouring Hydra.

60577.description:
I have to apologize for the state of the Tranquil Pools. Normally, it's quite peaceful here.

The wildseed tenders tell me that the plants you see walking around have eaten all the animacones intended for use in Tirna Vaal.

Could you rip the animacones out of those plants?

We have wildseeds that are in need of that anima.
60577.progress:
Have you found the animacones? They're still useful, even if they're a little slimy. 

Trust me, the spirits don't mind as long as they get their anima.
60577.completion: The animacones! In this time of drought, we have to scrounge for every bit of anima we can get. Thank you.
60577.title: Hungry for Animacones

60578.description:
I sense that in the spirit's vision, she struggles with the memory of a betrayal that is truly profound. 

Someone as close to her as a brother, turned to an enemy.

Go to the second Dreamshrine in the Basin, and help vanquish the pain of this nightmare.
60578.progress: Have you seen what dreams have come?
60578.completion:
To have an old friend turn against you, in the most terrible way. How very painful. 

But we are so close now, to soothing the spirit within the wildseed.
60578.title: Visions of the Dreamer: The Betrayal

60594.description:
You've been a huge help to Tirna Vaal. I need to bring this anima to one of our newest wildseeds.

I'd love for you to come with me. It's only fair, since you're the one who recovered the animacones.

I'm quite excited for you! Let's go.
60594.progress: The howling wind becomes a gentle breeze. All is well once again.
60594.completion:
Starlight shines within Dreamweaver, radiant and serene.

And... two rivers meet in a lush delta. A wildseed and a mortal, both new to the forest. Bonded by spirit and by fate.

Long has it been since the boughs beheld such an event. The weald will be watching.
60594.title: One Special Spirit
60594.objectives: Go with Dreamweaver to feed anima to the wildseed in Tirna Vaal.

60600.description:
Tirna Vaal is ready for the Winter Queen's arrival! And it's all thanks to you.

You have more than upheld your end of our bargain... and yet I was not able to do the same.

That is absolutely unacceptable for a faerie like me! What would the others think if they knew I had failed to honor our agreement?

Please, allow me to make it up to you. I may not have been able to deliver your message to the Queen, but I have a special surprise that I hope you'll accept instead!
60600.progress: Joy follows Lady Moonberry, a scent that lingers as a flower blooms.
60600.completion: Shadows loom over Heartwood Grove. Things unseen crawl within the darkness.
60600.title: Preparing for the Winter Queen
60600.objectives: Receive Ardenweald's essence from Lady Moonberry.

60605.description:
<A brightly-colored scale fell to the ground as the murloc ran off. It was unlike any other murloc you've seen in Northrend.

Perhaps King Mrgl-Mrgl would know more about this new species?>
60605.completion:
What do you have there? Oh! Isn't this colorful.

You say there's a new band of murlocs down south? That doesn't surprise me, strange things have been happening in the waters far from here, from what I've heard.

Well, if they're friendly, it's up to us to welcome them! Here's a few potions, you're probably going to need them.
60605.title: Glimmerfin Scale
60605.objectives: Show the scale to King Mrgl-Mrgl in Borean Tundra.

60606.description:
First thing's first, they're probably hungry. Life up here in the cold isn't quite as easy as it is elsewhere, and even the most acclimated murlocs sometimes have trouble finding food.

We're going to need to feed them, but also help them find food for themselves.

They're already watching you, so search the area around where you found the murlocs for food sources and show them what to hunt. Then bring the meat to their leader--just look for the biggest one.
60606.completion:
Mrg?

<Glimmergut looks at you, then cautiously takes the crab chunks and hands them to a nearby forager. The forager and Glimmergut appear to have a short conversation about your crab hunt.

Glimmergut turns back to you and points down at the sand.>

60614.description:
<Glimmergut begins to draw in the sand.

The murloc traces the outline of what appears to be a large seal. He points at the picture, then upwards, indicating that the creature must be somewhere on the surface of the water.

The murloc then digs a small, shallow hole in the sand, and points at it several times.>

Mrg! Mrg! Grml.

<He cocks his head expectantly.>
60614.completion:
Grml! Mrgl-rgml. M'gurgle.

<Glimmergut looks at the foragers next to him. They nod, and he nods back.>

60615.description:
<Glimmergut points across the ship. He wants you to take the blubber to someone.>

Mrg m'grrl.
60615.completion: <The oracle takes the blubberfat from you, as if expecting your arrival, and arranges it in a small pile.>

60616.description:
<The oracle draws a circle in the sand, then points down into the deeps. There is something round down there that she is after, perhaps a pearl or stone?

The oracle motions for you to wait a moment before you leave. She waves her hands around frantically, then places them under her mouth, mimicking two large fangs.

You take this as a warning that there may be something waiting for you in the icy darkness.>
60616.completion: <The oracle takes the pearl from you and rubs it gently before peering deeply into its shimmering depths.>
60616.title: Pearl in the Deeps
60616.objectives: Collect the Giant Pearl and deliver it to the Glimmerfin Oracle.

60617.description:
<The oracle finishes peering into the pearl and turns to face you. She appears to be deep in thought, staring directly at you and blinking a few times.

Finally, she nods. 

The oracle points at you, then points upwards. She places a hand a small distance above the ground, indicating something pet-sized.

Your surmise that there may be test of your connection with your battle pets ahead.>
60617.completion: <The oracle looks excited at your return. She points rapidly down at the blubber pile next to her, where an egg has been softly nestled.>
60617.title: Trainer's Test
60617.objectives: Defeat Trainer Grrglin in a pet battle.

60619.description:
<The seems quite excited about the presence of the new egg. You get the sense that this is an important occasion for these murlocs--there may be few eggs left.

The oracle waves a small piece of seaweed in front of you, showing you the young buds of the immature plant.

She warps the seaweed around a small part of the egg, then points at you, then back at the wrapped seaweed.

It appears that the egg needs to be wrapped in more immature seaweed stalks.>
60619.completion: <The oracle wraps the egg gently in the seaweed.>
60619.title: Wrap it Up
60619.objectives: Collect a Warm Seaweed Stalk, a Young Seaweed Stalk, and a Bulbous Seaweed Stalk and deliver them to the Glimmerfin Oracle.

60620.description:
<The oracle pats you on the shoulder, and seems quite pleased with all that you've done.

She holds up one finger, then spreads her hands wide and emits a terrible roar-like murgle.

She points outside, then at you, then your weapon, then nods seriously.

There must be one more trial to await you. It would appear to be a test of strength.>
60620.completion:
<The oracle pats you excitedly on the shoulder, and raises her arm in triumph.

She starts, then points quickly at the egg and rushes over.

The egg begins to hatch...>
60620.title: Guardian of the Smallest
60620.objectives: Slay Great Mua'kin and return to the Glimmerfin Oracle.

60621.description:
Lorkron is here. 

I tracked him all the way from the Glittering Falls. Then I saw the Drust try to flank our forces.

I'd say they were rather surprised that we turned the tables against them.

<Korayn's smile is fierce. She lifts her weapon and her voice to address all present.>

Huntsmen and huntresses, with me! We ride to defend the grove! Take no prisoners and leave none standing!
60621.completion: This attack... It is like they are being driven!
60621.title: Enemies at the Gates
60621.objectives: Reach Droman Aliothe in Hibernal Hollow.

60622.description:
Evading the Mawsworn's scryers requires powerful magical countermeasures.

The prime reagent? A luminescent eye, pried from the skull of a scryer recently shaken from its trance.

The scrying ritual begins as we speak. You will, of course, be compensated only for an intact eye.

Restraint is advised in its procurement.
60622.progress: Well? Do you have it, undamaged?
60622.completion:
Do you think he saw that one coming?

That was an attempt at mortal humor. You may laugh at your leisure.
60622.title: Eye of the Scryer
60622.objectives: Obtain the Eye of the Scryer from Leerok the Scryer in The Maw.

60624.description:
A storm of strife and fear rains down upon Heartwood Grove. Sylvar flee from the flood.

Brave the torrent astride a stag. Becalm the deluge and be the salvation of those who would drown.

Make haste. Time wanes.
60624.completion: We can't leave Heartwood Grove like this.
60624.title: Ride to Heartwood Grove
60624.objectives: Ride a stag to Heartwood Grove.

60628.description:
Strange creatures have been seen lurking just outside the grove. Terrible, ugly things.

Whatever they might be, they are not native to Ardenweald. 

It does not matter how they breached our borders, though. Every one of them must be eliminated.

I sent my best huntsmen and huntresses to slay them, but not one has returned. See if you can determine what has delayed them.
60628.completion:
Only Ara'lon and Lumera survived? The rest have fallen?

<Korayn trembles with unbridled fury.> 

I will see to it that their bodies are retrieved. And this cannot go unpunished. We will avenge them all!
60628.title: The Missing Hunters
60628.objectives: Find Jynkla, Serinkai, Rondar, and Ara'lon.

60629.description:
The Wild Hunt serves the Winter Queen under the leadership of Lord Herne. We are elite fighters, hunters, and trackers.

But we cannot fight without weapons and supplies. The droman here informs me that there are severe obstacles to their delivery.

I do not have time to wait. We need equipment, and we need it now.

See what you can scavenge from the field. A broken weapon can always be mended and put to use again.
60629.progress: Did you find anything of use out there?
60629.completion:
You found far more weapons than I expected.

Very strange. How could they acquire so many of OUR blades?

<Korayn appears troubled.>

They will be used against our enemies again, I swear it.
60629.title: Extreme Recycling
60629.objectives: Slay the Blighted and take their weapons.

60630.description:
I can smell our foes' dark magic, twisting the air and muddling my mind. They are up to something. Bringing awful powers into Ardenweald.

If you see any of their totems, destroy them immediately. 

I always feel better after smashing something to pieces, don't you?
60630.progress: What terrible magic has been brought into Ardenweald?
60630.completion:
If it was not clear before, it is now. This is a personal hunt.

We will rid Ardenweald of this monster.
60630.title: Totem Eclipse

60631.description:
Ara'lon's report matches what I have seen. Too many enemies, and too few of the Wild Hunt to dispose of them on our own.

Fortunately, I feel strongly inclined to take matters into my own hands. And avenge my fallen hunters. 

Let us depart. We will show those monsters the fury of nature.
60631.completion:
We have slain so many, and yet more remain. We must get to the heart of this evil and tear it out.

If we don't, then soon it could spread all across Ardenweald.
60631.title: Big Problem, Little Vorkai

60632.description:
This voice... I have heard it before. Though it is distorted and vengeful now.

He hunts us.

But I am not prey. And I will not let him gloat over his slain quarry. That is not the way of the Wild Hunt.

Though he may draw us to ground of his choosing, we will fight him.

And we will win. Are you with me?
60632.completion:
It cannot be easy for Korayn to hunt one of our own... but she is right. The forest is not safe so long as Lorkron lurks within it.

What a terrible fate... both for those who become possessed, and those who must hunt them down.
60632.title: I Know Your Face

60637.description:
Heartwood Grove was to give up its anima so that other groves could survive.

But then... I started seeing these masks on many of the other fae. Soon, everyone was wearing them.

I don't know what has come over them, but it's clear they mean us harm. Please... you have to...

They aren't the friends I once knew. Not anymore.
60637.completion: Thank you. I tried so hard to save them... but once that mask is on, there is no return.
60637.title: The End of Former Friends
60637.objectives: Slay 8 possessed creatures in Heartwood Grove.

60638.description:
One of my tasks in Heartwood Grove was to tend to the wildseeds.

Some were chosen to be brought back to Tirna Vaal. But now the masked fae are draining the anima from them!

We need to save the ones that remain. I beg of you, recover any surviving wildseeds you can find.

The spirits within them were chosen to be reborn. I won't let them wither away!
60638.progress: We need to split up and rescue as many wildseeds as we can.
60638.completion:
You found more wildseeds! They're so weak... I can't stand to see them like this.

We need to finish this and bring them to Tirna Vaal as soon as possible.
60638.title: Recovering Wildseeds
60638.objectives: Recover 6 Drained wildseeds in the Heartwood Grove.

60639.description:
We were supposed to take the heart of the grove to Tirna Vaal when we left this place to wither.

The masked fae struck before that could happen. They must be after the heart of the grove!

The heart contains all of the anima that was meant to save the other groves. We can't afford to lose it.

Can you secure it? I need to find Korenth, one of our healers. His skills will help any survivors we find.
60639.progress: Do you have the heart of the grove?
60639.completion:
Korenth is... gone? And the heart of the grove has been taken?

Then... then we have much to do.
60639.title: Heart of the Grove
60639.objectives: Bring the Heart of the Grove to Tirna Vaal.

60640.description:
The grove thrives, my mortal friend, but there is yet room for it to grow.

With enough anima, it can nourish even more wildseeds at once. Each one is a spirit that might otherwise be lost forever.

Speak with Zayhad once again, and see to the regrowth of the conservatory.
60640.completion: Your efforts revitalize the grove, and with it, countless spirits in need of aid.
60640.title: Regrowth of the Grove
60640.objectives: Upgrade the Queen's Conservatory to Tier Three.

60641.description:
The conservatory grows hearty and hale. Now, it must blossom anew.

Though it requires much in the way of anima, every additional spirit that the conservatory rebirths returns your generosity tenfold.

Confer with Zayhad, so that this conservatory may grow ever larger.
60641.completion: You have this grove's gratitude. Yet more spirits may now rejoin the cycle.
60641.title: Blossoming of the Grove
60641.objectives: Upgrade the Queen's Conservatory to Tier Four.

60642.description:
You have done much to return the conservatory to its former splendor.

In ages past, this grove was a place of convalescence for spirits who were wounded upon their demise, and needed special care before being reborn.

It was a place rarely used... but now, it is critical to the continuation of the cycle.

Tell Zayhad that the time has come. The Queen's Conservatory must thrive for the good of Ardenweald.
60642.completion:
The conservatory, and the spirits who are tended here, are forever in your debt.

Thank you, Maw Walker.
60642.title: The Grove Resplendent
60642.objectives: Upgrade the Queen's Conservatory to Tier Five.

60644.description:
Now that we have the dagger, it will take the combined will of all of us to sever the weapon's link to the High Chieftain. 

Jaina, Anduin, and I must do our part to keep Baine's spirit grounded, so it will be up to you to deal with whatever force is unleashed when the blade is broken.

Are you up to the task?
60644.completion:
Were it not for your efforts, I am certain my body and soul would be trapped in this forsaken place for eternity.

I owe you my life, {NAME}, and I will fight to my last breath to repay this debt.
60644.title: Draw Out the Darkness
60644.objectives: Draw out and defeat the Withering Presence in Detrithos.

60646.description:
The Mawsworn have begun harvesting the misery of the souls flowing through Gorgoa, the river of souls.

Why? I do not know yet. But it behooves us to stop them.

Destroy the conduits that they deposit the misery into and bring me some samples of their work. 

Perhaps with some research, I can discern their intentions.
60646.completion: Your burden is great, but today you have saved souls from damnation.
60646.title: Misery Business
60646.objectives: Collect 10 Essences of Misery and destroy the Misery Conduits.

60647.description:
The grove's droman is wearing one of the masks. I fear he's going to drain all of the anima from the grove's heart!

That anima is meant for the forest's other groves. If we lose it... then Heartwood Grove would have been lost for nothing...

We'll carve a path to the Shrouded Mire to find the droman before it's too late.

Many of these masked fae have stolen Heartwood Grove's animacones. We must recover them along the way. 

In this drought, every bit of anima is precious.
60647.progress: We can't let the possessed take anything else from us.
60647.completion: So many animacones lost... at least we were able to recover these.
60647.title: Recovering the Animacones

60648.description:
Korenth... I can't believe he's...

We have to save whomever we can. Droman Krelnor is too strong for us to face alone.

I saw a few other survivors scattered around the grove. Hurry, we have no time to waste!
60648.completion: Derawyn... I can't lose her too! We can use the animacones to save her!
60648.title: Survivors of Heartwood Grove
60648.objectives: Rescue Casad, Wagonmaster Derawyn, and Te'zan from the possessed.

60660.description:
I fix these to my arms... then they become wings, yes?

Then I jump off cliff. And fly!

You watch?
60660.completion: Hmm... did not work. What else, what else...
60660.title: Flight Test

60661.description:
We have lost so much... and this one is special.

<Moonberry looks at you, resolute. Her voice is strangely formal, her manner commanding.>

Come, {NAME}. We will carry her on the Path of Rebirth and entreat the Queen to save her.

Hurry and make preparations. We have little time.
60661.completion:
Well met, stranger. You arrive in... interesting times.

<Herne snorts a laugh.>

And with equally interesting company.
60661.title: Dying Dreams
60661.objectives: Take Ysera's wildseed to the Heart of the Forest.

60669.description:
The Horde has come under siege, $p.

The undead Scourge rises like a grim tide, in numbers not seen since Arthas Menethil sat upon the frozen throne. 

And as if that were not concerning enough... something terrible has occurred.

What I am about to tell you, I share in the strictest confidence. This information will be known by all soon enough, but I needed to speak with you directly first.

Allow me to explain.
60669.completion:
Though we must search for Thrall and Baine, we cannot neglect the protection of our citizens and allies in the process.

As such, I have enlisted the aid of those who are experienced in dealing with the Scourge.
60669.title: Cause for Distraction
60669.objectives: Speak with Lor'themar Theron atop Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

60670.description:
I have witnessed the relentless advance of the Scourge firsthand. It is only a matter of time before they swarm our gates. 

The fate that befell Silvermoon must never be repeated. 

Death knights from the Ebon Blade have stepped forward to combat the threat, but even they will need reinforcements.

The Argent Crusade has answered the call once more. I ask that you aid them in keeping our people safe, {NAME}.

Their commander awaits your arrival.
60670.completion:
<Commander Throgg grunts.>

You must be the one.
60670.title: Return of the Crusade
60670.objectives: Speak with Commander Throgg in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.

60671.description:
Hurry! We can use the animacones we gathered to save Derawyn.

I know they're intended for the wildseeds... but we can't let these monsters take anyone else from us.
60671.completion:
The heart of the grove...

We have to get it back... for all those who have fallen.
60671.title: The Sacrifices We Must Make
60671.objectives: Use the recovered animacones to save Wagonmaster Derawyn.

60673.description:
Right, looks like I should let you in now.

Can't promise Mateo will be too kind though. I prefer my old boss, but don't tell him that.

Wonder what happened to her. Denathrius seemed awfully upset when they last spoke.

Anyways, let me just get that door open for ya.
60673.progress: Do you have Mateo's mirror shard?
60673.completion:
He showed so much promise in his duties.

I suppose the promise of power was too much for him to resist. But now is not the time to dwell on such things, {NAME}. Let us proceed.
60673.title: The Traitor
60673.objectives: Kill Sinkeeper Mateo and collect his mirror shard.

60709.description:
Darkness grasps the heart of Droman Krelnor, as he grasps the heart of the grove.

Anima drains from the heart, nectar taken from ripened fruit. It must be stopped.

Foul magic bars the way. Anima in peril, anima the salvation.

Beseech Te'zan. An old soul, brimming with anima, the spark to ignite our hope.
60709.completion: We've lost so much. Why would anyone do this?
60709.title: Recovering the Heart
60709.objectives: Speak with Te'zan to break down the droman's barrier, then confront Droman Krelnor.

60721.description:
This device you see here can be used to send anima to the thirsting wards, aiding our people.

As each ward regains its flow of anima, it will begin to flourish. You may find those that live there ready to aid you in your journeys, or you may even find new challenges that await you.

Once you have brought some anima to our sanctum, use the device to direct it to a ward, and see the results for yourself.
60721.completion:
Anima is flowing to a ward once more. You will want to return to the device periodically and channel more.

As you gather anima and channel it into Revendreth, the flows will grow stronger. Though they will not last for long right now, eventually you will be able to reinforce the channel, making a permanent connection.

With anima flowing into our lands once again, it is only a matter of time until we unite all of Revendreth under our banner.
60721.title: The Anima Must Flow
60721.objectives: Use the Anima Conductor to channel anima to a location in Revendreth.

60722.description:
This device is used to channel anima to our towers across Maldraxxus, empowering our forces stationed at them.

Though you may find the support they offer useful, bear in mind that the anima will likely attract the attention of our foes.

Use the device to direct our stores of anima toward one of our towers. You will soon see what true power can accomplish.
60722.completion:
Yes, yes! I feel the flow of anima. You will want to return to the device periodically and channel more.

As you gather and channel more anima to a tower, its connection to our sanctum will grow stronger. Eventually you will be able to reinforce the channel, making it permanent.

With enough anima flowing throughout Maldraxxus, our armies will be unstoppable!
60722.title: Tower Power
60722.objectives: Use the Anima Conductor to channel anima to a location in Maldraxxus.

60723.description:
This device can soak the roots of our great canopy in anima. The branches thirst for it.

As each of the great trunks is filled with anima, it will begin to bloom once more. You may find those under its boughs ready to aid you, or you may find new challenges that await you in the shade.

Now, bring anima to the sanctum, and use the device to direct it out into the weald. Let the blooms flourish once more.
60723.completion:
The roots are soaked in anima once more. Return to the device periodically and channel more anima, so that all may drink deeply.

As you gather anima and channel it, the flows will grow stronger. While they will not last for long right now, eventually you will be able to reinforce the channel, making a permanent connection.

Soon, all will open their blossoms and bloom in full once more.
60723.title: The Roots Thirst
60723.objectives: Use the Anima Conductor to channel anima to a location in Ardenweald.

60724.description:
So many of my friends have returned to the cycle... all because of those strange masks.

Why did they take my friends? What was the point of destroying the heart of my grove?

You have to return to Tirna Vaal and tell Droman Tashmur what happened here. 

I'll make my way there eventually. I just... need some time to say goodbye.
60724.completion:
Shadows loom over the weald, harbingers of tragedy to come.

The river of fate flows swiftly, its currents inexorable. Where they lead... cannot yet be seen.
60724.title: Heartless
60724.objectives: Return to Droman Tashmur in Tirna Vaal.

60725.description:
We cannot anticipate where and when the Scourge will strike.

In order to mount a defense, the Argent Crusade has set up outposts at several key locations. But we have yet to receive word from them.

Seek out my field officers along the southern road. I expect a full report when you return.
60725.completion:
The situation appears far more dire than we thought...

Commander Throgg must hear of this.
60725.title: Field Reports
60725.objectives: Gather reports from officers in Durotar and the Barrens.

60727.description:
Our forces in Northrend have sent word. Justicar Trueheart requests our immediate assistance.

We must respond to this summons at once, no matter what terrors await us in Icecrown.

A {class} like you would do much to bolster our chances on the battlefield.

You have my word that Orgrimmar will be protected in your absence.

Battle calls, {NAME}. I trust you are ready.
60727.completion: You arrive just in time. Commander Throgg spoke highly of you.
60727.title: A Message from Icecrown
60727.objectives: Report to Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

60732.description:
<The tortured embodiment of the soul before you burns with magmatic flame. Whatever purpose it was meant for here in the cauldron has since been served.

The complete disregard for the remaining husk of this soul is unsettling. These efforts will continue if something isn't done.

Send the inhabitants of Zovaal's Cauldron a message.>
60732.completion:
Rejoice in your accomplishment, but do not forget the weight of your actions.

He is always watching.
60732.title: Disrupting the Flow
60732.objectives: Disrupt the Mawsworn's efforts in Zovaal's Cauldron.

60735.description:
I have given your presence here some thought, {NAME}.

It is clear to me that you are no ordinary arrival from Oribos. I do not know why you are here, nor what you hope to achieve. That alone is simply unprecedented.

You must understand... individuals do not merely come to Bastion on a whim. This fate is earned, and those that are chosen for it are uniquely suited to this existence.

So... I ask you... why are you here, truly?
60735.progress:
<Kalisthene peers down at you.>

What is it, mortal?
60735.completion:
<Kalisthene peers down at you.>

We have heard you, mortal.
60735.title: Trouble in Paradise

60738.description:
I've never seen a wildseed quite like this one. Even the ones that bonded with their caretakers in the past never manifested nightmares like this.

Then again, we've also never had a living mortal in our midst.

We need to bring this wildseed to Hibernal Hollow. There it can receive the care and attention it needs.

I'll place it into the spirit cradle. Can you ask Niya if she would accompany you?

The poor sylvar has been directionless since the fall of her grove. This would be good for her.
60738.completion: I'm surprised that any wildseed could spawn such nightmares.
60738.title: The Way to Hibernal Hollow
60738.objectives: Recruit Niya to help you bring the wildseed to Hibernal Hollow.

60759.description:
It is imperative that these reports reach Commander Throgg, but we are hard-pressed to defend the Crossroads.

Before you depart, I ask that you aid us in thinning the Scourge's numbers. It may grant us the reprieve we need.
60759.progress: In troubled times, the Light guides our path.
60759.completion: You have my thanks, {class}. It will take all of our might to vanquish the Scourge.
60759.title: Damned Intruders
60759.objectives: Kill 6 Cultists and 4 Bloodthirsty Ghouls at the Crossroads.

60761.description:
Deliver these reports to Commander Throgg. He must be told of the full extent of the threat we face.

If we fail to hold the line against the Scourge... then Light help us all.
60761.completion:
I will pass this report onto the Regent Lord. I fear this is only the beginning. 

Word has come from Icecrown. The darkness stirs, and your strength is needed.
60761.title: Return of the Scourge
60761.objectives: Bring Lieutenant Althera's report to Commander Throgg in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.

60762.description:
I have a task for you, Maw Walker.

Souls deemed suitable for service among the Mawsworn are broken down to their barest essence. The resulting creature forms a black shade, devoid of all individual will.

It is a tragic end.

I wish to better understand this process--what is it about a soul that causes this transformation?

Fragments of broken souls rain down across Ruin's Cradle. Bring me some of them, so that I might learn more about our common adversaries.
60762.completion:
It is perhaps... ethically questionable to benefit from these motes, given their source. 

But such knowledge may prove vital in defeating our enemies.
60762.title: Death Motes
60762.objectives: Collect 10 Death Motes from Ruin's Cradle in The Maw.

60763.description:
A message from the Primus of Maldraxxus, you say? We haven't heard from him in... Well, it's been a long time.

This isn't a prank, is it? The Queen doesn't have time for pranks. But I do!

<Moonberry leans in close and whispers to you.>

And for this one, I think we need one more lily.

<Moonberry winks.>

Let me take a look at this message. You bring that last night lily to Featherlight, and then we'll talk.
60763.completion: I hope that your arrival in Ardenweald is a sign that better times are on the horizon.
60763.title: I Moustache You to Lend a Hand

60764.description:
I will fly ahead to Hibernal Hollow and convince the Droman Aliothe to help us. Hopefully she will have agreed by the time you and Niya arrive.

This wildseed seems to take comfort in your presence, so you'll need to stick close to it.

Niya will also need to sing to the wildseed to keep it calm... or else the nightmares may return.

Spriggans love to interrupt our songs, so be on the lookout for them.

Let me know when you're ready to head off.
60764.progress: How strange that such a small wildseed could cause so much trouble...
60764.completion: It's good to see you again. The Wild Hunt could use your help.
60764.title: Soothing Song
60764.objectives: Travel with Niya to take the wildseed to Hibernal Hollow.

60765.description:
Many survivors from the House of Plagues are still in need help. Their suffering fills me with great sadness.

Maw Walker, I'd do anything to help them. Even saving a few is better than saving none.

Please, help me cure them!
60765.completion: You and Roseboil have done well to help the survivors from the House of Plagues.
60765.title: Cure For All Ills
60765.objectives: Use Roseboil's Regenerative Molt to cure 15 Plague-ridden Survivors.

60766.description:
Before you depart... we are in desperate need of reinforcements.

These reports must reach Commander Gregor. But if you would help us thin the Scourge's numbers first, it would grant us a much needed reprieve.
60766.progress: In troubled times, the Light guides our path.
60766.completion: Thank you, {class}. We will need all the strength we can muster in the coming days.
60766.title: Damned Intruders

60767.description:
Deliver my report to Commander Gregor. He must be informed of what we are up against. 

The Scourge's numbers are on the rise, and if they do not abate... then the Light help us all.
60767.completion:
I will see to it that King Greymane and the Lord Commander receive these reports, though I fear this is only the beginning.

This courier has just brought us dire news from Icecrown.

It appears we are not the only ones under assault.
60767.title: Return of the Scourge
60767.objectives: Bring Lieutenant Vernon's report to Commander Gregor in the Trade District of Stormwind City.

60775.description:
Surviving in this miserable place has been difficult, but I must confess... sending a few Mawsworn to a suitable demise does bring me joy.

The soulforgers in Zovaal's Cauldron are among the cruelest minions the Jailer employs. I find satisfaction in disposing of their cores in the very forges which they maintain.

This of course has the added benefit of temporarily slowing down their arms production, if you require more sober justification for your actions.
60775.completion: Next time, ask me how to run a stampede of mawrats off the edge of a cliff. That never fails to entertain.
60775.title: A Suitable Demise
60775.objectives: Throw 5 Soulforged Cores into Soulforges in Zovaal's Cauldron in the Maw.

60778.description:
<Featherlight checks his notes.>

Let's see... There was a request for help regarding an imperiled wildseed and... something about an egg? The original note wasn't entirely clear, but the fae who sent it was... Ah! It was Korenth. Again.

Well, I suppose we'll find out what his trouble is soon enough!

I'll fly ahead and look for him. Stick to the path.
60778.completion:
That was fun to watch! You had that bird ready to build a nest and raise hatchlings!

Oh, how I needed that laugh...
60778.title: Wildseed Rescue

60825.progress:
Your court is infested with spies, Maw Walker.

Necromancers from Maldraxxus, amateurs hoping to ambush me while my guard is down.

I will dispatch any that I come across, but I would prefer to focus my attentions on the court.

Bring me the heads of shrouded necromancers to prove you have some competence in counterintelligence.
Shrouded Necromancer Head (4)
60825.title: Amateur Spies

60827.description:
While the other crusaders regain control of the tournament grounds, you and I must press on.

Our forces previously attempted to set up a forward camp farther into Icecrown, but they were overrun.

With you by our side, I am confident we can reclaim the area.
60827.progress: There is no stopping what has begun. We must continue our efforts.
60827.completion:
Excellent work, {NAME}. 

Preparations are underway. Soon the foothold will be stocked and ready for use as a staging ground.

For the time being, there are other matters that require your attention.
60827.title: Advancing the Effort
60827.objectives: Secure a foothold atop the Ironwall Rampart in Icecrown.

60828.description:
Our preparations are complete. It is time we take the fight to the Scourge.

Justicar Trueheart has tasked me with leading our efforts at the forward camp.

Meet me there and we shall continue our work together.
60828.completion:
Our scouts report increased activity among the Cult of the Damned.

I believe it is time we learn exactly what our fanatical friends are planning.
60828.title: A New Foothold
60828.objectives: Meet Crusader Renn at the Argent Camp atop the Ironwall Rampart in Icecrown.

60839.description:
The Wild Hunt is holding the line against these monsters, lest they overrun the road to Hibernal Hollow.

Too many of my fellow hunters have been possessed by the dark magic of those twisted masks.

But with you here, we might be able to turn the tide. 

Aid any hunters you can find before our foes turn them against us.

I will meet you farther within the meadow. If we rally our numbers, we can bring an end to this battle.
60839.completion: Thank you for rescuing my fellow hunters. We'll have time to respect those who have returned to the cycle when this is all over.
60839.title: Remnants of the Wild Hunt
60839.objectives: Rescue 5 Wounded Defenders from Soryn's Meadow.

60841.description:
Our forces are in danger, and the fault is my own. Believing that the surrounding area was safe, I sent a small team to secure the abandoned camp in the valley to the southwest.

But our field reports were outdated or mistaken. The camp is a lost cause. We must now focus on rescuing those whom I assigned to it.

Head for the camp. Do what you can to save our allies.
60841.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. Your efforts have saved many lives.

From here on out, I will ensure that our scouting reports are accurate and up to date. It seems the threats we face escalate with each passing day.
60841.title: Evacuation Effort
60841.objectives: Rescue 6 allies in the Valley of Lost Hope. Kill 6 Scourge in the area.

60843.description:
Though our scouts have been able to infiltrate the cultist forces at Aldur'thar, sneaking into Mord'rethar has proven all but impossible.

Perhaps it is time to explore other methods of ingress.

Start by investigating the cult's nearby ritual chambers. You may find something of use.
60843.title: Cult Couture
60843.objectives: Collect a Collaborator's Hood and a Collaborator's Robe from the cultists at Aldur'thar.

60856.description:
