A nearby monstrosity has been thwarting our efforts to clear the meadow.

Together, we can bring it down.

You and I will face off against the beast. When the time is right, I will call for the hunt to charge.

The Wild Hunt has suffered too many losses. Today we will claim victory against these monsters!
60856.completion: Fine work, {NAME}. This won't win our war... but it will at least help us in the fight for Soryn's Meadow.

60857.description:
I am surprised--but pleased--that you weren't torn to pieces! Well done.

But now... I fear we have a far more serious task to complete.

The Winter Queen has decreed that Heartwood Grove's anima is to be reclaimed, and its denizens must leave it to wither. Not all of their wildseeds will go with them. In fact, only a few have been chosen to be saved.

We are to bring the final list to Droman Krelnor.
60857.completion:
<Droman Krelnor sighs wearily as he reads the short list of wildseeds.>

At least a few will be relocated to Tirna Vaal.

60859.description:
If you're standing in for Lady Moonberry, then maybe you can help!

Wagonmaster Derawyn was escorting a bunch of us to a new grove when we were attacked by a pack of hungry predators! The wolf be a fast soulshape, so I got away... but some of the little ones weren't so lucky. They're being hunted like prey!

Come on! They're just down the road!
60859.completion:
It's been a while since a new soul arrived in Ardenweald, so each one already here is precious to us.

I'll be sure to let Lady Moonberry know of your heroic rescue efforts on her behalf. She might even decide she owes you a favor!

60861.description:
Though we have been monitoring the cultist presence at Mord'rethar, we have not yet discovered what mysteries lie within its chambers.

Take these robes. Make your way into the inner sanctum and see what you can discover.

This may be our only chance to learn their intentions, {NAME}.
60861.title: Secrets in Shadows
60861.objectives: Use the Collaborator's Robes in Mord'rethar to discover what secrets lie within.

60867.description:
This is troubling news, $p. Whoever this "Banished One" may be, it is clear he is behind the Scourge's return.

That the undead are amassing in great numbers outside Icecrown Citadel cannot be a coincidence. Lead our hippogryph riders in surveying the area from above.

Determine if the dark herald you saw is among them, and then clear a path for reinforcements.

Let us hope she possesses the answers we seek.
60867.progress: The skies over the citadel may be dangerous, but we need to know what we're up against.
60867.completion: With their numbers momentarily reduced, now is our chance to strike.
60867.title: A Message from Above
60867.objectives: Discover the location of Herald Dalora. Destroy the Scourge forces surrounding Icecrown Citadel.

60869.description:
You must bring word of what we have uncovered back to Orgrimmar. One of our mages can open a portal for you at the tournament grounds.

As for the Argent Crusade, we must remain a bulwark against the Scourge. If you wish to continue aiding us, I will see to it that your skills are put to good use.

May the Light protect you, {NAME}.
60869.completion: This is troubling news, {NAME}. To think that Sylvanas would willingly ally with such a dark power...
60869.title: With Hope in Hand
60869.objectives: Establish a portal to Orgrimmar at the Argent Tournament Grounds. Deliver the news to Lor'themar Theron atop Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

60871.description:
You must bring word of what we have uncovered back to Stormwind. One of our mages can open a portal for you at the tournament grounds.

As for the Argent Crusade, we must remain a bulwark against the Scourge. If you wish to continue aiding us, I will see to it that your skills are put to good use.

May the Light protect you, {NAME}.
60871.completion: These are grim tidings, {NAME}. It seems the Banshee has aligned herself with a darker power than we know.
60871.title: With Hope in Hand
60871.objectives: Establish a portal to Stormwind at the Argent Tournament Grounds. Deliver the news to Genn Greymane at Lion's Rest in Stormwind City.

60881.description:
Thanks to your efforts, we have turned the tide of battle. We won't soon forget your aid. 

We should be able to hold Soryn's Meadow, now that this brute is dead. 

Ride with us, {NAME}. Let us return to the road and your wildseed.
60881.completion:
It is good to see part of the Wild Hunt's strength restored... and also that you found the spirit cradle of use.

Now let us bring the wildseed within it to Hibernal Hollow.
60881.title: Ride of the Wild Hunt
60881.objectives: Ride with the Wild Hunt to Niya and the wildseed.

60887.description:
There are people across Azeroth that could use your help, {NAME}. They come from different walks of life, but are all working towards finding their place on this beautiful world.

Examine the Warchief's Command Board and see where your adventure awaits!
60887.progress: I cannot wait to hear your stories someday.
60887.title: Cataclysm: Onward to Adventure in Kalimdor
60887.objectives: Find the Warchief's Command Board in Orgrimmar.

60889.description:
This item will be of great interest to the brokers. 

Per your previous deal with The Night Market, you should bring it to Ta'xera.

You will be fairly compensated.
60889.completion:
Is that a piece of paper?

<You present Ta'xera with the poem.>

A Stoneborn poem! Very few stoneborn express feelings or desires beyond that of the service and loyalty chiseled into them. 

I shall enjoy, I mean, this will make excellent documentation of potential depth to the Stoneborn, you must let me buy it!
60889.title: Favor: She Had a Stone Heart
60889.objectives: Bring the She Had a Stone Hearth poem to Ta'xera at The Night Market in Revendreth.

60898.description:
{NAME}, I have an urgent request to make of you.

Recently, the Wild Hunt has been encountering the masked fae in greater numbers... particularly in the area surrounding Blackthorn Grove. I sent a hunting party to investigate, but they have yet to return.

Ara'lon was leading the hunt. You have offered him aid before, yes? I ask that you do so again.

Search the area for signs of the missing hunters and report back to me.
60898.completion: Keep your voice down. There are masked fae are nearby...
60898.title: The Fate of Ara'lon
60898.objectives: Search near Blackthorn Grove for Ara'lon and the lost hunting party.

60900.description:
The rarest volumes are kept at the top of this tower, protected by an entity called the Archivist.

This stoic guardian is incorruptible. Intractable. Completely uninterested in striking a fair bargain!

Its utter lack of business acumen is really quite upsetting.

Ah, well. I fear we have no choice but to dispatch this impediment. Shall we?
60900.completion:
The volumes are not here!

The Archivist's final words must have meant something. A clue, perhaps?
60900.title: Archival Protection

60901.description:
You have done the Wild Hunt a great service. I must repay you in some way.

The battle for Soryn's Meadow has turned. With the brute defeated, the Blighted forces lose their strength.

Allow us to escort you to Hibernal Hollow.

Speak to me whenever you wish to depart.
60901.completion:
Dreamweaver has told me much about your strange wildseed. 

I will do what I can to help.
60901.title: Passage to Hibernal Hollow
60901.objectives: Speak with Ara'lon to receive an escort to Hibernal Hollow.

60904.description:
The Medallion of Desire rests upon the neck of the Countess. 

It is a source of power for her, but not her only source of power. Claiming it by force would merit us only a short victory. For this we must be much more subtle.

Lucky for us, Theotar has come to me with a plan but he will need your help. Speak with him and see what the two of you can do. 

He was closer to the Countess than any of us for a long time and I would consider him our resident expert on her.
60904.completion: Down for a little espionage and intrigue?
60904.title: Medallion of Desire

60905.description:
Dreamweaver tells me of a ritual to quell the wildseed's nightmares... but it will require anima.

A soul named Proglo lives beneath this tree, gathering anima for the grove's caretakers to use.

His mortal life came to a violent end, and his soul has been skittish ever since. He will not respond well to your current form.

I will grant you the ability to assume the soulshape of a fox. Approach Proglo in your new form to gain his trust and ask for his anima.
60905.progress: I hope we can aid this wildseed.
60905.completion: It's going to be difficult, but I know of a place where there may be enough anima to help this wildseed.
60905.title: Infusing the Wildseed
60905.objectives: Use Soulshape to collect anima from Proglo, then infuse the wildseed with the collected anima.

60906.description:
You have truly proven yourself a hero in the eyes of those who are its absolute judge.

I thank you for giving me the honor of holding it, even for this briefest moment. However, it is only proper that you be the one to enshrine the spear at it's rightful resting place.

Let us meet at Hero's Rest where you can do the honors.
60906.progress: <The resting place of the spear lies before you.>
60906.completion: <Place the Spear of Kalliope in its rightful place knowing that only a true hero can do so.>
60906.title: Rightful Resting Place
60906.objectives: Enshrine the Spear of Kalliope in its rightful place at Hero's Rest.

60907.description:
<This scroll details an invitation for Kleia to join you and Pelagos on the Path of Ascension.

It would be wise to deliver this to her at once.>
60907.title: Ascension Calling: Kleia
60907.objectives: Inform Kleia she is now able to participate in the Path of Ascension.

60910.description:
My hunting party was ambushed not far from here. I narrowly escaped capture, but the others were taken deeper into Blackthorn Grove.

We must find and rescue them, but we are vastly outnumbered. We'll need to disguise ourselves while we search the grove.

See if you can find something we can use to do so. I need just a little longer to recover from my wounds.
60910.completion: Yes! We can use these masks to disguise ourselves.
60910.title: Masks of Deception

60916.description:
Hi, best bud!

Me no go party. 

<Stonehead shakes his head vigorously.>

Got to stay for job!
60916.title: RSVP: Stonehead
60916.objectives: Forge a document to give Stonehead permission to leave his post for the Ember Court.

60928.description:
These disguises will allow us to explore the grove undetected, but beware of the overseers. Their Drust magic will more than likely be able to pierce through our deception.

We need to save the rest of my hunting party while we still can.
60928.progress: The Drust have taken so much from us...
60928.completion:
Gweyir is the only survivor... but she's already been afflicted by the Drust's cursed magic. 

We can't just leave her here. Not like this!
60928.title: Blackthorn Captives
60928.objectives: Locate the missing hunters in Blackthorn Grove.

60930.progress:
<Picky Stefan leans in close and whispers.>

Maw Walker, we are running low on refreshments!

Thankfully, you chose to serve such a humble... "delicacy"  that we can find more just about anywhere.

As you find fungus around the Ember Court, bring them to me and I shall have the dredgers sneak it onto the empty platters.
Wild Fungus (5)
60930.completion: Normally, I would be far more discerning in what we serve our guests, but this crowd seems to lack my sophisticated palette.
60930.title: Lower Your Standards

60932.description:
We may not know who this dark herald serves, but it is clear that the message she brings has emboldened the Scourge and the Cult of the Damned alike.

This cannot be allowed to continue. We must vanquish her and strike a definitive blow against her master's new minions.

Lead the charge, $p. The Argent Crusade stands with you.

Light willing, we will put an end to this madness here and now.
60932.progress: May we continue our fight together.
60932.completion:
It seems that eliminating the herald has slowed the Scourge's advance.

We will have to remain vigilant. Thank you for all you have done, {NAME}.
60932.title: Only Shadows Remain
60932.objectives: Defeat Herald Dalora in the Cathedral of Darkness.

60934.description:
I will do whatever it takes to save Gweyir from the Drust's curse.

Lord Herne must be informed of what befell my hunting party. Deliver my report to him while I escort Gweyir back to the Heart of the Forest.

Gweyir was under my leadership during the ambush... she is my responsibility. I will make sure she gets home safely.
60934.progress: Did you find the lost hunting party?
60934.completion: So Gweyir and Ara'lon are the only survivors... this is grave news.
60934.title: Report to Lord Herne
60934.objectives: Deliver Ara'lon's report to Lord Herne.

60935.description:
The Medallion of Avarice was the tool of the Curator.

With its power it granted her authority over the Catacombs Ward. Combined with her knowledge of the vast library of sinstones Revendreth has accumulated over the ages, the Curator was a master of her craft.

When Denathrius defeated my first rebellion, he tossed both myself and the Curator into the Maw. 

The Curator was clever, though, and she hid the medallion before Denathrius could act. Come, let us speak of plans.
60935.completion:
The Curator is one of the few remaining true venthyr forged during the founding of Revendreth.

Her memory is vast, but her time in the Maw has fragmented the order of those memories.

She will need your help.
60935.title: Medallion of Avarice

60945.description:
<The trident glistens in the sunlight.

This should give your soulbinds the ability to interrupt their foes in the Path of Ascension.>
60945.completion: Trident? Very very nice! I hold on for safe keeping.
60945.title: Deep Echo Trident
60945.objectives: Bring the Deep Echo Trident to Paolone.

60946.description:
<You have discovered plans for a trident that may give your soulbinds an edge in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this piece of equipment.>
60946.completion: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.
60946.title: Blueprint: Deep Echo Trident
60946.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Deep Echo Trident to Dactylis.

60947.description:
<You have discovered plans for a charm that seems to fortify your soulbinds in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this charm.>
60947.completion: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.
60947.title: Blueprint: Charm of Fortitude
60947.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Charm of Fortitude to Dactylis.

60948.description:
The Prince wishes to host court? Well, that should be interesting...

I am sure you understand that one musn't give without receiving something of value in return. It sets a terrible precedent, provides unrealistic expectations, and encourages beggars. 

So you shall do something for me.

House Briarbane is very proud of their new mascot. They have been flaunting it in the streets and irritating the other houses.

Steal it for me, but incriminate one of the other houses in the act.
60948.progress: It would be a shame to waste such a fine mascot on such an unworthy house.
60948.completion: Lovely. That should keep the houses distracted while I attend the Prince's soiree.
60948.title: RSVP: The Countess
60948.objectives: Disguise yourself as a member of House Iremoore and steal the House Briarbane mascot.

60955.progress:
<Noko breathes in slowly.>

The stage manager says he cannot find my flute anywhere.

The last time this happened, one of the rowdy roadies had run off with it.

You can find those troublesome dredgers causing trouble around the party.

Retrieve my flute from them and I will play for your guests.
Noko's Flute (1)
60955.completion:
<Noko holds his flute tenderly.>

I only truly feel like myself while holding the flute of my caravan.

Thank you for providing the opportunity to play.
60955.title: Noko's Flute

60957.progress:
<Lucky Ansel reluctantly breaks gaze with his sinstone.>

My burdens are still far too heavy.

I will never be free of the Maw's dangers while even a single sin remains on this stone.

Luckily, my exceptional music warrants praise from my venthyr controllers, and I am assured that aiding Prince Renathal's court is a worthwhile endeavor.

Retrieve my violin from the band supplies over near the dancers and I will begin my public penance.
Ansel's Lucky Violin (1)
60957.completion:
<Ansel turns his violin as it sparkles in the light.>

Let the show begin.
60957.title: Ansel's Lucky Violin

60960.progress:
I am nervous, {NAME}. Music lays bare my soul for all to see.

And while this sinstone reminds all of the darkness within me, I hope that my music will expose the light that also dwells within.

Lord Garridan at your embassy agreed. He as most kind and enjoyed the music I played for him when I first arrived.

I must've left my lute with him. Please retrieve it for me while I continue my pre-show meditation.
Chiu's Lute (1)
60960.completion:
<Chiu speaks to the lute while she quickly tunes its strings.>

What did those dredgers do to you, old friend?
60960.title: Chiu's Lute

60973.description:
<You have discovered plans for a phial that may give your soulbinds an edge in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this piece of equipment.>
60973.completion: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.
60973.title: Blueprint: Phial of Serenity
60973.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Phial of Serenity to Dactylis.

60974.description:
<Your steward friend gave you an extra bottle to store this potion in.

This should keep your soulbinds fighting in the Path of Ascension, as your phial does.>
60974.completion: Phial? Very nice! Just like friend! I hold on for safe keeping.
60974.title: Phial of Serenity
60974.objectives: Bring the Phial of Serenity to Paolone.

60975.description:
<You have discovered plans for a shield that may give your soulbinds an edge in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this piece of equipment.>
60975.completion: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.
60975.title: Blueprint: Spiritforged Aegis
60975.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Spiritforged Aegis to Dactylis.

60993.description:
The medallions, the source of magic the crown focuses, are still bent to the will of Denathrius. 

Forge cannot solve this. Citadel of Loyalty can.

Taken over by the Forsworn in recent times. If we can get the crown to the temple, we can break the loyalty to the medallion's former master.
60993.completion:
Here we are. I'm glad we have your friends here too.

We are going to need it if we hope to reach the temple.
60993.title: Citadel of Loyalty
60993.objectives: Meet Mikanikos at the Citadel of Loyalty.

60994.description:
We can alter the crown to expunge Denathrius's corruption in the medallions.

Problem, Forsworn have set large barrier protecting the temple. Only there can Denathrius's influence be truly broken.

Drain the anima from the barrier's sources that power it. Barrier will disappear.
60994.completion:
Excellent work. 

Barrier around the temple is gone. To fix the crown, we must go there.
60994.title: Lowering Their Defenses
60994.objectives: Drain the anima from the Forsworn Barrier Sources.

60995.description:
There are many enemies of Bastion here. 

If we thin their numbers, it will further mend the tension between our realms. 

Show no remorse. 

I will take to the skies to support from above. I will be able to provide ground support when needed.
60995.completion: Forsworn defeated? Good. The fewer of them there are, the happier I am.
60995.title: Disloyalty
60995.objectives: Kill 15 Forsworn in the Citadel of Loyalty.

60996.description:
The temple is now accessible. We must go now to aid Mikanikos in breaking the Sire's influence on the crown.

Prepare yourself. Denathrius's magic has always been potent and destructive. 

This won't be easy.
60996.completion:
With the echo of Denathrius defeated, Mikanikos assures me the crown is pure.

This is a key victory for Revendreth and all the Shadowlands.
60996.title: Face Your Fears
60996.objectives: Speak to General Draven to go to the Temple of Loyalty. Then, aid Mikanikos in purifying the Crown of the Harvesters.

61050.description:
One venthyr cannot wear seven medallions and command the power they bestow, nor command respect from anyone looking at them.

What I propose is the crafting of an artifact that can contain the power of the medallions. Focusing that power to one wielder.

Unfortunately, Revendreth lacks the craftsmanship needed to channel such powers. Not without turning the wearer into a puppet of Denathrius.

No, for this, we must employ the aid of a realm that specializes in service.

Draven has the details.
61050.completion:
After much strategizing, the Prince and I have developed a plan that requires the aid and resources of someone I once led actions against on behalf of the Master.

Prepare to shield your eyes. We need to go to Bastion.
61050.title: How to Wear Seven Medallions

61051.description:
Of all the foolhardy, misguided, exasperating...

<Guardian Kota snorts and stomps a hoof.>

But standing here does Sha'lor no good. We must find him and bring him back safely.

Come, meet me at the Autumnal Rise. We can survey the burrows below and see if there is any sign that he lives.
61051.completion:
No!

Whatever that beast was, it's taken Sha'lor!
61051.title: The Absent-Minded Artisan
61051.objectives: Search for Master Sha'lor on the Autumnal Rise.

61057.description:
You have shown strength, cunning and compassion since your arrival in Ardenweald. These are the values the greatest hunters possess. 

It has been a privilege to fight by your side, {NAME}. It would be my honor to continue, as your Soulbind.
61057.title: By Trials Forged
61057.objectives: Complete the soulbinding ritual with Korayn.

61058.description:
I knew you were something special when Ysera's wildseed reacted to you. Without you, she would have been lost! It would have been a tragedy not just for Ardenweald, but your world as well!

Since then, I have seen you take on many more tasks to help others in need. With your help, Ardenweald grows stronger.

I would be honored to help you continue the good work you have been doing, and to become your soulbind.
61058.progress: I am humbled by the care you have shown for others.
61058.completion: I just know that together we can save Ardenweald and all the spirits who slumber here.
61058.title: Bound in Dreams
61058.objectives: Complete the soulbinding ritual with Dreamweaver.

61059.description:
I heard about the prince wanting Rendle and me at 'is court. I aim to please 'im an all, but Rendle says 'e  haven't got proper ah-tire.

Says 'e needs a sootible hat, maybe somethin' posh that hints at 'is inner depths.

He says the only good hats are: Red Noggin Candle, or one a them Fae Revel Masques. Or mebbe a Pink Party Hat, or a fancy Crown o' the Righteous.
61059.completion: Wot a hat! Rendle will be the talk of the court, 'e will.
61059.title: RSVP: Rendle and Cudgelface
61059.objectives: "Sootible" hats may be crafted by players who have the recipe and appropriate tradeskill.

61061.description:
There is one who may know how to dispel the curse from Gweyir.

In the mountains of Drustvar lives Ulfar, an ancient Thornspeaker who sided with the humans of Kul Tiras against his fellow Drust.

Journey to his den and ask for his wisdom. He may hold the answers you seek.

Lord Herne and I will tend to Gweyir once she arrives with Ara'lon.
61061.completion: You have come from beyond the veil to seek my wisdom? A long journey indeed...
61061.title: Ulfar's Guidance
61061.objectives: Speak with Ulfar at Ulfar's Den in Drustvar.

61075.description:
Gorgoa is a protean force fueled by souls that trickle in from many worlds. They wash in from the head of the river, a place they have named the Crucible of the Damned.

The Jailer's unblinking eyes patrol the river and watch for souls who attempt escape.

Blind the eyes that find them. Close them for good. 

Take this and do what must be done.
61075.progress: Have you closed the Jailer's eyes?
61075.completion: Well done, Maw Walker. The Jailer's eyes are dangerous, indeed.
61075.title: A Spark of Light

61076.description:
I know the curse of which you speak. Dark magic that possesses the mind of the afflicted.

Long ago, the Drust were ruled by a sorcerer king named Gorak Tul. It was he who twisted our rituals and set us on the path of death and domination.

You will need to claim a portion of his power to break the curse. 

Take this fetish to Gol Inath and temper it in the Flame of Oblivion. But beware... it is a vile place, and danger lurks among its shadows.
61076.progress: Gorak Tul's magic empowers the curse, and only his magic can break it.
61076.completion: I can sense Gorak Tul's dark power seething within this fetish. Handle it with caution, {class}.
61076.title: Into the Flame
61076.objectives: Imbue the Drust Fetish with the power of Gorak Tul.

61077.description:
Thanks to the raid launched against Castle Nathria, we have obtained an opportunity.

A soul, powerful and fused with dark purpose at the hands of the Master's experiments. 

Given this soul is from Azeroth, the Accuser has asked for your assistance in untwining the corruption done to his sinstone.

the Accuser awaits you in the lower levels of Sinfall.
61077.completion:
I make no presumption that all mortals from Azeroth know each other. 

When confronting a challenging soul like this, however, it helps to offer even the faintest of familiarity.
61077.title: Confronting Sin
61077.objectives: Speak with the Accuser in Sinfall.

61079.description:
The Mawsworn's torturers have a talent for misery.

The suffering they inflict often produces more stygia than they can collect. The excess floats loosely in the air, left to drift into the abyss.

I have fashioned a conduit specifically for capturing the leftover stygia. You can borrow it if you wish.

There are a handful of prime gathering locations throughout Calcis. As you'll be using my conduits, we can split what you find upon your return.
61079.progress: Were the conduits effective? How much stygia did they collect?
61079.completion: It is satisfying to know that the Jailer's share now belongs to us. Well done, Maw Walker.
61079.title: The Jailer's Share
61079.objectives: Place 4 Stygia Conduits at marked locations within Calcis in The Maw.

61088.description:
The Mawsworn never cease to invent new forms of suffering.

Even the ground on which we tread is formed from souls pounded into dust. With the flood of souls passing through Gorgoa, the Mawsworn are keen to expand their domain.

At present, the Mawsworn are burying souls and crafting new terrain from their torment. It is not too late for some of them.

Free the buried souls and stop the endless expansion of suffering.
61088.completion: The curious forms of torment the Mawsworn invent will never cease to amaze me.
61088.title: Dust to Dust
61088.objectives: Rescue 8 Half-Buried Souls in Calcis in The Maw.

61092.description:
I'm busy, so I'll get right to the point. 

The only way I'm going is if you pay me enough coin to make it worth my while or you amuse me. 

As interesting and enjoyable as the Ember Court may be, I lose money every time I am away from here. That said, I do love a good slaughter.

So, coin or deaths. Take your pick.
61092.progress: You need to cough up the coin or get killing.
61092.completion: That works. I'll be there. It will be a nice vacation.
61092.title: RSVP: Grandmaster Vole
61092.objectives: Convince Grandmaster Vole by bribing him or slaying players of the opposite faction.

61096.description:
We will all suffer if Bastion and Maldraxxus fall into war.

For some time, the Necrolords have been isolated. You must travel to their realm and seek the truth of their incursion.

Though our anima reserves remain low, they will be enough to open the way for you.
61096.title: The Arbiter's Will
61096.objectives: Meet Kah-Sher in the Ring of Transference in Oribos.

61099.description:
I dare not step inside that accursed tower myself, of course.

While I cannot tell you exactly where your comrade is being held, I offer a gift to assist you.

Use it inside Torghast. It should take you somewhere near your missing ally. Baine Bloodhoof was his name, yes?

Either that, or you'll end up trapped within the tower's ever-shifting halls for all eternity.

But those are the risks one must take, I suppose. Best of luck!
61099.completion:
Finding Baine was no easy feat. But you braved the horrors of that tower and succeeded.

Well done.

But I fear your work is only just beginning.
61099.title: The Search for Baine
61099.objectives: Enter Torghast and search for Baine.

61102.description:
In my youth, I was mentored by a wise and powerful Thornspeaker named Kivarr. She passed from this world long ago, but her soul may yet rest within the Shadowlands.

Kivarr's knowledge is ancient and vast, far eclipsing my own. She may be able to offer you the guidance that I cannot.

Seek her out. Deliver the fetish to her. She will know what to do.

May the wind be your guide.
61102.completion: Kivarr... yes, I have heard of someone by that name. Ara'lon may know where to find her.
61102.title: Kivarr the Thornspeaker
61102.objectives: Speak with Lord Herne at Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.

61104.description:
There are many powerful lieutenants among the Mawsworn, but there is one who is particularly important to the Jailer.

Far beneath the Tremaculum lives the Jailer's prime interrogator, Grathalax. Power is fed to him via conduits throughout the area.

His role is to make the process of anima extraction more efficient. His methods are... unkind.

I believe we would both benefit from the end of his existence.
61104.completion: The end of Grathalax will deal a great blow to the Jailer's infrastructure. Well done.
61104.title: Grathalax, the Extractor
61104.objectives: Defeat Grathalax underneath the Tremaculum in The Maw.

61105.description:
Oh! This sounds like a wonderful opportunity to do field research in Revendreth, apprentice.

I look forward to collaborating with new colleagues. We must bring a gift to thank them for their invitation. What could be more appropriate than some lovely slimes?

Please pick some of the best slimes for me to present to our host. Just bring them to Kevin so they can make friends and travel together.
61105.progress: Have you finished choosing our gift slimes yet, apprentice?
61105.title: RSVP: Plague Deviser Marileth
61105.objectives: Herd Bubbling Oozes to Kevin so Plague Deviser Marileth has a present to bring to the Ember Court.

61107.description:
It is imperative that you identify the cause of the attack on Bastion.

We will require your aid to open the gateway. Once the focus is sufficiently powered, we will call upon the gate to Maldraxxus and direct it into position.

From there, the fate of this war must rest upon your shoulders.
61107.progress: Time is precious, now more than ever.
61107.completion: The way is open. The eternal battlefields of Maldraxxus await you.
61107.title: A Land of Strife

61109.description:
I am a Captain of the Wild Hunt, a defender of the sacred groves. As much as I would enjoy the diversion, my place is here fighting back the forces of the enemy, not venturing outside of Ardenweald.

Eggs are hatching again at Gormhive and we shall soon be overrun by gormling larva. Until that threat is neutralized I cannot leave my post.
61109.completion: Well done. Thank you for the help.
61109.title: RSVP: Hunt-Captain Korayn

61112.description:
<The bile-soaked cloth bears a deathly odor. Upon closer inspection, it appears familiar. The insignia of the Argent Crusade is unmistakable.

Commander Gregor will want to know of this at once.>
61112.completion:
This... This is from one of our own... from within the city walls.

I will send word to our patrols. Remain alert, {NAME}.

Should the Scourge rise up from within our own ranks, find me at once!
61112.title: A Hunger for Flesh
61112.objectives: Bring the Partially Digested Cloth to Commander Gregor in the Trade District of Stormwind City.

61113.description:
Kivarr... I have not heard that name in many an age.

She used to make her home near Eventide Grove to the south. Ara'lon knows the area well. I suggest you take him with you.

I fear that the situation with Gweyir weighs heavily upon him. Perhaps joining you on the hunt will do him some good.
61113.progress: Kivarr has made her home in Ardenweald for many an age, but she has always kept to herself.
61113.completion: This is the place, but Kivarr is nowhere to be found...

61114.description:
<The bile-soaked leather bears a deathly odor. Upon closer inspection, it appears familiar. The insignia of the Argent Crusade is unmistakable.

Commander Throgg will want to know of this at once.>
61114.completion:
This... This is from one of our own... from within the city walls.

I will send word to our patrols. Remain alert, {NAME}.

Should the Scourge rise from within our own ranks, find me at once!

61123.description:
I must politely decline your Prince's offer.

My skills are needed here, and I am not particularly well-suited to the social demands of attending court.

Perhaps the Paragon of Humility would be a better representative for Bastion.

You may find him at the Temple of Humility, east of here.

Please express my sincere regrets that I am unable to attend.
61123.completion:
Thank you for the reminder that sometimes duty calls me to do things that I find uncomfortable.

<Polemarch Adrestes salutes you.>

61129.description:
I serve my Queen and abide by my oath to guard this hollow and tend the spirits it encloses. 

Once, I might have enjoyed your Prince's party, but I am no longer suited to revelry.

My world was destroyed long ago, and perhaps I have lost the joy I felt as its wild guardian. I would dearly like a reminder of my old home.

I have heard those strange traders, the brokers, have unusual objects from other worlds. 

Perhaps they have something from mine?
61129.progress: Have you found a reminder of my home for me?
61129.completion: That scent! I would know it anywhere. My den was surrounded by this plant! Thank you. I will keep this token close to me to remember the joyous times.

61130.description:
Hello, {NAME}! Sika like to help. So much to do.

Would go to Ember Court, but too many things only Sika can do. Very sorry.
61130.progress: Busy, busy. Too busy. No one else can do all the things.
61130.completion:
What's in notes? Others need more help from Sika?

<Sika takes in a deep breath.>

Sika can do. Sika always helps.
61130.title: RSVP: Sika
61130.objectives: Find others in Olympic Village to take on Sika's tasks so she can attend the Ember Court.

61135.description:
With this greatest of gifts from Ardenweald, we have the final piece to rebuild the Crest of Ascension.

Let us make certain Willowblossom's sacrifice is not in vain.
61135.progress: <The vessel seems drawn to the spot.>
61135.completion: <Willowblossom's essence will suffuse the crest, completing it so Bastion can once more invest new Ascended.>
61135.title: Heart of the Crest
61135.objectives: Place the Vessel of Ardenweald at the Crest of Ascension.

61139.description:
Oooh a party! I love parties.

My friends have to come too or it's just not as much fun. Ask them please! You need to find Awool, Rury, and Slanknen so we can go together.
61139.completion: Hooray! We are going to a party.
61139.title: RSVP: Choofa
61139.objectives: Make sure all of Choofa's friends are able to attend the party.

61143.description:
There may be a way to break the curse and free your friend's mind, but it will require some work.

Ulfar was wise to send you to me. He knew that a portion of Gorak Tul's power would be necessary, but the other reagents we need do not exist on Azeroth.

My den is not far from here. Meet me there and I will help you prepare a ritual to break the curse.
61143.completion: It feels good to be out of that cage and back home in my den.
61143.title: Return to the Den
61143.objectives: Meet with Kivarr at her den in Ardenweald.

61145.description:
Our scouts report that Margrave Gharmal gathers their forces at the House of Constructs.

Our necropolis and our new kyrian allies have already begun an aerial assault. I need you to lead our forces on the ground.

Meet me within Zerekriss. We will begin our attack immediately.
61145.title: Take The Fight To Them
61145.objectives: Take the portal to meet Draka aboard the Zerekriss.

61146.description:
As you know, shedding our memories of life can result in dangerous creatures known as manifestations. They have increased in number and strength as of late, but I believe we can find use for them yet.

Manifestations carry great power within them--power we may purify and use in our own creations at the forge here. In making something positive out of such negativity, we do a noble act of service.

Simply eliminate any you come across, and collect their essence. That is all.
61146.progress: Be cautious in your travels. Manifestations are no simple foe.
61146.completion: These will do quite nicely! Go in service, Maw Walker.
61146.title: Manifesting Power

61156.description:
In times long past, Aspirants trained against the fauna of Bastion. The creation of the Centurions rendered such unstructured progression obsolete.

The many flying denizens of this realm are known for their quills. They are light and sturdy, perfect for our purposes.

Gather all that you can, please. Any flying creature shall suffice.
61156.completion: Acceptable portion received. You have my thanks.
61156.title: Where There's a Quill...
61156.objectives: Collect 30 Shimmerflight Quills from flying beasts.

61157.description:
The horned beasts of Bastion were once commonly used in aspirant training, but centurion sparring units have mostly taken their place. Over the past few eons, their numbers have grown and now must be culled.

Their horns are critical components to our work. Many specimens are broken from use in battle--they will not suffice. You must be careful in collecting them.

Face them, defeat them, and bring back their horns.
61157.progress: We require as many horns as you are able to procure.
61157.completion: Acceptable quality and quantity level. Thank you.
61157.title: Straight to the Point
61157.objectives: Collect 12 Elysian Horns from horned beasts.

61159.description:
All members of the Forsworn carry an insignia on their person at all times. We suspect they are imbued with the power of the Temple of Loyalty, bolstering their strength against us.

Collect these insignias from their deceased forms. Strip them of this power, and we shall put it to better use in our own machinations.

Such is the Archon's will, as it is ours.
61159.progress: Each insignia is a shift of power in our favor.
61159.completion: These will prove most useful. Well done.
61159.title: Signs of Demise
61159.objectives: Collect 20 Forsworn Insignias from Forsworn kyrian.

61166.description:
Centurions need lots of parts. But so do we!

Kofi needs their metal. Can be from Centurions or the ground. Your choice!

Not too damaged, ok? Hard to clean!
61166.completion: This is HEAVY metal! Just like Kofi's favorite music!
61166.title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
61166.objectives: Collect 20 Resonant Alloy from Forsworn centurions or Centurion parts.

61171.description:
The Drust will pay for this foul curse that they've unleashed upon us.

We have lost too many allies... too many friends to give up now. Even though we cannot save those who have fallen into possession, we can end their torment. I will instruct the hunt to put down all possessed they encounter.

Please deliver this report to the Winter Queen. She must be told what we have learned.

Thank you for your service, {NAME}. You are a true friend and guardian of Ardenweald.
61171.completion: If the Thornspeakers have no way to break the curse, then perhaps there truly is no hope for the possessed. These are tidings most dire.
61171.title: Unbroken Bonds
61171.objectives: Deliver Lord Herne's report to the Winter Queen.

61173.description:
Ember Court sounds interesting ... but very busy right now! Forsworn got into my supplies. Now everything jumbled and disorganized. Can't work in these conditions. My workshop isn't right!

Help me! Get parts. Most will be damaged and you don't know how to tell about flaws. Bring me many to examine. I will find perfect part.
61173.completion: Perfect one here! See? Rest are bad for my construction. You keep.
61173.title: RSVP: Mikanikos
61173.objectives: Assist Mikanikos by gathering potentially perfect parts so he can finish his construction and attend the Ember Court.

61174.description:
I am no stranger to courts, Maw Walker. Having attended on Queen Azshara herself, and then later serving my Lord Illidan.

That does not mean, however, that I accept every invitation I receive.

<Baroness Vashj smirks.>

Impress me with your strength, $p, and I will believe Prince Renathal has power that is worth my time.
61174.progress: Where are the heads of your enemies?
61174.completion:
<Baroness Vashj nods approvingly at the display of heads you placed before her.>

With your power behind the Prince's efforts, I suppose that I had better pay attention.

Very well. I will pay a visit to Prince Renathal and attend his Ember Court.
61174.title: RSVP: Baroness Vashj
61174.objectives: Gather the heads of fearsome foes to present to Baroness Vashj.

61179.description:
The Eternal Forge has anima again?

Ah! Yes! So exciting!

You must go. Find Forgelite Selene. She will help! So much to make!
61179.completion: Beautiful, is it not? I was not sure if I would ever see the forge empowered so ever again.
61179.title: Forge Ahead
61179.objectives: Speak to Forgelite Selene at the Eternal Forge.

61180.description:
The scroll you recovered details all manner of horrific ways to 'integrate' fallen kyrian into Gharmal's constructs.

It is also incomplete. There must be more of these among Stitchflesh's remaining followers.

I saw a number of surgeons and their lackeys retreat into the Hall of Chains just ahead as we arrived. I suspect they hold more of these scrolls.

We must ensure they are never read again.
61180.progress: This foul work must be destroyed.
61180.completion: Well done. I will see that these are destroyed personally.
61180.title: Burn Before Reading

61182.description:
You know Twirlpetal flowers?! They spin around in the light!

We need pollen. Only pollen if in bloom!

Get a bunch! Flowers in golden fields. And they spin! Round and round!
61182.progress: Pollen very fragile. Won't last long!
61182.completion: So much! Yes, yes, great! Perfect!
61182.title: Pollen Your Weight
61182.objectives: Collect 30 Twirlpetal Pollen in Bastion's plains.

61193.description:
Need Firstborne's Light! You know?

Named after Archon! Always in water. Kofi's favorite!

Shine big light when grown. And go to shore! Easy to see!
61193.progress: Only grown flowers! Little ones won't work.
61193.completion: SO SHINY! Kofi need shades next time!
61193.title: A Light Touch
61193.objectives: Collect 15 Firstborne's Light in water sources.

61196.description:
At times, even the most seasoned kyrian may have difficulty meditating. Recently, such problems have become increasingly common.

There is a special draught crafted from our purest waters that can be used to focus the mind. I believe it may prove useful in our work here as well, perhaps as a catalyst for more potent reactions.

Will you gather some? Move swiftly, for the liquid becomes unstable once removed from our sacred pools.
61196.progress: Were you able to find the draught?
61196.completion: I will put test these samples at once! You have my thanks.
61196.title: The Secret Ingredient

61199.description:
Many battles here. Especially lately!

Now weapons all over. Too many. We can use!

Go to big battle places and grab them. We will use better!
61199.title: Arms Day

61209.description:
Though we kyrian cease to be should we perish in battle here, there is much power within Bastion itself that can call forth echoes of our former brothers and sisters.

These memories wander the roads. At times, they take on some purpose they served in their eternity here--crafting goods, guarding our sacred grounds, and the like.

Take my lyre. Its ancient melody will dispel the memories, and in the process charge it with the residual energy of our realm.
61209.completion: The lyre thrums with power! We shall make good use of it.
61209.title: A Somber Melody
61209.objectives: Dissipate 15 Kyrian memories along the roads of Bastion.

61226.description:
We cannot carry out the baroness's plans alone. What she proposes will require a well-coordinated unit.

Three individuals maintained Nurakkir alongside me. When the necropolis fell, two of my soulbinds fell with it.

There remains a single soul paired with mine. My sister, Xennir, survived the wreckage--though grief besets her.

Meet with Xennir. Guide her through her trauma, and return when she is ready to rejoin the fight.
61226.completion: We have suffered so terribly. I must preserve what I still have.
61226.title: Extra Limbs

61227.description:
It is a fool's errand to command a necropolis without someone to repair it and keep it airborne. Nurrakir's mechanic was slain in the crash.

But opportunity arises in dire times. Vyn has told me of an... altercation among the constructs. One of their own resisted the reckless scavenging of Nurakkir, and was promptly detained for his objections.

Find this individual. An enemy deserter could make for a potential ally.
61227.completion: So you need a mechanic? Well, you're in luck!
61227.title: The Other Foot

61230.description:
It takes a particular kind of magic to pilot a necropolis. The Eyes' helmsman perished with Nurakkir.

But Baroness Vashj has informed me of a means to acquire a new helmsman.

Follow me to our house's communications beacon. My baroness has taught me a way to summon just the individual we require.

I suspect she will not be pleased at the prospect of serving us. I trust you will encourage her compliance.
61230.title: Outside Influence
61230.objectives: Meet with Khaliiq at the House of Eyes' communications pillar.

61246.description:
The necropolis is nearly in position. Now is the time to strike!

We must force Gharmal into the open together. Join me on my roc, and we will unleash your runeblade's power on the juggernauts.

The Margrave will be unable to ignore their deaths. Once they leave their blighted tower, we can finish them once and for all.
61246.progress: Every moment the juggernauts remain standing, our position is in jeopardy!
61246.completion: Such power! Gharmal will have no choice but to face us now.
61246.title: Power of the Chosen

61252.description:
We will do just as my baroness commands. Let us conjure a helmsman before us... however displeased it might make her.

Activate the beacon and prepare yourself for a fight. The liches regard all Eyes as their enemies, and I am certain your reputation among them does you no favors.
61252.completion: My baroness's trust in you is well warranted.
61252.title: Call In a Favor
61252.objectives: Summon Helmsman Caliroux and defeat her.

61255.description:
It would be an honor to represent Maldraxxus at the Ember Court of Prince Renathal. 

But before I leave my post, I must ensure my comrades will be safe while I am away.

Fight your way into the Ossein Foundry and retrieve weapons from our rivals there.

I will have them distributed among the troops while I make ready to depart.
61255.progress: Have you gotten the weapons yet?
61255.completion: A strong advantage. We gain additional arms and deprive our foes of the same.
61255.title: RSVP: Alexandros Mograine
61255.objectives: Collect 9 Ossein Staves and 3 Ossein Battleaxes from the Ossein Foundry.

61256.description:
Oh, how wonderful! Thank you for the invitation to the Ember Court.

We were just going to go cleanse ourselves with a meditation. That will be even more necessary if we are to travel soon. Care to join us?
61256.progress: Have you completed your meditation yet?
61256.completion: I always find meditation so relaxing and rewarding. Don't you? Now we are better prepared for our journey!
61256.title: RSVP: Kleia and Pelagos
61256.objectives: Join Kleia and Pelagos in the Meditation chamber and face the memories of your past.

61265.description:
<You have discovered plans for a charm that seems to hasten your soulbinds in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this charm.>
61265.title: Blueprint: Charm of Alacrity
61265.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Charm of Alacrity to Dactylis.

61269.description:
<You have discovered plans for a charm that encourages your soulbinds to persevere in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this charm.>
61269.completion: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.
61269.title: Blueprint: Charm of Persistence
61269.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Charm of Persistence to Dactylis.

61272.description:
<You have discovered plans for a charm that seems to damage your soulbinds' enemies in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this charm.>
61272.completion: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.
61272.title: Blueprint: Charm of Discord
61272.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Charm of Discord to Dactylis.

61304.description:
<You have discovered plans for a kit that lets you repair a piece of armor while out adventuring.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this kit.>
61304.completion: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.
61304.title: Blueprint: Kyrian Smith's Kit
61304.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Kyrian Smith's Kit to Dactylis.

61323.description:
We have gathered what forces we can. I hope it is enough.

Within the ruins of our necropolis awaits one final challenge. The one leading the salvage effort calls herself Gorgantus.

To preserve all that remains to us, we must end her. 

Lead the attack, and the Eyes will join you. We will reclaim our home.
61323.completion: I shall execute Akarek's will once more.
61323.title: See What You've Done

61331.description:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw. As long as this is still happening, we need to save as many as possible!

The Jailer twists the cycle of life and rebirth. This cannot be allowed to continue! We must thwart his plans.

Return to the Maw and rescue those that you can.
61331.completion:
Oh, wonderful news!

I will make sure these souls are well taken care of here in Ardenweald.
61331.title: Return Lost Souls

61332.description:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw, circumventing the natural order of the Shadowlands.

The Jailer denies these souls their rightful eternities. Only you, Maw Walker, can set things right.

Return to the Maw and save all that you can.
61332.completion: Well done. They have been spared a truly cruel existence.
61332.title: Return Lost Souls

61333.description:
Maw Walker, I'm sure you've seen firsthand the souls that continue to pour into the Maw. 

We must act now to cut off the Jailer's power, denying him as many souls as possible. That power belongs to the Necrolords.

I shall direct your efforts to save these souls, and help find them a place among the armies of Maldraxxus.

Return to the Maw and rescue those that you can.
61333.completion: Excellent Maw Walker. Our armies here will grow stronger with each soul you return.
61333.title: Return Lost Souls

61334.description:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw. 

Their anima, our very lifeblood of the Shadowlands, is going with those souls to fuel the Jailer. You rescued me from the Maw. I see no reason you cannot pull more souls from that abyss. 

Bring souls you rescue from the Maw to me and I shall see them put to better use. At least in Revendreth they have a chance of redemption.
61334.completion:
A very good collection of souls. Not too broken, not too drained, and not too innocent.

Never fear, their fate is better in our hands than the Jailer's.
61334.title: Return Lost Souls

61335.description:
You're looking for a mechanic, are you? Look no further!

I've been toiling on a new necropolis for ages. When Nurakkir collapsed, we saw a golden opportunity! We came to salvage parts from the wreckage, but these brutes locked me up when I criticized their methods.

But now you need help, right? I'm your construct!

You get me out of here, and you've got yourself a new mechanic!
61335.progress: Got a way to free me?
61335.completion: Thanks for the rescue! I owe you one.
61335.title: Rage Against the Cage
61335.objectives: Free Ansid the Mechanic from his cage using Toc's key.

61351.progress:
<Prince Renathal looks at the Ancient Sinstone you're carrying with great interest.>

Now where did you find that old sinstone?
Ancient Sinstone (1)
61351.completion:
I truly appreciate you bringing this sinstone to me, {NAME}.

It is almost as old as I am.
61351.title: Ancient Sinstone (+Formal)

61354.description:
Of course I will attend, {NAME}, the Ember Court sounds like a lot of fun! 

But I cannot go without a gift!

Hospitality gifts are an important tradition on many worlds and I feel obliged to provide something suitable for my host and fellow guests.

<Lady Moonberry suppresses a smirk.>

Now for reasons that I'm suuuure won't interest you, I'll need a stout but pretty vine, some dangerous but beautiful blossoms, and of course some gorm pheromones.

Easy enough for someone of your prowess.
61354.progress: Have you found all of the components for my gift?
61354.completion: This will be funny. Ah, I mean festive.
61354.title: RSVP: Lady Moonberry
61354.objectives: Collect 3 Silverheart Vine Leaves, 9 Blooming Lasher Spurs, and a Gorm Pheromone Gland.

61355.description:
Though you may wish to depart with your precious souls in tow, we now have additional matters to settle first.

The Eye of the Jailer is upon you. And that does not bode well for either of us.

Take this device. You will reinforce my wards to ensure he does not take notice of me as well.

The last thing I need is a loud, inelegant mortal bringing more attention my way. I can't have the Jailer capturing me, after all.

I'm far too valuable.
61355.progress: Our business is not yet complete. Attend to my wards.
61355.completion:
That should be enough to hide us from the Jailer's sight.

I need you alive. For the time being, at least.

Now, back to business.
61355.title: Rule 2: Keep a Low Profile

61356.progress:
We have made contact with a member of the former House of Eyes in Maldraxxus. She is a powerful marksman who would prove a most worthy adversary for your soulbinds.

She has requested a special anointment oil used in kyrian ceremonies in return for her memory.
Anointment Oil (1)
Soul Mirror (1)
61356.completion: That should satisfy our contact. Well done.
61356.title: Echthra, Dame of Hatred

61357.description:
As agreed, you may take my memory for the trials you seek.

Heed this warning, mortal--even as an echo of my physical form I will attack without hesitation. Expect no mercy, for I will show none.

You have done me a great service this day. See to your business.
61357.completion: A worthy acquisition--you did what you must. I will inform Adrestes of this spy network.
61357.title: Hatred Abated

61358.progress:
The Wild Hunt is made up of trackers and hunters of incredible might who protect Ardenweald from forces that wish to bring ruin to the place of rest.

We have reached out to a duo that has agreed to lend their memories if you help them take down a troublesome target.
Heartpiercer Javelin (1)
Soul Mirror (1)
61358.completion: This spear should be exactly what they need to take down their quarry.
61358.title: Alderyn and Myn'ir

61359.description:
As a Necrolord, your duty is to defend the Shadowlands. To carry out such service, the Primus grants us his strength.

Stand upon the altar of the Primus. Let his power become your own.
61359.progress: It is a great gift to wield the Primus's power.
61359.completion: You are a Necrolord, {NAME}. We stand strong.
61359.title: Power of the Primus

61360.description:
The forests of Ardenweald are safer with your help, envoy of the kyrian.

As a reward for your aid, we shall allow you to capture our memory. It is an honor to be chosen to help train the mighty warriors of Bastion.

Whenever you are ready.
61360.completion: The Wild Hunt are incredible hunters. I look forward to seeing what your soulbinds learn.
61360.title: The Hunt's Gratitude

61361.progress:
The tirnenn of Ardenweald are ancient, mysterious fae with many lessons to teach. While they prefer to avoid conflict and battle, they are powerful foes if crossed.

One tirnenn has offered themself as a teacher for your soulbinds. Along with their fleet of faeries, they have many nontraditional, yet crucial, lessons to teach you.
Fountain of Rejuvenation (1)
Soul Mirror (1)
61361.completion: Though their request was quite nonstandard, I am sure this fountain will be exactly what they need.
61361.title: Nuuminuuru

61362.description:
Tirnenn and faeries hold many dissimilarities.

While tirnenn stand patient and calm, like the trees that grow tall and protect us, faeries dance and dart and declare their desires directly.

Despite these differences, we stand together. Learning, growing, evolving.

We will help you and yours achieve the same symbiotic serenity.
61362.completion: It seems you have already learned from the tirnenn. I look forward to seeing what else they have to share!
61362.title: Caretaker of Faeries

61363.progress:
An alchemist in Maldraxxus swears that his new creation will be revolutionary, but is still missing a key catalyst.

If we lend him aid, he has agreed to allow you to capture his memory for the Path.
Catalyst of Creation (1)
Soul Mirror (1)
61363.completion:
<Dactylis inspects the catalyst.>

Well crafted. This should work perfectly for the scientist's needs.
61363.title: Mad Mortimer

61364.description:
They called me mad! As a matter of fact, they still do!

Ah, but none of them have the mental acuity of Doctor James Mortimus of the very much in-tact House of Plagues, nor his handsome smile! Fools!

With the catalyst you have so kindly provided, dear...whatever you are...certainly not a kyrian...

I digress!

We shall get to whatever it is you wanted in a moment, for now is the time of SCIENCE! Come, come, let me show you the wondrous fruits of my labors!
61364.completion: It appears you were successful. Well done, as always.
61364.title: Oozing with Opportunity
61364.objectives: Aid Mad Mortimer in his experiment, then capture his memory using the Soul Mirror.

61365.progress:
Drust ritualists have created a horrific creature that threatens our nearby allies in Ardenweald.

If we can successfully clear a path to the creature and mark it with a Praetor Resonance Beacon, we can both capture its essence for the Path and ensure it does not bring harm to the fae realm.
Praetor Resonance Beacon (1)
Soul Mirror (1)
61365.completion: May a great blow be struck to the drust this day.
61365.title: Splinterbark Nightmare

61366.description:
Your target lies near the Oaken Assembly in Ardenweald on the Elder Strand. Take caution, for powerful drust forces lurk nearby.

Once your target is in sight, activate the beacon and protect the praetors that arrive as they work to subdue the beast. You will only be able to capture its memory once it has been fully incapacitated.

Make haste, and good luck. Follow the path.
61366.completion: The Nightmare's memory will prove a formidable opponent. May its physical form remain at rest.
61366.title: Tactical Operation

61367.progress:
Maldraxxus is home to one of the most powerful types of anima wielders in the Shadowlands, the liches of the House of Rituals. 

Training against a lich would teach your soulbinds important lessons and tactics they can wield if they ever come face to face with a magic user with ill intent.
Soulseeker Crystal (1)
Soul Mirror (1)
61367.completion: This crystal will be useful in finding and capturing the memory you seek.
61367.title: Thran'tiok

61368.description:
This phylactery holds the soul of Thran'tiok... her very essence.

Be quick in whatever you need to do. I must get this piece of her soul away from here before she returns.

Her paranoia shall truly be her end.
61368.completion:
It is fortunate that you were able to capture the lich's memory without encountering her herself.

Such a powerful being is not to be underestimated.
61368.title: Filching Phylacteries
61368.objectives: Capture Thran'tiok's memory through the Phylactery of Pain.

61369.progress:
One of Denathrius's former subjects, Craven Corinth, has been deemed too dangerous to roam free even in their light-bathed Ember Ward.

His memory would be a perfect opponent in the coliseum. All we need is a key to free him from his prison.
Ashfallen Key (1)
Soul Mirror (1)
61369.completion: I am pleased that I retained the designs for this venthyr key for all those millenia. It was not easy to come by.

61370.description:
Corinth will not surrender his memory willingly. You must weaken him sufficiently before he will relent to the soul mirror's energy.

You will find him deep within the Desiccation in Revendreth, locked away among the other light-scarred venthyr. Once you free him, he will surely attack in his confused rage.

Subdue him, and capture his memory. He may then roam free among his kind.
61370.completion: Another worthy acquisition. Corinth will be a worthy test of your skills.

61371.progress:
For your final test in the Path, you must face an old friend from your first moments in this realm--Athanos.

It has been many millenia since the mighty goliath stepped into the arena with his legendary spear, Humility's Guard. The blade was disassembled upon his departure, as is tradition.

Should Athanos bear witness to Humility's Guard once more, I believe he can be convinced to enter the arena once more. We have the shattered spear, but require materials to reforge it.
Humility's Guard (1)
Soul Mirror (1)
61371.completion: May Athanos' return be upon us at last.

61372.description:
Even with Humility's Guard in hand, if you are to convince Athanos to join the Path of Ascension once more then you must prove yourself a worthy adversary.

Enter the ring and wield the spear against him. Even with its power you cannot hope to defeat him, but it should be able to parry his mighty stomp.

Thwart his assault for long enough, and he will surely allow you to capture his memory.
61372.completion:
<Dactylis' face expresses what appears to be surprise.>

You actually did it? Very well! A most worthy opponent indeed.

61373.description:
You must act at once!

A devourer of incredible strength has opened a rift in the coliseum and even now threatens to consume it! What few fighters were present at the time struggle to keep the creature at bay.

If this horror is not stopped, it will continue into the rest of the spires. You must take what anima you can in the area and subdue it.

Once the threat has been negated, take this spare mirror and capture its memory so we may learn more of its kind for future encounters.
61373.completion: A heroic effort! We will learn much from battling its kind.
61373.title: Azaruux, the Realm Ender
61373.objectives: Absorb anima to activate the Anima Confluxes to subdue Azaruux, then capture its memory.

61388.description:
Binding souls is but the first step. 

Over time, the power of our bond will grow in strength and manifest itself in the form of amazing new abilities!

To tap into this newfound strength, all you must do is place your hand upon the Forge of Bonds. There is no price to pay--the only limitation is your connection to Necrolords.
61388.progress: This device is merely a conduit to the strength that lies within us both.
61388.completion: May we prove worthy allies for the battles to come.
61388.title: A Journey Made Together
61388.objectives: Activate a Soulbind Power using the Forge of Bonds.

61391.description:
<The air around you stands still. A chill of domination suffuses your being. You hear a voice.>

Yes... I remember you...

Do you think that because you evaded my grasp once, that I would let it happen again?

No. The Maw answers to me. All that befalls you here will be because I willed it so.

Death comes for you, mortal. Everywhere you go, my eye is upon you.
61391.title: The Eye of the Jailer
61391.objectives: Speak with Ve'nari about what you just heard.

61396.description:
<The torn document appears to have been written by Surgeon Stitchflesh.>

...the kyrian flesh improves strength, obedience, and dexterity twofold! Such potential!

Now, if subject number one-three-five succeeds in a proper wing transplant at last...

<It continues on for some time. You should bring this to your kyrian allies.>
61396.completion: Allow me to read this for a moment.
61396.title: Dark Developments
61396.objectives: Bring the Abhorrent Design to Artemede.

61397.description:
This sanctum cannot function on anima alone. It will take many willing souls working in harmony to unlock the full potential of the Seat of the Primus.

Our Soul Warden is always in search of new souls to induct into the sanctum. Your ability to travel back and forth from the Maw will undoubtedly prove useful to him.

You should pay him a visit to see what assistance you can offer.
61397.completion: With your unique abilities, we have an opportunity we've never had before.
61397.title: Opportunity Strikes

61398.description:
Of course Darkhaven is honored to provide traditional decorations for Prince Renathal's court.

Venthyr decor is all about setting a certain mood. That means lurking stonefiends and death blossom scented candles in vast quantity.

Our resources are stretched thin, {NAME}. We can supply stonefiends easily, but our artisans need wax to melt with fresh death blossom. There should be candle remnants and drips in the village to scrape up. Death blossoms can be harvested from the plants themselves.
61398.progress: Have you managed to gather the raw materials for our artisans yet?
61398.completion: We had best get to work right away. Thank you.
61398.title: Ember Court: Traditional
61398.objectives: Collect 50 Candle Wax and 20 Death Blossoms. Death Blossoms can be harvested with the herbalism skill.

61399.description:
For a reasonable renumeration, Ta Cartel can supply the decorations you require. 

Restocking unique and intriguing items is an important aspect of doing business. As you can freely return to your own world, you can provide me some new and exciting products to offer.

Your world has captured the imagination of many of our clients. I have buyers looking for some specific things native to Azeroth.
61399.progress: Have you found something that fits each item on the list?
61399.completion: Yes, yes, this is excellent work. Our clients will love these.
61399.title: Ember Court: Mortal Reminders
61399.objectives: Help Keeper Ta'saran replenish stock by retrieving the items on the list he's provided you.

61400.description:
I support Prince Renathal's efforts and will certainly help the Ember Court!

Mystery mirrors will be dangerous but add real excitement to the party. I will need a lot of mirror fragments to complete enough of them in time.

You will also need to refresh my supply of Ashen Cores so I can get the glass sufficiently molten to work.
61400.progress: Have you found the mirror fragments and an Ashen Core?
61400.completion: Thank you for collecting the necessary ingredients to make the mirrors.
61400.title: Ember Court: Mystery Mirrors
61400.objectives: Collect 12 Shrouded Mirror Shards, 12 Scorched Mirror Fragments, and 3 Molten Cores.

61401.description:
Oh, hello again!

Did you hear that I have been given command of the guard for the Ember Court? That would probably be more impressive if there were already recruits.

I need to get these recruiting posters up. If you can take care of that, I can meet the interested recruits here and then we can test their combat skills when you return.
61401.progress: Those posters need to be put in visible locations and the recruits need to be tested.
61401.completion: Hah! I anticipate some fun with this. I will test the remaining recruits!
61401.title: Ember Court: Venthyr Volunteers
61401.objectives: Place 6 Recruiting Posters and test 3 Sinfall Recruits.

61402.description:
To call up the reserves to provide security for the Ember Court we will need anima. Good, loyal troops are ready as soon as we can animate them.

We will also need weapons for them.

Sort that out and I will make sure the Prince and his guests are well protected.
61402.progress: Have you filled the anima canister and found enough weapons to equip our new comrades?
61402.completion: Good. This will be sufficient for me to get those reserves ready.
61402.title: Ember Court: Stoneborn Reserves
61402.objectives: Fill the anima canister by defeating enemy stoneborn in Dominance Keep. Collect 12 Stoneborn Glaives.

61403.description:
So your prince's little parties have attracted unwanted attention?

<Emeni laughs.>

I have my own long list of enemies, and far too many of them hide from me in the land of the living. Cowards!

But I have finally found a solution.

Take this crystal to my remains on Azeroth, and use it to project my image among the living for a short time so that I may exact revenge on my old kin.
61403.progress: What are you waiting for? Those sethrak won't impale themselves.
61403.completion:
So much slaughter... So many names removed from my list...

A whole new generation of sethrak will fear my name!
61403.title: Ember Court: Maldraxxus Army
61403.objectives: Release Emeni's projection in Vol'dun and help her defeat her ancient sethrak enemies.

61404.description:
Theotar need tea for party? Tubbins make best!

Special tea. Very special. Only I can make. Recipe need very good water from garden place. Good pool on special floaty island!

You go get and Tubbins makes tea!
61404.progress: Need special water to make special tea. Makes sense.
61404.completion:
Mmm, water taste clean...

Like me! I'm cleanest!
61404.title: Ember Court: Tubbins's Tea Party
61404.objectives: Collect Pristine Water from Ardenweald's Distant Grotto.

61405.description:
Recipes very important. Must not be lost!

I learn new foods from many mortals, add to my book. Best way is taste some of thing so can know what is good. You teach recipe to me this way and bring me right ingredients so I cook too. Then taste yours, then taste mine. Helps me learn.

I bring desserts to Ember Court.

Fair, yes?
61405.progress: You ready to give ingredients and taste test?
61405.completion: Ones that seem simple are harder. All ingredients must be perfect.
61405.title: Ember Court: Divine Desserts
61405.objectives: Collect a sample of Banana Beef Pudding, 30 Aethereal Meat, and 20 Phantasmal Haunch. Then taste-test Stewart's concoction.

61406.description:
I had not realized the fame of my fungi had reached so far. I'd be delighted to provide a mushroom feast to the Ember Court!

Hmmm... I will need you to collect some rare specimens and will loan you my favorite foraging bag. It will help you find the very best fungi. It's never failed me.

Let's see, I need tiny lacy bells from Bastion and some of those Ardenweald fancy purple frills. From the very tops of our mushrooms here I will need the feather caps. You'll need to grapple your way up there.
61406.progress: Have you filled the foraging bag?
61406.completion: Well, those smell good and ripe! You're pretty good at this, {NAME}.
61406.title: Ember Court: Mushroom Surprise!
61406.objectives: Collect 18 Feather Caps, 24 Lacy Bell Morels, and 4 Violet Frills.

61407.description:
If Prince Renathal wishes to impart knowledge of Revendreth's highest calling to his guests, we would be honored to demonstrate the rituals of atonement.

However, I must ask for your assistance preparing the necessary components quickly.

Capture nearby fugitive souls that hide from the Lord Chamberlain's corrupt venthyr. Bring them to our avowed ritualists across the halls. They will prepare the souls for our purpose.

Sinstone fragments will also help us identify the sins of these lost souls.
61407.progress: Fugitive souls can be found hiding in the darkest corners of the Halls of Atonement.
61407.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. The Accuser and I will personally lead the rituals during the Ember Court.

We will remind everyone of Revendreth's true purpose.
61407.title: Ember Court: Atoning Rituals
61407.objectives: Collect 125 Sinstone Fragments and deliver 2 Fugitive Souls to Avowed Ritualists.

61408.description:
It would be wonderful to show Revendreth the wild creatures of Ardenweald!

You can get some Radiant Groupers near the waterfalls. They're fast so you have to grab them as they swim by. 

Here's a net to use to subdue the Territorial Waders. They should follow you once you've caught them.

Highland Runestags will let you ride them if you aren't aggressive. Bring a few here to me, please. Watch out for the bulls, they're not at all friendly.

We will get others to help too. This sounds like fun.
61408.progress: We need Radiant Groupers, Highland Runestags, and Territorial Waders please.
61408.title: Ember Court: Glimpse of the Wilds
61408.objectives: Bring 3 Highland Runestags, 8 Radiant Groupers and 4 subdued Territorial Waders to Niya.

61412.description:
Within the Hall of Chains lie more constructs that are nearly complete. As we speak, the Margrave's forces work fervently to graft the last pieces of flesh to their horrific visages.

If they are allowed to finish their work, then the destruction we have wrought thus far will make little difference in the final conflict. Our flank will be overrun by a fresh wave of horrors, and the day will be lost.

That must not come to pass. Destroy any of these abominations you encounter.
61412.completion: Every abomination denied is one less foe to contend with when we face Gharmal.
61412.title: An Early End

61414.progress:
<Prince Renathal looks at the Flimsy Firework you're carrying with great concern.>

This cheap party favor could send all of Sinfall up in flames!
Faulty Fireworks (1)
61414.completion:
I truly appreciate you bringing these fireworks to me, {NAME}.

Such cheap favors have no place at our party.
61414.title: Faulty Fireworks (+Safe)

61432.progress:
What is that you have found?
Renathal's Journal Pages (1)
61432.completion: I recognize that handwriting, are these actually the prince's pages? I will make sure they make their way to Sinfall, the court is grateful you returned them.
61432.title: Lost Journals

61433.progress:
Is that... a lungcap?

How did you possibly find one of those here in Revendreth?

No matter. Throw it on a platter!

Perhaps they will not notice how terrible it tastes.
Giant Lungcap (1)
61433.completion:
What it lacks in flavor, it more than compensates for in size.

I should be able to fill three platters with this if carve it correctly.
61433.title: Giant Lungcap

61436.description:
Now that you have the catalyst, you need only bring it to Mortimer in Maldraxxus. Our last correspondence indicates that his laboratory is still in-tact within the former House of Plagues.

Exercise caution in your journey--what remains of the house is fraught with danger, and Mortimer himself has earned a less than pristine reputation among his peers.
61436.completion: Ah, yes! You must be the one from Bastion! Marvelous!
61436.title: Field Trip
61436.objectives: Bring the Catalyst of Creation to Mad Mortimer in the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus.

61445.progress:
<Prince Renathal extends an arm while keeping his head held high.>

I will take that off of your hands.
Court Gossip (1)
61445.completion: This court is no place for such idle gossip. I will discard the scroll at once!
61445.title: Court Gossip (+Relaxing)
61445.objectives: <Prince Renathal extends an arm while keeping his head held high.>I will take that off of your hands.

61448.progress:
<Prince Renathal leans back and turns away while extending an arm forward.>

This filth must be disposed of immediately!
Blob of Slime (1)
61448.completion: Thank you for ensuring our party is as pristine as it should be.
61448.title: Blob of Slime (+Clean)

61450.progress:
What do we have here? An assortment of seeds?
Cluster of Seeds (1)
61450.completion: While not known for their flavor, I'm sure these morsels will please one of the picky palates in attendance.
61450.title: Cluster of Seeds (+Humble)

61473.description:
I can aid you in crafting many pieces of equipment for your soulbinds.

Though they may only equip one at a time, each piece grants a new ability that they may not have without it.

This time you must source your own materials from around the Shadowlands. When you have collected them, return to me and we can create the footpads!
61473.progress: You find materials okay? Blueprint can help!
61473.completion: Boots? Very nice! I hold on for safe keeping.
61473.title: Sourcing Your Own Materials
61473.objectives: Craft the Herald's Footpads with Dactylis. Check the materials in the crafting window to learn where you can gather them.

61475.description:
I knew we were gonna get along! Welcome to our covenant. Well, almost.

There's just a few details left. Little things. You know. Oaths to be made, blood pacts to sort out, firstborns to be promised.

<Moonberry snorts a laugh.>

I'm just kidding!

Well, not about the oaths part. We take those seriously around here.

I'll meet you at the camp outside the Heart of the Forest!
61475.completion: This is going to be such fun!
61475.title: The Heart of the Forest
61475.objectives: Meet Lady Moonberry at the Refugee Camp beside the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.

61478.description:
With Humility's Guard whole once more, you may be able to coax Athanos back into the arena.

Travel to Aspirant's Crucible, where your journey began so long ago. Seek Forgelite Sophone--she guides all those who seek an encounter with Athanos.

Present the spear to her. She will know your intent and instruct you further.
61478.progress: What is that you have there?
61478.completion: I never thought I would see this spear again! This will be most interesting.
61478.title: Humble Beginnings
61478.objectives: Bring Humility's Guard to Forgelite Sophone in Aspirant's Crucible.

61479.description:
<Moonberry looks serious.>

Mortal though you are, you have chosen to become one of our champions. While you uphold our cause, we are obligated to extend hospitality to you within our sacred hall and grant you certain boons.

As a member of the Court of Night, I can bestow our powers on chosen mortals.

{NAME}, {class} of Azeroth,  I bid you welcome to the first tree, Tirna Achiad, the Heart of the Forest.

Please, follow me.
61479.progress: Accept this boon and use it for the benefit of Ardenweald.
61479.completion:
May this boon aid you in the trials ahead, {NAME}.
