Before our Queen grants you our power and we accept you formally into our midst, there are certain... traditions which we must uphold.
61479.title: The Boon of Shapes
61479.objectives: Accompany Lady Moonberry into the Heart of the Forest and take part in the ceremony.

61485.description:
At last, we are fully prepared to enact the baroness's plan.

Now that you have arrived, I will recount our roles one final time. Then we will seize our fate.

Listen closely.
61485.completion: Let us put our plan into motion.
61485.title: I'll Only Say This Once
61485.objectives: Speak with Whisperer Vyn about the plan.

61486.description:
I... we... I mean... he's...

<The young courier gulps.>

We found him. We found the Blightcaller.

I was on patrol like I'd done a hundred times before only there he was sitting on the front porch of that old house with those terrible dogs and I swear he smirked at me and stared with those fiery red eyes and--

<The young courier wipes his brow.>

He's at the Marris Stead. Our forces have him surrounded, but, uh...

You should probably gather your friends. I don't think he plans to surrender.
61486.progress: What news do you bring of the Blightcaller?
61486.completion:
At long last, one of the most notorious enemies of the Alliance has met his end.

Well done, {NAME}. Well done indeed.
61486.title: The Banshee's Champion
61486.objectives: Confront Nathanos Blightcaller at Marris Stead in Eastern Plaguelands.

61488.description:
<The messenger appears visibly shaken.>

Word has reached us of... well, I'm not quite sure how to put it...

The Blightcaller has been found.

Horde forces have been scouring Azeroth for any sign of him. Determined to make him answer for his crimes.

One of our Argent patrols has found him. Not hiding in some distant land. Just... waiting at his old homestead.

We have him surrounded, but, uh, I confess I don't like our odds.

Perhaps you could gather your allies and bring him to justice.
61488.completion:
<A wry smile crosses the Regent Lord's face.>

A fitting end to the Blightcaller. I only wish I had been there to see it.
61488.title: The Banshee's Champion
61488.objectives: Confront Nathanos Blightcaller at Marris Stead in Eastern Plaguelands.

61489.description:
Echthra has taken residence in one of the few remaining structures in the former House of Eyes in Maldraxxus.

Bring the anointment oil to her, and she should allow you to capture her memory. Take caution, for she is well-known both as a master marksman and--perhaps more notably--for her quick trigger finger.

Good luck, Maw Walker.
61489.progress: Be cautious. There are many in the House of Eyes who would not tolerate your presence.
61489.completion: Let us have words quickly--before I change my mind.
61489.title: Of Hearsay and Heresy
61489.objectives: Find Echthra in the House of Eyes in Maldraxxus.

61490.description:
Ah, the anointment oil. I had expected one of Adrestes' recruits.

No matter. You seek my memory for your trials, yes? I am afraid mere oil will not suffice.

With our house gone, we are left to fend for ourselves. Though this tower offers some protection, we are left cornered to any who may desire our end.

Information is the key to survival. Use my anointed talisman to give me eyes across all the realms...even in Bastion. Follow the list precisely--no questions.

Then can we resolve payment.
61490.progress: There will be no negotiation in this matter.
61490.completion: Already my vision grows. The pact is sealed.
61490.title: War of Information

61492.description:
Renathal carries himself well, but hides great pain. His wounds from Denathrius have not healed.

He is vulnerable.

He intends to send you to secure his old fortress of Darkwall Tower with banners and rely on his own strength to deter enemies. This is a poor tactical choice.

Take this small reserve of anima with you and revive Chelra the Bladewall. She was last seen at Darkwall. Revive her and she can aid you in taking the tower.
61492.progress: I have suffered in stillness for months. I worried I would never wake again.
61492.completion:
Well fought. That will not hold them for long, but it should buy Renathal the time he needs.

Thank you, mortal, for the infusion. I shall put this precious anima to good use while it lasts.
61492.title: The Princeguard
61492.objectives: Revive Chelra the Bladewall and drive enemies out of Darkwall Tower.

61509.description:
Chordy is bored, boooored!

You want to go look for luckydos? Go on adventure with Chordy?

We go to land of wing people, go look for valuable luckydos there.

Ready?
61509.completion:
Interesting, these are in better condition than most of Chordy's finds.

These will serve us well. Thank you, Maw Walker.
61509.title: Shinies of Bastion
61509.objectives: Use Chordy to locate and collect 10 valuable salvage around Bastion.

61510.description:
Chordy want to go on adventure! You want to go too, yes?

I scavenge, weapons, armor, and valuable luckydos! Though, luckydos seem to be in short supply these days.

We go to land of tree people! If we search together, we'll find many luckydos!
61510.completion:
Where did you find these? They're positively covered in filth!

Ugh, that smell! Here, take this and go clean yourself up.
61510.title: A Bountiful Haul
61510.objectives: Use Chordy to locate and collect 10 valuable salvage in Ardenweald.

61511.description:
Chordy bored. Chordy want to go on adventure! You want to go too, yes?

Pale people in tall buildings have many shinies and luckydos. We go there and find some for ourselves!

You ready to go?
61511.completion:
Interesting finds. These will be quite useful.

Thank you, Maw Walker.
61511.title: Things They Leave Behind
61511.objectives: Use Chordy to locate and collect 10 valuable salvage in Revendreth.

61518.description:
Assuming the others are in position, we are prepared to steal the necropolis.

You and I must push forward to rendezvous with Ansid. Khaliiq will regroup with Vyn once their tasks are complete.

Come along, $p, and stay near. I will shroud the both of us in shadow, so long as you are at my side.
61518.completion: It seems we've been discovered. Times like these demand flexibility.
61518.title: Follow Me
61518.objectives: Follow Navigator Xennir to the rendezvous point.

61522.description:
There's work that needs doing 'round here. Mmmm hmmm.

Spotted a big ol' carcass nearby. I aim to salvage it for parts. 

Figure you could come along, help me drag it to Rathan. He'd like that. Mmmm hmmm. 

Reckon I could even carry you there and back. You don't look too big.

Ready to get going?
61522.progress: Yes? Did you find anything on your supply run?
61522.completion:
<Rathan gives Flytrap an apprehensive look.>

That's... that's great!

Thank you both for bringing back these resources!

<Rathan flashes you a nervous smile.>
61522.title: Corpse Run
61522.objectives: Return the Bone Carcass to Rathan at Butcher Block.

61523.description:
There's work that needs doing 'round here. Mmmm hmmm.

Spotted a big ol' carcass nearby. I aim to salvage it for parts. 

Figure you could come along, help me drag it to Rathan. He'd like that. Mmmm hmmm. 

Reckon I could even carry you there and back. You don't look too big.

Ready to get going?
61523.progress: Yes? Did you find anything on your supply run?
61523.completion:
<Rathan gives Flytrap an apprehensive look.>

That's... that's great!

Thank you both for bringing back these resources!

<Rathan flashes you a nervous smile.>
61523.title: Corpse Run
61523.objectives: Return the Bone Carcass to Rathan at Butcher Block.

61524.description:
Prince Renathal is prepared to host today's Ember Court whenever you're ready, Maw Walker.

Be sure to talk to the rest of the staff to finalize the guest list and amenities before we open the court.

Remember, we're trying to impress the guests and convince them that we know what we're doing, so make sure you choose amenities that'll make the guests happy!

Talk to Lady Ilinca if you have any questions about guests.

Once everything's ready, talk to me and I'll open the court!
61524.completion:
Now THAT was a court to remember!

How are you going to top that next week?
61524.title: The Ember Court
61524.objectives: Finalize your guest and amenity selections for the Ember Court, then do your best to impress the guests.

61525.description:
Prince Renathal is prepared to host today's Ember Court whenever you're ready, Maw Walker.

Be sure to talk to the rest of the staff to finalize the guest list and amenities before we open the court.

Remember, we're trying to impress the guests and convince them that we know what we're doing, so make sure you choose amenities that'll make the guests happy!

Talk to Lady Ilinca if you have any questions about guests.

Once everything's ready, talk to me and I'll open the court!
61525.progress: I can't wait to see who attends today's court!
61525.completion:
Now THAT was a court to remember!

How are you going to top that next week?
61525.title: The Ember Court
61525.objectives: Finalize your guest and amenity selections for the Ember Court, then do your best to impress the guests.

61526.description:
Prince Renathal is prepared to host today's Ember Court whenever you're ready, Maw Walker.

Be sure to talk to the rest of the staff to finalize the guest list and amenities before we open the court.

Remember, we're trying to impress the guests and convince them that we know what we're doing, so make sure you choose amenities that'll make the guests happy!

Talk to Lady Ilinca if you have any questions about guests.

Once everything's ready, talk to me and I'll open the court!
61526.progress: I can't wait to see who attends today's court!
61526.completion:
Now THAT was a court to remember!

How are you going to top that next week?
61526.title: The Ember Court
61526.objectives: Finalize your guest and amenity selections for the Ember Court, then do your best to impress the guests.

61541.description:
{NAME}, are you ready for another gift?

The next boon we grant thee is one of bonds. As you have bound yourself to us, we shall bind to you. In the binding of souls, we become something greater.

<Moonberry leans in close.>

Sounds scary, huh? Don't worry! You and your soulbind will both strengthen each other.

When I asked for volunteers, many fae stepped forward. I picked someone I just know you're going to like. And this will be a boon for her, too.

Go to Flutterby. She'll help you both.
61541.completion: Oh, wow! I love guiding soulbinding! It's my favorite duty!
61541.title: The Forge of Bonds
61541.objectives: Meet Flutterby at the Forge of Bonds.

61542.description:
<Flutterby clasps her hands before her and assumes an air of tranquility.>

Soulbinding is not an irrevocable act. However, such a bond must be carefully considered before it is made.

You and your soulbind will know each other's hearts and minds. Your hopes and fears; your dreams and memories; all will be shared between you. 

As long as the bond exists, you are intertwined; always together even when apart.

Once complete, your connection will transcend physical space and empower you both.
61542.progress: When you are ready, we may proceed.
61542.completion: You... have lived a very interesting life.
61542.title: The Boon of Binding

61548.description:
Ansid has been captured and imprisoned by the foundry's guards.

It seems they were expecting us, completely shattering the element of surprise. My baroness would be disappointed in my lack of foresight.

This plan cannot succeed without Ansid. One of these soldiers is bound to possess the key to his cage.

Should you find it, we may yet carry out my baroness's will.
61548.completion: Expertly navigated. Perhaps you should pilot the necropolis.
61548.title: Set Me Free
61548.objectives: Find the Ossein Key on one of the Ossein Strongarms and use it to free Ansid.

61550.description:
I know how you feel... and what you have endured for the sake of your world. 

You now know of my own triumphs and tragedies as well.

Our bond will grow stronger over time. But for now, let us see what it has granted us.

Ardenweald has needs of us. We must do everything in our power to save it.
61550.title: Strengthening the Bond
61550.objectives: Activate a Soulbind Power using the Forge of Bonds.

61551.description:
The mooring platform will be our best launching point to access the necropolis above. But one more fight remains before us.

Enforcer Borgulla oversees all of the work efforts that take place here. We'll need to eliminate her if we are to proceed unhindered.

She is a formidable foe. It appears Ansid has kept some of his explosives on his person. Let us utilize this advantage.
61551.completion: Your strength never fails to impress me.
61551.title: Crush 'Em All
61551.objectives: Use Ansid's Explosive to kill Enforcer Borgulla.

61553.description:
It is the Wild Hunt's duty to hunt down those who would harm our charges and to ensure the security of our borders. But as the crisis has grown, so have our duties to Queen and Grove.

This is where I come in. It is my duty to be aware of all that goes on within the endless forest. It is my charge to help deploy our resources, so that we may aid our queen.

Allow me to demonstrate...
61553.completion: They will succeed in their mission, I have no doubt.
61553.title: Know Where to Strike
61553.objectives: Use the Command Table to send your forces on an adventure.

61557.description:
$p, I... I am beset by dark visions. A power emanating from within Torghast.

A familiar sensation. One I have not felt since...

Come to Oribos. Do not delay.
61557.title: An Echo in the Darkness

61558.description:
<Thrall's brow is furrowed.>

We were speaking with the Highlord when he was struck by a jolt of agony.

He said he could see something stirring in the Maw. Inside the Jailer's tower.

The pain seems to be getting worse. We need to find out what he's sensing.
61558.title: The Highlord's Vision
61558.objectives: Find out what Bolvar senses inside Torghast.

61559.description:
While his father was missing, I cared for Anduin like a son. To see him like that, at the mercy of Sylvanas...

<Bolvar's eyes flare with fire.>

Something must be done.

Take a moment. Let me know when you are ready to discuss what comes next.
61559.title: A Mourneblade Born
61559.objectives: Discuss the vision with Bolvar and the others.

61567.description:
My spies have identified several astral projectors that Margrave Gharmal uses to rally their troops in the Stitchyard.

I do not wish for a swarm of frenzied constructs to descend upon us during the final confrontation. Surely you see the wisdom in cutting their fervor.

See to it that these projectors are destroyed. We believe them to be along the yard's perimeter.
61567.completion: Gharmal's influence runs deep in this place, but it will fade more quickly thanks to your efforts.
61567.title: Grave Intent
61567.objectives: Destroy the Southwestern, Northwestern, and Notheastern Astral Projectors.

61569.description:
At last, our target is within reach.

The necropolis rests above us, moored to this platform by a necrotic restraining bolt.

Twigin can fly you to the apex of the necropolis. It will be ours to command once you insert this keystone.

We will prepare for our departure. Rejoin us when you are done.

Victory will soon be ours.
61569.completion: Come, {NAME}. Would you not witness your success firsthand?
61569.title: Keys to the Ruin
61569.objectives: Fly with Twigin to the necropolis's apex and plug in the Runic Keystone.

61586.description:
With Bastion as our ally, we have the strength to crush Gharmal and the House of Constructs.

We'll gather the supplies for the attack, but our soldiers need a great champion to follow into battle.

Prove to them that you are the champion they seek.
61586.completion: Well done, Maw Walker. Our forces are prepared to strike.

61594.description:
We are fully prepared to launch the necropolis. We must hurry before Margrave Gharmal tries to interfere.

Speak with Vyn when you are prepared, but we mustn't waste time.

We will cast our shadow upon all of Maldraxxus.

61616.description:
We've got everything we need to host our first real Ember Court whenever you're ready, Maw Walker.

Take a moment to finalize everything, and then we'll open court!

Remember, we're trying to impress Cryptkeeper Kassir and convince him that we know what we're doing, so make sure you choose the refreshments and entertainment we hired for him!

Once everything's ready, let me know and I'll open the court!
61616.progress: Cryptkeeper Kassir is going to love this!
61616.completion:
Incredible! Flawless! The perfect party herald!

And you did well too.

Let's do this again next week!

61635.description:
News of our work here has spread, new souls have arrived seeking to join us!

Take their requests for new construct bodies. We'll see if we can build them new constructs too!
61635.completion: So many souls, we have much work to do!

61636.description:
You have proven your dedication to not only your soulbinds and their training, but to the ways of the kyrian.

Stand proudly in your accomplishments, but know that there is no end to what you can learn.

Your accomplishments have not gone unnoticed. The Archon requests your presence.
61636.title: PH - UNUSED

61637.description:
A unique construct has chosen to join us, but its unethical creation leaves it most unsettled.

The fusing of fragmented Kyrian souls within this construct, gives it pain and suffering. We must find a way to harmonize these souls so they can live together in peace.

Create the Bindings of Wellbeing and bring ease to the Soulfused Construct.
61637.completion: So many souls now in harmony. Perhaps with time this construct will find happiness and a home here.
61637.title: Unity
61637.objectives: Bring ease to the Soulfused Construct.

61638.description:
News of our work here has spread, new souls have arrived seeking to join us!

Take their requests for new construct bodies. We'll see if we can build them new constructs too!
61638.completion: So many souls, we have much work to do!
61638.title: Iron Solution
61638.objectives: Take the construct requests from the souls present.

61697.description:
With the final empowerment in place, our renewed Crest of Ascension stands bolstered by the might of not just Bastion, but all covenants.

Soon new Ascended will grace these halls once more as aspirants finish their long-awaited trials.

None of this would be possible without your aid, Maw Walker. The honor of activating the Crest at last is yours.
61697.progress: This is a glorious moment for all kyrian.
61697.completion:
With the Crest complete at last, we must next turn our eyes back to the Forsworn.

<You notice Grubby looking at you expectantly.>
61697.title: A New Age

61701.description:
It is clear that a struggle took place here. I fear that Kivarr may have been taken by the Drust.

I scouted the surrounding area before you arrived. Eventide Grove has been overrun.

The Drust cannot have taken her far. We may yet be able to find her. I just pray that we are not too late...
61701.completion: Ulfar sent you to find me? Free me from this cage, and I will do what I can to aid you.
61701.title: Searching the Grove
61701.objectives: Search for Kivarr at Eventide Grove in Ardenweald.

61702.description:
The Drust just took Kivarr away. They said they were going to sacrifice her in one of their rituals!

If we hurry, you may still be able to save her! I've seen where the Drust keep their sacrificial altar... it's scary, but I can take you there!

There's no time to waste! Follow me!
61702.completion:
Not a moment too soon! I appreciate your punctuality.

My den is not far away. We should hurry before more Drust arrive.
61702.title: A Swift Intervention
61702.objectives: Rescue Kivarr from Eventide Grove in Ardenweald.

61703.description:
In order to perform the ritual, I will need some nox root from Darkreach.

It is a unique plant that only grows within soil that has been corrupted by Drust magic.

Darkreach lies to the west, not far from my den. What was once a peaceful, verdant grove is now filled with blight and ruin.

I will travel to the Heart of the Forest to prepare the ritual. Meet me there when you have gathered the nox root.
61703.completion: Good, you were able to find enough nox root for the ritual. Unfortunately, we have another problem...
61703.title: Nox Root
61703.objectives: Collect 12 Nox Root from Darkreach in Ardenweald.

61704.description:
Prince Renathal will wish to invite certain guests to each Ember Court.

In the future, we'll be able to adjust the guest list to make it easier to please everyone in attendance. But, we should follow the Prince's lead on this first one.

Work with Lord Garridan and Lady Ilinca to ensure that Cryptkeeper Kassir is able to attend and returns his RSVP.

If you haven't met Cryptkeeper Kassir yet in your adventures, you may need to introduce yourself before he'll listen to you.
61704.completion: The prince is wise to hold court. A timeless tradition of influence and prestige in this realm.
61704.title: Ember Court: Guest RSVPs
61704.objectives: Speak with Lord Garridan to see your Guest List, then meet Cryptkeeper Kassir to earn his RSVP.

61705.description:
We should always serve refreshments in the Ember Court, tailoring our choice of refreshment type to the preferences of our guests.

Luckily, I know our first guest well. Like Theotar, he prefers it to be Formal.

Work with Picky Stefan to acquire everything we need to throw a fancy tea party.
61705.completion: You smart! Tubbins tea is best tea!
61705.title: Ember Court: Refreshments
61705.objectives: Speak with Picky Stefan to see your Refreshment options, then complete Tubbins's quest to earn the tea party contract.

61706.description:
Everyone loves entertainment!

Our first guest is from the Halls of Atonement, so he will certainly appreciate a presentation of the powerful rituals the Accuser is capable of.

Work with Hips to acquire everything we need to host atoning rituals at the Ember Court.
61706.completion: A new court in Revendreth? The Accuser must be pleased that you chose to include rituals of atonement in the festivities.
61706.title: Ember Court: Entertainment
61706.objectives: Speak with Hips to see your Entertainment options, then complete Gresit's quest to earn the rituals contract.

61707.description:
As the drought and devourers eat our buildin's, the structures lose their hold on reality. Thing is, it ain't a clean process. Some of that debris is still infused with anima.

When your out, be a stoneback an' bring us whatever infused debris you can find.

See, we can recycle it into new structures as you hero types go and get the anima flowin' again.

Bring it here an we'll get it sorted.
61707.progress: Impressed 'ow much you can carry with 'em 'itty bitty arms.
61707.completion: Everythin's bricks n' mortar with you. Love it.
61707.title: Crumbled Reality

61709.description:
I sent Ara'lon to steal a witch's satchel from the Drust... a dangerous task from which he has yet to return.

The Drust's nightscreamers carry many reagents we need to perform the ritual. We cannot proceed without one.

You must go to the Oaken Assembly to procure one of their satchels... and find Ara'lon, if you can.
61709.progress: Do you have the satchel? And what of Ara'lon?
61709.completion: This contains everything we need. Give me a moment and I will prepare the reagents for our ritual.
61709.title: Witch's Satchel
61709.objectives: Collect 1 Witch's Satchel from the Oaken Assembly in Ardenweald.

61710.description:
<The shattered remains of a sylvari spear litter the ground. You recognize the spear as belonging to Ara'lon.

This confirms that Ara'lon was here. Unfortunately, he is nowhere to be found.

Lord Herne will want to know of your discovery.>
61710.completion:
Though this bodes ill, I am not ready to give up hope that Ara'lon survived. He may still be out there.

I will assemble a search party. We will find him and bring him home... no matter what fate has befallen him. Thank you.
61710.title: The Broken Spear
61710.objectives: Deliver the remains of Ara'lon's spear to Lord Herne at Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.

61711.description:
I have finished making preparations for the ritual. The moment of truth has come.

The Drust fetish that Ulfar gave you will channel the ritual's power into Gweyir. It should counteract the curse that imprisons her mind.
 
This will not be pleasant. It may not even work. But this is the only chance we have to free her.
61711.progress: The ritual is our only hope of freeing Gweyir. We must try...
61711.completion:
You performed the ritual admirably, but the Gorak Zhar's power was too strong for Gweyir to withstand. There is nothing more we can do, I am afraid.

It seems the masked fae are lost to us after all...
61711.title: Ritual of Purification

61713.description:
<You have discovered plans for a charm that seems to make your soulbinds fleet of foot in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this charm.>
61713.completion: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.
61713.title: Blueprint: Charm of Quickness
61713.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Charm of Quickness to Dactylis.

61714.description:
<A beautifully crafted abacus rests in your hands. Its frame glimmers and shines in the light, its beads smooth auric orbs.

Your steward will appreciate this as not only a useful gift, but an exquisite one.>
61714.title: Gilded Abacus
61714.objectives: Summon your steward companion via Summon Steward, then give them the Gilded Abacus.

61725.progress:
I anticipate the timely return of our stolen merchandise, Maw Walker.

Their pilfering leaves a blemish on what could otherwise be a perfectly satisfying event.
Stolen Memento (10)
61725.completion:
<Keeper Ta'saran carefully inspects each memento.>

These are all in adequate condition. Their return shall be noted in the logs.

You needn't fear a reprisal for their theft any longer.
61725.title: Stolen Mementos

61730.description:
King Anduin has not been found inside Torghast. I fear we could spend eternity searching those endless corridors to no avail.

We must know what fate has befallen him. To peer into the tower represents a grave risk, yet we have little choice.

Stand with me, {NAME}. We will use the broken Helm of Domination to see into that hellish place.

Perhaps together we can hold back the hungry darkness.
61730.progress: We must peer into Torghast before Anduin is lost to us.
61730.completion:
Anduin may appear unharmed, but his soul is imperiled.

Sylvanas Windrunner cannot be allowed to carry out her plan.
61730.title: The Captive King
61730.objectives: Use the Helm of Domination to peer into Torghast.

61731.progress:
Curious. Most curious trinkets...

May I keep to study? Will learn much.
Magical Curio (1)
61731.completion:
Most intriguing! Thank you!

<Mikanikos immediately begins disassembling one of the trinkets to study.>
61731.title: Magical Curios
61731.objectives: Curious. Most curious trinkets...May I keep to study? Will learn much.

61732.description:
Your redistribution of anima has been commendable so far.

But venthyr are still venthyr. They may spend eons educating souls on the folly of greed and hoarding, but they often fail to acknowledge the return of that trait in themselves, given enough time.

My scouts have witnessed a number of venthyr siphoning the anima you have redistributed and hoarding it within their estates and dwellings. 

Search these places and recover this hoarded anima so that we might put it to better use.
61732.completion:
Greed. One of the few sins not fully purged but actually encouraged in the venthyr by Sire Denathrius in recent ages. 

We have watched as he used this as a tool to control his populous, to keep them stagnant and un-unified. 

Renathal's methods are the only way forward.
61732.title: Old Habits Never Die

61733.description:
Right. You've been a polished bit of gray so far and it's appreciated from the bottom up for sure.

Well, now I got a task for 'ou that would help all of us dredgers put that anima you obtained to good use.

Creepers.

Not just any creepers, but 'em mire creepers. 'Ey got a look about 'em and a taste about 'em that just sings when you put it to good use.

As you go trippin' around Revendreth, grab any creepers ya find an' stick 'em in this here sack. I'll pay ya.
61733.progress: Creepers. 'Ey like chewin' on the mortar at holds all these walls up.
61733.completion:
Well then, look at that!

A big ol' bag of Creepers, with their squinty eyes and mold smellin' breath.

Ain't 'ey cute? 

Havin' a few a these around the lads while they work will really help morale. Much appreciated from all of us.
61733.title: Big Bag of Creepers

61734.description:
The Curator once knew the contents and locations of every sinstone in Revendreth dating back to the founding of this realm.

Sadly, her time in the Maw disrupted those essential parts of her vast intellect and we can no longer rely upon her for such knowledge. At least, not for a while. And so it falls to me to rebuild a 'living' archive.

As you venture into Revendreth I would ask that you recover the contents and location of certain sinstones. This will help us orient our archive.
61734.completion: With time and enough information we may be able to anchor the Curator's knowledge so that she once again becomes the invaluable resource that she once was.
61734.title: Census of Sins

61735.description:
I have need of your services.

I have identified a collection of stoneborn throughout Revendreth whom may be swayed to our cause, or were already members of our cause before returning to their stone slumber.

You have provided us with the anima we needed, now it is time to put it to use. Seek out our allies and awaken them. I have fashioned an anima container for easier transport to aid in this endeavor. 

We need an army if we are to face an army.
61735.completion:
Terrifying, aren't they? Magnificent weapons crafted by the finest arts perfected since the coalescing of the Shadowlands themselves. 

They shall prove invaluable in the times to come.
61735.title: Awaken Our Allies

61736.description:
There is much you need to be told, {NAME}.

The Scourge has returned. With the Helm of Domination shattered, their evil runs rampant. Unchecked.

What's worse, Sylvanas Windrunner has sent her agents into the very heart of our kingdoms to take those who thwarted her efforts in the war.

Speak to Whitemane. She can tell you the rest.
61736.title: Stolen Away
61736.objectives: Speak to Sally Whitemane about the abductions.

61737.description:
There is much you need to be told, {NAME}.

The Scourge has returned. With the Helm of Domination shattered, their evil runs rampant. Unchecked.

What's worse, Sylvanas Windrunner has sent her agents into the very heart of our kingdoms to take those who thwarted her efforts in the war.

Speak to Nazgrim. He can tell you the rest.
61737.title: Stolen Away
61737.objectives: Speak to Nazgrim about the abductions.

61738.description:
Hips was smart to send you my way. The Lost Chalice Band plays the best music this side of the Maw!

The band is not quite ready to tour yet, however.

The musicians are all safe in the crypt behind me, but their instruments have been confiscated by our obnoxious neighborhood authorities!

Noise complaints and all that.

Help me get those back, and perhaps recruit a few groupies and roadies along the way to help out, and we shall throw the best concert your court has ever seen!
61738.progress: Any venthyr or dredger will do. We are not picky about our fans.
61738.completion:
I do not know what promotional tricks you used, but it worked.

A whole stream of dredgers and venthyr stopped by to join the band crew!

The Lost Chalice Band is ready to tour!
61738.title: Ember Court: Lost Chalice Band
61738.objectives: Use band posters to recruit 10 groupies and 10 roadies and recover 3 Confiscated Band Supplies.

61739.description:
It has come to my attention that you seek to uncover a plot by the baron Kel'Thuzad. 

That upstart has been a thorn in my side since he arrived at the House of Rituals. Not only did he pilfer my rightfully earned title, he has since shut me out of the house's dealings.

I have yet to find evidence that would mar Sin'dane's adoration for her new baron, and thus I offer an arrangement. I grant you access to the House of Rituals, and in return you help me bring down Kel'Thuzad.

Do we have an accord?
61739.completion:
<Balmedar's voice resonates from the floating eye.>

You didn't really think I would risk meeting you here in person, did you?

Come, we have much work to do.
61739.title: The Wayward Baron
61739.objectives: Open Balmedar's Supplies at the tower near the Scaplian Ridge.

61740.description:
We will have to construct an illusion to allow you entry into the House of Rituals. However, not just any illusion will do. In order to join Kel'Thuzad's inner circle, we require something... specific.

We're going to need a body.

Fortunately for us, one of the baron's favorite acolytes is performing a ritual outside of the house itself. You'll need to fight your way to her, but of that I'm sure you're capable.
61740.progress: Don't you have a corpse to procure?
61740.completion:
I must say it was satisfying watching you wipe the smug look off of Nelesis's face. She always thought she was so superior.

But enough revelry. We have work to do.
61740.title: Playing Favorites
61740.objectives: Defeat Acolyte Nelesis and bring her corpse back to the tower near Scaplian Ridge.

61741.description:
The illusion ritual will require a substantive amount of anima to complete. Since such a resource isn't simply lying around these days, we will need to take some.

The abominations from the House of Constructs recently arrived with a delivery of anima-rich spoils from the raid on Bastion. 

Use the maldracite crystal I've included in the parcel to extract enough anima for our ritual.
61741.completion:
This should be sufficient.

Let us prepare for the ritual.
61741.title: Pilfered Power
61741.objectives: Drain anima from the Kyrian Spoils in the House of Rituals to fill the maldracite crystal.

61742.description:
The ritual to complete your disguise should be quite simple with the assistance of my oculus. Even a {class} like you should be able to manage it.

When you are ready, simply hold the empowered crystal above Nelesis's corpse. My oculus will do the rest.
61742.completion:
An impressive resemblance. You may just be able to pull this off.

Well, what are you waiting for?
61742.title: A Fitting Guise
61742.objectives: Meet Balmedar in the Hall of Blades at the House of Rituals.

61743.description:
Now that you have your disguise--and I have assurance of your loyalty--it is time you reported to your new master.

Find Kel'Thuzad within the Vault of Souls. Do whatever tasks he requires of you, but keep your eyes open for anything untoward.

My oculus will continue to accompany you so that I can provide guidance when the time is right.

We will uncover this new baron's true intentions.
61743.completion:
Ah, you've returned. I take it the ritual went well?

Come, we have much to accomplish.
61743.title: The Pupil Returns
61743.objectives: Meet Kel'Thuzad within the Vault of Souls.

61744.description:
You have done well in my service, Nelesis. When the time has come to take my rightful place, you will be well rewarded.

Until then, I will require your utmost devotion and secrecy.

Our preparations are almost complete. Come, walk with me, and I will show you the splendor of our works.
61744.completion:
There are but a few tasks remaining before we can complete our ritual.

You must begin immediately.
61744.title: The Baron's Plan

61745.description:
The kyrian will no doubt make a worthy sacrifice for our ritual, but I am not entirely versed with the magics of his kind. I have requested that the Baroness Ninadar assemble a list of appropriate literature, so that I can ensure my ritual will have the desired effect.

As you know, the baroness enjoys exploiting her title, so expect to be faced with some manner of mundane tasks in exchange for her cooperation. 

Return when you have procured the tomes, acolyte.
61745.completion:
Kel'Thuzad always seems to have the most studious of pets, doesn't he?

What is it the baron wishes of me, acolyte?
61745.title: Mistress of Tomes
61745.objectives: Speak with Baroness Ninadar in the Grimoirium.

61746.description:
One of the... more regrettable duties of the Mistress of Tomes is the collation and maintenance of our scroll library. Unfortunately, many of our acolytes are less than prompt when it comes to returning items they have borrowed, which requires me to seek them out and retrieve them myself.

Of course, this is far too menial a task for a baroness, but that is why lackeys like you exist.

Go, and retrieve my scrolls. Feel free to use whatever persuasive means you have at your disposal.
61746.completion:
Wonderful. Kel'Thuzad's pets are nothing if not reliable.

We are done here.
61746.title: Cantrip Collections
61746.objectives: Collect 6 Overdue Scrolls from Necrotic Acolytes in the Grimoirium.

61747.description:
The House of Rituals is a place of constant study. Every day, new incantations and formulae are concocted to further the arts of necromancy. 

It can be difficult to keep track of such innovation. To aid in cataloguing our progress, our sorcerers have applied the use of enchanted quills and parchment. Unfortunately, if not properly stored, these implements tend to run amok. 

Of course, they were not properly stored.  Find the implements and return them to where they belong.
61747.progress: Enchanted quills will not collect themselves, now will they?
61747.completion:
Much better!

I simply cannot abide a disorganized Grimoirium.
61747.title: Errant Enchantments
61747.objectives: Retrieve 4 Errant Quills and 6 Rampant Grimoires in the Grimoirium.

61748.description:
Very well, you can have your list. The volumes you seek can be found in the Hall of Tomes.

Now, run back to your master like a good little pet.
61748.progress: You have returned? Do you have my tomes?
61748.completion:
Ah yes, these will do.

It will take some time to study these tomes. In the meantime, I have more need of you.
61748.title: The Hall of Tomes
61748.objectives: Collect the required volumes from the Hall of Tomes and return them to Kel'Thuzad in the Vault of Souls.

61749.description:
As you are well aware, a ritual of this complexity requires several reagents. I have asked that Carver Jor'dan prepare what I'll need.

Seek him out in the Reagentry, and provide whatever assistance he requests.
61749.completion: You are Kel'Thuzad's acolyte, are you not?
61749.title: Necessary Ingredients
61749.objectives: Speak with Jor'dan the Powerful in the Reagentry.

61750.description:
The baron requests a veilwing's heart, but procuring one is going to be something of a problem. 

<Jor'dan gestures to the disarray nearby.>

As you can plainly see, one of our sorcerers proved incapable of restraining the beast. I regret to inform you that our only specimen has escaped.

It cannot have gone far, though. If you follow its tracks you should be able to catch up with it and retrieve the heart yourself.

I assure you the baron will not be able to perform his ritual without it.
61750.completion:
This specimen should work nicely for the baron's ritual.

I will add it to his parcel.
61750.title: Heart of the Forest
61750.objectives: Collect a Veilwing's Heart from the Elusive Veilwing in the House of Rituals.

61751.description:
I will need your assistance with the collection of one other reagent for your master. These spore clusters he requests--while normally a trivial matter--will require a bit of work.

You see, as the veilwing rampaged throughout the Reagentry, it toppled and broke several nearby cages hosting the blightrays from which we harvest the clusters.

You will have to collect them through more... conventional means. 

The clusters are fragile, however, so try not to damage them while subduing the creatures.
61751.progress: Do you have the spore clusters?
61751.completion:
This should do.

I will assemble the reagents together to return to your master posthaste.
61751.title: Cage Free Spores
61751.objectives: Collect 6 Intact Spore Clusters from Escaped Blightrays in the Reagentry.

61752.description:
I have gathered most of the remaining reagents on your master's list. All that remains is the special shipment he requested from Oribos.

The brokers have yet to deliver the shipment. When it arrives, your master will have all he needs to complete his ritual.
61752.progress: Let us see what we have here.
61752.completion:
Let me hold onto these for now.

I will need you to get your hands on that shipment!
61752.title: The Final Reagent
61752.objectives: Bring the Bundle of Reagents to Balmedar in the House of Rituals.

61753.description:
The brokers deal in objects most exotic and profound. If Kel'Thuzad requires reagents from them, his ritual must be outside the normal scope of the House of Rituals.

This mysterious reagent could be the key to unlocking Kel'Thuzad's plan. We must get a hold of this delivery from Oribos. 

I have taken the liberty of concocting an alchemical bomb. Use it to ambush the caravan and retrieve whatever they are transporting.
61753.progress: The caravan will arrive any moment now. Make haste!
61753.completion:
Well done.

Now we must work quickly, before we are discovered.
61753.title: Explosive Schemes
61753.objectives: Use the Alchemical Explosive to ambush the Broker caravan at the Scaplian Ridge.

61754.description:
That explosion will likely bring onlookers from the House of Rituals. We must act quickly.

Search through the debris for anything that looks out of the ordinary. It is likely that Kel'Thuzad's mystery reagent won't be hard to spot.
61754.completion:
The runes on this blade... they are a hallmark of domination magic!

This is not good, {class}.
61754.title: No Crate Unturned
61754.objectives: Search the Broker's Crates for Kel'Thuzad's special reagent.

61755.description:
We cannot allow Kel'Thuzad to discover who stopped his shipment. 

None must be left to tell the tale of what transpired here.
61755.completion:
The guards have been dealt with? Good.

We have more pressing matters, now.
61755.title: Blinding the Brokers
61755.objectives: Kill 8 broker witnesses in the Scaplian Ridge.

61756.description:
The pieces are all coming together. The kyrian, the Paths of the First Ones, and runes of domination? 

Kel'Thuzad is looking to breach the Maw!

We cannot allow this to happen! The Maw has been locked away from the Shadowlands for good reason. Opening that floodgate could be catastrophic!

The baron is too powerful to confront headlong, so we will stop his ritual instead. Return to him with his reagents. I have made some "modifications" that should provide a calamitous end to his scheme.
61756.progress: My acolyte returns. What have you brought me?
61756.completion:
I see you managed to procure the reagents from Jor'dan, and... wait, what's this?

I am impressed that you managed to procure the shipment from the brokers when my sorcerers could not!  

You are quite the resourceful one, acolyte!
61756.title: Designed to Fail
61756.objectives: Bring the Bundle of "Modified" Reagents to Kel'Thuzad in the Vault of Souls.

61757.description:
Well then, since it was you who managed to procure the missing reagent, I find it only fair that you assist me with the final ritual! 

I can guarantee that this incantation will see you promoted to a full sorcerer of the house!

The preparations are already made. We can begin as soon as you are ready.
61757.title: Caught in the Act
61757.objectives: Assist Kel'Thuzad in completing the ritual.

61758.description:
There must be some way we can get ourselves out of these cells. 

I don't see anything I can use over here. Search your cell for anything that can facilitate our escape.
61758.title: Improvised Implements
61758.objectives: Search your cell for something that can be used to escape.

61759.description:
It takes but a simple act of necromancy to animate a hand. Unfortunately, since you will be in closest proximity, you must be the one to command it.

When you are ready, I will reanimate the hand. Once you have control, use it to pull the lever at the end of the hall. 

Couldn't be simpler, right?
61759.completion: We have no time to lose!
61759.title: A Helpful Hand
61759.objectives: Navigate the Reanimated Hand to the end of the hall and activate the Corroded Lever.

61760.description:
We must waste no time in warning the margrave of Kel'Thuzad's treachery. His reckless toying with forbidden powers could bring ruin to the house and beyond!

Let us put an end to this!
61760.progress: We must stop Kel'Thuzad before it's too late!
61760.completion:
I didn't think we would make it out of that encounter intact.

You are truly a skilled {class}, {NAME}.
61760.title: The Traitor Unmasked
61760.objectives: Confront Kel'Thuzad in the Hall of Sorcery.

61761.description:
We now have no choice but to make a strategic retreat. Kel'Thuzad is far too fortified within the necropolis, and if Ninadar is his ally, then the House of Rituals is firmly in his grasp.

It will take nothing short of an army to save the margrave now.
61761.completion:
The margrave has been captured? So Kel'Thuzad has seized control of the house!

This changes things.
61761.title: The Better Part of Valor
61761.objectives: Return to the Seat of the Primus.

61762.description:
If he be hostin' fancy courts with you and Temel, this dredger's gotta be special...

Smarter. Stronger. Quicker to apologize when they accidentally knock over the refreshments table and spill anima all over some poor duchess...

I got an idea! Broker bloke at the Night Market was tryin' to sell me some important drinks. Kaja'Extreme or somethin'.

Says it bigguns the brain, yeah? That's just what we need! 

Take these Scorchshrooms, that broker loves them, but note he rotates his costs each week.
61762.title: Making a Smarter Dredger
61762.objectives: Purchase a bottle of Kaja'Extreme from Ta'tru at the Night Market.

61763.description:
Here we go, onto the dredging part.

Just like we made that biggun here earlier!

I mean we don't need the stone of binding or three other dredgers, but you'll still be throwing stuff into the muck!

So it's the same. 

You head to the shore with this here Kaja-Infused Dredger Mix I whipped up for you.

Toss it into that muck pool and let's meet that new dredger butler of yours!
61763.completion: It worked! Of course I knew it would. Now what to name this guy... but first I am go'n to dismiss him so y'can test out the binding of the contract.
61763.title: Dredging up an Assistant
61763.objectives: Throw the Kaja-Infused Dredger Mix into the muck pool to create your dredger butler.

61764.description: Oi, why aren't you addressing me by my proper name? Wait, I don't remember my name, proper or other. Does this mean I have amnesias? Oh no, I don't have a name, please, help!
61764.completion: Oh yeah, that name totally fits my personality, or at least I think it does.
61764.title: Dredging up a Name
61764.objectives: Talk with your assistant and decide on a name for them.

61765.description:
The towering citadel in the distance is protected by perilous walls, but its greatest dangers cannot be seen with mortal eyes.

The Mawsworn have placed invisible runes of warding throughout Perdition Hold. These traps have caught many intruders unaware.

The runes can be dispelled, but only if you can see them. I believe one of their soulcloaks should give you the sight you require.

Good luck.
61765.progress: Are the wards gone? I am eager to resume surveillance of our enemy.
61765.completion: I trust you did not let your eyes wander while wearing the soulcloak? It can reveal some truly terrible things...
61765.title: Words of Warding

61766.description:
Every good party herald needs an assistant. Which is why I have you!

But every good party herald's assistant... also needs an assistant.

Which is why I procured permission from the prince for you to create your own dredger butler. We can start him on security while we cozy up to the guests and procure the necessary reading materials to train him on the social protocols of the different realms. He'll be entertaining the whole court in no time. 

No, don't thank me. You've earned this!
61766.completion:
You ready to get your hands dirty?

Makin' dredgers ain't pretty work.
61766.title: Homegrown Help
61766.objectives: Meet Rendle in Dredgewood to make a dredger butler.

61767.description:
Mograine has rallied the House of the Chosen to strike at Margrave Gharmal and his House of Constructs. They grow in strength with each passing day--this may be our only chance.

We will join them on the field of battle. We will have justice for the fallen at my temple, as well as Mograine's own fallen kin.

Rendezvous at Spider's Watch within Maldraxxus' northern reaches. We will move from there.
61767.completion: Now we can join our new allies.

61768.description:
We are to meet Baroness Draka aboard the Zerekriss above this position. Trust our allies' judgment in the battle ahead--true courage is knowing when to rely on the wisdom of others.

The plan is simple. Clear out our flanks to ensure Gharmal's forces do not interfere with our true goal, then assault the Margrave himself.

If we fail, we fail in the name of justice.

61769.description:
Alexandros and Emeni will lead the Chosen assault on the western gate. 

You and Xandria will direct your forces at the eastern gate. Secure the area and eliminate any resistance. 

Once both flanks are secured we can attack Gharmal directly.
61769.completion: This place is filled with horrors... horrors we will purge.

61770.description:
Did these fiends show my kin mercy when they attacked Bastion? When they tore my brothers and sisters limb from limb and used them to create more of these... these things?!

No! The butchers of Bastion made clear their hearts that day!

They deserve only the eternal darkness that awaits them. Ensure they see it!
61770.completion: All this bloodshed will not bring them back... but it may spare others the same fate.

61771.description:
Our forces above cannot fully descend upon this area while the Margrave's crystals cover the sky in destructive blasts.

The Margrave's foul butchers work even now to extract the remaining anima from the kyrian they abducted in their assault on Bastion. We must advance at once.

I shall imbue you with the flames of courage so that you may mark the crystals. Once marked, I will destroy them from afar.
61771.completion: You have done a great service here.

61772.description:
<The torn design document appears to be written by the late Surgeon Stitchflesh.>

...the kyrian flesh improves strength, obedience, and dexterity twofold! Such potential!

Now, if subject number one-three-five succeeds in a proper wing transplant at last...

<It continues on for some time. You should bring this to Artemede.>
61772.completion: Allow me to read this for a moment.
61772.title: Dark Developments
61772.objectives: Bring the Abhorrent Design to Artemede outside the Hall of Chains.

61773.description:
Though we have stopped the creation of more juggernauts, one of their most vile creations yet draws breath. It was born of one of the most pained souls they took from my temple.

As I flew above their ranks I could hear their surgeons chanting its name above the din of combat--Woeblade. It is an affront to all the kyrian stand for, an atrocity beyond any other.

Mark it with the flames of courage when you engage, and we will help you destroy it.
61773.completion: May our victory bring them peace.
61773.title: Descended

61774.description:
The scroll you recovered details all manner of horrific ways to 'integrate' fallen kyrian into Gharmal's abomination constructs.

It is also incomplete. There must be more of these among Stitchflesh's remaining followers.

I saw a number of surgeons and their lackeys retreat into the Hall of Chains just ahead as we arrived. I suspect they hold more of these scrolls.

We must ensure they are never read again.
61774.progress: This foul work must be destroyed.
61774.completion: Well done. I will see that these are destroyed personally.
61774.title: Burn Before Reading

61775.description:
Within the Hall of Chains lie more abominations that are nearly complete. As we speak the Margrave's forces work fervently to graft the last pieces of flesh to their horrific visages.

If they are allowed to finish their work, the constructs we have destroyed so far will mean little in the final conflict. Our flank will be overrun by a fresh wave of horrors, and the day will be lost.

That must not come to pass. Destroy any abominations you come across.
61775.completion: Every abomination denied is one less foe to contend with when we face Gharmal.
61775.title: An Early End

61776.description:
Alexandros and our Maldraxxi allies need reinforcement at the western gate on the Margrave's opposite flank. They are barely holding on!

Our forces will reinforce our position here and push forward towards Gharmal. We must make haste to Mograine--without both flanks we cannot hope to achieve victory.
61776.completion: I am glad Kynthia found you so quickly.
61776.title: Trouble on the Western Front
61776.objectives: Fly with Kynthia to report to Alexandros at the Stitchyard.

61777.description:
We can't advance with those juggernauts bombarding our position! I led a strike against the nearest, but conventional weapons do nothing against their imbued hides.

Thankfully, I have an idea.

Your old runeblade can't deal with them as it stands, but if you could purge Gharmal's empowered masses and absorb their essence into the blade...
61777.completion: This is a long shot, but it just might work...
61777.title: Charging The Blade
61777.objectives: Charge your runeblade by killing enemy constructs in the Stitchyard.

61778.description:
Gharmal's rocs dominate the skies above, striking at our forces as we advance. The Zerekriss can't get into position until they are cleared out!

I would take care of them myself, but I'm not much of a flier. Don't have the balance for it!

Take my riding hook and latch onto a roc. Once you're riding, just start hitting it 'til the job is done.
61778.completion: I could hear their cries from here. Nice work!
61778.title: Aerial Advantage
61778.objectives: Grapple 6 Battlesewn Rocs out of the sky.

61779.description:
My spies have identified several astral projectors that Margrave Gharmal uses to rally his troops in the Stitchyard.

I do not wish for a swarm of frenzied constructs to descend upon us during the final confrontation. Surely you see the wisdom in cutting their fervor.

See to it that these projectors are destroyed. We believe them to be along the yard's perimeter.
61779.progress: A blow inflicted to the enemy's morale can be as effective as traditional combat.
61779.completion: Gharmal's influence runs deep in this place, but it will fade more quickly thanks to your efforts.
61779.title: Grave Intent
61779.objectives: Destroy the Southwestern, Northwestern, and Northeastern Astral Projectors.

61780.description:
The Zerekriss is nearly in position. Now is the time to strike!

We must force Gharmal into the open together. Join me on my roc, and we will unleash your runeblade's power on the juggernauts.

The Margrave will be unable to ignore their deaths. Once he leaves his blighted tower, we can finish him once and for all.
61780.progress: Every moment the juggernauts live our position is in jeopardy!
61780.completion: Such power! Gharmal will have no choice but to face us now.
61780.title: Power of the Chosen

61781.description:
Our forces have control of the House of Constructs, thanks to your intervention.

Now, all that remains is the fall of the instigator themselves--Margrave Gharmal.

This battle has been long in the making, $p. I am at your side without hesitation.

Let us go to this monster. We will join Xandria to see him slain.
61781.title: The End is Now
61781.objectives: Meet with Xandria near the central chamber of the House of Constructs.

61782.description:
Draka stands ready to unleash the power of the Zerekriss upon Gharmal. We need only buy her time to focus its weapon.

What we do now, we do for all of us. Bastion and Maldraxxus have both lost many to these fiends.

He will not be defeated easily, but united our forces will finally bring him to justice!
61782.completion: Our fallen may finally rest in peace.
61782.title: Pursuit of Justice

61785.description:
One Alexandros Mograine of Maldraxxus is meeting with the Paragon of Courage in Archon's Rise. Xandria has requested you join them.

The two worked together recently to repel a nascent secondary assault on the Temple of Courage. Xandria seems to trust him well enough, so we have granted him access to the hold...for now.

I suspect they will not stay here long. You should make haste.
61785.completion: Good. Now we can begin the mission.
61785.title: An Expected Visitor
61785.objectives: Speak with Xandria in Archon's Rise.

61839.description: <The small gorger nips at your heels hungry and seeking your protection. Maybe it will like some of the plants here?>
61839.progress: Collect Endmire Vineroot for your small gorger.
61839.completion: <The gorger munches loudly on the vineroot and in between mouthfuls looks at you inquisitively.>
61839.title: Nipping at the Undergrowth

61840.description: <Again the small gorger shows up and you can clearly see is looking for more Endmire Vineroot.>
61840.progress: Collect Endmire Vineroot for your small gorger.
61840.completion: <You barely get your hand back as the gorger snags the bundle. You can't help but notice he looks to be getting bigger. In between bites he spits out something.>
61840.title: Vineroot on the Menu

61842.description: <Clearly bigger, the gorger looks at a vineroot you point to and you can see the hint of menace in its eye at being offered the root again. It looks longingly at the devourer mites nearby.>
61842.progress: Collect Infused Endmire Fruit from the Devourer Mites in the Endmire or Banewood.
61842.completion: <When you drop the fruit at the feet of the gorger he devourers each one whole,  clearly it is enjoying them. Looking at you not eating it lets a couple fall for you.>
61842.title: Vineroot Will Not Do

61844.description: <The gorger spawn bounded up to you, but was clearly looking at the devourer mites the entire time.>
61844.progress: Collect Infused Endmire Fruit from the Devourer Mites in the Endmire or Banewood.
61844.completion: <As you drop the fruit the gorger snaps some out of the air before they hit the ground. But you do see that the gorger has brought you a small item.>
61844.title: Hungry Hungry Gorger

61845.description:
The infusion of anima within Revendreth has led to a resurgence in devourer infestations. These eaters of the world must be slain.

By order of Prince Renathal and the rightful Court of Harvesters, this edict decrees the doom upon these aberrations.

Complete this quota of destruction within Revendreth and receive a reward equal to your efforts.
61845.completion:
Devourers. Filthy aberrations. We should have recognized their coming as the sign of the end times that they were.

You have our gratitude, Maw Walker.
61845.title: Edict of Doom: Devourers

61846.description:
The recent suffusion of anima in the region has led to an increase in dredbats being animated far and above any intended volume.

By order of Prince Renathal and the true Court of Harvesters an edict of doom is declared on dredbats within Revendreth. 

Avoid those used for transport or assigned to specific duties, but slay any in the less tamed regions of the realm and a reward shall be proffered.
61846.completion: Ah, well done. Dredbats are useful entities when they serve their intended purpose. Left unchecked and untamed, however, they become competing predators for what few souls remain in our care.
61846.title: Edict of Doom: Dredbats

61847.description:
There are many duties of a stoneborn that have been forsaken by the plans of Denathrius. 

One such duty is the elimination of manifestations. The process venthyr use to extract anima from souls is not clean, and often leads to unresolved issues made manifest. 

These entities are dangerous if left unchecked, and increase in number thanks to your revivication of anima to these droughted lands.

While you patrol Revendreth, destroy any manifestations you encounter and I shall provide you recompense.
61847.completion:
Your efforts are much appreciated. 

When this conflict is over, the Stone Legion should once again return to its noble purpose of protecting Revendreth, instead of satisfying the dark whims of Denathrius and his allies.
61847.title: Overdue Purging

61848.description:
By order of the true Court of Harvesters an edict of doom is issued for any Sinstone Golems that have coalesced into dangerous sizes within the realm. 

These entities are the manifestation of unresolved sins of those souls who failed their redemption and were condemned to the Maw. With the recent suffusion of anima to the region they have grown dangerously strong.

Expunge them from existence and recompense shall be provided.
61848.completion: You do the work the Stone Legion was once tasked to accomplish in better times. You have our gratitude.
61848.title: Edict of Doom: Sinstone Golems

61849.description:
Right. So you got a quota of venthyr you need offed and I got a mean need for some payback.

See, you may not think it to look at me but 'em venthyr loooove to chew on me specifically. Not sure what dark habit followed them across the veil but I just was a squishy bag of indulgence for far too long.

As you go about offin' 'em venthyr for your normal... motivations... I'd ask you to bring me a bunch of fangs off 'em you off, as it were. 

I'll pay for payback!
61849.progress: I'm gettin' quite a collection goin'.
61849.completion: Much obliged. This will go a long way to servin' "restitutions" as 'em fang heads would say.
61849.title: Take the Bite Out of 'Em

61851.description:
Yeah, this here muck pool's got everythin' we need to make your dredger butler.

We'll make this one special just for you. Made to specifications, as the fangs say.

First up, you gotta choose its color. Us dredgers comes in all kind of different shades of muck.

Take a peek at some me fellow dredgers and let me know what color we should dredge up for your butler.

We can recolor a dredger after-the-fact, but it ain't pleasant.

<Rendle shudders at the thought.>
61851.completion: I'll get the pigment all ready for you, but we're gonna need a little something extra for this dredger mucking.
61851.title: Shades of Muck
61851.objectives: Look at nearby dredgers to see color options, and then tell Rendle which color you want.

61869.description:
Zerekriss is ours... along with everything it contains.

The Primus was personally involved in the design of this necropolis. It was truly a sight to witness his hands shape the form of this vessel.

It would be wise to search the room. Perhaps he kept some tools here that might be of use to us.
61869.title: Search the Place
61869.objectives: Check the Foreman's Chest for anything valuable.

61871.description:
Ye've done good here, champion. MOTHER and I will be figurin' out what te do next.

Ye best get back te matters at hand, and do what ye can te empower that necklace o' yours.

I've got ways te reach ye once MOTHER and I have fixed things up here.
61871.completion: You're back. I suppose there's something around here for you to do.
61871.title: To Current Matters
61871.objectives: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail in Zuldazar.

61872.description:
Ye've done good here, champion. MOTHER and I will be figurin' out what te do next.

Ye best get back te matters at hand, and do what ye can te empower that necklace o' yours.

I've got ways te reach ye once MOTHER and I have fixed things up here.
61872.completion: {NAME}, it is good to see you again. There's much to do around here.
61872.title: To Current Matters
61872.objectives: Return to Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus.

61875.description:
The Thistledrop is magnificent creature. The roots go deep into the earth where they drink of waters most ancient. With these waters they collect the very essence of the land into a drop of dew that enables our artisans to craft powerful armaments.

Help us gather the dew and you will be well rewarded.

Hurry, before it evaporates!
61875.progress: The dew evaporates quickly, hurry now!
61875.completion:
This dew will help our craftmasters a great deal!

Thank you, little one.
61875.title: Doing the Dew
61875.objectives: Collect 30 Thistledrop Dew in Ardenweald's Forests.

61876.description:
Mograine and I spoke at length when he visited Bastion. He suggested that should we manage to kill Gharmal, his heart could be used to empower the Crest of Ascension.

The Margrave bears the power to shape form in ways few beings can. Though his results are grim, if we could harness that power our Ascended would be stronger than ever before.

It is not our way, but our way is changing, I think. Perhaps this is a step on our new path.
61876.completion: I am relieved that I am not the one to carry that thing back to Bastion.
61876.title: Take Heart

61877.description:
Let us ferry the heart to Elysian Hold swiftly.

There are many in the Shadowlands who would strike at us to take its power for their own. Keep your eyes open, Maw Walker.

We return to our kin victorious this day.
61877.completion: I am glad to be among our own once more. Maldraxxus is not to my tastes.
61877.title: Return to the Hold
61877.objectives: Meet Xandria at the Crest of Ascension in Elysian Hold in Bastion.

61878.description:
Once you are ready, all you must do is place the heart within the sphere here on the Crest of Ascension.

Mikanikos's handiwork will ensure that its energy is channeled properly to aid in our ascension rituals, and its power should help protect the Crest against any further attack.

May the House of Constructs never set foot in our realm again.
61878.progress: <This looks to be the orb Xandria directed you to place the heart in.>
61878.completion:
<The Fleshshaper's Heart fits readily into the glowing sphere. As it enters, you hear faint clicking sounds within the Crest, as if it were designed to accept such power readily.

Thus begins a new era for the kyrian.>
61878.title: Crest of Greatness
61878.objectives: Place the Fleshshaper's Heart in the Crest of Ascension.

61880.description:
It is my humble honor to be the Ember Court's first guest.

Please inform Prince Renathal and all of your other compatriots that I will certainly attend whenever you wish to open the gates.
61880.completion: If Kassir is coming, we had better ensure this is a formal affair.
61880.title: Honored Attendance
61880.objectives: Inform Temel that Cryptkeeper Kassir will attend the Ember Court.

61882.description:
The Accuser will be pleased that you have chosen such humble and formal entertainment for the first Ember Court.

I look forward to the occasion.
61882.completion: Ancient rituals? This is my kind of party!
61882.title: Formal Entertainment
61882.objectives: Inform Temel that you have secured entertainment for the Ember Court.

61884.description:
Tubbins's tea ready soon. Go tell Theotar and friends.

Tubbins is best!
61884.completion: Tubbins had better bring Gubbins along. He's the fun one!
61884.title: Formal Refreshments
61884.objectives: Inform Temel that you have secured refreshments for the Ember Court.

61892.description:
Expanding your influence is quite simple.

Find someone. Ask them what they want. Give it to them.

Congratulations. You now have influence with them.

If we wish to engage the other realms and win them over to our side, we must do the same on a larger scale.

So go to the other realms. Give them what they want. Expand our influence.
61892.completion:
Our contacts in the other realms have already reported positive chatter surrounding your actions there.

<Lady Ilinca smiles.>

Our influence grows.
61892.title: Ember Court Ambassador
61892.objectives: Complete World Quests across the Shadowlands.

61893.description:
Expanding your influence is quite simple.

Find someone. Ask them what they want. Give it to them.

Congratulations. You now have influence with them.

If we wish to engage the other realms and win them over to our side, we must do the same on a larger scale.

So go to the other realms. Give them what they want. Expand our influence.
61893.completion:
Our contacts in the other realms have already reported positive chatter surrounding your actions there.

<Lady Ilinca smiles.>

Our influence grows.
61893.title: Ember Court Ambassador
61893.objectives: Complete World Quests across the Shadowlands.

<Lady Ilinca smiles.>

Our influence grows.

61894.objectives: Complete World Quests across the Shadowlands.

Congratulations. You now have influence with them.

If we wish to engage the other realms and win them over to our side, we must do the same on a larger scale.

So go to the other realms. Give them what they want. Expand our influence.
61895.completion:
Our contacts in the other realms have already reported positive chatter surrounding your actions there.

<Lady Ilinca smiles.>

Our influence grows.
61895.title: Ember Court Ambassador
61895.objectives: Complete World Quests across the Shadowlands.

61896.description:
Do you know why the venthyr carve stoneborn into different shapes?

Because diversity in form allows for diversity in strategy. Our different shapes give us different purpose.

We need a new shape to solidify our court defenses.

With the right training and tools, venthyr guards could be hidden in plain sight--posed as greeters.

Able to be among the guests without raising concerns, they'd be the first to respond to active threats.
61896.completion: This was the easy part. The hard part will be finding guards who want to listen to socialites prattle for hours on end.
61896.title: Undercover Security
61896.objectives: Collect The Everyday Assassin training guide from Maldraxxus and 20 Enchanted Trickster Dust from Ardenweald.

61898.description:
The reviews are in, $p. Our menu is too Revendreth-centric!

All the best courts have exotic appetizers, small plates, and other specialties that guests can look forward to every time they come.

And for a court like ours, which boasts frequent guests from other realms, we simply must do better!

Do not worry, after tireless research, I have drafted a very particular list of ingredients for you to find me.

Bring them to me, and I will serve our guests eternity on a platter!
61898.progress: Are you sure Picky Stefan wanted ALL of these things?
61898.completion:
I never understand you mortals' fascination with cheese... It looks disgusting.

But Picky Stefan gets what Picky Stefan wants!

61899.description:
You started a trend, $p!

Your constant gallivanting around the different realms of the Shadowlands has inspired a new flair for the exotic among Revendreth's elite. If it's from outside Revendreth, the venthyr want to try it.

And I know just what the next big thing will be: anima tastings!

Think about it: we--and by 'we' I mean 'you'--bring back fresh anima from all the different realms you travel to.

Then socialites get to sip it and pretend it tastes like wherever you got it from!
61899.progress: That's a whole lot of anima you got there. That's all just for drinking?
61899.completion:
Hips already sent over a name for the Master of Anima he wants to lead the tastings.

I'll get her on the staff and have this stuff delivered to her.

61900.description:
I want guests to sit.

Standing is hard. I know 'cause I stand a lot.

Guest should sit and be comfy.

I make comfy chairs for all guests to sit.

Guests be happy, stay longer!
61900.progress: Boot knows his stuff. If he says we should make chairs, we should make chairs.
61900.completion:
<Temel can't stop himself from feeling the soft vulpin fur.>

Ooo, these chairs are going to be so comfortable!

61916.progress:
Decorations not ready!

Last Ember Court, those big fires from candles burn all the tablecloths.

Bring me pretty cloth and I make new tablecloths.

Then we can pick decorations for next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Shrouded Cloth (5)
61916.completion:
This good cloth. Will dip in muck to make fire-proof.

Decorations be ready for you now!

61945.description:
Smart move bringing in the specialists, $p.

Once you get into this week's Ember Court, be sure to let the specialists know what you want them to do.

Breakfist down in the dredger pools can smash or clean things to make the court more Messy or Clean for you.

Crooked Crick in the refreshments area can adjust Decadence.

Lady Ilinca in the embassy area can adjust Formality.

Cosmin the Illusionist on stage can adjust Excitement.

Wing Commander Vulpek at the front gates can adjust Danger.
61945.completion:
Phew, those professionals know how to get a job done!

I'll make sure they're at every Ember Court from now on, you just gotta swing by and give them orders before the gates open.
61945.title: The Professionals
61945.objectives: Enter the Ember Court, then give orders to one of the specialist staff members.

61950.description:
The supply of attuned anima is running low again. I'm surprised that we've managed to stretch our resources so far without a resupply.

You've proven yourself proficient at tracking down what is needed, perhaps you could assist us once again?

The runestags that roam Ardenweald's forests are particularly suffused with the power of the wilds, anima retrieved from them will be optimal for our needs.

Good hunting!
61950.progress: Worry not about the runestags, after some time they will return. This is just one part of the eternal cycle.
61950.completion:
Good job! Your efforts will go a long way to keeping our production moving ahead.

Thank you!
61950.title: Hunting the Wilds

61963.description:
The Wild Hunt is made up of fae who have dedicated their lives to the protection of Ardenweald and its denizens. Each member has skill sharp as a blade and sense unlike no other.

We have spoken to a duo, an evoker and a huntress, who will permit us to capture their memories for training if we help them on a particular hunt.

Meet Alderyn in Claw's Edge. He is one you seek.
61963.progress: You are not of these lands. How may I aid you?
61963.completion:
The envoy of the kyrian, armed with the perfect weapon to pierce our quarry's armor.

Are you ready for a hunt?
61963.title: Called to the Hunt
61963.objectives: Find Alderyn in Claw's Edge in Ardenweald.

61965.description:
Our quarry is one of the gorm, native creatures who were once helpful beasts of the realm, until the drought drove them mad.

This particular beast has not only grown to a frightening size, but also has a shell so strong that none of our weapons or arrows have managed to pierce it.

This spear you bring, infused with the anima of Bastion, could be the exact weapon we need to pierce the gorm's armor and put him down.

My sister went ahead to scout. Let's not linger.
61965.completion: The terror has been put down. Your aid, and your spear, were quite useful.
61965.title: Piercing the Shell
61965.objectives: Find Myn'ir in the Gormhive, then kill the Fortified Desiccator.

61968.description:
For untold ages, the humble Ardenmoth has supplied the scales for the creation of armor for the Wild Hunt. 

Now, with our attention divided between the threats to the realm and the anima drought, it has become increasingly difficult for our foragers to find the perfect scales that we require.

Only the scales of the highest quality are suitable. If you should obtain any in your travels and return with them, I shall ensure you are well rewarded.
61968.completion: Ah, remarkable quality! You've done well!
61968.title: Just Wing It
61968.objectives: Collect 28 Perfect Ardenmoth Wing Scales from Ardenmoths.

61981.description:
Right, here's the gig: we need anima.

Not just a bit or a pinch, but a lot. See, anythin' worth doin' can't be done without anima. Not in the Shadowlands. Not if we are gonna fix this mess Denathrius got us in.

So, we need your increasin'ly resourceful self to beg, borrow, steal, nick, burglarize, pulverize, pirate-ize, earn, swindle, or otherwise become the source of a great charity of any anima you can get.

Bring it to me, an' I'll stock our coffers, as it were, so you can put it to use.
61981.progress: How goes the anima hunt? You pinch us a pint or boost us keg?
61981.completion: Now that's a right grey professional job that is. This anima will get us makin' some fancy stuff in no time.
61981.title: Replenish the Reservoir
61981.objectives: Collect anima sources for the Anima Reservoir at Sinfall in Revendreth.

61982.description:
Hail, Maw Walker.

As our influence over Bastion grows, so too does our need for our most precious resource--anima.

We must replenish our reserves. Scour the realms for all that you can find and return here with the anima. 

With our precious reserves replenished, we can direct the anima wherever it is needed most.

Go in service, {class}.
61982.progress: Every drop of anima is a gift in these times.
61982.completion: You have my thanks, Maw Walker. We will not let it go to waste.
61982.title: Replenish the Reservoir
61982.objectives: Collect anima sources for the Anima Reservoir at Elysian Hold in Bastion.

61985.description:
The land speaks to me, {NAME}. Ardenweald is a realm of cycles, but it has never faced an anima drought such as this.

We will need the aid of all who reside here if we are to make it through this crisis.

Many souls slumber within the forests and hills. If they can provide us some of their anima, we may be able to endure a little longer. Should you encounter any of the souls in your travels, please awaken them and send them to me.
61985.completion:
This dew will help our craftmasters a great deal!

Thank you, little one.
61985.title: Wake The Sleepers

61996.description:
Ever since I cast my first spell, I've not been able to get enough of magic!

It's not as hard as all those liches say it is. You focus your thoughts, say the words, and magic starts happening!

There are tomes documenting ancient spells stored in the Archivam of Revendreth. Help me gather them so I can learn some new spells!
61996.completion: You have helped strengthen our forces, Maw Walker.
61996.title: Say The Magic Words
61996.objectives: Help Sabrina learn 12 new spells in Revendreth.

61998.progress:
We got room for another big statue on this here spot.

You get me some stone and I'll make whatever kind of statue you want, yeah?

Maybe one of you, or someone else, yeah?
Stone Brick (10)
61998.completion: Tell me what kind of sculpture you want me to make!
61998.title: Legacy of Stone

62041.description:
I've heard about the chaos in Revendreth. Reports of exiles driven mad and burned in the Desiccation. 

The very thought of all that suffering fills me with the urge to do something about it.

If you are headed there, please let me accompany you. I simply must help as many as I can!
62041.completion:
