Suffering is commonplace among those in Revendreth, but you and Roseboil were able to help a few of them nonetheless. 

Well done.
62041.title: In A Bad Light
62041.objectives: Use Roseboil's Regenerative Molt to cure 15 Light-Seared Exiles.

62043.description:
You must prove your worth to us again {NAME}.

We have not forgotten your betrayal.

Yet you say you seek penance. This task will start to demonstrate that you are serious about earning back our trust.
62043.completion:
So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

Once you complete this task with me you will leave your current Covenant and rejoin the Kyrian.
62043.title: Prove Your Worth
62043.objectives: Complete the task for the Kyrian.

62044.description: <The gorger is clearly bigger, it gestures with its head towards one of the other gorgers as if urging you to attack it.>
62044.progress: Attack and defeat devourer gorgers in the Endmire.
62044.completion: <There is little expression you can see on the gorger's 'face' but it appears as if it is very full of itself as if it defeated them on its own. It does offer you a shiny thing it found.>
62044.title: Standing Toe To Toe

62045.description: <Again the gorger is strutting ready for more fighting, staring down the the closest gorger.>
62045.progress: Attack and defeat devourer gorgers in the Endmire.
62045.completion: <Head high the gorger is really strutting his stuff and is clearly thinking you make a great team. He looks up at you ... and he spits up something that he thinks you might like.>
62045.title: Ready for More

62046.description: <The gorger is more than fully grown, rivaling most of the other devourers in the area. It clearly wants to stay with you, but it appears to be uneasy straying too far from the world eaters. Maybe if you take one down together it will not hold as much sway over the gorger.>
62046.progress: <The gorger gestures in the direction of a worldeater, seemingly feeling up to the challenge with you by its side.>
62046.completion: <The gorger is ecstatic that you took down a worldeater. It's excitement is palpable and it is on the brink of picking you up and carrying out off on a new adventure.>
62046.title: A New Pack

62052.description:
The liches of the House of Rituals were an instrumental piece in the Maldraxxi attack on Bastion. They are not currenty our allies, and it would be difficult to convince one to let us capture their memory for our training purposes.

We have made contact with a necromancer who has a score to settle with one of the liches. Find her and she will aid you in capturing this memory.
62052.progress: <Karaxi is sifting through a book very carefully.>
62052.completion: My plan is truly coming to fruition. An outsider, here to help me enact my revenge!
62052.title: Exiled by Paranoia
62052.objectives: Find Karaxi the Defector in the Challenger's Promenade in Maldraxxus.

62053.description:
My old master, Thran'tiok, is the epitome of paranoia. She believes everybody will turn on her, and it led to my exilement from not only her service, but the House of Rituals as a whole.

I had no intent to cross her... but that has changed.

Take the crystal casing you have built and slay my old colleagues to infuse it with necromantic energy. It shall lead you to Thran'tiok's phylactery, which should be exactly what we both seek.
62053.progress:
Thran'tiok thinks I am a threat...

I will show her what that word truly means.
62053.completion: We do not have much time. Thran'tiok will appear herself soon.
62053.title: Necromantic Power
62053.objectives: Charge the Soulseeker Crystal by defeating foes in the House of Rituals, then use it to find Thran'tiok's phylactery.

62054.description:
We need to show Denathrius that we mean business. His dredger... pet... should do the trick.

Bring me his head. Four times should do it. Dredgers are curious creatures.
62054.progress: I need the heads or we cannot make a profound statement.
62054.completion: With these I'm certain we'll catch the attention of Sire Denathrius.
62054.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
62054.objectives: Collect 4 Sludgefist's Head from Sludgefist within Castle Nathria on Normal Difficulty.

62055.description:
We need to show Denathrius that we mean business. His dredger... pet... should do the trick.

Bring me his head. Four times should do it. Dredgers are curious creatures.
62055.progress: I need the heads or we cannot make a profound statement.
62055.completion: With these I'm certain we'll catch the attention of Sire Denathrius.
62055.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
62055.objectives: Collect 4 Sludgefist's Head from Sludgefist within Castle Nathria on Heroic Difficulty.

62056.description:
We need to show Denathrius that we mean business. His dredger... pet... should do the trick.

Bring me his head. Four times should do it. Dredgers are curious creatures.
62056.progress: I need the heads or we cannot make a profound statement.
62056.completion: With these I'm certain we'll catch the attention of Sire Denathrius.
62056.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
62056.objectives: Collect 4 Sludgefist's Head from Sludgefist within Castle Nathria on Mythic Difficulty.

62057.description:
I've heard reports that the number of gorm sightings have risen greatly the past few days.

Normally they're simple decomposers, playing their part in the great cycle, but in great numbers the gorm can be aggressive. If left unchecked, their ravenous hunger will cause untold destruction.

The Wild Hunt has called for a gorm hunt. Meet your quota and you will be well-rewarded.
62057.completion: Ah, good work. The gorm serve their purpose, but as in all things, balance must be maintained.
62057.title: Those Who Hunger

62059.description:
You must prove your worth to us again {NAME}.

We have not forgotten your betrayal.

Yet we know you seek penance. This task should prove your willingness to rejoin our ranks.
62059.completion:
So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

Once you complete this task with me you will leave your current Covenant and rejoin the Necrolords.
62059.title: Prove Your Worth
62059.objectives: Complete the task for the Necrolords.

62060.description:
You must prove your worth to us again {NAME}.

We have not forgotten your betrayal.

Yet we know you seek penance. This task should prove your willingness to rejoin our ranks.
62060.completion: So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?
62060.title: Prove Your Worth
62060.objectives: Complete the task for the Night Fae.

62061.description:
You must prove your worth to us again {NAME}.

We have not forgotten your betrayal.

Yet we know you seek penance. This task should prove your willingness to rejoin our ranks.
62061.completion: So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?
62061.title: Prove Your Worth
62061.objectives: Complete the task for the Venthyr.

62062.progress:
Decorations not ready!

Last Ember Court, those thieves steal more than memories. They steal rugs too!

New rugs be so heavy thieves can't carry! Bring me things to make heavy rugs.

Then we can pick decorations for next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Shrouded Cloth (2)
Porous Stone (5)
62062.completion:
Ha! New rugs be heavy and pretty... just like me.

Decorations be ready for you now!
62062.title: Restock: Stolen Rugs

62064.progress:
Decorations not ready!

Last Ember Court, those prisoners break all the mirrors when they escape!

Laurent help me fix, but need pieces.

Then we can pick decorations for next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Angerseye (1)
62064.completion:
With mirrors fixed, I can see my pretty face again.

Decorations be ready for you now!
62064.title: Restock: Broken Mirrors

62065.progress:
Decorations not ready!

Last Ember Court, one of them big bad dredgers sit on my favorite table, break in half!

Need wood to fix table.

Then we can pick decorations for next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Twilight Bark (2)
62065.completion:
I make sure no big bad dredgers sit on my table again.

Decorations be ready for you now!
62065.title: Restock: My Favorite Table

62066.progress:
Decorations not ready!

Last Ember Court, that big slimeball leaked slimeball slime into our muckpool. Every new dredger all slimy!

Need way to get rid of all bad stuff... You know thing does that?

Then we can pick decorations for next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Potion of Soul Purity (2)
62066.completion:
Okay... I pour into muckpool and see if helps.

Decorations be ready for you now!
62066.title: Restock: Dredger Pool

62067.progress:
Decorations not ready!

Last Ember Court, dredgers see big new statue made. All want statues now!

Bring me stone and I carve tiny statues to hold. Make all dredgers happy.

Then we can pick decorations for next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Porous Stone (15)
62067.completion:
Maybe I carve for prince too. He like statues, yeah?

Decorations be ready for you now!
62067.title: Restock: Statues

62069.progress:
We got a problem, {NAME}.

Last Ember Court, the Accuser's rituals were a little TOO convincing. A bunch of my dredgers want their own sinstones now, so they can list things they think they've done wrong.

I'm going to need some resources to soothe their guilty consciences.

Then we can pick our entertainment for the next Ember Court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Collect: Sinstone Fragments (10)
62069.completion:
I can't believe we're doing this... But I am curious to see what the crew writes on these.

We can book the next Entertainment whenever you're ready.
62069.title: Restock: Sinstones

62070.progress:
We got a problem, {NAME}.

Last Ember Court, some of the animals had... issues. I can't get the stains out and everything reeks!

I'm going to need some very fragrant flowers to cover up this smell.

Then we can pick our entertainment for the next Ember Court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Vigil's Torch (1)
62070.completion:
These smell great! Or at least better than the current smell...

We can book the next Entertainment whenever you're ready.
62070.title: Restock: Fragrant Flowers

62073.progress:
We got an opportunity, {NAME}.

The Lost Chalice Band is the hottest entertainment in Revendreth after that killer performance at the last Ember Court. It's all anyone's talking about.

We should make some band shirts, give 'em out for free to keep the hype rolling.

Bring me the materials and I'll take care of the rest.

Then we can pick our entertainment for the next Ember Court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Soul Dust (1)
Shrouded Cloth (2)
62073.completion:
Soon every socialite in Revendreth will wearing one of these, promoting our court.

We can book the next Entertainment whenever you're ready.
62073.title: Restock: Band Shirts

62075.progress:
We got a problem, {NAME}.

Last Ember Court, we were able to save quite of a few of those abused souls the Master's minions attacked us with. 

That's great, but we need more chains and cages if we're going to keep that many souls here until the Accuser can take them.

Then we can pick our entertainment for the next Ember Court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Desolate Leather (5)
Sinvyr Ore (1)
62075.completion:
I'll get the ritualists to help us build the cages, so they'll be done right.

We can book the next Entertainment whenever you're ready.
62075.title: Restock: Soul Cages

62076.progress:
We got a problem, {NAME}.

Last Ember Court, that provocateur's gossip spread further than we thought. I've gotten all sorts of uncomfortable questions from socialites and nobles unsure of what to believe.

We've got to write some pamphlets to set the record straight and dispel that scoundrel's lies!

Then we can pick our entertainment for the next Ember Court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Dark Parchment (2)
Luminous Ink (1)
62076.completion:
Writing letters: one of the oldest forms of entertainment.

We can book the next Entertainment whenever you're ready.
62076.title: Restock: Free Press

62078.progress:
We got a problem, {NAME}.

Last Ember Court, the Countess's clothier showed everyone the future of fashion and we're all way behind. Medallions are all the rage, thanks to the Prince's growing collection.

I can't get a medallion, but I at least need a necklace so I don't get laughed out of courts.

Then we can pick our entertainment for the next Ember Court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (20)
62078.completion:
I can't believe I'm going to wear this gaudy necklace, but if this is what it takes to make sure we always have access to the best entertainment...

<Hips sighs.>

We can book the next Entertainment whenever you're ready.
62078.title: Restock: Fashion Accessories

62080.progress:
I suffer yet another crisis in the kitchen, Maw Walker!

Last Ember Court, our guests drank more tea than Theotar himself! Our entire supply is depleted.

I simply must acquire new tea ingredients, and I only accept the highest quality!

After that, I shall happily discuss refreshment options for our next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Widowbloom (1)
Marrowroot (1)
62080.completion:
Ah yes, these shall make a glorious tea once I have dehydrated them.

Now we may discuss refreshments for our next Ember Court.
62080.title: Restock: Herbal Tea

62081.description:
Reports say that once again the spriggan are proving to be a nuisance, {NAME}.

Word is that a bunch of them broke into the stores at the Heart of the Forest and made off with a huge store of animacones.

Needless to say, we need those animacones back.

The report says the spriggan group split up as they were making their escape, so any one you see is as likely to be carrying the animacones as the next. 

Good luck.
62081.progress: Were you able to find the animacones?
62081.completion: You were able to retrieve all of them? Outstanding!
62081.title: Return Those Animacones!
62081.objectives: Collect 44 Looted Animacones from spriggan within Ardenweald.

62082.progress:
I suffer yet another crisis in the kitchen, Maw Walker!

Last Ember Court, while your guests were so flippantly flinging food around court, several stray pies flew directly into my personal food supplies. Everything was ruined!

You know I do not like to make a fuss, but I simply must insist that you replace the delicacies ruined by that unwelcome food fight.

After that, I shall happily discuss refreshment options for our next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Banana Beef Pudding (1)
Steak a la Mode (1)
62082.completion:
Thank you. All is forgiven.

Now we may discuss refreshments for our next Ember Court.
62082.title: Restock: Personal Stash

62083.progress:
I suffer yet another crisis in the kitchen, Maw Walker!

Last Ember Court, those wild mushrooms you brought poisoned me and half of the socialites!

Thankfully, it does not appear to be a lethal poison, but it has been most uncomfortable for all involved.

We are in desperate need of anti-venom.

After that, I shall happily discuss refreshment options for our next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Spiritual Anti-Venom (1)
62083.completion:
<Picky Stefan pinches his nose and sips from the potion vial.>

I have never been more eager to consume something that tastes so foul.

Now we may discuss refreshments for our next Ember Court.
62083.title: Restock: Medical Supplies

62084.progress:
I suffer yet another crisis in the kitchen, Maw Walker!

Last Ember Court, the venthyr invaders did not just assault our guests--they stole our cutlery!

My old friend Forgy can craft replacement cutlery for us, but we will need to provide the supplies.

After that, I shall happily discuss refreshment options for our next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Laestrite Ore (2)
62084.completion:
The old cutlery was due to be replaced anyway.

Now we may discuss refreshments for our next Ember Court.
62084.title: Restock: Fine Cutlery

62085.description:
<The dense, chunky liquid inside the vessel emits a horrendous odor.

The initials O.K. are etched into the side. It seems someone stole Overseer Kalvaros' canteen.>
62085.completion:
I've been wondering where my canteen went. Where did you find this, {NAME}? Did you take a drink before returning here?

No matter, I suppose.
62085.title: ...Why Me?
62085.objectives: Deliver the Reclaimed Vessel to Overseer Kalvaros at the Challenger's Promenade.

62087.progress:
I suffer yet another crisis in the kitchen, Maw Walker!

Last Ember Court, the stone fiends dropped more than Theotar's tea set. They broke the dinnerware I had imported directly from Ardenweald, in order to help our Night Fae guests feel at home!

I believe I can repair them, but I will need resources.

After that, I shall happily discuss refreshment options for our next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Phaedrum Ore (1)
Twilight Bark (1)
62087.completion:
I am certain that our Night Fae friends will appreciate the effort we have gone through to accommodate them.

Now we may discuss refreshments for our next Ember Court.
62087.title: Restock: Imported Dinnerware

62094.progress:
I suffer yet another crisis in the kitchen, Maw Walker!

You may recall that an excess of gnats swarmed our last Ember Court. Although initially repulsed, I have begun to ponder if there might be some culinary value to these creatures.

I would like to attempt a few meals with them. I shall require a few things to steel myself for the culinary adventure.

After that, I shall happily discuss refreshment options for our next court.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Aerated Water (5)
62094.completion:
Wish me luck... I fear that I shall need it.

Now we may discuss refreshments for our next Ember Court.
62094.title: Restock: Exploratory Meals

62095.progress:
I have an urgent matter to discuss.

While the volunteer portion of our security showed tremendous bravery at the last Ember Court, it was clear that they were unprepared for the rigors of battle. They suffered tremendous injuries.

We need to resupply our medical team to be ready for the next court.

After that is resolved, we can discuss security options for future Ember Courts.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Shrouded Cloth Bandage (2)
Spiritual Healing Potion (1)
62095.completion:
Thank you. Caring for the wounded is an honorable endeavor.

The full breadth of our Security options are available to us now.
62095.title: Restock: Medic's Tent

62104.progress:
I have an urgent matter to discuss.

At the last Ember Court, many of our stoneborn suffered fractures and cracked limbs while defending our guests. We will need to repair them.

Bring me the stone, and I will coordinate the repairs with our dredgers.

After that is resolved, we can discuss security options for future Ember Courts.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Shaded Stone (2)
62104.completion:
This should be enough to rebuild the fallen stoneborn.

The full breadth of our Security options are available to us now.
62104.title: Restock: Stoneborn Reserves

62105.progress:
I have an urgent matter to discuss.

Fighting alongside the Maldraxxi forces at the last Ember Court inspired me to strategize outside of the typical boundaries of venthyr warfare.

I am certain you mortals have developed creative weapons. Bring me some, so that I may learn them.

After that is resolved, we can discuss security options for future Ember Courts.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Nutcracker Grenade (1)
Shadow Land Mine (1)
62105.completion:
Interesting. I did not expect them to be so... mechanical.

The full breadth of our Security options are available to us now.
62105.title: Restock: Unconventional Weapons

62106.progress:
I have an urgent matter to discuss.

The Stone Legion's surprise attack on our last Ember Court revealed that I have been far too lax in pursuing enchantments for our troops' equipment. We must use every advantage at our disposal.

Bring me any enchantment you can spare.

After that is resolved, we can discuss security options for future Ember Courts.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Enchant Bracers - Shaded Hearthing (1)
62106.completion:
The next time the Stone Legion invades, we'll be ready for them.

The full breadth of our Security options are available to us now.
62106.title: Restock: Enchantments

62108.progress:
I have an urgent matter to discuss.

At the last Ember Court, the devourer's ambush tactics caught our guards by surprise. Their portals opened all around us and we were too slow to respond.

We should stock up on supplies that will allow us to adapt to changing circumstances.

After that is resolved, we can discuss security options for future Ember Courts.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Potion of the Psychopomp's Speed (1)
62108.completion:
Even those made of stone can change with time.

The full breadth of our Security options are available to us now.
62108.title: Restock: Strategic Codices

62109.progress:
I have an urgent matter to discuss.

As you are aware, a murder occurred at the last Ember Court. That is an unacceptable failing on my part and I apologize.

I would like to acquire additional surveillance equipment to ensure we are prepared if it happens again.

After that is resolved, we can discuss security options for future Ember Courts.
Collect: Infused Ruby (5)
Potion of the Hidden Spirit (1)
Potion of Shaded Sight (1)
62109.completion:
I tolerate many questionable activities in the court, but murder will not be one of them.

The full breadth of our Security options are available to us now.
62109.title: Restock: Surveillance Equipment

62155.description:
Stone is a rare material in Ardenweald. Yet, I've heard tales that those who were masked by the Drust have small stones upon them.

I'd like you to retrieve some of these stones for the Wild Hunt, so that we may better understand their link to our enemy.
Face the masked and collect the stones from their deceased forms and I'll compensate you for your efforts.

It's a gruesome task, but one that must be done.
62155.completion: You were able to retrieve all of them? Outstanding!
62155.title: Runestone Roundup
62155.objectives: Collect 18 Runestone Spikes from drust possessed fae within Ardenweald.

62157.description:
The resurgence of the Scourge is troubling enough, but there are also reports that the Cult of the Damned has risen anew as well.

If true, then that bodes ill for us all. We cannot allow the cultists' machinations to continue unchecked.

I suggest we engage in some reconnaissance.
62157.completion:
They must be planning something. Though what, I cannot say.

I will instruct our scouts to observe and report.
62157.title: Scouting from a Safe Distance
62157.objectives: Survey the Cult of the Damned's presence at Aldur'thar and Mord'rethar.

62159.description:
There is much to do within the Shadowlands. Many areas are suffering from the anima drought.

The choice of who to help first is yours. Where will you go?
62159.completion: This is your first step towards thwarting the Jailer.

62160.description:
This grove needs something special, something to make it really stand out.

I have a plan, but first I need flowers.

Not just any flowers, but Night Lillies. They have a sweet scent that evokes starlit nights spent standing on a hilltop overlooking the majesty of the land.

As you go exploring Ardenweald, look to the waterways for Night Lillies growing in the waterways and collect them.
I will pay you for your efforts, of course.
62160.progress: Were you able to find any of the lillies?
62160.completion:
Ah, their scent is lovely!

Having a few of these placed around the grove will greatly help with morale.

62161.description:
I want nothing more than to make for Revendreth immediately... but it seems they have their own challenges to face.

All know of the mark we left on Bastion. The venthyr are sure to be wary of allowing us into their realm.

Once again, we must turn to you. Your renown across the Shadowlands has earned you the trust of many. Now, we need the trust of Revendreth.
62161.completion: You're just in time. I've received a missive.

62162.description:
Justicar Trueheart has sent a personal request for your immediate assistance, {NAME}.

The frozen winds of Icecrown await your return.
62162.completion: I am glad for your return, {NAME}.

62163.description:
Justicar Trueheart has sent a personal request for your immediate assistance, {NAME}.

The frozen winds of Icecrown await your return.
62163.completion: I am glad for your return, {NAME}.

62165.description:
Your presence is needed within the Enclave.

It is time for you to choose a covenant to ally yourself with.

62166.description:
Your presence is needed within the Enclave.

It is time for you to choose a covenant to ally yourself with.
62166.title: Tal-Inara's Call
62166.objectives: Meet Tal-Inara within the Enclave in Oribos.

62169.description:
The House of Eyes still reels from Akarek's demise. They search for direction. For purpose.

Perhaps you can help them find it. Continue to gain the trust of the Eyes. Their skills will be invaluable to our cause.
62169.completion: You've done well, Maw Walker. The Eyes place their trust in you.
62169.title: Eyes to the Sky

62170.description:
<You have stumbled upon some messy notes. Some of the lines seem incomprehensible while others seem melodic.>

Like wind and rain, discord storms my mind, tossing and blowing.
...
I must find the golden skies.
...
Remember, walk on, heart full of hope, and you'll never walk alone.

<It seems as though an aspirant cannot find their way home. You should inform someone at Hero's Rest.>
62170.completion: Ah, these wise words are certainly Eurgon's. I'm happy to report he made it home.
62170.title: You'll Never Walk Alone
62170.objectives: Turn these notes in to Inkiep in Hero's Rest.

62172.progress:
Is that a slightly worn doublet for me!
Dredger's Short Sleeved Doublet (1)
62172.completion: Thank you! I will put this away until the time is right to wear it.
62172.title: Shortsleeved Doublet

62173.progress:
<Your dredger reaches out enthusiastically for the long sleeved doublet.>
Dredger's Long Sleeved Doublet (1)
62173.completion: Oooh, it has sleeves that go past my elbows, thank you! I can't wait until we find the right time to wear it.
62173.title: Long Sleeved Doublet
62173.objectives: <Your dredger reaches out enthusiastically for the long sleeved doublet.>.

62174.progress:
<Your dredger butler eyes you as if not sure if you are giving him the coif, or just asking him to hold it for you.>
Leather Dredger Coif (1)
62174.completion: Is that a cap for me? It is so floppy, I love it! And it will go around my ears!
62174.title: A Proper Cover
62174.objectives: <Your dredger butler eyes you as if not sure if you are giving him the coif, or just asking him to hold it for you.>.

62175.progress:
Who is this? Oh, look at those flowing locks...
Fabius's Portrait (1)
62175.completion:
<Your butler shakes his head back and forth imagining the flowing locks in the portrait.>

Oooh, thanks, I am sure we could find a good time to cut my hair like this!
62175.title: Looking Fabulous
62175.objectives: Who is this? Oh, look at those flowing locks...

62176.progress:
That creature has a very distinct look...
Critter Two-Thumbs Portrait (1)
62176.completion: I bet if I curled into a ball using it the spikes would be pretty scary, not that I would think of doing anything like that at a party, unless we could use that... I will just save this poster for when the time is right for this cut.
62176.title: The Spikey Look
62176.objectives: That creature has a very distinct look...

62177.progress:
Oh, I have seen this dredger before!
Burgleclipped Portrait (1)
62177.completion: Ooh, this look feels fitting for a role like mine, I am sure many other dredgers have assisted while sporting this sparse, scraggly look. I can't wait to try it out!
62177.title: A Memorable Look

62178.progress:
Another muck dye!
Phial of Black Muck Dye (1)
62178.completion: Ah, black muck, it stains the fingers, but is very distinguished. I will save this for the next time we need to dye my doublet. I want to remind you that we will need one for each dying, but I can keep this one ready.
62178.title: Black Muck Dye

62179.progress:
Isn't muck so versatile!
Vial of Blue Muck Dye (1)
62179.completion: Do you think the blue muck looks like the sky? Dirk thought it did, but I don't think so. I will save this for the next time we need to dye my doublet. I want to remind you that we will need one for each dying, but I can keep this one ready.
62179.title: Blue Muck Dye

62180.progress:
There are so many muck colors, how do you choose just one?
Green Muck Dye (1)
62180.completion: I have only visited the Banewood Muck Pool once, but I found it was a bit crowded myself, I definitely prefer working solo. I will save this for the next time we need to dye my doublet. I want to remind you that we will need one for each dying, but I can keep this one ready.
62180.title: Green Muck Dye

62181.progress:
Is that one still bubbling?
Bubbling Red Muck Dye (1)
62181.completion: Ooh, its still warm. I could live out in the Ember Ward. I will save this for the next time we need to dye my doublet. I want to remind you that we will need one for each dying, but I can keep this one ready.
62181.title: Bubbling Red Muck Dye

62182.description: The letter is addressed to Nadja's contact Dimwiddle in Darkhaven. It is clearly sealed with Nadja's mark. It is certainly of great import, you should make sure the letter is delivered.
62182.completion: Uh, what can Dimwiddle do for you? Oh, a letter... <Dimwiddle sees Nadja's mark and his eyes go wide> yes, thank you I have been awaiting that letter. It's from my aunt <Dimwiddle winks at you> she has been ill. I will make sure to tell everyone you helped deliver important letters!
62182.title: A Letter From Nadja

62183.description: A very exact entity wanted this package to reach Ta'tru at the Night Market. It looks like Broker script. The package is clearly leaking, and it is marked perishable. Perhaps delivering it quickly would be best.
62183.completion: Ooh, is that my package of flesh-eating ooze?! I hope you did not get any on your hands. Wearing gloves while handling this particular ooze should mean you have only a 25% chance of suffering an adverse effect. The gloves may be burned, but I will leave that to your discretion. I will inform the locals of your assistance in delivery, even if it was delayed.
62183.title: A Leaking Box Marked Perishable
62183.objectives: Deliver the package to the Night Market.

62184.description: The crate is fairly big and looks heavy, but it also looks like something someone would be willing to compensate for. Take the crate to Gibbo at the Old Gate. He should be expecting the recurring shipment.
62184.completion: Finally! What have you been doing with that shipment? You are a week late and now I am behind. <He sees you starting to talk and carries on.> No, I don't want to hear it. I won't be giving you a good review for this delivery, but here is the arranged cut of the shipment.
62184.title: A Crate of Sinvyr Ore
62184.objectives: Deliver the crate to the Old Gate.

62185.description:
Maintaining a watchful eye on the Cult of the Damned has proven challenging... and perilous.

Several of our hippogryph riders recently ran afoul of the cult's winged terrors. Though a few were able to escape, the others were captured and brought to Aldur'thar.

Do what you can to free them from their captors. We cannot afford to lose any more of our forces.
62185.completion:
You have my gratitude.

I assure you this will not be forgotten.
62185.title: Fighting for Attention
62185.objectives: Free 5 Argent Hippogryph Riders from Aldur'thar.

62186.description: The masked sylvar set aside a single seed laden with anima; for what purpose, you can only imagine. Droman Tashmur would appreciate the return of such a precious resource.
62186.completion: What have you brought me? Why would the masked ones be collecting anima so? A concern for the future. Thank you for bringing this to me. It will nourish many wildseeds.
62186.title: Swollen Anima Seed
62186.objectives: Return the Swollen Anima Seed to Droman Tashmur in Tirna Vaal.

62187.description: This lost satchel is filled with wood given by the nearby Culex trees. Fluttercatch would surely appreciate its return.
62187.completion: A whole sackful?! Wonderful! I'll be sure to put this to good use.
62187.title: Satchel of Culexwood
62187.objectives: Return the Satchel of Culexwood to Fluttercatch in the Banks of Life.

62188.description:
I require your aid on a... delicate matter, {NAME}.

Starfly Wings form a vital ingredient for some of our creations and our supply is exhausted.
They are tiny things, very fragile, and I am ill able to handle them delicately.

Could you obtain the Starflies for me? They must be caught alive in order for their wings to not spoil and we desperately need them. 

I'll ensure that you are compensated for your time, of course.
62188.completion:
Outstanding! I could see the shine coming from your pack before you even arrived.

Thank you!
62188.title: Catch A Star

62189.description: Sheets of fine cloth, wooden parasol ribs, wooden dowels and metal braces, everything you would need to put together new parasols. These are worth a lot of gold in the Ember Ward. Mats would certainly reward you handsomely if you brought him this cache.
62189.completion: Oh, wow, this is a real find you have. Here, a heap of Infused Rubies for the bundle, the best you will see here in the ward. And if you see one of my goods you might like, let me know.
62189.title: Parasol Components
62189.objectives: Return the components to Sanctuary of the Mad.

62190.description:
We gotta fix up this muck pool before we go makin' that dredger butler of yours.

Looks like the anima shortage caused all sorts of problems for this pool.

Them muck pools gotta have plenty of filth and fiber in 'em to grow good dredgers.

But between them devourers and nasty elementals formin' from all that wild muck, I can't get close enough to feed it!

Help me out and throw some of that filthy rubble into the pool, yeah?
62190.completion:
I can smell it from here.

<Rendle inhales deeply and sighs.>

Home sweet home.
62190.title: It's a Dirty Job
62190.objectives: Throw 6 Filthy Rubble into the muck pool.

62194.description:
Throughout the Shadowlands, there is so much magic to learn!

A threat in Bastion has put many of their ancient teachings in danger. I wish to study their scrolls before they are lost forever. We must travel there and safeguard what we can!

Help me fight back the Forsworn at the Temple of Humility and save the scrolls within.
62194.completion: You have helped strengthen our forces, Maw Walker.
62194.title: Fighting Words
62194.objectives: Help Sabrina collect 8 Ancient Teachings and eliminate 8 Forsworn enemies.

62195.description:
Inquisitor Darksion was an aspiring practitioner of the arcane arts before Denathrius locked her away.

I've heard she will share her knowledge with anyone that releases her from imprisonment.

I want to learn all she knows! We must free her!
62195.completion: You have helped strengthen our forces, Maw Walker.
62195.title: The Last Word

62200.description:
<The incomprehensible core whirs with a pleasant hum. 

Surely someone would have a use for this? >
62200.completion: Thank you for this, {NAME}. We must conserve all the anima we can.
62200.title: Functioning Anima Core
62200.objectives: Deliver the Functioning Anima Core to Kalisthene.

62205.progress:
Is that Theotar's new book?
A Proper Soiree: A detailed account of Venthyr Etiquette by Theotar (1)
62205.completion: You know, I really like that Theotar, he knows his stuff and is nice to us even though at times he assumes we can read minds. Silly Venthyr.
62205.title: Venthyr Ettiquette

62206.progress:
Ooh, I am beginning to like these books.
The Winter Cycle: A Collection of Ardenweald Etiquettes and Parables (1)
62206.completion: This one looks fun, I like reading about dreams, and it has pictures!
62206.title: Ardenweald Etiquette
62206.objectives: Ooh, I am beginning to like these books.

62207.progress:
That looks like a 'big' book.
The Proper Path and Etiquette for Aspirants (1)
62207.completion: This seems pretty strict, I am surprised that they come to parties, I think it says here that might not be allowed. Well, I will make sure I memorize it word for word, I am sure they will have already.
62207.title: Bastion Etiquette

62208.progress:
It looks shorter than the others, but... are those bullets?
The Death March: An Introduction to Maldraxxi Etiquette (1)
62208.completion: Not going to lie to you, this sounds really dry. Do I at least get to wear their cool armor?
62208.title: Maldraxxi Protocols

62213.description:
Hey, {NAME}. I've found a lucrative business proposition that'll help me... us... greatly! See, Au'narim is willing to give us supplies if we can help him recover from a trade deal that went sideways.

Apparently, several of his cohorts never returned from a job. He needs us to follow their path and recover the item they failed to deliver. Simple, right?

To ensure we don't have any mishaps, I've taken the liberty of acquiring a few items that may be of help to us.

So, you in?
62213.progress: Did you find the item in question?
62213.completion: I knew the Maw Walker would deliver.
62213.title: A Brokered Deal

62214.description:
Survival requires that we keep our enemies in check, Maw Walker.

With Gorgoa overflowing, the Mawsworn continue to gain strength.

Perdition Hold has been fortified with fresh troops. We cannot allow the Mawsworn to bolster their ranks any further.

Make your way into Perdition Hold and decimate their forces. When the work is done, you may return to me for your reward.
62214.progress: I trust the Mawsworn did not trouble you?
62214.completion: A small victory, Maw Walker. Many more will be required.
62214.title: Forces of Perdition

62216.description:
Sergeant Krashj is an adequate drill master, but these recruits need proper training with a real warrior. Someone who has been bloodied on the battlefield. Someone like me!

And I know just the fight that will whip these troops into shape.

Let's go teach them a thing or three.
62216.completion: You two make quite the team. It's good to have dependable comrades in arms.
62216.title: Training Program

62217.description:
Though it was not by our hand, Maldraxxus has dealt a great injustice to the kyrian of Bastion. We must do all that we can to make amends.

The Forsworn menace continues to be a thorn in their side. Sounds like the perfect opportunity to both show our support and for our recruits to gain some combat experience.
62217.completion: You and Marz work well together. He'll take the hit whenever you need him to.
62217.title: Field Training
62217.objectives: Eliminate 15 Forsworn forces at The Eternal Forge in Bastion.

62218.description:
Nuuminuuru spends their days protecting and taking care of many faeries throughout Ardenweald. They have expressed concern about some faeries in their care whom they have not seen in some time.

Report to Nuuminuuru and see if you can help them find their scattered sprites.
62218.progress: A greeting to you, ally of the soulbearers.
62218.completion: A faerie fountain for a rare relaxation... an enticing incentive indeed.
62218.title: A Fountain for Fae
62218.objectives: Report to Nuuminuuru in Glitterfall Basin in Ardenweald.

62219.description:
Ever chasing their fleets of fancy, my faerie friends are seldom seen.

Their mercurial natures oft lead them astray, tracing them paths to distraction and dismay.

Seek my friends, insist they return to my roots, and both you and they may receive recompense.
62219.progress:
My wards know to return to my roost, to spin stories of their pursuits and strengthen their spirits.

The longer they flit away, the deeper the creases of my concern grow.
62219.completion:
The waters of your realm revitalize my wards in ways those of our home cannot.

Once again, they return to rest.
62219.title: Fanciful Distractions
62219.objectives: Find Riverblossom, Lunarwind, and Flitterfly and convince them to return to Nuuminuuru.

62221.progress:
That is such a beautiful death pony, ever since I saw my first one I have dreamed of ...
Sinrunner Pony Reins (1)
62221.completion:
<Your butler is nearly in tears.>

I get my own death pony to ride? You are the best mortal I have ever met!
62221.title: My Own Death Pony!
62221.objectives: That is such a beautiful death pony, ever since I saw my first one I have dreamed of ...

62222.progress:
What do you intend for me to do with that thing?
Juvenile Dredbat Harness (1)
62222.title: On Silver Wings

62223.description:
<While this scroll mimics Kleia's invitation to the Path of Ascension, it is very clearly written in Sika's hand.

It details an invitation for Mikanikos to participate in the Path, along with Bron.

Perhaps you should bring this to Mikanikos.>
62223.completion:
Me? Take part in the Path of Ascension? What a surprise!

Bron and I will participate, of course. The leaps we can achieve in centurion development... Imagine!
62223.title: Ascension Calling: Mikanikos
62223.objectives: Inform Mikanikos he is now able to participate in the Path of Ascension.

62224.description:
The Court of Night is akin to a thirsty flower, it quickly draws up its nutrients. If well supplied it will bloom and if its supply is depleted, it withers.

Our roots are beginning to dry, we need more anima!

I've sent workers out to place silk lined catchers along the roads and paths that cross Ardenweald. These catchers will collect a tiny bit of anima, not much but enough for what we need.

Seek them out and return the Anima Infused Silk to us.
62224.progress: Were you able to find the silk?
62224.completion: Well done. Our leaves lift to the sky in thanks.
62224.title: A Thread Of Hope

62225.description:
<The words of the shadowy herald are dark and foreboding. Whatever "the Banished One" intends to accomplish, it must not come to pass.

Something foul bubbles within the cauldrons nearby. Judging by the care with which the cultists are tending to them, their contents must be crucial to their plans.

Several barrels containing what appears to be a new type of plague have been left unattended. Perhaps they can serve as instruments for sabotage.>
62225.completion:
Thank the Light, you have returned unharmed!

Were you able to learn anything about what the cult is doing?
62225.title: Bursting the Bubble
62225.objectives: Sabotage 3 of the Cult of the Damned's experiments in Mord'rethar.

62232.description:
The spriggan of Ardenweald have always been a nuisance. But under Mueh'zala's influence, they could grow into a threat that looms over all of the Shadowlands.

Let's test these troops against a real opponent.
62232.completion: I see you and Marz have been busy. Job well done, both of you.
62232.title: Arboreal Tactics
62232.objectives: Eliminate 12 Bristlecone Spriggan in Mistveil Tangle in Ardenweald.

62234.description:
I have another task for you, Maw Walker.

Deep within Perdition Hold, there lurks a menacing mechanization known as the Soulsteel Colossus. It must be destroyed before it wreaks havoc upon us.

Travel to the Hold, and then across the bridge into the Altar of Domination. There, casting its vast shadow upon The Maw, you will find the Soulsteel Colossus.

Shatter the colossus and bring me its power source as proof of your victory.
62234.progress: The power source... I trust it was not too heavy?
62234.completion: The souls trapped within the power core may yet be saved. Leave me to my research, Maw Walker.
62234.title: Power of the Colossus

62237.description:
<A shimmering soul mirror draws your attention on Devos's corpse.

Peculiar that she would keep one on her person. Perhaps Thenios will want to see this.>
62237.progress: How can I be of service?
62237.completion:
<Thenios studies the mirror closely.>

I see.
62237.title: Mysterious Soul Mirror
62237.objectives: Bring the Mysterious Soul Mirror to Thenios at the temple in the Eonian Archives.

62238.description:
Uther was a being of justice on your world. I am sure it was quite surprising for you to see his fate here, following a leader who embodies what he stood against in life.

I believe you should witness this memory firsthand. Take it to my soul mirror. View the memories within.
62238.progress: Sometimes the hard truths are the most important to witness.
62238.completion: I hope that this memory helps you to understand Uther's path.
62238.title: Soul Led Astray
62238.objectives: Use the Soul Mirror at the Eonian Archives to view Uther's arrival in Bastion.

62239.description:
<The weapon buzzes with a dark, static energy. Whatever this Mawsworn was testing, it appears to have been somewhat successful on the nearby rodents.

Further investigation may yield additional information.>
62239.completion:
Serves them right for leaving this unattended.

I am sure we can find other uses for it.
62239.title: Rodent Removal
62239.objectives: Test the Tormentor's Rod on 8 Giant Mawrats in The Beastwarrens.

62244.description:
The thin pale ones of Revendreth have been hoarding anima. 

I've heard they've been hiding it away, digging holes in the woods and just leaving it there. Anyone could come along and take it.

I say that should be us!

Let's go get some anima.
62244.completion: Thank you for the supplies. I'll see about setting some aside for you at regular intervals.
62244.title: Digging Around

62246.description:
A bracelet delicately woven with living vines falls from Vivanna's wrist as she is slain. In the vines is written, 

"Until Winter's end.

-Flwngyrr"
62246.completion:
<They take the bracelet from your hand. A minute passes before they speak again.>

Her favorite was Azurebloom Tea.

Thank you for bringing this to me.
62246.title: A Fallen Friend
62246.objectives: Return this bracelet to Flwngyrr at the Heart of the Forest.

62250.description:
{NAME}! You're needed in the present. Things have... well, you should just come back to see.

I would finish what you're doing then head back. I can't keep you in the past for much longer!
62250.completion: Welcome back to the present! There's a lot you have to do.
62250.title: A New Adventure Awaits

62256.description:
Hey, it's my good pal {NAME}! Listen, I'm in a bit of a bind here. I've been trying to negotiate a deal with the broker Au'larrynar and he needs a little something, a job done before he'll accept.

The deal is he had an associate who went missing with a rare item. He's asked that I... we... locate and return the missing property.

The associate was last seen in Ardenweald. I know, strange place, way too bright for me. But, I... we... really need this deal to go through! 

So, you ready to go?
62256.progress: I trust you have held up to your part of the deal?
62256.completion:
Ah, now this is exquisite. Your reconstructed companion said you would be able to come through and you've done so magnificently!

Let him know I'll count this toward the repayment of his debts.
62256.title: Asset Extraction
62256.objectives: Travel to Ardenweald, locate Tabithia, and recover the Otherworldly Egg.

62259.description: You stumble upon an enchanted dreamcatcher, placed so remotely that it has managed to collect a significant amount of anima without being harvested. Droman Dawnblossom in nearby Dreamsong Fenn would surely appreciate its safe return.
62259.completion: Oh my! How did that get there? No matter. This anima will nurture many souls. Thank you, traveler!
62259.title: Anima-Laden Dreamcatcher
62259.objectives: Return the Enchanted Dreamcatcher to Droman Dawnblossom in Dreamsong Fenn.

62261.description:
It's tough keeping these hands of mine razor sharp. With all the hacking and cleaving, they can grow dull so quickly! What's a girl to do?

The House of the Chosen makes some very fine quality sharpening stones. I doubt they will just hand them over, but I'm sure my blades can persuade them otherwise.

How about we pay them a visit and see how many stones they can spare?
62261.completion:
I see Guillotine's "negotiations" were successful.

Thank you, Maw Walker. These sharpening stones will be useful.
62261.title: Grinder
62261.objectives: Collect 12 Sharpening Stones and 3 Bonesheared Grinders.

62262.description:
Just as I was making progress on our alternative defense research, my spore samples ran dry!

The mushrooms I was using can only be found in a particularly unpleasant location to the southeast. To collect an appropriately sized sample, you'll have to--how do I put this--feed them. 

Don't ask me why, but apparently, they mature fastest with a nice, rotting corpse nearby.

Try luring a few undead to our fungal friends. That should give 'em all the nutrients they need to grow big and strong.
62262.completion:
Oh, these are just lovely!

I hope you didn't get your hands too dirty.
62262.title: Fungal Feeding
62262.objectives: Collect 20 Mature Spore Samples from Gloomshrooms in Scourgeholme.

62263.description:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?
62263.progress: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.
62263.completion:
Must be nice to have the leisure to just sit and think all the time. 

I've barely got time myself, with all the work I have keeping this place together!

Still, that was nice of you to help out the old turtle.
62263.title: Go Beyond!

62275.description: After being set back by a surprise attack by Maldraxxus forces and an army of their own fallen kin known as the Forsworn, the Ascended stand to lose control of Bastion if they are not given aid.
62275.completion: Bastion is in dire need of your aid.
62275.title: Bastion

62276.description:
The Forsworn are ravaging the temples of Bastion, and the aspirants are leaving behind their supplies as they flee.

All those wonderful bottles of nectar falling into the hands of the Forsworn? I think not! 

There's no way we can save all of the aspirants, but we can keep the Forsworn from taking those supplies. Besides... we could all use something to drink around here.
62276.progress: Did you find us some supplies?
62276.completion: Uh, I see you brought back a few friends?
62276.title: Drink to the Dead

62277.description:
Ardenweald still faces threats from the Drust, as well as other nefarious forces.

The Winter Queen could use your aid in fending off the forces that seek to destroy Ardenweald.
62277.completion: Ardenweald would be most appreciative of your help.

62278.description:
With the houses in shambles, the loyal army of the Primus struggles to hold their ground in Maldraxxus.

They need help to tip the scales in their favor.
62278.completion: The armies loyal to the Primus need your aid.

62279.description:
Chaos rules Revendreth in the wake of Sire Denathrius's betrayal. 

They are in dire need of your aid!
62279.completion: Revendreth would be most grateful for your aid.

62292.progress:
The most powerful of the undead carry scourgestones imbued with the darkest magic. 

We do not know from whence they came, but their power is unlike any we have encountered before. 

Please relinquish any you find to the Argent Crusade. Who knows what foul evil may be lurking within them?
Pitch Black Scourgestone (25)
62292.completion: We will study these stones at once and seal them away. They bring me unease.

62293.progress:
Scourgestones were once common amongst the minions of the Lich King. But these new ones are different... and darker.

Bring them to us as you find them. They will serve both a mark of your victories, and as an opportunity for us to study their strange magic.
Darkened Scourgestone (25)
62293.completion: We prevailed against the undead before, and we shall do so again! For the Light!

62294.description:
It is said that one person's trash, is another's treasure. When it comes to relics, the adage is particularly true.

The House of Rituals is notoriously secretive, which means any knowledge we can glean from them will be all the sweeter.

If we sift through their detritus, I'm sure there are all sorts of treasures we will find.
62294.progress: Did you find anything of interest?
62294.completion: This is simply marvelous! This will provide some excellent insight into the history of Margrave Sin'dane... and possibly something we can use to our own benefit later on.

62295.description:
The Scourge's rampant aggression has proven difficult to predict, even for us.

By the time we knew they were upon us, it was too late.

With our forces spread thin, we are left with what you see before you.

Enter the vault. Slay our enemies where they stand.

Soon the Shadow Vault will be ours once more.
62295.title: Cleaning Out the Vault
62295.objectives: Purge the Shadow Vault of the Scourge presence.

62296.description:
Come to pay old Marasmius a visit? I have a special task for you.

One of my shoots has found a strange place, a place even I've never seen before.

I'm not entirely sure what's in there or if it's even safe. But that's what my trusty mushroomancers are for!

What do you say, {NAME}? Up for an adventure?
62296.progress: Keep your guard up. It could lead anywhere!
62296.completion: That was close. Those pests can quickly blast away whole chunks of Ardenweald if we aren't careful. We've got enough problems on our hands as it is!
62296.title: Into the Unknown

62297.description:
Acolyte, we could use a hand here!

It seems one of your fellow pupils botched their ritual in spectacular fashion. Now destructive necromantic energies are running rampant throughout the house.

This threat must be dealt with. Can you assist?
62297.progress: Have you taken care of the threat, acolyte?
62297.completion:
Well done, acolyte. The rest should dissipate with time.

Take this, it was left behind by the feckless adept that created this mess. I hope you will put it to better use.
62297.title: A Fatal Failure
62297.objectives: Kill 7 Fatal Coalescences in the House of Rituals.

62308.description:
You have done much to establish yourself as a promising acolyte. Your superiors have made it known that you are ready to be tested for your ritualist's mantle. 

When you are ready, begin the Ritual of Ancient Summoning to call forth an elder spirit of Maldraxxus. Conquer the spirit, and prove your mettle!
62308.completion:
You have proven yourself worthy to don the mantle, acolyte.

Wear it with honor and pride.
62308.title: Mantle of Mastery
62308.objectives: Summon an elder spirit of Maldraxxus through the Prime Arcanum and defeat it. Summoning requires three players.

62317.description:
<A note has been left here for Kel'Thuzad. It does not appear that he has read it.>

Baron, I do not trust your new favorite acolyte. Something has been off about them ever since they returned from their ritual with the Kyrian remains.

Your work is too important to allow such discrepancies. The acolyte should be disposed of.

Faithfully,

Sorcerer Vutral
62317.title: Casting Doubt
62317.objectives: Defeat Sorcerer Vutral in the Vault of Souls.

62320.description:
Ah, if it isn't Kel'Thuzad's favorite acolyte? I simply cannot understand how a baron like him would surround himself with such... homely company.

When was the last time you even chanced at a looking glass? Those faded robes do your station no justice.

I would take it upon myself to update your drab apparel, if I weren't sufferring such a shortage on the house's preferred amethystine tint.

You could always fetch some yourself. The sorcerers usually have some stashed among their tomes and altars.
62320.progress:
I will need large quantities of amethystine powder if I am to fix...

<Moret gestures at you broadly.>

...this.
62320.completion:
It brings me great relief that your pallid vestments will no longer offend my vision.

Do try keep them in better repair henceforth.
62320.title: Regalia de Rigueur
62320.objectives: Collect 10 Amethystine Powder from the House of Rituals.

62361.description: Now yous is all set with yer new dredger, go ahead call on them and officially introduce yerself.
62361.title: Introductions are in Order
62361.objectives: Talk with your new Dredger Butler.

62362.description:
The living slime within Maldraxxus naturally produces a powerful catalyst used in many of the House of Eyes's poisons. There is always a need for the substance.

It would be of great help if you could retrieve some for us.
62362.progress: Worry not, despite its appearance the catalyst is not toxic on its own.
62362.completion: A respectable amount. We will make good use of this.
62362.title: Volatile Reactions
62362.objectives: Collect 15 animated catalysts from the slime around Maldraxxus.

62363.description:
The stronger members of the House of the Chosen tend to take a fairly specific form. No doubt you've seen the larger warriors in the house?

They are the greatest threat in their collective force. Thin them out.
62363.completion: I must thank you. We are no match for the Chosen when it comes to brute strength.
62363.title: Heavy Lifting
62363.objectives: Kill 20 warriors of the House of the Chosen.

62364.description:
Necromancers and liches often use powerful tomes to assist in their rituals. Now that the House of Rituals has expanded their reach, the tomes can be found anywhere where their members are active.

Find these books and destroy them. It won't end their vile experiments but it should at least delay them.
62364.completion: Good. The House of Rituals will learn not to make enemies of the House of Eyes.
62364.title: Dire Learning

62365.description:
What better way to stop our enemies in their tracks than to use their own experiments against them?

Lucky for us, some of our... friends have left a few samples unattended. And I know just where to test it...

As menacing as they may be, those abominations down there are delicate creations.

It would be a shame if you were to get your hands on some of their equipment and disrupt the process...
62365.completion:
Hah! That worked better than expected. They'll be busy cleaning up that mess for a while!

Oh, um...

<Darkrider Arly points at your shoulder.>

Still got a little bit on you...
62365.title: Careful Creations

62368.description:
Well {NAME}, it seems you are serious about earning your way back into our good graces.

It seems you are serious about this penance. This task should prove your willingness to rejoin our ranks.
62368.completion:
So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

Once you complete this task with me you will leave your current Covenant and rejoin the Kyrian.
62368.title: Rebuild Our Trust
62368.objectives: Complete the task for the Kyrian.

62371.description:
The songs of Tirna Scithe have faded as the grove wanes, yet there is now silence. Droman Oulfarran's voice has not been heard in some time. The trees whisper of penumbral shadows, discordant songs, and dying roots. All is not well.

Friend of Ardenweald, travel to Root-home. Delve into the Mists. Remove that which threatens us.
62371.progress: What has silenced the grove of Tirna Scithe?
62371.completion: Word of your aid has been sung through the roots. Thank you, friend of the forest.
62371.title: Tirna Scithe: A Warning Silence
62371.objectives: Defeat Tred'ova in The Mists of Tirna Scithe.

62382.description:
Come to pay old Marasmius a visit? I have a special task for you.

One of my shoots has found a strange place, a place even I've never seen before.

I'm not entirely sure what's in there or if it's even safe. But that's what my trusty mushroomancers are for!

What do you say, {NAME}? Up for an adventure?
62382.progress: Keep your guard up. It could lead anywhere!
62382.completion: She seemed nice. The Mushroom Kingdom, was it? Hmph, never heard of it. Things kids get up to these days....
62382.title: Into the Unknown

62388.description:
The Ritualists are the ones behind this war. Every act of treason has been committed under their orders.

We cannot defeat their sorcery with strength of arms alone. Victory will hinge on our knowledge of what they are plotting.

Continue to bolster our forces. I will look for a way to infiltrate the House of Rituals.
62388.completion:
It seems we may have our way into the House of Rituals.

Do not mistake this lich for an ally. He pursues only his own agenda. But for now, our goals align... and we can use that to our advantage.
62388.title: House of Rituals

62389.description:
So you have taken the first step to reclaiming our trust.

Now you must prove that was not another false start in our relationship. 

This final task should prove your willingness to rejoin our ranks.
62389.completion: So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?
62389.title: Rebuild Our Trust
62389.objectives: Complete the task for the Venthyr.

62390.description:
I am acquainted with a few fleshcrafters who work outside of the House of Constructs. If we can find reagents for them, they can supply our war effort with constructs.

The House of Constructs has plenty of excess body parts. Find them and bring them back here.
62390.progress: We'll take any quality of parts you can find.
62390.completion: I will give these to the fleshcrafters. If we don't have enough soldiers, we will just have to build some.
62390.title: Body Count
62390.objectives: Collect 30 abomination parts from around Maldraxxus.

62391.description:
It will be difficult to reach Kel'Thuzad while he is in his necropolis.

Go now. It will take time for us to muster an army that can pierce his defenses.
62391.completion:
Our forces stand ready.

Let us end this.
62391.title: Mobilize Maldraxxus

62392.description:
You return as requested. Impressive, maybe you have indeed turned a new leaf.

I wish to see you complete one more task for us. To prove your dedication to this transition. 

Not that we doubt you, but you must understand your previous behavior gives us reason to doubt that dedication.
62392.completion: So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?
62392.title: Rebuild Our Trust
62392.objectives: Complete the task for the Night Fae.

62393.description:
You still have the same strength you had before it seems.

The question is - do you have any loyalty left within you?

I have one more task so you can demonstrate that loyalty again.
62393.completion:
So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

Once you complete this task with me you will leave your current Covenant and rejoin the Necrolords.
62393.title: Rebuild Our Trust
62393.objectives: Complete the task for the Necrolords.

62394.description:
Our forces are gathering.

Soon it will be time to move against the House of Rituals.

See what you can do to continue strengthening our position.
62394.title: House In Decline

62400.description:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?
62400.progress: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.
62400.completion:
I remember those guys. Bad news. 

They should stick to their own realm of existence!

Nice job cleaning house.
62400.title: Go Beyond!

62401.description:
The Lich King's minions once carried scourgestones given to them by their dark master. 

New ones have been found on the corpses of the undead. We do not know their purpose... but they have been touched by even more sinister magic.

As you slay the Scourge across Icecrown, keep your eyes open for such stones. If you bring them back to me, I shall turn them over to the confessors for study.
62401.progress: How goes your slaying of the undead?
62401.completion:
I will turn these over to the confessors immediately. There is more to these scourgestones than it seems. 

Perhaps they will grant us more knowledge of the creatures that assail us from the rift in the sky.

If you find any additional scourgestones while you are adventuring, please bring them to me.
62401.title: Strange Scourgestones
62401.objectives: Collect Darkened Scourgestones and Pitch Black Scourgestones from undead forces in Icecrown.

62403.description:
The boars around Maldraxxus have a peculiar trait. Their tusks absorb liquid. Depending on where it has been, these bones may contain a powerful compound of poisons or other alchemical rarities.

It takes a trained eye to tell what the bone is made of, so just bring back a large amount of them. From there I will see if any of them are valuable.
62403.progress: Take care not to let any of the bones touch your skin for too long. They may cause irritation.
62403.completion: A fine amount. There will surely be something useful in this collection.
62403.title: Boared to Death
62403.objectives: Collect 25 bloody tusks from the boars in Maldraxxus.

62406.description:
The Staff of the Primus. The final piece of our leader's regalia.

I can't deny the pride I feel in restoring this hall. You should feel the same sense of accomplishment.

The statue awaits you, {NAME}. Bring glory to this realm.
62406.completion: I sense power. Power and ease.
62406.title: Staff of the Primus
62406.objectives: Place the Staff of the Primus upon the Statue of the Primus.

62407.description:
My gas is the most potent in all of Maldraxxus, but I've heard some of the others saying that it's not the strongest in the Shadowlands. 

They claim there are some plants in Ardenweald with a bloom that is far more pungent than my gas. Nonsense!

Let's go and check these plants out. If their stench is as strong as the stories claim, I might even be able to mix them in with my own gas!
62407.completion:
How is it possible for him to smell even worse than before? 

Ugh. At least he gets results.
62407.title: Herbicidal Tendencies
62407.objectives: Help Gas Bag collect Rotbloom Petals.

62414.description:
It will do us no good to disguise yourself as Nelesis if word reaches Kel'Thuzad that she was slain. 

You must ensure that no one who sees you enter the cave survives.
62414.completion:
You left none behind to raise alarm? Good.

We can proceed with the plan.
62414.title: Burying Suspicion
62414.objectives: Kill 10 Lichsworn forces outside the House of Rituals.

62417.description:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?
62417.progress: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.
62417.completion:
Nothing wrong with picking flowers for a living. It's good, honest work.

And giving those blasted spriggans a kick in the rear is worthwhile too. Nice job.
62417.title: Go Beyond!

62420.description: <The Snapper Soul is determined. The shape of the dragon turtle will be yours to call upon.>
62420.title: Snapper Soul
62420.objectives: Bring the Snapper Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62421.description: <The Gulper Soul is patient and calm. The shape of the Gulper will be yours to call upon.>
62421.title: Gulper Soul
62421.objectives: Bring the Gulper Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62422.description: <The Ardenmoth is plentiful in Ardenweald. Delicate looking creatures, they have hidden strength. Their magic can soothe the most tortured soul... or send the unwary into an eternal sleep. The shape of the moth will be yours to call upon.>
62422.title: Ardenmoth Soul
62422.objectives: Bring the Ardenmoth Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62423.description: <The Ursine Soul is stalwart and brave. The shape of the bear will be yours to call upon.>
62423.title: Ursine Soul
62423.objectives: Bring the Ursine Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62424.description: <The Crane Soul dances with grace. The shape of the crane will be yours to call upon.>
62424.title: Crane Soul
62424.objectives: Bring the Crane Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62425.description:
<Graceful, dangerous, powerful. No creature in Ardenweald is more respected for its fierce defense of its family or territory than the veilwing. 

You have defeated a foe who endangered not only Ardenweald, but all of the Shadowlands. For this, Champion of Ardenweald, you have earned a special boon - the ability to call upon the essence of the veilwing and take their shape.>
62425.title: Veilwing Soul
62425.objectives: Bring the Veilwing Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62426.description: <The Gryphon Soul is agile and swift. The shape of the gryphon will be yours to call upon.>
62426.title: Gryphon Soul
62426.objectives: Bring the Gryphon Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62427.description: <The Hippogryph Soul is intelligent and valiant. The shape of the hippogryph will be yours to call upon.>
62427.title: Hippogryph Soul
62427.objectives: Bring the Hippogryph Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62428.description: <The Equine Soul is free-spirited and loyal. The shape of a horned horse will be yours to call upon.>
62428.title: Equine Soul
62428.objectives: Bring the Equine Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62429.description: <The Leonine sine Soul is powerful and brave. The shape of the lion will be yours to call upon.>
62429.title: Leonine Soul
62429.objectives: Bring the Leonine Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62430.description: <The Moose Soul endures and protects. The shape of the moose will be yours to call upon.>
62430.title: Moose Soul
62430.objectives: Bring the Moose Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62431.description: <The Shadowstalker Soul is cunning and careful. The shape of the Shadowstalker will be yours to call upon.>
62431.title: Shadowstalker Soul
62431.objectives: Bring the Shadowstalker Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62432.description: <The Owlcat Soul is a curious trickster, a beast of many parts working together in a playful balance, always seeking the next challenge. The shape of the owlcat will be yours to call upon.>
62432.title: Owlcat Soul
62432.objectives: Bring the Owlcat Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62433.description: <The Raptor Soul is loyal and fierce. The shape of the raptor will be yours to call upon.>
62433.title: Raptor Soul
62433.objectives: Bring the Raptor Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62434.description: <The Runestag Soul is calm and enduring. The shape of the Runestag will be yours to call upon.>
62434.title: Runestag Soul
62434.objectives: Bring the Runestag Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62435.description: <The Stag Soul is noble and mighty. The shape of the stag will be yours to call upon.>
62435.title: Stag Soul
62435.objectives: Bring the Stag Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62436.description: <The Shrieker Soul is swift and fierce. The shape of the veil shrieker will be yours to call upon.>
62436.title: Shrieker Soul
62436.objectives: Bring the Shrieker Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62437.title: Tiger Soul
62437.description: <The Tiger Soul is proud and strong. The shape of the tiger will be yours to call upon.>
62437.objectives: Bring the Tiger Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62438.title: Lupine Soul
62438.description: <The Lupine Soul is a fierce and free-spirited protector. The shape of the wolf will be yours to call upon.>
62438.objectives: Bring the Lupine Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62439.title: Wolfhawk Soul
62439.description: <The Wolfhawk Soul is cunning hunter. The shape of the wolfhawk will be yours to call upon.>
62439.objectives: Bring the Wolfhawk Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62440.title: Wyvern Soul
62440.description: <The Wyvern Soul is proud and determined. The shape of the wyvern will be yours to call upon.>
62440.objectives: Bring the Wyvern Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

62441.title: Fair Exchange for a Soul
62441.description:
While we work away here in the Conservatory, we must not forget to support the rest of the covenant.

I am needed here, but you can range far, even though your legs are short. 

Please, help our covenant recover the anima we need. I can then dedicate my time to preparing another spirit for you to restore.
62441.progress: Go, find more anima. I shall tend to the spirits while you do.
62441.completion:
You continue to serve the conservatory well. For this you have my thanks.

Now you may choose from the spirits I have collected myself for restoration.

62442.title: Aid the Covenant
62442.description:
I hear amazing things about the realm beyond this garden, but honestly I am too old to wish to place myself in danger.

You are young and vibrant! Head out across the realm, and return to me with the stories of your adventures!.
62442.completion: I find it helpful to have you do these things for me.

62443.title: Aid the Covenant
62443.description:
I hear amazing things about the realm beyond this garden, but honestly I am too old to wish to place myself in danger.

You are young and vibrant! Head out across the realm, and return to me with the stories of your adventures!.
62443.completion: I find it helpful to have you do these things for me.

62444.title: Aid the Covenant
62444.description:
I hear amazing things about the realm beyond this garden, but honestly I am too old to wish to place myself in danger.

You are young and vibrant! Head out across the realm, and return to me with the stories of your adventures!
62444.progress: Head out into the Shadowlands. Return to me with stories of your exploits.
62444.completion: I find it helpful to have you do these things for me.

62445.title: A Spirit's Pride
62445.description:
I seek to understand more about the prideful beings in this realm.

If you could place one in a wildseed, as you did for me, I could observe the restoration process.
62445.progress: Find a prideful spirit to restore. That is what I wish to see today.
62445.completion: This is nothing like my home world, but it is still quite fascinating.

62447.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
62447.description:
I have a mystery for you, {NAME}!

Who doesn't savor a good mystery? 

We have found a spirit unlike any other, one who does not respond to being placed in a wildseed.

Each of us who touched it experienced a dream in which we saw you battling a great beast. Only when you defeated it did the spirit begin on its path to rebirth. 

We think we know the beast.

Are you up for discovering if these dreams were a portent?
62447.completion: You did it! I cannot quite explain why that worked. Dreams can be strange, huh?

62448.title: Securing the House
62448.description:
Your journey into the Maw was impressive, but it will take even more phenomenal feats to earn the loyalty of the Maldraxxi.

Increase your renown among our ranks, Maw Walker. The Maldraxxi are dedicated soldiers, but they will not follow just anyone into battle. Let your deeds prove your worth to them.
62448.completion: Your actions have attracted the attention of the other houses--and those who question their orders.

62449.title: A Spirit's Duty
62449.description:
I seek to understand more about the Dutiful beings in this realm.

If you could place one in a wildseed, as you did for me, I could observe the restoration process.
62449.progress: Find a Dutiful spirit to restore. That is what I wish to see today.
62449.completion: This is nothing like my home world, but it is still quite fascinating.
62449.objectives: Place a Dutiful Spirit into a wildseed.

62450.title: A Spirit's Heart
62450.description:
I seek to understand more about the Untamed beings in this realm.

If you could place one in a wildseed, as you did for me, I could observe the restoration process.
62450.progress: Find an Untamed spirit to restore. That is what I wish to see today.
62450.completion: This is nothing like my home world, but it is still quite fascinating.
62450.objectives: Place an Untamed Spirit into a wildseed.

62452.title: A Spirit's Might
62452.description:
I seek to understand more about the Martial beings in this realm.

If you could place one in a wildseed, as you did for me, I could observe the restoration process.
62452.progress: Find a Martial spirit to restore. That is what I wish to see today.
62452.completion: This is nothing like my home world, but it is still quite fascinating.
62452.objectives: Place a Martial Spirit into a wildseed.

62453.title: Into the Unknown
62453.description:
Come to pay old Marasmius a visit? I have a special task for you.

One of my shoots has found a strange place, a place even I've never seen before.

I'm not entirely sure what's in there or if it's even safe. But that's what my trusty mushroomancers are for!

What do you say, {NAME}? Up for an adventure?
62453.progress: Keep your guard up. It could lead anywhere!
62453.completion: You know I appreciate hard work, but it's important to take care of yourself from time to time. Hope you had fun, blew off some steam, and are ready to get back at it!

62454.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
62454.description:
I awaken. I exist once more. And yet...

There is an emptiness within. A lingering tether to a home that no longer exists. So much wonder... so much splendor... lost.

Now I have no purpose. No fate. No path.

Will you teach me of this place, awakener? I sense there is much to be understood. Many secrets. Many truths.

In so doing, perhaps a new fate will emerge.
62454.progress: Return to me when you have the essences from each realm.
62454.completion:
Perhaps a new purpose awaits me.

You have rekindled my curiosity, at least.
62454.objectives: Speak to Falir and bring them essences from the realms of the Shadowlands.

62456.title: De Other Side: Dealin' Wit' Da Boss
62456.description:
Ay, mon. Long time no see!

I be havin' a bit of trouble wit' me boss, Mueh'zala. Now, now... don't you worry. Your ol' friend Bwonsamdi got dis whole ting under control!

I just be needin' some help gatherin' me mojo back from a few ungrateful business partners.

You bring me da mojo, and we goin' ta take care of ol' Mueh'zala once and for all!
62456.progress: First you get da mojo, then I get da powa'... then we be gettin' Mueh'zala!
62456.completion: Now dat da ol' boss be a captive audience, he and I goin' ta be makin' some new arrangements. Ya best be goin' now, but don't worry... I be seein' ya soon!
62456.objectives: Defeat Mueh'zala in De Other Side.

62458.title: De Other Side
62458.description:
Ay, dere {NAME}! Ya be just da {class} I've been lookin' for!

It be your ol' pal Bwonsamdi reachin' out ta ya from De Other Side! I be havin' a little problem over here wit' de boss...

Ya be lookin' mighty bored just standin' around here in Ardenweald. Why don't ya come to De Other Side and help out an ol' friend? Bwonsamdi promise he gonna make it worth ya while!

Ya might want ta bring a few more adventurers wit' ya... just ta be safe.
62458.completion: Ay, dere mon! It be good ta see a friendly face. Your ol' friend Bwonsamdi be havin' a bit of trouble wit' da Bossman...
62458.objectives: Speak with the Mask of Bwonsamdi in De Other Side.

62459.title: Go Beyond!
62459.description:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.
