I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?
62459.progress: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.
62459.completion:
Those are special moths! They really liven up the place, don't they?

You know moths work just as hard as anyone else, and they're under-appreciated. 

Thanks for savin' em.

62461.title: Stalking the Warrens
62461.description:
So, they are creating magical beasts deep within the Warrens. Their power is... substantial.

Maw Walker, I must trust in you to handle this. While I can provide insight, in combat I must admit your prowess exceeds my own.

Hunt the beasts that they train to hunt us. Show the Mawsworn that we too can bare fangs.
62461.completion: I suspect this will not be your last foray into the Warrens.

62462.title: WANTED: The Key of Eyes
62462.description:
I seek a mercenary of unparalleled might to venture into the House of Eyes and procure the "Key of Eyes".

Above average compensation is assured for the one who can both deliver the key and regale me with the story of its previous owner's demise. 

Be warned that the grounds once belonging to the House of Eyes are extremely dangerous and lone exploration is highly discouraged.
62462.completion:
Ah, very good! And a million eyes appeared, you say? How frightening! 

Glad she's gone and the key's in my hands now! She used it to break into many a locked door, you know? A very powerful item! Very profitable too.

And now it's mine!
62462.objectives: Eliminate Chelicera and obtain the Key of Eyes.

62465.title: Go Beyond!
62465.description:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?
62465.progress: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.
62465.completion:
Always nice to lend a hand to someone who's just tryin' to do their job. A metaphorical hand, obviously... although in your case, it's literal.

I know what metaphorical means!

Anyway, good work out there.

62466.title: Go Beyond!
62466.description:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?
62466.progress: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.
62466.completion:
Must be nice to have the leisure to just sit and think all the time. 

I've barely got time myself, with all the work I have keeping this place together!

Still, that was nice of you to help out the old turtle.

62467.title: Seed of a Thought
62467.description:
Within wildseeds, spirits slumber and grow. But so too can catalysts, when seeds take the place of spirits.

Seed Merchant Daybreak trades in such seeds. She can supply you with the ones you seek. Choose one to plant within a wildseed.

The forest holds its breath and awaits your choice.
62467.progress: Your talents as a cultivator continue to thrive.
62467.completion: The branches of your expertise reach for the heavens and blossom. This is good.
62467.objectives: Acquire a seed and plant it within a wildseed.

62473.title: What's Old is New
62473.description:
These damn Scourge make me sick!

<Brollen spits on the ground.>

They're only good fer one thing--bein' dead!

Head tae the valley southwest o' here. Plenty o' gear fer the pickin' over there!

Gather up what ye can. I'll make do with what ye find.
62473.completion:
These'll do nicely.

I'll get tae work.
62473.objectives: Gather 8 Jagged Blades and 8 Battleworn Chainmail from the Conflagration.

62477.title: Blueprint: Skystrider Glider
62477.description:
<You have discovered plans for a single use glider, invented by Dresaelus.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this kit.>
62477.completion: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.
62477.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Skystrider Glider to Dactylis.

62483.title: Steward Mail Pouch
62483.description:
<The pouch is well constructed, with plenty of room for scrolls and a division to keep letters flat. The stitching is clean, and the strap is adjustable to fit your steward's size.

You are certain your steward will love it.>
62483.objectives: Summon your steward companion via Summon Steward, then give them the Steward Mail Pouch.

62484.title: Werk In Progress
62484.description:
We received an... unusual delivery recently. I'm still in a bit of shock.

Some sort of flying contraption released a huge crate just overhead, parachute and all. If it weren't for the wind it would have landed nearby. Instead, it drifted down the hill below.

They left a note too. It would have been lost had it not been wrapped around a sizeable rock.

<Darkrider Arly massages a spot on her forehead.>

I don't know what it is, but if it'll help clear out the area, I'm all for it.
62484.objectives: Locate the delivery. Use the device on a Reconstructed Abomination, then destroy the Scourge presence at the Fleshwerks.

62486.title: Blueprint: Empyrean Refreshment
62486.description:
<You have discovered plans for a table of refreshing snacks that would be quite useful while out adventuring.

Dactylis should be able to help you with the crafting.>
62486.completion: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.
62486.objectives: Bring the Blueprint: Empyrean Refreshment to Dactylis.

62544.title: From a Dark Place
62544.description:
You rescued some of the night elves from the Maw before. While the danger is still great, I must ask you to do it again.

I have to believe that we can save them. As many of them as possible.

Please, go and see if you can recover any more lost souls.
62544.completion:
I thank you once again, Maw Walker.

These souls are finally free of the torment and pain.

There are still so many more, but I am optimistic that we may yet save them.
62544.objectives: Travel to the Maw and rescue Lost Souls.

62546.title: No Wisp Left Behind
62546.description:
More of the Kaldorei souls still languish in the Maw.

I ask you once again, Maw Walker, to find them.

Help correct this wrong.
62546.completion:
It brings me joy to see more souls freed from that dark place.

Thank you Maw Walker, for continuing to help us.
62546.objectives: Travel to the Maw and rescue Lost Souls from the Tremaculum and the Planes of Torment.

62549.title: No Wisp Left Behind
62549.description:
More of the Kaldorei souls still languish in the Maw.

I ask you once again, Maw Walker, to find them.

Help correct this wrong.
62549.completion:
It brings me joy to see more souls freed from that dark place.

Thank you Maw Walker, for continuing to help us.
62549.objectives: Travel to the Maw and rescue Lost Souls from the Tremaculum and the Planes of Torment.

62553.title: Delaying Their Efforts
62553.description:
The Scourge continue to replenish their weapons of war from blighted grounds. Stopping their workers slows their production, but a decisive blow to their stockpiles would be far more effective.

Take these and head to the area southeast of here. Plant the bombs, then make a quick exit.

Weakening their supply lines should provide us ample time to retaliate.
62553.completion: Your dedication to the cause is much appreciated, {NAME}. You have once again put yourself at risk to ensure the safety of our allies.
62553.objectives: Plant the bombs at the Northern, Eastern and Western sites of The Bombardment. Remove 12 Decrepit Laborers from the area.

62554.title: Sootible Hat: Red Noggin Candle
62554.progress:
One of them Noggin Candles would impress 'em all, right?
Red Noggin Candle (1)

62555.title: A Touch of Humility
62555.description:
With the Temple of Humility under our control, its power shall flow back into the Crest of Ascension once more.

Join me below so that we may witness it together. Mikanikos has ensured it will become even more magnificent as its power grows.
62555.completion: The Archon shall convene the Paragons to discuss our next moves. Go in service.
62555.objectives: Witness the Crest of Ascension become empowered by the Temple of Humility.

62556.title: Sootible Hat: Pink Party Hat
62556.progress:
A Pink Party Hat is stylish an' classy, innit?
Pink Party Hat (1)

62557.title: Our Realm Reclaimed
62557.description:
Though Forsworn still fight across Bastion, the Temple of Loyalty is ours, and with it our realm.

We will have to stay diligent to maintain control of all of the temples, and much remains to be decided with the fate of our fallen brethren, but today is a day of great victory.

Join me at the Crest of Ascension, and witness its final empowerment.
62557.completion:
This day would not have been won without you, Maw Walker.

On behalf of the Archon, the Paragons, and all kyrian--thank you.
62557.objectives: Witness the Crest of Ascension become empowered by the Temple of Loyalty.

62558.title: Sootible Hat: Fae Revel Masque
62558.progress:
I gots to get one o' them Fae Revel Masques. Gonna keep 'em guessin' and be mysterious an' all.
Fae Revel Masque (1)
62558.objectives: I gots to get one o' them Fae Revel Masques. Gonna keep 'em guessin' and be mysterious an' all.

62559.title: Sootible Hat: Crown of the Righteous
62559.progress:
I knows what I needs! Everybody gonna bow down when they sees me in a Crown of the Righteous.
Crown of the Righteous (1)
62559.objectives: I knows what I needs! Everybody gonna bow down when they sees me in a Crown of the Righteous.

62560.title: Growing in Power
62560.description:
Wonderful news, {NAME}!

You have gathered enough Anima. The Queen is now able to empower the Heart of the Forest!
62560.completion: We're on the right track, {NAME}! Keep doing what you're doing and it will be back to its full, glorious, starryness in no time!
62560.objectives: Witness the Winter Queen empower the Heart of the Forest.

62561.title: My Heart is Full
62561.description:
{NAME}! Can you believe it? We have enough Anima that the Winter Queen can fully restore the Heart of the Forest!

You've done so much for us!
62561.completion: We're so grateful for all your help, {NAME}. Seeing the Heart of the Forest like this again, full of power? My heart is filled with hope.
62561.objectives: Witness the Winter Queen empower the Heart of the Forest.

62563.title: Back Again!
62563.description:
Gorgantus just won't give up!

We've defeated her several times already, but the scavengers salvage the body, fix her up and send her right back in here!

She thinks this time she will defeat us... prove her wrong.
62563.completion: You made that look easy. Let's hope she learned his lesson this time.

62567.title: Adventurers Wanted: Chromie's Call
62567.description:
Chromie is seeking veteran adventurers to embark on expeditions through time and space.

This is your opportunity to experience the legendary adventures of the past--today!

Speak with Chromie near the Stormwind Embassy for more information.
62567.completion: I'm glad you made it, {NAME}! Something tells me that your future is waiting for you in the past!

62568.title: Adventurers Wanted: Chromie's Call
62568.description:
Chromie is seeking veteran adventurers to embark on expeditions through time and space.

This is your opportunity to experience the legendary adventures of the past--today!

Speak with Chromie near the Orgrimmar Embassy for more information.
62568.completion: I'm glad you made it, {NAME}! Something tells me that your future is waiting for you in the past!

62569.title: The Jailer's Grasp
62569.description:
By peering into the Maw, Bolvar drew the Jailer's attention.

His worst fears have come to pass.

You must help me break the link, {NAME}! The fragment of the Helm is the key!
62569.completion:
The Jailer... is gone... from my mind.

Thank you, {NAME}. You saved me from a darker fate than you could ever know.

For that, you will ever have my thanks.
62569.objectives: Help Jaina Proudmoore sever the Jailer's connection to Bolvar.

62584.title: Frontline Resupply
62584.description:
This forward camp relies heavily on our supply line from the tournament grounds. A recent shipment was attacked while in transit through the valley below us.

Salvage what you can, and if possible, eliminate the threat so this does not happen again.
62584.progress:
Caught in the frozen wastes, cold and alone... I only hope our allies put up a fight.

<Crusader Renn shakes her head.>

Were you able to salvage any of the shipment?
62584.completion:
Thank you for your swift action, {NAME}.

These supplies should see us through to the next shipment.

I will see to it that the bodies of those we lost are recovered and given their last rites.
62584.objectives: Recover 6 Salvaged Goods and kill 3 Retched Watchers in The Valley of Fallen Heroes.

62587.title: In Search of Inner Calm
62587.description:
I have always had dreams.

Special dreams you could say.

Any place of tranquility or calm can come to me in a dream.

Even those that may have danger nearby, as calm can be found anywhere, if you know how.

Now I dream of your world, your Azeroth. 

I cannot travel to your realm. Help me connect to my latest dream through your eyes.

I have dreamed of a high place. A very high place. Do you know it?
62587.completion: That was such a pleasant dream. I am glad to you got to experience the reality.
62587.objectives: Travel to Highmountain in search of calm.

62588.title: In Search of Inner Calm
62588.description:
You return.

This pleases me. 

More places of tranquility have come to me in dreams.

I see a sandy beach, Sunsets. 

I cannot travel to your realm. Help me connect to my latest dream through your eyes.
62588.completion: That was such a pleasant dream. I am glad to you got to experience the reality.

62589.title: In Search of Inner Calm
62589.description:
I am glad you wish to continue your meditations.

It will help you be more centered.

I have had another dream. A warm dream of a cold place.

It is wrapped in white. Do you know of it?

Venture there and experience the vista I saw in my dream.
62589.completion: That was such a pleasant dream. I am glad to you got to experience the reality.

62590.title: In Search of Inner Calm
62590.description:
Thank you for returning.

I have had another dream. Another vision of your realm.

In this dream the sky danced above me. 

On the edge of a cliff, in a northern land. 

Such a sight to behold. 

You must experience it for yourself.
62590.completion: That was such a pleasant dream. I am glad to you got to experience the reality.

62591.title: In Search of Inner Calm
62591.description:
We have already experienced so much together.

I am grateful to have a companion on this voyage of discovery.

You walk where I can only project.

You touch that which I can only see.

I have had another dream.

Another coast. A statue. 

A large statue of a little one. 

Go, seek out the view from my dream.
62591.completion: That was such a pleasant dream. I am glad to you got to experience the reality.

62592.title: Master of Inner Calm
62592.description:
You have come a long way.

You are almost prepared to access your inner calm anywhere.

Just one more journey under my guidance. 

It is a short one. Peace was here in this garden all along.

One more location of calm to experience.

Then you shall shed your spiritual shackles. 

I shall be proud.
62592.completion: That was such a pleasant dream, I am glad to you got to experience the reality.
62592.objectives: Find the new meditation location within the Queen's Conservatory.

62597.title: Bonesmith Heirmir
62597.description:
<Alexandros Mograine left you a very straightforward letter of introduction for a certain Bonesmith Heirmir in Maldraxxus.

What aid might she be able to offer the Ember Court?>
62597.completion: What do you want, Maw Walker?
62597.objectives: Deliver Alexandros Mograine's letter to Bonesmith Heirmir in Maldraxxus.

62598.title: Forgelite Sophone
62598.description:
<Polemarch Adrestes left you a very formal letter of introduction for Forgelite Sophone in Bastion.

What aid might she be able to offer the Ember Court?>
62598.completion: I assume you have need of me, Maw Walker. What can I do for you?
62598.objectives: Deliver Polemarch Adrestes's letter to Forgelite Sophone in Bastion.

62599.title: Gormsmith Cavina
62599.description:
<Hunt-Captain Korayn left you a terse letter of introduction to Gormsmith Cavina in Ardenweald.

What aid might he be able to offer the Ember Court?>
62599.completion: Do you need some armor repaired?
62599.objectives: Deliver Hunt-Captain Korayn's letter to Gormsmith Cavina in Ardenweald.

62600.title: Finding Inner Peace
62600.description:
This is a lovely spot don't you think?

I knew the myths of Ardenweald. 

Even glimpsed it in dream.

Yet it swells with tranquility unimagined. 

Calm is what my kind live for. Even in chaos.

You can always find calm. I can show you if you would like? 

I can sense a nearby convergence of calm. That will provide a suitable demonstration.
62600.completion: Do you see now? There is great power in being able to find calm. To be able to center ones self offer solace in even the most turbulent of times.
62600.objectives: Travel out into Ardenweald to commune with the calm of the land.

62601.title: Forgy
62601.description:
<Rendle left you a crumpled envelope addressed to Forgy in Darkhaven. On the outside of the envelope are very specific orders to tell Forgy that Rendle sent you.

What aid might Forgy be able to offer the Ember Court?>
62601.completion: What can I do for ya, Maw Walker?
62601.objectives: Deliver Rendle's letter to Forgy in Darkhaven.

62603.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
62603.description:
I'm glad to see you again, friend!

We have found another inert spirit gripped by dark dreams. Nasty stuff! 

In this dream, a noble figure that once embodied loyalty has been consumed by their own doubts, leading them down a dark path.

If you were to defeat the fallen paragon, I bet we'll be able to revive this poor spirit.

Will you help us once more, {NAME}?
62603.completion: Another dream vision fulfilled. This is remarkable!
62603.objectives: Defeat Devos in the Spires of Ascension.

62605.title: Broker Business
62605.description: <A web covered box of assorted scholar supplies lays haphazardly on the ground. The make seems Broker in origin. Perhaps the owner is nearby.>
62605.completion: Oh! My missing supplies! How fortuitous.
62605.objectives: Find the owner of the forgotten supplies.

62606.title: A Blackthorn Blend
62606.description:
Ah, just the mushroomancer I wanted to see! Mind getting me some clay?

There's all kinds of different soil, you know. It's not all just dirt! And clay... clay is something special. You ever try growing through clay? Oh, I guess not.

It's hard work to break down, but once you do the flavor is incomparable! My roots are looking forward to the challenge.

Blackthorn Grove has a particularly bitter and complex clay that is just what I'm craving. I'm sure they won't mind if you ask them for some.
62606.progress: If they give you any trouble, just tell 'em Marasmius sent you. I bet someone there is old enough to remember me.
62606.completion: Ooh, that's the stuff all right. It's bitter, sure, but wonderfully complex and subtle undertones. Mm! You'll have to try some sometime.
62606.objectives: Collect 6 Blackthorn Clay in Blackthorn Grove.

62607.title: Glittering Gritty Goodness
62607.description:
Well, hello there! Fancy helping me out today?

You ever been to Shimmerbough? Ever wonder why it's called that? I was there when it was named, you know.

Lots of people think it's the trees or the water, and they're right. But the secret to the shimmering is in the silt. The soil soaks and gains excess anima from the water, until the ground itself practically sparkles.

I could really go for some shimmersilt right now. Would you let an old mushroom relive his youth?
62607.progress: Oooh, I always used to get tingly all over when I had shimmersilt. And that's a lot of tingling!
62607.completion: Look at it sparkle and shine! I'm getting the tingles just looking at it. I feel ages younger already!

62608.title: A Royal Treat
62608.description:
So nice to see you again. I've got a special request for you.

The Winter Queen herself used to tend directly to groves, in the early times. Everything she touched burst with life and power. Even the ground she walked on.

Over time, the Queen's Garden came to be known as the Garden of Night, for the Queen had not tended to her garden in so long.

But the ground is still potent with her power. It's the finest meal I've ever had. I know this is indulgent, but you and I both know I deserve it!
62608.progress: Sometimes you just need to treat yourself to something nice.
62608.completion: Feel how luxurious the soil is! I'm going to savor this for a while. Thank you.
62608.objectives: Collect 6 Royal Peat in the Garden of Night.

62609.title: Necrolord Arsenal
62609.description:
<Bonesmith Heimir begins reading the letter you hand her.>

Hmm. Mograine usually has more sense than this...

<Bonesmith Heimir finishes the letter and shreds it with her bony fingers.>

An order's an order. I'll arrange for a shipment of raw materials and forging equipment to be delivered to your court.

While you wait, Mograine asks that you clear out some of our enemies to help cover for my absence.

It was in the letter. Shame it's all shredded up so you can't read it.
62609.completion:
Good. I've arranged everything needed on our side.

I'll be there.

62610.title: Hyphae Patrol: The Stalks
62610.description:
<Marasmius sighs.> 

They're at it again, up in the Stalks.

Seems like we didn't give them enough of a thrashing the first time, eh? What say you and I team up again and teach those younglings a lesson they won't forget?

Let me know when you're ready and we'll get 'em, just like before!
62610.progress: Let's go, before they do any more damage!
62610.completion: Hmph, serves them right. Think they can go stomping around my grove? I am the only one who gets to do any stomping! I am the one who stomps!
62610.objectives: Ride the fae rings and slay 30 Masked Invaders in The Stalks.

62611.title: Hyphae Patrol: Heartwood Grove
62611.description:
Those masked fiends have taken over Heartwood Grove, and I mean to stop their plans.

Heartwood Grove was so beautiful before. And now, it's... No matter. We're going to fix this, you and me. Right now.

Come, join me in battle. We'll give those monsters a thrashing that will make their masters think twice before desecrating that sacred place again!
62611.progress: Hurry up. I won't stand to let them spend one moment more in that grove.
62611.completion: There, it's done. They should be driven back, if only for a while. I appreciate the help.
62611.objectives: Ride the fae rings and slay 30 Possessed Desecrators in Heartwood Grove.

62612.title: Venthyr Arsenal
62612.description:
<Forgy reads the letter you hand him.>

Ah, Rendle sent you. Should've said so.

No problem. I'll get you everything you need to be bashing skulls at that court.

Gonna need some help convincing my boss for the time off, though.

Real stick in the muck, yeah?

Say you take care of some of the troubles around here, tell everyone it's for me--that'll do it.
62612.completion:
Nice work. Boss gave the all-clear for me time off.

See you there, Maw Walker.

62613.title: Kyrian Arsenal
62613.description:
<Forgelite Sophone reads the letter you hand her.>

I see.

Wherever I may serve, I will go.

Are you willing to do the same? Will you serve Bastion where it has need?

62614.title: Hyphae Patrol: Eventide Grove
62614.description:
I hope you're ready to fight.

The Drust are bolstering their forces in Eventide Grove. Most of Ardenweald doesn't remember them, but I do. You have to completely root them out to be rid of their presence, or they'll grow right back, tougher than ever.

Come with me. We're going to exterminate every last one of them. Let me know when you're ready.
62614.progress: Quickly, before they spread any further into Ardenweald. Now's our chance.
62614.completion: Good work. They're still holed up in Darkreach, but that's the best we can do for now. Keep 'em contained, and then we'll burn them out.

62615.title: Hyphae Patrol: Gossamer Cliffs
62615.description:
Bad news from the Gossamer Cliffs. We need to help.

The varmints terrorizing the poor silk striders have become more cruel and aggressive lately. The silk striders are important to Ardenweald; more important than almost anyone else knows. We can't lose any more.

Let me know when you're ready to go and we'll scare those gits away for good!
62615.progress: Quickly! The striders are counting on us!
62615.completion: The little misses should be safe for now. Their purpose is vital to Ardenweald, and I won't have any more of them dying on my watch!

62616.title: Night Fae Arsenal
62616.description:
<Gormsmith Cavina reads the letter you hand him.>

I'm not surprised the Hunt-Captain sent you to me. I am the finest gormsmith in all of Ardenweald, afterall.

Her orders are clear and I'm happy to help.

We'll need you to take on some extra patrols to make up for the lost time and resources.

Sound fair?
62616.completion: Everything's ready. I'm looking forward to the adventure.

62619.title: A Meandering Story
62619.description:
<A quick glance at this heavy tome reveals flowery language and a plot that doesn't seem to go anyplace. At least not in the first few chapters.

There is some dirt on the cover, but the damage isn't too bad. This book doesn't seem to have found itself in too much trouble-- a bit like its plot.

Archivist Dreyden would probably be pleased to have his book back.>
62619.completion: Oh! You found one of my books! Thank you so much for returning it to me.
62619.objectives: Bring the Meandering Story to Archivist Dreyden in the Grove of Memory.

62620.title: A Wandering Tale
62620.description:
<This book might have a point, but the author is taking every possible detour along the way. Or maybe it's about the journey and not the destination...

In any case, Archivist Dreyden would probably be pleased to have his book back.>
62620.completion: I was just thinking about this book! I had hoped it would come back on its own. Thank you for returning it to me.
62620.objectives: Bring the Wandering Tale to Archivist Dreyden in the Grove of Memory.

62621.title: An Escapist Novel
62621.description:
<Action, adventure, thrills, chills... This book has it all! Penned by a mortal soul who led an amazing life, this book is a page-turner. 

But is it true? Could one person fight conspiracies, ancient evils, vast enemy armies, demons and even gods in a single lifetime?

On further reflection, it could be true, but what is a "duck" this book speaks of? That part sounds fake.

Still... it was a good story. Archivist Dreyden would probably be pleased to have his book back.>
62621.completion: This was a good tale! Oh, I do hope the soul who wrote it down is doing okay in this drought! Oh dear me. Thank you for returning it to me.
62621.objectives: Bring the Escapist Novel to Archivist Dreyden in the Grove of Memory.

62622.title: A Travel Journal
62622.description:
<This book appears to be a travelogue of this book's personal journey around Ardenweald! And self-written and published no less!

Flipping towards the end you see yourself enter the picture as a villain, unjustly attacking the book and opening it. 

You read "This book appears to be a travelogue of this book's personal journey around Ardenweald! And Self-written and-"

You hurriedly close the book, feeling queasy. It should go back to Archivist Dreyden.>
62622.completion: It was writing itself? How fascinating! The feeling of recursion will pass.
62622.objectives: Bring the Travel Journal to Archivist Dreyden in the Grove of Memory.

62623.title: A Naughty Story
62623.description:
<You have held this book for less than five minutes and it has already escaped once, bitten you twice and somehow managed to steal some gold.

This is not what you were expecting from a "Naughty Story" but then again, maybe you should have.

You bind the book closed so it will hopefully cause a minimum of mischief. Time to bring it to Archivist Dreyden.>
62623.completion:
You found one of my books!

Oh. That one.

<Dreyden sighs.>

I suppose I will take it back. Thanks, I guess.
62623.objectives: Bring the Naughty Story to Archivist Dreyden in the Grove of Memory.

62624.title: The Queen's Conservatory
62624.description:
I have heard that you are aiding us in restoring our sanctum, {NAME}. 

There is a very special magical grove that we know as The Queen's Conservatory. 

Within this magical sanctuary we nurture the spirits of old deities back to life. But its magic has waned with the anima drought. 

It is in need of your help.

It would mean the world to us if you could start the restoration process by acquiring the resources we need.
62624.progress: You can go and Speak to Zayhad in your Sanctum to unlock the Queen's Conservatory once you have collected sufficient resources.
62624.completion: I am so happy to see you have started to help restore the Queen's Conservatory to its former glory.
62624.objectives: Speak to Zayhad to unlock the Queen's Conservatory.

62625.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
62625.description:
It's a joy to see the progress you've made in the restoration of the conservatory, {NAME}!

But there's still more work to be done.

We have found another inert spirit. A dark dream is preventing its awakening.

In this dream, the spirit is caught in the midst of a feud between ancient beings. Both are a bit on the unsavory side, but one is much, much worse than the other!

If you were to defeat the Father of Sleep, it should nudge the spirit from its slumber. Will you help?
62625.completion: Another dream vision fulfilled. This is remarkable!
62625.objectives: Defeat Mueh'zala in De Other Side.

62626.title: Mullby's Marker
62626.description: The Marker looks like it might be important to this Mulby fellow. Returning it to him in Maldraxxus might net you a finder's fee.
62626.completion:
You have something for me? Oh my! 

<In a quieter voice.> 

How did you get this? Of course I will compensate you for bringing it back to me, that Grandmaster Vole would not have parted with it until he rung me dry. You have no idea what you saved me from.

Oh, can you not mention this to Elsie, she would never let me hear the end of it, I swear my betting days are over.
62626.objectives: Return the marker to the Challenger's Promenade in Maldraxxus.

62627.title: All Spirits Great and Small
62627.description:
This is a most curious place.

So much energy of rebirth. A fusion of different forms of magic. Not what I expected.

I too was committed to rebirth among my kind. This magic is both known to me, and like nothing I have seen before. Yet it all serves to balance. 

It is not just great spirits of import that help to maintain the cosmic balance.

Even the smallest of creatures can play a role. 

I can show you if you like? Visit the remains of one such creature, and we shall rekindle its spirit.
62627.progress: Return to me when you have found the remains that birthed the spirit animal.
62627.completion: You have seen them already? Yes, you did. I can tell.
62627.objectives: Travel to Frostfire in search of the remains.

62628.title: Vole's Voucher
62628.description: <The voucher spells it all out, if you take the voucher to Au'narim at the Challenger's Promenade outside the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus he should dispense the funds to you from Grandmaster Vole's credit.>
62628.progress: You wish to make a transaction?
62628.completion:
<Au'narim takes the voucher from you, reads it over.>

Voucher authenticated, approval of funds authorized. Please approach again if you wish to engage in another transaction.
62628.objectives: Take the voucher to the Challenger's Promenade in Maldraxxus.

62629.title: All Spirits Great and Small
62629.description:
The time has come for us to rekindle another animal spirit.

This one was lost to fire and raiding in a distant land.

Go. Commune with the creature's remains. Release its spirit so that it may return here.
62629.completion: You have delivered this spirit back to us. It can now roam free here in the conservatory.
62629.objectives: Travel to Kun-Lai Summit in search of the remains.

62630.title: All Spirits Great and Small
62630.description:
The time has come for us to rekindle another animal spirit.

While appearing normal to you, and to the great winged creature that ate it, this creature was in fact somewhat special among its kind. 

You should travel to its grisly resting place and commune with its spirit so that it may join us in the conservatory.
62630.completion: You have delivered this spirit back to us. It can now roam free here in the conservatory.
62630.objectives: Travel to Tiragarde Sound in search of the remains.

62653.title: Stop the Inquisition
62653.description:
The Lord Chamberlain's inquisitors still torment the poor souls trapped under their care.

You must put a stop to their wicked deeds!

Speak with Archivist Fane, whom you worked with before to defeat an inquisitor, to acquire the sinstone of another inquisitor in the halls.

With their sinstone, you will be able to shatter that inquisitor's defenses and lead the charge to defeat them.

Bring friends, $p. Many of the inquisitors are far too dangerous to approach alone.
62653.progress: Archivist Fane can help you acquire an inquisitor's sinstone.
62653.completion:
<Archivist Janeera does not look up from her scroll as she responds to you.>

Noted and logged.

62691.title: A Calling in Revendreth
62691.description:
We got a lot of problems out there, boss. Big ones, little ones, really smelly ones, it's a lot.

If we're gonna take on Denathrius, the first thing we gotta do is clean up right here in Revendreth.

We get things cleaned up, yeah? Then we get some new allies, and we probably get our hands on some anima to boot.

It's a call to action, it is. And it's important that we get started right away.

Get on out there and get your boots muddy!
62691.completion: Ya did a good thing today, an' we're safer for it. Never been one to give a compliment, me, but today I gotta say ya did a good one.

62692.title: A Calling in Bastion
62692.description:
Our forces are weakened by doubt and our temples are under assault. If we are to aid the rest of the Shadowlands, we must begin here, in Bastion.

Travel the golden fields and root out evil wherever you may find it. In time, we will rebuild our forces and our anima stores, and stand tall once more.

Today, you walk the path of courage--it is your calling. Show our people that doubt will not fester here.
62692.progress: Do the hills echo with the cries of your victories, Maw Walker?
62692.completion:
The hills speak of your faith and honor, and our forces radiate with each victory!

Glory to Bastion, glory to the Archon, glory to the Maw Walker!

62693.title: A Calling in Ardenweald
62693.description:
Ardenweald is fractured, its roots strangled. Before we can begin to regrow our glades, we must unearth the evils that have festered here.

We call to you, today, to defend our forests. Take the weald paths through our lands, aiding our allies and defeating our enemies. With these actions, we will renew our forces, and rebuild our anima. In time, hope will blossom.

Our trust is in you, our newest seedling.
62693.progress: Have you brought hope and faith to our people today?
62693.completion: Our bonds are stronger, our roots grow deeper, due to your actions this day. We will hold strong against the onset of foes that plague us, as groves weave together in defense, thanks to you.

62694.title: A Calling in Maldraxxus
62694.description:
Today marks the beginning of our path to victory.

Enemies surround us on all sides. Aid our troops on the battlefield and return with the resources we need to wage our war.

Once we have secured our home front, we can direct our efforts outwards.

Such is your calling. Failure is unacceptable.
62694.completion: Our rival houses will think twice before stepping foot outside of their strongholds again. Blood and glory to you, Maw Walker.

62695.title: A Call to Service
62695.description:
An opportunity has arisen that will be perfect for you to display your... prowess... to the denizens of Revendreth.

Speak with Rendle. That dredger is disturbingly effective when it comes to hatching schemes. He says he has a plan for you.
62695.completion: It's right good of you to step up and take on this here challenge, it is. We've got a lot of work to do, here in Revendreth, so's I hope you're ready to get a bit dirty.

62697.title: A Call to Service
62697.description:
<Laurel picks out a sad tune on her harp.>

Our groves wilt and wither,
and enemies wait at our gates!
The forest calls out in sorrow, 
"Please help us before it's too late!"

<The melody becomes a call to arms.>

O <huntsman/huntress>, now answer our calling!
Ardenweald is in need of your might!
Envoy Blodwyn will give you a mission,
to ride with the Wild Hunt tonight!
62697.completion: I thank you for your visit, and entrust you with an important task. To regrow Ardenweald, we must begin by aiding its denizens.

62698.title: A Call to Service
62698.description:
Elysian Hold requires anima to operate fully. We need as much as we can so it may serve our needs.

Our temples are fraught with challenges. By heeding their call you will recover anima for use within the sanctum here.

Speak with Hermestes first, who will guide you on the path of courage.
62698.completion: I knew you would answer the call, Maw Walker. There is much to be done.

62700.title: Ashes of the Tower
62700.description: Your first step towards obtaining the power is to retrieve... something. Yes, I believe it's coming back to me.
62700.progress: Have you recovered what is needed?

62704.title: The Threads of Fate
62704.description:
It is my duty to observe the strands of fate. The wondrous possibilities that the Purpose lays before us.

Fate flows around you, mortal. It shifts. It changes. But I have stilled its movements to offer you... a choice.

You may journey through the Shadowlands in the same manner as those who came before you have done.

Or you may choose a different path. One that lets you forge a bond with a covenant now, and move freely through the realms of Death to forge your own destiny.

What say you, mortal?
62704.progress: Fate is not fickle. Should you accept its offer, there will be no turning back.
62704.completion: Your choice is made. The Purpose will guide you forward.
62704.objectives: Speak with Fatescribe Roh-Tahl and decide how you want to experience Shadowlands.

62707.title: The Elysian Fields
62707.description:
You must travel to Bastion, eternal home of the winged kyrian.

Do not be fooled by their golden fields and shining spires--the kyrian have been weakened by the great anima drought, and face the brink of civil war against their own fallen brethren.

They will benefit greatly from your aid. Seek one known as Kalisthene in the crossroads called Hero's Rest. She will direct you further.

Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide transport.
62707.completion: Why have you come to our realm, mortal?
62707.objectives: Speak to Kalisthene at Hero's Rest in Bastion.

62714.title: A Gift for an Acolyte
62714.description:
The materials you supplied were more than sufficient for my purposes. For that, you have my gratitude.

I think I know how to make the best use of the excess.

A dear friend of mine recently achieved the role of Acolyte in service to the Temple of Purity. You are new here, so I will spare you the details, but it is an honor to serve a temple before one reaches ascension.

I want to celebrate her success with a gift. Will you take this parcel to Acolyte Amalthina?
62714.progress: Welcome to the Temple of Purity. How may I be of service?
62714.completion:
What is this?

<She opens the parcel. A soft smile spreads over her face.>

This is wonderful. Thank you.
62714.objectives: Deliver Klystere's Gift to Acolyte Amalthina in the Temple of Purity.

62715.title: More Than A Gift
62715.description:
You have no idea what you just delivered, do you?

<She opens the parcel to reveal a wreath of Larion plumage.>

I will explain, but first... I wish to return the favor.

Klystere and I frequent a resting place to the north of here, along the path to the Temple of Courage. We planted a flower for our enjoyment, as we spend so much of our free time there.

Bring me this bloom, if you would be so kind. Then I will tell you about the significance of this gift.
62715.progress: Did you find the place I mentioned? And the flower?
62715.completion: This is perfect. I appreciate your efforts on my behalf.

62716.title: Re-Introductions
62716.description:
Though you have chosen your path, the fate of the Shadowlands has yet to be determined.

The power of the Banished One grows. It falls to you, and others of your kind, to thwart him.

The Arbiter's Honored Voice, Tal-Inara, will aid you in choosing a covenant. Bolstering their strength offers our best chance at victory.

Let the Purpose guide you, {NAME}. Always.
62716.completion: Ah, {NAME}. I was wondering when you were going to appear. Your aid is needed.
62716.objectives: Speak with Tal-Inara within the Enclave in Oribos.

62718.title: Hero's Rest
62718.description:
In light of the new arrivals to Bastion, Kalisthene has enabled the anima gateways to Hero's Rest once more!

Those wishing to partake of breathtaking views, unparalleled steward service, and all manner of training and repair facilities should venture to this most remarkable of locations at their earliest convenience.

Simply follow the path north and bear to the right at the crossroads.

Kalisthene will personally greet all new arrivals for this most joyous of occasions!
62718.completion: Welcome to Hero's Rest, crossroads of Bastion. You will find much to aid you in your journey here.
62718.objectives: Speak to Kalisthene in Hero's Rest.

62719.title: The Final Pieces
62719.description:
The final components you'll need to acquire are... vessels... rune vessels! Armor to hold the might that will be imbued.

And... powers? No... missives? Yes! Missives will allow your item to enhance your own personal strengths. But they cannot be the same. No, the two must offer different benefits.

All of these can be obtained from souls with the correct crafting knowledge.

And lastly, more of my memories. Memories of the runes, of the powers... of myself.
62719.progress: Have you acquired the remaining items?
62719.completion:
You've collected all the necessary pieces. Now all that's left is to combine them.

Speak with me again when you are ready, and I will create the prize you seek.

62723.title: Bolstering Bastion
62723.description:
You are no aspirant, but I welcome any aid that Oribos might bring us in these dire times.

Please, aid our people in any way you can. With anima in low supply and the insidious Forsworn encroaching from all sides, there is no shortage of trials to overcome.

Do this for us, and I will see to it myself that our almighty Archon hears of your deeds in service of the kyrian. Mark well my words, and follow the path.
62723.completion:
Word has spread across Bastion of your deeds since your arrival here.

You have proven yourself a worthy ally of the kyrian. Take this gift in thanks, and go in service.

May we cross paths again soon.

62729.title: Return to Oribos
62729.description:
You have proven yourself a worthy ally of Bastion in your time here, {NAME}. Though I wish you could remain here, there are other realms in the Shadowlands that require aid more.

Return to Oribos when you are able and seek out Tal-Inara. She will help you decide where to best next focus your efforts.

Archon watch over you.
62729.completion: You have fulfilled your purpose. Well done.

62730.title: Fruit of the Gods
62730.description:
You like sweet fruit? 

Stewards grow juiciest Purian. It special fruit! You find it many places in Bastion. It used for many things. 

Eat for nourishment.

Give to bells for blessings.

Give to stewards for treasure.

You find, I show you how!
62730.completion: Yes, this very sweet and ripe. Must use quickly, before it spoils!

62733.title: The Sweetest Tribute
62733.description:
Purian good to eat, yes, but better to give.

You find locked Silver Strongbox near steward statue. Give Ripe Purian fruit as tribute.

Then get nice surprise!

You try?
62733.completion:
I hope you liked your surprise! 

You find more silver strongboxes, give Ripe Purian tribute!

Oh-ho! You want key to my Golden Chest? Ask me about Steward of the Day!
62733.objectives: Place a Ripe Purian fruit in the steward statue Tribute Tray.

62738.title: A Fresh Blade
62738.description:
Though they were once unified in defending the Shadowlands, the houses of Maldraxxus have turned against each other.

Their armies clash within their realm and have even orchestrated an assault on Bastion. Now only the Necrolords remain loyal to the Primus.

Speak to Secutor Mevix at the Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus. His tactical skills will ensure you are sent where you are most needed.

Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide you with transportation.
62738.completion: Ah, another blade on our side! And you aren't even dead yet!
62738.objectives: Speak to Secutor Mevix at the Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus.

62739.title: Restoring Balance
62739.description:
Ardenweald is crucial to the cycle of rebirth for nature spirits that enter their realm.

Unfortunately, the anima drought has led to the loss of entire groves--souls that will never complete their cycle.

Now foes seek to destroy what remains of the once tranquil forests, threatening the already beleaguered Court of Night. 

Lady Moonberry of the Court has requested aid. Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide transport.
62739.completion: Welcome! What brings you to the Heart of the Forest?
62739.objectives: Speak to Lady Moonberry at the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.

62740.title: Dark Aspirations
62740.description:
Prince Renathal has started a daring rebellion against his father, the nefarious Sire Denathrius who betrayed us all by pouring Revendreth's vast anima stores into the Maw.

You must travel to Revendreth and aid Renathal in his efforts. He is our best hope at restoring Revendreth to order.

Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide transport.
62740.completion: And to what do I owe the pleasure of a mortal visiting Revendreth at such an...inopportune time?
62740.objectives: Speak to Prince Renathal in the crypt beneath Darkhaven in Revendreth.

62748.title: Rallying Maldraxxus
62748.description:
We need all the help we can get! It's taking all we have to hold our ground against the other houses, let alone gain any ground against them.

Truth be told, your blade will be welcome anywhere. There are no shortage of battles to be won, foes to be toppled, or weary soldiers to be relieved.

Help us regain control of Maldraxxus, and in the name of the Primus I will see you are amply rewarded.
62748.completion:
All who have reported back to me have said the same--you have brought victory upon victory to the House of the Chosen!

On behalf of all who serve the Primus, you have my eternal gratitude.

62761.title: Return to Oribos
62761.description:
I wouldn't be a tactician if I didn't recognize when the mission is complete.

Much remains to be done before Maldraxxus can stand tall once again, but that day will come thanks to your efforts. 

There are other realms in need of your skills more than us. You should return to Oribos and see to it that they receive it.
62761.completion: You have done well in Maldraxxus. Their path forward is clear.

62763.title: Support the Court
62763.description:
Groves are under attack everywhere! There simply aren't enough of us to protect them all!

You just might be our only hope.

We must restore order, or more precious souls will be lost to us. Please, help anyone you can, anywhere you can. My heart cannot bear to see any more pain!

I'll make sure the Winter Queen hears of your deeds, don't you worry!
62763.completion:
You have done a great service to not only Ardenweald, but the countless nature spirits we protect.

Thank you. Today you are a hero of Ardenweald!

62776.title: Return to Oribos
62776.description:
I wish you could stay and relax here, maybe enjoy a play at the Star Lake Amphitheater, but there's simply no time!

There are other realms out there that need your help, too.

You will always be a friend of the Court, but I'm afraid you must return to Oribos. The Shadowlands needs you!
62776.completion: Your efforts in Ardenweald have not gone unnoticed, Maw Walker.

62778.title: Reinforcing Revendreth
62778.description:
Denathrius must be stopped at all costs. However, we've no hope of taking him out while his forces still control much of Revendreth.

If you are here to aid us, then there is no shortage of work to be done. Disposing of my father's many allies being chief among that work, of course, but any aid you can provide will be of use.

There is too much at stake for all the Shadowlands if we fail. I will see to it that you are handsomely rewarded for your efforts.
62778.completion:
You have my sincere gratitude for aiding our cause. Together we will see Denathrius's hold on our realm broken, and with it win the freedom of my people.

I cannot offer as much as I would like, but I hope it will suffice until our victory is achieved.

62779.title: Return to Oribos
62779.description:
I truly wish you could remain here and aid our cause--it is truly the most pressing manner in all the Shadowlands--but Revendreth alone cannot stand against the growing darkness.

You must return to Oribos and ensure the other realms do not falter in their commitments. Tal-Inara will be able to guide you appropriately.

Thank you once again for your aid, mortal. May our paths cross again.
62779.completion: Revendreth stands stronger for your efforts. The Purpose is clear.

62785.title: I Could Be A Contender
62785.description:
Hold up there, <brother/sister>. 

If you are serious about fighting in the Arena you're going to need a manager. 
Lucky for you, <brother/sister>, I know a guy. He's just had some openings in his roster of fighters and you look like just the type of {class} he needs to fill his ranks.

Name is Louison, you can find him at the gate just east of here.

Tell him I sent ya, <brother/sister>.
62785.completion:
Oh, Anzio sent you? Hah, and here I was thinking you were just another nosy fan.

Yeah, you look like just the {class} I need!

62789.title: Of Great Renown
62789.description:
As you aid our sacred covenant across the Shadowlands, your connection to it shall grow ever stronger.

Your Renown will afford you many benefits over time.

Seek out Iona Skyblade at the front of the hold, near the Crest of Ascension. She will show you the glory of the path.
62789.completion: Greetings, Maw Walker. It is an honor.

62790.title: The Path Provides
62790.description:
All who follow the path are granted precious gifts by virtue of their connection with our covenant.

The strength of that bond, known as Renown, is reflected in the shining spires of Elysian Hold itself. Though you have yet to gain Renown, you will as you aid us across the Shadowlands.

When you are ready, I will show you all that the path can provide.
62790.progress: Some say it is the Archon herself who grants our covenant its strength.
62790.completion: Follow the path always, and all will be well.
62790.objectives: Examine your Renown with the Kyrian Covenant.

62791.title: Our Most Precious Resource
62791.description:
You have fulfilled your calling, Maw Walker, and brought peace to our realm.

Stay vigilant, for others will similarly call upon you in time.

The anima you have so dutifully recovered will be of great use in the hold. Bring it to Haephus at once. He will ensure it is kept safe until it is needed.

Go in service.
62791.completion: The Maw Walker returns triumphant! Have you any anima on hand?

62792.title: Into the Reservoir
62792.description:
As the flow of anima withered within Bastion, our mighty Archon entrusted me with guarding our stores until they are needed.

You may deposit any anima you recover into the reservoir here. By my life, and by the glory of the Archon, I will ensure they are kept safe.
62792.progress: Anima is best kept here, safe from our enemies who would take it from us.
62792.completion: Every drop is precious. I will keep it safe here.
62792.objectives: Deposit Anima into your sanctum's Reservoir.

62793.title: It's All Coming Together
62793.description:
Our brothers and sisters are spread thin fighting the Forsworn, maintaining order among aspirants waiting to ascend, and countless other duties.

The willing souls you recovered from the Maw will be a great boon to our capabilities in these dire times.

Go to Haephus at once--he has long been searching for aid in activating some of our sanctum's most powerful features. It is time we saw Elysian Hold brought to its full potential.
62793.completion: I could feel their presence as soon as you brought them to the hold. What a momentous occasion!

62794.title: Enhancing the Hold
62794.description:
As thanks for your efforts in recovering the anima and souls we now have available, you may decide which of Elysian Hold's features we upgrade first.

Once active, it shall expand our capabilities to help not only Bastion, but all the Shadowlands.

Do not worry--as you continue to recover anima and willing souls we will activate them all in time. For now, a single upgrade must suffice.
62794.progress: Take your time. The first step on the path is always the most difficult.
62794.completion: A wise decision. It will take some time to activate, but all good things are worth waiting for, are they not?

62795.title: A Conduit for Good
62795.description:
While the gifts your bond shall bring you are substantial, you may also empower yourself further through the use of conduits.

Conduits act to channel the energy of your soulbind into your form more directly, increasing your potential in a myriad of ways.

Use the ones I have given you as a test of this power, but fear not--you will find others as you aid the Shadowlands.
62795.progress: This is a crucial step in the path.
62795.completion: Your soulbind will grow alongside you in time, but your training is complete for now.
62795.objectives: Add the Conduits to the Forge of Bonds, then apply one to a slot on Pelagos.

62796.title: Return to Adrestes
62796.description:
Baine suffers within Torghast, but at least we know that he yet lives.

Rushing to his rescue would prove disastrous without a plan of attack. I will see to preparing one.

In the meantime, I suggest you bring the souls you rescued to Elysian Hold.

The kyrian are vital to the Shadowlands. If Bastion remains in turmoil, then all might soon be lost.
62796.completion: Welcome back, Maw Walker. Our work has not paused in your absence.
62796.objectives: Report to Polemarch Adrestes at Elysian Hold in Bastion.

62797.title: The Vessels of Metal
62797.description:
You have the bearing of one familiar with the art of smithing. But perhaps you have more to learn.

Vessels that hold the power of the runes can be crafted by a hand such as yours. But this I cannot teach you.

Hmm, there is a way. I will entrust you with a memory of my recipes for the vessels. Take it to a master of your craft and they will show you the way.

What's that? Do not worry. It is merely an echo of my memory. What you restored to me remains intact.
62797.completion:
<Au'berk inspects what you brought to him.>

A memory? Fascinating... With this knowledge, I can teach you to craft armors capable of holding immense power. 

For a price, of course.
62797.objectives: Bring the memory back to Smith Au'berk in Oribos.

62798.title: The Vessels of Leather and Bone
62798.description:
You have the bearing of one familiar with the art of leatherworking. But perhaps you have more to learn.

Vessels that hold the power of the runes can be crafted by a hand such as yours. But this I cannot teach you.

Hmm, there is a way. I will entrust you with a memory of my recipes for the vessels. Take it to a master of your craft and they will show you the way.

What's that? Do not worry. It is merely an echo of my memory. What you restored to me remains intact.
62798.completion:
<Au'qil inspects what you brought to him.>

A memory? Fascinating... With this knowledge, I can teach you to craft armors capable of holding immense power. 

For a price, of course.
62798.objectives: Bring the memory back to Tanner Au'qil in Oribos.

62799.title: The Vessels of the Thread
62799.description:
You have the bearing of one familiar with the art of thread work. But perhaps you have more to learn.

Vessels that hold the power of the runes can be crafted by a hand such as yours. But this I cannot teach you.

Hmm, there is a way. I will entrust you with a memory of my recipes for the vessels. Take it to a master of your craft and they will show you the way.
