63736.title: An Infusion of Anima
63736.description:
Normally we would infuse the Lodestaff with energy from the Netherstar, another relic of note.

Regrettably, that is not an option. But, in a pinch, anima is an acceptable substitute.

Take the Lodestaff. Brandish it near recently slain devourers in the estuary below us.

The staff should draw in and absorb their anima.
63736.completion: The Lodestaff is humming with vibrant energy! The anima worked better than I could have hoped.

63737.title: Finding One's True Purpose
63737.description:
All our efforts have led us here.

With the combined wisdom of the Archivists, and a little help from a {race} {class}, we will attune the Lodestaff to the relics that we seek.

Should we succeed, we will have what we need to re-establish the Archive.

Our sacred work can then continue.
63737.progress: Is it over? Was the attuning a success?
63737.completion: So much has been taken from us. And yet, due to Roh-Senara's sacrifice, there is hope.
63737.objectives: Participate in the ritual to attune the Lodestaff.

63738.title: Establishing the Archive
63738.description:
I will head to Keeper's Respite, where there is some small semblance of safety.

There, we will establish a new archive.

Meet me there when you are able.

I hope we can count on you again. We will have need of your assistance there in the future.
63738.completion: It is hard to imagine how I will continue without the Archivist.
63738.objectives: Meet Scholar Roh-Suir at Keeper's Respite.

63739.title: Hope Ascending
63739.description:
There is one final thing we must do.

Meet us atop the peak of Hope's Ascent.
63739.completion: I was beginning to worry that you had given up on our cause.
63739.objectives: Meet Archivist Roh-Senara and Scholar Roh-Suir near the top of Hope's Ascent.

63740.title: Consulting the Experts
63740.description:
We can restore the functions of the Lodestaff, but it will require the wisdom of the Archivists.

Not just me, but the Archivists who have come before. They were laid to rest near here. Given the scale of the destruction of Korthia and the likely possibility that this destruction will continue, this may be our last chance to visit their memorials before they are irrevocably ruined.

Visit the Archivists' memorials. Take Roh-Suir with you, so that he may take note of their messages before they are lost.
63740.progress: Do not fear the Archivists of old. They are here to help.
63740.completion: I trust you and Scholar Roh-Suir learned from the Archivists.

63751.title: A Terrible Power
63751.description: This strange shard pulses in your hand. An aura of dread radiates forth from it like a chill wind, sending a shiver down your spine. Perhaps the Primus could tell you more about this... if you could find him.

63753.title: Centurions March!
63753.description:
Three of our Centurions have broken through the side gate. They need additional anima to continue their assault.

Several of my assistants tried to deliver anima to them, but failed. Please get recover the anima and assist the Centurions in the attack.
63753.objectives: Collect 5 Anima Motes to empower and assist the Centurion in combat.

63754.title: The Caged Bird
63754.description:
Remain quiet. We must not attract attention.

Many of my sisters have already been lost. It will soon be my turn to perish in that witch's vile ritual.

Release me from this cage and I can see us both to safety. Keeper Odyn must be warned of this foul betrayal!

The Mawsworn called Kjellrun holds the seal that can free me. You can find her gloating in the nearby hall.
63754.progress: This is no fate for a Val'kyr!
63754.completion: I will tell the tale of your noble deeds, {NAME}. Your actions this day will be remembered.
63754.objectives: Acquire the Helwrought Seal from Kjellrun and release Danica from her captivity.

63756.title: Rescued from Torment
63756.description:
The Mawsworn are not only killing those they find in the Seeker's Quorum. They are interrogating the survivors.

We should help save those we can. It's possible one of them might have seen the Fatescribe.
63756.completion: I struggle to believe that not a single attendant has any information on where the Fatescribe might be.
63756.objectives: Rescue 6 Tortured Attendants in Seeker's Quorum.

63757.title: Looting the Looters
63757.description:
<The Mawsworn was carrying a Korthian artifact.

It's unclear what the enemy wants with such relics, but you suspect the attendants in Keeper's Respite would want to see them returned.>
63757.completion: Now this is special. This implement is used by the Fatescribe in his work.
63757.objectives: Retrieve 4 Korthian Artifacts from the Mawsworn.

63758.title: The Last Place You Look
63758.description:
I came here hoping to locate the Fatescribe or something to help me find him.

Evidence shows he was here and survived a Mawsworn attack. The only other place I haven't looked is a meditation chamber on the opposite side of the ruins.

It's too dangerous for me to head back into the Seeker's Quorum alone. Could you help me?

I must find the Fatescribe. It's a matter of great importance.
63758.completion:
Mad ramblings and incense. Weak clues, but they're all we have.

We need to search the Sanctuary of Guidance.
63758.objectives: Search the Seeker's Quorum for the missing Fatescribe.

63759.title: Redirect the Search
63759.description:
I believe the Fatescribe was headed to the Sanctuary of Guidance. A holy place for the attendants of Korthia.

Fortunately, because you seem to be in the habit of picking up every piece of trash you find, we have the Fatescribe's Implement!

I'm sure that will prove useful in locating him. But first, on to the Sanctuary.
63759.completion:
{NAME}! At last! 

You know that I cannot do this without you.
63759.objectives: Meet Caretaker Kah-Than at the entrance to the Sanctuary of Guidance in Korthia.

63760.title: Echoes of Fate
63760.description:
The devourers have swarmed this place, but our focus must remain on finding the Fatescribe.

Attendants who worshipped here would leave offerings of anima at the shrines.

The implement you found will resonate if the Fatescribe has been nearby. With any luck, it will give us insight into where he has gone.
63760.completion:
Using an illusion to hide.

Can you imagine anything so clever?
63760.objectives: Resonate the Fatescribe's Implement at the shrines in the Sanctuary of Guidance.

63761.title: Revenge Delayed
63761.description:
<The Korthian protector is gravely wounded and struggles to speak.>

Devourers... swarmed the sanctuary. Too few of us...

My duty... incomplete.

The Purpose... I...

<The protector's voice fades.>
63761.objectives: Kill 10 Devourers in the Sanctuary of Guidance.

63762.title: Under the Illusion
63762.description:
The Fatescribe has collected the necessary items to create an illusion in this chamber. Fortunately, we can use his own implement to dispel it and reveal him.

He will be grateful to see a friendly face, I'm sure.

I must say, you've proven to be incredibly helpful in this task. I truly couldn't have done it without you.
63762.objectives: Use the Fatescribe's Implement to dispel the illusion.

63763.title: They Could Be Anyone
63763.description:
<The still-warm head of the dreadlord Azodius grimaces at you.

The attendants at Keeper's Respite should be told of the Fatescribe's abduction.

No doubt Highlord Fordragon will want to hear of this unexpected threat.>
63763.completion:
News of the nathrezim infiltrating Korthia is deeply troubling.

How long have they been here? What is their goal?
63763.objectives: Take the head of Azodius to Bolvar Fordragon in Keeper's Respite.

63764.title: Claim the Sky
63764.description:
I mourn the loss of my sisters and desire nothing more than to avenge them. Yet I know that I am no match for the witch's magics or her army of Mawsworn.

We must let wisdom guide us and fly from here. 

Though I am weak from my captivity, I have the strength to bear you from this place.

Let us go, friend.
63764.objectives: Fly with Danica to Odyn's halls in Skyhold.

63765.title: Unseen Hero of the Party
63765.progress:
Oooh, this book looks long, I bet it is incredibly important.
Restock and Repair, Tips and Tricks for Keeping the Party Going (1)
63765.completion: This is what you had to do each week? I'll take care of this now, I won't let you down!
63765.objectives: Oooh, this book looks long, I bet it is incredibly important.

63771.title: Fate's Reminder
63771.description:
Fatescribe Roh-Tahl awaits you within Oribos, should you ever wish to change the course of fate.

You may speak with him at your leisure.
63771.completion:
You return, mortal.

Do you wish to change your fate?
63771.objectives: Meet Fatescribe Roh-Tahl in Oribos if you wish to enter the Threads of Fate.

63773.title: You and What Army
63773.description:
The Jailer has dispatched a force of elite troops to strike our rear lines. Their attack threatens our whole assault!  

I need you and one other soldier to eliminate these enemies. A volunteer from each of the five houses of Maldraxxus has requested to assist you, {NAME}.

Pick one and give them the honor of serving alongside you.
63773.completion: Victory will be ours, Maw Walker!
63773.objectives: Select a champion and Eliminate 3 Mawchained Rampagers and 5 Mawchained Demolishers.

63775.title: Cryptograms and Keys
63775.description:
The repositories of knowledge within Korthia have layers of security--for very good reasons.

Each vault requires cryptographs in order to decode and disable the barriers. They are, for lack of a better term, the keys to every secret.

Search outside the Vault for cryptographs stolen by the Mawsworn and return them to me. I will keep them, and the secrets they protect, safe.
63775.progress: We cannot allow the Jailer to raid the Vaults of Korthia.
63775.completion: I am deeply grateful for your service in keeping our secrets from the Jailer.
63775.objectives: Retrieve 6 Stolen Cryptographs from outside the Vault and Seeker's Quorum.

63776.title: Observational Records
63776.description:
Greetings, Maw Walker, a moment of your time?

As you no doubt know, my cartel has quietly spread observational devices all across Korthia. But that data is no good to us if it is not retrieved. Which is where you come in.

The Scholar's Den records should be ready to collect. You won't see the devices themselves, but the data will appear to you as a bright orb.

Be sure to check in the caverns below ground, as well!

Bring those data to me, and I will reward you handsomely.
63776.progress: Have you retrieved the observational records from the Scholar's Den?
63776.completion:
The Scholar's Den must have been a much different place before the Jailer's chains destroyed it. It is hardly a refuge for intellectual pursuits now.

This information is extremely valuable to us. And here is your reward, as promised.
63776.objectives: Collect 5 Observational Records from the Scholar's Den.

63777.title: Sealed Secrets
63777.description:
Ah, Korthia. What secrets will be revealed?

My associates have been hard at work, seeking to discover and procure various small items of interest throughout this broken land. Nothing of great importance, I assure you.

They have secured those items in designated drop boxes, and those now await pickup in the Scholar's Den. Don't worry: they are locked with an impenetrable seal to protect both the contents and the deliverer.

Bring those sealed containers to me, and I will reward you handsomely.
63777.progress: Do you have the sealed containers?
63777.completion:
Wonderful! You brought everything that I asked for.

Again, do not worry about the contents of these boxes. They pose no threat to you.

Here is the reward I promised.
63777.objectives: Retrieve 5 Sealed Containers from the Scholar's Den.

63778.title: We Move Forward
63778.description:
It breaks my heart to see another land so utterly obliterated. I can imagine how beautiful Korthia must have been, once.

But we must not wallow in what we've lost. Like Ara'lon taught me: we don't have to stand still.

We can choose to fight.

You can help by taking anima back from those Mawsworn. We can put it to use, building up our own forces and defenses.
63778.progress: I look forward to a time when we aren't always fighting for survival.
63778.completion:
Thank you, my friend.

Every bit of anima we collect gives me hope that we can heal the Shadowlands. One day, we will be whole again.
63778.objectives: Collect 8 Plundered Anima from Scholar's Den in Korthia.

63779.title: A Semblance of Normalcy
63779.description:
$p, we have to help the attendants of Korthia. They have lost so much, so suddenly.

Nearby, in the Sanctuary of Guidance, they would take offerings and leave them at shrines. Since the mawsworn invaded, they haven't been able to enter the Sanctuary or retrieve their precious offerings.

If you could collect the offerings and retrieve them. It might allow the attendants some semblance of their normal lives.
63779.progress: How are you? I have heard the Sanctuary of Guidance is overrun with devourers.
63779.completion: How wonderful. We will return these to the attendants so they may once again participate in their rituals. It's important to do activities that bring us peace.

63780.title: See How THEY Like It!
63780.description:
Just thinking about how the Jailer's forces breached Ardenweald makes me so mad! 

And when I get mad, I get even.

Or rather, I get your help with getting even! Slay those Mawsworn and bring back their emblems to show me how many you killed. 

I don't really care where you get them, as long as they come from those Maw jerks!
63780.progress: Those Mawsworn will get what they deserve!
63780.completion:
So many emblems! That makes me so happy.

Everything will be better when we've gotten the Jailer himself, but this will do nicely for now.

Thank you!

63781.title: Mawsworn Battle Plans
63781.description:
Which is more damaging to the enemy, destroying a contingent of their forces or interrupting their communications?

Better yet, what if that communication allows you to best place your forces to ambush their reinforcements?

I see you understand. There will be a Mawsworn lieutenant, Voxiferus, traveling from the Maw into Korthia, by way of the northern road. Find them, kill them, and bring me the battle plans.
63781.progress: Have you found and defeated the Lieutenant?
63781.completion: Again, you survive. You remind me of me. I will review these plans and inform our companions.

63783.title: Anima Reclamation
63783.description:
Our efforts here need a constant supply of troops, supplies, and anima. The last one is the hardest, for obvious reasons. But I've learned to be resourceful. 

Nearby there is a plentiful source of anima: the devourers that currently swarm the Sanctuary of Guidance. It's not as easy as beating it out of a soul, but it's just as effective, if you're strong enough. Are you?
63783.progress: Every drop of anima we reclaim is a potential weapon against the Jailer.
63783.completion: You can trust me with this anima. I will see it is turned against the Jailer and his forces.
63783.objectives: Reclaim 8 Devoured Anima from devourers at the Sanctuary of Guidance.

63784.title: Gold's No Object
63784.description:
$p! How's things?

We 'eard there was all kinds of interestin' stuff out 'ere.

So, 'em sneakin' hoppers? Hard to see, innit? They've got 'emselves a shiny pelt as me 'n' the lads could use to stay out of sight, as it were. You know, avoid the bosses n' such.

I need ya to capture a bundle of 'em. Gold's no object, just bring me the little pests alive.
63784.completion: Look at 'em! Drab little buns. They jus' blend in ta the wood work. That's stinkin' useful innit?

63785.title: Continued Efforts: Seeker's Quorum
63785.description:
The onslaught from Zovaal's forces continues to devastate these lands.

We must send them a message. Show them we will not back down, {NAME}.

The might of Ardenweald stands with you.
63785.completion:
Quite the show you put on, {NAME}.

That should buy us just enough time to sharpen our blades before our next battle.
63785.objectives: Repel the Jailer's forces from Seeker's Quorum in Korthia.

63789.title: Continued Efforts: Scholar's Den
63789.description:
We cannot allow the mawsworn a foothold so close to our own encampment. The attendants say they keep this place hidden from eyes, but I will not rest easy while I can see them.

Enter the Scholar's Den and cleanse the Jailer's forces from it.
63789.progress: Has the Scholar's Den been cleared of mawsworn?
63789.completion: You have performed admirably in this task, Maw Walker. We thank you for your aid.
63789.objectives: Clear the mawsworn from the Scholar's Den.

63790.title: Broker's Bounty: Lord Azzorak
63790.description:
A powerful dreadlord named Lord Azzorak is hampering the efforts of the Cartel in Korthia.

Anyone who exterminates this evil will be rewarded. 

Use caution. Azzorak is a powerful foe. You may require several allies to slay him.
63790.completion:
Thanks to you, Lord Azzorak will no longer hinder Cartel Xy here in Korthia. 

You have my personal thanks as well, Maw Walker. I see many great things in our future.

Please accept this reward as a token of our gratitude.

63791.title: Broker's Bounty: Valdinar the Curseborn
63791.description:
A spike-armored Mawsworn named Valdinar the Curseborn is hampering the efforts of the Cartel in Korthia.

Anyone who exterminates this evil will be rewarded. 

Use caution. Valdinar is a powerful foe. You may require several allies to defeat him.
63791.completion:
Thanks to you, Valdinar the Curseborn will no longer hinder Cartel Xy here in Korthia. 

You have my personal thanks as well, Maw Walker. I see many great things in our future.

Please accept this reward as a token of our gratitude.

63792.title: Broker's Bounty: Nocturnus the Unraveler
63792.description:
A nefarious Maw magus named Nocturnus the Unraveler is hampering the efforts of the Cartel in Korthia.

Anyone who exterminates this evil will be rewarded. 

Use caution. Nocturnus is a powerful foe. You may require several allies to defeat him.
63792.progress: What news do you bring of Nocturnus the Unraveler?
63792.completion:
Thanks to you, Nocturnus the Unraveler will no longer hinder Cartel Xy here in Korthia. 

You have my personal thanks as well, Maw Walker. I see many great things in our future.

Please accept this reward as a token of our gratitude.

63793.title: Broker's Bounty: Ensydius the Defiler
63793.description:
A winged Mawsworn named Ensydius the Defiler is hampering the efforts of the Cartel in Korthia.

Anyone who exterminates this evil will be rewarded. 

Use caution. Ensydius is a powerful foe. You may require several allies to defeat him.
63793.completion:
Thanks to you, Ensydius the Defiler will no longer hinder Cartel Xy here in Korthia. 

You have my personal thanks as well, Maw Walker. I see many great things in our future.

Please accept this reward as a token of our gratitude.

63794.title: Broker's Bounty: Hungering Behemoth
63794.description:
New lands bring new opportunity. We will provide a quantity of valuables to any interested party in return for a substantial amount of devourer blood, preferably the goliath kind.

Faint-hearted collectors need not bother.

Please bring this sample to Ta'nasi in Keeper's Respite.
63794.completion:
<Ta'nasi holds the sample up to the sky.>

An excellent specimen. This will do nicely.

As promised, here is your reward in trade.
63794.objectives: Retrieve a Substantial Amount of Devourer Blood from a Hungering Behemoth.

63810.title: Birds of a Feather
63810.description:
I have seen many ebon wings in the Maw, but never brilliant golden ones.

Now that the aural sequencers are relaying information reliably, we should discover the source of these feathers.

Follow the trail, Maw Walker. There is a mystery here... and very likely profit.

Gold has value where you come from, does it not?
63810.completion: My heart rejoices to see a noble face in this realm of nightmare.
63810.objectives: Follow the trail of golden feathers to find what dropped them.

63811.title: A Hate-Hate Relationship
63811.description:
When the first of my sisters went missing, we were concerned. Those sent to find her did not return. Nor did the next.

What we have discovered is a dreadful betrayal by someone we once trusted.

Come, we must tell Odyn what we have witnessed in the Maw.

His wrath will be great.
63811.progress: I do not fault the messenger, {NAME}.
63811.objectives: Accompany Danica to the Great Mead Hall and inform Odyn of Helya's actions.

63827.title: Encouraging Words
63827.description:
Our forces have been battling relentlessly for hours. No doubt they grow tired and disheartened.

Take this codex and recite the words within to our troops. Do not be fooled. Though the prose may seem meaningless, it holds immense power.

Hearing these words will reinvigorate our exhausted Protectors with hope.
63827.completion: You have done much to help our forces. Thank you,{NAME}.
63827.objectives: Recite the words within the codex to 8 Exhausted Protectors.

63828.title: Mine's Bigger
63828.description:
The Jailer has deployed a large number of newly forged constructs to oppose our forces. Fortunately, I was completely prepared for this possibility. 

I have readied our largest Centurion to repel this threat.

Please Maw Walker, ride with our Centurion and direct it in combat.
63828.progress: Have we driven back their constructs?
63828.completion: The Jailer's forces are unending and our numbers few, but with your help we shall succeed!
63828.objectives: Use the Centurion Demolisher to eliminate the Jailer's constructs.

63829.title: No One Floats Down Here
63829.description:
Now is our chance to free those we had assumed were lost!

Many of our aspirants were seized by the Jailer to make troops for his army. Those that resisted him are locked in the cages that float above us, left there till their souls are broken. 

Shatter the Chains of Domination and free the Trapped Aspirants from the cages.
63829.completion: Your actions show the purity of your soul. Artemede and I would fight along side you any day, Maw Walker.

63831.title: Fury Given Voice
63831.description:
I will answer this attack upon my val'kyr with relentless fury!

You have a vital role to play in this, {class}. You will muster the courage that you have demonstrated this day to lure my Eye to battle.

But first, a simpler task ... the creation of the horn that will summon my wrath. Master Smith Helgar will guide you.
63831.progress: Where is the horn that you have forged?
63831.completion:
This is well made, {NAME}.

Of course, every great horn has a name. It is our tradition!
63831.objectives: Assist Master Smith Helgar at the Forge of Odyn.

63833.title: Terrorizing the Tremaculum
63833.description:
I am certain that my compatriots and generals have more specific tasks they require of you.

But my request is simple. Our enemies currently surround us on all sides.

Push them back and give us more room to operate.
63833.progress: Our enemies surround us on all sides. You need not search far.
63833.completion:
We may not see an end to the Jailer's forces now, but all things must eventually end.

Even evil.

63834.title: Weapons of the Tremaculum
63834.description:
The venthyr of Sinfall do not waste souls, and her stoneborn do not waste armaments.

Retrieve the tools of our enemies so that we may repurpose them for our army.
63834.progress: Every weapon can be made to serve.
63834.completion: Few weapons are intrinsically good or evil. That burden lies with those who wield them.
63834.objectives: Collect 6 Mawsworn Weapons, 6 Ghastly Crowns, and 6 Shade Eyes.

63835.title: Wrath of the Party Herald
63835.description:
Oh, you're back so soon, $p!

...Or have we not already met? It is difficult to remember at times...

Regardless, I trust you are making progress with Cryptkeeper Kassir's plan to weaken our adversaries.

Details of the plan escape me, but I am certain Temel was involved. I hear he fancies himself a "party herald" nowadays...

<The Curator looks beyond you for a moment.>

"Party herald"... I must have been gone from Revendreth for longer than I thought.
63835.progress: You can find Temel on the ramparts near the Curator.
63835.completion: Ha! I presume the Jailer had never considering planning for a party herald's attack.
63835.objectives: Help Temel, the Party Herald, throw poison bombs at 50 enemies in the Tremaculum.

63836.title: Fangcrack's Fan Club
63836.description:
Fangcrack is the strongest dredger I e'er seen! He's incredible!

He's down there, reaching into dat big Torghast portal, pulling the baddies right out o' their home!

They don't even know what's happenin' half the time, ha ha!

Me and Cudgelface joined his fan club soon as we got here.

You want in? You gotta earn your membership same as everyone else: go down there and fight whatever he pulls out of the portal!
63836.progress: Looking for Fangcrack? Follow the cheering of his fans.
63836.completion:
You also joined Fangcrack's fan club? So did Lady Moonberry.

<Prince Renathal thinks for a moment.>

Perhaps I should reconsider my earlier rejection of Rendle's invitation to join...
63836.objectives: Kill 12 Torghast enemies pulled out of the portal by Fangcrack.

63837.title: A Tea for Every Occasion
63837.description:
My dear $p! I knew you would arrive in the nick of time to save us all from the brink of boredom!

I was just telling Niya here about the time you saved me from the Ember Ward through the healing power of tea!

She is a bit skeptical. Perhaps you can help Tubbins and Gubbins show her that, through tea, all things are possible!
63837.progress: Tubbins is up on the ramparts with Theotar.
63837.completion: Tubbins promised to save me a cup for our victory celebration at the Ember Court!
63837.objectives: Help Tubbins and Gubbins deliver tea to 15 allies in the Tremaculum.

63838.title: Duelist's Challenge
63838.description:
<Nadjia continues to parry attacks from enemy Mawsworn while she turns to face you.>

As you can see, we have our hands full here on the barricade.

I will hold the line while you challenge the champions of the Mawsworn army.

Defeat them in full view of their underlings.

No mercy, $p. Demoralize them.
63838.progress: Boot the Beaut can throw you up to the ramparts if needed.
63838.completion:
Nadjia single-handedly held off an entire platoon of Mawsworn while the dredgers established our base.

Even General Draven was impressed.
63838.objectives: Ask Boot the Beaut to throw you to the upper ramparts, then duel the champions of the Mawsworn army.

63839.title: If Even One is Worthy
63839.description:
I have seen firsthand that worthy souls have been unjustly cast into the Maw.

Gresit here was almost cast in himself by the Lord Chamberlain's minion. He has more than proven himself under my care.

Look among the souls that the Jailer's filth have deemed "unworthy". Inspect each to confirm that they deserve their fate.

Even if we examine every soul in the Tremaculum and find only a single worthy one to bring back to Revendreth, it will still be valuable.
63839.completion:
Even in the depths of the Maw, the Accuser remains focused on saving any soul she can...

Her devotion to Revendreth's true purpose continues to inspire me.
63839.objectives: Inspect Unworthy Souls in the Tremaculum until you find one that is truly worthy.

63840.title: They Grow Up So Quickly
63840.description:
I know what you're thinking, but I have these gormlings completely under control!

I picked up a trick or two at the venthyr's Ember Court for suppressing and controlling these troublemakers.

If you wish to use their power to aid our battle, I will loan you my staff. With it you can choose a gormling that can be ordered to feed on the corpses of our enemies and grow in strength and size.

You won't need many. Gormling grow quickly.
63840.progress: If you have lost your gormling, Niya up on the ramparts will have found it.
63840.completion: I will keep the gorm restrained here until they are needed.

63841.title: The Skyhunt
63841.description:
Boot the Beaut and the other large dredgers are being hit hard from air assaults.

The dredgers may not be able to reach them, but the Wild Hunt can reach any prey.

Take my spear and use it to ground the Mawsworn in the sky above the western bridge.

Once they are grounded, they will be easy to dispatch.

My trappers will help slow them down for you.
63841.progress: The Mawsworn flyers appear to be focusing their attention on the western bridge.
63841.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Our biggun dredgers are critical to troop movement in the area.
63841.objectives: Use Korayn's Spear to pull 8 Mawsworn Skylurkers to the ground and kill them.

63842.title: That's a Good Trick
63842.description:
These cruel tormentors make me so mad...

The Jailer's bullies torture good souls sent here unjustly because no one will stand up to them!

Well, I am here now, and I have the perfect plan to make them pay.

What do you say? Want to help me turn the tables on these bullies?
63842.progress: Well, if Lady Moonberry thinks it wise...
63842.completion: Let it not be said that it was ever boring while Lady Moonberry was present.

63843.title: Heart and Soul
63843.description:
The Forsworn that serve the Jailer dominate the skies above, but we know their weakness and shall use it against them.

Under my direction Mikanikos has created a supply of Trueheart Spears for our Protectors. When hit by these spears the Mawsworn will be weakened with their soul laid bare as they face their true self.

Collect the Trueheart Spears and use them to defeat the Mawsworn Myrmidons that fly above us.
63843.completion: There is great sorrow in this victory, but it had to be done.
63843.objectives: Collect 6 Trueheart Spears and defeat 6 Mawsworn Myrmidons.

63844.title: The Chosen Few
63844.description:
I have need of more val'kyr to join Danica in the battle to come. {NAME}, you are granted the honor of choosing the most worthy.

The strongest will present themselves in challenge at the Circle of Glory. Fight hard, {class}, and do honor to your weapons.
63844.completion: Well fought. Kolfinna, Dryfinna, and Aeskir have risen to the challenge and await you in Odyn's hall.
63844.objectives: Go to the Circle of Glory and fight the val'kyr to determine which are most worthy.

63845.title: Wrath of Odyn
63845.description:
The horn has been forged and the worthy have been selected.

Now, {NAME}, we have only to bind my chosen val'kyr to the horn and infuse them with my power that they may strike with my fury.

Come, bear witness.
63845.progress: Yes? Did you have a question?
63845.completion: It is done. Danica and her sisters are infused with my power and wield my wrath.
63845.objectives: Bear witness to the empowerment of the chosen val'kyr and the binding of the Ilskahorn.

63848.title: A Show of Gratitude
63848.description:
Your presence here fulfils an ancient prophecy, Maw Walker. I am certain you and your allies will save us.

Perhaps I judged your broker friend too harshly. She did escort you to Korthia, after all. 

Please extend our thanks to Ve'nari, and let her know we are happy to answer her questions.

She... does seem to have quite a number of them.
63848.completion:
A thank-you is polite.

A favor is better.
63848.objectives: Speak with Ve'nari at Keeper's Respite in Korthia.

63849.title: Hearing Aid
63849.description:
How fortuitous! You just happened to be transferred to a location in which I have a certain... interest. Place the aural sequencers I gave you and I will attempt to establish a functional signal.

Such a perilous location will require the utmost discretion. You will want to use your ethereal cloak to avoid being seen.
63849.completion:
Perfect. Their secrets will soon be mine.

Pardon me. I meant to say "ours."
63849.objectives: Place the Aural Sequencers in Desmotaeron to help Ve'nari eavesdrop on the inhabitants.

63853.title: Kill the Flame
63853.description:
Can you see it?  

Just out of the corner of my eye, it's always there... glowing so brightly!

How is one supposed to relax and enjoy a cup of tea while that reminder of fire and ash is around.

Please Maw Walker do me a favor... remove it so that we may all enjoy a cup of my favorite blend!
63853.progress: Have you killed that dreadful creature?
63853.completion: A sweet reprieve from that creature's dreadful glare.
63853.objectives: Kill Infernus the Infinite for Theotar.

63855.title: Ease of Passage
63855.description:
Korthia is ripe with opportunity. Look at all of these intriguing objects.

In anticipation of such wonders, I have come prepared. Let us find a suitable location and establish a more permanent connection between this place and my refuge.

Our work together is not yet finished.
63855.progress: I'll take my bag now, if you have it.
63855.completion:
A worthwhile trip that has opened so many possibilities.

<Ve'nari digs through the heavy bag and pulls out a few unusual objects.>
63855.objectives: Establish a connection between Korthia and Ve'nari's Refuge.

63856.title: A Gathering of Covenants
63856.description:
Though the Jailer remains confined to the Maw, his cruelty extends beyond the bounds of his prison.

Thankfully, the Archon is recovering from the attack. Though I am told her wound has an... unsettling quality.

The Eternal Ones and their allies await you and Highlord Fordragon in the Arbiter's chamber. I shall open the way.

With her voice have I spoken.
63856.completion: <Bolvar stares in wonder at the sight before him.>
63856.objectives: Speak to Tal-Inara to enter the Arbiter's chambers.

63857.title: Voices of the Eternal
63857.description:
<Bolvar peers at the grand figures before him, at the numberless gateways stretching out into the ether.>

This chamber is... truly wondrous.

Yet there is no time to be awestruck. The Honored Voice must begin this meeting at once.
63857.completion:
The Winter Queen must be the Jailer's next target.

We must do all we can to protect her.

And I have a few ideas how we can do that...

63859.title: Saved By The Bells
63859.description:
Our stewards are preparing Reinforcement Bells to summon additional Kyrian to aid in our assault. However, the Mawsworn have been attacking the stewards in order to disrupt their efforts. 

We need you to defend our stewards while they complete their work, then ring each bell to call in reinforcements.
63859.completion: The sounds of those bells strengthens our hearts and gives us the might to win this battle.
63859.objectives: Defend and ring the Reinforcement Bell West, East, and South.

63860.title: Talisman of the Eternal Scholar
63860.description:
<The talisman is dented and spattered with muck. Whoever stashed this here handled it roughly.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this talisman in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63860.completion:
Where... where did you find this?

<The Archivist brings the talisman closer for inspection.>

 I haven't seen this in eons. I thought it had been lost.
63860.objectives: Bring the Damaged Talisman to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63861.title: Beginning the Collection
63861.description:
Let us continue our work by retrieving the most important item of any scholarly study--the lost codex.

It will take some time, but as we continue our work the pages of this work will continue to grow and flourish, just as Korthia has itself for eons.

As for its location, it previously resided deep within the underbelly of Korthia itself inside the Cavern of Contemplation to the south.

We can only hope the Jailer's forces have yet to locate it.
63861.progress: Have you found the codex? I hope we're not too late.
63861.completion:
Yes, yes. This is it. Magnificent, don't you agree?

<The damp codex catches The Archivist by surprise. He gently runs his hand along the binding, muttering an incantation in a soft, enigmatic tone.>

That should help preserve it for now, but the incantation won't last. We must get to work.
63861.objectives: Recover the Codex of Memories for Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63863.title: United In Pride
63863.description:
Despite our competitive differences, Nemea and I work as a team when faced with greater threats. The pride and the phalynx are both fierce fighters upon the battlefield.

We would both be honored to assist you in the battle that lies ahead.

Please allow either Andira or Gatamatos to assist you in defeating the Jailer's champions that threaten our forces.
63863.progress: With those champions defeated our forces can push forward.
63863.completion: You display the greatest of courage.

63864.title: The Dreadful Blend
63864.description:
Gravedust and Stipple Weed is a dreadful flavor combination, and Tubbins made a very large batch of tea with those ingredients.

It was so horrid that I tossed the entire pot of tea on the fire. It turns out to be very wet, and an excellent extinguisher of flames! 

Tubbins will haul the entire batch with you. Put it to good use, by tossing it on the Volatile Embersparks around Zovaal's Cauldron.
63864.progress: Please, I hope you did not drink that.
63864.completion: Please tell me you did not drink any of that dreadful brew. We deserve only the finest blends for all our efforts here.

63867.title: Anger Management
63867.description:
I am no musician, though I've spent many an hour enjoying the entertainment in Tazavesh.

Giving this horn a voice will require the harvest of strong emotions.

Anger seethes unrestrained within the damned unfortunates consigned to the River of Souls. Use this siphoning device to drain the rage of these furious shades into your instrument.

The shrieks of fury that you acquire should allow you to pierce the Maw and reach your allies.

The tune, I suspect, will not be a popular one.
63867.completion: The instrument's voice will not be pleasing to most ears, but I believe it will serve its purpose.
63867.objectives: Use the siphoning device to drain rage from the Furious Shades in the River of Souls.

63892.title: Diviner's Rune Chits
63892.description:
<Inside the pouch is a single rune chit. It rotates and flips as if moved by an unseen hand.

Runes vaguely reminiscent of the Vrykul language are delicately carved into the stone. On the back of the chit is an indication that it is part of a set.>
63892.progress: Goodness, is that a pouch of rune chits? How many do you have?
63892.completion:
You have acquired a complete set of Diviner's Rune Chits!

This was one of the first relics that I studied as an acolyte scholar. If you cast the chits, the resulting scatter and orientation will answer any question you ask of them, though it takes experience and a good deal of intuition to interpret their meaning.

I never expected to see a complete set again.
63892.objectives: Collect 20 rune chits, then bring them to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63895.title: Grab Bag
63895.description:
Interesting. Aural sequencers and an ethereal cloak. You hang on to those, {NAME}. I have a suspicion they will prove useful.

Ah, and something special for me as well. If I'm not mistaken--and I so rarely am--this is a projection mechanism. Very handy!

And what's this? A transportation device of some kind. We should test it immediately.

By "we," of course I mean you.
63895.completion: This projector is certainly useful. A safe landing, I perceive.
63895.objectives: Test the transportation device from Ve'nari's bag.

63896.title: Tears of the Damned
63896.description:
To anchor the instrument to the Maw and make it capable of the effect you seek, it must be imbued with the raw, unfiltered agony endured by the souls trapped in this cursed prison. 

Sorrow is abundant here, and therefore simple to obtain. You need only travel to Gorgoa. The damned shed copious tears that fall as crystalized grief as they are swept along the River of Souls.

Be careful that their sadness does not overwhelm you.
63896.completion: The magnitude of the grief you have collected will bind the instrument to the Maw.
63896.objectives: Collect 10 Tears of the Damned from Gorgoa: The River of Souls.

63899.title: Book of Binding: The Mad Witch
63899.description:
<You hear a muffled voice speaking from within this book, interspersed with crackling static. Though the utterances are mostly unintelligible, you can make out the repeated request to recover crimson pages.

Flipping through the volume, you note that many of its pages are missing.

If the pages were retrieved, the book could be returned to the Archivist and reassembled.>
63899.completion:
Scholars at the Seeker's Quorum were researching this tome.

It appears as though it was a fellow scholar, not mawsworn or wildlife, that tore it apart. This is troubling. 

For our safety, I will stitch all but one missing page back into the binding before I add this to the archive. Until we know more about this relic, we cannot risk restoring it entirely.
63899.objectives: Collect 12 Crimson Pages, then bring them to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63901.title: Focusing the Eye
63901.description:
The combination of grief and rage you have harvested is sufficient for your needs. Most likely. 

If you insist on seeing this ill-advised endeavor through, use the horn at the Terminus Platform, where the River of Souls flows upward to Torghast. The energies there are most potent indeed.

The presence of your golden allies should draw the Jailer's Eye. I only hope this does not prove to be the end of you. I hate to see an investment wasted.
63901.completion: Songs will immortalize the deeds of this day, {NAME}.
63901.objectives: Go to the Terminus Platform and use the Ilskahorn to summon the Wrath of Odyn.

63902.title: Good News, Everyone!
63902.description:
Come, friend. Let us be rid of this foul place.

No doubt your comrades will be eager to hear the news of the defeat of the Eye. I will bear you to them.

Give the word when you are ready to depart, {NAME}.
63902.completion: The Eye defeated? Good news indeed.
63902.objectives: Fly with Danica to Korthia to give Bolvar the news.

63903.title: Storming the Sanctum
63903.description:
The Jailer has seized the sigils of all four covenants. It is clear he means to escape the Maw and steal the Arbiter's sigil from Oribos.

We cannot allow this to happen.

Atop Torghast sits the Sanctum of Domination, the Jailer's seat of power. The time has come to enter this dark domain.

No doubt Sylvanas Windrunner will command the forces that will attempt to thwart us. We must defeat her... and save Anduin Wrynn from her grasp.

Gather your forces, {NAME}. The Ebon Blade will stand with you.
63903.progress: How fares the battle in the Sanctum?
63903.completion:
The Jailer has what he wanted... along with Anduin at his side.

Our only victory--if you can call it that--is that we have Sylvanas in custody.

I pray she possesses knowledge that can give us an edge to stop whatever the Jailer is planning next.
63903.objectives: Defeat Sylvanas Windrunner in the Sanctum of Domination.

63904.title: The Heart of Ardenweald
63904.description:
I hid my sigil in the Heart of the Forest, to keep it safe from the forces of the Maw.

But the horn has called for aid.

You and your allies go, see what has prompted the call.
63904.completion:
Our best efforts were still in vain.

Our enemy's plan edges closer to fruition.
63904.objectives: Investigate the Heart of the Forest.

63908.title: Bulwark of Divine Intent
63908.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex confirms that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this shield in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63908.completion:
This shield is from the afterlife we refer to informally as the Inn of Forever.

When one's spirit reaches the Inn, they hang up their arms. This shield was forever retired as its owner went to join the eternal fireside festivities. It would not quite be correct to say that the shield is imbued with their sense of duty and selflessness... it IS these concepts.

I am curious whether this shield could be used in the field. The results of that testing would be fascinating. Perhaps someday...
63908.objectives: Bring the Bulwark of Divine Intent to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63909.title: Guise of the Changeling
63909.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this mask in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63909.completion:
Now this is quite a find!

The Guise of the Changeling has the power to convincingly modify the appearance of its bearer, but it has a mind of its own. The wearer cannot control the illusion, and the mask is wont to place them into embarrassing or dangerous situations.
63909.objectives: Bring the Guise of the Changeling to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63910.title: The Netherstar
63910.description:
<You recognize this relic from the Archivists' Codex.

The power source is nearly empty. However, it could be restored with exposure to raw, unfiltered anima. Nearby fissures would do the trick.>
63910.completion: When we scholars consider relics that are important to keep secured, the Netherstar is precisely the type of relic that we have in mind. Can you imagine how much damage could be done were this to fall into the hands of an... opportunist?
63910.objectives: Recharge the Netherstar, then bring it to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63911.title: Singing Steel Ingot
63911.description:
<The ingot wails, in a warbling vibrato.>

Woe! These ruffians hammer upon me with nary a care, bending my body to suit their ill aims.

Fie! Fie upon them.

<The ingot emits a high-pitched battle cry.>

Take the hammering to these mawsworn!
63911.completion: In all of my years as a researcher, I never would have expected this.
63911.objectives: Defeat mawsworn invaders, then bring the Singing Steel Ingot to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63912.title: Celestial Shadowlands Chart
63912.description:
<You recognize this relic from the Archivists' Codex.

The mawsworn discarded it, believing it to be useless.

And the chart is useless, without the accompanying data to plot the relative locations of Shadowlands afterlives. If the research were retrieved from deceased scholars, the chart could be returned to the Archivist, fully functional.>
63912.completion:
Aha! You have recovered the Celestial Shadowlands Chart.

With the chart and the data you collected, it can be restored to its fully functional form. It will take some time to analyze and interpret the results, which I can get started on now that the relic has been returned to the Archive.

Allow me a moment to find a good spot for it...
63912.objectives: Collect 6 Afterlife Navigation Research scrolls, then bring them to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63913.title: Unstable Explosive Orb
63913.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this device in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63913.completion: I appreciate you handling this relic carefully. It is nothing short of a miracle that it did not detonate when Korthia was invaded.

63914.title: Cipher of Understanding
63914.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for the cipher in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63914.completion: My stars! To comprehend any of these languages would allow one the insight to translate all of them. We must look into this further.
63914.objectives: Bring the Cipher of Understanding to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63915.title: Drum of the Death Loa
63915.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this drum in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63915.completion: I could hear you approaching with this drum before I saw you. And strangely, I though someone else might be with you.
63915.objectives: Bring the Drum of the Death Loa to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63916.title: Sack of Strange Soil
63916.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this soil in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63916.completion:
This soil can grow any type of plant, anywhere.

Not the most dangerous relic missing from the archive, and yet it could be the most useful. With enough time, one could restore the verdant beauty of Korthia.
63916.objectives: Bring the Sack of Strange Soil to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63917.title: Everliving Statuette
63917.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this statuette in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63917.completion:
I trust you did not listen to anything that this little monster told you.

It is absolutely incapable of uttering the truth.
63917.objectives: Bring the Everliving Statuette to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63918.title: Obelisk of Dark Tidings
63918.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this obelisk in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63918.completion:
We must be cautious around this obelisk.

More than one attendant was driven mad while researching the relic.
63918.objectives: Bring the Obelisk of Dark Tidings to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63919.title: Book of Binding: The Tormented Sorcerer
63919.description:
<You hear a muffled voice speaking from within this book, interspersed with crackling static. Though the utterances are mostly unintelligible, you can make out the repeated request to recover azure pages.

Flipping through the volume, you note that many of its pages are missing.

If the pages were retrieved, the book could be returned to the Archivist and reassembled.>
63919.progress: I find these strange speaking tomes... discomfiting.
63919.completion:
This appears to be a companion tome to the crimson book that was under the care of scholars in the Seeker's Quorum.

Knowing that this book binding was separated from its pages intentionally, I will stitch all but one azure page back into it before returning it to the archive.
63919.objectives: Collect 10 azure pages, then bring them to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63920.title: Enigmatic Decrypting Device
63920.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this device in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63920.completion: Though I have only a passing understanding of its operation, this relic can strip the complexity of communication into a form that is free from subtlety, guile, or metaphor. Pure logic.
63920.objectives: Bring the Enigmatic Decrypting Device to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63921.title: Ring of Self-Reflection
63921.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this ring in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63921.completion: I am curious to learn how this strange ring functions.
63921.objectives: Bring the Ring of Self-Reflection to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63922.title: Shadow Slicing Shortsword
63922.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this shortsword in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63922.completion: Though the blade's shadow severing properties may appear to be no more than a parlor trick, I believe this is one of the most dangerous relics in our care.
63922.objectives: Bring the Shadow Slicing Shortsword to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63923.title: Lang Family Wood-Carving
63923.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this wood-carving in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63923.completion: I believe this relic can teach us something about the history as well as the future.
63923.objectives: Bring the Lang Family Wood-Carving to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63924.title: Gorak Claw Fetish
63924.description:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this fetish in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>
63924.completion: Some mote of Gorak Tul yet lives within this fetish. His corruption is barely contained.
63924.objectives: Bring the Gorak Claw Fetish to Archivist Roh-Suir in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

63935.title: Precious Roots
63935.description:
Korthia. A sister forest, stricken.

But in the throes of destruction, there is still hope. 

Gather the anima, and build anew.
63935.completion: Precious anima that will be shared. A sacrifice, honored.
63935.objectives: Collect 8 Residual Anima from around the Vault in Korthia.

63936.title: Devoured Anima
63936.description:
Sika has idea!

Devourers... devour. They eat anything! So they eat anima, too.

If we take anima from devourers, then that anima is ours!
63936.progress: Sika wonders what anima tastes like.
63936.completion:
Thank you! Wow... you can't tell this was inside devourer!

Sika will get anima to those most in need.
63936.objectives: Reclaim 12 Devoured Anima from devourers in the Estuary of Awakening.

63937.title: Nasty, Big, Pointy Teeth
63937.description:
There's tons of interesting things to kill out here! Bears, birds, mawsworn, and gromits!

Let's start with the gromits shall we? Go slaughter the fierce gromits in the Mauler's Outlook and bring me their FANGS! I can always use more teeth.
63937.progress: I like the long teeth. Razor sharp fangs. The short ones are nice too.
63937.completion: EEEEEE! These are so good! Look how long and sharp they are! I am going to put these where they go right now! Thank you!

63944.title: Korthia Awaits
63944.description: Ready yourself, {NAME}. Our allies await your arrival in Korthia.
63944.completion:
Ah, yes. Your anima is rather familiar.

We were wondering when you would arrive.
63944.objectives: Report to Tal-Galan at Keeper's Respite in Korthia.

63945.title: The Soul Blade
63945.description:
The runeblade of a Necrolord can be a potent weapon in this realm. An abundance of souls are willing to contribute their anima to end their own suffering and bring defeat to the Jailer.

Take one of my runeblades and charge it with the anima of the willing souls you find here.

Once charged, use it lay waste to their forces here.
63945.completion:
<Bonesmith Heirmir takes her runeblade back from you and examines it carefully.>

Not bad, {NAME}. Always room for improvement... but not bad.
63945.objectives: Charge Heirmir's Runeblade with Willing Souls and use it to slay the Eye of Gorgoa.

63947.title: Raiders in the Ruins [PH]
63947.description:
While I abhor violence and prefer a reasoned response to conflict, there's no alternative here.

In order for us to escape safely, we must disrupt the attackers. Deliver a decisive strike to the mawsworn that have invaded Roh-Domum.

Take out their forces.

63948.title: Seeking the Seeker's Staff [PH]
63948.description:
We were researching the properties of an artifact that we dubbed the Sundered Staff.

The staff was split into three segments, as it was far too unstable to handle while assembled.

I do not think the invaders were looking for it, or aware of its properties, but they have found the pieces. Each segment is held by a different member of the mawsworn.

We must recover these pieces, quickly.

It is only a matter of time before they discover they are parts of a more-dangerous whole.
63948.objectives: Recover the three segments of the Sundered Staff.

63950.title: Razorwing Talons
63950.description:
These lands are not well known yet by my hunters, but we have discovered formidable beasts that reside here.

Among these are the Razorwing: vicious predators with terrible talons... and the temper of a vorkai.

<Herne grins fiercely.>

Bring me some of their talons to help teach our newest hunters about the kinds of beasts they will face.
63950.progress: Do you have those Razorwing Talons?
63950.completion:
These talons are in excellent shape. And they look like they could take out an eye! <Herne chuckles ironically.>

I expect they will get a lot of attention from our Wild Hunt recruits.

Thank you, Maw Walker.

63951.title: A Shady Place
63951.description:
Existence is not a simple thing, $p. It is layers upon layers of realities.

The Jailer's traps are pulling our troops into one such rift, hidden from normal sight.

I have obtained an Unbalanced Riftstone. It will give you the ability to enter the rift and destroy the traps keeping our troops trapped inside, before they are lost forever.

After you've destroyed the Rift-Veiled Traps, exit the rift and pull the trapped soldiers back into our reality.
63951.progress: There is much we cannot see.
63951.objectives: Use the Unbalanced Riftstone to enter the rift and break Rift-Veiled Traps to free $1a Riftbound Vorkai.

63952.title: Heavy-Handed Tactics
63952.description:
We need more constructs on the front lines, but we have no bodies, heads, or legs! 

Rathan's making the best constructs possible with what we DO have... a lot of hands.

Don't ask questions!

There are enemies in Calcis that we need dead. Take the hands and kill things!
63952.progress: Rathan is nothing if not resourceful.
63952.completion:
<Margrave Sin'dane looks impressed... or annoyed... or disgusted... or concerned?>

Hm. I suppose with enough hands, anything IS possible...
63952.objectives: Slay 8 Mawsworn Soulbreakers, 4 Crystalline Guardians, Lady Nalis, and Glassmaker.

63954.title: Sealed Secrets
63954.description:
Ah, Korthia. What secrets will be revealed?

My associates have been hard at work, seeking to discover and procure various small items of interest throughout this broken land. Nothing of great importance, I assure you.

They have secured those items in designated drop boxes, and those now await pickup in Seeker's Quorum. Don't worry, they are locked with an impenetrable seal to protect both the contents and the deliverer.

Bring those sealed containers to me, and I will reward you handsomely.
63954.progress: Do you have the sealed containers?
63954.completion:
Wonderful! You brought everything that I asked for.

Again, do not worry about the contents of these boxes. They pose no threat to you.

Here is the reward I promised.
63954.objectives: Retrieve 5 Sealed Containers from the Seeker's Quorum.

63955.title: Sealed Secrets
63955.description:
Ah, Korthia. What secrets will be revealed?

My associates have been hard at work, seeking to discover and procure various small items of interest throughout this broken land. Nothing of great importance, I assure you.

They have secured those items in designated drop boxes, and those now await pickup outside of the Vault. Don't worry, they are locked with an impenetrable seal to protect both the contents and the deliverer.

Bring those sealed containers to me, and I will reward you handsomely.
63955.progress: Do you have the sealed containers?
63955.completion:
Wonderful! You brought everything that I asked for.

Again, do not worry about the contents of these boxes. They pose no threat to you.

Here is the reward I promised.
63955.objectives: Retrieve 5 Sealed Containers from the Vault in Korthia.

63957.title: Observational Records
63957.description:
Greetings, Maw Walker, a moment of your time?

As you no doubt know, my cartel has quietly spread observational devices all across Korthia. But that data is no good to us if it is not retrieved. Which is where you come in.

The Seeker's Quorum records should be ready to collect. You won't see the devices themselves, but the data will appear to you as a bright orb.

Bring those data to me, and I will reward you handsomely.
63957.progress: Have you retrieved the observational records from Seeker's Quorum?
63957.completion:
The name "Seeker's Quorum" has puzzled me greatly since I learned of it. What are they seeking? What constitutes a Quorum? What did they do there?

These mysteries may be beyond us, or they may yet be revealed. And here is your reward, as promised.
63957.objectives: Collect 5 Observational Records from Seeker's Quorum in Korthia.

63958.title: Observational Records
63958.description:
Greetings, Maw Walker, a moment of your time?

As you no doubt know, my cartel has quietly spread observational devices all across Korthia. But that data is no good to us if it is not retrieved. Which is where you come in.

The records from outside the Vault should be ready to collect. You won't see the devices themselves, but the data will appear to you as a bright orb.

Bring that data to me, and I will reward you handsomely.
63958.progress: Have you retrieved the observational records from the Vault?
63958.completion:
The Vault is reason why the Jailer targeted Korthia with his chains. Many secrets of the Shadowlands are archived there.

If we can just get a glimpse of how it works and what it holds, that information would be most valuable indeed.

And here is your reward, as promised.
63958.objectives: Collect 5 Observational Records from outside the Vault in Korthia.

63959.title: Observational Records
63959.description:
Greetings, Maw Walker, a moment of your time?

As you no doubt know, my cartel has quietly spread observational devices all across Korthia. But that data is no good to us if it is not retrieved. Which is where you come in.

The Sanctuary of Guidance records should be ready to collect. You won't see the devices themselves, but the data will appear to you as a bright orb.

Bring those data to me, and I will reward you handsomely.
63959.progress: Have you retrieved the observational records from the Sanctuary of Guidance?
63959.completion:
The devourers have destroyed much of what might have been useful at the Sanctuary of Guidance. But this information will still prove valuable.

And here is your reward, as promised.
63959.objectives: Collect 5 Observational Records from the Sanctuary of Guidance in Korthia.

63960.title: Observational Records
63960.description:
Greetings, Maw Walker, a moment of your time?

As you no doubt know, my cartel has quietly spread observational devices all across Korthia. But that data is no good to us if it is not retrieved. Which is where you come in.

The records from the Windswept Aerie and Estuary of Awakening should be ready to collect. You won't see the devices themselves, but the data will appear to you as a bright orb.

And don't forget to look below ground!

Bring those data to me, and I will reward you handsomely.
63960.progress: Have you retrieved the observational records from the Windswept Aerie and Estuary of Awakening?
63960.completion:
Places like the Aerie and Estuary must have been desolate even before all the destruction. What interesting creatures congregate there.

Will they all survive these changes? Will some adapt, and become even more fearsome?

Here is your reward, as promised.
63960.objectives: Collect 5 Observational Records from the Windswept Aerie and Estuary of Awakening in Korthia.

63961.title: Sealed Secrets
63961.description:
Ah, Korthia. What secrets will be revealed?

My associates have been hard at work, seeking to discover and procure various small items of interest throughout this broken land. Nothing of great importance, I assure you.

They have secured those items in designated drop boxes, and those now await pickup in Mauler's Outlook. Don't worry, they are locked with an impenetrable seal to protect both the contents and the deliverer.

Bring those sealed containers to me, and I will reward you handsomely.
63961.progress: Do you have the sealed containers?
63961.completion:
Wonderful! You brought everything that I asked for.

Again, do not worry about the contents of these boxes. They pose no threat to you.

Here is the reward I promised.
63961.objectives: Retrieve 5 Sealed Containers from Mauler's Outlook in Korthia.

63962.title: Observational Records
63962.description:
Greetings, Maw Walker, a moment of your time?

As you no doubt know, my cartel has quietly spread observational devices all across Korthia. But that data is no good to us if it is not retrieved. Which is where you come in.

The records at Mauler's Outlook should be ready to collect. You won't see the devices themselves, but the data will appear to you as a bright orb.

Bring those data to me, and I will reward you handsomely.
63962.progress: Have you retrieved the observational records from Mauler's Outlook?
63962.completion:
Excellent, this data will serve us well. We can begin to answer some of our questions about Korthia, and the Mauler's Outlook. Was it always home to such terrible creatures, or did was it something more?

And here is your reward, as promised
63962.objectives: Collect 5 Observational Records from Mauler's Outlook in Korthia.

63963.title: Broker's Bounty: Ripmaul
63963.description:
New lands bring new opportunity. To any interested party, we will provide a quantity of valuables in return for a piece of heavily spiked hide from the beast known as Ripmaul.

Faint-hearted collectors need not bother.

Please bring this sample to Ta'nasi in Keeper's Respite.
63963.completion:
<Ta'nasi tugs at the spiked hide to test its strength.>

An excellent specimen. This will do nicely.

And as promised, here is your reward in trade.
63963.objectives: Retrieve a Heavy Spiked Hide from Ripmaul.

63964.title: Broker's Bounty: Grimtalon
63964.description:
New lands bring new opportunity. To any interested party, we will provide a quantity of valuables in return for an intact boney beak from the beast known as Grimtalon.

Faint-hearted collectors need not bother.

Please bring this sample to Ta'nasi in Keeper's Respite.
63964.completion:
<Ta'nasi knocks the sturdy beak against her palm, listening to the sound.>

An excellent specimen. This will do nicely.

And as promised, here is your reward in trade.
63964.objectives: Retrieve a Mature Ossified Beak from Grimtalon.

63965.title: Razorwing Egg Rescue
63965.description:
I'm amazed by the wildlife here in Korthia! So many interesting creatures...

Say, you know those flying beasts with the claws, the Razorwing? They sometimes knock their eggs out of their nests, and then they completely ignore them! If you find any abandoned eggs, could you bring them to me?

Gently, of course. I wonder if they can be raised to be friendly?

If not, well, it wouldn't be the first time I've had my antennae chewed on.
63965.completion:
Look at these wonderful eggs! I can hear their heartbeats.

This is the start of something beautiful, I just know it.

63968.title: Clean Out the Crucible
63968.description:
The Winter Queen has called a hunt. We will ensure that the Crucible of the Damned is rid of the Jailer's forces today.

Do your part and hunt down any enemies you find.
63968.completion: The hunt is not yet complete, but you have earned your place in the records of its victory.
63968.objectives: Kill 30 enemies in the Crucible of the Damned and Calcis.

63969.title: Looming Darkness
63969.description:
The Winter Queen called for a hunt in this location due to reports of a massive, unnatural darkness swelling in its upper regions.

The Wild Hunt is brave, but not foolish. We must learn what we can about this darkness before we charge into it.

Search the bodies of our enemies nearby for clues.
63969.progress: Have you learned anything regarding the darkness yet?
63969.completion: We will discover the source of this darkness, and end it.
63969.objectives: Collect 1 Mawsworn Ritual Book, 10 Mawsworn Missive Scraps, and 15 Dark Marrow.

63970.title: No Soul Left Behind
63970.description:
Do you hear the cries of tormented souls trapped in Gorgoa?

The twisted river of souls flows before us, swelling with cruelty and the torment of undeserving victims.

Our brave regiment of druid spirits led the charge into the river to seek out those lost souls, but I fear many have instead joined in their suffering.

Summon your courage and take my cradle with you into the river. Load the lost souls you find onto the cradle, then order the cradle to come back to me.
63970.progress: I admire Thiernax's dedication to even the least among us.
63970.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. We must not forget to help one another as we stride deeper into the darkness.
63970.objectives: Use Thiernax's Rescue Cradle to rescue 12 Lost Druids in Gorgoa and send them back to Thiernax.

63971.title: Snail Stomping
63971.description:
Careful where you step. You wouldn't want to accidentally squish a Mawsworn, would you?

Of course you would! It's so fun!

<Lady Moonberry giggles and points at the snails around her.>

It's so much easier to squish Mawsworn after you've transformed them into stinky little snails.

Here, take my wand and try it out on whatever you like.

You may need to weaken them a bit first, but it'll work on almost anything!
63971.progress: Lady Moonberry never ceases to surprise me.
63971.completion:
<Lord Herne grins.> My record was squishing four in a single jump.

One of the many benefits of being a quadruped.

63972.title: Just Don't Ask Me to Spell It
63972.description:
It's getting dangerous out there for druid spirits!

Thankfully, we always have room for another friend in our group, and this fine tirnenn has offered to help me and the gang get around the battlefield safely.

<The tirnenn behind Choofa begins speaking slowly, but Choofa just talks louder.>

Good ol' Kirriprkar- I mean, Karripkraker- I mean, Krackerkrisp...

<Choofa laughs.>

Let's just call her "Big K"!

Hop on, everybody!
63972.progress: Krrprripripkraak and Choofa are teaming up? This, I must see.
63972.completion: I have received many reports from hunters who were aided by Krrprripripkraak and her friends. Thank you for helping them.
63972.objectives: Help Krrprripripkraak and her friends sow chaos in the Crucible of the Damned.

63973.title: Double Dromans
63973.description:
Relax, $p. Breathe.

<Dreamweaver inhales and exhales slowly.>

Things are getting tense around here, but that doesn't mean YOU need to be tense.

Everything is going to be okay. If you don't believe me, let the mighty deeds of Droman Aliothe and Droman Tashmur reassure you.

They headed up the hill together to clear a path for the rest of us. They'll have everything taken care of in no time.
63973.progress: You can find the droman up the hill from here.
63973.completion: No matter how strong we become, we are stronger when we hunt together.
63973.objectives: Help Droman Aliothe defeat enemies along her path and kill Lord Dretnal.

63974.title: That's Going to Sting
63974.description:
<Niya speaks loudly to be heard over the buzzing coming from the collection of needler nests behind her.>

I've caught Moonberry trying to steal these nests for her pranks over ten times already!

The other faeries said I was crazy to bring the needlers out here. Too wild! Too unpredictable!

But that's exactly why we need them.

Lord Herne's scouts report powerful Heralds among our enemy's forces.

Take one of these nests, and use it to surprise the Heralds!
63974.progress: Niya is proving to be quite the clever tactician...
63974.completion:
I wish I could've been there to see it myself!

A fitting end for the Heralds...
63974.objectives: Use an Angry Needler Nest to weaken and kill Herald Gkeca, Herald Throgtu, and Herald Duarri.

63976.title: The Al'ley Cat of Oribos
63976.description:
Ah, Maw Walker. I have a message.

An individual has a proposition for you, specifically. I know nothing of the details, only that they asked you meet them towards the back of the Idyllia.
63976.completion: It is a pleasure to meet you.
63976.objectives: Meet with the mysterious contact in Oribos.

63977.title: Insider Trading
63977.description:
I am the foremost expert on broker culture. However, relationships between cartels are complicated and unstable.

Cartel So holds a small presence here in Oribos, which means the other cartels may have knowledge that I do not. Ask around--with your renown, surely they'll have whatever information that we are missing.
63977.progress: Have you had a chance to speak with the other cartels?
63977.completion:
How rude! They should be aware of who they are talking to.

I apologize for my kin, Maw Walker.
63977.objectives: Speak with various broker cartels around Oribos.

63979.title: Things Best Kept Dark
63979.description:
The leader of Cartel So represents a grave danger to the Shadowlands, Maw Walker.

Her name is So'leah. She seeks to assemble an artifact of the First Ones and use its power for selfish ends.

Pieces of the relic are said to be hidden on your homeworld. Brokers have never before found our way there. But if So'leah does, then Azeroth too is imperiled.

We must intercept her.

There is cargo nearby marked for Cartel So. Perhaps the manifest will give us clues as to their leader's whereabouts.
63979.completion:
Tazavesh, the Veiled Market...

An interesting choice of locations.
63979.objectives: Find a shipping manifest belonging to Cartel So.

63980.title: Seeking Smugglers
63980.description:
We brokers have found that it is in our best interests to remain mobile. And discreet.

A number of our cities and outposts are tucked away in the In-Between, capable of moving from place to place.

Much to my chagrin, it seems I have lost track of Tazavesh.

I believe our best course of action is to ask Cartel Ta for access. They pride themselves on keeping track of such things.

Let's try our luck with those at the Night Market in Revendreth. They may be more forthcoming than their Oribos kin.
63980.completion:
You seek information?

That requires a transaction.
63980.objectives: Speak with Ta'nla the Identifier at the Night Market.

63982.title: Above My Station
63982.description:
While I indeed know the location of the Veiled Market, I fear I can do little in terms of providing you with transportation to it.

In return for your assistance with a task, I can send you to someone who can assist us both. There is a bounty hunter at Transfer Station Ta--a broker enclave in Bastion. He is better suited to help you... and he owes me a shipment.

Meet with Ta'oku and tell him that Ta'nla sent you.

For your convenience, I can offer use of a portal. After all, we are partners, yes?
63982.objectives: Take the portal at the Night Market and speak with Ta'oku.

63983.title: Dead Drop
63983.description:
Ta'nla requested something very... specific... on behalf of a client.

The kyrian have been working on a new type of centurion they call an aquilon. I sent some of our trade specialists to retrieve the prototype in question, but they have yet to return. 

Until I have the item, there is obviously no way I can ship it to Ta'nla. Perhaps we can help one another.

If you can locate the aquilon and bring it here, I will help you reach Tazavesh.
63983.completion: Perfect! This will put us back on schedule.

63984.title: Coins for the Ferryman
63984.description:
Your side of the deal is done, Maw Walker. Now for your payment.

My cartel runs a ferry that travels between Oribos and Tazavesh. Its purpose is to transport cargo, but as in all things, there are... exceptions.

Take this coin to Ta'meri and you will be provided safe passage to the market.

What happens after that is up to you.

<Ta'oku bows, uttering a sound that seems almost like a chuckle.>
63984.completion: Maw Walker! What can humble Ta'meri do for you?

63985.title: The Veiled Market
63985.description:
Let me guess... Ta'oku sent you my way, yes? 

<Ta'meri looks at the coin you offer.>

So, you seek travel to Tazavesh. Not something we'd typically offer an outsider, but since payment has been accounted for, it would be my pleasure to assist you.

Step aboard, and do remember to keep any appendages inside the craft at all times. The currents of the In-Between can be fickle.
63985.completion: No worries! I have another plan.

63986.title: Tazavesh: Raiders of the Lost Artifact
63986.description:
It looks like you may need to show a bit of force once more, my dear friend. Tazavesh security will not let us simply walk in.

But So'leah needs to be stopped. If that requires a bit of physical... persuasion... then it is a necessary evil. 

Bring some friends. I have a feeling the security here has tricks up their sleeves.

63989.title: Oozing with Character
63989.description:
Apprentice! I've been looking for you.

Kevin has been such a wonderful helper in our experiments, I'd like to train my other oozes to be able to assist as well!

Can you take Plaguey with you and test their ability to infect organic life forms?
63989.completion: How did Plaguey do? Is he as viral as we'd hoped?
63989.objectives: Help Plaguey test their infection ability in the Mauler's Outlook.

63990.title: The Blade in the Night
63990.description:
Though my hunt has been arduous, I have two promising leads on additional Night Warriors. The first is here in Maldraxxus.

This tower contains records of those who arrived in Maldraxxus, including someone referred to as "The Blade in the Night." I believe this to be our next Night Warrior.

I encountered many traps on the way here. Doubtless we will find more within the tower. Someone is trying to stop us.

We will not let them succeed.
63990.completion: I am not opposed to helping you, but... There are matters I must attend to first.
63990.objectives: Search the Sepulcher of Knowledge for clues.

63994.title: Who is the Maw Walker?
63994.description:
Korthian prophecies foretell the arrival of a Maw Walker who can save us from disaster. 

Perhaps this is that day. But perhaps not. I must test your anima to verify your claim.

If you speak the truth, then I have a solemn duty to empower your anima before we proceed.
63994.completion: Maw Walker. We must summon the others.
63994.objectives: Participate in Tal-Galan's Maw Walker trial.

64007.title: Charge of the Covenants
64007.description:
Thanks to the efforts of you and other heroes of Azeroth, the covenants have grown strong. But we can no longer afford to wait for the Jailer to make his next move.

The way to the Maw is open. Our forces stand ready.

The covenants await your signal, {NAME}.
64007.completion:
The Maw...

Now our true work begins.
64007.objectives: Rally the covenant forces to go into the Maw.

64014.title: Mawsplaining
64014.description:
There remains one task now before the glorious battle can begin. The horn must be anchored to the Maw so that its voice may pierce the barrier that surrounds that foul realm. 

How this can be done, I do not know. Seek out one that understands the mysteries of that place. Surely they can guide your hand.

Danica and her sisters will listen for Ilskahorn's call. They will answer when you need them, {NAME}.
64014.progress: Have you bound the horn to the Maw?
64014.completion:
That's quite an instrument you have there.
