It seems the golden feathers were worth following, Maw Walker. You owe me yet again.
64014.objectives: Ask Ve'nari's help to bind the Ilskahorn to the Maw.

64015.title: Into the Meat Grinder
64015.description:
All these mawsworn have got me excited for some slaughter!

I've got a plan that probably won't end in you dying.

Are you in?
64015.completion:
Bwahahaha!

So much slaughter, so many parts! You've been a real strong arm today, {NAME}.
64015.objectives: Lay a trap for the Mawsworn.

64017.title: Oozing with Character
64017.description:
Apprentice! I've been looking for you.

Kevin has been such a wonderful helper in our experiments, I'd like to train my other oozes to be able to assist as well!

For Bloop, I'd like to know if their ooze is capable of propagation. Take them with you, and find those bears. Give them the command to inject the life form with their ooze and see what happens.
64017.completion: How did the tests go? OH! Look at all of them! They're so cute!
64017.objectives: Help Bloop test their propagation ability in the Mauler's Outlook.

64040.title: Once More, with Healing
64040.description:
The mawsworn continue to engage our forces at the Vault. There are heavy casualties on both sides. We must help!

Take this and restore any wounded covenant allies you find. Mikanikos helped me create it. It runs on anima and should help patch up anyone. Even the Stoneborn or Maldraxxi.
64040.progress: I wish we could do more. But we're stretched so thin.
64040.completion: How wonderful! I am relieved to know our allies are no longer wounded.

64042.title: Rituals of Night
64042.description:
Tyrande's time grows short, so we must act quickly. 

<Ysera frowns in concern.>

We had hoped to gather more Night Warriors, but we will have to proceed with who we have and hope it is enough.

<Ysera shakes her head, then looks more resolute.>

Before we can begin, we must finish preparations for the ritual. Please bring these last few items with you and meet us at the grove.
64042.completion: With everything in place we can begin. I only hope we are not too late for Tyrande.
64042.objectives: Assist with the preparations and ritual.

64065.title: Local Reagents
64065.description:
Korthia is an odd place. The wildlife here is different, likely due to years of exposure to the Vault and everything it contains.

Are you ready to try some experiments? We'll need a good stock of reagents first.

Near the Seeker's Quorum, you should be able to find shardhides, gromits, and razorwings. Watch out for their needles!
64065.progress: Feel like taste testing my newest experiment? It probably won't kill you.
64065.completion: This needle is so long and perfect! Well done apprentice. I can't wait to get started on our new tests!
64065.objectives: Collect 8 Shardhide Talons, 6 Gromit Feet, and 1 Razorwing Spines for Plague Deviser Marileth in Korthia.

64070.title: Staying Scrappy
64070.description:
Our army always need more weapons, armor, and troops. Always.

We're getting reinforcements, but I can't keep everyone properly armed at this rate. Especially without a full forge and assistants.

We'll have to make do with the next best thing. I need you to go get me any kind of scrap metal from the Mawsworn you can find. I'll figure out how to turn it into usable weapons.
64070.progress: One day, I'll fight a campaign where we are properly supplied and equipped. It'll be the easiest war I'll ever fight.
64070.completion: Well, it's not the finest materials, but it will do.

64080.title: Down to Earth
64080.description:
I can hear the wings of the Mawsworn in the sky up above, taunting us. 

But a bird in the hand can be crushed. 

Take my spear and prove your aim. Pull a few down and smite them. 

Be sure to use the spear. Do not traipse among them so that they will chase you back down to the ground. That's not the point.

I want to see you drag them out of the sky.
64080.completion:
It is so satisfying to see those flying Mawsworn get their wings clipped.

Well done, my friend.
64080.objectives: Use Korayn's Javelin to spear 4 Mawsworn Harbingers.

64083.title: Sinfall Tactician
64083.description:
Sinfall is gaining more respect than Denathrius could have ever hoped to earn! It is all thanks to your efforts, {NAME}.

Zo'sorg has once again requested your presence in Oribos. Go at once.

The favor of Cartel Zo is not something we want to squander. A broker clan's trust is not one effortlessly gained.

Perhaps they have more rewards to bestow upon you.
64083.completion:
I see your skills in combat have improved even further. I trust you have made good use of our previous offer? 

Zo'dash is now instructed to offer the full suite of his services to you. I look forward to seeing their impact on your performance.
64083.objectives: Meet with Zo'sorg in the Enclave in Oribos.

64084.title: Necrolord Tactician
64084.description:
You have brought great honor to the Necrolords. Such honor attracts the attention of others yet again.

Zo'sorg has once again requested your presence in Oribos. Go at once.

The favor of Cartel Zo is not something we want to squander. A broker clan's trust is not one effortlessly gained.

Perhaps they have more rewards to bestow upon you.
64084.completion:
I see your skills in combat have improved even further. I trust you have made good use of our previous offer? 

Zo'dash is now instructed to offer the full suite of his services to you. I look forward to seeing their impact on your performance.
64084.objectives: Meet with Zo'sorg in the Enclave in Oribos.

64085.title: Night Fae Tactician
64085.description:
Your bravery has allowed Ardenweald to grow once again. It has also once again drawn the attention of brokers.

Zo'sorg has once again requested your presence in Oribos. Go at once.

The favor of Cartel Zo is not something we want to squander. A broker clan's trust is not one effortlessly gained.

Perhaps they have more rewards to bestow upon you.
64085.completion:
I see your skills in combat have improved even further. I trust you have made good use of our previous offer? 

Zo'dash is now instructed to offer the full suite of his services to you. I look forward to seeing their impact on your performance.
64085.objectives: Meet with Zo'sorg in the Enclave in Oribos.

64086.title: Kyrian Tactician
64086.description:
Look around you, {NAME}. Elysian Hold stands as a testament to the progress we have made thanks to you.

Zo'sorg has once again requested your presence in Oribos. Go at once.

The favor of Cartel Zo is not something we want to squander. A broker clan's trust is not one effortlessly gained.

Perhaps they have more rewards to bestow upon you.
64086.completion:
I see your skills in combat have improved even further. I trust you have made good use of our previous offer? 

Zo'dash is now instructed to offer the full suite of his services to you. I look forward to seeing their impact on your performance.
64086.objectives: Meet with Zo'sorg in the Enclave in Oribos.

64089.title: Teas and Tinctures
64089.description:
How delightful! What a lovely little spot of nature.

Have you tried the local brews? Perhaps a nice herbal tea? No? Well, let's try it together! Search about this place and bring back any herbs that look... interesting.

A good spot of tea, and then we shall get to work. I'll wait here.
64089.progress: Tubbins! Grubbins! What are the two of you up to? Not bothering the Night Fae again are you?
64089.completion: Oh my! I've never even seen most of these herbs. Hum, this black one looks a bit dangerous. This green one seems promising. Well done {NAME}!

64090.title: The Big Squeeze
64090.description:
So our missin' blue got 'imself dragged off to the big squeeze. Fortunately I am wise to the prise.

We'll soft foot it in like we work there, find your moose, avoid eye contact with the fangs, and chisel out of 'ere like we're masons. Follow?
64090.completion: It sounds like Huln might not have much time left!
64090.objectives: Head to where Cudgelface thinks Huln was taken, and blend in.

64091.title: Mal'appropriated
64091.description:
<The dreadlord catches your eye, wishing to speak. You glance at your companions. Moonberry urges you forward with a mischievous grin. You step as close as you dare.>

Free me from this prison, mortal, and you will have my favor. I am aligned with powers greater than these pathetic puppets or their masters. They have no concept of the true forces at work. 

All I need are the sigils of binding which hold me. The rest I can... take care of.

Free me, and you will be granted untold power.
64091.completion: If he got nicked, I know where they took 'im.

64092.title: Hunting Huln
64092.description:
Huln is somewhere in the area, but the Stonewright isn't letting anyone in to her territory because of the recent, ah, troubles with Dreadlords. The guards won't let anyone in, and they're kicking out anyone who doesn't look like they belong.

Luckily for Huln, Cudgelface and I came up with a foolproof plan!

We just need to look like we belong and then we can ask around and find Huln. Easy!
64092.completion: I'm busy with this piece of dreadlord filth. Find something useful to do before the Stonewright gets angry. You don't want to see her angry.
64092.objectives: Don a disguise then search Dominance Keep for Huln Highmountain while avoiding the guards.

64101.title: The Proper Procedures
64101.description:
I came here to observe the actions of those from Revendreth. However I have been met with news that concerns me.

$p, the attendants tell me that they stored anima in canisters and that anima is being looted, by our own people. That's not how this should be done.

Can I entrust you to retrieve the anima, so I might see it returned to its proper place?
64101.completion: There's so much anima here. This will be very useful in helping the attendants rebuild. Thank you.

64103.title: Old Tricks Work Best
64103.description:
$p. Here we are again, fighting alongside each other to protect the Shadowlands.

We're waging a losing war, but we might be able to turn the tide. I need you to seek out some very specific commanders of the Mawsworn forces. In every army, there's good commanders and bad ones. By taking out the good ones, only the bad ones advance, weakening the force as a whole.

Our Eyes have brought us the names. Now I just need you to kill them.
64103.completion: A power vacuum can cause more damage to an army than any bomb or battle.
64103.objectives: Kill Moros, Oizys, and Apate, commanders of the Mawsworn.

64104.title: Think of the Critters
64104.description:
The wildlife of Korthia have been through so much. Some of them can't seem to find enough to eat.

I've saved some extra food that we can share with them. 

But I'm worried that they might be too shy to trust us, and I don't blame them! 

Here. Take these treats and see if you can get close enough to them to feed them properly. Even small creatures are so important.
64104.completion:
You were able to feed some of them? Wonderful!

I'll start saving up more food for next time. I hope that one day we can help this place heal, too.
64104.objectives: Approach and feed Hungry Gromits in Korthia.

64106.title: A Unified Effort
64106.description:
You have made strong allies within your covenant as well as the others within the Shadowlands. This bond is why they have decided to loan aid to our cause.

They are ready to fight alongside us as we begin our advance into the Maw.

Each covenant will strike at the Jailer from a different area. Help them scour this treacherous land for any who serve Zovaal so that we may put an end to his growing influence.
64106.completion: Do not relent, {NAME}. This is only the first of many battles to come.
64106.objectives: Aid the covenants in assaulting the Jailer's forces in the Maw.

64129.title: Charge of the Wild Hunt
64129.description:
Ever since I joined the Wild Hunt I've learned so much about how to fight and how to defend the realms. 

I admit I'm still learning. But I am so glad to be learning alongside you, and my runestag friend, Aldermeigh.

Aldermeigh is being trained to charge into battle with the bravery of a vorkai, but he needs practice. Will you take him out for a ride, and mow down all the Mawsworn you can?
64129.completion:
You and Aldermeigh make a great team! Thank you for taking him out and dispatching so many Mawsworn.

One day, I too will ride with the Wild Hunt, and we will right many wrongs.
64129.objectives: Mount Aldermeigh and slay Mawsworn in Korthia.

64159.title: Repatriate Rare Supplies
64159.description:
The rebels have stolen supplies from surrounding camps.

You have proven yourself adept at correcting such situations. I trust you can aid us in resolving this situation.

64162.title: Ritual Rival
64162.description:
Yet another rival Kahn has risen out of the rebel tribes.

I'd take care of then myself, but I'm busy overseeing things here. 

I trust you can teach them the error of their ways?

64163.title: Revenge Against Renegades
64163.description:
Rebel clans have laid claims to some of our camps across the river.

Such rebellious rabble need dealing with.

I trust that you are capable of teaching these rebels a lesson on my behalf?

The camps are an untidy mess as well, so just ignore the chaos for now. We can resolve that later once order is restored.

64166.title: Random Memory Access
64166.description:
When the Jailer snared Korthia and dragged it toward the Maw, he destroyed so much in this place. Not only mountains and buildings, but the people, too.

Those people had lives, hopes, memories.

I have to think that they can't all be gone, and we might be able to save something of them that lingers.

Here, take some of my power. See if you can collect those memories. Bring them to me, and I'll keep them safe. 

No one should be forgotten.
64166.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. I'll make sure these memories are taken care of. 

I wonder what it would have been like, being here as one of them...
64166.objectives: Collect Korthian Memories using the Ephemeral Wings.

64167.title: Pets Detective
64167.description:
I'm so glad you're here, {NAME}!

I've been expecting a delivery of pet supplies and some new pets.  But my distribution manager, Zantini has not reported in. I suspect foul play.

There's been some shady people eyeballing my store for a while now. But I haven't been able to leave the store and track them down. You can.

Take my pet cat, Fiona, and find these well hidden spies.
64167.completion: So there is a group of violet, pet fanatics in the Eye of Azshara?
64167.objectives: Investigate the city of Dalaran with Breanni's special spy catching cat, Fiona.

64196.title: Pet Up
64196.description:
It sounds like some group of pet poachers are up to no good in the Eye of Azshara. My supply manager's flight path takes him right over that area!

Zantini and his pets, Strigfellow and Speedy IV, were bringing back a rare murloc pet, along with some other pets and supplies.

{NAME}, please find Zantini and his pets. Help them out. Then we can try to recover the pets and the supplies.
64196.completion: Thanks for the rescue, pal. Stringfellowe, Speedy IV and me appreciate it.
64196.objectives: Find and help Zantini and his pets along the coast of the Eye of Azshara.

64202.title: Gotta Hand It To Ya
64202.description:
Your power Maw Walker... it rivals even mine before Zovaal separated my body.

This is but a small part of my whole, but more than enough...

Allow me to aid you in your efforts against Zovaal.  In doing so my vengeance will be fulfilled.
64202.completion:
<The five rings glow and morph their power coalescing into a small ring that would perfectly fit your finger.>

<Nilganihmaht's voice booms in your head> 

Let us embark from this place and bring down Zovaal together.

64203.title: The Coast is Clear
64203.description:
I was on the last leg of a supply run when we were shot down! They took the pets, but the supplies are scattered over this stretch of beach.

I don't know what they're planning, but I know we gotta get our supplies. You an' me, we ain't subtle.... But Speedy IV... He won't cause all them pirates to go into hiding. He can get the supplies while Stringfellowe surveils the area from the air.

Speedy's fond of you, so chat him up and let's try to recover the smoldering supplies before they all burn up.
64203.completion: We got our pet supplies back. Now we gotta get our pets.
64203.objectives: Gather pet supplies along the shores of Eye of Azshara with Speedy IV.

64210.title: The Box of Many Things
64210.description:
Ah, Maw Walker, of course. Soon I shall be undone, claimed by this place forever. But you continue to walk its halls, unbroken!

It was my great aspiration to prevail with the help of this box. Sadly, I overestimated my own capabilities.

I trust I am not overestimating yours. Take the box. Prove yourself worthy of it.
64210.completion: Ah... a curious device. Anchoring it in this place will prove useful.
64210.objectives: Bring the Box of Many Things to the Runecarver.

64211.title: Doorway in the Dark
64211.description:
I fear our efforts to stop Zovaal have been thwarted, mortal.

A doorway has been opened to a forbidden realm... and the Banished One has reclaimed a power taken from him long ago.

I sense your allies returning from the Sanctum of Domination. I must know every detail of what transpired.
64211.completion:
<Jaina appears sad, but resolute.>

We still have hope.
64211.objectives: Speak to Jaina and witness the end of the battle in Torghast.

64212.title: Doorway in the Dark
64212.description:
I fear our efforts to stop Zovaal have been thwarted, mortal.

A doorway has been opened to a forbidden realm... and the Banished One has reclaimed a power taken from him long ago.

I sense your allies returning from the Sanctum of Domination. I must know every detail of what transpired.
64212.completion:
<Thrall's brow is furrowed.>

We can't let the Jailer win.
64212.objectives: Speak to Thrall and witness the end of the battle in Torghast.

64213.title: A Symbol of Hope
64213.description:
Before Anduin followed the Jailer through the gateway, he dropped something.

I don't think this was part of the Jailer's plan. It must be a sign that Anduin's soul is still his own!

<Jaina opens her hand to show you a golden compass.>

This was very personal to Anduin. I feel his presence upon it.

We need to know why he left it for us.
64213.progress: If Anduin was able to leave this for us to find, then some part of him must still be free from the Jailer's domination...
64213.completion:
<Tears fall from Jaina's eyes.>

We cannot lose him, {NAME}. No matter what it takes.
64213.objectives: Assist Jaina in examining Anduin's compass.

64214.title: A Symbol of Hope
64214.description:
Before Anduin followed the Jailer through the gateway, he dropped something.

I'm not sure what it was, but Jaina picked it up. Perhaps this is a sign that Anduin is still fighting back against the Jailer!

We need to find out what this object was, and why the young king left it for us.
64214.progress: Why did Anduin leave this for us to find?
64214.completion:
Anduin Wrynn does not deserve such a fate.

We must fight to save him, {NAME}!

64215.title: Paw Patrol
64215.description:
While Speedy IV was collecting supplies, Stringfellowe was scouting the rest of the Eye of Azshara.

Turns out there is a whole mess of pirates to the west.  That must be where the pets are at.

Head over there and rescue the pets.
64215.completion:
Nice work freeing the pets, {NAME}. 

But still no sign of Gurgl.
64215.objectives: Obtain keys from the Violetsail pirates along the west coast of the Eye of Azshara. Then set the captured pets free.

64216.title: Tower Knowledge
64216.description:
The woven power of this box can only be unlocked by feeding it pride and memory. In its weave are incantations I have seen used in the other realms to siphon or condition a soul. This... abomination... has used these tools of redemption and honor to create a lock.

As you challenge the floors of Torghast, your skill, speed, and efficiency will all contribute to Tower Knowledge which this box can feed upon. 

Feed it to retrieve the powers within.
64216.progress: <The Box of Many Things thrums with power.>
64216.completion: <The box hungers, reaching into your memories of Torghast for past deeds to feed upon.>
64216.objectives: Place the Box of Many Things in Torghast.

64218.title: Danger Near and Far
64218.description:
We have done all we can about the Jailer for now, my friend. 

Other matters require our attention. Like the devourer rifts I recently saw opening to the east! 

If we do not stop them, those beasts will wreak havoc on this place.

Will you help me take care of them, {NAME}?

64219.title: A Mysterious Voice
64219.description:
So much destruction. The devourers are insatiable. 

I hope the creature we heard is not badly hurt.

This door is not going to open normally. Perhaps we can force our way through together!

Whatever is on the other side needs our help.
64219.progress: We must help whoever is trapped inside!
64219.completion: We were too late... but we must not give up hope.

64223.title: Core of the Matter
64223.description:
She has fallen, but appears to still be alive. There must be something we can do to help her.

Let us see if the Enlightened know anything. I will find some way to transport her and meet you back in Haven.
64223.progress: Let us hope we are not too late.
64223.objectives: Speak with Elder Kreth in Haven.

64224.title: Seeking the Unknown
64224.description:
If the Elders will not assist us, we must find someone who will. 

That other Enlightened, Firim... he was much more interested in the automa. 

He said he was estranged from his kin. Someone in Haven must know something about him. 

Look around the camp for clues about Firim's whereabouts. I will try again to convince the Elders to talk.
64224.completion:
The elders refuse to say anything about Firim.

I hope you were able to learn something.
64224.objectives: Search Haven for information about Firim.

64225.title: Finding Firim
64225.description:
You found something? What luck! May I see the letter?

So, an Enlightened named Xevveth heard that Firim was last seen west of the Forge of the Afterlives, and went to go seek him out. 

We should begin our search there.
64225.completion: Those assassins are after more than just my life. They wish to steal my research! I cannot let them have it.

64226.title: Security Measures
64226.description:
It seems the hidden traps I placed around the grotto are not as effective as I would like, considering your presence in my home. 

However, they are still useful in preventing the majority of unwanted attention. 

Since you so kindly brought assassins to me, I cannot reset the traps myself. 

So you will need to do it for me. I will stay here to guard both myself and my precious research. Use this Sensory Synchronizer I placed nearby to show you which traps need to be reset.
64226.completion: Good. That should shield us from notice for a while.
64226.objectives: Use the Sensory Synchronizer, then reset 10 Triggered Traps near Exile's Hollow.

64227.title: Unseen Agents
64227.description:
Ever since you opened the way from Oribos, certain cartels have taken the opportunity to come after me and my work in a rather... lethal fashion. They know how important my research is to everything. 

More assassins are sure to follow, what with you blazing a clear path right to me! 

I cannot get them all. You need to fix this and help protect my secrets. 

Take care of them for me.
64227.completion: I suppose you have proven to be useful. Thank you.

64228.title: Now You May Speak
64228.description:
You truly brought me an oracle! Intact even!

I have never known these divine beings to speak to anyone but automa. There is so much we could learn from her about Zereth Mortis.

You must tell me everything!
64228.objectives: Talk to Firim about the oracle.

64230.title: Cyphers of the First Ones
64230.description:
The way is not quite clear, but the first steps have been made.

It seems the divine construct has taken more of a liking to you than to me. 

Now that it has given you the beginnings of understanding, see what else it wishes to show you.

The results should be enlightening.
64230.completion:
Can't you feel the knowledge you've gained coursing through you?!

To think it is you who will unlock the secrets of Zereth Mortis...

I will be watching you very closely.

64235.title: [DNT] Training Kill Quest
64235.description: Help! all these bunnies are eating my flesh! Please, kill them before they kill us all!
64235.objectives: Kill 5 Bunny of Doom in Training Plaza.

64237.title: Gurgl and the Bandit
64237.description:
We've got all the pets back except Gurgl. {NAME}, we need to get that pet back for Breanni.

Stringfellowe saw a nook where we think the leader of these pet poachers is hiding out. 

Let's get 'em!
64237.completion:
You're back, {NAME}! And you've brought back our supplies, pets and Gurgl!!

Gurgl doesn't seem to want to leave your side.

He's been through enough hard times and I am not going to break this one's little heart.

Take care of my friend, {NAME}.

Take care of my friend, Gurgl.
64237.objectives: Find and battle the leader of the pet poachers.

64240.title: Flight of the Kyrian
64240.description:
We've engaged in a heavy battle at the entrance to the Vault of Secrets! Our forces could use some reinforcement.

Please, guide my fellow Ascended to give support to our fighters there. 

The fighters on the ground can handle the clean-up, but they need shields and healing.

Good luck!
64240.progress: Have you helped our forces at the Vault of Secrets?
64240.completion:
You don't always need to strike with force from the skies! Sometimes just a little extra help from healing is the best tactic.

Thank you, my friend.
64240.objectives: Assist covenant forces from the air at the Vault of Secrets.

64255.title: Party Time
64255.progress:
Oh neat that looks like Temel's hat!
Pink Party Hat (1)
64255.completion: <Your butler has a cheshire grin as he takes the party hat.>

64271.title: A More Civilized Way
64271.description:
Ah, $p.

I have a matter to discuss with you. But not here.

<Nadjia eyes the other denizens of Keeper's Respite suspiciously.>

Meet me where the road enters Korthia from the Maw and I will explain.
64271.completion: Your form still needs work. Thank you, for taking time out of our unending campaign to duel. We must remember, even in times of great struggle, to do things that bring us joy.
64271.objectives: Meet Nadjia near the road leading into Korthia.

64282.title: Full of Surprises
64282.description:
You continue to surprise me Maw Walker, your presence here is most unexpected!

Since we are both here, I believe we should work together.

The Jailer has a vault full of valuables, somewhere in this rift.  Locate it for me, or bring it here to be opened and we'll share the wealth together!
64282.completion: This is quite a profitable partnership. I am certain Cartel Ve will be most unhappy with our success.

64286.title: Paragon of Death's Advance
64286.description:
The call to action has been answered, yet again. Your efforts shall not go unnoticed.

Let us see if we cannot find a fitting reward for your efforts.
64286.objectives: Speak with Duchess Mynx at Keeper's Respite in Korthia.

64287.title: Paragon of The Archivists' Codex
64287.description:
You have gone to great lengths to restore that which we cherish most dearly, Maw Walker.

Meet me in my chamber when you are ready. We have one final matter to discuss.
64287.objectives: Speak with Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance in Korthia.

64288.title: Paragon of Ve'nari
64288.description:
Come, Maw Walker. Meet me at my refuge.

We have one final matter to discuss.

...and do make sure you are not followed.
64288.objectives: Speak with Ve'nari at Ve'nari's Refuge in The Maw.

64289.title: Picking Up the Pieces
64289.description:
Much was lost when Korthia was pulled into the Maw.

Priceless relics were torn asunder. I have seen creatures carrying the remnants of these items. 

They must be recovered.

Confront the Jailer's forces and search what remains of Korthia for these fragments of our once glorious vault.
64289.completion: These will do nicely. There is much I can do to improve them.
64289.objectives: Recover 50 Relic Fragments from rare creatures and treasures throughout Korthia.

64290.title: Collecting Research
64290.description:
You have done well to collect these fragments. They will go a long way to restoring our archives. 

I can use what you have found to gather more research about what was lost within Korthia. 

Afterwards, it will be up to you to find more fragments and relics within Korthia to boost our archives.
64290.progress: We thank you for your aid so far, Maw Walker.
64290.completion: This should do nicely. The reliquary will improve with more research.
64290.objectives: Speak with Archivist Roh-Suir to turn in any Korthian Relics for Cataloged Research.

64292.title: Maelie, The Wanderer
64292.description:
I can't thank you enough for finding Maelie! You know, I think she's just a little bit more than I can handle.

Would you mind watching over her? I think she's really taken a liking to you!
64292.completion: Take care of Maelie, Maw Walker.

64314.title: Covenants Renewed
64314.description:
Our efforts were focused on preventing the Jailer from shattering the barrier around the Maw and invading the rest of the Shadowlands.

Instead, he expanded the Maw itself to envelop Oribos and claim the Aribiter's sigil.

I do not fully understand what we witnessed atop Torghast. But the Primus certainly does.

It is time to enact his contingency plan. The covenants will arrive with their sigils shortly. 

Inform the Primus that we are ready to begin.
64314.completion:
Excellent, mortal. You have done your part.

Now my work begins.
64314.objectives: Speak to the Primus, then claim the Sigils from each covenant.

64322.title: Night Fae Veteran
64322.description:
Ardenweald is safer than it has been in quite some time, thanks to you.

Your accomplishments have not gone unnoticed, even beyond the borders of Ardenweald.

Tales of your victories have echoed through the halls of Oribos. Zo'sorg, the Master of Conflict, has requested a meeting with you in the Enclave.

They have a keen interest in the art of war. I suggest you don't keep them waiting.
64322.completion:
Ah, {NAME}. I have heard many stories of your prowess on the battlefield. 

I have interest in keeping great combatants like yourself well equipped. Zo'dash is authorized to further upgrade your armor and weapons.
64322.objectives: Meet with Zo'sorg in the Enclave in Oribos.

64323.title: Kyrian Veteran
64323.description:
Bastion is healing thanks to you, {NAME}. The path is clear.

Your accomplishments have not gone unnoticed, even beyond the borders of Bastion.

Tales of your victories have echoed through the halls of Oribos. Zo'sorg, the Master of Conflict, has requested a meeting with you in the Enclave.

They have a keen interest in the art of war. I suggest you don't keep them waiting.
64323.completion:
Ah, {NAME}. I have heard many stories of your prowess on the battlefield. 

I have interest in keeping great combatants like yourself well equipped. Zo'dash is authorized to further upgrade your armor and weapons.
64323.objectives: Meet with Zo'sorg in the Enclave in Oribos.

64324.title: Necrolord Veteran
64324.description:
The might of the Necrolords grows thanks to you, {NAME}.

Your accomplishments have not gone unnoticed, even beyond the borders of Maldraxxus.

Tales of your victories have echoed through the halls of Oribos. Zo'sorg, the Master of Conflict, has requested a meeting with you in the Enclave.

They have a keen interest in the art of war. I suggest you don't keep them waiting.
64324.completion:
Ah, {NAME}. I have heard many stories of your prowess on the battlefield. 

I have interest in keeping great combatants like yourself well equipped. Zo'dash is authorized to further upgrade your armor and weapons.
64324.objectives: Meet with Zo'sorg in the Enclave in Oribos.

64325.title: Sinfall Veteran
64325.description:
Sinfall's influence grows thanks to your triumphs, {NAME}!

Your accomplishments have not gone unnoticed, even beyond the borders of Revendreth.

Tales of your victories have echoed through the halls of Oribos. Zo'sorg, the Master of Conflict, has requested a meeting with you in the Enclave.

They have a keen interest in the art of war. I suggest you don't keep them waiting.
64325.completion:
Ah, {NAME}. I have heard many stories of your prowess on the battlefield. 

I have interest in keeping great combatants like yourself well equipped. Zo'dash is authorized to further upgrade your armor and weapons.
64325.objectives: Meet with Zo'sorg in the Enclave in Oribos.

64340.title: Bewitching
64340.progress:
Does everyone on your world wear these pointy hats?!
Bewitching Little Hat (1)
64340.completion: <Your butler tries out a terribly awkward cackle as he takes the hat, then coughs remembering his decorum.>

64430.title: Spill the Tea
64430.description:
It seems Tubbins and Gubbins have gone off somewhere.

I do worry about the two of them. Be a dear and check on them. One never knows what shenanigans they might be up to.

I last saw them speaking with one of the faeries from Ardenweald. They were discussing the fine art of tea making.
64430.completion: Ah, you've all returned safely. Wonderful!

64432.title: Strength to Weakness
64432.description:
$p, the scrap metal we've been recovering has some interesting properties. I have come to believe the mawsworn are imbuing their armor and increasing its durability.

Take this lightning rod. First, you will need to get struck by lightning. Don't make that face. You'll be fine. But, you need to also be grounded on mawsworn metal. The large chains embedded in Korthia, near the Windswept Aerie should work.

Once you are... ah... energized, I will send a tauralus, Borrhas, to carry you into battle.
64432.completion: I told you it would be fine. How did the test go? I wish I could have seen the looks on their faces when their fancy armor was suddenly the reason they were being destroyed.
64432.objectives: Empower the lightning rod, then kill mawsworn.

64437.title: Inform the Primus
64437.description: {NAME}, return to Korthia and tell the Primus that the Winter Queen's sigil has been restored.
64437.completion: Ah, good. With the Queen's Sigil restored, we're that much closer to being able to stop Zovaal. Thank you for this information.
64437.objectives: Return to the Primus in Korthia.

64438.title: Empowering Equipment
64438.description:
The research you find can unlock many possibilities.

One such avenue is improving some equipment that you may find within Korthia.

Speak with my assistant nearby. He can use our research to restore this equipment to its former power.
64438.progress: I will do what I can to aid you, Maw Walker.
64438.completion: This is the least we can do to help you in your efforts, Maw Walker.
64438.objectives: Speak with Assistant Scholar Kah-Vez to upgrade one piece of equipment from Korthia.

64441.title: A Loose Thread
64441.description:
<A book appears to have been recently knocked off the table from the nearby Venthyr encampment.

The Venthyr would likely appreciate you returning it to them before one of the gromits uses it for nesting material.>
64441.completion: <It appears you and Mal'ganis are not done with one another. When you finally confront the Jailer, you are certain the dreadlord will be there as well.>
64441.objectives: Pick up the book to return it.

64506.title: What Must Be Found
64506.description:
There is much detailed in the codex. Items that are forever lost, and some that still exist.

Some powerful relics may remain, hidden somewhere within Korthia. 

Browse the reliquary. You will find echoes of artifacts that are still whole here in Korthia.

Commit them to memory. You must find them and return them to me.
64506.progress: Have you seen the missing relics?
64506.objectives: Examine what relics are missing within the Reliquary of Remembrance.

64509.title: Stylish Cover
64509.progress:
Is that ta' same type of head topper Hips from the Sinstone Swingers wears?
Hips' Spare Fedora (1)
64509.completion: Is that actually his spare hat? I can't believe it, I think I see some sweat on the band... thank you!

64511.title: Missing Relics
64511.description:
Thanks to your aid, I have been able to recover more research regarding the lost relics from the vault.

I have gone over the codex and believe there are more relics within Korthia that can still be recovered.

These were sealed within chests that I believe have been scattered in Korthia during the initial attack.

I have set up the missing relics in here. Commit them to memory. They must be recovered.
64511.progress: Have you seen the missing relics?
64511.objectives: Examine the missing relics within the Reliquary of Remembrance.

64513.title: Ve'rayn's Head
64513.description: <Ve'rayn has been hunting Ve'nari for some time. Ve'nari would be very interested in seeing proof that she has been dealt with permanently.>
64513.completion: Is that what I think it is...?
64513.objectives: Deliver Ve'rayn's Head to Ve'nari in Ve'nari's Refuge.

64519.title: Lost Vaults
64519.description:
I have finished my research on more relics that may still exist in Korthia. I believe they are still within our smaller vaults.

With your help, I can recreate devices that are capable of repairing the entrances to these vaults.

Take note of the echoes of relics that are still missing. Please review them so you know what to look for.
64519.progress: Have you seen the missing relics?
64519.objectives: Examine the missing relics within the Reliquary of Remembrance.

64521.title: Helsworn Battle Plans
64521.description:
<These battle plans detail possible movements into Korthia, and include detailed reports of the defensive capabilities of the Death's Advance in the region.

Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite would be able to spread this information rapidly to those who need it.>
64521.completion:
<Duchess Mynx's eyes widen as she browses the documents you brought her.>

I will disseminate these immediately. Thank you!
64521.objectives: Deliver Helsworn Battle Plans to Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite.

64522.title: Stolen Korthian Supplies
64522.description:
<These supplies are marked with the seal of the Death's Advance, stolen from the Rift without being noticed.

Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite would be very grateful to have this returned.>
64522.completion:
<Duchess Mynx looks at you incredulously.>

You found these WHERE?!

Well, how am I supposed to stop thieves I cannot even see? Cowardly shades!
64522.objectives: Deliver Stolen Korthian Supplies to Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite.

64526.title: Mysterious Rifts
64526.description:
Thank you so much for your aid, {NAME}. I have uncovered more relics from the codex that remain intact.

The key to finding these relics rests within the strange rifts within Korthia.

I can now craft a way for you to enter these rifts, in order to gain access to these missing relics.

As before, take note of the echoes to understand what these relics look like. Please be sure to examine them before you depart.
64526.progress: Have you seen the missing relics?
64526.objectives: Examine the missing relics within the Reliquary of Remembrance and purchase a Repaired Riftkey from Roh-Suir.

64527.title: Observing the Chase
64527.description:
In our observations of your kind's conflict, we have noticed a high rate of escape among the prey.

This is unadvantageous to our observation efforts.

The Observer has acquired a tool we believe will improve your ability to force conflict.

Before I give it to you, we ask that you prove your willingness to participate in such conflicts, so that we know we will receive a worthy return on this investment.
64527.progress: Your hesitation to set out and hunt your prey is not promising, {NAME}...
64527.completion: Excellent. We will be watching your future endeavors with great interest.
64527.objectives: Enable War Mode and slay 1 player within the world.

64528.title: Wilderling Saddle
64528.description:
<As you slipped off of the escaped wilderling's back, it shook its saddle off at your feet. It reluctantly left your side as the night fae led it back to Keeper's Respite.

Reldorn in Keeper's Respite might know what to make of this gesture.>
64528.completion:
<Reldorn laughs when he sees the saddle you're carrying.>

I had wondered where that one's saddle had ended up. He has resisted every rider that has attempted companionship with it, but it appears he has finally found one he considers worthy.

You have made a very stubborn, loyal companion this day, {NAME}.
64528.objectives: Deliver Wilderling Saddle to Reldorn in Keeper's Respite.

64529.title: Intact Aquilon Core
64529.description:
<The massive devourer was clutching this aquilon power core in its fist when it died, no doubt ripped from one of the destroyed aquilon around it. The power core appears to be almost entirely intact.

Deos in Keeper's Respite would be able to help you locate an aquilon that you could power with it.>
64529.completion:
<Deos's eyes light up when he sees the intact power core you're holding.>

Thank the Archon! I recovered a few broken aquilon from the fight earlier, and one is missing its power core. I will restore it so that you may take it with you.
64529.objectives: Deliver Intact Aquilon Core to Deos in Keeper's Respite.

64530.title: Gravewing Crystal
64530.description:
<This large crystal fragment shattered off of the massive construct's body. Flashes of energy crackle inside of it.

The Stonewright in Keeper's Respite would be able to use this crystal to empower a gravewing for you.>
64530.completion:
<The Stonewright raises one eyebrow as you hand her the powerful crystal.>

This is truly a unique crystal... Luckily, I know just the stonechild worthy of it. I trust you will take good care of her.
64530.objectives: Deliver Gravewing Crystal to the Stonewright in Keeper's Respite.

64532.title: The Final Relics
64532.description:
I have excellent news, {NAME}. I have uncovered the last set of our missing relics! 

It may be difficult for you to locate them, but I have developed the proper research to aid you.

Please, review the last of our missing relics. We are so close to finding them all!
64532.progress: Have you seen the missing relics?
64532.objectives: Examine the missing relics within the Reliquary of Remembrance and purchase Research Report: Ancient Shrines.

64549.title: Legend of the Animaswell
64549.description:
<This appears to be an incomplete set of notes detailing one archivist's search for a mythical font of anima hidden somewhere deep in Korthia.

Watcher Vesperbloom in the Heart of the Forest would be able to help you put together a team to search for it.>
64549.objectives: Deliver Legend of the Animaswell to Watcher Vesperbloom in the Heart of the Forest.

64551.title: Legend of the Animaswell
64551.description:
<This appears to be an incomplete set of notes detailing one archivist's search for a mythical font of anima hidden somewhere deep in Korthia.

Merick Feldscar in the Seat of the Primus would be able to help you put together a team to search for it.>
64551.completion:
<Merick Feldscar carefully studies the documents you brought him.>

The documentation is incomplete. It is unclear if the archivist even survived...

But the tales of the anima are impressive, and there are enough details here to launch an expedition.

It will not be easy. The archivist warns of many dangers protecting the anima source...
64551.objectives: Deliver Legend of the Animaswell to Merick Feldscar in the Seat of the Primus.

64552.title: Legend of the Animaswell
64552.description:
<This appears to be an incomplete set of notes detailing one archivist's search for a mythical font of anima hidden somewhere deep in Korthia.

Koros in Elysian Hold would be able to help you put together a team to search for it.>
64552.completion:
<Koros carefully studies the documents you brought him.>

The documentation is incomplete. It is unclear if the archivist even survived...

But the tales of the anima are coherent, and there are enough details here to launch an expedition.

It will not be easy. The archivist warns of many dangers protecting the anima source...
64552.objectives: Deliver Legend of the Animaswell to Koros in Elysian Hold.

64553.title: Legend of the Animaswell
64553.description:
<This appears to be an incomplete set of notes detailing one archivist's search for a mythical font of anima hidden somewhere deep in Korthia.

Tactician Sakaa in Sinfall would be able to help you put together a team to search for it.>
64553.completion:
<Tactician Sakaa carefully studies the documents you brought her.>

The documentation is incomplete. It is unclear if the archivist even survived...

But the tales of the anima are incredible, and there are enough details here to launch an expedition.

It will not be easy. The archivist warns of many dangers protecting the anima source...
64553.objectives: Deliver Legend of the Animaswell to Tactician Sakaa in Sinfall.

64555.title: Surveying Secrets
64555.description:
Each of the covenants have provided their own specialists in their areas of expertise. A few of them have taken to the field to scout this unknown land.

Speak with them. They should all be keeping a report of their survey. Return them to me.
64555.progress: Have you found all of the scouts?
64555.completion: Most of this information is useful. My thanks, Maw Walker.
64555.objectives: Speak with the forward scouts in Korthia.

64556.title: In Need of Assistance
64556.description:
The inhabitants of Korthia have been through much. Were it not for our arrival, the Jailer's forces would have rampaged through the remainder of the City of Secrets, leaving destruction in their wake.

To continue our efforts, we must assist those in need.

Heed the call of our allies, Maw Walker. See to it no stone is left unturned and no ally of the Jailer left alive.
64556.completion: This work brings us one step closer to ending Zovaal's reign over this forsaken land.
64556.objectives: Complete 3 Daily Quests from Mikanikos, Ta'nasi, and Kael'thas throughout Korthia.

64560.title: Anima Reclamation
64560.description:
Our efforts here need a constant supply of troops, supplies, and anima. The last one is the hardest, for obvious reasons. But I've learned to be resourceful. 

Nearby there is a plentiful source of anima: the devourers that currently swarm the Sanctuary of Guidance. It's not as easy as beating it out of a soul, but it's just as effective, if you're strong enough. Are you?
64560.progress: Every drop of anima we reclaim is a potential weapon against the Jailer.
64560.completion: You can trust me with this anima. I will see it is turned against the Jailer and his forces.
64560.objectives: Reclaim 8 Devoured Anima from devourers at the Sanctuary of Guidance.

64561.title: Observational Records
64561.description:
Greetings, Maw Walker, a moment of your time?

As you no doubt know, my cartel has quietly spread observational devices all across Korthia. But that data is no good to us if it is not retrieved. Which is where you come in.

The records from the Windswept Aerie and Estuary of Awakening should be ready to collect. You won't see the devices themselves, but the data will appear to you as a bright orb.

And don't forget to look below ground!

Bring those data to me, and I will reward you handsomely.
64561.progress: Have you retrieved the observational records from the Windswept Aerie and Estuary of Awakening?
64561.completion:
Places like the Aerie and Estuary must have been desolate, even before all the destruction. What interesting creatures congregate there.

Will they all survive these changes, or will some adapt, and become even more fearsome?

And here is your reward, as promised.
64561.objectives: Collect 5 Observational Records from the Windswept Aerie and Estuary of Awakening in Korthia.

64562.title: We Need a Healer - You!
64562.description:
There are too many wounded on the battlefield! 

Not everyone can 'bash it and make better.' We need more healers.

You, take my device and get our wounded back on their feet!
64562.completion:
That got them back on their feet!

Any little bit helps to keep us in the fight.
64562.objectives: Restore 10 Wounded Covenant Allies in Seeker's Quorum.

64567.title: The Missing Scholar
64567.description:
Ah, Maw Walker. Your return blesses us with great optimism, and much needed assistance.

Several scholars remain unaccounted for. We believe they were last seen studying in the great court. We fear they may be lost, or worse, taken by those who seek to disrupt our way of life.

Return to me when you have answers.

May the path guide you.
64567.completion: How... how did you find me?

64579.title: Hollow Efforts
64579.description:
The large metal spheres that litter the landscape of Zereth Mortis are spent forges, discarded during the creation process. 

These empty metal husks still contain residual materials of creation that may be useful to us.

Use my Forge-Tap near these metal spheres to harvest any Remnant Neomotes. You may also find other useful proto-materials!
64579.progress: Have you gathered the materials already?
64579.completion: Excellent work, {NAME}. These resources will bolster our efforts here.
64579.objectives: Collect 40 Remnant Neomotes from Progenitor Forges using Firim's Forge-Tap.

64592.title: Historic Protection
64592.description:
The outsiders have disrupted the sands. We cannot reach the terraforming records we need in order to collect necessary historical information.

Will you assist us?

Help Mai Obet collect historical records in the Endless Sands.
64592.completion: We have archived the necessary records. Thank you for your assistance.
64592.objectives: Help Mai Obet examine 6 Terraforming Records in the Endless Sands.

64597.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
64597.description:
I feel Kel'Thuzad's presence in these halls. Claim shards from his phylactery and I'll be able to open a new pathway into his chambers.

Four shards should be enough. We wouldn't want him coming back again would we?
64597.progress: Four shards should allow us to access his chamber.
64597.completion: This should help us gain access to his chamber more readily.
64597.objectives: Collect 4 Phylactery Shards from Kel'Thuzad within the Sanctum of Domination on Normal Difficulty.

64598.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
64598.description:
I feel Kel'Thuzad's presence in these halls. Claim shards from his phylactery and I'll be able to open a new pathway into his chambers.

Four shards should be enough. We wouldn't want him coming back again would we?
64598.progress: Four shards should allow us to access his chamber.
64598.completion: This should help us gain access to his chamber more readily.
64598.objectives: Collect 4 Phylactery Shards from Kel'Thuzad within the Sanctum of Domination on Heroic Difficulty.

64599.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
64599.description:
I feel Kel'Thuzad's presence in these halls. Claim shards from his phylactery and I'll be able to open a new pathway into his chambers.

Four shards should be enough. We wouldn't want him coming back again would we?
64599.progress: Four shards should allow us to access his chamber.
64599.completion: This should help us gain access to his chamber more readily.
64599.objectives: Collect 4 Phylactery Shards from Kel'Thuzad within the Sanctum of Domination on Mythic Difficulty.

64607.title: Tazavesh: A Hard Bargain
64607.description:
Ah, my work looks marvelous on you. You are the very image of legitimacy!

And now that I've provided you with my talents, you shall provide me with yours. Seek out my business associate, Fe'tajid, at the Gilded Landing and offer him your assistance.

I look forward to hearing of your success.
64607.progress: Have you spoken with my associate?
64607.completion:
It seems our efforts to deceive the Zo were unsuccessful. But their efforts to kill you failed as well, so no harm done, yes?

Perhaps a more generous reward is in order. Please accept this, along with my sincerest gratitude.
64607.objectives: Seek out Au'manal's business associate and offer your assistance.

64641.title: Mysterious Greenery
64641.description:
There's a bright power emanating from the place above. I'm drawn towards it, like a moth to a light!

I want to check it out, whatever it is. Won't you join me, please? It'll be so fun!
64641.completion:
We are Circle Koh of the jiro.

We are here to fix this land.
64641.objectives: Visit the Untamed Verdure with Glimmercane.

64642.title: Clearing the Ruins
64642.description:
This place was abandoned for too long. The vegetation has overtaken the land.

We must enter the Blooming Foundry to fix it.

Until then: clear the area. Remove the deviants who have grown twisted over time.
64642.objectives: Kill 15 creatures within the Untamed Verdure.

64643.title: Scavenging a Solution
64643.description:
The Blooming Foundry created this area. It maintains the automa, the creatures, and the plants.

The overgrowth is its fault.

We need to enter the Foundry to fix this land. This constructor can break through when it is working.

Many automa in this area stopped moving long ago. Find usable pieces inside them.
64643.progress: With your help, we will restore this place to its glory.
64643.objectives: Find 8 Automa Internals from Abandoned Automa in the Untamed Verdure.

64644.title: A Splash of the Eternal
64644.description:
I don't really know much about this place or its inhabitants, but what I do know is magic! I can sense ancient power from the waters near us.

Maybe that can help?

Let's check out that pond!
64644.completion: <A small opening in the creature looks like the perfect size for a little pour of mystical water.>
64644.objectives: Help Glimmercane extract water from the pool in the Untamed Verdure.

64645.title: Moment of Truth
64645.description:
Our constructor is ready.

We shall start the process to open the Blooming Foundry and reset this land.

We can start over.
64645.objectives: Follow the Koh jiro in the Untamed Verdure.

64646.title: Ramping Up
64646.description:
We must restore the Foundry's power to use it. Conductors will channel power so we can use it.

We know how to use the conductors. Clear the way, and we shall start over.
64646.completion:
These automa should not act like this.

They are beautiful. Strange. New.

We must deliberate before continuing.
64646.objectives: Activate 4 conductors within the Blooming Foundry.

64647.title: Strange Gears
64647.description:
<Oddly, the seed within the automa's innards is still very much alive.

Are they all like this?>
64647.completion:
<Koh Shira examines the piece of the automa--entwined with living vines.>

This cannot be.

Automa do not have vines within them. But these automa do.

This... is beautiful.
64647.objectives: Collect 3 Winding Seeds from the automa in the Blooming Foundry.

64648.title: Reap What We Have Sown
64648.description:
We told the constructor that we will use the Foundry to reset this land.

We must stop it and protect the new automa.
64648.completion:
Learning about new creatures that are infused with living growth--well, that sounds right up my alley! 

I think I'll stay with them and see how I can help... and maybe pick up their language as well. 

Thanks for coming on this adventure with me, friend!

64650.title: Hyena Soul
64650.description: <The Hyena Soul is fiery and spry. The shape of the hyena will be yours to call upon.>
64650.objectives: Bring the Hyena Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

64651.title: Cobra Soul
64651.description: <The Cobra Soul is covetous and protective. The shape of the cobra will be yours to call upon.>
64651.objectives: Bring the Cobra Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

64706.title: A Matter Of Motivation
64706.description:
Giants litter these sands, mortal. But I believe we can revitalize them. 

The smaller automa that are hiding in the desert can be utilized here. Use my Motivator to rally them to our cause. If we can gather enough, their energy can replenish these defeated behemoths to bolster our forces.

Return as many as you can to me, and we will put them to work!
64706.completion: Well done, mortal! Soon we shall see the results of your efforts.

64713.title: Picking Up the Pieces... Literally
64713.description:
Orbs help us develop terrain for the Forge. Magic within the orbs draws the devourers. They tear apart the metal to reach it. We must collect the remains.

Look for the fragments around the orbs. Bring them to us.
64713.progress: Did you find the fragments? We need many pieces.
64713.completion: Enough to fix a small orb. This will do.

64717.title: Materials of Creation
64717.description:
The large metal spheres that litter the landscape of Zereth Mortis are spent forges, discarded during the creation process.

The spheres near the Forge of Afterlives contain trace amounts of materials unique to that location.

I have modified my Forge-Tap to harvest those materials.  Use it near the forges I have identified. The rare Eidolic Fragments have the greatest chance to be found on the largest of Progenitor Forges.
64717.progress: Have you collected what we need?
64717.completion: I shall make use of these immediately. These will help Saezurah and the automa resist the effects of the domination magic.
64717.objectives: Collect 10 Eidolic Fragments and 300 Minor Enigmet.

64718.title: Keys To Victory
64718.description:
The song... incomplete. Harmony is needed. Seek those who scry. Send them to serve the cycle.

Mawsworn hold the keys that bind. Take the keys, set them free.
64718.completion: The chorus gathers. Soon, our voices will merge.
64718.objectives: Free 6 Automa Scryers from their cells.

64720.title: Cleaving A Path
64720.description:
Maw Walker! My scouts report that the Mawsworn have dominated two automa Oracles to aid them in battle. These Oracles will most certainly predict our strategy and our ultimate goal, if given the chance.  

We need to eliminate both Oracles before we enter the Crypts. With them out of the way, the Mawsworn troops won't know what we're doing until we're finished with it.

Take Emeni with you. She's eager for battle.
64720.completion: Perfectly executed, {NAME}. The loss of those Oracles should keep the Mawsworn in the dark.
64720.objectives: Slay Oracle Zoketh and Oracle Voraxxi.

64722.title: Knocking On Death's Door
64722.description:
This is it, mortal. The forces you have assembled should be enough to break through the Mawsworn and reach the Crypts. Getting inside, however, will require more effort. The Mawsworn have barricaded the entrance.

Kbato will carry you into battle. Eliminate the Mawsworn, and destroy the devices that power the barrier.
64722.completion: By the First Ones... I never dreamed I would see this place with my own eyes.
64722.objectives: Riding Kbato, defeat the Mawsworn forces in the Endless Sands and open the way to the Crypts of the Eternal.

64723.title: Restoration Project
64723.description:
Without an Arbiter, the very purpose of the Shadowlands has been compromised. Souls flood the Maw with no direction.

As Saezurah noted, Zereth Mortis would ordinarily craft a new being to take the Arbiter's place. I suspect the Jailer's forces have disrupted the land to the point where this is no longer possible.

It is time to take action ourselves, and bring stability again to the Shadowlands! Speak to Saezurah, and see where we must begin.
64723.completion: The covenants are certain to send aid if we ask.

64725.title: Unforgivable Intrusion
64725.description:
Darkness spreads dissonance throughout these halls. Mawsworn drain life from the air, and give only suffering in return. This must not be.

If the song is to be restored, silence is needed. The Mawsworn must be destroyed.
64725.progress: When the halls are silent, we may proceed.
64725.completion: The golden hour of silence. A space for creation to begin.
64725.objectives: Eliminate 6 Dominated Automa and 3 Darkseer Corrupters.

64726.title: The Order Of Things
64726.description:
Essences of ancient souls, tampered with--they bleed from each room. The halls must be restored, the flow of souls redirected.

The spheres hold the key. Seal the breaches, restore the flow, then the vessel may be filled.
64726.progress: Seal the breach, restore the flow.
64726.completion: A breath held--anticipation. Soon, the soul will merge, and the song of creation will begin.
64726.objectives: Use $13oa Containment Spheres to seal the breaches.

64727.title: The Infinite Circle
64727.description:
Creation calls--can you hear it? Yet darkness lingers below, taints the ancient melody.

To forge anew, peace must be restored. The Walker must walk, and protect.

There is much to be done. Lead the way.
64727.completion: Our voices are muffled in the lingering dark.
64727.objectives: Escort Saezurah to the center of the Crypts of the Eternal.

64728.title: Acquaintances Forgotten
64728.description: It is time. The song shall bring life anew. Tell me when you are ready to begin.
64728.completion: Dissonance lingers. A pure tone is needed. Reset the cycle anew.

64729.title: Lifetimes To Consider
64729.description:
This song has been completed, and harmony has been restored. Yet Zereth Mortis remains haunted by discord.

Dissonance lingers still, outside these walls. We must leave before it finds us.

Speak with the one you call Firim--he will open the way.
64729.completion: I can hardly believe all we've accomplished... truly, this is a day worth remembering. We could not have achieved this without you, my friend.

64730.title: The Turning Point
64730.description:
A pause, devoid of breath. A melody lingers on. The cycle awaits a voice.

<You are unsure of what Saezurah means. Perhaps you should try to set up the ritual again, starting with the Vessel and the scryers.>
64730.completion: I do not wish to say it but... it seems we have failed, my friend.
64730.objectives: Examine the Vessel and the Automa Scryers.

64731.title: For Every Soul
64731.description:
Without the Arbiter to stem the flow of souls to the Maw, the Shadowlands will never be fully repaired.

This cannot be the end. Surely you can think of something?
64731.progress: This moment is of great importance.
64731.completion: A new voice added to the chorus -- the cycle continues ever onward.
64731.objectives: Find a way to create a new Arbiter.

64733.title: Help From Beyond
64733.description:
If we stand any chance of breaking through the Mawsworn forces, we will need the help of all of the covenants.

I will speak with the Kyrian. You and Pelagos can speak with the others. But before you go, ask Firim if there is any way we can gain the support of the Enlightened as well.
64733.completion: Between the strength of the covenant forces and the help of the automa, we should be able to reach the Crypts!
64733.objectives: Speak with representatives from the Enlightened, Venthyr, Necrolord, and Night Fae.

64739.title: Zovaal's Grasp
64739.description:
I remember this metal. I saw it when I was touched by Maw magic. When I was severed...

I will show you where this happened. Follow me. I will tell you my story.
64739.completion: It is worse than I thought. Much worse.
64739.objectives: Follow Hanoa the Exile and listen to her story.

64741.title: Security Check
64741.description:
I do not understand--these are my brethren! How can they be so careless, so unconcerned with both greedy cartels and the Mawsworn at their doorstep?

Their protective technology is antiquated. It will not keep danger out. If I cannot persuade them to leave, I can at least ensure they are safe where they insist on staying.

I do not want to lose my friends again.

There should be four hidden conduits around the edge of the shield. Take this kit. It will allow you to inspect and repair them, if needed.
64741.progress: Should those conduits fall, we will need to construct additional ones. Nobody wants that.
64741.completion: I knew it! Haven's defenses were deliberately tampered with -- by Cartel Xy!
64741.objectives: Investigate the Shield Conduits around Haven.

64742.title: Traces of Tampering
64742.description:
So the shield has been sabotaged. Of course the ruthless Cartel Xy are the first to attempt to profit off this land. 

Their greed has put us all in even more danger. We must stop them. Let us search together for signs of their passage.
64742.objectives: Find clues of Cartel Xy's presence.

64743.title: Xy Are You Doing This?
64743.description:
We cannot see them, but I am certain this is where Cartel Xy has established their base.

Something must have drawn Xy to this area of Zereth Mortis specifically, and we must discover what it is if we are to protect our friends here. 

Their cloaks do not cover their supplies very well. See what information you can gather from their belongings.
64743.progress: We must discover Cartel Xy's intentions here.
64743.completion: Oh, they thought they could hide their plans with a code? Hold on, my friend, this should take just a moment...

64744.title: Broker Decloaker
64744.description:
Do you sense a shift in the air? They may be hidden, but Cartel Xy is near.

Fortunately, the devices they use to cloak themselves are familiar to me. Here; take this. Place it on the ground and it will reveal nearby agents... for a time. 

Stop them, even if you must take their lives.
64744.completion: Their deaths are a shame, but we must protect Haven.
64744.objectives: Kill 12 Cartel Xy agents just outside of Haven.

64745.title: Selfless Preservation
64745.description:
The automa were once abundant here, singing, constructing various things, carrying out the purpose of the First Ones. Then, invaders from the Maw slaughtered them all.

The last automa to fall were protecting something important in a nearby structure. 

I witnessed one of the cursed Mawsworn steal a device by the door. The Elders say we should not meddle with artifacts, but would it be a transgression to recover what was stolen?
64745.completion: This automa still lives! But it is so weak.
64745.objectives: Recover the Stolen Artifact in the Arrangement Index and restore it to its rightful place.

64758.title: Following the Leader
64758.description:
We sealed the door to the Slumbering Vault when we first arrived. It is a sanctum, a cradle of all that is precious here. The power that sleeps within should not be touched by us. 

If the Xy leader made it past the shields while we were distracted by the beauty of this place, I shudder to think of what they have already disturbed.

Hurry! We must go to the Slumbering Vault and ensure its safety.
64758.completion: No! What has that fool done to the console?!

64759.title: Junk's Not Dead
64759.description:
This automa has been hiding here! I suspect it will not be receptive to our help.

I am hesitant to suggest this, but if the servitor were to associate you with this facility, it might be more amenable. 

If you have the means, copy the glyphs inscribed on similar automa outside. Those that the Maw have touched will be tainted, but I saw from my vantage point a few fallen automa in the sands with untarnished glyphs.
64759.completion: I hope this will encourage our friend here to view us as an ally. First Ones forgive us.
64759.objectives: Obtain glyphs from 6 Depleted Servitors around the Arrangement Index.

64760.title: Technical Difficulties
64760.description:
The console is going haywire! We have to fix it!

Maybe these buttons do something?
64760.progress: We have to fix the console somehow!
64760.completion:
Thank you for your assistance, Maw Walker.

I must return to Oribos. I will tell Cartel Al that our friends are not lost, but Enlightened.
64760.objectives: Press buttons on the console in the Slumbering Vault.

64761.title: Core Competency
64761.description:
The poor thing.

The sacred should not be disturbed, but... will the elders judge us if we help it survive? This is preservation, not interference.

...I hope. 

We can power it back up. Use this depleted core as a conduit. Perhaps the larger wild animates in the nearby sands have enough energy to charge it.
64761.completion: This lonely one will be strong again.
64761.objectives: Charge a Depleted Automa Core by draining slain wild creatures in the Arrangement Index.

64762.title: Revival of the Fittest
64762.description:
This core is brimming with energy!

Use the charged core to revive the automa. Hopefully, it will no longer see us as a threat.

Do be careful. The power of the First Ones is not meant for us to control.
64762.completion: Support has arrived. The restoration may commence.
64762.objectives: Revive the Hidden Servitor in the Arrangement Index.

64763.title: Maintenance Mode
64763.description:
The architect set forth these tasks: 

Stay safe. 

Restore the Protoform Repository when danger passes.

The mortal knows the cyphers. The mortal will help with the tasks.

Attuning of the energy terminals is required. Each terminal requires a codex. Invaders pilfered the necessary codices. 

Go.
64763.objectives: Attune 4 Energy Terminals in the Arrangement Index.

64766.title: Access Request
64766.description:
The architect alone possesses the Restoration Matrix required for the restoration. The architect will restore the Protoform Repository.

The mortal will gain access to the Chamber of Shaping and inform the architect of recent progress. The architect will restore the repository.

Fulfillment of the task is imminent.
64766.completion:
The Restoration Matrix is acquired. The architect is not present. The architect is therefore lost. 

Restoration of the repository is mandatory, even so.
64766.objectives: Find the Proto Architect in the Chamber of Shaping and retrieve a Restoration Matrix.

64767.title: The Final Song
64767.description:
Servitors do not possess the strength to restore the repositories. Nevertheless, the task must be completed.

The mortal must stay close to protect the restoration process.

Come.
64767.completion: I should have obeyed the elders! This is all my fault!
64767.objectives: Stay near Kodah while keeping enemies away to capture the Protoform Repository.

64771.title: Enlightened Exodus
64771.description:
Hello, my friend!

An expedition of Cartel Al was sent in search of this place long ago, and was believed lost. I entered Zereth Mortis in hopes of saving my splintered cartel from the dangers of the Maw that have preceded me.

At last, I have found my old friend! And yet, she refuses to return to safety.

Perhaps others can be convinced. Will you try?
64771.progress: Have any others chosen to leave?
64771.completion: If they cannot be persuaded, they must be protected.
64771.objectives: Talk to the Enlightened around Haven.

64772.title: Broken Circle
64772.description:
The jiro of Circle Olea work here. We make...

<The jiro pauses for a moment.>

They... make new lands and creatures for the Forge.

Devourers attacked, but some jiro still survive. You must find them. Tell them to gather outside the cave to the north. I will clear the way.

Do not tell them I sent you. They will not want to see me.
64772.completion: Thank you for finding the survivors!
64772.objectives: Find any surviving jiro and convince them to meet outside the cave.

64773.title: A Jiro Guide to Not Being Eaten
64773.description:
Devourers attacked. They overran the guardians. They still search for food.

We are not safe. Reduce the devourers' numbers.

This is how not to be eaten.
64773.progress: Is it safe? There are so many devourers...
64773.completion: Fewer devourers, less likely we will be eaten.
64773.objectives: Reduce the devourer presence at the Terrace of Formation.

64775.title: Mawdified Behavior
64775.description:
There is a devourer in the cave. It creates a rift. This should not be possible in Zereth Mortis.

Enter the cave and destroy the devourer. Search for clues. See how it can open a rift.

Be careful. This one is different from others. It has absorbed the magic of the First Ones. This has never happened before. Be ready for anything.

I will stay here and protect the jiro.
64775.progress: Is the devourer destroyed? Did you find any clues?
64775.completion:
A new type of devourer. Troubling. Hopefully these are the only ones.

As for this mysterious metal... I have seen it before.
64775.objectives: Kill the Unraveller and search it for clues.

64778.title: Rift Recon
64778.description:
Devourers are a problem. Rifts are a bigger problem. 

They will keep bringing devourers. We must close them. To do this, we need information. 

Take the crescendal. Use it to analyze the rifts. Bring the information back to us.
64778.progress: Do not break the crescendal. It can be... difficult to use.
64778.completion: This information will help us. Tell us how to close the rifts. Fewer rifts means fewer devourers.

64779.title: Pound of Flesh
64779.description:
Automa remove threats to us. But there are no more automa. We must help ourselves. We need magic.

Devourers ate the orb magic. Now they are warped and twisted. But also full of magic.

Bring us devourer flesh. We will extract the magic. We will need it to defeat the devourers.
64779.progress: Devourers were not meant to eat this magic.
64779.completion:
This is the flesh {NAME} gathered? 



It will have to do.
64779.objectives: Collect 30 Warped Flesh from devourers at Zovaal's Grasp.

64780.title: Mawsteel, Maw Problems
64780.description:
Zereth Mortis is sacred. Rifts should not form here. Something creates them. 

The metal you found has Maw magic. Devourers use it to make rifts. This is how they skirt our protections.

Mawsteel shards are strewn across the area. Take these shards. Throw them off our cliffs. Make sure devourers do not use them to create rifts.
64780.completion: Removing mawsteel prevents rifts. It is not much but it will help.
64780.objectives: Lift 4 Mawsteel Shards and throw them off the cliffs.

64783.title: Dance Dance Darkmoon
64783.description:
Simon says, "Are you ready to dance?" Step on in and show off your sweet moves, {class}.

The rules are simple. Your opponent will perform a series of stylish moves, then you gotta match 'em.

Earn enough accolades and then come back to ol' Simon. Just know that the more challenging the opponent, the more accolades you can earn.

Simon says, "Are you up for the challenge?"
64783.progress: Simon says, "Show me what you got."
64783.completion:
Simon says, "Those were some sweet moves, {NAME}." 

Simon is impressed!

64785.title: Overgrown Story
64785.description:
Since our arrival here the Untamed Verdure has been a mystery waiting to be solved. The lush foliage of the area grows on everything as the creatures run amok without purpose.

There could be valuable research data to be obtained from these creatures.

Use a Containment Trap to subdue the elemental creatures. Once subdued, examine them for research data.
64785.completion: This information will help, but I'm afraid those ruins still remain a mystery!
64785.objectives: Gaiagantic and 12 Geomentals examined for research data.

64794.title: Knowing is Half the Battle
64794.description:
{NAME}, you should join Shandris and infiltrate the Mawsworn forces from the east. Whatever information you two uncover will inform us of your next course of action.

Take care. We have no information on what you may find.
64794.completion:
You've arrived.

Their movements here are strange. It almost seems as if the bulk of their forces are elsewhere.
64794.objectives: Meet Shandris near the Provis Strata.

64796.title: Scour the Sands
64796.description:
The little I have seen so far has given me almost no information about our enemies. We will have to take a closer look.

I can hide the both of us from sight on your command. But stay away from the dreadlords--their eyes are sharp enough to spy even a hidden huntress.
64796.progress: The less attention we draw, the better.
64796.completion: We have discovered their immediate goal. We should return to our allies, quickly.
64796.objectives: Scout Provis Strata with Shandris Feathermoon.

64797.title: Harmony and Discord
64797.description:
These obelisks must be key to Zovaal's plans. Even without full knowledge of their purpose, we should stop the Mawsworn from meddling with them.

I will bring this information to Highlord Bolvar. Head to Darion Mograine and do the same. He will need to plan his defenses around this.
64797.completion: The enemy has not yet been able to break through our defending line, but I fear we will lose the battle without your assistance.
64797.objectives: Speak with Darion Mograine at Provis Terra.

64798.title: What We Overcome
64798.description:
I understand now. All of us that were touched by Domination were able to tap into something. Whether nobility or vengeance, it gave the strength to resist.

With all that I have faced, I have to remember that I am still here.

And if there are those willing to stand with Sylvanas, I have to believe they will stand with me as well.

I'm ready to try again. This time, I will overcome whatever I face.
64798.progress: We will not fail. There is no other choice but oblivion.
64798.completion:
All the shards are now infused with the resistance we gained from our experiences with Domination.

It was not easy, for any of us. But I am proud of what we were able to accomplish, together.

As for the rest, our future is in the hands of the Primus.
64798.objectives: Defeat the Mawbound Monstrosity and infuse the final shard.

64799.title: The Broken Crown
64799.description:
Our friends have returned from the Sepulcher of the First Ones with a familiar face.

Anduin... What terrible things he has endured. 

But as difficult and painful as it is, we must uncover what he knows. The Jailer has blocked our way within the Sepulcher, and we risk falling victim to Domination ourselves if we blindly follow.

He is our best hope.
64799.progress: We must defeat Zovaal, or all is lost.
64799.completion:
The suffering he endured... 

This will be difficult to overcome.
64799.objectives: Speak to Anduin Wrynn in the Geometric Cavern.

64800.title: Our Last Option
64800.description:
Zovaal has blocked our pursuit. If we are to defeat him, we must find a way to withstand Domination.

But to overcome it, we need to understand how it works. 

The Primus of Maldraxxus created Domination, he will be able to tell us more.

I asked Taelia to bring a piece of the Helm of Domination to Zereth Mortis. I dread to think of what might happen were I to try to carry it again... 

Let us discuss the way forward.
64800.progress: We can never turn things back to the time that was. We can only live with the choices made, and move forward.
64800.completion:
I don't like this as an option any more than Taelia does, but we need to wield Domination safely if we are to find a way to overcome it.

Our first step is to ensure that the helm still works. On us.

64801.title: Elder Eru
64801.description:
Since we have earned the trust of the Enlightened, I have learned more about their explorations into Zereth Mortis.

They know more than they are willing to tell, but often do not act on that knowledge. Perhaps where they observe, we can be a catalyst for action.
