In a secluded corner called the Lexical Glade, there is an elder named Eru. She may be able to give us insight on how we might use the language of the First Ones.

Seek her out, and see if she will help us.
64801.completion:
What is this? You wish to know if there is anything here that can help you resist Mawsworn magic?

You are in luck, stranger. I happen to know that this place is a library. And libraries are wonderful places to find what you are looking for.
64801.objectives: Find Elder Eru outside the Lexical Glade.

64802.title: Hello, Darkness
64802.description:
I created Domination as a tool to punish Zovaal.

My anger informed that creation, and now we pay the price for my hubris. Even Eternal Ones err on occasion.

But we are not without hope.

Take the half of the broken Helm of Domination, and test it upon one of your own. If it retains enough power, it can then be used to test it elsewhere in Zereth Mortis.
64802.progress: We will not give up until we have stopped Zovaal.
64802.completion:
Even those who overcame Domination are not entirely immune to it now.

But there may be something buried in that history that can aid us. 

I will think on this.

For now, focus your efforts on the creatures of Zereth Mortis. See what makes them more resistant.
64802.objectives: Test the broken Helm of Domination on Darion Mograine.

64803.title: Testing One Two
64803.description:
The creatures of Zereth Mortis have existed here since well before I created Domination.

We have seen the effects that Zovaal's forces have had on them, but I believe there is more to be learned.

Use the helm on the denizens of Zereth Mortis and see what you can uncover about a natural resistance.
64803.progress: You have an object that wields Domination, yet you are not overcome? Interesting.
64803.completion:
The more advanced creatures resist Domination for longer? 

Well of course, I could have told you that. It's all about the language!
64803.objectives: Test the Broken Helm on creatures in Zereth Mortis.

64804.title: Cryptic Catalogue
64804.description:
This area is a repository of various texts. Hmmm? What do they say? I have no idea!

I have dedicated myself to their catalogue and organization. This is more important than ever, with invaders destroying the balance in Zereth Mortis! We must preserve what we have found so far.

You can help. Go into the glade and memorize the phrases there, then meet me down in the grotto. There is something in it that might help you test that helm of yours further.
64804.progress: Think how much we could learn if we understood the intentions of the First Ones.
64804.completion:
This place is wondrous.

I could spend all of my existence here.
64804.objectives: Memorize Phrases in the Lexical Glade.

64805.title: The Not-Scientific Method
64805.description:
The language of the First Ones is not static like most others. It evolves.

Creatures like the sentries are more advanced than your average poultrid, obviously. Their more complex thought processes give them an innate resistance to the invaders' overriding magic. 

But you should not take my word for it. We can actually test this! 

In the grotto there is a librarian. Take those phrases you memorized and infuse them into it. Then try out your helm.
64805.completion:
You see! It took far longer for Domination to overtake the librarian's native purposing.

Of course it did fail in the end, but I would call that a success for your particular interest.

Do not worry, another automa will take that one's place. There must always be a librarian.
64805.objectives: Test the Broken Helm on an activated Lexicon Librarian and observe the results.

64806.title: Where the Memory Resides
64806.description:
I think I know what will be asked of us in Bastion. It will not be easy.

With this half of the Helm, we have collected the first part of what is needed to resist Domination. But there are those of us who have also suffered from it. Lived through it. 

In a way, it has marked us. All of us.

There must be something in those experiences that will help us break free from Zovaal's influence.

Let us go to the Chamber of First Reflection in Bastion.
64806.completion:
Good, you've arrived.

We have assembled those who have suffered from Domination in the past. Some more recently than others. 

All have come through it, not always intact, but we are still standing. That is what we must capture.
64806.objectives: Meet Highlord Bolvar inside the Chamber of First Reflection in Bastion.

64807.title: What We Wish to Forget
64807.description:
While the language of the Progenitors will aid us, there is another trait that will help break Domination's hold on us.

An indomitable will. 

Those of us who have endured before, and survived, have that inherent resistance, which we will offer up to be infused into each of the shards.

The Primus has assured me that this will work. With no other options, this is the only way. 

I trust that it will be worth the suffering.
64807.progress: We will do whatever it takes.
64807.completion:
I feel... lighter. But I cannot forget what has brought me to here, and what must still be done.

I hope that Taelia will remember what she saw... the man I am now. Not some lone figure locked away, but someone who does what is necessary for the good of all.
64807.objectives: Assist with the ritual and infuse the Shards of Domination.

64808.title: What Makes Us Strong
64808.description:
I wish that I knew of this place sooner. Where terrible darkness could be purged from oneself, memories examined and expunged...

I am willing to do whatever it takes to help defeat Zovaal, no matter the cost.

This is the only way.
64808.progress: It takes more than raw strength to do what must be done.
64808.completion:
I think I understand.

<Anduin steels himself.>

I am ready to try again.
64808.objectives: Assist with the ritual and infuse the Shards of Domination.

64809.title: One Half of the Equation
64809.description:
The Primus's theory about the language of the First Ones has borne out. 

Still, it may not be enough. 

While the Primus finalizes his plans, let us go deep into the Endless Sands to find pieces of this power to infuse the helm. 

Darion, Taelia, and I will meet you there to help with the Mawsworn.
64809.completion:
The enemy is formidable, but with the strength of our arms and the power of the Broken Helm, we may be able to even the odds.

Though I admit, I have an extra sense of caution with my daughter in the field.

64810.title: Oppress and Destroy
64810.description:
What we seek is in the vaults of the Endless Sands. To reach them will require strength and numbers.

Together we will destroy the Mawsworn. 

I look forward to taking the fight directly to them.

Remember, they will be vulnerable to the broken shard from the Helm of Domination.
64810.completion:
Well done. 

Let us hope that this is last time we see the helm used as a weapon.
64810.objectives: Slay Mawsworn in the Endless Sands.

64811.title: Aggressive Excavation
64811.description:
Elder Eru said that we could find the most complex examples of the First Ones' language out here. 

We'll need to fight our way to the vaults, and then infuse the helm once we find those phrases.

On a personal note, I never thought I'd have the chance to fight alongside my father. Though with the stakes this high, it somehow feels like exactly the place I'm supposed to be.

I am ready when you are.
64811.completion:
We've done it. The broken half of the helm is infused with the most advanced pieces of the First Ones' power that we could readily find.

We are so close to success.

64812.title: Forge of Domination
64812.description:
We have all of the pieces we need. The broken half of the helm has been augmented with the complexity of the language of the First Ones, and the shards bear our memories. 

Our will to resist Domination.

All that remains is for the Primus to reforge the Helm, then we will be able to draw upon that combined power for ourselves.

I know that it is dangerous, but it is our only hope.
64812.completion: How appropriate that the place I was imprisoned in will be the setting for how we free ourselves.
64812.objectives: Travel to The Runecarver's Oubliette in Torghast.

64813.title: The Crown of Wills
64813.description:
When I created Domination, I did not foresee how much pain it would cause the realms. Not only the Shadowlands, but yours as well.

It is time we take this helm, this symbol of that magic, and reforge it anew. But, not for the same purpose it once had.

Let it represent the strength of will that you and your kind possess, so that it may help us overcome and defeat Zovaal at last.
64813.completion:
This is a power unlike any I have felt before. We have made something new.

It will be our key to defeating Zovaal.

64814.title: Battle for the Forge
64814.description:
Our forces have been holding out so far, but we have not secured the area. We could use some assistance cutting down the enemy's numbers.

This should be a simple task for you, Maw Walker.
64814.completion: We must remain vigilant. No one may pass our defenses.

64815.title: Together, We Ride
64815.description:
The four covenants are working together here along with the automa. 

Unfortunately, some of our soldiers have been separated or wounded and are unable to return back here.

If you could aid them, that would help tremendously.
64815.completion: The fewer losses we suffer here, the longer we can hold the line.

64816.title: Reality's Doorstep
64816.description:
The time has come to follow Zovaal into the very heart of the Shadowlands.

We must return to Zereth Mortis and finish this.
64816.completion: There is more work yet to do here in Zereth Mortis before Zovaal's influence will be expunged from the Shadowlands.

64817.title: In Plain Sight
64817.description:
That sound! It came from the direction of the obelisk at Provis Flora.

Impossible. We've let no one through. Hurry, {NAME}. Follow me!
64817.completion: They managed to hide themselves. This bodes poorly for us.
64817.objectives: Defend the obelisk at Provis Flora.

64818.title: Reinforcements May Be Necessary
64818.description:
The dreadlords infiltrated deep into our ranks. Bolvar must know what has happened.

I cannot leave my position here. Quickly, give him the news. Perhaps the Enlightened council will have advice as well.
64818.completion: Mograine will have the forces he needs.
64818.objectives: Speak with Bolvar Fordragon at Haven.

64820.title: This is Your Fault, Fix It
64820.description:
Provis Fauna is normally regulated by autonomous constructs, but there have been reports that they are no longer working.

According to the reports, you are the one responsible for the tampering of these nodes. Which means it is on you to fix them. Take this tuner, it should help--and once they are repaired, do not meddle with them again.
64820.completion: With the defenses working again, hopefully the Mawsworn presence diminishes.

64821.title: Nothing is True
64821.description:
If we are dealing with dreadlords, they could be disguised as anything... including the denizens of Zereth Mortis. Fortunately we have just the thing for dispelling their illusions. 

Search the fields and test the automa. If you find any dreadlords, take care of them.
64821.completion: That should slow down their plans. Good work, Maw Walker.

64822.title: A Break in Communication
64822.description:
Mograine's request for reinforcements is unusual. We were already planning on reinforcing the area, and sent three different outfits his way.

From the sound of it, none of them have arrived. See if you can find their commanders and make sure they make it to Mograine.
64822.completion: They claimed you gave them their previous orders? Strange.
64822.objectives: Reassign orders to three covenant commanders.

64823.title: Doppelganger Duel
64823.description:
Something about this doesn't sit right with me. From what you reported, this seems like intentional sabotage from within our ranks... or the work of more dreadlords. 

If dreadlords are involved, then the obelisk may be at risk! Get to it--if we linger on this it may be too late!
64823.progress: Time is of the essence here.
64823.completion:
Mal'ganis...

We are losing this race.
64823.objectives: Find the Mawsworn presence at the Circle of Thought.

64824.title: Fighting for the Forge
64824.description:
We made our way here as soon as we could. Anduin has been sighted near the structure in the middle of this land, referred to as the Forge of Afterlives.

No doubt the Jailer will join him soon. We need to leave immediately.
64824.objectives: Head to the Forge of Afterlives with Jaina.

64825.title: Seeking Haven
64825.description:
I am at a loss.

We have no way to follow Zovaal and Anduin. I'll open a portal back to Haven. We will discuss our next steps there.
64825.completion: We will look into how to follow them into the Sepulcher. Until then, you should focus your efforts on more immediate issues.
64825.objectives: Return to Haven with Jaina and Baine.

64829.title: Finding Tahli
64829.description:
After eons of tranquility, the Maw's influence has brought sorrow to Zereth Mortis. One of our acolytes, Tahli, has found it particularly difficult to process recent events. She left some time ago and has not returned. 

Will you check on her? She was last seen heading toward the ruins that are buried under the sands.
64829.completion: Even now, this place is beautiful.
64829.objectives: Find Tahli near the Arrangement Index.

64830.title: Enlisting the Enlightened
64830.description:
The fate of Sylvanas is not my immediate priority.

The Jailer has destroyed the Harmonic Channels, ensuring that we cannot follow him. 

Perhaps the studious Enlightened Brokers know something about these channels that will help us--but broker cooperation comes often with strings attached. 

Do whatever they demand. We must learn more.
64830.completion:
Zereth Mortis has the answers you seek.

If you know where to look.
64830.objectives: Persuade the Elders of Haven to offer their assistance.

64831.title: Remnants of the First Ones
64831.description:
Some evidence of the Mawsworn's destruction may remain in Provis Esper. Recovering that evidence will provide some clue as to how to follow this Jailer.

Let us hunt together. I will know the sign of the First Ones's magic when we are in its vicinity.
64831.progress: Have we found all of the remnants?
64831.completion:
Only inert remnants, unfortunately.

But do not lose hope, my friend!

64832.title: Reclaiming Provis Esper
64832.description:
Provis Esper is overrun with devourers, buzzing around like hungry vespoids.

They are destroying the local automa, which is not at all what the First Ones intended. A cleansing is in order.

For our safety and to restore the natural order, clear some of them out.
64832.completion: More devourers will come, but you have lessened their impact for now.
64832.objectives: Kill 20 Insatiable Mites, 5 Soul-Parched Gorgers, and 2 Reality Breachers.

64833.title: Forging Unity from Diversity
64833.description:
The other Elders follow a strict interpretation of how best to honor the works of the First Ones.

I am not so inflexible. Our end goal is the same. 

Let us return to the area where you last saw the Jailer.
64833.completion: The site below is crawling with devourers. But you can manage, yes?
64833.objectives: Meet Elder Ara above Provis Esper.

64834.title: Glow and Behold
64834.description:
Look, {NAME}. The remnants are faintly glowing!

They must be reacting to something in Pilgrim's Grace.

Find out what is causing this reaction!
64834.progress: The remnants reacted to this translocator? Incredible!
64834.completion:
So the remnants have something to do with the translocator. But what?

Whatever their prior function, they have no power now.
64834.objectives: Locate what is causing the Conduction Remnants to react.

64835.title: Pluck from the Vines
64835.description:
I ran, scrambling through the thorny foliage, the lashers snapping at my heels.

My fellow pilgrims were not so lucky. I could hear their screams of pain and horror as I fled.

You must find a way inside. Rescue them, {NAME}!
64835.progress: Have you rescued the missing pilgrims?
64835.completion: I cannot thank you enough for rescuing the pilgrims who could be saved.

64836.title: Nip It in the Bud
64836.description:
The Catalyst Wards used to be peaceful. Pilgrims have been coming here for ages to observe the wonders of the First Ones. But this place is no longer safe. The Cultivator showed no mercy and no reason as it slew several of our brethren.

You must destroy it.

Other Elders would disagree with me. The other Elders are wrong.
64836.progress: What could have caused the Cultivator to behave so irrationally... so violently?
64836.completion: Putting the Cultivator down was the right call.

64837.title: The Pilgrim's Journey
64837.description:
Pilgrim's Grace is a sacred site for the Enlightened. The Elders there have an intimate understanding of the creations of the First Ones.

We will find answers there about these strange remnants we have found.

Meet me at Pilgrim's Grace. It is not far.
64837.objectives: Meet Elder Ara at Pilgrim's Grace.

64838.title: Where There's a Pilgrim, There's a Way
64838.description:
If the remnants can be restored, someone in Pilgrim's Grace may know how.

Begin with Elder Nirav. I hope he is willing to help. He seems anxious and distracted today.

Find me in town when you are done.
64838.progress: Have you spoken to the Enlightened in Pilgrim's Grace?
64838.completion:
Feroz is our best bet? And he has gone missing along with several other pilgrims?

We should hurry.
64838.objectives: Speak to the inhabitants of Pilgrim's Grace.

64839.title: Root of the Problem
64839.description:
I suspect we can harness the growth energy present in these plants for our own purposes, but I will need fresh samples.

You can harvest energized plant matter from any of the lashers or vine-choked automa nearby, or those inside the Catalyst Wards.
64839.progress: Have you recovered the energized plant matter?
64839.completion: These roots are overflowing with growth energy.

64840.title: Unchecked Growth
64840.description:
This growth energy is highly unusual. I would like to know more about how it affects the local automa.

Harvest replicating essence from deceased automa in the Catalyst Gardens.

Bring it back to me for study.
64840.progress: Do you have the replicating essence?
64840.completion:
Hmm... it replicates rapidly until it kills the host. 

This is more of a curse than a gift!

64841.title: Take Charge
64841.description:
That floating structure looming overhead is the Creation Catalyst.

I cannot get close to it. The tower is overloaded with an excess of Progenitor energy. To travel there now would be suicide.

There are consoles in the gardens that can be used to discharge that energy. Do so.
64841.progress: Is it safe to fly up to the Creation Catalyst?
64841.objectives: Discharge the excess energy of the Creation Catalyst.

64842.title: Flora Frenzy
64842.description:
Those guardian automa will shoot down anything that attempts to reach the Creation Catalyst.

May I suggest fighting fire with fire? Or rather, fighting the creations of the First Ones with the creation energy of the First Ones?

I have had little time to adequately test my theory, but this potion should provide the boost you need to destroy them... ideally without dying from exposure to the creation energy in the process.
64842.progress: Your safety is probable, but not guaranteed.
64842.completion: It was quite poetic, I think, using their own growth energy against them.
64842.objectives: Drink Feroz's solution and destroy the automa of the Catalyst Gardens.

64843.title: Key Crafting
64843.description:
With those agitated automa quelled, there is but one task ahead.

We shall ferry you and your Enlightened companion up to the Creation Catalyst.

The rest is up to you.
64843.progress: It is incredible to see the Creation Catalyst up close.
64843.objectives: Restore the Translocator Key at the Creation Catalyst.

64844.title: The Pilgrimage Ends
64844.description:
You have rescued many pilgrims, and I have restored your entrance to the Sepulcher. With that, our bargain is concluded--and so, too, is my pilgrimage.

But your journey continues.

Return to the overlook behind Pilgrim's Grace and open the translocator.

My thanks, {NAME}. This adventure has been... enlightening.
64844.progress: Let us listen to what they have to say.
64844.completion: The next step is a large one. Are you ready, {NAME}?
64844.objectives: Return to the overlook behind Pilgrim's Grace.

64846.title: Torghast
64846.description: Countless souls are tortured in the halls of Torghast. They need your help!
64846.completion: Too many have been lost to Torghast. The way in is difficult... but not impossible.

64849.title: Tower of the Damned
64849.description:
We know little of Torghast. However, Fatescribe Roh-Tahl claims there is work that must be done there.

He believes there is a path for you to reach this place... and that someone there requires your aid.

Do what you must to reach Torghast and aid anyone who is within.
64849.completion:
Stay back! 

Wait... you're not one of the Jailer's forces.

Box! We have a visitor, play the nice music would you?
64849.objectives: Travel to Torghast by jumping into the Ring of Transference, then find any entity there that needs your aid.

64850.title: Traversing Torghast
64850.description:
I've heard of you, the Maw Walker! You must know of me, the legendary Ve'nish.

I am here to find great treasures within Torghast with the aid of my box. I can see you admiring it.

Perhaps we can work together. Why don't you go into Torghast ahead of me to scout ahead?

I shall even reward you for anything you discover within.
64850.progress: How goes exploring the darkness of Torghast?
64850.completion:
Ah, the place is filled to the brink with all sorts of terrible creatures... and also plenty of powers!

Perfect! Did you hear that, box? We'll find plenty in this place... perhaps even more than that coward Ve'nari out in the Maw.

Ahem, thank you, Maw Walker. You've done your part well. I shall have more questions later.

64852.title: Aeon Matrix
64852.description: <Firim could make use of this item>
64852.completion: This is just what I needed! Take this in appreciation for your efforts!

64853.title: Two Paths to Tread
64853.description:
Did that answer your question?

Oh, you wanted a way to completely resist Domination magic? That I'm afraid I do not know. The First Ones' language will only delay the inevitable.

What I can tell you is that if you want to find more deliciously complex phrases of the First Ones' language, you should go to the Endless Sands and search the vaults.

I wish I could go myself, but it has been overrun by those nasty Mawsworn.

Good luck with the rest of your studies!
64853.completion:
This Elder has given us an important answer to this puzzle. But now we must act on the information. Though, doing so will be difficult.

First we must infuse the helm with those indecipherable phrases from the First Ones that are in the Endless Sands.

But that will not be enough on its own. We will need more. Let me prepare, while you acquire what we need. I will send word for you after.
64853.objectives: Report to the Primus in the Geometric Cavern.

64854.title: Trappings of Success
64854.description:
The wildlife of Zereth Mortis are attracted to the frenetic creation energy that flows throughout the land. When the wildlife finds something charged with that energy... they eat it!

The Mawsworn Cryptoseers have become aware of this and are attempting to find such wildlife to extract any remnants of that energy.

Eliminate the Cryptoseers, and use the Containment Trap to subdue and examine the wildlife for our research.
64854.progress: You have collected data before the Cryptoseers?
64854.completion: This information will help us continue to unravel the mysteries of Zereth Mortis.
64854.objectives: Slay 5 Mawsworn Cryptoseers and examine the wildlife listed.

64860.title: Aetheric Lattice
64860.description: <Firim could make use of this item>
64860.completion: This is just what I needed! Take this in appreciation for your efforts!

64861.title: Kismetric Disc
64861.description: <Firim could make use of this item>
64861.completion: This is just what I needed! Take this in appreciation for your efforts!

64863.title: Arcane Guardians
64863.description:
Those constructs patrolling the creche are not animated by the Earth-Warder's magic.

<Dervishian narrows her eyes.>

We cannot allow there to be enemies in our midst.

Destroy them to clear our path forward.
64863.progress: Who would dare defy the Earth-Warder in this way?
64863.completion:
Those constructs were animated with blue dragonflight magic. 

The Earth-Warder would never have allowed this!

64864.title: Awaken, Dracthyr
64864.description:
<Only flashes of memory remain as you shake off what feels like an endless sleep.

The dracthyr before you is unresponsive, frozen in place by some unknown magic. You sense that within you lies the power to break your ally free.

There may be others within the creche who are suspended in this stasis.

It is your duty to awaken them.>
64864.completion:
<Azurathel listens to your report.>

My memories are as broken as yours, {NAME}. But we cannot dwell on that now.

We need to assess and make a plan.

64865.title: Gear Up
64865.description:
Hostiles have invaded, our people have been confined in magical stasis, and our creche seems to be collapsing.

This is why we train, {NAME}. When in doubt, fall back to what you know.

First things first. Weapons, armor, supplies. Gather what you can find and get equipped while I marshal our forces.

Then we will locate the Earth-Warder. Surely Neltharion can provide the answers we seek.
64865.progress: When memory fails, fall back on your training.
64865.completion:
This gear is ancient, and the food has turned to dust.

It makes no sense... those rations should have lasted a lifetime.

Well, we will make do with what we have.

64866.title: Into the Cauldron
64866.description:
Your skills are needed, evoker.

The creche is crumbling and we have few supplies. We must reach the passage out, but we have to get past this arcane barrier first.

In the chamber beyond, there are dracthyr in need of aid. Tend their wounds. Destroy any foe who stands in your way.

This may be the last time we walk these halls together, {NAME}. Make it count.
64866.completion:
You healed our people. Well done.

Now to deal with that dragon.

64870.title: Paragon of Enlightened Brokers
64870.description: My, my. You've been busy, haven't you?
64870.objectives: Speak with Vilo at Haven in Zereth Mortis.

64871.title: The Dragon at the Door
64871.description:
That blue dragon will collapse the creche and trap us inside!

He claims to serve Malygos. That name is familiar, but... why would any dragon want to keep us prisoner?

Listen, $p. We were trained to fight beside the dragons, not against them. But we have been left with no choice.

Time to do what must be done, evoker.
64871.completion:
We will get that rubble cleared and make sure no {race} is left behind.

But first, we need to secure this area.
64871.objectives: Defeat Lapisagos and escape the War Creche.

64872.title: The Fire Within
64872.description:
You are an evoker, {NAME}. The best of the best. An elite soldier who has mastered the skills of each of our weyrns.

I expect a lot of you.

Your memories may be broken, but the might of dragons courses through your veins. Harness it.

One of your most potent weapons is your breath attack. The fire within becomes more powerful the longer you inhale.

These insects swarming over our training grounds should make fine targets.
64872.progress: A nice, deep breath clears the head.
64872.completion:
Good. You remember your training.

Keep your head low and your lungs full.
64872.objectives: Learn Fire Breath and practice empowered attacks.

64873.title: Stretch Your Wings
64873.description:
I am heartened to see that so many escaped the War Creche. My own weyrn... was not as fortunate.

<Emberthal stands in silence for a moment.>

There are other creches throughout the Reach, filled with dracthyr in peril. Strong wings will be needed to reach them.

Focus. Remember your training. Get a feel for the wind again. You must regain your strength and fly to the other creches.

The time for rest is over.
64873.completion:
You are getting the hang of this a lot faster than I was!

But then, you finished your {class} training. I was hoping to specialize as a diplomat.

64875.title: Something Wonderful
64875.description:
{NAME}, I am so glad you are here! Firim sent me to find you.

It's the oracle, it... well... it's hard to describe. You should come see it for yourself. Hurry!
64875.progress: We must hurry, {NAME}. We do not know how long this will last.
64875.completion: We may be on the cusp of a wondrous revelation!
64875.objectives: Travel to Exile's Hollow to witness for yourself what is happening to Saezurah.

64876.title: Music of the Spheres
64876.description:
It started gradually, the energy emanating from the oracle in increasing amounts, until the grand design you see before you took shape.

The terrible clamor ringing in our ears began shortly afterward.

My attempts to approach the fractals have been... unsuccessful. But they appear to resonate with Pocopoc.

You share a special bond with it; perhaps you shall have better luck than I.
64876.completion: A vision! The oracle communicates with us! You saw it too? Such magnificence! Such... a migraine left in its wake.
64876.objectives: Examine the fractals that surround Saezurah's body.

64878.title: What a Long Strange Trip
64878.description:
<The voice from the vision speaks through Pocopoc, albeit distant and distorted.>

I... am Saezurah. Oracle. This automa... speaks with my voice. Acts with my will. For now.

The pattern... is torn. Disrupted. Mending must be done.

A great hunger swarms the sands. What it seeks must not be consumed.

Journey with me. Follow my voice.
64878.progress: Pocopoc has not reached the destination yet.
64878.completion: Above the sands. Above us. The vessel awaits.
64878.objectives: Go with Pocopoc to make sense of your vision.

64879.title: A Monumental Discovery
64879.description:
Maw Walker--Pelagos stopped by earlier to give a report and said that the oracle's preparations were complete, and you were urgently needed. 

If this is something that can help our efforts, I want you involved. Head to Exile's Hollow and see what they need.
64879.completion: Mortal, I have monumental news. Saezurah has indicated that preparations are complete. It is time to create a new Arbiter!

64888.title: Borrowed Power
64888.description:
The land provides. The land thirsts. Invaders devour what we require.

Reclaim what has been consumed. Absorb what remains abundant.

Wings need wind to fly. We need power to ascend.
64888.completion: Power thrums. A renewal of hope.
64888.objectives: Defeat volatile lured enemies or soak power from pools to reclaim Cosmic Energy to empower Pocopoc.

64889.title: Match Made in Zereth Mortis
64889.description:
The cyphers are the key. Each one, a step along the path. You must find them all.

Enter the inner chamber. The Prime Locus Arrangement awaits.

The first step toward ascension. Toward the vessel.
64889.progress: Need to gather the cyphers to reach the door where the vessel waits.
64889.completion: The last leg of the journey begins.
64889.objectives: Study the Locus Arrangements and use the Locus Shift to reach the Ultimus Locus.

64935.title: Between a Rock & a Rock
64935.description:
<Piles of rock are scattered around the area. The devourers have done enough damage to obscure the cypher you seek.

Perhaps one of the nearby servitors could be made to clear the rubble.>
64935.progress: Until we discover the cypher, we need to keep smashing rubble.
64935.objectives: Smash the rubble barring access to the secundus locus arrangement.

64936.title: Searching High and Low
64936.description:
Three locks upon the door, three keys hidden atop the zenith.

Find the phrases. Speak the words. Secure the vessel.
64936.objectives: Gather the Ingress Phrases on the Ultimus Locus that are needed to claim the Vessel.

64937.title: You Light Up My Life
64937.description:
Great power entices great hunger. The insatiable devourers scale the cliffs in search of sustenance.

Soon they will swarm the plateau. They seek to consume all they encounter. The vessel. Its power. Us.

This must not come to pass. Wield this automa. Silence their slavering howls.
64937.completion: Sanctuary, for now. A greater task remains.
64937.objectives: Use Pocopoc to defend the vessel against the devourers.

64941.title: Chicken Soul
64941.description: <The Chicken Soul is perky and voracious. The shape of the chicken will be yours to call upon.>
64941.objectives: Bring the Chicken Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

64942.title: Call of the Primus
64942.description:
Though we fought to stop the Jailer in the Sanctum of Domination, we failed. He enveloped Oribos in the Maw, struck down the Arbiter, and opened the way to Zereth Mortis. 

The time has come to follow him. 

Within the Arbiter's Chamber, we will forge our own path.

Hurry, Maw Walker. The fate of the Shadowlands, and all the realms beyond, is at stake.
64942.completion: There is but one final sigil needed to pursue Zovaal.
64942.objectives: Speak with Tal-Inara in Oribos to travel to the Arbiter's Chamber.

64944.title: A Hasty Voyage
64944.description:
The path to Zereth Mortis is open.

We must part ways here. The Eternal Ones are forbidden from returning to the place of our creation. Zovaal has defied the most sacred laws of the Progenitors.

You must undertake this journey alone.

Go. Find a foothold in Zereth Mortis so that we can send the covenant forces through.

Then we will pursue the Jailer and end his madness.
64944.objectives: Begin your journey to Zereth Mortis by mounting the anima wyrm.

64945.title: Strangers in a Strange Land
64945.description:
Did we... did we reach Zereth Mortis? And are we walking on water?

What a wondrous place! At least, from what I can tell through this fog.

I think I can make out a structure in the distance. Perhaps we will find answers there.
64945.completion: I will not abide agents of the Jailer defiling this land!
64945.objectives: Accompany Pelagos and explore your surroundings.

64947.title: Give Me A Hand
64947.description:
To drive the Jailer from Zereth Mortis, we must direct all our resources against the enemy.

An object of potential power lies in a nearby repository, but the chamber's defenses respond only to automa. I would never harm their kind, but I have encountered one that no longer functions.

If you extract its hand, we could use the inert appendage to gain access to the repository.

I find such use of the First Ones' creations unsavory, but we cannot abide the presence of Mawsworn in this realm.
64947.completion: Admittedly, I did not foresee this result.

64949.title: For Research Purposes
64949.description:
I have taken pains not to disturb the automa during my time in Zereth Mortis, and so far they have paid little attention to me.

It seems recent events have changed that.

Again, let me be clear that I have no wish to harm the creations of the First Ones. But if, in the course of your efforts, conflict with the automa becomes inevitable, we must ensure that some good can come of it.

If I can examine fragments of fallen automa, it may provide knowledge to use against the Mawsworn.

Go carefully.
64949.progress: Did you find any useful fragments?
64949.completion: Though the loss of automa is unfortunate, these fragments could prove a boon to my research.
64949.objectives: Collect 12 Intact Automa Fragments from Alerted Automa within Genesis Vestibule.

64950.title: A Mutual Exchange
64950.description:
It seems the other automa did not appreciate our appropriation of their colleague's hand. They have become hostile.

Unfortunate, but we cannot allow this to impede our progress.

The automa's hand should activate a console within the Genesis Repository. I believe it holds an object of great potential.

After you acquire it, I will guide you to a place that may provide a means to reach the allies you left behind.

Do we have an accord?
64950.progress: Did you acquire the object from the console?
64950.completion:
<Firim snatches the core from your hands.>

Intriguing. I have examined many automa cores, but this one glows with an energy unlike any I have seen before.
64950.objectives: Use the Automa Hand to activate an Automa Console and obtain the Repository Treasure.

64951.title: The Road to Haven
64951.description:
I did not expect to encounter a living mortal and a kyrian this day, but your assistance has been valuable.

Before I begin my studies of this automa core, I will guide you to Haven, the settlement founded by my expedition upon our arrival.

Though my colleagues saw fit to exile me for challenging their "Enlightened" dogma, I have no wish to see Haven wiped from existence by the Jailer.

Aid them and they may assist your efforts to return to your allies. We brokers are nothing if not transactional.
64951.completion:
I can go no further.

My former colleagues and I have... philosophical differences.
64951.objectives: Ride with Firim out of the Genesis Repository.

64952.title: Destroying the Destructors
64952.description:
The Mawsworn possess terrible weapons that gather dark magic and hurl it against our gates.

The defensive barrier around Haven will not hold much longer. All that we are, all that we hold dear, will soon be erased from existence.

If you are who you claim to be, then prove it to us. Destroy the enemy's armaments and help defend our home.

I pray to the First Ones that you succeed.
64952.completion: You have bought us time, mortal. First Ones bless us all.

64953.title: Defending Haven
64953.description:
The Mawsworn are gathering in force outside our very gates. It is clear they mean to overrun our home!

The Enlightened wish only to honor the marvels of the First Ones in peace. Haven's defensive barrier was put in place to shield us from minor threats. We did not imagine the Jailer would send his forces against us.

You claim to be our ally, mortal? Then help us defend this sacred land.
64953.progress: Our pilgrims cannot continue like this.
64953.completion: You have proven your mettle, yet the enemy grows bolder.
64953.objectives: Defeat 13 Mawsworn in the Great Veldt.

64957.title: This Old Waystone
64957.description:
The Jailer has withdrawn his forces. I should be relieved, but I fear this means he has found a way into the Sepulcher.

<Elder Ara trembles.>

Despite Elder Kreth's doubts, you have proven to be an ally. Something we need more of.

When our expedition arrived in Zereth Mortis, we discovered a dormant waystone. If you are indeed a Maw Walker, then the prophecies tell us that you will be able to activate it.

If your allies can save this sacred place, then the path to them must be opened.

Come.
64957.completion: Maw Walker! Thank the Light you and Pelagos are safe!

64958.title: The Forces Gather
64958.description:
I am relieved that you survived the passage to Zereth Mortis. From what I've overheard of Pelagos's conversation with Kleia, it sounds like you had an incredible journey.

These Enlightened brokers could make valuable allies. Their knowledge of the automa and the land itself should help us against the Jailer.

Our forces are gathered and ready to follow you to Zereth Mortis.

The final battle lies before us, $p.
64958.completion:
You defended Haven, and now you bring allies to preserve this sacred land.

Blessings of the First Ones be upon you, mortal.
64958.objectives: Speak to Elder Kreth in Zereth Mortis.

64959.title: Otter Soul
64959.description: <The Otter Soul is swift and boastful. The shape of the otter will be yours to call upon.>
64959.objectives: Bring the Otter Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

64961.title: Cat Soul
64961.description: <The Cat Soul is elegant and inquisitive. The shape of the cat will be yours to call upon.>
64961.objectives: Bring the Cat Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

64962.title: As Foretold
64962.description: The spheres are in place. A melody builds. Go--bring forth the chorus of Scryers, that the cycle of rebirth may begin.
64962.completion: The rustle of creation, whisper in the dark. We may begin.
64962.objectives: Bring Firim and the Scryers to the center.

64963.title: A Defector's Request
64963.description:
<Unrolling the scroll, you can make out that it's a coded arms requisition from the Maldraxxi of Death's End to their venthyr allies... all servants of the Jailer.

Surely someone among the Death's Advance in Korthia will be able to help you fully break the code and learn exactly what they were planning.>
64963.completion:
<A smile creeps across Duchess Mynx's face as she looks over the scroll you provided. A moment later, an echoing laugh bursts from her.>

The forces of the Jailer use such pathetic codes! This scroll of yours doesn't say where, but it seems there's a weapons cache ready to be claimed. A team of your allies should be able to investigate and retrieve it without too much trouble.
64963.objectives: Deliver the missive to Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite in Korthia.

64964.title: Choose Your Fighter
64964.description:
The presence of the Jailer's forces at Provis Strata have been causing untold damage to the region. If left unchecked, we will lose all knowledge in the area.

One of our kin has prepared some automa to deal with the Mawsworn. Meet with them, and fight back against those who would disrespect Zereth Mortis in this manner.
64964.objectives: Pick an automa construct and use it against the Mawsworn.

64969.title: In the Weeds
64969.description:
I understand now why Elder Nirav is filled with worry.

Many of the pilgrims who have journeyed to the Catalyst Wards have not returned. This includes Feroz, who is most likely to have information we need to restore the remnants. 

Prepare yourself. The First Ones's newest creations are prevalent at the Catalyst. If something has gone wrong there, it could be tragically dangerous.
64969.completion:
Feroz explained what happened to the missing pilgrims.

They are trapped inside the Catalyst Wards!
64969.objectives: Meet Elder Ara outside the Catalyst Wards.

64970.title: Timeworn Keystone: The Broken Isles
64970.description:
I recently came into possession of a unique keystone. It may look old and worn, but I believe it still has a story to tell.

Take it with you. Perhaps it will serve as a reminder of adventures long past. Adventures I hope you will tell me about, of course.
64970.completion: Your tales of adventure are most exciting, my friend! Please, allow me to offer a token of my gratitude.

64977.title: Step Into the Ring
64977.description:
One of the remarkable things we have found about these lands is that they seem to be adaptive and changing, even as ancient as they are. Things are not stationary.

In the depths of the Nexus of Actualization there is a forge that appears made to test these various designs, and to learn. These creatures may one day be used to defend Zereth Mortis from threats, so you should test their effectiveness where possible.

Go there, challenge what the forge creates and report back to me.
64977.completion: What a remarkable device. Of course there is clearly some improvement to be made in what it creates. But perhaps it will learn from the lessons you have provided.
64977.objectives: Defeat Generated creations in the Nexus of Actualization.

64984.title: Bunny Soul
64984.description: <The Bunny Soul is clever and quick. The shape of the bunny will be yours to call upon.>
64984.objectives: Bring the Bunny Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

64985.title: Rat Soul
64985.description: <The Rat Soul is curious and sociable. The shape of the rat will be yours to call upon.>
64985.objectives: Bring the Rat Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

64988.title: Snake Soul
64988.description: <The Snake Soul is patient and watchful. The shape of the snake will be yours to call upon.>
64988.objectives: Bring the Snake Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

64989.title: Porcupine Soul
64989.description: <The Porcupine Soul is cautious and shy. The shape of the porcupine will be yours to call upon.>
64989.objectives: Bring the Porcupine Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

64990.title: Cricket Soul
64990.description: <The Cricket Soul is a lucky one. The shape of the cricket will be yours to call upon.>
64990.objectives: Bring the Cricket Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

64992.title: Prairie Dog Soul
64992.description: <The Prairie Dog Soul is ever alert. The shape of the prairie dog will be yours to call upon.>
64992.objectives: Bring the Prairie Dog Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

64993.title: Saurolisk Hatchling Soul
64993.description: <The Saurolisk Hatchling Soul is tenacious and fierce. The shape of the saurolisk hatchling will be yours to call upon.>
64993.objectives: Bring the Saurolisk Hatchling Soull to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

64994.title: Frog Soul
64994.description: <The Frog Soul is a joyful one, filled with song. The shape of the frog will be yours to call upon.>
64994.objectives: Bring the Frog Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

64995.title: Saurid Soul
64995.description: <The Saurid Soul is a mischievous and playful one. The shape of the saurid will be yours to call upon.>
64995.objectives: Bring the Saurid Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

65008.title: Goat Soul
65008.description: <The Goat Soul is stoic and unwavering. The shape of the goat will be yours to call upon.>
65008.objectives: Bring the Goat Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65009.title: Ram Soul
65009.description: <The Ram Soul is brave and fierce. The shape of the ram will be yours to call upon.>
65009.objectives: Bring the Ram Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65010.title: Alpaca Soul
65010.description: <The Alpaca Soul is wary and alert. The shape of the alpaca will be yours to call upon.>
65010.objectives: Bring the Alpaca Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65020.title: Practical Applications
65020.description:
Greetings, Maw Walker.

I am pleased to announce that we have accumulated the relevant research necessary to set up a Field Anima Diverter.

Please find a suitable location for it in the Reliquary, preferably where it will not be impacted by interference from other anima-charged relics.
65020.completion:
That is a fine spot for the Field Anima Diverter.

Perhaps one of the greatest benefits of our research is a reduction of expended effort.
65020.objectives: Place the Field Anima Diverter in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

65021.title: Eagle Soul
65021.description: <The Eagle Soul is brave and alert. The shape of the eagle will be yours to call upon.>
65021.objectives: Bring the Eagle Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65022.title: Sporebat Soul
65022.description: <The Sporebat Soul is quick and alert. The shape of the sporebat will be yours to call upon.>
65022.objectives: Bring the Sporebat Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65023.title: Jormungar Soul
65023.description: <The Jormungar Soul is fierce and determined. The shape of the jormungar will be yours to call upon.>
65023.objectives: Bring the Jormungar Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65024.title: Cloud Serpent Soul
65024.description: <The Cloud Serpent Soul is energetic and loyal. The shape of the cloud serpent will be yours to call upon.>
65024.objectives: Bring the Cloud Serpent Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65025.title: Boar Soul
65025.description: <The Boar Soul is fierce and cunning. The shape of the boar will be yours to call upon.>
65025.objectives: Bring the Boar Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65026.title: Owl Soul
65026.description: <The Owl Soul is solemn and smart. The shape of the owl will be yours to call upon.>
65026.objectives: Bring the Owl Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65031.title: Battlegrounds
65031.description:
Champions of the Horde and Alliance continue to fight across countless battlegrounds. The brokers of Cartel Zo are paying combatants in order to observe their tactics.

Will you answer the call and join the fray?
65031.completion: The brokers of Cartel Zo will certainly be pleased by your choice.

65032.title: Battleground Observers
65032.description:
Zo'sorg and the other brokers of Cartel Zo can be found just down the hall.

They will certainly be eager to hear that large-scale battles are included in the Purpose.
65032.completion: Cartel Zo is a reliable partner. You have chosen well.
65032.objectives: Speak with Strategist Zo'rak in Oribos.

65033.title: Observing Victory
65033.description:
The threads of fate have called you to the realm of conflict, $p.

Will you rise to the challenge issued by your territorial rivals? Will you face them in combat and emerge victorious?

If you allow me to observe your victory, I will pay you your worth.
65033.completion: Victory is never assured. Return tomorrow for another observation.

65034.title: Return to Oribos
65034.description:
Return tomorrow for another observation.

Until then, Tal-Inara will be able to help direct your efforts in a productive manner.
65034.completion: Cartel Zo speaks highly of your efforts. The Purpose is clear.

65035.title: Return to Oribos
65035.description:
You have been fantastic to work with, Maw Walker. You should bring this information back to whoever sent you here.

Me? Oh, I'm staying here with my helpful box. 

Feel free to come back whenever you want. I may even have more tasks for you to do!
65035.completion:
You encountered a crazed broker and a... box? 

I am relieved you made it back in one piece, Maw Walker.

65036.title: Train Like We Fight
65036.description:
Jumping through hoops is helpful to get your bearings, but we train like we fight--relentlessly.

Go ahead and try Soaring around the area until you feel you have mastered the technique. Of course you must be mindful of the local wildlife and keep an eye out for any potential threats. That is why we practice, after all.

Report back to Emberthal when you feel you are ready. Good luck!
65036.completion: Time runs short. A storm approaches.

65045.title: Stormsunder Crater
65045.description:
Dervishian's report is troubling. An enemy force calling themselves the Primalists have invaded Stormsunder Crater, pinning the Ebon Scales down at the Siege Creche.

These intruders are summoning violent elementals and recruiting the vicious tarasek to their cause. 

Azurathel will need your help at the crater. By wing or by talon, save our people.

Once the Ebon Scales are safe, ask their commander to rendezvous with me. Be warned. Sarkareth can be... prickly.
65045.completion: Well, {class}, I hope you are ready to get your talons dirty.

65046.title: The Primalists
65046.description:
My memories are still clouded from stasis, but I am certain we have encountered these Primalists before.

<Dervishian grits her fangs.>

It is no use. Trying to remember feels like chasing fragments of a dream.

Perhaps you can fare better. Look for any clues as to what--or who--motivates these invaders.
65046.completion:
The Primalist speaks of unleashing a terrible storm.

Could an even greater threat be locked away somewhere on the Reach?
65046.objectives: Find clues about the Primalists' origins and intentions.

65049.title: Tangle with the Tarasek
65049.description:
The tarasek are unpredictable and wild. Like primordial drakonid, if you will.

Neltharion considered them little more than fodder. Targets for our training. But they are cunning hunters, and deadly when encountered in packs.

Should they gain elemental power from these Primalists, they will become even more dangerous.

We cannot let that happen, {NAME}. Thin their numbers.
65049.completion:
Do not mourn the loss of a few tarasek.

Where there is one, scores more lurk in the shadows.

65050.title: Conjured Army
65050.description:
These Primalists are summoning an army of elementals. We have to assume they mean to unleash them against our forces.

Well, not on our watch.

Rain fire upon them, evoker! Burn those elementals from the Reach, and take out their conjurers before they summon more.
65050.progress: Where are they drawing all of this power from? And to what end?
65050.completion: Conjured elementals may not be the most satisfying foe, but it does feel good to stretch our wings again.

65052.title: The Ebon Scales
65052.description:
We got past the Primalist incursion. Now we must reach the creche.

Scalecommander Sarkareth is as tough as they come, and his weyrn holds the line. But a dragon has the Ebon Scales pinned down. 

Time for us to join the fight!

Take point. Give the signal when we are in range of the dragon. Then we hit it with everything we have.

Watch out for ambushes. I have a bad feeling about this.
65052.completion:
You fight well, {class}, but we had this under control.

The Ebon Scales look after our own.

65057.title: Rally to Emberthal
65057.description:
Now that the fight is done, you ask me to report in to Emberthal. Does Azurathel expect me to follow her commands?

I think not.

The Ebon Scales answer only to the Earth-Warder. And thus far, I have received no orders from Neltharion.

<Sarkareth glowers.>

Still, I am not blind to the threat these Primalists represent. I am certain I have fought their kind before, and yet...

We will rally to the grounds once my people have recovered. You are dismissed, evoker.
65057.completion:
The Primalists empowered their leader in some kind of ritual?

Tell me everything.

65060.title: Caldera of the Menders
65060.description:
Your vision from the arcane beacon showed that there are dracthyr trapped within their creches. We cannot afford to lose any more of our people.

<Emberthal pauses, her brow furrowed.>

The Healing Wings are the finest medics in our ranks. Their creche lies within the Caldera of the Menders. Cindrethresh knows the way.

Leave no one behind, evoker.
65060.completion:
Look at all these wounded...

There are more Menders inside. We need to help them!
65060.objectives: Meet Cindrethresh in the Caldera of the Menders.

65063.title: Into the Hive
65063.description:
Whatever toxin has infested this creche is potent enough to take down our best healers.

That does not bode well for either one of us, {NAME}.

No matter. Dracthyr are trapped inside. We are going in, regardless of risk.

Take a deep breath and follow me!
65063.completion:
Good. You are awake.

<Viridia coughs to clear her throat.>

We need an {class}'s skills right now.

65064.title: Look Who I Found!
65064.description:
Behold this magnificent creature!

Siloh says we have no resources for another of my "abnormal pets."

But we may be able to alter E'rnee so that I can keep him. Strange interactions occur between creatures and this environment. Perhaps we can make him smaller.

I know a spot where we can conduct our research. There are flowers nearby called chromatic rosids that might trigger a reaction. Why don't you collect some on the way?
65064.progress: We must find a way to keep E'rnee.
65064.completion: Perhaps we should do some experiments with other subjects before trying things out on E'rnee.
65064.objectives: Retrieve 6 Chromatic Rosids near Dimensional Falls.

65065.title: The Tuskarr
65065.description:
Oh, excuse me but we did not know your kind was on this island. We are only newly arrived to these shores looking for a unclaimed land to call a home. We mean no harm and will move on if this land truly is forbidden.

My son To'no is quite the fan of dragonkin of all sorts and I am sure would have many questions for you. He is my little explorer. If you see him before I do know that you may be accosted by many questions.

Now where did that little moo get to...?
65065.completion:
Oh! Dragonkin! You are skinnier than the others. Oh! And you have wings! 

Um... halp?

65066.title: Flora Aroma
65066.description:
Perhaps we should not experiment on E'rnee without first knowing the effects.

Hang on to the rest of these rosids. We can run more tests. Some of the creatures here near the waterfall are more tame than others, and will be suitable for such experimentation.

Let us discover whether different creatures have diverse responses to the rosid aroma.
65066.progress: Those rosids have such an odd aroma... Perhaps creatures will respond to it in unique ways.
65066.objectives: Experiment with Chromatic Rosids near Dimensional Falls.

65067.title: Broker Beaker
65067.description:
I was running some experiments of my own before you got here.

Those tests... did not go too well. It turns out some environmental components can aggravate the creatures, turning even the most docile into predators.

I dropped my component container and ran, and I cannot recall where I left it.

The beaker must be somewhere among the herd of carnivorous cervids. If these flowers do not work, we will need that container for our next round of tests.
65067.progress: Be careful with those carnivorous cervids--they bite!
65067.completion: Ah. This will certainly be useful.
65067.objectives: Retrieve the Component Beaker from Carnivorous Cervids near Dimensional Falls.

65068.title: Cascades of Magnitude
65068.description:
Many of the creatures here at Dimensional Falls are particularly affected by the environment. Hmm... let us experiment with the waterfalls themselves!

We have seen unique effects from various natural components here in Zereth Mortis. Why not the water as well?

Collect some water, then sprinkle it on a creature in the Falls to see what happens.
65068.progress: These Falls must contain magic we cannot even comprehend.
65068.objectives: Experiment with waterfall water in Dimensional Falls.

65069.title: Culling the Maelstrom
65069.description:
Those little E'rnee duplicates were unfriendly.

Some effect of the Falls created them. They are not stable. Did you see where they went? 

They must be culled before they harm the rest of the wildlife. You take care of that while I collect another sample from the Falls.
65069.completion: Oh my... what happened to you?

65070.title: Can I Keep Him?
65070.description:
Oh, no. I have created havoc in this sacred place.

Look. E'rnee has bonded with you. It pains me, but you would be a better caretaker for him than I have been.

Once we resolve this, you should take him.

Now we know, at least, that the Falls have the ability to change the size of creatures. Let us try it again.
65070.progress: If this does not work, we can always try again!
65070.completion:
It worked! I cannot thank you enough for your help. And now, he is yours. Take good care of him.

Goodbye, E'rnee.

65071.title: Halp!
65071.description:
I need halp!

I am To'no and I was exploring cuz that is what I am good at but I did not realize my sister Ko followed me and I need you to halp me find her cuz she is in trouble so please halp please?

She went into this cave but she is not as good at hiding as I am and our parents are too far away to halp. 

Can you find her before the monsters do?

65072.title: Not Safe for Work
65072.description:
Rana's discovery of Progenitor relics at the Ageless Shards has created quite a stir among the Enlightened. These relics predate our earlier discoveries, and through them we may gain a deeper understanding of the workings of Zereth Mortis.

Rana is collecting the relics, but I fear she is in danger. Agents of Cartel Xy have been spotted in the area, and will likely attempt to steal the relics.

Please travel to the Ageless Shards, and help Rana collect the relics.
65072.progress: Have you collected the Progenitor Relics?
65072.objectives: Assist Rana in her search and collect 8 Progenitor Relics.

65073.title: A Toxic Problem
65073.description:
You recover quickly, {NAME}. Good.

Those who escaped my creche are healing, but others remain trapped inside. Rush in to save them and I will just have to drag you out again.

There are beetle nests scattered around the caldera. Their toxin glands might provide a way to counter the effects of that poison.

I am in no shape to collect them myself. I must rely upon your skills, evoker.
65073.completion:
Good. These are just what I needed.

I will work on something to counter the toxin and get you back into the creche.

65074.title: Easy Prey
65074.description:
The wilds surrounding this creche are home to scythid. They are voracious insectoids, often territorial and aggressive. 

All these wounded would be easy prey for those beasts. I do not want them attacking our Menders while they recover.

Cull their numbers while I look after Viridia.

She is.. very brave.
65074.progress: The menders do not need any more stress.
65074.completion: The scythid were always formidable, but it seems during our stasis they have grown even larger and more threatening.

65075.title: The Healing Wings
65075.description:
Evoker, you have my gratitude for aiding my weyrn in our most desperate hour.

After we regain our strength, the Healing Wings will rendezvous with the rest of our forces.

Cindre tells me that Emberthal lost everyone from her weyrn. I fear I have no magic that can heal such a wound.

She may seem stoic, but Emberthal feels this loss deeply, {NAME}. Tell her I am on my way.
65075.completion:
I am relieved that Viridia lives.

If what Dervishian says is true, we will have need of her talents in the battle to come.

65080.title: Anima, Diverted
65080.description:
Now, for the moment of truth.

Deposit any anima on your person at the Field Anima Diverter behind me.

With any luck, you will not experience any side effects - loss of anima, loss of consciousness, loss of memory. That sort of thing.
65080.progress: Were you able to deposit your anima at the Field Anima Diverter?
65080.objectives: Deposit anima at the Field Anima Diverter in the Reliquary of Remembrance.

65084.title: The Froststone Vault
65084.description:
Look there, across the Reach! Primalist forces are converging on Froststone Vault.

The storm they seek to unleash must be locked inside.

<Emberthal winces, wrestling with her broken memories.>

We fought this enemy before, and won. Neltharion commanded that the vault be secured, but I... cannot remember why...

This is no time for contemplation. Rally with Sarkareth and the Ebon Scales at the vault. Ensure the enemy does not breach it!
65084.completion: Steady there, {class}. The Ebon Scales will put an end to this incursion.

65087.title: The Prize Inside
65087.description:
So the Primalists want what's inside this vault?

<Sarkareth narrows his eyes.>

Let them come.

We will show them what the dracthyr were born to do!
65087.progress:
We are not defending a creche. We are defending something far more dangerous. I can feel it.

The magic behind that barrier is fighting to get out. Stand your ground and do NOT let these Primalists pass.
65087.completion:
We are overrun! They are about to breach the vault!

Where are those black dragons?!

65090.title: Return More Lost Souls
65090.description:
Souls still continue to pour into the Maw. Can you venture out again to save more?

We must thwart his plans.

Return to the Maw and rescue any more that you can.
65090.completion:
Oh, you found so many more deserving souls!

I will make sure these souls are well taken care of here in Ardenweald.

65096.title: Your Death Or Mine
65096.description:
We have obtained a wealth of information from relics discovered at the Ageless Shards. 

The Mawsworn are aware of our discoveries, and are trying to stop us. They have placed traps around the area to block access to the relics. 

We cannot allow the Jailer to cut off our access to those relics.

Please eliminate this Mawsworn threat, and recover as many relics as possible.
65096.progress: Have you secured the relics at the Ageless Shards?
65096.objectives: Slay Punisher Makaris and collect 6 Sacred Relics.

65097.title: Run!
65097.description:
Storms are about to overwhelm us! We must evacuate!

Save everyone you can. And find those black dragons!
65097.completion:
My thanks, {NAME}. 

Your aid is unexpected... but appreciated.

65098.title: The Consequence of Courage
65098.description:
Thank you for healing me, {NAME}. I hope that we are earning one another's trust.

<Wrathion shudders.>

The Storm-Eater. I have never faced a dragon of such raw elemental power. If there are others like her...

Wait... where is Ebyssian? Did he survive? You must find him!
65098.completion:
I am relieved you made it out, {NAME}.

But I.. cannot help but feel lost.

65100.title: Final Orders
65100.description:
The storm unleashed by Raszageth is too powerful. We must evacuate the only home we have ever known.

There is no longer an Earth-Warder to command us. For the first time, we are free to make our own choices. To find our own fate.

Wherever you go in this new age, I hope you find worthy allies. Tell them our story.

As for me, I will stay here and look for survivors. Along the way, I may find answers about our past.

May fortune favor us all, $p.
65100.progress: We are leaving! I never thought it would be like this but we will return again with greater preparation.
65100.completion:
Wrathion speaks of a group called the Alliance. Noble folk who care for one another and defend this world.

He has offered to introduce us to their leaders in a place called Stormwind. Come, {NAME}.
65100.objectives: Organize the evacuation of Forbidden Reach.

65101.title: An Iconic, Draconic Look
65101.description:
You turned every head in Stormwind with your arrival, $p. No doubt some citizens were more... amenable to your presence than others.

In order to better commune with other races, we dragons adopt a mortal visage, like the one you see before you. Not only does it put allies at ease, but it makes passing through doorways considerably less disruptive.

Clearly the essence of dragonkind flows through the dracthyr. I suspect you may share our ability to assume a visage.

Walk with me.
65101.progress: Mortals can be so nervous around superior beings.
65101.completion:
Your visage suits you well, {NAME}. It is unlike any I have seen before!

Perhaps when we learn more of your origins, we will understand why the {race} visage differs from that of a dragon.

But now, we have an expedition to prepare for.

65103.title: Return More Lost Souls
65103.description:
Souls still continue to pour into the Maw, we must stay the course and find more worthy souls.

Return to the Maw and save all that you can.
65103.progress: There is no fate worse than the Maw, did you find more?
65103.completion: Well done. I know we can spare even more from this truly cruel existence.

65104.title: Return More Lost Souls
65104.description:
Maw Walker, we must do more to cut off the Jailer's power and deny him any more souls. 

Return to the Maw and rescue any more that you can.
65104.progress: There is no fate worse than the Maw, did you find more?
65104.completion: Excellent, Maw Walker. Our armies here will continue to grow stronger with each soul you return.

65105.title: Return More Lost Souls
65105.description:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw. 

I see no reason you cannot pull even more souls from the abyss.

Return to the Maw and find me even more worthy of redemption.
65105.completion:
Another good collection of souls. Not too broken, not too drained, and not too innocent.

I know just where to send these souls on their path to redemption.

65118.title: How to Glide with Your Dragon
65118.description:
Let us start with the basics.

If you fly straight you will wear yourself out right now. Use gravity as an aid and aim slightly down to fly a long distance. The rings will give you the general angle that you should use for basic gliding.

First, call upon your drake, or our Red Drake friend here can give you a lift.

Then, fly through the rings and land at the target location.

If you find yourself stuck, use the Bronze Timepiece and Celormu will reset you.
65118.objectives: Summon your skyriding mount, or mount the Red Drake. Then glide through the rings and land in the target area.

65120.title: How to Dive with Your Dragon
65120.description:
Gliding will get you to where you want to go. But what if you want to get there faster?

Diving after jumping from somewhere high will give you a speed boost.

Fly through the rings to the target location.

If you find yourself stuck, use the Bronze Timepiece and Celormu will reset you.
65120.completion:
See? That was much better.

If you start your flights with a dive you will get to where you want to go so much faster.
65120.objectives: Dive then glide through the rings and land in the target area.

65133.title: How to Use Momentum with Your Dragon
65133.description:
Now what if there is an obstacle in your way?

As long as you fly well, you can conserve your momentum and gain some height after a dive.

When you dive this time you will find your flight path takes you below the landing area. By using your momentum you can regain lost height at the end of the course to still land in the target area.

If you find yourself stuck, use the Bronze Timepiece and Celormu will reset you.
65133.completion: Well done. The rest is now a matter of practice.
65133.objectives: Dive through the rings and land in the target area.

65147.title: No Ordinary Steward
65147.completion:
There is greatness within you, Maw Walker. I can feel it!

And the Forgelite Prime is rarely wrong.

You bear the wisdom of one who knows much. Yes, you must share it with me!

...and I with you, of course.

65149.title: Surveying Cyphers
65149.description:
There are many consoles such as that one scattered throughout Zereth Mortis. 

They have all been beyond my understanding, but perhaps that creature intends to reveal their meaning to us? 

Fortunately, I know where there are more. I will mark them on your map, and accompany you... for research, of course.

Let us see what this creature's purpose is.
65149.completion: You have gained a glimpse of knowledge unimaginable. Now, to make use of it.
65149.objectives: Find the Concordance consoles in Zereth Mortis.

65157.title: A Hardened Bond
65157.completion: Our shared knowledge will benefit all of Maldraxxus.
65157.objectives: Our shared knowledge will benefit all of Maldraxxus.

65165.title: Soul Support
65165.completion: Though Emeni's body has yet to be rebuilt, she can still offer you advice and support in her soul form!

65168.title: My Wings Are Yours
65168.completion:
We have been through so much together, {NAME}. I am deeply grateful for all that you've done already.

We could do even more as soulbinds! What do you say?

65177.title: Fruit of the Bloom
65177.description:
We never know when something new may emerge from the confluence of creation and energy.

The Catalyst Gardens have blossomed with a new crop of fruit. Their seeds may have special properties, and we wish to understand them.

Please gather what you can find, and make the gardens safer for the future.
65177.progress: How can one understand what cannot be defined?
65177.completion:
There is so much to learn from just these little seeds. What will they grow into? Will the vombata eat them?

Thank you for helping me to understand this place further.
65177.objectives: Gather Catamelon Seeds and slay Overgrowth in the Catalyst Gardens.

65219.title: Jiro to Hero
65219.description:
I have spoken to other jiro. Our orb can create a dampening field. It should close the rifts and stop new ones from forming.

It must be done where the Maw magic is strongest. Between the giant chains. The power released by the orb will draw devourers. You and I must defend the orb until the field is set.

I will escort the others. Meet us at the rift when you are ready.
65219.completion:
Devourers have been repelled. For now. But they will return.

One day, we will remove them forever. I will stay to defend the jiro until then.

This could not have been done without you. You have my deepest gratitude.
65219.objectives: Defend the jiro from devourers until they enact the dampening field.

65226.title: Fleet-Footed and Fastidious
65226.description:
When the Mawsworn came to Zereth Mortis, they brought mawrats with them!  

A swarm of their mawrats overran my cave, making off with many of our research items!

Rana is assembling a team to help recover the items. Meet up with her and aid in the effort.
65226.progress: Have you dealt with those mawrats?
65226.completion: A most excellent effort! I had feared these items lost for good.
65226.objectives: Help Rana recover 6 Stolen Relics and slay 80 Thieving Mawrats.

65237.title: Oracle, Heal Thyself
65237.description:
The vessel, snatched from peril. This automa, a steadfast servant. Its energy, the key to my restoration.

Pocopoc, it calls itself. A name that shall return to it.

My name will be mine again. Saezurah, among the last of the oracles. Guide to those who would save Zereth Mortis.

Bring Pocopoc. Its time as proxy has ended. The time of my awakening has arrived.
65237.completion: Dormant no longer. The pattern aligns. But more must be done.

65238.title: Souls Entwined
65238.description:
I must confess, at first I thought Pelagos was making a horrible sacrifice. But now I see--he was giving the Shadowlands all the hope and compassion he holds in his heart. We should go and see him.

Speak with Tal-Inara when you reach Oribos.

I will meet you there, my friend.
65238.completion: Pelagos is right. But if anyone can accomplish what is needed... I believe it is you, my friend.

65245.title: Pop Goes the Devourer!
65245.description:
Once... they had purpose. Made for balance. But now... shifted, altered. Disharmonious.

They rend the pattern. It cannot continue.

Elimination is the only recourse.
65245.objectives: Kill mutated devourers in the Resonant Peaks.

65249.title: The Jailer's Defeat
65249.description:
At long last, we have thwarted the Jailer's schemes. 

Both the Forge of Afterlives and Azeroth's world-soul have been restored, and the Shadowlands can now begin to recover from the anima drought.

I know it is in your nature to push ever forward. But this was a monumental victory, and it deserves a moment of reflection.
65249.progress: Have you witnessed the defeat of the Jailer?
65249.objectives: Speak to Bolvar to relive the victory against the Jailer.

65250.title: Prisoner of Interest
65250.description:
With the Jailer defeated, we must now turn our attention to healing the wounds he inflicted upon the Shadowlands. That process begins with Sylvanas Windrunner.

Though she proved instrumental to our victory, the terrible atrocities she committed have been neither forgotten nor forgiven. She is to face the new Arbiter's judgment in Oribos.

Uther awaits you in the Ring of Fates. Together, you will escort Sylvanas to the Crucible.
65250.objectives: Speak to Uther in Oribos to escort Sylvanas to the Arbiter.

65255.title: Forcing the Cycle
65255.description:
The forces of Zovaal have been spreading their malign influence into the natural life within Provis Fauna. With the rate of their corruption, attempting to cleanse them one by one would be ill advised.

Instead, we can just return their energies into the systems of Zereth Mortis to be used to create new fauna. Use this orb, let it absorb their energy as they die, and then cleanse it once it has been charged.
65255.completion: Their energy will serve the cycle.
65255.objectives: Charge and cleanse the Progenitor orb.

65256.title: Cluck, Cluck, Boom
65256.description:
The endemic poultrids of Zereth Mortis have been influenced in an unseemly way by all these invaders.

Use this device on the ones that have malfunctioned. Otherwise, they will do too much damage to the land.
65256.progress: These mysterious ways must be understood.
65256.completion: Those poultrid do make quite a mess. Thank you for your assistance.
65256.objectives: Use the Kinematic Micro-Life Recalibrator to "recalibrate" Malfunctioned Poultrids in the Great Veldt.

65259.title: Heart of the Sepulcher
65259.description:
Soon after we stepped forth into the realms of Death, a message left behind by the Primus gave warning that the Jailer must not be allowed to reach the Sepulcher.

Despite all our efforts, he has done so.

Within the heart of that ancient place lie secrets the Jailer could use to dominate the entire cosmos. If he succeeds, everything we hold dear will be lost.

Gather your allies, {NAME}. Claim victory for the Shadowlands... and for Azeroth.
65259.completion:
At long last, our campaign is at an end. Thanks to you, the Jailer has been defeated.

Your efforts have saved us all, {NAME}.
65259.objectives: Defeat the Jailer in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.

65260.title: A Long Walk
65260.description:
The Arbiter awaits us. Though few are allowed within the Crucible, several who hail from Azeroth have been granted permission to bear witness as he passes judgment on Sylvanas.

Yet we are far from the only ones affected by all the carnage Sylvanas has wrought. Her actions have brought pain and suffering to a great many.

Screaming back at the Banshee as she passes might be their only chance to speak their mind. Let them be heard.
65260.objectives: Speak to Uther in Oribos to escort Sylvanas to the Enclave, then speak to Tal-Inara to be brought to the Crucible.

65263.title: The Fate of Sylvanas
65263.description:
The time has come.

Let this bring the dark saga of Sylvanas Windrunner to a close and herald a new dawn for the Shadowlands.

Speak to me, and we will begin.
65263.objectives: Speak to Pelagos to witness the judgment of Sylvanas Windrunner.

65264.title: Operation: Relocation
65264.description:
Devourers have disrupted the avians nesting at Provis Esper.

This may be our last chance to examine them before they become tainted, like the others.

Capture several of the avians at Provis Esper and return them to Pilgrim Arizh for relocation and study. Deal with any problems that get in your way.
65264.completion: Well done, {NAME}. The avians will be moved to a safer location where we can observe them.
65264.objectives: Deliver 8 wrangled Wild Proto Avians and slay 6 Soul-Parched Gorgers and 2 Reality Breachers in Provis Esper.

65265.title: Buried Remnants
65265.description:
Much has been lost to the invading forces, those that came with destruction in their hearts.

We cannot preserve this land as the First Ones intended if the Mawsworn are allowed to pulverize all remnants of their knowledge.

See what you can recover from the sands of Provis Strata.
65265.progress: What was before, will be again.
65265.completion: Without the context in which these were first made, they may remain mysteries. But at least they are not trampled underfoot anymore.
65265.objectives: Recover Strange Artifacts from Provis Strata.

65267.title: Smash 'Em to Feathereens
65267.description:
I was curious about these strange, winged creatures and attempted to introduce myself. I would have been eaten if not for Professor Chirpsnide and her large mechanical fowl!

Could you help us deal with these "Screechflight"? The native bluefeather rocs are having a difficult time defending their nests from them.
