Also, I'd hate for any more introductions to go the way mine did with them...
65267.progress: The only thing I can thank these harpies for is giving me the chance to meet the professor!
65267.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}!

I've been assisting the good Professor while you've been gone. I'm afraid to say I've made things worse for her...
65267.objectives: Kill 8 Screechflight Witherers and 10 Screechflight Hexclaws.

65268.title: Bzzzzt!
65268.description:
The vespoids of the region use debris in the area to form the core of their nests. While this is normally something we'd allow them to naturally do, they've started taking some of the relics we were studying.

I have a device that should hopefully allow for the removal of such relics from their hives without damaging the core structure. Use it to retrieve these relics.
65268.completion: That is enough for now, thank you.
65268.objectives: Use the enlightened broker device to remove the progenitor debris from vespoid nests.

65271.title: Forging Connections
65271.description:
Firim described these Enlightened brokers unfavorably. Then again, he does seem a bit... eccentric.

Regardless, if we are to restore contact with our comrades in Oribos and defeat the Jailer, we will need allies in Zereth Mortis.

The Mawsworn look to be gathering outside the gates of Haven. We must not let any more innocents fall prey to the Jailer's villainy.

Hopefully the Enlightened will welcome our aid. After you, my friend.
65271.progress: You dare enter the sacred lands of the First Ones, outsider?
65271.completion: If you do not have the power to help us, then you must go.
65271.objectives: Enter Haven and meet with the Enlightened.

65279.title: By Royal Decree
65279.description: Idiot gnoll not understand crown. Only understand violence. Beat them up or I eat you.
65279.completion: Good start... but have bigger plans.
65279.objectives: Kill 8 Brackenhide Warriors and 4 Brackenhide Shamans in Creektooth Den.

65286.title: Draconic Connections
65286.description:
Ordinarily such a flight would take considerably longer. But when the bronze Aspect himself speeds you on your way, it allows one to make the journey in record... 

<ahem> ...time.

Oh, the soldiers with the pointy weapons? Not to worry. Merely a formality.

I shall see about arranging an audience with the Lord Commander while you and Azurathel get your bearings.

Thankfully, I wield considerable influence in this city.

65287.title: Separating the Yolk
65287.description:
I've deciphered the scroll and, surprise, it's bad news!

The Screechflight aren't just eating the bluefeathers for sustenance. Turns out they've found a spell or two that transfers the rocs' innate strength to themselves upon consumption. Especially the eggs!

Save as many of those roc eggs as you can down the cliffs from here. It'll stall the harpies long enough to put my plan into motion.

And watch out for rogue elementals. The Cursewives' spell work has stirred them up!
65287.progress: Saving these eggs from the harpies is key to protecting these Bluefeathers from any further endangerment. As well as any future prey they plan on consuming next.
65287.completion:
This is more than I imagined you'd be able to recover!

Maybe you're not a bad sort after all. Not that I was thinking that or anything!

65297.title: Penance and Renewal
65297.description:
When I became the new Arbiter, I vowed to myself that I would listen to those around me, to take their counsel into consideration before passing eternal judgment.

I have an inkling of what Tyrande intends for Sylvanas. Her fury is tempered by wisdom, and I trust in the decision she has made.

Meet her in the Ring of Transference and see her judgment come to pass.
65297.objectives: Speak to Tyrande at the Ring of Transference in Oribos.

65302.title: Keys to the Kingdom
65302.description:
Need weapons for plan. Have good weapons, but locked up. Gnolls leave key in camp--protect weapon cache.

Get pointiest sticks. They have most blood stains.
65302.progress: You bring weapons yet or you want me eat you?
65302.completion:
Always wanted power stick!

MON-ARK PROVIDES!
65302.objectives: Collect the key and use it to open the weapon cache.

65305.title: The Way Forward
65305.description:
I see you have a new friend, Maw Walker!

With Pocopoc at your side, I wonder what else you will discover about Zereth Mortis? The secrets we uncover here will be of great help against the Jailer. Perhaps they can teach us how to awaken this oracle.

Highlord Bolvar will surely want to hear of them.

Please go to Haven and inform him. There is a transporter just outside the cave you may want to use. 

I will remain here and keep watch over the oracle.
65305.completion: You have returned, Maw Walker. What news do you have for me?
65305.objectives: Return to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Haven.

65306.title: Rot Rancher
65306.description: Decay gross, smelly, and painful. Have idea but need ooze. GET OOZE!
65306.objectives: Collect 20 Smelly Ooze from the decaying rot.

65307.title: Mercy First
65307.description:
The toxicity in the creche nearly claimed us all. While the antidote is being prepared, I need you to seek out the wounded and heal them. 

Yes, even the blue drakonid. The Healing Wings do not stand idly by while others suffer.
65307.progress: The toxins flooding the creche could not penetrate the stasis magic, but it engulfed us when we awakened.
65307.completion: Violence is not the only avenue to victory.

65313.title: A Roc-ing Appetite
65313.description:
Segallia seems like a good egg, good with gadgets, but she panics easily.

For example: When I sent her into the caves directly south of here, she was promptly run out of them by an unusually large harpy. Seems it was giving orders to the others as well.

Could it be the matriarch of this brood? Perhaps a commander of some kind? Get in there and find out, {NAME}.

And don't be afraid to ruffle a few feathers, if you know what I mean.
65313.completion:
My fine-tuned bird senses are telling me these Screechflight aren't just here for snacks...

But you did well, {NAME}! Let me decipher this scroll and we'll find out just what these harpies are after.

65325.title: Motes of Knowledge
65325.description:
The creatures of Untamed Verdure are ingesting everything in sight. They have consumed our Compilation Nodule, and the Composition Motes needed for compilation. We Jiro require these resources.

This area is too hazardous for unprotected Jiro operation.

Please help us reclaim our resources. Mai Obet will assist you.
65325.completion: You have recovered our resources. Your assistance is appreciated.
65325.objectives: 1 Compilation Nodule and 10 Composition Motes recovered.

65326.title: Circle of Strife
65326.description:
Automa need assistance to operate properly. We fulfill this purpose, but outsiders have caused too many interruptions. We cannot properly address them all. 

Please assist Mai Obet in inspecting and reviewing the performance of the automa.
65326.completion: The automa are functioning properly. Thank you for your assistance.
65326.objectives: Inspect 10 Automa Constructors in Provis Flora.

65327.title: Schematic Reassimilation: Ambystan Darter
65327.description: <This schematic contains the pattern of a new protoform construct. Present it to an appropriate protoform forge and it may instantiate one of these creatures for you.>
65327.completion: <The protoform forge chimes a melancholy song as it draws in the schematic.>
65327.objectives: Present the schematic to an appropriate protoform forge.

65328.title: Arbiter in the Making
65328.description:
Maw Walker, I ... I do not know what to say. I did not expect this.

She speaks of preparations and a new Arbiter. We must tell our friends in Haven.
65328.progress: Everyone will want to know that we are going to make a new Arbiter.
65328.completion: An Arbiter? I had not imagined we could set that to rights.
65328.objectives: Go to Haven and deliver the news that Saezurah seeks a new Arbiter.

65329.title: Safe Haven
65329.description: Let us return to Zereth Mortis. You should report back to Bolvar and tell him of what we have accomplished. We may have achieved this victory, but there is still much to be done.
65329.completion:
A new Arbiter has been established? This is excellent news, {NAME}, and a massive step towards restoring balance to the Shadowlands. Your efforts here will not be forgotten. 

However, it is still only one step towards our goal. We must continue to strengthen our position in Zereth Mortis, and drive the Jailer's forces out. 

Our work continues--but with you on our side, victory is that much closer. Thank you.
65329.objectives: Report back to Bolvar in Haven.

65331.title: Herbal Remedies
65331.description:
Using the roots you collected, I have crafted a concoction that, in theory, will cause the plants to revert to their natural state.

Hurl vials of this remedy at the lashers of the Catalyst Gardens.

If it works, wonderful! If not, you will need to deal with them more directly, by killing them.
65331.completion: A quasi-successful test run, but a success nonetheless.
65331.objectives: Kill 30 Sentient Overgrowth and 6 Carnivorous Overgrowth.

65335.description:
I bear important news that will grant us insight into the Jailer's methods. 

With faith and understanding, we may also execute true justice.

There is much we should discuss, Hero.
65335.progress: In transformation, there can be redemption.
65335.completion: Sylvanas's experience may be intrinsic to Anduin's fate.

65349.title: Lost Grace
65349.description:
The waters of the Wellspring no longer flow.

The designs of the First Ones have never before failed us. The pilgrims are beginning to wonder... are the First Ones displeased?

Certainly they may question, but MY faith remains steadfast. And as I expected, it seems the First Ones have sent us a solution. 

You, of course. 

Ancient research and texts indicate that the source of the wellspring is in an underground temple in Provis Esper. Go, I have faith that you will restore the Wellspring.
65349.completion: <This automa has been ravaged by devourers. It clutches a curious object in its hand.>

65350.title: Restore the Flow
65350.description:
Look! Devourers have penetrated the temple's defenses. Those ravenous menaces feed on any energy that they can find. They must have been drawn to the wellspring's power.

With that kind of interference, no wonder the waters have been stalled!

The solution must be inside Locrian Esper. Once there, see if you can find a way to reverse the damage that has been done.
65350.completion: <It seems as though your efforts were successful--the waters are once again flowing through the temple. The wellspring should be restored.>
65350.objectives: Find a way to restore Locrian Esper.

65351.description: <This schematic contains the pattern of a new protoform construct. Present it to an appropriate protoform forge and it may instantiate one of these creatures for you.>
65351.completion: <The protoform forge chimes a melancholy song as it draws in the schematic.>
65351.objectives: Present the schematic to an appropriate protoform forge.

65353.title: An Automa-free Diet
65353.description:
These devourers are relentless! They feed on any energy they can find. If left unchecked, they would surely devour the whole of Zereth Mortis. We cannot allow the creations of the First Ones to be sullied by these invaders! 

I am no fighter. But you... perhaps the First Ones delivered you to us after all. Will you help?
65353.completion: Stranger, I... I apologize. My trust in you was lacking. In turn, my faith wavered as well. Forgive me, and take with you my thanks--the First Ones truly guide your hand.
65353.objectives: Kill 10 Invading Gorgers and Reality Breachers.

65362.title: Not of the Body
65362.description:
Enemies of Zereth Mortis wear the guise of productive automa. They do not complete any desired tasks.

Scan the automa to reveal enemy threats, then eliminate them.

Mai Obet shall assist.
65362.completion: You have exceeded expectations. Thank you for your assistance.

65363.title: Dangerous State
65363.description:
Enemies have attacked the jiro and severed them from the circle. The jiro are no longer stable. They are a danger to the order of things.

They must be removed.
65363.completion: Order has been restored. Thank you for your assistance.
65363.objectives: Leashkeeper Helzid and 12 Dominated Jiro slain.

65364.title: Super Jiro
65364.description:
The outsiders have disrupted the tasks and purpose of the jiro. We cannot allow this to continue.

We will empower a larger jiro to help combat these threats. Jiro Prime will destroy the enemies that threaten Zereth Mortis.

Help direct Jiro Prime to resolve our crisis.
65364.completion: Order has been restored. We thank you for your assistance.
65364.objectives: Direct Jiro Prime to rescue 7 Distressed Jiro, while slaying 5 Mawbroken Automa and 100 Mawsworn forces.

65370.title: Gut Check
65370.description:
The crescendal is a powerful tool created by automa. They are given to jiro when work is hard or important. When the devourers attacked, crescendals were likely... eaten.

crescendals are strong. They do not easily damage. Check the stomachs of bigger devourers. Perhaps find one intact?
65370.progress: We have very few crescendals. It is important to recover one.
65370.completion:
<The jiro looks over the guts-spattered device.>

Not ideal. But mostly intact... it will need cleaning.
65370.objectives: Collect a Crescendal from an Insatiable Breaker or a Voracious Stalker at the Terrace of Formation.

65371.title: A Nest of Our Own
65371.description:
The scroll you found is a command that all bluefeather eggs are to be brought to the harpy chef, Fry-Aerie. Apparently, the Screechflight's matriarch won't eat anything that hasn't been properly prepared and seasoned.

So we'll bring her a special egg of our own. One that's EXPLOSIVELY delicious... and will explode when she eats it. Of course.

How will you deliver it? In disguise!

Slay the creatures on the lower cliffs, collect up this list of parts, and I'll whip you up a full-feathered outfit.
65371.progress: Got everything I asked for yet?
65371.completion:
Perfect! And a little gross. Just as I planned.

Time to craft a disguise and take this matriarch out to roost!
65371.objectives: Collect 20 Screechflight Talons, 6 Screechflight Staves, and 3 Creekborne Cores.

65373.title: Plucking Parts
65373.description:
Oh, no... I've made a huge mistake.

Harleen entrusted me with the famed Feather-Plucker 3300, a phenomenal invention of her very own!

I was planning to pluck roc feathers in the cave south of here for her research, but the harpies ambushed me and it broke into pieces as I was running out.

Please retrieve the parts! They're probably strewn about like shed scales on the cave floor.

I can put it back together. Definitely. Well, probably.
65373.progress: I was so desperate to prove myself!
65373.completion:
Oh, thank the flights!

I've come to like the professor, and this could have spelled the end of our new friendship!

65374.title: It's Plucking Time
65374.description:
Harleen told me she's making a disguise for you! How exciting! But she'll need some feathers from the roc hatchlings to complete the outfit.

Luckily, I've just finished fixing up the Feather-Plucker 3300!

The Screechflight are capturing roc hatchlings on the lower cliffs to raise and breed for themselves. Use the Plucker to yank the hatchlings out of danger. It'll automatically pluck some of their feathers for you as well!

Two birds with one Plucker? I should say so!
65374.progress: Professor Chirpsnide tells me that I've got a knack for gadgets! If I wasn't part of the Dracthyr military, do you think I could've worked in a Goblin city?
65374.completion: This is more than enough feathers! And all collected without the Feather-Plucker exploding... right?

65419.title: Protoform Synthesis
65419.description: <Pocopoc jumps around anxiously. When you completed your research into the basics of Dealic, it got very excited and it is urging you to follow it somewhere else in this realm.>
65419.progress: <Pocopoc looks between you and the console excitedly.>
65419.completion: <Pocopoc points to some controls on this device, and you understand just enough Dealic to glimpse its purpose in bringing you here. With some materials found across Zereth Mortis and Pocopoc's help, you can trigger this machine to create fully realized beings based on specific schematics.>
65419.objectives: Escort Pocopoc to the Protoform Synthesis Forge.

65420.title: Judgment Call
65420.description:
Oh no... No no no... What have I done?

The elders will never take me back. They shall cast me out as they did Firim.

Please, outsider, speak to Elder Amir in Pilgrim's Grace. Give him my thanks for sending you, and tell him all that has happened here. He will understand why I must never return.
65420.completion:
Tahli is alive? And you preserved an automa archive with her help?! Oh, my. That is... a lot to take in.

And, of course, her guilt has prevented her from returning home. Oh, Tahli.
65420.objectives: Speak to Elder Amir in Pilgrim's Grace.

65421.title: Climb Every Mountain
65421.description:
Hope ye are a quick study, {class}. 'Cause I got no time for a lesson! 

Grab a pack and find a path tae the top o' that peak.

Once yer up there, toss this parachute to our pal Yips. Poor kid got stuck on some vines when these air elementals crashed our plane!

Quickly now, so we can get outta here!
65421.progress: Hurry on, now! Yips can't hold fer long!
65421.completion:
Nice climbing! Yips owes ye a drink or two!

Oh, the elementals? Nah, don't worry 'bout 'em. This is OUR adventure!

<Rocky resumes gleefully shooting bullets through the air elementals.>

65426.title: The Lost Component
65426.description:
Maw Walker! Look.

We have been studying this automa component for some time. Its cyphers are similar to those of the components near and within the Protoform Repository.

Kodah's last effort should not be in vain. Please return this component to the repository that our friend restored.
65426.objectives: Pick up the Protoform Catalyst and return it to the Protoform Repository.

65427.title: A New Architect
65427.description:
The architects prototype designs to fulfill the purposes of the First Ones. 

This archive contained many such designs.

A number of design entries are lost or corrupted due to the Maw invasion. 

An untouched design lattice and tools are detected nearby. The mortal will retrieve them to begin the synthesis process.
65427.progress: Have the necessary materials been located?
65427.completion:
Success. 

The Protoform Repository is now restored.
65427.objectives: Collect 1 Cervid Lattice and 3 Protoform Tools and bring them to the Servitor Interface in the Protoform Repository.

65431.title: Further Research: Aealic
65431.description:
Maw Walker, you have made some wondrous discoveries, but there are still secrets to uncover.

You have taken the first step, in unlocking the console and I believe that you are ready to take another.

Please go investigate the console and see what new piece of the pattern unfolds itself to you.
65431.progress: Go see what secrets await you!
65431.completion: New knowledge! The First Ones truly did leave such marvelous insights.
65431.objectives: Investigate the Cypher Console in Exile's Hollow further.

65432.title: Further Research: Dealic
65432.description: <The console hums with a mysterious energy.>
65432.objectives: Further investigate the Cypher Console in Exile's Hollow.

65433.title: Further Research: Trebalim
65433.description: <The console hums with a mysterious energy.>
65433.objectives: Further investigate the Cypher Console in Exile's Hollow.

65435.title: The Dragon Isles Await
65435.description:
Heroes of the Horde, I bring news. The Dragon Isles are awakening!

The Isles went dormant in the wake of the Sundering. But now, at long last, they have called my kin and me  home.

While the Isles hold many wonders, it is also a perilous land. We will require the aid of our mortal allies to reclaim our legacy.

I am about to present the Aspects' invitation to the Horde Council in Orgrimmar. Meet me there and we shall see what they have to say.
65435.completion: I am grateful you have answered the call. Your courage will be welcome on the journey ahead.

65437.title: Aspectral Invitation
65437.description:
Your arrival is well timed, $p.

I have just met with the Horde Council, and they have accepted the Aspects' invitation to the Dragon Isles.

The same invitation extends to you, as well.

You may also notice some unfamiliar faces here in Orgrimmar. The dracthyr are new arrivals you will learn about on the journey ahead.

Let us speak more.
65437.completion:
I am honored that you will journey to the homeland of dragonkind.

One of your allies is eager to assist you in preparing for what lies ahead.

65439.title: Whispers on the Winds
65439.description:
Hello, $p. It's been a while, and I wish we had more time to catch up.

But you see, I've just had a rather enlightening... no, make that foreboding... yes, a foreboding conversation with an old friend.

Sometimes a revelation can be both, after all.

I really must tell you of what I've learned.
65439.completion: Unsettling news indeed, but you had to know of the peril we face.
65439.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar outside Orgrimmar.

65443.title: Expeditionary Coordination
65443.description:
Pleasure to meet you, I am Naleidea Rivergleam.

The invitation to visit the Dragon Isles is quite an exciting prospect. Don't you agree?

The Reliquary has combined forces with our expeditionary counterparts to help coordinate our efforts. As a member of the Dragonscale Expedition, it is my honor to welcome you.

Though first we must gather a few more members for our journey. Shall we begin?
65443.progress: Have you spoken with the others yet?
65443.completion: I believe this expedition shall be a great success.
65443.objectives: Recruit explorers, artisans, and scholars throughout Orgrimmar for the expedition to the Dragon Isles.

65444.title: To the Dragon Isles!
65444.description:
Our preliminary expedition has made landfall in the Dragon Isles.

Thanks to the efforts of those brave Dragonscale Expedition members, we've established a protected landing site in the Dragon Isles and made contact with the dragonflight's embassy.

Are you prepared to accompany us on our next voyage to the Dragon Isles?
65444.objectives: Ride the Defiant Dragonscale to the Dragon Isles from the zeppelin tower outside Orgrimmar.

65445.title: Necessary Resourcing
65445.description:
Devourers are consuming neomotes.

We need neomotes for necessary creation work. Without them, we are unable to complete our work.

Eliminate the devourers and retrieve the neomotes.
65445.completion: You have completed the task. Thank you for your assistance.
65445.objectives: Obtain 30 Neomote Residue and 3 Solidified Neomotes from Devourers in Zereth Mortis.

65448.title: A Return to Grace
65448.description: <With the temple restored and its defenses back online, the Wellspring should be safe from the devourers. Conservator Olem will want to know what you've done here.>
65448.progress: You return--and as I expected, you were successful.
65448.completion: As I thought--your arrival was by the design of the First Ones. I look forward to the legacy you forge in this land of our creators.
65448.objectives: Speak to Conservator Olem and give him the good news.

65456.title: Long Lost Firim
65456.description:
I was gathering data here when your portal opened. The disruption activated these gate-locking mechanisms. 

It is only fair for you to gather the gate keys, yes? We shall speak while you search.
65456.completion: You are stronger and more patient than you look.
65456.objectives: Help Firim open the gate into Zereth Mortis.

65460.title: Your First Cantaric Protolock
65460.description:
Maw Walker, it appears that Pocopoc has learned the Cachial skill. This grants you access to the Caches of Creation. You will find several types of these caches all throughout Zereth Mortis.

In order to aid me with my research, you will need to be able to decode various cyphers such as the Cantaric Protolock. 

Now, let me show you what you need to do to assist me.
65460.progress: Good, now take your expanded knowledge out into the field.
65460.completion:
Well done, Maw Walker.

I am sure that with enough energy and effort your companion will be able to help you overcome these challenges, if they become a struggle for you.

65461.title: Your First Mezzonic Protolock
65461.description: In order to aid me in my research, you will need to decode various Progenitor cyphers like the Mezzonic Protolock.  Now, I will show you what you need to do.
65461.progress: Use this knowledge to collect more data from the field.
65461.completion:
Use this knowledge and collect more data from the field, Maw Walker.

There is still one more Cache of Creation that I must instruct you on.

65466.title: Your First Fugueal Protolock
65466.description: In order to aid my research you will need to decode various Progenitor cyphers like the Fugueal Protolock. This is a most difficult cypher, I will show you what you need to do.
65466.progress: Use this knowledge and collect more data from the field.
65466.completion:
Well done, Maw Walker. That was truly an impressive effort.

Remember, that if you do struggle with these protolocks, your companion can help you overcome them if they have enough energy.

Now take your expanded knowledge out into the field.

65467.title: Turkey Soul
65467.description: <The Turkey Soul is bold and fierce. The shape of the turkey will be yours to call upon.>
65467.objectives: Bring the Turkey Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

65475.title: Rolling in the Screech
65475.description:
<You pull a scrap of parchment from the gooey, blood-soaked satchel of the Roc-Muncher. All you can make out is imagery of harpies devouring large eggs.

You're positive the thick, unintelligible scratch marks will make plenty of sense to your favorite senior ornithologist, Harleen Chirpsnide.>
65475.completion:
Ho, now! That's certainly no dinner menu you're holding!

Or maybe it is...
65475.objectives: Bring the Screechflight Scroll to Harleen Chirpsnide in the Bluefeather Cliffs.

65486.title: Picture Perfect
65486.description:
Sorry if ya be waitin' long. Sometimes I get lost in de telescope.

Do ya ever find da world be easier understood from a distance? No interference, just nature goin' about its business without us...

<Akunda the Cataloger sighs.>

I see Coralie gave ya a camera. Good.

Take a ride down the river with Fren, and take photographs of some wildlife in dey natural habitats for me to study.
65486.progress: Fren will row the raft for ya. Don't worry, she's da very best!
65486.completion:
<Akunda flips through the photographs quickly, intently analyzing each one.>

Re-mark-a-ble! Surprisin' too. I've much to learn from these; so many new specimens to document!

Thank you, {NAME}!
65486.objectives: Ride the Cataloger's Raft with Fren and take pictures of local wildlife.

65490.title: Explosive Excrement
65490.description:
The harpies are a nice surprise and all, but I came to these mountains for one reason and one reason only: EXCREMENT!

Specifically, the excrement of bluefeather rocs that's then been eaten and digested by bugs. Scarab stomach juices enhance the explosive nitrogen content by tenfold! At least!

Here, take this Chirpsnide Auto-Excre-Collector. Stomp on the scarabs crawling around the cave floor, and use the Collector to reap the rewards.

Bring it back full and we can start the real fun: EXPLOSIONS!!
65490.completion:
Oh, yes! Quality stuff!!

Have you thought about doing this work professionally, {NAME}?

65504.title: Dragonhawk Soul
65504.description: <The Dragonhawk Soul is nimble and resilient. The shape of the dragonhawk will be yours to call upon.>
65504.objectives: Bring the Dragonhawk Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65505.title: Scorpid Soul
65505.description: <The Scorpid Soul is fierce and voracious. The shape of the scorpid will be yours to call upon.>
65505.objectives: Bring the Scorpid Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65506.title: Ray Soul
65506.description: <The Ray Soul is clever and swift. The shape of the ray will be yours to call upon.>
65506.objectives: Bring the Ray Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65507.title: Elekk Soul
65507.description: <The Elekk Soul is clever and mighty. The shape of the elekk will be yours to call upon.>
65507.objectives: Bring the Elekk Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65508.title: Tallstrider Soul
65508.description: <The Tallstrider Soul is agile and curious. The shape of the tallstrider will be yours to call upon.>
65508.objectives: Bring the Tallstrider Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65509.title: Bat Soul
65509.description: <The Bat Soul is cunning and swift. The shape of the bat will be yours to call upon.>
65509.objectives: Bring the Bat Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65510.title: Brutosaur Soul
65510.description: <The Brutosaur Soul is loyal and valiant. The shape of the brutosaur will be yours to call upon.>
65510.objectives: Bring the Brutosaur Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65512.title: Silithid Soul
65512.description: <The Silithid Soul is brutal and quick. The shape of the silithid will be yours to call upon.>
65512.objectives: Bring the Silithid Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65513.title: Gromit Soul
65513.description: <The Gromit Soul is exuberant and inquisitive. The shape of the gromit will be yours to call upon.>
65513.objectives: Bring the Gromit Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

65514.title: Armadillo Soul
65514.description: <The Armadillo Soul is cautious and resilient. The shape of the armadillo will be yours to call upon.>
65514.objectives: Bring the Armadillo Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

65515.title: Pig Soul
65515.description: <The Pig Soul is curious and tenacious. The shape of the pig will be yours to call upon.>
65515.objectives: Bring the Pig Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

65516.title: Sheep Soul
65516.description: <The Sheep Soul is calm and stalwart. The shape of the sheep will be yours to call upon.>
65516.objectives: Bring the Sheep Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

65517.title: Penguin Soul
65517.description: <The Penguin Soul is playful and sociable. The shape of the penguin will be yours to call upon.>
65517.objectives: Bring the Penguin Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

65518.title: Bee Soul
65518.description: <The Bee Soul is protective and spry. The shape of the bee will be yours to call upon.>
65518.objectives: Bring the Bee Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

65519.title: Snail Soul
65519.description: <The Snail Soul is cautious and patient. The shape of the snail will be yours to call upon.>
65519.objectives: Bring the Snail Soul to Choofa in the Heart of the Forest.

65563.title: Delivery for Kasea
65563.description:
Hope ye don't mind, but I used some of your materials to craft something Kasea has been asking me for.

Would you mind bringin' it over to her?
65563.completion: Thurgaden finally made it, did he? And sent it with just the right person!
65563.objectives: Deliver the Bladed Helmet to Kasea Angerforge.

65564.title: Good Fiery Boy
65564.description:
I train hounds of all types, 'long as they're fiery. I've trained up Grimhowl here since he was a wee pup, but a life in Shadowforge City isn't what he's meant ta live!

Grimhowl needs that special someone to bond with, someone who'll take him 'round all of Azeroth. Perhaps that could be you?

Take some time to get to know him. I think Grimhowl will warm up to ye real quick!
65564.progress: If ye bond with this beastie, you'll have a loyal companion for life!
65564.completion: They like ye, they really like ye! Treat this pup with love and they will be your adventuring partner for years to come.

65594.title: Making a Mountain Out of a Gnoll Hill
65594.description: Stupid decay thinks it in charge, but me in charge. We kill it now. Me turned ooze into friends.
65594.completion: You live this long? Good meat.

65595.title: One Bad Apple
65595.description:
Rot starve gnolls.

Rot hurt friends.

We kill rot now. Is what Mon-Arks do.
65595.completion:
Me lead gnolls to better hunt now. You... not so bad. Gnolls hungry though, and you still meat.

Leave. Me no chase.

65613.title: An Iconic, Draconic Look
65613.description:
I am sure your arrival in Orgrimmar drew the attention of its citizens. No doubt some were more comfortable in your presence than others.

When I was a young dragon, I took on the mortal visage you now see. It allowed me to live among the tauren of Highmountain as an ally.

Though your path differs from mine, the essence of dragonkind flows through you as well, $p. Perhaps that will allow you to assume a visage of your own.

Let us walk together.
65613.completion:
You have a noble visage indeed, {NAME}. Most distinctive.

I do not know why your visage is unique from that of a dragon. Perhaps when we learn more of your past, the answer will present itself.

But for now, we must prepare for the journey ahead.

65615.title: Arcane Intrusion
65615.description:
That beacon ahead--I am certain it was not there before we were imprisoned.

Spellcraft is not my forte, but I know arcane magic when I see it. The same magic used by the blue dragon in the creche.

He said a name... Malygos. It sounds so familiar, but the Earth-Warder's teachings feel distant. Fragmented.

If this Malygos put us into stasis, perhaps the arcane beacon was placed on his orders.

Investigate the area and report back. Ensure the beacon cannot be used to call in enemy reinforcements.
65615.progress: There is powerful magic in the air. But it is ancient, fading.
65615.completion:
<Azurathel listens intently as you tell him what you witnessed.>

So there were beacons placed outside the other creches as well.

Our allies are in peril. We must reach them!

65625.title: The Jailer's Gauntlet
65625.description:
Maw Walker! I have been looking for you. 

Word is there is a new gathering of the Jailer's forces in Torghast. I'm not sure what they are doing, but it can't be good.

Perhaps you should put an end to their plans?
65625.objectives: Enter the new portal in the Torghast Lobby.

65640.title: Cervid Soul
65640.description: <The Cervid Soul is noble and wise. The shape of the cervid will be yours to call upon.>
65640.objectives: Bring the Cervid Soul to Lady Muunn in the Heart of the Forest.

65652.title: Summons from the Matriarch
65652.description:
Greetings, {NAME}.

Let us not mince words--you are urgently needed in Silvermoon. 

We're experiencing a resurgence of Scourge in Quel'Thalas. With nothing to hold the Scourge in check, we'll soon be overrun. We must hold the line!

Meet me in the Hall of Blood, and we will get you a full briefing.
65652.completion:
Good, you made it.

Let us begin.

65653.title: Victory for the Sin'dorei
65653.description:
The power of the ranseur has been spent, but we are victorious! With Vorath defeated, perhaps the Scourge will be more easily dealt with--thanks to you.

Meet me back in the Hall of Blood. Silvermoon is grateful for your bravery.
65653.completion:
This is not the end of the Scourge, but it is gratifying to drive the threat from our lands with such tenacity.

Silvermoon is grateful for you this day.
65653.objectives: Return to Lady Liadrin in Silvermoon City.

65657.title: Assemble the Forsaken
65657.description:
It's heartening to see progress has been made in rebuilding Brill, but this is only a first step. The ruins of the capital remain inaccessible because of the blight.

And here is where I hope you will aid the cause.

Restoring as much of the land as possible will require a gathering of minds all working toward a singular purpose.

A number of influential figures have risen to prominence among the Forsaken. Please help bring them together so we can meet and discuss the path forward.
65657.progress: Everyone is working hard to get back on their feet. Might not be the feet they started out with, but they work.
65657.completion:
Looks like we're ready to get started.

I don't think there have been this many Forsaken in one place since... well, Darkshore.

But we are in our own lands now, and it's time we take care of our own.
65657.objectives: Assemble Dark Ranger Velonara, Lillian Voss, and Master Apothecary Faranell.

65658.title: This Land is Ours
65658.description:
The plague unleashed during the war has tainted the land and disturbed the dead. That is to say, more so than they already were.

We have worked hard to rebuild, but our people cannot complete their efforts while under threat.

My first duty is to ensure the safety of the Forsaken. I will meet with the others as Calia requests, but first you must help me eradicate some of these Blighted.
65658.progress: We need the pressure off of Brill so we can continue to rebuild.
65658.completion:
That should give our guards some breathing room. Metaphorically speaking, of course.

Thank you for the help, {NAME}.
65658.objectives: Slay Blighted Soldiers in Tirisfal Glades.

65659.title: The Blight Congress
65659.description:
We, the Forsaken, have been through a lot since the destruction of Lordaeron. But we're determined to keep our home.

Why should we give up what we've fought so hard to carve out for ourselves?

Calia is still a relative newcomer in some ways, but obviously she's known to our people. How could she not be, as the sister of Arthas himself?

I hope we can move forward, and that she can really help. Her voice could be a powerful one, if she is really truly committed to the people.
65659.completion:
I expected that my presence might cause friction. But I'm grateful to Lilian for her mediation, and for giving me the chance to show that I am committed to helping the Forsaken people.

But now, I must prove it.

65660.title: Walk of Faith
65660.description:
I promised that I would help, and I shall. We need that pure sample of the plague afflicting Lordaeron, but we cannot put anyone else at risk.

Come with me. I will call forth a shield of Holy Light to safeguard us deep into the blighted area so that we can collect that sample.

This spell will require my full focus. I'll trust you to protect us from anything that might try to stop us.

Are you with me?
65660.progress: I guess I should have faith.
65660.completion: That's something you don't see every day.
65660.objectives: Protect Calia inside her shield and collect the pure plague sample.

65661.title: Consulting Our Allies
65661.description:
I hope Calia is right about these lords of Maldraxxus. That they know how to deal with this sort of powerful plague.

We've only got one plague eater left, too, but Faranell says he can replicate more of them as long as they're strong enough to survive.

Let's get to the Shadowlands.
65661.completion:
You carry a rather nasty example of the unchecked and unfettered ambition of a plague-maker.

I trust the creator of this monstrosity has already been purged. What would you ask of the houses of Maldraxxus?
65661.objectives: Speak to Margrave Sin'dane in Maldraxxus.

65662.title: House of Plagues
65662.description:
The one with the knowledge you seek is a survivor of the House of Plagues. You already know him.

Plague Deviser Marileth may not be the most lucid of conversationalists, but he will know what to do with your plague.

Find him near the ruins of that fallen house. But be wary! Many things lurking there could end your existence without a hint of concern.
65662.completion:
Hello, my favorite apprentice! 

Say, you look a tad wan. Are you certain you're getting enough sleep?
65662.objectives: Meet Plague Deviser Marileth in the House of Plagues.

65663.title: Feed the Eater
65663.description:
The House of Plagues has suffered calamity, much like Lordaeron. I hope that our work and effort here will reverse some of that destruction.

But first, we must reach farther into the House of Plagues so we can strengthen the capabilities of Faranell's plague eater.

Any slime or creature you slay will surely help it gain fortitude.
65663.progress: We all have something we can contribute.
65663.completion: The Plague Eater is looking so much stronger already. I think Master Apothecary Faranell would be pleased.
65663.objectives: Slay Slimes and Plaguerocs in the House of Plagues.

65664.title: Essence of Plague
65664.description:
Your little friend there looks hungry! Not to worry, I know just what to feed it. Soon it will grow big and strong and be able to eat all the plague it can.

There are various concoctions nearby that will give it bolstering properties. And every color is a different flavor!

I will take the plague sample you brought me deeper into the House of Plagues, to see what else we can learn. Meet me there, and let your plague eater dine in style!
65664.progress: Every color is a different flavor!
65664.completion:
Did you see that? What a fearsome plague sample you brought me!

It hit me in the head and quite nearly killed your friends, apprentice. Marvelous!
65664.objectives: Absorb different Concoctions in the House of Plagues.

65665.title: Embodiment
65665.description:
What a nasty little plague you've brought me, apprentice. Must've been concocted by a true sadist.

To study the sample, I gave it form. But the ungrateful thing turned on me and attacked, completely unprovoked! 

It's shuffled a bit further on into the House. I hate to say it, but I believe this one must be put down before it is allowed to grow any stronger... or larger.

Look on the bright side. If your plague eater manages to survive, it'll be attuned to your particularly terrible form of blight.
65665.progress: Have you disposed of that manifestation?
65665.completion: Despite all the trouble that sample gave us, I think I actually have a little bit of hope now.

65666.title: Return to Brill
65666.description:
We've strengthened our plague eater, and now it looks ready to take on a much, much bigger meal.

Let's get it back to Faranell. He said he can replicate its properties and disperse plague eaters all across the ruins.

Then maybe, just maybe, we can set foot in our home again.

Here, take my hearthstone. It'll bring you back to Brill.
65666.completion:
Wonderful! Not only did you manage not to lose my plague eater, you brought it back stronger than ever!

Now, witness the genius and rapidity of my machines. There will be more than enough plague eaters to spread across the surface of the Undercity.
65666.objectives: Return to Master Apothecary Faranell outside of the Ruins of Lordaeron.

65667.title: The Remedy of Lordaeron
65667.description:
The time has come. By the Light, I pray our plan works.

Master Apothecary Faranell's wagons have reproduced the plague eater many times over, and the bats are ready to deploy them.

If you see a place where our forces could spread even more of the remedy, you can signal them with a flare.

Take to the skies, and let's put an end to this blight. For Lordaeron, and for the Forsaken.
65667.completion:
We did it. By working together, we've cleared the surface level of the deadly plague cloud.

It will take more time to clean up the lower reaches of the Undercity, but it's a fine start.
65667.objectives: Mount a Shadowbat and deploy Plague Eaters in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

65668.title: The Desolate Council
65668.description:
By combining our knowledge and expertise, we've restored the surface of the Undercity to the Forsaken.

It was only possible by setting aside our distrust and acting for the good of our people. Now it's time to make this council official.

We are no longer the same undead that followed and served Sylvanas Windrunner. From here on, we lead ourselves, with the same spirit of independence and pride we've had since we reclaimed our free will.

It's time for a new future, with new leadership.
65668.progress: Hope, and fresh air, have been restored.
65668.completion:
I am greatly honored that they have accepted me as part of the new leadership of the Forsaken. 

I swear that I will do my best to protect and preserve the people, no matter where they come from, or what form of undeath has created them.
65668.objectives: Witness the formation of the new Desolate Council.

65669.title: Report to Greymane
65669.description:
Thank you for all of your assistance, leading to this historic moment.

I believe there may be others who are interested in what happened here. Please, carry this letter, and my well wishes, when you return to them.
65669.completion:
They did WHAT?

And Calia has proposed a discussion on the return of Gilneas?

Your ability astounds me, {NAME}. Well done.
65669.objectives: Deliver Calia's letter to Genn Greymane in Oribos.

65674.title: What Is This Thing?
65674.description:
<The ambiguous essence in your hands looks as if it could serve a variety of purposes. In fact, it almost seems to radiate possibility.>

<Perhaps Firim may have some answers about this.>
65674.completion:
Oh, now this is a most interesting find indeed, mortal.

I have encountered such material in my research before. In theory, it can alter the fate of various objects--unlocking their potential, as it were. Curious, no?

I will keep this essence as I have need of it. In exchange, I will share with you the knowledge on how to use similar materials in your own creations.
65674.objectives: Bring the Unformed Essence to Firim in Exile's Hollow.

65680.title: Schematic Reassimilation: Heartbond Lupine
65680.description: <This schematic contains the pattern of a new protoform construct. Present it to an appropriate protoform forge and it may instantiate one of these creatures for you.>
65680.completion: Excellent. With this schematic and the right components, a new song can begin here to accompany you.
65680.objectives: Present the schematic to an appropriate protoform forge.

65686.title: To the Azure Span
65686.description:
Greetings, {NAME}! 

Pakina and I are here on behalf of the Kirin Tor looking for aid. 

The Kirin Tor are working to safeguard the wild arcane magic located all throughout the Azure Span.

Kalecgos, the Aspect of the blue dragonflight and one of our leaders, needs aid in reclaiming the Azure Oathstone there as well.

If you're willing to help, keep traveling along the road to find Glania of the Blessed Ones.

She can direct you to where you can help the most.
65686.completion: Excellent, an adventurer. I can fill you in on the details before I have to learn to... fish.
65686.objectives: Meet with Glania of the Blessed Ones within the Azure Span.

65687.title: Punching Up
65687.description:
Some of the other disciples are... very mean.

<Ingot rubs a fresh wound on his snout.>

It used to not be like that, but when Cygenoth came, he said "We should value strength above all else". Now everybody fights all the time.

I try to fight back, but their hides are too thick... and I'm too small.

But not you! You must fight bullies all the time. Maybe you can help?
65687.progress: The Worldbreakers aren't all bullies. Promise!
65687.completion:
Those snagglescaled clods won't be hurting anyone else! The Earth-Warder thanks you! 

Oh. And me. I thank you too.

65688.title: Meeting Kalecgos
65688.description:
I fear we will have to split our attention. The Primalist threat to the east must be handled.

I must ask you travel to the Azure Archives in my stead to aid Kalecgos in reclaiming the Azure Oathstone.

You'll need to pick up a few supplies to help you with whatever is happening there.

Speak with our portal quartermaster, they ought to have something that can aid you along the way. 

Good luck, {NAME}. Kalecgos will appreciate the aid.
65688.progress: I'm relieved to have any help. I know Khadgar and the others must be quite busy with the Primalists.
65688.completion:
Khadgar is wise to redirect his efforts towards the Primalists.

But now... we've got a lot of work to do here.
65688.objectives: Get the Bag of Helpful Goods, then meet Kalecgos at the base of the Azure Archives.

65689.title: The Many Images of Kalecgos
65689.description:
Good to formally meet you, {NAME}. My name is Kalecgos, Archmage of the Kirin Tor and Aspect of the blue dragonflight.

I'm having difficulty repairing the Azure Archives to reclaim the Azure Oathstone. I could use an extra pair of physical hands.

I'm currently up in the archives themselves. I was able to reactivate the pylon outside, which should allow you to traverse up here.
65689.progress: Glad to see you've made it.
65689.completion: Let's get to work. It's imperative to reclaim the Azure Oathstone.
65689.objectives: Use the Crystal Pylon to reach the Azure Archives.

65690.title: A Cultist's Misgivings
65690.description:
Another outsider arrived yesterday. She called herself an "emissary" for the red dragonflight and asked for an audience with our leader, the Voice of Neltharion. 

But the Voice got terribly mad. He said that the Earth-Warder was testing us, and that we had to execute her!

I know we're not supposed to trust outsiders, but we don't have to kill them! Please, help me save her.
65690.completion:
This hatchling asked for your help?

<Ayasanth exhales with relief.>

Perhaps we can save the Worldbreakers after all.

65691.title: The Shadow of His Wings
65691.description:
The Voice of Neltharion resides below, spreading lies amongst his followers. 

He appears to be dragonspawn like me. but his Draconic is clumsy--fit for the unscaled. 

I suspect duplicity: an illusion, perhaps. If we can subdue him, I'm certain the truth will out.
65691.completion:
We quenched the last embers of the Twilight's Hammer today. But the Worldbreakers are another matter--these scaleborn will find new explanations for their misfortune, new myths, and new leaders. 

My kin and I will watch over them. Should another Voice rise, we will intervene.

You've done a good thing this day.

65700.title: Core Control
65700.description:
Your timing is most excellent.

It appears one of my traps captured a rather curious creature moments ago. I dare not investigate, but you... you can do this for me.

Take Pocopoc along with you. Perhaps there are secrets yet to be discovered.
65700.completion: Pocopoc is most intriguing, yes? I do wonder the extent of its capabilities.
65700.objectives: Examine the curious creature outside of Exile's Hollow.

65701.title: Preservation, Augmentation, or Devastation
65701.description:
If what these dragons say is true, then a great battle is upon us. We need you focused and strong, evoker.

Time to choose your battle specialization. Will you preserve your allies, or devastate your enemies? 

To hone your combat skills to their sharpest, choose Devastation.

To maximize your healing potential, take the path of Preservation.

To enhance your wingmates, embrace Augmentation.

Each specialization should serve you well. And remember, you can change or adapt it later.
65701.completion:
Excellent choice.

Remember, you can reconsider your specialization and adjust abilities as needed--so long as you are not in the heat of battle.

65702.title: Driven Mad
65702.description:
The Azure Archives was once a place where the blue dragons would gather to discuss magic.

Now I am the only one of my kind here.

This place controls the ley lines beneath the Azure Span, but it and its servants have gone out of control.

I believe if we bring order to this place that I can then reclaim the Azure Oathstone.

The various constructs and elements are brimming with unstable arcane energy that needs to be redirected.

Destroy them and collect what you can.
65702.progress: The archives are in a perpetual state of recreation for most of its guardians. We need to fix its flow.
65702.completion: Excellent work. The creations here are already being soothed with just this amount of unstable arcana removed.

65709.title: Arcane Pruning
65709.description:
We cannot activate the oathstone in the Azure Archives until we fix the issue with the out of control ley energy here.

Two out of the three draconic runes that are meant to control it are being choked by unstable arcana.

I apologize that this falls to you, given Khadgar's responsibilities and the lack of my brethren appearing.

There should be a ley scepter within that bag of helpful goods you have.

Use it to help repair the runes nearby.
65709.progress: The ley scepter should allow you to properly align and configure the runes nearby.
65709.completion:
Excellent work. It seems these runes are able to transport us to the top of the archives.

I believe that may be where our last problem resides...
65709.objectives: Look through the Bag of Helpful Goods for the Ley Scepter, then use it to repair 2 platforms.

65711.title: Stealing Its Thunder
65711.description:
It's you! Thank Ohn'ahra. I was pretending to be hurt to fool the next brute who dared come in here. Ugh--the hoof lickers put some binding spell on me. I'll figure it out.

They've got Lizi in the cave. Please save her. I'll figure out how to free myself.

Do what you have to do.
65711.progress: Anyone whose laid a hoof on Lizi will pay!
65711.completion: <Radiya is unusually quiet and trembling slightly as she looks upon the tortured beast.>
65711.objectives: Kill the Storm Extractors and rescue Lizi the Thunderspine in Kaighan Camp.

65717.title: Leading Motives
65717.description:
<A small object catches your eye. It glitters with Progenitor magic--ancient, yet... strangely more refined.>

<Soft vibrations and tones are woven into the device in a repeating refrain that almost seems to be trying to... speak?>

<Firim would be very interested in this.>
65717.completion:
By the First Ones... once again, you bring me the extraordinary. You say you found this when you defeated the Jailer? How curious.

It almost seems as if it's trying to... to communicate somehow. The implications alone are--ah! Forgive me for getting carried away. This will require more than simple research, I'm afraid. 

Please, take this in return. It was one of my first discoveries--I suspect you have more to gain from its mobility than I do. 

Thank you, my friend.
65717.objectives: Bring the Almanac's Echo to Firim in Exile's Hollow.

65725.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
65725.progress:
The large bufonid beneath the mud remains still.

There must be something it fancies. Have you some meats we can use to lure it out?
Tenebrous Ribs (30)
65725.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Let us see if this does the trick.

65726.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
65726.progress:
If meat and honey could not lure this creature from the waters, let us try another approach. 

Bring me some Shrouded Cloth. I will craft a net from it that may be more effective.
Shrouded Cloth (200)
65726.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Let us try this for Bud's sake, if not our own curiosity.

65727.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
65727.description:
Have you stopped to watch the bufonids?

A lovely one lurks underwater. Still, patient, unmoving. Wise Bud takes after him. They are much alike. I sense Bud desires to see this large bufonid up close. 

Perhaps the creature can be lured out with some honey from the vespoids here in Zereth Mortis. Would you please gather some?
65727.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Now, let us see if this will entice that bufonid to emerge.
65727.objectives: Collect 15 Vespoid Honey from Vespoid around Zereth Mortis.

65728.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
65728.progress:
Since a trap did not work, let us try again to find a lure that interests this austere bufonid. 

Perhaps it desires some fish? Please bring us some.
Elysian Thade (10)
65728.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Let us hope this works.

65729.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
65729.progress:
I am running out of ideas. What else might entice our shy friend?

Let us try more flesh from the creatures of Zereth Mortis. Something must grab its attention!
Protoflesh (5)
65729.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Let us see if this produces results.

65730.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
65730.progress:
What else could we possibly try to persuade this bufonid to emerge?

Maybe the jiro know the trick. I hear there is one with fruit pastries to offer. Bring us one, if you please.
Catalyzed Apple Pie (5)
65730.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Maybe our bufonid friend just has more refined taste.

65731.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
65731.progress:
Hmmmmm...

My friend, I am nearly out of ideas. We have exhausted most of Zereth Mortis' supply of tempting flavors. 

I have spent hours pondering the things I find enticing. Only one thing outside of Zereth Mortis brushes my memory: 

Sweet organic melons. 

My dear friend once sold them just inside the great Tazavesh marketplace. Is it possible they are still there? You will need to gain access to the city, if you have not already.
Organic Melon (1)
65731.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. This is a piece of a past long lost and forgotten...

But it is not for me. Let us see if this at last will attract our hidden bufonid friend.

65732.title: The Patient Bufonid
65732.description:
Look, another magnificent creature of Zereth Mortis! By the glint in its eye, I would say it was playing along the whole time.

Patience delights. Bud is pleased. 

Excellent work, Maw Walker.
65732.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. The creature seems quite friendly, and I believe it has taken a liking to you! I am certain you will take excellent care of it.

65735.title: WANTED: Custos
65735.description:
A once-stable automa is showing signs of unusual dysfunction, attacking Enlightened along the road outside of Pilgrim's Grace. 

It is essential that the roads remain safe for our pilgrims.

Rafiq has designated the elimination of this threat to be of the highest priority.
65735.completion: I do not understand why it was behaving in that manner, but we will be safer now that it is gone. This reward shall start you on the way towards some of my finer equipment.

65748.title: You Supply the Effort
65748.description:
The gear I provide is made available by the blessings of the First Ones and the... efforts of many other travelers.

Each of us needs to provide for those that will follow later.

Collect what provisions you come across in your exploration of Zereth Mortis. Keep a sharp eye out--they may be hidden in mysterious places. Return them here to me. I will in turn provide them to future travelers.
65748.progress: What have you found for me?
65748.completion: Well met, traveler! What have you found there? Ah, this will help many other travelers in need. You have my thanks--and theirs as well.
65748.objectives: Locate 10 Enlightened Provisions from chests, nests, relics and other containers about Zereth Mortis.

65750.title: Eight-Legged Menace
65750.description:
{class}!

I require your aid if you're willing...

This joint expedition was intended to study the unique arachnids inhabiting the area, but, as you can see, our plan has gone awry. 

What we originally assumed was an evolutionary adaptation is instead a Primalist perversion of the natural order!

I take my responsibilities as a conservationist seriously, but the time for studying live specimens has passed. We can't let their perversion spread. We can study their corpses instead. 

Will you help us?
65750.completion:
An unfortunate necessity. We could not allow them to spread.

I think we've learned all we can from them.
65750.objectives: Kill 10 Shiverweb Creepers or Shiverweb Crawlers and 3 Primalist Tenders in Shiverweb Vale.

65751.title: Platform Adjustments
65751.description:
It seems the last of the arcane disruption is up here. 

I'll continue adjusting the ley energies. Use some of the arcana you recovered to dispel the disruptions here.
65751.completion: Fine work! I can feel the ley lines beneath this place beginning to heal. We're almost done.
65751.objectives: Dispel 3 Unstable Arcane Energies at the top of the Azure Archives.

65752.title: Arcane Annoyances
65752.description:
A large number of mana wyrms are absorbing the wild arcane magic coming out from the archives.

The rate that they're doing it is causing the ley lines to be thrown off balance... which is preventing the Azure Oathstone from being reclaimed.

I will use some of the unstable arcana you collected to form a hook of sorts.

Use it to slay several of the wyrms. The brief delay will be enough for me to adjust the energies below.
65752.progress: These wyrms will learn to feast somewhere else.
65752.completion: The Kirin Tor will ensure these archives are properly cared for when this is finished. Thank you for your aid.

65758.title: Grungir the Explorer
65758.description:
{NAME}! My Explorers' League counterpart, Grungir Ironspout, wasn't among those you rescued. He had fought his way free originally, but once he saw how few of us made it out, he turned around and headed right back in! Alone!

The oaf is as brave as he is impulsive and does not deserve whatever fate has befallen him.

Please... find him.
65758.completion: Good tae see another face with the right number o' eyes!

65760.title: Reporting for Duty
65760.description:
I've only read of the djaradin in books.

Ancient rivals to the dragons, powerful giants with mastery over earth and lava... dedicated wholly to hunting dragons to extinction.

<Sendrax furrows her brow at the distant volcano.>

My instructor said that they hadn't been seen since the dragons left as they slumbered deep in the earth.

If they've awoken, every whelpling on the isles is in danger!

We should hurry to Commander Lethanak at the Dragonheart Outpost.
65760.progress: Our ancient enemies have risen from their slumber... and wasted no time.
65760.completion:
I will take what reinforcements I can get.

We must act swiftly.
65760.objectives: Meet commander Lethanak at the Dragonheart Outpost.

65761.title: More Adventure Than Expected
65761.description:
<Godoloto's stare is beady and accusatory. She huffs.>

<Perhaps the ohuna can help you find and rescue Radiya.>
65761.objectives: Work with Godoloto to find and rescue Radiya.

65762.title: Sepulcher of the First Ones - Heavy is the Crown
65762.description:
Anduin's blade is a powerful conduit for The Jailer. If we claim fragments of this weapon, I'll be able to open a pathway directly to the boy king.

Four fragments should be enough. With these, we can break the Jailer's hold on Anduin for good.
65762.progress: Four Sword Fragments should allow us to access his chamber.
65762.completion: This should help us travel directly to Anduin.
65762.objectives: Collect 4 Sword Fragments from Anduin within the Sepulcher of the First Ones on Mythic Difficulty.

65763.title: Sepulcher of the First Ones - Heavy is the Crown
65763.description:
Anduin's blade is a powerful conduit for The Jailer. If we claim fragments of this weapon, I'll be able to open a pathway directly to the boy king.

Four fragments should be enough. With these, we can break the Jailer's hold on Anduin for good.
65763.progress: Four Sword Fragments should allow us to access his chamber.
65763.completion: This should help us travel directly to Anduin.
65763.objectives: Collect 4 Sword Fragments from Anduin within the Sepulcher of the First Ones on Heroic Difficulty.

65764.title: Sepulcher of the First Ones - Heavy is the Crown
65764.description:
Anduin's blade is a powerful conduit for The Jailer. If we claim fragments of this weapon, I'll be able to open a pathway directly to the boy king.

Four fragments should be enough. With these, we can break the Jailer's hold on Anduin for good.
65764.progress: Four Sword Fragments should allow us to access his chamber.
65764.completion: This should help us travel directly to Anduin.
65764.objectives: Collect 4 Sword Fragments from Anduin within the Sepulcher of the First Ones on Normal Difficulty.

65768.title: Our Forward Scouts
65768.description:
The Jailer's forces control much of Zereth Mortis, but there are other dangers out there as well.

I have dispatched scouts to survey the surrounding area and pinpoint any potential threats.

Speak with each scout. They should have a report of their surveys. Gather this information and then return to me.
65768.completion: This information will help us plan our next move. Thank you, Maw Walker.
65768.objectives: Speak with the forward scouts in Zereth Mortis.

65769.title: Icy Webs
65769.description:
Many of my friends and colleagues were captured when the arachnids and their Primalist masters attacked. 

I saw them being bound in frozen webbing and dragged away to a fate I dare not consider. 

Please free any of them that you can!
65769.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. I feared I would never see any of them again.
65769.objectives: Free 6 Cocooned Survivors in Shiverweb Vale.

65770.title: A Promise Is A Promise
65770.description:
The animals are comfortable around you. That's a good indicator of your spirit.

Actually... can you keep a secret? I want to introduce you to my friend. Nobody else knows about her.

You have to promise me first that you'll keep this between us. My Ohn would exile me from the plains if she found out.
65770.objectives: Promise Initiate Radiya to keep her secret.

65771.title: Favor of the First Ones
65771.description:
The attack from the Jailer's forces is a sign! In the past, there was one among us who sought the forbidden knowledge of the First Ones. For that, we must have earned their ire and lost the protections we once had.

We must atone for the trespasses of our kin.

Take this incense. Go out into the veldt and burn it as offerings to the First Ones. I hope they will offer us forgiveness.
65771.completion:
May the First Ones accept these offerings as penitence for past transgressions. 

Thank you, Maw Walker.
65771.objectives: Burn Enlightened Incense around the Great Veldt.

65772.title: Necessary Harvest
65772.description:
Between the Mawsworn attacks and your presence here, our supplies are dwindling. It pains me to say it, but the most immediate solution for replenishing our resources is the local wildlife. 

It is unfortunate that it has come to this, but it is what must be done. Cull some of the local wildlife, and help us replenish our supplies.
65772.progress: Have you brought us the necessary supplies?
65772.completion: Thank you. Your efforts are greatly appreciated.
65772.objectives: Collect 15 Latent Protein from raptora, cervids, and lupines in The Great Veldt and surrounding area.

65774.title: The Catalyst Awakens
65774.description:
Adventurer, can you feel it? High above the Catalyst Gardens, the Creation Catalyst hums with new power. 

This power will change the world itself. You must harness it at once.
65774.progress: The very fabric of creation shudders.
65774.completion: The power of creation itself is in your hands.
65774.objectives: Travel to the Catalyst Gardens and use the Creation Catalyst.

65777.title: Mudcaked Necklace
65777.description:
<The ancient markings on the necklace are quite difficult to read, but the materials appear to be made of animal hide and carved bone fragments.

Perhaps a knowledgeable hunter may glean insight into this object's value.>
65777.objectives: Locate someone knowledgeable in plainshunting and handcrafted artifacts.

65778.title: Screechflight Potluck
65778.description:
Are you ready to put those acting chops of yours to good use, {NAME}?

What? You don't have any chops? Then it's a good thing I've made you an im-PECK-able Screechflight disguise out of all the materials you just gathered!

Segallia and I still need time to finish building the final "egg" that will take out the matriarch, but I've made a smaller, prototype version for you to try out on the chef.

And don't worry! You'll be 12% safer from these explosions under all the feathers!
65778.progress: Old Monte Gazlowe once invited me over and cooked dinner to impress me. To be honest, it smelled a lot like whatever is coming from that cave over there.
65778.completion:
You did great and looked pretty good in that outfit to boot!

Finally ready to cut this terrifying threat off at its beak?
65778.objectives: Wear your disguise and use the Prototype "Egg" on the Matriarch's Personal Chef.

65779.title: Into the Plains
65779.description:
The green dragonflight has returned to their gardens in the nearby plains. Queen Alexstrasza wishes for you to make contact with Merithra of the Dream.

The centaur of those plains are fierce hunters. To reach the Emerald Gardens, you will need to establish diplomacy with them first.

Be respectful, but show no weakness.
65779.progress:
<Tomul eyes you up and down with reserved curiosity.>

State your business in the plains.
65779.completion: You serve as an envoy of the dragons, then. Times are changing.
65779.objectives: Meet the Shikaar scout in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

65780.title: Proving Oneself
65780.description:
A gift from dragons may impress some centaur, but Clan Shikaar must see how well you hunt.

One of our hunting parties just brought down a proto-dragon infused with the power of flame. Prove your worth by aiding in the kill.
65780.progress: You look like you can handle yourself, but looks can be deceiving.
65780.completion: You are a more formidable fighter than I assumed.

65782.title: Under Lock and Key
65782.description:
When we heard rumors of a Deathwing cult, Majordomo Selistra ordered me to bring these erstwhile scaleborn back into the fold. We'd hoped it was a simple misunderstanding.

Clearly, we were wrong.

Their leader must be dealt with--but first I need out of this cage. Find the key and bring it to me.
65782.progress: I must admit: this cage has gotten rather tiresome.
65782.completion: I may have suffered imprisonment--but the Worldbreakers barely spit an ember next to the Twilight's Hammer. I should be grateful for that at least.
65782.objectives: Acquire the Worldbreaker Cell Key and free Ayasanth.

65783.title: Welcome at Our Fire
65783.description:
You have fought alongside our hunters and earned a place at our fire.

Our khan is at our hunting post in the swamp, readying our upcoming caravan. I will notify her of your arrival and purpose.

Surely you can find your way on your own.
65783.completion: You outsiders seem to have a habit of meddling in the affairs of others.
65783.objectives: Meet with Scout Tomul at Timberstep Outpost.

65784.title: The Otter Side
65784.description:
To the northeast, there are a system of otter burrows along the bank. Some of the otters there are blessed by the river to grow to magnificent sizes.

I will not have you hunting these blessings out of respect. Instead you will bring them back here, alive, so that we may treat them with the reverence they deserve.
65784.progress: Remember, they must be returned alive.
65784.completion: Fine creatures. We will make use of everything they have to offer.
65784.objectives: Bring 3 Gargantuan River Otters back to Clan Aylaag.

65788.title: A Walk with Ghosts
65788.description:
Reclaiming these ruins means a lot to the Forsaken. Especially since the war ended, our people have needed something to hold onto, to give us purpose in the wake of everything that's happened to us.

I saw Calia walk toward the throne room. That place holds many memories for her. Many ghosts. 

We should check on her.
65788.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. You have helped so much. 

From here, I believe the Forsaken will rebuild and solidify their identity. Not just as former denizens of Lordaeron, but as their own people. A people I am proud to be one of.
65788.objectives: Speak to Calia in the throne room of Lordaeron.

65791.title: Life-Binder on Duty
65791.description:
Soon the Life Pools will be full once again.

Thank you for your part in this, {NAME}, it means more than I can ever hope to express.

Go, find the Life-Binder by the oathstone. Tell her that we are ready for the eggs.
65791.completion: The future of all the flights is now secure.
65791.objectives: Meet Alexstrasza by the Ruby Oathstone.

65792.title: Teeth for a Tooth
65792.description:
Toliqui has been claiming that just the other day she killed a rockfang without any assistance. Given our connected souls, I don't want to call her as a liar. So instead... 

I want to prove to her, and everyone else, that I'm the better half of our soul! The nearest rockfang quest is to the northeast - meet me there!
65792.progress: I cannot let Toliqui continue to leave me in her shadow.
65792.completion: The clan will be talking about this for weeks!

65793.title: Black Wagon Flight
65793.description:
With the oathstone empowered once more, we must now transport the future of our kind to the Life Pools. It is the right of every true dragonflight to have their eggs nurtured by its waters.

Unfortunately, our enemies will be watching the skies, now that we have revealed ourselves. We will make the final leg of the journey on foot to avoid their scrutiny.

Meet me near the Obsidian Bulwark, {class}. As the Life-Binder's champion, you are welcome to join me in this.
65793.objectives: Escort the eggs to the Life Pools.

65794.title: A Charge of Care
65794.description:
You have my thanks, {class}, and my condolences for having to deal with those two for as long as you did.

The red dragonflight is charged with the preservation and nurturing of all dragons, even those we may tire of at times.

With the return of the Black Dragonflight's eggs, dragonkind is united as it has not been in thousands of years. I believe this is what will restore our ruby oathstone.

Speak with me when you are ready to bring the eggs to the Obsidian Lifepool.
65794.completion:
The Life Pools are filled once more, in no small part thanks to you.

With our purpose fulfilled, our oathstone shines once more as a symbol of our calling.
65794.objectives: Witness the Black Dragon Eggs rejoin the Life Pools.

65795.title: Next Steppes
65795.description:
The green dragonflight requires your aid now, hero. My sister's daughter and her flight have entered the Emerald Dream in an attempt to empower their own oathstone, but we have heard nothing since their slumber began.

Seek out the centaur that rule over the Ohn'ahran Plains. You may well need their connection to the land and its spirits if you are to rouse the greens.

They are a proud and territorial people who do not suffer insult lightly. Speak with our ambassador and he will prepare you.
65795.completion: We have much to discuss, you and I.
65795.objectives: Meet Ambassador Taurasza in the Rubyscale Outpost.

65798.title: An Opportunistic Approach
65798.description:
The Shikaar have formed an offensive line against the Nokhud to the north. While I do not like stooping to scavenging, it is unfortunately a necessary evil for our supplies. Brave the battlefield and return with weapons, and I will reward your efforts.

If you could focus said efforts on the Nokhud side of the line, perhaps the ancestors will judge me less harshly.
65798.progress: Weapons will be the most useful thing - I apologize for asking this of you.
65798.completion: Ancestors forgive me. If I were stronger, we would not need to resort to such a questionable method for resources.
65798.objectives: Retrieve weapons and slay Nokhud forces at the Nokhud Approach.

65801.title: Making Introductions
65801.description:
<As Sansok Khan signs, Okir vocalizes for her.>

It has been countless generations since an outsider like you reached our lands. With Primalists treading on our lands and peddling forbidden magics, my people are understandably wary.

If you are to travel with us, you must make yourself known. Introduce yourself to the members of my clan.
65801.progress: Good. The Khan is putting you to work.
65801.completion: The rest of our attending clan has already traveled to Maruukai to prepare our site. The caravan from this outpost will be the last to arrive.
65801.objectives: Introduce yourself to members of Clan Shikaar.

65802.title: Supplies for the Journey
65802.description:
<As Sansok Khan signs, Okir vocalizes for her.>

While you travel with us, you must pull your weight. Unruly gorlocs have been raiding our medical supplies recently, and we must restock. Gather the orange blooms around the outpost so we can create more poultices.

There are supplies around the outpost that need to be brought to the caravan as well. I would like you to gather them while you are out.

Once you have everything, bring it to Tomul.
65802.progress: Don't bother me until you have the caravan provisions.
65802.completion:
<Scout Tomul looks over the gathered provisions.>

Everything seems to be in order.
65802.objectives: Collect 5 Camp Provisions from around Timberstep Outpost and 4 Feralbloom Pods from the nearby woods.

65803.title: Toward the City
65803.description:
The Khural is a time of discussion amongst clans. Stories are shared. While there are many centaur clans across the plains, we are all Maruuk.

The caravan is ready to go. As Maruukai is some distance away, we will make stops.

When you are ready to leave, find me at the caravan. Don't keep us waiting.
65803.objectives: Travel alongside the Shikaar caravan to Wanderer's Steppe.

65804.title: For Food and Rivalry
65804.description:
Maruuk travel from all across the plains to attend the Khural, and the gathering lasts many days.

Feeding that many centaur is no simple feat. Clan Shikaar's hunters provide meat for all of the shared meals. It is our tradition to hunt on our way to Maruukai. 

You must pull your weight as well.
65804.progress: Our youngest hunters are passionate and determined. Be sure they don't show you up.
65804.completion: You hunt as strangely as you fight. I hope Aru and Belika observed your technique.
65804.objectives: Collect 30 Fresh Game Meat from wildlife in Wanderer's Steppe.

65805.title: Connection to Ohn'ahra
65805.description:
The wind is restless here, {NAME}. Ohn'ahra is reaching out. I must answer her call.

I need reagents for my ritual: reeds from the riverbanks, feathers from the tails of mallards, and the heart of a salamanther. Gather these materials from the river so that I may heed her voice.
65805.progress: Ohn'ahra's song is fleeting. We must work quickly.
65805.completion: Excellent. I will use these materials to interpret her song.
65805.objectives: Collect 4 River Reeds, 8 Fowl Tailfeathers, and a Salamanther Heart from the river banks.

65806.title: Maruukai
65806.description:
<Okir vocalizes as Sansok Khan signs.>

Maruukai rests beside a mountain near this grove. Our journey is almost over.

The Khural is a time of truce amongst the Maruuk, but Ohn Seshteng's omen is troubling. We must stay on our guard.

65832.title: Dwarven Antifreeze
65832.description:
I'm in a wee bit of a pickle, $Uladdie:lassie;. The Primalist frost lickers stuck me in this overgrown ice cube and the only reason I'm nae frozen solid yet is me secret stash o' the good stuff. 

Sadly, me less secret stashes got nicked when tae thieving scum jumped me. I'm runnin' low!

Would ye do a dwarf a kindness and fetch me flasks afore me blood turns tae ice?

Oh, and $Uladdie:lassie;, if ye do haftae pull one out o' some spider's unmentionables, dinnae tell me. I'd rather nae know.
65832.progress: I can feel ma wee piggies freezin'!
65832.completion: Thank Magni! This'll keep me blood from freezin' long enough for the ice tae melt.

65833.title: Primalist Tampering
65833.description:
