The Primalists are infusin' spiders with elemental ice and are fixin' to use 'em as shock troops tae overrun the dragons' defenses in the Span. We cannae let that happen.

The three frosty lookin' ones are in charge. Take 'em out and bring me the runestones they're using tae focus the primal magic and we can see about cuttin' off the flow.

65834.title: Kill the Queen
65834.description:
Here we go! A lil' formal education, a lil' educated guessin', a touch o' re-chiselin' runes, and we got ourselves a magic un-infuser! Defuser? Out-fuser?

Whatever! It'll do somethin' unpleasant tae the queen, o' that I'm pretty sure. And she's got tae go if we're aimin' tae stop the threat. Squashin' the lil' ones will only slow 'em down. Ye got tae cut 'em off at the source.
65834.progress: She's in the cave over yonder.  Giant spider. Cannae miss 'er.
65834.completion:
Aye, that should throw a wrench intae their plan.

Now... just tae push... a... lil'... harder...

65836.title: Show of Storm
65836.description:
<Watu stands up easily, as if his injury was gone.>

I--I--I stuck the shard into myself. Nothing hurts anymore. I feel good. Great. Immense.

Olekk still isn't back. Something must have gone awry. He should have never gone without me!
65836.objectives: Regroup with Watu in the Sagecrest Pines.

65837.title: Trouble In The Pines
65837.description:
There's been a primalist attack in the Shikaar Highlands.

If you have information or think you can help, head over to Pinewood Post and look for Olekk. Tell him I sent you. <Tirren chuckles.> I sure hope the dusty hoofer remembers me.

Keep to the roads, $p. The plains are not as peaceful since all this change arrived.
65837.completion:
Tirren? He's still hoofing around, is he?

Thank you for coming. We can use all the help we can get.
65837.objectives: Speak to Sentinel Olekk at Pinewood Post in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

65838.title: Breaching the Brackenhide
65838.description:
If the gnolls here have discovered decay magic, the ley line and even the land itself are in grave danger. 

My mirror images are spread too thin to withstand elemental disruption of this scale. Please enter the forest and investigate the decay. 

I'll work with our new tuskarr friends to find a place I can maintain my image. Then, I will meet you deeper in the forest.

We must put a stop to this!
65838.progress: Can you sense the disruption of magic all around us?
65838.completion: You may want to cover your mouth. You don't want to breathe in the decay.

65840.title: Same as the Old Boss
65840.description:
The Worldbreaker dragonkin are a trusting lot. We have followed many different leaders over the years, believing that each will lead us to the Hour of Twilight and the return of Deathwing.

However, Deathwing has not returned, and still there is no Twilight.

It is time for a new leader. You can help bring about the change.
65840.progress: Are we ready for a new leader?
65840.completion: You have done well. Now there is ample room for a new leader to rise and bring the Worldbreakers to a better future.

65842.title: Disarming Behavior
65842.description:
I have little love for the Worldbeaker dragonkin. They follow a misplaced belief that Deathwing himself will return one day, and they will not help us with the Obsidian Throne.

Weaponmaster Vordak, who once swore loyalty to the Black Prince, has stolen many weapons crafted here in the Citadel and given them to the Worldbreakers. I will not allow such theft. Or such betrayal.

Go to Smoldering Peak and recover the weapons... by force if necessary.
65842.completion:
Well done. These weapons are back where they belong.

I'm sure this won't be the last conflict we have with the Worldbreakers, either. Anyone crazy enough to think that Deathwing will return isn't going to be reasoned with.
65842.objectives: Eliminate Weaponmaster Vordak and collect 15 Worldbreaker Weapons.

65844.title: Cut Out the Rot
65844.description:
This decay must have rotted these gnolls' brains as well as their bodies! 

Destructive as they are, gnolls are native to this land--just like us.

But we already saw them spreading decay to the Big Tree Tribe. At this rate, they'll consume the Span and destroy themselves. 

We can't let this happen. It's a shame... but put an end to them.
65844.progress:
Er, please, do tell... Did you see any interesting effects of the decay on any gnolls you observed? The effect on their social structure must be enormous...

Ah, we should stay on task.
65844.completion:
Gnolls can be fascinating creatures! They're not evil, only wild. And very dumb. 

Killing them is a shame, but the decay helps no one. And we can't let them hurt our family.
65844.objectives: Kill 5 Rotting Treants and 10 Brackenhide Rotflingers.

65845.title: Echoes of the Fallen
65845.description:
There are tuskarr here! My friends, my people--my family. They left for a hunt not a week ago.

Already they're too decayed to recover. 

Their spirits are here still. They linger in rage and regret. Kaqiata, Lutokk, Tuyuki...

Please, {NAME}, take this totem and place it near their remains. It'll contact their spirits... and help them find peace.
65845.progress:
Some of my fallen kin were able to take Karkut's hand into the next world. Others weren't. I feel their presence like a weight.

Lutokk was going to wed in the next moon. 

Tuyuki wanted to sail to Northrend to reconnect with our distant kin. 

Popoak was a great hunter, and Hanu's cousin. His kills made for the best soups.

Nomurok was so young. This was his first hunt.

Kaqiata was little Rowie's only blood family left. Now who'll teach him to fish?
65845.completion:
So they all chose to lend their power to my totem? 

<Brena squeezes her eyes shut in sorrow.> 

Thank you, my friends. We will use the strength of your spirits well. The gnolls will not reach Iskaara.
65845.objectives: Place Brena's Totem near 5 tuskarr corpses to contact their spirits.

65846.title: Ley Litter
65846.description:
The ley line is here--I can feel it! 

But first, we must stop the gnolls. That ancient will be their greatest weapon.

There are some ley crystals the gnolls have gathered. Thankfully, they don't seem to understand the power that the crystals hold. 

Bring me as many as you can. They'll empower my mirror image and help me summon something useful from the Archives to take that monster down!
65846.progress:
I'm sorry I can't be of more help in this form. I can feel the decay sapping my image's strength. 

I hope once we reach the ley cavern, Gleamcove as the tuskarr call it, I'll be able to teleport here fully.
65846.completion:
What were they doing with these? Using them as back scratchers?!

<Kalecgos pinches the bridge of his nose.>

...I suppose we should be grateful they didn't figure out their true potential.
65846.objectives: Collect 7 Ley Crystals from Brackenhide Outskirts.

65847.title: Realignment
65847.description:
Now for this ley line. It looks like my fears were correct -- the decay has spread into the line itself.

We'll need to purge the decay and speed along the healing process, but I can't channel enough energy with my mirror image alone. 

Focus yourself on this ley crystal here. My connection with you will help me teleport here physically. Then, I will be strong enough.
65847.progress: While the decay here is lessened, it's still thick enough to cause trouble teleporting safely.
65847.completion:
We did it. Great work, {NAME}. Breathe the fresh air again!

With this ley line restored, and Khadgar finishing up on the one in the tower, the Oathstone should be ready to claim. I must return to the Azure Archives shortly.
65847.objectives: Focus on the Ley Crystal, then destroy 3 Decay Infections.

65848.title: Tome-ward Bound
65848.description:
We must stop that tree! With these ley crystals, I can finally help.

Speak with me when you are ready. I'll open a portal into the Azure Archives and try to bring out something useful. 

Stand back, it may be rather unstable.
65848.completion:
You did well, hero, thank you. 

That tree was probably not their only pool of decay, but it was the riskiest one for the tuskarr and this ley line. With it gone, this area may be able to recover. It will take time, but it will heal. 

I'm glad we were able to give the spirits of those tuskarr some peace.

65849.title: To Iskaara
65849.description:
Thank you, {NAME}, for all your help. My family is safe because of you.

Now, we can finally return to Iskaara and see old Ponoliak taken back to the sea. He was my mentor, and a fine chieftain. 

Please, you must join us! A celebration of the Cycle of the Sea is something all can share in.
65849.completion:
I'm so glad you have come to join us. 

I must ask you to be patient, however. There is still much to be prepared for the ceremony.

65850.title: The Cycle of the Sea
65850.description:
Thank you, {NAME}. I have learned what I need for now from our new friends. 

The funeral ceremony for their former chieftain is about to start. Given how kind and hospitable the Iskaarans have been to us, it seems only right that we join them before departing back to the Archives. 

Speak with Brena and let her know we are ready when they are.
65850.progress:
It is good to slow down, now and then. And interesting to see the tuskarr's traditions. 

It has been long since the blue dragonflight has had traditions such as these.
65850.objectives: Speak with Brena to witness the funeral ceremony.

65852.title: Straight to the Top
65852.description:
There appears to be something sapping the arcane energies at the apex of the tower. 

Now that you've stabilized the energies down here, you should be able to "ride" the arcane magics in the area.

Look in that bag of yours for something called an arcane stepping stone, and use it to meet me at the top.
65852.progress: It's a long way down from here. Be careful.
65852.completion: It's a bit worse up here than I had anticipated!

65854.title: Reclaiming the Oathstone
65854.description:
Fine work, friend. It seems we've managed to repair the leylines within the Azure Archives.

Back when the blue dragonflight was united, I would tell my brothers and sisters to never doubt the strength of mortals.

Meet me at the oathstone to the south of here. I will reclaim it, and then be on my way to Thaldraszus.
65854.completion:
It is good to be back... or reactivated, as it were. 

There is much to do, and I am glad to give whatever aid I can.
65854.objectives: Witness Kalecgos reclaim the Azure Oathstone.

65855.title: Aiding Azure Span
65855.description:
The oathstone's energy cannot be reclaimed until the ley lines within the Azure Span are repaired.

Some ley lines may only be reachable by those of Kalecgos's skills... but you may still be of aid.

If they still yet survive, seek out the tuskarr. They lived here in my times and have a deep knowledge of the land.

Speak with one of our arcane aids to return to your allies.
65855.progress: What can I do for you?
65855.completion: The tuskarr? There are a number of tuskarr merchants and travellers who pass through here.
65855.objectives: Return to Noriko the All-Remembering in Camp Antonidas.

65864.title: Catch the Caravan
65864.description:
You should catch up with Brena. Her caravan passed through no more than a few hours ago.

They were collecting our late chieftain's most prized possessions for a funeral to honor him.

Given that the caravan was heavily burdened, she can't be far ahead.
65864.completion:
The gnolls were ruthless in their assault.

They hit us hard and fast and took everything that wasn't nailed down.
65864.objectives: Catch up with Brena near the Big Tree Hills.

65866.title: Snap the Traps
65866.description:
The hills ahead are littered with insidious bladejaw traps.

With a keen eye, you should be able to locate them. Very carefully spring the traps using this old tuskarr trick: a long stick. Note that while stepping on them is another way to set the traps off, I wouldn't recommend it.

Once enough have been removed, find Hanu. Elder Poa and I will catch up when we can.
65866.completion: Well done. It will be safer for Brena to make her way here.

65867.title: Howling in the Big Tree Hills
65867.description:
The gnolls that attacked our caravan were led by three lieutenants.

Durgun was flanked by a dozen hyenas.

Kerwal cackled maniacally each time we tried to pursue him and fell for one of his steel-jawed traps.

Bakra taunted us, mercilessly.

To have a hope in recovering what was stolen, they must be slain.
65867.completion:
Good, you did what I could not. 

But there is another gnoll leading the Shadepaw... more terrifying than the three you encountered.

65868.title: Those Aren't for Chewing
65868.description:
I found one of Ponoliak's funerary offerings, mishandled and then discarded by these Shadepaw gnolls... It has bite marks all over it!

This offering, and others like it, are needed for the memorial ceremony for the recently deceased Iskaara chieftain.

It's a travesty that something so sacred should be employed as a chew toy. Please keep an eye out for more offerings.
65868.progress: <Hanu leans forward and gazes into your pack hopefully.>
65868.completion:
<Hanu's nose crinkles.>

Ugh... slathered in slobber.

They will have to suffice for the chieftain's memorial.

65869.title: Another Ambush
65869.description:
A tragedy. And potentially the first of many more.

Find out what Akiun knows, then examine anyone who fell in the attack. 

I have my hunches about what happened here. Let's see if the clues support my theory.

Meanwhile, I'll try to reassure my rattled friends.
65869.progress: We must pinpoint the source of this gnoll aggression, before they can do any more damage.
65869.completion:
This is truly a tragedy... but at least we can follow the clues.

We are getting closer to the source of this rot.
65869.objectives: Speak to Akiun and examine 4 nearby corpses.

65870.title: Supplies!
65870.description:
There was no sign of our stolen hunting supplies in the Big Tree Hills. They must be in that cave.

Keep an eye out for the supply containers, and be prepared for anything.

I would not trust the gnolls to leave the goods unprotected.
65870.progress: I'd hate for Iskaara to go hungry...
65870.completion:
<Elder Poa looks approvingly at the supplies you've recovered.>

The Iskaara tuskarr will hunt again.
65870.objectives: Recover the caches of hunting supplies.

65871.title: Gnoll Way Out
65871.description:
I've tracked the captured tuskarr, including my husband Norukk, to this cave. 

Norukk doesn't always look out for his own hide, so that responsibility falls to me. But I'm not too proud to ask for help.

Please rescue them!
65871.progress: We can't leave our brothers and sisters behind!
65871.completion:
<Hanu wrinkles her cheeks and shoots a tusky grin at Norukk.>

I'm beyond relieved that Norukk made it out alive. We will mourn those we lost once we return to Iskaara.
65871.objectives: Rescue Norukk and 3 other captive tuskarr.

65872.title: Ill Gnolls with Ill Intent
65872.description:
I'm catching a strange scent on the wind. Something here isn't right...

Hanu described the gnolls in this cave as strange... and sickly. We should learn more about what is causing this.

Don't let your guard down. Despite their sickly appearance, expect them to be just as devious and dangerous.
65872.completion:
We have never seen rot take on a form like this.

This is troubling.
65872.objectives: Kill 16 Shadepaw gnolls in Kargpaw's Den.

65873.title: Leader of the Shadepaw Pack
65873.description:
Kargpaw is the true leader of the gnolls in this part of the forest. We've had... unpleasant encounters with him in the past.

This time was different. He carried a strange totem that seemed to twist his very essence.

Kargpaw must be stopped and this totem recovered. I fear the gnolls are meddling in something darker than we can imagine.
65873.completion:
<Brena recoils in disgust as she accepts the totem.>

Kargpaw was always violent, but he was also a coward. He and his band never attacked us if we traveled in large numbers.

Something has changed... and this totem is behind it.
65873.objectives: Kill Kargpaw and recover his totem.

65874.title: A Rotten Revelation
65874.description:
Hmm...

<Brel peers intently at the strange totem, turning it over in her thick hands.>

We've got to put our whiskers together and determine what this means.
65874.objectives: Speak with Hanu, Elder Poa, and Norukk.

65875.title: A Dragon's Day Off
65875.description:
A lifetime spent in Outland... always fighting. So little time to relax!

Sometimes a dragon just needs a day off by the sea with a cold, cold drink in their claws.

Hey, maybe you can help me relax! Do me a favor and see if you can find a few of these drinks to refresh our supply here.
65875.progress: Have fetched my beverages yet? No? That's too bad.
65875.completion: Yes! Time to kick back and relax!
65875.objectives: Locate the various drinks for Vazallia.

65886.title: To Rhonin's Shield
65886.description:
Raszageth and the Primalists are launching an all out assault on Vakthros. We cannot let her succeed!

Khadgar and I will go ahead to handle the situation there from the sky.

In the meantime, make your way to the Rhonin's Shield, one of the last Kirin Tor camps in the area.

You may be able to get there faster by riding that drake of yours from the top of the archives.

See that the Kirin Tor there are all right, then make your way to Vakthros.

We'll be counting on your help from the ground.
65886.completion: I saw Kalecgos and Khadgar go towards the mountains a moment ago. We're holding our own against the Primalists here, but we can always use more help!
65886.objectives: Meet with Drok Scrollstabber in the Tower Outlook.

65887.title: To the Mountain
65887.description:
It's a sight to behold up there, Khadgar and Kalecgos fighting the Primalists in the sky!

They've summoned several mirror images of themselves to help you through the monstrous hole the Primalists have created.

One pair is at the base of the mountains right now. 

If things start to look bad... well I'll get the word out to the rest of us in the Azure Span.
65887.completion: This is worse than I could have expected. There's no time to lose.
65887.objectives: Meet Khadgar and Kalecgos's mirror images at the base of Vakthros Range.

65890.title: The Nelthazan Ruins
65890.description:
The Dragonscale Expedition requires your assistance.

A skyscribe was sent to the ruins to gather information. They should be uninhabited, but I can hear his shouting from over here.

He must be in dire circumstances for it to be audible at this distance.

On this expedition, we take care of our own. Even the insufferable ones. Seek him out and protect him from whatever danger he has found.
65890.completion: Well of course I am shouting! The book will not listen. What else am I to do?
65890.objectives: Meet Skyscribe Adenedal at the Nelthazan Ruins.

65891.title: Tools of the Tirade
65891.description:
Good. I was just thinking that I am in need of an adventurer like you. Strong. Sturdy. Willing to work for a trivial sum.

It is as if I willed you into existence. Well done, me. These ruins seem to have brought the attention of others. We cannot rely on them to excavate it properly. They will taint the samples!

Take this. Deploy it around artifacts of interest around the ruins. It is enchanted to perform any necessary duty.
65891.progress: I think I shall write a bit of poetry. Or, rather, instruct the book to write it for me.
65891.completion: We will gather everything in time.
65891.objectives: Deploy the enchanted tools to 5 piles of rubble.

65893.title: The Relic Inquiry
65893.description:
The Sundered Flame are here. Would you trust anyone claiming to be sundered with precious artifacts?

I did not think so. Regardless, we need to know what they are here for if we are to proceed. Gather what you can recover from them and report back to me with your findings.

There are more pieces to this puzzle than what we will find in the ground.
65893.completion:
They are still looking for something? Then why did you bring me this garbage?

We have to find it before they do!

65895.title: Competing Company
65895.description:
Bah! We will learn nothing from the slaughter of laborers.

Seek out their leaders. One of them will know what we need.

Oh, and {NAME}. Listen to them before you kill them this time. You may learn something useful.
65895.completion: I have seen a sickness like this once before in my life. I had hoped to never see it again.
65895.objectives: Gather information about the Sundered Flame.

65896.title: Let the Healing Begin
65896.description:
Do you think you would be able to step into this city without me noticing? No!

I was right about your kind before and I'll be damned before I let dragons destroy my home again.

This once was a park filled with joy and peace. Then your progenitor, Deathwing, came. Oh yes, I know all about him. 

See for yourself the legacy of destruction that was left behind. The pain that walks these streets still.
65896.completion:
You have given me the most wonderful gift today. You have shown me that my city is ready to heal. That our legacies are still in our control.

Go forth with honor, friend.
65896.objectives: Help the people of Stormwind heal.

65898.title: Proto Problems
65898.description:
I hold no love for the Sundered Flame, but even I cannot stand idle while they rip themselves apart like this. It is all too familiar.

Whatever this Locus is, it is safer in our hands than in their clutches. Follow the trail of bodies and I suspect we will find it.

Do be careful, $p. I worry we will find that the nest is not quite as abandoned as it appears.
65898.progress: I am glad you made it out safely. Do you have the Locus?
65898.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}.

You have been most helpful.
65898.objectives: Acquire the Locus and defeat the protodrake that protects it.

65899.title: Find Theramus
65899.description:
{race}! Are you here to visit the beautiful Lilac Ramble? I'm so sorry about its current state. I promise it's not usually this untended!

Theramus, the garden's keeper, was supposed to meet us today and tackle the issues together. He's been struggling with the upkeep lately, so Felina and I are helping out. But we can't do it all.

Would you help us look around for him? Maybe he did forget.
65899.completion: You found him! It looks like he's really down in the dumps today.
65899.objectives: Search the nearby caves and find Theramus.

65900.title: Suspiciously Spiced Steak
65900.description:
My sister's idea is charming, but Theramus needs a real pick-me-up.

That would be a generous serving of sourbloom. We can make it into a paste to slather onto his favorite food: turtle meat!

Will you help me collect the ingredients?
65900.progress:
Do you know why sourbloom grow under the coastal trees?

The tree roots trap an abundance of nutrients from the waves, which then feed the sourbloom. This gives them incredible nutritious value.
65900.completion: The meat to sourbloom ratio is just right.
65900.objectives: Collect 2 Perfectly Tender Turtle Meat, 6 Reptilian Eggshells, and 15 Sourbloom.

65901.title: Sneaking Out
65901.description:
I'm grounded indefinitely! Doesn't my Ohn know I'm turning sixteen next spring? I should be able to leave when I want to.

You look like you could help me out. I do have an escape plan: by channeling these totems, I'll concentrate the air and create quite a stir. But I can't go around placing them, because I'm under maximum wind watch. Even Togo won't help me.

But with your help... Please! I promise I'll show you something cool.
65901.progress: If you rat me out, I'll haunt you with the windiest ghost--FOREVER! Don't do it!
65901.objectives: Place the air totems in Ohn'iri Springs and then inform Radiya.

65902.title: Food or Floof
65902.description:
Look at this juicy and delectable herbed turtle meat! I speak objectively, of course. I'm a vegetarian.

Go on! He probably hasn't had a meal all day.
65902.progress: Go, before the meat gets old!
65902.completion: Oh dear. We heard his outburst. Are you okay?
65902.objectives: Bring the Herbed Turtle Meat and Glade Hoppers to Theramus.

65903.title: Can't Beat Fluffy
65903.description:
Poor Theramus. I have an idea to cheer him up!

Take this net to catch some of the native hoppers, which are docile but quick. They've made quite a home by the coast.

We'll bring them to Theramus. He'll literally be overrun with fluffy goodness!
65903.progress: They are impossibly soft! I could spend all day petting them.
65903.completion: So! Many! Hoppers! Let's pet them all!

65904.title: Enough Is Enough
65904.description:
Grumpy or not, Theramus has a job to do. While he hides inside, he can't see the consequences of his absence.

Let's go together. We'll show him the evidence.
65904.progress: This would convince anyone that the grove needs help, now!
65904.completion: ...I think it worked? He left the cave!
65904.objectives: Bring the evidence of Lilac Ramble's damage to Theramus.

65905.title: More Than Weeds
65905.description:
Perhaps it's best we give Theramus some space. 

But we can't be idle. The grove is destroying itself at a rapid rate! Please help us out.
65905.objectives: Clear out overgrowth and monsters in Lilac Ramble.

65906.title: A Disgruntled Initiate
65906.description:
I received an interesting letter from Ohn'iri Springs.

As for the letter's contents, it details, quote, horrid imprisonment, controlling mentors, and extreme boredom. It is formally signed by Initiate Radiya. There's also a sketch of an eagle... kicking a centaur named Meluun off a cliff.

Well. I suppose this is a call for help, if you are so inclined to see for yourself. To be frank, I think Radiya is probably okay. She sends me such letters often.
65906.completion:
Who are you? Ordven sent you? He actually reads my letters?!

<Radiya snorts with surprise and pleasure.> Thank Ohn'ara!
65906.objectives: Speak to Initiate Radiya at Ohn'iri Springs in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

65907.title: Favorite Fruit
65907.description:
Mystic training is so boring. I'm watching water be wet half of my days. My brothers are already out in the wild hunting drakes and primalists, and making a difference in the world.

Anyway, I promised I'd show you something cool! Did you know mudstompers love bushfruit? It grows nearby, among the geysers. Go pick some and we can feed them together.
65907.progress:
I used to really like bushfruit until I had too much one day.

My whole body was shivering, like a bad cold, and my breath was minty for days after.
65907.completion: Seems like they like you! Or just the fruit. That's okay too. <Radiya winks.>
65907.objectives: Forage Wild Bushfruit from the Ohn'ir Geysers and feed them to 6 Lounging Mudstompers.

65911.title: Azure Alignment
65911.description:
The bonds of this community... the friendship and family they share. 

I... never had that. The blue dragonflight never had that. And maybe that's because we haven't had a chance to. 

Now is the time. I must gather my kind. 

Meet me at the Azure Archives. There is much to be done.
65911.completion: I never expected to learn so much from the tuskarr. I think I'll visit when I can, and maintain those bonds of friendship.
65911.objectives: Return to Kalecgos in the Azure Archives.

65913.title: Wotcher, Watcher?
65913.description:
Thank the Titans! {class}, we need your help!

Primalists attacked only moments ago. My sisters and I were able to defend, but at a severe loss...

There will be time to mourn after my watcher is safe! A group of Primalists broke away while we were fighting and I swear if they hurt our Watcher--

You must help her before it's too late!
65913.completion: Thank you, {race}. Were it not for your aid, I would have surely perished.
65913.objectives: Rescue Watcher Mara from the Primalists in Tyrhold Reservoir.

65914.title: Mammoths Matter
65914.description:
Our tribe has proudly nurtured the On'tuq mammoth herd for generations. Now they're... gone. 

Their souls will linger in rage, after such a massacre. We must honor their lives by making good use of their remains.

There's too many for us to gather alone. Please, gather what materials you can from the youngsters and matriarchs, then meet me in the Kauriq Gleamlet.
65914.progress: My children had already picked out calves to foster into companions. How will I tell them?
65914.completion: With these remains, I think we can make something truly special... something that will put the souls of the mammoths at ease.
65914.objectives: Collect On'tuq Hide Scraps and On'tuq Tusks from fallen On'tuq Mammoths near the Kauriq Gleamlet.

65916.title: We Don't Negotiate with Primalists
65916.description:
The Primalists thought they were able to overcome the might of Tyr. They were wrong. 

My refti were able to track down the Primalists to a cave not far from here. As I thought, they have the missing keystones. 

Champion, if we are to restore the reservoir, we must get those keystones back.

Furthermore, their leader must be slain so that they won't attempt a second assault.
65916.progress: Surely once we get the keystones back, Zuttiki will not look so... Dismal.
65916.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Our final task of restoring the wards awaits.
65916.objectives: Slay Primalist Leader Ko'jo and retrieve the Missing Keystones in Tyrhold Reservoir.

65918.title: Preventative Maintenance
65918.description:
The Primal Elementals are reproducing unchecked. Ordinarily, my sisters and I would take care of them, but we're in no condition to fight them. We've had so many of our soldiers eliminated. 

Besides, we few that remain have other matters we must look into.
 
<Zuttiki winces in pain.>

That's where you come in, $p. Could you take care of the elementals?
65918.progress: Mara, my sisters? This wasn't supposed to happen.
65918.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. That should hold them at bay for now.
65918.objectives: Kill 8 Unleashed Elementals in Tyrhold Reservoir.

65920.title: For the Ward!
65920.description:
We can finally restore the wards. We have suffered great losses, but our work must be completed.

$p, we need your help once more. Bring each keystone to its rightful place in order to make the wards whole again. 

Once that is done, come back, so we can activate the console and restore order in the reservoir.
65920.progress: Once all three wards are repaired, return here to activate the ward console.
65920.completion: Excellent work, {NAME}. The wards have been restored, and Tyrhold Reservoir is once again protected. Thank you for all you have done. Thaldraszus owes you a great debt.
65920.objectives: Use the Missing Keystones to repair the reservoir wards, then activate the console.

65921.title: Refti Retribution
65921.description:
I cannot get it out of my head, $p. So many of my sisters massacred! Lives tossed away... Their sacrifices will not go unanswered!

My soldiers have tracked down the Primalists, and they say some of our sisters are still alive.

We must rescue them, and ensure every Primalist knows my anger!
65921.progress: I knew this day could always come, I just hoped that it would not.
65921.completion: I will always feel pain for those we lost, but I am thankful for the ones we rescued.
65921.objectives: Kill Primalists and rescue refti in Tyrhold Reservoir.

65925.title: Culling the Cullers
65925.description:
These wyrms don't belong here. I don't know what's driven them from their underground lairs, but there's no way to help them, now.

We can't allow them to destroy the native life here.

Slay the wyrms, {NAME}. Keep their parts, if you must, and find me in the Gleamlet when you're done.
65925.completion: It's a pity to wipe out any natural life... even troublesome ones.
65925.objectives: Slay Ice Slitherers and Ice Borers near the Kauriq Gleamlet.

65926.title: Tackling the Falls
65926.description:
Have you heard the tale of the Gleamfisher? She built a boat strong enough to pass down waterfalls! 

Elder Nava loves to tell the story.

I think the noble spirits of the On'tuq mammoths would be honored if we used their remains to craft such a boat again.

My brother says no. But if we succeed, we can help bring fish to our struggling sister tribes.

You've proven your skill and passion! Together, I'm sure we can build something great.
65926.completion: Ruriq is as stubborn as ever.

65928.title: Wayward Winds
65928.description:
Bah! Work together, she says? 

But... if the Gleamfisher believes there is a chance we can help the other tribes... we must try. 

For the wind spirit Kraunot to acknowledge us, we will first have to tend to his element. The nearby wind elementals have been agitated ever since the land began to awaken.

While I inspect this boat you two made, you go and fight to dismantle them, then bring me their restless motes. That should bring some calm back to the area.
65928.progress: Don't worry, these wind elementals being here simply means they are riled up. By destroying them, we will restore some peace to the winds here.
65928.completion: I will tend to these motes, so they dissipate harmlessly. Kraunot will be pleased.
65928.objectives: Collect 10 Restless Wind Motes from Restless Winds near the Kauriq Gleamlet.

65929.title: Ice Breakers
65929.description:
I knew the ancestor would approve!

I don't know much about spirits -- Kauj is the shaman. But we will need to appease the great Spirits of Air and Water before they will appear to us. 

Anyone could see water elementals up the mountain slowly freezing. It is not a natural freeze. Cold has been coming down the mountains more than usual, lately. Left be, our entire river could ice over.

Release them from their icy prisons!
65929.progress: We welcome the natural shift of the earth, but this encroaching ice... it threatens our entire home.
65929.completion: Excellent. Otu'rorq, the local River Spirit, will be pleased to know his river will continue to flow, for now.
65929.objectives: Break Freezing Waters from ice near the Kauriq Gleamlet.

65930.title: A Wrestle of Wind and Water
65930.description:
Now we should be able to face the Spirits.

Did Ruriq fail to mention it? By our tribe's traditions, we must face the Spirits in combat before asking a boon of them. The strength of their blessing is dependent on how well you impress them. 

Perhaps that is why the Gleamfisher insisted we all work together.

If you take on Kraunot, the Spirit of Air, Ruriq and I will tackle Otu'rorq, the Spirit of Water.

They dwell in the cave behind the nearby waterfall. We will meet you there, adventurer.
65930.progress: We must impress those spirits if Ruriq's vision is to come to life.
65930.completion:
With how much older he is, Kauj has always been almost... more a father than a brother. 

I thought getting older and starting my own family would make me feel less like I needed him. 

I was wrong. Even before my wife passed, I was wrong.
65930.objectives: Face Kraunot, the Spirit of Air, near the Kauriq Gleamlet.

65935.title: Catching Up to Chromie
65935.description:
You have helped us regain our hold on the sands, but I can sense something greater happening up on the temple platforms. Let us take to the skies and regroup with Ambassador Chronormu there.

As always, time is of the essence.
65935.completion: About time! Eternus might look frozen in that bubble, but she's struggling with all her might to get free.
65935.objectives: Meet with Chromie on the Temporal Conflux platforms.

65937.title: Proof of Negligence
65937.description:
We can't give up. He must understand what's happening out here! If he won't leave the cave, we'll show him directly.

Anything will do, I'm sure. There's so much going wrong, from the corrupted flora to the antagonized wildlife!
65937.progress: It's terrible to see the grove, and Theramus, in such a state.
65937.objectives: Find and then show evidence of the Lilac Ramble's damage to Theramus.

65938.title: The Once and Future Team
65938.description:
All right! Let's pop that stasis bubble around the temple doors and release our Wardens! Are you ready for a huge tug-of-war match with time itself?

Yank at the door's bubble like you did with the crystals earlier. But be careful, all the time energy released is sure to collect and attack you. I'm not sure what will be there, but at least you'll have the freed Wardens on your side no matter what happens.

Good luck, {NAME}!
65938.progress: We really should've foreseen this when we built our security system all that time ago...
65938.completion:
That's the second largest time elemental I've ever seen! I knew I should have packed my S.E.L.F.I.E Camera today.

Oh well! I'll just stop by this moment again on my next day off.
65938.objectives: Use your Timewalker Staff to pop the temple door's stasis bubble.

65939.title: The Courage of One's Convictions
65939.description:
The next battle will no doubt be fierce, but our courage and determination will overcome their greater numbers.

I am counting on your exceptional skills to help lead the troops to victory.

We shall begin the assault when you are ready.
65939.completion: Excellent, {NAME}! The djaradin forces are on the run! We control the upper courtyard of the citadel. However, the vaults below may take much longer to secure.
65939.objectives: Gain control of the Obsidian Citadel.

65940.title: By Broken Road
65940.description:
I hope you don't mind getting your feet wet. The next leg of our journey will take us across two rivers.

Ohn Seshteng would like to share a story with you about our blessed watcher, Ohn'ahra. I happily leave you under her watch.
65940.completion: I sense something on the wind.
65940.objectives: Travel with the Shikaar caravan to the river crossing.

65943.title: Primal Offensive
65943.description:
Khadgar and I are doing our best to hold off the Primalists in the sky, but we can't push further towards the tower.

We need you to weaken their ground forces so we can get closer to Raszageth and stop her before it's too late.

Make your way through the Primalists ahead. If I can maintain my concentration, there'll be another mirror image waiting.
65943.completion: Good work, some of their forces are diverting from above.

65944.title: Lava Burst
65944.description:
The Primalists have torn apart the mountain to send their forces streaming to Vakthros!

I spied some lava orbs in the initial corridor that they're using to spread more of their elemental chaos.

Destroy them to help slow their advance. I'll do what I can from up here to help Kalecgos.
65944.completion: That should slow them down a bit. It seems I'm getting a bit rusty compared to the fight with the Burning Legion...

65947.title: Time-Locked Timewalkers
65947.description:
I'm so glad you're here! I need you to stabilize the situation here on the platforms while Dante and Zera help me hold our infinite dragon friend in place.

The temple's security measures locked Eternus in a stasis bubble when she tried to take control of our Oathstone. Unfortunately, the other Timewalkers were also caught in those security measures.

Your Timewalker staff should free them, no problem. Just make sure to deal with any angry timelings that pop up!
65947.progress:
We can't have our Temple visitors rest inside of stasis bubbles when they get here.

Oh, wait! Maybe that's exactly what we should do! I'll write it down for later, {NAME}.
65947.completion: It worked? I'm not surprised... not entirely, at least!

65948.title: Cracks in Time
65948.description:
When the temple locked down, the Wardens got sealed up with the temple doors. We need to pop that stasis bubble to get them out! Unfortunately, that'll need a fully empowered Timewalker staff...

I know! You can drain the crystals here on the platforms! That should power up your staff enough.

They have their own stasis fields, so just yank them out and absorb their energy with your staff.

And don't feel bad if they shatter--the power is still there, even if it's in pieces!
65948.completion:
Excellent work!

You should be cooking with more than enough time juice to release the Wardens now!
65948.objectives: Use the East and West crystals to further empower your Timewalker Staff.

65949.title: The Sole Mender
65949.description:
When we join Ohn'ahra in the wind, we leave these medallions behind.

Although I helped craft this medallion, I am not its rightful owner.

It should be returned to Roscha. It is the last memory of her betrothed.

Take it to her so she may mourn and be at peace.
65949.completion:
Is this... ah. It is. My beloved is in the sky, then, running with Ohn'ahra. I will join her... in time.

Thank you, {NAME}. 

I will remember what you have done for Clan Shikaar. And for me.
65949.objectives: Return the Medallion to Farrier Roscha.

65950.title: Thieving Gorlocs
65950.description:
Is Farrier Roscha invited to the caravan? No! But who must provide shoes for the caravan? Farrier Roscha. And from whom do the Mudfins steal? Of course, Farrier Roscha. Pah.

I would send Khasar, but who knows where he has wandered this time? 

Find my supplies. Teach those thieving creatures not to steal from Farrier Roscha.

Go!
65950.progress: There are too many gorlocs around us. We're not safe here.
65950.completion:
Roscha sent you? She must be furious.

She has been through so much already. I could not return without securing all that was lost.
65950.objectives: Return the stolen supplies from the Mudfin Village.

65951.title: Sole Supplier
65951.description:
Poor Roscha! She has toiled endlessly to prepare for the caravan, only for her supplies to be stolen by nasty gorlocs. 

She has lost so much already. I am doing my best to assist her. 

Khasar likely went after her supplies alone, telling no one. It is his way. But he has been gone too long. Many dogs are missing as well. 

Would you please check on Khasar and the dogs, $p?
65951.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Let's get to work.

65952.title: A Chief of Legends
65952.description:
The gorlocs of this swamp were once simple creatures. Pests, perhaps, but never raiders, thieves, or dog-eaters.

It is their chief, Grrlgllmesh, who has led them away from their nature.

Put an end to him, and the gorlocs will threaten us no more.
65952.progress: Chief Grrlgllmesh is a scourge to these lands.
65952.completion:
With their chieftain slain, the gorlocs will no longer bother us. 

I am astounded by how strong they became under Chief Grrlgllmesh. 

I have never seen such primitive creatures rise up against a mighty civilization like ours before. Are we not so different? So much further evolved? I suppose not...

65953.title: The Ora-cull
65953.description:
Of all the madness in this gorloc village, I have discovered none so troubling as the gorloc shamans.

They are particularly vicious and play recklessly with storm magic with no regard for the consequences. 

This must be put to an end. Slay them, and bring me their totems. Our mystics will be interested in them.
65953.progress: The gorloc shamans have gone too far.
65953.completion:
<Khasar frowns at the totems.>

These totems are for storm magic. Storm magic is sacrilege to the gift of winds given by Ohn'ahra herself.

I will deliver these to the mystics.

65954.title: Release the Hounds
65954.description:
I have heard the familiar howls and barks of bakar that are missing from camp.

Our beloved dogs are trapped in cages, waiting to be ripped apart by those... those things.

We have a duty to our companions. Free them and witness the true might of a Shikaar bakar!
65954.progress: The gorlocs of this village will learn to fear our bakar.
65954.completion:
Magnificent beasts, aren't they?

Every bakar holds a special place in Clan Shikaar. They are our fellow hunters, guards, and our most cherished friends.

65955.title: A Centaur's Best Friend
65955.description:
It isn't safe for us to remain in the open, $p.

The gorlocs forced my hunting companion, Baba, into a cave to the east.

Set me free, then we shall rescue Baba. I will meet you in the cave when the path is clear.
65955.progress: Together, Baba and I are one hunting unit greater than all the rest.
65955.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. We are safe in here and can speak freely. 

I will protect Baba from any gorlocs that dare venture in while he rests.
65955.objectives: Free Khasar and meet him in the cave.

65956.title: Talon Strike
65956.description:
With your help, my Blacktalon assassins will cut down the djaradin defending the outer perimeter. Mark any targets with a small stun bomb, and they will come to your aid.

Proceed quickly and eliminate anything that may hinder our advance.
65956.completion: Our advance is pushing them back! All that remains is to breach the gates.

65957.title: No Time for Heroes
65957.description:
From what we have observed, djaradin society is built on strength. The strongest serve as examples for others to fight all the harder. 

Among the forces below are three examples of the mightiest djaradin... and your targets.

You, {NAME}, will personally eliminate them. This should deal a devastating blow to their morale.
65957.completion: You've proven yourself the true hero of the day, {NAME}.
65957.objectives: Slay Modak the Flamespit, Piercer Gigra, and Olphis the Molten.

65958.title: Primal Power
65958.description:
I'm afraid it's becoming harder to maintain my mirror images. The Primalists are focusing their efforts to tearing me out from the sky.

Not to worry... I have a plan.

I need you to take the orb you recovered and gather elemental magic from slain Primalists. 

We'll need that elemental power up ahead to divert their forces away from me.
65958.completion: That orb is brimming with power! That will be perfect for what's next.
65958.objectives: Use the Elemental Focus to drain elemental energy out of slain Primalists and elementals.

65962.title: The Never-Final Countdown
65962.description:
I never thought I'd save our temple by dismantling the very security we set up to protect it, but here we are!

With the time elementals purged, our Timewalkers free, and our Wardens at the ready, it's finally time to let this last stasis bubble down and deal with Eternus.

Let me know when you're ready. I know with you by my side nothing can go wrong.
65962.completion: Eternus and Chromie have fallen through space and time. We must retrieve them at all costs!

65977.title: Kirin Tor Recovery
65977.description:
When the Primalists attacked our expedition, I feared many of our mages were lost to us.

It seems they were taken by the Primalists and are being tortured as we speak!

Please, you must rescue the mages left here. They may not be able to help in this fight, but we cannot leave them behind!
65977.completion: You have my thanks. We cannot forsake anyone in this fight.

65989.title: Invader Djaradin
65989.description:
We may not have the power to take back our outpost, but we do not have to surrender without a fight.

Show them we still have teeth.
65989.progress: The djaradin had not been seen for generations. We were... unprepared.
65989.objectives: Kill 6 djaradin at the Dragonheart Outpost.

65990.title: Deliver Whelps From Evil
65990.description:
They descended upon us before we could even respond. My guards held as long as they could as we evacuated the young and helpless, but I fear that there are more within the outpost.

Cross that bridge and search for survivors.
65990.progress: We will take back the town as soon as we can muster the forces... but for now, the lives of our people must be our priority.
65990.completion: We cannot rest yet, but I breathe easier knowing we have rescued them. Thank you.
65990.objectives: Save 4 Whimpering Whelplings from Dragonheart Outpost.

65991.title: Time for a Reckoning
65991.description:
Cadet Sendrax has informed me of our majordomo's plans. Thank the Life-Binder that we have their help. Their interference gives us the reprieve we need to get our wounded back to the Life Pools to be treated.

I wish I could reinforce Selistra but I must keep my guards near the wounded. Go to the enemy stronghold to meet them. 

If there were another way of handling the djaradin, I would ask it. But, as it were...

You must do what you must.
65991.completion:
It does my heart well to hear such good news from Dragonheart Outpost during such a terrible time. The refugees will be safe at the Life Pools.

Even the djaradin would not raise arms against the might of Queen Alexstrasza herself.
65991.objectives: Meet Wrathion and Majordomo Selistra at Scalecracker Keep.

65992.title: Blacktalon Intel
65992.description:
While Selistra and I attracted their eyes above, shadows crept in through their defenses.

My agents, the Blacktalon, are keeping an eye and an ear throughout the keep. Meet them and let them know you're on our side. They'll give you some valuable information on our enemies.
65992.progress: I've put my life in their hands. You can trust them.
65992.completion: That is troubling, to say the least. Yet another reason to fight them.
65992.objectives: Speak to Wrathion's spies hidden around Scalecracker Keep.

65993.title: Killjoy
65993.description:
Ah, yes.

I saw the leader of these giants headed back from the raid shortly after I arrived. She's celebrating their victory somewhere within the camp. 

It would be a shame if someone interrupted her revelries, don't you think?
65993.completion: The djaradin seem to have no shortage of bodies to throw in our way... but perhaps this blow shall give them pause. Well done, friend.
65993.objectives: Kill Meatgrinder Sotok at Scalecracker Keep.

65995.title: The Obsidian Citadel
65995.description:
<At a glance, this seems to be internal communications between djaradin camps.

The words 'Obsidian Citadel' leap out at you.

Perhaps Wrathion would be interested in seeing this.>
65995.completion:
A treat! I love seeing into the minds of my enemies. Helps me strike fast, strike true.

Let's see...

The Obsidian Citadel?

No.

No!
65995.objectives: Give the Qalashi Plans to Wrathion.

65996.title: Veteran Reinforcements
65996.description:
Commander Lethanak was insightful, as always. We will need the help of our most veteran guards to stop their threat. Rallying them was the perfect task for a young cadet like Sendrax, but she may need support.

Sendrax's path will take her towards the west, which may have been overwhelmed by this rising threat. They will need aid as well. Take this concoction and give them your support.
65996.progress: We are all in this together, {NAME}. The safety of the isles is at stake.
65996.completion:
Sendrax stopped by and rushed through. That one is a whirlwind.

I like her.
65996.objectives: Help the injured guards and find Sendrax.

65997.title: Chasing Sendrax
65997.description:
Cadet Sendrax came through here not long ago.

She relayed Commander Lethanak's orders for all drakonid to rally back at the Life Pools. Our whole defensive regiment set off in that direction not long after.

But our scouts were out on patrol in the old ruins, so she headed in there to rally them too.
65997.completion:
I haven't read anything in the archives about the Primalists stealing dragon eggs before.

This is bad. Very bad.
65997.objectives: Find Sendrax in the Life-Binder Conservatory ruins.

65998.title: Future of the Flights
65998.description:
There is no higher charge given to a drakonid upon their graduation than to defend every single dragon egg with their lives.

It's why we train. Why we exist.

I can no longer hide and observe, $p. By stealing and infusing these eggs, the Primalists threaten the entire future of the dragonflights!

We are vastly outnumbered, but will you stand by my side? Will you fight to save the dragonflights?
65998.progress: Such cruelty and selfishness... I cannot even fathom.
65998.completion:
<Sendrax is clearly shaken by what she had to do.>

Death was the only mercy left to those poor whelplings...

65999.title: Red in Tooth and Claw
65999.description:
Commander Lethanak warned us recruits that he had received reports of the Storm-Eater, Raszageth, escaping her prison. It seems her servants have followed in her wake, threatening all we hold dear.

They move quickly. These ruins were reported to be abandoned during the last patrol.

We must stop the Primalists here.

For the Life-Binder, and for all of the dragonflights!
65999.progress: The dragonflights will prevail against the Primalists.
65999.completion:
<Sendrax pats out a lingering flame on her armor.>

We've done what we could. What was needed.

66000.title: Library of Alexstrasza
66000.description:
<The pages on this book are charred.

The Primalists seem to be burning the ancient tomes found here, putting the dragonflights' very history in peril. It's as if the Primalists want to erase the dragonflights from history.

Save what you can.>
66000.progress: I smell burning parchment on the wind...

66001.title: A Last Hope
66001.description:
A whole brood of whelplings, lost...

<Sendrax straightens her back and sticks her chin up.>

There is one more location we have not checked yet. The large ritual site where that proto-dragon dropped off the eggs.

Let us charge their cruel defenses together, $p, and save what we can.
66001.objectives: Rescue the last Infused Dragon Egg.

66003.title: Rings To Bind Them
66003.description:
The djaradin here have become bold, binding flame elementals and letting them rampage through the area. The wildlife has fled, and the elementals are dangerously close to our camps.

Luckily, I have been able to construct a small bastion of stone to stand against this fiery tide the djaradin have unleashed... and we will not fall!

Gather the magical rings that bind these flame elementals. We shall use them to bolster our defenses against the flame elementals.
66003.progress: Have you gathered all the rings I asked for?
66003.completion: Perfect! The residual energies of these rings can be turned against their creators to summon a construct under our control!

66005.title: Medallion of a Fallen Friend
66005.description:
<This chewed up hunk of metal was once a beautiful ornament of great importance to a Shikaar centaur. 

Khasar may know more about the owner.>
66005.completion:
This medallion is all that remains of a dear friend of mine who ventured too far into the swamp this past season. I thought it lost to the elements.

I cut this leather from her first mammoth hunt. We were children, then.
66005.objectives: Return the Medallion of a Fallen Friend to Khasar.

66006.title: Return to Roscha
66006.description:
Baba is rested, and Roscha's supplies are recovered. We can return without upsetting her further. 

Take some boxes when you go. I will send warriors for the rest.
66006.completion:
You have the supplies? Good.

Leave them by the forge.

<Roscha looks around and frowns.>
66006.objectives: Return the supplies to Farrier Roscha.

66007.title: Free Air
66007.description:
The Primalists are using these massive orbs here to hold off Kalecgos. 

At this rate, Kalecgos will be too injured to continue the fight. If he falls, I won't be able to fend off Raszageth.

The empowered gem you hold should allow you to disguise yourself as an elemental to sneak ahead.

Use the gem to destroy the orbs. That should give Kalecgos room to unleash his power.

I will focus my attention on shielding the tower from Raszageth.
66007.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Now it's time to show the Primalists the true might of the Aspect of the blue dragonflight!

66009.title: In Defense of Vakthros
66009.description:
It's time, {NAME}. The Primalist forces in the air are dwindling now that you've handled things on the ground.

Raszageth is calling in one of her lieutenants to reinforce the Primalist forces, thanks to your efforts.

I need you to handle this monster while I push forward to fight Raszageth and help Khadgar.

Look for my magic during your fight. I will do what I can to aid you.

It is time for Raszageth to face the fury of the Aspect of magic!
66009.completion: Good to see you adventurer. Time is of the essence!

66011.title: In Memory of Ysera
66011.description:
Oh, no! Now I think I understand. Theramus...he misses Ysera, and she can't come back.

Come! I suspect I know where he went. We won't bother him further, but it'll be good to tell him that we're sorry, and that we'll give him the space he wants.

We are here for each other, within the nature all around us.
66011.progress: We appreciate you sticking around, {race}. You've been a great help.
66011.completion: <Theramus looks quietly upon the newly restored shrine.>

66012.title: The Sealed Door
66012.description:
Our scouts have been combing the Dragon Isles for anything of interest. They've returned much of note, but one discovery stands out amongst the rest--a door.

A door forged by the titans, and sealed against the world. No one has yet managed to find their way through to the artifacts that surely lie within.

But then, no mystery has endured under the discerning gaze of the Reliquary.

With the help of the Explorers' League, this challenge will be simple, I am certain.
66012.completion: I trust the journey was trivial for one of your capabilities.
66012.objectives: Travel to the Sealed Door in Thaldraszus and speak to Naleidea.

66013.title: Investigate the Door
66013.description:
Here we are. If we're going to get past this door, we need to understand who locked it, and how.

Take a look around and see if you can find anything that might give us the answers we seek.
66013.progress: What an intriguing discovery. What do you imagine is on the other side?
66013.completion: We'll need more to go on than this.

66015.title: The Blue Dragon Oathstone
66015.description:
The Azure Span has stabilized for now and more blue dragons have arrived... just in time.

It's time to return to the Azure Archives and reclaim the oathstone.

I would request your presence there, {NAME}. You've been a great boon throughout this ordeal.
66015.progress:
I'm quite relieved you all prevented the complete annihilation of the Azure Span.

Shall we continue?
66015.completion: The Oathstone is empowered once more. There is much to do... but the Azure Span is at least returning to what it once was.
66015.objectives: Accompany Kalecgos to claim the Blue Dragon Oathstone.

66016.title: Clan Teerai
66016.description:
<As Sansok Khan signs, Okir vocalizes for her.>

Clan Teerai is the clan of our Khanam Matra, our direct connection to the Maruuk ancestors. They are the holders of our traditions, and our storytellers.

To understand the Maruuk, you must understand Clan Teerai. One of the Khanam Matra's daughters, Qariin Dotur, is preparing a meal for our ancestors. Aid her. She will teach you about our people.

66017.title: Clan Ohn'ir
66017.description:
<As Sansok Khan signs, Okir vocalizes for her.>

The mystics of our lands, like Ohn Seshteng, belong to Clan Ohn'ir. The clan is not made up of families, but rather of centaur from across the plains with an innate connection to Ohn'ahra. They spend their lives building that connection and honing their skills. Eventually, they receive assignments to advise different clans and protect our lands.

Ohn Seshteng went to speak with her khan about the omen she received. Join her to learn about the Ohn'ir.
66017.completion: It is good to be back with my clan.
66017.objectives: Meet Ohn Seshteng at the mystic pools.

66018.title: Clan Nokhud
66018.description:
<As Sansok Khan signs, Okir vocalizes for her.>

Clan Nokhud is the newest to rise to power. Their late khan, Jhakan, raised a mighty army to seize territory from their predecessors. Such is the way of our people.

While Jhakan had earned his respect, his son has not. Balakar killed his father and took control of the clan. They have grown ever more insular since. But to know the Maruuk, you must know them.
66018.completion: I have the great unpleasantness of introducing you to Bahir, one of Balakar Khan's thugs.

66019.title: Honoring Our Ancestors
66019.description:
Our ancestors walk beside us upon the winds of Ohn'ahra, guiding and protecting us. All Maruuk, dead and living, gather under truce at the Khural. 

The scent of this meal calls the ancestors to our fire. When they arrive, the Khural begins.
66019.progress: The Maruuk have returned to this spot for generations upon generations. We walk alongside our ancestors.
66019.completion: Our ancestors risked much for our future. It is right to invite them to gather alongside us.
66019.objectives: Help Qariin Dotur cook a meal for the ancestors.

66020.title: Omens and Incense
66020.description:
I shared with Tigari Khan the omen we received before entering Maruukai. She expressed her concern, as the wind felt cold to her as well.

We cultivate certain flowers here, blooms that can be ground and burned to elicit a trancelike effect. They are used to deepen our connection to an omen. 

I request that you collect some so that we may make an incense to burn. With my khan's help, perhaps we can learn more of Ohn'ahra's plight.
66020.progress: Tigari Khan is most well-versed in reading omens. With her aid, we can learn more about this omen.
66020.completion: A betrayal threatens Ohn'ahra herself. We must stand tall, {NAME}. Now is a time for allies.
66020.objectives: Collect 5 Sweetsuckle Blooms, grind them into Sweetsuckle Incense, then aid Ohn Seshteng in the ritual.

66021.title: Unwelcome Outsider
66021.description:
Hah! Look at you. Weak. Just like those puny hunters that brought you here.

You want to know the Nokhud? We speak through battle. 

Our battle ritual is called "the tabarr". We train. We spar. And it hardens us. Now there is no weakness in our clan.

Enough talk. Go spar.
66021.completion:
The Nokhud prefer brute strength and power over all else.

We do not see eye to eye on many things.

66022.title: The Khanam Matra
66022.description:
I cannot linger in centaur lands; I must return to the gardens as soon as I am able.

The Khanam Matra has agreed to hear our plea for aid. She awaits my arrival at the top of the krutal, the central building of Maruukai.

Though I must speak with her on my own at first, you are more than welcome to join us.
66022.progress: The Khanam Matra is waiting for you.
66022.completion:
That traitorous fool.

<Akato spits on the ground.>
66022.objectives: Report to Khansguard Akato to join Gemisath's audience with the Khanam Matra.

66023.title: Trucebreakers
66023.description:
Balakar disgraces his clan. He leads them into the storm, blinded by his lust for power.

Their betrayal reveals their fragility. Cut them down.
66023.progress: To attack the Khanam Matra... it is a rejection of our ways.
66023.completion:
The path they have chosen is now stained with blood.

Scout Tomul tried to warn us this might happen. She may have further suspicions.

66024.title: Covering Their Tails
66024.description:
The Nokhud drool over war stories of our kind's ancient past. In truth they are weak, playacting children. And with one strike of lightning, they have severed their connection to Ohn'ahra.

Well! If they will walk the path of corruption to seek war, then we will indulge them.

Of course, Bahir was left in command to cover his escape. Her blood will soon stain the ground.
66024.completion:
Balakar was an easy target for Koroleth's corrupting influence.

The storm has arrived.

66025.title: The Nokhud Threat
66025.description:
Clan Nokhud's army is taking Maruukai. 

Let us discuss our next moves in the khan chambers. We must keep the Maruuk safe.
66025.completion: The very lifeblood of the Maruuk is in danger.

66026.title: Urgent Action Required
66026.description:
The source of these attacks must be the Brackenhide.

We've fought with the Brackenhide gnolls for generations, but until now they've been nothing more than a nuisance.

We have no choice but to take urgent action against the gnolls. Their foul decay will destroy the Azure Span, including whatever you're searching for.

Meet us outside Brackenhide. We will need all the help we can get.
66026.completion:
Just standing here, I can feel the dread of this forest wash over me. Something is deeply wrong here. 

I'm beginning to regret sending our best fighter back to Iskaara.

66027.title: Calling the Blue Dragons
66027.description:
I can no longer be afraid of reuniting the blue dragons, {NAME}. It is better for us to be a family... than a fragment of our former selves.

Even if I cannot reclaim the oathstone, I can still use its power to send a message to all of the blue dragons. 

It is time they received word... from their Aspect.
66027.objectives: View Kalecgos call back the blue dragonflight.

66028.title: To the Future!
66028.description:
I have tracked Chronormu and Eternus to a potential future. I know not what you will find there, only that it is dark and chaotic.

Soridormi has taken some of our timewalkers ahead to that future in order to hold our connection to that time stable. Her considerable power will be needed to keep the portal open, so she must rely on your talents.

Soridormi will be able to direct you further once you meet her there.

Hurry, {NAME}. Find Chronormu.
66028.completion: We need to find Chromie and Eternus before more damage can be done to this time.

66029.title: Temporal Tuning
66029.description:
Chronormu and Eternus are falling though time, but I sense them stop every so often. These brief moments are our opportunity to find them.

<Nozdormu conjures a small chrono crystal.>

I have imbued this crystal with power as well as my own temporal resonance. They have gone to a... troubling possible future. Find them and use it. Hopefully you can fix their position in time before they slip away again.
66029.completion: The process was not finished but I can more accurately track Chronormu now.
66029.objectives: Use Chrono Crystal on Eternus and Chromie in the Primalist Future to stop them from falling through time.

66030.title: Resistance Isn't Futile
66030.description:
The temporal ripples have caused trouble for the people here. Enemies appear where they were not, or are far stronger than they should be. These changes are small, but they are disastrous.

I ask you to help the resistance fighters here. Heal their wounds so that they may fight once more. Set their timeline back on its correct course, as if it had never interacted with our own. It is not much, but it is what we can do for them.
66030.completion: These brave fighters will be able to bolster their forces once more.
66030.objectives: Heal resistance fighters in the Primalist Future.

66031.title: Making Time
66031.description:
I guess I shouldn't be surprised to find myself here.

This is not the Azeroth I wanted, but it's the one I have. We're fighting to preserve what's left and take the world back, but your arrival has caused some trouble. 

We use the essence of those elementals out there to fuel our protections and keep ourselves safe. See that shield? That's the only thing keeping us from discovery and annihilation and you drained our resources. Bring back some of that essence and we may survive another day.
66031.progress: Have you collected what we need?
66031.completion: You've given us some breathing room.
66031.objectives: Collect Elemental Essence for the survivor's camp.

66032.title: Return to the Present
66032.description:
This timeline is dark and chaotic. The disruption here has been severe. I shall remain in this timeline a moment more to help sort out what remaining ripples may appear. 

Return to Nozdormu. He will want to know of our success, even if it was less complete than we would like.
66032.completion: Your journey did not accomplish our goals, but it was a success nonetheless.
66032.objectives: Return to Nozdormu in the Present.

66033.title: To the... Past?
66033.description:
It is regrettable that we could not stabilize Chronormu, but there is another potential location where we may be able to catch her and bring an end to her fall through time. 

<Nozdormu frowns.>

The glimpses of this timeline past are... strange. Even among some of the visions I have witnessed in my life.

Be on your guard, {NAME}. I am uncertain what you will face, but it is powerful and... oddly familiar.
66033.completion: Whatever I expected... This is not it.
66033.objectives: Take the portal and meet with Andantenormu in Azmerloth.

66035.title: Murloc Motes
66035.description:
An alternate timeline born from murlocs??!

Forgive my selfishness, but would you obtain a few stray motes of temporal energy while you locate Ambassador Chronomu? 

Just walk into them and your staff should do the rest. I will examine the data later. When we are not in the middle of venturing through rips in Azeroth's varied realities.
66035.progress: I have no doubt we shall succeed against the Infinite this day, and studying this foreign energy will be our reward!
66035.completion:
Astounding work! 

Now, what do you imagine the murlocs of this Murloc World are? I shudder to think...

66036.title: Mugurlglrlgl!
66036.description:
Mrglgulglrrlglgul! Grurguglullgurl!

Gruglrlgllrugl rrgulgrulgrgl grugll gurgull gur. Murgllgllrugl gurgllglrl Murgul gruggullgl. Murguglegurgllgur gurgll gurgulgul guruulgurllgr guuglrllgl.

Mgrgulllglll gurl gugll.

<You aren't certain what's being said, but there are lots of stabbing motions. It seems like this murloc wants you to kill something.>
66036.completion:
Frrg thrg Allrghnnge!

<The murlocs appear to be pleased.>

66037.title: Back to Reality
66037.description:
We were able to increase Ambassador Chronormu's connection to our time. I am certain when we find her again, we will be able to finish the ritual.

For now, let us return to our present and a world with... significantly fewer murlocs.
66037.completion: Thank you for helping to uphold the timelines... odd as they may sometimes be.
66037.objectives: Return to Nozdormu in the Present.

66038.title: Race Through Time!
66038.description:
{NAME}, we must act quickly to catch up to Ambassador Chronormu, and I mean that quite literally.

Zera and I will do what we can to speed our progress, but it is imperative we avoid entangling with this time period as much as possible. To do so will slow us down and we may not be able to catch the Ambassador before she is lost to even Nozdormu's magic.

We haven't a moment to lose!

(Accepting this quest will begin a timer)
66038.completion: By the Aspects... This is the Black Empire!
66038.objectives: Race through time, following Chromie and Eternus's Path.

66039.title: Chromie Time
66039.description:
This... This is the Black Empire. We have traveled very far into the past, indeed.

Look! I see Ambassador Chronormu and Eternus! We need to hurry and complete the ritual. 

Even my curiosity is not enough to wish to see where they might travel to next.
66039.completion:
That feels much better!

Oh, don't worry about Eternus. We've come to a bit of a truce for the moment.
66039.objectives: Find Chromie and Complete the Temporal Stabilization Ritual.

66040.title: Back to the Future
66040.description:
We're not going to fall through time anymore but we're far in the past. Waaaaay far in the past. "The Titans Haven't Visited Azeroth Yet" far in the past. Getting home is going to be... tricky.

But we dragons can do it! 

We're going to need you to keep those Black Empire minions off our backs though. It shouldn't take too long! 

I think.

Probably.

Don't worry about it! Just keep those creepy monsters away and we'll handle the rest! Easy!
66040.progress: This has been an... unexpected turn of events.
66040.objectives: Defend your allies against the Black Empire until the temporal portal is created.

66044.title: Taking the Walls
66044.description:
Sabellian and the other dragons are holding back the djaradin for now. We must act quickly to secure the high towers and ensure our victory.

You and I shall clear the siege arbalests that threaten us from above.

Let me know when you are ready.
66044.progress: Are the Arbalests and Champion Choruk defeated?
66044.completion: Well done, {NAME}. Sabellian and his forces will hold off the djaradin, while I activate the Oathstone to restore power.
66044.objectives: Eliminate the three Siege Arbalests and Champion Choruk.

66048.title: Best Plans and Intentions
66048.description:
Attacking the djaradin controlling the Obsidian Citadel will be no easy task. Even with Wrathion and his Blacktalon forces, this will be a fierce battle. Wrathion may be confident, but... I am not so certain.

Perhaps we can speak to those helping to plan the strategy, and see if we can find any room for improvement.
66048.progress: Can you improve our odds of success?
66048.completion: I see. I shall consider your evaluation carefully, of course.
66048.objectives: Review the plans with the various members of Wrathion's forces.

66049.title: Obsidian Oathstone
66049.description:
When Neltharion became the Earth-Warder, he swore an oath to protect this world, {NAME}. To safeguard the deep places of the earth and, with his flight, to serve as Azeroth's defenders. The Obsidian Oathstone represents that promise. 

We must activate the stone and let the Dragon Isles know that the black dragonflight has returned!

Follow me, {NAME}.
66049.completion: This is a setback, but with your help, I am sure we can repair the Oathstone. Work with Bazentus... make it so.

66055.title: A Shattered Past
66055.description:
The Oathstone is damaged! There are pieces missing.

Do what you can to recover the fragments... maybe there is a way to fix the stone!
66055.progress: Have you found the missing fragments of the Oathstone?
66055.completion: This looks like all the pieces. I believe we can repair this!

66056.title: Forging a New Future
66056.description:
The forge of the Earth-Warder is the most powerful of all the dragon forges in existence. Our ancestors used it to create the strongest weapons and armor to defend Azeroth.

Within the hearth of that forge is the power necessary to reform the shattered fragments of the Oathstone.

Let us go and prepare the forge for the work to be done.
66056.progress: Have you finished the work we require?
66056.completion: Very good. Now with the arrival of our Prince, we can begin.

66057.title: Restoring the Faith
66057.description:
The shattered fragments have been reformed. We are ready to repair the Oathstone.

Go now and help Wrathion complete the repairs.
66057.completion: This complicates matters, but I will not be denied what is rightfully mine!

66071.title: Flying Rocs
66071.description:
The name is Professor Harleen Chirpsnide, infamous ornithologist extraordinaire! I came here to study the mythical bluefeather rocs of the Dragon Isles, but I suppose we've got bigger fowl to fry.

I bet these harpies flew in from Kalimdor when the Isles opened up. They're highly invasive and feasting like a pack of ogres at the Bilgewater Casino buffet.

Let's give the native rocs here a fighting chance. Take this medical kit and use it to get the injured ones back on their feet.
66071.progress: Don't worry about using up my supplies. I'm good pals with the clerks at the Expedition's reimbursement office.
66071.completion:
A full-feathered job, {NAME}!

I would have helped you with the healing and the slaying, but I'm more of an 'ideas goblin' these days.

66078.title: Sharp Practice
66078.description:
For years I have fostered the Blacktalon, teaching and encouraging them to pursue the same heights you have reached.

They may not have achieved the same lofty goals as yourself, but they are accomplished in their own right. They've made me proud.

Each would be honored if you test their skills. I think you will see some of yourself in them.
66078.progress: Have you tested them and found them worthy?
66078.completion: I believe the Blacktalon are prepared for anything.
66078.objectives: Test the skills of 8 Blacktalon Assassins and Avengers.

66079.title: Wrathion Awaits
66079.description:
These eggs represent a new generation of dragonkind. They must be protected and fostered. Yet... my heart aches, and I worry for Wrathion. I fear his stubborn determination will lead to folly. 

You have been a trusted friend over the years, {NAME}. Perhaps you can go in my place, and help him. 

Seek him out at the Obsidian Bulwark. And please, watch over him. There are so few of his flight left.
66079.completion: Ah, champion--your arrival is most fortuitous. With you here now, my plan will certainly succeed.
66079.objectives: Meet with Wrathion at the Obsidian Bulwark.

66080.title: Temporal Difficulties
66080.description:
Hello, {class}. You're right on time!

Some trouble up at the temple is causing the timeways to destabilize and spill out into the valley. Not only that, but a bunch of Timewalkers are missing!

We've asked for extra help, but one of the new recruits hasn't arrived yet.

Can you look for her? Be careful though, time's in a massive state of flux around the valley. There's no knowing what dangers are around!
66080.completion: I knew somebody would come around... eventually!
66080.objectives: Find the missing recruit in the Flowing Forest in Thaldraszus.

66081.title: Time is Running Out
66081.description:
With the bronze temple under attack temporal energy is seeping out everywhere.

The Timewalkers placed collectors all through this forest trying to gather all the errant magic. Anything collected can also be used as extra power! Which is a good thing, this crisis is draining all our resources.

I was supposed to retrieve the collectors, but I still need a moment to catch my breath.

Could you get them for me?
66081.progress: Were you able to find them all?
66081.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. 

Now the forest can try to recover, and the Timewalkers have extra some extra energy.
66081.objectives: Collect 8 Temporal Collectors in the Flowing Forest of Thaldraszus.

66082.title: Time in a Bottle
66082.description:
Great! The Timewalker staff intact! But, it is definitely drained.

I know! You can recharge it using the temporal energy coalescing around the wildlife here. Unfortunately, that means defeating affected creatures in the forest. The energies were making them dangerous and unstable, and we would have had to cull the population after anyhow... 

Sometimes you have to sacrifice for the greater good. Could you help? I still need a minute.
66082.completion:
This staff has been through a lot, but it should be fully functional again.

Thank you, {class}.
66082.objectives: Collect time energy from slain time-charged wildlife within the Flowing Forest of Thaldraszus.

66083.title: Feels Like the First Time
66083.description:
Shepherding the timeways is a dangerous duty.

Though you are not a Timewalker, Ambassador Chronormu believes you will be of great help. But to ensure your safety we must properly train you.

Unfortunately, all our instructors are still missing. I will do my best to help. Let us see how we both do. I know the Ambassador Chronormu is counting on the both of us.
66083.completion:
That was quite unexpected! As you can see, there are many dangers that come with wielding time energy.

I do wish there was time to examine the effects of your little hiccup, but there are more important matters.
66083.objectives: Speak with Andantenormu and participate in Timewalker training.

66084.title: Times Like These
66084.description:
Despite that small hiccup during training, I believe you are prepared enough to aid us here.

The distortions in the valley are allowing different time periods to cross over into ours. We are unsure why these timelines connect which is quite alarming. We need more information.
