Please, see if you can find anything about the creatures pouring in from different timelines. I am sure their passage will have left some sort of residue. By studying it we can hopefully find a way to get ahead of this crisis.
66084.progress: While it is unfortunate this is all happening, I am eager to discover new chronologies to study.
66084.completion:
With these samples, we will have a better understanding of how and why these timelines are intersecting with ours.

Thank you for your assistance.
66084.objectives: Collect 100 Temporal Residue from time-lost enemies in the Shifting Sands.

66085.title: If We Could Turn Back Time
66085.description:
A proper Timewalker never leaves a crisis half-resolved. Why wait and study when we have the tools we need already?

Since you have my original staff, I found a spare for me to use. I am sure no one will miss it. This is my plan: we team up on those rifts together and save the day! All the days, really. Sorry, I still get confused about the time stuff. 

What do you say? The task should be simple enough, right?
66085.completion:
We did it! Right?

Okay maybe there was a wrinkle or two--nothing Dante needs to know about. Also, an unexpected visitor..

Still, overall I would say that went pretty well.
66085.objectives: Close the Time Rifts in the Shifting Sands with Siaszerathel.

66087.title: Closing Time
66087.description:
These incursions push the durability of this timeline to the point of breaking. If only we had our full contingent of Timewalkers!

Though you are a novice with the staff, I am told that you have managed to help us out greatly. With an extra push, I believe you may further aid our cause.

Normally, I would put you through a full training but the times are... unorthodox. Take this scroll of advanced knowledge and use it to push back the invaders! Be swift though, the effects are only temporary.
66087.progress: Every incursion threatens to weaken this timeline.
66087.completion:
A Timewalker's staff is crucial to shepherding time. Sometimes a gentle prod is all that is needed. Other times, firmer action is required. This should be enough to mitigate the instability in this area for now. 

While there is still more work to be done, your companions are eager to assist up at the temple. I will ensure the area down here is supported while you all go ahead.

Good luck.

66094.title: The Ruins of Szar Skeleth
66094.description:
According to the watcher's logs, the stone of Insight can be found in a draconic tower on a river in the center of the Ohn'ahran Plains. That should be Szar Skeleth. Be careful. We can be sure the Sundered Flame won't let us just walk in and take it.

Once you get there, rendezvous with Toddy. Then we can retrieve the stone.
66094.completion: Ye made it. I've quite the mission for ye, {NAME}.
66094.objectives: Meet up with Toddy near Szar Skeleth in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

66100.title: Supplying in Weight
66100.description:
I really screwed up this time. I only stepped away from the campsite for a moment, but I barely returned in time to see the tarasek snatching up everything I had not bolted down.

Those supplies were expensive, and I can't exactly ask for help getting more! My sister Nori thinks I'm inept enough as it is.

If you are sure you want to head through the valley, would you mind keeping an eye out for any stray bags of supplies?
66100.progress: <Alvi glances in your direction, clearly panicked. The missing supplies seem to be the last thing on her mind at the moment.>
66100.completion: Thank you, {NAME}, but we have bigger things to worry about now.

66101.title: From Such Great Heights
66101.description:
Toddy and Naleidea have requested a survey report of the surrounding area immediately.

Luckily, I have acquired an enchanted telescope and surveyor's disc that will help us scout out nearby areas from the safety of the clouds.

Unluckily, I am deathly afraid of heights and cannot bring myself to set foot on the contraption.

You are not afraid of heights, are you?
66101.progress: Good luck up there. I much prefer the ground under my feet.
66101.completion:
<Aster breathes a sigh of relief.>

I thought for certain you would plummet to your death from up there. Thanks again for taking the risk so that I was not required to.
66101.objectives: Use the Surveyor's Disc to bounce into the sky and scout the area.

66104.title: Forensic Ecology
66104.description:
I'm at my wits end, {NAME}. Tharu and I have made our way through nearly all the corpses only to stumble at the end because we cannot agree on a methodology. If only he would just listen to me!

<Ecologist Iskha sighs.>

The stress of the situation is getting to us both. I don't even have a firm hypothesis yet.

You look like you have a strong stomach. Will you take over on these last two gorlocs? You can borrow my scalpel.
66104.progress: Don't worry, you'll get used to the smell after a while.
66104.completion:
It's the gorlocs fighting that's been harming the wetlands so?

<Ecologist Iskha looks ashamed.>

I think I understand now...

66105.title: A Scalpel of a Solution
66105.description:
I believe we are gathering enough data safely from here but... 

Tharu is an exceptional ecologist and prefers we take action. Still, the ecosystem is fragile, and we may damage it if we are not careful. I do however agree we don't have much time. 

It might be worth indulging him. A little.

Culling the rampaging elementals ought to buy us time without impeding our research. Be sure to cull them in equal numbers--we don't want to throw things further out of balance.
66105.progress: Is it done? Can I finally get Tharu off my back about this?
66105.completion:
Did that seem to affect anything? No?

<Ecologist Iskha sighs.>

Well, at least we're nearly finished with our research.
66105.objectives: Kill 5 Rampaging Water and 5 Rampaging Wind.

66106.title: Don't Be So Shellfish
66106.description:
I was a fool to doubt Iskha when he insisted there was more to this. He wouldn't be my mate if he wasn't always two steps ahead of me.

We can make it up to him--by taking action, of course. If it's shells that are causing all this elemental chaos, why don't you go into their camp and take those shells right out of their slimy hands?

Bring back piles of the wind and water shells, enough for Iskha to research to his heart's content.
66106.completion:
Iskha and I will take these back to the life pools--somewhere where they can't cause any more trouble.

You've done good work here today, {NAME}.
66106.objectives: Collect 15 Water-Infused Shells and 15 Wind-Infused Shells from Soggymaw and Windyfin Gorlocs.

66107.title: Wildlife Rescue
66107.description:
It doesn't take an ecologist to see that the wetlands are in real trouble.

But Iskha's got us stuck here examining dead creatures when we ought to be stopping them from dying in the first place! The red dragonflight is about preserving life--not dissecting it!

I love Iskha, and he's good at what he does, but if we wait until he's done puttering, there won't be any wetlands left to save. 

I'll manage his overthinking. You get out there, get your boots muddy, and rescue some wildlife.
66107.completion:
There! The wetlands are fixed! Meanwhile, Iskha is still doing his taxidermy... I mean research!

Wait, what do you mean the elementals keep coming?
66107.objectives: Rescue the wildlife of the Restless Wetlands.

66108.title: A Sledgehammer of a Solution
66108.description:
While I'm glad Tharu now sees my point of view, I'm also grateful he had you rescue wildlife while I was dawdling.

The situation is much more dire than anticipated; he was right to take action. With what we've learned, I fear this elemental bombardment won't stop until we've dealt with the gorlocs.

If I were Tharu and thinking actionably, I would go straight for their leaders. Without anyone to rally around, the fighting should dissipate and no longer threaten the wetlands.
66108.progress: This should buy us some room to breathe while we clean up this mess.
66108.completion:
That ought to leave them scrambling--at least for a while.

Thank you for all your help, {NAME}.
66108.objectives: Slay Sogglmoggl, King of the Soggymaw and Whirglgurgl, King of the Windyfin.

66110.title: Give Peace a Chance
66110.description:
Aka'Magosh, $p.

This expedition is under the protection of both the Horde and the Alliance. Our instructions are clear: give aid to any members of the Dragonscale Expedition regardless of their other allegiances.

The Alliance's representatives, Captain Garrick and her son Henry, stand guard on the other side of camp.

I fought with Captain Garrick against the scourge. She is honorable and will serve the Expedition well.

Go offer her your assistance. Show her that the Horde honors its agreements.
66110.completion:
<Captain Garrick salutes your approach.>

Warlord Breka proves her honor once again by sending you to me.
66110.objectives: Introduce yourself to the Alliance representatives.

66111.title: Encroaching Elementals
66111.description:
The crafters, artisans, and explorers of the Dragonscale Expedition are ill-suited to the vigors of battle.

But not you and I, $p.

Here in the Dragon Isles, let us use that strength to protect those who can't protect themselves.

Clear out the elementals encroaching from the north, so the expedition can focus on their noble pursuits.
66111.completion:
For the Dragonscale Expedition!

<Captain Garrick salutes you.>
66111.objectives: Kill 15 primal elementals in Wingrest Embassy.

66112.title: Always Be Crafting
66112.description:
Have ye ever seen such powerful elementals?!

<Grun cheers.>

I hear the guards grumblin' 'bout havin' to fight 'em all the time, but they're missin' the big picture... Bigger elementals means bigger craftin' components!

While you're out there clearin' the elementals for our safety or whate'er it is ye be doin', be sure to pick up pieces of the biggest ones ye can find. I want tae try makin' somethin' out of 'em!
66112.progress: I'm gonna build a grand helmet first... No, a hammer... No, a BIG hammer!
66112.completion:
<Grun's eyes open wide as you hand him the primal cores.>

Incredible! This is the best day of me life!

66113.title: An Inconspicuous Conveyance
66113.description:
[DNT] Our foes watch the skies. I will risk no harm to the future of my flight, so we must travel by less traditional mean.

I ordered a more... down to earth means of transport be acquired, but it seems to have suffered some damage during the exchange. You are undoubtedly more familiar with such things than I, {race}, so your assistance in repairing the wagon would be most appreciated.

66114.title: For the Benefit of the Queen
66114.description:
We safeguard our precious eggs to protect the future of all dragonflights. The Primalists do not simply threaten pain or anguish with their actions. 

They threaten us with extinction.

I must inform our queen at once.
66114.completion: This is dire... but our flight has suffered many tragedies over the years. We shall endure.
66114.objectives: Ride with Majordomo Selistra to the Ruby Lifeshrine.

66115.title: The Mandate of the Red
66115.description:
Our calling is care and compassion. We aid the other flights not only for their own sake, but for the sake of dragonkind as a whole.

Perhaps speaking with the dragonspawn here at the Ruby Lifeshrine will help you understand us further.
66115.progress: The red dragonflight preserves the future of us all.
66115.completion: I hope you have grown to appreciate what we do.
66115.objectives: Talk to the tenders at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

66116.title: The Primary Threat
66116.description:
There are far too many vulnerable eggs to secure. If the enemy breaks through, all is lost!

I am sure our guards are mustering on the field to push them back. Speak to Commander Lethanak, and he will use your strength where it will be most helpful.
66116.progress: I need all the help I can get.
66116.completion: I will use every weapon in my arsenal to stop these foes.
66116.objectives: Find Commander Lethanak at the Flashfrost Assault.

66118.title: Basalt Assault
66118.description: Raszageth and her Primalists have summoned towering earth elementals to break our walls. They must be stopped!
66118.progress: They will do anything they can to destroy our walls!
66118.objectives: Destroy 4 Enraged Cliffs in the Flashfrost Assault.

66119.title: Ruby Life Pools: Primalist Invasion
66119.description:
The Primalists have torn their way into our home. We were not prepared for such an intense attack... several got through.

One of our drakonid ventured in to follow them, but he has not reported his findings. I fear the worst.

I will stand guard. No more shall breach our walls while we draw breath, but you must stop those who made it inside.

Go!
66119.progress: They will destroy our future if we cannot stop them.
66119.completion:
Our home will bear the wounds of this assault for years, but we are strong. We will endure... and the eggs we saved will bring about a bright future for us all.

Thank you.

66121.title: Egg Evac
66121.description:
The Primalists have stolen our eggs for their perverse rituals! They must be stopped.

Help us recover our eggs before it is too late. Mark each egg as you find them, $p. I will ensure they are safely extracted from the area.
66121.objectives: Rescue 4 eggs from the Flashfrost Enclave.

66122.title: Proto-Fight
66122.description:
These proto-dragons detest us. They believe we are a twisted version of dragonkind that is manipulated and chained by the Titans. They do not understand.

Which is why they feel safe even as they throw their forces at our walls. 

They are mistaken.

Take this spear, $p. Kill our enemies.
66122.progress: They intend to harm our dragons. They deserve no mercy.
66122.completion: They may have been our kin, and perhaps we could have approached them as our brethren... but their cruelty leaves no mercy in my heart.
66122.objectives: Defeat 3 proto-dragons in the Flashfrost Enclave.

66123.title: Cut Off the Head
66123.description:
Jadzigeth, one of Raszageth's foul lieutenants, proudly leads the Primalists here.

Let us show them all what happens to those who stand against us.
66123.objectives: Defeat Jadzigeth in the Frostflash Enclave.

66124.title: Exeunt, Triumphant
66124.description:
From what I saw, the queen fell back to the Wild Hatchery. It is an outpost to keep watch over the proto-drakes in the area... I only hope that its defenses are enough.

We must head there at once!
66124.completion:
I could not rest until the eggs were safe... this is a relief.

Thank you, {NAME}.
66124.objectives: Escape the Frostflash Enclave with Majordomo Selistra.

66126.title: Unlocking Our Past
66126.progress: A restored Obsidian Key could allow us to unlock aspects of this forge that we have only dreamed about!
66126.completion: A wise choice. All these squabbles over the throne will not solidify our defenses. We must craft weapons and gear to fend off the djaradin.

66128.title: Next Steps
66128.description:
These stones are an incredible discovery, even if their intended use is never realized.

But before we try them out, we have a process to adhere to. They must be examined and cataloged, and reports sent and received to both the Reliquary and Explorers' League headquarters.

Let's meet back at basecamp. We can go over what's next.
66128.progress: Oh ye wouldn't believe the plans I have to get into that facility!
66128.completion: Don't ye worry. Show a little patience, and we'll get to the bottom a' this yet.
66128.objectives: Meet with Toddy and Naleidea in the Explorer's tent at the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores.

66130.title: Unlocking Our Past
66130.progress: Find me more restored Obsidian keys, and we shall unlock the full potential of the Obsidian Citadel.
66130.completion: Good work, champion. This key will allow us to access more of the Citadel's lost secrets.

66131.title: Unlocking Our Past
66131.progress: Bring me additional restored keys, and we shall continue our work here.
66131.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Your support in this matter shall bolster my claim to the throne.

66134.title: Azeroth Pest Control
66134.description:
You there! Hatchling!

Lend me a hand, won't you? These podlings are ripping up all my plants!

All kinds of elementals have invaded the gardens, and they seem to be... affecting the wildlife. It's like their energy has driven these podlings mad! More mad than usual!

I've got my hands full with just these three. Please! Before they rip up all my flower beds.
66134.progress: I'm too old to be fighting podlings!
66134.completion:
Thank the Titans you showed up! Otherwise I don't know if I'd ever get these pests to leave.

So what do you say to helping an old Drakonid out with the rest of the gardens?
66134.objectives: Kill 8 Agitated Seedlings in the Gardens.

66135.title: The Gardener's Apprentice
66135.description:
Basilton! Lord Basilton, where are you?

My executive assistant and apprentice, Lord Basilton, has gone missing! He loves to explore, but he's even worse at defending himself than I am. I'm a gardener, not a warrior!

Could you please go find that layabout? I need him here so I can think. He's usually in the shed, digging through piles of junk.

Be careful though. He can be a bit prickly at first.
66135.progress: At my age, an executive assistant is a necessity.
66135.completion:
Ah, there he is! My lovely assistant. Who's a good boy? A good, spiky boy? Basilton! Who's the spikiest? That's right! You are!

Ahem. Thank you, {NAME}.
66135.objectives: Search for Lord Basilton in the Garden Shed by cleaning up Piles of Junk.

66136.title: Elemental Extract
66136.description:
A huge fire elemental destroyed the pond a few days ago. I think it's behind all this ruckus, but it's too big to fight. We need to weaken it somehow.

But don't count Old Gryrmpech out just yet, I have a plan!

Water elementals decided to make themselves at home in the Blue flight's gazebo. If you can collect enough essence from them, we might be able to use their magic against them.

Fight fire with fire, right? Well, fight fire with water, I guess.

Anyway, you should probably get going.
66136.progress: In all my years, I've never seen so many elementals in one place. So why did it have to be my gardens?
66136.completion: Excellent! This is just what we need to snuff out those fire elementals once and for all.
66136.objectives: Collect 5 Watery Essence in the Gardens.

66137.title: Lashing Out
66137.description:
I'm sure the podlings aren't the only wildlife acting like hooligans.

Alexstrasza's tree has always been a thorn in my side. Her life magic draws all sorts of plants and animals to it, good and bad. And guess who has to take care of the bad ones? Old Gryrmpech, that's who!

Aspects above, I'm getting too old for this.

The stewards aren't trained in combat, so it is up to you to take care of the Life-Binder's weed problem.
66137.completion: The elemental problem is more dire than I thought, if you killed that many. Alexstrasza will be happy, at least.
66137.objectives: Kill 10 Invasive Deathblossoms and Lasher Weedlings in the Gardens.

66138.title: Like Sands Through the Hourglass
66138.description:
Like the rest of the gardens, Nozdormu's hourglass has had to weather the elemental unrest. Turbulent wind elementals came through and scattered the magical sand contained within.

Without this sand, Nozdormu's influence here is greatly diminished.

As a steward-in-training, I have been tasked with overseeing the hourglass at all times. If you would collect the sand in my stead, I would be eternally grateful.
66138.progress: I can rest easy knowing Nozdormu has already foreseen your success.
66138.completion: Excellent work.  Nozdormu informed me yesterday that he wishes to express his gratitude.
66138.objectives: Collect 8 Piles of Windswept Time Sand in the Gardens.

66139.title: Flame at Last
66139.description:
Alright, youngling, I've placed all the water elemental essences in this jar for you.

If you just toss it at the big one, it should work. I mean, when has water not worked against fire? It's foolproof.

The heat, uh, isn't good for my joints, so I'll just stay here. I trust you can handle it.
 
Good luck, young one!
66139.progress: You remind me of myself, when I was your age. Nothing could stand in the way of Gryrmpech!
66139.completion: Incredible! I wasn't sure it was going to work, but I'm glad it did.
66139.objectives: Use the Concentrated Essence of Water to defeat the Blazing Inferno in the Gardens.

66141.title: Broken Traditions, Broken Bodies
66141.description:
My fellow furbolg are no longer themselves. They have done... bad things. Now, they have become worse things.

Furbolg has never fought furbolg!

My brother and I escaped them. I came here looking for help. He remains by our clan's den.

Help us before our clan is lost!
66141.completion:
My brother spoke the truth.

It is even worse than when I left.
66141.objectives: Meet Garz and Narn on the way to Rustpine Den.

66147.title: Crystals in the Water
66147.description:
We might not look it this moment, but we are professionals. The Expedition entrusted us with finding a clutch of rare crystals in the area--a geological survey if you will.

I'm still collecting myself after the gorloc attack. Would you be a dear and go look for these crystals? Bring samples back if you can.
66147.completion: Excellent work! I'll get this to LOU-C and see what her little contraption can make of it.
66147.objectives: Collect 4 Crystal Samples in Gorloc Shore.

66148.title: Former Furbolg Family
66148.description:
Primalists came. They offered us new strength: the command of the elements.

I did not think Stoneheart would accept their gifts. Our clan did not need power. He thought nothing of the cost.

His terrible decision cannot be unmade. The magic has corrupted my clan--like disease rots a root.

My heart breaks, but culling the corrupted is the only way.
66148.completion: I am sorry you met the Rustpine clan now. This is not my people.
66148.objectives: Kill 15 Rustpine furbolg and elementals, then meet Narn further in Rustpine Den.

66149.title: Elemental Influence
66149.description:
Narn says not all the Rustpines followed Stoneheart or the Primalists.

Some resisters are held against their will. Totems spewing rock and mud restrain them... to force them to obey. 

Shatter the totems. Set them free!
66149.progress: My friends do not deserve this fate.
66149.completion: I will never forgive the Primalists for making our clan suffer.
66149.objectives: Destroy 3 Primalist Earthbind Totems, then meet Narn further in Rustpine Den.

66150.title: Rescuing Radza
66150.description:
Radza Thunderclaw is our Spiritkeeper. She holds true our traditions and history.

Primalist beliefs go against everything our clan holds true. I knew she would defy Stoneheart! 

Stoneheart will do anything to bring her to heel. No one is chieftain without Radza's blessing!

Narn says Khargall Fivefangs, the Chieftain's guard, is trying to break her. If Radza dies, our clan dies with her.

Go aid her, {NAME}, and be ready. He will not let her go without a fight.
66150.completion:
So many of my clan have fallen in battle with their brothers and sisters... all for the promise of power.

<Radza utters a guttural growl which fades into a long, mournful whisper.>

66151.title: His Stone Heart
66151.description:
We howl with grief for our chieftain, yet he lives.

What remains of Stoneheart is in the cave ahead. Many tried to reason with him. 

He killed them--and almost killed Narn.

He is a monster! This is the goal of the primalists. They would turn us into stone and flame to serve them.

There is no Rustpine left in him. He must be destroyed before others meet the same fate.
66151.progress: Our chieftain wanted power to protect the clan... but it took everything from us.
66151.completion:
My chieftain, I am sorry.

There was nothing else that could be done.

66152.title: Nowhere to Go
66152.description:
We cannot stay here.

I do not know what to do... where to go next...

We will return to your Camp Nowhere. The tuskarr should know what happened at Rustpine.

If we tell our story and keep it, maybe it will not happen again...
66152.completion:
Our clan has been clawed to shreds.

I hope another will accept us.

66154.title: Salivatory Samples
66154.description:
<The gaunt undead pinches the bridge of his nose and sighs heavily.>

This is going to reflect very poorly on my record. Somehow in a single day we've managed to stir up the local gorlocs, lose half of our equipment, and are now down a dwarf. 

In this situation, protocol dictates that we be as efficient as possible. Go thin out some of our toothy antagonists and bring me their saliva for further testing while you're at it.

Only the good stuff, mind you.
66154.completion:
Well, what do you know? Someone around here actually accomplished something. What's that old saying? Two for you, one for me?

<Rowe takes a small sip from the beaker.>

Ah, that's the stuff.
66154.objectives: Collect 12 Saliva Samples in Gorloc Shore.

66155.title: Ruriq's River Rapids Ride
66155.description:
I did not expect my brother's approval... but it is welcome, all the same. 

The time has come! Let's see if our hard work has paid off!

Join me in The Fallstrider, {NAME}, and we shall take off down the river, catching fish for Iskaara as we go!
66155.progress: With all of our hard work together, I'm certain our trip will be successful.
66155.completion:
Phew, what a ride! It's a miracle the boat is in one piece!

Thank you very much, {NAME}. Let us meet again for another ride!
66155.objectives: Ride the Fallstrider down the river.

66163.title: Nowhere to Hide
66163.description:
Welcome to Valdrakken, {race}. 
The climate in the city has been a bit warm of late, and I do not mean the weather.

The Primalists are skulking about, fomenting dissent among the citizens of our city.

Our foes are crafty. They have been disguising themselves as citizens of our city to hide from the Scalesworn. They know how to avoid my guards but will not suspect an outsider.

Take this Dragon's Eye gem, it should help you see through their disguises.

Go reveal and kill these infiltrators!
66163.progress: Have you taken care of our infiltrator problem?
66163.completion: Good. Let this serve as a notice that the Primalists will never be welcome in Valdrakken!

66164.title: Fishy Fingers
66164.description:
Now that Mordigan's off licking rocks, we can get to the crux of the problem...

Those perfidious fishmen have pilfered my parts!

We weren't in this dinky little village for more than an hour and WHAM! Gorloc were swarming all over us! Rowe was yelling, Aelnara was screaming, and I'm flailing around with my wrench like a madgnome! 

See if you can't salvage the situation and get some of my parts back!
66164.completion: You're back! I'll start getting the Geoscanner 289-07 reconfigured and as functional as circumstances allow. These seaside conditions are admittedly less than ideal.
66164.objectives: Recover 5 Stolen Parts in Gorloc Shore.

66166.title: Eyes and Ears
66166.description:
The Primalists have been spewing their propaganda among the citizens of Valdrakken. 

Our enemies are too wily to say anything in the presence of my Scalesworn, but perhaps you might be able to get close enough to eavesdrop on their conversations.

I have marked locations on your map for further investigation.

You may want to visit the Transmogrifier to see about changing your look to avoid any suspicion.

Take this enchanted stone, as long as you have it on hand we will be able to communicate.
66166.completion: So, the Primalists are up to something in the south and soldiers have not been arriving from South Hold Garrison... This does not sound good {NAME}. That does not sound good at all.
66166.objectives: Locate Clues within Valdrakken, and visit the Transmogrifier to learn how to change your appearance.

66167.title: Southern Exposure
66167.description:
Based on your discoveries I suspect the Primalists are attacking Commander Eranog's Garrison at South Hold. But, my Scalesworn cannot leave the city as that would be exactly what the Primalists are hoping for.

I need your help again, {NAME}. 

Travel to South Hold, see what kind of forces we are facing, and if possible make contact with the garrison guardians there.
66167.completion: You have my thanks, and my apologies, stranger. In the heat of battle it is difficult to distinguish a friend from a foe, and there are plenty of foes around.
66167.objectives: Travel to South Hold Gate in search of making contact with the garrison guardians.

66169.title: Vengeance, Served Hot
66169.description:
The Primalists caught us completely unawares.

<Velomir spits in disgust.>

My fellow guardians were ripped apart by these monsters. I would have joined them in death if you had not shown up when you did.

Off in the distance I can still hear the sounds of battle. Perhaps others still live, maybe even Commander Eranog.

Lend me your aid. I need you to cause a distraction so I can sneak to a position closer in.

Killing a few of these so called "Magmasworn" would be perfect.
66169.progress: Do you have a bodycount for me, {NAME}?
66169.completion: Great work, {class}. Those monsters deserve every bit of pain you gave them twice over!
66169.objectives: Kill 12 Magmasworn Primalists within South Hold Gate.

66170.title: Silent Vigil
66170.description:
<Dori'thur hovers silently, peering at you with keen, expectant eyes.

Perhaps the noble owl wishes you to see something of import.>

66173.title: Hall of Samples
66173.description:
Did you hear what that console said?

There's a hall full of samples. Ancient titan machinery? Specimens from other worlds? Only Tyr knows what's in there!

Let's change that.
66173.progress: Do ye wonder what else the titans captured as "samples?"
66173.completion: If ye decide to retire from adventuring, I'm sure ye could find work as a dragon wrangler.

66174.title: Hall of the Aspects
66174.description:
The Hall of the Aspects, eh? Why would Tyr seal something like this away? Was he hidin' something?

The implications are staggering--hopefully we'll find some answers in there.
66174.progress: Let's pop through that transporter before Naleidea gets cold feet!
66174.completion: I don't care what Naleidea says, I knew ye were the right choice from the beginning.
66174.objectives: Explore the Hall of the Aspects.

66175.title: Field Experiment
66175.description:
Thanks to you, our geological survey is now operating at nearly 96% efficiency! 

<LOU-C furrows her eyebrows.>

Those are rookie numbers.

Help me run the samples you collected through my Geoscanner 289-07. It should give us a baseline as to what exactly is going on at the plateau.
66175.completion: They say to expect the unexpected, but wow... this is unprecedented!
66175.objectives: Help LOU-C run her tests in Whaler's Nook.

66176.title: Elemental Experimentation
66176.description: Go conduct experiments on the water elementals harassing the gorlocs!
66176.objectives: Conduct 6 elemental experiments in Gorloc Shore.

66177.title: No Dwarf Left Behind
66177.description:
The salt levels here are off the charts! We need to find Mordigan and get him out of there. He must be dangerously dehydrated by now. 

He's only been gone a couple hours. See if you can't determine which path the grumpy old dwarf took!
66177.completion: You've been busy. So have I.
66177.objectives: Follow Mordigan Ironjaw's path through Gorloc Shore.

66178.title: A Day in the Groves
66178.description:
Rymek was sent here by the blue flight to learn about and protect our gardens. 

I am glad for their support. We are few in number, and our losses have been great. The blue dragonflight commands powerful magic, so we can learn a great deal from each other.

Come. Let us demonstrate the green dragonflight's important role here in the Dragon Isles.
66178.completion:
It is so peaceful here.

This is Somnikus's favorite place to rest, but... he has been morose since his son was killed in the centaur attacks. 

But we shall focus on the present. Let us show Rymek our purpose here in the groves.
66178.objectives: Meet Merithra and Rymek at the Leafy Repose in the Emerald Gardens.

66179.title: Seeds for the Future
66179.description:
The Primalists' attack left its mark on the Emerald Gardens. I wish to see it grow and flower once again.

In this part of the garden, we have an overabundance of lashers. Their seeds can be used by the Sisters of the Garden to cultivate vegetation in those damaged glades.

Thin out the lashers to collect their seeds, and then give those seeds to the Sisters. They sometimes struggle to inflict harm on any creature, even when it is in the best interest of the gardens overall.
66179.completion: Thank you. Do not fear, the lashers always grow back at a remarkable rate. Their numbers will rebound quickly.
66179.objectives: Collect seeds from various Lashers and give them to Sisters of the Garden.

66180.title: Wake the Ancients
66180.description:
There are many ways to keep the gardens safe, and we have allies to help us.

A few Ancients rest dormant in these glades. They are giant trees sworn to defend the forest and the creatures within. 

Use this fragment of my breath to wake them.
66180.completion:
One of the ancients was slain? By frost?

This does not bode well. We must be alert. The Primalists could be preparing another assault on the garden.
66180.objectives: Use Merithra's Borrowed Breath to wake Ancient Guardians in the Emerald Gardens.

66181.title: A Frenzied Defender
66181.description:
I have noticed that these gardens have rather diverse defenses, from the dragons to the drakonid and ancients... and even the wildlife!

But there is one defender that seems to have become rather too zealous in its protectiveness. It even tried to swoop at me when I arrived!

And since we know something has been killing within these groves, it cannot hurt to be too cautious.

Unfortunately, this creature must be slain before it can do more damage.
66181.progress: Have you found and put down that overzealous bird?
66181.completion:
The gardens are more peaceful already, are they not?

You are quite capable, {race}.

66182.title: Gerithus's Research
66182.description:
The green dragonflight has many duties, not solely in the tending of the garden. We also defend the Emerald Dream, and some extend their attention even further.

My son Gerithus, for example, has always had interest in all kinds of magic.

You and Rymek should seek him out, to see what he is working on and help where you can.
66182.completion:
Welcome! I appreciate that my mother has been interested in my research. Even if it's a little far-fetched.

Though I'm sure Rymek, as an emissary of the blue flight, will have a much greater understanding of magic than I do. I hope that we can make some real progress.

Let's begin!
66182.objectives: Meet Gerithus deeper in the Emerald Gardens.

66183.title: Emerald Tears
66183.description:
We may've only recently returned to the Emerald Gardens, relatively speaking, but we carry our long-lasting feelings with us.

Many of us are still reeling from the death of Ysera, my grandmother. Including myself. I wish I had gotten to spend more time with her and to learn more from her. What amazing things she's seen in her life!

In places like the Emerald Gardens, when we shed tears, they can crystalize and carry great power within them. I have an idea for how this galvanized grief could help us.
66183.progress: Have you collected some of the Emerald Tears in the garden?
66183.completion: These are beautiful examples, {NAME}. Now let's see what we can do!

66184.title: Anchors to Life
66184.description:
Based on my research, I believe there's a way to reestablish Ysera's ties to the Emerald Dream, so we can bring her closer to Azeroth.

When Ysera died, the Winter Queen used her own power to restore her in Ardenweald. For now, she's bound there, but I think if we can just get Ysera over into the Emerald Dream, we can use these anchors to keep her there.

But I'm getting ahead of everything.

First, we have to infuse these anchors with the power of those Emerald Tears.
66184.progress: There is so much potential within ourselves.
66184.completion:
That's it! I can feel the power in the anchors.

Now, of course, there's just the one tiny problem of how to get Ysera to cross from the realms of death into the realms of life. One thing at a time.

For now, I'll get these anchors to the Shady Sanctuary for safekeeping.

My mother is here. She must have more that she wants you and Rymek to see.
66184.objectives: Empower the Inert Anchors with the Emerald Tears.

66185.title: Across the Weald
66185.description:
It is time. I know I said that I was fine, but ever since Solethus' death, it's like I've been missing something essential.

I am alive, and he is not. That feels... wrong.

But there might be a way I can set things right. Ysera is the only one who can help us get control of Ancient Bough again. I think I can help bring her back.

It's getting harder and harder to cross over. We need to make this count.

Tyrande and Malfurion will meet us there.
66185.completion:
Greetings. Somnikus has told me of the grave threat in the Emerald Gardens. He has told me of his own part in it.

But I'm afraid the solution will not be as simple as he hopes.
66185.objectives: Meet Somnikus at the Grove of Awakening in Ardenweald.

66186.title: The Price
66186.description:
I am eager to return to the Emerald Dream and defend the gardens from the Incarnates and their followers. But I cannot leave Ardenweald yet, not with my bond to the Winter Queen.

I dare not ask anyone to do this, unless they accept the consequences. As I did.

But there is one who could take my place.
66186.completion:
It is settled. I will remain in Ardenweald.

I remain to protect the Dream and all the hope that grows within it. It must be me.

66187.title: Mad Mordigan & The Crystal King
66187.description:
I've scouted the perimeter. If Mordigan's anywhere, he's inside this cave.

<Muffled curses and insults echo out from the cave entrance.>

He's definitely inside this cave.

LOU-C said these crystals have dangerous dehydrating properties. See if you can't separate him from his... geological finds. And try not to hurt him too much.

He's fairly respected in his field.
66187.completion: An inelegant solution, but I appreciate your quick thinking and... resourcefulness.
66187.objectives: Decrystallize Mordigan Ironjaw in Gorloc Shore.

66188.title: Storm's Rest
66188.description:
Let us go into the Grove of Awakening. The Winter Queen is the only one who can transfer this bond from Ysera to me. I have faith that she will agree. She aided Ysera in a time of desperate need, and now Ysera can help us in turn.

If the Winter Queen agrees, I expect that I will not be able to remain awake for long. The weight of the bond will be heavy to bear.

In time, I hope that I may wake again and gaze upon the fully grown might of the new tree.
66188.progress: I long to see the twisting green expanse of the Dream once again.
66188.completion:
It has been done. Malfurion will sleep here in my stead. And Tyrande will watch over her people as she has capably done for millennia before.

Now, we must ready ourselves. When I cross over into the Emerald Dream, there will be a brief window when you can join me.

Are you ready?
66188.objectives: Activate the Globes of Rebirth in the Grove of Awakening.

66189.title: Step Into the Life
66189.description:
We mustn't delay. I can feel the energies of rebirth surging in me. I am ready to cross back into the Emerald Dream. 

From the realms of Death into Life.

Follow me through the gate of Awakening, and we will race across the Dreamway to Ancient Bough. I expect there will be some resistance within, so be on your guard.
66189.completion:
It is worse than I feared. I can destroy the ice that surrounds the grove, but there are too many enemies upon us. And we need to find a way to bring down the barrier that keeps the others out.

We must work quickly and vanquish these foes, so Merithra and the others can reinforce us.
66189.objectives: Fight your way across the Emerald Dreamway with Ysera and enter Ancient Bough.

66190.title: So Close
66190.description:
I must take a moment to thank you, {NAME}, for all your help. 

Truly, I never thought I would have a chance to admire the Dream within Ancient Bough! Not as a humble emissary! How very kind.

Lord Somnikus has graciously invited me to set foot inside the grove and see the portal. I would be honored if you would join me.

I will remember this moment for the rest of my life. Share it with me.
66190.completion:
I... can't believe...

This cannot be...

I failed. I trusted Rymek and his dragonkin, and they betrayed us all.
66190.objectives: Enter the Dream portal grove with Rymek.

66191.title: And Yet So Far
66191.description:
I cannot slip into the Dream here as I once did. With the bough defenses activated, we are essentially blocked from the grove.

But I'm afraid it only gets worse, {NAME}.

I believe Rymek did not merely trick us to gain access to the Dream. I suspect he is looking for something within it... something precious and powerful that I swore to protect. 

Not even Gerithus or Somnikus knew of its existence, but now, my hand is forced. You must know the truth.
66191.completion:
Our situation is dire. Rymek has left us few options.

He has forced our hand. Now we must make great sacrifices.

Though we may not be able to enter the grove from this side, there is a way in... from beyond the realms of life.

66196.title: A Quack For Help
66196.description:
<This duckling flails around frantically inside the bubble, quacking in fright.>

<Maybe the ecologists would know how to help it?>
66196.progress:
<Tharu coos at the bubbled duckling.>

Shh, don't cry, little one.

Us big strong ecologists will keep you safe! And {NAME} too of course.
66196.completion: We'll look after Waddles. Let us know if you find any other lost ducklings out there.
66196.objectives: Bring the Bubbled Duckling back to the Ecologists' Camp.

66201.title: Hooves of War
66201.description:
Balakar will marshal his forces for war. I will do the same, but we are outnumbered.

The dragons have asked for our aid, and we can use their help to even the odds. To answer their call for an alliance, I must blow the Horn of Drusahl, but I need Ohn'ahra's blessing. Will you help me?

Go to Teerakai and deliver my declaration of war to my lieutenant, Jebotai. He will marshal my forces and direct you to the mystics who can find Ohn'ahra.
66201.completion: <Jebotai reads the message. His face grows more and more concerned.>
66201.objectives: Deliver the Khanam Matra's message to Khansguard Jebotai at Teerakai.

66210.title: Gather the Family
66210.description:
Your friend Kalecgos wishes to speak of ley lines, but preparations must be made for the funeral. 

While I meet with him, could you gather the final offerings from around Iskaara and place them in the funeral boat alongside dear old Ponoliak? 

I hope you take a moment to enjoy the town, as well! My people will welcome you warmly, especially after your help in Brackenhide.
66210.progress: Did you get yourself a bowl of soup?
66210.completion: Your friend is very inquisitive! Does he ever take a moment to relax?
66210.objectives: Collect 4 Funeral Offerings from around Iskaara, then place them in the funeral boat.

66211.title: Brackenhide Hollow: To the Source
66211.description:
We cannot thank you enough for your aid pushing back the Brackenhide gnolls. 

But they continue to gather, using their foul decay magic from some source deep within Brackenhide Hollow. Worse, we have not heard from the tuskarr in that area for weeks, now.

I fear something terrible is happening there. We must protect our home. Please, gather your forces, find our people, and see what you can do about the decay!
66211.progress: We must save our people, and stop the spread of decay!
66211.completion: Iskaara would be lost without you.

66212.title: Fishing: Aileron Seamoth
66212.description:
Doesn't ANYBODY know how to fish PROPERLY anymore?

<Lukoturukk wiggles his nose angrily.>

You, with the face, go get me some fish. GOOD fish. And no grungles!
66212.progress:
Well, what've you caught, then? 

It better not be any skinny little ancheevies.
66212.objectives: Fish up 5 Aileron Seamoths from the ocean around the Dragon Isles.

66213.title: The Weave of a Tale
66213.description:
My dearest wife, Poa, is an excellent storyteller. 

But it's been thirty years, and she tells the same ones over and over again! Please, {class}, talk to Poa and give her a new story to tell.

What's that? Tell her a story about your adventures? Don't be ridiculous -- I don't want to hear about that! The greatest stories are always about fish. Tell a story about fish, even if you have to make one up!
66213.completion:
Thank goodness, a new story. 

Let's hear it!
66213.objectives: Tell Elder Poa a fishy tale.

66217.title: WANTED: Krojek the Shoreprowler
66217.description:
We've been watching the great shark we know as Krojek for many years now, waiting for the best time to hunt him down. 

His hunting ground has meandered closer and closer to the shore. That means the time is now. Gather your hunting party and take him out!
66217.completion: It is the cycle of the sea life out here. Some we leave to continue the line. Some we cull, some we eat. All in balance.

66218.title: Scampering Scamps
66218.description:
Hello again.

Could you do me and Norukk a favor? Our kids, Neelo and Nau, left to play. They know they should be back by now. 

I am occupied, so please find them. I doubt they are in danger; my kids know how to take care of themselves.
66218.progress: Neelo and Nau can fend for themselves. But they know they are supposed to be home helping by now.
66218.completion:
Ta says all gnolls are dangerous and mean. But this is just a baby! 

Ma says I always have to take care of Nau, and she's a baby, too.

66221.title: Moving On
66221.description:
With the Bronze Oathstone restored, Alexstrasza can proceed with her plan.

Travel to Valdrakken, {NAME}. She will want to hear of your success.
66221.completion: {NAME}, please accept our most sincere gratitude for all you have done for us. I will let you know when the time comes to accompany me on this next step.
66221.objectives: Speak with Alexstrasza at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken.

66222.title: The Calm Before the Storm
66222.description:
The Nokhud are powerful and have many allies. It will take all we have to withstand them.

{NAME}, you have the Khanam Matra's trust. Her orders were to rally our friends and prepare our people. 

I need your help. Seek Hojin to mobilize the remaining khansguard. Alert Scout Khenyug to possible Nokhud incursions. Inform Agura to expect wounded, and tell Gensai to prepare our provisions.

As for the mystics, I believe they left recently. I will see if any remain in Teerakai.
66222.progress: It is rare for us to meet outsiders. It is even more rare to have them helping us, as you are. Thank you.
66222.completion: I did not wish to cause a panic, but the people must be ready. Clan Nokhud is not known for mercy.
66222.objectives: Communicate Jebotai's orders to the townsfolk of Teerakai.

66223.title: Can We Keep It?
66223.description:
He's only trying to eat us because he's so hungry! 

Fish! Nobody can turn down some tasty, ice cold, raw fish!

Frigidfish are the best, ever. You can fish them up all over the ocean! But if you can't fish one yourself, Jinkutuk in Iskaara will definitely sell you some. 

Bring me so many he won't be hungry any more!
66223.progress:
So many fishes! I want to eat them all!

... But no. They're for Scaps. This is important.
66223.completion: Scaps is gonna love these and then we're gonna be the bestest of friends!
66223.objectives: Bring Neelo 7 Frigidfish from either a vendor in Iskaara or fishing in any Dragon Isles ocean water.

66224.title: Mystic Mystery
66224.description:
I'm sorry, I've failed to commune with Ohn'ahra. You will need someone else to fulfill the Khanam Matra's request.

Several days ago, my fellow mystics were called to Ridgewater Retreat on an urgent request from Tigari Khan. They should still be there.

Meet me outside of town. The least I can do is show you the way.
66224.progress:
{NAME}, you're alright! Thank Ohn'ahra.

Oh! These are my totems.
66224.completion: I barely escaped that ambush with my life. I'm afraid my fellow mystics weren't so lucky....
66224.objectives: Meet up with Boku and travel to Ridgewater Retreat.

66225.title: Toting Totems
66225.description:
Boku asked why I sent a message calling all mystics to Ridgewater Retreat.

I sent no such message. Balakar purposefully drew my mystics into a trap to cripple Clan Ohn'ir.

But there may be a second reason. The Nokhud are gathering mystic totems, as many as they can find. These totems are blessed by Ohn'ahra.

The Nokhud motives in this are unclear, but we cannot allow them to take Ohn'ahra's gifts. Recover as many totems as you can.
66225.progress:
The totems are infused with Ohn'ahra's wind magic.

Yet the Nokhud have abandoned her teachings. What are they up to?
66225.completion: So many totems. So many fallen mystics.
66225.objectives: Gather 8 Bundles of Totems from the Nokhud at Ridgewater Retreat.

66226.title: Emotional Support Companions
66226.description:
Please don't hurt me... 

What? You're here to help? You must save the animals!

The Nokhud attacked without warning. We all fled for our lives! I barely escaped death by diving into the lake.

The animals! We left them behind. Please, I beg you, rescue the creatures. Who knows what cruelty the Nokhud have in store for them.
66226.progress:
As initiates, we practice our healing arts by rehabilitating wounded creatures. 

Four creatures were under our care. However many you can rescue will be a relief.
66226.completion:
You saved them! They're a bit worse for wear, but they're alive and will recover.

Thank you stranger. Please take this, as a token of our everlasting gratitude.
66226.objectives: Rescue the innocent creatures from the Nokhud at Ridgewater Retreat.

66227.title: Some Good Fishing
66227.description:
Another pair of hands! I could use some help catching enough fish to bring home for a meal.

These Kirin Tor seem concerned about something called magical anomalies in the area, whatever that means.

You're all welcome to stay here as long as you pitch in and help out.

Grab a fishing pole and start fishing. Many hands make light work!
66227.progress: Let me know if you need a few tips.
66227.completion: Ah, that will do nicely! Thank you, adventurer.
66227.objectives: Catch 3 blue-tailed minnows within Khuri's Fishing Spot.

66228.title: Camp Antonidas
66228.description:
The Kirin Tor have our main camp set up to the south of here: Camp Antonidas.

I believe Noriko and Khadgar are there now gathering adventurers to aid Kalecgos in reclaiming the Azure Oathstone.

If you wish to help in our endeavours, go there.
66228.completion:
Ah, {NAME}. Good to see you...

Hold on... do you feel that?
66228.objectives: Meet Noriko the All-Remembering in Camp Antonidas.

66230.title: A Sketchy Request
66230.description:
The tarasek took everything they could get their claws on, including my scouting ledger.

These overgrown lizards hoard trinkets and trophies by the dozens. I am sure that they stashed my ledger away somewhere. Could you keep an eye out for it as you work your way through the pass?

Oh, and {NAME}? If you do manage to find it, please do not look inside. The contents are sort of... personal.
66230.completion:
Ah... You really did find it.

In truth, it's more of a sketchbook than a ledger. For as long as I can remember, I've been more interested in doodling than scouting...

<Alvi looses a long, low sigh.>

Maybe if I had actually done my job properly, then Nori wouldn't have gotten hurt.

I have to fix this... but I don't know if I can do it alone.
66230.objectives: Retrieve Alvi's "Ledger" and return it to Waywatcher Alvi.

66232.title: Afront 'Till A Salt
66232.description:
We don't mind accommodating you and your friends in our little place--not that anyone asked-- but would you be a good neighbor and nab me some crystal flakes if you're going up to the springs? We use 'em to preserve all kinds of things. It's a crucial part of keeping food around here.

The larger gorlocs are absolutely covered in the stuff. Maybe get some flakes off them?
66232.progress: Now that you mention it, I'm actually pretty hungry.
66232.completion: This is will go a long way in helping us in these parts. We just might let your friends stick around...
66232.objectives: Gather 120 Crystal Flakes in Gorloc Shore.

66236.title: Catching Wind
66236.description:
The Nokhud are collecting totems. The Primalists are capturing ohuna. And Ohn'ahra is silent.

Whatever the Nokhud plans are, we must foil them. You and Boku must travel to Windsong Rise. Our enemies are likely there already.

Search for Ohn'ahra there. If her children are in danger, she will undoubtedly go to them, and we must help. The Windmother is powerful, but I fear what these Primalists are capable of.
66236.completion: Balakar and these Primalists have trampled on our most sacred beliefs.

66237.title: Spiritual Allies
66237.description:
Our arrival will not have gone unnoticed.

Allow me to speak with them before we enter. I have something of a history with the council.

There will be time for introductions after.

66239.title: Spreading Decay
66239.description:
<Brena turns Kargpaw's totem over and over in her thick hands.>

Kargpaw is a pawn. He isn't the source of this rot. We must find it, before the decay spreads further.

The closest tuskarr presence from here is a trading outpost, just across the bridge on the way to Iskaara.

We should check in with them... and quickly.
66239.completion: As I feared, they were attacked as well.
66239.objectives: Meet Brena at the trading outpost.

66242.title: Weather Control
66242.description:
This unnatural storm is heavy with magic. By the looks of it, the Nokhud are learning to manipulate the sacred essence of Windsong Rise to create storm elementals. Some have had more success than others...

<Boku gestures to the unfortunate Nokhud initiate nearby still smoking from lightning burns.>

{NAME}, we can't allow them to continue.
66242.progress: The Nokhud will regret abandoning Ohn'ahra for the Primalists!
66242.completion: I don't want to spill blood, but the Nokhud must be stopped.
66242.objectives: Kill 8 Stormbound Essences and 6 Stormcaller Initiates.

66243.title: A Gift of Hope
66243.description:
Greetings, Maw Walker.

I bear a summons from the Winter Queen. She requests your presence in Ardenweald to witness a ceremony involving others from your world.

Shandris Feathermoon will be among them. You can find her in the Grove of Awakening.
66243.completion:
The Winter Queen's gift... what we just witnessed...

<Shandris's eyes glisten with tears of hope.>

We must ask Ysera to help us keep this precious seed safe.
66243.objectives: Meet Shandris Feathermoon in the Grove of Awakening.

66244.title: To Valdrakken
66244.description:
Thanks to you, we narrowly avoided a complete catastrophe.

However, we should convene with the other Aspects and share word of what happened here.

Please meet me at the Seat of the Aspects within Valdrakken. I'm sure the others will have insight into what Raszageth and her Primalists are attempting.

There is a crossing into Thaldraszus north and a bit east of here. The flight is scenic, but do not take too long getting there.
66244.completion: Welcome to Valdrakken, {NAME}. Kalecgos says there is news about the Azure Span.
66244.objectives: Travel to Valdrakken and meet with Alexstrasza the Life-Binder.

66245.title: Remember the Fallen
66245.description:
So many of my comrades have fallen.

Please... Collect their identifying signets so that their names may not be forgotten.
66245.progress: How goes your task, hero? Did you find any signets?

66246.title: The Fog of Battle
66246.description:
The Primalist attack came suddenly and with no warning. My unit attempted to find our leader, Commander Eranog, but before we could get to the other side of the garrison we were cut off.

In the battle my unit leader, Sergeant Tagrik, held off three Primalists by himself as Kaora, Mikor, and myself battled at his side.

Their screams are the last thing I remember before I fell. 

Please, {race}, if you see any signs of my unit let me know what happened to them.
66246.progress: Have you found what happened to my unit? I fear the worst, but I have hope that they survived.
66246.completion: This... pains me to hear... but I understand. Thank you, {class}.
66246.objectives: Search for the members of Guardian Velomir's unit in the South Hold Gate.

66247.title: Slightly Used Weapons
66247.description:
This spear appears to be in good shape, given the condition of its former owner.

Guardian Velomir mentioned to keep an eye out for useful materials, perhaps a few more of these spears can be obtained from the Magmasworn.
66247.completion: Good find, {NAME}! These should be useful.

66248.title: Tying Things Together
66248.description:
This coil of heavy rope seems to be in good condition. 

Guardian Velomir said to keep an eye out for useful materials, perhaps if you can find a few more coils he might find them useful.
66248.progress: What is it, friend? Did you find something?
66248.completion:
What is this? Rope? There is no time to make a net!

Wait... I have an idea. There are some old weapons that we could use with these... 

Good eye, {NAME}! These are perfect!

66249.title: Clear the Sky
66249.description:
You did well to gather those spears and rope. With them, we can ensure those haughty Primalists will no longer rule the skies!

There is a platform up the stairway with several Siege Scorpions. If you use the rope to string their bows and use the spears as ammunition, you should be able to strike the Magmasworn's dragons in the air!

Once cleared, the path up the spire will be safe and we can continue our search for Commander Eranog.
66249.completion:
Well done, {NAME}! That should take some heat off us. 

Keep your weapon in hand though, we are not done yet.
66249.objectives: Control a Siege Scorpion and then use it to clear the skies of Magmasworn Trueborn.

66250.title: Where's The Chief?
66250.description:
This is the only part of the fortress we haven't yet searched, {NAME}. If Commander Eranog is anywhere, it has to be here.

<Velomir glances towards the nearby doorway.>

Let us see what we can find out.
66250.completion: Damn it all! The commander was behind this? I cannot believe he would betray us like this.
66250.objectives: Accompany Guardian Velomir and inspect the Lookout Tower within South Hold Gate.

66251.title: Fire Fighter
66251.description:
Commander Eranog has betrayed us and left this beast in charge.

You have done so much for me already, but I can not handle that monster in my current state.

Please, do this one last thing for me and help ensure that South Hold Gate does not fall to these Primalists.

We must kill their leader!

Help me, {NAME}.
66251.completion: With their leader dead these Primalists should be easy for reinforcements from Valdrakken to clear out.

66252.title: Reporting In
66252.description:
The Primalists threat has been diminished, {NAME}. Forces from Valdrakken will be headed in soon, and can clean up any remnants. 

You should head back to the city and inform Captain Drine of what has happened. She will be interested to know what occurred here with Commander Eranog.

Thank you again, {NAME}, for everything.
66252.completion:
Eranog joined the Primalists? Flame and Scale, this is a terrible development!

However, you were able to prevent them from taking South Hold Gate.

That is no small feat. I appreciate your service to Valdrakken, {NAME}. It will not be forgotten.
66252.objectives: Return to Valdrakken and report to Captain Drine.

66253.title: Stolen Shipments
66253.description:
Tha shipments from Shiri and Zen'kala keep comin' in, we can barely keep up! But one of my workers thinks I won't notice if he shaves a little off the top. 

The goblins here have been workin' on a little device to help make a mess of this thief: an exploding pie.

Look for Kanyaku and throw one straight at him. I'm sure he's makin' mischief somewhere.
66253.progress: Throw an explosive pie at the thief to get the shipment.
66253.objectives: Throw the explosive pie at the thief and retrieve 1 Shipment.

66254.title: Pessimistic Mystic
66254.description:
War? Dragons? You need me to contact Ohn'ahra?

I can't. I can't hear Ohn'ahra at all. I'm just an initiate, and it seems like Ohn'ahra has withdrawn her blessings from me. Maybe I'm not good enough...

<Boku starts digging through a satchel.>

When my mentor assigned me to this clan, she gifted me with these totems. She said they would empower me if ever I doubted myself.

Will you help me place them? I will try to call upon Ohn'ahra one more time.
66254.completion: Still nothing. Not even a sigh from Ohn'ahra.
66254.objectives: Place the Empowerment Totems around Boku.

66256.title: Eagle-itarian
66256.description:
We've discovered why the Nokhud want mystic totems. They can be used to capture the Children of Ohn'ahra. Though the Nokhud have stolen the totems, the Primalists are the ones behind this blasphemy.

The Children of Ohn'ahra are sacred ohuna, blessed by the Windmother herself. Please, {NAME}, free any ohuna you see! And if you come across any Primalists...

<Boku trails off, but his expression is one of grim determination.>
66256.progress: The Children of Ohn'ahra bear the spirits of the honored dead to the beyond.
66256.completion: After all Ohn'ahra has done for us, we must do all we can to help her children. Thank you, {NAME}.
66256.objectives: Free 6 Children of Ohn'ahra and eliminate 6 Primalists at Windsong Rise.

66257.title: Fowl Sorcery
66257.description:
It is said that Ohn'ahra infused the spear of our ancestor, Maruuk, with her power. Balakar Khan must have told the Primalists about that legend.

They have stolen the magic from Ohn'ahra's children, polluted it with storm sorcery, and infused it into ballista bolts. Why would the Nokhud need such weapons?

We shouldn't wait to find out. These storm bolts are being loaded into wagons for transport. Take my totems and place one atop each wagon you come across. My wind magic will smash them to pieces.
66257.progress: You might want to run after placing a totem.
66257.completion: I'm sure there's more out there, but we destroyed what we could. Hopefully, this will at least slow them down.
66257.objectives: Use Boku's Wind Totem to destroy the Nokhud wagons.

66258.title: Oh No, Ohn'ahra!
66258.description:
That Primalist is restraining Ohn'ahra, but just barely. She doesn't seem to notice us.

Tigari Khan would say, "Even the slightest breeze can topple a teetering stone." If I can disrupt her spell, even just a little, Ohn'ahra might be able to break free.

Keep the guards distracted. I have an idea.
66258.completion: We took quite a tumble. We're lucky to be alive.
66258.objectives: Defeat enemies as Boku tries to free Ohn'ahra.

66259.title: A Storm of Ill Tidings
66259.description:
{NAME}, we need to tell the Khanam Matra everything that's happened, including the capture of Ohn'ahra.

You must go to Maruukai as quickly as you can. You'll have to go alone. I was hurt in the fall, and I'd just slow you down.

Don't worry about me. I'll catch up later. Go!
66259.completion: This is dire news, {NAME}, but we cannot lose focus. We are bruised but not beaten.
66259.objectives: Deliver your report to the Khanam Matra in Maruukai.

66261.title: A Minor Setback
66261.description:
Ah, adventurer! Just the sort of well-armed individual I was hoping to encounter.

I'm here in this literal backwater on very important Kirin Tor business, you see, and whilst I was beginning to set up my camp, I was chased off by filthy, mangy gnolls.

In fact, a rather concerning number of gnolls have gathered nearby, enough that I believe they pose a threat to the wider Span.

Fear not though, for I have a plan! Meet me in the lake just over there, and I'll explain everything.

66262.title: Waste Water Cleanup
66262.description:
First things first--I need my base of operations back! But the elementals running amok around here have made it very difficult to gain even a toehold.

And of course it is those wretched gnolls' fault.

The gnolls have dumped so much refuse, offal, and Light knows what else into the lake that the local elementals have started to go berserk.

Be a dear and clean up a few of the more revolting messes before things come to a head. And, more importantly, before they stain my robes permanently!
66262.completion: I can taste the difference already!
66262.objectives: Clean 6 Rotting Piles from the lake.

66263.title: A Precision Approach
66263.description:
Gnolls are awful creatures. Smelly. Always scratching, laughing at you. And there are multitudes here and more are constantly arriving. We, and by that I mean you, could reap them like wheat for days and never get anywhere. They can't be suffered to stay here.

We must strike at the heart of the snake! Remove their leadership and they'll be paralyzed with indecision and despair. 

What do you mean why are we doing this? Isn't it obvious? They're gnolls! What more reason could one need?
66263.progress: Did I mention I'm allergic to gnoll fur? My throat gets itchy just thinking about them.

66264.title: Disarmed and Docile
66264.description:
There's a frankly unnerving amount of weaponry being waved about up there. Relieving them of some should help calm things down. Or at least calm my nerves.

What are they going to do without weapons, after all? Attack you with their bare hands? Ha!
66264.completion: Oh, those? Just dump them anywhere. I'm sure the elementals won't mind.

66265.title: Who's Next?
66265.description:
Aha! Well, it seems that another gnoll has stepped up to assume command. Just as I expected. Yes.

Having a trusted vice-warlord to ensure continuation of government makes perfect sense now, doesn't it? We'll just have to hit them a little harder to tumble their bureaucracy, hm?

What? Am I going to take this moment to reflect on whether I'm rushing to judgement on these gnolls? Ridiculous! They're gnolls! 

Quickly now! Kill Cracktooth before the iron cools off or they arrange for an election!
66265.completion: Ha! Maybe next time they'll think twice before electing a new leader!

66266.title: Filthy Mongrels
66266.description:
Those flea-bitten Hyena Mongrels the gnolls breed have got to go! Not only do they have no manners at all--you would not believe the places I've seen them relieve themselves--but they may very well be able to sniff me out despite my exemplary illusions.

Do the well-mannered world a favor and remove them from it.
66266.objectives: Slay 3 Hyena Matriarchs and 12 Hyena Mongrels.

66267.title: M.E.T.A.
66267.description:
Those fiends! Pillaging and murder are one thing, but animal abuse? I'll not stand for it. 

The gnolls have set out traps for animals to catch and feed to their slavering hyena mutts. Find a way to free their fluffy captives and show the ruffians how a mage ethically treats animals!

Of course this makes ethical sense in light of my recent actions. What exactly are you trying to insinuate?

66268.title: Third Try's the Charm
66268.description:
What? Another one's seized power? Whatever happened to abhorring a vacuum? Or at least waiting for a respectful period of mourning to pass in order to keep up appearances?

Do they have no decency? No sense of propriety? No respect for a well-crafted plan? I made charts!

Deal with this Bloodclaw fellow. I need a moment.

And I don't need your nagging comments, thank you very much!
66268.completion: Finally! That has to be the last one. Right?

66269.title: Just To Be Sure
66269.description:
Just... kill anyone who looks like they might be magically inclined. Or has organizational skills. Or looks overly ambitious.

Really, just use your best judgement on this one.

Your "best judgement" is to stop speaking to me? Come on, {class}! They're... up to something nefarious, obviously!
66269.progress: Don't they know they've been outwitted?

66270.title: Whack-a-Gnoll
66270.description:
Oh, Light... there are more on their way! How could this happen?

All my careful planning! The days spent hiding in this rancid lake! The assassinations!

This should have thrown them into chaos and caused their settlement to crumble, but we've barely slowed them down!

Maybe... maybe you're right, {NAME}. I've been wrong all along...

No! Impossible! We're in too deep now anyway.

Go...deal with these new arrivals. I need time to collect myself.
66270.completion:
They're just going to keep fighting until they find a new leader? That settles it then. If I'm ever going to have a base of operations here, we'll have to kill all of them.

The plan is that we...

Wait, you're leaving? You don't want any part of this? What am I going to do? I can't leave this lake now that I've made an enemy of the gnolls!

Fine! Side with those flea-bitten miscreants!

Take what I promised and go. You're not the only "champion" in these woods! I'll find someone else to help me!

66277.title: [DNT] Making Quest
66277.description: Welcome adventurer to your first quest! Today we are going to kill dastardly bandits. Go kill them now!

66278.title: One Drakonid's Junk
66278.description: <A glistening pocket watch lays amongst the many piles of junk. Maybe Gryrmpech will know what to do with it.>
66278.completion: This was in the shed? It's not mine, but I think I remember who it belongs to.
66278.objectives: Bring the pocket watch to Gryrmpech in the Gardens.

66279.title: New Kid on the Clock
66279.description:
Oh yeah, this pocket watch belongs to one of the stewards that help me tend to the gardens. 

He's one of Nozdormu's. Orizmu, I think? I can't keep all these kids straight. Most days he stands next to that hourglass near Alexstraza's tree without moving. Or blinking.

Nozdormu's bunch have always been strange, if you ask me. But, he'll be grateful you brought this to him.
66279.progress: Walking all the way down to the sundial is too much effort for my old bones.
66279.completion: Thank you, {NAME}.  Nozdormu will be pleased to have this returned.
66279.objectives: Take the pocket watch to Orizmu in the Gardens.

66299.title: The Awaited Egg-splosion
66299.description:
Our prototype worked! Excellent!

Now it's time for the main course. This time, YOU are the chef.

With some necessary adjustments, you'll suit up in your disguise again. Then you'll take our masterpiece EGG-splosive, dunk it in this rancid stew here, head up to the matriarch's cave, plate it for her, and glide back down with the blasts detonating behind you!

If all things go as planned, she'll be toast. Because of the explosion. Which will burn her to toasty bits.
66299.progress: Careful with that chef's hat. It's bound to be a collector's item one day!
66299.completion:
Things didn't go exactly to plan, but no good Goblin scheme ever does! Nice work!

There will still be Screechflight here, but they'll be easier to cull without their Matriarch organizing their efforts. And the Bluefeathers will actually have a chance to survive.

Harpies and dragons aren't that different. Forgetting their attempted mass digestion of the cliffside, they're akin to a civilization of their own. Maybe there's a peaceful brood out there? 

Oh, and keep the disguise. Looks good on you.

66308.title: Feeding the Fire
66308.description:
The creation of new weapons and armor in the Earth-Warder's Forge will insure our eventual victory over the Djaradin.

The flames of the forge though must be constantly kept fueled. Cindershard Coal will provide the strongest heat, necessary to forge weapons.

You can find Cindershard Coal from deposits and Elementals within the Cindershard Seam.
66308.progress: Have you collected fresh Cindershard Coal?
66308.completion: This coal will do nicely, {NAME}. That should keep the forge going for a while longer.

66320.title: The Flow of Time
66320.description:
The threads of time flow like a river, with many bends and branches. Occasionally, those flows can be changed. However, any anomaly left unresolved may doom our destiny to a false timeline.

We are quickly approaching one of those anomalies. I have sent Chronormu to the Shifting Sands to investigate and correct any issues to the one true timeline.

I foresee that your assistance will be invaluable. 

Please lend us your aid and meet with Chronormu.
66320.objectives: Travel to the Shifting Sands and speak with Chromie.

66321.title: Bar Their Efforts
66321.description:
Djaradin forces are threatening an attack on our position. I can feel it down to my claws. 

We should strike first. Before they have a chance to mobilize!

Go to the Burning Ascent and wreak havoc on the djaradin forces there.
66321.progress: Have you weakened the djaradin forces?
66321.completion: They won't forget the destruction you wrought for a while. Nicely done.

66323.title: Idling Pie
66323.description:
Now that we have the wares back we can finish up here. But all my workers are lazin' about the city. 

Find where they're hidin' and 'encourage' 'em to head back here. A little leftover pie to the face, should have 'em runnin'.
66323.completion: Many thanks, everyone is back and workin' hard. <his eyes glance over to an extra pie>

66324.title: Never Forgotten
66324.description:
The antidote is ready. Use it to search the Support Creche for survivors. Work quickly--the effect will not last long, so you may have to reapply it.

If any of my people yet draw breath, save them.

And if they do not, I ask that you recover their horn signets so that their names may be honored.

While inside, perhaps you can find evidence of how this infestation came to be.
66324.progress: None shall die or suffer if it is within my power to prevent it.
66324.completion:
Thank you for rescuing those who could be saved.

Rethenash. Katrinasa. Tenezeth.

I vow that the names of the fallen will be remembered.
66324.objectives: Recover items and survivors from within the Support Creche.

66327.title: Chasing the Wind
66327.description:
We must take a moment to pause and consider our strategy. 

We need Ohn'ahra's blessing to sound the Horn of Drusahl and summon the green dragons. Without their aid, we cannot win this war. The Nokhud already outnumber the other clans, and their forces are bolstered by the Primalists. And now Koroleth has captured our Windmother! We must therefore find Ohn'ahra before the Nokhud can launch their final attack and encircle Maruukai.

I will send all of our scouts. I only hope we can find her in time.
66327.progress: We should depart as quickly as possible. You may ride Taivan and accompany us, or meet us at the Horn of Drusahl.
66327.completion:
We are too late. The Nokhud have overrun the Horn of Drusahl and slaughtered my people. 

This act of aggression will not go unanswered.

66328.title: Green Dragon Down
66328.description:
Those dragons went down over the plains to the west. We must get to them quickly before the Nokhud do.

We would not want them to think of all Maruuk as their enemies because of Balakar's actions.
66328.progress: The dragons need our help, outsider. We should hurry!
66328.completion:
Our ancestors said the green dragons were tempered and wise. We are fortunate they restrained their anger long enough to hear our side of the story.

Now that we know the Primalists and Nokhud are our common enemy, it is time to take them down.
66328.objectives: Meet the Khanam Matra at the watering hole.

66329.title: Blowing of the Horn
66329.description:
Why would they have brought Ohn'ahra here? Unless... 

{NAME}! I do not think Balakar intends to destroy the Horn. I think this is a trap! We must find a way past this wind, quickly!
66329.completion:
I will not rest until Balakar answers for the crimes he committed here today. The slaughter of my people, the blasphemy against Ohn'ahra, the treachery against our ancient ally....

Vengeance will have to wait. There are more pressing matters. We must help the green dragons.

66331.title: The Primalist Front
66331.description:
The Khanam Matra sent word that she and her forces have arrived in the Emerald Gardens. They've located Koroleth and her Primalists. It appears a massive enemy invasion is gathering on a beach to the north.

Wisely, she has several scouts watching strategic locations around the battlefield. Go and collect their reports, then meet me and my forces at the battlefront. Glory awaits us in battle, and, if we succeed, there will be vengeance.
66331.progress: Every moment we delay, our enemies advance. We must move quickly, {NAME}.
66331.completion: Our enemies are one step ahead of us. Do not despair. Our resolve is as strong as our alliance. Prepare yourself, {NAME}.
66331.objectives: Speak to Scout Tomul, Ari and Belika, Ohn Seshteng, and Merithra in the Storm Scar.

66333.title: Justice for Solethus
66333.description:
So long as a single green dragon draws breath, these Primalists will not defile the Ancient Bough without a fight.

We are eager to do our part in this battle, but as long as those dragonkiller ballistae are on the field, we cannot approach. The Nokhud's strongest warriors guard them, so you will need to take down the warriors as well.

Destroy the ballistae and Nokhud Warmongers. Eliminate this threat, and the green dragons will turn the tide of battle.
66333.progress: Make haste, mortal. I will not commit dragons to battle while those ballistae remain.
66333.completion: Good riddance to those awful weapons. May no other dragon suffer as Solethus did.
66333.objectives: Kill 3 Nokhud Warmongers and destroy 3 Dragon-Killer Ballistae.

66335.title: Deconstruct Additional Pylons
66335.description:
With those vile weapons destroyed, the green dragonflight can join the fray in force.

We are much more familiar with the situation on the ground. We need to light up some targets, so Merithra and her dragons can strike from above.

Merithra gave me these enchanted seeds. Place them near the Primalist pylons. We will use their light to call in attacks from airborne dragons.
66335.progress: I would appreciate if you did not stand so close to me with those enchanted seeds. Thank you.
66335.completion: I will remain forever grateful that the dragons were on our side during this battle.
66335.objectives: Mark the Primalist Pylons with Enchanted Seeds.

66336.title: The Isle of Emerald
66336.description:
Your part in this has not escaped me, mortal. It is in large part due to your bravery that we were able to defeat the Primalists.

I have invited the centaur to join me under the Ancient Bough. You, along with the Khanam Matra and her people, are welcome in our home.

Follow this path through the archway across the water and into the trees beyond. I will wait for you there.
66336.completion: Welcome to the Ancient Bough. You stand before the Emerald Oathstone of the green dragonflight.
66336.objectives: Meet Merithra in the Ancient Bough.

66337.title: Stormbreaker
66337.description:
{NAME}, to me! We are within reach of victory!
