The Primalist ranks are broken, and their war is all but through. Everything we have achieved hinges on this final battle against the Primalist leader, Koroleth.

Let us finish this, you and I! Together! To battle, <brother/sister>!
66337.completion: At last, it is done. Our sacred isle is safe once again. Thank you for all you have done for my kind, {NAME}.

66339.title: The Nokhud Offensive: The Wind Belongs to the Sky
66339.description:
Is this the end of your time with us, {NAME}, or will you aid us once again?

My scouts report that Balakar has withdrawn into his stronghold, where he is holding Ohn'ahra. This is unacceptable!

Meanwhile, his Nokhud raiders storm across the plains wreaking havoc. While we engage them in battle, you could infiltrate the Nokhud stronghold and rescue Ohn'ahra. Will you do this for us?
66339.completion: With this victory, you have helped the Maruuk more than you will ever know. Our most sincere thanks, {NAME}. Go with the blessings of Ohn'ahra.

66340.title: Into the Azure
66340.description:
We have done our part. Though I must remain here to watch over the Oathstone and guide the green dragonflight, know that you leave here with our gratitude and faith.

I have received word the Kirin Tor are seeking help in claiming the Azure Oathstone. Helping them with their Oathstone will bring us one step closer to healing Azeroth.

Find Pakina and Masud the Wise of the Kirin Tor. They will instruct you further. Safe journey and pleasant dreams, {NAME}.
66340.completion: Hail adventurer! I'm glad our call for help reached you.
66340.objectives: Meet Masud the Wise in the Forkriver Crossing.

66344.title: With the Wind at Our Backs
66344.description:
So the Primalists have recruited Clan Nokhud as allies. 

We have held off the Primalists until now, but the Nokhud have brought a new weapon: a dragonkiller ballista. I fear Solethus will not be the last dragon to fall to its foul storm magic.

Come. I will take you to the dragons' haven at Shady Sanctuary. You can tell me what you know of the Nokhud while the Khanam Matra gathers her forces. We must prepare for our next move.
66344.completion: We have arrived, mortal. Welcome to the Emerald Gardens.

66351.title: Smoke Over the Mountain
66351.description:
<Pathfinder Jeb looks at the mountain ridge beyond the camp and sniffs.>

I don't like it. Pathfinder Yips should've been here days ago. Was gonna help me teach this new batch of explorers how to climb these pillars safely.

Now I see smoke in the distance.

I don't like it at all.
66351.completion: Ye're just in time. Pathfinder Yip is starting to lose her grip up there!

66352.title: What the Enemy Knows
66352.description:
It is vital that we determine the Sundered Flame's mission in these ruins and how it relates to the arcane surge.

We'll do this the old fashioned way: reconnaissance and espionage.

The ruins are overrun with Sundered Flame devotees. I am sure some of them carry orders that may illuminate their mysterious goals.

Use any means necessary to obtain these documents.
66352.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. I am humbled by your skill and efficiency.

Maybe I'm not the only one who will be a "good influence" on Rannan.

Now... let us find out what the Sundered Flame is doing here.
66352.objectives: Find Sundered Flames documents and bring them to Lathos.

66353.title: R.A.D. Anomalies
66353.description:
There is a LOT of arcane energy here...

But! The R.A.D. can help with that! It's an awesome device--it's right in the name: "Rannan's Awesome Device!" It detects AND dispels arcane energy.

Here... hold it! Do you feel the POWER in your hands? No?

Well, now that you've got it, take it and dispel those anomalies!
66353.progress: Go! Go! That arcane energy is not going to dispel itself.
66353.completion:
Hm... You dispelled the anomalies, but the R.A.D. still detects an arcane surge... and it's rising by the minute.

That... can't be a good thing.
66353.objectives: Use the R.A.D. to dispel three arcane anomalies.

66354.title: The Spark
66354.description:
The forge is ready. All it needs now is flame.

Place the damaged Oathstone fragments upon the forge, and Wrathion shall provide the spark to ignite the process.
66354.completion:
The damaged pieces of the Oathstone are repaired! This is only the beginning of what can be accomplished here!

With the forge re-ignited I can begin the process of crafting new weapons and armor to aid our efforts.
66354.objectives: Reform the damaged parts of the Oathstone.

66363.title: Basilisk Bucklers
66363.description:
Interlinked scales are the key to stopping an arrow. The bucklers we make are the best in the plains. However, I am short of basilisk hides for my next order. 

I see you are interested in learning about our crafts. Gather basilisk hides from around the Dragon Isles, and I will give you instruction on our techniques.
66363.completion:
These are of excellent quality! You have my thanks.

For your help, please take some of the extra leather we have in our stores. I can also give you some insight about your trade, as I promised.
66363.objectives: Gather 20 Rigid Basilisk Hides from the basilisks of the Dragon Isles for Dhurrel of the Maruuk Centaurs.

66364.title: To Fly a Kite
66364.description:
Let me tell you about an opportunity.

The proto-drakes and proto-dragons have an amazing range of motion on their wings. And the ribbing! It is so extendable. We mostly make our kites from stretched hides. With the proto-drakes causing havoc, I was wondering if you could return some of their wings to me? I can make kites that would be the envy of the tribe.
66364.completion:
These will work masterfully. I will have a working kite fashioned in no time. 

Oh, and for all your help, let me give you some insight to your trade. It is the least I can do.

66369.title: The Earthen Ward
66369.description:
I have empowered a ward using the rings you collected. It has gathered the very stones of the earth around it and created a Living Earthen defender to protect this territory.

Test the Earthen Ward to ensure it's functional.
66369.completion: Thank you for your aid, {NAME}. I will place more of these wards throughout the area to combat the djaradin and the elementals. Use these charms to activate them when you need assistance.

66383.title: Legendary Assistance
66383.description: {NAME}, we have convinced the Enlightened Brokers to provide additional supplies for the battle against the Jailer!
66383.completion: Welcome. Please view my wares, several of which can assist you in the crafting of Legendaries!
66383.objectives: Visit Vilo, the Enlightened Quartermaster, to see what is available.

66390.title: Missing Merchandise
66390.description:
Hmmph, those sea-brained Seabraids are off on another adventure, and I'm stuck here sifting through their goods!

Ah, maybe I'm a bit bitter, but I do wish Tawny could be a bit more brief. I don't need a novel, just some instructions is all. And on top of it all some of the merchandise has disappeared, along with one of my workers! 

Would ye mind gettin' it back for me? I'm sure ye could tempt him with an exchange of a drink, or throw this at him if ye can't.
66390.completion: Ah! Ye got seawater on the merchandise! Ah well, I don't think the Seabraids will mind too much... long as it's intact.
66390.objectives: Retrieve the stolen goods from the thief at the Stormwind Harbor.

66391.title: To the Ruins!
66391.description:
Are you interested in hearing about my invention, the R.A.D.? No?

Well, I'll tell you anyway--because it found something.

Today it detected a HUGE SURGE of arcane energy from the Karnthar Ruins. Lathos thinks the Sundered Flame are to blame. It's the PERFECT opportunity to showcase the R.A.D.!

Wanna come? It's going to be awesome.
66391.completion:
You missed it! We walked RIGHT into a Sundered Flame patrol. 

Lathos SLASHED through them, but there were too many!

So, I started casting arcane explosions left and right... KAPOW! ZING!

Oh, but um, yes... the energy surge...
66391.objectives: Meet Rannan and Lathos in the Ruins of Karnthar.

66392.title: Rallying Nature's Allies
66392.description:
We cannot give into despair now. We must push forward. We must think of another way through the barrier.

First, we need our allies. Countless elementals summoned by Rymek are pouring through the portal. We will need an army that can move in the Dream like we can, or one that can be brought in easily.

Rally the druids and centaur in Shady Sanctuary. It is time to call upon their oaths to preserve the grove.
66392.progress: Are you ready to cross to Ardenweald?
66392.completion:
I will go with you into Ardenweald. I will tell Ysera that we need her back, and we know a way to do it. 

I should be the one who makes this sacrifice. I've lived a long life. I never wanted to live longer than my son. This way, I can atone for Rymek's betrayal and bring back our Aspect.

Are you with me?
66392.objectives: Muster the druids and gather the empowered anchors in Shady Sanctuary.

66393.title: To Somnikus
66393.description:
Somnikus has been melancholy and agitated since the death of his son.

Though we have all endured loss, I cannot imagine what I would feel were something like that to happen to Gerithus.

Go with Rymek to the isle, and see if there's anything we can do. Somnikus suspects that the Primalists are on the verge of another attack. I fear that he may do something rash.

Do not worry. Because of your help with the Emerald Oathstone, you can cross the barrier easily.
66393.completion:
Welcome to Ancient Bough, young one. 

Did Merithra send you to check on me? I am far too old for her to be worrying about me.
66393.objectives: Meet Somnikus with Rymek near the Oathstone in Ancient Bough.

66394.title: Thin the Veil
66394.description:
There must be a way to lower the barrier from within this grove. I sense several points around us that strengthen it.

If you can deactivate enough of those, we should be able to lower it the rest of the way so the others may join us.
66394.progress: Have you found the barrier moorings?
66394.completion:
That should do it. The barrier is about to come down. 

Soon the others will be able to join us in the Emerald Dream, and we can fight together again.
66394.objectives: Deactivate Barrier Moorings in Ancient Bough.

66395.title: The Chittering Rocks
66395.description:
Merithra needn't worry about me. I'm fine. My son's death... I'm fine.

If you really want to help put my mind at ease, there is something you could do. I suspect Primalists will try to invade these lands again. Unlike last time, I doubt they'll attack the Ancient Bough directly. They know we'd defeat them.

See those rocks over there? Those off-color, slightly smelly rocks? I hear something moving underneath them. Perhaps Primalists are lurking nearby! Could you investigate? Squash whatever you find.
66395.progress: I can hear them skittering around under the rocks. Who'd dare to summon creatures like that so close to the portal?
66395.completion:
I knew there had to be something there. And to think, they were so close to the portal. Now I can contemplate... other things.

While you were hunting, Rymek and I had a lovely conversation. He's quite understanding and sympathetic. In a way, he reminds me of Solethus...

He asked if he could see the portal to the Emerald Dream with his own eyes. I see no reason why not, especially since you've cleared those spiders away. I'm sure he'll be quite impressed.
66395.objectives: Investigate Suspicious Permafrost and slay Glacial Tunnelers.

66396.title: Guarded Appreciation
66396.description:
I know it can be quite exhausting work to defend such an important locale. And often, we drakonids and dragonspawn get very little thanks for our dedication.

I wish to bestow some of my own appreciation to the guards here in Ancient Bough.

Here, offer them these gifts from me, as a sign of friendship. I hope my heartfelt gesture properly expresses my gratitude.
66396.progress: Have you given the guards my gifts?
66396.completion: Very good. I hope they like those gemstones. I made them myself, just for this special occasion.

66397.title: Our Full Strength
66397.description:
We need reinforcements, and quickly. But Merithra cannot yet join us in the grove because of the barrier. We will need to manage both from here within the Dream.

Slay these Primalists and take anything you need from them, so we can melt those ice prisons and free the grove guards.
66397.progress: That was too cold. Close. Too close.
66397.completion:
Thank you for breaking me out! I can't believe that Ysera is actually here, back in the Emerald Dream! Just like in my theory. 

I'd dearly love to ask her ten thousand questions, but I have to focus. There's still the problem of Rymek.

And I saw where he was headed, too, just as he caught me in ice.

He's after something in the Dream, something powerful. I don't know what, but we have to reach him before he finds whatever it is!

66398.title: The Emerald Dragonflight
66398.description:
If we are to eradicate the Primalists from the Emerald Dream, the one place we must secure is Lunedane. According to my son, that is where Rymek has gone.

It is the last line of defense for the nascent Tree. There, an ancient artifact shields the Tree from being found. And, it is powerful enough to expel all our enemies at once.

I do not know if my mother has the power to command and use it anymore. But we will deal with that once we have found and stopped Rymek.

Fly with us, as one.
66398.completion: We've made it. But Rymek has already started his assault. We can't let him break through!
66398.objectives: Speak to Gerithus, and fly with Merithra and Ysera to Lunedane.

66399.title: We'll Cross that Bridge
66399.description:
We have to do something about this snow! If we're to give you proper support against Rymek and his minions, we can't have our wings freezing off.

I sense powerful Frost Cores nearby. They're probably sustaining this blizzard. If you can destroy them, we can take out Rymek's minions in short order.

And Somnikus is out there too. He flew off for Rymek like a dragon possessed. We need to get to him as soon as we can.
66399.completion:
<Somnikus's breathing is labored and pained. He shivers with cold.>

I held him off... as long as I could.
66399.objectives: Destroy the Frost Cores and reach Somnikus.

66400.title: Winter's Fall
66400.description:
<Somnikus struggles to breathe as he slowly freezes.>

I managed... to stop him from reaching the tree. I hope it was enough.

Rymek must fall, now. It is up to you.

Tell Ysera and Merithra that I am sorry... for being a foolish old dragon.
66400.completion:
Rymek is defeated, but there are still too many elementals and Primalists roaming through the Dream.

I suppose... now we find out who the Dreamer really is.

66401.title: The Dreamer
66401.description:
We have fought so hard to reach this point, and only one thing remains. The power in Lunedane will only respond to someone who can command the Emerald Dream from within.

I had thought that it could only be my mother, but... I see how she has changed. 

I do not know if that difference is better, but it is real and I must acknowledge that.

Come, let us face this moment together.
66401.objectives: Unleash the power of the Dream Locus.

66402.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
66402.description:
From the moment I stepped into the Dream again, I knew that things were different. But now that we have beaten Rymek and his Primalists, I must consider all of the implications of what has happened.

My daughter has worked to keep the green dragonflight together after my death. It is only fitting that she be the one to ascend now. 

Merithra must lead the Emerald Flight.
66402.progress: I am ready. I must be.
66402.completion:
Where my mother once flew, I must fly now and in the future. Where her breath brought peace and life, so must mine.

I pledge that I will do my best as the leader of the green dragonflight. I promise that I will do whatever it takes, as Ysera did for so many millennia.

66409.title: Pressing Matters
66409.description:
The chieftain is not taking visitors.

Whether Iskaara sent you or not, we're dealing with our own share of trouble right now. We don't need outsiders bringing more of it.

If you want our time, make yourself useful and help our guards. The djaradin have been attacking us from across the river. Flameshaper Lorak is behind the assault. He may not look like much as far as djaradin go, but he's got more brains than the rest of them.

Deal with him and bring back proof. Then we'll talk.
66409.progress: If that weapon's just for show, tell us now so we don't waste time.
66409.completion: I'll admit I didn't expect you to come back alive.
66409.objectives: Collect a trophy from Flameshaper Lorak at Scalecracker Keep.

66410.title: Worst Impressions
66410.description:
<Hakota turns the trophy over in his hand before clasping it. He grimaces.>

So this is what we've been reduced to. An outsider does more work for us in a day than our chieftain has in weeks.

Come. I will take you to him.

Maybe this will be the kick in the stern that he needs.
66410.progress: What do you seek to take from us?
66410.completion: <Tutaqan tosses the trophy on the ground nearby, tired and disinterested.>

66411.title: Troubled Waters
66411.description:
It saddens me to see our chieftain like this, but our needs cannot wait.

The river has provided for us for generations. But as the djaradin push forward, the waters recede, and the creatures fight with each other for space and resources. 

Without guards, our anglers cannot venture far to fish. Our food stores dwindle by the day.

You do not seem to need protection though. Take this net to help gather any fish you can from the river. Meat from the nearby crabs would also be welcome.
66411.progress: The river was once beautiful and its bounty plentiful. I pray that its gifts will return to us one day.
66411.completion: At least our children will not go hungry while our chieftain neglects his duties. Thank you, {NAME}.
66411.objectives: Gather 10 Warmwater Riverfish and 6 Succulent Snapper Meat.

66412.title: Carry On, Basilton
66412.description:
There is one more thing this old drakonid would like to ask you, before you leave.

Back when Lord Basilton and I first met, we would go on all sorts of adventures together. I think that's why he wanders off. He misses exploring.

I can't do that for him anymore. But you can! You can take him to see places I never would have dreamed of, I can tell.

However, we should ask Basilton what he thinks first.
66412.completion: I'm jealous of him, if I'm being honest. To be young again, and exploring the world. You'll have to visit, sometime, so you can tell me what he's been up to.
66412.objectives: Speak with Basilton in the Gardens.

66413.title: Encroaching Heat
66413.description:
<This fish has clearly been dead for some time.

Upon closer inspection, you notice that it appears to have been boiled--probably while still alive in the river.

Unujaak back at the village might be interested in this.>
66413.completion:
Oacha'noa preserve us! How my heart aches to see the river disturbed in this way. 

This must be yet another of the djaradin's atrocities. Their fiery magic has been heating the river beyond anything these poor creatures can endure.

But it would be disrespectful to allow this one to go to waste. Go on, throw it in the pot. We will use it for tonight's meal.
66413.objectives: Take the Half-Boiled Fish to Elder Unujaak.

66414.title: All But One
66414.description:
I have seen what you've done for the village. In easier times, I would have handled it, but...

<Tutaqan glances towards the river, then back to you.>

Some of our ottuks went missing recently. We believe they swam too close to the djaradin's territory. Several were recovered. None of them alive. Few in one piece.

We could not find my ottuk, Ipko. She has been my hunting partner for many years. If she...

<He shakes his head.>

Please... aid me. If you search the river, I will search the shore.
66414.progress: I shouldn't have let her wander so far...

66415.title: The Only Way Past Is Through
66415.description:
Unujaak told you to come, didn't he? He was the one who helped me find Ipko when I became a hunter--or, rather, helped Ipko find me. They choose and we are chosen.

He is hurting. Everyone is hurting because of me. I know that they need me to lead, but I have been half of a leader without her. If I couldn't protect her, how can I protect all of Uktulut?

<He takes a deep breath.>

I cannot forgive myself. But I cannot let that weight keep me from putting at least one foot on the path I must walk.
66415.progress: I knew this would happen one day, though it does not blunt the pain.
66415.completion: Nothing will replace Ipko. But water can only fill hands cupped to receive it.
66415.objectives: Help Tutaqan find a new ottuk companion.

66417.title: Salvaging Supplies
66417.description:
Bah! I can't believe Tutaqan's still moping around when we need him to command his guards and hunters!

We used to trade with the Iskaara at our pier, but that's gone belly up with the djaradin closing in and scaring off our traders. Half of last month's supplies and most of our boats are still lost out in the shallow river.

The guards and hunters want to help, but they've got no weapons. You look like you can protect yourself, so get out there and grab something I can make spears with!
66417.progress: Once our guards and hunters have new weapons, I can pull together a group to gather the rest of the wreckage.
66417.completion: It's about time! They're a little wet, but I'll be able to make many fine weapons with these.
66417.objectives: Collect 8 Whalebone Fragments and 30 Waterlogged Wood.

66418.title: Testing the Tuskarrsenal
66418.description:
The first weapon is ready! Soaking the bones in river water warmed by the djaradin's fire made them more pliable. I'll remember that trick!

Since you've been helpful so far, I'll do you the honor of letting you test out some authentic Uktulut weaponry. You'll find no sharper blade or sturdier haft this side of the Dragon Isles.

Go test this out in our training area for me. Maybe it'll remind the chieftain what real fighting looks like! Ha!
66418.progress: Our training area is just up the hill. Make sure those weapons are ready to crush some djaradin.
66418.completion:
Haha! I heard that commotion all the way over here! 

If that talk doesn't get Tutaqan moving again, I don't know what will.

At least our hunters will have all the weapons they need to defend our village, with or without their huntmaster's help. Thanks, {NAME}.
66418.objectives: Take the Uktulut Bone Spear and destroy 4 Tuskarr Training Dummies.

66420.title: Happy Hour
66420.description:
Now that the merchandise is back, it's time ta get everything else sorted out.

With everything going on some of my crew decided it would be okay to disappear for some extended meal times.  See if ye can find them and get them back here. 

We can all celebrate AFTER the work is done.
66420.completion: Great job! Now that we're all back ta work we'll make good time.
66420.objectives: Throw briny seawater at 3 workers in Stormwind.

66422.title: The Expedition Continues!
66422.description:
An ancient site, an organization with inscrutable motivations--even Rannan's R.A.D and its analyses... 

It all stirs the explorer in me.

We must discover more about what's going on here.

There are stairs to the south leading up to a tower. We shall press on.
66422.completion:
These Sundered Flame did not die by my hand... or by Rannan's "signature move." 

They were dead when we arrived. 

Rannan believes they suffered multiple traumatic wounds caused by arcane energy.

I agree with his observations. But it's unclear if it was the dragon console discharging or friendly fire...
66422.objectives: Meet Rannan and Lathos by the tower.

66423.title: Worries and Validations
66423.description:
The deaths of these Sundered Flame underscore how dangerous the Ruins of Karnthar are.

But Rannan believes that with some tinkering the R.A.D. can still quell the energies here.

Again, we're treating the symptoms and not the root cause.

Search the ruins for clues and see if you can discern their original function. And make haste, {NAME}. We may not have much time.
66423.progress: Were you able to learn anything about the ruins?
66423.completion:
This is... not good news.

If Sindragosa could not control Karnthar and ordered this station abandoned, I can only imagine the nefarious things that the Sundered Flame could do with it.

We must not let it fall into their hands.
66423.objectives: Find clues about the origin of the ruins.

66425.title: Arcane Overload
66425.description:
There! Finished!

May I present to you... the R.A.D.D.E.R!

DUN DUN DUUUUN! 

I have calibrated it to the frequency of the energy surrounding the dragon consoles and inscribed a glyph of dispel magic on it.

The R.A.D.D.E.R. will dispel the arcane energy and shut down the dragon console, but the glyph will weaken after each use.

Pretty handy, isn't it?

I detect four of these consoles in our vicinity. Go shut them down!
66425.progress: Were you able to dispel all the arcane bubbles with the R.A.D.D.E.R.?
66425.completion:
You've done it {NAME}!

Well, you and the R.A.D.D.E.R...

But whatever... Now, help me get Lathos back to Camp Nowhere.
66425.objectives: Help Rannan dispel the arcane bubbles.

66426.title: Running Out of Time
66426.description:
I can feel the arcane surge growing as we speak. 

I suspect there is not much time before the ruins make Rannan's J.A.M. look like a distant star in the night sky. 

We have to get there and stop it.

Please be careful, $p. 

Meet us by the east tower. We will assess the situation there.
66426.completion:
This is worse than we thought. The arcane energy is almost at its peak.

Something is hastening the process.

66427.title: A Looming Menace
66427.description:
The arcane wounds I suffered cannot be healed in the field. I am afraid that they are too grave for me to fight. 

I must ask your help again, {NAME}.

You have to find Tharohn and stop her from overloading more consoles. 

Doing so would buy Rannan a few precious moments to calibrate the R.A.D. ... R.A.D.D.E.R... whatever he's calling it now. 

Maybe then we can thwart the Sundered Flame's machinations.
66427.progress: Do not waste a moment. We are on borrowed time.
66427.completion:
It is done then.

Now it is all on Rannan. I trust his abilities. They have gotten us this far...

66428.title: Friendship For Granted
66428.description:
Alright! The R.A.D.D.E.R.E.R is calibrated and ready to go--for you!

Why am I not using it? Simple! 

You have to think of and consider all the possibilities. 

Let's say it blows up. Who would fix it if I am injured, unconscious, or dead? Could you imagine? 

Now, go dispel the barrier so we can return to camp and get Lathos patched up. I'll be... standing back.
66428.progress: Is this day going to get any better?
66428.completion:
Just like that he's... gone?

He gave his life to save us because the R.A.... the machine didn't work.

Lathos believed in me... I should have listened... I let him down...
66428.objectives: Use the R.A.D.D.E.R.E.R to dispel the arcane barrier.

66429.title: I Will Remember
66429.description:
I... I need a few moments, please. 

Go back to Camp Nowhere, $p. I will meet you there.
66429.completion:
It was only at the very end that I began to appreciate Lathos. I took his patience and experience for granted.

We owe him our lives.

<Rannan looks towards the Ruins of Karnthar.>

I will never forget him.
66429.objectives: Meet Rannan outside of Camp Nowhere.

66431.title: In Mourning
66431.description:
This did not need to happen. Those cowardly djaradin... slaughtering our ottuks and leaving them for their twisted beasts to pick clean...

I do not take Tutaqan's grief lightly, but I worry for the future of our people if he dwells in darkness and grief for too long. 

We need to act.

It looks like he was headed to the overlook above us. You have done him a great favor this day. He may be open to any good will you can show him. Please, see what can be done.
66431.completion: <Tutaqan rubs his face with both hands, sighing deeply. He looks haggard.>

66435.title: Site Salvage
66435.description:
I've worked with many elementals as a shaman, but I've never seen any this aggressive!

The Expedition discovered a titan vault here, but a barrier protects the inner chamber. When we tried to dispel the barrier, I think we triggered some kind of security system... There were suddenly angry elementals everywhere!

Many explorers were working in the dig site when the elementals attacked. Many of them are trapped, and NONE of them are fighters. 

Please go down into the dig site and help them retreat!
66435.progress: I am only a consultant for the Expedition, but I care for the explorers I've met here. We can't leave any of them behind!
66435.completion: Everyone's safely within our new perimeter. Thank you, {NAME}.
66435.objectives: Rescue 5 Beleaguered Explorers in Life Vault Ruins.

66436.title: Unearthed Troublemakers
66436.description:
The earth elementals are not just trying to repel us, they're destroying artifacts and equipment, too! It's as though they've been programmed to destroy anything titan...

We're holding them off, but we can't continue to study this site while they're here. Please help us push them back so we can have some exploring room!
66436.progress: The elementals caught us by surprise! Be careful!
66436.completion: That should be enough to solidify our position here. Good work, {NAME}.
66436.objectives: Kill 12 Earth Elementals in the Life Vault Ruins.

66437.title: A Key Element
66437.description:
<This orb of earth thrums with energy.>

<Elementalist Taiyang might know what to do with it.>
66437.completion: I can feel the elemental energy stored within this orb. You may have found a solution to our troubles here.
66437.objectives: Return the Orb of Primal Stone to Elementalist Taiyang in the Life Vault Ruins.

66438.title: Lofty Goals
66438.description:
Air is a powerful element. It cuts through stone and fills sails to take us where we need to go.

My hypothesis is that air will be the most effective at removing this barrier. It's simple, really.

My scouts report they've found the Orb of Primal Gales. Scout Ri'tal can lead you to it. You can find them near Hornswog Hollow. Quickly!
66438.completion: Tae'shara stays above many tasks, preferring to delegate. I can see why the Orb of Primal Gales interests her. I'll hold onto it for now.
66438.objectives: Find Scout Ri'tal in Hornswog Hollow.

66439.title: Rapid Fire Plans
66439.description:
Elemental orbs, eh? If there's earth, there's bound to be fire!

The primalists over near tae hornswog nests are reshapin' tae land with lava. If anyone has an interest in tae Orb o' Primal Flames, it'd be them!

Take them out and see if they have anythin' useful!
66439.progress: Acadia had a lead on the Orb of Primal Flames. Have you found it?
66439.completion: Ah, the Orb of Primal Flames. It is as vibrant and fiery as Acadia. I will hold onto it for now.
66439.objectives: Collect Primal Flame Fragments from Primalist Forces in Hornswog Hollow.

66440.title: Closure
66440.description:
I do not know what to say. I had no idea that the chieftain's pain ran so deep.

It makes sense. Ottuks are not pets to our people--especially not to hunters like our chieftain. They are our friends, our companions... and members of our families.

Ipko was Tutaqan's first and only ottuk. Uktulut hunters hold this bond to be sacred.

I will see that her passage to the place of our ancestors is a peaceful one.
66440.progress: This is all I can do.
66440.completion: <Tutaqan's jaw is set tightly, tears brimming in the corners of his eyes. He does not look at you.>

66441.title: Distilled Effort
66441.description:
The Orb of Primal Stone is a fortuitous find, but Acadia and Tae'shara have conflicting hypotheses regarding the barrier.

I have my own hypothesis. Perhaps with more elemental orbs an answer will become clear.

One of the explorers saw an oversized water elemental in a nearby cave. Defeat the elemental, and perhaps you will find another orb.
66441.progress: Did the elemental have another orb?
66441.completion: We must be like water: ready to adapt. Thank you for bringing the Orb of Primal Waves to me.
66441.objectives: Kill Acequian in the cave east of the Life Vault Ruins.

66442.title: Let's Get Theoretical
66442.description: We now have four elemental orbs! Let us see which hypothesis proves fruitful.
66442.completion: My original hypothesis stands firm. The elements are more effective together.
66442.objectives: Help test the orbs against the Titan Barrier in Life Vault Ruins.

66443.title: Calling the Hunting Party
66443.description:
<The resounding call of a hunting horn rumbles from the center of the village, calling the Uktulut hunters to attention.

You should investigate.>
66443.progress: This could be our only chance to hit them where it hurts!
66443.completion: If the chieftain doesn't take care of the job, I'll smash that djaradin to pieces myself. Mark my words.
66443.objectives: Investigate the reason for the hunting call.

66444.title: While the Iron Is Hot
66444.description:
I spoke to our lookouts on the way down. They say this djaradin--Zhurtan the Riverboiler--has begun his heinous ritual southwest of here, close to the waterfalls where many of our ottuks build their nests.

If they're boiling the river upstream from us now, I assume they've decided to be done with us more quickly. We would be forced to starve or retreat. We will do neither.

They've prodded us like cowards afraid of a true fight. So let's bring the fight to them this time, shall we?
66444.progress: We have your back, as you have ours.
66444.completion:
Our river--and our people--could not have been saved without your help. 

The Uktulut tribe owes you a great debt.

66445.title: Honor Our Fallen
66445.description:
The djaradin have no regard for the sanctity of the Citadel or the bodies of our kin! They break the bones of the dead and take their personal keepsakes as souvenirs.

This disrespect cuts at the heart of every proud black dragon. They deserve honor. 

Recover these items that the djaradin have stripped from the bodies of our fallen.
66445.progress: Have you recovered the items of the fallen?
66445.completion:
The memory of those who fell will not be lost. No thanks to the djaradin.

These items will be kept safe and we will remember the dead.
66445.objectives: Recover 8 Fallen Defenders Ring, 3 Earth-Warder's Flame Blade and 1 Horn of Scorxia.

66447.title: Beyond the Barrier
66447.description: Now that the barrier is down, let us explore the vault!
66447.progress: There's a lot to examine in the vault, but we should start small to be safe first!
66447.completion:
I think we'll be alright now, {NAME}. Thank you. It's time for the Expedition to dig deeper!



Just a little shaman humor. Too soon?
66447.objectives: Investigate the Life Vault in the Life Vault Ruins.

66448.title: The Wayward Waywatcher
66448.description:
The Waywatchers have kept the roads of Thaldraszus safe for travelers for as long as I can remember. It is a duty that my family has upheld with honor for generations.

Alas, my sister Alvi seems less than interested in that honor of late. She is supposed to report to me here each morning, but I have not heard from her in over a day. 

If you find a bronze drakonid east of here, lazing about with her head in the clouds, I ask that you direct her to me. Otherwise, I will have to seek her out myself.
66448.completion: Oh, gracious, a traveler. Please forgive me, I am a bit of a mess at the moment.

66456.title: A Poisonous Palette
66456.description:
I may not be great at my job, but at least I paid attention when I was learning how to do it. Every Waywatcher worth her scales knows how to make a proper antidote. I just need enough poison to mix it properly.

Nori said the tarasek who attacked her had spears coated with the stuff. Find them and bring their spears to me. If my hunch is correct, I'll be able to make an antidote with the residue from the spearheads.

I just hope we have enough time.
66456.progress: Please hurry, {NAME}. I am keeping Nori stable for now, but the poison is still spreading.
66456.completion:
<Alvi takes the spears that you gathered. She carefully scrapes her dagger across one of the blades, removing a film of sticky, sickly sap.>

It's just as I thought. Thank you, {NAME}. This should be enough for an antidote, and I even think I know where the poison is coming from.

66457.title: Ending the Blue Period
66457.description:
The Embertooth all follow an oversized brute that I've taken to calling Bluescale. He has always been the aggressive sort, but until now he's always kept his pack of scavengers away from the main roads. Sure, they were territorial, but hostile? Not until now.

Bluescale has to be responsible for this sudden escalation. Find him and take him down.
66457.progress: Be careful, {class}. Bluescale is tougher than your average Tarasek scavenger.
66457.completion:
With Bluescale taken care of, I doubt we will have to deal with any organized tarasek encroachment any time soon.

Now all that's left is to deal with the poison.

66458.title: Legacy of Tyr: Secrets of the Past
66458.description:
To stop Raszageth from freeing the other Incarnates, the power of the Aspects must be restored.

Inconveniently, the Titans are rather preoccupied and Keeper Tyr is long dead.

Queen Alexstrasza has suggested a plan. In the depths of the Badlands lies a Titan facility called Uldaman. Apparently allies of Tyr may have hidden a disc of his memories there.
 
Word is that the place has been overrun by troggs. Gather your allies, head to Uldaman, and seize the disc in the name of the Dragon Queen!
66458.completion:
Infinite dragons? Their kind always has some kind of plan.

I will inform the Dragon Queen that she will have to find some other way to restore the power of the Aspects.
66458.objectives: Enter Uldaman: Legacy of Tyr in the Badlands and recover the disc.

66459.title: The Field of Ferocity: Terror of the Swamp!
66459.description:
Welcome one and all to the Fields of Ferocity!
 
While this sparring field is used for traditional events, the centaurs have graciously allowed me to set up shop off-season. They say it tests their strength and brings them honor.
 
You want to take home the title of champion? Well then, let me know when you're ready and you can take on the introductory competition.
66459.progress: Speak with Gurgthock to start the round, then defeat the first competitor of the Field of Ferocity.
66459.completion: You've done well, for the first ladder. But we're just warming up. Speak with Gurgthock again when you're ready to move on to the second round.

66460.title: The Field of Ferocity: Lord of Decay!
66460.description:
I tried to get one of those nasty gnolls for this gauntlet. Unfortunately, none of my associates know how to speak with them.
 
We did manage to catch one of their freaky creations though. That should serve as a good opponent! Let me know when you want to start the second round!
66460.progress: Well, what are you waiting for?  Speak with Gurgthock to start the round, then defeat the second competitor of the Field of Ferocity.
66460.completion: I'm glad you dealt with that as quickly as you did. The stench was starting to reach the podium here.

66461.title: The Field of Ferocity: Foe from the Volcano!
66461.description:
One of the first volunteers for this competition hails from the Waking Shores. A big djaradin fellow, not quite as angry as his kin.
 
He just seems to enjoy the sport of fighting. Hey, that works for me.
66461.progress: Ceega has a famous entrance. You need to speak with Gurgthock to start the round, then defeat the third competitor of the Field of Ferocity.
66461.completion: What a show! I could feel sparks flying from here!

66462.title: The Field of Ferocity: Lost in the Dream!
66462.description:
You know, for it being the Dragon Isles, I haven't seen too many dragons. We did get a duo of dragonkin that requested to be signed up for this competition together though.
 
They seem plenty eager to prove themselves though, so good luck!
66462.progress: You need to speak with Gurgthock to start the round, then defeat the fourth competitors of the Field of Ferocity.
66462.completion:
... Wuzzat? Is the fight over? I think I fell asleep in the middle of it for some reason.

I'm guessing you won if you're standing in front of me?

66463.title: The Field of Ferocity: Elemental Revenge Round!
66463.description:
We're changing the roster at the last minute. Some Primalist bigwig wants to join in on the competition to face you. And I'm not saying no to an angry elemental dragon.
 
I'm sure you'll be fine. If not, then... well, you signed the waiver, right?
66463.progress: You need to speak with Gurgthock to start the round, then defeat the fifth competitor of the Field of Ferocity.
66463.completion: I now understand the rumors I have heard about you and your crew. You have gotten further than I would have ever expected.

66464.title: The Field of Ferocity: Master of the Hunt!
66464.description:
This is it. You and your pals have hit the big time. A match against the champ, Huntmaster Amaa herself. Don't pat yourself on the back just yet. She's ruthless. It was nice knowing you.
 
After she kills you, can I have your stuff?
66464.progress: You need to speak with Gurgthock to start the round, then defeat the final competitor of the Field of Ferocity. Good luck.
66464.completion: You are quite the impressive and fearsome combatant. The centaurs are in awe of you. Gurgthock is fuming for not betting his farm on you instead of Amaa. You win the grand prize.

66465.title: Cache and Release
66465.description:
Even with their leader gone, the Tarasek are unlikely to stop using their poison-tipped spears simply because we ask them nicely. I cannot risk even one of these weapons being used on an unsuspecting traveler.

They will all need to be destroyed. If you did not see any in the caches by the pools, then the Embertooth are likely keeping their spears closer to the source. 

No one else will get hurt because of my carelessness. Enter the cave and destroy any weapon caches that you find.
66465.completion:
The Passage will be a far safer place without those poisoned spears to worry about.

You have kept a lot of people safe with your deeds this day, {NAME}. The Waywatchers - and I - owe you a great debt.

66467.title: Art Imitates Life
66467.description:
The last time I was in this cave, I sketched a massive flower that dripped a vile, viscous sap. It's one of my best drawings, I couldn't forget it if I tried.

That sap is what's stuck to these tarasek spears, I'm sure of it. They must have started harvesting it to envenom their weapons.

The plant is beautiful; it will be a shame to kill it. Still, we can't let the tarasek keep harvesting it. {NAME}, please cull the plant and put a stop to this whole mess.
66467.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. The Embertooth's venom harvesting days should be behind them now that they have been deprived of their source.

I realize now that I don't have to be a Waywatcher to make a difference in the world. I am going to resign my post and commit myself to my art. Hopefully some day I will be able to depict the most beautiful vistas in the Dragon Isles, for all the world to see.

I just hope my sister understands.

66468.title: What Once Was Ours
66468.description:
<Thadezus scoffs at your approach.>

Are you a mortal of action, or are you going to get out of our way, {class}?

I have lost many good soldiers to those Primalists up ahead.

We have an idea of what they are planning, but we must first rout the enemy and rescue those serving under me.
66468.progress: Have you stopped the Primalists, or do I need to do this myself?
66468.completion:
<Sharnax stares down at you.>

Hmm... It appears you are someone with more skill than the commander had originally assumed.

There is more to be done before the day is over.
66468.objectives: Defeat the Primalists occupying the Gelikyr Overlook.

66470.title: The Forward Push
66470.description:
<Sharnax scratches her chin.>

The commander was right. The Primalists are calling reinforcements from the elemental planes.

<Sharnax smirks.>

It would be a shame if something happened to their gateways, {class}.
66470.progress: We need to close those gateways.
66470.completion: Looks like you made it in one piece.
66470.objectives: Obtain Misttouched, Earthen, and Iceforged gateway stones, and close the 3 elemental gateways.

66471.title: Prime Planning
66471.description:
The commander ordered me to establish a forward base and dispatch any resistance. It wasn't until I did all the dispatching that I realized something.

<Sharnax lets out a long sigh.>

The Primalists were talking about Tyrhold.

Unless you are exceptionally skilled at interrogation, I need you to discover their plans.
66471.progress: Do you have something we can show the commander?
66471.completion: This is just what we needed.
66471.objectives: Collect 7 Primalist Orders from the nearby Primalists in the upper terrace of Gelikyr Overlook.

66472.title: Primal List
66472.description:
The gateways closed, the elementals slain, and the Primalists stopped... for now.

<Sharnax laughs.>

Is there anything we cannot do, {class}? I guess only time will tell.

Take the plans back to the commander. I am certain he will be glad to see we have been successful.
66472.progress:
<Thadezus stares at you.>

What do you want, {class}?
66472.completion:
<Thadezus pauses for an uncomfortable amount of time.>

Allis and I had bets on if you would be successful, {class}

 I am glad that you were.
66472.objectives: Deliver the Bundle of Primalist Orders to Commander Thadezus on the bridge at the Gelikyr Overlook.

66473.title: The Land Awakens
66473.description:
The fiends in this cave were too much for me.

<Sharnax lets out a labored cough.>

I have seen what you can do.

I need you to slay these elementals before they reach their full potential. We cannot allow the Primalists to take control of Tyrhold!
66473.completion: Thank you for everything you have done for us, {class}.
66473.objectives: Defeat the Primordial Wrath and Primordial Hail in the Gelikyr Overlook.

66488.title: WANTED: Frigellus
66488.description:
<The page's script glows with a soft blue light.>

Previously a cherished plaything of Malygos, the elemental Frigellus suffered from his master's neglect. 

While this once-happy settlement crumbled apace, the churlish and playful creature grew warped and twisted by the evils that plague this land.

Please see that it is safely neutralized.

Bring word of your success to Custodian Cynegos.
66488.progress: Return to Custodian Cynegos in Camp Antonidas.
66488.completion: Let us hope there aren't any more surprises trapped in that glacier.

66489.title: Setting the Defense
66489.description:
Custodian Cynegos and I were just discussing the impact the Primalist attack has had on the plans to assault the Cobalt Assembly, and I had an idea. 

<Celeste withdraws a wand from the folds of her robes.>

Take my wand and empower their weapons!

A little bit of fire should do the trick...
66489.completion:
Fantastic job! 

After repelling their attack on the camp, it's imperative that we keep the Primalists on the back foot. 

Now please give me my wand back.
66489.objectives: Empower Azure Defenders in Camp Antonidas.

66493.title: Send It!
66493.description:
<You hear muffled muttering coming from the other end of the portal.>

Hey! Hey you! 

I have some mail for our apprentices in the field: care packages, gifts, things they've ordered via magical courier... 

Standard fare, really.

Mind doing me a favor and handing them out?
66493.progress:
How's your arm? 

Don't forget to stretch, or you might hurt yourself.
66493.completion: Well done! Don't worry... it's the courier's fault if a parcel wasn't marked "fragile."
66493.objectives: Throw packages to Kirin Tor Apprentices in Camp Antonidas.

66500.title: Ways of Seeing
66500.description:
We're not doing anything! We're not doing anything!

Hang on a minute...

You look like a pretty important {race}... Want in on a secret?

Turns out there's magical art in these ruins. And we can see it!

<Scrumpy proudly sticks out his chest.>

I can show you how to see 'em too! Just... don't tell Noriko yet.
66500.progress: Noriko told us to stay out of trouble. Not sure how to do that to be honest.
66500.completion:
Malygos and Sindragosa, huh? Never heard of 'em. Sounds like they were pretty in love though.

I wonder who put these here?
66500.objectives: Uncover ancient images in Camp Antonidas.

66503.title: For The Love of Others
66503.description:
Ah, I see my apprentices have roped you into their little games. 

<Noriko chuckles.>

It appears they--and you--have stumbled onto something. The purpose behind these ruins is slowly revealing itself to us, and there's more than faded images and song...

Something calls out from atop this tower.

I see the intrigue in your eyes. Go. You have my permission. 

See what you can see.
66503.progress: Remembrance is a gift--and a burden.
66503.completion:
To watch your world crumble into ruin and think it lost forever...

I cannot imagine.

We must remember.
66503.objectives: Investigate the top of the Ruined Tower in Camp Antonidas.

66504.title: A Shard of Crystalized Mana
66504.description:
<The small blue crystal vibrates lightly when touched, then produces a low tune that sounds like a distant song. You can hear the words echoing like a soft melody in your head.>

Lathos may find it interesting.

66509.title: Paranoid 1
66509.description: Agura sent me out here to pick FLOWERS for my ANXIETY but there are CREATURES and I'm terrified.

66513.title: Ground Leave
66513.description:
Perhaps we should get an idea of this city, if it is to be our new home. A scouting mission, if you will.

Go, see what this place has to offer. I will follow Wrathion and attempt to help in any way I can.

Try not to upset the locals any more than you must, though. I doubt many of them are used to seeing dragons walk among them.

Meet up with us once you've gotten the lay of the land.

66516.title: Mundane Gems, I Think Not!
66516.description:
It's such a waste. The djaradin of this land use powerful gems as mundane decorations. Mere jewelry! Gems have so many uses: telescopes, mirrors, focusing pointers, not to mention the myriad magical properties they possess.

We must rectify this situation, explorer. Relieve the djaradin of their gems, and bring them back to me. I'll make sure they're put to better use! Be careful though--the djaradin are fierce warriors.
66516.progress: Were you able to get the gems?
66516.completion:
There's so much potential in these gems, even Lugrah wouldn't know what to do with them all!

Lugrah is the jewelcrafting representative to the Artisan Consortium. Let me share some of the notes she sent me before I left. They're sure to help you with your jewelcrafting studies here in the Dragon Isles.
66516.objectives: Gather 25 'Mundane' Gems from the djaradin of the Dragon Isles for Gnoklin Quirkcoil of the Dragonscale Expedition.

66517.title: A New Source of Weapons
66517.description:
These Sundered Flame pose a great threat to our borders. Their weapons are concerning. Gather what you can of their weapons--we can study them for any weaknesses, and even use them for our own defenses.

I have faith in you, outsider. If you perform this task for us, I will teach you some of our own blacksmithing arts.
66517.progress: What were you able to secure?
66517.completion:
Thank you, outsider. This should help greatly.

As promised, here is a scroll I had our blacksmiths prepare for you. May the knowledge grant you swift learning.
66517.objectives: Gather 25 Intact Dracthyr Weapons from the Sundered Flame of the Dragon Isles for Dhurrel of the Maruuk Centaurs.

66523.title: Tending the Forge
66523.description:
If you're looking for an instructor, I'm sorry to say I... Ah, you're not an apprentice! My apologies. Allow me to introduce myself. 

I am Custodian Vernagos, one of the caretakers of these ruins. More specifically, the task of restoring this workspace to its former glory has fallen upon my very tired shoulders. 

Would you be able to lend a hand? All the reagents I need are nearby: ice elemental cores, embercones, hornswog leather...

Fairly standard, easily gathered stuff. What say you?
66523.progress: Fresh air and magical relics. What more could one ask for? Ha!
66523.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. The embercones will burn hot. The elemental cores will temper the heat. And this leather... is fairly disgusting. But the bellows they produce will more than suffice!

Now all I need is time.
66523.objectives: Gather reagents for the forge by collecting hornswog hides, dormant embercones, and calving cores around Camp Antonidas.

66524.title: Amateur Protography
66524.description:
So, you want to be a seasoned cataloger like me? You've come to the right place! 

The Wild Preserve is teeming with knowledge waiting to be found and filed! And how do I do that you ask? Why, with my handy Catalog-izer 3000 Dragon Isles edition--now with improved motion capture!

To gain experience, photograph a proto-dragon egg, a whelp learning to fly, and a hunting proto-drake. Meet me at the ancient, proto-dragon skeleton west of here, and I'll assess your photos.
66524.completion: These are wonderful! Just wonderful! Say, have you done this before?

66525.title: Competitive Protography
66525.description:
Well, now that you've cut your teeth on some starter shots, how about we move onto something a little spicier?

I spotted a gorgeous proto-drake flying around the area behind us. Beautiful horns, scales crackling with electricity... Probably the work of the Primalists, no doubt, but art is art!

See if you can get a picture of the proto-drake and some of its eggs. You might have to climb up a bit to get a good shot!
66525.progress: If you get in a fight with the Primalists, make sure you keep that camera pristine! It's my only prototype!
66525.completion: Oh, look at that! The colors came through beautifully. Looks like you're a pretty good cataloger already!
66525.objectives: Photograph an Infused Proto-Dragon Egg and an Infused Proto-Drake.

66526.title: Preserving the Wilds
66526.description:
The Wild Preserve is one of the few areas where proto-dragons thrive. But the Primalists are disrupting their nesting grounds by sending sorties to capture and experiment on proto-whelps and proto-drakes.

Show them no mercy. Locate these Primalist poachers, wipe them out, and free their captives. The proto-dragon species depends on it.
66526.progress: If we want these creatures to survive, we must protect them.
66526.completion: Good. The Primalists remain a threat, but these dragons enjoy their freedom once again.
66526.objectives: Free 5 Captured Proto-Whelps or Captured Proto-Drakes.

66527.title: Professional Protography
66527.description:
I haven't trained a photographer as good as you... that's still alive, that is. It's a dangerous profession.

Speaking of dangerous, our final target is a large proto-dragon we believe may be one of the next apex predators in this preserve. Let's get up close and personal and take a picture!
66527.progress: Don't worry, {NAME}. You're much more competent than the last person I sent up there.
66527.completion:
So totally unrelated, but you didn't see another camera up there, did you?

You know what? Forget I said anything.
66527.objectives: Use the Vertical Enhancement Apparatus and photograph the Slumbering Proto-Dragon.

66528.title: King Without a Crown
66528.description:
This ancient proto-dragon must have been a glorious creature when it was alive--perhaps the largest the Wild Preserve has ever seen.

But it wasn't enough. Observe the skeleton more closely, so we may learn the story of its final moments.
66528.progress: An incredible specimen--and a reminder of our origins.
66528.completion:
So, a fight to the death with something just as strong? I wonder if it was protecting the preserve from invaders?

Thank you, {NAME}. It's good to remember the sacrifices of those that have come before us.

66529.title: A Thousand Words
66529.description:
With all that we've learned here, I can't imagine moving on without a memento. 

Would you be kind enough to take my picture next to the proto-dragon fossils?
66529.progress: It should only take a moment.
66529.completion:
Someday, I hope to fight for my people with the same bravery as this proto-dragon in its final moments.

Thanks again, {NAME}.
66529.objectives: Photograph Dervishian near the Proto-Dragon Skeleton.

66534.title: Ground Leave
66534.description:
It seems like our arrival was noticed after all. Maybe there's hope for these people yet.

I'll follow up with Ebyssian and the Horde leadership and try to smooth this out. You're on recon.

See what this place has to offer. We may be here for a while, after all.

Come find us once you're finished. Hopefully we'll have all the boring bits sorted out by then.

66546.title: Retrieve the Discs
66546.description:
The discs in here represent the sum of this facility's knowledge. We need to retrieve them!

I'll bring the barrier down with this console. It'll be on ye to retrieve the discs.
66546.progress: Can ye imagine the knowledge that these discs hold?
66546.completion: I knew we could count on ye!

66547.title: It Belongs in a Museum... Eventually
66547.description:
Waves of titan security, escaped proto-dragons, keys that turn you into constructs... I'll just say it.

I've never had so much fun in my LIFE!

Although Naleidea will probably say this is where the real fun begins. We're sitting on a trove of confidential titan data, thanks to the effort ye put in!
 
When ye can, come meet us at camp and we'll compare notes.
66547.progress: Thanks again for a once-in-a-lifetime experience!
66547.completion:
Our leads have dried up for now... at least until we can parse more information from these discs.

Until then, stay observant and follow the clues. You never know where the next adventure will come from!
66547.objectives: Meet Toddy back at the Dragonscale Expedition camp.

66553.title: Hollow Up
66553.description:
The Winterpelt are a special case among the furbolgs. 

I'd categorize 'em as a wee bit "isolationist." They are ghosts in the hollow, their pelts blendin' in with tha snow. 

Usedta keep to themselves, but now they're outright aggressive. They attacked our camp with nae provocation!

Somethin' must be wrong to drive 'em to it. I can't ask 'em what happened--yet--but maybe ye can find some clues in their village?

66554.title: Aggressive Self-Defense
66554.description:
With the Winterpelt all in a tizzy, I don't imagine they'll appreciate ya poking around up there. 

Don't be afraid to defend yourself if they start somethin'. A firm reminder that ya mean business might knock some sense back into 'em.

Try not to kill anyone though, will ya? I know how ya adventurin' types can get.
66554.completion: Hopefully ye didn't go too hard on 'em.

66555.title: Bear With Me
66555.description:
Aye, sounds like a right mess up there--like a storm blew through and wrecked the whole place. I can see why they'd be up in arms, but why attack us?

This would be a lot easier if we could just talk it out, but the Winterpelt are famously tight-lipped and don't seem to speak any of the common branches of Furbolg-ish. Furbolgian? Eh, ye know what I mean.

I don't suppose ya happened to have a nice chat with any of 'em while ye were checking in on them, did ye?

66556.title: Ice Cave Ya Got There
66556.description:
Well, yer accent is atrocious, and ten-thousand years o' isolation an' linguistic drift hasn't done us any favors, but I think I got a rough impression at least.

The common thread in what they were tryin' to say was somethin' aboot a "bad cave wind" or an "evil storm cave." That, or their laundry was too Thursday?

Look, this isn't like learnin' Gnomish; there're goin' to be some hiccups. I'm pretty sure aboot the cave though, so let's start there.
66556.progress: That's the best I got. Ye try translatin' this stuff if ye don't like it.
66556.completion: I told ye I had the cave part right. Now we can see about establishin' some proper diplomatic relations.

66557.title: Academic Acquaintances
66557.description:
Aye, this Winterpelt variation on furbolg is provin' to be a tough nut to crack even for me.

I've got some colleagues down in Camp Nowhere who might be able to help. I hear there are other furbolg tribes in the area, and comparin' notes on those dialects might give us somethin' to go off of.
66557.completion: I speak my own tongue, yes, but there is something I need your help with first.
66557.objectives: Find another expert in furbolg languages in Camp Nowhere.

66558.title: Rowie
66558.description:
You were the one that came back with the others from Brackenhide, weren't you? Then you probably know what happened to Kaqiata...

Her son, Rowie, has been distraught ever since Brena and the others returned without her. I'll stay here in case he comes back, but could you look for him? 

I think he ran off towards the ice cave to the east. He said something about trying to fight the yeti in there!
66558.completion: Thanks for helping me. You're nice.

66559.title: Back To Camp
66559.description:
I saw Mordigan run out of there like a dwarf possessed. I'll go chase him down and make sure he gets back to the others in one piece.

If you hug the cliff and jump down the waterfalls, you should be able to avoid stirring up any more of the gorlocs. 

See you back at camp.
66559.completion:
It appears you've managed to return our dwarf. And in a single piece, no less. On behalf of both our team and the Dragonscale Expedition, I thank you. 

We'll get Mordigan some fluids, then start packing up. 

There's nothing in these hills save blood and salt.
66559.objectives: Return to Examiner Rowe in Whaler's Nook.

66575.title: Item as Questgiver: Vial
66575.description:
<This strange vial nestled amongst the odds and ends of the Tarasek stash seems to be filled with a viscous, bubbling fluid.>

< It would be wise to show this to Alvi.>
66575.objectives: Turn in the item to Waywatcher Alvi.

66579.title: Sounds of Healing
66579.description:
<You hear a soothing sound emanating from the disc as it hums softly.

Olea Manu might know more about this.>
66579.completion: The Jailer is no more. What you bring is proof--Zereth Mortis is beginning to heal itself! You may find new tools born of that healing. Tools that resonate strongly with the Cyphers. With them, you can rid us of the remaining Mawsworn.
66579.objectives: Bring the Resonating Disc to Olea Manu at Faith's Repose.

66582.title: Power Procurement
66582.description:
In normal circumstances, the capture of energy is not problematic. However, the energy we require is massive and unstable. This enchanted vessel should provide a safe means of transport.

There is a region to the southwest filled with energy-laden creatures. The anomalous energy within these creatures is powerful, but unstable.

Capture their energy and return it to me. Then we may embark on the remainder of this journey together.
66582.progress: Have you collected what we discussed?
66582.completion: Oh my. The warmth within the vessel is fascinating.
66582.objectives: Gather energy within the vessel for Warpcaster Delandra at Camp Antonidas.

66586.title: Legacy of Tyr: Secrets of the Past
66586.description:
To stop Raszageth from freeing the other Incarnates, the Aspects' power must be restored.

But this will not be an easy task. The Titans are silent and Keeper Tyr is long dead.

Queen Alexstrasza has devised a plan. In the Badlands lies a Titan facility called Uldaman. She believes Tyr's companions hid a disc of his memories inside its depths.
 
Take your allies to Uldaman and find the disc for the Dragon Queen. Let us hope Tyr's knowledge can be used to re-empower the Aspects.
66586.progress: Has the exploration been a success?
66586.completion:
Infinite dragons? Their kind always has been troublesome.

I will inform the Dragon Queen that she must find another way to restore the power of the Aspects.
66586.objectives: Enter Uldaman in Badlands. Discover the cause of the disturbances.

66589.title: Expeditionary Coordination
66589.description:
The name's Toddy. I'll be headin' up our band of cheery adventurers under the banner of the Dragonscale Expedition. We'll get into the details later. For now, let's focus on gatherin' up our crew.

Every expedition worth its salt has a variety of folk. We'll be needin' scholars, artisans, and of course explorers.

Well? What're you standin' here for? Assemble that crew!
66589.completion:
That was fast!

Eager to get to the Dragon Isles, eh? Me too!
66589.objectives: Recruit explorers, artisans, and scholars throughout Stormwind for the expedition to the Dragon Isles.

66596.title: Whispers on the Winds
66596.description:
Hello, $p. It's been a while, and I wish we had more time to catch up.

But you see, I've just had a rather enlightening... no, make that foreboding... yes, a foreboding conversation with an old friend.

Sometimes a revelation can be both, after all.

I really must tell you of what I've learned.
66596.completion: Your reaction is understandable. I dare say I felt the same.
66596.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Stormwind.

66598.title: Nightborne Know-How
66598.description:
Ancient symbols aren't really me thing. However...

<Thaelin searches through his belongings, eventually pulling out a map. At the top of the parchment appears the name Antonidas, scribbled in large, sloppy letters.>

Ah hah! Here it is!

Bit of a trek, but a few of those old magic users can be found... here. 

<Pointing to a spot on the map.>

Maybe they have somethin' tae offer.
66598.completion:
Well traveled, I see. These symbols you speak of are quite mysterious, as well as old.

Since you seem interested enough to travel all the way out here to find me, the least I can do is offer some guidance.
66598.objectives: Locate Warpcaster Delandra at Camp Antonidas in The Azure Span.

66611.title: Clearing the Skies
66611.description:
Can you hear that? Bugs! All around. Some of them are getting pretty big.

Why don't you and your gliding friend use the thermal behind me and do something about it?

66612.title: Crabtender's Quandry
66612.description:
The crabs are in danger!

This particular bunch has been through a rough season. Their previous habitat was ransacked by the Primalists, and then I led them to this area only for gorlocs to invade!

I thought they would be safe here, but the gorlocs only nurture aggression in their crabs, leading them to an early demise!

Please, defeat some of the gorlocs so the crabs can escape!
66612.progress: These crabs deserve better than to serve a gorloc!
66612.completion: Aspect's grace shine down on you, {NAME}! You saved my precious crabs! I will watch them more closely this time. No gorloc will overtake my charges again!

66622.title: Wayward Tools
66622.description:
This is terrible! My *hic* tools seem to have run off when I wasn't looking. I can't *hic* stand the thought of them all alone out there, no doubt scared out of their minds!

Would you round them up for me? Just be patient and *hic* try to soothe their nerves and I'm sure they'll warm right up to you!
66622.completion: Thank you, {NAME}! I'll *hic* always remember your heroism!

66633.title: Make a Statement
66633.description:
These djaradin believe the black dragonflight is finished. They don't fear or respect Wrathion's authority here.

We need a statement to remind them that the obsidian flight has returned, and that we are stronger than ever.

Slay the djaradin and mark each corpse so they don't forget who rules here.
66633.completion: Masterfully done, {NAME}. That's how you send a message.
66633.objectives: Plant a black dragon banner into the corpses of 12 djaradin.

66635.title: Reunited, Once Again
66635.description:
That should be enough. I can sense the others just on the outside of the grove, ready to enter the Dream.

When you're ready, speak to me and I will break the ice walls and bring down the dome. I hope that my changes will not dishearten the flight. 

We will not be done, but we will be all together again.
66635.completion:
I cannot believe it. All that I could have hoped for... 

She is here.

But I can tell that she's changed. I do not know what this means, and I fear we do not have much time to ponder it. We must go after Rymek.
66635.objectives: Speak with Ysera to lower the barrier.

66636.title: The Other Side
66636.description: We've finally figured out the placement of the third stone--and ye get to do the honors! I've affixed the stone to what's left of the watcher's staff. Just climb the scaffolding there, hold it up, and watch the show!
66636.progress:
When I get back tae Stormwind, my name is going into the book beside the greatest explorers of our time. 

Move over Brann, Toddy's here to stay!
66636.completion: There's so much to see, and we're just getting started!
66636.objectives: Open the door with the watcher staff.

66646.title: Quelling Causalities
66646.description:
The Infinite has forced the energies of time to aggression. This is not good.

Please slay any time elementals you encounter while assisting Ambassador Chronormu. I will remain here and help her hold Eternus in place.
66646.progress: Did any of them escape to the past? I wonder if we would realize if they did? Hmmm.
66646.completion: Excellent work! Usually I am against killing time, but today is an exception.

66647.title: Elemental Unfocus
66647.description:
Kalecgos and I are under heavy fire in the skies above the mountain. The Primalists are unrelenting and their army endless.

Soon, Kalecgos and I may be overrun by their forces.

But I have a plan.

At the base of the mountain is a disturbed orc named Ruvin Stonegrinder. The Kirin Tor fought her numerous times.

She holds a device that can absorb and redirect elemental energies. 

Take it from her, then meet me further in.
66647.progress: The Elemental Focus should prove useful if you can recover it.
66647.completion: This is it! Hold onto it... you'll need it for what's next.

66648.title: Crossing Fate
66648.description:
<Reality spins around you. Your memories of this place become obscured, and shift intensely with each passing moment. Something has changed.>

<You are certain that for all its similarities, this is not the place you once knew. Not exactly.>

<Regardless, the path ahead beckons. Neither deception nor distortion will delay your destiny.>

66649.title: Turning the Wheel
66649.description:
<Through your many trials you feel the power inside you growing. Whatever the source of these anomalies, they now bring you comfort instead of confusion.>

<Dive once more into uncertainty, strive against the darkness, and grasp Fate with both hands.>

66651.title: Up to No-khud
66651.description:
The Nokhud and Ukhel clans have overtaken the Eternal Kurgans. Their purpose can only be malign. Our most esteemed ancestors are buried there.

I sent Initiate Zorig to investigate. He still has not returned.

He is capable, but lacking in confidence. Please help him put a stop to their foul activities!
66651.completion: Clan Ukhel dishonors itself with dark magic. Now they have moved into the kurgans with their Nokhud allies. Neither clan should be here! I've been watching from here, where I'm safely out of sight.
66651.objectives: Meet Initiate Zorig at the Eternal Kurgans.

66652.title: Return to Mender
66652.description:
I can't see what they're doing from here, but I fear they're desecrating the kurgans.

Please go to the nearest tomb, and see if you can stop the ritual they're performing. 

And if you find anything that may tell us their purpose here, please bring it back to me.
66652.progress: Did you stop the ritual? Any clues as to what it was about?
66652.completion:
This spear... it belonged to my mother, Cathan. She was a great hunter. When she got sick, I... I couldn't save her.

Like all great Maruuk centaur, she was buried with her weapon. But this means the Ukhel are using these weapons to raise spirits and bind them to their service - including my mother!
66652.objectives: Investigate the Ukhel ritual at the nearby mound.

66654.title: Desecrator Annihilator
66654.description:
My mother was a hero. She deserves peace and rest, not this... enslavement! None of our heroes do.

They must pay for this. And our ancestors must rest once more with their weapons, with honor. Take the weapons back from those desecrators!
66654.progress: Did you get the weapons back from those graverobbers?
66654.completion: This is a good start. I can use these weapons to free their owners... I hope.
66654.objectives: Kill Nokhud Desecrators and Ukhel Gravestirrers, and recover the ancestral weapons they have taken.

66655.title: Reagents of De-Necromancy
66655.description:
I fear the spirits will be unable to find their tombs, even if we release them from the Ukhel's grip.

The Ukhel are also raising the ancestors' animal companions who guided and protected them in life.

Bring me the skulls of those animals, and the sacred soil disturbed by these enemies. Combined, these reagents should help the ancestors find peace.
66655.progress: Do you have the reagents? We must free the ancestors before Clan Ukhel takes them away from the Kurgans.
66655.completion: Perfect! I should be able to use these to release them from the Ukhel. Then they can return to the rest they deserve.
66655.objectives: Gather 4 Intact Skulls from risen companions and 6 Clumps of Sacred Soil.

66656.title: Definitely Eternal Slumber
66656.description:
The ancestors are gripped by this dark magic. They will fight before they follow. The Ukhel raised our fiercest warriors and hunters. Stopping them will be no easy task.

I'm going to come along and help. It's time I put my mother's spear back to use.

Once they are defeated, use this totem I've crafted to help the subdued spirits find their way back to the kurgans.
66656.progress: Hurry. We must free these spirits.
66656.completion: I'm so relieved that my mother is at peace again. Thank you, {NAME}!
66656.objectives: Defeat each renowned centaur spirit, then use Zorig's Totem of Respite to release them.

66657.title: And Stay Dead!
66657.description: Tombcaller Arban has holed up in the largest kurgan, where the first Maruuk ancestors were laid to rest. Stop Arban before he raises Maruuk and Teera!
66657.progress: He'll have no tomb of his own when this is done.
66657.completion: Unlike my mother, and our ancestors, no one will wish for Arban to live again. Thank you for helping me avenge them.
66657.objectives: Enter the main kurgan and defeat Tombcaller Arban.

66658.title: The Nokhud Offensive: Founders Keepers
66658.description:
Teera and Maruuk's weapons were removed before we stopped Tombcaller Arban. Our greatest ancestors may fight again in these plains... for the Nokhud.

Go to the Nokhud Offensive. Find Maruuk and Teera. When you have subdued them, bring their weapons back to the Teerakai burial mound. We will lay them back to rest with the honor they deserve, in a place we can protect more easily.
66658.progress: Were you able to defeat the legendary spirits of our founders?
66658.completion: I would never have expected such help from an outsider before. You have my thanks.
66658.objectives: Enter the Nokhud Offensive, defeat Teera and Maruuk, and place their weapons in the Teerakai kurgan.

66660.title: On Your Mark... Get Set...
66660.description:
<Nozdormu's gaze is unfocused.>

The further they fall, the faster they travel. They punch holes through the fabric of time which send out great ripples. You will need to be swift to catch them.

<Nozdormu's focus sharpens and shifts to you.>

I will send my timewalkers to help you navigate the timeways and speed your efforts. Avoid entangling with the temporal locals and do not stop until you have found Chronormu!

Go. We have precious little time.
66660.objectives: Join Andantenormu and Siazerathel in the past.

66661.title: It's Just a Coin, What Could it Cost?
66661.description:
<This curious object provides more questions than answers. How did you come to have it? What is it used for? Is it dangerous?>

<If the Eternal City does not hold answers for you, then surely the Brokers who trade there will.>
66661.completion: That coin... no one in Oribos will take its kind, and I doubt you'd survive the trip to the market that could. If I may be so bold, perhaps my associates and I could provide assistance?
66661.objectives: Seek out a Broker in Oribos for information.

66671.title: Path to Nowhere
66671.description:
Ye look like a willin' and able adventurer! How would ye like to help out the Dragonscale Expedition?

We've got ourselves a lovely camp in the middle of a nice bit of wilderness.

There's plenty for ye to do if ye'd like to take the trip over there. 

Talk to me sis, Maddy, when ye get there. She'll get ye all settled in.
66671.completion:
Caddy sent ye? She wasn't here before all the commotion broke out with the tuskarr and the furbolg!

To say we got things to do in the camp is a wee understatement. We're flooded with problems!
66671.objectives: Meet Maddy Scattershot at Camp Nowhere within the Azure Span.

66673.title: Speak to Koranos
66673.description: The Watchers have observed much over the years. Many of them are lost to the vagaries of time, but we still have Koranos.
66673.progress: Koranos has been here since the beginning. If he doesn't have answers, he should be able to point you in the right direction.
66673.completion: The Sundered Flame won't let us recover these stones without a fight.

66675.title: Aspect Power
66675.description:
The Mother Oathstone is an ancient gift bestowed to our flights by the Titans. If what we have learned is true, I might be able to reactivate it and in doing so restore our aspectral powers.

Though we are unsure of the outcome, if this has the slightest chance of working I must attempt it.

{NAME}, I would appreciate if you would join me in this.
66675.objectives: Assist Alexstrasza at the Mother Oathstone.

66676.title: Sneaking In
66676.description:
This is Lizi... she's my secret friend. I've been taking care of her since she was rejected by her mother.

This isn't looking good. Whatever they did to her is beyond my knowledge. I have to bring her home. My Ohn may ground me for the rest of time, but Lizi must get help. I am ever grateful to you, $p. I'm sorry this was more trouble than you signed up for.

If you wouldn't mind one more adventure... please face my Ohn's wrath with me? Meet me back at the springs.
66676.completion: You've returned! Look--Lizi is going to be all right.
66676.objectives: Return to Radiya in Ohn'iri Springs.

66680.title: Counting Sheep
66680.description:
How frustrating. A rabid stag did this while my brother Olekk and I were scouting.

<Watu gestures at his bloody leg and winces.>

Are you here to help? After the primalists attacked, our herd of argali scattered into the pines. Their wool and milk are essential to the camp's functions.
