Take this whistle, which commands Wish to herd the argali back home. Sondo the butcher has her favorite treats if she needs extra encouragement.
66680.progress: Make haste. Argali are a favorite snack for the local--well, local everything.
66680.completion: So our argali live. Give Wish an extra pat for me, will you? I would do it myself, but I can't move. <Watu sighs.>
66680.objectives: Befriend Wish with food, and use Wish's Whistle to save 5 Lost Argali in the Sagecrest Pines.

66681.title: Tempests Abound
66681.description:
If you're venturing out into the pines, please slay any stormtouched animals. This is not easy for me to ask, but they're clearly in pain, unable to be helped, and spreading the aggression.

I suspect it's the primalists' doing. It must be coming from their outpost nearby, where I saw a strange magical altar at work.

I'm going to go investigate again. If I'm not back by the time you return, Scout Watu can brief you on additional tasks. We're grateful for any help.
66681.completion: The pines should be a little safer now.
66681.objectives: Kill 8 Stormtouched Beasts in Sagecrest Pines.

66683.title: Last Resort Analysis
66683.description:
<Watu mumbles to himself, eyes closed and arms crossed.>

Of course I get gored by a stag, of all creatures. Now I'm just another one who needs help. My brother will get all the credit, and no one back home will be surprised.

<Watu looks up.> What? What's that you've got there? Glowing rocks? I'll look at one, but take the rest to somebody else. I'm a hunter, not an archaeologist. <Watu snorts, glaring at his leg.> Maybe this is a sign for me to switch jobs. Go on, you've proven more useful than I.
66683.progress:
<A strange look has overcome Watu. He barely registers your presence, infatuated with turning the shard over in his hands.>

You see how it glows, like new lightning?
66683.completion: <Watu stares at shock at his leg, newly bloody and pierced with the shard.>
66683.objectives: Inquire about the Stormtouched Shards in Pinewood Post.

66684.title: Storm Chasing
66684.description:
<Watu rips the shard out and gasps for air.>

I...completely lost control. Olekk was right. This terrible magic has to be the primalists' doing. Please, stop them!

I must get my brother back to camp.
66684.progress: Go with haste! That kind of power must be kept in check.
66684.completion: You've returned! I felt the destruction of the source from here.
66684.objectives: Destroy the Primalists' source of storm magic.

66687.title: Land of the Apex
66687.description:
You should know of Rellen, the Learned, who gave centaur the tools to survive a merciless land. His memory requires offerings from worthy beasts.

Take care, traveler. They are not as dangerous as they were eons past, but they're still the plains' apex predators.
66687.progress: Have you returned with the offerings?
66687.completion: You've returned intact. Good. Always respect the animals' prowess.
66687.objectives: Collect 10 Shadespinner Webs, 2 Slyvern Talons, and 2 Thunderspine Scales.

66688.title: Signs of the Wind
66688.description:
When the elements, true primals of the world, challenged the centaur, Himia met them with our given gift. The wind.

A singing stone stands strong in the plains. There, you can offer tokens of the wind to evoke her memory. Such tokens may be found all around us--a bird's feather, a plant spore, a river's reeds.
66688.progress: The singing stone is a morning's ride from here.
66688.completion:
<There are ashen remains of previously offered wind tokens in the iron container.>

<You place what you've gathered on top.>
66688.objectives: Gather wind tokens and give them to the Offering Vessel near the singing stone.

66689.title: More Than A Rock
66689.description:
<The shards are smooth and slightly hot to the touch. Lightning sparks deep within their core.>

<Maybe Watu or Olekk would know more.>

<The thought of parting with the shard fills you with compulsion to hold the shard close. To keep it forever.>
66689.completion: <Watu doesn't register your presence. He remains sitting, favoring the injured leg, and has his eyes closed.>
66689.objectives: Show the Stormtouched Shards to Watu.

66690.title: The Nokhud Offensive: The Final Ancestor
66690.description:
You've proven yourself an ally to us, with genuine interest in our values and way of life. There is one more ancestor I'd like to tell you about, but it will be dangerous.

Kill the traitorous Balakar, leader of Nokhud, son of none. He wears a precious medallion at all times. Bring it back to me, and I will be forever in your debt.
66690.progress: Balakar never parts with the pendant. You'll have to kill him.
66690.completion: ...I thought I'd never see the day.

66698.title: Counting Argali
66698.description:
One of our key resources is our argali herd. Every loss is felt deeply for the strength of our clan.

A few of the argali have gotten separated and have wandered away from the herd. Our shepherds could use your assistance reclaiming them.
66698.completion: Thank you. Our clan deeply appreciates the assistance.
66698.objectives: Speak with the Aylaag Shepherd and return the lost sheep to the clan.

66699.title: Ask the Locals
66699.description:
Kalecgos is wise to seek the tuskarr's counsel. They have generations of experience with this land.

Many are resting here on their way to their various camps across the Span. 

Ask around! One of them must know about local ley lines.
66699.progress: I'd offer you a bowl, but you appear to be in a hurry.
66699.objectives: Speak to tuskarr around Camp Antonidas.

66700.title: The Black Locus
66700.description:
It really is quite enticing, isn't it? The Locus was too much for the Sundered Flame. However, it fits just right in my hands. Funny, that.

<Adenedal shakes his head.>

Perhaps not. Not this day. Not again. Take it from me. It is not my burden to bear.

Good bye, dear friend.
66700.progress: Do you have something to show me?
66700.completion:
This was found at the Nelthazan Ruins? Fascinating. 

Its markings are ancient, but they bear a resemblance to other artifacts we have discovered in and around the ancient machinations of Deathwing.

Further study is necessary.
66700.objectives: Bring the Black Locus to the Telemancer Aerilyn.

66703.title: Snowball Effect
66703.description:
Snowhide gnolls smart. They know you put food on ice, food is good longer. But just ice no good. Magic ice be better! 

This be the work of shamans. And they put Frostbite here, so he starve to death next to delicious tuskarr meat.

If {race} want help tuskarrs, time running out. 

But Frostbite knows how to break the spell.

Why Frostbite help? He no like shamans either.
66703.progress: Tuskarr friends don't look so good, {race}.
66703.completion: So the sneaky shamans are dead?
66703.objectives: Retrieve 3 Snowhide Totems from the Snowhide Shamans in the Azure Span.

66704.title: Mugurlglrlgl!
66704.description:
Mrglgulglrrlglgul! Grurguglullgurl!

Gruglrlgllrugl rrgulgrulgrgl grugll gurgull gur. Murgllgllrugl gurgllglrl Murgul gruggullgl. Murguglegurgllgur gurgll gurgulgul guruulgurllgr guuglrllgl.

Mgrgulllglll gurl gugll.

<You aren't certain what's being said, but there are lots of stabbing motions. It seems like this murloc wants you to kill something.>
66704.completion:
Lrgktrr O'Glrlrlrl!

<The murlocs appear to be pleased.>

66708.title: Riders in the Snow
66708.description:
Greetings, {class}. This magical dome is truly astonishing, is it not? But even though it protects us from the biting cold and the wilderness, we cannot count on the Kirin Tor forever.

A few days ago, some of our most seasoned hunters ventured into the forests looking for food and supplies, but they never came back. Even though I know their leader, Old Grimtusk, is a seasoned hiker and hunter, it is very hard not to worry about him and his hunting party.

Can you find them for me?
66708.completion: <This tuskarr lies unconscious on the snow with a wooden spear protruding from his side>
66708.objectives: Find the missing tuskarr hunters in the Azure Span.

66709.title: Field Medic 101
66709.description: <It's hard to say how long this wounded tuskarr has been lying here alone in the forest, but he won't last much longer without help.>
66709.progress: Of course, take your time. That's what you young pups do best.
66709.completion: Honestly? I thought your "help" would be the end of me.
66709.objectives: Help Old Grimtusk recover from his wounds.

66715.title: The Extraction
66715.description:
Right now the most important thing is to bring back my people. Preferably in one piece.

And as much as it pains me to say this, I'm in no condition to fight them on my own. 

Will you help us?
66715.progress: You look strong, little {race}. Are you?
66715.completion: You smell like death... Frostbite likes that.
66715.objectives: Rescue tuskarr from the Snowhide Camp in the Azure Span.

66719.title: One Step Backwards
66719.description:
My friend, it is with great sorrow that I must say that I am familiar with the plight facing your kind in these ruins. If you proceed any further, you too will surely succumb to their madness.

Be it through your nurture or your nature, the call you hear is a physiological one. You have a craving that must be sated.

It brings me great shame to say that I possess the means to feed this malediction. It will not quite be the same, but you will be able to function... For now.
66719.progress: I regret that it came to this.
66719.completion: Perhaps your people and mine are not so different after all.

66724.title: The Gleamfisher
66724.description:
I am sorry you have been dragged into this, traveler. 

My brother tends to get... carried away. This is only the latest of his follies. But this one might get him killed. 

He won't listen to me. He probably won't listen to you, either. 

Our ancestor, Kauriq the Gleamfisher, though, is the center of his fixation. She may be able to.

Please catch some Gleamfish and bring them here. I shall use them to help us commune with her spirit, which lingers in this stone.
66724.progress: Not all my ideas have worked out, but that doesn't mean this one won't!
66724.completion: Did you hear all that, hero?
66724.objectives: Retrieve 3 Gleamfish and place them in the offering basket.

66729.title: Conditionals
66729.description:
I don't like the alliance. Remember me? 

Go kill Mawsworn.

66730.title: True Survivors
66730.description:
I know we're pretty banged up, but we can't forget why we're here. Our people are counting on us, and I don't plan on letting them down. We've got to find a temporary place for ourselves in these savage parts, and I know just the place.

Now quit whining and MOVE IT.
66730.completion: That wasn't so hard, was it?
66730.objectives: Find and speak with Old Grimtusk at the Frozen Lake in the Azure Span.

66734.title: Leave Bee Alone
66734.description:
Oh, thank the Life-Binder! Someone with empty hands!

These gardens are normally a lovely playground for our whelps, but the bees have multiplied uncontrollably. The blooms returned with vigor--and so have the bees. The whelps are terrified, the dragons are annoyed, and just yesterday one was stung and--

<Vaeros takes a deep breath to center himself then looks at you pleadingly.>

Will you please gather up the bees and relocate them to the lake? Take this smoke diffuser; it will calm them down.
66734.progress: Try not to be too rough with the bees. They are doing their best. We all are.
66734.completion:
Please tell me the relocation went well.

<Vaeros lets out a deep sigh of relief.>

Hopefully the bees will be kept busy pollinating the plants that are far away from our whelps. Thank you, {NAME}.
66734.objectives: Use the Smoke Diffuser to calm and gather 8 Bothersome Bees, then release them near the lake.

66735.title: Just a Trim
66735.description:
The bees scaring the whelps is not the only problem. While pollination is usually a good thing, the recent swarm has caused the flora to grow out of control.

Would you mind taking my gardening shears and cutting back the shrubs? Some have already begun to sprout dangerous lashers, but I hope we can stop more from doing so. An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure, after all.

And I could... very much use some prevention right now, {NAME}.
66735.progress: If you use my gardening shears on anything other than plants, I will be very cross with you.
66735.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. With any luck, the bees will have fewer reasons to be close to the whelps now.

66737.title: A Better Start
66737.description:
Vaeros is diligent, but whelps have a way of finding trouble. Not mine, of course--but I suppose not every dragon rears their clutch to understand the gravity of their station.

While I am loathe to encourage outdoor play over study, I will help you safeguard the garden more effectively. Take these seeds and plant them nearby. When mature, the blooms produce a fragrance that insects find disagreeable.

The gardeners can help you--and maybe my bronze brethren, if you mind your manners.
66737.progress:
Do remember to be courteous to our bronze companions, lest they toss you into a timeline without luxurious stationery and herbal tea.

<Adazius sighs wistfully.>

What a terrible existence that would be.
66737.completion:
I am rather surprised you did not earn more than a scathing reproach from Veladormi. She must be feeling generous today.

I suspect the insect problem is now solved. You are welcome.
66737.objectives: Plant seeds in 6 Fertile Soil patches and allow them to mature.

66779.title: Heir Apparent
66779.description:
As Neltharion's heir and leader of the only surviving flight of black dragons, I was not expecting to find myself in competition for my birthright. Particularly not against a self-important whelp younger than you, mortal.

Nevertheless, if you need more than these self-evident facts, feel free to speak with members of my flight. There's no need to take my word on the subject.
66779.completion: I trust that you understand, now.

66780.title: Claimant to the Throne
66780.description:
I have dedicated myself to saving Azeroth from destruction time and time again, and this fool thinks he can just swoop in and claim the title of aspect? I think not.

Talk to my people, {NAME}. See what they have to say about me and what I have done for this world.
66780.completion: Surely you back my claim, do you not, {NAME}?

66783.title: Renewal of Vows
66783.description:
Centuries ago, I made a vow of friendship and cooperation with the first centaur. Although much has changed, I feel it is time for us to renew that vow again.

A recitation was composed to help future generations of centaur remember their bond with the green dragonflight. Each verse must be answered with an offering from the khans. I hope the centaur can still remember the original meanings.

The choice of gift is critical. Choose the right offering, and our allegiance is bound.
66783.progress:
The recitation is as follows:

From the hunters who value skill above all, a rite of passage: a first.

From the mystics who commune with the wind, her lightest touch: a lift.

From the descendants of the matriarch, a drop of unbroken progeny: a line.
66783.completion: Now that our bonds are renewed, nothing can stand in our way. By wind and wing, so be it.
66783.objectives: Help Sansok Khan, Tigari Khan, Khanam Matra Sarest, and Merithra exchange gifts.

66784.title: Starve the Storm
66784.description:
You fight well for one who must balance on only two legs!

It matters not how hard we fight so long as the Primalists continue to draw reinforcements. We must close that portal, the Storm Corridor!

Fight your way into the nearby cavern and slay the Primalist Storm-Summoners holding it open. I will aid you if I am able.
66784.progress: All this is pointless if that portal remains open!
66784.completion: Now that we have cut off our enemy's reinforcements, the battle will enter its final stage. Great work, {NAME}.
66784.objectives: Kill Primalist Storm-Summoners to close the Storm Corridor Portal.

66785.title: The Last Eggtender
66785.description:
I understand your concern, {class}, but all will be rectified shortly as it seems that we are about to have company. 

Feel free to stay and witness what transpires. It should be quite cathartic.

Do speak with our egg tender when you have a moment, though. She will no doubt need the support.

66788.title: Egg-cited for the Future
66788.description:
I can scarcely believe it! Eggs of the Black Dragonflight! After all this time!

But look at the state of this place! It will not do at all! Nothing is too good for these eggs.

Though with those two blowhards squabbling like children for the Life-Binder's favor, you can bet they have not spared a thought for us! You, though, will not leave an old egg tender all alone, will you?
66788.progress: We are not done yet, young one.
66788.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. I feel like we have a future once more.
66788.objectives: Help Mother Elion restore the area.

66814.title: The Judgment of Tyr
66814.description:
Welcome to the Veiled Ossuary. Originally built to house and memorialize the dead. Now the likely location of the stone we've come to call the Judgment of Tyr.

We haven't received reports of any overt Sundered Flame presence here, but the expedition has learned that they prefer to strike unawares.

Be on your guard, {NAME}.
66814.progress: All I ever wanted was to study. Instead, I'm sifting through rubble and getting chased by draconic ghosts.
66814.completion: Tyr held this at one point. Incredible.

66825.title: A Ruby Lifecalling
66825.description:
$p! How fortunate you are here! We are about to begin a Lifecalling Ceremony and would be honored if you assisted us. 

A dragonspawn's Calling is very special. Some become masterful gardeners; others care for particular wildlife.

These young dragonspawn have finished their training and are ready to take on their first Callings. I know they would be thrilled to have you participate. When you're ready, please present each of the items on this table to them.
66825.progress: Ah, I remember my first calling like it was yesterday...
66825.completion: A Calling can change throughout a dragonspawn's life, but we each cherish our first greatly. Thank you again for participating in our ceremony.
66825.objectives: Participate in the Lifecalling Ceremony at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

66827.title: Flowers of our Labor
66827.description:
The legend says she only sings it for those who prove their devotion to life.

I've been tending this garden for years... And I think my plants and I are finally ready.

I'll start setting up by the pool here. You can help me with the harvest!

Gather seed pods from beneath bushes, dragonflowers from sunny fields, and dragonfruit high in the trees. You can borrow my old rake to help with those. And watch out--sometimes the foliage can be feisty!
66827.progress:
<Akora talks nervously to herself.>

Just remember the mantras...

Fruit that is sweet,
is harbored from heat.

Tilling early the soil,
saves future toil.

If a tree should bare fruit,
don't forget its roots...
66827.completion:
Well... at least the animals seemed to enjoy my work.

<Akora tries to smile but is unable to hide her disappointment.>

Maybe the legend was never real at all.

66828.title: Huddle at the Hollow
66828.description:
I've never seen Akora this upset. Usually she's as sunny as her flowers, but that legend means a lot to her. She talks about it all the time. Hm...

<Keshki fidgets with their glasses.>

I don't know a lot about plants, and I don't think frogs would cheer up anyone but me...

But north of here there's a quiet spot where I do my thinking: Hornswog Hollow. Maybe we can find something to cheer her up there? Or, uh, try to formulate a plan to help?
66828.completion:
As much as I want to cheer up Akora, {NAME}, taking care of these poor frogs is a bigger priority.

For the red dragonflight, preserving life always comes first!

66830.title: Hornswoggled!
66830.description:
Oh, those hornswogs make me so mad!

<Keshki stomps her foot angrily, knocking her glasses askew>

They're big, greedy bullies! Just because the place is named after them doesn't mean they get to jump all around and eat everything smaller than them!

Here, use my jar of fireflies--it's a frog-minder's best friend. It'll calm the frogs enough that you can collect them, and we can get them out of harm's way.

And if any hornswogs get in your way, don't be afraid to bully them back!
66830.progress: Frogs are gentle creatures! It's not fair to push them around like this!
66830.completion: Whew, all the frogs we helped are in the carrier!
66830.objectives: Use Keshki's Jar of Fireflies to lure 8 Bullied Frogs to safety.

66831.title: Home Is Where the Frogs Are
66831.description:
All the frogs are rounded up, {NAME}! I guess we're, uh, taking the frogs to Akora anyway. They'll be safe at the Life Pools until the hornswogs get bored and move on.

Um, well, I guess we didn't find anything to cheer up Akora. I hope she understands...
66831.progress: Honestly? I'm just glad the frogs are safe.
66831.completion:
I guess the legend was real this whole time.

<Keshki grins, looking bashfully at Akora.>

And maybe we're, um, both pretty good at tending life after all.
66831.objectives: Meet Keshki back at the Life Pools to release the rescued frogs.

66834.title: Rellen, the Learned
66834.description: Bring your offerings to the central den. You may witness the legend of Rellen, the Learned, who gave centaur our livelihood as we know it.
66834.progress: The offering den is in the center of Teerakai.
66834.completion: Rellen established the centaur's footing in these plains. We would have never survived without his teachings.
66834.objectives: Make your offerings in the offering den and witness each of Rellen's teachings.

66837.title: Nothing for Breakfast
66837.description:
My brother Valdo was supposed to order more supplies. But it's been a week and nothing has come. 

I'm not surprised. The lazy oaf probably took a nap instead! Now we're short on food, and I'm too busy to hunt on top of my chores--and Valdo's! 

Would you hunt for us? The meat of the vorquin striders and striped bruffalon south of here would keep the kitchen open until I can order supplies.
66837.progress: Did you get some vorquin meat? Any bruffalon flanks? Great! I was ready to put fillet of boot on the menu...
66837.completion:
Thanks to you--and no thanks to Valdo--I can feed all these hungry travelers!

Hmm... are you looking for a job? I've got a recent "opening"...

Can't pay you much, but you can have Valdo's spot! No? Ah well, can't blame me for trying.
66837.objectives: Collect meat from the vorquin striders and striped bruffalon south of Three-Falls Lookout.

66838.title: It's Cold Up Here
66838.description:
Being a good innkeeper means anticipating guests' needs. Unfortunately, I didn't anticipate how cold the nights would be here. Oops?

My guests are going to need blankets--and good, thick ones. Maybe bear pelts will do?

There are some large bears in the forest just east of here. If you bring me some of their pelts, I'll pay you for them! 

Please? Think of the adventurers and their cold, cold feet...
66838.progress:
Huh? Oh! You're back already?

Sorry, I got kind of involved in my card game... 

Do you have the pelts?
66838.completion:
Oh! These are awesome. So luxurious and soft...

Now, only if Valdo were here to clean them up!
66838.objectives: Collect thick bear pelts from thickmane bears.

66839.title: It's Brew Time!
66839.description:
The gang had some time off and was hankerin' for a pint, so we bellied up to the inn.

But, ach! I can nae believe it! They didna have any brew! What kind o' inn is that? One ran by the Stonehinges--that's what kind!

So we're takin' matters into our own hands! The forest to the east has flowers and herbs that we could use to brew some sweet mead. Feel like helpin' me and doin' some flower pickin'? There'd be somethin' in it for ye!
66839.progress: Ye get a nice mead-brewin' bouquet yet?
66839.completion:
Oh, these are be-u-ti-ful! This one is spicy! And this one reminds me of Earthroot. Oh, I can taste the sweet mead now...

Thank ye kindly, friend! Ye saved me and the gang's afternoon!
66839.objectives: Gather Blood Berries, Bronze Horn Berries, and Dragon Foil Blossoms.

66840.title: Water Safety
66840.description:
My greatest responsibility is to make sure everyone has access to clean drinking water.

With the gnolls to the east dealing with the decay, I must make sure that the camp is safe.

I don't want to alarm anyone by personally taking samples, but I feel testing is necessary.

Bring me samples from the three nearby waterfalls, and I will reward you handsomely.
66840.completion:
A deep wyrm?

Something must have driven it away from its underground nest. Whatever spooked this apex predator  must be very terrible indeed.

Thank you, {NAME}, I will make sure to remove the carcass it doesn't contaminate the water.
66840.objectives: Bring three water samples to Manny Read.

66841.title: A Shard of the Past
66841.description:
I've seen ye runnin' in and out of the camp helpin' people. Ye think ye could help ol' Gannar too?

I surveyed the area, and somethin' caught me old eyes. I think 'tis an ancient potsherd or a jar or somethin' just down south of here at the edge of that waterfall.

Now, I am not much of a swimmer, but I'll give ye some coin and you can deliver the findings to Thanessa Silverbloom.
66841.progress:
You must be {NAME}.

Gannar said you were running some sort of an errand for him?
66841.completion: This is an unbelievable find! I have never seen ancient pottery like this. And these markings... Give me a moment while I inspect them.
66841.objectives: Recover and bring the artifact to Thanessa Silverbloom.

66843.title: Out of Lukh
66843.description:
Ach! Have ye seen me assistant, Lukh?

The kid wanted a moment to look 'round, but he's been gone for an hour! 

I told him it ain't safe here and to nae walk far, but the kid has a head as thick as a ram's.

I can nae say I blame him. it's pretty out here, and he has a thing for flowers.

Could ye help me find 'em? They need me and the wagon back at Three-Falls Lookout!
66843.progress:
Well? Where is he? Did ye find 'em yet? 

We have to go! That collapsed cave at Three-Falls Lookout won't clear itself!
66843.completion:
Thank ye for findin' him. Betcha he won't stray far alone anymore.

Here's a little somethin' for ye help.

66844.title: The Great Shokhari
66844.description:
Of all da animals I have seen here, Shokahri, da great sky vixen, be da most proud.

It be a shame she preyed on a gnoll shaman, cause now she be crazed with decay. When I saw her eating one of her kits, I knew something was not right.

I took da kits away and brought them here, but Shokhari attacked me, swiping me good. I almost didn't make it.

Shokhari must be put down. If da decay rots more of her mind, she be coming for us soon.
66844.progress:
Shokhari got a taste for our flesh now. It be a matter of time before she come to Three-Falls Lookout.

Ya must end her suffering!
66844.completion:
Oh, it be a sad time for me, but it had to be done. 

Here, take one of Shokhari's kits. I can't keep dem all. Carin' for dem be the least we can do. 

Raise it well.

66845.title: Legendary Foil
66845.description:
Last night, I was lying in my bedroll, tossing and turning, when an unnatural chill filled the inn. 

Then, out of nowhere I saw... the ghost of a draconid! It went through my luggage then vanished into thin air! 

But the true horror is that when I woke up... the ghost had taken my most beloved card!

Would you be so kind as to track down the ghost and get my card back? It is my most prized possession.
66845.progress: Please, you have to find my legendary card! It was a family heirloom given to me as a young cub. It means the world to me!
66845.completion:
The apparition explained itself and asked for forgiveness.

But then they asked to play a single match with me. 

Our game is apparently very different from what they used to play, and they wanted to try it.

Thank you for helping both of us. Maybe the match will be fun?
66845.objectives: Find the draconid ghost and retrieve the legendary card.

66846.title: The Heart of the Deck
66846.description:
The day the Dragon Isles began their slumber was the day of my very last match. Fate was cruel, and I lost my strongest card before I could compete.

Guo-Hee's card, you see, was mine. I do not know how her ancestors came upon it.

Alas, I cannot claim it as my own as it has been in her family for centuries. That was a foolish mistake on my part.

Perhaps you and I could craft a card together? A truly unique card... Yes! Will you help me?

Speak to me once you are ready.
66846.progress: The card we create must be powerful as well. I will need your assistance in creating it!
66846.completion:
This is it! I have never seen such a card before! Such power! So many possibilities!

Magnificent!

Thank you, {NAME}. Now I am ready...
66846.objectives: Help the apparition craft a new card.

66847.title: Vault of the Incarnates: Fury of the Storm-Eater
66847.description:
No! We locked the Incarnates away to save this world and now Raszageth seeks to free them!

She cannot succeed, {NAME}. All life on Azeroth is in grave danger if you do not stop her!

I shall return to Nozdormu at the Seat of the Aspects to plan for whatever is to come. 

Khadgar and Kalecgos are already inside with a contingent of allies. Join them to put an end to Raszageth.

Good luck, champion.
66847.progress: Have you stopped Raszageth? We cannot let her plans go unchecked, {NAME}.
66847.completion:
This is grave news, {NAME}. Azeroth is in danger once more, but Khadgar is right.

We can't lose hope.
66847.objectives: Enter the Vault of the Incarnates and defeat Raszageth.

66848.title: Omens on the Wind
66848.description:
Ohn'ahra does not speak in language as we do. Her voice carries through the very winds. We mystics are trained to feel her presence, follow her call, and interpret her messages.

I have used the materials you gathered to bind totems to this particular call. Aid me in a ritual to center her voice, then I will interpret her song.
66848.progress: Ohn'ahra's voice is all around us. You just have to listen.
66848.completion: The storm is an omen of grim portent. Trouble is brewing.
66848.objectives: Aid Ohn Seshteng in her ritual.

66856.title: Becca Black and the Seven Gnomes
66856.description:
The djaradin have ransacked the Obsidian Citadel and stolen a number of valuable artifacts.

Wrathion has tasked us to recover every item taken from the Citadel. My team has located several in the area, but we could use your help.
66856.progress: Have you found everything on the list?
66856.completion: Excellent work, {NAME}. Once we've located more of the stolen artifacts, we'll be sure to call for your help again.

66858.title: Tour the Trading Post
66858.description:
<A flyer, carried by the wind, flaps into your hands.>

Fancy yourself a collector, trader, or adventurer? 

We've travelled all over Azeroth collecting goods of the finest quality for someone exactly like you!

Visit one of our outposts in Stormwind or Dornogal and browse all the latest goods!

--T&W Trading Post

<You squint to read the fine print.>

Be sure to present this flyer for some extra Trader's Tender!
66858.progress:
Welcome to the Tradin' Post! 

We've got goods from all over Azeroth for ye to collect. Would ye like to take a look?
66858.completion:
Now that ye've visted the shop and taken a look at our wares, here's a few more Trader's Tender for bringin' in that flyer.

If you want to keep earnin' tender, then check out the Traveler's Log portion of the Adventure Guide to see what activities ye can do. Complete enough activities and we'll reward you with tender and other amazing items.
66858.objectives: Collect Trader's Tender from the Collector's Cache and tour the Trading Post.

66879.title: Hornstrider Havoc
66879.description:
Hornstriders! They've got bone-breaking beaks, fast legs for getting away from danger, and they can eat anything in the Isles.

This Calling's the easiest around! It's just me and my favorite big birds spending time together. And if anything comes up, I know how to wrangle all of the Isles' critters.

Would you mind following me to the hornstrider plateaus up north? I wouldn't mind an extra pair of hands while getting set up.
66879.completion: I've read so many books on hornstriders, and I've wrestled the biggest baby thunder lizard you ever did see... but I don't know one thing about water elementals!
66879.objectives: Meet Dazakros in the Overflowing Rapids.

66883.title: Ancient Horn Ring
66883.completion: An ancient horn ring? It should be worn to honor those that fell in battles before us.

66884.title: Fireproof Gear
66884.description:
The armor of the djaradin can withstand even the fiercest flames. Such qualities would be of great use in combating them!

See what you can gather from the djaradin. We can study it, and apply the same enchantments to our own armor.
66884.progress: Were you able to gather any armor?
66884.completion:
These are perfect samples for studying! We should be able to shore up our own armor quite nicely. 

You have our thanks for your aid, friend.
66884.objectives: Gather 10 Fireproof Gear from the djaradin of the Dragon Isles for Temnaayu of the Iskaara Tuskarr.

66890.title: Stolen Tools
66890.description:
We have been plagued by gnolls raiding our supply caravans. They appear to be obsessed with the various engineering tools within. We cannot risk these violent raiders figuring out our specialized art! Also, these thefts have set our production schedule back more than I'd like to admit.

If you can retrieve some of the stolen engineering parts, we can get back on schedule.
66890.progress: Have you retrieved the stolen tools?
66890.completion: These parts will help us get back on track with our engineering projects.
66890.objectives: Gather 20 Stolen Tools from the gnolls of the Dragon Isles for Dothenos of the Valdrakken Accord.

66891.title: Explosive Ash
66891.description: The molten phoenixes in the Dragon Isles create an unusual ash substance once they die. It could be used to create some material improvements for some complex, life-changing machinery. Though I would probably use it for explosives.
66891.completion: This ash could provide the essential component in a variety of machines that would improve the lives of people across Azeroth. But who am I kidding? We're going to make explosives with it. BOOM!
66891.objectives: Gather 20 Explosive Ash from the phoenixes of the Dragon Isles for Gnoklin Quirkcoil of the Dragonscale Expedition.

66892.title: Deluge Dilemma
66892.description:
Elementals are killing the hornstriders! I know how to wrangle large critters, but I never thought I'd have to go toe-to-toe with an elemental! These aren't anything like baby thunder lizards...

<Dazakros sighs, distressed.>

Please knock down a few of them elementals. Hornstriders have a lot more sense than we give them credit for. They'll fight back if they have the means to!
66892.progress: If fighting elementals is anything like wrangling lizards, just give those soggy good-for-nothing's a solid knock to the nose and they'll fall in line!
66892.completion:
And I thought I'd seen it all. Would you look at how these little ones drop from the spring?

Turns out being a caretaker isn't so easy. Thanks for your help, {NAME}. I've learned a lot from you!
66892.objectives: Kill 12 Water Elementals in Overflowing Rapids.

66893.title: Beaky Reclamation
66893.description:
I may not know anything about water elementals, but I do know hornstriders!

I've thrown together a salve that'll keep the 'striders healthy and ready to fight. I've never had a chance to apply it to a real hornstrider, but I've done all the studying I can do.

It's time to put on a brave face and lather them up!
66893.completion: It's downright uplifting to see the hornstriders take back their home. You brought that to them, {NAME}. Thank you for your help.
66893.objectives: Heal 8 Injured Hornstriders in Overflowing Rapids.

66895.title: Same as the Old Boss
66895.description:
The Worldbreaker dragonkin are a trusting lot. We have followed many different leaders over the years, believing that each will lead us to the Hour of Twilight and the return of Deathwing.

However, Deathwing has not returned, and still there is no Twilight.

It is time for a new leader. You can help bring about the change.
66895.progress: Are we ready for a new leader?
66895.completion: You have done well. Now there is ample room for a new leader to rise and bring the Worldbreakers to a better future.

66897.title: Fuel for the Forge
66897.description:
To make the best blades, you need the heat that only a Magma Core can provide. We try to keep a few on hand as a fuel source for our forges. Lately, we've been running low on cores and could use a resupply.

Magma Cores are obtainable from most lava creatures in the Dragon Isles.
66897.progress: Have you gathered the Magma Cores?
66897.completion: The blacksmiths will be glad to have this resupply for their forges.
66897.objectives: Gather 10 Magma Cores from the lava creatures of the Dragon Isles for Dhurrel of the Maruuk Centaurs.

66899.title: Fuzzy Legs
66899.description:
We have received a request for "Fuzzy Legs" for tailoring...

Don't look at me, I don't make the requests, I just pass them on. I imagine the legs of tarantulas would fulfill this request.
66899.progress: Have you gathered the Fuzzy Legs?
66899.completion: I can't imagine what these will be used for, and I don't really want to think about it, but thank you regardless.
66899.objectives: Gather 20 Fuzzy Legs from the tarantulas of the Dragon Isles for Gnoklin Quirkcoil of the Dragonscale Expedition.

66900.title: Enchanted Relics
66900.description:
Ah, the tides have brought you at just the right time! Gnolls have stolen some of our relics. These are more precious than most--they have been enchanted. We cannot allow the gnolls to learn our magics!

Someone of your skill should have no issue identifying the stolen relics. Please, will you lend us your aid?
66900.completion:
I worry about what the gnolls may have learned about the relics while they had them in their possession.

Thank you for retrieving them.
66900.objectives: Gather 10 Enchanted Relics from the gnolls of the Dragon Isles for Temnaayu of the Iskaara Tuskarr.

66929.title: Gotta Collect Them All
66929.description:
$PC, do you mind helping me get my cards back? 

I told Setogosa I need them to show other students how to play Hearthstone. I want to form a club, but she's not giving them back!

She's always been rude to me, but this is taking it further than normal.
66929.progress: I got a few of the cards out myself, have you gotten the rest yet?
66929.completion:
Thank the aspects! Most of these are still in one piece.

I figured out a way to reverse time on the cards using bronze magic and get them back to mint condition!

66931.title: Who Brought the Ruckus?
66931.completion:
I--

As much as I wish to follow my queen into battle, I must prove worthy of her trust and protect the Lifeshrine.
66931.objectives: Discover the commotion at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

66935.title: Crystal Quill Pens
66935.description:
There are unique creatures in these lands called crystalspines. They are cute little creatures protected by sharp crystal quills.

When I was treating one of our researchers for being stuck by one, I noticed that there was a lingering power resonating within. They might make for an excellent source of enchanting crystals.
66935.progress: Have you found some crystal quills?
66935.completion: These are a perfect source of magically resonant crystal.
66935.objectives: Gather 15 Crystal Quills from the crystalspines of the Dragon Isles for Gnoklin Quirkcoil of the Dragonscale Expedition.

66937.title: Decaying News
66937.description:
The gnolls and their use of decay magic are concerning. We need to gather as much knowledge as we can, in case the threat escalates. 

As alchemists, we are used to gathering such foul substances safely--plus, we're used to the smell. Will you lend your aid?
66937.progress: Have you gathered the Rotting Samples?
66937.completion: We will research these samples and see if we can come up with an alchemical solution to this looming problem.
66937.objectives: Gather 10 Rotting Samples from the decay gnolls of the Dragon Isles for Dothenos of the Valdrakken.

66938.title: Mammoth Marrow
66938.description:
Creating new and unusual brews is one of our many specialties. While we do enjoy experimenting with new and fascinating ingredients, we have a few common ingredients that we keep in stock. 

One of these ingredients is the marrow from mammoth tusks. We have run short on marrow and would appreciate your help in collecting more for our alchemists.
66938.progress: Have you gathered enough Tusk Marrow?
66938.completion: The alchemists of the Maruuk Clan will be pleased.
66938.objectives: Gather 20 Tusk Marrow from the mammoths of the Dragon Isles for Dhurrel of the Maruuk Centaur.

66939.title: Hunting the Huntmaster
66939.description:
I heard from one of the guards in Camp Nowhere that there's a nasty piece of work mutilating the local wildlife. Calls itself a 'huntmaster'.

Hunting is one thing, but I can't abide torturing any living thing. 

Besides, my wagon could use a good luck charm.

<Nesingwary spits over the side.> 

Bring me back its paw.
66939.completion:
Ah, looks like you were successful. 

Good.

Here's hoping the critters around here can rest a bit more easily.
66939.objectives: Hunt down Huntmaster Krakle around Imbu's Shield.

66940.title: Elixir Experiment
66940.description:
Our alchemists have recently looked into a variety of new ingredients for experimentation. Their most recent interest is... interesting... to say the least.

It appears that gorloc mucus has some properties that can be beneficial for certain elixirs.
66940.progress: Have you gathered the mucus from the gorlocs?
66940.completion: Wonderful. Now we will see what exciting concoctions our alchemists will produce with this.
66940.objectives: Gather 15 Gorloc Mucus from the gorlocs of the Dragon Isles for Dhurrel of the Maruuk Centaurs.

66941.title: Tremendous Tools
66941.description:
The djaradin have some mighty large tools and weaponry. We can easily find a use for such tools, even if only to smelt them down into more tools for ourselves.

Bring back some djaradin tools for us to study and use.
66941.progress: Did you find the djaradin and collect some of their tools?
66941.completion: The blacksmiths have their work cut out for them. Thank you for collecting these tools.
66941.objectives: Gather 10 Large Tools from the djaradin of the Dragon Isles for Dhurrel of the Maruuk Centaurs.

66943.title: Wood for Writing
66943.description:
We've found some unusual information in our studies of the Dragon Isles. For instance, the bark of treants afflicted by decay magic acts similarly to hide parchment. 

This odd parchment is strangely able to hold the magic for more powerful inscriptions. Very useful! Can you help us gather some?
66943.progress: Were you able to retrieve any bark?
66943.completion: It's so strange. The bark feels like a fine vellum. Though... holding the untreated sheaf brings dark thoughts into my mind. This amount will suffice for now.
66943.objectives: Gather 15 Bark Parchment from the decay treants of the Dragon Isles for Dothenos of the Valdrakken Accord.

66944.title: Peacock Pigments
66944.description: The peacocks of the Dragon Isles have such colorful feathers! I bet we can make some pigments from them for our scribes to use as ink.
66944.progress: Have you gathered the Peacock Feathers?
66944.completion: So colorful! We will make some very nice pigments with these.
66944.objectives: Gather 8 Peacock Feathers from the peacocks of the Dragon Isles for Gnoklin Quirkcoil of the Dragonscale Expedition.

66945.title: Icy Ink
66945.description: The icy beasts in the frozen biomes excrete a very rare and mysterious liquid. The liquid's properties make it the perfect binding agent for our inks. I'm a southpaw so the prospect of not smudging my page is very exciting to me.
66945.progress: Have you gathered the Icy Excrements?
66945.completion: Thank you for your hard work. We can make fine ink with these.
66945.objectives: Gather 20 Icy Excrement from the ice spiders and ice bears of the Dragon Isles for Dothenos of the Valdrakken Accord.

66948.title: The Emissary's Arrival
66948.description:
I will admit that I have not left the Emerald Gardens in all my life, and as such, I have never met a centaur, let alone a mortal from the mainland.

However, I am not here for a kindly visit, but rather to plead for the centaur's aid in securing our oathstone and protecting our charge.

I am glad to see you are here to help as well. There is much to discuss.
66948.progress: The Green Dragonflight has lost much over the years. We need the aid of mortals where possible.
66948.completion: More friendly faces are welcome indeed.
66948.objectives: Learn about the situation in the Emerald Gardens.

66949.title: Trinket Bandits
66949.description:
The gnolls have quite a collection of trinkets. Tuskarr trinkets. They have either stolen them from our villages, or worse, from the brave tuskarr that fell in battle against them. These trinkets are our heritage and should reside with us.

If you bring some back to me, I will teach you the techniques that are used to make them.
66949.progress: Have you retrieved the Stolen Trinkets from the gnolls?
66949.completion: I recognize these trinkets. I remember those they originally belonged to. Thank you for returning them to us.
66949.objectives: Gather 10 Stolen Trinkets from the gnolls of the Dragon Isles for Temnaayu of the Iskaara Tuskarr.

66950.title: Heart of a Giant
66950.description:
There are various giants within the Dragon Isles that are rumored to contain beautiful gems at their core. We normally don't hunt the creatures of the Isles for treasures, but these giants have caused quite a bit of havoc.

We may as well collect these gems in the process of clearing out the destructive giants.
66950.progress: Have you found any gems from within the giants?
66950.objectives: Gather 5 Giant Cores from the mountain, ice, or molten giants of the Dragon Isles for Temnaayu of the Iskaara Tuskarr.

66951.title: Population Control
66951.description:
Recently there has been an overpopulation of a few different species on the Dragon Isles. In particular, the rockfang and the bruffalon.

We don't want to be wasteful, of course. Be sure to collect as much of the hides as you can from the creatures.
66951.progress: Have you dealt with the overpopulation and brought back some hides?
66951.completion: Thank you for handling the situation and for not wasting the hides.
66951.objectives: Gather 25 Salvaged Hides from the rockfang and bruffalon of the Dragon Isles for Temnaayu of the Iskaara Tuskarr.

66952.title: The Gnoll's Clothes
66952.description:
The gnolls are a constant threat, launching bloody raids and attacks against the expeditions and peoples of the Dragon Isles. So how are their clothes so clean?

After your battles with these raiders, could you collect a sample of their worn cloth for me to analyze?
66952.progress: Did you bring the Gnoll-Worn Cloth?
66952.completion: Thank you for these samples. On casual inspection it seems to just be wildercloth stolen from the tuskarr, but I'll have our tailors really examine the stitching to be sure.
66952.objectives: Gather 20 Gnoll-Worn Cloth from the gnolls of the Dragon Isles for Dothenos of the Valdrakken Accord.

66953.title: All Things Fluffy
66953.description: The tailors are always anxious to get their hands on that fluffy argali fur. The wool is especially useful for surviving in the freezing cold mountains of the Dragon Isles.
66953.progress: Did you get some of that Fluffy Fur?
66953.completion: So fluffy! Yes, this will do.
66953.objectives: Gather 20 Fluffy Fur from the argali of the Dragon Isles for Dothenos of the Valdrakken.

66957.title: A Shadow In The Ice
66957.description:
I've heard whispers while passing through Camp Antonidas. Talk of mutilated fauna being found across the icy steppes. Some nothing more than bloody splatters. 

Whatever it is, it's got the mages scared and made the local wildlife scarce.

Poke around the top of the glacier. If I was a betting dwarf, I'd say that's where any apex predator worth its salt would stake its claim.

Bring me a piece of it so we can soothe the Kirin Tor.
66957.progress: Be careful. Whatever this thing is, it's strong. And relentless.
66957.completion:
An ice giant? By Magni's bronze beard... And you're in one piece too! Impressive.

I'll show this to the Kirin Tor. Now maybe they'll get off our backs!
66957.objectives: Investigate the top of the glacier that overlooks Camp Antonidas.

66958.title: Protect And Herd
66958.description:
I was talking with some hunters out of Iskaara the other day, and they mentioned finding a grisly scene. 

Apparently, a particularly murderous rhino, Bloodhorn, has been goring the smaller bruffalon in the area. 

The bruffalon have enough competition in Azure Span without worrying about getting their herds thinned out by an invasive brute from out of town!

Bring me his horn. I'd like to make a good impression on our Tuskarr friends!
66958.progress: Remember: watch out for his hooves! That's how rhinos get you.
66958.completion:
Excellent job, {NAME}! This will go a long way in helping the bruffalon prosper and will hopefully show our Tuskarr neighbors we are also good stewards of this land.

We could learn a lesson from Bloodhorn. Just cause we're stomping through this beautiful place doesn't give us the right to do what we want with it!

Always leave the world better than you found it.
66958.objectives: Hunt down Bloodhorn east of Iskaara.

66959.title: Tour the Trading Post
66959.description:
<A flyer, carried by the wind, flaps into your hands.>

Rare antiquities from every corner of Azeroth! Fine goods fit for any taste!

You will not find these unique treasures anywhere else, friend.

Come see us at one of our outposts in Orgrimmar or Dornogal and gaze in wonder upon the mysteries in store for you!

--Zen'shiri Trading Post

<You squint to read the fine print.>

Be sure to present this flyer for some extra Trader's Tender!
66959.progress:
Welcome to the Trading Post. 

We have goods from all over Azeroth here for your collectin'. Please, take a look.
66959.completion:
Ah, ya brought in one of our flyers! As promised, here's some Trader's Tender ya can use in our shop.

If ya want to keep earning tender, then check out the Traveler's Log portion of the Adventure Guide to see what activities ya can do. Complete enough activities and we'll reward ya with tender and other amazing items.
66959.objectives: Collect Trader's Tender from the Collector's Cache and tour the Trading Post.

66963.title: Out For Delivery
66963.description:
I tried to tell Vevesi that I could pull the wagon out of the mud.

But, no, he insisted on using magic to get it out... And now look what he's done.

<Hauler Bennet sighs.>

While I try to talk sense into Vevesi, can you run up the hill to the Basecamp and let Cataloger Wulferd know that he might need to ship another crate of camera supplies over from Boralus?
66963.completion:
<Cataloger Wulferd laughs.>

Not a problem. I packed plenty of spare film in my carry-on.
66963.objectives: Tell Cataloger Wulferd in the nearby basecamp that his supplies won't be arriving anytime soon.

66964.title: Artifacts in the Wrong Hands
66964.description:
We've got a myriad, no, an incalculable number of problems here!

Oh man, where to start! 

The Kirin Tor uncovered a Sundered Flame plot. They're after an artifact called "Valthrux".

It's immensely powerful and... sentient? That's an exponential increase in danger if you're keeping track.

One Alia Sunsoar went south with a pair of tuskarr to investigate the Sundered Flame. She should have been back by now.

Please find her and stop the Sundered Flame from acquiring the artifact!
66964.completion: Finally, a stroke of good luck! We could really use a hand here.
66964.objectives: Locate Alia Sunsoar in the Lost Ruins within Azure Span.

66968.title: Pruning The Pack
66968.description:
<Nesingwary gestures to the side of the path.>

See those imprints in the snow? 

Yeti tracks. 

Something must of riled them up to hunt this close to the road. See if you can't hunt down their pack leader. We don't want them to start ambushing travellers! 

If he's a particularly mean brute, collect his head. That should dissuade the others.
66968.progress: Careful, friend. Yeti hunt in packs.
66968.completion:
Whoa! Talk about a mean mug... I'm glad you made it back alive! 

As unsavory as making an example of it is, keeping the yeti off the roads is best for them.

And us.
66968.objectives: Hunt down Yetor near Ronin's Shield.

66969.title: Clans of the Plains
66969.description: While you wait for the emissary to arrive, Sansok Khan is interested to hear how meeting the clans went. She sent me to find you and tell you to meet her in the center of Maruukai to discuss.
66969.progress: <Sansok Khan smiles at you, welcoming you back.>
66969.completion:
<As Sansok Khan signs, Okir vocalizes for her.>

While there are many clans of various sizes throughout the plains, Shikaar, Teerai, Ohn'ir, and Nokhud hold the most power.
66969.objectives: Report to Sansok Khan in Maruukai.

66971.title: The Face of Death
66971.description:
Tell me, friend. Have you ever seen the face of death?

<Nesingwary pauses for dramatic effect.>

What am I saying? Of course you have.

Death, after all, has many faces. 

I've heard tell from the Imbu tuskarr that one of its faces lives up in these hills. To even say its name is to invite a violent, frigid death:

Frostjaw.

<Nesingwary looks around warily.>

Well, now you have to hunt it--for my sake at least!
66971.progress: Don't dawdle about. I'm in mortal danger now!
66971.completion:
You're alive!

Ha ha! I can't imagine what kind of fight that beastie put up when you cornered him. Azure Span's a little safer thanks to you!

Do me a favor and check on my da...
66971.objectives: Hunt down Frostjaw north of Winterpelt Hollow.

66972.title: Old Stonetusk
66972.description:
I have a grim task for you, $p. Not every kill is a measure of skill. Some are measures of kindness. 

There's an old bull mammoth wandering the forest east of Camp Antonidas. I saw him from a distance awhile back, and I hear his sad trumpeting every so often. Clearly he's in great pain.

He's started crashing blindly through the undergrowth, and I'm worried he's becoming a danger to others. 

It'd make my old heart glad if you put a fellow weary soul to rest. Bring me his tusk so we can honor him.
66972.completion:
This brings me no joy.

But I'll hang his tusk in a place of honor.

Thank you, {NAME}.
66972.objectives: Put Old Stonetusk down near Camp Antonidas.

66997.title: Nursery Direction
66997.description:
I'm so grateful that Lasztak has accepted the Calling of a Whelptender! Especially given how many of the precious little things are teething right now.

Beyond that, the nursery gardens are admittedly facing challenges. The whelps are stressed and the tenders are--well, more stressed than usual.

Please, whenever you have a spare moment, find me in the gardens below. We could use your help as well!
66997.completion: Thank goodness you're here! You may have noticed the bees on your way in. We must do something about them!
66997.objectives: Meet Vaeros in the gardens of the Ruby Life Pools.

66998.title: Fighting Fire with... Water
66998.description:
In all my years of tending to the lava elementals, I have never seen them act like this! We can barely keep them contained to the cave.

Do you have a minute to spare? We'll hold the exit while you thin their numbers inside.

Here, take this bottled water elemental with you.

I always carry a few spare bottled water elementals when I'm looking after the lava elementals. Natural enemies make for good distractions!
66998.completion: Thank you for a moment's respite. A caretaker's work is never done.
66998.objectives: Kill lava elementals in the Erupting Cavern.

67004.title: Good Things in Large Boxes
67004.description:
Our efforts have created everything we need to open an Earth-Warder's Vault. There are several beneath the Citadel. Locate one and I will reward you.

I have crafted chains to help move it. If you bring the Vault here, we can share in the riches.

Watch for the Vault being moved, as I have dispatched others to find them as well.
67004.completion: Excellent work, {NAME}. With any luck we can open additional Vaults soon!
67004.objectives: Locate an Earth-Warder's Vault for me. If you bring it back, we can share in the loot.

67007.title: Archival Assistance
67007.description:
<The crisp, clean lettering, written with an elegant touch, fades quickly into the parchment's wet, smudged ink and a smell reminiscent of spilled, fermented beverage.>

ADVENTURE SEEKERS, ARCHIVAL ENTHUSIASTS--

The archives call to those who seek answers, yearn to discover, and those who wish to reveal secrets of the past, and perhaps, the future!

This request is not for the faint of heart, nor those of wavering will.

Only curious and brave adventurers need apply.

- Kemora
67007.completion:
<Kemora turns gracefully to address you. Before speaking, with a smile upon her face, her eyes follow your being from the ground upon which you walk moving upward, slowly, until your eyes meet in a calming gaze.>

Is it answers you seek as well, {race}?

I am ready to speak if you are up for the challenge.
67007.objectives: Speak with Kemora at the archives in Valdrakken.

67011.title: Tale of an Adventure: Molten Core
67011.description: So, you want to tell me a story of your adventure?
67011.objectives: Tell Elder Poa of your adventures in Molten Core.

67033.title: Assemble the Defenses
67033.description:
The Primalists have been hunting the Kirin Tor since we arrived in the Azure Span. They detest our practice of arcane magic.

I'll send word to Kalecgos to return from the Azure Archives. In the meantime, we need to hold them off.

It seems one of our main arcane defenses was destroyed in their initial attack. Bring the pieces back to me and I can reassemble it.
67033.progress: Do you have the pieces? I remember exactly how it was assembled, so repairing it should not be a problem.
67033.completion: Excellent. I'll begin the ritual to fix this in a moment.
67033.objectives: Recover 3 pieces of the Arcane Blaster.

67035.title: Preservation of Knowledge
67035.description:
Greetings, {race}. I am Althanus. I wish we could have met in a less... chaotic time.

We were helping the Kirin Tor study the history of this place just a few moments before the Primalists attacked.

I fear several tomes may still be out there, at risk of being destroyed in this dreadful assault.

Please, you must recover these tomes! If they're destroyed, the history of this place will be lost.
67035.completion: What a relief! To lose all that knowledge... I could not bear the thought.
67035.objectives: Find 4 Ancient Tomes scattered around Camp Antonidas.

67036.title: Wrath of the Kirin Tor
67036.description:
I've assembled the pieces of the device you recovered. 

Place it near Khadgar and use it to repel the Primalists! 

We just need to hold out a little longer until Kalecgos arrives.
67036.progress: Just hold out a little longer...
67036.completion: I am relieved that the attack was repelled... but it seems we will need to figure out a plan to help Kalecgos in the Azure Archives.
67036.objectives: Use the Arcane Blaster to help Khadgar defeat the primalists.

67044.title: Tale of a Hero: Yanikk
67044.description: Let me tell you the tale of Yanikk.
67044.objectives: Listen to the tale of Yanikk.

67047.title: Warm Away These Shivers
67047.description:
I believe the plant you're looking for has a fine, narrow stem and red leaves all about it.

You'll be hard-pressed not to run into any of those dastardly crawlers while you're collecting flowers though. I'd advise you steer clear when you can, or ready a sharp weapon when you can't.

And let your dragon friend know they can repay me in a cup or two of the stuff next time I'm in the city.
67047.progress: Steeped just right, coldsnap fills the drinker with warmth for hours to come.
67047.completion:
Ah! This is most certainly the Coldsnap Sagittate! My nostrils are exhilarated! 

Excellent work, {NAME}! I am positive our venerable guests will be gargling your praises with each sip of warmth imbibed. Let us not forget to do so with some of these delicious little cakes Morsel and Flemthroat made as well!

67050.title: Frostbite: Causes and Symptoms
67050.description: Elements live in the totems, {race}. Release them and break the ice. Free your tuskarr friends!
67050.completion: You did WHAT!? Bah... doesn't matter for now. This isn't over just yet.
67050.objectives: Place the totems to release the trapped tuskarr hunters in the Azure Span.

67051.title: Dragon Eyes
67051.description:
We know the djaradin will attack us directly, but I'm worried about other dangers out there as well. Ones that aren't so obvious.

I have dispatched three dragons to survey the surrounding area and pinpoint any potential threats.

Meet with each of them. Collect their reports for me. Once you have gathered this information, return to me so we can best prepare for what the djaradin are planning.
67051.completion:
Thanks to you, we will be better prepared for anything the djaradin plan to throw at us.

We will always keep our eyes open.
67051.objectives: Speak with Baskilan, Vazallia, and Zepharian in the nearby areas.

67053.title: Give Peace a Chance
67053.description:
Light be with you, $p.

This expedition is under the protection of both the Horde and Alliance. Our orders are clear: give aid to any members of the expedition, regardless of their other allegiances.

The Horde's representatives, Warlord Grimaxe and her daughter Shuja, stand guard on the other side of camp.

I fought with Warlord Grimaxe against the scourge. She is noble and will serve this expedition well.

Go offer her your assistance. Show her that the Alliance honors its commitments.
67053.completion:
<Warlord Breka Grimaxe salutes your approach.>

Captain Garrick proves her honor once more by sending you to me.
67053.objectives: Introduce yourself to the Horde representatives.

67063.title: 10,000 Years of Roasting
67063.description:
Spices? Oh! Ya must be with da big 'ol dragon cook. Da one with a little duck chef on her head.

Djaradin collect up a powder, Spicy Lava Spices, off da fiery elementals down below. 

Don' you look at me like dat! It's what da Djaradin be calling dem, not me!

Good luck down there. I wouldn't go alone if was you.
67063.progress: I wish I could talk with one the Djaradin cooks. They must have their own rich culinary history! If only it did not include eating my fellow kin...
67063.completion:
Do those not smell absolutely marvelous!

Let us give these meats the Aspect treatment! We will have premium cuts marinated, roasted, skewered, and served straight to your mouth. You'll swear your taste buds were never satisfied before!

67064.title: Rambling Delight
67064.description:
Oh, Rumiastrasza! Myself and the dryad sisters, Celina and Felina, had a lovely evening cooking for her.

The kelp we ate is a unique strain called Glimmering Ramblekelp. Swarms of frillfish devour them all along the coast. I wouldn't be surprised if they attack you while you're plucking their food from the sea floor.

Please give the chefs my best when you see them. They're always welcome here in our sanctuary.
67064.progress: I have been tantalized by the smell of fresh berries all day. It has been a most incredible afternoon, {NAME}.
67064.completion:
Yes! Glimmering Ramblekelp! The delicious, vegetal taste from the Shady Sanctuary.

I must say, the aroma of it brings me back to my youth. I became friends with a most humble guard of an Emerald Dream portal, and was enchanted by the variety of strange ingredients growing near his post. This kelp gives off the same, sweet hints of that glorious realm I remember from back then!

Thank you, {NAME}. You have gifted this old chef a side of nostalgia with her meal today.

67065.title: Future-Fresh Fungi
67065.description:
A delicious mushroom? Alternate futures are not pantries to be raided for midmorning snacks.

But still... I would be lying if I said I had never dreamed of eating Rumi and Morsel's cooking again.

Very well! You have my permission to pass through the portal, though I advise you to find others to travel with.

My wardens have mentioned these dark mushrooms to me before. Apparently, they never stay in the same place for very long. Make of that what you will.
67065.progress:
Morsel went so long with telling me about this amazing fungi!

What else are you keeping from me, you wonderful little chef, you!
67065.completion:
These... are... MAGNIFICENT!!

Never have I seen such incredible fungi! I must be sparing in my use of these. Or not! Who knows!

I am also glad to hear that the good Captain Sinjoirmi is faring well. It would please me beyond measure to cook for her again in the future.
67065.objectives: Capture 7 Time-Blasted Trufflettes from the Primalist Future.

67066.title: Delights to Delve For
67066.description:
Rumi and Morsel?

Gosh, that was quite a long time ago now. Eating a fish with a dragon and duck chef duo sounds like the beginning of a tale Elder Poa might tell for the younglings. We'd be hard-pressed to forget such a happening!

The fish was a Savory Deviant Dealfish, a top Tuskarr favorite! They're rare, but found just off the coast here.

Fair warning - it's azuretooth mating season. Those bloodthirsty fiends will take a chunk out of you for messing with their favorite snack.
67066.progress: Morsel is an incredible angler. He does not even require a fishing rod!
67066.completion:
Oooh hoo! You smell that? Nothing fresher than fresh-caught right from the sea!

Morsel and I simply must spend another summer with the Iskarra. There is simply no better way to learn more about an ingredient than with the artisans that source them.

67067.title: Navigating the Leapmaize
67067.description:
There's a dragon chef in Valdrakken? Truly? I'll have to ask her to try my arclight bisque! It's an old family recipe.

I know the plant you speak of. It grows around streams here, but it's caused some problems.

The stalks of leapmaize seem to be a natural feeding ground for beetles and small salamanthars, which are, in turn, natural prey of the hornswogs. That's fine if you can spot them out in the open, but there's a few here that are incredibly stealthy.

I'd watch my back if I were you.
67067.progress:
I met Morsel while he was roasting an enormous hornswog over an open pit of coals. The mangy leaper had followed him from the Hollows all the way to the Life Pools before he and a few guards worked together to defeat it.

Of course, he shared the scrumptious meal with all of them in return!
67067.completion:
I tell you, {NAME}, the flavors produced by this leapmaize are truly revolutionary! Morsel says it has something to do with the active lava throughout the Shores and the unique soils it creates. 

I have found it best to believe in him in most all matters, culinary and beyond.

67068.title: Anything But a Breeze
67068.description:
Breezehunters?! Oh, those falcons have been a problem. Just the other day, our stable master, Marren, almost fell to her death trying to tame one.

She's pretty proud, so she blamed it on the breezehunter itself. Told me that if it didn't think her eggs were being attacked, it wouldn't have been so aggressive as to bully her off the cliff's edge.

I guess that means that you might find the eggs you're looking for out there? It was to the east, just around the mountainside here.
67068.progress:
Looks like you made it back with a few scrapes as well as the egg!

Worry not about your pride or anything of the like! Even a dragon of my size wouldn not want to take on a nest of them alone.
67068.completion:
Glorious!

Morsel and I will whip up a cake so divine your palette will swear it was in the afterlife. Imagine an experience that is lighter than air, tangy like a sunfruit, but with a crisp texture.

Prepare to feel like a breezehunter yourself!

67071.title: What a Long, Sweet Trip It's Been
67071.description:
{NAME}! Just who Morsel and I were looking for!

From the bottom of both of our winged-hearts, we thank you dearly.

We started The Ruby Feast to share the Isles' culinary culture with all of Azeroth's races, and to learn from them too. We had you running from one end of our beloved continent to another, but you helped bring our dream vision of these gatherings to each honored visitor and guest here.

As friends, we would like to give you a gift. Grab the top journal from our hoard behind the cauldron.
67071.progress:
Our hoard is just behind the cauldron.

Not to worry though, we lowered the sealing enchantment and deathly magical traps for you!
67071.completion:
Catch a fish for a mortal, they will eat for a day.

Teach a mortal to cook, they will eat for a lifetime.

Give a mortal your most prized recipe, they will think of you each time they make it. At least we hope you do.

<Morsel and Rumi smile at you like only good friends can.>

Come back any time, {NAME}! The meal is on us!

67073.title: Red Dawn
67073.description:
We've come so close to recovering our powers... should Raszageth succeed before our powers return, I fear that the timeways will bend to a dark future for all of Azeroth.

We must not allow this to occur, {NAME}!

Hurry, you must find and aid Alexstrasza before all is lost!
67073.completion: Razageth and her allies must be stopped!

67074.title: The Gift of Silver
67074.description:
Shortly before his passing, Keeper Tyr gifted us with a dragon scale forged of purest silver. We kept it in the vaults of Valdrakken during our absence, but I believe it is time to share it once more.

Though we have no idea the purpose for this memento, it has always been a symbol of unity and friendship to us. As a true ally to dragonkind, we would like to share it with you. Speak to me when you are ready, {NAME}.
67074.progress: What do you make of this, {NAME}?
67074.completion: I thank you, {NAME}, for being an ally we can trust with a matter this important.
67074.objectives: Speak to Alexstrasza to reveal Tyr's gift.

67075.title: The Magic Within
67075.description:
Intriguing. There are many mysteries living within this citadel that no one, save Keeper Tyr himself, understand. If we are to unlock this further we shall have to explore more of Tyrhold. 

I believe that the scale will draw out secrets stored within this place.

However. there is one complication. The guardians of Tyrhold are still... unstable. They may take your exploration as disruption and try to interfere. Take this conduit. It will help you should the guardians prove troublesome.
67075.completion:
This spark feels familiar. I was not aware of anything like it here in Tyrhold.

Most curious.
67075.objectives: Draw out hidden magic from consoles around Tyrhold to uncover the mystery of the Silver Scale.

67076.title: A Spark of Discovery
67076.description:
Though this spark is of peculiar origin, I sense it is familiar. I am not sure of its purpose, but I believe it may lead to your next step in unraveling this mystery.

Follow it and see if you can learn more of its purpose, while I see what else I can discover in the meantime.
67076.completion:
I sensed a great surge of magic emanating from Tyrhold all the way from Valdrakken. Its source must be this spark you have found. 

I wonder what it could mean...
67076.objectives: Investigate the Titan Spark in Tyrhold.

67077.title: Memories of the Past
67077.description:
This place is where we last saw our friend, Tyr.

We did not understand the circumstances by which he had to leave, only that it was for something important.

Though it may be difficult for our hearts to bear, I believe this spark called us here to witness that time once more. With Nozdormu's aid we may relive that moment and see if there was some other clue Tyr left behind for us.
67077.progress: Forgive me, {NAME}. This is still emotional for me.
67077.completion:
Though it is a sad memory, I am grateful for the chance to hear his voice again... if only through time.

Thank you for bringing us here, {NAME}.
67077.objectives: Speak to Nozdormu to witness the memory of the past.

67078.title: Parting Instructions
67078.description:
<The echo speaks with an ancient voice.>

To my dear friends, I apologize for my sudden departure.

But, I promise that you are not without my aid. I know that you have come upon the time of great need, but to ensure this gift does not get misused I must ask you to perform a series of tasks.

The first is simple: reactivate the forge within Tyrhold. The Silver Scale is the key.
67078.progress: You have a means to activate the forge?
67078.completion: It appears activating the forge is not so simple as you were led to believe.
67078.objectives: Place the Silver Scale at the forge in Tyrhold.

67079.title: Hard Lock Life
67079.description:
The security in the forge is stricter than in any other area of Tyrhold. This will be quite a challenge for us, {class}.

Only certain units around the citadel have the capability to bypass this security, and the protocols to unlock require more than one code in case of corruption.

These units will not want to relinquish their overrides, you may have to take them by force. Be careful, {NAME}.
67079.progress: I hope we have not disrupted Tyrhold greatly. May the Keeper forgive us.
67079.completion: Excellent, {NAME}. With these we can override the lockdown and complete the task Tyr left behind.
67079.objectives: Retrieve the Primary Security Disc and Secondary Security Disc within Tyrhold.

67080.title: Artisan's Supply: Dragon's Alchemical Solution
67080.description:
Are you looking for work, alchemist?

The Artisan's Consortium has reached out to me with a "crafting order" for my alchemical solutions. I am as curious as the next dragonkin to find out more about these business practices, but I am simply too busy.

Perhaps this is an opportunity for you, my apprentice. Create some alchemical solution by reclaiming your earlier concoctions, and bring it to Haephesta, just down the path.
67080.progress: How can the Artisan's Consortium help you today?
67080.completion: A delivery! Excellent. Good doing business with you, {NAME}.
67080.objectives: Use the Reclaim Concoctions recipe to create 2 bottles of Dragon's Alchemical Solution for Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

67081.title: Halls of Infusion: An Infusion of Materials
67081.description:
<The image of Tyr speaks again.>

You have reactivated the forge. The next task will not be as simple.

Transcribed within the scale are schematics for something I require you to forge. I have entrusted one of my watchers, Irideus, with the necessary materials for this task. They are of special origin, and only few of them are left in existence.

Seek Irideus within the Halls of Infusion, where I hope his careful watch has kept the facility operating in an orderly fashion.
67081.progress: Once you have retrieved the required materials you will be able to proceed.
67081.completion:
I trust everything was in order within the Halls of Infusion and that Irideus is doing well.

Now for the next task.
67081.objectives: Retrieve 10 Ancient Titansteel Ingots and defeat the Primal Tsunami in the Halls of Infusion.

67084.title: The Silver Purpose
67084.description:
<The echo of Tyr activates to your presence.>

Your task is at hand, my friends.

Cast the ingots into the fire and activate the forge. I have prepared the necessary procedures for you already.

The Silver Scale holds the schematic. Its purpose shall reveal itself to you.
67084.completion:
I cannot find the words to describe our gratitude to you, {NAME}! You have returned our long-lost friend to us!

In the absence of any further instructions he left, perhaps we can eventually find out what we must do next to restore his true self.

If we can...
67084.objectives: Place the Ancient Titansteel Ingots into the forge and finish the task Tyr has left behind.

67093.title: An Anomalous Shrine
67093.description:
My research team located a strange sanctum nearby. We were able to make out some writing on the outside of it--titan runes, to be exact--which we believe reference Aman'Thul the Highfather, leader of the titans, in several places.

We tried to inspect more closely but must have triggered the sanctum's defenses. A massive sand amalgam blocked us off and we narrowly made it out alive.

We aren't certain what it's protecting, but it must be important. Can you investigate?
67093.progress: This land is a sleeping giant. We ought to wake it with requisite caution.
67093.completion:
<Nozdormu peers searchingly at the sphere as you hand it over. The sands inside brighten and swirl under his touch.>

I had thought this to be lost in this timeline. Nothing ever remains so, it seems.

67094.title: A Dryad's Work Is Never Done
67094.description:
It is wonderful to see Valdrakken so lively again, but there are so many things that have wilted under thousands of years of neglect - not the least of which are all of the adorable little city critters! Alas, we don't have enough dryads to go around tending to them all. 

Say, how would you like to be appointed Honorary Valdrakken Dryad? Some of the city's cutest little friends have gone far too long without their preferred snacks. Won't you help me tend to them?
67094.progress:
Tut tut, Junior Dryad! Those critters won't feed themselves!

...Or, well, they could I suppose. But where's the fun in that?
67094.completion:
Oh, how wonderful! I bet they all have smiles on their cute little faces, beaks, snouts and whatnot. 

There is one more critter that needs our help, though, and I fear the situation is rather dire.
67094.objectives: Help Thalendra feed the many small animals of Valdrakken.

67100.title: A Gift for Miguel
67100.description:
$p, could you do me a favor?

I want to get a gift for my husband, Miguel.

He means so much to me, but I've been so busy lately that I haven't had time to make him anything. 

Could you help me make him something high quality?
67100.completion:
Fantastic! You're so swell!

Here, take this reagent bag as thanks. You can hook it into that extra spot on your belt. Oh, and if you need even more space, a skilled tailor can make you an even larger one.
67100.objectives: Talk to Thomas about quality, then gather 3 Fiery Spirits near Hornswog Hollow for Miguel's gift.

67111.title: The Ailing Apprentice
67111.description:
This mission was a mistake from the beginning. Alia Sunsoar enlisted our aid to keep the Sundered Flame from acquiring a dangerous artifact. We had tracked it down to these ruins.

But the Sundered Flame beat us here and the area is infested with ice spiders. Alia was badly poisoned, and I fear she will not last long without the antidote.
