I can make it, but I need venom glands from the nearby spiders. I'm afraid to leave her. Will you find some for me?
67111.progress: Do you have the venom glands I asked for?
67111.completion: Ah, wonderful! With these venom glands, I can brew an antidote for Alia. She'll be feeling better in no time at all.

67137.title: Professionally Equipped
67137.description:
Say, I heard from Haephesta that you're a working artisan as well.

We'd like to get you set up with some professional equipment. Free of charge. That's what business partners are for, right?

Talk to our tailor, Mahra Treebender, to get fitted.
67137.progress: Now, let us get you equipped.
67137.completion:
Here is your new equipment! Try it on!

You can equip this above your profession recipes.

Oh, and if you want more, look to your fellow crafters if you don't know how to make equipment yourself.

67142.title: Wyrm Food
67142.description:
It's hungry work, defending and fighting for the Obsidian Citadel, and dragons can eat a great deal. We need to replenish our stores.

Lurking beneath the hardened lava, squirming through the magma, are some very tasty worms. This may not appeal to you, but to a hungry dragon, they are delicious.

Take our servant Gulchak and use his pointer to direct him towards disturbances in the lava. He will attract the worms for you to harvest.
67142.progress: Have you found anything good to eat?
67142.completion:
<Voraxian taps his teeth together approvingly.>

Thank you. This will go a long way toward keeping our kin fed and healthy. We do not fight for our future on an empty stomach.
67142.objectives: Collect Lava-Charred Flesh from Crust Lurkers in the Emberflow.

67143.title: To Give One's Heart
67143.description:
Now that we have the elemental essence gathered, do you think you could put them in this bottle?

It's a simple recipe that you can craft the same way as any other recipe.

If you lost, or use up the high-quality reagents, you can always get more from the elementals at Hornswog Hollow.
67143.completion:
Wow, this is so sweet! Oh, Thomas is just a darling.

Look at this. So well-crafted. Did you help with this? If so, thank you, a thousand times thank you.

Give Thomas my sincerest thanks, would you?
67143.objectives: Craft a Heart in a Bottle |A:Professions-Icon-Quality-Tier3-Small:20:20|a with any crafting profession.

67154.title: Entropic Remnants
67154.description:
When an entity passes through the timeways, the sands of time can sometimes accumulate on their body. 

Typically, this sand dissipates in short order--but sometimes, the entropic fluctuations inherent in time travel can cause that sand to vitrify. In these cases, it becomes rather difficult to remove. I've ruined several good pairs of shoes this way.

Vitrified sand can be quite powerful for our purposes. It would be in best interest to reclaim as much of it as we can.
67154.progress: Have you had any luck? It's usually somewhat rare, but we've been seeing more of it lately.
67154.completion: An unexpectedly large haul. Perhaps those rifts are causing more trouble than we calculated.
67154.objectives: Collect 8 Vitrified Sand from creatures in the Shifting Sands.

67167.title: It's Time To Duel!
67167.description:
With my deck back, I can focus on recruiting new members to my club! I was thinking about asking the dracthyr...

Oh, that is another thing you can help me out with, {NAME}! 

I am going to be a bit busy trying to get other dragons to join and I really want to get the dracthyr involved.

Do you mind talking to them for me? Be warned; many of them have never played before.
67167.completion: Wonderful! Thanks so much for all your help {NAME}! With the new interest in Hearthstone I am sure we will get approval for the club!
67167.objectives: Challenge 8 dracthyr to a game of Hearthstone.

67174.title: Arcane Detection
67174.description:
Greetings! I am Miva Star-Eye, and I am conducting arcane investigations in this area. 

The Azure Span has magic all around it. Some of it is benign... while some can be quite dangerous. 

I've been tasked with ensuring no arcane energies reside in anything the tuskarr possess. 

We already had one incident in Camp Antonidas of a fishing box spontaneously combusting! 

Can you take my detector and examine a few objects here? I need to continue speaking with Julk over here.
67174.progress: Let's hope there's nothing out of the ordinary here.
67174.completion:
A toy boat that's a magical time bomb?

Oh boy.
67174.objectives: Investigate tuskarr objects in Khuri's Fishing Spot for signs of arcane magic.

67175.title: How To Stop An Exploding Toy Boat
67175.description:
I am loathe to part a child from their toy, but it would be a great value to the Kirin Tor to study how it absorbed so much arcana.

Then again... I do not want to slight our new tuskarr allies. I do have a wand that could dispel the magic...

Let's speak with Toolk's mother, then decide what to do.
67175.progress: The wand should handle any dispelling if we're not too late.
67175.completion: We did the right thing today. There will be more magical oddities to research, but this girl will not get more gifts from her lost father.
67175.objectives: Speak with Toolk's mother, then recover the toy boat.

67177.title: WANTED: Gorger
67177.description:
If you are going to be amongst the tuskarr, you would do well to lend a hand! 

As of late, a beast we call Gorger has been making its home nearby. 

More of its kind seem to be migrating to this area. This is something we can take advantage of.

Kill the Gorger and bring me its horns. We'll need them for building supplies to expand this outpost.
67177.completion:
Fine work! We'll put this aside for our future building plans. 

It is concerning Gorger and its kind have migrated down here, but we will make the best of it.
67177.objectives: Slay Gorger and recover its horns.

67178.title: White Eyes, Blue Dragon
67178.description:
$PC can you make sure the match happens as fairly as possible?

Setogosa is known for bending the rules to suit her whims. 

I would not wish to see Yumadormu lose due to cheating.
67178.completion:
Thanks for helping me out back there! If it weren't for you I don't think I'd have been able to beat Setogosa.

Setogosa will be fine, I'm just going to wait for her to cool down a bit before I reverse the reversal.

67221.title: A Head for Metal
67221.description:
To fully utilize the potential of the Earth-Warder's forge, you must learn the basics of creating Obsidian Seared Alloy. Only then can you follow in the footsteps of Neltharion's greatest smiths.

Bring me a piece of Crystallized Draconium found deep within the Cindershard Seam. Then I shall gift you the knowledge you desire.
67221.progress: Have you gathered what I require?
67221.completion: Your success has earned you this knowledge.
67221.objectives: Collect 1 Crystallized Draconium inside the Cindershard Seam.

67222.title: Darkened Clouds
67222.description:
The Primalists have infected Windsong Rise with their nonsense teachings. Our kin there are foolish to entertain their ideas.

If we assist with clearing this sacred ground of their presence, perhaps the other clans will come to our aid in time of need. Do you think you could assist?
67222.objectives: Clear out the Primalist presence from Windsong Rise.

67295.title: That's My Specialty
67295.description:
So, you've started taking up a specialization, eh? 'Tis a glorious thing to have an exclusive skill you can call your own.

As a member of the Artisan's Consortium, I would be delighted to help you on your journey to honing your specialization.

Have you a minute to listen to my words of wisdom, and perhaps learn something to help you on your adventures?
67295.progress: Aye, that's the gist of it, anyhow.
67295.completion:
Excellent. If you ever have questions about specializations, you can always talk to me again.

Now go out and hone your talents! Oh, and take this with you. I found it on my travels.

There is something mysterious about it. Perhaps the knowledge contained within can further your specialization training.

Thomas was telling me he met a master artisan the other day. Perhaps this master could help you unlock the secrets within?
67295.objectives: Talk to Miguel Bright about a professional specialization.

67298.title: The Wonders of the World
67298.description:
My husband Thomas has gained many insights from exploring these primal lands.

Perhaps following in his footsteps would similarly inspire you?
67298.completion:
Huh, this is really interesting! I guess you never know where you'll find knowledge.

Keep an eye out for any treasures like this. Maybe there will be more wisdom to find in the world.

And thanks for seeing this vista with me. It's really spectacular, isn't it?
67298.objectives: Find out how Thomas gains his artisan's insight.

67299.title: Drakes be Gone
67299.description:
The primalists have been ceaselessly attacking our camp with their drakes!

We've been able to keep them at bay with our shields, but we could use more aid in taking them out of the sky.

Use one of our blasters to take those drakes down!
67299.completion: Thank you, adventurer. Any reprieve we can get from these attacks is a welcome one.
67299.objectives: Use an Arcane Blaster to defeat 5 proto-drakes.

67605.title: Thundering Plains
67605.description:
There is a great storm beast which wanders this ridge. Many a Shikaar hunter has attempted to take it down, only to fall to its ferocity.

If you wish for some hunting glory, you may attempt to bring down the beast. Bring back its horn as tribute.
67605.progress: So, have you seen the beast?
67605.completion: Excellent work. Yours will be a tale to be told to our next generation of hunters.

67606.title: A Dryadic Remedy
67606.description:
While you were gone, I heard from a dreamhare that one of the local ducklings is feeling rather down in the dumps. Luckily, I know exactly how to fix that!

Whenever I'm feeling moody, I snack on something sweet and tasty! As an expert in cute, lovable creatures, I know that the same principle will surely apply here.

This particular duckling is fond of a local dessert known as a Tasty Hatchling's Treat. Won't you find one and bring it to the poor dear? It's the dryadic thing to do, after all!
67606.progress: Well, friend? How fares our ailing avian ally?
67606.completion:
Oh, thank you, {NAME}! We dryads are stretched so thin that it can be hard to see to every little bird or beast that roams these streets.

With your help, though, everything turned out splendidly! You make quite the useful dryad in a pinch! In fact, I may ask for your aid again some other time. There are always more adorable little creatures to attend to, after all!
67606.objectives: Acquire a Tasty Hatchling's Treat and administer it to the Despondent Duckling.

67700.title: To the Dragon Isles!
67700.description:
Great news, $p! The spearhead of our expedition has made landfall in the Dragon Isles.

Thanks to the efforts of yerself and other Dragonscale Expedition members, we've established a protected landing site and made contact with the dragonflight's embassy.

Are ye prepared to accompany us on our next voyage to the Dragon Isles?
67700.objectives: Ride the Rugged Dragonscale to the Dragon Isles from Stormwind Harbor.

67722.title: Break on Through
67722.description:
Toddy and Naleidea are preparing to head out. Meet at the Sealed Titan Facility in Thaldraszus. Apparently they've made a breakthrough.

Be sure to bring any pertinent information back for cataloging!
67722.completion: Ye made it! Just in time, too.
67722.objectives: Meet Toddy and Naleidea outside the Sealed Titan Facility in Thaldraszus.

67724.title: The Fending Flames
67724.description:
Kattigat and I came here to prove ourselves by stopping the Sundered Flame and recovering the Valthrux.

Now we're stuck watching over this elf after she takes a few ice spider bites. We haven't even fought the Sundered Flame yet, and the spiders may do us in before we can!

We need to keep them at bay. 

Thankfully, there's a natural way to repel them. Burning silk from their cocoons creates an aroma that repulses the spiders.

Grab some silk and I'll throw it on the fire. It'll keep them away!
67724.progress: Were you able to find any spider silk?
67724.completion: Great! This spider silk will burn for a long time.

67772.title: The Trouble with Taivan
67772.description:
Hello, friend. Welcome back to Maruukai. I am Selbekh, healer of Clan Teerai.

Are you good with animals, {NAME}? Perhaps the influence of a newcomer is just what I need.

Taivan here, while a very good companion, has become something of a burden on my clan. I'm afraid if we can't find a good use for him, I may have to send him away. Will you help me?
67772.completion:
What brings you to the Shikaar hunting grounds, stranger?

The Teerai would like us to train your bakar as a hunter? We do not usually accept such requests from other clans, but I will consider it. Her gift is quite generous, and a fully-trained beast of his size would be a sight to behold. I bet he could take down a bull mammoth all on his own!

Hmm... I will have to see him in action before I make my decision.
67772.objectives: Help Healer Selbekh prepare Taivan for training.

67921.title: The Hunting Hound
67921.description:
Go and hunt the nearby beasts with your giant bakar. The bigger, the better. I will observe from here, and decide if he is worthy of Shikaar training. 

Be warned, I will only accept the best.
67921.progress: Go and hunt the nearby beasts with your bakar. I will be watching.
67921.completion:
Your bakar, while massive and strong, does not seem to have the will to do what needs to be done in the hunt. He is too soft!

I will give him one more chance, but this is it!
67921.objectives: Hunt dangerous beasts with Taivan to prove he is worthy of training.

68084.title: The Gentle Giant
68084.description:
If Taivan is really as "un-ferocious" as Jadar says he is, perhaps he'll be better suited as a herding bakar! 

The Aylaag are expert argali shepherds, and aren't so proud that they require lavish gifts to help another clan. 

Please send Taivan to Shepherd Tevatei at the Mallakh, a spot between two hills in the south-west where they train their bakar.

Ohn'ahra, please let this work. If it doesn't, I'm all out of ideas.
68084.completion: Well hello there, newcomer. What can I do for you and your very large friend?
68084.objectives: Send Taivan to Shepherd Tevatei at the Mallakh to be trained.

68085.title: Shaping a Shepherd
68085.description:
You want me to train your bakar in shepherding? Well, that's certainly what we do here, but I've never trained one quite so BIG before...

The argali don't seem to be bothered by his presence, though, and they're very good judges of character. Trust me. 

I'm willing to give him a shot, but a herding bakar needs to not only be gentle, but smart, too. And if they aren't able to take charge of the herd, the argali won't obey them. It's harder than it looks! Go on and give it a try, I'll watch.
68085.progress: Go on and try to command Taivan to herd the argali. I'll be able to tell if he has the potential for it or not.
68085.completion:
Hmm... Taivan still seems confused. He just doesn't seem to be grasping this.

You did great, though! Are you in the market for a new career?
68085.objectives: Teach Taivan to herd argali at the Mallakh.

68087.title: Danger in Daruukhan
68087.description:
I guess there's nothing to be done but send you and Taivan back to Maruukai. 

Wait... who is that approaching? Not another stranger with a giant bakar, I hope!
68087.completion: Oh, {NAME}! Thank Ohn'ahra the messenger found you. We have our hands full here!
68087.objectives: Talk to the Teerai Messenger to hear Selbekh's urgent request.

68639.title: Prowling Polar Predators
68639.description:
The species we've been sent to study is the frigidpelts.

Their hunting grounds have been tainted by ley lines. Arcane energies leech into the water and into the plants... and into prey species like the slyvern.

But unlike other organisms, the frigidpelts survive the process and gain power from it.

They also become aggressive--which is a problem. Engage a few, and I will take notes on their strength and aggression. 

My report will help the Kirin Tor decide what to do for them.
68639.completion:
<She scribbles notes down in her journal.>

Yes... Yes, this is all very helpful. Hopefully the Kirin Tor will be able to use this information to help others afflicted by the arcane sickness.

68640.title: Sudden Isolation
68640.description:
We used to trade frequently with the Uktulut tribe in the Waking Shores, but they haven't been sending or accepting shipments for months now. Our letters have gone unanswered. Naturally, we suspect the worst.

Their chieftain, Tutaqan, has always been the reasonable sort. Somewhat prone to strong emotions, but I can't imagine anything terrible could have happened under his leadership.

Could you please check on them? If they need help, we'll happily provide.
68640.completion: You're checking on us? A likely story.
68640.objectives: Attempt to make contact with the Uktulut tuskarr.

68641.title: Mossing the Mark
68641.description:
Poor girl...

She must have gotten sick after eating something tainted.

Luckily, my grandfather was a druid and taught me how to treat arcane-based illnesses.

I don't have all the components on me, but we can make do with what's around.

First, I will need some drakmoss. It is a rare lichen that only grows on dragon bones.
68641.completion:
Oh! Thank you so much, {NAME}!

I may be a mage, but sometimes natural solutions are the most effective.

68642.title: Needles to Say
68642.description:
I want to help Sylvie, but I don't want to delay Cally any longer.

To give Sylvie the medicine, I need arcane-infused quills from the crystalpine. I'm sure they won't mind if you pluck a few off! 

And mind the bakar! They eat crystalpine and might get mad at you touching it. If you do have to defend yourself, you can collect some spines from them as well.

But... try not to do that, please.
68642.progress:
Be careful handling the quills! They are VERY sharp. Ask me how I know!

<Steria sighs>
68642.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. You didn't hurt yourself on the crystalpine, right?

68643.title: Vitamins and Minerals
68643.description:
I suppose I should have expected that Steria would be upset at me asking you to fight animals...

There are of course alternative research methods.

Take these vials and collect some water from the nearby ice crystals. 

I theorize that they contain minerals infused with ley crystal energy--and may be fueling the outbreak here.
68643.progress: Have you filled all the vials?
68643.completion:
Excellent, {NAME}. 

These samples should give us a more complete picture of how the outbreak is spreading.

68644.title: Sugar, Spice, and Everything Nice
68644.description:
There! Now I have all I need for Sylvie!

And just in time. I doubt she would have lasted much longer like this.

But... I need someone to help me. I'd ask Cally but... would you mind assisting me again?

Let me know when or if you're ready, {NAME}.
68644.completion:
I've healed her, but she is clearly still in distress.

Hm, I wonder if...

68794.title: Ally of Dragons
68794.description:
Your aid to the Dragon Isles has not gone unnoticed, {NAME}.

The Life-Binder herself wishes to show you something as a reward for your service to dragonkind.

Go and speak to her at the top of the tower. All the Aspects await you.
68794.completion: Thank you for joining us here, {NAME}. There is something we wish to show you.
68794.objectives: Speak to Alexstrasza at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken.

68795.title: Skyriding
68795.description:
One thing you may have already discovered about this place: the Dragon Isles are vast. 

Some of the drakes have an intense interest in exploring every corner and secret hiding place in this renewed land, even those places that are not readily reached from the ground. They are eager for a second set of eyes to aid them in their journey, and in trade will gladly bear a rider across the lands.

Speak with Lord Andestrasz, here in the Ruby Lifeshrine. He will explain more of what they intend.
68795.completion:
Let us get started.

Do not worry, the fancy maneuvers will come later.
68795.objectives: Speak with Lord Andestrasz in the Ruby Lifeshrine.

68796.title: The Skytop Observatory
68796.description:
Those are the basics of riding a drake! You are doing quite well.

Now, I would like to introduce you to some of the others involved in this adventure. We have made a home for ourselves over at the Skytop Observatory.

Celormu will be able to help guide you there. Speak to him when you feel ready to take to the skies!

See you there!
68796.progress: Are you ready for adventure today?
68796.completion:
I suppose I was so eager to show you our foundation here, I may have flown a bit too fast. My apologies!

There is not much to look at for the moment as it has been a long time since someone inhabited these terraces. However, we will make them our home once again.

Now, let us introduce you to everyone!
68796.objectives: Travel to the Skytop Observatory in Waking Shores.

68797.title: A New Set of Horns
68797.description:
Just as mortals do, dragons care very much about their appearance. Your drake is able to change as well, according to what you find and experience.

Speak to Glensera at the Rostrum of Transformation, and see for yourself!
68797.progress: Sometimes I wonder what I would look like with red hair. What do you think?
68797.completion:
As you explore the Dragon Isles, you will discover even more varied and unique appearances for your dragonriding companion. 

Both of you shall be able to travel in style! As one must, when exploring a new land. How else do you make the best first impression?
68797.objectives: Meet Glensera and use the Rostrum of Transformation to customize your drake.

68798.title: Skyriding Talents and You
68798.description:
Obviously, it is not just Glensera and myself that are invested in these adventurers. Lithragosa is also excited to help you hone your dragonriding skills, and you have already met Celormu which is excellent.

Your next stop is to speak to Lithragosa, who can show you what skills you can learn!
68798.progress: Have you found the dragon glyph?
68798.completion:
As you can see, those of us from the different flights have all come together to aid our drakes and yourself. We are all ready for adventure!

Of course, we have not yet convinced... or found... a member of the black dragonflight to join us. But some day they may!
68798.objectives: Speak to Lithragosa to see your Skyriding skills.

68799.title: Return to the Ruby Lifeshrine
68799.description:
And this is just the beginning of your dragonriding journey! 

Keep your eyes open for new adventures and experiences throughout the Dragon Isles, and be sure to visit us in any of our outposts.

For now, return to Alexstrasza to continue your exploration in these lands.
68799.completion:
Welcome back.

There is much more to do here, but know that you do not take to the skies alone.

68863.title: A Lost Tribe
68863.description:
Hi, {NAME}!

Murik wanted to talk to you about something real important back in Iskaara. You should go see what it is.
68863.completion: If you have a moment, {NAME}, I would be grateful for your help.

69093.title: A New Mystery
69093.description:
<Doc Nanners looks out of breath as he hands you a letter inviting you back to the Dragonscale Expedition Basecamp. He eagerly tries to explain.>

Sealed door. Titan secrets. Yes?

<Doc Nanners nods excitedly, awaiting your response.>
69093.completion: Might I intrigue you with tale of a mysterious sealed door?
69093.objectives: Speak with Naleidea Rivergleam in the Dragonscale Basecamp.

69094.title: Saving Centaur
69094.description:
The treachery of the Nokhud knows no limits! Only craftsmen live in the village of Daruukhan. They stood no chance against the raiders.

We desperately need your help, {NAME}. The Nokhud are still nearby, and we must tend to the wounded!

Search the village, and carry any survivors you find to me. We will triage and stabilize who we can!
69094.progress: We're overwhelmed here! Please, save anyone you can!
69094.completion:
That... that seems to be everyone!

Taivan! That was incredible! I had no idea he had this in him!
69094.objectives: Rescue injured centaurs in the village of Daruukhan.

69095.title: Homeward Hound
69095.description:
We have everyone stabilized, thanks to you and Taivan, but many of these villagers will need to heal for a while longer in Maruukai.

Why don't the two of you lead our train back? You are both the heroes of the day, after all!
69095.progress: We're ready to depart. Go ahead and mount Taivan when you're ready.
69095.completion:
And here we are. Home again, safe and sound.

I can't begin to express how grateful I am that you and Taivan arrived when you did. You saved many lives today!

69096.title: Taivan's Purpose
69096.description:
Do you see that young one, sitting by themselves over on the bank of the stream?

<She points to the northeast, where you see a young-looking Centaur staring at the water.>

Chimei lost both of their parents in the Nokhud attack. I have healed all of their physical wounds, but they have not eaten or said a word to anyone since we found them. They just sit and stare. 

This is beyond my skills, and I am at a loss. Will you try to talk to them, {NAME}?
69096.completion:
<Selbekh's eyes still glisten with tears.>

Taivan... So this is his true gift. 

How could I have been so blind? He is different from other bakar, yes, but he has proven himself a valuable member of Clan Teerai. He will stay by my side for the rest of his days, rescuing who he can, and healing who I cannot.

Please, come and visit us anytime you'd like! We are both truly grateful for all you have done for us!
69096.objectives: Try to comfort the centaur orphan Chimei.

69097.title: A Vault Unsealed
69097.description:
<Doc Nanners looks out of breath as he hands you a letter inviting you back to the Dragonscale Expedition Basecamp. He eagerly tries to explain.>

Loud dwarf. Serious elf. Ready for you. Yes?

<Doc Nanners nods excitedly, awaiting your response.>
69097.completion: It's great to have Toddy and Naleidea back. Now if I could only enjoy some peace and quiet in this tent...
69097.objectives: Speak with Cataloger Jakes in the Dragonscale Basecamp.

69855.title: A Climber's Calling
69855.description:
<Doc Nanners looks out of breath as he hands you a letter inviting you back to the Dragonscale Expedition Basecamp for training. He eagerly tries to explain.>

From Big Jeb. Good friend. Climb now. Yes?

<Doc Nanners nods excitedly, awaiting your response.>
69855.completion: You look like you've got the strength, but I wonder if you've got the gumption...
69855.objectives: Speak with Pathfinder Jeb in the Dragonscale Basecamp.

69862.title: Save a Slyvern
69862.description:
Now that she's healed, I think Sylvie wants to show us something. 

Our work isn't done yet, {NAME}! Let's see what's upsetting her.
69862.progress: A cave? Wait, I can hear something inside!
69862.completion:
It's faint, but I can hear what sounds like kits in the cave!

This is bad...
69862.objectives: Find out what Sylvie is upset about.

69869.title: A Cataloger's Paradise
69869.description:
<Doc Nanners looks out of breath as he hands you a letter inviting you back to the Dragonscale Expedition Basecamp for training. He eagerly tries to explain.>

Kind elf. Proud tiny-man. Many cameras. Yes?

<Doc Nanners nods excitedly, awaiting your response.>
69869.completion: There are incredible new specimens to catalog everywhere you look!
69869.objectives: Speak with Cataloger Coralie in the Dragonscale Basecamp.

69870.title: Pictures with Purpose
69870.description:
Pictures bring people together, $p.

Our catalogers are typically sent out in pairs for safety, and it has been lovely to see members of different factions and backgrounds working together in pursuit of knowledge on these incredible isles.

One such eager duo is currently charting one of the central rivers of the Waking Shores.

If you wish to aid our efforts, join them in cataloging the wildlife there.
69870.completion: I hope ya brought ya swim trunks. This river be lively!
69870.objectives: Meet Akunda the Cataloger and Gunner Fren near the Overflowing Rapids.

69888.title: Unusual Suspects
69888.description:
{NAME}, you're here. Good. Don't react, but our findings on the titan discs have just been stolen! Other than us, only the Sundered Flame know what we were up to in that facility.

I need ye to take this device and scan some of the suspicious members that have joined us recently. Reveal the spy and recover the data if you can. We cannae allow it to fall into their hands!
69888.progress: Be quick and be casual. Got it?
69888.completion:
They escaped? That's not good. The Sundered Flame have been one step ahead of us this whole time, and our one advantage has been lost!

Fortunately, I created a copy of these findings. I'm a betting gal, but even I've learned to hedge my bets.
69888.objectives: Scan Suspicious Explorers to reveal the spy.

69896.title: Disastrous Detour
69896.description:
I knew joining the Dragonscale Expedition meant venturing into dangerous territory. But I was not expecting to fight off elementals!

Our dig site at the Life Vault Ruins is in complete disarray! Stone monstrosities are rising up out of the ground! We called in an elementalist to consult, but I believe she will need all the help she can get.

Perhaps you can help her? Our camp is just across the river.
69896.completion: Thank you for coming! The Expedition is in desperate need of your help!
69896.objectives: Meet Elementalist Taiyang in the Life Vault Ruins.

69897.title: Behavior Analysis "Homework"
69897.description:
I need to talk to someone who knows proto-whelps. Like the ones that live in the Wild Preserve! 

Are they as angry as the big ones? Do they bite or breathe fire at you?

What if I... er... you petted a proto-whelp? Would they know that you're nice and trying to help them?

I'm asking for science, of course. Tyrgon always tells us to test our hippa... no... hypo... hmph! Hyppotatotoast... ugh! THEORIES!

I think they would like petting and it would make them feel good. Could you test that for me?
69897.progress:
Do you think a whelp would feel better if I petted them? I always feel better when I get hurt and mom takes care of me.

<Iyali looks around, avoiding eye contact.>

I know I'm not supposed to touch the animals. It's for my homework on, uh, proto-whelp behavior. And it's due, uh, soon. So...
69897.completion:
So, some proto-whelps like to be petted, but some don't? 

That's not good. What if this one calls its friends? Or what if it's mean? 

I mean, this lesson, uh, makes no sense! This, uh, homework is very difficult. 

Thank you for helping me. I'm sorry if you got hurt...
69897.objectives: Pet 3 Sleeping Whelps and report back to Iyali.

69898.title: Scientific Meat-thod
69898.description:
So, I have, uh, more homework... Professor Tyrgon's lessons are super tough! He wants us to find out what proto-whelps, uh, eat! Yeah...

I already know the answer! It's riverbeast meat! 

Can you bring me a piece of riverbeast meat? Some riverbeast meat would be a great "visual aid" for my project.

But it has to be a REALLY good piece, ok? Like... the ones from Pudgy Riverbeasts. One like a momma proto-drake would give their whelp to make them strong because, uh, it will make Mister Tyrgon happy.
69898.progress:
Mom says food makes everyone happy.

Maybe it will be friends with me then...

I mean, we'll all be friends! And Professor Tyrgon won't give me a bad grade if I make Riverbeast meat part of my project!
69898.completion:
Oh, wow! That's the most delicious-looking meat I've EVER seen! My project will get the BEST grade. The proto-whelp will definitely want this!

<Iyali's expression is suddenly filled with concern.>

Oh no! 

I mean, uh, everyone will lwant to copy me... for the project!

<Iyali smiles unconvincingly.>
69898.objectives: Collect 1 piece of Extra-Delicious Riverbeast Meat.

69899.title: Secret Research
69899.description:
I know.. I am acting weird. I'm sorry!

You probably guessed I am not being truthful.

I can tell you my secret... if you like. But you will have to promise not to tell the adults!
69899.progress:
We found this Injured Proto-Whelp in the Wild Preserve.

There was an evil Primalist attacking Proto-Dragons and... they hurt this poor little whelpling!

Please don't yell at us... We just wanted to help!
69899.completion:
They did what? Oh, these younglings... When will they learn? They could have gotten hurt--or captured!

This is very serious indeed...

69900.title: Identifying the Source
69900.description:
Judging by what the children have said, we might have a primalist prowling the Wild Preserve.

This calls for immediate investigation.

According to what other researchers have observed, Primalists like to steal eggs and whelps to infuse them with power and corrupt them. Those that don't acclimate to the process suffer a slow death... not that the primalists seem to care...

We need them out of the Preserve. Attend to that, and I will try to distract the children. They must not know of this.
69900.progress: Keep your voice down! Have you done what I asked?
69900.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}! I'm certain that was... unpleasant.

I'm sure you would prefer to limit your tasks to exploring and researching, but, unfortunately, we sometimes have to get our hands dirty protecting wildlife from those who endanger it.
69900.objectives: Slay the experimenting primalist in the Wild Preserve.

69901.title: Bring In the Expert
69901.description:
Did Iyali say how long this creature has been suffering? If it's too injured to eat, we need to treat it quickly.

Normally a Dragonscale Expedition camp would have everything I need to help this whelp, but getting supplies to the "frontier" here on the Dragon Isles has proven tricky. There have been significant delays in our supply routes.

But, fear not. The land itself will provide! If you bring me Sunlight Flowers, I can craft a soothing balm that will calm the drake so I can heal it.
69901.progress:
Sunlight Flowers are very useful resource.

Their petals and stalks have sedative properties which will ease the whelp's suffering while we heal it.
69901.completion:
Terrific, {NAME}. 

I hope these kids were able to learn something from you. 

Where did they get the idea we wouldn't help them? Helping wildlife is part of our mission. Maybe our pedagogy needs a review...

69902.title: Theory in Practice
69902.description:
{NAME}, I require your assistance...

I hope no one was expecting me to craft, subdue the whelp, heal, and teach these children all at once! Multitasking like that is certainly overrated. 

Now, you can start by using those flowers. I'll need a couple minutes to prepare myself to heal the proto-whelp. 

Hopefully, the children will find this incident... instructional.
69902.progress: Where on earth did they get the idea we wouldn't help them? I need to investigate this further...
69902.completion:
Great work, {NAME}! I hope the younglings learned a valuable lesson... or a memorable one at least. 

We will keep the whelpling here for a while as I need to ascertain the best occasion for returning it to Preserve.

I shall also make you an honorary Brave Researcher. Your commitment was essential for this creature's survival. I'll just advise you to tell me sooner if you see the children plotting something reckless again.

Now, if you excuse me, I must reevaluate my pedagogy. It's clearly not working.
69902.objectives: Assist Tyrgon to heal the creature.

69904.title: Suspiciously Quiet
69904.description:
Can you spare a minute, $p? I haven't heard from my two apprentices, Scrumpy and Tucky, in some time. 

This is concerning. 

I sent them to fetch us supplies for the inn. They couldn't have strayed too far...

Please find them, but I warn you... They're... quite the handful.
69904.completion:
<The young vulpera nervously puts his hands behind his back.>

Do we know you? Noriko said not to talk to strangers...
69904.objectives: Find Noriko's apprentices in Camp Antonidas.

69910.title: Where is Wrathion?
69910.description:
How unusual.

Ebyssian told us that Wrathion would be awaiting our arrival along with an ambassador for Alexstrasza the Life-Binder, Queen of the Dragons.

It isn't like a dragon to break a promise.

At least this eager drakonid is here to greet us. Would you kindly inquire into when the others shall arrive?
69910.progress:
Welcome to the Dragon Isles, friend!

... I think I may have already said that. No matter! I am just excited you are here!
69910.completion: I do not know! As I said, this is my first assignment... Let me think on what to do.
69910.objectives: Ask Sendrax when the dragons are expected to arrive.

69911.title: Excuse the Mess
69911.description:
I wish I knew more about how to welcome you to the Dragon Isles, but I'm only the sentry.

<Sendrax motions to the tower behind her.>

You could try talking with Ambassador Fastrasz in the visitor center. He might be able to answer more of your questions before the dragons arrive.

Mind your step in there. He was clearing out rubble last I saw.
69911.progress: Ambassador Fastrasz will be eager to meet you.
69911.completion:
The embassy is looking better already!

Is every {race} as helpful as you are? I can't wait to meet more.
69911.objectives: Help Ambassador Fastrasz restore the embassy.

69912.title: My First Real Emergency!
69912.description:
<Sendrax looks puzzled.>

I have never known the majordomo to be late to anything, much less THIS late to something THIS important.

Most unusual...

<Sendrax perks up at a thought.>

I could use my emergency signal flare to alert them to your arrival. Then they would come rushing to greet you immediately!

I've never fired my emergency signal flare before, though...
69912.completion:
Well then, {NAME}. What do you say? Do you fancy a fight alongside your newfound dragon acquaintances?

I assure you, there is no quicker way to earn their trust.
69912.objectives: Convince Sendrax to fire her emergency signal flare to alert the dragons of your arrival.

69914.title: The Djaradin Have Awoken
69914.description:
I wish we'd time for more pleasant introductions, but we can't all be Chronormu, can we?

I am Selistra, majordomo to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder, Queen of the Dragons.

Queen Alexstrasza asked me to convey her kindest regards and escort you to her at the Life Pools.

But I'm afraid I must ask for your assistance before we go meet her.

Our ancient rivals, the djaradin, have awoken from their slumber under the earth and have already assaulted a nearby outpost!
69914.progress: We must do whatever the majordomo asks of us.
69914.completion: The djaradin have awoken? This is not good, {NAME}...
69914.objectives: Receive your orders from Majordomo Selistra.

69915.title: Targeted Ads
69915.description:
Hi, hi, hi! You looking for a gig?

We're doing a BIG opening sale for our new Crafting Order service, and we need to draw attention! But the wind took my flyers and I think some of the local goats ran off with them.

Could you get my flyers back?
69915.progress: Whoo! Setting up a business is busy, busy, busy!
69915.completion: Thank you, thank you, thank you! You're the best {NAME}!
69915.objectives: Recover flyers from Forkriver and Meddlesome Goats.

69918.title: Shaking Our Foundations
69918.description:
Djaradin stonebinders are threatening to break the very foundations of the Citadel! They have to be stopped!

We haven't even had a chance to reclaim the Citadel as our own and yet it might crumble beneath us. We can't let that happen.

Do what you can, {NAME}... by that I mean kill them!
69918.progress: Have you saved the foundation of this Citadel?
69918.completion: I knew you could be counted on. I feel better knowing that the Citadel isn't about to collapse beneath our feet.
69918.objectives: Slay Stonewrecker Tokara, Molka the Grinder, and the elementals they have unleashed.

69919.title: A Craft in Need
69919.description:
You seem like a skilled crafter. Would you like to fill some crafting orders for fellow adventurers and get rich, rich, rich?

I'll tell you the rules of working with the Artisan's Consortium, then you can pick up Crafting Orders at any crafting station on the Dragon Isles!
69919.completion: Great, great, great! Keep it up. There's always more orders to fill!
69919.objectives: Speak with Azley to learn about filling Crafting Orders.

69923.title: A Primal Threat
69923.description:
Raszageth has wasted no time building up her Primalist forces.

The Kirin Tor have detected massive storms being unleashed at key points across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

The Primalists are unleashing the elements to add to their strength. It seems they plan to cause chaos not only in the Dragon Isles, but in the lands of the Alliance and Horde as well.

Seek out the enemy and study their methods. We have to stop them before it's too late.
69923.progress: I'm afraid this is only the beginning.
69923.completion:
It is good you thwarted their attack, at least for now.

<Khadgar examines the motes you brought him.>

Hmm, primal elemental energy. I will take this for further study.
69923.objectives: Gather 10 Motes of Primal Energy from enemies in active primal storm locations throughout Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

69925.title: Calming the Storms
69925.description:
These Primalists are relentless, unleashing elemental devastation across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.

You must show the same determination, {NAME}. It is the only way to stop them.

Find their next incursion, remove the enemies within the primal storm area before it is too late and foil their efforts.

We must protect Azeroth!
69925.completion: Well done. Let us hope that buys us time before their next incursion.
69925.objectives: Gather 10 Motes of Primal Energy from enemies in active primal storm locations throughout Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

69932.title: Every Life Counts
69932.description:
Making potions for Gelikyr means that I don't have time for my other duties.

A duck landed in my garden with a broken rib. I've tended to the wound, but her dressing needs replacing. And since you're so eager to help...

<Szareth shoves a list of ingredients into your hand.>

This is what you'll need. Bring the rest to me.
69932.completion:
<Szareth takes the extra pollen and linens, then looks toward their hut.>

Ducks have to contend with harpies further up the cliffside. The wounded land here, and I aid them how I can.

I hope this one will make it.
69932.objectives: Collect ingredients to replace Little Jetstream's dressings.

69933.title: Curiosity's Price
69933.description:
Look across the ravine, {race}. Primalists attacked Gelikyr Post days ago, and the battle still rages.

Those people need salves and stitching. I can make it for them, but my ingredients are running low. Since you've chosen to intrude upon my home, consider yourself volunteered.

Go to my garden and find the largest vine you can. Snap it from the root, then bring it to me.
69933.progress: Be quick. A fresh ingredient is a potent ingredient.
69933.completion:
The lasher attacked you?

<Szareth frowns, sniffing at your clothes. Their snout wrinkles in disgust.>

No wonder--you reek of blood. And not yours, I assume.

War truly engulfs the Isles.
69933.objectives: Take a cutting from the Stubborn Vine.

69934.title: Bleeding Hearts
69934.description:
The potions are ready--now to deliver them.

Take one crate to a small cave in the ravine below us. No one will be there to accept it, but you can trust it will be used well.

Take another crate to the infirmary in Gelikyr Post. An old friend tends to the patients there.

I... realize this is not your duty. Nor is it really mine. But you've been surprisingly helpful, and this medicine could save lives.
69934.progress: Excuse me, I don't have time to chat.
69934.completion:
Szareth wants to heal everyone, no matter the consequences. Rebels, Scalesworn, wildlife: each deserves equal care.

And while I might find Szareth's idealism galling, Gelikyr depends on their expertise.

So my thanks to Szareth--and you as well. These potions will be invaluable.

69936.title: Zambul, Head Vandal
69936.description:
Good work. Those desecrators cannot force any more of my ancestors to fight for them. But the brute yelling out their orders must be handled.

That is their overseer, Zambul. He must be stopped.

Take him down.
69936.progress: Did you give Zambul the end he deserves?
69936.completion: An initiate must not take pleasure in the death of another Maruuk. But Zambul makes that a challenge.

69937.title: Sylvan Succor
69937.description:
Ah, {NAME}, there you are! I've been looking all over for you.

Another of our local critters has been suffering from a distinct lack of affectionate treat-feeding of late. Won't you go and find them something sweet to snack on?
69937.progress: Well, {NAME}? Did you tend to the poor, hungry critter?
69937.completion: Another day, another delighted little friend! Excellent work, my Sylvan apprentice!
69937.objectives: Acquire a Tasty Hatchling's Treat and administer it to the Despondent Duckling.

69940.title: Sylvan Succor
69940.description:
Ah, {NAME}, there you are! I've been looking all over for you.

Another of our local critters has been suffering from a distinct lack of affectionate treat-feeding of late. Won't you go and find them something sweet to snack on?
69940.progress: Well, {NAME}? Did you tend to the poor, hungry critter?
69940.completion: Another day, another delighted little friend! Excellent work, my Sylvan apprentice.
69940.objectives: Acquire a Blubbery Muffin and administer it to the Anxious Eft.

69944.title: Chasing Storms
69944.description:
Well, that wizard certainly knows how to make an entrance, doesn't he?

We won't be able to set sail until someone gets those elemental storms under control.

Check-in with Storm Huntress Suhrakka. She's leading the expedition efforts to investigate the storms and can help outfit you with whatever gear you need.

While you handle that, I'll coordinate the rest of the preparations. At least it'll give me some time to read a few more volumes on dragon history before we set sail.
69944.completion:
These storms are wild, dangerous things. If you wish to confront them, you'll want extra protection.

In my years of hunting, I've gathered many things that helped ward against the wrath of the elements. Perhaps some of them may be of use to you as well.
69944.objectives: Speak with Storm Huntress Suhrakka at the zeppelin tower.

69946.title: The Master of Their Craft
69946.description:
While I was traveling through these plains, I met an old centaur in a cave up north. They had clearly mastered their craft and had wisdom to spare.

They helped me understand the knowledge I had gained from the Dragon Isles.

If you're curious about specializing in your profession, seek out the wisdom of this master. Khadin was their name, of Clan Teerai.
69946.progress: Patience, young one. Rest in knowing that there is much to learn, and that is acceptable.
69946.completion: If you truly seek my knowledge, you must prove yourself worthy of it.
69946.objectives: Seek out Master Khadin to learn their professional wisdom.

69950.title: Sylvan Succor
69950.description:
Ah, {NAME}, there you are! I've been looking all over for you.

Another of our local critters has been suffering from a distinct lack of affectionate treat-feeding of late. Won't you go and find them something sweet to snack on?
69950.progress: Well, {NAME}? Did you tend to the poor, hungry critter?
69950.completion: Another day, another delighted little friend! Excellent work, my Sylvan apprentice.
69950.objectives: Acquire a Celebratory Cake and administer it to the Sorrowful Slyvern.

69965.title: Quality Assurance
69965.description:
Are you looking for work, {class}?

I represent a new trade company, the Artisan's Consortium, which matches artisans and clients through our crafting orders network.

The Dragonscale Expedition placed an order for some enchanted mining tools. The tools are crafted, but we would like to test them before completing the order.

We will pay you for your services, of course.
69965.progress: Do the tools work as intended?
69965.completion:
Thank you for your help, {NAME}.

If you ever need items crafted, the Artisan's Consortium is here to provide.
69965.objectives: Test Haephesta's Tools on nearby geodes for the Artisan's Consortium.

69979.title: A Worthy Hunt
69979.description:
Wisdom is not gained. It is earned. If you wish to prove yourself worthy, you will do so in the manner of my people: learning as we act.

Find and hunt Thousandmile, the Elderbull, he who has escaped the hunt for generations.

From this, you will gain the wisdom you seek.
69979.progress: Do you return victorious? A great hunt comes with great reward.
69979.completion:
The path to mastery is slow but steady. Honor the journey.

If you seek additional wisdom, continue the good hunt. There will always be quests in the world, creatures to hunt and learn from.

And I shall be here to help you understand the knowledge you gain.

69980.title: Seavine: Fisherman Tinnak's Gift
69980.description: <You can see the poor fisherman's spectral hand is still gripping a thread woven of a very strong, yet light, kelp. Nunvuq in Iskaara might find a use for that.>
69980.objectives: Bring the seavine tope to Nunvuq in Iskaara.

69981.title: Customer Satisfaction
69981.description:
Hey {class}, got a tick to help with something?

Some of our favorite customers placed recrafting orders through the Artisan's Consortium, but we haven't heard back from them.

If you run into them, can you check to make sure they're satisfied with their purchases? Gotta keep customers happy, happy, happy!
69981.progress: <Mahra is whistling to herself as she crafts.>
69981.completion:
Oh no! Bless their soul... <Mahra looks over the equipment.>

It's all ruined. Spent too long in the elements. 

Here, take this and craft some new armor. Or speak with one of the Crafting Orders clerks next to me or in Valdrakken and have someone do it for you. I suggest something for your wrists or chest.

One other thing. The quality of these reagents isn't great, but you can always have your new equipment recrafted later to raise its quality.
69981.objectives: Ask the Artisan's Consortium customers if they are happy with their recrafting orders.

69992.title: Sigil of Storms
69992.description: <Someone with great knowledge of magic may be interested in studying a find such as this.>
69992.completion:
This is outside of my league, magic-wise.

But I'll get it to Khadgar. Continue to push back the Primalist threat.
69992.objectives: Deliver the Sigil of Storms to Storm Huntress Suhrakka in Durotar.

70025.title: Artisan's Supply: Draconium Sickle
70025.description:
You look like someone with nothing to do. How's about employment?

I have a crafting order to fill for the Artisan's Consortium for a draconium sickle. Now I could easily take care of this, but as an apprentice I think it makes more sense for you to take this one on.

Craft the sickle and bring it to the Ruby Lifeshrine, a draenei named Haephesta will pay you for it.
70025.progress: How can the Artisan's Consortium help you today?
70025.completion: A delivery! Excellent. Good doing business with you, {NAME}.
70025.objectives: Deliver a Draconium Sickle to Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70026.title: Artisan's Supply: Lava Beetles
70026.description:
Are you looking for work, herbalist? The Artisan's Consortium asked me to gather some beetles for their customers.

The land is plentiful, but not so much that I can simply step away and be back with their request.

But if you venture out, perhaps you could collect a few beetles on your way?
70026.progress: How can the Artisan's Consortium help you today?
70026.completion: A delivery! Excellent. Good doing business with you, {NAME}.
70026.objectives: Deliver 5 Lava Beetles to Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70027.title: Artisan's Supply: Surveyor's Cloth Bands
70027.description:
Are you looking for work, tailor? The Artisan's Consortium asked me to craft some wristbands for their customers.

While I appreciate that these explorers are trying to involve themselves with our weaving, I do not have time for such requests.

Perhaps you would be interested in taking on this project?
70027.progress: How can the Artisan's Consortium help you today?
70027.completion: A delivery! Excellent. Good doing business with you, {NAME}.
70027.objectives: Deliver Surveyor's Cloth Bands to Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70028.title: Artisan's Supply: Salt Deposits
70028.description:
Are ye looking for work, miner?

I was talkin' to Haephesta an' she says the Artisan's Consortium is needin' salt for their customers.

Noo I'd do it meself, but, well, I dinna want to.

Be a pal and fetch 'em for 'er, eh?
70028.progress: How can the Artisan's Consortium help you today?
70028.completion: A delivery! Excellent. Good doing business with you, {NAME}.
70028.objectives: Deliver 5 Salt Deposits to Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70029.title: Artisan's Supply: Runed Serevite Rods
70029.description:
You seem to have a magical touch, enchanter. Would you be able to help with an order I've got?

The Artisan's Consortium has requested several rods made of Serevite for a customer, but enchanting rods aren't quite my specialty.

If you're willing, Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine will compensate you for your time and effort!
70029.progress: How can the Artisan's Consortium help you today?
70029.completion: A delivery! Excellent. Good doing business with you, {NAME}.
70029.objectives: Deliver 2 Runed Serevite Rods to Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70030.title: Artisan's Supply: Quality-Assured Optics
70030.description:
Ah, an engineer! Excellent timing.

I've got some schematics to fix, but some tall lady came by asking for a set of optics.

You know how to make those, right?

Take 'em to the Ruby Lifeshrine when you have 'em crafted. I think she said she was with the Artisan's Consortium or something.
70030.progress: How can the Artisan's Consortium help you today?
70030.completion: A delivery! Excellent. Good doing business with you, {NAME}.
70030.objectives: Deliver a pair of Quality-Assured Optics to Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70031.title: Artisan's Supply: Chef's Smooth Rolling Pin
70031.description:
Are you looking for work, scribe?

I received an order from a company called the Artisan's Consortium.

It seems like a simple enough task for an apprentice crafter such as yourself.
70031.progress: How can the Artisan's Consortium help you today?
70031.completion: A delivery! Excellent. Good doing business with you, {NAME}.
70031.objectives: Deliver a Chef's Smooth Rolling Pin to Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70032.title: Artisan's Supply: Jeweler's Specs
70032.description:
Are you looking for work, jewelcrafter? The Artisan's Consortium asked me to craft some spectacles for their customers. 

Me! Like I have time for this.

You can do it, yeah?
70032.progress: How can the Artisan's Consortium help you today?
70032.completion: A delivery! Excellent. Good doing business with you, {NAME}.
70032.objectives: Deliver Sundered Onyx Loupes to Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70033.title: Artisan's Supply: Pioneer's Leather Boots
70033.description:
Are you looking for work, leatherworker? The Artisan's Consortium asked me to craft some boots for their customers.

Clearly they don't understand my popularity. Do you know how many explorers have come through today complaining of holes in their shoes?

If you have the time, take these measurements. Perhaps this Artisan's Consortium could be a promising business opportunity for you.
70033.progress: How can the Artisan's Consortium help you today?
70033.completion: A delivery! Excellent. Good doing business with you, {NAME}.
70033.objectives: Deliver Pioneer's Leather Boots to Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70034.title: Artisan's Supply: Salamanther Scales
70034.description:
Are you looking for work, skinner? The Artisan's Consortium asked me to gather the scales of a salamanther for their customers.

I may be an artisan, but I am no one's errand child!

But... ah, perhaps you could find some?
70034.progress: How can the Artisan's Consortium help you today?
70034.completion: A delivery! Excellent. Good doing business with you, {NAME}.
70034.objectives: Deliver 3 Salamanther Scales to Haephesta at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70040.title: Tumbling Through Time
70040.description:
When the magic of Bronze and Infinite collided, it sent Chronormu and Eternus into an uncontrolled tumble through time.

As they fall, they rip the fabric of time itself, sending out countless ripples across time and space. We must locate them and bring them back. Only then will we be able to stop any further damage. I see that you will be the one to stop Chronormu's fall.

I would ask that you to gather the allies you will need to save Chronormu, while I focus on her magic.
70040.progress: Quickly. Even we do not have time to waste.
70040.completion: If we work quickly, I believe we may be able to catch her.
70040.objectives: Gather your allies and then speak with Nozdormu.

70041.title: The Storm-Eater's Fury
70041.description:
Raszageth is attempting to rip all the arcane magic out of the tower so she can destroy it!

Kalecgos is doing what he can to hold her back, and I am using my magic to try to replenish the ley energy.

I fear we will not last much longer. As we speak, more Primalists make their way up here to overwhelm us!

Take my modified Arcane Disc. Hold off the incoming Primalists... and let us hope for a miracle.
70041.completion:
Raszageth has fled, Vakthros is stabilized... and more blue dragons have arrived.

I think we can rest for a moment now.
70041.objectives: Ride Khadgar's flying disc and hold off the Primalist army.

70042.title: Opportunities Abound
70042.description:
Ya scared me, thought I was nabbed!

Look at all the brave explorers ready to conquer the Dragon Isles... packs bulging with tools and equipment.

We could get rich here!

Check around see if you can grab a few items, and I'll cut you in on the profits.
70042.progress: You find what we was looking for?
70042.completion: See, I told ya we'd make a profit.
70042.objectives: Acquire several items for Vish the Sneak.

70048.title: A Primal Threat
70048.description:
Raszageth has wasted no time building up her Primalist forces.

The Kirin Tor have detected massive storms being unleashed at key points across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

The Primalists are unleashing the elements to add to their strength. It seems they plan to cause chaos not only in the Dragon Isles, but in the lands of the Alliance and Horde as well.

Seek out the enemy and study their methods. We have to stop them before it's too late.
70048.progress: I'm afraid this is only the beginning.
70048.completion:
It is good you thwarted their attack, at least for now.

<Khadgar examines the motes you brought him.>

Hmm, primal elemental energy. I will study this further.
70048.objectives: Gather 10 Motes of Primal Energy from enemies in active primal storm locations throughout Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

70049.title: Calming the Storms
70049.description:
These Primalists are relentless, unleashing elemental devastation across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.

You must show the same determination, {NAME}. It is the only way to stop them.

Find their next incursion, remove the enemies within the primal storm area before it is too late and foil their efforts.

We must protect Azeroth!
70049.completion: Well done. Let's hope that buys us time before their next incursion.
70049.objectives: Gather 10 Motes of Primal Energy from enemies in active primal storm locations throughout Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

70055.title: Sigil of Storms
70055.description: <Someone with great knowledge of magic may be interested in studying a find such as this.>
70055.completion:
This is outside of my league, magic-wise.

But I'll get it to Khadgar. Continue to push back the Primalist threat.
70055.objectives: Deliver the Sigil of Storms to Storm Hunter William in Stormwind.

70058.title: Friend on the Mend
70058.description:
Happy Duck got hurt while we were flying around... He was doing so good and then I... I hit a tree!

<Lillistrasza gestures mournfully at the damaged duck plushie on her head.>

His stuffing is falling out! His feathers are all bent! One of his eyes is gone! Noooo!

You can help fix Happy Duck, right?
70058.completion:
Yes, yes! These materials should be plenty to repair your Happy Duck, young one.

<Mahra smiles at you.>

Thank you for bringing this important matter to my attention, {NAME}. It should only take me a moment.
70058.objectives: Collect 5 Soft Ruby Feathers, 3 Scraps of Fabric, and 1 Glass Bead from around the Ruby Lifeshrine to help repair Happy Duck.

70061.title: Training Wings
70061.description:
The dragons were gone from the Isles for quite some time, $p. To tell the truth... some of our skills have atrophied as they were passed down from generation to generation.

These whelps should be easy to teach, yet we are having some trouble wrangling them.

Say.

I have seen that even Majordomo Selistra trusts you with the most crucial tasks. Would you lend us your aid and help one of our young?
70061.progress: Some whelps need more encouragement than the rest. Of course, we love them all.
70061.completion: It is good to see our young flying with such joy and liberty in their hearts. Thank you for helping them achieve that.
70061.objectives: Guide a whelp to eliminate 12 Agitated Weedlings, 6 Intrusive Pupstingers, and 1 Relentless Gust.

70062.title: Some Call Me Bug Catcher
70062.description:
Ah, young {race}, I could use your help. I have raised generations of life here. 

None more my favorite than the ducklings. But my body has grown old and weak... still that does not stop the cycle.

I need you to catch food for my brood.
70062.progress: There is a beginning and end to all creatures. It does not matter how long or how short.
70062.completion:
Oh...  Back so soon?  It only felt like a moment. 

You got the good parts as well!

Firequackers and Pilot are going to love the chitin.

70069.title: Others Call Me Duck Herder
70069.description:
My days grow shorter... Still my duties are not done. 

The brood should all be by the creek. I leave them there hoping they will grow more independent. Soon they will have to fend for themselves.

Today they will rely on you. Please bring them the food you caught, and then the ducklings to me. Be wary of Pilot, she is always jumping off something.
70069.progress:
Be careful of Firequackers.  He will bite your finger. 

A surprisingly strong bite for such a young duck.
70069.completion:
My beautiful ducklings! You look so strong!

Pilot, come. Play time is over. 

<Pilot refuses to leave your side and tries to hide behind your legs. Until Gracus scoops her up.> 

Seems she likes you.
70069.objectives: Feed 4 ducklings and return to Gracus.

70070.title: But... I Am the Hero of Ducks
70070.description:
Hold on... there is something...

<Gracus looks around.> 

Firequackers! The boy must have gone down the river again! No matter how often I tell him, he always tries to play with the hornswogs!

I need you to go check on him. I hope he didn't get swallowed again.
70070.completion:
He was swallowed by the--

Firequackers still has much to learn. 

Pilot on the other hand has already taken a liking to you. The smartest of the brood and the one most ready to leave. 

For all that you have done, I thank you! Take care of my sweet duckling!
70070.objectives: Find Firequackers and make sure he gets to Gracus.

70122.title: Explorers in Peril
70122.description:
Don't mistake the expedition's scholarly pursuits as timidness, $p.

We are not recluses studying books in far-off towers.

We are adventurers, hunting down knowledge first-hand in every corner of Azeroth!

That same passion for adventure often leads us into the path of perils and hazards, and a few expedition members have bitten off a little more than they could chew...

But, hey, the danger makes it more fun!
70122.completion: The dragons are nae here to meet us like Wrathion said they would...
70122.objectives: Rescue 3 Dragonscale Expedition members in the Wild Coast.

70123.title: Primal Pests
70123.description:
<Azurathel glances suspiciously at the proto-dragons lurking on the ridge behind him.>

I'd swear that those proto-dragons edge closer to camp every time I turn my back...

Those are not the dragons Wrathion invited us here to meet.

Proto-dragons are ruthless predators who cannot be reasoned with. We must be ruthless in return.

Cull their numbers to keep their ambitions in check, or this expedition will be over before it begins.
70123.completion:
That may dissuade them from attacking the expedition camps for a time.

It's eat or be eaten in the Dragon Isles, {NAME}. You'd do well to remember that.
70123.objectives: Kill 8 Primal Proto-drakes on the Wild Coast.

70124.title: Practice Materials
70124.description:
The proto-drakes here are unlike any I've seen before.

Their scales appear to be naturally flame-resistant, stronger than steel, and don't lose flexibility in the process. Incredible.

The artisans are clamoring to get their hands on some to work with.

Start with the whelps. The smaller scales should be more pliable until we've mastered our techniques with 'em.
70124.completion:
<Thaelin carefully studies the scales.>

Brilliant. Our artisans'll have no problem puttin' these to good use!

70125.title: Where is Wrathion?
70125.description:
Hm, wonder where Wrathion is?

He said he'd be here waitin' for us with an ambassador for Alexstrasza the Life-Binder, Queen of the Dragons.

It does nae seem like a dragon to break a promise.

Well! At least this eager wee drakonid is here to welcome us. Can you talk to 'em and find out when the others are gonna arrive?
70125.progress:
Welcome to the Dragon Isles, friend!

... I think I may have already said that. No matter! I am just excited you are here!
70125.completion: I do not know! As I said, this is my first assignment... Let me think on what to do.
70125.objectives: Ask Sendrax when the dragons are expected to arrive.

70126.title: A Finishing Touch
70126.description:
Ah, $p, good to see you. 

You've been an exceptional help for the Artisan's Consortium, and to Thomas and myself personally. Thank you.

There is one more thing you should know as a crafter, and that's building a rapport with your clients.

I filled a crafting order for a customer today. Could you talk to him for me? Try to convince him to come to me for his future crafting needs. Remind him that he needs to come to me personally if he wants high-quality goods.
70126.progress: That's the secret, {NAME}: it's the little acts of kindness that add up in a relationship.
70126.completion:
Take these finishing reagents. Use them to increase your crafting skill when you really need something high quality.

Be kind and respectful to your customers and they will honor you with their business, {NAME}.
70126.objectives: Convince Miguel's customer to entrust him with future crafting orders.

70129.title: Toejam the Terrible
70129.description:
You're right, I'm not strong enough to take on this yeti... not alone! 

But you're here!

The lair of the evil yeti, Toejam the Terrible, is just ahead. This cave is... big. Not scary! Maybe a little scary. 

Could you go in there and soften him up a bit? I'll... I'll be right behind you!
70129.completion:
Goodness, what did you tell him? I've never seen Rowie so spirited!

Thank you for bringing him home. I will do my best to take care of him in Kaqiata's place.
70129.objectives: Help Rowie slay Toejam the Terrible.

70134.title: Memories
70134.description:
Thank you for listening to me, young one. I have a favor to ask. 

Don't worry. No more stories.

When we left this place, I left a... time capsule of sorts. Would you... would you be able to retrieve it for me? We left it at the bottom of the Ruby Life Shrine, hidden behind one of the pillars.

I hid it with a sigil. If you activate it, you should see my time capsule.
70134.progress:
I find myself oddly... excited? 

Apparently I am looking forward to looking through the time capsule, how... Unexpected.
70134.completion:
Thank you, young one, you have given me a lot to think about. 

It seems like I put this in the time capsule. I don't think I have much use for it anymore, maybe it's useful to you?

70135.title: Encroaching Elementals
70135.description:
The crafters, artisans, and explorers of the Dragonscale Expedition are ill-suited to the vigors of battle.

But not you and I, $p.

Here in the Dragon Isles, let us use that strength to protect those who can't protect themselves.

Clear out the elementals encroaching from the north, so that the expedition can focus on their noble pursuits.
70135.progress: These elementals are unlike any I've seen before...
70135.completion:
For the Dragonscale Expedition!

<Warlord Grimaxe salutes you.>
70135.objectives: Kill 15 primal elementals in Wingrest Embassy.

70136.title: Haven't Got Time For the Pain
70136.description:
Ugh... One moment...

My first assignment... Unstable temporal energy seeping into the forest... Affecting the wildlife... Need to assess the impact and collect that magic for the Timewalkers...

<Zera shakes her head a moment.>

I was examining a pack of vorquin when I was attacked by a crazed bear overflowing with time magic. It caught me off guard. I barely escaped.

Could you find my missing gear for me, {class}? Uh, you might also have to deal with that bear.
70136.progress: Were you able to find the them?
70136.completion: Thank you, for recovering all that valuable equipment {class}.
70136.objectives: Retrieve the Timewalker Staff, Timewalker Notes, and slay the Crazed Alpha in the Flowing Forest of Thaldraszus.

70139.title: Where There's a Ward, There's a Way
70139.description:
This reservoir used to be protected by three warding stones placed by Tyr. 

They were meant to stabilize the elemental magic that is prevalent in the Dragon Isles. 

When you woke me, I sensed damage done to the west ward. I fear the Primalists may have done this to all of them. 

Still, we must assess the damage done in order to figure out what we should do next.
70139.progress: We must find out the extent of the damage done to the warding stones. I can already feel the elemental energy growing out of control.
70139.completion:
As I suspected. It is imperative that we find the missing keystones.

Otherwise the losses that Zuttiki and I have suffered would be for nothing.
70139.objectives: Assess the damage done to the ward stones in Tyrhold Reservoir.

70148.title: Without Purpose
70148.description:
Could I have a moment of your time? 

I'm worried about another dracthyr that passed through here. He asked my associates and me all kinds of questions, but seemed... disappointed with our answers.

He called himself "Talon Ethrethi". I believe that makes him quite junior amongst your ranks?

I got the sense that he could use a hand. Mind helping me keep the peace?

I saw him talking with Kholmar over there.
70148.progress: Any news on this Ethrethi fellow?
70148.completion: You've raised the spirits of not just Talon Ethrethi, but the entire camp! It's not every day someone finds a new lease on life...
70148.objectives: Search for Talon Ethrethi in Wingrest Embassy.

70154.title: A Gateway to Somewhere
70154.description:
The enchantment will protect us from the unstable energy contained within.

I will open the way to the nearest stone. 

Once you pass through, stay close. I shall need your assistance when we arrive to power up the device.
70154.completion:
Not quite what I expected, but we have arrived in one piece.

I must admit, with all that has happened I am even more curious about the potency of the vessel's contents now more than ever.
70154.objectives: Follow Warpcaster Delandra to the Waygate's location.

70155.title: Look, Listen, and Breathe
70155.description:
Hail, {race}. Few stop to say hello, let alone stay for a time. Most are in a rush to their next destination.

Would you like to fish with me?
70155.progress: If I could tell my younger self one thing, I'd say: try fishing.
70155.completion: Return whenever you like, young one.

70156.title: An Ancient Awakening
70156.description:
The waygate sits just behind me. There is no way to tell how long we have until the waning enchantment on this vessel fades, or even worse, breaks.

That amount of unstable energy being released could be catastrophic. 

Shall we continue?
70156.completion:
Now that we, and by we I mean you, have figured out what these things are fer there's no tellin' how many more are out there!

Keep yer eyes open, {NAME}. No tellin' what we might find around the Isles.

70159.title: A Taste of Home
70159.description:
Oh, finally! Another dracthyr to lend a hand.

My brother and I have been trying to cook up some rations to eat, but...

<Scaralesh gestures to his surroundings.>

Everything is so different around here. It's hard to find the same ingredients we used to cook with.

But we can adapt. Go ask the Horde if they have anything we can substitute for vegetable matter, protein, and emulsifying fluid. Then we'll really have a meal.
70159.completion:
They don't look much like they did back home, but we {race} are resourceful. We'll give it a try.

Who knows, maybe it'll end up being even better.
70159.objectives: Ask around members of the Horde at Dragonscale Basecamp to see if they can loan you the ingredients you need.

70164.title: A Tinker's Chance
70164.description:
If you have a moment, $p, I am close to a breakthrough!

After the creche collapsed, I lost more than my ability to fight. I lost my identity as a dracthyr. Perhaps you can understand.

I have always enjoyed putting things together and taking them apart, so Expedition seemed like a good fit for me. But this artifact is giving me some trouble.

Would you ask Phosildral and Sibrit to review my notes? I want to prove I am a capable tinker... to them and to myself.
70164.progress: I almost have the orb where I want it, but I need just a little more time.
70164.completion: Our history is complicated, {NAME}, but I am eager all the same to unravel what we were meant to be... and what we will become. It is in our talons now!
70164.objectives: Speak with Chronomancer Phosildral and Sibrit Clacketpage in the Life Vault Ruins.

70166.title: The Joy of Painting
70166.description:
Do you like my collection? These are all the work of the greatest painter that ever lived, Hudson.

They're rare and probably valuable--he's a recluse and hasn't painted anything in awhile. Oh, but I'd love to meet him... Or to learn from him!

You... seem like the bold type. Would you find him for me? H-here! Take some of my work with you. Maybe he'll be impressed!

Or maybe he'll think I'm terrible... oh dear.
70166.objectives: Deliver Rauvros' Painting of Introduction to Hudson.

70168.title: Sad Little Accidents
70168.description:
You came all this way... I'm sorry.

My dear Hudson used to love painting. It was his life! I don't know what's caused this block. 

A few weeks ago on his way back from a painting trip, he took all his unfinished paintings and threw each away in a fit of rage. 

Please, traveler, if you don't mind... could you find them? They may just give him back the spark he needs. 

Hudson does not shy away from dangerous places to find the best vistas. I hope you are prepared.
70168.completion:
What? What have you done?

Why would you bring me this garbage?!
70168.objectives: Recover Hudson's Lost Paintings from the final bosses of the Ruby Life Pools, Nokhud Offensive, and Brackenhide Hollow dungeons.

70169.title: Even Trees Need Friends
70169.description:
I know you and Ran are simply trying to be helpful. 

I don't think there's any helping me. My spark--my will to paint--is simply... gone. 

But Ran is right. I owe you at least to try.

Bring this budding artist friend of yours to me.
70169.progress: All I need is a chance to prove myself.
70169.completion:
I cannot believe it! A chance to learn from the master himself!

Oh, goodness... I do hope he likes my work.

70170.title: Beat the Demons Out of It
70170.description:
He can be very stubborn, I'm afraid.

But I can't just give up on him. We'll just have to try again! 

There are more paintings still out there he threw out. These were in even more dangerous locations, so I hope you are up for the challenge!
70170.completion: Again? Why must you keep bringing me these crimes against art?

70171.title: Happy Little Accidents
70171.description:
<Ranpiata's eyes look damp.>

Is it me? Am I the reason he has lost his spark?

He says he loves me, but... you heard how not painting makes him feel.

I want what is best for him. If he is better off... I will go. 

There is one last piece he threw away. The last thing he tried to draw before giving up. 

I could not bear to see it go. I hid it away in our home. Please... bring it to him... as a memento.
70171.progress:
What a strange tuskarr. How does one get so stuck in their own head? 

Is this just what being an artist is like? Will that happen to me too? Oh dear.
70171.completion:
This all seems a bit much for me. I just wanted to learn to paint from a master!

But... it has made me think about what my art means to me a bit more. 

I think... maybe I'm done with painting. 

I'm just going to leave my paints here... maybe try something new...

70174.title: The Shikaar
70174.description:
Sansok Khan is the most skilled hunter in our clan. Though she cannot hear, she proved her capabilities time and time again as both a hunter and a leader.

She is a mentor to us all, a trusted leader, and a fierce defender of the Maruuk.

It is an honor for you to speak with her.
70174.completion: <Sansok Khan gives you a slight nod.>

70175.title: Broken Banding
70175.description: <This might be something Emila Bellocq is looking for.>
70175.completion:
Soft metals just don't withstand the elements.

<Emila shakes her head as she takes the band from you.>

 I will be sure this band is put away somewhere safe.
70175.objectives: Deliver the item to Emilia Bellocq.

70178.title: Expedition Supply Kit
70178.description:
Explorer, your discoveries have been invaluable.

There is even more out there to uncover and we have the tools to help you do it.

Come back to the Dragonscale Basecamp and gear up using the Expedition Supply Kit.
70178.objectives: Examine the new tools available in the Expedition Supply Kit at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

70179.title: A Two for One Deal
70179.description:
Greetings, adventurer! Say, you look like a capable person. Could you give me a hand?

Azkra and I are charged with watching over this tower, which is in what I like to call "an exciting state of pre-renovation." My problem is as we started repairs, the local earth elementals attacked us!
