So I thought "Zefren, why not take care of the earth elementals and get some building materials at the same time?" Which is where you come in! Could you help?
70179.progress: I have to say, I'm quite looking forward to being able to work on this tower once again, I might even put in a little plaque commemorating your help! You are still planning to help, right?
70179.completion:
Oh bother, these are quite a bit more crumbly than I was expecting. They look quite a lot more solid when they are launched at your head! 

Well. I'm sure I can use these for building regardless, thank you for your help! 

Maybe there are some mud elementals around here somewhere I can use to glue it together....
70179.objectives: Obtain Building Materials from the local Earth Elementals.

70180.title: Jump-Start? Jump-Starting!
70180.description:
Some folks in the city claim this here device was created by the legendary Titan Watcher Tyr. 

Problem is we can't get it to work! We tried all the usual tricks, dissemblin', gyroscopin', a little mild electrocution. None of it sides the electrocution worked. Actually... I just had a great idea.

See that gyrocopter over there? Hop in and let's see if we can give this titan thing a little more... juice.
70180.objectives: Help Greyzik power-up the mysterious device.

70181.title: First Challenge of Tyr: Finesse
70181.description:
<As you approach, the inscription on the statue emits a faint glow.>

"Wield the Keeper's power and carry its light to a better future for us all."
70181.completion: Admirably done. You have earned your reward.
70181.objectives: Complete the first Challenge of Tyr in the Azure Span.

70182.title: The Sweet Taste of Victory
70182.description:
There is great potential in small things. The Bottled Essence may feel light as a feather, but it holds immense power. 

Take it to the Engine of Innovation.
70182.completion: Can you feel the potential emanating from the bottle?
70182.objectives: Return to the Engine of Innovation in Valdrakken.

70183.title: Specialized Secrets: Alchemy
70183.progress:
What wisdom do you seek?
Dragon Shard of Knowledge (1)
70183.completion:
Patience, young one. There is still much to learn.

But you may celebrate today, for you understand more than you did before.

70184.title: Specialized Secrets: Blacksmithing
70184.progress:
What wisdom do you seek?
Dragon Shard of Knowledge (1)
70184.completion:
Patience, young one. There is still much to learn.

But you may celebrate today, for you understand more than you did before.

70185.title: Mysterious Beast
70185.description:
<You find a large pawprint sunk into the dirt. Looking around, none of the nearby creatures have paws, let alone of that size.

Perhaps the centaur will be impressed if you hunt this great beast.>
70185.progress: Do you return from your hunt?
70185.completion:
<Tomul looks the pelt over before offering a small nod.>

You defeated Konkhular, then. Not bad, two foot. He has evaded our hunters for many moons. His pelt always blended in well with his surroundings. Perhaps now our hunters can use his camouflage to their own advantage.
70185.objectives: Find and slay the beast, then bring back proof to Scout Tomul.

70186.completion:

70192.completion:

70193.completion:

70194.progress:
What wisdom do you seek?
Dragon Shard of Knowledge (1)
70194.completion:
Patience, young one. There is still much to learn.

But you may celebrate today, for you understand more than you did before.

70195.title: Taken By Storm
70195.description:
According to reports, the Nokhud were accompanied by an outsider wielding never-before-seen magic. This outsider tore through our ranks like a tempest. 

If the Nokhud have allies who can wreak this much havoc, we must find out as much as we can about them.

I have sent my ohuna, Altan, to find this outsider. She has not flown back, and I am concerned. {NAME}, can you search for clues about this outsider and see what has become of Altan?
70195.progress: I have my suspicions about the identity of these new Nokhud allies, but I must be sure.
70195.completion:
So, we are at war with both the Nokhud and the Primalists. Now it is even more critical that we get Ohn'ahra and the dragons on our side.

Thank you for your assistance, {NAME}, and thank you for saving Altan.
70195.objectives: Rescue Altan and search for clues about the outsider.

70197.title: The Call of the Isles
70197.description:
Are ye ready for the adventure of a lifetime? I know I sure am!

Our allies have gathered and supplies are loaded. So what're you waiting for?

Meet me at the Stormwind docks. It's time to set sail for the Dragon Isles!
70197.completion: Ye sure look ready. Let's get underway!
70197.objectives: Meet Toddy Whiskers at the Stormwind Harbor.

70198.title: The Call of the Isles
70198.description:
Our allies gather in Durotar. This is a very exciting time!

Join us, {NAME}! It's time to set sail for the Dragon Isles!
70198.completion: I am so excited! Are you ready to begin our adventure together?

70199.title: Catch and Release: Scalebelly Mackerel
70199.progress:
If we over-fish this spot there will be no fish left for anyone. Sustainability is key.

Bring me any fish you want to return to the pools.
Scalebelly Mackerel (20)
70199.completion: I will return these to the pools. Managing the fisheries is an important responsibility.

70200.title: Catch and Release: Thousandbite Piranha
70200.progress:
If we over-fish this spot there will be no fish left for anyone. Sustainability is key.

Bring me any fish you want to return to the pools.
Thousandbite Piranha (20)
70200.completion: I will return these to the pools. Managing the fisheries is an important responsibility.

70201.progress:

Aileron Seamoth (20)
70201.completion: I will return these to the pools. Managing the fisheries is an important responsibility.

70202.progress:

Cerulean Spinefish (20)
70202.completion: I will return these to the pools. Managing the fisheries is an important responsibility.

70203.progress:
If we over-fish this spot there will be no fish left for anyone. Sustainability is key.

Bring me any fish you want to return to the pools.
Temporal Dragonhead (20)
70203.completion: I will return these to the pools. Managing the fisheries is an important responsibility.

70204.title: Golden Claw
70204.description: <This might be something Emila Bellocq is looking for.>
70204.completion:
The dragonflights definitely had an affinity for gold, didn't they? It's everywhere! And now we have it.

I'll make sure this goes under lock and key.
70204.objectives: Deliver the item to Emilia Bellocq.

70207.title: Tail Fragment
70207.description: <This might be something Emila Bellocq is looking for.>
70207.completion: It needs restoration... but it's fine craftsmanship. I will catalogue this one myself!
70207.objectives: Deliver the item to Emilia Bellocq.

70210.title: Tradition Not Forgotten
70210.description:
One tradition for the Aylaag as we stay at this camp is for our members to make the pilgrimage to the Eternal Kurgans to ask for journeys safe from that which plagued our ancestors. The presence of the Nokhud has made this pilgrimage perilous.

If you do not mind, I would ask you would uphold our tradition for us.
70210.progress: Clan Nokhud and Ukhel desecrate the spiritual land just by their presence.
70210.completion: I owe you much. It is hard to ask an outsider for help with something so important to our clan, but I do not see another option.
70210.objectives: Place incense and clear out ghostly beasts from the Eternal Kurgans.

70211.title: Stomping Explorers
70211.description: The influx of explorers to the Dragon Isles isn't letting up anytime soon. We need to replenish your stock of Explorer's Plate Boots. Even serevite can't withstand what is being asked of these boots. Get to work and see me when you have finished the job.
70211.completion:
This is fine craftsmanship. We will hear the lovely clang of more plate boots around here soon. 

Your skill is progressing well. Here is something you can study to improve your blacksmithing even more.
70211.objectives: Craft 2 Explorer's Plate Boots for Metalshaper Kuroko in Valdrakken.

70215.title: Curiosity is Key
70215.description:
My hesitation to discuss these symbols was not for a lack of trust in you, but rather the unknown nature of these symbols and the stones upon which they reside.

Yes, stones. Multiple, in fact. Scattered across the Isles.

<Warpcaster Delandra glances at you. A hint of curiosity and excitement glows in her eyes.>

You did not know.

Very well. Your persistence and willingness to seek me out shows that you are keen to understand your recent discovery. Perhaps it is time we discuss this at length.
70215.completion:
I have prepared a vessel which allows one to capture and store rampant energy.

This knowledge is not known to many. It would be wise to proceed with caution.
70215.objectives: Speak with Warpcaster Delandra at Camp Antonidas.

70220.title: Shady Sanctuary
70220.description:
We must inform the rest of the green dragonflight that the barrier to the Ancient Bough is under threat. Gerithus and I have much to discuss.

{NAME}, I will place my mark upon you. The other dragons who see it will know that you are my trusted messenger.

Go and rally my flight. They must know and prepare for the battle ahead.
70220.completion: My dragonflight is ready, then? Good. We will confront our enemies with everything we have.
70220.objectives: Speak to Guard-Captain Alowen, Sariosa, Sidra the Mender, and Viranikus.

70229.title: Boku the Mystic
70229.description:
The mystics were called away to Ridgewater Retreat a few days ago, but one mystic remains. His name is Boku. He can be found on top of the hill at the Ohn'ahran shrine.

He's just an initiate, but he should be able to commune with Ohn'ahra and acquire her blessing. With Ohn'ahra on our side, we might be able to win this war before it starts.
70229.completion: Who are you? Did Ohn'ahra send you?

70233.title: Axe Shortage
70233.description: A mix-up with orders resulted in a severe shortage of new axes for our explorers. We have an immediate need for more Draconium Axes and are looking for all blacksmiths to pitch in. In return, I will impart new Blacksmithing Knowledge to you to assist in making even more epic pieces.
70233.completion:
These will add to our dwindling stockpile nicely. 

Your skill is progressing well. As promised, here is something you can study to improve your blacksmithing.
70233.objectives: Craft 2 Draconium Axes for Metalshaper Kuroko in Valdrakken.

70234.title: All this Hammering
70234.description: The anvils have not been quiet since the Dragon Isles awoke. The anvils are doing fine, but our hammers are starting to crack. To keep up with the demand, we need to restock.
70234.completion:
You can't have enough hammers can you? 

Your skill is progressing well. Here, have this to study so you can continue to improve your blacksmithing.
70234.objectives: Craft 2 Draconium Blacksmith's Hammers for Metalshaper Kuroko in Valdrakken.

70235.title: Repair Bill
70235.description: The Dragon Isles have not experienced conflict like this in millennia. Our work is not in dispute, but any good armor suffers from all of this constant use. I have a big order for Serevite Repair Hammers and I need everyone I can get to fill it. If you help out, I will again give you more information to expand your Dragon Isles Blacksmithing skills.
70235.completion:
I haven't had this many repair hammers ready to go. Want to wager how long before our customers get through them?

As promised, here is this to study. You can always improve your blacksmithing.
70235.objectives: Craft 6 Serevite Repair Hammers for Metalshaper Kuroko in Valdrakken.

70236.title: Dislodged Dragoneye
70236.description: <This might be something Emila Bellocq is looking for.>
70236.completion: Oh... look at that sparkle! It's hard not to just... slip it in my pocket. But I won't. I'll put it somewhere safe that's not on my person.
70236.objectives: Deliver the item to Emilia Bellocq.

70239.title: Untold Regrets
70239.description:
Duroz is old, sick, and stubborn as a kodo. There was no stopping him getting on the airship to come here. Best I could do was come be his walking stick.

I've seen him in pain enough times on the battlefield to know when he's hiding it. He's been getting worse every day out here. Can you help me get him to the potion makers? Ale's not doing the trick anymore. 

If you can carry our weapons, I can help him walk.
70239.progress: I wish there was more I could do.
70239.completion:
<Bathoras frowns in concern as he looks over the old orc.> 

I will examine him and see what I can do.
70239.objectives: Walk with Duroz and Kolgar to find help.

70240.title: Pain Management
70240.description:
It is a good thing you brought him here when you did. I can tell he is in a great deal of pain, though he bears it well. So must we all when it comes time.

I am afraid that it is age that ails him and not illness, but I may be able to relieve some portion of his suffering.

Would you mind gathering some snapflowers, shallowlilies, and pure water from the garden nearby? I can create a pain medicine with these components, if you find enough.
70240.progress: Was the dragonspawn... willing to make anything?
70240.completion: <Duroz takes the potion from you with a small, sad smile. He almost looks disappointed by something.>
70240.objectives: Gather 5 Milky Snapflowers, 3 Blooming Shallowlilies, and a Filled Life Pools Vial.

70241.title: The Bitter End
70241.description:
It just happened. I--He was sleeping and I looked away and-- We came back here every day, he just wanted to sit with the whelps, I didn't know he--

<Kolgar's face is clearly tear-stained. He rubs his eyes with the back of his hand.>

No, I knew. I knew. But I don't know what to do now. What do I do with him?

Can you-- Can you find Bathoras?
70241.progress:
Oh, greetings once more, {NAME}. 

I have been able to make a few more batches of that medicine with all the herbs you brought me. 

Duroz began refusing it earlier today, but I may be able to find other uses for it.
70241.completion: I see, then. Sometimes there is little that can be done.
70241.objectives: Bring Bathoras to Duroz and Kolgar.

70242.title: Life After Life
70242.description:
I could sense that his friend bore a deep scar. Something in this place reopened it--perhaps so that it could heal cleanly this time.

Now it is Kolgar's time to heal.

In the terrace above us, you will find my friend Trellain working with the enchanters. Tell him that I require one of the vessels he uses in his work. He will give it to you freely.
70242.progress: Were you able to find Trellain?
70242.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. This will be suitable.
70242.objectives: Collect an Inert Vessel from Trellain in the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70268.title: Memories Revived
70268.description:
You found a partially destroyed diary. It appears to be written from the view point of a young black dragon woman, before the corruption. 

While the back part of it is illegible, skimming through the first part, a name stands out to you. Veritistrasz.
70268.progress: Hello young one, nice to see you again.
70268.completion: Oh? What's this? A Diary? I wonder what's in it.

70299.title: Draconic Defensive
70299.description:
I've heard words on the wind of outsiders allying with Clan Nokhud in an effort to defeat our dragon neighbors. These Primalists are a blight on the plains of our ancestors.

Slay them, and bring me the cores of the elementals they command.
70299.progress: The dragons and our kin have long held peace. This threat to such cannot be ignored.
70299.completion: Hopefully that keeps Aylaag safe from the dragons' ire. Unfortunately we cannot offer anything beyond this meager assistance.
70299.objectives: Slay primalists in the Storm Scar.

70319.title: Nergazurai
70319.description:
My uncle told me many tales of his battle with a hornstrider named Nergazurai. He told me of its fuchsia scales weaving through the hills of the plains as it seeks its prey, its razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.

While I was out hunting I saw the flash, but it was too late; it left me with a nasty bite in my shoulder. He was as terrible as my uncle described, but I came out alive.

I need to clean the infection from his bite. Please, collect the reagents I need. Time is of the essence.
70319.progress: My fever grows worse, friend. I fear if I do not clean the infection soon, it will be the death of me.
70319.completion:
Thank you. With these reagents I should be able to stop the infection from spreading, then hopefully clear it completely. I owe you a life-debt.

Be wary of Negazurai, traveler. His thirst for blood is unyielding.
70319.objectives: Bring an Ottuk Heart, a Rockfang Femur, a Hornstrider Scale, and a Vulture Gizzard to Muqur Rain-Touched in Timberstep Outpost.

70337.title: Emberwatch
70337.description:
Hail, outsider.

The winds tell me of a group taking shelter in the ruins of Emberwatch. They seem only interested in the past while we centaur choose to live for the present under the grace of Ohn'ahra.

Nonetheless, they are guests in our home. I have fashioned for them these wind chimes so they may hear Ohn'ahra's presence. May it bring their hearth some joy and comfort.
70337.completion:
What's this?

How fascinating. It must be an ancient artifact of great importance.

We will need some time to study it.
70337.objectives: Bring the Ohn'ir Wind Chimes to Emberwatch.

70338.title: They Took the Kits
70338.description:
If Sylvie is this distressed, that must mean it's her kits that are in there! 

While she was infected, the giants must have kit-napped her babies and she was too weak to save them.

Kits are energetic at this age, hopefully they've all been quick enough to evade the giants until now...

Here, make use of my invisibility charm-- Quickly, you must save them before they're eaten!
70338.completion:
Now that Sylvie is healing, these kits will be in good hands...

Er, paws...

Claws?

70339.title: In Tyr's Footsteps: The Ohn'ahran Plains
70339.description:
Though you have done well in your first challenge, do not think you shall surpass all so easily. Keeper Tyr meant the Engine of Innovation to be only for those worthy enough to use it wisely. 

If you are undeterred, the next challenge shall be found in the Ohn'ahran Plains. I look forward to testing your capabilities, adventurer.
70339.completion: <It feels as if the statue reacts to your presence, its mechanism slowly awakening and coming to life.>
70339.objectives: Find the Second Challenge of Tyr in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

70341.title: Well-Earned Victory
70341.description:
The smallest of things can contain the greatest of treasures.

Take the essence to the Engine of Innovation.
70341.completion: Can you feel the potential emanating from the bottle?
70341.objectives: Return to the Engine of Innovation in Valdrakken.

70351.title: Garden Party
70351.description:
I've been tending to this garden for years, preparing for the day I'd finally accept my Lifecalling. Now that day is here!

I love flowers and all trees and plants--even the bugs that live amongst them. I can feel nature's spirit--the Great Dragon Spirit--when I tend the garden.

There's only one thing left to do. I'm going to invoke the Great Dragon Spirit, just like the legends.

<Akora smiles brightly.>

Meet me down in the garden by the pool where her bones rest. I'll explain more there.
70351.completion: Excellent! Now we can really get to work, {NAME}.
70351.objectives: Speak to Akora in the Ruby Life Pools.

70352.title: Scaling Ever Higher
70352.description:
You there, outsider! You have killed proto dragons before, yes?

So it stands to reason that your experience combined with my hunting prowess, we can take down quite a few! There are springs around here that attract draconic beasts. 

Help me prove to my foolish other half that I am the better hunter.
70352.objectives: Slay hornswogs and territorial proto drakes with Toluiqi.

70370.title: Occupation Examination
70370.description:
Hello! Are you interested in working with the Artisan's Consortium to earn plentiful profits and provide valuable goods and services to clients across Azeroth?

Excellent! Which two skills have you trained in?

...Hmm? You have only one profession? What a missed opportunity!

<Haephesta ponders for a moment.>

I know! I will ask you a series of questions about your personality, and we will find out together which second profession best complements your first one! How does that sound?
70370.completion:
I am glad we found a profession that suits you!

Best of luck in your training! Please return to the Artisan's Consortium when you are skilled. We have many opportunities for you!
70370.objectives: Take Haephesta's personality quiz to find out your ideal profession.

70371.title: Deathwingurlugull!
70371.description:
Deathwingurlugull! Deathwingurlugull! Deathwingurlugull delgrbrrl!!

Grrrooooooooom blarglg!!

<You don't need a translation to know that they want you to bring down their murloc version of Deathwing. Before you can agree or disagree, the roars of a machine engine make their way toward you!>
70371.completion:
Lrgktrr O'Glrlrlrl!

<The murlocs celebrate your deeds this day!>

70373.title: Deathwingurlugull!
70373.description:
Deathwingurlugull! Deathwingurlugull! Deathwingurlugull delgrbrrl!!

Grrrooooooooom blarglg!!

<You don't need a translation to know that they want you to bring down their murloc version of Deathwing. Before you can agree or disagree, the roars of a machine engine make their way toward you!>
70373.completion:
Frrg thrg Allrghnnge!

<The murlocs celebrate your deeds this day!>

70374.title: Himia, the Blessed
70374.description:
The Elements lay claim to this land and do not welcome our intrusion.

O, Elements, have you forgotten our protector--Air! Invisible, yet omnipresent and vital for all existence! Forgotten, as easy as you breathe it. After facing me, you will never forget again.
70374.completion: So you have witnessed Himia, the Blessed.

70376.title: Second Challenge of Tyr: Might
70376.description:
<As you approach, an inscription on the statue lights up with a faint glow.>

"Wield the Keeper's power and show the undaunted determination of one who stands strong."
70376.completion: Once again, you have done well and earned your reward.
70376.objectives: Complete the second Challenge of Tyr in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

70377.title: Derelict Fashion
70377.description:
<A disgusting set of sunglasses is dripping with slime, but they look extremely expensive.

Someone is definitely missing these. This style is very hot right now.>
70377.progress:
I cannot possibly be seen at the VIP area without my sunglasses!

You see, I grabbed a glider, and was getting some A-MAZ-ING pictures. I looked below, and saw all of these tiny elementals the size of ants! I thought, hah, ant-size elementals: what a great photo-op.

But when I got there, they were at least three times the size of ants. A muddy one chased me, but I am very fast.  I hate to think of what has happened to my sunglasses...
70377.completion:
My sunglasses?! You expect a reward, I gather. You know the least you could have done is clean them.

<Zeldis breathes on them, then wipes them off.>

I suppose I can throw a few small coins your way.
70377.objectives: Find the owner of the sunglasses.

70414.title: Shaky Grounds
70414.description:
In the name of Khaz'goroth, what goes on here? 

This magma works with a mind of its own, consuming these elemental cavestones from below. Tis more than chance causin' this... I aim to figure it out!

Place these Shattering Totems next to each trapped elemental to free them!
70414.completion: Good work, we will need elemental allies if we wish to solve the mystery of what is happening here!
70414.objectives: Place the Shattering Totems to free the trapped cavestones.

70437.title: To Tyrhold
70437.description:
Centuries have passed since the flights last visited Tyrhold. 

Nevertheless, we must travel there and investigate if the Mother Oathstone still functions.

Come, speak with me at the Seat of the Aspects. We must learn about the dangers we may face at Tyr's former stronghold.
70437.progress: It is good to see you, {NAME}.
70437.objectives: Meet Alexstrasza at the Seat of the Aspects.

70444.title: The Fields of Ferocity
70444.description:
To the bravest Shikaar! 

Gather your best and head on over to the Fields of Ferocity. You could be crowned the fiercest of them all!

Prove your might. Show us your best fight!

Terms and conditions apply.
70444.completion:
Hey, you're no centaur.

Ehh. You'll do.
70444.objectives: Meet Gurgthock at the Fields of Ferocity.

70446.title: A Personal History
70446.description:
In delving into the archives here, I've found threads that point towards the Obsidian Observatory as a place of personal importance to the Earth-Warder. I can only guess what knowledge it may contain about the history of our flight.

Given Emberthal's interest in the subject, I informed her of my discovery. I pray that wasn't a mistake.

She has gone ahead to scout. Please, keep an eye on her. She is a competent soldier, but this subject is... troubling. Who knows what truths you may uncover.
70446.completion: I am confident I will be able to handle anything we encounter. Still, given the matter at hand... it was wise of Edress to send you to accompany me.
70446.objectives: Meet Emberthal at the Obsidian Observatory.

70450.title: Otter Devastation
70450.description:
Hey there, friend. These here ottuks keep stealin' my catch!

Personally, I'd blow 'em up, but our Tuskarr friends don't seem too keen on that action. I made this here Ottuk Deterent Device MK-SH4RK, but... I aint a great swimmer.

You seem like you got the goods, why don't ya do us all a favor, activate the device, swimmy-swim around over there, and scare 'em off?
70450.progress: You get rid of them pesky ottuks yet?
70450.completion: 'Ey! Great job, buddy. Now let's chum these waters good!

70501.title: License to Hunt
70501.description:
Ah, finally ready to prove yourself as a hunter? Keep in mind this is not as simple as running around and hunting everything that moves. The Shikaar hunt with purpose. We hunt to feed and clothe the clan, to prove our strength against mighty foes, and to balance nature.

We do not hunt the land barren, we sow the seeds for future Grand Hunts as we go. Prove yourself capable of following these instructions and you may join us.

However I do not have confidence in your friend there succeeding.
70501.completion:
Excellent! You are ready to join the Grand Hunts! 

Please inform this Nesingwary Jr. that there is more to hunting than mindless killing and that he is unwelcome to join us.
70501.objectives: Complete the Grand Hunt training tasks.

70503.title: The Vigilance of Tyr
70503.description:
Bodies, broken gear, uncontrolled titan energy. What a disregard for safety, and... and protocol! It looks like they found the stone and it was unstable, bursting into pieces.

Fortunately, I'm particularly adept at repairing magical devices.

But before I can reform the stone we need to collect each and every piece.
70503.progress: I can't believe it. It's all here! Well done.
70503.completion: I'll head back to basecamp and have my people reconstruct this stone. Don't worry {NAME}, artifact restoration is our specialty.
70503.objectives: Recover the fragments of the stone.

70507.title: The Insight of Tyr
70507.description:
Did ya see Szar Skeleth on your way in? It's that ruined tower to the northeast.

We've got a bit of a good news, bad news situation there. The good news is the stone's already been found. Bad news is it was found by the Sundered Flame, specifically a magic-using dracthyr named Makko. And they're using it to control gorlocs.

Did I mention the dracthyr's misuse of the stone drove them mad?

Well, good luck!
70507.progress: Turns out gorlocs don't make for good bodyguards, eh? I wonder how dangerous she could've been if she held on to her sanity.
70507.completion: You've got it! Don't worry about me. We should be safe to handle it unless we try to do something crazy. Like mind-controlling little fish monsters.

70509.title: Third Challenge of Tyr: Persistence
70509.description: <It seems those who have reawakened with the Isles have not been kind to Keeper Tyr's creations. Perhaps finding the missing pieces of the statue would help.>
70509.progress: <As you approach, you can feel the warmth of Titan's energy flowing through the statue once more.>
70509.completion: Excellent work as always. I feel that Tyr's faith in the future was not unfounded.
70509.objectives: Retrieve missing parts and repair the broken statue.

70510.title: Victorious
70510.description: Once again I ask you to bring this essence to the Engine of Innovation.
70510.completion: Have you noticed that each bottle is brighter when you bring it here? It shows that you are meant to walk this path.
70510.objectives: Return to the Engine of Innovation in Valdrakken.

70530.title: Examination Week
70530.description: The students at Algeth'ar Academy ran out of solutions... again. Forgive me for asking, but could you gather more Dragon's Alchemical Solution so they can continue their studies?
70530.completion:
Excellent. We will not have to cancel the exams. After all, you can't take an exam without solutions!

Here, study this. Even as a skilled alchemist, there is more for you to learn.
70530.objectives: Craft 5 Dragon's Alchemical Solution using the Reclaim Concoctions recipe for Conflago in Valdrakken.

70531.title: Mana Markets
70531.description: Demand for mana potions has increased dramatically this week, $p. I will need your assistance filling customers' orders. Surely as a skilled alchemist you can spare a few, yes?
70531.completion:
Thank you {NAME}. My alchemy is brilliant but my customer service leaves something to be desired. I am glad you were here to help me fill these orders.

Here, study this. Even as a skilled alchemist, there is more for you to learn.
70531.objectives: Craft 10 Aerated Mana Potions for Conflago in Valdrakken.

70532.title: Aiding the Raiding
70532.description: Oh $p, I am glad to see you. Several champions have been injured in the latest assault against the Primalists. We are greatly in need of healing potions. As an adventurer yourself, I imagine you have several on hand already. We will need many.
70532.progress: Every moment you waste, the Primalists grow stronger.
70532.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. This will revitalize the health of our injured champions and keep the Primalists at bay for another week.

Here, study this. Even as a skilled alchemist, there is more for you to learn.
70532.objectives: Craft 10 Refreshing Healing Potions for Conflago in Valdrakken.

70533.title: Draught, Oiled Again
70533.description: Did you know that Writhefire Oil is an excellent reagent for finishing your draughts? I did. And now I am out of it. I cannot work without a plentiful stock of oils. Please $p, help me restock my laboratory.
70533.progress: A craft without Writhefire Oil is like a dish without salt.
70533.completion:
Wonderful, thank you. Always use a finishing reagent like Writhefire Oil for excellent craftsmanship.

Here, study this. Even as a skilled alchemist, there is more for you to learn.
70533.objectives: Craft 6 Writhefire Oils for Conflago in Valdrakken.

70539.title: And You Thought They Did Nothing
70539.description:
Hey sparky, you know what everyone forgets they need when they're flying around on dragons? Goggles.

You know what we sold out of today? Goggles.

You know what I need from you right now? You guessed it!
70539.progress: <Clinkyclick is muttering to herself as she looks for something.>
70539.completion:
Oh, great! These look perfect. Thanks!

Here, take these schematics. I bet there's something in there you didn't know.
70539.objectives: Craft 2 Milestone Magnifiers for Clinkyclick Shatterboom in Valdrakken.

70540.title: An Engineer's Best Friend
70540.description:
Hey sparky, have you seen my...

Err... maybe hand me the...

That's it--I think it's time we start keeping a few more tools around this shop, you know what I'm saying?
70540.progress: <Clinkyclick is muttering to herself as she looks for something.>
70540.completion:
Finally! It's like trying to craft with two hands tied behind my back without those things.

Here, take these schematics. I bet there's something in there you didn't know.
70540.objectives: Craft 2 Draconium Encased Samophlanges for Clinkyclick Shatterboom in Valdrakken.

70541.title: Hunting Tactics: Companion
70541.description: Your renown with the Maruuk grows. You may now hunt alongside a tenacious bakar or swift ohuna companion.
70541.objectives: Choose to fight alongside a bakar or ohuna during the Grand Hunt.

70550.title: Welcome to the Assembly
70550.description:
We could use your aid.

The Sundered Flame have taken control over most of the Cobalt Assembly. 

Please help us in this fight against them. Our numbers are small, but there are a few things we can do to aid you.
70550.progress: We can use all the help we can get.
70550.completion: Once we have more control over the Cobalt Assembly, we'll be able to better support our allies in the fight against the Sundered Flame.
70550.objectives: Speak with Xavin within the Cobalt Assembly to see what abilities are available within the area.

70557.title: No Scopes
70557.description:
Great gadgets, sparky, do I have a big one for you today!

Apparently, some firework fad caught on with the hunters. They try setting them off to scare the ducks into the air. Bet the ducks are way to smart for that, but it won't stop us from profiting! Think you're up to the task?
70557.progress: <Clinkyclick is muttering to herself as she looks for something.>
70557.completion:
Thanks, sparky! That should take care of this until they come up with some new hare-brained scheme.

Here, take these schematics. I bet there's something in there you didn't know.
70557.objectives: Craft 15 Bronze Fireflight for Clinkyclick Shatterboom in Valdrakken.

70558.title: Disillusioned Illusions
70558.description:
My scribe apprentice, you could not have chosen better timing.

There has been a terrible accident! All of the Illusion Parchment I ordered turned out to be real! Can you believe it! Do they think this is some game? Someone might get hurt!

Do you think you could rectify this situation and create some real illusions?
70558.progress: Have you inscribed what I need?
70558.completion:
Thank you a thousand times, my scribe apprentice.

Please take these glyphs as a token of my thanks. Perhaps you can study them to further your practices.
70558.objectives: Craft 5 Illusion Parchment: Spell Shield for Talendara in Valdrakken.

70559.title: Quill You Help?
70559.description:
My scribe apprentice, I am delighted to see you.

Earlier today I had a few novices come in to try their hand at inscription. They all wrote with too much force and snapped their quill nibs right off!

I hate to ask, but could you craft a few more quills to keep in stock?
70559.progress: Have you fresh quills for my apprentices?
70559.completion:
Thank you, my scribe apprentice. I do not know what I would do without you.

Please take these glyphs as a token of my thanks. Perhaps you can study them to further your practices.
70559.objectives: Craft 2 Scribe's Fastened Quill for Talendara in Valdrakken.

70560.title: The Most Powerful Tool: Good Documentation
70560.description: My scribe apprentice, do you feel ready for writing today? The Dragonscale Expedition has brought copious notes from their adventures, and they have asked that we compile their chicken-scratch penmanship into a suitable compendium for field-ready review. And oh, my hand is simply not up for the task today. Could I rely on you once more?
70560.completion:
Thank you, my scribe apprentice, thank you.

Please take these glyphs as a token of my thanks. Perhaps you can study them to further your practices.
70560.objectives: Craft 2 Core Explorer's Compendiums for Talendara in Valdrakken.

70561.title: A Scribe's Tragedy
70561.description:
My scribe apprentice! It is awful, just terrible! I cannot fathom how I am to go on in my life!

<Talendara begins weeping.>

...I have run out of ink! Could you please bottle some more?
70561.completion:
Thank you, my scribe apprentice. If only a mage would duplicate you...

Please take these glyphs as a token of my thanks. Perhaps you can study them to further your practices.
70561.objectives: Craft 5 Blazing Ink for Talendara in Valdrakken.

70562.title: The Plumbers, Mason
70562.description:
Jewelcrafter, how would you feel about a chance to practice your prospecting techniques?

The architects and plumbers of the Dragonscale Expedition have requested that we acquire some stones for the construction of a new bath house. I think you will find this a suitable task to occupy you and practice your masonry.
70562.completion:
Nice work, {NAME}.

Here, I made these cuts. You can study them to learn how to be a better jewelcrafter like me.
70562.objectives: Craft 15 Crumbled Stones for Tuluradormi in Valdrakken.

70563.title: The Exhibition
70563.description:
Oh jewelcrafter, how would you feel about a chance to practice your gemcutting?

I was going to put on a display of various cuts, and I suppose I could exhibit your gems as well, so long as you hurry. Submit nothing less than the highest quality for this demonstration.
70563.progress: Are your gems worthy of display?
70563.completion:
Very well, I suppose these will do.

Here, I made these cuts. You can study them to learn how to be a better jewelcrafter like me.
70563.objectives: Craft a variety of gems for Tuluradormi in Valdrakken.

70564.title: Spectacular
70564.description:
Jewelcrafter, there is an exhibition coming up, and I am concerned that the clients will not be able to see the beauty of each cut without the proper lenses.

You do not need anything fancy. Just make a few loupes so our customers can see clearly.
70564.completion:
Your work is appreciated... By someone, I would imagine. Probably.

Here, I made these cuts. You can study them to learn how to be a better jewelcrafter like me.
70564.objectives: Craft 2 Sundered Onyx Loupes for Tuluradormi in Valdrakken.

70565.title: Separation by Saturation
70565.description:
Oh jewelcrafter, do you like my necklace?

Of course you do. But I cannot show it off properly unless it stands out.

I know! Why don't you make a few simple pendants and we shall flood the market. Once everyone is wearing your designs, my necklace will be a sparkling cut above the rest!
70565.completion:
All in the name of fashion, {NAME}.

Here, I made these cuts. You can study them to learn how to be a better jewelcrafter like me.
70565.objectives: Craft 2 Pendants of Impending Perils for Tuluradormi in Valdrakken.

70567.title: When You Give Bakar a Bone
70567.description:
I had some of the most beautiful bonewrought bows, but our bakar got to them before they could be put to use. Bakar love to chew bones, whether bow or not, and now they are ruined!

Can you aid me in crafting replacements?
70567.progress: I will be far more wary of the bakar when next I carry these.
70567.completion:
Thank you {NAME}.

Here, take these designs. You can study them to improve your leatherworking.
70567.objectives: Craft 2 Bonewrought Crossbows for Hideshaper Koruz in Valdrakken.

70568.title: Tipping the Scales
70568.description: Our scale bracers are finely crafted and highly in demand. I am finding it difficult to keep up with all of the orders! Would you lend your skill in replenishing my supply?
70568.progress: Our goods are of the finest quality and craftsmanship. I am not surprised they sell so quickly.
70568.completion:
Well done, {NAME}. 

Here, take these designs in return for your aid. You can study them to improve your leatherworking.
70568.objectives: Craft 2 Trailblazer's Scale Bracers for Hideshaper Koruz in Valdrakken.

70569.title: For Trisket, a Task Kit
70569.description:
I have many valued customers, but Trisket is one of my favorites. Most recently he came to me because his herbalist's pouch has worn out. 

I offered to make him a selection of baskets to replace his old pouch. 

Would you help me with these tasks, $p? Trisket would be appreciative.
70569.progress: I think Trisket will be far happier with these sturdy baskets.
70569.completion:
Thank you for the aid, {NAME}.

In return, take these designs. You can study them to improve your leatherworking.
70569.objectives: Craft 2 Herbalist's Floral Baskets for Hideshaper Koruz in Valdrakken.

70571.title: Drums Here!
70571.description:
We are known far and wide for our drums--the centaur have been honing these skills for generations. Unfortunately this means that our drums are in short supply these days.

You have skills of your own, I see. Perhaps you could help me craft a few drums for our stores?
70571.progress: Your skills are quite impressive--where did you learn to craft?
70571.completion:
Ohn'ahra bless you, {NAME}.

Here, have these designs. You can study them to improve your leatherworking.
70571.objectives: Craft 2 Feral Hide Drums for Hideshaper Koruz in Valdrakken.

70572.title: The Cold Does Bother Them, Actually
70572.description:
If there is one thing I have learned in my years as a seamstress, $p, it is that adventurers will always underestimate the cold.

I have explorers in the Azure Span begging me for warmer robes.

Would you take pity on them and craft a few?
70572.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}.

Please, learn from these examples. Study them to improve your tailoring.

And stay warm.
70572.objectives: Craft 2 Surveyor's Cloth Robes for Fulafong in Valdrakken.

70582.title: Weave Well Enough Alone
70582.description:
If there is one thing I have learned in my years as a seamstress, $p, it is the importance of practice.

Always be practicing your craft, even when you believe you have mastered everything. I want you to be able to weave with excellence without my supervision.

Why don't you practice this week? Make a few Wildercloth Bolts at the highest quality.
70582.completion:
You have done well with these, {NAME}.

Please, learn from these examples. Study them to improve your tailoring.

And stay sharp.
70582.objectives: Craft 3 Wildercloth Bolts for Fulafong in Valdrakken.

70586.title: Sew Many Cooks
70586.description:
If there is one thing I have learned in my years as a seamstress, $p, it is that too many cooks spoil everything.

In this case, I was going to go out for a drink and an order came in last minute for an entire wardrobe of chef's uniforms.

If you could sew the hats, I will take care of everything else.
70586.progress: Do you have the chef's hats?
70586.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. You are hungry as ever for a good challenge.

Please, learn from these examples. Study them to improve your tailoring.

And stay hungry.
70586.objectives: Craft 2 Wildercloth Chef's Hats for Fulafong in Valdrakken.

70587.title: A Knapsack Problem
70587.description: If there is one thing I have learned in my years as a seamstress, $p, it is that you can never have enough space for your reagents. In fact, we could use a few more bags around here to hold everything. Would you mind stitching another?
70587.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. This will do just fine.

Please, learn from these examples. Study them to improve your tailoring.

And stay away from anyone offering you infinite storage space. You do not want to know what lies down that road.
70587.objectives: Craft 1 Simply Stitched Reagent Bag for Fulafong in Valdrakken.

70589.title: Blacksmithing Services Requested
70589.description:
Hi, hi, hi $p! Crafting orders are coming in left and right!

If you're looking for work, the Artisan's Consortium always has orders to fill!

You can take a look at our public orders, or if you've built up a network of clients for yourself, fill some guild orders or personal orders! Just get it done, done, done!
70589.completion: Thanks for your business! Keep on crafting, crafting, crafting!
70589.objectives: Fill Blacksmithing Crafting Orders for the Artisan's Consortium.

70592.title: Inscription Services Requested
70592.description:
Hi, hi, hi $p! Crafting orders are coming in left and right!

If you're looking for work, the Artisan's Consortium always has orders to fill!

You can take a look at our public orders, or if you've built up a network of clients for yourself, fill some guild orders or personal orders! Just get it done, done, done!
70592.completion: Thanks for your business! Keep on crafting, crafting, crafting!
70592.objectives: Fill Inscription Crafting Orders for the Artisan's Consortium.

70593.title: Jewelcrafting Services Requested
70593.description:
Hi, hi, hi $p! Crafting orders are coming in left and right!

If you're looking for work, the Artisan's Consortium always has orders to fill!

You can take a look at our public orders, or if you've built up a network of clients for yourself, fill some guild orders or personal orders! Just get it done, done, done!
70593.completion: Thanks for your business! Keep on crafting, crafting, crafting!
70593.objectives: Fill Jewelcrafting Crafting Orders for the Artisan's Consortium.

70594.title: Leatherworking Services Requested
70594.description:
Hi, hi, hi $p! Crafting orders are coming in left and right!

If you're looking for work, the Artisan's Consortium always has orders to fill!

You can take a look at our public orders, or if you've built up a network of clients for yourself, fill some guild orders or personal orders! Just get it done, done, done!
70594.completion: Thanks for your business! Keep on crafting, crafting, crafting!
70594.objectives: Fill Leatherworking Crafting Orders for the Artisan's Consortium.

70595.title: Tailoring Services Requested
70595.description:
Hi, hi, hi $p! Crafting orders are coming in left and right!

If you're looking for work, the Artisan's Consortium always has orders to fill!

You can take a look at our public orders, or if you've built up a network of clients for yourself, fill some guild orders or personal orders! Just get it done, done, done!
70595.completion: Thanks for your business! Keep on crafting, crafting, crafting!
70595.objectives: Fill Tailoring Crafting Orders for the Artisan's Consortium.

70613.title: Get Their Bark Before They Bite
70613.description:
$p, you are a skilled herbalist, are you not? I have alchemists nearly begging at my door... well, if I had a door... for more Writhebark. We have nearly sold out! 

Will you help me gather more? I fear if the alchemists cannot create the phials they need, they will begin experimenting with my belongings.
70613.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}.

Please, take my field notes. Study them to improve your herbalism.
70613.objectives: Gather 8 Writhebark for Agrikus in Valdrakken.

70614.title: Bubble Craze
70614.description:
<Agrikus shouts at you.> I have no more poppy tea!

...Oh, you're not one of them. Praise the Titans. Someone made "Bubble Poppy Tea" the most fashionable drink on the market this week and I've sold out of the herb completely. Please, could you bring more poppies before they return in droves?
70614.progress: <Agrikus is trying to calm himself down.>
70614.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}, thank you.

Please, take my field notes. Study them to improve your herbalism.

I need to... make some tea...
70614.objectives: Gather 8 Bubble Poppies for Agrikus in Valdrakken.

70615.title: The Case of the Missing Herbs
70615.description:
Aah, $p! There you are!

They took it! They took my Saxifrage!

I left for barely two hours, and when I returned, someone had taken my Saxifrage! All they left to show for their crimes was this heavy sack of gold coins. As if you could put a price on herbs!

...Please $p, I need more Saxifrage to replenish what that criminal took from me.
70615.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. What a week this has been...

Please, take my field notes. Study them to improve your herbalism.
70615.objectives: Gather 8 Saxifrage for Agrikus in Valdrakken.

70616.title: How Many??
70616.description:
<Agrikus is crying as you approach.>

They did it... I cannot believe they did it...

Someone has come here and asked for the delivery of ONE THOUSAND herbs!

I cannot even fathom this! It is preposterous. Ridiculous! Ludicrous!!

...Please help.
70616.progress:
Five hundred sixty one... five hundred sixty two...

<Agrikus begins sobbing again.>
70616.completion:
Oh, good. This will help. Thank for your assistance.

Please, take my field notes. Study them to improve your herbalism.

I have herbs to count.
70616.objectives: Gather 20 Hochenblume for Agrikus in Valdrakken.

70617.title: All Mine, Mine, Mine
70617.description:
There is nothing as useful as Draconium ore. So much can be done with it! It is the perfect ore, pure in every way.

Bring me Draconium. I must have it. You are a miner, yes? Then go mine!
70617.progress: Well? Have you brought me my ore?
70617.completion:
Yes, yes, yes! This is exactly what I needed.

Take my field notes when you go--I've written down some useful information about the mining process here in the Isles.
70617.objectives: Gather 7 Draconium Ore for Sekita the Burrower in Valdrakken.

70618.title: The Call of the Forge
70618.description: The forge... she calls to me. And she asks for Serevite. You there! Bring me Serevite! Yes, lots of Serevite! <Sekita begins laughing zealously.>
70618.progress:
More for the forge, more, more!

<Sekita begins laughing zealously.>
70618.completion:
Yes, yes!

The forge is satisfied with this.

Take my field notes when you go. There must be something in there that will teach you about mining.
70618.objectives: Gather 16 Serevite Ore for Sekita the Burrower in Valdrakken.

70619.title: A Study of Leather
70619.description:
You there! Perhaps you can help me with my studies of this leather. Some of it is soft and pliable, yet other pieces have a more firm temper--the better for crafting armor, I suspect.

Bring me more leathers to investigate. I wish to continue my studies.
70619.progress: Were you able to find any leather to study?
70619.completion:
Thank you {NAME}. This should help me hone my craft.

Here, have my field notes. They will teach you about the beasts of this land and to better procure their hides.
70619.objectives: Gather 40 Resilient Leather for Ralathor the Rugged in Valdrakken.

70620.title: Scaling Up
70620.description:
Many people ask me how I became so good at skinning. To them I say: it is all in the scales. 

Are you curious to learn more? Bring me some scales, and I will show you what I mean.
70620.progress: Have you found any worthy scales?
70620.completion:
Excellent--with all that practice, now you have become better at skinning! You see? All in the scales.

Here, have my field notes. They will teach you about the beasts of this land and how to better procure their hides.
70620.objectives: Gather 40 Adamant Scales for Ralathor the Rugged in Valdrakken.

70621.title: Third Challenge of Tyr: Persistence Embodied
70621.description:
Your third challenge was meant to have you overcome unfavorable odds. It was to help show me your persistence in all matters.

I believe fighting djaradin and fixing my statue with the expectation that I would issue you a challenge is more than sufficient to fulfill your victory condition. 

<You think you catch a small smile play across her lips.>
70621.completion:
Your third challenge was meant to have you overcome unfavorable odds. It was to help show me your persistence in all matters.

I believe fighting djaradin and fixing my statue with the expectation that I would issue you a challenge is more than sufficient to fulfill your victory condition. 

<You think you catch a small smile play across her lips.>
70621.objectives: Accept the Bottled Essence from Maiden of Inspiration.

70627.title: What of the Winterpelt Clan?
70627.description:
We could join another clan... if we knew it to be safe.

I worry the Primalists tempted other clans as they did ours. 

This "Dragonscale Expedition" tells me they have a clawhold near the Winterpelt clan.

They may be tainted. Or they may heed our warning. With either truth, they need us.

There is a "furbolg expert," Sonova Snowden, in Theron's Watch. Please go to him and learn what he knows.
70627.completion: Regretfully, friend... I've got bad news for ya about the Winterpelt furbolg.
70627.objectives: Meet Sonova Snowden at Theron's Watch.

70633.title: Fueling the Engine
70633.description:
You have done well to pass the first challenge that Keeper Tyr left behind. Though this is but the first step on your journey I have faith you shall do well. You have earned your chance at furthering yourself in unlocking the secrets of the Forge. 

Add the Bottled Essence to the Engine of Innovation and see what occurs.
70633.progress: <The Engine hums quietly as you approach>
70633.completion:
A Spark of Ingenuity. An item that can unlock potential unheard of since the time of Tyr himself.

I am sure you shall use it wisely.
70633.objectives: Use the Bottled Essence to empower the Engine of Innovation.

70640.title: WANTED: Boss
70640.description:
<The page's script glows with a soft blue light.>

Previously a cherished plaything of Malygos, the elemental Frigellus suffered from his master's neglect. 

While this once-happy settlement crumbled apace, the churlish and playful creature grew warped and twisted by the evils that plague this land.

Please see that it is safely neutralized.

Bring word of your success to Custodian Cynegos.

70641.title: A Waking Oath
70641.description:
Hold a moment, $p. I wish to personally thank you for your aid in restoring our oathstone.

I was not aware of the dracthyr until your reawakening on the Forbidden Reach. It was unclear what your arrival among us meant. Whether your kind would prove to be a boon to the defense of life... or a bane.

I would encourage you to learn more about our oathstone. Speak with a few of my flight here at the Ruby Lifeshrine. Perhaps you will find familiarity among our tales.
70641.progress: There is much for the {race} to learn about the flights, {NAME}.
70641.completion: We all share stories of growth. I hope you have come to understand more of where we began and where we strive to reach.
70641.objectives: Speak with members of the red dragonflight around the Ruby Lifeshrine.

70647.title: Oh Where, Oh Where Can He Be?
70647.description:
{NAME}, I am glad to see you! I am worried sick and could use your help.

Recently, I rescued an abandoned proto-drake whelp. I named him Lubbins because he is so lovely! I brought him here to care for him and hopefully find him a good home as someone's pet. 

But now he is missing, and I am concerned that he is lost or hurt. I need to keep watch over the rest of my little ones, otherwise I would go searching for him myself. Would you please look for him?
70647.progress: I hope Lubbins is safe. I am terribly worried.
70647.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. I am so relieved to see little Lubbins safe and sound.
 
Oh! He seems to have taken a liking to you!
70647.objectives: Rescue Lubbins and bring him back to Jyhanna at the Little Scales Daycare in Valdrakken.

70697.title: An Expert Opinion
70697.description:
Lubbins' wounds may have healed, but I am afraid his confidence may still be injured. I believe it is time to call on others for help.

Far to the southwest in a remote section of the Azure Span there is a pet trainer named Patchu. She is one of the world's foremost experts on these matters.

Please visit her, I am sure she can help Lubbins!
70697.objectives: Talk to Patchu in The Azure Span.

70701.title: Bakar Dream of Lost Argali
70701.description:
Some of the clan's argali have wandered away from our flock again.

The ridge around us is too dangerous for our shepherds to search for them. It would be a great boon if you could take one of our bakar and bring back the argali. Our shepherds can point you in the right direction.
70701.completion: We must be vigilant about our livestock. We are limited in resources to begin with. To lose an argali is a setback we would much like to avoid.
70701.objectives: Herd the lost argali back to Clan Aylaag.

70702.title: Continued Waygate Exploration
70702.description:
<The little messenger's loud, screeching call captures your attention. They hand you a note before running off.

The note is a request from Thaelin Darkanvil, seeking your assistance.>
70702.completion: I see ye found me letter. Glad tae see ye again!
70702.objectives: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost in The Waking Shores.

70703.title: The Legacy of Tyrhold
70703.description:
Keeper Tyr did love his mysteries. Clearly, there is deeper meaning to the gift he gave us. As he most likely forged this scale at his former citadel, perhaps it will be the key to helping unlock its secrets.

Go with Koranos to Tyrhold, {NAME}. As a trusted advisor and watcher of this land, I am sure he will have insight into this matter.
70703.completion: That magic... You have awakened something within Tyrhold.
70703.objectives: Investigate the Silver Scale with Koranos at Tyrhold.

70706.title: Waygate: Shady Sanctuary
70706.description: Our expedition reports a dormant stone out in the lush hillsides to the southwest. It's quite a journey, but worth sendin' someone with yer knowledge tae investigate.
70706.objectives: Locate the Dormant Waygate at the Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

70707.title: The Next Waygate
70707.description:
I've been keepin' this here vessel from yer nightborne friend safe.

What do ye say 'bout us puttin' it tae good use and pursuin' another of those old stones?
70707.objectives: Choose the next waygate location to pursue.

70708.title: Hollow
70708.description:
Feels like it's been years. Also feels like it's been minutes. 

I could use someone to talk to, if you have time. 

You wanna grab us a round of drinks? Get whatever you want. I'm paying.
70708.progress: I know I owe you more than a drink, but I hope this will do for now.
70708.completion: It's time to go, I guess.

70721.title: After My Ohn Heart
70721.description:
There is a small pond by the Mirror of the Sky where Narman and I first met during my initiate training.

Initiates travel up there to be closer to Ohn'ahra so they may feel the wind. I first saw him in the reflection of the water when a sudden breeze opened my eyes. It is the most beautiful sight in all of the plains.

It will be the perfect place for our proposal.
70721.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}.

Dawa and I will always remember what you have done for us.
70721.objectives: Help Windsage Dawa and Hunter Narman with their proposals.

70722.title: What Lubbins Needs
70722.description:
I think that I know what we gotta do, {NAME}. 

But first, let's talk about it!

I even have a gift to give you after we're done! Fun, right?
70722.completion: Make sure to summon Lubbins, then use this battle-stone on him. It'll permanently make him stronger.

70723.title: Shattering the Earth Primalists
70723.description: Rethelshi in Valdrakken will be grateful to get this to aid his research on the Primalists.
70723.completion: This will help further our research on the Primalists. Thank you.
70723.objectives: Bring the primal core to Rethelshi.

70730.title: Shikaar Giver
70730.description:
Oh, $p.

Do you feel comfort under the sun? Do you feel safe under its bright caress? Does each new day represent hope for the future and a chance to live your life as you've always dreamt it?

Then you know love as I do.

Narman of Clan Shikaar is my sun. He is my warmth. He is my light. He is my hope.

A man like him deserves a proposal worthy of stature.

We must seek guidance from an Ohn.
70730.progress: Narman deserves a gesture as great as he is.
70730.completion:
Arbhog's horns? They'll do just fine.

Arbhog was once the mightiest musken on the plains. These are a fitting gift for the mightiest hunter. I am sure Narman will appreciate them.

Perhaps one day he will teach me to hunt. An Ohn'ir huntsman. Ha! Imagine that.
70730.objectives: Help Windsage Dawa prepare for the perfect proposal.

70732.title: A Practice Bout
70732.description:
All right! Now that you used that stone on Lubbins, let's have a practice bout to test out his skills! 

There's a big ole Hornswog named Gwosh that lives on the shore to the north of here. Gwosh loves to fight! Well, play really. He's super good with other pets, too! 

It'll be a perfect playtime... I mean fight... for Lubbins.
70732.progress:
Gwosh is real gentle, but still fierce. I think he and Lubbins will have a fun bout! 

Just head up north of here and you'll find him.
70732.completion:
Wow! That went great! Good job Lubbins!

Don't worry about Gwosh, he's a big ol' softie. He'll be just fine.
70732.objectives: Defeat Gwosh in a pet battle.

70738.title: The You-ga Class
70738.description:
Everything was going so well, but now? Elementals are causing some, um, mild challenges.

Our guests were enjoying the facilities when suddenly, all these elementals appeared! Those nasty fiends have disrupted everything. Probably even the new you-ga instructor. 

Oh yes, you-ga is a new type of stretching that helps you meditate at the same time. I am sure both teacher and students are so relaxed they do not even notice the elementals.

Still, better to be safe than sorry. Please, look for them.
70738.completion: Hopefully this experience won't tarnish their reviews!
70738.objectives: Find the instructor and 6 you-ga students.

70739.title: Bloodlines, Sweets, and Teerai
70739.description:
I have hunted with khans, outrun our fastest bakar, and wrestled a full grown bruffalon bull bare-handed. As a hunter, I've nothing left to prove.

However, as a partner, I still have much to learn. 

Windsage Dawa of Clan Ohn'ir is my heart and my joy. I wish only to prove worthy of his love, but I know nothing of traditions and rituals. I require the wisdom of the elders in Maruukai.
70739.progress: What if I am not good enough for Dawa's love?
70739.completion:
I would sooner ask all the stars of the night sky to admire me back than claim to be wholly worthy of Dawa's love.

Nonetheless, I will find the courage to proceed. When the time comes, will you assist me with a grand proposal?
70739.objectives: Help Hunter Narman earn a traditional blessing for his marriage proposal.

70740.title: Steam Cleaning
70740.description:
Xijan seems to think the elemental invasion on our beautiful spa is only a minor problem, but this surge of flame and steam needs to be brought under control immediately.

We had booked musical acts to play in the lower area, but the elementals destroyed their gear. As we have never had such levels of elemental destruction in this area before, I suspect Primalist influences.

If you want to help, clear the elementals on the east side of the lower spa. That is where the first events are scheduled.
70740.completion: A good start, but there are still far too many for my liking...
70740.objectives: Kill 12 elementals in the lower spa.

70741.title: Some Favorite Things
70741.description:
<It looks like the you-ga class was interrupted, and the students' belongings are scattered everywhere. 

Collecting these items will certainly aid the Serene Dreams Spa.>
70741.completion: It is very kind of you to gather these items. We will return them to their owners right away!

70742.title: Runs in the Family
70742.description:
From the air, I scouted one of the artifacts Edress uncovered by the entrance of the ruins. Doubtless there are more inside.

They are warded somehow, though I will need to get closer before I can examine them. The magic here is very old.

The grounds appear deserted, but I wouldn't trust that to last long once we start meddling. Keep an eye out. We will uncover all we can.
70742.completion: This has given me... much to ponder. I would prefer some time alone, if it's all the same.
70742.objectives: Search the Obsidian Observatory for clues about the dracthyr's past.

70743.title: Precious Baby
70743.description:
You there, $pr! Are you semi-competent?

Do you have your priorities in check?

Good!

My precious Baby is missing. Save her immediately. Be quick about it, she can't fend for herself in these horrible conditions.
70743.completion:
<Elzara ignores you and looks at Baby.>

Are you safe, my precious cuddlemuffin?

Did the Primalists bleed on you? How dare they!

<Elzara notices you.>

I shall definitely be rating this spa at one star. I expect a blood-free experience.

70744.title: Look at the Bones!
70744.description: <Surely the spa manager would appreciate if there wasn't blood everywhere...>
70744.completion: I do not want to know, do I?

70745.title: Enforced Relaxation
70745.description:
Those Primalists that you saw certainly do not seem like the leadership type to me. Who would be afraid of a little dog? Hah!

So, if they mentioned Vadne, that sounds like their leader. She must be the one bringing in these elementals. We need to get rid of the summoner. They must be close by to be causing such trouble. Check the cave directly under us. I know it is where some of the less diligent employees like to take an extended break.
70745.completion:
I am glad this will finally start to get better! We all deserve a little bit of downtime.

I hope you find a short respite here as well: you have earned it, {NAME}.

70746.title: Shades of Blue
70746.description:
You there, $p!
It's good to see a friendly face in these parts. Telash and I were just discussing reports we've heard of... newcomers, in the area.

<Emberthal lowers her voice.>

Blue dragons. 

Given our... history, with the blues, Telash and I thought it necessary to assess the situation ourselves. 

Please, join us.
70746.progress: Keep your head clear and your wings ready, my friend.
70746.completion: No sign of blue dragons yet, but plenty of their underlings.
70746.objectives: Accompany Emberthal and Telash to Camp Antonidas.

70747.title: The Azure Wizard
70747.description:
I do not have time to quibble with sorcerers. 

Go and treat with this "Archmage", $p. Learn what you may, and be on your guard always. They might be allies still or enemies yet...

Our reports indicate there's a large archival complex to the south of here. 

That is where I'm going.
70747.completion:
On behalf of the Kirin Tor, I'm deeply concerned to hear what Malygos did to your people. 

This demands an immediate investigation.

... Where are your companions?
70747.objectives: Talk to Archmage Khadgar in Camp Antonidas.

70748.title: For Blue Eyes Only
70748.description:
It is no wonder your companions have yet to find anything. 

These books were meant for blue eyes only. 

However, my presence should suffice in allowing for some of the more pertinent tomes to divulge their secrets.
70748.progress: Have you found that which you seek?
70748.completion:
You have the answers you seek, yet you do not look content...

I am sorry.
70748.objectives: Search the Azure Archive for Malygos's notes.

70750.title: Aiding the Accord
70750.description:
You there! Yes, I'm speaking to you. Who else do you see around here?

<Therazal glances quickly at quite a few passers by.>

Ignore them. They are not part of this request. It is you I've heard of, and you I wish to speak with!

The Valdrakken Accord has asked me to seek out those who have shown they are making a name for themselves across the Isles, and those who seek to ensure our allies and their safety remain the highest priority.

Do what you do best, friend. You shall be rewarded handsomely.
70750.progress: The tales of your exploits ring true, but what is it you bring me? Information, news? Get on with it.
70750.completion:
Yes, indeed I am impressed, friend. As a representative of the Accord I can assure you your work has not gone unnoticed!

Please, accept this on behalf of our allies.
70750.objectives: Continue your efforts in aiding the Valdrakken Accord and their allies throughout the Dragon Isles.

70752.title: Vaporizing the Water Primalists
70752.description: Rethelshi in Valdrakken will be grateful to get this to aid his research on the Primalists.
70752.completion: This will help further our research on the Primalists. Thank you.
70752.objectives: Bring the primal core to Rethelshi.

70753.title: Dissipating the Air Primalists
70753.description: Rethelshi in Valdrakken will be grateful to get this to aid his research on the Primalists.
70753.completion: This will help further our research on the Primalists. Thank you.
70753.objectives: Bring the primal core to Rethelshi.

70754.title: Extinguishing the Fire Primalists
70754.description: Rethelshi in Valdrakken will be grateful to get this to aid his research on the Primalists.
70754.completion: This will help further our research on the Primalists. Thank you.
70754.objectives: Bring the primal core to Rethelshi.

70766.title: The Fractured Flame
70766.description:
The gorloc clutches a journal, its cover marred by moisture and lack of care. The faded symbol of the Sundered Flame peeks proudly from behind the tears and discoloration.

If you find the missing pages, perhaps you can gain insight into Reclaimer Makko and the madness that has fractured her mind.
70766.completion:
Thanks, but you can keep it. 

<Toddy rolls her eyes.>

And I thought the Sundered Flame were crazy before...
70766.objectives: Collect the pages of Makko's Journal from gorlocs in Szar Skeleth.

70781.title: Out of the Blue
70781.description:
Did you see that?!

This winged creature just fell from the sky! I don't know what sort of being it is, but it certainly isn't native to the Isles.

Wait... I do remember a punchy little goblin asking for directions to the Bluefeather Cliffs just above us. You think she would know anything about it?
70781.completion: Some guard in Gelikyr told you I'd be here? Did they say I own 'em any money?
70781.objectives: Locate Harleen Chirpsnide in the Bluefeather Cliffs.

70784.title: The Abandoned Outpost
70784.description:
From what you mentioned, it appears the stone of Vigilance can be found at an abandoned station northeast of the Azure Archives. That must be Zelthrak Outpost.

Meet up with me when you arrive, {NAME}, and we can find the stone together.
70784.completion: I know this place is abandoned, but I didn't think it would be so... messy.
70784.objectives: Meet up with Naleidea near Zelthrak Outpost in the Azure Span.

70785.title: The City of the Dead
70785.description:
An ancient city of the dead can only mean one thing. The Veiled Ossuary off the coast of northern Thaldraszus.

It's extensive, remote, and hard to approach. The perfect place to hide something. I'm not sure what we'll find there, {NAME}. But you can bet that it won't appreciate our presence.
70785.completion: Good, you're here! The sooner we begin the sooner we can leave.
70785.objectives: Meet up with Naleidea at the Veiled Ossuary in Thaldraszus.

70788.title: Wrapped Gold Band
70788.description: <This might be something Emila Bellocq is looking for.>
70788.completion: Beautiful. I will put this away so it's safe.
70788.objectives: Deliver the item to Emilia Bellocq.

70789.title: Finely Carved Wing
70789.description: <This might be something Emila Bellocq is looking for.>
70789.completion: It's so delicately carved... We have really lost some fine techniques over the ages. I'll take this and make sure its safeguarded.
70789.objectives: Deliver the item to Emilia Bellocq.

70790.title: Stone Dragontooth
70790.description: <This might be something Emila Bellocq is looking for.>
70790.completion: It's very old, but you can still tell what it is... I will make sure this is filed away safely.
70790.objectives: Deliver the item to Emilia Bellocq.

70791.title: Coldwashed Dragonclaw
70791.description: <This might be something Emila Bellocq is looking for.>
70791.completion: What a colossal statue this must have been! And now we only have... this. But at least we have something! I'll make sure we get it logged.
70791.objectives: Deliver the item to Emilia Bellocq.

70805.title: Precious Stone Fragments
70805.description: <This might be something Emila Bellocq is looking for.>
70805.completion: I wonder what it would have looked like when it was new? Awe inspiring, I'll bet. For now, it's going into a box under lock and key!
70805.objectives: Deliver the item to Emilia Bellocq.

70806.title: Chunk of Sculpture
70806.description: <This might be something Emila Bellocq is looking for.>
70806.completion:
Hm.

<Emila turns the piece over, looking at it from different angles.>

Perhaps? No, I can't tell what it is. It's old though and undoubtedly important. In the collection it goes!
70806.objectives: Deliver the item to Emilia Bellocq.

70837.title: Follow the Clues
70837.description:
<Investigator Erima reviews the map.>

It is clear what the X scrawled over the Seat of the Aspects represents.

But there is also a circle drawn around the Misty Vale. Perhaps this is the rebels' next target? Or a base of operations.

Only one way to find out. Meet me at the Vale.
70837.completion:
This is definitely a base of operations.

The Misty Vale is crawling with rebels... and Primalists!
70837.objectives: Meet Investigator Erima at the Misty Vale.

70838.title: Rebels With a Cause
70838.description:
The rebel staging ground... we have been looking for this very place. How fortunate for us that their saboteur's carelessness led us here.

I cannot believe my brethren would stoop to working with the Primalists. We cannot let this stand. Take out the rebels and their Primalist friends before they can cause any further chaos.
70838.progress: I trust these turncoats will pose no threat to you.
70838.completion:
You handled yourself well.

These rebels are no slouches.

70840.title: A Titan Relic
70840.progress:
Have you found a Titan Relic?
Titan Relic (1)
70840.completion:
Amazing! This relic is perfectly preserved. I will begin studying it right away.

Your efforts are most appreciated! I will remember my promise to speak well of you to the Valdrakken Accord. 

Now, where was I? Yes, this will fit in right over here...

70841.title: More Titan Relics
70841.progress:
What have you brought me today?
Titan Relic (5)
70841.completion:
How did you find so many of these? This is a veritable treasure trove of relics! One day you must tell me your secret. 

Once again you have greatly increased our knowledge of the titans. The Valdrakken Accord will think well of you indeed!

70842.title: Detonation Locations
70842.description:
I am sure that the rebels are documenting their plans for future attacks. We must find out what they are attempting to do before it happens.

Search their camp for any marked maps like the one we found in Valdrakken.
70842.progress: Were you able to recover the rebel plans?
70842.completion: I will send word to step up our security measures in these locations.

70843.title: Ruin the Runestones
70843.description:
<This runestone is strikingly similar to the one a rebel tried to plant in Valdrakken.

Though this stone is unfinished, you spy caches of completed runestones off in the distance.

If you destroy these caches the rebels will not be able to put them to use.>
70843.progress: Brave of you to tinker with those strange stones.
70843.completion:
I could feel the tremor of those explosions all the way from here!

Valdrakken is now safer, thanks to your efforts.

70845.title: In Tyr's Footsteps
70845.description:
Keeper Tyr planned for all eventualities. He suspected there would be a need to empower the craftspeople of the realm some day, thus he created the Engine of Innovation. It possesses the ability to create a unique material that can help an item achieve expertise beyond that of mortal ability.

To ensure his engine would not be misused he created me to oversee any who sought its power. Only those worthy will be able to unlock the engine's full potential. 

Are you equal to the challenge?
70845.completion: <It feels as if the statue reacts to your presence, its mechanism slowly awakening and coming to life.>
70845.objectives: Find the First Challenge of Tyr in the Azure Span.

70847.title: Ancient Obsidian Charm
70847.completion: It's still intact. Hopefully it brings the next owner more luck.
70847.objectives: Deliver the item to Talonstalker Kavia.

70848.title: Forgotten Dragon Crest
70848.completion: This crest belonged to the first dragons that lived in this Citadel. We shall display it in a place of honor.

70849.title: This Calls for a Specialist
70849.description:
Lubbins is doing lots better now, but I think he still needs some more help. 

A little bit ago I met a super smart Dragonscale Expedition explorer named Haniko who works with proto-drakes all the time. She's a pet trainer, too. I bet she could help Lubbins more! 

I think she was going to the Waking Shores. I bet if you go there you'll find her. 

I'm so happy I was able to help you! 

<she waves happily>

Goodbye! Good luck, Lubbins.
70849.objectives: Talk to Haniko at the Wild Preserve in The Waking Shores.

70850.title: Maldra's in Hot Water
70850.description:
Excellent work. While you were off disrupting things I was scouting the camp. I did not expect to find my old friend Maldra Flametongue.

I knew she was missing, but the rumors said she had joined the rebels. From what I could see, though, she is their captive!

We cannot leave her here. Rescue her from the dragonspawn holding her captive!
70850.progress: Maldra is a dear friend. We cannot leave her here with these rebels!
70850.completion: I am indebted to you for rescuing my friend.

70851.title: Born to Be Wilder
70851.description: There's a lot of information you need to know. Let's have a talk and then we can decide what's best for Lubbins.
70851.progress: There's a lot to cover. Let's talk.
70851.completion:
Good! Now to get to work, {NAME}.

Before you go, take these polished pet charms. Pet trainers like to trade these for useful supplies, so keep an eye out.
70851.objectives: Learn what Lubbins needs from Haniko.

70853.title: A Friend for Lubbins
70853.description:
Like we talked about, Lubbins needs two things: a buddy and a battle.

I think we can get him both at the same time.

This area is a prime mating ground for Shyflys. If you look around a bit, you're sure to find a bunch.

Remember, you need to weaken it before you can capture it with your trap.

Come back when you have one. It might be a bit bruised after your battle, but I've got some battle-training stones that will fix 'em right up!
70853.progress: The Shyflys shouldn't be too hard to find, especially now that you know where to look.
70853.completion:
Nicely done. I believe these battle-stones are just what your new pet needs. 

You know what? Take a few polished pet charms too. 

Did I mention you can trade them for good stuff? Because you can!
70853.objectives: Capture a Shyfly at the Wild Preserve in The Waking Shores.

70854.title: So How Did It Go?
70854.description:
You've done well, {NAME}. Lubbins is doing much better and is in excellent spirits. 

Jyhanna will want to know, so go back and give her the good news!
70854.completion:
I am so glad you were able to help Lubbins. 

Perhaps you can help another animal I rescued. His name is Mister Toots. He is extremely sweet, and I think you two would get along.

What do you say? Do you think you can handle another pet?
70854.objectives: Return to Jyhanna at the Whelp Daycare in Valdrakken.

70856.title: Kill it with Fire
70856.description:
