These vile spiders lay their eggs in corpses.

And sometimes the living.

We've seen several bodies of Sundered Flame who have fallen victim to them.

We can't let those eggs hatch if we want to survive here and defeat the Sundered Flame.

Take this torch. It is imbued with the power of air and fire. Point it in the direction of what you want scorched, and it will do the rest.

The Tuskarr don't mess around with spiders. I came prepared.
70856.completion: Good work. This should give us some breathing room.
70856.objectives: Destroy 10 Infected Corpses with the Flamethrower Torch.

70858.title: Back into the Action
70858.description:
All right, the antidote is ready. I'll keep Alia steady. You pour what's in the vial into her mouth.

I hope she will live... we'll need her magic to track down this artifact.
70858.completion: You have my thanks... I thought I would die before acquiring this artifact.
70858.objectives: Use the Ice Cold Antidote on Alia Sunsoar.

70859.title: What the Guardian Beholds
70859.description:
I appreciate your aid, {class}. I was the Kirin Tor mage who first discovered this artifact, Valthrux, and the Sundered Flame's plans.

The retrieval and study of this supposedly sentient and powerful artifact is of the utmost importance, and mark my word, I shall be the one to do it.

The Sundered Flame guess at its location, but I've used my magic to find a path for us.

There is a corrupted guardian nearby that holds a magic shard connected to Valthrux. I can use it to find the rest of the artifact.
70859.completion:
Give it to me! Quickly now!

Did you hear the whispers too?
70859.objectives: Recover the Whispered Shard from Edavix, the Corrupted Guardian.

70871.title: Iskaaran Fishing Net
70871.description:
I see you're getting along with the villagers.

You seek to learn more about our ways of fishing you say? Well, first of all no one fishes with their bare hands. I can craft you a good, strong net worthy of an Iskaaran.
70871.progress: Have you found suitable materials? I need strongest vines of kelp, and some good stones with holes in them.
70871.completion: Here's your Iskaaran fishing net. Use it wisely, and never take from the cycle of life more than you need to sustain yourself.
70871.objectives: Bring Tavio materials and let her craft an Iskaaran fishing net.

70873.title: Chasing Waterfalls
70873.description:
The real threat lies in the Emberslate Cavern. This is where they carve those runestones and infuse them with primal fire.

No doubt you noticed the blazing wall of flame that blocks the entrance. I cannot dispel it, however I may be able to do something to help. I believe that with the proper application of Fallingwater, we can pass through it safely.

Harvest water motes from the nearby elementals.
70873.progress: We will need those motes to get you safely into the Emberslate Cavern.
70873.completion:
<Maldra examines the Fallingwater Motes.>

Yes, these should do nicely.

70874.title: To Breach a Fire Wall
70874.description:
The rebels inside the cavern have been imbued with an elemental blessing, allowing them to safely pass through the wall of flame. I can grant you that same boon.

Do not worry; I have seen the blessing granted many times. It shouldn't be any problem to recreate it effectively.
70874.completion: Worry not. That chilly, damp feeling is temporary.

70875.title: Worst of the Worst
70875.description:
The rebels in the Emberslate Cavern have an unflinching loyalty to the Primalists, and are therefore the greatest threat to Valdrakken.

Eliminate them, and any elementals they have unleashed.
70875.completion:
Well done, {NAME}.

Those who follow the Primalists cannot be allowed to spread chaos and destruction.
70875.objectives: Kill 3 rebels and 4 elementals in Emberslate Cavern.

70876.title: Fracture the Foci
70876.description:
If Maldra speaks the truth, the rebels are creating the runestones in the Emberslate Cavern.

Given the nature of these devices, we know there must be Primalist foci involved.

Destroy the foci. You will know them when you see them.

The rebels cannot be allowed to create any more weapons of destruction.
70876.completion: Without those foci, the rebels will no longer be able to imbue their runestones with explosive flame.
70876.objectives: Destroy 4 Primalist Foci in Emberslate Cavern.

70877.title: A Quack in Time
70877.description:
<This duckling is despondent, quietly quacking to itself as its eyes dart around in fear.>

<Maybe the ecologists would know how to help it?>
70877.progress:
<Tharu coos at the bubbled duckling.>

Shh, don't cry, little one.

Us big strong ecologists will keep you safe! And {NAME} too, of course.
70877.completion: Thanks for bringing Daisy to us. If there's two so far, there must be more, so keep an eye out next time you venture out there.
70877.objectives: Bring the Bubbled Duckling back to the Ecologists' Camp.

70878.title: Ring of Fire
70878.description:
In the deepest recesses of the Emberslate Cavern, the Primalists erected a fiery portal from which they unleash elementals.

I can seal it, but my actions will draw the ire of whatever is on the other side. Including the revenant Magmaticus the Primalists have been aiding.

I will need your protection if we are to stop them.
70878.completion:
Nicely done, {NAME}!

Maldra shared with me the details of your heroics.
70878.objectives: Protect Maldra Flametongue while she seals the Primalist portal.

70879.title: Report on the Rebels
70879.description:
I am impressed with what you have accomplished today. I hope you agree, {NAME}.

We have successfully shut down the nefarious activities of these Primalist-allied rebels. For now at least. We will need to keep a close watch on any dissent going forward.

Return to Captain Drine at your earliest convenience. She will want our full report.
70879.completion:
Welcome back, {NAME}.

My eyes and ears have just told me the good news.
70879.objectives: Meet Captain Drine at the top floor of the Seat of the Aspects.

70881.title: Fourth Challenge of Tyr: Resourcefulness
70881.description:
The engine is close to reaching its full potential. All it requires now is a power core to process any essence put into it more efficiently.

Tyr left the knowledge of such devices with Watcher Irideus. Go into the Halls of Infusion and find him. I am sure he will help you with whatever you need.
70881.completion:
Perhaps it was these enemies of order that Keeper Tyr wished to defend against. At least the loss of Watcher Irideus can still be a victory for us. By his power core we may power the engine and part of him shall always live on as creation of Tyr. 

<You can swear you see sadness cross over the maiden's face.>
70881.objectives: Obtain a Power Core from Watcher Irideus and defeat the Primal Tsunami in the Halls of Infusion.

70899.title: Fifth Challenge of Tyr: Ingenuity
70899.description:
As this was not how the Power Core was supposed to be obtained, it requires a re-attunement to the energies of the Engine. The resonance frequencies of the denizens of Tyrhold should bring the core to its full potential once more.

Though I do not wish to sacrifice more of my brethren, I believe this is the only way this challenge may be completed.
70899.completion: You have completed the last challenge. Though it comes at a loss, I believe it is for the greater good. Keeper Tyr meant for you to succeed.
70899.objectives: Attune Irideus' Power core with titanic energy from Tyrhold.

70900.title: Innovating the Engine
70900.description:
Tyr believed that the Engine of Innovation would be necessary for the battles to come. 

You have proven yourself worthy and overcome all the challenges set before you. You may now unlock the Engine's full potential.
70900.progress: <The Engine hums quietly as you approach>
70900.completion: <With the new core installed, the Engine pulses with warm energy>
70900.objectives: Insert the newly attuned Power Core into the Engine of Innovation.

70917.title: A Shoulder to Quack On
70917.description:
<This duckling is full of nervous energy. It seems eager to escape its current predicament.>

<Maybe the ecologists would know how to help it?>
70917.progress:
<Tharu coos at the bubbled duckling.>

Shh, don't cry, little one.

Us big strong ecologists will keep you safe! And {NAME} too, of course.
70917.completion: Thanks for bringing Dipper to us-- these ducklings are starting to pile up! Keep an eye out for any more.
70917.objectives: Bring the Bubbled Duckling back to the Ecologists' Camp.

70926.title: Stolen Totems
70926.progress:
Have you come to return our totems?
Sacred Tuskarr Totem (1)
70926.completion: Ah! Our totems are very important to us. You have our thanks for returning them, young one!

70927.title: More Stolen Totems
70927.progress:
Have you come to return our totems?
Sacred Tuskarr Totem (5)
70927.completion: There are far too many in these isles that prey on our people. Losing our totems is like losing pieces of ourselves--our heritage, our legacy! You have our thanks for returning these to us, young one.

70928.title: Hunting Trophy
70928.progress:
What have you brought me outsider?
Centaur Hunting Trophy (1)
70928.completion: Clan Shikaar knows a great hunting trophy when we see one. This will earn you much favor in our eyes.

70929.title: More Hunting Trophies
70929.progress:
What have you brought me, outsider?
Centaur Hunting Trophy (5)
70929.completion: Only the greatest of hunters can boast of this many great hunting trophies. You honor our hunt.

70931.title: Whispered Fragments
70931.description:
I believe Valthrux is trying to communicate to us through the shard we recovered.

We can use this to our advantage as long as we keep our minds guarded from the artifact's influence.

I was wrong about the Sundered Flame. They have unfortunately collected several shard fragments already. 

Valthrux's whispers claim they're close to finding its location.

Go and recover the shards from the Sundered Flame before they reach the artifact!
70931.progress: The whispers... they're... louder now. Do you have the fragments?
70931.completion: Excellent. With this many shards, I'll be able to easily locate the artifact.
70931.objectives: Recover 40 Whispering Fragments from the Sundered Flame.

70935.title: Catch and Release: Islefin Dorado
70935.progress:
If we over-fish this spot there will be no fish left for anyone. Sustainability is key.

Bring me any fish you want to return to the pools.
Islefin Dorado (20)
70935.completion: I will return these to the pools. Managing the fisheries is an important responsibility.

70936.title: Stolen Tuskarr Totems
70936.completion: You there, young one! Our warriors take totems with them when they venture out into the Dragon Isles. Our totems are part of our livelihood--they are very important to us. Our enemies delight in taking them as trophies, and we can't let that happen! Please, return any totems you find.

70937.title: What Valthrux Once Was
70937.description:
<To'tik whispers to you.> 

I don't like this. Mysterious artifacts whispering promises of greatness does not sound good.

But we can't just walk away... otherwise the Sundered Flame will get their hands on it. Whatever "it" is...

I'm familiar with ruins like this. The blue dragons often left behind notes on their work. Keep your eyes open, and you may find some around.

We can use whatever evidence you find to warn Alia and Kattigat.
70937.progress: Did you find anything useful in the ruins?
70937.objectives: Find clues regarding what the artifact Valthrux really is.

70938.title: Community Feasts
70938.description:
There you are, {NAME}! The soup's on! 

You better hurry up and get to Iskaara. Big Kinook has been looking for you. 

One time he told me to get a slimy, icky spinefish for the soup and I didn't want to, so I yelled: "No, chef!"

He was so mad I thought he was going to throw me in the soup!
70938.completion:
Are you ready to make magic, adventurer? 

No, I don't mean that hand wavy stuff some like to make. I mean the mystical aroma arts, the deep knowledge of ingredients and flavor, and the way a soup speaks to you to let you know what it needs. Is that you salivating? No? Must be me. 

Let's get cooking!
70938.objectives: Speak to Big Kinook at Iskaara in The Azure Span.

70941.title: Fishing Holes
70941.description:
Hello again! Did you know I'm gonna be the bestest fisherman in the village? I caught a giant piranha once. It tried to eat my face!

<Rowie looks around distractedly.>

Oh yeah! I have a message for you. Nunvuq, back in Iskaara, wants to tell you about fishing holes.
70941.completion:
Hail, fellow fisher. 

I'm almost hesitant to tell you of these serene fishing holes. But I must, because not doing so would deny you a bounty of fish and also the pleasure of a relaxing time fishing.

In telling everyone I worry about crowding my fishing spot, but I'll admit I can only take so much of the quiet. A good conversation with fishing friends is an even better way to relax than fishing alone!
70941.objectives: Speak to Nunvuq at Iskaara in The Azure Span.

70946.title: No One May Wield It
70946.description:
What you found makes it sound like the artifact's power has doomed everyone who has used it so far.

The dragonspawn who lived here killed each other over it. The Sundered Flame seem like they're also getting corrupted by its influence too.

This isn't an artifact we need to recover. It's one that needs to be destroyed before it can harm anyone else.

We must convince Alia and Kattigat.
70946.completion: This is worse than I thought. Way worse.

70957.title: The Sea Out West
70957.description:
Enjoying the greenery around our little scenery, {NAME}?

It reminds me of a dish I once tasted from a pair of dryad sisters and their kind treant friend. Sugarbough was their name! A resident of Shady Sanctuary on the western coast of the Plains.

It was a medley of fresh herbs, veggies, and spices. At the heart of this dish was the most delicious layer of sea kelp you have ever tasted!

What? Never tasted sea kelp before? Well you simply must seek some out. And bring back enough to share, please!
70957.objectives: Speak with Sugarbough at the Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

70958.title: Finest Fungi at the Feast
70958.description:
Fine dining is all about using the finest techniques on the finest ingredients, naturally. The food composed for fine dining is oft locked behind wealth and means, but we would never allow that at The Ruby Feast!

Morsel has informed me of a perfect ingredient for today's theme. One so rare, so exquisite, that it... does not exist yet! Tantalizing, no?

The bronze have uncovered a portal to a dangerous future. One where a black truffle with untold flavor exists!

You must go!
70958.completion: Oh, {NAME}? My plate is full, but I will always make room at the table for you.
70958.objectives: Speak with Warden Captain Sinjoirmi at the Temporal Conflux in Thaldraszus.

70965.title: Wanted: Watcher's Golden Girdle
70965.description:
<The posted sign is written in beautiful calligraphy.>

The archivists humbly request that all expedition members seek out the Watcher's Golden Girdle for our artifact archives.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for processing and compensation.

You may wish to start your search at our northern dig site, where Elementalist Taiyang has reported a malfunctioning Watcher causing trouble.
70965.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
70965.completion:
Whew, glad I don't have to wear this heavy thing!

I'll ensure this is properly documented, researched, and archived for the expedition.

70970.title: Good Intentions
70970.description:
I may know where the artifact is. Alia was whispering frantically when you brought all the shards back.

She kept saying something about a "cave" and how the spiders seemed attracted to it.

There's no cave in the area in front of us... which leads me to believe there might be one deeper in the ruins.

We'll stay here and keep your escape path open, {NAME}. Please save Alia and destroy this cursed artifact.
70970.completion:
To'tik was right. This place is cursed. 

We'll let the Kirin Tor know what happened here, {NAME}. Thank you for your help. 

This is a lesson I won't soon forget...
70970.objectives: Stop Alia Sunsoar and destroy the artifact Valthrux.

70975.title: Wanted: Everblazing Fireheart
70975.description:
<The posted sign is written in beautiful calligraphy.>

The archivists humbly request that all expedition members seek out the Everblazing Fireheart for our artifact archives.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for processing and compensation.

Some expedition members have reported seeing a massive fire elemental under control of the Primalists in the north that may provide an opportunity to acquire one.
70975.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
70975.completion:
The Primalists sure do love their elementals, huh?

I'll ensure this is properly documented, researched, and archived for the expedition.

70976.title: Slacking and Sledding
70976.description:
As you may know, the children of Iskaara are fiercely independent. They learn from a young age to fend for themselves.

It's a rite of passage for many of the older kids to sneak off to the iceberg southeast of here. Kiopo, the eldest of our children, is out there right now. Tell him I sent you, and he should offer you one of our sleds!

Ah, that reminds me of my younger days... out there with my friends...
70976.completion:
Oh, Murik sent you? He's really nice, so you must be really nice too!

Why did he send you? A sled? Of course I can give you a sled! 

We have two types. But if you want both, I'm gonna need some good stuff for a trade!
70976.objectives: Seek out Kiopo on the island to the southeast.

70981.title: Savory Seas
70981.description:
The smell of the sea! Do you smell it, {NAME}? Do you smell the multitude of minerals, laden with thick sea salt? Do you??

Suspiciously absent from the delights here today is a rare variety of fish I once tasted near the Iskaara's home in Azure Span. Two Tuskarr fellows were simply roasting one over a fire, and it filled that glacial tundra with the most savory aroma!

See if you can not find one for us. I know our patrons will be just as ensorcelled by the sea's flavor as I was that day.
70981.completion: Please tell me you aren't here with that Ironjaw fellow. We had enough gorloc troubles before he showed up...
70981.objectives: Speak with Wayun in Whaler's Nook of the Azure Span.

70985.title: The Lonely Scout
70985.description:
I know, I know, it's silly. A centaur and a dryad, right? We can't be more different.

But ever since I first laid eyes on the Emerald Gardens, I really have wanted to get to know one better. I just can't seem to say or do anything to keep them interested in me.

I've heard they're into... plants. And cute baby animals. And maybe killing poachers, but I don't even know where to start.

Please, you can talk to them, right? Could you ask around and find out what they like? Then maybe I can have a shot.
70985.progress:
Any luck? Please tell me there's hope.

It would just be so nice.
70985.completion:
Flowers!!

<Scout Santuun smacks her palm on her forehead.>

It's so obvious. I was overthinking it, like I always do.

Thank you, {NAME}, you're the best!
70985.objectives: Speak to dryads in Shady Sanctuary.

70987.title: Hearts of Starch
70987.description:
What could be better than a meal you can carry while you explore?

Street foods are the essence of busy cities this great world over. But not every meal is set for mobility. The core of great on-the-go cuisines is a starch that will hold strong while moving. Breads, potatoes, rices, and beyond are the heart of hand-sized dining.

I would like to treat my Pandaren peer here to a flavorful specimen known as Leapmaize. Morsel introduced it to me when we first met near the titan ruins in the Waking Shores.
70987.completion:
Great, you're finally here. I need a dozen more cushions, three tapestries, a scrollshelf, a few more of those enchanted brooms, and...

Wait. You're not with the Expedition. What do you want?
70987.objectives: Speak with Meliane Enorath at the Life Vault Ruins in the Waking Shores.

70988.title: The Egg's the Thing
70988.description:
"All the world's an egg." That is how the saying goes, right?

Eggs! They are the core of confections, and one of the great catalysts of culinary creation! They are the fat that puts acids, heats, and salts on their highest pedestals, to their highest potentials!

Our Isles are teeming with fowl of immense strength, but the Breezehunters of the Plains lay eggs primed with flavor!

They often nest on the Eastern side of the Plains, so ask around the outpost in Rusza'thar Reach.
70988.completion:
Oh! Hello!

Sorry about the mess here! I mean, I didn't cause it or anything, I'm just apologizing that you have to deal with it.

Not to imply you wouldn't be able to handle it! Just saying that you might be uncomfortable with the state our furniture is currently in.

Not that this is how we want the furniture set up! We don't want it set up like this, we were planning to... uhm...

What did you say you needed?
70988.objectives: Speak with Ilana at Rusza'thar Reach in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

70989.title: Part of a Pack
70989.description:
Perhaps your bakar needs to be shown the proper way to hunt by his own kind.

You may borrow some of our trained bakar. Take them and bring down the drake that circles the area. 

Let us see how Taivan behaves in a pack!
70989.progress: Have you brought down that drake yet? My bakar should be more than enough for your quarry.
70989.completion:
<Jadar shakes his head.>

Very disappointing. I'm afraid Taivan just does not have it in him to hunt like a Shikaar. Even with other bakar fighting beside him, he could not shake his unwillingness to attack his enemy. 

What a waste!
70989.objectives: Hunt the Ravenous Proto-Drake with Taivan and the pack of hunting bakar.

70992.title: Wanted: Lost Tuskarr Kite
70992.description:
<The posted sign is written in beautiful calligraphy.>

The archivists humbly request that all expedition members seek out the Lost Tuskarr Kite for our artifact archives.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for processing and compensation.

Some expedition members have reported seeing such a kite attached to a tuskarr transport along the western coast, but none have been able to reach it as the transport keeps it aloft and out of reach when traveling.
70992.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
70992.completion:
I wonder what all the little scrolls on here say? The archivists'll have fun with this one.

I'll ensure this is properly documented, researched, and archived for the expedition.

70994.title: Drainage Solutions
70994.description:
Want the honor of assisting world-renowned Head Geologist of the Dragonscale Expedition? That's right. I'm exactly who you think I am. And I'm in a bind!

I was perusing this river for new sedimentary samples, but then the water started to walk away with the most interesting pieces of silt!

I have here my patented water entrapment device, but it's in desperate need of someone to march around and siphon those elementals into it.

Think you're up to the task?
70994.completion:
Yes, that's it! That's the composition I was looking for! Thank you! Finally, someone knows when to listen to me.

Do me a favor and don't mention this to anyone back at basecamp, got it? My thesis is still in progress, and I'm supposed to be writing about volcanic sedimentary sources. I'm sure you can understand, yeah?
70994.objectives: Siphon 8 Glittery Streams in the cave east of the Life Vault Ruins.

70995.title: Wanted: Fenistrasza's Skull
70995.description:
<The posted sign is written in beautiful calligraphy.>

The archivists humbly request that all expedition members seek out Fenistrasza's Skull for our artifact archives.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for processing and compensation.

Some expedition members have reported seeing it in the possession of an outcast djaradin in the western mountains, but no one has been able to convince him to part with it yet.
70995.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
70995.completion:
<Cataloger Jakes frantically tries to prevent the magma pouring out of the skull's eye sockets from burning her other documents.>

Okay, now I KNOW the archivists are putting out these requests just to annoy me!

Nevertheless, I'll ensure this is properly documented, researched, and archived for the expedition.

70996.title: A Little Kelp for My Friends
70996.description:
Well gosh, it sure sounds like Grimtusk is in a pickle. I'd say I'm done with conflicts on the mainland, but...

Frostbite and I have got a history. And a score to settle.

Oh, fiddle! I can't leave the others here undefended... We've an issue with an elemental causing trouble at the beach. I'm the only one who can keep him at bay. Slippery fella... literally.

Tell you what. If you will deal with the elemental for me, I'll mosey on over to Grimtusk's camp.

Whaddaya say, champ?
70996.progress: How's it going? Did you get that slippery, slimy elemental yet?
70996.completion: Well I'll be! Guess I'm heading out to help my pal Grimtusk after all!
70996.objectives: Defeat the Wild Kelp Elemental on Longclaw Island.

70997.title: Wanted: Ruby Lifeband
70997.description:
<The posted sign is written in hasty scratches.>

Expedition members have reported a Primalist attack on the Ruby Life Pools, threatening the destruction of countless artifacts stored by our dragon allies there.

Toddy and Naleidea urge all combat-ready members to join the fight, and seek out the Ruby Lifeband if you are able.

It is a unique, priceless artifact that must be preserved.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for safekeeping until the dragons may safely retrieve it.
70997.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
70997.completion:
They say this was handcrafted by Alexstrasza herself? Thank the tides you saved it.

I'll ensure this is properly documented and researched while we have it for safekeeping.
70997.objectives: Find the Ruby Lifeband in the Ruby Life Pools.

71000.title: Barst Recruited
71000.description:
Well a deal's a deal. If Grimtusk needs a hand killing Frostbite once and for all, then I'm in.

What hate I have left in me I reserve for Frostbite. Did Grimtusk tell you what happened? 

All of us who hunted with Grimtusk thought we were unstoppable. Until we met Frostbite. 

Frostbite didn't just defeat us. He humiliated us in front of everyone in the hideaway. 

We were all defeated and left bloodied and battered at the hideaway. Frostbite used us as an example.

Now it's time for payback.
71000.completion: Here's Barst. Just as... annoying as ever.
71000.objectives: Let Grimtusk know you've recruited Barst.

71001.title: Wanted: Earthbound Primordial Core
71001.description:
<The posted sign is written in beautiful calligraphy.>

The archivists humbly request that all expedition members seek out the Earthbound Primordial Core for our artifact archives.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for processing and compensation.

Recent learnings from records recovered from the Obsidian Citadel indicate it may have once been stored in the Dragon's Hoard of Neltharus, although it's current location is unclear.
71001.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
71001.completion:
I can tell this one's going to be a troublemaker... I'll get the magically sealed containers Naleidea enchanted for problem cases.

Don't worry, I'll ensure this is properly documented, researched, and archived for the expedition.
71001.objectives: Find the Earthbound Primordial Core in Neltharus.

71002.title: Best Spell Ever
71002.description: <Gently levitating and emanating with arcane magic, this enchanted book contains countless spells and enchantments created by the chaotic yet beautiful mind of Millhouse Manastorm.>
71002.completion:
<Using your own knowledge of the arcane, you begin browsing through Millhouse's notes until you find a worn out page filled with numerous drawings of ducks, big and small. 

In the very center of it are words to Millhouse's newest conjuration with a curious hand note below: 

"Best Spell Ever.">
71002.objectives: Read "Manastorming for Beginners" and discover Millhouse's secret spell.

71004.title: Wanted: Ohuna Mass-Binding Totem
71004.description:
<The posted sign is written in beautiful calligraphy.>

The archivists humbly request that all expedition members seek out the Ohuna Mass-Binding Totem for our artifact archives.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for processing and compensation.

Expedition members have reported a particularly powerful Primalist in the Windsong Rise of the Ohn'ahran Plains, who appears to wield the rumored powers of this totem.
71004.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
71004.completion:
Not sure I see what all the fuss is about with this one. Feels like every other dirty hunk of rock I've held before.

Oh well, I'll ensure this is properly documented, researched, and archived for the expedition.

71005.title: Wanted: Fangfall
71005.description:
<The posted sign is written in beautiful calligraphy.>

The archivists humbly request that all expedition members seek out the legendary blade Fangfall for our artifact archives.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for processing and compensation.

The sword was reportedly fractured long ago, but expedition members have reported that the Sundered Flame is recovering fragments of it in ruins of the Ohn'aran Plains.
71005.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
71005.completion:
Ooo, I love puzzles! I should ask the archivists if I can help with putting these back together!

I'll ensure this is properly documented, researched, and archived for the expedition.

71007.title: Wanted: Disoriented Wishtail
71007.description:
<The posted sign is written in beautiful calligraphy.>

The archivists humbly request that all expedition members seek out the legendary Wishtail for our artifact archives.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for processing and compensation.

Expedition members have reported seeing a colorful fish matching its purported appearance inside a massive water elemental in Azure Span.
71007.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
71007.completion:
<Cataloger Jakes puts her ear close to the fish and listens intently while whispering to it.>

I know you can talk, little guy. Just say something and grant me a wish! It'll be easy!

<Cataloger Jakes sighs.>

It was worth a shot. I'll ensure this is properly documented, researched, and archived for the expedition.

71008.title: Wanted: Stoneheart's Stone Heart
71008.description:
<The posted sign is written in beautiful calligraphy.>

The archivists humbly request that all expedition members seek out Stoneheart's Stone Heart for our artifact archives.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for processing and compensation.

Expedition members have reported seeing Stoneheart in a cave of central Azure Span.
71008.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
71008.completion:
This used to be a beating furbolg heart? The Primalists really are something else...

I'll ensure this is properly documented, researched, and archived for the expedition.

71009.title: Elementary, My Dear Drakonid
71009.description:
Grimtusk wants to take another crack at Frostbite, eh? I hate to turn him down, but I left that life behind for the life of a scholar.

I'm trying to uncover the history--and make history. But I'm stumped by this esoteric riddle here in these ancient ruins. 

The riddle is this: if you touch a nearby crystal, it says "follow the pattern." But I haven't the faintest idea what that means!

Tell you what. If you can help me crack this riddle, I'll go help Grimtusk finish Frostbite off once and for all.
71009.progress: "Follow the pattern." What could that mean?
71009.completion: Oh dear... I'm not going to lie, {NAME}, this isn't my proudest moment.
71009.objectives: Help Varsek solve the mystery of the Ancient Outlook.

71010.title: Wanted: Temporal Spyglass
71010.description:
<The posted sign is written in beautiful calligraphy.>

The archivists humbly request that all expedition members seek out the Temporal Spyglass for our artifact archives.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for processing and compensation.

Expedition members have reported overhearing a dwarf bragging about his magical spyglass in the inns of Southern Thaldraszus. We recommend focusing your search in that region.
71010.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
71010.completion:
<Cataloger Jake shakes her head as she keeps the spyglass far from her eyes.>

No thanks. The present holds enough headaches for me. Don't need the past or present butting their unwanted faces in too.

I'll ensure this is properly documented, researched, and archived for the expedition.

71011.title: Wanted: Torrential Lily
71011.description:
<The posted sign is written in beautiful calligraphy.>

The archivists humbly request that all expedition members seek out the Torrential Lily for our artifact archives.

If acquired, please deliver to Cataloger Jakes for processing and compensation.

Expedition members have reported seeing a powerful Primalist in Gelikyr Overlook of Thaldraszus with a magical flower pinned to her collar. It is unknown if that is the legendary Torrential Lily, but it is a good place to start your search.
71011.progress: Do you have something for the archives?
71011.completion:
Just what we needed, another flower that leaks some weird liquid...

<Cataloger Jakes rolls her eyes.>

I'll ensure this is properly documented, researched, and archived for the expedition.

71012.title: Varsek Recruited
71012.description:
Seems like I'll be able to solve the mysteries of this place just fine in the future. 

Let's just never speak of this to Old Grimtusk, OK?

I'll make my way to his hideaway. I think I'll enjoy taking out some pent up aggression on Frostbite.
71012.completion: There's Varsek. Guess he finally solved whatever puzzle he was after, eh?
71012.objectives: Let Grimtusk know you've recruited Varsek.

71013.title: No Vengeance on an Empty Stomach
71013.description:
Now that we've gotten back to what we aimed to do, we need to have a talk tusk to tusk. That gnoll Frostbite? The one you spoke to?

We've got a history with him.

This may take awhile to explain. You go and get some fish while I talk, pup. We need to feed everyone. They need their strength for what's next.
71013.progress: It's hard work fishing out here. That's the point.
71013.completion:
Now you know what's at stake. 

Time to get moving.
71013.objectives: Fish 3 Frozen Tail Darters within Grimtusk's Hideaway.

71014.title: A Far Furbolg Friend
71014.description:
Barst was one of the toughest furbolgs I've ever known. It says something about Frostbite that his pack beat him in a fight.

Last I heard, Barst left for some island off the coast of Iskaara. Called it his "retirement" or some other garbage.

Tell Barst it's time to get back into action. 

Oh, and don't be fooled by the way he talks. He'll tear you in two if you look at him wrong.
71014.completion: Well, look at you! You made it all the way over here! How can I help you?

71015.title: All Brawn, No Brains
71015.description:
Varsek is one of the toughest drakonids you'll ever meet. One of the dumbest ones too, but he'll never admit that.

He got spooked after Frostbite and started re-evaluating his life or... something. Said he never got to study the ruins left behind by his ancestors. Ran off to be a "scholar".

Get Varsek back here. He doesn't belong there anyhow!
71015.completion: It's very nice to meet you, but as you can see, I'm a bit busy trying to solve this puzzle.
71015.objectives: Find Varsek in the Ancient Outlook.

71016.title: Grimtusk's Sister
71016.description:
Last is my sister, Naluki. She helps run the inn at Iskaara now.

Just give her this letter. 

Don't open it.
71016.completion:
Why, well aren't you just a fresh fish hopping out of the water! 

What's this? A letter from Grimtusk?
71016.objectives: Deliver Grimtusk's letter to his sister, Naluki, in Iskaara.

71017.title: Naluki's Letter
71017.description:
Let me guess, Grim told you not to open the letter, right?

Looks like you did as you were told. No wonder he trusts you so much! 

Give him this fish head for me. He'll know what it means.
71017.completion:
<It's hard to tell, but you think you see a slight smile on Grimtusk's face. It quickly fades away.>

This will do.
71017.objectives: Deliver Naluki's fishhead to Old Grimtusk.

71019.title: Vault of the Incarnates: Break a Few Eggs
71019.description:
Broodkeeper Diurna is somewhere within this fortress, no doubt watching over the vault from her chamber. If you can claim pieces of her greatstaff, it should allow us to assault her lair directly.

Three should be enough. Four seems excessive.
71019.progress: The power contained in these shards will allow us to quickly access The Clutchwarren.
71019.completion: These should allow us to ascend to Diurna's chamber more readily.
71019.objectives: Collect 3 Shards of the Greatstaff from Broodkeeper Diurna within the Vault of the Incarnates on Heroic Difficulty.

71022.title: Reign of the Ram
71022.description:
Since the argali don't seem to have much respect for Taivan, we should see if he can handle the herd's ram next.

He's the boss of all the argali here, and quite the stubborn thing. If Taivan can assert dominance over the ram, the herd will start obeying him.

You can find him just over there, on the hill. Good luck, Taivan. If this doesn't work, I'm afraid there's not much hope for him being a herder!
71022.progress: The herd's ram is on the hill just over there. Hopefully Taivan handles this task a little better.
71022.completion:
That could have gone better. Sorry, friend, but I don't think Taivan is cut out for this. 

He's a very nice bakar, but doesn't quite seem smart enough to figure out how to get the argali into the pen, or aggressive enough to take command of the herd away from the ram. 

I'm afraid I'm going to have to send you back to Selbekh with bad news.
71022.objectives: Command Taivan to confront the herd's Stubborn Ram.

71024.title: Chaos and Commotion
71024.description:
{NAME}! Did you hear the noise? There has been an incident on the bottom floor.

One of my trusted investigators, Erima, was there first. He will require assistance gathering evidence while he tries to interview the crowd.
71024.completion:
I am grateful Captain Drine sent you to help.

You have keen eyes and are resourceful.
71024.objectives: Help Erima investigate the incident at the bottom floor of the Seat of the Aspects.

71026.title: Against Overwhelming Odds
71026.description:
Though you puny mortals have come to a truce, I have heard rumor that some of you still harbor grudges.

If you gather some friends, I know a place you can show the other side who is truly superior.

And to make it interesting, if you are successful I have a prize for you.
71026.objectives: Slay 25 Level 70 Horde anywhere within the Dragon Isles.

71027.title: WANTED: Mara'nar the Thunderous
71027.description:
Looking for a mighty hunter to take down a rampaging beast!

A thunder lizard named Mara'nar the Thunderous worked his way from Thunderspine Thicket to Primordial Vale, disrupting local wildlife. It has electrified water, knocked down trees, and broken duck nests.

This menace must be stopped. Slay him and bring one of his plates to Khansguard Jebotai as proof.

May Ohn'ahra guide you.
71027.completion: Mara'nar has been slain. May his kin learn to stay within their own lands.
71027.objectives: Slay Mara'nar the Thunderous in Primordial Vale and retrieve one of his plates.

71028.title: Hunting Tactics: Blessing of Ohn'ahra
71028.description: Your renown with the Maruuk grows. Listen closely, and I will teach you to call upon a blessing of Ohn'ahra to protect you and your allies.
71028.objectives: Select a blessing of Ohn'ahra for use in the Grand Hunt.

71029.title: Hunting Tactics: Companion Training
71029.description: Your renown with the Maruuk grows once more. For your efforts, I will teach you to command your hunting companion more effectively in combat.
71029.objectives: Choose an additional companion ability for use in the Grand Hunt.

71034.title: Dragon Isles Artifacts
71034.progress:
Do you have something for the archives?
Dragon Isles Artifact (1)
71034.completion:
Ooo, a new artifact. Let me log it in the ledger and note you returned it. 

<Cataloger Jakes makes a notation in her ledger.> 

Got it! Keep them coming!

71035.title: Multiple Dragon Isles Artifacts
71035.progress:
Do you have something for the archives?
Dragon Isles Artifact (5)
71035.completion:
Look at all these artifacts! This might take a minute. 

<Cataloger Jakes hastily makes several notes in her ledger.> 

Got it! Off with you, now! Come back if you have more!

71041.title: Many Stolen Totems
71041.progress:
Have you come to return our totems?
Sacred Tuskarr Totem (5)
71041.completion: There are far too many in these isles that prey on our people. Losing our totems is like losing pieces of ourselves--our heritage, our legacy! You have our thanks for returning these to us, young one.

71042.title: A Titan Relic
71042.progress:
Have you found a Titan Relic?
Titan Relic (1)
71042.completion:
Amazing! This relic is perfectly preserved. I will begin studying it right away.

Your efforts are most appreciated! I will remember my promise to speak well of you to the Valdrakken Accord. 

Now, where was I? Yes, this will fit in right over here...

71043.title: More Titan Relics
71043.progress:
What have you brought me today?
Titan Relic (5)
71043.completion:
How did you find so many of these? This is a veritable treasure trove of relics! One day you must tell me your secret. 

Once again you have greatly increased our knowledge of the titans. The Valdrakken Accord will think well of you indeed!

71053.title: Hermit Kill Quest
71053.description: Help! all these bunnies are eating my flesh! Please, kill them before they kill us all!
71053.objectives: Kill 5 Bunny of Doom in Training Plaza.

71094.title: Help Is Our Way!
71094.description:
Hiya! 

Are you also here to help? You look very helpful!

<Heleth points to the injured dracthyr.>

That guy hurt his wing trying to fly all the way up here! He looks like one of those bad guys from downstairs, but I'm not scared of him! I'm gonna help him out anyway, because that's our way!

<Heleth puffs out their chest.> 

I'll stand guard over him, while you go find some bandages!
71094.progress: Finally! New people to play with!
71094.completion: We're gonna help this bad guy out so good!
71094.objectives: Find bandages in the tower above the Cobalt Assembly to heal Venderthvan.

71095.title: A Claw in Need
71095.description:
Let's see what we can do to help this guy!

<Heleth leans in close and whispers.>

Don't worry, we aren't gonna let him take anything or stuff like that. Let's just have some fun!

It's been ages since anyone has come up here to check up on us. We're SO bored!

<Heleth winks at you.> 

Why don't you ask him what he wants?
71095.progress: Go ahead, {race}, do all the work for me. It will be a piece of cake to take the artifact from you when the moment is right.
71095.completion:
That looks promising. Give it here. 

...what do you mean you're not going to give it to me?
71095.objectives: Ask Venderthvan how you can help him and do what he says.

71096.title: Is A Claw Indeed
71096.description:
<Venderthven rubs his eyes and groans in pain.>

Fine. If you won't give it to me, you can do the work of figuring out how to make it work. 

I'll just take it from you when you're done. By force, if necessary.

So go ahead. Give it a shake or something.
71096.progress: <Venderthvan is distracted, looking at a toy duck Nezzie is showing him.>

71097.title: A Helping Claw
71097.description:
Alright, you've charged the artifact. Let's turn it on.

And stop giving me that look. Don't pretend like you aren't curious to see if it works. 

Just give that thing another shake, back away slowly, and let me finish the job.
71097.completion:
Enough... enough!

I didn't sign up for this. 

Just take the artifact. Before I think too hard about this and change my mind.
71097.objectives: Activate the artifact in the tower above Cobalt Assembly and monitor Venderthvan's actions.

71135.title: Loose Ends
71135.description:
If there's anything I learned from my time out in the wilderness, it's that if you don't deal with an evil when you find it--if you don't break its bones and dig up its roots, it'll keep growing. And then it'll be harder to kill.

These mountains were plagued with Frostbite's existence when I was a young pup like you, and it will only get worse once he takes full control of the Snowhide tribe. 

I should have done something about him long ago, but we're the only ones who can right that mistake now.
71135.progress: We cannot rest until Frostbite and the Snowhide gnolls have been dealt with.
71135.objectives: Confront Frostbite at the Snowhide Camp in the Azure Span.

71138.title: Waygate: Rusza'thar Reach
71138.description:
An expeditionary member reported a dormant stone sighting atop a lookout in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Up fer an adventure?
71138.completion:
Up and runnin' already? That was quick!

I'll hold onto this here vessel. Looks like it's still got some energy wizzin' about!

Never know if if we'll be needin' it again.
71138.objectives: Locate the Dormant Waygate at the Rusza'thar Reach in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

71139.title: Glowing Arcane Jewel
71139.description:
<This jewel seems to be quite powerful. There is an eerie glow to it.

Perhaps it's best to deliver it to the Kirin Tor for it to be placed in a safe spot.>
71139.completion:
Look at this jewel! I'll make sure it gets to Dalaran immediately for study. 

Here, take this for your efforts. We recently uncovered it from another excavation.
71139.objectives: Bring the Glowing Arcane Jewel to Noriko the All Knowing in Camp Antonidas.

71141.title: Gills with Gall
71141.description:
Kad'irsza is reckless, but she knows her crabs. The gorlocs have gone too far!

I noticed the gorlocs going to Gurblbrblr for everything. Notably, he is instructing them to take crabs prisoner. We cannot allow this to continue, for the balance of life, and for the safety of those who tend it.

Defeat Gurblbrblr. Remove their means of expanding beyond this river!
71141.progress: Do not permit the gorlocs to encroach on the wildlife!
71141.completion:
Good. Now the gorlocs will lack the wherewithal to shackle more of these crabs. 

... And you have done more than just protect the crabs, {NAME}. You have protected Kad'irsza as well. I thank you.
71141.objectives: Kill Gurblbrblr the Invader in Cliffdrip Camp.

71143.title: The Horde Slayer
71143.description:
Wow! Keep it up, soldier! 

Slay a bit more Horde and you will go down in the record books among the Alliance. 

But it won't be easy, the Horde have put a bounty on your head, so watch it!

For the Alliance!
71143.objectives: While being hunted by the Horde, slay 10 Horde without dying.

71144.title: The Alliance Slayer
71144.description:
Yes! Keep going, keep slaying those Alliance dogs!

Slay a bit more Alliance and you may set a new record, {class}.

But it won't be easy, the Alliance have put a bounty on your head, so watch it!

For the Horde!
71144.objectives: With a bounty on your head, slay 10 Alliance without dying.

71146.title: Continued Waygate Exploration
71146.description:
<The explorer-in-training hands you a taut, rolled note. Upon investigating, it appears to be from an old friend, Thaelin Darkanvil, seeking your aid.

Before scurrying off, the critter extends its hand as if it were seeking a treat. Moments later, a loud screech rings out as the curious creature storms off empty handed.>
71146.objectives: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost in The Waking Shores.

71148.title: Continued Waygate Exploration
71148.description:
<The curious creature before you presents a note--signed and sealed by the Dragonscale Expedition.

A call for assistance from a famed explorer, perhaps.>
71148.objectives: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost in The Waking Shores.

71149.title: Continued Waygate Exploration
71149.description:
<Surprisingly, the messenger did not leave you with a satchel or a note this time, rather a single item from Thaelin's personal collection.

Upon further investigation, a tiny little message from Thaelin seeks your assistance once again.>
71149.objectives: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost in The Waking Shores.

71150.title: Continued Waygate Exploration
71150.description:
<The parchment emits an unpleasant, mold-like smell. After struggling to regain focus, it becomes clear Thaelin needs your assistance in seeking answers to newly discovered findings.

The only question that remains is what to do with this parchment of intolerable odor.>
71150.objectives: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost in The Waking Shores.

71151.title: Continued Waygate Exploration
71151.description:
<The letter is clean, crisp and bears the seal of the Dragonscale Expedition.

Thaelin Darkanvil requests your presence.>
71151.objectives: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost in The Waking Shores.

71155.title: The Azure Vaults
71155.description:
We have a problem, {NAME}.

Beneath the Azure Archives rests the Azure Vault. In my life, I stored many important and dangerous magical curiosities in it.

A large group of Sundered Flame have broken into the vault, convinced it holds some kind of secrets.

Please, you must go in there and stop this brazen assault before they unleash dangers they do not comprehend.

These thieves know not what lies within.
71155.progress: Do be careful within the vaults.
71155.completion:
Ten thousand years of delaying what I feared in my heart would be the inevitable end for my child. 

Malygos and I hoped one day we would find a cure. Though that day never came, I would not change any of our actions.

We must always strive for hope, even if it seems nonexistent. 

I take comfort in knowing at least my child is now reunited with the true Sindragosa and Malygos.

Now go.

71157.title: Waygate: Skytop Observatory
71157.description:
Word from some of our northern explorers is there's another o' those stones high atop the spire to the northeast.

Heard it's quite difficult tae reach bein' so high up and all, but I'm sure ye can find a way!
71157.completion:
The spire-seeker returns!

Hope it wasn't too much trouble fer ya.
71157.objectives: Locate the Dormant Waygate at the Skytop Observatory in The Waking Shores.

71161.title: Waygate: Vakthros
71161.description:
Received a report of another of them dormant stones in the wintry region tae the southeast.

Now before ye go gettin' all excited just know this isn't a place most go willingly, but if ye feel the need fer adventure and possible death, this is fer you!

Sold ye on it enough yet? Good!

Toss on yer warmest attire, then head east until the chill of the wind tickles yer nose and keep goin'. You'll know yer close when ye start feelin' the toughness in yer breath and the chill in yer bones.
71161.completion:
Bit chilly, wasn't it?

Now that that's o'er and done with, what's next on yer agenda?
71161.objectives: Locate the Dormant Waygate atop the spire in Vakthros in The Azure Span.

71162.title: Waygate: Algeth'era
71162.description:
Another stone. Another spire.

Best be gettin' along on yer journey. This one's quite a trek and dangerous tae boot! At least accordin' tae the ones who discovered it.

Are ye up fer it?
71162.progress: Can always count on ye tae get the job done.
71162.completion:
I'm startin' tae wonder when this vessel might run out of power. Errr, maybe I'm the only one thinkin' that.

What's in this thing anyways?

<Thaelin shakes the vessel, but it makes no sound.>
71162.objectives: Locate the Dormant Waygate atop the spire in Algeth'era in Thaldraszus.

71165.title: Waygate: Eon's Fringe
71165.description:
Far across the land in the mountainous regions of Thaldraszus sits a little inn nestled on the mountainside. Just inside the entryway sits a long-forgotten, dormant stone.

What say ye? Up fer another adventure, {NAME}?
71165.progress: Ye know I'd love tae sit around and talk, but there's work tae do.
71165.completion:
Yer adventurous nature never ceases tae amaze!

I wonder how many more o' these things are out there.
71165.objectives: Locate the Dormant Waygate at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.

71178.title: Waygate: Shady Sanctuary
71178.description: Our expedition reports a dormant stone out in the lush hillsides to the southwest. It's quite a journey, but worth sendin' someone with yer knowledge tae investigate.
71178.completion:
Looks like it worked!

I'll keep the vessel safe in case we'll be needin' it again.
71178.objectives: Locate the Dormant Waygate at the Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

71179.title: Look to the Overlook
71179.description:
{NAME}, I have another task for you.

There have been reports of Primalist activity near the Gelikyr Post that threaten our control of Tyrhold.

Speak with Commander Thadezus and see how you can assist.
71179.completion:
<Thadezus sighs deeply.>

You are telling me that Drine sent you?
71179.objectives: Speak with Commander Thadezus at the Gelikyr Overlook.

71182.title: Wayward Archivists
71182.description:
You, dracthyr. 

Two of your kin have been searching the archives just south of here. I have yet to introduce myself, and would appreciate the company.

If you have the time, I can meet you in the upper archive.
71182.completion: You are a very jumpy bunch.
71182.objectives: Meet Sindragosa in the upper archive in the Azure Archives.

71191.title: Net Worth
71191.description:
Alas, my fishing net was carried away by the stream. <Sigh> I'm not too keen to use fishing poles like my friends...
If you happen to find my fishing net around, bring it back to me.
71191.completion: You you found it! Alas, too late, I've got a replacement from Tavio in Iskaara already. Feel free to keep it, it's best fit for catching fish in these icy waters.

71193.title: Underwater Menace
71193.description:
Did you see that? Underwater! A huge, armored, hungry beast! No way I'm getting near water with my net while that monstrosity lurks below. If you want, you can likely lure it out with a handful of Ominous Conches. Those shouldn't be too hard to catch.

To gain conchs, be sure to have your Iskaaran Harpoon handy as you fish in the Dragon Isles.
71193.progress: You're not afraid of littoral megafauna, are you? Because I am!
71193.completion: You don't mind sharing some of the meat with me? Why thank you, let me show you the best fishing net spot around in return.

71195.title: To Tame A Thunderspine
71195.description:
I guess this is Lizi's new favorite spot. She hasn't been interested in coming back home. After all, she is a wild beast.

I have to tell you... I haven't spoken to Meluun since we saved Lizi. I know she was right, but I don't know how to approach her. She doesn't seem to approve of anything I do. I know I have to focus more on my training.

Meluun makes a stomping good curry that Lizi would love. Do you think you could ask her for it? She's usually working in the Ohn's house west of the springs.
71195.progress: Did you talk to Meluun yet?
71195.completion: I can smell the curry from here! Oh, by the ancestors, Lizi will be so happy! I'll take this as a sign that Meluun hasn't cast me out of her good graces completely.
71195.objectives: Collect Meluun's Green Curry in the Ohn'iri Springs and 150 Dragon Isles Supplies.

71196.title: To Tame A Thunderspine
71196.description:
I'm so happy that Lizi is safe and sound with us.

However, her wounds are healing slower than expected. I hope that the magic inflicted upon her didn't cause permanent damage.

Could you help me gather insect ichor? I know, it sounds gross! It's actually the base of many healing ointments.
71196.progress: Have you returned with more ichor? I hate to see Lizi still in pain.
71196.completion: I'll go apply it to her wounds right away. It should offer immediate relief.
71196.objectives: Collect 20 Fluorescent Fluid from insects around the Dragon Isles and 150 Dragon Isles Supplies.

71197.title: To Tame A Thunderspine
71197.progress:
Lizi is healed, but she's still nervous about leaving her spot. In the wild, she'd forage about a musken's weight of plants a day. It's impossible for me to do that! We need her to move out of the water and to the grasses.

I'll keep trying to coax her out, but in the meantime, could you help me forage? I hear there are especially nutritious high-fiber leaves in the Emerald Gardens. Please bring back any you can find!
High-Fiber Leaf (20)
Collect: Dragon Isles Supplies (150)
71197.completion: This should tide her over until she can forage by herself again.

71198.title: To Tame A Thunderspine
71198.progress:
Lizi's doing so much better. She's moving around with ease and consuming everything edible in sight.

I learned today that thunderspines enjoy eating fish--especially piranhas! How fascinating! It is how they keep the piranha population in check at home.

Will you go fish some? Mind your fingers!
Thousandbite Piranha (10)
Collect: Dragon Isles Supplies (150)
71198.completion: Those piranhas sure look...crunchy. I'm glad a predator exists for them.

71199.title: To Tame A Thunderspine
71199.progress:
Everyone is curious about Lizi, but the truth is, she sticks out like a sore hoof. Lizi herself is starting to wander more and more, as if she's looking for something.

She mostly rests by the water on the mud. I'm sure it's fine, but I know thunderspines like to make a bedding from grasses.

I've got an idea better than grasses. Will you help me gather wool from the plains? I'll weave her a blanket and some toys.
Woolly Mountain Pelt (20)
Collect: Dragon Isles Supplies (150)
71199.completion: Perfect! This will do! I've not met an animal that doesn't like soft things.

71209.title: Beast of the Plains
71209.description:
I think Lizi is ready to be a beast of the plains again. She's so friendly to you and I now, but I can tell she wants to return to the wild.

One day, when I am a Windsage, I will explore all of the world beyond these springs. But first--my midseason initiate trials! How time flies.

I made a saddle and reins from the wool you gathered. Lizi will be happy to come at your call.

Please take her on all the adventures, $p.
71209.completion: Don't forget to visit me sometime! Goodbye, {NAME}!

71210.title: To Dragonbane Keep!
71210.description:
<Flaps drops a slightly singed note into your hand.>

{NAME}, the Obsidian Outcasts have heard tales of your bravery. Our former home, Dragonbane Keep, has fallen into djaradin hands. We can't let that stand. Join us in reclaiming our territory.

- Boss
71210.completion: Another battle is won, but the war continues.

71226.title: Kill Rock Snails
71226.description: Help! all these bunnies are eating my flesh! Please, kill them before they kill us all!
71226.objectives: Kill 5 Bunny of Doom in Training Plaza.

71227.title: Aerial Challenges
71227.description:
<Flaps flaps his wings excitedly, dropping both a note and a singed rodent at your feet.>

Dragonrider! Your flight prowess has become well known. Come test yourself in Aerial Challenges across the Dragon Isles.

Speak to any Bronze Timekeeper to get started.
71227.completion:
Another challenger? Welcome! 

Aerial Challenges are timed races on courses throughout the Dragon Isles. Beat track times to earn your rank.
71227.objectives: Speak to a Bronze Timekeeper to learn about aerial challenges.

71229.title: Call of the Plains
71229.description:
<Roki drops a message into your hand.>

{NAME}, Clan Aylaag has heard tales of your great deeds. We invite you to meet our clan and share our ways.

Hadari Khan
71229.completion: Your aid is welcome, Dragonrider. There is much to be done around our camp.
71229.objectives: Speak to Hadari Khan in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

71230.title: Tuskarr Fishing Gear
71230.description:
Hi again, {NAME}.

<Rowie looks around and hums a little tune.>

Oh right! Tavio was making me a new net and said she could make you one too. She can make some other fishing gear too if you bring her all the stuff.

You should go talk to her.
71230.completion: My family is known as the best weavers of nets and crafters of harpoons. If you bring me the supplies I need, I can craft some new tools for you.
71230.objectives: Speak to Tavio at Iskaara in The Azure Span.

71231.title: Call of the Hunt
71231.description:
<Roki drops the note into your hand>

{NAME}, Clan Shikaar invites you to the Grand Hunt. Meet with Trainer Frodrum in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
71231.completion: Dragonrider! Your aid will be welcome in the coming hunts.
71231.objectives: Speak to Trainer Frodrum in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

71232.title: Renown of the Dragon Isles
71232.description:
There is still much that must be done to aid the Dragon Isles.

I would ask you speak with Koszaru. He has much information regarding who needs help within this land.
71232.completion:
Good to see you, {NAME}. 

There are many sources of power within the Dragon Isles, as long as you know where to look!

71233.title: Falling Water
71233.description:
I love waterfalls. 

Want to know what's better than a waterfall? 

Two waterfalls. 

And the only thing better than that is... well, check out Three-Falls to the west of here and you'll see!

The innkeeper there is quite nice.
71233.completion:
Welcome to Three-Falls Lookout! 

We're pretty high up, and there's rushing water everywhere--so look out!
71233.objectives: Talk to Willa at Three-Falls Lookout in the Azure Span.

71234.title: Nook News
71234.description:
You there, {race}. 

You look well-travelled. 

My cousin Wayun was bringing a catch over from Whaler's Nook and mentioned that some... strange folk have set up camp over there.

They appear to be behaving themselves, but would you mind checking in on Wayun?

He can be a bit salty.
71234.objectives: Visit Whaler's Nook in the Azure Span.

71235.title: Field Mages
71235.description:
Lok'tar, {race}. 

If you have the time, we have two mages doing fieldwork nearby who I'm sure could use a hand.

This is a dangerous land in the best of times. 

These are not the best of times.
71235.completion:
We don't need your help.

But we'll take it.
71235.objectives: Check on the Kirin Tor mages near Slyvern Plunge in the Azure Span.

71238.title: The Ruby Feast!
71238.description:
Attention to all aspiring culinarians!

Does your heart desire the ultimate flavors of this world? Do you seek out opportunities for grand exploration? Are you willing to risk life and limb for complete strangers?

If this is you, come speak with the eminently distinguished, world-renowned chef duo, Rumiastrasza and Morsel! Currently hosting The Ruby Feast in the city of Valdrakken!
71238.completion: Is this about the posters? Did they actually work?!
71238.objectives: Speak with Chefs Rumiastrasza and Morsel at The Ruby Feast.

71239.title: Lost to the Skies
71239.description:
I need a favor, and you look like the favor-doing type.

An ol' pal of mine, Harleen Chirpsnide, was supposed to meet me in the city a few days ago. We was planning to eat our way through The Ruby Feast, get a trim at the barbershop, then visit that swanky auction house they got here.

But she ain't shown up. She gets lost in her work plenty, but I'd feel a lot more comfortable knowing where she was.

Try the mountains south of here. She mentioned she'd be swinging by on her way in.
71239.completion: Ol' Fizzlecrank is worried, eh? Guess the drinks are on me when I finish up here.
71239.objectives: Locate Harleen Chirpsnide in the Bluefeather Cliffs.

71241.title: Duck, Duck, Trap
71241.description:
The grove called the Primordial Vale is rich with the magic of the old dragons. A type of slyvern there are prized by my kin for their fur, but they are elusive and hard to find.

Instead of having you try to track them down, you can find some of our hunting traps in the area. Use meat from the nearby waterfowl to reset them - I will send some of our clan to retrieve whatever gets caught.
71241.progress: The fowl in the area are the preferred source of food for the slyverns.
71241.completion: Thank you. Our clan will hopefully be able to use the resulting pelts for trade.
71241.objectives: Reset the Clan Aylaag hunting traps at the Primordial Vale.

71242.title: Supporting the Storm Researchers
71242.description:
This looks like a large cluster of overflowing power from creatures within the Primalist Storm.

There's bound to be a researcher in Valdrakken who'll want this.
71242.completion: Oh, marvelous! This is just what we were looking for, thank you.
71242.objectives: Bring the Elemental Overflow Cluster to a researcher in Valdrakken.

72027.title: [DNT] Training Kill Quest JKP
72027.description: Someone left these lava vipers all over the place. I bet if you kill them Sam Snakehater will give you rewards. Also, get rid of that snake charmer out there. He can't be making Sam happy.

72060.title: Special Treatment
72060.description: <The mud mask looks curious about your intentions, but it is cornered on this branch!>
72060.progress:
I know my sunglasses are amazing, but come on now. This is the second time an ooze has run off with them!

How am I supposed to be gorgeous in these conditions?

Wait, did you find them again?!
72060.completion:
Oh, wow. Look at all that snot on them.

<Zeldis pauses.>

You know, I think they were going out of style anyway.

Keep that sludge away from me. 

Or keep it as a pet, whatever floats your boat.
72060.objectives: Return the sunglasses to Zeldis. Again.

72063.title: Return Yennu's Toy Boat
72063.description: <This hand made toy boat resembles the ships of the Tuskarr. Yennu, the young Tuskarr, was musing about a boat, it must belong to him>
72063.completion: My boat! Thank you so much.
72063.objectives: Return the toy boat to Yennu alongside the river in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

72068.title: Aiding the Accord: A Feast For All
72068.description:
Our allies require your aid, {NAME}!

Your efforts throughout the Isles have not gone unnoticed. Our trusted allies to the south, the Iskaara Tuskarr, seek to celebrate your accomplishments with a feast of all feasts!

Journey to the lands of Iskaara whilst continuing your work alongside the allies of the Accord. When you reach the shimmering waters of the southern lands do not hesitate to participate in the celebrations!
72068.progress: Back so soon? Where does the time go?
72068.completion: You look well-traveled, {NAME}... and well fed. Your adventurous endeavors bring stability to our lands and comfort to our allies.

72069.title: Subglacial Refill
72069.description:
The fish could be biting better, don't you think?

You know, that gives me an idea. Seems we have caught almost all the fish under the ice. Could you catch some more from the Timbertooth Trail downstream, bring it here, and drop it into an ice hole?
72069.progress: Have you dropped those fish yet?
72069.completion: Good work, I can already see more fish flickering under the ice.
72069.objectives: Collect fish to restock the fishing hole and throw it into an Ice Hole.

72071.title: Round Two, Fish!
72071.description:
How do you feel about doing a little fishing, then, {NAME}?

There's a school of bait fish just offshore that the dumb beast attacks whenever they gather, forgetting that it's already dead.

Swim out there and wave that lure around, maybe do your best impression of a wounded seal, and it won't be able to resist.
72071.progress: It's out there. I can feel it.

72074.title: Highland Habitat
72074.description:
The fish could be biting better, don't you think?

You know, that gives me an idea. Legend says these lakes and rivers did not always have fish. They say, these watering holes were stocked with fish when the dragons soaring overhead dropped them! Can you believe it?

Maybe you and your drake could give it a try?
72074.progress: Have you dropped those fish yet?
72074.completion: Ha! The legends are true, how fantastic!
72074.objectives: Collect fish to restock the fishing hole and mount your drake to drop them from above.

72083.title: Me Lucky Lure
72083.description:
Ya find me in a low place, {race}, and it's not because I'm dead.

I died on the hunt, making sure the beast that killed me crew wouldn't live to kill again. There's nothing wrong with that, it's what me Pa would have wanted.

No, the problem is that the fight was a draw!

The beast's spirit is still out there, as sure as I stand here before ya. But, being a ghost, I can't even reclaim me lucky lure from the critters that picked me body clean to have another go!

Would ya mind helping me out?
72083.progress: No, I don't know which one ate it. I was busy being dead at the time.
72083.completion: No fish can resist me lucky lure, living or dead!

72122.title: Erstwhile Ecologists
72122.description:
The wounded are stabilized, but something still troubles me, {NAME}.

A pair of dragonspawn ecologists had come to the outpost to study the wetlands. I haven't seen scale nor claw of them since the attack, and it's become worrisome.

If you're venturing out, would you mind keeping an eye out, and making sure they're safe?

And do take care. Rumor has it those wetlands are gorloc-infested.
72122.completion:
An attack? On Dragonheart Outpost?

Well, that does sound serious. But as you can see, we're dealing with our own crisis here.
72122.objectives: Check in on the wayward ecologists.

72129.title: Aiding Khadgar
72129.description:
Welcome to Dalaran, {NAME}. I'm glad you made it through safely.

Speak to me within the Violet Citadel. There's much to do.
72129.completion:
Good to see you again, {NAME}. 

The Broken Isles is in in dire need of aid.
72129.objectives: Meet Khadgar within the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.

72134.title: An Adventurer's Aid
72134.description:
We've discovered that there are many issues around the land which we float above, the Broken Isles.

We'll do what we can from here. I want you to look at the nearby map to see who you can aid first.
72134.completion: Fine choice, adventurer. Let's get to work.
72134.objectives: Use the Scouting Map to choose your first zone.

72155.title: Spread the Enchantment
72155.description: Algeth'ar Academy has put in an order for more enchanting rods. We need everyone to pitch in if we are going to fill the order on time. Could you be of assistance?
72155.progress: Hurry! We are running out of time!
72155.completion:
Thank you. With this order filled, the Academy will be churning out more enchanters in no time!

Here, study this. Even as a skilled enchanter, there is more for you to learn.
72155.objectives: Craft 2 Runed Draconium Rods for Soragosa in Valdrakken.

72156.title: A Fiery Flight
72156.description: The forge is cooling! Quick, can you help me? Bring me some Rousing Fire. Perhaps it will help!
72156.progress: The forge is nearly out! Do you have them?
72156.completion:
Yes, yes!

This will work.

Take my field notes when you go. There must be something in there that will teach you about mining.
72156.objectives: Gather 15 Rousing Fire for Sekita the Burrower in Valdrakken.

72157.title: The Weight of Earth
72157.description: I have an order for several hundred tons of Primal Molten Alloy, but I have run out of Rousing Earth. I know it's a heavy ask, but I can make it worth your while!
72157.progress: My clients are breathing down my neck. Do you have them?
72157.completion:
Perfect. Just what I needed.

Take these old field notes. There must be something in there that will teach you about mining.
72157.objectives: Gather 15 Rousing Earth for Sekita the Burrower in Valdrakken.

72158.title: A Dense Delivery
72158.description:
Our scales are tough, but we can always use more protection. Only the densest of hides will do for our armor--a challenge to gather, but perhaps one you are up to?

I've seen your skills. Go and gather some hides for our stores.
72158.progress: Only the best will do for our crafts.
72158.completion: Ah! These are excellent quality. I was right about you.
72158.objectives: Gather 2 Dense Hides for Ralathor the Rugged in Valdrakken.

72159.title: Scaling Down
72159.description:
Scales have a multitude of purposes--they offer protection, but in some cases, they also offer a keen reflective surface. Many of our finest mirrors are in fact scales.

Those mirrors also happen to be in high demand. Gather some scaled hides for me, and I'll share some of my crafting secrets.
72159.completion:
Ah! These will work perfectly. Your skills continue to impress me.

As promised, take these notes. I'm sure you can learn more from them.
72159.objectives: Gather 2 Lustrous Scaled Hides for Ralathor the Rugged in Valdrakken.

72172.title: Essence, Shards, and Chromatic Dust
72172.description:
We seem to be in constant need of basic components. Essence, shards... and our stock of Chromatic Dust is almost always depleted.

If you wouldn't mind helping us stock up, perhaps we can make it more than a day into the week without needing to replenish our supply.
72172.progress: We're already out of Chromatic Dust for the day! Have you finished any yet?
72172.completion:
Thank you. I'm sure the supply will last a bit longer this time.

Here, study this in your free time.
72172.objectives: Craft 10 Chromatic Dust for Soragosa in Valdrakken.

72173.title: Braced for Enchantment
72173.description:
The Dragonscale Expedition has requested some enchantments for their gear.

The Dragon Isles can be a treacherous place. I don't blame them for needing some bracer upgrades.
72173.progress: The Dragonscale Expedition await the enchantments.
72173.completion:
I'll get these sent off to the Dragonscale Expedition right away.

Take this to expand your enchanting knowledge.
72173.objectives: Craft 2 Writ of Leech for Soragosa in Valdrakken.

72175.title: A Scept-acular Time
72175.description:
There are some exciting orders to fill this week! The students at Algeth'ar Academy have been going horns over heels for these fun scepters.

Why don't you assist with some of the scepters?
72175.progress: The Algeth'ar students are getting restless.
72175.completion:
Wonderful! The students will love these.

Take this to expand your enchanting knowledge.
72175.objectives: Craft 3 Scepter of Spectacle: Fire and 3 Scepter of Spectacle: Air for Soragosa in Valdrakken.

72189.title: Garden Variety
72189.description:
Are you enjoying the butterfly garden?

You know, there's a much larger garden just to the south of here. An older drakonid by the name of Gryrmpech tends to it.

He could always use an extra pair of hands. He has an 'assistant', but I've never actually seen him. I can't imagine he's of much help.

If you stop by, be sure to let him know that Xina sent you.
72189.completion: Oh praise the Titans, help at last!

72190.title: Reservoir Reservations
72190.description:
{class}! I know someone who is in dire need of your skills.

Tyrhold Reservoir has just been attacked by Primalists. I was lucky to make my escape when I did. I fear the others may not be so lucky.

It's just to the north of here. Find Zuttiki, she'll be able to fill you in on the details.

If she's still alive, that is.

72240.title: The Obsidian Warders
72240.description:
This Toddy's enthusiasm is admirable. But I hope it does not blind her to the dangers awaiting us in the Dragon Isles.

Regardless, the Obsidian Warders are duty-bound to protect the expedition.

I must speak with Wrathion and the Lord Commander about the mission ahead.

My fellow dracthyr are exploring the city. Seek out Dervishian, my trusted lieutenant, and inform her that we are to rally at the docks. She will relay my orders to the rest.
72240.progress: Ye think a dracthyr can fly faster than a gryphon?
72240.completion:
I'm pleased the dracthyr are comin' with us.

Can't wait to challenge that scalecommander to a race on ol' Wildfeather.

My gryphon will best his leathery ol' wings any day!
72240.objectives: Deliver the scalecommander's orders to Dervishian and the Obsidian Warders.

72241.title: Lessons From Our Past
72241.description:
I am Emberthal, a scalecommander of the dracthyr. Wrathion aided us after we awakened from our long stasis, and now it is my turn to help him.

No doubt you have questions about my people and our history. Until recently, I did as well. 

But Nozdormu, the Timeless One, has revealed lost truths about the dracthyr. He granted me a vision of our origins... and why we were locked away. 

Let me tell you of the things I have seen.
72241.progress: There is much we can learn from one another.
72241.completion:
Now you know the truth.

The past is the past. It is time for the dracthyr to seek a new future alongside the other peoples of Azeroth.

72246.title: Serene Dreams
72246.description:
Welcome to the Serene Dreams Spa!

I must apologize. We are not able to admit new guests at this time due to circumstances beyond our control.

Let me refer you to the Spa Manager, Xijan Thornpaw. He is qualified to answer all your questions.
72246.completion:
Welcome to the Serene Dreams Spa! With us, you may partake of many relaxing activities!

Oh! Are you here to help? I would be honored to have your assistance.

72256.title: The Dark Talons
72256.description:
Naleidea is enthusiastic, but she's a historian, not a soldier. She knows nothing of the dangers we'll face in the Dragon Isles.

Not that anyone needs to worry. After all, the Dark Talons will be protecting the expedition.

I'm going to discuss mission logistics with Ebyssian and your Horde leaders.

My lieutenant, Kodethi, is exploring the city along with the other dracthyr. Be a good soldier and let him know we are going to rally at the zeppelin tower. He'll relay my orders to the others.
72256.progress: Do you suspect that a dracthyr could outpace a boat over the entire trip to the Dragon Isles? Exhaustion would take its toll, surely?
72256.completion:
I am pleased to have the dracthyr accompanying us on the expedition.

Their unique perspective should prove valuable, and learning more of their own history will help them come to terms with their current circumstances.

As I've said before, history heals every wound.
72256.objectives: Deliver the Scalecommander's orders to Kodethi and the Dark Talons.

72259.title: Vault Artifacts
72259.progress:
Have you found another artifact?
Ancient Vault Artifact (1)
72259.completion:
As you bring me more artifacts, our knowledge of the Incarnates and their time period increases.  

You have my thanks. As a member of the Dragonscale Expedition, I want you to know how important your contributions are. And as a researcher, I want you to know the wealth of discoveries I have made from the artifacts you have brought me is a long-time dream come true. 

Please, take these supplies and use them well.

72260.title: Vault Artifacts
72260.progress:
Have you found more artifacts?
Ancient Vault Artifact (5)
72260.completion:
Thank you again for your generous contribution of artifacts.

Our study of the Incarnates continues successfully largely due to your dedicating to finding and donating artifacts. Your patronage of the Dragonscale Expedition is truly appreciated.
