Please, have more supplies on us!

72261.title: More Than a Prison?
72261.description: <The ancient artifact appears elemental in nature. Lillian Brightmoon in Valdrakken might be able to tell more.>
72261.progress: Have you brought me something to study?
72261.completion:
The Incarnates were locked away in the Vault, but aside from that we know very little either about it or its prisoners.

Artifacts like this can shed light on their culture, their history, and... their power. Studying them could improve our odds in defeating the primalists. Bring me more of these I will reward you with supplies.

Oh, and I will pen a note to Caretaker Jakes reminding her of your continued assistance of the Dragonscale Expedition.
72261.objectives: Bring the Ancient Vault Artifact to Lillian Brightmoon.

72263.title: Cavalry Has Its Place
72263.description:
Evoker! This place still has herds of vorquin!

I managed to round a few up that could be used as mounts for when your wings are tired. Remember how to ride?

This one is to be issued to you as the scalecommanders are ordering you all over the place. Please take good care of it.
72263.completion:
{class}, this place still has herds of vorquin!

I managed to round up a few of the more agreeable creatures that could be used as mounts for when your wings are tired. Remember how to ride?

I was ordered to issue one to you as the scalecommanders are ordering you all over the place. Take good care of it.
72263.objectives: Learn to ride your personal vorquin mount.

72266.title: The Waking Shores
72266.description: The drakonid Sendrax is looking for help in aiding all of the newcomers within the Waking Shores.
72266.completion: Oh, hello! I do have a good idea on what you can do to help us out now.
72266.objectives: Meet with Sendrax within the Waking Shores.

72267.title: Ohn'ahran Plains
72267.description:
The green dragonflight needs the aid of adventurers. To do so, you must ally with the centaur of the plains.

Ambassador Taurasza can be of aid.
72267.completion: We have much to discuss, you and I.
72267.objectives: Meet Ambassador Taurasza in the Rubyscale Outpost.

72268.title: Azure Span
72268.description:
The Kirin Tor need all the help they can get tracking down the Blue Dragon Oathstone.

Some of their mages have been spotted in the Ohn'ahran Plains looking for help.
72268.completion: Ah, another adventurer! We could use your aid.
72268.objectives: Speak with Masud the Wise within the Ohn'ahran Plains.

72269.title: Thaldraszus
72269.description:
Alexstrasza the Life-Binder is arranging a meeting of the Seat of the Aspects to discuss the threat of the Primalists.

She has put out a call for any willing adventurers to come help.
72269.completion: Welcome to Valdrakken, {NAME}. Let us begin.
72269.objectives: Travel to Valdrakken and meet with Alexstrasza the Life-Binder.

72293.title: Adventuring in the Dragon Isles
72293.description:
Oh, I know what you can do!

The Dragonscale Expedition has posted a very fine looking map of the Dragon Isles nearby. 

Their drawings are quite accurate and detailed, if I do say so myself. Sorry, you're not here for an art review.

You should go check it out to see what areas of the Dragon Isles could use your help!
72293.completion: <Your decision has been made. You can return to the scouting map at any time to choose another location.>
72293.objectives: Review the Scouting Map to choose an area within the Dragon Isles to support.

72339.title: Engine of Innovation
72339.description:
Tyr believed that the Engine of Innovation would be necessary for the battles to come. 

You have proven yourself worthy and overcome all the challenges set before you. You may now unlock Engine's full potential.
72339.completion:
You have proven yourself worthy and overcome all the challenges set before you. 

You may now unlock the Engine's full potential.
72339.objectives: Insert the newly attuned Power Core into the Engine of Innovation.

72354.title: The Great Vault
72354.description:
Over the years, the Aspects and their kin acquired many remarkable artifacts and armaments. The Aspects ordered the construction of an enchanted vault where they could be stored for safe-keeping until such a time as a worthy soul came in search of that which lay within.

You will find this Great Vault within the walls of the bank. Perhaps, if you prove your mettle, it will grant you a piece of the Aspects' ancient hoard.
72354.progress: The vault seems to know when a worthy soul approaches. You need not be afraid. Go on. Give it a look.
72354.completion:
So you were able to open it after all? Even those ancient magics recognize your knack for heroic exploits. 

It would be wise to check the vault regularly. No doubt the treasures that lie within will prove useful in the battles to come.
72354.objectives: Obtain a piece of loot from the Great Vault.

72373.title: Aiding the Accord: The Hunt is On
72373.description:
Our allies from the Ohn'ahran Plains have sent word-a request-for any and all who hunt these lands to lend their aid to their cause.

Whilst continuing your efforts across these Isles, pay a visit to our allies at one of their hunting camps and assist in their efforts.

There is much to be done. Best not delay.
72373.progress: Has our renowned traveler returned with more news of success?
72373.completion:
Oh my. You did all of that and return in one piece? Quite impressive.

Please accept this as a token of our appreciation.

72374.title: Aiding the Accord: Dragonbane Keep
72374.description:
Our allies once again seek your assistance as our efforts continue across the Isles. Words within the walls of Valdrakken whisper a resounding comfort knowing your efforts have helped shape our future.

Now then, to business.

A lingering djaradin threat moves upon the Waking Shores deep within the smoldering inferno of Dragonbane Keep. We must move to disrupt their advances.

We await your return, {NAME}.
72374.progress: Do you bring news of your success?
72374.completion:
My, my. What wondrous news! The Accord will be most pleased by your efforts. 

Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.

72375.title: Aiding the Accord: The Isles Call
72375.description:
Your actions have not gone unnoticed.

Across the Isles, our allies seek to ensure the safety of all who venture throughout these lands. There are, however, some who would seek to end your... work, as it impedes in their plans.

Do what you must to ensure our allies are protected.
72375.progress: Travels treating you well? Not too many enemies made along the way, I should hope.
72375.completion:
Ah, you return! I should not act surprised, but alas, here we are.

Please accept this as a small token of our appreciation.
72375.objectives: Continue your efforts in aiding the Valdrakken Accord and their allies throughout the Dragon Isles.

72380.title: Together We Are Unstoppable
72380.description:
{NAME}, you must tell Alexstrasza and Nozdormu what has happened.

Khadgar and I will meet you at the Seat of the Aspects momentarily.
72380.completion:
We stand united against the Incarnates, {NAME}.

Together, we will protect this world.

72396.title: Horns of Plenty
72396.description:
Many of our inventions rely on using a sturdy and springy material. Fortunately, vorquin horns have served as the perfect product for many of our modern creations.

Even more fortunate for us, the Dragon Isles are swarmed with vorquin. It should be a simple task for you to gather some springy horns from the vorquin for us.
72396.progress: Did you collect the vorquin horns?
72396.completion: Our engineers will be thrilled to have more materials. Thank you for your contributions.
72396.objectives: Gather 20 Springy Horns from the vorquin of the Dragon Isles for Dothenos of the Valdrakken Accord.

72397.title: Orientation: Dragonscale Basecamp
72397.description:
Welcome to basecamp, $p.

It took Toddy and me awhile to settle on the perfect site to establish camp, but I couldn't be happier with our selection.

Easy access to ruins, proto-dragon breeding grounds, and of course the dragonflights.

Why not take a few minutes to explore the camp and meet some of the suppliers helping to fuel the expedition?
72397.objectives: Meet the important suppliers in the Dragonscale Basecamp.

72398.title: Rock and Stone
72398.description:
Earth elementals in the Dragon Isles are composed of various rocks and minerals. Our blacksmiths are thoroughly fascinated with the unique tools they are able to manufacture from smelting such materials. In fact, they appear to have smelted the last of their samples.

I would hate to ruin their fun. Would you mind replenishing the supply?
72398.progress: Have you gathered enough Earthen Samples from the Elementals?
72398.completion: Ah, the blacksmiths will be pleased with these samples.
72398.objectives: Gather 15 Earthen Samples from the earth elementals of the Dragon Isles for Dhurrel of the Maruuk Centaurs.

72399.title: The Hermit's Garden
72399.description:
Our parents always say we shouldn't visit the gardens above Gelikyr. They think the gardener is mean and dangerous. 

That's not true, though! They're a bit grumpy, but they're really nice! 

None of us have been up there since the Primalists showed up. It's way too dangerous now. Still, I hope the gardener is okay. Could you go and check on them, since we can't visit anymore?
72399.completion: You'd better not have trampled any of my plants with those clumsy stompers of yours. Now, what do you want from me?
72399.objectives: Speak to Szareth in Shadow Ledge.

72405.title: An Unlikely Informant
72405.description:
This is a top secret mission, {NAME}.

We've had a break in.

A powerful historical artifact was stolen from the Keep... and it looks like the Defias Brotherhood is to blame. We caught one thief, but the other got away.

But I don't like it, {NAME}... my gut tells me there's more. 

I've called in a... specialist on the Brotherhood. Meet us in the basement of the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
72405.progress: We must recover what was stolen from the Keep, at all costs.
72405.completion:
My few interactions with Vanessa told me she isn't interested in the banditry of the old Defias Brotherhood. To her, the Brotherhood meant supporting the downtrodden... those that Stormwind had left behind. 

That, I can respect. 

But most of her Brotherhood continue to engage in thievery from innocent travelers. That's not revolution, that's highway robbery.

She insists she tries to stop them.
72405.objectives: Meet Mathias Shaw in the basement of the Lion's Pride Inn.

72407.title: Soaked in Success
72407.description:
Fishermen of our tribe are constantly plagued with waterlogged packs and boots. Lately, the riverbeasts have been swarming fishing spots and causing even more mayhem.

The hide of the riverbeasts are quite slick and water-resistant. Perhaps we can handle two problems at once. If you could help handle the over abundance of riverbeasts and bring back their hides, our fishers would be quite pleased.
72407.progress: Have you found some hide with waterproof qualities?
72407.completion: I am confident that these hides will do well to protect our equipment from further water damage. Thank you for your help.
72407.objectives: Gather 18 Waterproof Hide from the riverbeasts of the Dragon Isles for Temnaayu of the Iskaara Tuskarr.

72408.title: A Window to the Past
72408.description:
In this, I trust Vanessa's word. I do not believe she knows what the Drakefire Amulet is. Some of the story about Onyxia was made public, but not all.

Perhaps even you do not know. 

I will explain everything, for both of you.
72408.completion:
We all have our own versions of the past, don't we? 

I don't care if some dragon lady had a magic amulet. It wasn't complete mind control. 

The nobles already hated the common people. The Stonemason's Guild would never have needed to turn to banditry and become the Defias Brotherhood, if not for them.
72408.objectives: Speak with Shaw under the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire to hear about the history of the Drakefire Amulet.

72409.title: Rotten Old Memories
72409.description:
Whatever is going on, I don't like it. Last thing we need is this dragon lady's power corrupting everyone again. 

Whoever did this must have known much about Onyxia. Shaw mentioned this... Reginald Windsor. He was the only one to suspect Lady Prestor. Well, maybe his friends in the Burning Steppes have more of his information. 

She must have had allies. Anything that points us to people close to her would help. 

Check it out, will you?
72409.progress: Drink always seems to be empty... why's me drink always empty?
72409.objectives: Speak with Ragged John at Morgan's Vigil in the Burning Steppes.

72410.title: Pincers and Needles
72410.description:
We've been running low on needles for tailoring lately. Those darn things keep snapping in two!

Some pointy parts from the scythid in the area might serve as good replacements.
72410.progress: Have you found some pointy parts to replace our needles?
72410.completion: Great! Now the tailors can get back to work.
72410.objectives: Gather 10 Pointy Pincers from the scythid of the Dragon Isles for Gnoklin Quirkcoil of the Dragonscale Expedition.

72411.title: Cause Without a Rebel
72411.description:
Good to see you again, {NAME}! Alexstrasza doesn't think we can stop the rebels effectively through force, despite the successes you've had.

To find other ways forward, Alexstrasza has called Maldra Flametongue here to talk about the rebellion and what drew her to it.

Perhaps it would be helpful to join the conversation, and see what Maldra has to say. To avoid prying rebel eyes and ears, they will be meeting below us, on the second level of the Seat of the Aspects.
72411.completion: I've found the rebels are stockpiling a huge number of bombs beneath the Valdrakken aqueduct! We must stop them!
72411.objectives: Listen to Alexstrasza's conversation with Maldra Flametongue.

72412.title: Explosive Interruption
72412.description:
I managed to infiltrate a rebel camp, down in Scalewatch Cavern. It seemed like any other camp, except for frequent wagons coming into camp with their contents covered.

Eventually, I was able to discreetly make my way to where the wagons would be unloaded. The rebels are stockpiling bombs, but it's even worse!

They're piling the bombs against a pillar directly underneath the aqueduct from Tyrhold.

Meet me down there, and we'll find a way to stop this!
72412.completion: We seem to be in time, {NAME} - let's put a stop to this before the aqueduct is destroyed!

72413.title: Irreconcilable Differences
72413.description:
I wish we never had to raise arms against fellow dragonkin, {NAME}. We should be allies, not enemies. Unfortunately, their leader, Agitator Zoralek, made the choice for us when he threatened the aqueduct.

Fight your way inside the cave, and put a stop to Agitator Zoralek by any means necessary, before he can set off those bombs. Then bring back his detonator so we can secure it. Once we have that, the Scalesworn will be able to remove the bombs safely.
72413.progress: Were you able to stop Zoralek? Is the aqueduct safe?
72413.completion: By stopping Zoralek and retrieving his detonator, you've secured the aqueduct, for both Valdrakken and the life pools.
72413.objectives: Kill Agitator Zoralek and recover the detonator.

72414.title: Know Prisoners!
72414.description:
If Alexstrasza truly wants to find the causes of this rebellion, we need to hear out the rebels.
   
To do that, we have to safely detain rebels who want to kill us. Well, you. That's much harder than resorting to violence, and more dangerous as well.

But I've experienced this when I left the rebels. Orian Darkwater cast a spell to bind me totally. It worked, and I paid close attention.

I've imbued that spell into a ring. You can use it to bind them safely. It should work, anyway!
72414.completion: This is the more difficult way, but every rebel we capture instead of kill is a chance to end this violence - and a life saved.
72414.objectives: Use Maldra's Ring of Binding to detain 8 rebels.

72415.title: Rebel Rousing Writings
72415.description:
The rebels seem to have a lot of signs and flyers around the cave. They probably use it as a way to keep everyone aligned to their purpose, and motivated to fight.

It's hard to keep a large group united around a cause - especially if you use detestable methods like bombing civilians or destroying a water source - without a steady stream of reinforcement.

Let's get a bunch of their propaganda. It may tell us a lot about what they're thinking, or who's telling them what to think.
72415.progress: Have you gotten a good sample of their writings?
72415.completion:
These seem to mostly be written by Instigator Belaphon - I met her once, when I was in the rebellion. If we can find her, perhaps we can stop her from inciting so much anger! 

I'll also be able to look through these for any codes or ciphers from my rebel days they might still be using, to see if we can find out more. Good work, {NAME}!

72416.title: Temporary Accommodations
72416.description:
We've been sending the rebel prisoners to Steelcliff Rampart. It's the barracks where Valdrakken's city guard, the Scalesworn, are based.

So there are plenty of guards to keep them from causing harm or escaping.

Head over there and we'll see what the next steps are in putting a permanent stop to this rebellion.
72416.completion: Thank you for coming, {NAME}. I am here to discuss with these prisoners why they wanted to rebel against the dragons. Please join me and we'll see what they have to say.

72417.title: Persistent Dissidents
72417.description:
My goal is to see this rebellion brought to an end, with as little violence as possible. To do that, I need to understand the root causes of this rebellion.

The rebels have clearly come to resent the Aspects and the dragonflights. And while we had to use force to protect Valdrakken, that hasn't brought about an end to the rebellion.

I'd like you to speak to the prisoners, and ask why they rebelled. I'll accompany you to hear their reasons.
72417.completion: I might not agree with all their reasons - certainly not their violent methods - but I have a new understanding of why they want change.

72418.title: Solicited Opinions
72418.description:
That was enlightening, to say the least. The rebels we talked to had a lot to say which I wouldn't have anticipated.

I have my thoughts on the situation, but what did you think of their grievances?

As neither a dragon nor dragonkin, you bring a certain objectivity to the matter.
72418.progress: Is there merit to what the dragonkin say, or only dereliction of duty?
72418.completion: I will consider your advice. Thank you again, {NAME}, for your aid.
72418.objectives: Discuss the rebels' grievances with Alexstrasza.

72419.title: Cleaning up the Cliffraff
72419.description:
{NAME}! Maldra has been going through the propaganda you retrieved, using ciphers she knew from her days as a rebel.

She found a coded message that led her to another rebel camp, where Belaphon is stirring up rebellion among anyone she can.

Maldra and Inspector Erima are already there - go join them and let's see if we can finally put a stop to this rebellion!
72419.completion: The rebels are finding their way here from Scalewatch and other locations, based on the same ciphers Maldra found, {NAME}. Now there are far too many rebels for us to stop Belaphon without your help.
72419.objectives: Meet Maldra and Erima at the Rebellious Cliffs.

72420.title: Wreckonciliation
72420.description:
Captain Drine informed me that Alexstrasza wants this done as peacefully as possible. And I've heard Alexstrasza is considering granting the Dragonkin more rights. Or even freedom.

Instead of fighting our way through all these rebels when peace may be on the horizon, let's spread the word! Tell the dragonkin here that things are changing. Perhaps some will lay down their arms or choose to leave.

But be prepared to deal with those who insist on fighting.
72420.progress: Remember, each dragonkin you convince is a life you've saved.
72420.completion: That's great that so many stopped fighting! Too bad for those who didn't, but if you'd told me a camp full of rebels was largely going to lay down their arms, I wouldn't have believed it. Alexstrasza will be pleased, {NAME}!
72420.objectives: Inform 12 dragonkin of Alexstrasza's planned changes.

72421.title: The Quill to Power
72421.description:
{NAME}, we need to stop the quills from inciting the rebels long enough for us to be heard. 

Their leader, Belaphon, seems to be giving the quills a degree of autonomy with that glowing staff. Gather up as many as you can, so they can't keep reproducing her words.

Once they're out of commission, we'll confront her directly - but we don't want the quills to scatter and continue spreading these messages.
72421.progress: How many quills have you found, {NAME}?
72421.completion: If we didn't gather up those quills, they'd keep inciting dragonkin, and we'd keep having more rebels to deal with. Thank you for putting a stop to them.

72422.title: Stop the Presses
72422.description:
This is it, {NAME}. As the one propagating the ideas that drive the rebellion, if we can stop Belaphon, we'll see the end of the rebellion.

Try to bind her with my ring, though you'll likely need to weaken her first. If she's willing to surrender, we'll bring her to Alexstrasza.

I imagine the Queen of Dragons will have a lot of very choice words when they meet.
72422.progress: What word of the rebel leader, Belaphon?
72422.completion: Thank you, {NAME} - you've aided us in opposing this rebellion from the beginning. Now Valdrakken is safe, and more importantly, I will see that the dragonkin are treated with the respect they deserve.

72423.title: Weathering the Storm
72423.description:
Ah, you have arrived just in time! We've heard tales that the Nokhud centaur have powerful, dangerous weaponry infused with storm enchantments. We would like to bring some samples to our enchanters for study.

At the very least, we can decommission the weapons and put them to better use.
72423.progress: Have you found any weapons for study?
72423.completion: With these weapons no longer in destructive hands, we can feel more at peace and begin to understand these enchantments.
72423.objectives: Gather 12 Tempest Armaments from the Nokhud centaurs of the Dragon Isles for Temnaayu of the Iskaara Tuskarr.

72424.title: Looking for Something Specific
72424.description:
<Ragged John blinks blearily up at you.> 

So ye took down that ol' worg, didye? Well aren't ye the biggest strongest human I seen since ol' Windsor. 

<Ragged John sighs.>

...Well? What're ye still doing here? Go take what ye found to whoever sent ye here in the first place!
72424.completion:
Ragged John is still around, is he? Been a while since I sent some agents to check up on him. He's a good man, under it all. 

Now, what are these notes? Hmmm... a Clessington?
72424.objectives: Return to Shaw in the basement of the Lion's Pride Inn.

72426.title: The New Clessington Estate
72426.description:
Excellent, {NAME}. Finally, something we can work with. 

Count Clessington is a member of the House of Nobles and a powerful mage. He has fallen on hard times since Anduin cracked down on corruption in Stormwind.

I would not put it past him to have something to do with this.

He recently purchased an old manor in Duskwood. I will contact my sources and see what other information I can find. You and Vanessa should go to the manor and investigate.
72426.progress:
Did you feel that? 

This place is creepy. I swear every now and then something brushes by me. The hairs on the back of my neck keep going straight up!
72426.completion:
You have my deepest apologies, friend, for the behavior of my "attendants". 

Though, I suppose they were never mine. They're my father's. Likely sent with me to keep me out of his way while he does something terrible. 

I had hoped it wouldn't come to this. I'm so sorry. Please, let me help you stop him.
72426.objectives: Investigate the manor at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

72427.title: Animated Infusion
72427.description:
I have a simple request for you today.

The alchemists are short on an ingredient used in a particularly tricky brew. The herb is easy enough to retrieve. You'll just need to find some aggressive plants to extract samples from. Think you can handle that?
72427.completion: Well, not all hunts will be the most exhilarating. Nonetheless, the samples you retrieved will be put to good use.
72427.objectives: Gather 13 Spiked Leaves from the lashers of the Dragon Isles for Dhurrel of the Maruuk Centaurs.

72428.title: Hornswog Hoarders
72428.description:
It's no secret that the hornswogs in these lands have a fascination for gems, jewels, and all things shiny. Why, even the other day I found a very rare jewel in some hornswog droppings!

Well, it might not be the most appealing task, but it seems the hornswog have a habit of not only collecting, but also consuming valuables.
72428.progress: Were you able to find some gems?
72428.completion: Well these gems don't smell very delightful... We'll get to cleaning them up right away.
72428.objectives: Gather 20 Pungent Gems from the hornswog of the Dragon Isles for Gnoklin Quirkcoil of the Dragonscale Expedition.

72429.title: Orientation: Maruukai
72429.description:
<As Sansok Khan signs, Okir vocalizes for her.>

The Maruuk as a people are not staunchly against outsiders, but we do require any potential allies to prove their worth. As you meet the clans and aid in our ventures, word will spread of your support.

On the lower level of the krutal on the hill you will find one of the Khanam Matra's daughters, who can help you see where you stand with our people. Be sure to introduce yourself.
72429.progress: I look forward to seeing how you contribute to the Maruuk.
72429.completion: I look forward to seeing how you contribute to the Maruuk.
72429.objectives: Meet the Keeper of Renown and Renown Quartermaster in Maruukai.

72430.title: Misdeeds in Moonbrook
72430.description:
Moonbrook? What is this Count Clessington doing at my home?!

It can't be anything good. I'll signal Shaw.

<Vanessa glances at Cecilia Clessington.>

She might make for a good hostage. Let's bring the rich girl, too.

Meet us there.
72430.objectives: Meet Vanessa and Shaw in Moonbrook in Westfall.

72431.title: A Hungry Heritage
72431.description:
It's been a while since I've been home. 

Something isn't right. My people should be here. 

I'm going in... but I won't turn down some back up. 

... I never should've left for so long.
72431.objectives: Investigate the Defias Hideout in Moonbrook with Vanessa.

72432.title: Supply Only the Finest Goons
72432.description:
These "attendants" of my father's attacked us the moment we arrived!

These are certainly not the kindly servants I had as a child. These are hired killers!

If my father is planning what I think he's planning... we can't let them do this. They will kill everyone in their way.

<Cecilia winces.>

If it's kill or be killed...
72432.progress: I wish there was more I could do to help. I've never regretted it more that I didn't pick up my father's skills in the arcane.
72432.completion: I hope their souls find peace. I wish it didn't have to be this way.
72432.objectives: Slay 16 Clessington Attendants in the Defias Hideout in Moonbrook.

72434.title: Ruby Lifeshrine Loop
72434.description:
They say I'm not big enough to fly some of these courses yet. 

But I can still watch others do it. You should race! Then I can watch you race.
72434.objectives: Complete the Ruby Lifeshrine Loop course.

72435.title: Orientation: Iskaara
72435.description:
Welcome to Iskaara, friend.

Word of your exploits in Brackenhide has already spread among our people. You have already met many of us, and there are more who would like the chance to exchange knowledge and wares with you.

Please, take a moment to familiarize yourself with some of the friendly faces around Iskaara. We are a community that supports one another, so just as you have much to offer us, many of our people have much to offer you in return.
72435.progress: We have much to offer each other, friend.
72435.completion:
I hope you have a pleasant time in Iskaara. 

As you know now, many us are fine craftsmen and merchants. I encourage you to continue to ask around and learn what all of my people have to offer.
72435.objectives: Familiarize yourself with some vendors with valuable wares.

72438.title: Tarasek Intentions
72438.description: When the tarasek accepted power from the Primalists, they stole many ancient scrolls and tomes to combine with their newfound magic. We need help getting these scrolls back in our possession.
72438.progress: Have you retrieved any of the scrolls?
72438.completion: Thank you for helping us recover this valuable knowledge.
72438.objectives: Gather 15 Draconic Scrolls from the tarasek of the Dragon Isles for Dothenos of the Valdrakken Accord.

72440.title: Silver Mettle
72440.description:
I believe the Silver Scale may still be of some use to us. During my observations, I felt an... energy in it that transcends time and seems to be attuned to Tyr. It also has the same architecture as the disc.

It stands to reason we may use the Silver Scale to collect one of Tyr's memories that he did not commit to the disc.

Though it seems macabre, going to his tomb in Tirisfal may allow us to at least partially restore him.

Alexstrasza can tell you more, $p.
72440.progress: I do not wish to startle the man with my... presence. Perhaps it would be best if you approached him first.
72440.completion: This place is a monument to Tyr's legacy. We must proceed with caution and reverence.
72440.objectives: Venture into the Tomb of Tyr with the aid of the Aspects.

72441.title: Breaching the Tomb
72441.description:
Something recently activated the tomb's titan defense system. I had not seen titan constructs here before.

I was investigating why they appeared when I was locked out of the tomb. Perhaps your mission awakened them.

Should we intend to venture forth, we must disarm the new defenses. The glowing orbs flanking the doors might be the key. If only they weren't damaged...
72441.completion: Your mission has renewed my faith. Now, what must we do to restore Tyr?
72441.objectives: Disable the Titan Orbs at the entrance to the tomb.

72442.title: The Remains of Tyr
72442.description:
As Nozdormu could sense power lingering in the scale, I can sense Tyr here. It is in the very stones of this place.

I suspect the other constructs can sense it as well. They must have come here when Tyr was reforged. We must be on the right track.

If something of his presence still remains, the scale should be able to gather it--with the help of this console. But the constructs may interpret our collection of Tyr's last memories as us trying to destroy them. 

Keep them away if they awaken.
72442.completion:
The task was too great for this aged console, but our persistence has been rewarded.

The scale has something, but I am not sure what.

 I am... uncertain I wish to return to Alexstrasza with just "something." The scale could contain nonsense corrupted by the console's failure. Or it could be what we need.

Perhaps another console could verify its contents?
72442.objectives: Defend Watcher Koranos from the constructs in the tomb.

72443.title: Tyr's Fall
72443.description:
This console will allow us to examine the scale's contents, but I do not know what we will find. 

The other titan servants here should leave us alone; accessing it should not be as disruptive as transferring what we sensed of Tyr. 

Something is making Travard uneasy. Be prepared for anything, $p.

Place the Silver Scale in the console when you are ready to proceed.
72443.progress: There is much we still do not know about Tyr.
72443.completion:
Such nobility even in his final moments. Zakajz used the dragons to taunt him... But did Tyr really know they would betray them? Will Alexstrasza? 

This would be a great blow to them... 

If Tyr cannot be raised, perhaps it is not something they need to know.
72443.objectives: Use the Titan Console to witness Tyr's final memories.

72444.title: A Sliver of Silver
72444.description:
Tyr's final memories are in our hands. This is not a responsibility to be taken lightly.

Let us take the Silver Scale to Nozdormu in Tyrhold. We will attempt to use the console there to awaken him. 

If he is whole again, there will be much to discuss.
72444.progress: We will do whatever we must to restore Tyr.
72444.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}.

I am... disappointed that the Silver Scale was not the answer.

We may have to resign ourselves to a future without Tyr.

I am not still without hope we may find the disk and restore Tyr. And some part of me believes we may defeat the infinites--and the Incarnates--on our own. 

But some paths, however dark, are fated to be tread.
72444.objectives: Escape the tomb and return to the Aspects at Tyrhold in Valdrakken.

72445.title: To Northshire
72445.description:
Vanessa's care for her people deserves better than a brotherhood of bandits. I am glad to see them part ways. 

And as spymaster, I'm in no small part relieved.

Now, Northshire. Peasants can become heroes, there. Perhaps your own journey began in that abbey?

It's also a strong, defensible position to attack Stormwind from. We cannot let it fall!

Hurry, to Northshire!
72445.objectives: Meet Vanessa, Cecilia, and Shaw in Northshire.

72446.title: What's Their Problem?
72446.description:
Good to see you again, recruit. Wish it were in better circumstances.

Whatever this "influence" is, anybody with half a grudge now thinks it's worth spilling blood over!

Not to mention all the Defias bandits! And the hired thugs! At this rate, more soldiers from Stormwind will only create more confusion.

From what I've seen, you can knock the sense back into most of these people. If they keep fighting you after their eyes have cleared... do what you must. They have made their choice.
72446.progress: I've seen quite a few things in my days of training new recruits... but this is madness!
72446.completion:
We'll take anyone we can and heal them up. Even if we have to tie some down. 

Sure hope that magic doesn't have any lasting effects.

72447.title: Greatest of Threats
72447.description:
Powerful djaradin and other creatures threaten both the Obsidian Citadel and the safety of my flight. 

This cannot stand.

Help secure the area. Seek out and eliminate two of our most powerful enemies.
72447.completion: Well done. Your willingness to assist has been noted... and is appreciated.
72447.objectives: Eliminate two rare enemies within the Obsidian Citadel or Slagmire.

72449.title: Knock It Off!
72449.description:
We're too late, {NAME}. 

Clessington has holed himself up inside the abbey and is spreading the chaotic influence of the amulet all over Northshire! 

I don't think most of the people here know the difference between friend and foe, anymore.

This man seems like the type to have a backup plan. Those agents must have a way to get past Clessington's barrier. Take them out and look for anything useful!
72449.progress: We must get past the barrier and to Clessington, as soon as we can.
72449.completion: Hmm, it looks like these might be able to combine, somehow...
72449.objectives: Collect 4 Barrier Keys off the Leading Attendants.

72450.title: The Clessington Will
72450.description:
I'm no great mage like my father, but I do know a few of his tricks. 

I saw those signets you got off the enforcers. My father's private chambers were locked by a similar magical trinket, which can be broken apart into pieces. 

Let me put those signets back together into an arcane key. That should get us past the barrier.

Then... I can only hope we can talk some sense into him.
72450.progress: I hate that it's come to this...
72450.completion: I'm sorry, I need a moment. He was not a good man, but... he was still my father.
72450.objectives: Confront Count Clessington inside Northshire Abbey.

72451.title: Will to Survive
72451.description:
... So it is done. 

I would have liked to have questioned the man more. But the power was too much for him. 

We cannot allow the amulet to end up in anyone else's hands. Claim it, {NAME}, and we shall ensure its safe return to Stormwind, together.
72451.completion:
I'm tired, {NAME}. I'm tired of the constant battles. I'm tired of being manipulated, abandoned, and hurt. All of our people are. 

I miss the person I used to be. A simple girl who wanted to follow her father's footsteps and help her home in the same stride. The girl who thought that was possible. 

 

... I suppose I owe you some thanks. You've given me much to think about.

72452.title: Go with Honor, Friend
72452.description:
This mission ended up being far more than any of us expected, {NAME}, and you did very well. I shudder to think of what would have happened without you here. 

Some time back, the King commissioned a set of armor be made. Armor to adorn our greatest heroes. 

You have proven yourself more than deserving of such honor.

Meet me in the Valley of Heroes, {NAME}.
72452.progress: You have done much for Stormwind, hero.
72452.completion:
You have done so much for this city. Thank you, hero. 

Wear this armor with pride.
72452.objectives: Meet Shaw in the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind.

72453.title: Betrayal of the Brotherhood
72453.description:
I should have known. I lost control of the Brotherhood the moment those pardons were offered. Anyone with principle is long gone. 

It's only the brutes left, now. And Duncon Ratsbon was always the biggest brute of them all.

Let's get out of here, {NAME}. If any of these fools try to get in our way, let's teach them a lesson about standing in the path of a VanCleef.
72453.completion:
It feels odd and yet... this feels a long time coming. 

Since fighting the Legion, I've felt distant from the Brotherhood. More aid started to trickle into Westfall, and while it will never be enough... the spark of revolution dimmed.

...Or maybe I'm just getting older.
 
Still, I once thought of myself as someone who stood up for the people. I made mistakes, I hurt them... but who else do they have? 

I need to do better, not for the Defias, but for Westfall.

72454.title: The Obsidian Hatchling
72454.description:
An egg from the black dragonflight is ready to hatch.

Report to Mother Elion in the Ruby Lifeshrine to pick up the egg. Then, I request that you bring the egg to the Obsidian Oathstone to hatch in a location strong with their flight's power.

Once this is complete, return here with the hatchling, where we will further take care of it.
72454.progress: Have you brought the newest hatchling?
72454.completion:
An uncorrupted obsidian hatchling.

<A small smile creeps on Lasztak's face.>

It has been quite a long time.
72454.objectives: Collect the Black Dragon Egg at the Ruby Lifeshrine then hatch it at the Obsidian Oathstone.

72455.title: Warmth and Comfort
72455.description:
In order for the obsidian hatchling to be comfortable, we must build them a proper nest.

You will need to build their nest from Obsidian Citadel coal to make sure it is warm and suitable. Secondly, Archivist Edress will be able to assist you in finding something that ties them to their people.

We will want to gather something from Zaralek Cavern as well, as much of their flight's history is rooted there. Surely somebody in Loamm can help.
72455.progress: We have the most to learn with this hatchling... I hope she has patience while we improve.
72455.completion:
<Agapanthus looks over to the Obsidian Hatchling's nest, relieved.>

They will be quite comfortable in their new nest. Well done.
72455.objectives: Gather supplies for the Obsidian Hatchling's nest.

72456.title: Tomes Of Trust
72456.description:
Despite securing the upper ramparts of the Obsidian Citadel, the djaradin forces continue to pillage the courtyard. The area is full of priceless historical records! We must act quickly to secure anything that documents the lineage of the black dragonflight.

Both Wrathion and Sabellian desire this information, so you can curry favor by procuring a tome for each of them.

Travel to the collapsed tower of the citadel. You should find something worth recovering.
72456.completion: Excellent! I am certain both Wrathion and Sabellian will be pleased with your efforts.
72456.objectives: Recover volumes of the Obsidian Genealogy, and deliver them to Wrathion and Sabellian's quartermasters.

72457.title: A Home-Cooked Meal
72457.description:
Black dragon whelps need to grow up to be big and strong. Our hatchling here seems quite small, so I believe she will require something hearty and nutritious to help her along her way.

Roast duck is not only good for your stamina, but also your brain. I think it would be the perfect meal for our young hatchling.
72457.progress: Duck is a delicacy local to the Dragon Isles. Did you know we have not found them anywhere else in Azeroth?
72457.completion: Whelps need a good source of energy to grow. They are voracious!
72457.objectives: Gather Roast Duck Delight for the Obsidian Whelp. This can be crafted via the cooking profession or purchased from the auction house.

72458.title: Tag, You're Anxious
72458.description:
Every whelp needs some playtime to get out their energy. Our new obsidian friend is no exception.

The hatchlings love playing a good game of tag. See if she would like to play with you!
72458.progress: Every whelp loves a game of tag!
72458.completion: She is quite timid, isn't she?

72460.title: A Solid Pet
72460.description:
I worry about Ruszi. She is incredibly nervous and insecure, and she jumps at nearly anything! I have never heard of a black dragon so terrified of the world.

I believe the best way for us to build her confidence is to find her a companion. Something sturdy and strong that does not move quickly or suddenly.

The black dragonflight's charge is the protection of earth. Perhaps a small elemental will suit her well.

Speak to Lysindra at the pet shop in Valdrakken. She should have something suitable.
72460.progress: Earth elementals are wonderful first pets. They eat gravel, they do not go very far very quickly, and they can stand against almost anything!
72460.completion: Look at this wonderful elemental! Hopefully it can help our little whelp build her confidence.

72461.title: Anatidaephobia
72461.description:
The time has come, {NAME}. Her new pet Iggy has been doing wonders for Rusziona's confidence, and now I think she's ready to face her biggest fear.

Ducks.

There is a tauren in the Waking Shores who is an expert at using pets to help heal trauma. I think she might be just what we need.

Lasztak and Rusziona will meet you there.
72461.progress: A large duck still may be too much for Rusziona, but a duckling will be perfect.
72461.completion: Thank you for what you've done for Rusziona, {NAME}. She has asked if she can go along with you on some of your adventures. She's confident she'll be safe as long as she's with you.
72461.objectives: Help Rusziona and Iggy defeat a duck in a pet battle.

72462.title: A People in Need of Healing
72462.description:
It is strange, {NAME}. Despite the years of peace, I am restless. Despite having the Horde and my son, I am lonely. You feel the same, don't you? I see it in your eyes, and in the eyes of many orcs.

I feel perhaps that while we have found our way on Azeroth, we have lost our way as orcs.

Come with me. I wish to speak with an old friend about these troubles, and I would like you by my side.
72462.completion:
This was meant to be a quiet family visit with Drek'Thar, and perhaps a conversation with Durak about his future. 

Instead, we have set off on a path that will affect the orcish people as a whole!

Do not misunderstand me, I think this is the best course of action. It is just surprising how quickly it happened. I am to be a Farseer...

There is much for us to do. We had best get to it.
72462.objectives: Travel with Eitrigg to Alterac Valley to discuss the future of the orc people with Drek'Thar.

72463.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise...
72463.description:
<The young orc's last words were a request to deliver these Cactus Apples to Galgar.

Will you honor her request?>
72463.progress: Oh, hello {NAME}. What do you have there?
72463.completion:
Why are you delivering these? I asked...

Oh no.

No one is supposed to die over these! I just ask all the young orcs to do this! It's supposed to be easy!

Well... Thanks for delivering them for her I guess. Enjoy your reward...
72463.objectives: Bring the Bag of Cactus Apples to Galgar.

72464.title: The Kosh'harg
72464.description:
The Kosh'harg will be held in Razor Hill. Go'el and Eitrigg are gathering the clans as we speak.

We will have to part ways for now. You must begin mentally preparing yourself for the om'gora--the rite of honor. It is my task to make sure it is a worthy challenge, even for you.

I will call our wind riders to carry my family to the Kosh'harg. You may travel with them, or meet us there.
72464.completion: Your om'gora has begun. May the spirits guide you to victory.
72464.objectives: Travel to the Kosh'harg in Razor Hill and begin the om'gora, the rite of honor.

72465.title: The Blessing of the Land
72465.description:
To earn the blessing of the land, a young orc must learn respect for the spirits that dwell alongside us. If we do not live in balance with the elements and life around us, it can lead to calamity.

I will call to the spirits, and they will guide us to where your aid is needed. It is up to you to complete the task before you.
72465.completion:
Hear me, young one. I am the spirit who protects this place, what your people call "Thunder Ridge".

The canyon below once teemed with life. It could once more, with your intervention.

Aid me now, and it will benefit my people and yours.
72465.objectives: Find the Spirit of Thunder Ridge to learn how you can earn the Blessing of the Land.

72466.title: The Spirit of Thunder Ridge
72466.description:
Life can only thrive when a delicate balance is maintained. The arrival of your people and the humans was but the first link in the chain that led to desolation.

You yourself are not to blame, but you can be the force that restores what once was.

Dive into the waters below and recover the seeds buried in the silt. They are a memory of the ancient forest that once grew in harmony with my people.

Beware, the elements are not at peace here.
72466.progress: You return! I trust you have aided the Spirit of Thunder Ridge?
72466.completion:
You have done well, {NAME}. The spirits sing your praises on the wind.

Eventually, Thunder Ridge will flourish into a new oasis, benefiting the people of Orgrimmar and the thunder lizards alike.

You have earned the blessing of the land.
72466.objectives: Work with the Spirit of Thunder Ridge to restore life to the area.

72467.title: The Blessing of the Clan
72467.description:
To earn the blessing of the clan, a young orc must learn that the clan is only as strong as its members. Prove your strength, and worth, to the living orcs.

Since you were not born into a clan, you must first choose a clan to champion, and be accepted by the clan's chieftain.

The chieftains have gathered in the barracks. Join a clan, and complete the task given to you.
72467.progress: The clan representatives are inside the barracks. You must choose one to join.
72467.completion: Your path has been chosen. Are you ready to proceed?
72467.objectives: Choose a clan to champion during your om'gora.

72474.title: Tracking a Killer
72474.description:
Gor'krosh, the Long Knives, has been terrorizing the Valley of Trials for weeks. Orcs have been going missing, and many of our young trainees have been injured.

The peons took to calling the mysterious attacker the Long Knives because the few bodies we have found all have long, terrible gashes across their backs. They're terrified, and refusing to work!

We have no idea who or what Gor'krosh really is, but they are clearly very dangerous. Please, find this monster and end this madness!
72474.progress: Have you learned anything about Gor'krosh?
72474.completion:
What have you found?

<You tell Kaltunk about the large three-toed print, Karranisha's mention of raptors, the peon witness account, and the bodies with deep slashes.>

So... you're telling me Gor'krosh is actually a huge, white raptor?!
72474.objectives: Seek out information about Gor'krosh, the Long Knives, from the residents of the Valley of Trials.

72475.title: Cornering Gor'krosh
72475.description:
If Gor'krosh is a truly a raptor, you should be able to track it down just like any other animal.

See if you can find its trail. We know it's been around here recently. Corner it in its lair and end this once and for all!

Make sure you return to Razor Hill straight away once you make the kill. The Farseer will need proof of the deed.

Thank you, {NAME}. May the spirits guide your blade. Lok-tar!
72475.progress: Do you have the trophy? Have you painted your face with the blood of your kill? You will not receive your blessing until the deed is done.
72475.completion:
<Aggra inspects the blood on your face carefully. Satisfied with what she sees, she nods.>

A clean kill. You have defended the young and the weak honorably. The spirits are pleased.

You have earned the blessing of the clan.

...You may have your clothes back.
72475.objectives: Hunt down Gor'krosh and return to Razor Hill with proof of your kill.

72476.title: The Blessing of the Ancestors
72476.description:
The blessing of the ancestors is meant to teach young orcs that the living owe everything to those that came before. We must honor the ancestors, seek their wisdom, and live up to their expectations.

Your task is to craft an offering worthy of the honored dead, and worthy of being the centerpiece at the offering stone of the first Kosh'harg of Azeroth! You must put all of your energy into its construction, or it will not be enough.

Cook Torka will guide you. The ancestors will be watching.
72476.completion:
So, the big hero comes to Cook Torka for help, eh? 

Fine, but you're going to have to do most of the work yourself!
72476.objectives: Talk to Cook Torka to learn about crafting your offering.

72477.title: Orcish Groceries
72477.description:
In here is a recipe for the traditional feast left for the ancestors at the Kosh'harg by the clans. We're going to have to substitute some ingredients that, you know, no longer exist... 

But it will for the better! We'll bring some Azeroth flair to this traditional dish!

I will teach you each piece of the recipe, but it will be up to you to gather the ingredients and actually cook it. Orc traders have come from all over, so you should be able to find everything you need right here in Razor Hill.
72477.progress: Did we find everything on the list? Torka said we could probably find everything in Razor Hill!
72477.completion:
We tracked down everything on our list! 

What's next?
72477.objectives: Gather cooking ingredients from traders in Razor Hill.

72478.title: Honor and Glory
72478.description:
You have successfully completed the om'gora! Congratulations, {NAME}.

Now it is time for us to celebrate! We have prepared a feast for all in attendance, in your honor!

Go, revel in the glory you have earned. Enjoy yourself. If any of these orcs get out of line, remind them why you were the one who was chosen to complete the new rite first!
72478.progress: The Kosh'harg has been a great success, better than I had dared hope. Have you had your fill of the festivities?
72478.completion: Yes, I think it's time we draw this celebration to a close. There is such a thing as partying too hard!

72479.title: Aka'magosh
72479.description:
The Kosh'harg has been a great success, in no small part thanks to you, {NAME}.

All that is left is for Aggra to perform the ceremony to bring the festival to an official close.

I wish to speak to the crowd before we all disperse again, on some things long overdue in being said.
72479.completion:
A new age has dawned for our people, {NAME}. 

I could never have imagined bringing you in on my old fool's crusade would have led to this moment.

We had this armor specially made, just for you. You have more than earned it.

Hail, {NAME}, Champion of the Orcs!
72479.objectives: Observe the formal closing of the Kosh'harg.

72480.title: [DNT] Training Collect Quest
72480.description: You know what I hate more than snakes? Their eyes. Get me some of them eyes and I will try and get over it.

72481.title: The Waking Shores Tour
72481.description:
And what is the most fun about dragonriding? Races! 

My bronze colleagues have mapped out race courses all over the Dragon Isles. It is such a varied and dynamic landscape that it just begs to be explored at top speed.

If you find yourself near one of our race courses in The Waking Shores, why not give it a go?
72481.completion:
Well done! You are getting a handle on dragon racing just as quickly as I thought you would. 

And that was just the beginning. Next up is the Ohn'ahran Plains!
72481.objectives: Fly each of the race courses in the Waking Shores.

72482.title: The Waking Shores Advanced Tour
72482.description:
Now that you've flown the basic courses all over the Dragon Isles and proved your ability, how about a new challenge?

The advanced race courses are similar to the standard courses you have flown, but many have adjusted flight paths or extra obstacles to test your skill.

Let us start with the courses in the Waking Shores!
72482.completion:
Nicely done! Those obstacles sting a bit when you first hit one. But you powered through and completed all the courses!

Now! I bet you can guess what is up next. Races in the Ohn'ahran Plains!
72482.objectives: Fly each of the advanced courses in Waking Shores.

72484.title: The Ohn'ahran Plains Advanced Tour
72484.description:
The advanced courses should be more challenging, but I am sure it is nothing you cannot handle!

My bronze colleagues have set up advanced courses in the Ohn'ahran Plains that have a few obstacles and surprises thrown in them. You can also compete against your own best times!

Good luck!
72484.completion:
Well done! You are just like a whelpling taking to air or a duck taking to water as one might say. 

Next, we will conquer new challenges in the Azure Span!
72484.objectives: Fly each of the advanced courses in Ohn'ahran Plains.

72485.title: The Azure Span Tour
72485.description:
Azure Span courses are a unique experience. Their high peaks, snowy terrain, and dense forest present plenty of interesting obstacles--and challenges!

While you are there, seek out my bronze colleagues and give their courses a try!
72485.completion:
Good show, {NAME}! Nimble work completing the Azure Span courses... 

And barely a scratch on you! It seems like the trees there jump out in front of me all the time...

Next up, we are on to Thaldraszus--for more races, of course!
72485.objectives: Fly each of the race courses in the Azure Span.

72486.title: The Azure Span Advanced Tour
72486.description:
The advanced courses in the Azure Span are designed to elevate your dragon riding skills to new heights! 

Just... make sure you don't fall from them!

When you're ready, seek out my bronze colleagues and fly those courses!
72486.completion:
Nicely done! You have almost mastered all of the advanced race courses in the Dragon Isles!

Now! On to Thaldraszus and the last set of challenges!
72486.objectives: Fly each of the advanced courses in the Azure Span.

72487.title: The Thaldraszus Tour
72487.description:
Thaldraszus. It is the home of the Seat of the Aspects and much of dragonkind's history. 

It is also home to soaring heights and steep deep ravines just waiting to be flown over!

As before, my bronze colleagues have set up race courses in Thaldraszus to fly while you explore. 

Why not give them a try and complete your Dragon Isles racing tour?
72487.completion:
Fantastic! You have raced your way all over the Dragon Isles. This is irrefutable proof of your skill as a dragon racer!

Even so, I can see even more challenges and advanced courses await you in the future!

But for now, congratulations!
72487.objectives: Fly each of the race courses in Thaldraszus.

72488.title: The Thaldraszus Advanced Tour
72488.description:
Once more to Thaldraszus with its peaks and valleys and courses ready and waiting for you to race!

Seek out my bronze colleagues to fly the advanced courses and finish your racing tour of the Dragon Isles!
72488.completion:
You did it! You've flown all of the advanced race courses all over the Dragon Isles. I am immensely pleased--and impressed! 

Feel free to re-fly any of the courses to beat your own best times. The sky's the limit!
72488.objectives: Fly each of the advanced courses in Thaldraszus.

72512.title: A Whispering Breeze
72512.description: <Godoloto cocks her head quizzically, nods at you, and finally holds your gaze. After a long moment, she casts her eyes up towards the sky... and the mountain just beside Maruukai. You sense that she wants you to travel up to Ohn'ahra's Roost.>
72512.completion: <As you approach, the great ohuna spirit settles on the ground and gazes at you. Gently, she lowers her head to touch your forehead with her own. In that moment, a comfortable warmth spreads within you. The winds are now within your reach.>

72513.title: Our Destiny
72513.description:
Evoker! You might have felt a disturbance just recently.

Ebyssian and I have begun to unbind the ancient siphons that were extracting the black dragonflight essence from dracthyr. I suspect that only the fully trained evokers like yourself are tuned enough to feel the change.

There is more, though. Please, come join Ebyssian and myself at the High Creche in the Forbidden Reach. We have a dragon to unchain.
72513.completion: {class}, stand to. We may have a situation.
72513.objectives: Speak with Scalecommander Emberthal at the High Creche.

72514.title: The High Creche
72514.description:
Have you felt it?

We have already started bringing the barrier down. This prison for Adamanthia held so much power.

And now I can augment again! A fully trained evoker was always intended to empower their allies, as much as healing or devastation. I remember that now... and more.

I am starting to remember who this imprisoned black dragon was... who she was to all dracthyr.

Please, $p, help me remove these shackles.
72514.progress: The vindictiveness of this trap... how could we have been so blind to Neltharian's cruelty?
72514.completion: Well done. We will need Ebyssian to sunder the last strand of magic sustaining this imprisonment.

72515.title: Augmenting a Dragon
72515.description:
Adamanthia!

She has been imprisoned for ages, trapped in torment. While the dracthyr slept, she suffered.

I can only hope she has not given in to Deathwing's madness during her long imprisonment. The passage of time may have shattered her mind.

Be ready, champion. Should she lash out, aid Ebyssian. Augment his abilities, so he can subdue Adamanthia instead of slaying her.

She has earned a chance. We must give it to her.
72515.progress: Adamanthia has waited long enough for this day. Let us hope it has not come too late.
72515.completion:
We... are good.

I think... she will be okay after this. Thank you, {class}. Now we can get Adamanthia the help and healing she needs, so we can welcome her to this new world.

72519.title: Temporal Two-ning
72519.description:
I see... They are falling through possibilities as well as time.

Hurry, I have located another point in the timeline where we might catch them. It is... unusual, but do not let the strangeness of this world slow you down. Chronormu's fate is in your hands.
72519.completion: The process was not finished but I can more accurately track Chronormu now.
72519.objectives: Use Chrono Crystal on Eternus and Chromie in Azmerloth to stop them from falling through time.

72524.title: Basic Climbing Gear
72524.description:
<Pathfinder Jeb motions to the supply kit next to him.>

You're going to need supplies to survive out there.

Let's get you what you need to start climbing.
72524.completion:
This basic equipment will get you started.

Come back when you have more Dragon Isles Supplies to get trained in new gear.
72524.objectives: Use the Expedition Supply Kit to research Climbing Gear.

72525.title: Basic Cataloging Gear
72525.description:
Every expedition cataloger deserves their very own camera!

You don't need to give yours a special name, but I highly encourage it. It's far more fun.

Anyway, Pathfinder Jeb should be able to get you everything you need.

I've yet to need a single thing that he hasn't brought along with him. He's incredible!
72525.completion: Oh, your new camera is beautiful. It matches you perfectly!
72525.objectives: Use the Expedition Supply Kit to research Cataloging Gear.

72526.title: Keeper's Rest
72526.description:
I do not enjoy seeing others forged by Tyr disabled. They went through such effort to keep the tomb from collapsing, and now it will languish devoid of even what was left of Tyr's light.

<Koranos gestures to the Silver Scale.>

I hope whatever is in the scale is worth their destruction. Let us find another console to see what, if anything, is on the scale.
72526.progress: We act in the service of Tyr. He would understand.
72526.completion: We are safe for now, but we should not linger.

72527.title: No Such Thing as Bad Luck
72527.description:
Look, believe it or not, I'd be in the Isles already if it wasn't for unfinished business. Recent events have not been kind to me. I owe the Baron, and nobody owes the Baron for long. He will absolutely find and skin me if I don't pay up.

I invested his money in these magic crystals, but their price just crashed on the market because of the front page ripper in the Booty Bay Journal. And the shipment of crystals is missing!

Someone must be plotting my demise. Perhaps the Goodstitches will help me.
72527.completion: ...I shouldn't be surprised that no one will help me for free. Ask Blixrez his price.
72527.objectives: Find Blixrez Goodstitch in Tan-Your-Hide Leatherworks in Booty Bay.

72529.title: Information is King
72529.description:
Information ain't cheap. Outta everyone, Zeros should know that best.

People have sighted dangerous crocolisks around Janeiro's Point. You know what I see? Money, money, money! Get me their precious skins and maybe I'll remember something important about those crystals Zeros is after.

If that's too dangerous for your cup of tea, I might be open to other forms of payment too. You know, the most common form.

<Blixrez folds his arms and waits expectantly.>
72529.progress: Friendship is like a scale. It must remain balanced at all costs!
72529.objectives: Collect 3 Crocolisk Skins in Janeiro's Point, or give gold to Blixrez Goodstitch.

72530.title: Anyway, I Started Bribing
72530.description:
The scoundrel! I had a deal with Arty to market the crystals in the paper. Someone must've cut a bigger deal with him.

Arty routinely inspects the Venture Company's working area on the shore. He always brings his own guards, but no one is immune to gold in Booty Bay.

Take my last bit of gold. Go to the oil rigs and bribe the guards to look the other way before you confront Arty.
72530.progress: That's all the gold I got, so if you need to throw in some punches to sweeten the deal, be my guest.
72530.completion: Pirates?! Of course. We know where to go next.
72530.objectives: Use the gold to bribe Arty's Hired Bodyguards and then confront Prospector Arty in Wild Shore.

72532.title: Money, Money, Money!
72532.description:
Grub Redcut and his crew are notorious for their love of money. They'll do anything for it.

I assume there is treasure to be had on his own ship, but just in case there isn't, there must be gold within their pockets. Will you do me the dirty business of collecting it?

I won't question your negotiation tactics--just don't kill them! I'm not trying to start a serious blood feud today.
72532.progress: It's high time those pirates learned they can't terrorize anyone they please.
72532.completion: Oh my gold, that looks like a hefty sum.
72532.objectives: Collect 1500 Gold Coins from Grub Redcut's pirates in the Southern Savage Coast.

72533.title: Crystals Shmystals
72533.description:
Grub. Redcut. <Zeros spits.> A sore, crusty loser, who thinks he's all tough because he's big and buff. He hates that someone like me can make more money than him.

Believe it or not, I play the auction house fairly. I'm a saint compared to him!

So Grub sold my crystals, eh? And then paid Arty to lie about them so no one would go looking for them. A fine plan.

Grub must have something valuable on that ship of his. Well we're going to go take it. Search the ship thoroughly.
72533.progress: Please hurry! The Baron wasn't kidding about my scales--I'm a dragon, as you know, and my scales are worth quite a lot.
72533.objectives: Retrieve Grub Redcut's treasure from his ship in Southern Savage Coast.

72534.title: Settled with the Baron
72534.description:
Ha...! You returned just in time. A minute later and you might've found a skinned dragon on your hands.

Give him the treasure, quickly.
72534.progress: Give him the gold already, will you? Please!
72534.completion: Senegos! You just saved my life.
72534.objectives: Give the treasure to Baron Revilgaz.

72545.title: Creche Fallen
72545.description:
This is my failure, $p. 

I led these dracthyr here. They knew death was a possibility, but they also trusted me to be there for them.

I should have been down there, clearing the ruins, not up here trawling through books. 

<Emberthal balls her fists.>

I need you to retrieve their horn signets. We need to give them honors.
72545.progress: Hmm? Sorry. My thoughts are... elsewhere, right now.
72545.completion:
<Emberthal gives you a solemn nod.>

Thank you, {NAME}.
72545.objectives: Collect the Horn Signet of Tetsos, Horn Signet of Arrosh, Horn Signet of Ekrati and Horn Signet of Hermin in the Lost Atheneum.

72546.title: Academic Assistance
72546.description:
{NAME}! I've made a breakthrough with tha Winterpelt dialect. Ya helped get tha ball rollin' on this, so I felt like I ought ta keep ya apprised of the situation.

Meet me in Theron's Watch and I'll tell ya all about it.
72546.objectives: Meet Sonova Snowden in Theron's Watch.

72547.title: Academic Acquisitions
72547.description:
I'll head up tae the village an' give 'em the bad news--or try. Winterpelt's a right tricky dialect tae learn.

I need ye tae get out there an' find me some furbolg writin' samples tae study if we ever hope tae communicate properly.

The Primalists've wiped out or converted most o' the remainin' furbolg in the Span, so go shake 'em down until whate'er cultural artifacts they have drop out.

I'll need at least five tae start, but bring me as many as ye can, and I'll keep teachin' ye what I learn.
72547.completion:
Not a bad start, {NAME}.

I'm goin' tae need a lot more if we ever want to have a conversation, though!
72547.objectives: Recover furbolg artifacts from Primalists in the Azure Span.

72551.title: A Living History
72551.description:
The Winterpelt finally trust us enough to ask for aid.

We must nurture this trust so we may one day clasp their paws in friendship!

This Winterpelt, Jyrra of the, uh, Fuzzy Feet, says their elders went into hiding during the Primalist attack on their village. I don't yet understand their language, but it seems the elders left markers to help the clan find them later.

It's time to let the Winterpelt elders know it's safe to come home. Will you convey this message? It seems a simple enough task.
72551.completion:
Wait... is it true? You've come from our village? 

Has the fighting stopped?
72551.objectives: Follow the markers to find the hidden Winterpelt elders.

72552.title: Gathering Together
72552.description:
I haven't heard an outsider speak our tongue. Your grasp is a bit basic...

But only a friend of the clan would speak it at all!

I am Elder Mhaz. If it is safe to return home, we should set off soon. But many of us are weak with sadness of the heart--and grumbling of the stomach. I would not put you at risk gathering fresh meat, but could you gather roots for us? 

We have already gathered ones that are close. I hope this comfort food will lift our spirits enough to return!
72552.progress: The roots grow around the bases of the large trees. We have not ventured east because there are many worms. Perhaps there are more there?
72552.completion: I'm glad to see you have returned safely!

72553.title: More Effort, More Reward
72553.description:
We're not sad. We're starving. That's the truth of it. A few tasty roots won't be enough.

Elder Mhaz doesn't recognize strength, but I do. It should be (100)-trivial for you to bring us some fresh meat! The worms to the east should be easy prey.

Please, bring back what you can carry!
72553.progress: Worm meat should be easy enough. Pick on the little worms if you're not up for the bigger ones.
72553.completion: I knew I was right about you, {class}.
72553.objectives: Collect 12 pieces of meat from worms.

72554.title: Break Him
72554.description:
You handled those little worms with such ease!

However... Saza hasn't come back. The giant worm, Icebreaker, has been hunting us for weeks. It took two of our elders while we gathered food and injured me when I tried to avenge them. And now, with Saza missing, I fear the worst.

Find Saza, and get rid of that worm!
72554.completion:
So. It was Icebreaker?

<Matron Fherg cries out in a mournful howl.>

Our bright, brave cub... Oh, Saza...

Anyone here would gladly give up their lives in trade for Saza's. Icebreaker's death brings some comfort, but it will not bring her back. 

Saza's loss will be felt by all of us.
72554.objectives: Find Saza and kill the large worm, Icebreaker.

72558.title: Our Honored Ancestors
72558.description:
It is time to take the next step to understanding the Winterpelt. That step is a spiritual one. 

They look to their ancestors for advice as they choose their path forward. We can learn from them too.

But the Winterpelt rite to call their ancestors is... intricate. And long. 

It would be rude to copy their ritual anyway. We'll do it our way with Rustpine Spiritspeaker incense.

Come! Let us reveal their ancestors' wisdom and learn more about our new friends!
72558.progress: When you're ready, the incense will allow you to see spirits.
72558.objectives: Use Radza's incense to allow spirit sight.

72559.title: History Heist
72559.description:
When the Primalists raided our village, they took more than our lives; they stole the heart of our community--our priceless historical documents! 

I will not stand for records of our traditions, rituals, and rich history taken from us! We still have lessons to learn from them.

Please, recover them from those looting Primalist scouts so they can be preserved!
72559.progress: Did the ancestor send you on a mission?
72559.completion: These pieces are incredible! What a horrible loss this would have been to the Winterpelt.

72584.title: Setting Your Very Own Net
72584.description: Want to try out your net? Go to the river mouth to the south of Waking Shores, and find a place where the fish are abundant. There should be a good spot for setting up a net.
72584.progress: Don't forget, south of Waking Shores. Go.
72584.completion: Good. Don't forget to pick up your fishing net in a few hours. We don't want the fish to go to waste!
72584.objectives: Set up a fishing net in the River Mouth Fishing Hole.

72585.title: Open Orientation
72585.description:
You have done much for the Dragon Isles, hero. 

There are many who are grateful for your contributions and want to welcome you more wholly into their communities. Go to them and orient yourselves with each group and their specialties. 

I think you will find that just as you have much to offer the Dragon Isles, many here have much they wish to offer you in return!
72585.completion:
You've met everyone? Excellent. Maybe they will stop sending me emissaries, then. 

I hope you will continue to strengthen the bonds you have made with these communities. You have only to benefit each other.
72585.objectives: Complete the Orientation quests in each major faction hub: Dragonscale Basecamp, Maruukai, Iskaara, and Valdrakken.

72586.title: Additional Academic Acquisitions
72586.description:
Keep 'em comin'!

The more examples o' furbolg writin' ye collect for me tae cross reference, the better.
72586.progress: Don't stop now; we got ourselves a language tae learn!
72586.completion: I'll get right on catalogin' this batch.
72586.objectives: Recover furbolg artifacts from Primalists in the Azure Span.

72587.title: Astonishing Academic Acquisitions
72587.description:
Where did ya get that beauty?

Tha Primalists seem a lot more interested in destroying civilizations than preserving their history, which makes a find like this all tha more precious.

I'll get out me good rubbing stick for this one!
72587.progress: I cannae wait to get to work on this!
72587.completion: Nothing like a fresh artifact to start tha day off right.
72587.objectives: Recover an Intact Scribe Stick from Primalists in the Azure Span.

72588.title: Primalist Pillagers
72588.description:
I'm startin' tae grasp the basics of Winterpelt, but what I'm pickin' up is grim.

Seems a band of Winterpelt foragers fell afoul o' the nearby Primalists. The winters here are as harsh as any in Dun Morogh, an' the supplies they were gatherin' will be sorely missed.

Why don't ya see about recoverin' what ye can. With prejudice, if ye don't mind.
72588.progress: There's a whole village dependin' on these supplies, so don't skimp on what ye bring back.
72588.completion: Maybe next time the thievin' Primalists will keep their mitts tae themselves.

72589.title: Honor Their Sacrifice
72589.description:
There's nothin' we can do for the foragers the Primalists killed, but we can at least try an' provide some closure tae their kin.

See if ye can find anythin' of a personal nature on the fallen. I'm sure the Winterpelt will appreciate whatever ye can bring them.
72589.progress: How many did the Primalists kill?
72589.completion: It's not much, but it's somethin'. And that's what matters.
72589.objectives: Recover personal effects from the fallen Winterpelt Foragers.

72590.title: Ursol's Wisdom
72590.description:
We have strayed from wise Ursol's path, trading focus for obsession and contemplation for fear.

Gather cones from the mighty Rustpines. As their roots stretch deep into the earth, take strength from the waters, reach into the winds, and are ripened by fire, they will be a symbol of our renewed commitment to true balance.

Take to the skies on that drake of yours and you should be able to gather enough. The upper branches are the best place to find them.

Offer them to Ursol at his nearby shrine.
72590.completion: Our path forward is clear now. Thank you for your part in this.

72591.title: A Debt That Must Be Paid
72591.description:
{NAME}, I have heard you cultivated good relations with the centaur of the Ohn'ahran Plains. I would like to ask a favor.

Baine left for the plains a few days ago in search of a group of missing tauren. I offered to accompany him, but he insisted on going alone.

The tauren of Thunder Bluff have a long and bloody history with the centaur of Kalimdor, as does Baine. While the Maruuk centaur are unrelated, I still have my concerns.

Your presence could help smooth tensions. I hope.
72591.completion:
Ah, {NAME}. Mayla sent you? 

While I prefer to do this alone, I admit your relationship with the centaur might be useful.
72591.objectives: Find Baine in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

72592.title: Scars from the Past
72592.description:
A tribe of tauren came to the Dragon Isles led by a close friend of mine, Bovan Windtotem. No one has heard from them since they entered these plains.

If they have gone missing, then I must find them. Unfortunately, I underestimated the size of this place. 

You have an existing relationship with the centaur. Will you go speak with them and see if they have any information on Bovan or his tribe? 

Perhaps they can help narrow down my search.
72592.progress: Thank you for your help. I would be... uncomfortable dealing with the centaur directly.
72592.completion: I sent you to get information, not to invite one of them to join us! Can you not just send her home?!
72592.objectives: Ask the Maruuk centaur about the disappearance of Bovan Windtotem.

72593.title: A Tomul-tuous Beginning
72593.description:
Since the dragons returned, we've seen an overwhelming number of outsiders passing through the plains. Normally we keep a close eye on our borders, but their sheer numbers, combined with the Nokhud threat, have made it difficult to track them.

One scout reported a group of outsiders that matched your description traveling along the eastern road. We should start our search there.

As for your friend, my khan gave me a command. A huffy companion won't stop me from carrying it out.
72593.completion:
It seems the centaur here are not all that different from those in Kalimdor.

<Baine eyes Tomul suspiciously.>
72593.objectives: Meet Tomul and Baine on the eastern road near the Watering Hole.

72594.title: Delivering Bad News
72594.description:
As soon as we arrived, Baine was whisked away. Bovan is still missing, so he is speaking to someone named Tagar.

Of course I've been left out here in the cold. It seems they still don't trust me.

In any case, you should go in and speak with the tauren. Take the items you found and try to identify who they belonged to. At the very least, you can let the families know what we've discovered so far.

But... be gentle, {NAME}. For some of them, this may be the worst day of their lives.
72594.progress:
Tagar has known me since I was a child. He was my father's second-in-command for many years.

Long ago, he was responsible for sending Rexxar, Rokhan, and Chen Stormstout on a mission to rescue me from the centaur.

But they needed aid to complete that mission... and that is when they met Bovan Windtotem.
72594.completion:
Thank you for what you have done for these people.

As for Tomul, I hate to admit it, but she seems to be proving her worth.

Despite her grating personality.
72594.objectives: Speak to the tauren and identify to whom the items you found belonged.

72595.title: The Search for Bovan Windtotem
72595.description:
According to this survivor, the centaur took them completely by surprise. Bovan led many of the braves against the centaur, hoping to buy time for the others to escape. 

He succeeded, but Bovan and most of the braves have not returned. We must find him, {NAME}.

I need you to search the surrounding area. If you find survivors, tell them to make their way back here.

If you find fallen tauren... take something recognizable to bring back to their families.
72595.completion:
I have spoken to the survivors, and no one has seen Bovan since the battle. 

This headdress you found on the deceased tauren does not belong to him, so he is either still missing... or captured.

<Baine's expression hardens.>
72595.objectives: Search the surrounding area for the missing tauren.

72597.title: Ursoc's Strength
72597.description:
