It has been many years since we last offered sacrifices to mighty Ursoc, but we will need his blessing if we are to restore balance among our people.

His shrine is hidden in the mountains to the east where few would stumble upon it by chance.
72597.completion: Thank you, outsider. Though the news you bring is grim, we will honor Ursoc's memory as best we are able.

72598.title: Words of the Winterpelt
72598.description:
The Winterpelt Chief sent word while ye were out that he wanted tae speak with ye again.

And, thanks tae all the work ye been puttin' in, we could actually understand the message!

We're on the cusp o' somethin' great here, {NAME}. Think of it... The trade routes we could establish! The cultural exchange that could take place! The papers I could publish!

Well? What are ye standin' around for? Go see what he wants!
72598.completion:
It seems... strange to speak of our traditions to an outsider. But if the ancestors spoke through you... 

I have task for you, {NAME}... one that I hope will set us on the right path.

72599.title: Joint Rescue Operation
72599.description:
Tomul says the attacks on the Windtotem were carried out by an enemy clan known as the Nokhud. 

Just down this road is their closest outpost, and the most likely location where tauren prisoners would be taken.

The task is simple--rescue the captives. We do not know how many there are, or how long they have been here, so we must hurry.

I speak from experience when I say centaur do not keep their captives for long.
72599.completion: We have scoured the camp and saved who we could, but Bovan is not among the captives.

72600.title: A Proper Shikaar Send-Off
72600.description:
We're here to rescue the captive tauren, but I have a personal request.

The place we are assaulting was once my home. The Nokhud took over after a surprise attack during the civil war.

Take these Shikaar banners. When you kill a Nokhud or one of their allies, plant a banner on their corpse. I want to send a message--if they continue to occupy our home, they will pay in blood.
72600.progress: How many banners did you place?
72600.completion: I saw the banners all across the highlands. It will not change what happened, but it puts a smile on my face.
72600.objectives: Plant a Shikaar Banner on 15 slain Nokhud centaur or their allies.

72601.title: Bovan's Last Hope
72601.description:
If Bovan is not here, the Nokhud could have taken him anywhere. We might have one last chance to find him, but it's a long shot.

We still have Bovan's necklace. One of the Ohn'ir mystics might be able to use it to help divine his location. I've only heard about this ritual, so I have no idea if it will work.

Go to the Ohn'iri Springs and look for Boku. I'm sure he will help us.

Baine and I will make sure the tauren we rescued get back safely. We'll meet you at the Ohn'iri Springs.
72601.completion: Tomul has filled me in on what you need!
72601.objectives: Find Boku at the Ohn'iri Springs.

72602.title: Optimistic Mystic
72602.description:
I'm sure I can find this Bovan Windtotem--but I will need a few items from you.

First, I need a selection of flowers that grow at the base of the springs. They have the specific properties we are looking for.

Next, I require the heart of a salamanther. A stronger heart will better our chances--look for the strongest you can find!

I can gather the rest of the materials on my own.
72602.completion: Yes, this will do nicely! Since your friend does not wish to enter the springs, I've set up here.
72602.objectives: Collect a Strong Salamanther Heart and 8 Geyser Flowers.

72603.title: What Words Are Worth
72603.description:
Let me just grind these flowers and... there we are, all ready! 

Take these items and place them in the incense burner. Together with Bovan's necklace, I can entreat Ohn'ahra to help us find him. 

With luck, she will give us a vision.
72603.completion: At least I have one reliable ally. Thank you, {NAME}.
72603.objectives: Place the items in the incense burner and witness the vision.

72604.title: Desperate Rescue
72604.description:
I should have known I could not trust the centaur. They may provide token amounts of aid, but they would never risk themselves for us.

Let us focus on the matter at hand. We cannot allow Bovan to remain in centaur captivity! I will set out immediately for Nokhudon Hold. 

Meet me there as quickly as you can.
72604.objectives: Meet Baine Bloodhoof outside Nokhudon Hold.

72605.title: Saving Bovan Windtotem
72605.description:
Time is against us, {NAME}. We must find Bovan as quickly as possible.

This hold is teeming with centaur. Our search will go faster if we split up--and it will be easier to slip by the patrols.

Take one of these potions I brought. It should help you go undetected, but beware of the Nokhud wardogs. If Tomul spoke correctly, they will sniff you out.

Search the area for Bovan. If you find him, get him out. Do not wait for me.
72605.objectives: Search Nokhudon Hold for Bovan Windtotem.

72606.title: See Red
72606.description:
Nokhud. Gelkis. Magram. Kolkar. They are all the same...

They plague the land. They murder my people. No more!

I will end this centaur threat. Here! Now!
72606.progress: I will make them pay for what they have done.
72606.completion:
<After cutting through dozens of centaur, Baine is visibly fatigued. He is breathing hard and covered in wounds.>

Jamoku... was responsible for all of this...

I will not... let him escape...

72607.title: Old Hatreds
72607.description:
<Baine is still breathing heavily from his recent battles.>

I will not leave... until Jamoku pays... for what he has done...

I will avenge Bovan... no matter the cost...
72607.completion:
Jamoku is dead, as are many of the centaur. We have avenged Bovan and the others.

<Baine grimaces as he touches a wound on his side.>

In hindsight, perhaps we should not have taken on the entire Nokhud army. Luckily, Tomul's timely arrival helped even the odds.

<Baine glances at Tomul.>

A centaur fighting to save a tauren... I never would have believed it.

72609.title: Case Closed
72609.description:
You are lucky we arrived when we did. We intercepted the Nokhud reinforcements about to flank you during your fight with Jamoku.

We lost two of our number in that battle. Their bodies have already been recovered. Bovan's is the last.

The Nokhud will not take long to rally and hunt us down. We must leave now.

Head to Toghusuq Village, where the tauren are encamped. We will meet you there.
72609.completion:
Baine hasn't said much since we left Nokhudon Hold. I did not realize just how much this Bovan meant to him until now.

As for me, I will head back to Maruukai after this funeral. My khan's command has been fulfilled, even if this was not the outcome we would have liked.
72609.objectives: Meet Scout Tomul and Baine Bloodhoof at Toghusuq Village.

72611.title: Letting Go
72611.description:
The Shikaar lost two of their own during the battle. All of Tomul's reinforcements... they volunteered to help, of their own will.

I... have much to consider.

After speaking with the Shikaar, we decided to honor our dead together. We have blended our funerary rites into one ceremony for this occasion.

We would be honored if you would stay and participate.
72611.progress: These centaur... may the Earth Mother embrace them.
72611.completion:
Bovan is gone, but his people remain. Why did he bring them here? What did he see in his visions?

The Windtotem have always been nomads. Perhaps he saw that they might finally find a home.

Or... did he know what would happen with the centaur? Did he bring us here to make peace with them? Or to make peace with the hatred in our own hearts?

All I know for certain is I must continue to live according to his ideals. In that, I can honor his life and memory.
72611.objectives: Speak to Baine Bloodhoof about the funeral.

72644.title: An Urgent Matter
72644.description:
Hello {NAME}. I was told to give you letter. The messenger mentioned it was urgent.

The crest on it seems to be from SI:7. I would read it right away if I were you.
72644.objectives: Meet Master Mathias Shaw on the outside ramparts behind Stormwind Keep.

72650.title: Warm Winds and Water
72650.description:
Kirygosa wrote me after leaving Stranglethorn some years ago. She said it was beautiful and balmy, but not very quiet. I presume--and hope--she has found peace in Pandaria.

If I am honest with myself, I should not be surprised that she hasn't answered the Isles' call. Yet, we must do our duty and seek her out. If I am doubly honest with myself, I would have any excuse to see her again.

Let us take a break from these chilly winds and visit the Jade Forest.
72650.objectives: Find Kirygosa in The Jade Forest in Pandaria.

72651.title: Carp Care
72651.description:
The village carp bring fortune and peace. Their well-being reflects the health of the village.

The carp thrive on special food made from worm meal and vegetable paste. It's not as unpleasant as it sounds, especially after we finish dehydrating it into neat little blocks.

Here! Just toss it gently in the water near them.

Their ponds also require cleaning, so please skim any debris you find.
72651.progress: Have you finished feeding the carp?
72651.completion: All done? Thank you. The carp are so pretty, aren't they? Their scales shimmer almost like a dragon's.
72651.objectives: Feed the carp and clean their ponds of debris in Dawn's Blossom.

72652.title: Self Care
72652.description:
How strange and wonderful it is to be in Kiry's own home.

That being said, I can't help but notice it is an absolute mess in here. She spends all this time helping with the villagers, I have a feeling that she doesn't reserve time for herself. Typical Kiry... <Kalecgos sighs.>

Would you mind tidying this place up a bit, $p? I'm sure she'd be glad for the help.
72652.progress: <Kalecgos is paying deep attention to Kirygosa.>
72652.completion: Oh--did you finish? Thank you very much. I can tell Kiry appreciates you.

72653.title: Local Deliveries
72653.description:
I've been cultivating a new flower in this land. It's quite versatile, but the villagers and I are still refining its various uses.

I just harvested my latest batch today. Will you help me deliver them?
72653.progress: Have you met my neighbors yet? Don't be shy about introductions. Everyone is pleased to meet outsiders that respect our traditions and way of life.
72653.completion: Wonderful! By the way--if you like the flowers, I would love to give you a bunch from my next harvest.
72653.objectives: Deliver Wild Blue Yonders to villagers in Dawn's Blossom.

72654.title: Up, Up, and Home
72654.description:
Honest work for an honest day. Thanks, $p.

Why don't we have some tea and conversation at my home? Just tell me when you're ready.
72654.objectives: Fly with Kirygosa to her home.

72655.title: A Drink with Kalecgos
72655.description:
<Kalecgos is quiet for a moment, a wistful look on his face.>

I'd call upon Nozdormu to help us pass the time, but he'd tell me that I should be able to handle this.

So... the Drunken Hozen. If Kiry recommends it, then let us go!
72655.progress: Peiji Goldendraft recommended the perfect brew for comradery. Hot barley tea! Please, have some.
72655.objectives: Have a drink with Kalecgos in The Drunken Hozen.

72656.title: Winterspring
72656.description:
Haleh, Matron Protectorate, presides over Winterspring. Even after defeating the power hungry mage Umbranse, she continues to find and dispel danger in her homeland. As the last living consort of Malygos, she tirelessly upholds his legacy as a guardian of magic.

Her return would greatly strengthen the blue dragonflight.
72656.completion: I have been keeping tabs on Haleh since my awakening.
72656.objectives: Speak to Sindragosa for more information.

72657.title: A Protector of Magic
72657.description:
I am very curious about Haleh--she is one of the last living consorts of Malygos. I am grateful for her going to Malygos in his time of need.

I will admit, I have spent some time spying on her. She is a blue dragon through and through. Studious, proud, and one of the more careful ones around magic. 

I do feel most suited to be the one to visit her about the call of the Isles. Take my portal when you are ready. I shall meet you there.
72657.objectives: Find Haleh in Winterspring in Kalimdor.

72659.title: Test Subject
72659.description:
Today is day forty-one without finding a harmful artifact. I am further delighted to report that while you were away, a handful more proved harmless. Perhaps my hunt in Winterspring is almost concluded!

Come to think of it... you have some magical ability, don't you? Or enough bravery to help me test some more artifacts?

Do not be nervous. None of them will permanently hurt you. Artifacts with that kind of dangerous power were taken care of in my first year here.
72659.progress: Do take your time, {NAME}... there are only hundreds more to go.
72659.completion: It seems three out of three were of little magical impact. This is truly great news.
72659.objectives: Test the artifacts Bottled Spirit, Icy Book, and Left Boot.

72660.title: Owl of a Sudden
72660.description:
While you were working, I was inspecting the totemic ruins you retrieved. There has always been something odd about the Hidden Grove. It used to be occupied by a robust population of harmless white hares. Now there are only maddened owlkin and strange totems...

I put the pieces together. It is no masterpiece, but hopefully we can glean a stronger magical effect from the whole.

Maybe it will even make us sprout some feathers and fur. You would think as a blue dragon I would enjoy the cold, but no.
72660.progress: I cannot remember the last time I had proper help. Thank you.
72660.completion: Of course, what did I expect?

72661.title: A Wyrm Rest
72661.description: Oh dear. I have an idea. Speak to me when you are ready.
72661.progress: I fear Haleh has not been getting adequate rest.
72661.completion: Sometimes we just need a taste of the simple things again.
72661.objectives: Work with Sindragosa to cheer up Haleh.

72662.title: Resupplying Supplies
72662.description:
The Nokhud have been striking at outsiders crossing into the plains. This is no doubt their handiwork.

This survivor says that most of their food supplies were destroyed in the ambush. We should try to help out.

Let's collect meat from the plentiful game around the Watering Hole. That should be enough to cover their immediate needs.
72662.objectives: Collect 40 Fresh Plains Meat from the area surrounding Toghusuq Village.

72663.title: Pinewood Trail
72663.description:
If Bovan is not dead, and he is not here, then either he is still out there... or he has been captured. Given Tomul's message, I fear it's the latter.

The Windtotem are safe for now, but with an attack possible at any moment, they can't spare any braves to go after Bovan.

It looks like it is up to us. Let us head to Pinewood Post.
72663.completion: Tomul wanted me to wait for you in her encampment, but I... politely declined to do so.
72663.objectives: Meet up with Tomul and Baine at Pinewood Post.

72664.title: Eggs in Abundance
72664.description:
<Flaps does a spin and deposits a drool-soaked note into your hand.>

$p, the Ruby Life Pools are overwhelmed with dragon eggs ready to hatch. We are excited to welcome these blessings to Azeroth, but we do not have enough whelptenders to mind them all.

Please visit me at the Lifeshrine so we may discuss a potential solution.

- Amella
72664.completion: Thank you for coming, {NAME}. Soon the whelps will greatly outnumber us.
72664.objectives: Meet Amella at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores.

72665.title: Whelptender's Wisdom
72665.description:
Our egg-tenders report a new clutch of eggs is soon to hatch. Ordinarily, a whelptender would take each newly hatched dragon and raise them with their flight. However, not all dragonspawn are called to the life of a whelptender, and we are short of hands.

Gather wisdom from whelptenders of each flight in the gardens below the Lifeshrine. Agapanthus, an experienced whelptender of the blue flight, has offered his services as head of the Little Scales Daycare. But he will need your assistance.
72665.progress: Whelptenders of the red flight study the methods of each flight to provide the best all-around care. It makes sense that you are studying those methods, too.
72665.completion: Amella said to meet you. I have been assigned to help Agapanthus with the daycare.
72665.objectives: Speak to whelptenders at the gardens of the Ruby Life Pools.

72666.title: Daycare Director Agapanthus
72666.description:
Amella has told me about the incoming whelps and about the daycare. Did you know Agapanthus is a renowned whelptender? I heard he fought back demons while rearing whelps! 

If he's as amazing as they say, I have much to learn from him. I only just received my Calling, but I will help in any way I can.

The Little Scales Daycare is in Valdrakken. I will gather my things and meet you and Agapanthus there.
72666.completion:
Lasztak has just informed me of his rigorous study as a whelptender of the red flight. Most of my experience is hands-on. And you...

<Agapanthus sighs and scratches his chin.>

We will have to develop curriculum.
72666.objectives: Meet Agapanthus at the Little Scales Daycare in Valdrakken.

72667.title: Snack Run
72667.description:
The whelps that visit the daycare eat snacks during their visit. A lot of snacks.

If there are going to be whelps that stay here with regularity, we will need even more rations to sate their endless hunger.

Here is a list of snacks the whelps have taken to lately. I also ordered something for Sir Pringly, so be sure to get that as well.
72667.progress: It was the same in Aszuna. Cheese and crackers are treasured by all whelps.
72667.completion: That was a remarkable first snack run, {NAME}. Hopefully these snacks continue to be to the whelps' liking.
72667.objectives: Gather snacks from vendors in Valdrakken.

72668.title: A Nurturing Environment
72668.description:
Young whelps can be careless in how they treat their space. The daycare is effectively under siege day in and day out!

Help clean up the daycare. The new whelps will need a proper place to stay.

I will not let one claw set down on unpolished stone or overgrown grass!
72668.progress: Is there anything better than squaring away a space?
72668.completion:
This should do for your first sweep of the daycare. Good work, {NAME}.

I believe our curriculum is off to a good start. Now we must await the whelps.
72668.objectives: Help put the Little Scales Daycare back into order.

72670.title: Those We Left Behind
72670.description:
In attempting to defend their home against the fury of the blue dragonflight, Shandaral's mages condemned the souls of their people to an eternity of crystalline torment. 

Now their echoes wander aimlessly, reliving their civilization's doom again and again for more than ten thousand years.

I have found that some of the shades yet retain a shred of sentience. Perhaps they can be reasoned with--convinced to free themselves from the mire of their own ancient fear and pass on at last.
72670.completion: This crystalline prison is not easy to escape. Still, with luck our work here will let the spirits that yet linger find some modicum of peace.
72670.objectives: Ease the restless echoes of Shandaral.

72674.title: A Shattered Legacy
72674.description:
Shandaral's reckless use of the crystal focus placed too much stress on the relic, causing it to shatter. Its fragments have been scattered amidst the crystalline permafrost.

I can recreate the focus, but I will need you to collect enough of those shards to give me something to go on. You should be able to find them amidst the piles of crystal refuse scattered throughout the area.

Take heed, {class}. Those shards may still hold fragments of the mages's memories from that fateful day.
72674.progress: Malygos's rage fed Shandaral's desperation. Now our flight's failure is frozen in crystal for the world to see.
72674.completion: Malygos believed that we alone were capable of stewarding the myriad truths of the arcane. His--and our--failure to consider the potential of mortals led to the tragedy you see here.
72674.objectives: Retrieve the fragments of the Crystal Focus.

72679.title: An Arcane Requiem
72679.description:
The time is upon us, {NAME}. With your help, most of the restless echoes of Shandaral have been quelled. However, some yet remain whose rage and sorrow burns too brightly to be eased by mere words.

Using the shards that you recovered, I have managed to recreate a facsimile of the crystal focus that brought Shandaral to ruin. Using it here should bring the anchored spirits to bear and give us an opportunity to grant them final rest.

Be on guard. I do not know how their long-held sorrows will manifest.
72679.progress: This will not be a happy ending--but it will be an ending all the same.
72679.completion:
At last, the magic that was binding these tormented memories to this ruin has been broken.

It will be some time before the lesser echoes fully dissipate. Still, with their source finally banished and the relic's fragments removed, the fragments of memory that remained trapped here will finally be relieved of their torment.
72679.objectives: Grant the echoes of Shandaral their final rest.

72681.title: Report to the Trading Post
72681.description: <The glint of a distant object catches your eye. You suddenly remember that you have tender to collect for use at T&W Trading Post.>
72681.completion: Hope ye like this month's collection of new and exotic wares, {NAME}.
72681.objectives: Return to the Trading Post to collect your Trader's Tender from the Collector's Cache.

72708.title: Dragon Isles Supplies
72708.description:
<That proto-dragon must've snatched this bag of supplies off of an unlucky Dragonscale Expedition member.

Cataloger Jakes in Wingrest Embassy will know what best to do with it.>
72708.completion: We're always looking for more supplies, and I know just what we can do with these.
72708.objectives: Deliver Dragon Isles Supply Bag to Cataloger Jakes in Wingrest Embassy.

72709.title: Funding a Treasure Hunt
72709.description:
<Cataloger Jakes quickly flips through her own supply bag and pulls out a freshly drawn map.>

One of our archeologists just reported some new findings in regards to a lost artifact, suspected to be in this area.

If you'll donate those supplies to fund the archeologist's next expedition, you can have this map that points to a nearby treasure.
72709.progress: Our archeologists love their work, but they still need funding to do it.
72709.completion:
Rae'ana and I will be traveling with Toddy and Naleidea to our permanent basecamp, once they figure out where that's going to be.

Find us there later to see our full catalog.
72709.objectives: Buy the Archeologist Artifact Notes from Cataloger Jakes.

72712.title: The Best We Have
72712.description:
I am glad you're here, $p. 

The storms have cleared and the creches are open. Now is the time to strike! I'm leading a team of scouts further into the Reach.

When you're ready to depart, speak with Talon Damos. He's acting as my second-in-command. The dracthyr he leads will be accompanying us on our next reconnaissance mission.

72713.title: Inheritance
72713.description:
Glad you could make it, soldier.

<Damos gives you a sardonic salute.>

This is surreal. We're back in a place we knew long ago. Now it's in ruins. And it's crawling with all kinds of new wildlife. 

I guess it's true what they say. You can never go home again.

Enough talking. Time to work. Emberthal wants this place locked down.
72713.completion:
Thanks for the assistance, {NAME}. You're a real asset in the field.

After this is over, we should meet up in Valdrakken. I think there's a couple watering holes with our names on 'em.
72713.objectives: Help the dracthyr scouts secure the Lost Atheneum.

72714.title: An Interdisciplinary Approach
72714.description:
The Dragonscale Expedition does not pose a threat to Sarkareth. The fact that Sarkareth and his followers would be so brazen as to attack them during their research...

<Ebyssian furrows his brow.>

Save as many Expedition members as you can. The knowledge in these ruins is priceless if it can unlock the secrets of our past, but it is ultimately worthless when weighed against the value of single innocent life.

I will meet you in the ruins above when I am done here.
72714.progress: We must save as many folk as we can.
72714.completion: Well done, {NAME}. It gladdens me that you were able to save so many... and we are richer in knowledge because of it.
72714.objectives: Rescue 5 Frightened Researchers at Talonlords' Perch.

72715.title: Keeping the Flame at Bay
72715.description:
It's not enough that Sarkareth kills our people, twists our heritage, and burns everything in his path. Now he seeks to pillage the creche of the Adamantine Vigil. 

<Emberthal snarls.>

Ebyssian and I will stay here while you push back the Sundered Flame. We'll meet you up top once the Expedition is secure.
72715.progress: Don't tell me you need to catch your breath.
72715.completion:
There is no victory to celebrate this day. Every dead dracthyr is a tragedy that could have been... should have been avoided.

Our hands run red with blood from our failures.
72715.objectives: Slay 4 Sundered Pillagers, 6 Sundered Ruinstalkers, and Winglord Iyazael in the High Creche.

72717.title: A Creche Divided
72717.description:
This place... I have not been here for a long time. Not since before I was a Scalecommander. 

It is a dark place, full of pain... and failure. 

This was where Neltharion tested those he considered most worthy of his attention. He poked and prodded us with powers we could not understand or control.

Many of us were found... wanting.

Perhaps Sarkareth brought me here to test me the same way our father tested us.

Will you walk with me?
72717.completion:
We have him cornered! 

They aren't attacking... why? What trick is this?
72717.objectives: Help Emberthal explore the caves beneath Dragonskull Island.

72729.title: The Great Swog
72729.description:
A peculiar coin fished up around the Dragon Isles.

You've heard rumors from fellow anglers of a creature in the Ohn'ahran Plains who collects such things.
72729.objectives: Bring the Rusted Coin of the Isles to The Great Swog in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

72773.title: Learning Ingenuity
72773.description:
There are some goblins within Valdrakken that are investigating an abandoned titan device. 

Honestly, they're causing quite a disturbance. Some are concerned their investigation could cause more harm than good.

The denizens of Valdrakken would appreciate you meeting these goblins to see if you can find a solution to their investigation.

Without destroying part of our city.
72773.completion: Nice to meetcha. We could use another pair of hands figuring out how to kickstart this thing.

72783.title: Crafting Orders
72783.description:
That's a nifty thing you got there from the titan device. Now hand it over!

Just kiddin'! I wouldn't know the first thing about how to use that. Do you?

Go talk to Mimzy Sprazzlerock. She's got a whole gig setup findin' folks to do something called "crafting orders".

You put up the goods, someone takes 'em and crafts something for you. 

Simple, right? Go talk to Mimzy to check it out! And don't tell her I sent you.
72783.completion: <You can return to any Crafting Order representative to put in more orders for new equipment as long as you have the components!>
72783.objectives: Speak with Head Clerk Mimzy Sprazzlerock to learn about Crafting Orders.

72784.title: Supporting the Cobalt Assembly
72784.description:
{NAME}, excellent timing.

Have you heard of the Cobalt Assembly? It was once a wondrous place where most of my kin lived.

The Sundered Flame forced us out and have taken it over. 

There was a hope that we could take it from them, but the latest information from there shows we are fighting a losing battle.

Can you lend us your support? Meet Venthi within the Cobalt Assembly if you can.
72784.completion: We could always use more aid. Allow me to tell you of our current situation.
72784.objectives: Speak with Venthi within the Cobalt Assembly.

72785.title: Contribute Supplies: Draconium Nugget
72785.progress:
I'm always glad to collect rare materials for better fishing gear.

If your nets are good enough already, bring me any spare draconium nuggets you find.
Draconium Nugget (1)
72785.completion: That is a heavy one! Thank you, my friend.

72786.title: Contribute Supplies: Strong Seavine
72786.progress:
I'm always glad to collect rare materials for better fishing gear.

If your harpoon rope is good enough already, bring me any spare strong seavine you find.
Strong Seavine (1)
72786.completion: Strong enough, is it? Thank you, my friend.

72788.title: Contribute Supplies: Irontree Branch
72788.progress:
I'm always glad to collect rare materials for better fishing gear.

If your harpoon is good enough already, bring me any spare irontree branches you find.
Irontree Branch (1)
72788.completion: A good, solid branch. Thank you, my friend.

72789.title: Contribute Supplies: Salinated Serevite
72789.progress:
I'm always glad to collect rare materials for better fishing gear.

If your harpoon head is good enough already, bring me any spare salinated serevite pieces you find.
Salinated Serevite (1)
72789.completion: Be careful, it's razor-sharp. Thank you, my friend.

72790.title: Contribute Supplies: Khaz'gorite-infused Resin
72790.progress:
I'm always glad to collect rare materials for better fishing gear.

If your harpoon is good enough already, bring me any spare khaz'gorite-infused resin you find.
Khaz'gorite-Infused Resin (1)
72790.completion: Oh, a rare find. You have my gratitude, friend.

72791.title: Contribute Supplies: Khaz'gorite Wire
72791.progress:
I'm always glad to collect rare materials for better fishing gear.

If your nets are good enough already, bring me any spare khaz'gorite wire you find.
Khaz'gorite Wire (1)
72791.completion: Oh, a rare find. You have my gratitude, friend.

72798.title: Tale of the Phoenix
72798.progress:
The phoenix knows there is no shame in death.

Shame falls only on those who flee the challenge.
Ash Feather (20)
Smoldering Phoenix Ash (15)
Phoenix Ash Talisman (1)
72798.completion:
The defeated phoenix rises evermore to continue to fight.

Watch it. Learn from it.

Be better than it.
72798.objectives: The phoenix knows there is no shame in death.Shame falls only on those who flee the challenge.

72831.title: Creative Solutions
72831.description:
I have always hoped that mages would once again walk the streets of Theramore. This, however, is not what I had in mind.

If this Sullied Banner truly intends to reconstruct a working mana bomb, then they must be stopped--but I will not repeat the mistakes Malygos made. There must be a way to reason with them. 

I shall place an enchantment upon you that will allow you to subdue the mages without killing them. See to it that they cannot continue their ill-intended actions.
72831.progress: These mages walk a dangerous path, but I do not believe that they are beyond redemption.
72831.completion:
Arcane magic has always been well-suited to matters of stasis and security. I am pleased that we could put it to such effect here.

Still, the question remains: what drove these mages to such reckless action in the first place?
72831.objectives: Pacify the rogue mages of the Sullied Banner.

72832.title: Aftershocks
72832.description:
These precocious whelps seem to be trying to recreate the very bomb that leveled Theramore. Predictably, they have yet to succeed. Still, I would rather not give them the chance to stumble into a more effective solution.

If our dear Aspect wishes to avoid simply turning the whole lot of them into mana dust, then I suppose I can refrain from carpeting the ruin in spellfrost. Someone will need to go and repossess their banal attempts at ordinance, though.

Do take care not to set them off, hmm?
72832.progress: Do not dally, mortal. Those bombs may be prototypes, but even an accidental detonation could present issues.
72832.completion:
Well, {class}, I suppose you are not as hapless as most mortals who cross my path. You may deserve some modicum of recognition for your deft work.

...not from me, mind you. If you want a pat on the head, go ask Kalecgos.

72833.title: Breaking the Cycle
72833.description:
With many of their rank-and-file captured, it is time to deal with the leader of this so-called Sullied Banner.

I imagine Kalecgos wishes to take her alive. I have no such compunctions, but I am not a picky dragon. So long as we put a stop to her schemes, I care little what happens to her.

His plan, though troublesome, seems to have worked thus far. I am willing to give him the benefit of the doubt, at least for a short while longer.
72833.progress: Act quickly, {class}. I do not want this gnome to slip away from us now.
72833.completion:
I admit, I did not expect things to go this way. That gnome... no. Magus Flickerflame. She has suffered much. It makes sense that she would wish to cultivate her power, in order to subvert further tragedies from coming to pass.

Kalecgos says that we must be mediators and protectors, not hoarders of secrets. I think I am beginning to understand what he means.

72854.title: Our Enemies Abound
72854.description:
Just when we get our feet back under ourselves, someone wants to knock us down again.

There are people who still think that we don't deserve this home, and they're willing to kill us to get what they want.

And some old grudges never go away. Somehow, the Scarlet Crusade, or what remains of it, has gotten a toehold on Fenris Isle.

Go to the southern wall of the Ruins of Lordaeron. Deathstalker Commander Belmont has got eyes on them.
72854.progress: This is why we can never let down our guard.
72854.completion:
I didn't expect the Scarlets to have so many soldiers they could muster for an attack like this.

If I wasn't so mad I'd be impressed. Fortunately when I get mad, I get stabby.

Still, this is bad, {NAME}. This isn't just some random rabble of farmers. Someone must be calling the shots and they know what they're doing.
72854.objectives: Speak to Deathstalker Commander Belmont at the southern wall.

72855.title: To the Sepulcher
72855.description:
Faranell and Velonara already went to the Sepulcher to work on a piece of our plan.

We can hold the wall for now with just a few deathguards and dark rangers, but we need someone who can hit the Scarlets where they are. Preferably without losing more of our own.

Go to the Sepulcher and meet with Velonara. You are the sharpened tip of our poisoned blade.
72855.completion:
Good, you've arrived in one piece. Master Apothecary Faranell and I have pondered on a few ideas for how we can take out those Scarlets. 

But first, we need to watch our backs out here. And I think Faranell is cooking up something rather explosive.
72855.objectives: Meet Dark Ranger Velonara in the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

72856.title: Nothing Like the Classic
72856.description:
We of the Royal Apothecaries have synthesized many nuanced plagues in recent years, in keeping with our agreement with the Desolate Council not to... overdo it.

But when it comes to rooting out Scarlet assailants, there really is nothing like the classic. The original plague that exists -- mostly -- only in the diseased tissue of surviving descendants.

Go, gather up samples from this marvelous wildlife and bring them to me. I can put them to greater use.
72856.progress: I remember the days when we had unfettered license to experiment and brew as we wished... ah, perhaps one day again. Have you found those plague samples?
72856.completion:
Excellent! Ah, I can still smell that original plague formula. It brings back such pleasant memories. 

Toxifying the ambient air, melting the living down to their bones, how I miss those days - err - did I say that out loud?
72856.objectives: Collect 12 Plagued Flesh from nearby wildlife.

72857.title: Boom Weed
72857.description:
You've heard of Gloom Weed, you've heard of Doom Weed, now it's time for... Boom Weed!

That's right, another variety grows right here in Silverpine! And it can be used in combination with our alchemical formulas for a very incendiary outcome.

Go and collect some for me. Just mind your eyebrows. You don't really need any eyebrows, do you?
72857.progress: Have you found all the Boom Weed I need? I cannot wait to mix this up.
72857.completion:
Wonderful! And I see you still have your eyebrows. I think. I'm sure you can get some new ones stitched on if you really want to.

Now, let us commence with the alchemy!
72857.objectives: Collect 6 Boom Weed in Silverpine Forest.

72858.title: Acid Beats Paper
72858.description:
While the Scarlet Crusade have taken Fenris Isle, they try to intimidate and cow our people in Silverpine Forest. 

We cannot let them win either by strength or by terror. 

When you collect materials for Faranell's concoction, destroy any slanderous propaganda you find.
72858.completion:
Words have power. Power that can be taken away, when the words are also taken away.

Our people have suffered enough by ink and blade.
72858.objectives: Use the Acid Rifle to destroy Notices to All Undead.

72859.title: A Proper Disguise
72859.description:
Our plan is to send you to Fenris Isle, but first, you must look the part.

We've scouted out a group of Scarlet solders training in Valgan's Field, supervised by a lieutenant. That lieutenant's armor should let you walk deep behind enemy lines, unnoticed.

Take it from them, however you see fit. I don't need to know how.
72859.progress: Have you acquired your Scarlet disguise?
72859.completion:
That's one Scarlet officer that can't cause more trouble for the Forsaken, and now you can look the part.

Next, let's hope that we can get you on that island without any fuss.
72859.objectives: Slay Lieutenant Hawlsey at Valgan's Field and take their armor.

72860.title: Fear is Our Weapon
72860.description:
The Scarlet Crusade is recruiting. Apparently, when you want to blame all your problems on someone else, people flock to the lies.

But that's a choice that they're going to live to regret. We're not the problem here. THEY attacked OUR home.

Take one of the banshees with you. Between the two of you, those recruits will be scared to death.
72860.progress: Have you thinned out those Scarlet recruits?
72860.completion:
It's better to kill something dangerous before it spreads. Now Fenris Isle is on its own, and not getting fresh blood.

It's time for the next phase of our plan.
72860.objectives: Frighten Scarlet Recruits and slay them.

72861.title: The Scarlet Spy
72861.description:
Now it's time to sneak you onto Fenris Isle. I know this armor isn't exactly what you want to wear, but it will help you move around without being noticed.

Approach the isle on their level. No fancy sky maneuvers.

Once you've put on the armor, find a way to get across the water. There's a quartermaster who can tell you where to go from there.

From there, you know how to raise bedlam.
72861.completion:
Hawlsey! You're looking a bit grey around the gills.

Are those new recruits working you to the bone already?
72861.objectives: Don your disguise and report to the Quartermaster Newlem on Fenris Isle.

72862.title: Among Us
72862.description:
We could use those recruits to bolster us, but those dreadful undead are harrying our supply lines! They will all be put in the ground permanently, soon enough.

Could you check on our stockpiles to make sure we've got enough for your recruits? Of course the good stuff has already gone up to Fenris Keep for the Commander, but everyone has to eat.

Well, almost everyone.

Get a move on, lieutenant.
72862.completion:
I can smell the plague... and the smoke. 

Well done, cutting through their defenses.
72862.objectives: Plant Explosive Plague and eliminate Scarlet Archmages without being discovered.

72863.title: The Flight of the Banshee
72863.description:
With the island's defenses weakened and the cannons and mages silenced, we're ready to safely bring in our troops once more.

You didn't think you would have to fight all of them by yourself, did you? 

I know you could, but leave some for the rest of us, too.

When you're ready to call the others in, let me know.
72863.completion:
They thought we would stay in our walls and hide? 

Childish pretenders. Now we'll show them the might of the Forsaken.
72863.objectives: Speak to Velonara to call in the full force of the Forsaken.

72864.title: Death to the Living
72864.description:
Now it's time for them to pay. They'll wish they never set foot in our lands and threatened our home.

We will drive them out, we will drive them into the ground, and we will leave them to rot.
72864.completion:
Sometimes, the only way to get through to people is in the language they understand.

And the Scarlet Crusade hears strength.

But those are just the followers. We need to reach the leaders of this brazen invasion and deliver the message, too.
72864.objectives: Kill every Scarlet that has a beating heart.

72865.title: This is the Hour of the Forsaken
72865.description:
We haven't seen the Scarlet Crusade put this many fresh soldiers on the field in a long time.

And we know that they didn't get here on their own. Someone's guiding them. Someone who's fought Forsaken before.

Someone I remember well.

Come with me, and let's put an end to Commander Forsythe.
72865.completion:
There, it's done. A few Scarlets may have escaped from us, but we've wiped them off of Fenris Isle. 

Without their commander, hopefully they can't regroup anytime soon. And they'll think twice about coming after the Forsaken again.

We have our strength, our common purpose. And we have you.
72865.objectives: Slay Scarlet Commander Forsythe in Fenris Keep.

72866.title: Return to Lordaeron
72866.description:
Let's get back behind the walls and meet the others. I think Belmont had the time of his unlife with you, getting to cut down Scarlets again.

But this isn't the end of the Crusade. Even though they lost, they might still turn this into yet another way to recruit.

We'll be ready if they ever come for us again. Or our neighbors.

Come on, let's get back to the Ruins of Lordaeron.
72866.completion:
Welcome home.

We couldn't have won this without you, I hope you know.
72866.objectives: Take the portal to return to the Ruins of Lordaeron.

72867.title: I Am Forsaken
72867.description:
We have fought to win back our home. We have fought to keep it safe. 

Your courage and strength are inspirational to the Forsaken. And with you, we know we have our champion. 

Go, they want to see you.
72867.progress: Go on, everyone's waiting to honor you.
72867.completion:
See?

And we will continue to fight, for as long as our bones let us, for our right and space to exist on Azeroth.

We are the Forsaken.
72867.objectives: Receive the honor and accolades of the Forsaken.

72868.title: More Hunting Trophies
72868.progress:
What have you brought me, outsider?
Centaur Hunting Trophy (20)
72868.completion: Only the greatest of hunters can boast of this many great hunting trophies. You honor our hunt.

72872.title: Culling the Deep
72872.description:
Have you seen these deepflayers before? Well, of course you have! You were almost eaten by one!

They're getting a little too cozy to me and my people's settlement nearby, and need to be dealt with. Inside the cave, outside the cave, they're all over the place!  That's why I came here in the first place.

Since I can tell we'll be ramblin' round with each other for a bit, why not give me a hand?
72872.progress: Not bad, uplander! Have you dabbled in monster hunting before this?
72872.completion:
Did you made friends with any of the flayers?

Hah! Just kidding! That was a joke! Please don't try to do that unless you want become some swooper's tasty snack!

72873.title: It Was Not Enough
72873.description:
You're smellin' real down and out there, kid. Can't imagine what you been through to end up here.

Well, it don't matter! We niffen ain't the sort to leave anyone behind. Especially not people who're about to be served up as a deepflayer's snack!

This master sniffin' snout of mine can smell you didn't come down here to our Zaralek Cavern alone. What say we get you out of those crystals and find your friends!
72873.completion:
Told you we'd sniff out your companions! 

Though it seems like they're carrying a lot of dirt on their backs. The figurative kind, I mean.  

Anyway! If you're willing to pay back the favor of me rescuing you, I've still got some business here.
72873.objectives: Follow Elder Honeypelt to find Wrathion and Sabellian.

72874.title: Secrets From Our Father
72874.description:
Look closely, {NAME}. You see this odd chunk of metal in the deepflayer muck?

I have felt my head swimming since we arrived in these caverns. I thought it was just the ceaseless prattling of our whelp, Wrathion, but this object here may prove otherwise.

I will continue my efforts to unlock this relic's secrets. Seek out similar pieces in the nearby caves. A dark theory is emerging, though we will need more information before I am willing to confirm it.
72874.progress: I know this device still has power...
72874.completion:
A dead scout for the Sundered Flame near one of the relics? 

That is no coincidence. Ebyssian told us they were pursuing clues left by father. I must admit that this relic, and the ones you describe finding, look quite familiar to me.

Familiar... And familial. It stirs my insides.

72876.title: Multiple Dragon Isles Artifacts
72876.progress:
Do you have something for the archives?
Dragon Isles Artifact (20)
72876.completion:
Look at all these artifacts! This might take a minute. 

<Cataloger Jakes hastily makes several notes in her ledger.> 

Got it! Off with you, now! Come back if you have more!

72878.title: Slime Time Live
72878.description:
$p, if I could grab your ear again, my dear?

Since making it back to Loamm, I've noticed that some of our incense pots have gone missing.

Incense is what we use to mark our trade routes, and find our way back to Loamm. It's very important that we replace the missing incense as soon as possible.

By the way, we make our incense from snail slime, so you're going to have to wrangle some snails first!

Once you're done, Citros can help you out with the rest.

Say hello to Marie Shellie for me!
72878.progress: Snail slime is the base that most of our incense is built upon.
72878.completion: Did Aurantia send you? This snail slime is mighty fine--it'll make some great incense!
72878.objectives: Lasso 8 Dripping Redolent Whelks to collect Snail Slime in Zaralek Cavern.

72879.title: Smells like Kith Spirit
72879.description:
Well, it's not too often we see uplanders around here!

Honeypelt must have a good reason for sending you my way, she doesn't trust just anyone with her incense.

A kith's incense is their pride and joy. Each one smells unique, and we use them to identify each other. 

Making incense is a delicate business. Just head over to that cauldron and Marie Shellie and I will help ya out with whipping up some replacements.
72879.progress: It's starting to smell really good!
72879.completion: Not bad for your first go at it! You should go put these down where they belong.

72880.title: Incense Gratification
72880.description:
That's some real potent incense you made! Usually it takes time to get this good!

Now, I've got some of my own brewing to do, so you're gonna have to go out and set those up by yourself.

Once you're finished I'm sure Honeypelt will be mighty keen on hearing about it! Best follow up with her when you're done.
72880.completion: Thank you, {NAME}! I take it Citros was helpful?
72880.objectives: Place 9 Missing Incense in Zaralek Cavern.

72881.title: A Swallow's Tale
72881.description:
Uplander!

I'm Effervesta, Lady Redolence to the niffen of Loamm--the daughter of their leader. No need for formalities though, you can just call me Effie!

Keep this between you and me, but we're a bit behind on some shipments to Glimmerogg, and the Drogbar are definitely not happy one bit! You've already been so helpful to Elder Honeypelt... maybe you can give me a hand too?

Our swallows keeper, Nevroll, might be able to dig up some dirt on the issue. 

Will you go talk to him, please?
72881.objectives: Speak with Swallows Keeper Nevroll in Zaralek Cavern.

72882.title: Flown the Coop
72882.description:
They're gone! Just... gone!

The swallows, Nevroll, all of it!

And now you say that Effervesta told you that we're behind on our shipment of swallow nests to the Drogbar?

This is really bad, Uplander. 

If you want to help, you can start by bringing back as many birds as you can find.

I'll see if I can scrape together any useable nests for the Drogbar in the meantime.
72882.progress: If Nevroll or the Drogbar show up before we find those birds, we're toast!
72882.completion: Oh, I'm so glad you were able to find some of them!
72882.objectives: Find 6 Lost Swallows in Zaralek Cavern.

72883.title: A Bitter Pill to Swallow
72883.description: <The corpse of a single cave swallow rests on the cavern floor. You should tell Cinnam.>
72883.completion: Who cares about dead swallows now? Effie is missing!
72883.objectives: Take the dead swallow to Cinnam.

72884.title: Expedition Effervesta
72884.description:
My daughter's gone missing--we have to find her!

As High Redolence, I may be the next target. $p, will you come with me?

I can still smell her, faintly. She has to still be in Loamm somewhere.

We have to hurry!
72884.completion: Look, there's a cave up ahead! That must be where she is.
72884.objectives: Search for clues about Effervesta's whereabouts in Zaralek Cavern.

72886.title: Suss Out the Imposter
72886.description:
Do I smell... Nevroll?

If he's the kidnapper, that must mean he's also behind the missing shipment!

I don't think it's safe for me to go in there, $p. 

Please, rescue Effie!
72886.completion: Effie! I'm so glad she's okay!
72886.objectives: Defeat Nevroll and rescue Effervesta in Zaralek Cavern.

72900.title: Keeper of the Ossuary
72900.description:
Greetings, {NAME}. While I continue to search for the remaining blue dragons, I could use your aid in another matter.

Alexstrasza and I plan on laying to rest the remaining essences of Malygos and Sindragosa. She has held on to their lingering essences after both were slain years ago.

Senegos said there was a time where dragons would be laid to rest in the Veiled Ossuary. Unfortunately, the place is a mess.

He's gone ahead to clean the area up with Stellagosa. Could you aid them?
72900.progress: Ah, here to help are we?
72900.objectives: Meet Senegos in the Veiled Ossuary.

72908.title: Sight Beyond Sight
72908.description:
I had not expected to find djaradin here, though it does not surprise me. Legends tell of their elders slumbering beneath the earth. It makes sense that some would delve underground in search of them.

Their forces are heavily guarding this outer area. I recognize the magic their scouts are using--it is farsight, powered by those totems near them.

I spotted a larger totem at the top of the nearby tower. If you can figure out how to power it, we can use it to search the caldera from afar.
72908.progress:
This tower provides the best vantage point in the caldera.

If there is any evidence that Fyrakk came through here--or worse--we will see it.
72908.completion:
<Ebyssian narrows his eyes in contemplation. At last, he sighs a deep breath and sets his jaw.>

We cannot act yet. We need more information, and a better opening.
72908.objectives: Inspect nearby Flamesight Totems to find a way to activate the Greater Flamesight Totem atop the guard tower.

72909.title: Legends of the Zaqali
72909.description:
Because of our recent conflicts, I have been researching the djaradin. Our archives had little information on their elders.

Legends say that they were once great warlords who now slumber beneath the earth. The djaradin believe they will awaken and lead them to a brutal victory against the dragonflights.

We need to know what we are up against. There is an empty shrine just below us that resembles the ones housing the elders. 

We may find some answers there.
72909.completion:
From what we have gathered so far, it seems that Iridikron has made a deal with the Zaqali and sent the Primalists to awaken their elders.

Do they merely share a common enemy, or is Iridikron receiving something else in return?
72909.objectives: Inspect the Zaqali belongings left near the Elder's shrine.

72910.title: Know Thy Enemy
72910.description:
That djaradin called her people the "Zaqali"--but my troops did not report any information regarding a second active djaradin tribe in the Dragon Isles. I detest an unknown in war.

We will need to learn what we can about them--and quickly--in order to assess their strengths and weaknesses. I have found the best way to know a culture is to examine how they make war.

Slay any you find in the nearby area and take their armaments. I will expect your report.
72910.progress: No detail about an enemy is insignificant. Everything can be used against them.
72910.completion:
These Zaqali are far more magically talented than the Qalashi, it seems.

Bothersome.

The beast we knew would have been preferable to the beast we do not, but I will adapt our strategies accordingly.
72910.objectives: Gather 8 pieces of Zaqali equipment from Zaqali djaradin near the empty shrine.

72912.title: Consequences
72912.description:
Shadowflame...

Did Iridikron know this was here? Did he corrupt his brother? Or has Fyrakk fallen to the temptation?

Only ignorance or arrogance tempts fools to seek it out, believing they can master dark forces that not even Neltharion could. It infected him, slowly, like a gangrenous lesion until finally he succumbed to madness.

So too will Fyrakk.

I will not take that risk with Sabellian. 

He was burned badly before I was able to fly you to safety. Let us assess the extent of the damage.
72912.progress:
I will not lose a single person to shadowflame.

Not Sabellian. Not anyone.
72912.completion:
If Fyrakk is absorbing the shadowflame infused in the caldera itself, we will need more strength than just our own to stop him.

But we cannot worry about any of that until Sabellian's wound is cleansed of corruption.

72913.title: Battlefield Triage
72913.description:
Our situation is less than ideal, we will have to improvise. I can conduct flame to earth to create magma. Shadowflame could behave similarly.

The Primalists are summoning earth elementals nearby. If we extract their cores, I can use them to contain the shadowflame infecting Sabellian's burn.

The Zaqali's totems should already be attuned to the elements here. It will make the siphoning process much more efficient.

Sabellian will need to come with us. I must keep an eye on him--for his sake.
72913.progress:
We cannot delay. Shadowflame deteriorates both mind and body with insidious haste.

I will do everything I can to halt it.
72913.completion: I can only hope these components will be sufficient for the cleansing ritual.
72913.objectives: Collect 5 Vacant Elemental Cores and 1 Zaqali Flame Totem.

72914.title: Rushing Quality
72914.description:
Look ahead! The djaradin have cleared away from the northeastern side of the caldera to augment their forces near the elders.

There is an altar bordering the lava pool that appears safe for now. We can set up our spell components there.

Let us hurry before the djaradin return.
72914.progress:
Fyrakk and the elders can wait.

If Sabellian is lost, we will fail regardless.
72914.completion:
Sabellian is still injured from the burn, but the shadowflame has been purged from him.

It is the best I can do for now. I will ensure that he has time to rest later.
72914.objectives: Cleanse the shadowflame from Sabellian's injury.

72915.title: Alliance of Convenience
72915.description:
The Primalists have a sizeable force of djaradin guarding them while they complete their work.

Even in small numbers, djaradin prove to be formidable opponents when allowed to engage in battle on their own terms. It is far better to bring the fight to them, leaving as little time to react as possible.

Take them out. We cannot have them encroaching on the space we have managed to carve out thus far.
72915.progress: I am certain there will be no lack of djaradin this close to the elders' shrines.
72915.completion: Good. We will need to keep this area clear for now.
72915.objectives: Kill 4 Zaqali djaradin guarding Igira's shrine.

72916.title: Shut Them Down
72916.description:
Up ahead, the Primalists are working to awaken the Zaqali's final elder.

When we used the farsight totem earlier, I observed that they were draining something from the elder. Now I realize it is likely an attempt to dispel the magic keeping the elder in stasis. They are using elemental cores to contain the magic in the same way we did to cleanse Sabellian.

Fyrakk absorbing shadowflame is disastrous. We cannot add an elder awakening to that threat. We must halt their efforts.
72916.progress: I cannot be certain if this will stop them entirely, but it will at least slow their progress.
72916.completion: I hope we have bought ourselves enough time to gather reinforcements.
72916.objectives: Destroy 3 Earthdrainer Conduits and 4 Extracted Elemental Cores.

72917.title: From Hell's Heart
72917.description:
No longer can we allow Fyrakk to lie here peacefully, twisting himself with shadowflame and becoming a threat on par with Deathwing. We must act! Is it dangerous? Yes. But not to do anything would be catastrophic.

I have ripped gronn apart with my bare claws before. Those battles were gambles, this one is not. Slaying a proto-dragon with a weapon meant for dragonslaying is obvious. It is logical. It is guaranteed.

I will not tremble before an opportunity to end this now.

72918.title: No Dragon Left Behind
72918.description:
I... cannot move so long as this spear remains in my side. But we need to follow Fyrakk's trail.

<Ebyssian grunts sharply, his breathing labored, claws digging into the dirt.>

Remove it. I can... bear the pain it will cause.
72918.progress:
He did not leave me.

I cannot leave him.
72918.completion:
We should both be able to walk.

Fyrakk has left a trail of destruction across the cavern. We must help any harmed by him, even if we can do nothing to stop him.
72918.objectives: Find a way to remove the spear from Ebyssian's side.

72919.title: Raked Over the Coals
72919.description:
The shadowflame has already corrupted Fyrakk irreparably. Every place in Zaralek darkened by his wings has been lit ablaze with shadowflame.

We cannot leave it behind and let it fester--it will need to be extinguished while it is still kindling, lest we allow its corruption to take root.

<Ebyssian coughs, then winces.>

Sabellian and I cannot take to the air in this state. Disperse the flames with your drake. We will follow you below and meet you back at Loamm.
72919.completion:
Titans forgive us...

There will be worse than this to come.
72919.objectives: Disperse 12 patches of shadowflame by dragonriding through them.

72920.title: The Endless Burning Sky
72920.description:
Fyrakk must have breathed shadowflame upon the niffen on his way out of the cavern. There is too much fire for it to have merely sloughed off of him.

He did this on purpose.

<Ebyssian clenches his staff tightly. He looks weary for a moment. Only a moment.>

We will save Loamm. All of Loamm. No more lives will be lost.
72920.completion:
<Ebyssian struggles to catch his breath, wiping the sweat from his brow.>

Fyrakk will answer for this.

I swear.
72920.objectives: Extinguish the fires consuming Loamm and rescue 5 Loamm villagers.

72921.title: On the Trail Again
72921.description:
Ah... the Veiled Ossuary. I was given the task to be a sort of gravekeeper, which included keeping wildlife away from the area.

I had a rather fun spell split up within several tomes kept within this place to deal with such pests. 

The other blue dragons did not approve of my... reckless methods, so I had to keep the tomes hidden.

Here, allow me to cast a spell on you to grant you the sight to find these old tomes.

Once they are all gathered, we can cleanse this place of the invasive wildlife.
72921.progress: Did you find my old tomes?
72921.completion: Here they are! I am glad some things have survived all of this time.
72921.objectives: Receive Senegos's special sight, then recover the missing tomes.

72922.title: Fading Embers
72922.description:
This is a difficult situation, my friend. Wounds and insecurities cannot be easily dismissed. Only time--and cooperation--can soothe the sting born of longstanding rivalries.

But there are more urgent matters to address. If there is a large force of drakonids still loyal to the memory of Neltharion, this land is much more dangerous than any of us expected.

Emberthal still pursues Sarkareth--alone. She must be made aware of the threats that surround her. We must find her and give her aid.
72922.completion: Sarkareth may try to hide behind the might of Aberrus but to no avail.
72922.objectives: Help Emberthal stop Sarkareth at the Brimstone Garrison.

72923.title: A Whisper to Sabellian
72923.description:
Our assault on Brimstone Garrison will not work without Sabellian and his relentless and mighty dragons. We must convince him that our objectives are aligned.

If we appeal to him as a tactician and general, I'm sure he will help us... I hope.

We will find him with his troops at the Djaradin Assault.
72923.completion: Perhaps we will be able to fight as one.
72923.objectives: Speak to Sabellian at the Djaradin Assault.

72924.title: Appealing to the Black Prince
72924.description:
Our assault will not be successful without the stealth and cunning of Wrathion and his Blacktalon agents. We must convince him to help us.

Thankfully, I know in his heart he will not deny someone in need--especially if they flatter him.

Let us go to Wrathion at the Obsidian Rest and try to sway him.
72924.progress: I only hope that his temper has cooled by now.
72924.completion: I am glad to have him by our side.
72924.objectives: Speak to Wrathion at the Obsidian Rest.

72925.title: With Our Powers Combined
72925.description:
Emberthal is waiting for us in front of the Brimstone Garrison.

Come, {NAME}. She will be pleased to see we have rallied the full might of the black dragonflight to aid her cause.
72925.completion: Nothing can stop the black dragonflight when we stand together.
72925.objectives: Speak to Emberthal at the Brimstone Garrison.

72926.title: In the Right Hands
72926.description:
There are several weapons of historical value that I believed were lost to time. I would bet my talons that they are here at this garrison.

The dragonspawn and drakonid loyally cling to the memory of my long-dead father. Misguided fools. 

They have access to my father's forges and weapons, and it is likely the very weapons I thought lost are stored nearby. 

If they find out what they have, they will use the weapons against us. They cannot remain in their claws.
72926.progress: These fools must be parted with such powerful blades.
72926.completion: We make a great team, my friend!
72926.objectives: Retrieve the Ebon Eviscerator and the Resting Blade from the Brimstone Garrison.

72927.title: Finding Sarkareth
72927.description: Now that we have a foothold within the garrison, we can extend our search. We will hold off the forces of Aberrus here while you find Emberthal and aid her in reaching Sarkareth. We will join you as soon as we secure the front here.
72927.completion:
There he is.

Aberrus protects him still as he works on that device. There must be a way for us to strip his defenses!
72927.objectives: Meet Emberthal within the Aberrus Approach.

72928.title: Wipe Them Out
72928.description:
Do you know what I see when I gaze upon the Brimstone Garrison?

Traitors.

These soldiers believe themselves followers of the black dragonflight, yet they ignore us, the true heirs to Neltharion, and bend a knee to the specter of our malevolent father. 

This cannot be allowed to stand. 

Show them the error of their ways.
72928.progress: I know that I rule with an iron claw... but it is only because I see what must be done to preserve our people.
72928.completion: It is a shame that these warriors swear allegiance to the wrong cause. They could have been fine allies, but their misguided allegiance doomed them.
72928.objectives: Defeat the Brimstone forces loyal to Neltharion in the Brimstone Garrison.

72929.title: Cracking His Shell
72929.description:
We have seen shields like this before. Sarkareth is drawing on the power of Aberrus to protect himself while he finds his way in.

Cowardly, but clever.

Disrupt the conduits that are supplying his shield power, and we should be able to reach him.
72929.progress: We must bring that shield down!
72929.completion: Good. Now I have one last chance to reason with him.
72929.objectives: Destroy the conduits generating the shield at the Aberrus Approach.

72930.title: Stopping Sarkareth
72930.description: This is our last chance, {NAME}. If we allow Sarkareth to slip in to Aberrus, he may gain power that puts him beyond our reach. We must stop him now!
72930.completion:
He does not care for the dracthyr loyal to him. He only cares for himself.

<Emberthal sets her jaw.>  

He is lost to us all now.
72930.objectives: Defeat the Dreadful Defender at the Aberrus Approach.

72931.title: Forward Camp
72931.description:
Since Sarkareth now wields the power of Aberrus's defenses, he has an army that will shield him from us.

The next step for us will be to establish a stronghold inside the garrison. That way we can search it without interruption. 

Meet me there.
72931.progress: I have full faith we will carve a path through the garrison.
72931.completion: Good. Now we can safely support Emberthal in her search. I know she will succeed in stopping Sarkareth.
72931.objectives: Find Ebyssian in the Brimstone Garrison.

72933.title: Rolling Out
72933.description:
I remember having so much fun rolling these creatures up with my spells. Unfortunately, I fear these old bones will not let me move as quickly as I once did.

I would love for you to give it a shot. Let me live vicariously through you! 

The more creatures you roll up, the bigger the ball becomes. The bigger the ball, the bigger the creature you can roll out.

Speak to me and I shall give you my special arcane ball to roll up the creatures around here.
72933.completion: Fine work! Ah, to be young again.
72933.objectives: Use Senegos's Arcane Ball to roll up the creatures lurking in the Veiled Ossuary.

72934.title: Lest We Forget
72934.description:
We will be joined shortly by Kalecgos and Alexstrasza. Before then, I have a request.

There was a tradition to have gravestones set before your death. It allowed you to choose where you would rest when you passed.

It was the job of the caretakers to update the gravestones and deposit the lingering essence of arcana at the site.

Before our guests join us, would you help me in this task? 

Take this list, and these graves. Update the existing graves and place the new ones.
72934.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. I believe we are prepared for our guests to arrive.
72934.objectives: Update the gravestones of the departed blue dragons.

72935.title: Archives Return
72935.description:
It is not unusual that Malygos and Sindragosa would have such powerful memories. From what I understand, their deaths were particularly painful. Both slain by adventurers.

It breaks my heart to think of Sindragosa enduring death not once, but twice after being raised by the Lich King.

But enough of this old dragon's ramblings. Stellagosa and I will meet you back at the Azure Archives.
72935.completion:
Thank you for your help, {NAME}. As you can see, more blue dragons have arrived! 

Yet... some are still missing. We cannot forget about them.

I will also ensure we find out more information about this strange phenomenon with Malygos and Sindragosa's memories.
72935.objectives: Return to Kalecgos in the Azure Archives.

72936.title: Azuregos's Support
72936.description:
Many blue dragons have returned, and many others have informed me of their plans to make their ways to the Isles.

There are a few key members of the flight, however, that I have not heard from. One of them may be able to help: Azuregos, stationed within the Nexus in Northrend. 

You, myself, and Sindragosa will travel to meet Azuregos. He has ignored all of my attempts to contact him from afar.

Thanks to the oathstone being empowered, Sindragosa can now travel further than ever before.
72936.completion: Perhaps Kalecgos's timing is not as bad as I thought... especially if he has the simulacrum of Lady Sindragosa with him.
72936.objectives: Travel to the Nexus in Northrend to meet Azuregos.

72937.title: Unusual Disruptions
72937.description:
Of course I can help track down the missing blue dragons. However, I have a mess on my hands that must be addressed first.

Moments ago, several bursts of arcane energy swept through the Nexus, followed by attacks of strange arcane creations.

I can create a method of tracking down the blue dragons if you can put down the locations of this wild arcana.

Take this staff--do not break it--and use it on three locations within the Nexus. Oh, and prepare yourself for a fight.
72937.progress: Do you need even more help? Just place the the staff at the disruption.
72937.completion:
Well... things appear much calmer now. 

I suppose I better investigate how "wide spread" these wild memories will become.
72937.objectives: Put down strange arcane attackers in the Nexus.

72938.title: Archival Arrival
72938.description:
I have crafted a magical globe to help you find the remaining blue dragons. It should give you their rough locations.

Now go. On top of everything else I was working on, I must now investigate these "memories" that attacked the Nexus.

I shall get to the bottom of it.
72938.completion:
Hopefully Azuregos will join us later. 

In the meantime, we have the whole of Azeroth to search.

72939.title: Theramore
72939.description:
According to Azuregos's notes, the blue dragon Surigosa was last seen investigating a sect of rogue mages known as the Sullied Banner. 

Surigosa's last missive stated that she intended to travel to the ruins of Theramore. Perhaps she uncovered traces of the Sullied Banner there. Either way, if Surigosa is to be found, Theramore seems the best place to search for her.
72939.completion: Theramore? I would rather not return to that place... but if Surigosa is there, then perhaps there is work to be done.
72939.objectives: Speak to Kalecgos about Surigosa's last known location.

72940.title: Where in the World is a Lost Blue Dragon?
72940.description:
Azuregos has narrowed down the locations of the missing blue dragons.

Each of us will handle finding several of them. I would entrust you to aid us in finding a few others.

Choose where you'd like to go first.
72940.objectives: Choose an area to investigate the missing blue dragons.

72941.title: Ancestral Advice
72941.description:
I have a message for my descendent. It is very important.

I understand you are new to our language. I will try to speak in small, (100)-easy words. When you are ready to give your full attention, I will (90)-share my message.
72941.progress: Did the ancestor give you a message?
72941.objectives: Listen to the ancestor's message and convey it accurately.

72942.title: Veiled Trouble
72942.description:
I was hoping that we would find a way to dispel these strange arcane memories from what remains of Malygos and Sindragosa.

It appears they've grown more out of control than I expected. 

Please, accompany some of the gathered blue dragons to the Veiled Ossuary and help Azuregos.

Sindragosa and I will remain here, and investigate what to do about this situation.
72942.completion:
I suppose this is that "teamwork" Kalecgos has been talking about. 

Perhaps this is useful after all.
72942.objectives: Investigate the arcane disturbances within the Veiled Ossuary.

72944.title: Sending Stone: Protest
72944.completion:
Well... this stone was unexpected.

It would seem this Adamanthia was not beyond reason.

72945.title: Our Path Ahead
72945.description:
I have a message for Chief Kranac Sagesnow. I believe that it is not too late to lead our people down a (80)-better path.

However, if he chooses the wrong direction, I see only (90)-darkness ahead for our people. 

When you are ready, I will (80)-impart this message.
72945.progress: It would be best to not leave the chief waiting!
72945.completion:
That the Winterpelt ancestors trusted you to give this message to their chief is an excellent sign.

How did he react?
72945.objectives: Listen to the ancestor's message and convey it accurately.

72946.title: Veiled Ossuary Chaos
72946.description:
Malygos and Sindragosa's essences have created this massive arcane disruption. Their memories are running around the Veiled Ossuary trying to drain the arcana out of the graves!

Our combined efforts are merely keeping the energies at bay. We need the memories in the nearby area disrupted.

Once they are dispelled, we should be able to remove this barrier to reach the essences inside.
72946.progress: Hurry! We need to deplete the arcana in this area.
72946.completion: The barrier is getting weaker! Fine work.
72946.objectives: Weaken the arcane invader's control over the Veiled Ossuary.

72947.title: Memories of Old
72947.description:
Three incredibly powerful memories have formed throughout the Veiled Ossuary.

Soon their energy will be so vast that they will be able to create their own arcane constructs... thus overwhelming this place.

Take them down, so we can weaken this barrier and reach Malygos and Sindragosa's essences!
72947.progress: Have you handled those memories yet?
72947.completion: The chaos in the area is weakening. Tell me, what memories did you see?
72947.objectives: Slay three powerful memories within the Veiled Ossuary.

72948.title: What Still Remains
72948.description:
The barrier is weakening, thanks to your aid. In a moment it will be broken down.

Our main priority is recovering Malygos and Sindragosa's essences. Something has gone very wrong with laying them to rest. There are a few theories I have regarding their current state. We can speak about it as we enter.

Let me know when you are ready.
72948.progress: It seems the blue dragons still cannot leave behind our legacy.
72948.completion:
To think a merciful gesture could turn like this...

I suppose we all underestimated the rage still within Sindragosa and Malygos.
72948.objectives: Go beyond the arcane barrier to recover Malygos and Sindragosa's essences.

72949.title: Swiftly to the Archives
72949.description:
I can hear the pained cries of rage and agony from these essences. I suspect this was triggered after attempting to put them to rest. 

They were dormant for a time, but the combined rage of both Malygos and Sindragosa merged together to create this phenomenon. 

Quickly, we must make for the Azure Archives and inform Kalecgos and Sindragosa of this!

Together, we may be able to finally give them the peace that they deserve.
72949.completion:
I am glad you recovered the essences of Sindragosa and Malygos. 

I never imagined trying to place their spirits to rest would lead to this.
72949.objectives: Meet Kalecgos back within the Azure Archives.

72950.title: The Last Conflict
72950.description:
Malygos and myself both suffered horribly violent ends. The remains of our essences have been trapped in an endless loop.

They must be reformed, and broken out of that loop. To do so will require a tremendous amount of concentrated power.

We will have to utilize every amount of arcane energy within the Azure Archives... along with all of the assembled blue dragons.

It is the only chance we have to reform these spirits... and to put an end to their suffering.
72950.completion:
Malygos and Sindragosa's spirits can finally rest. Thank you once more for all of your aid, {NAME}.

There is one last thing that must be done.
72950.objectives: Subdue the restless spirits of Malygos and Sindragosa within the Azure Vault.

72951.title: A Peaceful Farewell
72951.description:
It brightens my heart to see everyone reunited, and Malygos and Sindragosa at peace at long last. 

It is time that I give you all one last gift, something the blue dragons have not seen in quite some time.

The peaceful passing of one of their own.

It is my time, {NAME}. I should have flown beyond some time ago, but I could not leave with my kin still in disarray. 

Would you do an old dragon the honor of seeing me off on one last adventure?
72951.completion:
Senegos... what a tremendous gift he's given to us all. 

Thank you, {NAME}. I don't know if I could have united the blue dragons without you--and for that I will be forever grateful.

It's time for me to lead everyone forward.
72951.objectives: Speak with Senegos one last time.

72952.title: The Scary Vault of Ur
72952.description:
Tacha's big ears heard some noise in one of the tunnels. We took a peek inside. I'm not going to lie: it's grim in there. Pretty terrifying. All sorts of horrible creatures. Not the sort of thing Tacha and I usually deal with up close.

You have experience dealing with monsters, right? Excellent. You go first. Don't worry. Once it's safe, we'll come in and join you. Really, it's the least we can do.
72952.completion:
Good work in there. Very brave. As long as we have more keys, we'll have more to explore. 

Not all of the vaults are terrifying, of course. Deadly? Sure. Treacherous? You bet. But maybe not as terrifying. Maybe.

Keep in touch. In a few more days, we'll be ready to explore another vault.
72952.objectives: Enter and explore Zskera Vault: Ur.

72953.title: Zskera Vault: Az
72953.description:
We have discovered a series of vaults below the island. Neltharion hoarded treasures, accumulated knickknacks, and stashed away the results of his failed experiments.

When I say he's a hoarder, I'm not kidding! He filled chamber after chamber, and in time, they were all forgotten... until now. Treasure awaits us behind these locked doors! Also, the occasional deathtrap. Also, treasure! Now we have the keys to unlock those doors.
72953.completion:
Well done. As long as we keep finding keys, we can keep exploring. In a few days, I'm sure we'll explore another vault.

I think the names of these vaults are numbered. Az, Ur, Ix, Kx... those words must mean something. Don't get me wrong, I'm focused on the treasure, but I wouldn't mind learning a thing or two along the way... or is it "a thing or Ix"? Maybe it is.
72953.objectives: Enter and explore Zskera Vault: Az.

72954.title: Zskera Vault: Ix
72954.description:
Wulferd spotted some pirates making their way into the vaults this morning. If we don't act fast, they'll strip the vault clean!

We're going into the vault immediately. There's no time to lose. Will you be joining us?
72954.progress:
Have you explored the vault? I'm worried about those pirates.
