You're probably expecting me to make some pirate joke about "arrrr-tifacts," but I have too much self-control for that. i do, however, think the treasure we find will be... "booty-full." Okay, back to work.
72954.completion:
Good work in there. We can continue this exploration as long as we have keys. In a few days, we'll explore another vault.

Ever since the storms died and Raszageth left, it's been a rush to grab as much as we can. Sadly, we're not the only folks rushing to grab it all. It's a good thing you're here to help us deal with that.
72954.objectives: Enter and explore Zskera Vault: Ix.

72955.title: Zskera Vault: Kx
72955.description:
I was afraid this might happen. The Sundered Flame is here. And they've discovered the Vaults.

Of course, we have to stop them. Anything useful or dangerous, they're going to take straight to Sarkareth.

I've had enough of his nonsense. Time for you to do what you do best.
72955.completion:
Good work in there. As long as we find more keys, we can continue exploring. And then it's only a matter of time until we find another vault to explore... a few days, I'll bet.

Oh, and good luck with the Sundered Flame. I hate to see dracthyr fighting dracthyr... especially when we can be uncovering the secrets of the past instead. Stay safe out there.
72955.objectives: Enter and explore Zskera Vault: Kx.

72956.title: More Doors To Open
72956.description:
There are still more vaults, but there aren't enough of us to explore them all.

That's where you come in. Could you look for more keys? Then we can continue exploring the vaults.

Tacha and I will stay here and work on documenting our earlier discoveries. That's tough work, but one of us has to do it. Okay, two of us. But it is a lot of work, I assure you.
72956.completion:
Look at you! Opening doors! Having adventures! That's... a-door-able.

Sorry. Long day. Good work in there. As long we have keys, we'll find more adventure. And I'm fairly sure we'll find another vault in a few days. 

You and me! And Tacha! Exploring the unknown. Well, mostly you, but we're helping.
72956.objectives: Enter and explore additional Zskera Vaults.

72958.title: Save-A-Mole
72958.description:
Perisimona told me about her life-mate, Tuberros, and what she knows about his disappearance.

Tuberros was guiding a client from the Dragonscale Expedition around some ruins here. It sounds as though they may have run into the Sundered Flame.

I would rather not go after the Sundered Flame myself. Doing so would announce my presence to Sarkareth. 

Will you aid us by finding and rescuing Tuberros and his client? Maybe then he can help guide us to Neltharion's vault.
72958.completion:
It is time to get back to why we are here, and that is finding Sarkareth.

I will send the niffen and Rannan back to Loamm, where it is safe.
72958.objectives: Find and save Tuberros and his uplander client.

72959.title: Whose Vault Is It Anyway?
72959.description:
I do not know what we will find in the vault or why Sarkareth wants access to it, but I hope we are not too late.

Before we continue any further, Tuberros should lead Rannan and Perisimona back to Loamm.

Come and talk to me once you are ready to move forward.
72959.completion: I still think we should have sent them back to Loamm, but I trust Ebyssian's judgement.
72959.objectives: Talk to Emberthal once you are ready to go.

72961.title: Charging Up
72961.description:
Emberthal wanted this guy Sarkareth dealt with yesterday. I understand! I hate waiting too!

This door is frustratingly hard to crack... But! I have a plan because I always have a plan! My recipe for success is being one step ahead of everyone else. It's worked for me so far! Sorta.

So, about this plan... I might need your help!
72961.progress: Were you able to get me some of those orbs?
72961.completion: Tuberros is a life saver! These should do just fine! Now give me a moment to calculate the energy flux and... hmm... Yes... no, nope, ok, maybe...
72961.objectives: Gather 6 buzzing orb core for Rannan Korren.

72962.title: Open That Door!
72962.description:
I am glad we are making progress but... I cannot shake a sense of foreboding of what awaits us inside. As Sarkareth learns about Neltharion, his intentions seem to get ever darker...

I can only imagine what he is telling his people now--about me and about the other dracthyr. He will fracture our people forever.

Talk to Rannan and see how much longer we have to wait. We can't waste more time.
72962.completion: Sarkareth would not have come here alone, {NAME}. I advise that you stay close and stay sharp.
72962.objectives: Talk to Rannan about his progress.

72963.title: The Upper Hand
72963.description:
It troubles me that Dezran would sacrifice himself so willingly for Sarkareth... And that Amythora and Marithos would leave Dezran to save him.

We both know the loss of waking in a new world. But Sarkareth wallows in the darkness of our past. I cannot let him continue to recruit our people.

Sarkareth awaits in the next room. I do not wish to kill him, but we must bring him to justice.

Let me know when you are ready.
72963.completion: I now feel only pity for Sarkareth. Nothing was left of him but an empty husk driven into madness.

72964.title: Singed
72964.description:
Standing here, seeing these two Sundered Flame before me, there is no more anger. I see the confusion in their eyes and how they look at each other... They are so uncertain of their future.

They remind me of myself and the moment I emerged alone, my creche dead and forgotten by passing ages.

I have to talk to them, {NAME}. Will you accompany me? As a friend?
72964.progress: I want to help them... be there for them when no one was there for me.
72964.completion: Perhaps I could help them cope with their feelings of abandonment. Maybe... I can reconcile my own past and lead them to a better future--one they deserve.

72965.title: Aspects of Our Legacy
72965.description:
I am proud to see that Emberthal is blossoming into a confident leader once more. Her people need her.

But that Sarkareth found Oathbinder is a reminder of the horrors of Neltharion's legacy and the folly of following him.

I have a feeling that we will discover more than his trinkets and whispers here in these caverns.

Come. We have much to discuss. Let us go back to Loamm and see if my brothers have found a way to subdue Fyrakk.
72965.completion:
I am... startled by Ebyssian's censure. 

Any objects of power Neltharion was hoarding would have been a boon to us.

But he is right... if I want to be an Aspect, I need to show everyone what power the true heir to the black dragonflight holds.

I will start with Fyrakk.

72966.title: Where There's Smoke, There's Fire
72966.description:
If you are finished indulging Ebyssian's associate, I would have us return to more pressing matters. 

Locating Fyrakk is still our primary mission. We cannot continue to delay it.

I have discovered a massive caldera at the western edge of Zaralek. If Fyrakk is still here, then logic dictates that this volcanic area would be his hideout.

Meet us there and we will proceed.
72966.completion:
You found your way here. Good.

We have not seen Fyrakk yet, but we have seen djaradin. Many of them.
72966.objectives: Meet Ebyssian and Sabellian outside the Zaqali Caldera.

72970.title: Niffen and Goliath
72970.description:
I didn't just come all the way out here to save your sniffers, ya know!

The deepflayers are vicious and stubborn, like obsidian ore. We've tried to lead them from our town by leaving out food and such, but they're all too keen to attack our sparrow caravans.

It's the big'un ruling over them that'll be trouble. Want to pay me back? Let's you, me, and your cologne-scented friend hunt it down together. I've got the perfect bait we can use too!
72970.completion: Yeesh! Certainly wasn't no lack of fight in that one, was there!

72972.title: The Waking Shores Reverse Tour
72972.description:
It's time to send you backwards. Not backwards in time, although we could do that, but have you fly the courses in reverse.

Get ready to see these courses in a different way.

Let's start with Serohs Gnikaw!

Wait. Waking Shores!
72972.completion:
Enjoying the new way of looking at things? Or do you not know if you're coming or going?

Either way, let's get you off to the next set of races in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
72972.objectives: Fly each of the reverse courses in Waking Shores.

72973.title: Smells Like Loamm
72973.description:
I smelled you weren't a bad sort from the start. A little sweaty, but not a bad sort.

Consider this your personal invitation to Loamm, home of the niffen!

Let's all meet just outside the entrance. That way I can give you and your pals the proper niffen welcome!
72973.progress:
You got Elder Honeypelt with you somewhere?

Hiding inside your boots, maybe?
72973.completion:
Welcome to Loamm, Uplander! Our shining smell of a city!

Aurantia is the name. I'm the High Redolence around here, which is just a fancy way of saying I'm the leader. It also means I'll be protecting my people from all the trouble that's broken on through from above.

But, you know what? We've got time for all that later! Ebyssian and Emberthal have already filled me in, so why not take a second to rest up on a soft patch of dirt?

72974.title: Welcome to the City of Smells
72974.description:
Ain't it incredible, uplander!

Now for the backbreaking labor. We've got to deliver this deepflayer meat to all my customers and collect their pay. I'd carry it all myself, but I'm just a poor, old, frail, gorgeous woman in need now, aren't I?

<Honeypelt gives you an expertly practiced wink.>

Why don't you handle it for me? Brynnsahce will do the heavy lifting while you take a little tour of the place. Put your best smell forward--we're a friendly sort!
72974.progress: It'd be a waste not to keep those nostrils open here in Loamm!
72974.completion:
Not too shabby, kid. Maybe there's room for you on the monster hunting roster, yet!

Just kidding! Another joke! There is no roster! Just combat-hungry suckers who got rocks rolling 'round their gut like I do.

You'll get there one day. Keep trying.
72974.objectives: Deliver deepflayer parcels around Loamm and return to Elder Honeypelt with the profits.

72975.title: The Land Beneath
72975.description:
I heard word you were aiding the green dragonflight, {NAME}.

I bring word from Ebyssian.

The Life-Binder has news of the Incarnates, and she requests our presence at the Seat of the Aspects.

The black dragonflight will await you there. I will move on ahead to continue tracking our foe.
72975.completion: The Aspects have gathered. Let us not keep them waiting.
72975.objectives: Meet the black dragonflight at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken.

72976.title: A Crack in the World
72976.description:
As you can see, Wrathion and Sabellian are also ready. If the Aspects have news of the Incarnates' actions, then the black dragonflight is prepared to answer the call.

Come. They are eager to speak with us.
72976.progress:
Wrathion and Sabellian made waiting for your arrival quite... tedious. 

I wish they could turn their boundless enthusiasm for bickering toward worthier means. Perhaps they just need the motivation.
72976.completion:
I have read what I can about the Incarnates. 

Fyrakk is every ounce as powerful as Iridikron, only lacking the discipline to focus that strength into singular goals. He would be just as happy burning his own followers down as he would our people.  

This will be a fight that all the Isles' denizens have a stake in.

72977.title: Where the Flames Fell
72977.description:
The Aspects have requested our help. As protectors of the Isles and dragonkind, we are more than willing.

I must locate Emberthal and ask her to join. I believe I can recruit her to our cause as long as we remain committed to hers against the Sundered Flame in the future.

Meet Sabellian and Wrathion at the site of the Incarnates' devastation.
72977.completion:
Perfect timing, {NAME}!

It would seem my efforts to investigate the area are not welcome. Would you mind helping me straighten out this situation?
72977.objectives: Meet Sabellian and Wrathion in Cascades Canyon.

72978.title: Scar of Earth and Fire
72978.description:
This centaur practically attacked us upon our arrival. He seems quite protective over this burning pile of ashes.

I know you have worked alongside the Shikaar before. Would you speak to him? I would like to confirm what happened here.

There is no chance that this is all a coincidence. If it connects to the Incarnates at all, we must learn all we can.
72978.progress: Have you learned anything of value?
72978.completion:
I begin to see why Fyrakk was sealed away...

Your assistance, as always, has been invaluable.

72979.title: The Earth Gives Way
72979.description:
You may stay here to see what comes of this relic, or meet me afterward in Loamm. That is Honeypelt's home, which she offered us respite at while you were still in the cave.

I would only ask that you check on Wrathion. He may be a ceaselessly buzzing pest, yes, but... these recent events force me to admit I care for his well-being too.  

There are only so many black dragons left. We must look out for each other.
72979.completion:
Is that depressing lump of moods, Sabellian, alright?

...What? I care enough to at least ask about him!

72980.title: Brother's Keeper
72980.description:
By my scales, I needed that win! That blasted Incarnate swatting us like flies did a number on my ego, and I assume Sabellian feels no different. 

As infuriating as I find his lack of humor, groaning voice, and ugly shoes... I would ask that you check in on him. He is still family, after all, and I do not wish him to become dinner to these deepflayers.

Meet Honeypelt and I outside these dreadful nests when you finish up with Sabellian.
72980.completion:
I could hear you and Wrathion's yawping from all the way over here.

If you have finished with all that, why not take a look at this, {NAME}.

72981.title: The Patience of Princes
72981.description:
The centaur's report of Primalist forces pushing into the underground after Fyrakk changes the situation. Wrathion and I believe it would be a tactical mistake to dawdle here any longer, waiting for Ebyssian and his devotee to arrive.

We still wish for you to join us. If you are ready, then we three should proceed together.
72981.completion: To say you smell lost is an understatement!
72981.objectives: Delve underground and fell the Primalist blockade.

72982.title: The Ohn'ahran Plains Reverse Tour
72982.description:
Time to go forward to go backward once more.

More races await you in Ohn'ahran plains. Head over there now, make sure you go in the right direction.
72982.completion:
I think you're getting the hang of going backwards.

Onto the Azure Span!
72982.objectives: Fly each of the reverse courses in Ohn'ahran Plains.

72984.title: The Azure Span Reverse Tour
72984.description:
The next set of backward courses are back in the Azure Span.

When you're ready you should head back over there and retrace your previous steps to the previous races.
72984.completion:
More courses undone, well done!

Onto Thaldraszus for the last set of challenges!
72984.objectives: Fly each of the reverse courses in the Azure Span.

72985.title: The Thaldraszus Reverse Tour
72985.description:
Once more you'll be heading back to where it all finished. Or started. I can't remember anymore.

Seek out my bronze colleagues to fly the reverse courses to complete your rewinding.
72985.completion:
Who are you? I don't think we've met before.

I'm joking. Well done on completing the newest tour.

Feel free to re-fly any of the courses to beat your own best times. The sky's the limit!
72985.objectives: Fly each of the reverse courses in Thaldraszus.

72987.title: Here We Go Again
72987.description:
I understand Alexstrasza's concerns. Shadowflame is a vile force that poses an indescribable threat to anyone who comes close to it, as we have personally witnessed. Unfortunately, Aberrus may contain even more threats.

We need to continue to push forward.

Before I left Zaralek Cavern, I made contact with soldiers stationed by Neltharion at the Obsidian Rest. Luckily for us, they remain loyal to the Black Dragonflight. 

Let us meet there.
72987.completion: I am glad you were able to join us, {NAME}.

72988.title: The Booty Bay Journal
72988.description:
You will not believe who I read about today in the Booty Bay Journal. What is that look, $p? I too enjoy light reading about world affairs. Booty Bay is fascinating!

Regardless, I read about Zeros--he was once the captive of an evil mage who hated all blue dragons. He seems to have found his own way in the world since his rescue.

A bit of advice for you, young one. Debt is a foolish thing to be in, especially in Booty Bay, and especially to the Baron.

Let's retrieve him before the sharks do.
72988.completion: Get your hands off me! Oh, wait a minute... you're not from around here.
72988.objectives: Speak to Senegos to temporarily neutralize your standing with Booty Bay, and then find Zeros in Booty Bay in the Eastern Kingdoms.

72989.title: The Ruby Hatchling
72989.description:
An egg from the red dragonflight is ready to hatch.

Report to Amella in the Ruby Lifeshrine to pick up the egg. Then, I request that you bring the egg to the Ruby Oathstone to hatch in a location strong with our flight's power.

Once this is complete, return here with the hatchling, where we will further take care of it.
72989.progress: Have you brought the newest hatchling?
72989.completion: I am absolutely thrilled! All of my training has more than prepared me for one of my own flight.
72989.objectives: Collect the Red Dragon Egg at the Ruby Lifeshrine then hatch it at the Ruby Oathstone.

72990.title: Crimson Comfort
72990.description:
I am looking forward to our red whelp. They are, after all, my specialty!

I have already spoken with Amella, and I would like to handle the nest myself. Here is a list of materials. Bring them to me when you are done, and I can fashion the most comfortable cushion you have ever seen!

<Lasztak hands you a list of supplies.>
72990.completion: How comfortable. A cushion worthy of Queen Alexstrasza herself!
72990.objectives: Gather supplies for the Ruby Hatchling's nest.

72991.title: Warm Dragonfruit Pie
72991.description:
When I think of red dragon comfort food, I immediately think of the pies back at the Ruby Life Pools. You can always tell when our blacksmith, Krendisc, has downtime between orders--the entire mountain smells of delicious baked dragonfruit!

My pie may not be as good as his, but I am sure our ruby hatchling will love it. If you bring me the ingredients I will bake the best pie I can!
72991.progress:
<Lasztak cracks his knuckles.>

It has been a while since I baked anything, but I am confident!
72991.completion: When it comes to taking care of red dragons, I know what I am doing!

72992.title: You're Playing Wrong!
72992.description:
Our red hatchling seems to be having quite the trouble making friends. Any time she tries to get one to play, it tends to end quickly.

She can be a bit pushy, but whelps are whelps. Why don't you get her in the right mindset to play with some tag?
72992.progress: Every whelp loves a game of tag!
72992.completion:
<Agapanthus sighs.>

I can already tell that whelp is going to be quite the handful.

72993.title: I'm the Boss!
72993.description:
Never have I met such a bossy child!

She has a list. A list! Please, take Belastrasza off our claws for a bit. I just... I need to sit down.
72993.progress: <The bags under Agapanthus's eyes are even deeper than usual.>
72993.completion: Not only does she need to learn patience, but she also needs to learn that she is not the center of the universe!

72994.title: A Cavalier Pet
72994.description:
I believe that the only way we can teach Belastrasza to be less self-obsessed is to show her firsthand how it makes others feel.

Vorquin are beautiful creatures, but they are incredibly high maintenance companions who need a lot of care.

Lysindra in Valdrakken has a baby vorquin for Bela. Perhaps she will learn through getting a taste of her own medicine.
72994.progress: A stubborn pet for a stubborn whelp.
72994.completion: This pet should teach Bela to be less stubborn... or just make twice the work for poor Lasztak. Well, one of them will learn from this.
72994.objectives: Obtain a Baby Vorquin battle pet for Belastrasza.

72995.title: Patience, Please
72995.description:
Belastrasza has learned much through her vorquin foal, but I have thought of one more lesson that should be excellent for her.

Her lack of patience has been stumping me for quite some time. Recently I was reflecting by the water, watching the turtles go about their day. Then I was hit by a revelation!

Wurallie has the perfect battle to test Belastrasza's patience, but poor Princess Vorquistrasza doesn't have the endurance. Can you meet them in the Waking Shores to lend a hand?
72995.progress: Slow and steady, Bela. Slow and steady.
72995.completion:
She has truly come a long way since arriving at the daycare. While she still has more to learn, I am extremely proud of her.

She has expressed a desire to accompany you on your adventures. I hope she will not order you around too much.
72995.objectives: Help Belastrasza learn patience by defeating a turtle in a pet battle.

72996.title: The Bronze Hatchling
72996.description:
An egg from the bronze dragonflight is ready to hatch.

Report to Xius in the Ruby Lifeshrine to pick up the egg. Then, I request that you bring the egg to the Bronze Oathstone to hatch in a location strong with their flight's power.

Once this is complete, return here with the hatchling, where we will further take care of it.
72996.progress: Have you brought the newest hatchling?
72996.completion:
Ah, a bronze whelp.

Let us hope they stay in whelp form, hmm?
72996.objectives: Collect the Bronze Dragon Egg at the Ruby Lifeshrine then hatch it at the Bronze Oathstone.

72997.title: Nothing Like a Sandy Nap
72997.description:
While red dragons enjoy their surroundings lush and lively, bronze dragons prefer their environments dry and sandy. I am sure you can find many materials for our hatchling's nest in the Temporal Conflux in Thaldraszus.

I have read that bronze whelps also enjoy an appropriately sized basin to curl themselves in. My friend at the inn in the Bronze Enclave has exclaimed often about an excess of bowls... I am sure she would not mind if we took one off her hands.
72997.progress: Bronze dragons are like cats. They defy time and space.
72997.completion: I cannot say that I quite understand the bronze flight's predilection for sandy environs... I find that the granules get everywhere.
72997.objectives: Gather supplies for the Bronze Hatchling's nest.

72998.title: Artisanal Aging
72998.description:
I have been learning much about bronze dragons since arriving in Valdrakken. While they take their charge of time seriously, they have found many hobbies for their free time that their magic can aid them with.

My friend Gorgonzormu swears by his cheeses for all stages of dragon life. He mentioned that he has a type of parmesan that is excellent for bronze whelps. It seems that our hatchling's first meal is figured out!
72998.progress: Cheese is best when aged over time, but bronze dragons have perfected rapid aging with their control of time!
72998.completion: Not only can bronze dragons age cheese quickly, but they can also digest it more rapidly!
72998.objectives: Buy Temporal Parmesan from Gorgonzormu in Valdrakken for the Bronze Hatchling.

72999.title: Here? There? Everywhere!
72999.description:
Our bronze hatchling has been staying away from the other whelps, mostly hanging out in the sand. Sometimes we find him in the sandbox with the others, but we never see him moving around!

He could use some friendship. Why don't you treat him to a game of tag?
72999.progress: Every whelp loves a game of tag!
72999.completion: Those are some strong allergies. We may need to find some medication for this one.

73000.title: Sneezing Through Time
73000.description:
Zhusa is throwing us for quite the loop, {NAME}.

Since he is so young, his control over time is not fully developed. Unfortunately, he has a strange reflex. Every time he sneezes he disappears, popping up elsewhere in any form! To top it off, he seems to have many allergies.

Please, help Zhusadormu figure out what he is allergic to so we can keep him in one place!
73000.progress:
<Agapanthus rubs his temples.>

Oh, bronze whelps...
73000.completion:
So Zhusadormu is allergic to... everything?

This may be more troublesome than we thought.

73001.title: A Scaly Pet
73001.description:
We have been trying to decide on the perfect pet for Zhusadormu. His allergies limit our options by quite a bit, but I believe I have thought of a pet for him.

I know for a fact that Zhusa is not allergic to scales. A baby hornswog is hypoallergenic and I believe Lysindra could acquire one for us.
73001.progress: The whelps love hornswogs. They will love having one in the daycare!
73001.completion: A bronze hornswog for a bronze whelp. A perfect fit!
73001.objectives: Obtain a Baby Hornswog battle pet for Zhusadormu.

73002.title: Temporal Immunity
73002.description:
Zhusadormu has been trying hard to keep his powers in check.

While we may not be able to prevent his allergies, he does not have to jump through time with each sneeze.

Wurallie believes she can test his control. Please go to the Waking Shores and help them with this lesson.
73002.progress: I believe in Zhusa. I hope you do too.
73002.completion:
A sneeze without a teleport! A breakthrough to be proud of.

Now that he won't get lost, Zhusadormu will want to join you on some quests
73002.objectives: Help Zhusadormu confront his allergies during a pet battle.

73003.title: The Azure Hatchling
73003.description:
An egg from the blue dragonflight is ready to hatch.

Report to Axkall in the Ruby Lifeshrine to pick up the egg. Then, I request that you bring the egg to the Azure Oathstone to hatch in a location strong with our flight's power.

Once this is complete, return here with the hatchling, where we will further take care of it.
73003.progress: Have you brought the newest hatchling?
73003.completion: It is nice to care for a hatchling from my own flight. He reminds me of my days in Azsuna.
73003.objectives: Collect the Blue Dragon Egg at the Ruby Lifeshrine then hatch it at the Azure Oathstone.

73004.title: A Scholar's Delight
73004.description:
Blue dragons are seekers of knowledge, even from an early age. They seem drawn to books and scrolls, finding the most comfort when surrounded by them.

For our azure hatchling, the best nest is truly amongst our many books. I request that you collect the following for his nest--a quill of his own to learn to write, something to keep him nice and cold, and a bedtime story from Azure Span. I have heard tale of one that many blue dragons remember fondly.
73004.progress: I have raised dozens of blue whelps at all stages of life. At this point, their needs are second nature to me.
73004.completion: A nest amongst the books--perfect for a young blue dragon.

73005.title: Crystal Nutrition
73005.description:
Yes, blue dragons eat normal food, but the most important part of their diet is magical in nature. Wherever the blue flight can be found, you can be sure there is a source of nutritious ley crystals nearby.

Of course, the homelands of the blue dragons became home to many others during their absence. The brackenhide gnolls have settled in our lands with the most ley crystals and taken them for themselves. You will need to enter their camps to reclaim the crystals for our whelp.
73005.progress: From the moment they hatch, dragons have incredibly sharp teeth.
73005.completion: The gnolls are not the first to steal our ley crystals, and they certainly will not be the last.
73005.objectives: Gather 6 Bite-Sized Ley Crystals from Brackenhide Hollow for the Azure Hatchling.

73006.title: Well, Actually...
73006.description:
As expected, our dear blue whelp is quite the little "bookwyrm". I knew many hatchlings just like him in Aszuna, though we only had a small collection of scrolls.

While there are books aplenty here in Valdrakken, whelps need to get up and moving! Why don't you play some tag?
73006.completion: Such a young whelp, yet so full of knowledge!

73007.title: New Lenses
73007.description:
Zalethgos is a bright child, but as he has gotten older we have realized something very clear about him.

He has terrible eyesight!

He is constantly speaking of things being fuzzy and of not being able to tell where one thing ends and the next begins.

There is a salon just across the bridge in Valdrakken. Please, accompany Zalethgos to try to find him the perfect pair of glasses to aid his vision.
73007.progress: I look forward to Zalethgos learning that sharp edges exist!
73007.completion: Zaleth seems absolutely thrilled with his new spectacles! He will surely flourish now.
73007.objectives: Bring Zalethgos to the Victorious Visage in Valdrakken to find a suitable pair of glasses.

73008.title: A Scholar's Pet
73008.description:
Long ago in Aszuna, young blue whelps from Azurewing Repose often studied magic alongside the elves of Nar'thalas Academy. I have many fond memories of the place, but one stands out among the others.

The enchanted books, while excellent to study, were quite the rascals. I have heard Lysindra acquired a similar book. I think this would be the perfect pet for Zalethgos!
73008.progress:
Enchanted books are the perfect companions. They are full of magic, knowledge, and fun!

Additionally, you do not need to feed them.
73008.completion: I hope Zalethgos enjoys his new companion.
73008.objectives: Obtain an Enchanted Book pet for Zalethgos.

73009.title: Sight Isn't Everything
73009.description:
Since getting his glasses, Zalethgos has been relying heavily on his eyesight. Of course, this is normal, but he needs to remain flexible in case he loses them.

I believe it is time to turn out the lights. I think Wurallie has the perfect trick.

She believes she can teach Zalethgos to find victory even when he cannot use his eyes. Please join them in the Waking Shores.
73009.progress: In order to grow into a well-rounded dragon, Zalethgos must use everything at his disposal.
73009.completion:
As proud as Zalethgos is of his glasses, knowing he can get along without them has given him new confidence. 
He may want to join you on your adventures in the future.
73009.objectives: Help Zalethgos overcome his insecurity about his eyesight.

73010.title: The Emerald Hatchling
73010.description:
An egg from the green dragonflight is ready to hatch.

Report to Zahkrana in the Ruby Lifeshrine to pick up the egg. Then, I request that you bring the egg to the Emerald Oathstone to hatch in a location strong with their flight's power.

Once this is complete, return here with the hatchling, where we will further take care of it.
73010.progress: Have you brought the newest hatchling?
73010.completion:
Every so often I would bring the whelps in my care to meet with some green whelps in Val'sharah.

They were always... so much calmer...

<Agapanthus stares off into the distance.>
73010.objectives: Collect the Green Dragon Egg at the Ruby Lifeshrine then hatch it at the Emerald Oathstone.

73011.title: Home Sweet Dirt
73011.description:
Green dragons prefer a home that is both natural and mystical, imbued with the power of the Emerald Dream.

The Emerald Gardens will certainly have many materials with which to build an appropriate nest for this little one. Perhaps we should speak to a member of their flight to find something to bring them comfort as well.
73011.progress: We will have to maximize this hatchling's comfort to allow them to rest well and grow.
73011.completion:
May this whelp grow roots strong and firm.

Not literally, of course.
73011.objectives: Gather supplies for the Emerald Hatchling's nest.

73012.title: Hochenblume Harvest
73012.description:
Every green dragon loves a leafy, crunchy snack. The plants that grow with Dream exposure are densely packed with nutrients, keeping the greens healthy and content.

Hochenblume flowers are a sweet, delightful treat for young green dragons, and contain all the vitamins that a growing hatchling needs.
73012.progress: Not only are the hochenblume sweet on the tongue, but they also have a delightful aroma.
73012.completion: What a treat. They seem absolutely thrilled!

73013.title: So... Tired...
73013.description:
I have some worries about our new green friend. They are not sleeping as much as most green whelps tend to do.

They seem to be having trouble sleeping. Why don't you get them up and moving around with a game of tag?
73013.progress: Every whelp loves a game of tag!
73013.completion: That poor whelp. We must get them some rest soon.

73014.title: A Green Who Can't Sleep?
73014.description:
{NAME}... we have a problem.

Posidriss has insomnia.

I did not even know it was possible for a green dragon to not be able to fall asleep! How are they to learn to protect the Dream if they cannot enter it?

Please, try anything you can think of to help Posidriss fall asleep.
73014.progress: Every green dragon needs to be able to sleep!
73014.completion: We uh... we will keep working on it. We have to!
73014.objectives: Try to help Posidriss fall asleep.

73015.title: A Sleepy Pet
73015.description:
Posidriss's sleeping troubles are still causing them many problems. This is preventing them from developing their connection to the Dream.

Bears hibernate, bears dream, bear cubs are soft, warm and cuddly. Some of the cubs in the Dragon Isles are even connected to the Dream. Can you fetch one from Lysindra for Posidriss?
73015.progress: Where there are bears, there are druids. And where there are druids, there are green dragons!
73015.completion: Okay cub, please teach Posidriss your sleeping ways.
73015.objectives: Obtain a Bear Cub pet for Posidriss.

73016.title: Hibernation
73016.description:
Posidriss's companion has been helping them with their severe insomnia, but I worry that they are still falling behind other whelps in their connection to the Dream.

Perhaps we can aid them through a pet battle! Green dragons often protect the Dream from the Nightmare, and Wurallie has found the perfect critter for them to practice this on.

It is mostly harmless.
73016.completion:
Posidriss was certainly enthusiastic about facing the enemies of the Emerald Dream. I think they learned a lesson as well.

Posidriss will want to join you on some of your future adventures, though you may have to keep them from rushing after the big threats.
73016.objectives: Help Posidriss defeat the Nightmare critter.

73021.title: A Lesson in Responsibility
73021.description:
The daycare is always looking for new activities to enrich the education of the whelps.

Lasztak has suggested a class pet might help teach the whelps responsibility. Sir Pringly has been my personal companion for some time, and I believe his calm demeanor and sense of fun would serve the position well.

Sir Pringly will need his own habitat for the daycare, however. If you would gather materials, we can prepare a space just for him.
73021.progress: There is a particular way that Sir Pringly likes his habitat constructed. If you get the materials I listed, he should like it.
73021.completion: The habitat is looking wonderful, {NAME}. I hope Sir Pringly will be on his best behavior.
73021.objectives: Gather materials for Sir Pringly's habitat.

73026.title: Booty Bay
73026.description:
Land of pirates, swindlers, and raiders! Zeros, once just a captive whelpling, has built a mighty reputation as an auction house trader in one of the most cutthroat places on Azeroth.

However, his recent investment blunder made the front page of the Booty Bay Journal. Rescue him before his debt is collected by the Baron.
73026.completion: You think I know anything about Booty Bay? Why yes, I do...
73026.objectives: Speak to Senegos for more information.

73031.title: Champion of the Winterpelt
73031.description:
Thank you for all that you have done, {NAME}.

It is all too easy to turn within and simply continue on as you always have.

The Winterpelt will rejoin the world. We will return to the path our ancestors strayed from.

And we will never forget your part in this.

I have gathered the tribe and our new allies together to celebrate. Speak with me when you are ready to begin.
73031.objectives: Speak to Kranac to begin the celebration.

73035.title: Path of Trust
73035.description:
Radza sent me to find you and tell you to come to her. She set her incense burner out which means she's going to perform a ritual.

That means whatever she wants is important.

Radza's just west of here. I wouldn't keep her waiting!
73035.completion: Thank you for coming to see me. The Winterpelt shaman have begun to trust us! We have much work to do...
73035.objectives: Speak with Radza Thunderclaw in Winterpelt Hollow.

73036.title: Medicinal Fungi
73036.description:
When we happened upon these poor souls, it was clear they were attacked by djaradin. The poison on those brutes' weapons is preventing me and their leader, Narvra, from healing them.

I noticed peculiar mushrooms on some crystals nearby. I have seen their like before, and I may be able to fashion an antidote from them.

Can you harvest some while Voraxian and I keep watch here?
73036.progress: Do you have the cuttings? I'm not sure how long these poor people have.
73036.completion:
Thank you. This looks like what we need. 

It will take me a while to purge them, but we should be able to make it work.
73036.objectives: Collect 10 Drooping Mushroom Cuttings from the Viridian Throne.

73037.title: Healing Crystals
73037.description:
Greetings! 

Apologies if I seem... distracted. I have been beside myself worrying about my injured friends. 

But maybe you, gentle{class}, can assist us?

Narvra needs aid in healing us. Shards from crystal elementals have healing properties. I feel terrible asking to harm a fellow elemental, but if you could... obtain some from them, that would greatly aid my friends.

Don't worry--the elementals will regenerate in time. My friends' needs come first, however impolite our gathering methods may be.
73037.progress: Have you retrieved the crystals? I'm worried about Butterfingers; he's not doing well.
73037.completion:
<Narvra winces.>

Thank you. These crystals should allow us to heal everyone once again.

Myself included.
73037.objectives: Collect 10 Viridian Heartcrystals from enemies in the Viridian Throne.

73038.title: A Room Without a View
73038.description:
This vault is of Black Dragon make which means its contents are my flight's property.

Normally I would have suggested we venture in together, but I was not expecting aggressive watchers. I will protect Rupert while you search for artifacts for us to examine.

To keep you safe, I will cast a spell on you I use when fighting the gronn.
73038.progress: Did you find anything of interest?
73038.completion:
Ah, the downside of spending all my life in Outland. I have no idea what these artifacts are... 

You say you found a journal? 

We should bring these back to the Dragonscale team. They may know more.

<Voraxian notices you looking at the dead watchers around him.>

Ah yes, we had a bit of excitement while you were in the vault. No matter, it has been handled.
73038.objectives: Recover artifacts from the Buried Vault.

73039.title: Restless Death
73039.description:
What could lead someone to do this... 

I can perform a ritual that might aid these poor creatures passing on. Take these totems and place them along the river. With enough anchor points, I should be able to help them move on.

We'll move ahead to look for a ritual site.
73039.progress: Have you placed the anchor totems?
73039.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. Give me a moment. We will begin the ritual shortly. 

Let us hope we can bring rest to these souls.
73039.objectives: Place anchor totems in the Acidbite Ravine to allow Narvra to start a cleansing ritual.

73040.title: Bringing Disorder to Order
73040.description:
How incredibly rude! I know we did not bring gifts, but this is hardly the way to greet visitors! There is no excuse for such terrible manners! Scoundrels! Cads! Brutes!

<Rupert coughs into his hand.>

What I meant to say was these watchers appear to be a threat. Anyone who tunnels in here could be in danger. 

Would you be able to make this place safer by eliminating them?
73040.completion: Good show, {NAME}. This place is much safer now. Those Ruffians will not bother anyone else.
73040.objectives: Eliminate 6 Enraged Watchers in the Buried Vaults.

73041.title: Respite
73041.description:
Thank you for everything you have done for us. 

We've been able to get back on our feet now, and Butterfingers has cooked up a meal. 

We lost a member of our team and everyone is still a bit shaken... We could do with the morale boost of a good meal.

Would you like to join us?
73041.progress: Thank you, {NAME}. I think we needed that small break.
73041.completion:
Returning these artifacts is the least we can do. And the opportunity to study additional artifacts is tantalizing!

Thank you for helping us, {NAME}. This opportunity for study will be huge for the Dragonscale Expedition.
73041.objectives: Join the Dragonscale team in the Zaralek Cavern for a meal.

73042.title: A Tower Yonder
73042.description:
$p, I... don't want to ask more of you, but could you help us finally complete our mission?

We were ordered to investigate the Gaze of Neltharion. We were defeated on our first approach, but with an escort of two dragons and the mighty $p, I'm not as worried about the djaradin.

I want us to move out soon. Could you scout out the tower first for us?
73042.progress: Did you scout out the tower?
73042.completion:
You were attacked by what?! Are you okay? 

What did you find? Another book?

Tellywin, come and take a look at this!
73042.objectives: Investigate the Gaze of Neltharion in the Sulfur Wastes.

73043.title: A Ghastly Legacy
73043.description:
We need to give these creatures peace.

While you are down there assisting Voraxian, please end their suffering. Even a temporary release from this existence will help relieve their burden. In the meantime, Narvra can work on her ritual.
73043.completion:
Thank you {NAME}.

What was done here... I am worried about Voraxian.

I am glad you went with him.
73043.objectives: Eliminate 10 Ghostly Researchers and Failed Experiments in the Acidbite Ravine.

73044.title: Cataloging Horror
73044.description:
I... I need to bring the evidence of this insanity back to my flight. It may destroy us, but my people need to know what happened here. 

I borrowed some cataloging cameras from Tellywin. Can you join me in documenting these atrocities?

I can provide you with a similar protection to that which I gave in the vault. I will leave any fighting to you; I cannot bring myself to cause any more suffering than my flight has already wrought. 

Let us be done with this as swiftly as possible.
73044.progress: I can barely believe what was done here...
73044.completion:
Thank you. To know that this was occurring before my flight's fall...  sickens me to my core. 

I will take these photographs to our leaders. If we cannot learn from our history, we are doomed to repeat it.
73044.objectives: Use the Cataloging Camera to take pictures of experiment dumping sites in the Acidbite Ravine.

73045.title: Stain Removal
73045.description:
We can begin the ritual whenever you are ready.

Let's help these spirits pass on.
73045.progress: We need to complete this ritual, {NAME}.
73045.completion:
Thank you {NAME}.

As Sytorian passed, the ritual was unblocked and we were able to complete it. In time, the last remnants of his actions will fade.

You have helped so many today. I don't know if we can ever repay you. For now though. I think we should return to camp.

73046.title: Cavernous Capers
73046.description:
While we wait for Veritistrasz and Narvra to nurse the rest of the camp back to health, I thought we might take a short jaunt.

I sensed a cavern on our way here, and... I feel like I may need a bit of spelunking to take my mind off what just happened...

Fancy joining me?
73046.completion:
How very rude! 

Why, we turn up, we introduce ourselves politely, and we are attacked!

Ruffians!
73046.objectives: Travel with Rupert from the Dragonscale Camp in the Zaralek Cavern.

73047.title: Terrestrial Tunneling
73047.description:
I have to say that I am quite done with this place.

Would you like to return to camp?
73047.completion:
Oh, everyone appears to be back on their feet! Jolly good!

And Butterfingers appears to have laid out quite the feast!
73047.objectives: Return to the Dragonscale Expedition camp in the Zaralek Cavern.

73069.title: Sindragosa and Malygos's Rest
73069.description:
The preparations are now complete. Kalecgos and Alexstrasza should be here soon with the remaining essences of Sindragosa and Malygos.

Both suffered such violent ends. I heard even with his last breath, Malygos cursed Alexstrasza.

And Sindragosa--she was slain ten thousand years ago by Nelthar... by Deathwing. Yet she was reanimated by the Lich King and slain by adventurers. I can only imagine the state this essence is in...

Forgive my ramblings. Kalecgos and Alexstrasza should be here shortly.
73069.completion:
Thank you for aiding Senegos, {NAME}.

It's time to return to the archives.
73069.objectives: Observe Kalecgos and Alexstrasza putting Sindragosa and Malygos's remains to rest.

73071.title: A Brew for the Ages
73071.description:
Legends speak of an ale brewed by Neltharion himself. Yet this ale has been lost to the ages! If those stories are true, and doubtless they are, we may find the recipe within this vault. 

Ipfelkofer and I found three keys to this vault, so we decided to look around. Hopefully, our thirst for discovery will be quenched.

If we found that recipe, imagine the excitement in the brewing community! We could even feature that ale at the next Brewfest! First round will be on me.
73071.progress:
Have you found that recipe? 

I bet you it's a porter... or maybe a stout... something dark and just a little bitter.
73071.completion:
Our operation is a success! Now that we've got the recipe, we won't be needing these. So help yourself.

So what should we call this ale? Deathwing Dark? Black Flagon? Beyond the Dark Porter?

Anyway, that was amazing. I need a drink.

73076.title: Return to the Reach
73076.description:
Long ago, the Reach was our training ground. Now it's time to return. The island may still hold secrets from our past.

Scalecommander Emberthal has gone on ahead. She awaits the arrival of any who would lend us their aid. We'll need all the help we can get finding a foothold in the Reach. Safe travels.
73076.completion:
You came from the mainland? Our call for aid has been answered, then.

Our allies have come from every corner of the isles, but our base of operations is far from secure.

Come, {class}. There is much to do.
73076.objectives: Meet Emberthal in the Forbidden Reach.

73077.title: This Might Sting
73077.description:
Relax. This Sundered Flame is merely poisoned. He won't die. Probably.

 He will just be in pain.

<Patroclosa looks at you, then sighs.>

I suppose if you wanted to spare him this fate, you could collect bile from the Quartzite Sporebats that roam this valley. It contains a natural antivenom that would ease his suffering. But I will not waste my healing magic on a murderer.

And you may as well bring back loamshrooms, to help him keep the bile down. Though it's a kindness he doesn't deserve.
73077.progress: We all have to find our own path. I just wish ours was a little bit easier...
73077.completion:
I hope that was the right thing for her. Don't judge Patri too harshly. She hasn't been the same since losing Ekrati.

<Tezelari still manages to smile at you.>

Nothing to do but keep going, right?
73077.objectives: Collect 8 Spongy Loamshrooms and 6 helpings of Quartzite Spore Bile.

73081.title: Stress Fractures
73081.description:
Another member of the Sundered Flame has been apprehended on Scalecommander Emberthal's behalf. A messenger, Amythora thinks.

We must decide what to do with him. In the meantime, it would be helpful if you could see if he has any important information.

He is well-guarded, so don't worry about him putting up a fight. Some passing Dracthyr offered their aid-- said they were companions of the Scalecommander! And they knew just how to handle Sundered Flame prisoners.
73081.progress:
I know you want me to talk, but I can't.

Whatever you do to me, Sarkareth's punishment would be a thousand times worse.
73081.completion:
You... didn't have to do that.

<The {race} fidgets with his bindings.>

I'm grateful you did, though.
73081.objectives: Investigate the captured Sundered Flame messenger.

73085.title: Cold Feet
73085.description:
If Marithos and Amythora want to run off and play adventurer, that's their choice. I have a sense of loyalty.

<Despite his bold words, the messenger looks uncertain.>

You don't know what Sarkareth is capable of, all right?

Look through my things and draw whatever conclusions you'd like. But I won't tell you anything. I can't.
73085.progress:
Did you find anything? And why do you look like you've been in a scuffle?

...Oh. I see. That's quite troubling.

<Marithos sighs.>
73085.completion:
Thank you for going above and beyond, {NAME}. I suspect this won't be the only fight to break out as we try to rebuild.

I'll see what sense I can make out of the information you found.

Oh, and I'll make sure to return this horn signet to our captured friend. I'm not sure of his fate, but at least I can offer some peace of mind.
73085.objectives: Examine the apprehended dracthyr's belongings for clues about the Sundered Flame.

73086.title: Healthy Competition
73086.description:
More of my creche mates have been welcomed under Emberthal's leadership, but there are still tensions between the former Sundered Flame and the dracthyr we've hurt.

Fortunately, I think I've found a way to work out those tensions in a productive, dracthyrian method that will reinforce our bonds as evokers. Sparring!

Now, come on. Try me! We can show all these louts how it's done.
73086.completion: Well done! That's a lesson they'll never forget. And I reckon there's some things I could learn from you, as well. Though don't let your head hit your wings about it.

73089.title: What's Behind The Next Door
73089.description:
If we're going to keep exploring these vaults, we're going to need to open more doors! And that means we'll need more keys.

See if you can find more keys around Forbidden Reach. Every door is another opportunity!
73089.completion:
Good work in there, my friend. We can continue our exploration as long as we have keys. 

I'm sure we'll find another vault to explore in a few days. My curiosity is killing me!
73089.objectives: Enter the vault and open 3 more doors using Zskera Vault Keys.

73090.title: Regrets in Crystal
73090.description:
I have some idea of what Lanigosa might be doing in Crystalsong Forest, although I cannot imagine why she has taken it upon herself to do it.

That forest conceals within it the ruins of Shandaral, a former highborne settlement and the site of one of the mortal race's first clashes with the blue dragonflight. If Lanigosa truly is in Crystalsong, then it may well have something to do with Shandaral.

Seek her out there, {NAME}, and try to convince her to return to us.
73090.completion:
Forgive me, {class}. I mistook you for a tormented arcane apparition.

...do not give me that look! You would be surprised at how easy a mistake that is to make out here.
73090.objectives: Speak to Lanigosa in Crystalsong Forest.

73091.title: Crystalsong Forest
73091.description:
The blue dragon Lanigosa lent her aid to mortals during the most recent war against the Burning Legion. However, she failed to respond to the call of the Isles.

Has something befallen her? Or has she simply chosen not to return? Whatever her reasons, Azuregos's globe seems to suggest that she was last seen in Crystalsong Forest.
73091.completion: Lanigosa has always been cordial with me. I hope she is all right.

73092.title: Something Like Family
73092.description:
Grab a bite! Scaralesh's Special! If you're a hungry dracthyr in need of cheer, this is the place!

<Scaralesh lowers his voice to talk to you.>

Between you and me, {NAME}? Our people have been through a lot lately. We need something to help us relax, and remind us that we've always got each other. I think a family meal could be just that.

Rommen and I can handle the cooking. Will you bring plates to dracthyr who need a warm bite to eat?
73092.progress: Ah, that smells incredible! We've really improved on creche food, don't you think?
73092.completion:
Any other hungry bellies left to feed? No? Good.

<Scaralesh lowers his voice to talk to you.>

Thanks for that, {NAME}. I see some of these {race} smiling for the first time in a long time tonight.
73092.objectives: Bring plates of food to dracthyr at the party in Weyrnrest.

73093.title: Empty Chairs
73093.description:
I don't want to detract from the festivities, but there's someone missing who should be here.

This is a time for all dracthyr to come together, but Rathane might not see it that way-- he was Sundered Flame, just like us. And though he left them after what happened at the Aberrus, I fear he's still grappling with the guilt. He seemed rather distressed.

Would you go find him? And make sure he's alright, and that he knows he's welcome?
73093.completion:
There is a lot of work to be done, a lot of things to be mended.

<Rathane looks down at the broken horn signet in his hand.>

But we can help each other.

73094.title: Aiding the Expedition
73094.description:
Sarkareth must pay for his crimes.

<Emberthal steels herself.>

We cannot let any more dracthyr suffer because of Sarkareth's twisted ambitions. 

If the Sundered Flame is threatening the Dragonscale Expedition, then our allies need our help.
73094.completion:
Too many have suffered. Too many have died.

Enough is enough. Sarkareth is responsible, and he must pay.
73094.objectives: Meet Scalecommander Emberthal and Ebyssian at Stormsunder Crater in the Forbidden Reach.

73107.title: Sending Stone: Initial Report
73107.completion:
They... they knew. They knew we were not broken but still kept us in stasis.

I will have this translated for all to read. May it provide insight.

73108.title: Sending Stone: The Prisoner
73108.completion:
So, Raszageth had a jailor. Or was Adamanthia our jailor? 

Puzzling. I shall have this translated and added to the volumes for others to read. My thanks, {NAME}.

73109.title: Receiving Stone: Final Warning
73109.completion:
What? What was Neltharion attempting to stop Adamanthia from doing?

I will have this translated and added to the logs. It is good these messages come with a sense of time encoded in their magic. 

But why were they not destroyed after use?
73109.objectives: Bring the Receiving Stone to Scalecommander Azurathel.

73110.title: Journal Entry: Experiments
73110.completion:
Ah! Excellent. More hints to our past.

<Cindrethresh reads over the journal entry growing more and more enraged.>

Experiments?! We were just... "things" to them?! They couldn't control us so we... aahhh!

Thank you for bringing this to me. We need to get this translated so others can read it.

73113.title: Journal Entry: Relics
73113.completion:
Order. Always the enforcement of order.

Thank you, {NAME}. I will have this added to the translations.

73114.title: Journal Entry: The Creches
73114.completion:
It is quite disturbing to read this, even knowing what happened and how it ended.

I will have it translated for the others. Thank you, {NAME}.

73115.title: Journal Entry: Silence
73115.completion:
A silence that lasted for how many thousands of years all because of one order.

And to think I would have followed such an order without question until the day of my death.

Thank you for bringing this journal entry to me, {NAME}. I will add it to our translations.

73120.title: Appetizing Aftermath
73120.description:
Today's activities were interrupted by a spontaneous food fight. This has attracted several undesirable visitors to the daycare!

Please help clean up.
73120.progress: It is interesting, being a janitor, educator, and minder, but I suppose that is what all caretakers become.
73120.completion:
I wish it were possible for all this to just stay clean for a few minutes!

In any case, thank you, {NAME}.
73120.objectives: Help put the Little Scales Daycare back into order.

73128.title: Off the Page
73128.description:
$p, the whelps are begging us to tell them a story from their favorite anthology, but we are absolutely exhausted.

The book the whelps gravitate towards is enchanted and makes every retelling a workout.

Would you mind taking over for a spell and tackle story time for us?
73128.progress: I have heard these stories many times now. Battling them every day is tiring, to say the least.
73128.completion:
Once the whelps learned we could conjure story elements to display them, they demanded all stories be told in that manner.

Thank you for giving us the chance to rest!
73128.objectives: Battle the villains of various stories for the whelps at the Little Scales Daycare.

73130.title: Fowl Runic Scribblings
73130.description:
Our magic rune lesson yesterday has apparently bled into today. The whelps are keen on practicing their runes anywhere they can, prudent or not.

This fascination has led to an interesting playtime period! Please, help us return the toys to their proper place and dispel any runes you come across.
73130.progress:
We really ought to teach them runes for something helpful, like stone polishing...

That would have gone a long way here.
73130.completion:
Thank you for the assistance, {NAME}. That sandbox has a mind of its own! 

We will do our best to keep the whelps from stirring it up again via runes.
73130.objectives: Help put the Little Scales Daycare back into order.

73131.title: Dignified Disguises
73131.description:
$p! I have crafted masterful disguises for me and my friends, but there is only one way to know if they are perfect.

Let's play hide and seek! Find us in Valdrakken and I will know my disguises need work!
73131.completion:
That was fun! And now I have new inspiration for the disguises. I am going to go work on them right away!

You can go now!
73131.objectives: Find Belastrasza and her friends in Valdrakken.

73135.title: Obsidian Obfuscation
73135.description:
Hi, $p.

<Ruszi looks around nervously.>

Do you want to play hide and seek with me? I think it would be very good training. 

I need to watch out for danger, so it is good to know where to hide. Will you help me practice?
73135.progress: If I am hiding, then maybe they will not find me!
73135.completion:
You found all of us! I think I am getting better at hiding. I cannot wait to play again!

<Ruszi does a spin.>

This was super super fun!
73135.objectives: Find Ruszi and her friends in Valdrakken.

73137.title: Chasing the Flame
73137.description:
"He awaits you in the darkness"?

<Emberthal's eyes narrow.>

I know where Sarkareth is.

I'll need your help holding him to account. If you want, you could stay here a while and pick through these ruins, but I think we have more pressing needs at hand. If you're willing to see this through to the end, then I need you to follow me.

I'm going to Dragonskull Island.
73137.completion:
I knew you'd come. 

Thank you, {NAME}.
73137.objectives: Meet Scalecommander Emberthal on Dragonskull Island.

73139.title: Deep Sea Supplies
73139.description:
We are accustomed to threats emerging from the sea. But there are some enemies that should never be allowed on our shores.

In the east, naga are advancing on our beaches and coves. They've brought supplies with them. If we could reduce the local naga population and seize their supplies, our chances of survival here would increase.  

Here's the plan: take those supplies from their caches or their corpses, and slay their leader. Lives are on the line.
73139.completion: Thank you for facing waves and waves of naga. Their supplies will certainly help us support our settlement, so we can make a home here.
73139.objectives: Slay Farscale Naga and gather their supplies.

73140.title: Sunder the Crater
73140.description:
The Primalists have moved into Stormsunder Crater. They're raising elementals and exploiting the land.

They should be dealt with in a swift and decisive manner. Thin their ranks. Destroy their totems. Help us make the Forbidden Reach safe for the dracthyr, the tuskarr, and all the dispossessed who want to call it home again.
73140.progress: Have you taken care of the Primalists in Stormsunder Crater?
73140.completion: Well done. You just did some serious damage to their plans here in the Forbidden Reach.

73141.title: Everburning Embers
73141.description:
Warmth and heat are constant concerns for us at the homestead. We don't want to burn through everything we brought, and we don't like collecting driftwood on hostile shores. Too risky!

The Primalists, though, carry some of their own fire with them.

If you could slay some powerful fire Primalists, take their Everburning Embers, and bring those embers back here, we could make good use of them.
73141.progress: Everburning Embers could certainly help keep the camp warm all year round.
73141.completion:
These are perfect! They will help keep us warm on the coldest nights. Even when the weather is terrible, they will help keep the cooking fires lit.

Thank you! May you always have a warm welcome here.
73141.objectives: Collect Everburning Embers from powerful fire Primalists in the Siege Creche.

73142.title: Busting Blues
73142.description:
Malygos left behind forces to monitor us while we slept. He's gone, but his minions are still here, making life difficult for everyone.

Scouts have seen them using Arcane Foci. I think we could make better use of them. Go collect some. Their security forces might put up a fight, but that won't be a problem for you, will it?

<Cindrethresh snorts.>

Maybe they'll take the hint and leave.
73142.completion: That's a relief. Thank you. Now we can all sleep a little better at night.
73142.objectives: Collect Arcane Foci from Blue Security forces in the Old Weyrn grounds.

73155.title: The Forgotten Ring
73155.description: <The ring bears unusual markings. It might be of interest to one of the dracthyr at Morqut Village.>
73155.completion:
Oh! I have not seen a relic like this since before our awakening! It is a special ring, clearly crafted by Neltharion's smiths.

You should keep it. Keep it close. It might be of use to you.
73155.objectives: Deliver the ring to Researcher Imareth at Morqut Village.

73156.title: Return to Viridia
73156.description:
I should entrust you to Viridia. She's working with the Healing Wings in Morqut Village to build a safe place for the dracthyr, the tuskarr, and our other allies in the Reach.

We have a home here... and I... I have some thinking to do. I'm grateful that you walked beside me through this trial.

This isn't over. But at least I know that the next time we face Sarkareth, we can count on you. Thank you.
73156.completion:
Welcome back, {NAME}. I can tell from the look on your face that wasn't easy.

I'm not looking forward to dealing with Sarkareth again, but we'll be ready next time. For now, we have more pressing matters at hand. We won't be done until we've made the Reach safe for everyone.
73156.objectives: Meet with Viridia in Morqut Village at the Forbidden Reach.

73157.title: Wings of Mercy
73157.description:
With the lifting of the storms, we dispatched scout teams to explore the island. 

Several of our teams have not returned. We fear they may have fallen to unknown dangers.

Can you search the island for them? Once you locate them, use the Mender's Signal to summon a medic.
73157.completion: I am grateful for the help you have given our scouts.
73157.objectives: Aid Dracthyr Scouts at three locations on the Forbidden Reach.

73159.title: Exploring Our Past
73159.description:
With your help, we can now delve deeper into the secrets of this land.

Nearby lay the Zskera Vaults. Within these large underground chambers, Neltharion stored various treasures and forgotten research. Exploring these vaults would be most beneficial.

Please travel with Tacha and Jeb and assist them as needed.
73159.completion: Behind these massive doors lies a multitude of chambers to explore. Are you ready, {NAME}?
73159.objectives: Meet Jeb and Tacha at the entrance to the Zskera Vaults.

73160.title: Helping Hand and Claw
73160.description:
Members of the Dragonscale Expedition traveled here to help explore ruins on this island. Their efforts may help us uncover more details about our past.

My scouts have spotted three of them shipwrecked on Sharpscale Coast. See if you can help them reach the village safely.
73160.progress: Is it safe to travel to Morqut Village?
73160.completion:
With your help, Jeb and I are safe. And our supplies are safe, too!

A tuskarr fisherman has agreed to give us a lift to Morqut Village. We hope to see you there soon.
73160.objectives: Aid Jeb, Tacha, and Wulferd at the Sharpscale Coast.

73169.title: The Lunar Festival
73169.description: It's that time of the year, {NAME}! The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in a celebration of the Lunar Festival. You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in Stormwind at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight. She can tell you more about the holiday.

73170.title: The Lunar Festival
73170.description: It's that time of the year, {NAME}! The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in a celebration of the Lunar Festival. You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in Orgrimmar at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight. She can tell you more about the holiday.

73171.title: Gain New Look: Maiev
73171.progress:
Apply a Rumble Foil to your Warcraft Rumble Mini and gain a new look!
Rumble Foil (1)

73173.title: Gain Even Newer Look: Maiev
73173.progress:
Apply a another Rumble Foil to your Warcraft Rumble Mini and gain an even NEWER look!
Rumble Foil (1)

73174.title: Gain New Look: Sneed
73174.progress:
Apply a Rumble Foil to your Warcraft Rumble Mini and gain a new look!
Rumble Foil (1)

73175.title: Gain Even Newer Look: Sneed
73175.progress:
Apply a another Rumble Foil to your Warcraft Rumble Mini and gain an even NEWER look!
Rumble Foil (1)

73178.title: Hands Off Our Booty!
73178.description:
The Irontide Pirates have been stealing from dracthyr and tuskarr. They're taking anything and everything. It's all just booty to them!

You should recover our stolen goods. Make them regret coming here.
73178.progress: Did you teach those pirates a lesson?
73178.objectives: Defeat Irontide Pirates and recover Stolen Goods.

73179.title: Soupocalypse Now!
73179.description:
The Irontide pirates think they can sail in and take over the islands. They clearly have no idea who they are dealing with. Our Morqut friends will provide you with the transportation. We dracthyr will provide the... munitions.

<Cindrethresh smirks.>

Fusethrian has been trying to learn to cook the tuskarr way with mixed results. Ask him for his more volatile attempts. We can get some safe disposal and run off these pirates in one go!
73179.progress: Did you teach those pirates not to sail into our waters?
73179.completion: Heh. I love the smell of soup-based munitions in the morning. Smells like victory.
73179.objectives: Defeat Irontide Pirates to drive off the invasion.

73181.title: Zeroing Debt
73181.description:
I do hope that is the last we see of the Baron. Truth be told, I respect his seat of power in Stranglethorn.

We were lucky to find Zeros still alive. He must have developed quite the positive relationship with the Baron before all this nonsense, or else he would not have been given so much time.

Let us return to the Archives.
73181.completion: I am rather spent from this mission, {NAME}. Let me rest for awhile.

73183.title: Wanna Play a Game?
73183.description:
<You open a scribbled note.>

Heya pal! The name's Mizzen, and I hear you're pretty good at findin' stuff.

See, I've been playin' this new game called Warcraft Rumble but I'm fresh outta coins.

How about we meet up and I'll tell you where to find some?
73183.completion:
Hey there, glad you could make it!

You gotta check out this machine!

73188.title: The Sullied Banner
73188.description:
So long as there has been magic, there have been those willing to utilize it for nefarious ends.

I am not certain what grievances these rogue mages hold that has prompted Surigosa to chase them down, but I am inclined to trust her judgment on the matter. Let us go to her, {NAME}; perhaps we can solve this rogue mage problem and convince Surigosa to return in a single turn.
73188.completion: Greetings, mortal. You and your hangers-on have arrived just in time to see me obliterate this pack of miscreant magi.

73189.title: Creche Cache
73189.description:
I'm glad you're here. Beetles infected our support creche, so we evacuated in a hurry. That meant leaving a lot of supplies behind.

Now we've got a lot of injured explorers, and we could sure use those supplies. Can you help us?

We need you to retrieve as many as you can. Just don't let the toxins get to you.
73189.progress: Hey, have you retrieved those supplies?
73189.completion: Thank the Aspects! These supplies will go a long way to getting us back on our feet. Thank you.
73189.objectives: Collect 6 Mender Supplies in the Support Creche.

73190.title: Toxic Infestation
73190.description:
The Healing Wings need access to our support creche, but it's still overflowing with an infestation of toxic beetles.

I'm sure Viridia would appreciate it if we helped exterminate those pests.
73190.completion: We're clearing out that infestation, day by day. Every bit helps. Only a matter of time until those beetles are gone forever!
73190.objectives: Kill beetles in the Caldera of the Menders.

73191.title: Snake Wrangling
73191.description:
The same toxins that plague our Support Creche are seeping into migrating watersnakes.

We need to relocate the snakes back to their original pools. If we don't, that invasive species is going to wreak havoc on the environment.

I can loan you a friendly water elemental to help you transport the snakes. It's for our own safety as much as theirs.
73191.completion: This is great! We're really making progress revitalizing the Caldera of the Menders.
73191.objectives: Relocate 6 Toxic Watersnakes to the pools in the Caldera of the Menders.

73192.title: Feathered Fiend
73192.description: The trinket appears to be some sort of Noblegarden decoration. It should probably be returned to the festivities in Goldshire.
73192.completion: Ah, thank you for returning this. I'll see to it that any stolen decorations are restored!

73194.title: Up Close and Personal
73194.description:
The great proto-dragons are some of the fiercest creatures to roam the Forbidden Reach.

Taking them down isn't easy, but we have many weapons in our arsenal.

Take this spear and harpoon. You'll need them. If you get caught in a proto-drake's maw, you'll need to fight tooth and claw with everything you've got to survive.

It isn't easy, but I know you can do this.
73194.completion: That's the way to do it! Nothing like being caught in the jaws of death to make you feel alive.
73194.objectives: Slay a proto-dragon using the Proto-Killing Spear.

73196.title: Tarecgosa's Rest
73196.description:
{NAME}, hold a moment.

Before you leave... I have one more thing that needs to be done. There is one last member of my kin that deserves rest.
73196.completion: This feels as if I am saying goodbye to a piece of myself, but it must be done.

73197.title: Love Unending
73197.description:
Alongside a proper conduit to house Tarecgosa's soul during the ritual, we need enough magical essence to ground the flower. The bronze dragonflight was involved in creating the staff you hold, so I believe it best we use their magic again.

Some of the sand within the Temporal Conflux should suit this purpose perfectly. Just make sure it's of the more magical variety.
73197.progress: How goes the hunt for the sand?
73197.completion: Time is a fickle thing even when it flows properly. I do not understand how my kin can master it.
73197.objectives: Gather Ephemeral Sand from the Temporal Conflux.

73198.title: Forget Her Not
73198.description:
The staff was made with the bough of a world tree, so the receptacle that the soul is transferred to needs to be comparable. Within the adverse conditions of Vakthros there may be a flower that is tenacious enough to grow.

However, it will be fragile given the circumstances. Find it, and then bring it to one of the green dragonflight's groves to help strengthen it.
73198.progress: Did you find it? It grows very rarely.
73198.completion: The flower only grows in specific conditions and due to that it contains quite a bit of magical energy. This should be a perfect conduit for Tarecgosa.
73198.objectives: Collect a Manaheart flower and bring it to the Ancient Bough to bloom.

73199.title: Rhapsody in Blue
73199.description:
It is time. I cannot delay this any longer.

Let us say our farewells.
73199.completion:
<Kalecgos holds silent for a moment.>

Thank you, friend.
73199.objectives: Assist Kalecgos in sending off Tarecgosa.

73227.title: Jade Forest
73227.description:
Daughter of Malygos and Saragosa, Kirygosa survived the turbulent Nexus War that ripped away her life and family.

Afterwards, Kirygosa sought a permanent summer in Stranglethorn. Finding warmth but not quite peace, she moved on to Dawn's Blossom, a small village nestled in the Jade Forest.

The blue dragonflight would welcome her return.
73227.completion: ...Kiry. Yes, I know where she is.
73227.objectives: Speak to Kalecgos for more information.

Apply a Rumble Foil to your Warcraft Rumble Mini and gain a new look!

73398.title: Too Far Forward
73398.description:
Our forward forces pressed too aggressively into a Sundered Flame stronghold. Now they need help. We really need to send you in to extract them.

Help them get out of there. You can use your own magic or these healing draughts from Viridia. And while you're there? Put some hurt on the Sundered Flame. They certainly deserve it.
73398.completion: It's good to see our forces returned safely, even if their pride is a little wounded. We need every soldier we have for what's to come.
73398.objectives: Slay Sundered Flame and heal injured Dark Talons and Obsidian Warders.

73399.title: The Search for Blue Dragons
73399.description:
Thank you for your help so far, {NAME}. We've still got more blue dragons to track down.

I'll give you the honors of choosing where to go next.
73399.objectives: Choose an area to investigate the missing blue dragons.

73404.title: Lost Blue Dragons
73404.description:
The Azure Archives are starting to feel much more lively, thanks to your help.

Choose which location you'd like to investigate next.
73404.objectives: Choose an area to investigate the missing blue dragons.

73405.title: A Pair of Blue Dragons
73405.description:
I appreciate your aid so far, {NAME}. 

Where would you like to look next?
73405.objectives: Choose an area to investigate the missing blue dragons.

73406.title: The Last Missing Blue Dragon
73406.description:
We've only one more blue dragon to locate now, {NAME}.

Let's finish this, shall we?
73406.objectives: Choose an area to investigate the missing blue dragons.

73550.title: Honeyfreeze Mead
73550.description:
Right, so now that we've established somewhat friendlier relations and learned a wee bit of Winterpelt, it's about time tae make friends in the proper dwarf manner.

What gesture of friendship is better than a stiff drink tae ward off tae cold? Both dwarves and furbolgs have a long history of brewin', so we can call it somethin' of a cultural exchange too!

I saw some hearty lookin' bees a bit south of here. And where there's bees, there's honey. And where there's honey, there could be mead.
73550.progress: I can almost taste it already.
73550.objectives: Collect 8 Honeyfreeze Honey for Sonova Snowden.

73692.title: Hive Maintenance
73692.description:
It wouldn't do tae steal a hive's honey without ensurin' they have enough food tae make it through the cold. Especially if we might want more down the line.

Frostbell pollen's sticky stuff an' a wee bit fragile. But if ye run through some of the bloomin' plants, it'll be on ye like fleas on a kobold.

Then, all ye have to do is bring it back tae a bee afore it blows away--they'll lick it right off ye! Tickles a bit too!
73692.progress: It's a rough life out there for a wee bee.
73692.completion: That ought tae keep 'em goin' for a while.
73692.objectives: Bring pollen to the Honeyfreeze bees.

73694.title: Stuck in Stasis
73694.description:
When the first dracthyr awakened from millennia of slumber, we left the Forbidden Reach for the Dragon Isles. Yet not all of the dracthyr are free. Some are still in stasis, hidden deep within their creches.

We need your help. Travel to Froststone Vault. See if you can find more of our friends. One of my Healing Wings would be glad to accompany you. Choose someone who best suits your need.

It is time for all dracthyr to rejoin the world as we have.
73694.completion:
It warms my heart to see so many new arrivals. We will do our best to orient them on all the changes in the world since they were last awake.

Thank you, friend.
73694.objectives: Free dracthyr trapped in stasis within Froststone Vault.

73703.title: A Summon to Orgrimmar
73703.description:
{NAME}, Eitrigg has requested your presence in Grommash Hold. 

He seemed like he had much to tell you.
73703.completion: Ah, {NAME}. Thank you for coming. We have much to talk about.
73703.objectives: Speak to Eitrigg in Grommash Hold, Orgrimmar.

73704.title: Local Flavors
73704.description:
Now that we have the base o' the brew figured out, we need tae add the spice.

Put that rudimentary Winterpelt I taught ye tae use and ask around for local ingredients tae blend into the flavor profile. Try talkin' with Kazzi. From what I gather she's somethin' of a trader. 

The finished brew will be a mix of dwarven and Winterpelt traditions which seems appropriate for the circumstances.

An' if we're lucky, it won't taste half bad!
73704.progress:
Get out there an' ask. She won't bite.

Unless ya inadvertently ask her tae, I suppose.
73704.completion: Right, let's see what we can do with these.
73704.objectives: Ask Kazzi for ingredients to flavor the brew.

73707.title: TICKET: Glimmerogg Games
73707.description:
<Written in sloppy handwriting that makes it almost impossible to read.>

CONGRATULATIONS, LOAMM VISITOR! YOU'VE FOUND A TICKET TO THE BEST COMPETITION IN ZARALEK CAVERN: THE GLIMMEROGG GAMES!

You'll find the games in the south of ZARALEK CAVERN. Just look for a bunch of happy drogbar! Don't miss our fun activities like...

<The rest of the page is illegible except for the name "Brogg.">
73707.completion:
Lucky you! You found a ticket to the Glimmerogg Games!

Now, that isn't all you need to get in, brul.
