73707.objectives: Pay a visit to Glimmerogg in the south of Zaralek Cavern.

73708.title: Pay to Play
73708.description:
It doesn't matter if you were invited or if you just showed up. Drogbar, niffen, or {race}, everyone pays for the Glimmerogg Games! 

Even I did, and I'm runnin' this show!

<Brogg points aggressively to a ticket of his own.>

I know you can't pay in drogdollars, but you can pay in snacks for everyone. And we love mushrooms and fish! Bring Brogg some food, and we're square, okay?
73708.progress: Have the fee in full? And no, can't pay later. Brogg had enough from deadbeats.
73708.completion:
Good work, uplander. Now Brogg has snacks for the week!

...I mean, we have snacks for everyone!

Now, get out of here. And have some fun, brul!
73708.objectives: Collect 4 Glimmer Mushrooms and 4 Echoed Lurker Flesh near Glimmerogg.

73709.title: Favor on the Side
73709.description:
Brogg counts more people than fees today. It's not sitting well with me neither. I'm gonna blow my top!

Sure, Glimmerogg is popular, but it's not all fun and games. We have rules and everyone must follow them.

You look like someone who can read fine print and follow rules. If you get rid of the intruders that are cheating Brogg, I may have something for you.
73709.completion:
Brogg thanks your good eye and discipline, little brul. 

Remember to play by the rules... If a rock lifts by itself, somebody is cheating.
73709.objectives: Uncover 6 intruders and kick them off the Glimmerogg Games.

73710.title: Rock By Rock
73710.description:
Ah, a challenger! So, you think you can defeat Storul Heavystone in his famous rock-lifting marathon challenge? 

HA! Silly uplander. No one can compare to Storul! No one has EVER matched my strength.

But maybe you try. Defeat will teach you a valuable lesson: true strength comes from struggle!

Or, Storul will have a new friend to spot him at the gym! Get it, brul!
73710.progress:
What? You're not afraid to lose, are you? Don't let fear consume you before you start.

Just do it, brul. Storul will give you a fair trial.
73710.completion:
Good, brul, good! You a weakling no more! 

But even though you've proved you can lift as much as me, you're still not as great as Storul. 

Not yet.

There are more rocks ahead for a great challenger like you.
73710.objectives: Complete Storul Heavystone's weight lifting spree.

73711.title: Marked Champion
73711.description:
You did good on Storul's challenge, but that does not make you a champion like him.

To get on my level, you have to lift the greatest rock--not a real rock, a spirit one.

You must face what every drogbar fears... and venerates! You must be blessed by the Carcaxas, The Great Daughter-Worm.

But Carcaxas only bestow her mark on those who are DETERMINED and don't FEAR SMELLING BAD!

Are you ready to take on this challenge? CAN YOU DO IT, BRUL!?
73711.progress:
Did you get your blessing from The Great Daughter-Worm? No? 

You're not visualizing hard enough. See yourself beating Carcaxas. Now go!
73711.completion:
{race}! I can smell Carcaxas's mark upon you.

The Great Daughter-Worm made you a champion like me! Strorul can tell you are stronger. You SMELL stronger!

Now you can lift every rock in your path. Remember to stay focused. Greatness requires constant physical and mental strength. One day you'll be as great as Storul. That is the Glimmerogg way!

And don't forget--we spotting partners now. See you in the gym next weekend.

73715.title: Driftwood Derby
73715.description:
One of the challenges of any new village is finding enough raw building materials. Fortunately, the ocean often brings us exactly what we need.

Take my boat and sail around the island. Along the way, you can collect driftwood in nets. But be wary. You may attract some unwanted attention!
73715.progress: How goes the hunt for driftwood?
73715.completion:
Excellent work! This will help us build new homes, tools, and everything we need for a life here.

We'll put it all to good use.

74117.title: Rare Prey
74117.description: Rare and dangerous creatures lurk around the creches of the Forbidden Reach. If you and your allies want to stay safe, you should hunt down these threats.
74117.progress: Are there still dangers roaming the land?
74117.completion: I'm glad you dealt with those threats. I'm sure they got what they deserved.
74117.objectives: Hunt down the special threats across the Forbidden Reach.

74118.title: Spelunking the Den
74118.description:
Did you have a chance to visit the Skyfox Den? A very exciting place, from what I've heard. Expedition's spelunkers started surveying the cave and even installed a few grappling hooks on the ceiling, but they were scared away by violent slyverns.

Can you do me a favor? Get inside the Skyfox Den, grab the abandoned gear, and check the ceiling for any hidden crevices. Who knows what could be hidden inside?
74118.completion: Well done! My research and writing never end. I'm glad you've seen what's in the den firsthand.
74118.objectives: Explore the Skyfox Den's ceiling using Dragonscale Expedition climbing gear inside the cave.

74119.title: Angler's Challenge
74119.description:
Say, have you noticed how good the fishing is around here? Dragonskull Island seems like it would have some great spots to cast a line. 

Why don't you go there and catch something for dinner? Be mindful, though. We still need to set some of our catch aside for later.
74119.progress: My belly's rumbling... can't wait for those fresh fish!
74119.completion: We'll have a feast tonight, thanks to you!
74119.objectives: Catch or restock fish in the Dragonskull Fishing Hole.

74282.title: Authentic Authorization
74282.description:
The importance of this expedition can not be understated. I assure you, all who participate will have a place in history... along with me, of course!

If I can make one remarkable discovery, my scholarly legacy will be assured! But what will we find? A copy of Neltharion's signature? One of his personal letters? Can't wait to find something to share with my fans. Also, I'll have more fans!

If you would be so kind as to find me something memorable, I'll offer you suitable remuneration! I can pay!
74282.completion:
What an amazing find. The mind reels. 

Oh, and I can't wait to write about this discovery and publish our findings. We will publish... or perish trying!
74282.objectives: Find a Sealed Letter to Neltharion.

74291.title: Blue is My Favorite Color
74291.description:
Oh, Kiry's here! I wonder if she has made her decision.

Please ask her for thoughts, $p.
74291.objectives: Speak to Kirygosa and then return to the Azure Archives.

74293.title: Not Forgotten
74293.description: Viridia is confident that more dracthyr may slumber in these chambers, long forgotten amongst Neltharion's relics.
74293.completion:
It warms my heart to see so many new arrivals. We will do our best to orient them to the changes since they were last awake.

Thank you, friend.
74293.objectives: Free dracthyr trapped in stasis within the Zskera Vaults.

74294.title: The Keys You Need
74294.description:
Can I trust you? These are the only keys we have. If we lose them, we can't open any locked doors.

Here. Take them. Use them on the doors within this chamber. You look like a hero. Be bold! Throw those doors wide! You'll find glory or... um... something that is not glory but is still amazing! Just don't die.

We might find more, but we'll have to search the island to find them.
74294.completion: Be sure to not to lose those keys. Did I say that? I think I said that.
74294.objectives: Take the keys from Tacha at the Zskera Vaults.

74334.title: Future Aspects
74334.description:
My brothers are not interested in investigating the Sundered Flame or helping Emberthal. 

It worries me that we are dividing our efforts, but I understand their motivation in considering our next steps against Fyrakk immediately.

I will aid Emberthal as I promised, but perhaps we should ask for help from the local niffen...
74334.completion: Thank you for continuing to aid us, {NAME}. Emberthal will fill you in on what we have discovered so far.

74335.title: A Moment of Reflection
74335.description:
I do not understand what would drive Turi Flickerflame and her band of mages to attempt what they have done here today. But I do understand the pain of losing family. I understand the fear and regret that follows you wherever you go.

I have much to think about. I imagine Kalecgos has much yet to do in the Dragon Isles--return there with him. I will follow soon... I need some time to think upon what happened here today.
74335.completion:
Surigosa and Azuregos are hardly the only members of my flight to question my more measured approach to the misuse of magic. I'm glad for their perspectives--and their willingness to check my optimism.

Still, I hope that they will come to see things as I do now.

Come. We have much yet to do.
74335.objectives: Return to Kalecgos in the Azure Span.

74354.title: Artifacts Abound
74354.description:
It is... certainly bizarre to see Sindragosa, real in all but the flesh.

Look, I appreciate that you have both come all this way for me. The Isles sounds delightful, but I have dedicated many years to cleaning up Winterspring. I am not about to leave a job unfinished. Magic is abound and unfortunately not all good.

If you would like to help, The Hidden Grove is next on my list. Therein lie ruins of totems that still emanate with some sort of magic. Will you collect pieces of them?
74354.progress: And that one, I suppose, is harmless enough...
74354.completion: Thank you. Now, to take a closer look at these.
74354.objectives: Collect 5 Totemic Ruins from the Hidden Grove.

74355.title: Primordial Embellishment
74355.description:
How remarkable! You can affix such a variety of special gems to enhance its power!

You should journey back into the Zskera Vaults and locate a Primordial Jeweler's Kit. Yes, that's what you'll need.

Crafting gems of this type requires specialized tools. Once we have them, we can fully explore the ring's power! The mind reels with limitless possibilities...
74355.completion:
There's far more here than I expected! 

I never dreamt to see such wonders. With these tools, we could even craft another ring! Just in case you lose that one... or, say, want to give one to... 

Oh, forgive me! I am presumptuous. It's just so... wonderful.
74355.objectives: Collect the Primordial Jeweler's Kit and the Primordial Anvil from the Zskera Vaults.

74356.title: Back with the Blues
74356.description:
It seems I had a good idea.

Now let us hope we can broach the subject of the Isles again. I am glad to see Haleh relaxed. She deserves it.
74356.completion:
We shall have to find Haleh a hot springs here, too. 

<Sindragosa smiles.>

74359.title: Plunder Siege
74359.description:
We're not the only ones to have noticed the storms abating over the Forbidden Reach. 

Other interested parties have arrived too, looting everything they can and storing their spoils in chests. If they use Neltharion's old hoard chests, they're in for a surprise when the chests' enchantments lock them out. We'll need to clear out surrounding looters to break the chests' enchantments.

See if you can recover a stolen item, specifically my old journal. It's nowhere to be found.
74359.progress: Were you able to find it?
74359.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}.

My world has changed so drastically since I last wrote in this. It will be an interesting read, given what I know now.
74359.objectives: Recover Atrenosh's Journal from chests within the Forbidden Reach.

74374.title: An Important Heirloom
74374.description:
I can guide you in crafting your offering to the ancestors, but you will need two things:

First, you need to know the basics! Arugi here can teach you how to cook if you don't already know.

Second, I need my old cookbook. We're going to make something truly special, a fusion of old Draenor and Azeroth, and I'm going to need it for reference. 

Go fetch my book from the inn, and we can get started.
74374.progress: Did you find my book? It's somewhere inside the inn.
74374.completion:
Ah, here we are. It may not look like much, but this old thing made it through the Dark Portal! 

It's a family heirloom from before the Horde. Unusual for an {race}, I know. My great grandmother, Cook Barasha, collected recipes from all the clans at each Kosh'harg. As I understand it, she didn't trust anyone else to get it right, so she wrote it all down! We have stories of her awesome stubbornness...

Enough reminiscing! Time to get cooking! Hope you're ready, we have some work ahead of us.
74374.objectives: Learn the basics of cooking and retrieve Cook Torka's cookbook.

74375.title: Collating Their Research
74375.description:
It no longer matters how the Sundered Flame got here; now we need to know why. What is in this vault that Sarkareth is after?

{NAME}, while you are in their camp, look for notes, research papers, journals--anything you can find that might reveal their intentions. Please bring whatever you find to me.
74375.progress: Were you able to learn anything yet?
74375.completion:
The information in these notes is... troubling, but it does not tell me why Sarkareth is trying to find and enter Aberrus.

The only way to know will be to catch up to him.
74375.objectives: Find out why the Sundered Flame expedition is in Zaralek Cavern.

74376.title: Coalesced Storm Remnants
74376.description: The Primalist Researchers in the area will be interested in this for further study.
74376.completion: Fascinating! I'll relay my findings to the other researchers in Valdrakken.
74376.objectives: Bring the Coalesced Storm Remnants to Brendormi in the Primalist Tomorrow.

74379.title: Still Within Reach
74379.description:
While we dracthyr were kept in stasis, the Spellsworn, ancient servants of Malygos the Spellweaver, were our wardens. However, despite being slain years ago, the late Aspect's forces are still loyal to him and his lasting directive to keep this island contained. They present a danger to any dracthyr still lost, wounded, or otherwise unaccounted for.

Scouts have reported the sighting of a rather large Spellsworn brute hunting for escaped dracthyr. This deadly pursuer must be dealt with.
74379.completion:
Thank you, {class}. You have diminished the risk to our rescue and recovery operations around the Forbidden Reach.

It may be too late for some, but know that other sets of wings will be able to fly home because of your actions.
74379.objectives: Kill the Spellsworn Wingcatcher at the Old Weyrn Grounds in the Forbidden Reach.

74381.title: Hidden Legacies
74381.description:
Raszageth and her storms are gone, but our troubles are far from over.

The way to the Reach is clear again, and some of our allies have returned to establish a base camp. However, Sarkareth and the Sundered Flame have begun making their way there as well.

We need to secure the island. We would appreciate your aid.
74381.progress: Ah, an adventurer! Did Emberthal send you?
74381.completion:
Thankfully, our enemies have not discovered our scouts. The Incarnates and the Sundered Flame are both formidable foes. I'm uncertain whether we'll be able to safely monitor them again without retribution.

The situation is heating up. Some of the dracthyr have already returned to the island, but they're going to need a lot of help building up their base of operations.

You're about to be very busy, friend.
74381.objectives: Speak to the Healing Wings Envoy at the Seat of the Aspects to learn about events in the Forbidden Reach.

74389.title: Filming the Caldera
74389.description:
The arthropods in Caldera of the Menders are truly vicious. One of our gyrocopters went missing there!

Our expedition sent a unmanned surveillance aircraft there, but it hasn't returned. Can you find the gyrocopter? You could use it to capture the Caldera's wildlife on camera?
74389.completion: Well done! Extensive photography makes our documentation complete!
74389.objectives: Fly over the Caldera of the Menders and capture local wildlife on your camera.

74390.title: Brutal Prey
74390.description:
This land is crawling with opportunities for a skilled hunter. We want you to join the hunt. 

Some threats are feral. Dare I say it, some are greatest threats are sentient and malevolent. If we all work together, we can make the Reach a safe haven, as it used to be.
74390.completion: I like how you deal with problems. I'm sure they got what they deserved.
74390.objectives: Hunt down elite creatures across the Forbidden Reach.

74391.title: Harpooner's Challenge
74391.description:
Say, have you noticed how good the fishing is around here? Dragonskull Island seems like it would have some great spots.

Why don't you go there and catch something for dinner? Be mindful, though. We still need to set some of our catch aside for later.
74391.progress: I can almost taste those fresh fish!
74391.completion: I've heard about "fine dining." I don't quite know what that is, but I know we'll eat well tonight!
74391.objectives: Gather 3 Lunker Morsels from Lunkers in Dragonskull Island Fishing Hole.

74393.title: Report: Battlefield Ruins
74393.description:
Our situation is worse than we thought. 

Their dominance of the air keeps us at a disadvantage. They plan on freeing their powerful Elder from Aberrus. Allowing them to accomplish this could result in us permanently forfeiting control of this area.

Seek out Field Commander Ignax in the Battlefield Ruins and see what can be done to turn the tide of this battle. We will join you shortly.
74393.completion: It is good to see an ally out here in the field. We could use one right now.
74393.objectives: Find Field Commander Ignax in the Battlefield Ruins.

74415.title: A Worthy Offering
74415.description:
Now that we have everything on the list, you just have to put it all together, right? How hard could it be?

Umm... I'm going to let you handle it, though. I'll watch.

<Cooking Recipes can be found under Orcish Cuisine in Classic Cooking.>
74415.completion:
You have done well. It is a rare thing for the ancestors to cross over and manifest before an offering. Yours must have been truly worthy. I hope Durak appreciates the honor that was just bestowed upon him, as well.

When the om'gora is finished, you should pass on the messages you received for the others. I think he would appreciate it.

<She offers you a quick wink.>
74415.objectives: Cook the orcish dishes and then place the Feast for the Ancestors at the offering stone.

74433.title: Returning the Blade
74433.description:
<This dagger, found buried in the chest of the giant worm Icebreaker, belonged to Saza. It is evident that Saza fought bravely, deeply wounding the monster before her death.

This blade should be brought back to the village to give her clan closure.>
74433.progress: That's... Saza's dagger. Why do you have her dagger? Oh...
74433.completion:
<Jyrra sighs as you tell her the news, her eyes dulled by tears.>

Thank you for bringing this dagger back and for telling us of her bravery. Saza fought hard for her family. As I would too.

I should have gone with you. If only...

I'm sorry, {NAME}. I am in your debt. 



Oh, I will miss you, little sister...
74433.objectives: Bring Saza's dagger to the Winterpelt.

74436.title: Storm Warning
74436.description:
Ah, {class}! I knew I would find you at the right place at the right time. 

The elements do not just threaten the Dragon Isles in our current time, but also from beyond. Go to the Temporal Conflux and travel through the rift into the future the primalists have overrun.

There, speak to Soridormi. She will have more details for you when you arrive.
74436.progress: It is good to see you again.
74436.completion: We meet again, {NAME}. We have more need for your help, I'm afraid.
74436.objectives: Speak to Soridormi in the Primalist Future. The portal to the Primalist Future can be found at the Temporal Conflux in Thaldraszus.

74437.title: Resisting the Storm
74437.description:
The Primalists are growing in strength in this future timeline, despite our best efforts. If they overrun this valley and threaten the Temporal Conflux, they may become a problem for the rest of the timeways.

We are already protecting the timeways from enough threats.

Push back on them, {NAME}. We need to keep this peril in check. Speak to Tarnormu to gather any supplies you might need.
74437.progress: We cannot let the Primalists become a threat to other periods in our history.
74437.completion:
You have been an inspiration to the few forces that still remain, {class}. 

The threat may be pushed back a little for now, but we must continue our vigil here so that the rest of the timeways are not in yet more dangers than before.
74437.objectives: Stock up on any necessary supplies and complete "The Storm's Fury" event in the Primalist Future.

74442.title: One Dragon's Junk...
74442.description:
Greetings! I am looking for items of power from my flight's past. 

We have a history of great warriors and battle prowess, and I want to recover items that will help us reach that again.

I heard you found these vaults. If you see anything of interest inside, could you show it to me?
74442.completion:
Oh, this is... definitely something?

It does not seem like it could be used as a weapon, but I suppose it is worth investigating. You never know.
74442.objectives: Locate an object for Voraxian within the Zskera Vaults.

74443.title: Is Another Dragon's Treasure?
74443.description:
I must admit, I am out of my depth here. 

It is of black dragon make. The decoration on the pommel matches, but I have no idea what it is. Which I suppose is the point.

I have heard you have travelled the Isles. Do you have any recommendations on who to talk to?
74443.progress:
It is a fascinating object. I am tempted to tell Evorian it's a weapon just to see what happens when he tries to use it... but I suppose not. It might actually be really dangerous.

Would be fun to see his scales singed a bit though.
74443.completion:
You think this Veritistrasz could help? I am willing to give it a shot!

Good suggestion, {NAME}.
74443.objectives: Talk to Voraxian in the Forbidden Reach.

74447.title: Verbal Archaeology
74447.description:
Where should we meet this Veritistrasz of yours?

Ruby Lifeshrine? Are you sure this is not an attempt to introduce me to Alexstrasza? 

No? Well then! I shall meet you at the Ruby Lifeshrine!
74447.progress: Let us hope this is something exciting!
74447.completion:
Well, that is a bit of a disappointment.

I suppose an old egg-tending device is some form of culture, even if it is not very exciting. 

If you find something else of interest in the vaults, I would be interested in looking at it.

74476.title: Slime Dies When You're Having Fun
74476.description:
The investigators here told me that there were some side effects to removing the time anomaly from Eon's Fringe. Seems a bunch of slimes snuck through the timestream in the process. 

Oh! Oh! Time slimes! They're Time slimes! Ha.

Anyway, could you take some of them out?
74476.completion: I recorded the sounds of you killing the slimes for reference. I hope that's okay.

74488.title: Runaway Rusziona
74488.description:
Black whelps have the agility of a rock, but they try to make up for it with the most impressive top speed. Try to take it easy around those corners!

[Eruption]: Dash forward.
[Rock Halt]: Stops forward movement.
[Earthen Will]: Restores all Vigor. Must be grounded.
74488.objectives: Help Rusziona glide through the rings.

74491.title: Pole Position Posidriss
74491.description:
Green whelps have an affinity for short naps and bursts of speed, so do your best to keep pace.

[Nature's Wind]: Fly up then restore 1 Vigor.
[Emerald Restraint]: Adds 5 sec to Winds of Life's duration.
[Winds of Life]: Anytime you restore Vigor, dash forward.
74491.objectives: Help Posidriss glide through the rings.

74492.title: Blistering Belastrasza
74492.description:
Red whelps can be a little out of control, so best of luck!

[Ruby Exhaustion]: Consumes all Vigor over time.
[Crimson Flight]: Restore all Vigor, boosting forward each time.
[Renewal]: Consumes Crimson Flight, resets cooldowns.
74492.objectives: Help Belastrasza glide through the rings.

74493.title: Second Time Is The Charm
74493.description:
<Voraxian bounces the Odd Round Object in his hands a few times.>

Hmm, it lands in the hand well, like it was made for this. Let us talk to Veritistrasz and see if he knows more.
74493.progress: Let us hope it is something exciting this time!
74493.completion:
By the Titans... talk about putting my claw in my jaw. 

Sorry {NAME}, I will sit here for a bit with Veritistrasz and wait until he is ready to talk again. 

If you find anything else of interest, please do bring it along.
74493.objectives: Determine the origin of the Odd Round Object.

74494.title: A Scale for a Scale
74494.description:
The elder waking was a threat, certainly. But there is one more mission I must complete before we depart, lest we lose our only chance to complete it at all.

However different the Zaqali tribe may be from the Qalashi, they are still dragonslayers. Their implements of war are no less deadly to our kind.

I need a spear on par with the one we saw at the elder's side. Find the largest one you can and deliver it to me.
74494.progress: Djaradin weapons are vile creations, but they were created for one task and one task alone.
74494.completion: This is the only way forward.
74494.objectives: Collect a Zaqali Dragonslayer's Spear for Sabellian.

74495.title: The Tale of Hraxian
74495.description:
Hello {NAME}, it is good to see you.

Would you like to join us around the fire? I think it is time we heard a positive story about the obsidian flight of old.

I once promised yourself and Voraxian I would tell you the story from the vase you found in the Zskera Vaults. I believe it is that time.
74495.completion:
<Veritistrasz sits in silence for a short while.>

Thank you for listening, {NAME}. I have forgotten much over my life, but not this. 

I hope Hraxian's story gives the obsidian flight hope after the discoveries we made here.
74495.objectives: Listen to the tale of Hraxian.

74503.title: Another Gift
74503.progress:
OUTPUT: Additional gift access requires authorized token.
Neltharion Gift Token (1)
74503.completion:
OUTPUT: Please accept this GIFT. 

ADMINISTER GIFT DISTRIBUTION PROTOCOL.
74503.objectives: OUTPUT: Additional gift access requires authorized token.

74514.title: The Slowest Fan Club
74514.description:
Has a crowd ever roared for you? Everyone shouting your name, pushing you on to victory? 

I want to give that same feeling to Slick. Give him the taste of being a champion.

Course, we don't speak snail, so we can only be so useful. Round up some snails that could use purpose in their lives. Slick needs a fan club.
74514.progress: A race track ain't no race track without fans to watch the race. That's just facts.
74514.completion: Perfect! Stick some Big Slick in the City merchandise on these critters and they're ready to go. Our boy's going to be more motivated than ever.

74515.title: Snail Mail
74515.description:
Racing snails are all about speed, but riding snails? They need stamina to boot.

I owe some supplies to a buddy in Loamm. Why don't you make the delivery for me? Help build Slick's endurance.

Oh, and make sure you don't dismount. Not much of a training session if you keep hopping off and on.
74515.progress: This buddy of mine, always asking for supplies. I got snails to train!
74515.completion: Speed and stamina! This snail has it all, folks. Well done.

74516.title: A Snail's Pace
74516.description:
It's an off day for our local racing track, so I figured we could take the opportunity to build up Slick's speed. Grow some confidence on his home turf, I'm thinking.

Take two laps around the track. Let's see how your training is coming along!
74516.progress: Not every day needs to be at a hundred, you know? Even in the fast-paced world of snail racing.
74516.completion:
Look at you two, tighter than mucus brothers. Oh, that's what I call it when two snails get stuck to each other. Happens.

You're both coming along just fine. Can't wait to see where you go!
74516.objectives: Collect 1 Lap Markers by doing two laps around the snail track.

74517.title: All Terrain Snail
74517.description:
While life in these caverns is plenty exciting, Slick has a future in the world above. Namely as your trusty mount. 

Which means he needs to prepare for all sorts of environments.

Luckily, the Dragon Isles has biomes to spare. Why don't you take him for a spin? Give him a taste of what's to come. One lap per location should do the trick.
74517.progress: I don't do too well above ground, myself. All that sunlight and fresh air just plays havoc on my sinuses.
74517.completion:
Here comes Slick, traveler extraordinaire! Mucus seems alright, membranes nice and translucent, no cracks in the shell. 

Thanks for taking care of him.
74517.objectives: Ride Slick through Snail Markers in Restless Wetlands, Wanderer's Steppe, Upper Frostlands, and Shifting Sands.

74518.title: Resistance Training
74518.description:
These caverns aren't easy on my poor snails, which is why I feed them a special crystal diet. Keeps their shells hard and gleaming. 

Slick eats more than his fair share though, so I'm plumb out. 

Would you collect some crystals in Zaralek Cavern? Get a nice mix, too. We need to make sure Slicks ready for every environment.
74518.progress:
Everyone says they want their snails to have strong, healthy shells, but when it comes time to collect the crystals? They're too busy, they're too scared. 

Crokin' cowards..
74518.completion: That's the stuff! Just wait until you see how Slick's shell shines. Huh. Say that three times fast, am I right?
74518.objectives: Collect 5 Glowing Crystals, 5 Sulfuric Crystals, and 5 Magma Crystals from around Zaralek Cavern.

74519.title: Good for Goo
74519.description:
Every snail trainer knows that it's all about the goo. The slime. The mucus. That's how you turn a speedy snail into a champion.

Slick could use a good slather. Go out and collect some goo from the local slime trails to slick him up. Heh.
74519.completion: Now that's a slicked Slick if I ever did see one. Nice job.
74519.objectives: Collect Goo from slimes and oozes in Zaralek Cavern.

74520.title: Less Cargo
74520.description:
Those djaradin think they own these caverns, coming around here and looting our supplies. How am I supposed to train champions under these conditions?

Can you do me a favor and get those supplies back? I can't help you train Slick without them. 

Besides, the big fellow could use a rest day.
74520.progress: Shell polish, mucus paste, racing rocks... Crok it all, we need those supplies back!
74520.completion: Shell yeah! Way to put the work in. Now we can get back to Slick's training.
74520.objectives: Collect 10 Stolen Supplies from djaradin in Igira's Watch.

74521.title: A Flame, Extinguished
74521.description:
Sarkareth is no more.

His hubris left him vulnerable to the dark influences that have assaulted our flight for millennia. Just like Neltharion before him.

I believe Emberthal seeks more answers than what Wrathion and Sabellian are able to give. She may need some assistance.
74521.progress: Return to me if you'd like to help further.
74521.completion:
Here we are, {NAME}.

I admit that the black dragonflight's legacy is rife with moments that many would deem disreputable, vicious, or even vile.

So understand the weight of my words when I say that the contents of this edifice may be the worst of it.

74522.title: Remnants
74522.description:
Some call me a miracle, you know. Yet my birth was anything but natural. I was crafted, much as the creatures in here were crafted. Many died painful, tragic deaths so that I could live.

This... callousness towards the living is something I wish to eradicate.

Take this, and use it to destroy any intact specimen tanks we encounter. Nothing deserves to suffer like this.
74522.progress: We need to end this here.
74522.completion: Finally, the suffering of these abominations has come to an end.
74522.objectives: Destroy 7 Specimen Tanks with the Blacktalon Napalm.

74523.title: A Traitor's Due
74523.description:
These sycophants shame themselves and the black dragonflight. It is clear that they are willing to die in service of my father's dark machinations.

Let us not disappoint them.
74523.progress: We will never erase this mark on our legacy. But there is no way forward while they yet live.
74523.completion: Wrathion's Blacktalon may not be front-line soldiers, but they should be able to take care of the rest.

74525.title: Honorbound
74525.description:
<The djaradin's body is gaunt and wasted, its life energy siphoned away by the hungry machines that power this dark laboratory.

Perhaps there are other djaradin imprisoned here that can be spared from this horror.>
74525.progress: The black dragonflight is defined by our actions, not our accomplishments.
74525.completion: May they find the honor in death that was denied them in life.

74538.title: Blow It Up
74538.description:
Make no mistake, the djaradin are experienced dragon killers. But right now their ruthless tactics are overshadowed by the devastating power of their battlefield ballistae, capable of taking out any threat from a long distance. 

I have lost many good soldiers to these potent weapons.

It is essential that we destroy the ballistae if we hope to level the playing field and take to the skies. It is possible that we may even be able to gain the upper hand in this war.
74538.completion: We can see the smoke from up here! Good job.
74538.objectives: Destroy the djaradin heavy weaponry in the Battlefield Ruins.

74539.title: Thinning Their Defenses
74539.description:
The Firecallers are a formidable force. Their powerful, lethal magic allows them to vaporize anything that comes near them.

Their strategic positioning on high ledges makes them difficult to reach, but we cannot allow them to continue causing destruction among our forces.

The fate of our forces depends on your success. Good luck!
74539.completion: Another advantage taken from the enemy!
74539.objectives: Neutralize Zaqali Flametongues in the Battlefield Ruins.

74540.title: Intercepting Communications
74540.description:
{NAME}, we need intel, and we need it now.

Somewhere within one of the djaradin's encampments, you will find their field general. He is a seasoned and formidable opponent, responsible for many attacks on our forces. 

According to our field agents, he may possess crucial military orders outlining their next offense and the locations of their new supply lines.

It is imperative that we obtain these orders. We cannot allow the djaradin to gain the upper hand.
74540.completion:
This is not what I expected, soldier.

According to this report, the djaradin discovered a new dragon-like species living in the caves to the east.

<Ignax puts his finger on the map.>

They also marked it as one of their assault points.
74540.objectives: Eliminate Warchanter Ronvath and obtain the Invasion Plans in the Battlefield Ruins.

74542.title: Air Superiority
74542.description:
<As Ignax looks up, you see a small smile appear on his face.>

Few of my soldiers have experience fighting alongside dragons. What a glorious day.

Their presence gives us confidence, {class}. Now we must put an end to the djaradin's advance once and for all.
74542.completion:
This must be the nesting area mentioned in the stolen report.

But why are the djaradin here dead?

Are we too late?
74542.objectives: Defeat the djaradin forces and stop their advance in the Battlefield Ruins.

74557.title: Investigating the Unknown
74557.description:
We can only assume that something ambushed the marching djaradin. Who could have done this? 

We should investigate it before we proceed.
74557.completion:
So, the djaradin were stopped here by an unknown dragonkin force. Judging by how many lie dead, these dragonkin are as brutal as the djaradin. 

What worries me the most is that they still carry Neltharion's banner, which means they remain loyal to him and whatever task he once gave them. 

We must be careful--this has just got more complicated.
74557.objectives: Investigate the origins and motivations of the creatures in the area.

74562.title: Break Them Out
74562.description:
Cages, chains and transportation carts... I think we all know where this leads.

If the drakonids plan on capturing and enslaving the slitherdrakes, then they are no better than the djaradin. 

See what you can do to thwart their plans.
74562.completion: The slitherdrakes are free! Well done, {NAME}.
74562.objectives: Disrupt the poachers and stop them from capturing the slitherdrakes.

74563.title: Worst of the Worst
74563.description:
Everything here suggests this is a well-coordinated effort. These slitherdrakes are almost like wild beasts. They will not stand a chance without our aid.

Find whoever is leading their operation and put an end to this.
74563.completion: So the slitherdrakes were not born here, but inside Aberrus?   Were they part of his experiments that ultimately led to the creation of the dracthyr? When I think about that, it horrifies me how easy it was for Neltharion to both create and destroy life.   Nevertheless, that was a decisive blow to their operation.
74563.objectives: Find and eliminate drakonid leading the poachers.

74568.title: They Who Would Burn Us
74568.description:
The djaradin and their Primalist allies are a stain upon the land, {NAME}.

Wipe them from it.
74568.completion: Good. Nothing stops a ritual quite like killing the ritualist.
74568.objectives: Slay djaradin and Primalists assaulting the Ohn'ahran Plains.

74569.title: Deny Them Resources
74569.description:
This entire invasion has been carried out with the sole objective of infusing raw materials with elemental power on an unprecedented scale.

While we may not know Fyrakk's ultimate goal, frustrating his efforts seems straightforward enough.

If he wants these materials, we will deny them to him.
74569.completion: Excellent. Anything we can take from him buys us time.
74569.objectives: Recover infusion supplies from Fyrakk's forces.

74570.title: Aid Our Wounded
74570.description:
{NAME}, our forces were not prepared for such an onslaught.

These djaradin fight with more furor than the forces we have faced in the past. We have wounded behind enemy lines.

If you possess knowledge of how to heal then I ask you employ it. If you do not, we have bandages to aid the wounded with. 

Please help bring our people out of the fire.
74570.progress: Our healers cannot be everywhere at once. Nor will they last long behind enemy lines.
74570.completion: Many have fallen to these invaders who desecrate our sacred plains. Thank you for stemming the tide of death today.
74570.objectives: Heal 6 Wounded Guardians using the provided bandages or your own abilities.

74571.title: Clear a Path
74571.description:
The djaradin are fortifying their beachhead. We cannot allow them to dig in any deeper or we risk their advances becoming permanent.

Destroy their barricades before that can happen.
74571.progress: Leave them nothing to cower behind.
74571.completion: With their defenses broken, it will be that much easier to repel their advances.

74572.title: Make it Rain
74572.description:
The djaradin are setting the Plains ablaze with the reckless use of fire magic. We must act before these small sparks grow into a raging wildfire.

A deep pool of fresh water can be found not far from here. Skim the surface on your drake to collect as much as you can carry, then fly over the djaradin camp to douse any flames beneath you.

This won't be enough to put out the larger blazes, but it will buy us time.
74572.completion: I could see the plumes of steam from here. Excellent work, {NAME}.
74572.objectives: Extinguish fires across the djaradin camp.

74573.title: Aerial Support
74573.description:
The Primalist portals must be destroyed if we are to prevent them from infusing these raw materials with elemental energy.

Unfortunately, their structures are too heavily warded for any single attack, whether mortal or draconic, to do lasting harm.

Together, though, there is a way.

Take this seed. Use it to weaken their defenses and we will be able to strike before they have a chance to react.
74573.completion: Well done. That should put them behind schedule.

74576.title: Restored Hakkari Bijou
74576.description:
<The bijou fragments fit together with ease; drawn toward each other with minimal intervention.

It thrums gently with remnants of an ancient power. Too much to be of no consequence, yet too little to be of much use.

Someone, somewhere, would surely be interested in seeing your discovery.>
74576.completion:
An old Hakkari bijou, eh? I dare not ask HOW you came into possession of it, but there is no mystery to its origin.

Should you find yourself within the walls of Zul'Gurub again, keep an eye out for other treasures... and bring them to me.

I will be seeing you again soon.
74576.objectives: Find somebody interested in the Restored Hakkari Bijou.

74581.title: The Long Knives
74581.completion:
Is that you, {NAME}? Look at how much you've grown! But why are you here? 

They've sent you to deal with Gor'krosh? Thank the ancestors!
74581.objectives: Talk to Kaltunk in the Valley of Trials.

74695.title: Zulian, Razzashi, and Hakkari Coins
74695.progress:
I seek the Paragons of Power known as the Coins of the Tribes.  They are the currency used by the various denizens of Zul'Gurub, and each is imbued with subtle but powerful mojo.

There are nine distinct kinds to be found.  Should you have any extra, I will trade you a Bargaining Token for a set of three.

And yes, you will be bringing those right back to me soon enough.
Zulian Coin (1)
Razzashi Coin (1)
Hakkari Coin (1)
74695.completion:
Excellent - this set of coins will make a fine addition to my growing collection.

Here's your token, as promised.

74696.title: Gurubashi, Vilebranch, and Witherbark Coins
74696.progress:
I seek the Paragons of Power known as the Coins of the Tribes.  They are the currency used by the various denizens of Zul'Gurub, and each is imbued with subtle but powerful mojo.

There are nine distinct kinds to be found.  Should you have any extra, I will trade you a Bargaining Token for a set of three.

And yes, you will be bringing those right back to me soon enough.
Gurubashi Coin (1)
Vilebranch Coin (1)
Witherbark Coin (1)
74696.completion:
Excellent - this set of coins will make a fine addition to my growing collection.

Here's your token, as promised.

74697.title: Sandfury, Skullsplitter, and Bloodscalp Coins
74697.progress:
I seek the Paragons of Power known as the Coins of the Tribes.  They are the currency used by the various denizens of Zul'Gurub, and each is imbued with subtle but powerful mojo.

There are nine distinct kinds to be found.  Should you have any extra, I will trade you a Bargaining Token for a set of three.

And yes, you will be bringing those right back to me soon enough.
Sandfury Coin (1)
Skullsplitter Coin (1)
Bloodscalp Coin (1)
74697.completion:
Excellent - this set of coins will make a fine addition to my growing collection.

Here's your token, as promised.

74769.title: Stemming the Irontide
74769.description:
Unfortunately, we are not the only ones who took notice of opportunities in the Reach. 

Our scouts have sent word of pirate vessels moored offshore. The first longboats have apparently come ashore on our northeastern beaches.

Our history is not theirs to plunder. If you come across these pirates, send them swimming back to their little boats.
74769.completion:
You have my thanks. With luck, these brigands will take heed.

We're willing to defend these lands and the secrets they contain.
74769.objectives: Slay 10 Irontide Pirates on the Tempest Coast.

74771.title: Key Hunting
74771.description:
My pockets are empty. I have no more vault keys!

See if you can find any Zskera Keys, and Jeb and I will see what we can find. If we pool our keys, we can open a lot of doors.
74771.completion: We also found some keys! I can't wait to open more doors!
74771.objectives: Find 3 Zskera Vault Keys in the Forbidden Reach and deliver them to Pathfinder Tacha.

74774.title: More Keys
74774.description:
I have more keys! You can use these to open more locked doors!

Please, take these and use them within the chamber.

74775.title: Disciple of Fyrakk: Kretchenwrath
74775.description: <Fyrakk's disciple has fallen. Perhaps the remains of this beast will bring some comfort to those whose land has been ravaged.>
74775.progress: I heard you faced a disciple of Fyrakk.
74775.completion:
So this is the beast who would swear their loyalty to such an Incarnate. Their zealotry has festered for ages upon ages of this world. 

I cannot even begin to fathom such a deep-seated hatred.

Thank you for ending this flame of wrath upon our plains.

74783.title: The Sound of Silence
74783.description:
It has been so many years since Shandaral has known true silence. With luck, our actions today will allow the echoes of this cursed place to fade.

You are due back in the Isles, no doubt--and I think it is high time I fly there as well.
74783.completion:
The aftermath of the conflict in Shandaral has hung over our flight like a pall for so many years. To think that Lanigosa has been toiling all this time to lay those spirits to rest...

Thank you for lending her your aid, {NAME}. You have once again shown yourself a true ally to my people.
74783.objectives: Return to Kalecgos in the Azure Span.

74786.title: Snailspiration: Shimmershell Snail
74786.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74786.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74786.completion:
Well, that shimmershell certainly lives up to its name! Practically glowing brighter than this cavern's crystals. 

Absolutely stunning snailwork, {NAME}.
74786.objectives: Summon a max-level Shimmershell Snail battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74787.title: Come Snail Away
74787.description:
Hmm. You ever mount a snail before?

I've trained generations of racing snail champions, but now I've come across my toughest case yet. Problem is he's too crokin' big. Straight up barred from competition.

It's a shame to keep such a prize specimen stuck in a bucket though. If you can help me train Slick up to be the speedster I know he is, we'll call him yours!
74787.progress: The big guy's racing name is Big Slick in the City, but we just call him Slick.
74787.completion:
He likes you! Well, he doesn't dislike you. Hard to tell with snails.

Now you just need to come back here every day for Slick's training regimen. He may be slow now, but we'll get him up to speed.

74795.title: An Odd Round Object
74795.description: <This object looked out of place in the Zskera Vaults. It is round, with three claw-like divots in it. Perhaps it is of interest to Voraxian.>
74795.completion:
Hmm, round... clearly claw holes... squishes a bit... I have no idea what this is. Perhaps some form of thrown weapon?

How exciting!
74795.objectives: Bring the Odd Round Object to Voraxian in Rusza'thar Reach.

74796.title: A Dusty Vase
74796.description: <You have found a vase. It appears to represent a black dragon fighting what could be a djaradin. It could be something Voraxian is interested in.>
74796.completion:
<Voraxian holds the vase up to eye level and squints at the carvings.>

Hmm, yes, I think you are right {NAME}. It does look like a djaradin. 

It is a vase though. Unlikely to be too exciting. Do not get your hopes up.
74796.objectives: Bring the Dusty Vase to Voraxian in Rusza'thar Reach.

74847.title: Emberthal Awaits
74847.description:
We are by no means ready to relax, but at least our encampment here is stable... for the time being. I should be able to handle the rest of our operation from here.

Emberthal arrived while you were in the field. She and her allies are surveying the area from the cliffs above. It would be wise to check in with her, I think. We would not want her to attempt taking the Reach alone.
74847.completion:
This was our training ground... and for many, it became our resting place.

So many secrets remain here. So many questions. With luck, we will find answers.
74847.objectives: Meet with Emberthal above the cliffs of Morqut Village.

74857.title: Mouse Detective
74857.description:
Normally I'd chase strangers off my property, but today's an exception.

My sniffin' mouse has gone missing. It's not like Persii to ignore me when I call for her...

I can't smell as good as other niffen, so I can't tend to the harvest without her help.

Poor thing must be so scared, out there all on her own. Please, you gotta find Persii!
74857.completion: That niffen needs his mouse, huh? Hmm...

74858.title: Agrulculture
74858.description:
The niffen say that sniffin' mice have great noses. They can make their way through the caverns and track down the fastest racing snails. Even sniff out glow spores ready for harvest.

But I have a good nose, too. Maybe I could even sniff out those glow spores!

Let's collect the harvest for the hermit. That will show him it's okay that his mouse friend isn't here--because I can fill in!
74858.progress: Sniffin' mice must make this a lot easier. But I don't mind hard work!
74858.completion:
See? Just as good as a sniffin' mouse!

I hope the hermit agrees...

74859.title: Sporemoth Exterminator
74859.description:
Looks like sporemoths are wrecking these crops.

If they keep eating all the spores, the hermit won't have anything to harvest.

We need to cull the sporemoths. That should help keep the harvest thriving--and show that I know how to take care of a farm.
74859.progress: If we don't keep the pests under control, the spores won't grow.
74859.completion: That should help keep the spores healthy for now.

74860.title: A Friendly Introduction
74860.description:
It's time to deliver the harvest to the hermit. When he sees what good work we did, maybe he'll hire me as a farmhand!

I, uh... tried talking to him once before. Wanted to ask if he needed a helper.

Doesn't seem to like guests, though. Especially drogbar. So I got nervous and ran off.

You were looking for his mouse. Could you introduce us?
74860.progress: You have to find Persii before it's too late!
74860.completion: That drogbar ran off because he's guilty. I'm sure of it!
74860.objectives: Deliver the harvest and introduce Agrul to Yarren.

74861.title: An Unfriendly Confrontation
74861.description:
I knew I recognized that drogbar's voice.

He probably took Persii. I bet he knows where she is!

Please, $p, you gotta track down that big bully. Do whatever it takes to get Persii back!
74861.completion: I never should have worked for Malrogg...

74866.title: Journal Entry: Experiments
74866.completion:
Good. More of our history in the voice of someone who lived it.

<Azurathel reads over the journal entry growing more and more stoic.>

This is... disturbing. As soldiers we knew there was a degree at which we were expendable. But to read this...

Thank you for bringing this to me. We need to get this translated so others can read it.

74869.title: Primordial Answers
74869.description:
Revelations await us within this vault. Perhaps we'll find a way to protect ourselves against Primalist magic. The elementals hiding in these vaults are wild, ancient, and free of Primalist control. Perhaps they hold the secret to helping the elementals on the surface.

I have an idea. We'll need four primordial cores. Then we can construct a talisman that can purify and remove the influence of Primalist control from the elementals outside.

If you help us, I will share what we have found here.
74869.completion:
These primordial cores are all I need here. 

Please let me share with you the things I have found. May they help you in your efforts.
74869.objectives: Obtain a Primordial Earth, Fire, Water and Storm Core from the elementals within the Zskera Vaults.

74876.title: The Buddy System
74876.description:
Oh, hello there. Was I speaking my thoughts out loud again?

I don't mean to trouble others with my problems, but...

I'm a sniffenseeker, you see. We find unique and amazing places all over the cavern! But we have an important rule here in Loamm--we always follow the buddy system. Nobody digs alone!

I've had the same buddy since we were pups, but she's too busy to dig anymore. I found this interesting new smell. Before, I had a buddy...

Say, how do you feel about being a stand-in dig partner?
74876.progress: Just let me know if you decide you'd like to go with me!
74876.completion:
You're a good partner. We should do more digs together. We could even have a dig team name! Like... the diggies? Duggies? I'll think about it.

I'm not sure when my main dig buddy will have time to go again, so I'm glad to have met you, friend!
74876.objectives: Go on a dig adventure with Myrrit.

74877.title: Best Friends
74877.description:
Really, I have fun digging with you. I do! Please, don't take this badly, but... I miss my best friend.

I don't blame her for being busy. She was kidnapped, and she is the princess! I know she doesn't have lots of time. I just wish... 

...I don't know.

Maybe I wish things were the way they used to be, when she wanted to dig with me.
74877.completion: Maybe she forgot, or she's still busy.
74877.objectives: Set up a dig for Myrrit and Effervesta.

74878.title: Old Friends, Dear Friends
74878.description:
I don't want to give up on my best friend, but what if she doesn't want to be friends anymore?

We've been dig buddies since we were tiny pups. Maybe it matters to me more than it does to her.

What do I even say?
74878.progress: Why is this conversation so difficult?
74878.completion:
I think I'm okay now, {NAME}.

We can still be best friends even if we don't do digs anymore. And I have new friends like you to dig with.

I'm glad I got this off my chest.

74880.title: Journal Entry: Relics
74880.completion:
I think I remember Ebyssian talking about the Hammer of Khaz'goroth and how it was used to expunge him of corruption.

Given it did not work on us I can only assume I was never corrupted. I am taking this as a win!

Thank you for this information, {NAME}. I will add this to our collection.

74883.title: Journal Entry: The Creches
74883.progress: Have you found any more journal entries of Adamanthia?
74883.completion:
This is just creepy. I know what happened and yet this is crawling up my scales like one of those annoying beetles. 

I will get a translated copy added to the collection so others can read it. 

I am very much wondering whose side this Adamanthia was actually on.

74896.title: Journal Entry: Silence
74896.completion:
So they kept us secret even from the other aspects. Malygos knew, but from what I have heard, he could be just as disconnected as Neltharion.

I will add this journal entry to our translated collection. Thank you, {NAME}.

74900.title: Receiving Stone: Final Warning
74900.completion:
Oh... I remember that tone of voice. 

I am starting to think Adamanthia may have crossed a line, and she could not walk back.

I will get the translation of this stone added to our transcripts.

74901.title: Sending Stone: Protest
74901.completion:
Well, good to see a black dragon standing up for us, even if it was too little too late.

I wonder what this "Aberrus" is. If it is another place where dracthyr were held then we may need to find it.

I will add this to the translated logs. I recommend taking a look as you find more of these.

74902.title: Sending Stone: Initial Report
74902.completion:
They knew we were not broken.

THEY KNEW.

I think we knew that, but to read this... it just feels like more oil on the pyre. 

Still, I thank you for bringing this to us. I will get this translated for everyone to read and added to the logs.

74903.title: Sending Stone: The Prisoner
74903.completion:
Huh. If this is right, then Raszageth was awake the entire time we were in stasis.

I can see why she was so mad. I still do not agree with her or her methods, but anyone trapped for more than ten or twenty thousand years in a hole with little light is going to go mad. 

I will get the translated version added to the transcripts we have been handing around. Thank you for this, {NAME}.

74908.title: New Adventures
74908.description:
Cataloger Daela is here to investigate places of wonder and mystery. Skyfox Den and Caldera of the Menders look especially promising.

Completing her quests will unlock her Envoy Tasks today. You will be able to unlock other factions' Envoy Tasks tomorrow.
74908.completion: Fascinating! We must plan our next steps wisely. I'll give you detailed instructions.

74909.title: New Catches
74909.description:
Turik is here to investigate the riches of the sea across the Forbidden Reach on behalf of the Iskaara Tuskarr.

Completing this quest will unlock his Envoy tasks today. You will be able to unlock other factions' Envoy tasks tomorrow.
74909.completion: The fish are really biting today!

74910.title: New Foes
74910.description:
Storykeeper Ashekh is here to scout for enemies of the Maruuk.

Completing this quest will unlock her Envoy tasks today. You will be able to unlock other factions' Envoy tasks tomorrow.
74910.completion: Let me consider our enemies' strength. There is much to be done.

74911.title: New Horizons
74911.description:
Kraxxus represents the strength of Valdrakken Accord here on Forbidden Reach.

Completing this quest will unlock her Envoy tasks today. You will be able to unlock other factions' Envoy tasks tomorrow.
74911.completion: Welcome to the Forbidden Reach, friend!

74912.title: Neltharion's Legacy
74912.description:
<As you stare into the cracked titan gem, a voice echoes through your mind.>

{NAME}! This is Nozdormu. 

The time to redeem the legacy of your creator, Neltharion, is at hand. 

You hold a vital piece to the artifact Neltharion once used to control you and all of the dracthyr.

Meet me in Valdrakken. There is much to discuss.
74912.completion: Thank you for coming. I have been preparing for this moment for quite some time.

74913.title: Memories of an Artifact
74913.description:
Emberthal aided me in discovering the Oathbinder. This was the artifact Neltharion used to control you all.

I have been scouring the timeline to discover how it was made to forge a counterpart to it to protect your kind.

This gem you've recovered is just the key I need to move my studies forward.

You and I shall next meet within Zaralek Cavern, where you once fought over the broken Oathbinder.

It is there we will find the secrets to forge your own weapon to fight against tyranny.
74913.progress: Let us see what we find within the caverns.
74913.completion:
You hold the memories of how to forge the counter to the Oathbinder. 

It is time for you to embark on this path.

74923.title: It Takes a Village to Make an Artifact
74923.description:
You must go now and seek aid to create the key components to forge a new glove.

Essence of Order is normally difficult to find, but the memories you have acquired will allow you to recover them at many locations.

This new glove will be one to empower your allies and your community... which means you will have to rely on others to aid you in this.

Take the memories you've recovered and use them to teach others how to craft these parts.
74923.progress: Have you recovered all the items? You will have to request the aid of your fellow adventurers to create all the pieces.
74923.completion:
Fine work! You've gone through great lengths to craft these individual parts. 

Now we must uncover the last part to bring it all together.

The essence of the first black dragon aspect.

74924.title: Nasz'uro, the Unbound Legacy
74924.description:
Through my research, I've uncovered the last piece to make this artifact truly a counter to the Oathbinder.

The essence of Neltharion.

It is here that I can finally aid the dracthyr. We shall travel to the Maelstrom to see his final moments.

With his essence, we shall finish crafting your artifact, Nasz'uro, the Unbound Legacy.

Speak to me when you are ready.
74924.objectives: Speak with Nozdormu to travel to the Maelstrom to view Neltharion's defeat.

74942.title: Grime Lies Where You're Killing Slimes
74942.description:
Did you see that? Some of the slimes are leaving little piles of grime behind. Hmm...

Melly makes stuff out of all kinds of things. You think she could use the grime to help out Tempo? I bet she could.
74942.progress: Time grime! I'm on a roll here.
74942.completion: Nice! I'll hand these off to Melly. Along with my list of excellent slime rhymes.

74946.title: A Place of Refuge
74946.description:
Our next priority is to catch up with the others who fled during Bovan's stand. Hopefully, Bovan and the other braves have regrouped with them.

This Tomul says the most likely place the tauren would seek refuge is an abandoned village to the southeast. 

While her reasoning is sound, this is also the perfect location for a trap.

{NAME}, I know you vouch for her, so I will give her the benefit of the doubt.

Let us hope your trust in her is not misplaced.
74946.completion:
The good news is that we have found the other tauren.

The bad news is that this Bovan he seeks isn't here.

The irritating news is that everyone wants me dead.
74946.objectives: Meet Baine and Tomul at Toghusuq Village.

74948.title: Snailspiration: Amethyst Softshell
74948.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74948.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74948.completion:
Crok, what a beaut. And they come from the ocean? Can't imagine one of my snails handling all that salt. 

I'm sure Slick is impressed.
74948.objectives: Summon a max-level Amethyst Softshell battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74949.title: Snailspiration: Archetype of Vigilance
74949.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74949.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74949.completion:
That... is the weirdest, fanciest snail I have ever seen.

 If Slick isn't impressed by this fellow, I don't know what's going to impress him.
74949.objectives: Summon a max-level Archetype of Vigilance battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74950.title: Snailspiration: Blackchasm Crawler
74950.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74950.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74950.completion:
Now THIS is a snail who enjoys a good cavern! I'm sure Slick can relate. 

I certainly do.
74950.objectives: Summon a max-level Blackchasm Crawler battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74952.title: Snailspiration: Microlicid
74952.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74952.completion: Not sure what's so micro about that critter, but they sure got a shell on them. Though I guess most snails are micro next to Slick!
74952.objectives: Summon a max-level Microlicid battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74953.title: The Heavy Crown
74953.description:
I was really down when Effervesta didn't come like she said she would.

But I understand that she's so busy, what with being kidnapped and all of her duties. I don't blame her.

I want to tell her how much that time meant to me when we were pups, though. That I'll be here for her if she ever needs me. Then at least she knows I'm still here.

Can you help me get her attention long enough to say what I need to?
74953.progress: I don't want to bother her...
74953.completion: Now that I have her here, I don't know what to say!
74953.objectives: Help create a time for Myrrit to talk to Effervesta.

74959.title: Snailspiration: Mudshell Conch
74959.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74959.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74959.completion:
Some people see a mudshell conch and think, what's so special? But me, I appreciate the simple things. There's beauty in that. 

I'm sure Slick agrees!
74959.objectives: Summon a max-level Mudshell Conch battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74960.title: Snailspiration: Predatory Helicid
74960.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74960.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74960.completion:
Predatory, huh? Just keep that critter away from my buckets. I don't need any accidents. Not again.

<Briggul stares off at the distance, her eyes haunted.>

But yeah, I'm sure Slick is feeling that fighting spirit.
74960.objectives: Summon a max-level Predatory Helicid battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74961.title: Snailspiration: Prismatic Softshell
74961.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74961.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74961.completion:
Prismatic, huh? That's a fancy term for pretty colors? Well this snail fits the bill. I hope Slick doesn't get too self-CONCH-scious about it. Ha! 

He's plenty pretty himself.
74961.objectives: Summon a max-level Prismatic Softshell battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74962.title: Snailspiration: Rapana Whelk
74962.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74962.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74962.completion: Don't let that one fool you, {NAME}. I can sense the shell of a killer. Hope Slick is more inspired than spooked!
74962.objectives: Summon a max-level Rapana Whelk battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74963.title: Snailspiration: Rusty Snail
74963.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74963.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74963.completion:
Oh! Rusty like the COLOR. I was worried how you were caring for this little one. Made me scared for Slick here!

Whew, that's a relief.
74963.objectives: Summon a max-level Rusty Snail battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74964.title: Snailspiration: Scooter the Snail
74964.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74964.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74964.completion:
Look at the shell on that one! And you said a child gave them to you?

Glad they ended up in your hands! Runts tend to behave... questionably toward snails.
74964.objectives: Summon a max-level Scooter the Snail battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74965.title: Snailspiration: Shelly
74965.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74965.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74965.completion:
Now "Shelly" is a name I can get behind. Maybe this critter is Slick's long-lost cousin!

<Briggul looks over the progenitor snail again.>

Huh. Maybe... very long-lost.
74965.objectives: Summon a max-level Shelly battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74966.title: Snailspiration: Silkbead Snail
74966.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74966.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74966.completion:
Just look at that critter move! The silkbead snail has a particularly silky consistency to its mucus. 

Not sure Slick can really learn from that, but hey. You can.
74966.objectives: Summon a max-level Silkbead Snail battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74967.title: Snailspiration: Spireshell Snail
74967.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74967.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74967.completion:
I'm sure Slick a-SPIRES to be as strong as your snail there! Ha!

<Briggul wipes a joyful tear from her eye.>

I should bring that one to the next race. The other trainers are going to eat it up.
74967.objectives: Summon a max-level Spireshell Snail battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74968.title: Snailspiration: Zoom
74968.description:
I smell a snail on you, but it's strange. You holding out on me?

Not many people know this, but snails are incredibly susceptible to peer pressure. Show off that wonder-snail you got there, and let's get Slick inspired.
74968.progress: Show me that snail! Let's inspire Slick to be his best slimy self.
74968.completion:
That... that's ZOOM! The legendary racing snail of Highmountain!

Crok me, I have to tell cousin Boomboom about this. What an absolute honor. For Slick as well, I'm sure.
74968.objectives: Summon a max-level Zoom battle pet and show it to Briggul.

74983.title: Authentic Authorization
74983.description:
The importance of this expedition can not be understated. I assure you, all who participate will have a place in history... along with me, of course!

If I can make one remarkable discovery, my scholarly legacy will be assured! But what will we find? A copy of Neltharion's signature? One of his personal letters? Can't wait to find something to share with my fans. Also, I'll have more fans!

If you would be so kind as to find me something memorable, I'll offer you suitable remuneration! I can pay!
74983.completion:
What an amazing find. The mind reels. 

Oh, and I can't wait to write about this discovery and publish our findings. We will publish... or perish trying!

74984.title: Authentic Authorization
74984.description:
The importance of this expedition can not be understated. I assure you, all who participate will have a place in history... along with me, of course!

If I can make one remarkable discovery, my scholarly legacy will be assured! But what will we find? A copy of Neltharion's signature? One of his personal letters? Can't wait to find something to share with my fans. Also, I'll have more fans!

If you would be so kind as to find me something memorable, I'll offer you suitable remuneration! I can pay!
74984.completion:
What an amazing find. The mind reels. 

Oh, and I can't wait to write about this discovery and publish our findings. We will publish... or perish trying!

74996.title: A Difficult Legacy
74996.description:
Let us talk to Veritistrasz about this vase, $p. 

I want to temper your expectations though. It is just a vase, but you never know. It could be exciting.

Maybe it could point us to a cache of weapons?
74996.objectives: Talk to Voraxian and Veritistrasz at Rusza'thar Reach.

66090.title: Path of the Dark Rangers
66090.completion:
<Velonara peers at you knowingly.>

It was a fair disguise, but I saw at once that you were not who you claimed to be. 

Regardless, you risked your life to aid us. I will not forget that.

There are those among the kaldorei raised by Sylvanas' val'kyr who wish to return to their own. If Tyrande would have them back, they are free to go. The rest will be welcome in the ranks of the dark rangers. 

In recognition for your service to us, I offer this gift.

66091.title: Path of the Dark Rangers
66091.completion:
For years, we dark rangers worked as agents of the Banshee Queen. Now, under the leadership of the new Forsaken council, we serve a greater cause: shaping our people's future.

We cannot be certain what lies ahead. But I vow that the dark rangers will do everything in our power to defend this kingdom.

Your aid was crucial in helping us cleanse the ruins of Lordaeron. Take this, with our thanks.

66507.title: A Winter Veil Gift
66507.completion:
A small tag on this present reads:

Happy holidays, {NAME}!

66508.title: A Gently Shaken Gift
66508.completion:
This present looks like it has been shaken a few times. The tag on it reads:

To a very special {race} {class}.
66508.objectives: This present looks like it has been shaken a few times. The tag on it reads:To a very special <race> <class>.

70335.title: Simple Excavation Tools
70335.completion:
Your help is greatly appreciated! As a show of our gratitude, I want to offer you one of my special excavation tools. I also have all of these available for trade, so come and see me again if you wish to complete the set. 

Thank you adventurer!

70807.title: Advanced Excavation Tools
70807.completion:
We appreciate your continued help with the expedition! As a reward for your efforts, I want to offer you one of my advanced tools. I have all of these tools available for trade, so come and see me again if you'd like another.

Thank you, adventurer!

70808.title: Initial Mysteries of the Dragon Isles Drakes
70808.completion: Dragons have long fascinated me. Being here is a dream come true! I have already learned much about the renewed proto-drakes of the Waking Shores. Would you like to see one of the manuscripts I have put together? I have made many observations, and would be willing to trade for others as well!

70809.title: Deeper Mysteries of the Dragon Isles Drakes
70809.completion: I have made great progress since we last spoke, adventurer! Please, choose another manuscript to help your renewed proto-drake learn another trait. Do not forget, you may always speak with me if you would like to trade for others!

70810.title: Broader Mysteries of the Dragon Isles Drakes
70810.completion: I was able to expand my studies to the other drakes of the Dragon Isles. The red scales most common to the renewed proto-drakes are not limited to their variety. Each of the other main drakes can show red scales as well! Please, choose a manuscript for the drake you prefer. If you wish to trade for the others, come see me again!

70812.title: Expedition Cloaks
70812.completion: A good cloak can be the most essential piece of gear on an expedition. Your help's earned you your choice of cloak. See me if you want to trade for a different one.

70813.title: Digging Up Treasure
70813.completion: Most of the treasure around here is in the ground--ancient artifacts, maybe even valuables. You're going to need a good shovel to get to it, though. Lucky you, I've got an official expedition shovel with your name on it. Look for disturbed dirt, and see what you can find.

70814.title: Unlocking Magical Treasures
70814.completion: This place has many treasures you have yet to see, as they are bound in magic. I can teach you to see them. Many lie hidden deep within caves, or are magically locked away in the various ruins of the land. Good luck in your search!

70815.title: Demolitions Access
70815.completion: Some excavations require a delicate touch, and others need something a little more explosive. I think we can trust you to know when to use which. You can have this first explosive for no trade. Use it wisely, and don't prove me wrong.

70819.title: Renowned Explorer's Armor
70819.completion: You've done some great things, adventurer--and it hasn't gone unnoticed. The expedition leadership has authorized me to issue you a set of our best armor. Thank you for all your help.

70820.title: The Basecamp 'Pets'
70820.completion: Ach! I thought a lifetime of gryphon wrangling would have prepared me for taming the unruly beasts of the Dragon Isles. But these Marmoni and Skitterbugs are pushing me to my limits! I will gladly offload one to you. If you seek another, I'll offer ye a fair trade!

70821.title: Skitterfly Riding
70821.completion: Who woulda known that caring for juvenile skitterbugs would have consequences? Their parents, Skitterflies, came looking for them. Rather than wanting a fight, they nested--just like a gryphon would! I started training them and wouldn't you know it, it's close to riding a gryphon... once you get used to the buzzing wings. With all the help you're providing around here, I'd like you to have your first Skitterfly mount on me. I will gladly train you another, in exchange for some very specific items.

70822.title: Lost Expedition Scouts
70822.completion: We've sent out plenty of scouts since we landed, and a fair number of them haven't returned. Could you keep an eye out for them while you're exploring? They can often be spotted with our standard issue Expedition Scout Pack. Oh, and if you find any artifacts, deliver them Cataloger Jakes. She'll appreciate it.

70828.title: Wayfinder's Compass
70828.completion: These lands are vast--the terrain rises so much that it's easy for even the most knowledgeable tracker to get lost. If you want to help us out, you'll need a way to navigate. Take this compass, it should do the trick.

70831.title: Researching in Comfort
70831.completion: Many hours of expedition work is spent--how do I say this? On your behind. I do not see why we can't make that time a bit more comfortable. Therefore, I have asked our new allies in the Reliquary to fashion us a set of pillows that will do nicely. I will let you have your pick, but you will have to trade if you want more!

70832.title: One of Us Now
70832.completion: You're just the type of adventurer we want in our expedition, and we're so glad to have you! To show our appreciation, I'd like to reward you with our tabard. It'll show the world everything you've accomplished! We can't forget our roots, though--if you'd like a banner for the Reliquary or the Explorer's League, I have those available as well. Thank you for everything you've done!

70833.title: Rumors of the Jeweled Whelplings
