70833.completion: Have you heard the tale of this ancient jewelcrafter from the Dragon Isles? Legend has it they had a technique to craft jeweled whelpling statues that would come to life. I took it for just a story as well, but then this map was found in the pack of one of our fallen scouts with a clue to a jeweled whelpling. Take the map, see if it leads to the secret of creating these fabled living statues.

70834.title: Titled Story
70834.completion: I've been cataloging every deed and artifact that every member has contributed to the Dragonscale Expedition since we landed. Today I noticed the sheer height of your accomplishment. I could not be prouder to bestow upon you this prestigious title and this coveted Primal Infusion item that you can have crafted into a powerful item. Go forth and carry it as a true accomplishment for your heroic efforts.

70839.title: The Search for Titan Relics
70839.completion:
I have spent all of my time since the waking studying the titans. Their history is fascinating. What power they must have wielded to create the dragonflights! There is so much knowledge to be gained about them! 

If you could bring me any titan relics you find around the Dragon Isles, I will put in a good word for you with the Valdrakken Accord.

70880.title: To Cook With Finery
70880.completion:
Hello there. Can I offer you a fork? Or maybe some tea?

It is a pleasure to see so many in Valdrakken. I am sure you will aid us admirably. If you find yourself in need of the knife to match your fork, let me know and we will trade!

70882.title: Renown Supplies
70882.completion: Greetings, {class}. You've proved your worth to the Valdrakken Accord. Here are some supplies to help you aid our cause. Don't let us down!

70885.title: Renown Supplies
70885.completion: Greetings, {class}. You've proved your worth to the Valdrakken Accord. Here are some supplies to help you aid our cause. Don't let us down!

70887.title: Feeling Freedom
70887.completion:
My smaller kin are now able to freely explore the Dragon Isles. It pleases me to see them flourishing and enjoying new experiences.

Allow me to show you more ways that they can express themselves to you and others.

70888.title: Rubbing Shoulders With The Best
70888.completion:
Working day and night to outfit our forces is no small feat. It's arduous work, but I enjoy it. And I hear you have been a boon to our efforts. 

As a show of thanks, I want you to take one of my armor pieces. Just one. If you require another, I will want something in trade.

Make your choice quickly. I have work to do!

70889.title: Crafting for Expertise
70889.completion:
You have returned, alchemist? I've been watching from afar, and I've seen you hard at work on your skills.

To reward your effort and mold you into an expert, I present you with these additional notes from our master alchemists. Study them carefully. Only with practice can you stand among the greatest of your craft.

70891.title: Fitting In
70891.completion:
If you are going to live or work in this city, you MUST blend in.

I will make a custom garment for you in the latest style--I'll even give you your choice of color! Which flight do you feel most accentuates your eyes?

If you can't pick just one, then of course we can talk about multiple outfits. For a fair trade, of course!

70892.title: Crafting Your Start
70892.completion:
You wish to learn from our master alchemists? 

You must improve your skills before requesting their guidance. But don't worry. I have some notes they're willing to give aspiring alchemists.

The notes will give you something to cut your fangs on! Practice crafting what's in them, and one day they'll entrust you with greater knowledge.

70895.title: Soaring in Style
70895.completion:
Ah, mortal. Word of your adventures is spreading throughout the city. All eyes are upon you as you and your drake ally soar above the skies!

Let us speak further about the amazing variety of expression among dragonkind.

70897.title: A Coming of Age
70897.completion:
You have returned. The work has not lessened. In fact, my skills are in greater demand than ever before.

So, are you going to stand there all day or will you select one of my immaculate helms? Yes, I know how good they are. 

Do you wish to trade for something else? If you're not ready to trade, I must return to my work.

70901.title: A Collection of Creatures
70901.completion:
Greetings, mortal. I tend the grounds and the creatures that call them home--even stray proto-whelps.

Unfortunately, there are more proto-whelps about than I can reasonably care for.

Hmm, you seem responsible. Would you like to take care of one? Later, if you would like a companion for your, uh, companion, please seek me out again.

70902.title: Crafting for Expertise
70902.completion:
Looks like you've been working hard, {NAME}. Wait, aren't engineers supposed to work smarter, not harder? Perhaps you're not cut out for engineering after all!

Merely a jest, {race}. Here. The master engineers left you further notes to help you increase your skill. They've promised me their documentation is more thorough this time, but you be the judge of that. Good luck!

70903.title: Wielding Titanic Might
70903.completion:
The study of Tyrhold and all titan artifacts in the Dragon Isles is critical to our efforts in fighting against the Primalists.

The weapons they left behind are especially important. I have recently discovered a great cache of them, and would like to award one to you in recognition of your efforts.

After I catalog my findings, I would be willing to offer others in trade. But I ask that you bring me materials to further my research.

70904.title: Variety is the Spice of Life
70904.completion:
Dragons are ancient beings, as diverse in our appearances as you mortal races.

I could teach you much about our lineage, and about the varied looks I have encountered.

Perhaps this drake you fly with would be interested in hearing my tales and exploring the possibilities before them.

70905.title: Flying with Our Colors
70905.completion:
We dragonkin proudly wear the colors of our flights! As you can see from my attire... and my scales. 

But now scaled and scaleless alike can show that they stand with our renewed flights. Don a tabard and wear it with pride!

70909.title: Crafting for Expertise
70909.completion:
I can tell by the smudges on your armor that you've been hard at work. And you've caught the attention of our masters as well! For your work, not for the cleanliness of your armor, to be clear...

As a reward, they have left more notes to help you learn. Study them and keep practicing, and perhaps one day you'll even surpass them. Good luck!

70910.title: Mysteries in Paper and Glass
70910.completion:
Welcome back to my shop! I have many new goods that may be of interest.

Your efforts in the Dragon Isles are the talk of the market, so I will let you have one item for free.

If anything else catches your eye, I'm certain we can strike a bargain.

70911.title: Armored and Ready
70911.completion:
Ah, the noble {class} returns from the path of adventure.

A dragon's scales may be thick and tough, but it would be irresponsible to send our young into battle unprotected. Allow me to supply your drake with its first set of armor.

See me later if you would like to purchase another set. Other armors may be found throughout the Isles. Fair skies and strong winds!

70912.title: The Accord's High Standards
70912.completion:
Carrying the banner of a dragonflight shows your support for what it stands for.

Please choose a banner and display it with pride. If you wish to trade for another, seek me out.

70913.title: To Bear Our Mantle
70913.completion:
Back from your adventures, eh? Looks like you've seen a scrape or two. Bet you could use some new pauldrons. 

If you don't see anything you like, there is a special set of armor I can make to order. It requires very specific materials, but that's not a problem for someone with your skills.

70914.title: The Breadth of Dragon Weaponry
70914.completion:
Ah, {class}. Welcome back to our forge. We have all heard tales of the amazing deeds you have done in service of Valdrakken.

We smiths serve the cause in our own way. To have a hero like you wielding one of my finest weapons would be an honor indeed!

70916.title: Beknownst and Glorious
70916.completion:
Hail, friend {NAME}. Your service to Valdrakken has been exceptional.

Let it be known to all that you are truly an Ally of Dragons! 

And to reinforce our esteem of you and your deeds I am also giving you a Primal Infusion. Take it and make a great crafted piece from it that will continue to crush our enemies.

70939.title: Cooking Utensils
70939.completion:
Do you wanna be a great big soup master, too? 

I can't wait until I can see over the lip of the big pot! Then I'll finally be big enough to lead a feast!

Here, this is for you! It'll help you on your soupy journey! Let me know if you wanna trade for anything else!

70940.title: Tuskarr Champion's Tales
70940.completion:
The deeds of the tuskarr of the Dragon Isles are many!

Over the years though, some of our stories have been lost. Many travelers never returned from their journeys with tales to tell. 

Please, if you find any scrolls that document what our lost brethren were able to accomplish, bring them back to me.

70952.title: Abandoned... or Hidden Caches
70952.completion:
Let me let you in on a little secret.

Some of our less-than-friendly neighbors are jealous of our fishing prowess--and our fishing spots.

They trespass on our fishing claims and steal our tackle boxes, stashing them along the shores to not get caught in the act. Let me tell you what to look for, and you might just be able to help yourself to some useful supplies while you're out fishing.

70953.title: Tuskarr Headwear
70953.completion:
Greetings, dear friend. 

You've been so kind to our community here in Iskaara. I have heard of your deeds and wanted to knit you something as a thanks.

Please, take your pick! I've made many hats to while away the hours of the long winters. I would be happy to trade you for others as well, if you wish!

70954.title: Mounting Curiosity
70954.completion:
While gnolls remain the primary focus of my research, I'm very curious about the recently returned dragons as well. 

After intense study and observation, I began jotting down my notes on the subject. It's nowhere near complete, but when it is, I'm sure it will be a helpful guide to you.

In the meantime, would you like to look at one of my other manuscripts? I've started to trade them for items that will help continue my studies, so if you would like to learn more, visit me again!

70955.title: Fascinating Fliers
70955.completion:
I saw a drake with a spotted pattern fly by yesterday! That was certainly a first for me, but you probably see many like it in your travels! 

That said, I took detailed notes in case it's a new subspecies. It also had some other fascinating traits I had not seen previously!

If you'd like to read more of my observations, pick a manuscript to take with you. And if you'd like more reading material, I'll happily trade with you.

70956.title: Of Azure Scales
70956.completion:
Do you enjoy poetry? Wait. If you don't, don't tell me. Hanu might hear you.

In our travels here, Hanu and I have noticed there are few blue-scaled beasts outside the Azure Span!

I hypothesized some theories on the origin and nature of blue scales and jotted them down. And Hanu wrote a lovely poem about their perfect blue color! 

She is shy about her writing, so she asked me to give it to you. Please, treasure it as I treasure her.

70959.title: Cute and Cuddly
70959.completion:
Do you love animals?

Of course you do, who doesn't? Even the scary ones are pretty neat!

You wanna take care of one of the animals I tamed all by myself? I can tame more if you wanna trade for them, too--as long as you promise to take good care of them!

70960.title: Trader's Apparel
70960.completion:
Hello, adventurer. 

I pride myself on my leatherworking skills. I would be honored if you would take this cloak as recognition for your efforts in helping us. 

If you have a penchant for leather armor, I also am happy to make a set of our finest gear for trade.

70961.title: Shouldering the Needed Armor
70961.completion:
Hello again! You've done so much for us, friend! We'd be in dire straits indeed without your assistance. 

As a token of our appreciation, I want you to have a set of my tufted shoulderpads. They should keep you warm on your adventures. 

If you would like me to make you a sturdier set, simply bring me the materials to craft it.

70966.title: Trading Made Easier
70966.completion:
Have you traveled much? You don't look like you have--you're missing one of my sturdy backpacks!

A good pack will make all the difference out in the world. You've helped my people out many times, so I want to offer you one of my best basic packs. 

I have many other packs as well! If you would like to offer a fair trade, I will gladly trade you for more.

70967.title: Fishy Entertainment
70967.completion:
Fishing is great. I love it! I eat, sleep, and dream it. And when I'm not fishing, I craft fishing gear!

If I've learned anything from my many years fishing, it's that you also have to have a little fun out there--change things up, think outside the net!

Here's some gear I dreamed up to help you new fishers along! You can have one for free, but if you'd like both, I'll gladly trade you for the other.

70968.title: Of the Cloth, of the Community
70968.completion:
It is my honor to bestow upon you this gift, for all you have done for the tuskarr. The colors of our community are woven into its cloth, symbolizing how we all are woven together into a community--one that you are now a part of.

Wear it with pride, my friend!

70969.title: Becoming One of Our Community
70969.completion:
Greetings, friend! The tales of your deeds have spread across the Azure Span from Iskaara to Imbu to the Gleamlet. You've proven yourself time and time again, and we are grateful for it.

Chieftain Brena has declared that you have earned an honored place within our community... and within our family. You will forever be known as one of Iskaara. Thank you for everything you've done, friend. Please also take this Primal Infusion you can use to have a great item crafted.

70971.title: Arms for Every Arm
70971.completion:
Have you come to spar? No? Shame.

I know what you have done for our people. It would be an honor if you would wield one of my weapons. Pick which ever one pleases you. 

Take your time. I realize my collection is massive. 

If you would like more of my weapons, continue to prove your mettle. Bring me items showing you are not losing your martial prowess, and I will trade you for more armaments!

70972.title: Our Loyal, Lanky Steeds
70972.completion:
Our ottuks choose only to be ridden by our most esteemed warriors.

I think it is time to see if one will bond with you. They are fiercely loyal, but they love to have fun!

I will leave you and the ottuks to decide which will be your bonded companion. 

Ottuks that are large enough to ride are rare, and their tack is expensive. If you wish to train another one, my fellow trainers and I must ask for a large trade in return.

70977.title: Scaps Packs
70977.completion:
YOU BRING SCAPS HUNGRIES? BRING FEESH?

NO?

<SCAPS watches as you gesture towards his backpack.>

WANT PACK-BACK? 

<SCAPS considers this.> 

YOU TAKE PACK-BACK, OKAY?

BUT NEXT TIME--BRING FEESH! THEN GIVE PACK! 

ME HUNGRIES!

70978.title: Dragon Isles Champion's Tales
70978.completion:
Young one! The Dragon Isles are full of stories that date back generations upon generations.

If you venture deep within the great halls and vaults of this land, I am sure you can find and reclaim scrolls that detail these stories. If you bring them to me, I'll have a special gift for you in return!

71030.title: Hunting Tactics: Shikaar Mentorship
71030.completion:
Your renown with the Maruuk rises. Seek out other Shikaar during the grand hunt, and they will improve your combat prowess while the hunt is on.

Come to me again when your renown grows, and I will train you more.

71031.title: Hunting Tactics: Proof of Prowess
71031.completion:
I see your renown with the Maruuk has grown once more. Let me show you how to carry the thrill of victory through multiple foes.

Return again when your renown grows, and I will train you further.

71032.title: Hunting Tactics: Apex Hunter
71032.completion: Your renown has reached its peak, champion. I have one more technique to teach you. No quarry, no matter how powerful, will stand before you.

71058.title: Observing the Wind
71058.completion:
{NAME}, you are a dragonrider, yes? You show great promise as an ally.

Let me give you this, then, to celebrate our growing alliance. And I promise there is more where that came from!

71060.title: To Adorn Your Head
71060.completion:
Your deeds honor your people, friend {NAME}. Please accept this helm as a gift in recognition of all that you do for us. 

Should you find yourself wanting more, I would be happy to trade with you.

71067.title: Whistling Rocks
71067.completion:
Dragonrider! The Aylaag understand that navigating to their camp can be challenging. And you know them--they welcome anyone who will follow their ways.

One of their nomads dropped off these windstones for you. They are not well-enchanted, but will transport you to the Aylaag camp. A few times, at least. Should that enchantment fade, they could likely make more!

71073.title: Mantle of Friendship
71073.completion:
My friend! It's a joy to see you again. I have another gift for you!

Please, take it with my compliments. But don't tell Huseng that I'm giving it away. He wanted me to charge you for it!

71074.title: Befriending Wings and Wind
71074.completion:
You're just in time, dragonrider. I have a special acquisition from the Ohn'ir. 

With our clans spread so far apart, we often rely on ohuna to relay critical messages. This will allow you to call upon our eagle mail carriers wherever you go. They're not the swiftest, but they are reliable.

Normally I would require a trade, but this is too important a boon. You may have need of it.

71075.title: Understanding Their Grace
71075.completion:
Ah, my friend, you have returned! We were just speaking of how helpful you are!

Here, accept this gift. It is the least we can do for an ally.

71079.title: Getting to the Point
71079.completion:
So they've finally sent you to me, have they? Excellent!

I stock many fine weapons for you to consider. Normally I'd insist on trading for my goods, but today I wish to honor your deeds for my people.

Just don't tell Huseng. He'd never let me hear the end of it if he knew I gave something away... even to a dragonrider.

71083.title: An Expected Unexpected Gift
71083.completion:
Dragonrider! Some of our goods are missing. 

I'd bet my back hooves that it's Rondare being too generous again. I've made clear that she can't just give things away. Seems I must have yet another chat with her.

<Huseng grumbles, then realizes something.>

Oh, I almost forgot. I wanted to give you this.

71085.title: Representation Matters
71085.completion:
Ah, dragonrider. The clans have been sharing tales of your deeds for several moons now.

They've all asked that I make your next gift a pennant of their clan's colors so you can represent them on the battlefield. Trouble is, I can only spare one of them. Huseng's on to me.

Which would you choose?

71089.title: Get on the Horn
71089.completion:
Friend, the Shikaar have asked me to offer you their ritual hunting horns. They insisted the horns were only for you, and that I was not to use them.

Hmph! I'm an excellent hunter. Perhaps the best they will ever see! They just don't know it yet.

<Huseng laughs.>

So here you are. My stock is open to you, should you want any others.

71090.title: From the Heart, For the Heart

71091.title: The Highest Honor
71091.completion:
My friend, you have defended these plains alongside my people, lending your aid to each of our clans without hesitation. You are an outsider no longer, but a familiar face among the centaur.

To honor our bond, I anoint you with the title of Khansguard and present you with this gift. May you proudly bear the Maruuk name wherever your travels take you.

72038.title: Dragon Isles Supplies
72038.completion: Your deeds are essential to our expedition's success in the Dragon Isles. To that end, I have been authorized to issue this supply allotment to assist you. Keep up the good work, adventurer!

72048.title: Dragon Isles Supplies
72048.completion: Welcome back, adventurer. I am glad that I have been authorized to increase your supply allotment, as you certainly have earned it. I know I tell you this all the time, but I do hope you continue to aid our efforts.

72113.title: Shapes Beyond the Veil
72113.completion:
Greetings, dear friend.

You have done much to aid us in your time here, but I can sense fate calls you elsewhere.

In honor of the many souls you have rescued on your journey, and to serve as a guiding light for those you have yet to encounter, please accept this gift. May it serve as a reminder of what wonder life can bring when given a little assistance.

72117.title: Cultural Exchange
72117.completion:
Outsider, you are proving yourself useful. Let this warm you on cold nights. And when it does, remember that we are friends.

<Huseng grins.>

I see you doing great things for our people, {NAME}.

72294.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72294.completion: Lok'tar, adventurer. You must be the new scribe helping out the expedition! I was told to pass along this notebook. Our scribes put their pens together for a few notes to help jump start your crafting here in the Dragon Isles. Come back to me when you're through with them. I may have more for you.

72295.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72295.completion: There's my favorite hardworking scribe! Everyone's been talking about the quality of your inscription work, {NAME}. To reward you, I've asked the master scribes to come up with more instructions and exercises to help you master your craft. You've done me proud, {class}. Now get back to work!

72296.title: A Gift of Knowledge
72296.completion:
Ah, dragonrider! I know that you're a leatherworker of no small skill, but we Maruuk have methods you would do well to learn.

Our crafters assembled these notes to aid your progress. Perhaps you'll visit with them and share some of your knowledge as well.

Between friends, there are no secrets under the sky!

72297.title: A Gift of Secrets
72297.completion:
{NAME}, the heart of a centaur beasts within you... and you have shown greater dedication to your craft than we could ever have imagined.

When last we spoke of your leatherworking skills, I shared the first portion of our masters' crafting wisdom. But you have proven there are no techniques you cannot master.

Here are the rest of their notes. I know you will make good use of them.

72299.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72299.completion:
Enchanting, eh?

<Boss Magor looks at a list.>

Yep, we need more of those. No experience? No problem! I've got a manual here that will help you get started. Spend some time honing your skills, and I may have more to give you to help. Welcome to the Dragon Isles, {race}.

72300.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72300.completion: An engineer! We have need of your skill here in the Dragonscale Expedition. I have some schematics and notes put together by some master engineers in Orgrimmar. I've been asked to pass them along to anyone on the expedition that has an interest in engineering. Practice, and later on I may have more that will help increase your skill.

72301.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72301.completion: We need professionals and crafters of every kind in the expedition. Even jewelcrafters! Don't know much about jewelcrafting myself, but I have a book here donated by a master jewelcrafter that will help you get started. Hone your skill and come back to me. I may have more to help you later.

72302.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72302.completion: So you're here to mine the new frontier, eh? Well, you'll definitely have that opportunity here on the expedition. Got an old miner's almanac here for you if you want to study up on your skills. Swing your pickaxe a few times and get a feel for it then come back to me. I'm sure there are more books and notes around that'll help you out.

72303.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72303.completion:
Ah, you're a tailor you say? Good. I can't even thread a needle, but I have some patterns left by the last expedition tailor that you can practice on. Once you're ready for more, come back and I may have something else that well help you.

What happened to the last tailor? Why, it's said that at night you can still hear him... Nah, just kidding. Went home to be with his family.

72304.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72304.completion: Back already, enchanter? Good for you! We need more hard workers here in the expedition. If you're ready for more work, I've got another, more advanced manual here for you. Keep up the good work!

72305.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72305.completion: Throm-ka, engineer. Seems you've been busy! Your feats of engineering have not been unnoticed by the Dragonscale Expedition! I've received more advanced schematics for you to try. You've impressed some important people, it seems. Keep up the good work, {NAME}!

72306.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72306.completion: {NAME}! You've made your mark on the Dragonscale Expedition with your jewelcrafting skill. When people think "jewelcrafting," they think "{NAME}!" And I've got just what you need to cement your reputation: a book on advanced jewelcrafting. Maybe it will help you master your craft, eh?

72308.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72308.completion: {NAME}! Glad to see you've safely returned. I admit I was a bit worried about you out there mining the wilds of the Dragon Isles. Your mining has been very helpful to the Dragonscale Expedition, but if you want to help out more, here's an advanced almanac that can help you increase your skill.

72309.title: Expedition Crafting Knowledge
72309.completion: Welcome back, tailor. I hear you're doing well for yourself. Many say you're... a cut above the rest! I'm sorry, {NAME}. I couldn't resist. If you'd like to stay there, here are more patterns and notes to improve your tailoring courtesy of the Dragonscale Expedition. Good luck!

72310.title: A Gift of Knowledge
72310.completion:
Ah, dragonrider! I know that you're a skinner of no small skill, but we Maruuk have methods you would do well to learn.

Our skinners assembled these notes to aid your progress. Perhaps you'll visit with them and share some of your knowledge as well.

Between friends, there are no secrets under the sky!

72311.title: A Gift of Knowledge
72311.completion:
Ah, dragonrider! I know that you're a alchemist of no small skill, but we Maruuk have methods you would do well to learn.

Our alchemists assembled these notes to aid your progress. Perhaps you'll visit with them and share some of your knowledge as well.

Between friends, there are no secrets under the sky!

72312.title: A Gift of Knowledge
72312.completion:
Ah, dragonrider! I know that you're a blacksmith of no small skill, but we Maruuk have methods you would do well to learn.

Our smiths assembled these notes to aid your progress. Perhaps you'll visit with them and share some of your knowledge as well.

Between friends, there are no secrets under the sky!

72313.title: A Gift of Knowledge
72313.completion:
Ah, dragonrider! I know that you're a herbalist of no small skill, but we Maruuk have methods you would do well to learn.

Our herbalists assembled these notes to aid your progress. Perhaps you'll visit with them and share some of your knowledge as well.

Between friends, there are no secrets under the sky!

72314.title: A Gift of Secrets
72314.completion:
{NAME}, the heart of a centaur beasts within you... and you have shown greater dedication to your craft than we could ever have imagined.

When last we spoke of your alchemy skills, I shared the first portion of our masters' crafting wisdom. But you have proven there are no techniques you cannot master.

Here are the rest of their notes. I know you will make good use of them.

72315.title: A Gift of Secrets
72315.completion:
{NAME}, the heart of a centaur beasts within you... and you have shown greater dedication to your craft than we could ever have imagined.

When last we spoke of your blacksmithing skills, I shared the first portion of our masters' crafting wisdom. But you have proven there are no techniques you cannot master.

Here are the rest of their notes. I know you will make good use of them.

72316.title: A Gift of Secrets
72316.completion:
{NAME}, the heart of a centaur beats within you... and you have shown greater dedication to your craft than we could ever have imagined.

When last we spoke of your herbalism skills, I shared the first portion of our masters' crafting wisdom. But you have proven there are no techniques you cannot master.

Here are the rest of their notes. I know you will make good use of them.

72317.title: A Gift of Secrets
72317.completion:
{NAME}, the heart of a centaur beasts within you... and you have shown greater dedication to your craft than we could ever have imagined.

When last we spoke of your skinning skills, I shared the first portion of our masters' crafting wisdom. But you have proven there are no techniques you cannot master.

Here are the rest of their notes. I know you will make good use of them.

72318.title: Iskaaran Crafter's Knowledge
72318.completion:
Ah, an enchanter! One who appreciates an ancient art.

Our ancestors were master enchanters. Now that you are helping us, we'll share our knowledge with you. With enemies all around us we must demand the best from everyone in our community, and I hope that includes you as well. 

Here are notes that should get you caught up on the basics. Speak to me when you wish to learn more.

72319.title: Iskaaran Crafter's Knowledge
72319.completion:
A fellow lover of nature! Good.

All tuskarr respect the cycle of nature. Herbalists are highly regarded in our community! We have a long tradition of using the gifts of the land in both ritual and medicine. Our elder herbalists are very learned but also... tend to keep to themselves. But they have left behind notes and drawings for those who want to follow their path into the wilderness. Use them well and come back to me for more learning later.

72320.title: Iskaaran Crafter's Knowledge
72320.completion:
Jewelcrafting? Hm, the profession always appealed to me. Who wouldn't be tempted by the glittering treasures of the earth?

Like many of your kind, we have perfected the art of jewelcrafting. And we've also preserved our knowledge for the future. If you wish to help us, jewelcrafter, we can share our knowledge.

72321.title: Iskaaran Crafter's Knowledge
72321.completion:
Greetings, leatherworker.

We tuskarr prize our ability to work with leather. Our culture has used skins and fur to protect us from the elements and from injury for many generations. You'll find no finer leatherwork anywhere. Because you wish to help us, we'll share our skills with you. I have here patterns and notes that will put you on the path to mastery of tuskarr leatherwork.

72322.title: Iskaaran Crafter's Knowledge
72322.completion:
You wish to learn about skinning? You've come to the right people.

We pride ourselves on the quality of our hides and furs. Our hunts bring back only the finest pelts, and our hunters guard their secrets carefully. Or at least some do. I have notes from some of our most prolific hunters that I can share with you. It should get you started skinning like a tuskarr!

72323.title: Iskaaran Crafting Mastery
72323.completion:
The aspiring enchanter returns! Have you mastered your first studies? Good!

Normally, you would now be assigned an enchanter mentor to guide you. But these are desperate times. Instead, I have more notes from out master enchanters. May they serve you well, and may you use them to help our community.

72324.title: Iskaaran Crafting Mastery
72324.completion:
Hail, herbalist! I see you have returned from your travels in the wilderness.

I've heard rumors that your talents have grown, and you've greatly aided our community. In thanks, I have gathered more notes and drawings for you to help you increase your skill. May you use them well!

72325.title: Iskaaran Crafting Mastery
72325.completion:
Jewelcrafter! I am glad to see you again.

I've heard whispers that your jewelcrafting rivals that of the most talented craft masters. I wouldn't know. Both a fine gem and glass glitter to me! But what I do know is that your bravery continues to help our community. As a reward, I have gathered more notes from our craft masters to give to you.

72326.title: Iskaaran Crafting Mastery
72326.completion:
Leatherworker! It is good to see you return.

I trust you want to learn more of our leatherworking secrets. Ha ha ha! Of course you do. I will not keep them from you. Your bravery has made you famous among our people. Here... I have more patterns and notes to help you master your craft. One day we may not be able to tell your leatherwork from our own!

72327.title: Iskaaran Crafting Mastery
72327.completion:
Ah, our aspiring skinner has returned. I can tell by your hands you have been hard at work. Excellent!

On a normal day in a normal time, I would help find a master to guide you. But this is not a normal day or time, and we must manage with what we have. Please, accept these notes to help you master your craft. Your work and your bravery make you a valued friend of the tuskarr.

72328.title: Our Ferocious, Armored Steeds
72328.completion:
Hello again, friend! Do you think another ottuk will bond with you? Well, we shall see. 

I will leave you and the ottuks to feel out if there is another bond. I will say that a pack of ottuk fighting together is a fearsome sight. I almost pity your enemies!  

I remind you that ottuk tack is expensive, especially war kit. If you wish to train another one, my fellow trainers and I must ask for a large trade.

72329.title: Crafting Your Start
72329.completion:
A blacksmith, eh? If you want to spend your days covered in soot, be my guest. 

But if you want to learn blacksmithing from our masters, you need to put some work in. They've left notes for people like you who want to improve. 

Take them. They're a little singed, but legible. Get some practice in and maybe they'll help you in person later on.

72330.title: Crafting Your Start
72330.completion:
So you want to be an engineer, eh? I'll bet you want to learn from our master engineers too.

Good luck then. Their time and skills are too in demand for them to make time for "aspiring" engineers.

I'll tell you what... I have some of their notes handy. Maybe if you practice on the schematics they've jotted down, you'll show your skill and get their attention!

72331.title: Crafting Your Start
72331.completion:
Inscription? A noble pursuit. It requires a keen mind, a steady hand, and quiet.

If you're looking for training, I don't think you'll make any friends of our master scribes by disturbing them. But I do have some notes they left here for those who want to learn their art.

Perhaps if you practice from their notes, they will gift you with greater knowledge later!

72332.title: Crafting Your Start
72332.completion:
You'd like to learn about mining? Really? Do you enjoy wandering around in the dark? Or do you just really like explosives?

No, don't tell me. Probably best not to know.

Our master miners are away doing what they do best. But I do have some notes that they left for aspiring miners. Sorry about all the smudges and scribbles. I imagine it's hard to write by headlamp light.

72333.title: Crafting Your Start
72333.completion:
You want to learn tailoring from our masters?

<Dothenos looks you up and down and frowns>

Well, I wouldn't go calling on them in that outfit. Here... I have some patterns they selected for aspiring tailors to try. Get some practice in and come back to me later--preferably in something more fashionable, {race}.

72334.title: Crafting for Expertise
72334.completion:
Ah, you have returned! I knew that you would.

Our master scribes have seen your work and are proud to call you one of their own. They have passed along these meticulously crafted notes for you to further your studies.

Well done, scribe!

72335.title: Crafting for Expertise
72335.completion:
Been hard at work, {NAME}? I can tell. You're a shade paler than you were before. Occupational hazard, isn't it?

Our master miners have heard word of your diligence and have left you more of their notes to help increase your skill.

If you get to work now, I'm sure you'll be a master in no time!

72336.title: Crafting for Expertise
72336.completion:
<Dothenos looks you up and down again.>

Hmph, well... fashion is subjective, I suppose. But I can't argue with results.

Your tailoring prowess has attracted the attention of our tailoring masters. Here are more patterns and notes to help you achieve even higher levels of expertise!

72363.title: Good at Doings, Not Understandings
72363.completion:
Ah, dragonrider. Welcome back. Here's some dust. No, I don't know what it really is either. The Ohn'ir mystics say it's supposed to help you commune with our ancestors. That the ancestors are all around us. Seems optimistic, if you ask me.

I can't claim to understand the Ohn'iri. The sky's honest truth is that I don't really want to. They're good people, mostly, but they're strange. Unnerving. But also allies, and they asked me to give it to you. And to make more available if you want it. So I do.

72372.title: Taming the Dragon...kin
72372.completion:
The blood of the dragon has touched many creatures in this land. Though not all of them can be reasoned with, that does not preclude them from becoming stalwart companions.

There is a deep bond that one must build when befriending dragonkin. Of course it comes naturally to my kind, but I can give you a book that will teach you our methods.

After that, it is up to you to achieve the bond needed to keep them by your side.

72392.title: Dragon Isles Supplies
72392.completion: Greetings adventurer. Please, take these supplies to aid you in your efforts to help our community!

72688.title: Renown Supplies
72688.completion: Greetings, {class}. You've proved your worth to the Valdrakken Accord. Here are some supplies to help you aid our cause. Don't let us down!

72690.title: Renown Supplies
72690.completion: Greetings, {class}. You've proved your worth to the Valdrakken Accord. Here are some supplies to help you aid our cause. Don't let us down!

72693.title: Renown Supplies
72693.completion:
Your victories against the Primalists have caught the attention of the Accord, {class}. They have decided to reward you handsomely... in the hopes you will continue fighting for the cause, of course. 

Please, take this larger allotment of supplies. Use them to defend the Dragon Isles!

72738.title: The Way to an Otto's Heart
72738.completion: <After inhaling the fish in front of him, Otto looks down at the barrel and then back up at you with a warm smile and a look of determination.>

74502.title: Complimentary Gift
74502.completion:
OUTPUT: Please accept this GIFT. 

ADMINISTER GIFT DISTRIBUTION PROTOCOL.
74502.objectives: OUTPUT: Please accept this GIFT. ADMINISTER GIFT DISTRIBUTION PROTOCOL.

74994.title: Hraxian's Unbreakable Will
74994.completion:
I have forgotten much in the course of my life. 

Twice now you have helped me recover a valuable memory.

<Veritistrasz smiles faintly.>
 
Perhaps I should take Tellywin up on his offer to write memoirs, if just for my own sake. 

You have done so much for myself and these folks. I hope one day to repay the favor.
Dusty Vase (1)

66156.title: Renowned with the Dragonscale Expedition
66156.description:
Your deeds have not gone unnoticed, and you continue to show that you are a renowned explorer!

Return to the Dragonscale Basecamp as I have prepared more supplies to help you continue in your endeavours.
66156.completion: Your deeds bring renown to all explorers. Take these supplies to aid you!
66156.objectives: Speak with Cataloger Jakes at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

71023.title: Renowned with the Valdrakken Accord
71023.description:
Your deeds are certainly in line with your fabled reputation prior to coming to the Dragon Isles. 

I wish to assist you further by providing you with additional supplies. Seek me out in Valdrakken.
71023.completion: It is my part to acknowledge those whose efforts further the accord and by acknowledgement aid them further. I take pride in aiding one such as yourself. Please take these so they may continue to aid your efforts against the Primalists.

66511.title: Renowned with the Iskaara Tuskarr
66511.description:
You continue to show us that you are an integral member of our community. 

To honor that bond seek me out in Iskaara as I have prepared a pack of supplies to aid you.
66511.completion: Again, we can only thank you so much and these supplies do not do that thank you justice, but please know your aid means a great deal to us!

75018.title: Into the Dark
75018.description:
My Blacktalon forces continue to secure the laboratory, but I think we are done here, {NAME}.

We have secured some slitherdrakes to take us down to the central platform. From there we can continue below, to where Sarkareth fell.

I am certain Ebyssian and Emberthal will benefit from our presence.
75018.completion: Good, you have made it. I could use your help, {NAME}.
75018.objectives: Meet with Ebyssian and Emberthal in the room at the bottom of the laboratory.

75023.title: Memories of Sindragosa and Malygos
75023.description:
I admit, I forgot about this phenomenon. Blue dragons who meet violent ends occasionally have some lingering arcane energy.

That energy may manifest in various ways once their essences are laid to rest. 

Luckily, it is a simple enough process to dispel them. Simply wave anything through the energy and it will dissipate. 

I shall investigate the essences of Sindragosa and Malygos within this gravestone while you handle that.
75023.progress: How strange that these memories still linger...
75023.completion:
That should do it, though it is odd not all of the memories were dispelled as quickly as I had hoped...

Let us speak with Kalecgos to let him know we should keep an eye on this.
75023.objectives: Dispel the lingering memories of Sindragosa and Malygos.

75024.title: Sneaky Pebbles
75024.description:
Beetles are swarming our support creche! Some of them are now eating pieces of broken Infusers, and that's making them stronger. We keep trying to smush them, but they won't stay smushed.

Now it's harder to get rid of them, but we have a plan. We've discovered that hitting them with pieces of broken Infusers can weaken them again!

Do you mind helping us clear out these Infused Beetles?
75024.progress:
Have you cleared those beetles yet?

I knew we'd discover new wildlife when we returned to the Reach, but this isn't what I wanted. Also, I'm getting really tired of treating bug bites.
75024.completion: Amazing work! Now we it will be easier for us to reclaim the support creche.

75025.title: A Good Day for Rolling
75025.description:
I have an... odd request for you. I need help with some squirrels. Primalists have corrupted them, and it's making them unstable!

I know just the thing to cool them off. Snow! If you could roll the creatures up in a big snowball, they would cool down as the snow melts. Ingenious, yes?

Can you help me?  I can't concentrate or finish my cataloguing, and I don't have time to write more eloquent prose. If nothing else, think of the loss to great literature!
75025.progress:
Have you, uh, rolled up those critters yet?

You make your work look so easy. I'm sure it will be... snow problem at all. 

Forgive me. It's the heat.
75025.completion:
Thank you for helping me! I can finally relax for a bit.

I'll thank you by recording your deeds in my records. I might also write a character inspired by you in my next novel. I'll claim it's an original character, but we'll both secretly know it's you.

75028.title: All the Broken Pieces
75028.description:
Emberthal is in mourning. In truth, she has been grieving for Sarkareth for some time now.

The way forward is for her to determine. We can only be there to support her along the way.

There are shards of Sarkareth's signet scattered all over this room. Would you gather them? I believe she would appreciate the gesture.
75028.progress: <Emberthal is in no mood to speak just yet.>
75028.objectives: Collect the shards of Sarkareth's signet.

75029.title: A Legacy, Reforged
75029.description:
Grief is a painful burden to bear. It warms my heart to see Emberthal emerge from her sorrow and focus on her people. The pain of her loss will ebb, in due time.

We need to inform Alexstrasza and the others of what has transpired here... and of the future of the black dragonflight.

With all that you have done to ensure that we have a chance at a future, I would like you to be there.
75029.completion: A new path. But one I accept gladly.
75029.objectives: Meet Ebyssian at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken.

75050.title: An Eclectic Accord
75050.description:
While the storm over the Reach was raging, I gathered allies for our eventual return. I want to ensure they have everything they need, but I can't welcome all of them personally.

Would you be my envoy, {NAME}? Can you make sure they have what they need? We have few supplies to offer and a shortage of assistance. 

The least I can do is offer my gratitude. Please thank them personally on my behalf.
75050.progress: I appreciate your aid. I would attend to our allies' concerns myself, but there are still many missing dracthyr.
75050.completion:
I must thank you as well, {class}. Our allies have come to the Reach for many reasons. Their kindness humbles me.

Now we need to follow through and do everything we can to make this place safe and prosperous.
75050.objectives: Speak with the newly-arrived denizens of Morqut Village.

75145.title: In the Wake of the Ashes
75145.description:
We did all we could. We will return to help them rebuild, but for now... the people of Loamm need time to mourn.

Alexstrasza must be informed of what happened here today. She must be warned what has been unleashed upon the Dragon Isles.

We will meet you at the Seat of the Aspects.
75145.progress:
Everyone must know what happened.

It is the only way we can hope to prepare for the damage to come.
75145.completion:
That is all we can do for now.

Sabellian, Wrathion, and I must plan our next steps as we prepare to return to Zaralek.
75145.objectives: Meet Ebyssian at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken.

75148.title: Ancient Techniques
75148.description:
I've heard tales that the djaradin forge their blades with magic so hot that they can actually quench the metal with lava. Lava! It's like ice water compared to the heat their magic creates! 

But I've never been able to verify it for myself. They aren't exactly peddling their wares at the market.

You smell like battle, though. Go and fetch some of their weapons for the blacksmiths back in Loamm and we'll see if the legends are true, eh?
75148.progress: I find the tales hard to believe, but then again... they do live in magma pits!
75148.completion:
<Crubus tries to accept the blades from you, but quickly yanks his hands back and shakes them out.>

YEOW! How are you holding those so easily?!

Just--just set them down. I'll get some gloves.

75149.title: Obsidian Essays
75149.description:
It's not common these days, but we do have a few of our histories in writing--well, carvings really. We can trace the etchings with our fingers! 

We used to use clay tablets for this, but they were brittle, and prone to breaking. Not good if you want to preserve history!

I hear the djaradin carve their important texts into volcanic glass. If they can manage that without shattering the tablets, we could probably learn a thing or two from their techniques!

Take some samples back to Loamm for study.
75149.progress: New knowledge can come from the strangest sources!
75149.completion:
Very interesting... they might look like brutes, but this carving requires a light and careful hand. Not to mention enormous amounts of patience.

With any luck, we'll both make something as fine as these one day, eh?

75150.title: Incandescence
75150.description:
Some of our incense needs to be burned very slowly to release the right aromas. You can check the heat yourself, of course--but it gets to be a bother.

Fortunately, I've found a solution! If you grind up shards of fire elementals and sprinkle the dust over the incense, you can keep the heat consistent using enchantments. Completely hands-free!

Those shards are a bit hard to come by, though. Could you find some and bring them to my friends back in Loamm?
75150.progress: Elder Honeypelt usually brings us back a stock of shards when she returns from a hunt, but I'd hate to bother her again so soon.
75150.completion: Wonderful! With this haul, I'll be able to keep our incense burning for weeks and still have some to spare.

75154.title: Waygate: Morqut Islet
75154.description:
We have access tae The Forbidden Reach now, and Cataloger Daela is already waitin' fer ya there. 

She's sent me a word of a very promising spire not far from the village where she's stayin'. 

Think there might be another dormant Waygate around? Go on an' find out!
75154.objectives: Locate the Dormant Waygate on the Morqut Islet in The Forbidden Reach.

75164.title: In Need of Primal Foci
75164.progress:
The major factions of the Dragon Isles are looking to upgrade the gear of their warriors. 

Do you happen to have any Primal Foci you would be willing to donate to this effort? The faction you donate to is sure to take note.
Primal Focus (2)
75164.completion:
Thank you!

Tell me which major faction you would like to donate these to, and I will make sure they hear about your generosity.

75165.title: In Need of Concentrated Primal Foci
75165.progress:
The major factions of the Dragon Isles are looking to upgrade the gear of their warriors. 

Do you happen to have any Concentrated Primal Foci you would be willing to donate to this effort? The faction you donate to is sure to take note.
Concentrated Primal Focus (1)
75165.completion:
Thank you!

Tell me which major faction you would like to donate this to, and I will make sure they hear about your generosity.

75166.title: In Need of Many Primal Foci
75166.progress:
The major factions of the Dragon Isles are looking to upgrade the gear of their warriors. 

Do you happen to have any Primal Foci you would be willing to donate to this effort? The faction you donate to is sure to take note.
Primal Focus (10)
75166.completion:

75167.progress:
The major factions of the Dragon Isles are looking to upgrade the gear of their warriors. 

Do you happen to have any Concentrated Primal Foci you would be willing to donate to this effort? The faction you donate to is sure to take note.
Concentrated Primal Focus (10)
75167.completion:
Thank you!

Tell me which major faction you would like to donate these to, and I will make sure they hear about your generosity.

75168.title: Air Control
75168.description:
We will never make progress while those shadowflame drakes have us pinned down from the air.

Get up there and knock them from the skies.
75168.progress: They are not the only ones who can fly.
75168.objectives: Slay or knock Primal Nightflames from the air with Whirling Surge.

75181.title: Volunteer Fire Fighters
75181.description:
We must contain the fires these rituals are causing.

We are too far from the river to take advantage of the waters there but luckily we have two... volunteers... from beyond the plains that claim they can help. They need another pair of hands.

Please go find the goblin and gnome. I appreciate their help but they need a third party to direct them.
75181.completion: A useful trick, to be sure. Now if those two would just see more eye to eye.
75181.objectives: Use the Water Elemental to diffuse fires in the Suffusion Camp.

75182.title: Grand Theft Mammoth
75182.description:
The djaradin have loaded a mammoth with the spoils of their labor here for delivery to Fyrakk.

Redirect that shipment. We can make use of whatever supplies they've gathered.
75182.progress: It should be hard to miss. They are quite large, after all.
75182.completion: Excellent, this should put a mammoth dent in their operations.
75182.objectives: Mount an Overladen Mammoth and return it to your lines.

75189.title: Safety in Numbers
75189.description: It is time we joined with the other survivors. The others mentioned that King Greymane and his royal guard are just south of here.
75189.completion: You've done well in coming here. If we Gilneans stick together, we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.
75189.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane in the military district.

75190.title: Ready and Abel
75190.description:
Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.

We're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.

That reminds me. Someone was asking about you. A monk, Todd Abel, said he needed to speak with you. He seemed very concerned.
75190.completion: Glad to see you made it here safely.
75190.objectives: Speak to Todd Abel in the Military District.

75203.title: Absent Friends
75203.description:
I am concerned about our queen.

Alexstrasza left to gather her thoughts some time ago and has not yet returned. I have no real cause for concern, but with all that has happened, I cannot help but fear for her well-being.

Please ease an old dragon's mind and ensure she is alright.

75221.title: Find a Rumble Coin
75221.description:
To use this game machine, you need a Rumble Coin.

There are a bunch of coins hidden all around the Dragon Isles. We'll chat about those later.

I stashed one coin here in the Roasted Ram. If you find it, it's all yours, pal.

Insert that Rumble Coin into the Rumble machine and watch the fun begin!
75221.progress:
<The Warcraft Rumble machine stands before you. A small sign reads:>

Insert Rumble Coin to play.
75221.completion:
<As you insert your coin, the fun little machine rumbles and jingles.

You got a prize!>

75223.title: Warcraft Rumble Minis: New Look!
75223.description:
<You find a message etched into the foil.>

This Rumble Foil can be used at a Warcraft Rumble machine. Go and get a new look for one of your minis!
75223.completion: <The Warcraft Rumble machine has a hatch. It's the perfect size to insert a miniature toy and a Rumble Foil.>

75230.title: Reconcilable Dissidents
75230.description:
My hope, {NAME}, is that our work to understand the rebels will allow us to find a path to peace.

My concern is if we are not able to come to an understanding with Belaphon, other rebels may see her as a martyr for the cause.

Whatever happens, you have my gratitude for your assistance throughout this rebellion.
75230.progress: I hope Belaphon can see the way forward for Dragonkin.
75230.completion:
This crisis has driven us to a better understanding of each other, and driven me to be a better leader.

And we could not have found the way to peace without your help. {NAME}, thank you.
75230.objectives: Listen to Alexstrasza's conversation with Instigator Belaphon.

75232.title: Fallen Effects
75232.description: <You wrap Sheridon's effects into a bundle, and place them in your pack to return to the camp members.>
75232.completion:
Oh... Sheridon... He bought our lives with his own. I... I will make sure his family gets these.

I'll mark the location of his body, we'll have Rupert retrieve it so he can have a proper burial.

Thank you. Please, have this.
75232.objectives: Return Sheridon Hastle's Effects to Earthmender Narvra in the Dragonscale Expedition camp in Zaralek Cavern.

75233.title: Flesh to Bone
75233.description:
We found Skuttog near a cave to the north, by some nasty spiders. It seems like his skin is turning into bone.

I can heal him, but I need venom from whatever bit him. Please help.
75233.progress: Please hurry. He's almost a statue already.
75233.completion: This should be enough. Let's see if it works.
75233.objectives: Find the venom of the beast that bit Skuttog.

75237.title: Reach West
75237.description:
You and your drakes seem to enjoy your adventures in Forbidden Reach, don't you? 

I heard the windstreams in the western Forbidden Reach are especially good today. Why don't you try a few courses out there?
75237.completion: You both look you had quite a workout. Way to go!

75239.title: Disciple of Fyrakk: Shadeisethal
75239.description: <Fyrakk's disciple has fallen. Perhaps the remains of this beast will bring some comfort to those whose land has been ravaged.>
75239.progress: That was a lot of fire. So many people burned.
75239.completion:
This thing was so angry. Rage and fury festering for eons before my people first sailed the seas. I cannot even imagine that depth of hate.

You have put it to rest. I thank you, {NAME}, on behalf of all of those whose lives you have saved by slaying this beast.

75244.title: Reunited Again
75244.description:
Thanks to you, {NAME}, all of the blue dragons are accounted for. We can get back to caring for Azeroth's magic and making sure its power isn't abused.

I believe a speech is in order. I would be honored if you would stay for it. 

We can head to the Nexus afterwards to see what Azuregos has discovered about Sindragosa and Malygos's arcane memories.
75244.progress: It is good to see so many blue dragons returned.
75244.completion: It appears this was a short reunion.

75258.title: A Final Word
75258.description:
I have sent a message to Mayla in Valdrakken, relaying what has happened here. I suspect she will be relieved to hear from me... and in knowing she was right to send you. 

Before you leave, I would like to speak with you a moment.
75258.completion:
{NAME}, there are few who would have gone to the lengths you have to aid me in this endeavor. You had no personal stake in this matter, yet you risked your life for my sake.

For this, you have my deepest gratitude. Should you one day require my assistance, you need only ask.



And now there is one last person I must speak to.

75259.title: Aiding the Accord: Zskera Vaults
75259.description:
Our allies once again seek your assistance as our efforts continue across the Isles. Words within the walls of Valdrakken whisper a resounding comfort knowing your efforts have helped shape our future.

Now then, to business.

Pathfinders of the Dragonscale Expedition are delving deeper into the Zskera Vaults on the Forbidden Reach. They are asking for brave adventurers to help them explore these new mysteries.

We await your return, {NAME}.
75259.completion:
My, my. What wondrous news! The Accord will be most pleased by your efforts. 

Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.

75261.title: Reach Center
75261.description:
You and your drakes seem to enjoy your adventures in Forbidden Reach, don't you? 

I heard the windstreams in the central Forbidden Reach are especially good today. Why don't you try a few courses out there?
75261.completion: You both look you had quite a workout. Way to go!

75263.title: Reach South
75263.description:
You and your drakes seem to enjoy your adventures in Forbidden Reach, don't you? 

I heard the windstreams in the southern Forbidden Reach are especially good today. Why don't you try a few courses out there?
75263.completion: You both look you had quite a workout. Way to go!

75286.title: Blacksmith's Back
75286.description:
The kith of Loamm request the skills of a seasoned blacksmith! We've heard of the wonders you uplanders make with smelted ore!

Our Kilnmaster, Mister Crubus, has heard you have devised a way to dig without claws or earth magic! What a wonderful invention!

Please deliver some of these "shovels" as soon as you can, won't you?
75286.progress:
Who are you? Oh, Kayann sent you?

Well, do you have what I asked for or what?
75286.completion:
So these are those... What did you call them? Shovels?

And you hold them in your hands, and move dirt with them? Huh.

I'll be honest with you, friend. I'm an old niffen. I'm hoping these will spare me from bending over so much.

Well, here goes nothing!
75286.objectives: Deliver Sturdy Expedition Shovels to Kilnmaster Crubus in Loamm.

75288.title: Enchanted Tales with Topuiz
75288.description:
The kith of Loamm request the skills of an excellent enchanter! Magic is so prevalent in this wondrous city, it practically floats about on the breeze!

Our chief Dustmonger and Sparklefinger, Mister Topuiz, has heard of the many different ways you enchant your clothes on the surface, and wishes to see some examples for himself!

Please deliver those scrolls as soon as you can, won't you?
75288.progress:
Greetings, friend! You smell new!

What brings you to the Dustmonger?
75288.completion:
Oh, the scrolls I requested from Kayann! Lovely!

Mmm, smells like magic! Let's see if I can put these to good use!

75289.title: Ink Master
75289.description:
The kith of Loamm request the skills of a scribe! We niffen have heard of the powerful magical writings you produce on the surface, and wish to smell your handiwork with our own noses!

Our Chief Chiseler, Miss Scridorsa, has requested a sample of both pigment and runestone be brought below.

Make a delivery to Loamm as soon as you can, won't you?
75289.progress:
Hmm? Can I help you?

I'm very busy, you know!
75289.completion:
What's this? Why are you handing this to me?

...

OH! These are the items I requested from Kayann! Why didn't you say so?
75289.objectives: Deliver Shimmering Pigments and Chilled Runes to Scridorsa the Chiseler in Loamm.

75304.title: I Need... a Tailor
75304.description:
The kith of Loamm request the skills of a talented tailor! We niffen are terribly curious about the magical finery you create here!

We have our own stitchers and clothes-makers down below. Mister Rossmar has expressed an interest in the procurement of bolts of high quality cloth!

Make a delivery to Loamm as soon as you can, won't you?
75304.progress:
Did Kayann send you? Oh, thank the soil!

I need those bolts of cloth, and quickly!
75304.completion:
Ohhh, this is wonderful cloth! It glides so gently through my claws, but also feel strong enough to withstand daily use! 

And you delivered it just in time! What's the emergency? Well...
75304.objectives: Deliver Vibrant Wildercloth Bolts to Rossmar in Loamm.

75308.title: Scrybbil Engineering
75308.description:
The kith of Loamm request the skills of an engineer! We have heard of the marvelous machines invented right here in this city, and eagerly wish to put these to use underground!

We have an engineer of our own down below, Mister Scrybbil, who has a special interest in what you call "fishing rods". How does such a thing work? Do you use them to spear the fish? How strange!

Please deliver these "fishing rods" as soon as you can, won't you?
75308.progress:
Step right up, and witness the fantastic inventions of Scrybbil! Can I interest you in a firework, sir and/or ma'am?

What's that? You have a delivery for me?
75308.completion:
Oh, wonderful! I've been waiting for this day!

Down here, we just use our claws to catch fish. It's a bit barbaric and not really efficient! Now I can use this and catch a mountain of fish!

... How does it work?
75308.objectives: Deliver Draconium Fisherfriends to Scrybbil in Loamm.

75354.title: Mycelium Mastery
75354.description:
Hey there, stranger! I had an idea to run by you.

The mushrooms that grow down in Zaralek Cavern have thick and powerful mycelium capable of gripping into even the hardest crystals.

Imagine the possibilities with such a material! I had a friend down in Loamm who was trying to work out how to make it into a leather!

Interested? Bring my friend Garram some mushrooms!
75354.progress: We call those crystal clinging mushrooms Nightlight Conkerbells. Not only do they give off light, they even have a strong enough scent to help guide our noses!
75354.completion:
What? There's hardly any mycelium on these!

<Garram thinks.>

I wonder... do they leave it behind in the crystal? 

Hmm... I'll try to grow more here and experiment. Thanks for the help!
75354.objectives: Collect 10 Nightlight Conkerbell Samples and deliver them to Garram in Loamm.

75362.title: Cephalo-crystalization
75362.description:
Well, hello there!

Have you seen those snails in Zaralek Cavern with the crystals growing from their shells? 

When crushed to powder and mixed with a proper solution of slime, those crystals make a paste that adds a considerable luster to our gems! Bring some to my good friend Fanilly, and I'm sure she'll be happy to chat your ear off about jewelcrafting!
75362.progress: You know, a good shine on a gemstone is very important to us... we have such a hard time seeing it otherwise!
75362.completion: Oh yes, this will do! Now watch, just grind it together, then apply it to the gem and polish...
75362.objectives: Collect 10 Whelkshell Crystals and deliver them to Fanilly in Loamm.

75363.title: Deepflayer Dust
75363.description:
Why, I just got another letter from my good friend Mistie. She's been looking for interesting ingredient ideas for her smelly concoctions!

A while ago, the kithguards took down a deepflayer near Loamm. I noticed a peculiar dust it shed when it perished. It had a unique aroma to it, and I'm sure Mistie would love to experiment with something like that!

Could you gather some from the deepflayers near Loamm, then bring it to Miss Mistie? You'll be doing us a favor, too!
75363.progress: Such a mysterious musty aroma... the grim note of death alongside the gentleness of soil.
75363.completion: Oh yes, this'll do nicely! Can you smell that with your nose? It's very fragrant!
75363.objectives: Collect 10 Deepflayer Dust and deliver them to Mistie in Loamm.

75367.title: The Obsidian Rest
75367.description:
It is a miracle this outpost survived so long after Neltharion's... disappearance. 

For weeks now local scouts have reported increased djaradin activity in the area. They are amassing an army, and they are also becoming increasingly aggressive in their efforts to expand their territory.

We must take every possible precaution and try to understand our enemy's motivations.
75367.progress: These are trying times for all of us.
75367.completion: We must discuss what you have learned, {NAME}.
75367.objectives: Gather information and resources at the Obsidian Rest.

75368.title: Stones and Scales
75368.description:
I'm sure you've run into some of the mean beasties we have down in Zaralek while you were on your adventures! Have you seen any rock vipers yet? 

They're covered in both scales and stones! And have massive fangs!

Mister Garram has offered a reward for anyone brave enough to bring him some of their hides! I'm sure he will make it worth your while!
75368.progress: Have you collected those hides yet? Those snakes are a little scary, but I think a {class} like you can handle them!
75368.completion:
Wonderful! These'll do nicely. Look how hard and sharp the scales are!

Thanks for your help, friend! I'll let Kayann know if I need anything else.
75368.objectives: Collect 10 Scaly Stone Hides from rock vipers  in Zaralek Cavern.

75369.title: Use Your Coin!
75369.description: Use that coin on the Warcraft  Rumble machine over there.

75371.title: Fascinating Fungi
75371.description:
Ah, Uplander! Can I ask for your assistance?

The cavern below is full of mushrooms that are useful for all kinds of things! Miss Mistie has asked for help gathering them for her alchemical experiments.

She says the Gelcap mushrooms produce sticky spores that she can make into a balm, good for easing achy joints and bunions! I sure could use some after standing around on these hard stones all day!

If you can find her some, I'm sure she will make it worth your while!
75371.progress: Have you collected the spores? I'm eager to get my hands on them!
75371.completion:
These are incredibly sticky spores! Thank you, {NAME}! 

Next time you see Kayann, tell him I'll get him his balm soon--and some free sunscreen to boot! I don't know how he stands being up there all day!

75372.title: Drive Them Before Us
75372.description:
Drive these whelks from our lands, {NAME}!

For Imbu! For the Azure Span!
75372.completion: That'll leave a mark they won't soon forget!
75372.objectives: Slay djaradin and Primalists assaulting the Azure Span.

75373.title: Charge of the Ottuk Brigade
75373.description:
Bah! They hide behind their barricades, hoping that will protect them from our vengeance.

Clear the way and we will ride them down like the cowards they are!
75373.completion: Prepare to taste our spears, Fyrakk!

75374.title: To Defend the Span
75374.description:
The djaradin struck without warning, {NAME}. Our people are capable fighters, but no one escapes a battle like this unscathed.

Please, help with the wounded. Many are trapped behind the enemy lines and can't make their way back in their current state.
75374.progress: There are always more wounded that need healing.
75374.completion: Fewer deaths is always worth celebrating. We have lost enough as it is.
75374.objectives: Heal 6 Gruff Fishers using the provided bandages or your own abilities.

75375.title: Burning Ice
75375.description:
Whatever magic the djaradin are employing is lighting the ice on fire out there, {NAME}.

We can't let this spread to the wider Span. It has to be stopped before it consumes everything.

Gather as much water as you can while on that drake of yours and drown the fires. Hopefully that will be enough to extinguish them.
75375.progress: The sight of burning ice unnerves me.
75375.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. At least we can contain the damage.
75375.objectives: Extinguish fires across the djaradin camp.

75376.title: Suffuse, Reuse, Recycle
75376.description:
If Fyrakk is willing to openly attack the surface in pursuit of these materials, they must be vital to his plans.

Grab whatever you can. There must be a way to turn these to our advantage.
75376.progress: We'll strengthen ourselves even as we deny our enemies.
75376.completion: Admirable work, {NAME}. They would not have let this go lightly.
75376.objectives: Recover infusion supplies from Fyrakk's forces.

75377.title: Maintaining the Barricade
75377.description:
It's all I can do to keep this shield up under the barrage these shadowflame drakes are putting out.

Thin their ranks before we're pinned down for good.
75377.completion: Excellent work. I might even be able to catch my breath before the next catastrophe.
75377.objectives: Slay or knock Primal Nightflames from the air with Whirling Surge.

75382.title: Portal Combat
75382.description:
The Primalists are channeling elemental forces through those portals, energizing their entire effort and speeding the production of these suffused ingots.

Soon they will be stabilized enough to allow their elemental allies to pass through to reinforce their position.

We have to seal them before that happens or the battle may turn against us.

Take this focus and disrupt the portals' protective runes, then we can strike from above. Only together do we stand a chance.
75382.completion: Excellent. That will at least stabilize the situation.

75383.title: Hideaway No More
75383.description:
This was supposed to be a peaceful retirement, not a warzone!

Grab one of those totems the shamans left lying around and put out these fires before my dreams of a nice fishing retreat go up in smoke! Literally!
75383.progress: Who burns down an ice fishing hut?
75383.completion: Good job, {race}. Maybe I'll get an afternoon to myself, yet.
75383.objectives: Use a water totem to extinguish fires in Grimtusk's Hideaway.

75384.title: Payback's a Mammoth
75384.description:
Trying to kill me I can forgive, but attacking my Hideaway? Now it's personal.

The djaradin are loading their mammoths with all the ingots they can bear to get them back to their precious Fyrakk.

Hijack one and bring it back here, cargo and all.
75384.progress: What are you waiting for? A thaw?
75384.objectives: Mount an Overladen Mammoth and return it to your lines.

75388.title: The Azure Vaults
75388.description:
There's a problem in the Azure Vault, {NAME}. 

Beneath the Azure Archives rests the Azure Vault. Sindragosa stored many important and dangerous magical curiosities in it.

A large group of Sundered Flame have broken into the vault to unlock its secrets.

You need to go in there and stop the Sundered Flame!
75388.completion: Thank you for your help within the vaults, {NAME}.
75388.objectives: Stop the Sundered Flame within the Azure Vaults.

75407.title: Silk Scavenging
75407.description:
Hello friend! You're a tailor, right? So you must know about silk!

Mister Rossmar down in Loamm knows how to make special silk from the cocoons of the Underlight Moths, but could use some help gathering them up! 

You should be able to find them in the mushroomy area near Glimmerogg. I'll sure he will make it worth your while!
75407.progress: Hey, uplander! Do you have those cocoons yet?
75407.completion:
These look great! Thanks, {NAME}!

Now we just need to boil them and turn them into thread. Oh they make SUCH a smelly smell when you boil them.

What's that? You have to go? Oh, ok!
75407.objectives: Collect 10 Underlight Cocoons Fibers in Zaralek Cavern.

75408.title: Calling All Dracthyr!
75408.description:
<This flyer is illustrated with inviting sketches of dracthyr eating, sparring, and having fun.>

Calling all dracthyr!

Do you feel adrift after the events of the underground? Do you want to bond with your creche mates? Do you just need someone to talk to?

Come join us at Weyrnrest for food, fun, and camaraderie! ALL dracthyr welcome!
75408.completion:
Everyone's tired, that much is clear. But this kind of togetherness is what will help us start healing.

Why don't you take a look around, talk to some {race}?
75408.objectives: Go to the party at Weyrnrest in Valdrakken.

75417.title: Symbol of Hope
75417.description:
Champion--Ebyssian, Sabellian, and Wrathion have come to an agreement of who should lead, and are presenting a unified front. All three were quite eager to speak of your contributions and aid in Zaralek Cavern as well. It seems that they are also in agreement that they could not have succeeded without you.

High praise indeed--and well deserved.

Please, stay for a little longer. The other Aspects and I have matters to discuss, and I believe you should be here as well.
75417.progress: Please, stay for a little longer. The other Aspects and I have matters to discuss, and I believe you should be here as well.
75417.completion:
We still have much to do--but the sight of five united Aspects fills my heart with hope... and with joy. 

Thank you. Your part in this will never be forgotten.

75419.title: Sundered Flames
75419.description:
Did Neltharion keep this place as his hoard? No wonder that Sarkareth was looking for it. 

Neltharion's "treasures" litter every corner of it.

There's no telling what Sarkareth has gotten his claws on here.

Stay close!
75419.completion: I did not wish to fight Dezran. Sarkareth's strong personality and manipulative tongue are making his people follow his wildest whims.

75440.title: Satiating Sharpbeak
75440.description:
Sheridon Hastle was our flight master and Sharpbeak's rider. After his death, she won't let anyone touch her.

<Narvra clutches her side in pain.>

Or feed her. Rupert tried but... she just won't.

The rest of us are too injured to move... I'm worried about her.

Can you... ow... try? Someone new may get through to her. Her feed is in the bag by the tent.

And... if you can get her to accept food, she might let you ride her.
75440.completion:
<Sharpbeak tentatively accepts the feed from you. 

After a few snapping bites, she looks you in the eye, spreads her wings and shakes them.

You feel as though she might let you ride her if needed.>
75440.objectives: Feed Sharpbeak in the Dragonscale Camp in Zaralek Cavern.

75444.title: Waygate Exploration: The Forbidden Reach
75444.description:
<Another visit from Nanners, and another calling from the Dragonscale Expedition.

It seems Thaelin Darkanvil have something of an interest for you yet again.>
75444.objectives: Meet Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost in The Waking Shores.

75456.title: News From Beneath
75456.description:
Before I arrived, I was informed that the Life-Binder has need of our aid. There is news of the Incarnates, and she requests our presence at the Seat of the Aspects.

As for Emberthal -- there is very little we can do for now. It is best we allow her to reflect and gather thoughts alone.
75456.completion: The Aspects have gathered. Let us not keep them waiting.
75456.objectives: Meet Alexstrasza at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken.

75462.title: Mouse Rescuers
75462.description:
I feel bad for everything I did working for Malrogg. He was just so big and scary, I never felt like I had a choice...

<Agrul slowly shakes his head.>

No more excuses. We need to get that sniffin' mouse back home to Yarren.

I was never strong enough to take on Malrogg alone. But you... You can save Persii.
75462.completion: I can't thank you both enough for saving Persii!

75493.title: Surveying the Riverbed
75493.description:
Hope you brought your boots, 'cause this is gonna be a wet one!

This river carries artifacts down from the mountains, and they wash up here in the silt. The centaur have found loads of stuff here over the years.

We're here to take a deeper look and see if there's anything interesting below the surface.
75493.completion:
<Roska lets out a low whistle.>

Now that's something you don't see every day. Let's get her out of there.
75493.objectives: Speak with Roska to start the dig, then excavate artifacts from the riverbed.

75518.title: The Body on the Banks
75518.description:
<The state of the corpse of this centaur woman is surprising.

Her clothing is in a style unfamiliar to you, and her skin is emblazoned with intricate tattoos.

Her body is intact, so it seems as though she could not have been dead long... or could she? Conditions here may have led to better preservation.

Roska will want to have a look at this!>
75518.progress: Nothing like silt, eh {NAME}? Never know what you'll find!
75518.completion:
Would you look at that! I bet this poor gal has been buried under all that silt for hundreds of years if not more.

Bogs and riverbeds like this tend to preserve what's been left in them.

But now that she's out, we can find out more about who she was and how she got here!
75518.objectives: Speak to Roska to begin carefully excavating the centaur corpse.

75519.title: The Long Hunt
75519.description:
<Dori'thur hovers silently, peering at you with keen, expectant eyes.

With a taloned foot, the noble owl offers you an imbued crystal. Within that crystal, you sense a message.>

75528.title: A Tester's Guide to Entering Zaralek

75538.title: Beginning Impositions
75538.description:
Darkest greetings, {race}. Ahem, yes. Yes! Darkest greetings indeed.

<The lanky man seems to suddenly remember where he is.>
