On behalf of my patron, I bid you travel to the Darkmoon Faire. The Faire! Who doesn't love it? Yes. Yes!

Ahem.

She requires your presence, she does! Our Lady of the Midnight Moon. The Damsel of Darkness! The Mother of Crows...

...Madam Shadow.
75538.progress: Everyone knows the way to the Faire...

75539.title: Some Wicked Things This Way Come
75539.description:
Phineas did well in bringing you to me, $p. There is much work to be done.

We'd best get to it!

As a master of the dark arts, I need you to help me whip these newcomers into shape. Talk to them. They come from many walks of life--all of them unfamiliar with the dark arts.

Learn their wishes. 

Their hopes.

Their dreams.

This path we walk can bestow gifts unending and power unimaginable. One just needs to know what one truly desires...
75539.completion:
Only one or two pairs of cold feet, hm? 

<Madam Shadow chuckles.>

Excellent.

Now that we know who wants to be here, it is time to determine who deserves to be here.
75539.objectives: Talk to the newly arrived warlocks around the Darkmoon Faire.

75540.title: Hermetic Insurance
75540.description:
Ah, the latest group have gathered beneath my wings like chicks to a mother crow. You've done well so far, $p. They trust you. 

I trust you.

The next step in shepherding these simple souls along in their diabolical journeys is to safeguard them against the void. Against oblivion. Against death.

Take my soulstone and use it to gird the willing... and the damned.
75540.objectives: Use Madam Shadow's Soulstone on willing initiates in the Darkmoon Faire.

75541.title: Those Who Hesitate
75541.description:
Hm.

There is one who has been counted amongst our number, but is not here.

The draenei.

<Madam Shadow inhales.>

I can taste the Light about him. Go, see to it that he rejoins us.

There is much work to be done.
75541.progress: This view reminds me of... many things.
75541.completion: Now to appease our mysterious patron...
75541.objectives: Talk to Initiate Oman in the Darkmoon Faire.

75542.title: Curses & Cultists
75542.description:
The wheat has been separated from the chaff. Now the fun can truly begin.

I have an exciting... field trip... planned for our students. But they are not yet ready. Take my grimoire and have the pandaren, zandalari, and tauren try their hand at curses. 

I found some uninvited guests loitering on the edges of our fairground. They should make excellent, if unwilling, test subjects.

Oman will have the honor of summoning the group far afield, and I will instruct him as such.
75542.completion:
It worked! That grimoire of Madam Shadow's really is powerful...

I hope I didn't startle you, {NAME}.
75542.objectives: Teach the initiates curses from Madam Shadow's grimoire in the Darkmoon Faire.

75543.title: Last Rites By Accident
75543.description: <You can hear the faint sound of screaming coming from the other side of the portal.>
75543.completion:
The others... their soulstones...

I saw a green flicker in their eyes as they fell, one by one. Like the very essence of their souls were being drawn forth.

They deserved better.
75543.objectives: Go through the Demonic Gateway and help the Initiates.

75544.title: When Revenge Burns Green
75544.description:
Whatever game this Madam Shadow has been playing, it appears as though we're nearing the end of it.

<Oman grunts in pain.>

From what we've heard, it sounds like our next destination is somewhere in the Blasted Lands.  I must rest, but please $p... go and see this through. Bring Madam Shadow to account. Avenge our fellow warlocks.
75544.completion:
Those soulstones... the other warlocks. 

<Oman closes his green eyes.>

When I chose to walk this path, I knew there would be repercussions. That I would be sacrificing a part of myself. A part of how my people see me. 

But to have your soul torn asunder... for what? Petty revenge?

Truly that is a fate worse than anything I have taken upon myself.
75544.objectives: Confront Madam Shadow in the Blasted Lands.

75569.title: Blacksmith, Black Dragon
75569.description:
The black dragonkin in the north of Zaralek Cavern are said to be fine blacksmiths.

They're quick to claim it has something do with a "dominion over the earth", but I'd like to see them try burrowing like a proper niffen!

Still, you can't argue with the results. Grab a few examples and bring them to Kilnmaster Crubus in Loamm so he can study their techniques.
75569.progress: I wonder if I could use one of their helmets as a tub?
75569.completion: The craftsmanship is impeccable, but would it kill them to use a color besides black?

75573.title: Proclamation Reclamation
75573.description:
You know who likes to hear themselves talk, loves bureaucracy, and enchants their own records? Dragons!

Go poke around in the old black dragon fort north of Loamm. I'm sure they'll be all sort of magic-ish decrees, proclamations, and shopping lists just lying around!

Bring whatever you uncover to Scridorsa the Chiseler back in Loamm. I'm sure she'd love something new and heavily enchanted to read!
75573.progress: Can't do anything simply, can they?
75573.completion:
<Scridorsa flips through the documents.>

"By my hand...", "The will of the Earth-Warder...", "At my command..." Sounds like a dragon, sure enough!

Still, these should make for an interesting study, if not read.

75575.title: Ballistae Bits
75575.description:
Those djaradin might smell like brutes, but their engineering corps must be top notch to keep churning out ballistae strong enough to threaten a dragon!

Northeast of Loamm there's an ongoing scrap between them and some black dragons. There ought to be lots of spare parts scattered around. Or slightly used, moderately on fire ones, anyway!

Haul them all back to Loamm! A little scorching won't stop our top minds from reverse niffeneering them.
75575.progress: I wonder what they use for torsion?
75575.completion: Interesting, that's a lot more bone than I would have expected given the stress involved!

75598.title: Snailed It
75598.description:
Hmm. You ever mount a snail before?

I've trained generations of racing snail champions, but lately I've come across my toughest case yet. Simply put, he's too crokin' big. Straight up barred from competition.

It's a shame to keep such a prize specimen stuck in a bucket, though. If you can help me train Slick up to be the speedster I know he is, we'll call him yours!
75598.completion:
I have never been prouder. Y'all snailed it.

Not many have what it takes to enter the fast-paced world of snail racing, but you? You got it. I just know Slick is going to enjoy spending the rest of his snaily life going on adventures with you.

<Briggul sniffles and pats Slick's shell.>

Happy slime trails to you, big guy. Make sure you come back to visit!

75600.title: Silk's Silk
75600.description:
We may not have access to all those fancy plant fibers you surface types use up here, but we do have a lot of options I bet you don't!

The spiders near Loamm make the most interesting smelling silk I ever did sniff. I think it might have something to do with their diet?

If you round some up, I'm sure Rossmar back in Loamm will be happy to teach you a thing or two about how to use it!
75600.completion: Doesn't the calcium give it the best texture?

75602.title: Chips off the Old Crystal Block
75602.description:
The crystalline creatures back home are as mysterious as they are stompy.

What allows them to move? Are they even really alive? What do they taste like?

Bring Fanilly a few samples to start studying. Just not any big enough to step on anyone in Loamm, ok?
75602.progress: Who knows what we could learn?
75602.completion: Fascinating, {NAME}, thank you for your contribution to the art.

75603.title: Do Rites by Her
75603.description:
This gal has been here for a long, long time. It's a wonder she's in such good condition.

It's one thing to dig up pottery shards in the mud, but something like this requires more care and expertise than you and I have combined! Maruukai isn't far from here...

We should tell the centaur about this. They can decide how best they'd like to proceed, eh?

While we're at it, I bet some of their expert artisans can tell us about her gear.
75603.progress: We've got a proper dig now here!
75603.completion:
It doesn't get better than this, {NAME}. New chapters of history unfolding, whole communities rallying around a find... 

They'll be talking about this dig for years!

Makes all the stomping around in the mud worthwhile, doesn't it?
75603.objectives: Consult Storykeeper Jaru, Farrier Rondare, and Tigari Khan for guidance on how to treat the ancient corpse.

75604.title: Antiquated Antics
75604.description:
Well, there's two factors at play here, eh?

We should do our due diligence and figure out who this was a statue of. But between you and me? I'm much more interested in learning about the jokesters that turned it into this work of art.

I'm sure there's a historian of the black dragonflight somewhere near Aberrus. And why don't you poke around Loamm to see if there are any stories surrounding this kind of... artistic license.
75604.completion:
We'll keep up the dig around the tower. 

There's still an awful lot of midden to go through. Even if we don't find something this spectacular again, we've got a lot to learn about the niffen and how they lived before and during the dragons leaving.

But I think we've done a good day's work for now!
75604.objectives: Find experts from both Loamm and the black dragonflight to weigh in on your find.

75608.title: Titan Trash or Titan Treasure?
75608.description:
The watchers left all sorts of amazing technology just laying around when they went to sleep.

We could learn so much from their ancient castoffs. Even the least of contraptions are marvels to behold!

If only there was someone brave, intelligent, and dare I say handsome enough to go retrieve a few examples for our finest niffeneers back in Loamm to examine... sound familiar?
75608.progress: I wonder if we'll ever truly understand their technology?
75608.completion: What's a hololithic gear, you ask? I don't know, but I look forward to finding out!

75617.title: Honor the Flame
75617.description:
The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.

We will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, {NAME}?

75622.title: Calling All Competitors!
75622.description:
The Artisan's Consortium has struck a deal with the quartermasters of the Gladiator's Refuge!

In addition to the usual selection of powerful combat equipment they offer, worthy combatants can now purchase tokens that can be used in Crafting Orders or one's own crafts to certify the equipment for use in battlegrounds and arenas!

Present this flier to Calderax to receive two complimentary Trophies of Conquest, on us!

- Rabul
75622.completion:
Hm, they sure know how to reach their audience.

Here are your trophies as promised. Use these when crafting your own equipment or submitting Crafting Orders and the gear will be comparable in power to what I offer. It is perfect if you are looking for something highly specific or imbued with a certain embellishment... and are willing to put in some extra work.

Questions? Take them to the Artisan's Market.
75622.objectives: Deliver the flier to Calderax in the Gladiator's Refuge of Valdrakken.

75625.title: Wanna Play a Game?
75625.description:
<You open a scribbled note.>

Heya pal! The name's Mizzen, and I hear you're pretty good at findin' stuff.

See, I've been playin' this new game called Warcraft Rumble but I'm fresh outta coins.

How about we meet up and I'll tell you where to find some?
75625.completion:
Hey there, glad you could make it!

You gotta check out this machine!

75626.title: Wanna Play a Game?
75626.description:
<You open a scribbled note.>

Heya pal! The name's Mizzen, and I hear you're pretty good at findin' stuff.

See, I've been playin' this new game called Warcraft Rumble but I'm fresh outta coins.

How about we meet up and I'll tell you where to find some?
75626.completion:
Hey there, glad you could make it!

You gotta check out this machine!

75632.title: A Dislocated Disc
75632.description:
As a gesture of good will, Eternus has pledged her assistance in finding the disc that contains Tyr's memories. The infinites have devices that can aid in divining its location.

To quote Eternus, "This is a mess Deios made. It is fair we help clean it up."

I feel some responsibility as well after our attempt to wake Tyr with the Silver Scale.

Meet Eternus at Tyrhold. She will brief you on her progress. Perhaps now our old friend will finally join us once more.
75632.completion: We meet again, {NAME}. Nozdormu said you would come. I welcome your aid.

75633.title: We Have the Technology
75633.description:
During our... long discussion about how to find Tyr's disc, Chromie and I agreed that you were the right person to help us, {NAME}. But finding the location of Tyr's disc could be very dangerous and would likely require more than just your help.

While I work here to narrow down what we need to find the disc, Chromie can give you more details.
75633.completion: It's good to see you again, {NAME}! I have hope that this time we will finally be able to restore Tyr's memories.
75633.objectives: Ask Chromie about the plan to recover Tyr's memory disc.

75634.title: Reforging the Tyr's Guard
75634.description:
After the tomb was destroyed and the Silver Scale failed to bring Tyr back, I made the decision to rededicate my life to Tyr.

And I made the even harder decision to leave the past behind and reforge Tyr's Guard.

I had faith Tyr would need me again soon. And, after consulting with the Silver Hand, Koranos and I believe we have found four worthy Tyr's Guard recruits.

Come with me to Brackenhide Hollow, and assist me in their final training. Then we can venture into the timeways to find Tyr's disc.
75634.completion: Now that you're here, we can get started with my recruits' final trials.
75634.objectives: Meet Travard at the Tyr's Guard camp in Brackenhide Hollow.

75635.title: For Tyr!
75635.description:
Did they all complete their trials successfully? Good. I'm sure you played no small part in that.

There's one final step we need to take before I can formally induct our recruits as full-fledged members of the Tyr's Guard: the Tyr's Guard initiation ceremony. 

It would make me proud if you stood with us on the steps of Tyrhold as I formally reforge the Tyr's Guard. Will you join us?
75635.completion:
The Tyr's Guard stands once again. I feel both renewed and... very old. They still have much to learn, and I have much to teach them.

Now, onto the task of recovering Tyr's memories!
75635.objectives: Witness the induction ceremony of the Tyr's Guard on the steps of Tyrhold.

75636.title: Tyrangulation
75636.description:
The portals are ready. The sooner your team deploys those beacons, the sooner we can get the location of the disc. 

How you deploy your forces is up to you--and Travard.
75636.completion: Welcome back! Eternus said there was a signal from your beacon, so I assume everything went smoothly?
75636.objectives: Protect Travard at the Temple of Order.

75637.title: The Final Beacon
75637.description:
Valunei and Talthis still aren't back. They must have had trouble with their beacon. We can't find the disc without it, and there's no way to help from here. 

We must lead the Tyr's Guard through their portal to help. Are you ready, {NAME}?
75637.progress: We must discover what was happened.
75637.completion:
We're all back in one piece, thank the Light.

Now, hopefully our dragon friends can find that disc!
75637.objectives: Help the Tyr's Guard activate the Final Beacon.

75638.title: Dislocated Disc Located
75638.description:
We were successful, {NAME}, but we barely made it back from our battle with the Black Empire.

Eternus is still divining the location of the disc, and while she does, I'd like to ask a favor.

I have unwavering faith in my recruits, but...

I am worried about Valunei. I would speak to her, but I don't want it to appear as though I think she has failed us. Talk to her and make sure she's all right.

It may also be a good idea to check in with the rest of Tyr's Guard as well.
75638.progress:
I'm worried about my recruits, but maybe I should be worried about myself.

Reforming the Tyr's Guard has been a kind of catharsis. But I'm worried that it may be too much so.

I was devastated by the loss of my comrades in the Tyr's Guard... I worry that I may be pushing them too hard.

Or myself. I've been at this a long time, {NAME}. But to see Tyr alive once more... that gives me purpose.

I just hope wisdom comes with my age, and I do right by my new recruits. And that they all come home.
75638.completion:
I'm glad to hear you were able to speak to her. It sounds like she is ready despite what happened. 

A lesser person would have not been able to pick themselves up after that, but Valunei is stronger than many of us realize.

As soon as Eternus locates the disc, we will be ready.
75638.objectives: Check in with the Tyr's Guard.

75639.title: Fel Suspicions
75639.description:
At the risk of stating the obvious, something very wrong is going on.

I know you feel it too.

Madam Shadow is sending myself and the other initiates to the Altar of Storms, to try our hand at summoning demons. Please, $p, poke your head around here and see if you can't piece together what she's up to. 

I saw her and her servant heading towards the back of the faire... I'm sure she has her guard up. Maybe there's some way you can get close without drawing attention to yourself?
75639.completion: The gate is warm to the touch.
75639.objectives: Spy on Madam Shadow and Assistant Phineas in the Darkmoon Faire.

75640.title: Honor the Flame
75640.description:
The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.

We will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, {NAME}?

75643.title: Orientation: Loamm Niffen
75643.description:
I'm impressed. Elder Honeypelt speaks highly of you--and that's rare!

Your friends Ebyssian and Emberthal admittedly made similar impressions with us after we caught their scent. They told me of your hunt for the fiery monster that's invaded Zaralek from the uplands. A worthy reason to become allies.

But we'll need a bit more time to discuss it. Why not take a short break to meet with my people. Trade, leisure, travel--there's no shortage of ways to spend your time here in Loamm!
75643.progress: Smells around every corner, but nothing dangerous!
75643.completion:
Zaralek Cavern will not see the end of these new enemies any time soon, so let us continue getting to know each other with open arms and open snouts.

Consider this your official invitation to stay with us here in Loamm, the great city of smells!
75643.objectives: Meet the Flight Master in Loamm.

75644.title: Six Hundred Feet Under
75644.description:
That was just a taste of the niffen lifestyle. There's still far more to Loamm and even more from Zaralek Cavern. Continue exploring while you pursue the fiery monster, and let its scents continue to amaze you!

For now, Ebyssian asked that I send you his way. Seems your companions are planning what to do next.
75644.completion:
Though I still wish you had waited for Emberthal and myself to arrive, I do not believe the outcome would have been any different. This Incarnate is more powerful that we anticipated.

There is much to consider.
75644.objectives: Discuss the next plan of action with Ebyssian.

75647.title: Honor the Flame
75647.description:
The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.

We will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, {NAME}?

75650.title: Honor the Flame
75650.description:
The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.

We will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, {NAME}?

75662.title: A Race to the Finish
75662.description:
You look like someone that enjoys a good snail race! 

And what makes a snail race good you ask? Each snail must have a chance to win! 

And sometimes the snails might need a little bit of help. 

If you grab a bag of treats from the chef and toss it in their path that'll get them moving. 

How about we give Bashful a nudge to victory?
75662.progress: Has your snail won the race?
75662.completion: That was a great victory. I think you should be Bashful's new trainer!

75694.title: Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible: Sarkareth
75694.description:
I have no interest in following my brothers within Aberrus, but I continue to care for their safety. Neltharion fell so deeply into madness that his secret stronghold is no doubt filled with any number of unspeakable dangers.

Go with them, {NAME}. Stand with them. They will need your support in what is to come.
75694.progress: Aberrus holds mysteries and dangers alike. They must be dealt with, before any of them fall into the wrong hands.
75694.completion:
I never imagined that Sarkareth would have gone to such lengths to seize power.

Thank you, {NAME}.
75694.objectives: Enter Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible, and defeat Sarkareth.

75706.title: A Race to the Finish
75706.description:
Everyone loves a good snail race! In the most exciting races, every snail has a chance to win.

You can help a snail win by giving it treats. Watch how fast it makes them go!

Grab a bag of treats and toss them in the path of the snails. See if you can get Tricky to win!
75706.progress: Has your snail won the race?
75706.completion: That was a great victory. I think you should be Tricky's new trainer!

75709.title: Find a Rumble Coin
75709.description:
To use this game machine, you need a Rumble Coin.

There are a bunch of coins hidden all around the Dragon Isles. We'll chat about those later.

I stashed one coin here at the docks. If you find it, it's all yours, pal.

Insert that Rumble Coin into the Rumble machine and watch the fun begin!
75709.progress:
<The Warcraft Rumble machine stands before you. A small sign reads:>

Insert Rumble Coin to play.
75709.completion:
<As you insert your coin, the fun little machine rumbles and jingles.

You got a prize!>

75711.title: Find a Rumble Coin
75711.description:
To use this game machine, you need a Rumble Coin.

There are a bunch of coins hidden all around the Dragon Isles. We'll chat about those later.

I stashed one coin over in the inn. If you find it, it's all yours, pal.

Insert that Rumble Coin into the Rumble machine and watch the fun begin!
75711.progress:
<The Warcraft Rumble machine stands before you. A small sign reads:>

Insert Rumble Coin to play.
75711.completion:
<As you insert your coin, the fun little machine rumbles and jingles.

You got a prize!>

75712.title: Warcraft Rumble Minis: New Look!
75712.description:
<You find a message etched into the foil.>

This Rumble Foil can be used at a Warcraft Rumble machine. Go and get a new look for one of your minis!
75712.completion: <The Warcraft Rumble machine has a hatch. It's the perfect size to insert a miniature toy and a Rumble Foil.>

75713.title: Warcraft Rumble Minis: New Look!
75713.description:
<You find a message etched into the foil.>

This Rumble Foil can be used at a Warcraft Rumble machine. Go and get a new look for one of your minis!
75713.completion: <The Warcraft Rumble machine has a hatch. It's the perfect size to insert a miniature toy and a Rumble Foil.>

75720.title: Care to Barter?
75720.description:
Hey, Uplander!

I hear you like helping. Maybe you could help me out? 

I need some packages sent to Valdrakken. If you don't peek and don't ask, I can make it worthwhile. 

Stop by when you're in Loamm. We can work out a deal!

Your new friend, Ponzo.
75720.completion: I can smell my letter on you. Ready to help?

75721.title: Bartering 101
75721.description:
So here's what I need you to do. 

A friend of mine, Kayann, went all the way up to Valdrakken. He's expecting a delivery from me. Can you get it to him? 

No questions, though. Don't look, don't smell, don't taste. This is for Kayann's nose only!

If that's all right with you, I'll send you on your way--with my thanks, of course!
75721.completion:
I know a Ponzo box when I smell a Ponzo box!

Thanks for bringing it up--quite the trip! Here's something Ponzo will love to trade for.
75721.objectives: Deliver Ponzo's box to Kayann in Valdrakken.

75722.title: Bag of Gold
75722.description:
Hello, $p! 

I heard you've been helping us out! Good deeds should be rewarded--and I've got something special for you! Why don't you meet me in Loamm?

Keep up the good work, 

Mimuup

75723.title: Cavern Drakewatching
75723.description:
Well hey there, Uplander!

Word is, you've been helping us out a lot! We got a little something for you in return. See me in Loamm and I'll hand it over!

Best, 
Harlowe Marl
75723.completion: We're lucky to have you around!
75723.objectives: Talk to Harlowe Marl in Loamm.

75724.title: Like the Niffen Do
75724.description:
Hello there, $p!

We want to thank you for all the help you've given us. It's only right! 

Meet me in Loamm and I'll teach you to dig like we niffen do!

Sincerely, 
Mimuup
75724.completion:
Just put these mitts on, get them in the dirt, open your snout and boom!

Loamm can be smelled from anywhere in Zaralek Cavern. 

The secret's in the claws! It's always been in the claws!

75725.title: Off to the Track
75725.description:
Hey Champ! 

We got a fresh golden opportunity for you. Snail racing! One of the most dynamic sports in the games! 

Ponzo said you'd be interested. Called you a real go-getter!

So go! Get to the track in Glimmerogg! 

See ya there, 
Briggul

75727.title: The Smelliest Tabard
75727.description:
Greetings, $p!

You just keep doing us amazing favors, don't you? Come on back to Loamm for an extra special reward!

Sincerely,
Mimuup
75727.completion: Here it is, handcrafted and handscented!

75728.title: Bartering Boulders
75728.description:
Oh hey, Uplander! I could use your help again. 

I like your battering style. But you know these bricks? They're useless! Boulders are where it's at! 

Come see me in Loamm, and I'll give you all the details.

Ponzo
75728.completion: I hope you've been working out. These aren't light at all!

75729.title: Attune to the Observer
75729.description:
Can you believe this used to be an observatory? Our records indicate that the dragonkin here were mapping heavenly bodies in an attempt to predict the future.

How do you think they did it?

I'm picking up a partial signature that matches the time window we're shooting for. Put on the Technoscryers and try to pinpoint the sources so we can dial it in.
75729.progress: Without those attunement relics we won't be able to solve this mystery, {NAME}.
75729.completion: Ah ha! Give me your scryers, so I can calibrate them.
75729.objectives: Technoscry for the three attunement relics.

75730.title: Slitherdrake Watching
75730.description:
Well hello there!

Word around here is that we've got your continued support--so we got a little something for you. Meet me in Loamm so I can hand it over!

Best,
Harlowe Marl
75730.completion: We're lucky to have you around!
75730.objectives: Talk to Harlowe Marl in Loamm.

75731.title: Scented Boots
75731.description:
Well hello there!

Word gets around of your continued support. We've found some armor that you may be able to use. Come meet me in Loamm and we'll see if it's useful!

Best,
Harlowe Marl
75731.objectives: Talk to Harlowe Marl in Loamm.

75741.title: Bundle of Boulders
75741.description:
Hey Uplander!

I heard you've been telling people I've been mean to you. 

I haven't, but they told me to be nicer to you because all you've done for us. 

Taken advantage of? More like giving you some honest work!

To make you and the others happy, I'll give you some boulders. 

See me in Loamm, 
Ponzo
75741.completion: Make sure to mention to Mimuup that I was nice to you, you hear?

75742.title: Drake Helms
75742.description:
Howdy!

Word gets around of your continued support. 

We got a little something for ya. Meet me in Loamm so I can get it to ya!

Best,
Harlowe Marl
75742.completion: We're lucky to have ya around.
75742.objectives: Talk to Harlowe Marl in Loamm.

75744.title: A Token of Our Gratitude
75744.description:
Greetings!

With all the help you've given us, we've decided it's only fair to return the favor.

Meet me in Loamm. We have a reward we're eager to give you.

Sincerely,
Mimuup

75765.title: Liquid Art
75765.description:
<A clay pot filled with... mud?

It appears to be niffen in origin. Perhaps a resident of Loamm is looking for it!>
75765.completion:
You found my favorite slip pot!

I can make slip in any pot, but this is one of the first pots I made of special sediments I dug myself.

It's sentimental ... AND sedimental!
75765.objectives: Return the Dripping Clay Pot to its owner in Loamm.

75766.title: Ruby in the Rough
75766.description:
<A beautiful ruby set in fine gold sits nestled in a box of draconic origin.

The jewelcrafter in Loamm would love to take a look at this.>
75766.completion:
This is beautiful! Did the dragons make this? It's so red and sparkly!

Thank you, {NAME}!
75766.objectives: Deliver the Shimmering Draconic Gem to Fanilly in Loamm.

75767.title: Good Time Boy
75767.description:
<A very wet gorloc totem rests on the cave floor. How did this even get here?

The niffen love stuff like this. Maybe someone in Loamm will take it off your hands.>
75767.completion:
<The niffen gives the totem a huge sniff.>

He smells like fish! Excellent! 

He'll make an excellent bouncer for my shows. I think I'll call him... Whistlee!
75767.objectives: Find a new home for the Soaked Totem in Loamm.

75768.title: Lucky Ducky
75768.description:
<You find a small toy duckling.

It reminds you just a little of Loamm's swallows. Maybe Cinnam will like this?>
75768.completion:
Wow! Thank you, {NAME}.

Seeing as I'm the new Head Swallowsminder, I've been in need of an apprentice!
75768.objectives: Give the Feathered Friend to Cinnam in Loamm.

75769.title: Drawing a Blank
75769.description:
<A discarded painting covered in dust rests on the cave floor.

Maybe someone in Loamm could make use of this?>
75769.progress: How did you know I wanted to try my nose at scent-painting?
75769.completion:
A brand-new canvas! This will be perfect to practice my scent-painting on.

Right now it smells so... blank! Thanks!
75769.objectives: Give the Stretched Canvas to a niffen in Loamm.

75770.title: A Glass of Bubbly
75770.description:
<You find a glowing blue potion of indeterminate origin.

Maybe the Loamm alchemist will want to take a look?>
75770.progress: Hmm... I'll need to run some analysis!
75770.completion:
This is most intriguing.

I'll have to get the best noses in Loamm on the case so we can identify just what this is.

Thank you, {NAME}!
75770.objectives: Take the Bubbling Elixir to Mistie in Loamm.

75771.title: Incense Replay
75771.description:
<You find some incense that smells familiar, but you can't quite place it.

Citros will definitely want to take a sniff.>
75771.progress: Boy howdy! That's some mighty strong incense!
75771.completion:
This doesn't smell like niffen!

It doesn't smell bad, though, not at all!

If you don't mind, could I take a closer sniff?
75771.objectives: Take the Mysterious Incense to Citros in Loamm.

75772.title: Flask Manager
75772.description:
<A small leather-wrapped flask sits on a shelf in the cave.

Someone might be missing this.>
75772.progress: Well it's not mine, but I'll take it off your hands!
75772.completion:
There's no way this belonged to someone in Loamm. I've never seen leather quite like this before.

If you don't mind me asking, could I take a closer sniff at this? I might be able to apply some of these techniques!
75772.objectives: Find the owner of the leather-wrapped flask.

75773.title: Little Blank Book
75773.description:
<You find a book filled with Draconic text and not much else.

Maybe someone in Loamm could help you decipher it?>
75773.progress: What do you mean, read it? It's blank, silly!
75773.completion:
There's no writing in here! It just smells like blank paper!

I can't read it if there's nothing to smell, Uplander. 

Still, it was nice of you to bring me a blank notebook.
75773.objectives: Bring the book back to Loamm.

75783.title: Apex Canopy River Run - Reverse Challenge

75833.title: Report to the Trading Post
75833.description: <The glint of a distant object catches your eye. You suddenly remember that you have tender to collect for use at T&W Trading Post.>
75833.progress: Did you collect this month's tender?
75833.completion: Hope ya like this month's collection of new and exotic wares, {NAME}.
75833.objectives: Return to the Trading Post to collect your Trader's Tender from the Collector's Cache.

75859.title: Aiding the Accord: Sniffenseeking
75859.description:
Our allies once again seek your assistance as our efforts continue across the Isles. Words within the walls of Valdrakken whisper a resounding comfort knowing your efforts have helped shape our future.

Now then, to business.

Our niffen allies in Zaralek Cavern are always on the lookout for something new and exciting--or smelly. Join them on a dig through the many lost and forgotten caverns in their domain, and see what you find.

We await your return, {NAME}.
75859.progress: Do you bring news of your success?
75859.completion:
My, my. What wondrous news! The Accord will be most pleased by your efforts. 

Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.

75860.title: Aiding the Accord: Researchers Under Fire
75860.description:
Our allies once again seek your assistance as our efforts continue across the Isles. Words within the walls of Valdrakken whisper a resounding comfort knowing your efforts have helped shape our future.

Now then, to business.

Researchers of the Dragonscale Expedition are exploring the depths of Zaralek Cavern. They are asking for brave adventurers to help protect them from the many dangers in that area.

We await your return, {NAME}.
75860.completion:
My, my. What wondrous news! The Accord will be most pleased by your efforts. 

Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.

75861.title: Aiding the Accord: Suffusion Camp
75861.description:
Ash blows from the south. 

A dark bargain has been made, {NAME}, between the djaradin of the Zaqali and Fyrakk. Their forces are building... something.

We do not know what their goals are, but they have had no hesitation in displacing anyone and everything in their path. 

Please, {NAME}, we need champions like you to undermine these villains and deprive them of their resources.

We await your return, {NAME}.
75861.completion:
There is much we can learn from your efforts. What were they making? Well, that is a mystery for us to unravel later. 

Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.

75865.title: Relic Rustler
75865.description:
A group of mean, scaly uplanders moved in near the old titan ruins south of Loamm and started tearing the place apart.

Rude, but they're sure to have uncovered all sorts of ancient titan scraps. And that stuff is almost always magic in some way.

Grab some and go see what Dustmonger Topuiz back in Loamm can make of it!
75865.progress: I can't wait to see what you uncover!
75865.completion: Amazing! These smell ancient... and just the right sort of tingly!

75867.title: A Link to the Past
75867.description:
Okay, calibrations complete! Mine too, so I'll be able to see what you see.

Let's head over to that telescope and we'll see what we see.
75867.completion: Unfortunate for them, but perhaps an opportunity for us. Hmm....
75867.objectives: Observe the events from the past.

75868.title: A Window into the Future
75868.description:
Those lenses are a wondrous integration of technology and arcane artifice. I'm sure we could learn much, and maybe even upgrade my own invention.

But first we'll need to find it. You're a dragonrider, right? Can you fly up and recover the lens?

It's possible the dreadsqualls still have it in one of their nests.
75868.completion:
Success! 

I knew you were the right person for the job!
75868.objectives: Search Dreadsqualls nests to recover the lens.

75874.title: Time to Fly
75874.description:
Zandalar is home to many pterrordaxes. One will accompany you into the skies.

Visit Beast Master Kalatak at Dazar'alor in Zuldazar.
75874.completion:
I'm glad you came. This pterrordax is unruly and yearns to see the world beyond Zandalar's shores. I cannot train such a beast.

You take it. May it bring you good fortune in your journey.

75877.title: Time to Fly
75877.description:
Kul Tiras is home to many gryphons. One will accompany you into the skies.

Visit Leila Stafford at the Tradewinds Market  in Boralus.
75877.completion:
I'm glad you came. This young gryphon was left behind when the rest were sent for training. I didn't think I would ever see this day, but it is now ready to fly.

Will you take it and fly around the world for me? May it bring you good fortune in your journey.

75885.title: Get Rich Quick
75885.description:
Uplander! I have a question for you. 

Do you want to wear an expensive hat like mine? Own the best snails in town? Enjoy the good life?

If the answer is yes, you're ready to make more wealth than you've ever dreamed of! Ponzo style!

Together we can both be rich! Of course I'm already rich, but you can be too!

Just take these items I have here and show them around town. I'll cut you in for a share of the profits for every order you get.
75885.completion:
You did great! I even have a bonus for you.

Now you can buy more things from me and sell as much as you want. Every sale you make makes us both richer.
75885.objectives: Get the citizens of Loamm to order some Ponzo's Cream and Glimmerogg Timeshare Vouchers.

75887.title: Fyrakk's Forces
75887.description:
Champion, Fyrakk and his Primalist allies have struck a dark bargain with the djaradin. We have received word that their forces are assaulting the Dragon Isles in search of resources for some nefarious project.

Please, champion, find one of these Suffusion Camps and assist any of our allies you can find there.
75887.completion: Welcome Champion! Your aid would be appreciated.

75888.title: Suffusion Camp
75888.description:
Fyrakk has made a deal with the dragon hunting djaradin!

Their blacksmith, Igira, has sent her finest crafters under the aegis of Fyrakk's Primalists. They are gathering materials for the construction of... something. 

Find a way to access their Suffusion Crucibles and Molds. Keep what you find but we must learn more about what they are doing. The forces appear to require special wards to access the Crucibles and Molds. Start there.
75888.progress:
What have you found in the Crucibles and Molds? 

All of this shadowflame about makes my scales crawl.
75888.completion:
Shadowflame! They are suffusing every ingredient and component with shadowflame!

What are they crafting? It must be something far more dangerous than simply outfitting the army here.

Well done, hero. We trust you to put those materials to better use than these beasts.
75888.objectives: Loot a Suffusion Crucible and a Suffusion Mold.

75890.title: The Clarion Call
75890.description:
Good to see you, {NAME}. I have a message from someone called Arko'narin Starshade. It reads...

"As a protector of the kaldorei, I must ask for you to meet me near the embassy in Stormwind. Tyrande has called the Wardens to action, and Maiev Shadowsong herself requested your aid in this matter as well."

Arko'narin Starshade
75890.completion: It is an honor to meet you, {NAME}.
75890.objectives: Speak with Arko'narin Starshade near the Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City.

75891.title: Ancient Curses
75891.description:
Thank you for answering my call so quickly, {NAME}.

Demonic corruption has seen a resurgence in Felwood recently. Tyrande sent out a contingent of Sentinels and one of her own priestesses to investigate the matter further. None have returned.

Tyrande asked the Wardens to look into the matter--and Maiev has asked for your assistance personally.

We need to make haste to Felwood, and see what Maiev has discovered.
75891.progress: May Elune guide us all to victory in this forsaken place.
75891.completion:
I will fill you in on what we need to do, {NAME}.

But first, let me put my friend to rest.

75918.title: Fire Season
75918.description:
No doubt you have seen the destruction that Fyrakk continues to leave in his wake.

While others fight him directly, my troops and I have been serving as the eyes and ears of the green dragonflight. Although Fyrakk's actions may seem erratic, there are trends to his strategies.

We learned that he is to have a secret meeting with Vyranoth soon in Lunedane. This is a deviation from his recent tactics, and we need to know why.

Given the danger, we would value your aid. Meet me in Lunedane.
75918.completion:
Keep to the shadows, {NAME}.

Lunedane is already crawling with Fyrakk's forces.
75918.objectives: Meet Shandris at Lunedane in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

75919.title: Dousing the Wards
75919.description:
Fyrakk and Vyranoth are already here. I spotted them near the overlook at the northeastern edge of Lunedane. Landing close to their location would reveal our presence, thus we are forced to begin our mission here. 

However, the bridge connecting this area to the overlook has been protected with fire magic. We will not be able to break through it.

Fyrakk's Primalist allies appear to be maintaining the fire using wards set up around this area. 

If we destroy the wards, the fire should subside.
75919.progress: We need to bring that barrier down so we can get closer to the Incarnates. We cannot hear them from this far away.
75919.completion:
Destroying those stones appears to have extinguished the fire magic protecting the bridge.

Though I cannot be certain how long it will stay that way. It would be best to move swiftly.

75920.title: Eyes of Fire
75920.description:
This area is swarming with far more Primalists than I expected. Fyrakk does not generally travel with guards, so I doubt the Primalists are here to accompany him.

They seem to be trying to establish a foothold here. But why? 

Perhaps whatever the Incarnates are discussing will answer that question.

In the meantime, let us thin out the Primalists guarding this area. We cannot risk having them in full force behind us as we cross the bridge.
75920.progress: We will need to work quickly. We cannot risk drawing the attention of the Incarnates.
75920.completion:
<Shandris looks back at the bodies of the druids. She appears bewildered, but there is pain in her eyes.>

Druids of the Flame? 

Fyrakk has conscripted them into his service?

Why would any night elf agree to this...?
75920.objectives: Kill 8 Burning Flamespeakers or Blazing Overseers.

75921.title: Through the Flames
75921.description:
Druids of the Flame...

<Shandris frowns deeply, eyes shut as she holds back her anger.>

To think that they still exist. That any of our people would join Fyrakk and his--

<She stops, releases a heavy breath, and continues.>

We have a mission to complete.

We need to cross the bridge to get close enough to the Incarnates that we can overhear their conversation. I will shroud us so that we can move between the elementals still guarding the way forward.
75921.progress:
We need be as close to the Incarnates as we can.

We cannot afford to miss a single word of their conversation.
75921.completion: This is as close as we can get without revealing ourselves.
75921.objectives: Collect 4 Smoldering Blossoms while crossing the bridge towards Fyrakk and Vyranoth.

75922.title: Inflammatory Information
75922.description:
<Shandris whispers to you.>

Do you see that up ahead? The Druids of the Flame have captured what appears to be a keeper--a guardian of nature, sacred to our people. If their power is already enough to...

<Shandris shakes her head, then gestures at the dense shrubbery nearby.>

Stay hidden with me and we will listen to the Incarnates, and perhaps discern what the druids intend to do with the keeper.
75922.progress: I will hold off any reinforcements that come. Deal with the keeper!
75922.completion:
I had feared what we might learn today, but this...

<Shandris tightens her grip on her bow to steady herself.>

This is beyond anything we could have prepared ourselves for.

75923.title: Raise the Alarm
75923.description:
So the Druids of the Flame have allied with Fyrakk to help him invade the Emerald Dream.

They were able to turn that keeper to the flame with hardly any effort. Fyrakk must be bolstering their power, perhaps as payment for their aid in accessing the Dream.

We need to mobilize troops immediately to find every Druid of the Flame on the Dragon Isles and stop them.

Go to Captain Drine in Valdrakken and alert her. She will dispatch the drakonid.

I will go to Merithra and handle things here.
75923.completion: We have to trust Alexstrasza for now.
75923.objectives: Deliver your report to Captain Drine at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken.

75937.title: No Time Like The Present
75937.description:
Emberthal arrived while you were in the field. She and her allies are surveying the area from the cliffs above. 

It would be wise to check in with her, I think. We would not want her to attempt taking the Reach alone.
75937.objectives: Meet with Emberthal above the cliffs of Morqut Village.

75949.title: Downbeat Data
75949.description:
You say that Tempo mentioned objects from other timelines?

I have a device used for syncing melodies. Strangely enough, it seems to have the same effect on timelines in this town. Perhaps a side effect of the chaotic temporal energies here?

I've upgraded Pedgi's glasses to allow him to observe the rhythms of the world. They may make it easier to find mis-timed entities. Ask if you can borrow them.
75949.progress: Have you found any mis-timed entities?
75949.completion:
Looks like the mis-timed objects are back in their proper place. One less thing for Tempo to worry about.

Hmm... Interesting data here. Perhaps it will come in handy later.

Apologies that Pedgi hasn't been much help. Probably best to muster up his resolve. This is his song to compose, after all.
75949.objectives: Use Melly's device near objects from other timelines. Pedgi's sunglasses will make them easier to find.

75950.title: An Exemplar of Justice: Hadwin
75950.description:
We've been out here for a good bit of time. Time enough for me to watch the gnolls around here.

Gnolls are usually a nuisance, but the decay gnolls around Brackenhide Hollow...

The decay doesn't just warp their bodies. It warps their minds too.

Decaymonger Rotpaw is the worst of them. She's indiscriminate in who or what she spreads her decay to: the unwilling of her people, travelers, animals, children...

If there's any justice in this world, she should be taken down.
75950.completion: Perhaps I bit off a bit more than I could chew... But with your help, Rotpaw and her ilk paid for their crimes.

75951.title: An Exemplar of Order: Talthis
75951.description:
I know why Travard chose this area for our training. The decay here is... chaotic and disordered.

Things that Tyr and the titans are not! 

The nearby gnolls revel in the decay. Revolting.

They have taken over territory that was once occupied by the proud, noble, and civil tuskarr.

The tuskarr have asked that relics they had to abandon are returned to them. Please help me fight the gnolls and retrieve the relics so the tuskarr can continue their rituals in Iskaara.
75951.progress: The gnolls had no right to those relics. They belong to the tuskarr.
75951.completion: I am glad that we could restore these relics to the tuskarr. It feels good to impose some semblance of order on the chaos of decay.

75952.title: An Exemplar of Sacrifice: Nolaki
75952.description:
Much is said about how decay spreads through the air and ground. But it also spreads through the water. 

Slimes that live in the rivers and streams ooze pestilence. The water is toxic with it. But if we wade in and kill the big one, the poison in the water will diminish.

It may poison me in the process, but I am going to kill one if it's the last thing I do. This place needs a purging. 

Are you with me, {NAME}?
75952.completion: Thank you for stopping those smaller slimes, {NAME}. I was able to kill the big one, but I would still be there if it weren't for your aid.
75952.objectives: Help Nolaki defeat a massive slime.

75953.title: An Exemplar of Compassion: Valunei
75953.description:
It makes my heart ache to see what the decay has done to some of the wildlife here...

I cannot save all the creatures that live around Brackenhide Hollow, but I wish for my trial to at least save some.

In a cave to the west, there is a family of bears that has recently been corrupted. I believe I can fight my way there and heal them. Will you help me, {NAME}?
75953.completion:
Tyr's compassion for the vrykul inspires me. I think he would have compassion for animals too, do you not? They suffer and feel pain just as you or I would... 

Thank you for helping me save those bears. Even a little compassion goes a long way.

75966.title: Compose Yourself
75966.description:
I promise he's not always like this. But he is, often, like this.

Usually it takes him a few days to come out of his funk, but we don't have that sort of time. The commission he got to write this song won't last forever.

Maybe we can speed up the process. Could you help raise Pedgi's confidence?

75971.title: Squeaky Toy of Time and Space
75971.description:
We have detected another time anomaly. A strange object that even we cannot understand the significance of.

This artifact must be returned before it does irreparable damage to the true timeline and the world as we know it.

Return here once you have recovered the artifact. I will open a portal so you may return it to its proper place.
75971.progress: All of our fates depend on returning that artifact to its proper time.
75971.completion: Thank you, champion. You have helped save Azeroth once again. I shudder to think what would have happened, were you not here to intervene...
75971.objectives: Find the Time-Displaced Toy and return it to its proper time.

75985.title: Rest Well, Warrior
75985.description:
Shalkeel deserves to be seen off properly.

I want to dress his burial area and say a few words. I know your time is precious, but would you take the shovel and bury his ashes while I perform the rites?
75985.progress: If I were able to handle his ashes, I'd have poured them out over the stream he and I played in when we were children.
75985.completion:
I wish I could compensate you for this act, but I have no diplomatic medals or legendary weapons to bestow, {NAME}. 

Just know that I... I could not have shouldered the weight of this day alone. A heart hollowed by loss takes time to fill again.

Be well. And thank you.

75986.title: Feats Per Minute
75986.description:
Alright, one last problem to help solve. Succeed at this and we'll surely have earned an audience with Tempo!

The investigators discovered another Time Slime. A much larger, powerful Time Slime. 

We've come to call it Time Slime Prime.

Its temporal energies are greatly accelerated, making it especially deadly. I recommend using the metronographer several times to slow it back down before engaging in combat.
75986.completion:
Ah, there you are. Thank you for your assistance in our time-tidying efforts. 

Now I have to a chance to speak with Pedgi himself! Truly, what an honor. It was so difficult holding myself back when he first approached me. But now I have plenty of time to speak with him.
75986.objectives: Re-synchronize and defeat the Time Slime Prime.

75990.title: Star-Crossed Lovers
75990.description:
We found a time disruption long, long ago. Someone helped Illidan charm Tyrande, dooming us all to the Burning Legion!

Malfurion is so distraught he can't even sleep. He has no idea how to win her back.

We need you to help him out before the timeline is ruined.
75990.progress: As painful as it can be, heartbreak can be essential for making us who we are. Even if who are isn't always... nice.
75990.completion:
If only we could've let Illidan have his happily ever after with Tyrande, at least for a little while longer. I always thought those two were really cute together!

But we all have our role to play to make sure events flow smoothly.
75990.objectives: Help Malfurion gain Tyrande's affection in Val'sharah.

76026.title: Surveying the Tower
76026.description:
Get a load of those rock formations! Surveying doesn't get much better than this.

This tower has been here for ages. The black dragonflight used it for some seriously dark stuff, but that's not why we're here. After the dragons left, a troupe of niffen bandits took shelter in the ruins and robbed the place blind. But they left a bunch of trash everywhere.

Imagine what we could learn about the niffen from that trash once we get digging!
76026.completion:
<Roska lets out an uproarious bout of laughter.>

Oh, now that one's got to have some kind of crazy story behind it!
76026.objectives: Speak with Roska to start the dig, then excavate artifacts from around the tower.

76030.title: Airborne Winding
76030.description:
Well hello there!

Word around here is that we've got your continued support--so we got a little something for you. Meet me in Loamm so I can hand it over!

Best,
Harlowe Marl
76030.completion: We're lucky to have you around!
76030.objectives: Talk to Harlowe Marl in Loamm.

76032.title: Hidden in the Midden
76032.description:
<This dragon statue is similar to others found in the region but has been covered in paint.

Googly eyes, stink lines, whiskers, and all manner of other rude drawings decorate the otherwise-imposing stone. The paint looks old and is flaking in places but is not as old as the statue itself.

Roska will want to have a look at this!>
76032.progress: Nothing like volcanic rock, eh {NAME}? Never know what you'll find!
76032.completion: I'll tell you what, these niffen bandits had a sense of humor!
76032.objectives: Carefully excavate the defaced dragon statue.

76072.title: Shades of Scarlet
76072.description:
I need your help, {NAME}. I thought I had achieved some semblance of peace--although my sins might not be forgiven, I could at least reunite with the spirits of my beloved family. Yet...  my wife's spirit is missing. It is as though she never existed.

Hallow's End draws the shades that haunt the Monastery out from the shadows. Trapped in the past, they walk the grounds repeating their nightmares.

With any luck, one of them might give us answers as to what happened to her.
76072.completion:
<Sir Thomas is lost in thought, and jumps at your approach.>

{NAME}! My apologies for running off back there. There are... some memories I wish never to revisit. 

It would seem these cruel shades know just how to salt our wounds.

Come, I think I know where to look next.

76073.title: No Laughing Matter
76073.description:
There is a fountain terrace at the end of this path. Before the Scourge wrought havoc across Lordaeron, I used to bring Suzannah there. I remember how certain I felt then--in myself, in the Light... in her, and my children. 

I wonder when it was that my path started to dim.

If there is a shade that can enlighten us, they would be at the fountain.
76073.completion:
<Suzannah remains silent for a time.>

Not so very long ago, my husband Thomas begged me to leave for Kalimdor to flee the Scourge. He hadn't come to bed that night, instead keeping vigil to protect us. The fear in his voice scared me, and the desperation in his eyes...

<Suzannah gently traces a line across her palm, then clutches it tightly.>

I won't abandon him. Not this time, not ever.

76074.title: The Headless Horseman, Returned
76074.description:
Thomas retreated into the Scarlet Monastery. His ties to this place are strong, even when he is in his corrupted form.

Your name is {NAME}, yes? My husband trusted you to help him, and so I must ask the same. I intend to give chase, but I cannot save him alone.

Will you join me?
76074.completion: Once more I have been saved from madness. How could I ever thank you enough?

76075.title: A Ghostly Message
76075.description:
Excuse me, {NAME} is it? You've made quite a name for yourself lately, for both the living and the dead. 

I have in my possession the Tome of Thomas Thomson. For years it has been in my library, a reminder of times we must not forget. Imagine my surprise when the tome flings itself to the floor, falling open to a page with a single name on it.

Yours, {NAME}.

If Thomas' spirit is trying to reach you, then I think you should take this tome. Perhaps he awaits at the Scarlet Monastery?
76075.completion:
At last, {NAME}. I knew you would come.

I am once again in need of aid, and an adventurer of your caliber would be most welcome.

76083.title: Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible: Echoes of the Earth-Warder
76083.description: I sense a dark presence somewhere within these halls... something strangely familiar. Perhaps it will reveal itself as we explore the many chambers of Aberrus. If you can find evidence of this looming evil, we may be able to gain easier access to the depths below.
76083.progress: The knowledge gained from these may allow us to access the lower depths of Aberrus more directly.
76083.completion: These should allow us to descend into the depths of Aberrus more easily.
76083.objectives: Collect 3 Tomes of the Earth-Warder from the Echo of Neltharion within Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible on Normal Difficulty.

76085.title: Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible: Echoes of the Earth-Warder
76085.description: I sense a dark presence somewhere within these halls... something strangely familiar. Perhaps it will reveal itself as we explore the many chambers of Aberrus. If you can find evidence of this looming evil, we may be able to gain easier access to the depths below.
76085.progress: The knowledge gained from these may allow us to access the lower depths of Aberrus more directly.
76085.completion: These should allow us to descend into the depths of Aberrus more easily.
76085.objectives: Collect 3 Tomes of the Earth-Warder from the Echo of Neltharion within Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible on Heroic Difficulty.

76101.title: Tougher Down Under
76101.description:
Quite a few uplanders have arrived since the cavern was split clean open! 

A friendly winged-one by the name of Vaskarn has been particularly helpful to us. She's made the guard's armor tougher and the monster hunter's weapons stronger.

She's going to be plenty valuable if you plan on taking down more giant beasties here in Zaralek!
76101.completion: Got quite the gear on you! Shall we see what we can make of it?

76103.title: Report to the Trading Post
76103.description: <The glint of a distant object catches your eye. You suddenly remember that you have tender to collect for use at T&W Trading Post.>
76103.progress: Did you collect this month's tender?
76103.completion: Hope ye like this month's collection of new and exotic wares, {NAME}.
76103.objectives: Return to the Trading Post to collect your Trader's Tender from the Collector's Cache.

76104.title: Report to the Trading Post
76104.description: <The glint of a distant object catches your eye. You suddenly remember that you have tender to collect for use at T&W Trading Post.>
76104.completion: Hope ya like this month's collection of new and exotic wares, {NAME}.
76104.objectives: Return to the Trading Post to collect your Trader's Tender from the Collector's Cache.

76114.description: <The glint of a distant object catches your eye. You suddenly remember that you have tender to collect for use at T&W Trading Post.>
