76114.completion: Hope ya like this month's collection of new and exotic wares, {NAME}.
76114.objectives: Return to the Trading Post to collect your Trader's Tender from the Collector's Cache.

76140.title: Dawn of the Infinite
76140.description:
My vision is hazy, but there is no mistaking what I saw. A dark alliance opposes the bronze dragonflight. One I do not know if I shall be able to overcome...

I ask you to meet me in Eon's Fringe, {NAME}. We will speak more of this threat there. If there is any who I would entrust with safeguarding our future, it is you.
76140.completion:
Yes, it is I! Chromie from the future! Nice to meet you. Again.

Now, I can't talk too much about when I'm from or why I'm here. Protecting the timeways and all that, you understand. But I know exactly what's going to happen and exactly how to stop it!
76140.objectives: Meet Nozdormu at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.

76141.title: Align in the Sand
76141.description:
So, the timeways, yeah? They're VERY misaligned. And you know how we bronzes hate that! So we need to realign time with these temporal hourglasses. Just plop them down throughout Eon's Fringe.

But you know me, always needing to help! So I'll be placing another hourglass nearby. Meet me there when you're all done.
76141.progress: I never thought you would be the one making a mess of the timeways! Usually you're the one helping us get out of trouble, not in it.
76141.completion:
<Chromie listens to your explanation of what you're doing, her eyes wide.>

Me? From the future? Why, she's one of my top three people to trust! 

But it doesn't make sense. Why would she want you to distort the timeways to help Nozdormu? Seems like it would just give him a headache.
76141.objectives: Place the Temporal Hourglasses throughout the Shifting Sands in Thaldraszus.

76142.title: On Borrowed Time
76142.description:
I need you to fetch me some time-lost essence. The creatures around here are filled to the brim with the stuff. 

Snuff them out and then use this epoch extractor to collect their essence. We'll make good use of it for our next step!

And yes, this is going to be a multi-step process. You know how crazy these time shenanigans get!
76142.progress: What's this? Time-lost essence? An epoch... extractor?
76142.completion: Not sure what this all is, but I suppose I'll find some use for it. Best to not let it go to waste.
76142.objectives: Extract Time-Lost Essence from slain Time-Lost creatures in the Shifting Sands.

76143.title: Chro-me?
76143.description:
One result of your "time realignment" is that it seems to have summoned... me? Well, alternate timeline versions of me. 

I've never seen so many Chromies in one place! And while they all may be cute, they're playing havoc on the local timeways.

We need to trap them to synchronize their time signatures. Maybe then they'll be able to tell us what's going on!
76143.progress:
I know it's not very polite to trap a fellow Chromie, but we need to synchronize their time signatures as soon as we can! 

I'm sure they'll all understand. I know I would! I think?
76143.completion:
<Chromie listens to your report about what the alternate Chromies told you, her eyes growing wider.>

Oh no. We've been tricked! That Chromie from the future isn't a future Chromie at all. She's an alternate timeline me, just like the rest of the Chromies running around! 

Why would she lie to you?
76143.objectives: Trap Alternate Chromies in time stasis.

76144.title: Morchie Mayhem
76144.description:
We need to get to the bottom of this "future Chromie" business. Just where is that dragon? She needs to explain herself!

Let's start by inspecting one of her temporal hourglasses. Maybe that will give us a clue.
76144.progress: Oh, that Morchie! I've never met such a tricky, nasty Chromie in all my life.
76144.completion:
Well, at least we stopped Morchie's accomplice. Those infinite dragons are always causing all sorts of trouble.

But we can't rest until Morchie herself is captured and sent packing back to her OWN crummy timeline!

76145.title: Who's That Chromie?
76145.description:
Morchie didn't just teleport herself away, she took all the other Chromies with her! I have a bad feeling about why...

We have to follow and capture her. And question her! I want to know what she's up to.
76145.completion:
We can't give up now! There's still time to save the temple and beat those infinites once and for all. We can't let them control the true timeline.

And I certainly will not let them turn Nozdormu into that nasty Murozond.

76146.title: Dawn of the Infinite: Chrono-Lord Deios
76146.description:
Chrono-Lord Deios must be behind this all. As the leader of the infinites, he's sure to have led this invasion. I bet Morchie is working for him too.

Let's head into the Bronze Temple! We need to stop Deios before he ruins the true timeline.
76146.completion:
It is all thanks to you, {NAME}. You have saved us from the infinite's terrible dawn.

But, even more so, you have saved me from a fate that I thought was all but inevitable. You have my eternal gratitude.

76155.title: A Wolf Among Sheep
76155.description:
Thank you for indulging me. 

But I do not want to appear unappreciative of our new... mentor. Do me a favor--go and fill Madam Shadow's soulstone by some other means. Far be it for us to test our teacher, but she has yet to earn my trust.
76155.objectives: Help Oman fill Madam Shadow's soulstone on Darkmoon Island.

76158.title: Temporal Gossamer
76158.description:
The Temporal Gossamer takes shape in the form of delicate, silken strands that appear to strengthen when near an Evoker's Ancient Memories.

Assisting the Evoker in finding Temporal Vestigials seems to empower the resolve of these webs, allowing them to bond closely with the Ancient Memories.
76158.completion: Thank you for assisting. Allow me to complete the binding of these temporal strands.

76159.title: Report to the Trading Post
76159.description: <The glint of a distant object catches your eye. You suddenly remember that you have tender to collect for use at T&W Trading Post.>
76159.completion: Hope ye like this month's collection of new and exotic wares, {NAME}.
76159.objectives: Return to the Trading Post to collect your Trader's Tender from the Collector's Cache.

76163.title: A Lighter Shade of Fel
76163.description:
Dear $p,

Greetings. I have taken some time and collected my thoughts after our encounter with Lord Banehollow. 

I have also sought those who have similarly survived his dark plan, and have gathered them to me in Booty Bay so that we can decide on a way forward.

We would ask that you meet us there.

Darkest regards,

Ph'el Oman
76163.objectives: Meet with Oman in Booty Bay.

76164.title: Bovan's Last Hope
76164.description:
If Bovan is not here, the Nokhud could have taken him anywhere. We might have one last chance to find him, but it's a long shot.

We still have Bovan's necklace. One of the Ohn'ir mystics might be able to use it to help divine his location. I've only heard about this ritual, so I have no idea if it will work.

Go to the Ohn'iri Springs and look for Boku. I'm sure he will help us.

Baine and I will make sure the tauren we rescued get back safely. We'll meet you at the Ohn'iri Springs.
76164.objectives: Find Boku at the Ohn'iri Springs.

76167.title: A Place of Refuge
76167.description:
Our next priority is to catch up with the others who fled during Bovan's stand. Hopefully, Bovan and the other braves have regrouped with them.

This Tomul says the most likely place the tauren would seek refuge is an abandoned village to the southeast. 

While her reasoning is sound, this is also the perfect location for a trap.

{NAME}, I know you vouch for her, so I will give her the benefit of the doubt.

Let us hope your trust in her is not misplaced.
76167.objectives: Meet Baine and Tomul at Toghusuq Village.

76168.title: A Place of Refuge
76168.description:
Our next priority is to catch up with the others who fled during Bovan's stand. Hopefully, Bovan and the other braves have regrouped with them.

This Tomul says the most likely place the tauren would seek refuge is an abandoned village to the southeast. 

While her reasoning is sound, this is also the perfect location for a trap.

{NAME}, I know you vouch for her, so I will give her the benefit of the doubt.

Let us hope your trust in her is not misplaced.
76168.objectives: Meet Baine and Tomul at Toghusuq Village.

76169.title: Glow in the Dark
76169.description:
Codswallop! Peevish has run off again. He is assigned to this post but is never here!

I heard him screaming from the nearby cave. He must have tried to hide in there.

Take my torch and go to the Coldshadow Cave.  Find Peevish along with the bottles of Dauntless Draught he stole. He can desert his post if he wants,  but I won't let him take the drinks!
76169.progress: Have you found "Peevish" Paeton Berncort and the bottles of Dauntless Draught he took with him?
76169.completion:
I didn't anticipate Peevish would muster the courage to return, but at least you recovered the Draught. 

We'll raise a toast and wish him luck in that cave.
76169.objectives: Locate "Peevish" Paeton Berncort and recover 8 bottles of Dauntless Draught.

76171.title: Walking the Path of Tyr
76171.description:
Before they embark on their last training trial, it is a tradition that recruits first receive their Tyr's Guard gear.

The highest-ranking Tyr's Guard officer would normally do this but... I would be honored if you would bestow their tabard and shield on them for their final trial instead.
76171.progress: The tabard and shield are important symbols of a new recruit's dedication to the Tyr's Guard.
76171.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. Now our recruits should be ready for their final trials.

Go to them. I am sure they will want your guidance in completing their missions.
76171.objectives: Distribute gear to the Tyr's Guard.

76176.title: First Steps
76176.description:
Now, let's get to work tracking down the disc. I can't believe that after thousands of years we are so close to seeing Tyr return, much less that I will have a hand in it.

We should meet with Chromie and Eternus inside. They'll tell us what to do next.
76176.completion: You're back just in time, {NAME}! We've determined where the Tyr's Guard needs to place the beacons. Check in with Eternus, and we're ready when you are!
76176.objectives: Meet Chromie and Eternus in Tyrhold.

76194.title: A Grim Portent
76194.description:
Tyrande suspected there was something foul happening here in Felwood... and she was right.

Her priestess, Kaylessa, was sent here to purify the moonwell from the fel corruption that plagues this land, in an effort to reclaim that which belongs to us.

Now we have lost one of our sisters and the moonwell still remains corrupted. We cannot let this stand. We will finish what Kaylessa started, and heal the moonwell. 

Arko'narin has history with this place. I will let her tell you why we are here.
76194.progress: Have you spoken with Arko'narin yet, {class}?
76194.completion: It is time to put our skills to use, {NAME}.
76194.objectives: Speak with Arko'narin Starshade to learn about Jaedenar.

76195.title: Countering Corruption
76195.description:
I cannot thank you enough for your help with this, {NAME}. I knew I had to be here to help Nari when she told me about this mission. 

It seems as though my skills are needed, just as I thought. The magic here is foul and all-corrupting. It must be contained.

Please, take this book and read the incantation within after putting the satyr around Jaedenar to rest.

Jaedenar need not be a place of death and corruption any longer.
76195.progress: Please, {NAME}, you must make sure to cleanse the fel energies that seep from the satyr's corpses.
76195.completion: These satyr... were Sentinels? Whoever committed this atrocity will pay!
76195.objectives: Use the Incanter's Tome on 6 Feltouched satyr corpses.

76196.title: Mercy or Misery
76196.description:
This place... it was once so important to my family. That is why I agreed to come--and why Lysander wanted to come along as well. 

<Arko'narin glances over at Lysander before looking back at you.>

Even after the horrors of Teldrassil, my brother still tries to do everything he can to help others. Much like you, {NAME}.

Come. We must eliminate the threat that these power hungry cretins pose. I think you are just the kaldorei for the job.
76196.objectives: Slay cultists occupying Jaedenar in Felwood.

76197.title: A Glimpse of Terror
76197.description:
We will strike together on your command, {NAME}.

<Maiev rolls her shoulders.>

The last thing this fiend will see is our blades.
76197.completion: Our Sentinels... warped and twisted! This will not stand. We will hunt down the leader of this foul incursion, and I will have his head!

76203.title: Stepping into the Shadows
76203.description:
Their ranks have been thinned, and their corpses cleansed. You have done well.

<Maiev shifts her weight, looking towards the path leading into Shadow Hold.>

Come, {NAME}. We must find what lurks below and put an end to it.
76203.completion: We no longer need the element of surprise.
76203.objectives: Navigate through Shadow Hold with Maiev Shadowsong, dealing with threats along the way.

76205.title: Balancing the Scales
76205.description:
The time for subtlety is over. Lord Hel'nurath has made himself known to us... and I will not rest until I see him slain.

<Maiev clenches her teeth.>

Ready yourself, {NAME}. Together we will show these demons why they should fear the kaldorei.
76205.progress: We will not rest until Shadow Hold has been cleansed of this foul corruption!
76205.completion: I heard their cries from here, {NAME}. Well done.

76206.title: Heart of the Issue
76206.description:
I can't believe how much Nari has been through. This perversion of our history, our culture... my family...

<Lysander glances at his sister.>

These demons came in here from somewhere. I'm certain the source of their invasion lies in the depths of our barrow den. You and I can put a stop to it.

I won't let this place haunt her any longer, {NAME}.
76206.completion:
Lysander... he is determined, I'll give him that. 

And brave. 

Thank you, {NAME}. Now... it is time to face the leader of all of this.
76206.objectives: Disrupt 4 Portals to the Twisting Nether in the depths of Shadow Hold.

76207.title: Wardens' Wrath
76207.description:
Lord Hel'nurath's hubris gave me an opportunity to study what he's doing. I think I found a way to give us an opening to strike.

<Arko'narin glances at her brother.>

I fear this will take a lot out of Lysander. But I know he'll give it everything he has. Perhaps... perhaps my perceptions have been misplaced.

It is time to put my... our demons to rest.
76207.completion:
Don't worry over me, {NAME}. My sister does enough of that already.

Look at the moonwell instead. It's beautiful...
76207.objectives: Defend Lysander as he works to disrupt Lord Hel'nurath's ritual.

76212.title: A Mark For A Protector
76212.description:
Traditions should not hold us back, {NAME}. They should inform the future. 

<Maiev looks at Lysander before turning her gaze back to you.>

I have let my perceptions hold me back as well. No more. I am tired of seeing rifts between our people, regardless of what they use to better themselves or the world.

It is time I give Lysander his marking. The kaldorei are no strangers to change. Our traditions should adapt to our lives, not define them.
76212.completion:
I can't believe it, {NAME}! I can't believe it!

How... why...? Today will go with me for all of eternity. Thank you.

76213.title: Honor of the Goddess
76213.description:
Today is a day of celebration, {NAME}. And a day of new beginnings. 

Arko'narin and Lysander have reminded me that the kaldorei are no strangers to change. I forget, sometimes, how long I was away, and just how much my kin have progressed in my absence. 

<Maiev looks up to the sky.>

Lysander celebrates this day, but your service also deserves to be recognized. Come, {NAME}.
76213.completion:
Hold your head high, Ama'shan {NAME}.

May your deeds continue to inspire the kaldorei.
76213.objectives: Learn the meaning of Ama'shan from Maiev Shadowsong.

76214.title: Work It
76214.description:
The Trial of Style gives us the opportunity to look good, {class}.

The camera makes sure we keep looking good. 

So focus on me and my camera, follow my directions and I'll make sure you look fantastic!
76214.progress:
Focus on me and follow my directions. 

I'll make sure you look great.
76214.completion:
The camera doesn't lie, {NAME}. 

You are one stylish {class}.

76217.title: Living History
76217.description:
My name is Nirobin. It is worth remembering, as I am a genius in the field of arcane codicology! Quite an accolade, if I say so myself... and I do say so!

I've spent countless hours fusing blue and bronze dragon magic to investigate history like never before. Today, you and I will experience the results of my effort!

Let's start by using my instruments on a fabulously preserved goblet uncovered from the Forbidden Reach.
76217.progress:
You may be frightened.

Try to dig deep inside of yourself for strength... if only because there's nothing I, personally, can do to help you with that.
76217.completion:
Unexpected...

But "unexpected" is the exact territory pioneers like myself were born to explore! 

Onward! For scholarship!
76217.objectives: Activate Nirobin's instruments to analyze the Intriguing Dracthyr Goblet.

76241.title: Lab Partners with a Squirrel
76241.description:
I have finally brought history itself to life! I am a success!

Now let's utilize your particular set of skills. Chiefly, I require your ability to go outside without dying of fright.

Channeling my magic onto our new friend here, I'll teleport it to the location with the highest concentration of resonant energy linked to the relic. You'll meet up with it there and await further instructions.

Fear not! My magics may elude your understanding, but my intellect is certain to guide us true!
76241.completion:
<Out of this arcane squirrel's mouth comes the crackled sound of Nirobin's voice.>

{NAME}? Can you hear me? It's Nirobin! Codicological genius and mild agoraphobe!

I assume you're ready to use this critter to uncover the lost secrets of Dracthyr civilization. Why else would you be talking to a squirrel?
76241.objectives: Meet Reese at the Lost Atheneum in the Forbidden Reach to continue your research.

76242.title: A Research Thesis Worth Publishing
76242.description:
Reese here is hungry as a dragon-horse for clues. Clues of the past!

More specifically, we're going to use my unique brand of magic to unveil and analyze energy that resonates with the same frequency as our relic. 

You will guide Reese to these "clues," where I will use him as a remote conduit to absorb those energies. 

When we've reached our critter's capacity to hold those energies, I'll port him back here to transmute it all into cold, hard data.

<Reese winks at you. How strange...>
76242.progress:
You'd think I'd know about the history of the Forbidden Reach, considering I was there for thousands of years.

But surprise! I wasn't much for the world outside of my lab back then.
76242.completion:
I am completely baffled and mildly impressed that you showed no outward embarrassment while escorting a flying, translucent blue squirrel in the open like that. Quite commendable! Bravo!

For now, accept this reward. If you find it lacking, please write to the academy about my annual stipend.

For later, be prepared for further codicological excursions on my behalf!
76242.objectives: Ingest clues in the Lost Atheneum with Reese.

76247.title: Keep the Home Fires Burning
76247.description:
The keyflame braziers, located across the countryside keep the darkness at bay and our people safe. Many have gone dark as the Radiant Remnants needed to maintain them have become harder to find.

We've worked hard to ensure our brazier is always lit, but we could always use your help.

Please gather remnants from our supplies and use them to help empower our family keyflame.
76247.objectives: 5 Hillhelm Remnant Supplies gathered and used to empower the Hillhelm Keyflame.

76257.title: Darkmaster's Scourgestone
76257.description:
<The scourgestone in your hand feels as real as everything else in this memory. It chills your very bones as it rests in the palm of your hand.

While it may be a relic of a past time, the Argent Dawn should nonetheless be made aware of its existence.

The ritual conducted upon Eva's journal may have had greater consequences than either of you anticipated.>
76257.completion:
A scourgestone? I don't understand. How did you ever find this? After all we have done, here and upon Northrend...

No, it does not matter. I will take it off your hands and ensure its destruction, {NAME}. Surely this is one of the last in existence. Surely.

If it happens that you find others like this, bring them to me as well. I hope for all our sakes this is the last we ever speak of this.
76257.objectives: Find somebody interested in the Darkmaster's Scourgestone.

76258.title: By Time Fire be Purged!
76258.description:
That big ol' slag elemental has taken the heart of me forge! Without it, a timeforge is just, well, a forge. And that's no use to a chronosmith!

Even if we had Seashellamayne, I wouldn't be able to repair it.

Such power cannot be allowed to remain in the possession of that... that molten moron!

The other elementals took off for the towers. I bet half me beard the big one's close by too.
76258.progress:
Those confounded elementals must have come from the heart of me forge. Was it destabilized, somehow?

Either way, it's bad news. Every chronosmith worth their minute knows you don't mix elemental and temporal energies.
76258.completion:
<Ironus clutches his chest in relief with a beaming smile.>

That was a close call! Can you imagine Eon's Fringe burning down shortly after I arrive? How embarrassing.

And look at that, one of those wee elementals from me forge seems to have taken a liking to you! You're free to keep it.

In fact, I insist. Keep it. I don't want it.
76258.objectives: Retrieve the Heart of the Timeforge.

76263.title: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
76263.description:
Long ago, magical wards placed upon Naxxramas stymied our attempts to assault Kel'Thuzad's forces. Though I was able to conceal our army past them, I have since learned to dispel them should the need ever arise.

I will confess my disbelief of your story. However, if you are so devoted to this investigation, I will enchant your insignia so you may breach these barriers yourself. For a price.
76263.progress: Have you brought the necessary reagents?
76263.completion: You will feel a slight tingle, {NAME}. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you should be able to see whatever it is you believe you will find.

76264.title: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
76264.description:
Long ago, magical wards placed upon Naxxramas stymied our attempts to assault Kel'Thuzad's forces. Though I was able to conceal our army past them, I have since learned to dispel them should the need ever arise.

I will confess my disbelief of your story. However, if you are so devoted to this investigation, I will enchant your insignia so you may breach these barriers yourself. For a small fee.
76264.progress: Have you brought the necessary reagents?
76264.completion: You will feel a slight tingle, {NAME}. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you should be able to see whatever it is you believe you will find.

76265.title: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
76265.description:
Long ago, magical wards placed upon Naxxramas stymied our attempts to assault Kel'Thuzad's forces. Though I was able to conceal our army past them, I have since learned to dispel them should the need ever arise.

I will confess my disbelief of your story. However, if you are so devoted to this investigation, I will enchant your insignia so  you may breach these barriers yourself.
76265.completion: You will feel a slight tingle, {NAME}. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you should be able to see whatever it is you believe you will find.

76266.title: A Multitude of Tasks
76266.description:
Hi {NAME}! I have a super exciting assignment for today. I need you to place seven loaves of bread around Stormwind, and five jugs of milk in Orgrimmar. You'll finish that up with...

<Chromie looks at a note in her hand.>

Seven hundred and forty two grains of rice scattered across Pandaria!
76266.progress: You're so lucky, always getting to do these fun quests! Meanwhile I'm stuck here, just telling people what to do.
76266.completion:
Wow, that was incredible! The three day journey with the Emperor of Pandaria and his band of heroes was really the highlight.

Thanks for letting me stretch my wings, {NAME}. I'll take it from here.
76266.objectives: Perform a series of tasks in the Everywhere Inn in Eon's Fringe.

76268.title: Corruptor's Scourgestones
76268.progress:
A Corruptor's Scourgestone was the insignia of the Scourge's overlords. Powerful beings that once held a position of authority over the Scourge always possessed one.

I formerly exchanged valor tokens for these. While I doubt you will ever find more, please bring any others back to me immediately so I can see to their destruction.
Corruptor's Scourgestone (1)
76268.completion:
More and more scourgestones pile up by the day, {NAME}, from yourself and a growing number of other adventurers.

Fortunately, none of our soldiers have mysteriously disappeared nor have I heard more bloodcurdling screams than what is normal for this region.

I would rather not ask questions. Here is your reward.

76270.title: Invader's Scourgestones
76270.progress:
An Invader's Scourgestone was the insignia of the Scourge's elite troops. These were sometimes found on the stronger of the troops positioned in Stratholme and Scholomance.

I formerly exchanged valor tokens for these. While I doubt you will ever find more, please bring any others back to me immediately so I can see to their destruction.
Invader's Scourgestone (10)
76270.completion:
More and more scourgestones pile up by the day, {NAME}, from yourself and a growing number of other adventurers.

Fortunately, none of our soldiers have mysteriously disappeared nor have I heard more bloodcurdling screams than what is normal for this region.

I would rather not ask questions. Here is your reward.

The Trial of Style gives us the opportunity to look good, {class}.

The camera makes sure we keep looking good. 

So focus on me and my camera, follow my directions and I'll make sure you look fantastic!
76271.progress:
Focus on me and follow my directions. 

I'll make sure you look great.
76271.completion:

You are one stylish {class}.

76276.title: A Changed Land
76276.description:
The arrival of Amirdrassil brings great change to Azeroth. Its roots are finding a home in the soil beneath even as its branches stretch skyward to taste the air.

This is an auspicious moment, but we must not forget our allies from the Isles. Visit with those nearby to ensure they are safe and sound.
76276.progress: Amirdrassil has safely arrived, but we must make sure our allies are also safe and sound.
76276.completion: I am heartened to hear that our friends are well. Thank you for visiting them, Champion.
76276.objectives: Check on nearby Dragon Isles residents.

76278.title: Work It
76278.description:
The Trial of Style gives us the opportunity to look good, {class}.

The camera makes sure we keep looking good. 

So focus on me and my camera, follow my directions and I'll make sure you look fantastic!
76278.progress:
Focus on me and follow my directions. 

I'll make sure you look great.
76278.completion:
The camera doesn't lie, {NAME}. 

You are one stylish {class}.

90467.title: Tales of the Sky
90467.objectives: Collect 6 Stray Skyshards in the Cascades of Harandar.
90467.description:
Wait a minute... You're no rutaani at all! Are you one of those "outsiders" that Saku and Orkon keep talking about?

Oh! I just had a great idea. Did you know that the Goddess used to have a pet? Rumor has it that when the Goddess disappeared, Aln'sharan was SO sad that he flew up into the highest roots of Harandar, never to be seen again. But every so often, he goes looking for food... And his scales fall as skyglass!

I wanna gather some. It's my dream to see Aln'sharan firsthand! Will you help me?
90467.progress:
Aln'sharan is a folk tale that we tell haranir children to explain the shards of glass that occasionally rain upon Harandar.

Most grow out of searching for sky serpents. But Kuri's heart has always been filled with whimsy.
90467.completion: Goddess preserve. Kuri has always had her mind wrapped up in the roots.

90533.title: Go Get Orweyna!
90533.objectives: Go get Orweyna in the Den and find a way to free Gazlowe.
90533.description:
Hey! Champ!

Look, I swear I'm glad to see ya. I'm just in a little bit of a diplomatic situation here.

Can you go get Orweyna and bring her back here? See if she'll talk this beast into letting me go?

I'm not an elekk plushie, for cryin' out loud.
90533.progress:
Never try to take something from a beast like this without offering something better. 

I would hate to lose another friend that way.
90533.completion: I'm pleased that Monte came this way to visit. But I can see that he is as out of his depth here as I was in Undermine.

90733.title: The Listener
90733.objectives: Speak to Aksem in the Den.
90733.description:
Now that you've learned about our legends, you've earned the notice of one of our elders. He wants to meet you.

His name is Aksem, and he knows things that the rest of us have never learned. History that remains hidden, even in the paintings.

Go and introduce yourself. He's expecting you.
90733.completion:
Yes, I wanted to speak with you. 

There are many truths that are hidden, even to the oldest living haranir. Continue to learn and they may be revealed.

Show respect to our history, and I will eventually tell you more.

90734.title: In the Name of the Goddess
90734.objectives: Return to Aksem in the Den.
90734.description:
The high priest Aksem has asked for you again. He said you are not the only one on a quest for knowledge about the deep history of Harandar.

Go to him. I believe he already has another guest who is also interested in learning this hidden history.
90734.completion:
Thank you for the tea, student.

As you can see, you are not the only one with questions and ambition in equal measure. Keep searching, and keep learning.

Soon I will call you for the next lesson.

90741.title: Once More Into the Rift
90741.objectives: Speak to Aksem, then meet Orweyna in the Rift of Aln.
90741.description:
Aksem has asked for you again. He says he's ready for you to undergo the final ritual for the knowledge he wants to teach you.

I admit, I'm envious, but I do not envy the trials you'll need to undergo in order to prepare for this knowledge.

Go speak to Aksem, and do as he says. Orweyna will be joining you.
90741.completion:
<Orweyna breathes carefully and steadily, her eyes slightly unfocused. Then, she sharpens her gaze and looks at you.>

I'm glad you're here. I admit, I am nervous about what we will learn. I have heard only one story of the goddess for as long as I can remember.

To know that there is more to the story, it... it fills me with curiosity and dread.

But as Aksem said, there is no going back now. And we are ready.

90889.title: Tale of the Echoes of Sai'alyo

91000.title: A Humble Servant
91000.objectives: Aid the people of Hammerfall in their recovery.
91000.description:
$p, residents of Hammerfall have been focused on daily life, defense, and survival over the past months. 

They have not had sufficient time, or frankly numbers, to address all the harms that were done.

There is much we can do to help them get back on their feet.

I know this is humble work, but it makes a very real difference to the orcs who live here.
91000.completion: Good work, {NAME}. Things are starting to look better.

91375.title: The Silence at Fungara Village
91375.objectives: Seek Ghikal outside of Fungara Village in Harandar.
91375.description:
Fungara Village has been silent for some time now.

We've largely been occupied with the Lightbloom and the threat it presents, so we haven't had time to check in on the fungarians to the east. Usually, they are rowdy yet manageable... but it's rare that they go completely silent.

I am going to investigate. If you wish to prove yourself an ally, you would do well to join me.
91375.completion: Normally, I would refuse the intervention of an outsider without a second thought... but given the situation, perhaps you can be of some help.

91390.title: Special Assignment: What Remains of a Temple Broken

91391.title: Still Scouting
91391.description:
When the Alliance originally fought the Horde here, Kurdran served as a scout. He's still an excellent one. He took his gryphon to Blackrock Mountain to see what kind of forces we may be dealing with there.

Meet up with him and see what kind of trouble you can cause.
91391.completion: Arator, {NAME}--thanks fer coming. Plenty o' Dark Horde in there.

91506.title: Tale of the First Shul'ka and the Flame

91509.title: The Tale of a Stone Falls from the Sky

91627.title: Saltheril's Haven
91627.objectives: Speak to Lord Saltheril at Saltheril's Haven.
91627.description:
{NAME}, I presume? Very good. Your reputation precedes you.

Lord Saltheril sends his most sincere greetings, along with a cordial invitation to join him at his estate south of Silvermoon.

A portion of the grounds have been carved out as a decadent haven for those seeking refined company and pleasant conversation. He believes you would bring a... unique perspective.

<He looks you over with a hint of polite disdain.>

Receiving an invitation is a rare honor. His lordship hopes you will accept.
91627.completion:
Ah, {NAME}. Welcome to my Haven--a sanctuary from the world's turmoil since the days of Anasterian.

Some presume this to be merely a frivolous party, but on these beautiful gilded grounds, decisions have been made over wine that have shaped the fates of entire generations.

91700.title: Darkness Unmade
91700.objectives: Eliminate 2 Rare creatures in the Stormarion Citadel and surrounding area.
91700.description:
The Void energies concentrated in this citadel have given rise to numerous aberrant creatures.

Wildlife mutated by residual energy and horrors originating from beyond the anomalies, continue to feed and draw upon the energies here. It is most unpleasant!

To safeguard my future enterprises, these threats must be neutralized.
91700.completion: I feel much safer knowing those threats have been eliminated.

91726.title: Unstoppable Force
91726.objectives: Ask Kurdran about the events of that day.
91726.description:
This statue seems out of place here. Nothing else like it. But this is where Anduin Lothar fell against Orgrim Doomhammer at the Battle of Blackrock Mountain.

Many fought on this field. Many didn't make it. Lothar... 

Let me tell ye what happened all those years ago.
91726.progress: It was such a dark day, {NAME}. Painful to remember.
91726.completion:
It's a tragic story, but maybe something better can be made o' it with those fragments of Turalyon's shield.

Perhaps it can be restored--along with our friend.

91787.title: The Journey Ends
91787.description:
The Light takes many forms. But I know now what it means to me, and how I want to wield it.

I'm not just a weapon like my father, nor can I devote myself purely to service like Dezco.

But I can protect people from the evil that threatens them. Right now, that's Xal'atath and her Devouring Host.

We should return to Lor'themar and do whatever is needed to defeat the Void.

Beyond that, I shall see where protecting others with the Light takes me.
91787.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}, for bolstering our defenders at the Sunwell.

It looks like Arator has sorted things out as well, and is ready for whatever may be ahead. It is good to have you both focused on the fight against the Void once more. 

Arator is a good man. I'm grateful we didn't lose him to this conflict.

91802.title: The Best Bites are Bog Bugs

91928.title: What's For Lunch?
91928.objectives: Slay Trigores for 3 Trigore Flanks and collect 20 Shadow-Grown Berries that grow in the area.
91928.description:
My Shadowtrade Mercenaries will fight for Stormarion Cores, no questions asked, but they do get hungry also!

Food is quite scarce here, so we need supplies!

Take a mercenary out with you and find some food for them to eat. I'll make it worth your while!
91928.completion: When it comes to mercenaries, nothing keeps them loyal like a full stomach... and gold.

91929.title: What's For Lunch?
91929.objectives: Slay Unstable Oozeling for 12 Void Malgrease and collect 3 Domanaar Microwell.
91929.description:
My Shadowtrade Mercenaries will fight for Stormarion Cores, no questions asked, but they do get hungry also!

Food is quite scarce here, so we need supplies!

Take a mercenary out with you and find some food for them to eat. I'll make it worth your while!
91929.completion: When it comes to mercenaries, nothing keeps them loyal like a full stomach... and gold.

91930.title: The Abundant Lands
91930.objectives: Speak with Chel the Chip at Loaknit Den in Zul'Aman.
91930.description:
De loa have reunited with us forest trolls, and de land reacts with glorious bounty!

Do ya wish to take part? Then go north, and meet me at de entrance to Loaknit Den.

There I will introduce ya to prosperity and plentitude like ya never seen...
91930.completion: It is time to learn from de master himself.

91932.title: The Abundant Awakening
91932.objectives: Speak with the Loa of Abundance and learn the ways of harvesting abundance.
91932.description:
De Loa of Abundance accepts everyone, and everyone de Loa of Abundance accepts is granted de privilege of learnin' how best to serve abundance.

Speak with his glorious visage and become a fellow acolyte.
91932.progress: Do not fear. I am indeed the finest judge of your every action and choice.
91932.completion:
Quite acceptable!

You may yet prove a glorious addition to the acolytes of abundance.

91933.title: The Abundant Honor
91933.objectives: Purchase an Abundant Beacon from Chel the Chip.
91933.description:
On to the next phase of your education: mercantilism!

Imagine yourself, offering the bounty of endless harvest to my glorious self, and reaping the abundant rewards I bestow upon you in kind.

Now let us put that beauteous vision into practice! 

I will grant you a minute portion of unalloyed abundance. You, in turn, shall trade it to your fellow acolyte for one of many premium goods.
91933.progress:
There are few things amongst mortals or gods that cannot be viewed through the lens of trade.

Some of us are simply... less coy about that truth than others are.
91933.completion: Ah! I see you are already well-versed in the art of barter and trade!

91970.title: WANTED: Gelatonius
91970.objectives: Kill Gelatonius in the Gloom Mire.
91970.description:
Are you ready to test yourself against a true foe? In the center of the Gloom Mire is Gelatonius, a fungal giant of enormous proportions. 

Kill him, if you think you can. I'm willing to be impressed, and to pay handsomely for this task.
91970.completion: You return in one piece? Not bad, outsider. Not bad.

91980.title: WANTED: Hellebora's Thorn
91980.description:
See that huge creature over that way? That's Hellebora. She's set herself up too close to the road and we're concerned she's going to wander out of the mire and become even more of a threat. 

Deal with her, if you can, and bring me back one of her thorns as proof of your hunt.
91980.progress: Hurry up and put Hellebora down before she wanders out of the mire.
91980.completion: You return with her thorn? Ah yes, a fine trophy. Well done.

91982.title: WANTED: Toadshade's Petals
91982.description:
The three-headed hydra, Hellabora, has been causing havoc in the lower end of Gloom Mire.

Give her a good pruning and bring me back her petals as proof.
91982.progress: Less talking, more pruning. Go get those petals.
91982.completion: You've the petals? Let's take a look. Yes, these are from that hydra. Good work.

91998.title: WANTED: Muckmire's Choking Vines
91998.objectives: Collect the choking vines of Muckmire.
91998.description:
Deep within the swamp is a creature of mud, leaves, and rage. His vines choke the life out of any who come near, and this dangerous creature cannot be allowed to live.

Defeat Muckmire and bring me back his vines as proof of the deed.
91998.progress: Be careful Muckmire doesn't drag you into the mud with him.
91998.completion:
You look properly covered in mud and grime. Have you done it? 

Ah yes, these are his vines. Well done.

92012.title: WANTED: Gorebarb's Pincers
92012.description:
Gorebarb is a creature quite unlike most others who make Harandar their home. He's incredibly violent and his kind is not seen here very often. 

Let's see less of him. Kill him and bring me his pincers as proof of the deed.
92012.progress: Take care that Gorebarb doesn't catch you with those pincers. I imagine his breath isn't pleasant at all.
92012.completion: Well, well. You managed to take down Gorebarb and retrieve the pincers? Ah, of course I never doubted you would.

92136.title: Infusion of Hope
92136.description:
I hope my staff's light has been enough to uphold those at the Sunwell while we have sought these relics.

Together with those from Light's Hope, they should be a much more significant aid.

Let us return there quickly.
92136.completion: Quickly, {NAME}. Let us get these distributed!

92145.title: Special Assignment: The Grand Magister's Drink

92013.title: WANTED: Dionaea's Thorntusks
92013.description:
Many thornmaws make the mire their home, but none as are vicious as Dionaea. Unlike the others, she kills merely for the joy of it, and her gluttony threatens the delicate balance of the wildlife in this area. 

Take her out and restore the equilibrium. Bring me back her thorntusks as proof of the deed.
92013.progress: Dionaea hunts for the thrill of it. She seems to be unable to satiate her hunger. Have you handled her yet?
92013.completion: You bring me the thorntusks? Excellent. May balance return to the Mire.

92365.title: Creating Defenses
92365.objectives: Follow the steps and deploy two defenses.
92365.description:
Deploying defenses is crucial to safeguarding operation of the Singularity Anchor. I need to ensure you fully understand the process.

First, collect the Stormarion cores I have in storage. Then, activate the defensive positions, and finally, choose and deploy one defense at each position.

When you have completed that I can entrust you with further Stormarion cores to use as you see fit.
92365.completion: You've done well, I feel safe entrusting you with these additional Stormarion Cores, use them wisely!

92407.title: Hidey-Hole
92407.objectives: Use the Anomaly Inverter to collapse 5 Hidey-Holes.
92407.description:
When Xal'atath departed she left behind a large number of anomalies, small pocket dimensions where enemies can hide. As Romuul calls them, "Hidey-Holes".

The Artificer has rigged up a device that should do the job.

We need to close these Hidey-Holes and flush out any enemies lurking inside.
92407.completion: Excellent work, I'm sure we'll discover more anomalies hiding about, but with your help we've eliminated any immediate threats.

92945.title: The Power of Anguish
92945.objectives: Learn how to hunt your prey.
92945.description:
These threats we chase are intelligent. Determined. Deadly.

Their ingenuity will seek to confound you. Their strength will seek to destroy you. It is from their very will to live--to predate--that we will extract the essence required to fuel the magical defenses of our city. 

I have had my assistants lay out our friend's toys. You'd do best to familiarize yourself with them.
92945.progress: Speak with Astalor Bloodsworn to continue.
92945.completion: One fool's trap is another elf's treasure.

92954.title: Maisara Caverns: Master of Souls
92954.objectives: Collect Malacrass's Notes from Vordaza and complete the Maisara Caverns dungeon.
92954.description:
Malacrass's notes are with Vordaza, and she's using them to further her necromantic experiments.

I need you to go into de Maisara Caverns to recover them. It will be dangerous, and you will need to gather allies before venturing in.

I will stay here and protect my uncle. We need to sort through all de scrolls we gathered and see what else we can find out.

93013.title: Special Assignment: Push Back the Light

93047.title: Butchery Basics
93047.description:
We can't keep up with how much these soldiers eat. Lend us just a bit of your time to feed dis army, hm?

We need boar. Not just a steak or two, we need de entire boar. Nothin' goes to waste, yah?
93047.progress:
De art of Amani huntin' is about discipline. You practice until de skills come as naturally as breathin'.

But right now, discipline means doin' what I tell you.
93047.completion: You are an impressive hunter, dat is for sure. Thank you for helpin' us out here.

93048.title: Got No Rhythm
93048.description:
Dat boy Kovu stormed out of here without even tryin' a single step. He thinks he's got two left feet, but he isn't even willin' to try.

You look like an impressive fighter. He'll respect you for dat.

Maybe he just needs de right dance partner to show him de steps. Help him out, hm?
93048.completion: Dat boy still needs a lot of practice, but you helped him get out of his head and just feel de rhythm.

93049.title: Homework Support
93049.objectives: Collect 15 Pristine Shade Lilies and 8 Dragonhawk Fern Fronds.
93049.description:
<The little girl keeps her voice low, making sure her father doesn't overhear.>

My friends are goin' out to play down where de shade lilies grow, but I'm supposed to do a buncha borin' apothecary stuff.

Papa wants me to collect some plants to make salves and balms we use for healin'. I asked if it could wait and he said no.

What if... you helped me out? Just dis once, pleeease?
93049.progress: Did you get all of dem?
93049.completion:
All in perfect condition!

Maybe you should be de apprentice instead.

93050.title: Altar History
93050.description:
De altars need to be infused with de power of de loas every so often.

I'm not as spry as I used to be and de altars are all spread out.

Help an old shaman out, eh? I'll give you my totem to channel de loas' power into de altars.

And maybe you can learn a thing or two from de other acolytes and myself in de process.
93050.progress:
I just need to take a little breather here.

Don't go worryin' about me, now. Keep focused on the task at hand, eh?
93050.completion: My days of combat are behind me, but I'm glad to be helpin' out around de village.

93051.title: The Final Exam
93051.objectives: Spar Dar'rak for his final exam.
93051.description:
My trainin' is almost complete!

My commander says I need to prove myself against a strong fighter before she can recommend me for combat.

But I've been strugglin' to find someone willin' to spar with me after... uh, after what happened de last time...

You look capable. And intimidatin'. Mind helpin' me out here?

And no goin' easy on me, yes? I can take it.
93051.progress:
Do not pull even a single punch. De boy must succeed or fail on his own.

If he's not ready, you will be doin' him no favors sendin' him into the fray unprepared.
93051.completion:
You fought well.

Your own strength proved Dar'rak can hold his own against warriors far stronger than himself.

I never expected him to beat you, {NAME}. But de fact that he still breathes is an impressive enough feat, hm?

93244.title: Special Assignment: Agents of the Shield
93244.objectives: Smash Arathi Supply crates and recover Airship Tools.

93423.title: Sparks of War: Eversong Woods
93423.objectives: Collect 100 Sparks of War in Eversong Woods, while in War Mode.
93423.description:
Mysterious creatures are out in the wild across the Eversong Woods. 

Go and see what you can find out about them.
93423.completion: That provides some answers, many thanks.

93424.title: Sparks of War: Zul'Aman
93424.objectives: Collect 100 Sparks of War in Zul'Aman, while in War Mode.
93424.description:
There's unknown danger out in Zul'Aman.

Get out there and clear things up!
93424.completion: Many thanks for clearing things out.

93425.title: Sparks of War: Harandar
93425.objectives: Collect 100 Sparks of War in Harandar, while in War Mode.
93425.description: Powerful creatures have grown through the lands across Harandar. Go look into it.
93425.completion: That was a tremdenous effort - much thanks.

93426.title: Sparks of War: Voidstorm
93426.objectives: Collect 100 Sparks of War in Voidstorm, while in War Mode.
93426.description: Chaotic forces are being disruptive in the Voidstorm. Go investigate and clear things up!
93426.progress: There's more to look out for.
93426.completion: This provides some answers and clarity.

93432.title: Swords to Plowshares
93432.description:
First Mor'duun and the Blade ambush Atal'Aman. Now it's overrun by these "echoes..."

At least, that's what Doru calls them: echoes. All I see are ghosts of a bloodier time. And like those days, no matter how many we cut through, they never stop swarming in.

Get out there and see for yourself. Bring de echoes' remains as well. Doru wants to study what dey are and how dey work.
93432.progress: It's like a dream you can't wake from.
93432.completion:
See? An endless ocean.

Perhaps Doru will learn something from de ashes.

93433.title: Shrine, Sealed, Delivered
93433.objectives: Deliver supplies to the Elders of the four Loa Shrines: Elder Shimarra, Eagletender Rhyd, Elder Thak, and Elder Vu'lona.
93433.description:
Curse de echoes. 

Curse Zul'jin, and Mor'duun, and dat snake Malacrass too.

They only cause more mess for de livin' to clean up.

Listen, hash'ura. I need you to deliver supplies to each of de shrines in de city. We've packaged food, water, bandages, and reagents to keep their barriers at full strength.

Ask about their status as well. Though safe, they all likely feel boxed in.
93433.completion:
Barriers holdin'? Good.

Now we can focus on de offensive.

93435.title: Four Instigators
93435.objectives: Slay the echoes of Prigmon, Zungam, Budd Nedreck, and Harrison Jones.
93435.description:
De scouts report seein' a few unique faces among de echoes. I felt old angers rising when I heard de names.

Dey were not honorable fighters for us to challenge ourselves against, such as yourself. They were vermin--greedy opportunists that drove legions of connivin' adventurers to rob us of our possessions, our treasures, and... our tusks.

Slayin' de echoes of these key figures should reduce de number of echoes appearin'.

And it will make me grin to know they've fallen.
93435.completion:
I admit it, {NAME}: knowin' you have slain de instigators brings warmth to my old bones.

Does dat lower your opinion of me?

93436.title: Hex the Innocent, Disrupt the Guilty
93436.objectives: Poison 3 Raider's Feasts, hex 7 Civilians, and sabotage the Warlord's Chest.
93436.description:
I will study de ashes you acquired, but we can get dis situation under control by means other than de axe.

You must disrupt de battlefield, hash'ura. De echoes believe dey're in de midst of a decades-old battle, so we must target de support dey relied on back then.

Poison de feasts dey find respite at, hex their disrespectful civilian allies, and sabotage dat chest they seem so keen on lootin'!
93436.progress: Let us prove dat even echoes of de past can feel woe.
93436.completion: De echoes are runnin' from de battlefield like scared hogs because of your work!

93437.title: In Their Own Blood
93437.description:
After studying de ashes, Doru believes we can only fight with de past using weapons of de past.

I cannot ask this of any Amani. Or Witherbark, Revantusk, or Shadowpine. Ya presence with us in these times must be fate... because we could only make this request to an outsider.

Ya must inhabit a soul of de profane ones: those that accepted Malacrass's vile bargain and consumed loa power during de era of Zul'jin.

Return to de shrine of de profane one ya wish to merge with.

Ancestors forgive us...
93437.completion:
Thank you, hash'ura. Truly.

The battle against de echoes will continue. However, it would seem dey cannot return after being slain now dat their leader has been dealt with.

Memories stirred my blood these last few days. Now we can all rest. Perhaps even move on?

Bah! It's just de ravin' of an old warrior. Do not mind me. 

Simply consider myself in your debt.

93440.title: Personal History
93440.objectives: Speak with Torundo the Grizzled in Atal'Aman.
93440.description:
With Mor'duun slain and de Twilight's Blade defeated, my people want to return to Atal'Aman.

It should be a moment of great celebration but... somethin' unexpected is barrin' our way.

Seek out Torundo and Elder Doru. Dey are supportin' de resettlement. They'll know how best to use your talents.

Prepare yourself, hash'ura, and do not hesitate to defend Atal'Aman no matter who you meet there.
93440.completion:
Zul'jarra sent you, hash'ura?

Heh. She must be tired of waitin' on us to make headway.

93501.title: The Season Starts: Midnight
93501.objectives: Review the Delver's Guide and the rewards offered by Naleidea Rivergleam and Telemancer Astrandis.
93501.description:
Things have started to get interesting, {NAME}. I'm hearing of all sorts of treasures popping up in delves.

I'm compiling my notes in this book, and our illustrious hosts have even broken out some of their own artifacts to trade for what we uncover.

Why don't you take a look before we head out. Better prepared than dead.
93501.completion: Good. Now as long as nothing goes wrong we can get to the good part.

93511.title: A Missing Member
93511.objectives: Listen to what Reno has to say.
93511.description:
He took him! Finley...big...purple...man!

<Reno is clearly distraught and both physically and emotionally exhausted.>

93525.title: Nulling Nullaeus
93525.objectives: Improve your gear until you are able to confront Nullaeus within his lair.
93525.description:
That thing looked tough, and it took Reno out as an afterthought.

We'll want the best gear we can get before trying to take it down.

Thankfully, I have some leads on bountiful delves we can start with.
93525.progress: He'll get what's coming to him.
93525.completion:
Thanks for the assist.

I've been where Finley was.

93575.title: Maisara Caverns: Maisara Hungers
93575.description:
I will not leave my people to die to de Vilebranch's dark rituals. We must go after dem.

The heart of Maisara Caverns is where de Vilebranch keep their secrets. I expect dis to be a bloody trip. We will have to face de ugliness of the Vilebranch greed, and what it is costin' all of us.

We must discover what purpose they have for my stolen kin. If any still be alive. I will be dere to aid you... but bring a fierce party of warriors. We will need it.
93575.progress: Gather your warparty. I will see you in Maisara Caverns.
93575.completion:
Dat be a dark business indeed. So many lost, to such a terrible fate!

But no more, thanks to you. You have de Witherbark's gratitude... and mine.

93593.title: A Call to Battle
93593.description:
Ours is a world of constant struggle, wouldn't you agree? Even in between times of peace, there is value in keeping one's battle skills sharpened.

I have heard much of your prowess. Let us see what you are capable of.
93593.progress: There is no substitute for constant vigilance, {class}. Al'anna, dalomore.
93593.completion:
How did you fare in the battlegrounds? Some wins? Some losses?

There are lessons to be learned from both.

93595.title: A Call to Delves
93595.description:
Seeking out challenge and treasure can test one's skills, all while uncovering that which will give us even greater power.

Were I you, I would delve into places that provide both.
93595.progress: Has your delving come to a satisfactory conclusion?
93595.completion: You yet live, which means two things. The first is that I was correct in guiding you to those delves. The second is that you are more capable than you were before.

93598.title: Emissary of War
93598.description:
It is only when we push ourselves beyond our limits that we truly grow... or fail and make way for others.

Prove yourself by challenging the deadliest of places. Shorel'aran.
93598.progress: Will you become the stuff of myths and legends, {class}?
93598.completion: You have proven yourself beyond even my wildest expectations. Well done, {NAME}.

93599.title: The Very Best
93599.description:
Even the smallest amongst us must play their part. That includes our little friends.

If you would strengthen both their prowess and your bond, challenge others. Only the fittest will survive.
93599.progress: By strengthening those bonds, you and your little companions will be ready for whatever comes.
93599.completion: News of your success precedes you. You guided your team well, {NAME}.

93600.title: The Arena Calls
93600.description:
Old, musty dungeons and battlefields are one thing, but the arena is where the wheat and the chaff are separated.

Can you prove yourself, {class}? Show me. Let me hear your name shouted from the stands by those crying for blood.

93605.title: The World Awaits
93605.description:
Sinu a'manore, {class}. It is true in the past, I have been less than... egalitarian in my outlook. Yet in these times of trouble, there is much to be done--whether here in Quel'Thalas or elsewhere.

Will you face the challenge and prove yourself once more?
93605.completion: Your efforts are known and appreciated. Anu bala belore'alon.

93651.title: The Blinding Vale: Lightbloom Roots
93651.description:
We have traced Ruia's flight through the Rootways. As we suspected, he has sought refuge deep within The Blinding Vale, where the Lightbloom first took root within Harandar.

With Alndust empowering our command of life, we are able to keep the Lightbloom from spreading uncontrolled. But we will run out of Alndust long before Ruia runs out of patience.

Ruia is wise and powerful. But his actions in Eversong prove that his conviction has grown into an uncontrollable fanaticism. He must be stopped.
93651.progress: Ruia is too powerful to challenge alone. Who knows what manner of overgrown monsters lurk in the heart of the Lightbloom?
93651.completion:
So it is done, then.

Ruia's demise is a tragedy. You never knew him as such, but he was once a man of honor and conviction. To think that the Light would blind him so completely to the folly of his ambitions...

In the end, he thought he was doing what was best for Harandar. I can only hope his soul finds both peace and forgiveness, as it seeks Aln'hara in death.

93687.title: Taste True Power
93687.completion:
A sight to behold, is it not?

Since the time of Dath'Remar, the elves have used this great forge to craft armor of unparalleled might. It is said that the flames were first stoked by the soul of a phoenix who thought it a fitting nest, and that its power still weaves itself through every creation.

We will permit you to share in its gifts.

93751.title: Windrunner Spire
93751.objectives: Complete the Windrunner Spire dungeon on any difficulty.
93751.description:
Former home of the Windrunners... now desecrated beyond thought. Since the Scourge invasion, the spire houses our greatest nightmares: banshees, abominations, hateful spirits.

There is no redeeming such a place, but perhaps we may help lay the tormented to rest.
93751.completion: It's as I thought... the spire houses more than just remnants of the Scourge. It's a mirror to the tragedies that befell the Windrunner family.

93752.title: Murder Row
93752.objectives: Complete the Murder Row dungeon on any difficulty.
93752.description:
I've always disagreed with Lor'themar about the existence of Murder Row. But I guess like any forest, a city should and will have its secrets.

Though recently, Lor'themar has expressed concern about rising fel activity in the area. With the majority of Silvermoon's watch on the Voidstorm, many folks are testing boundaries, taking advantage, making a play for power...

You have my permission to investigate and crush any such illegal activities.
93752.progress: More reports of fel activity come in daily. Silvermoon is at risk, I fear. I hope you're on the case..
93752.completion:
Well done thwarting such a massive operation.

Lor'themar will be relieved. Perhaps this will inspire him to enforce stricter measures in Murder Row.

93753.title: Magisters' Terrace
93753.objectives: Complete the Magisters' Terrace dungeon on any difficulty.
93753.description:
Powerful monsters of the void have taken over Magister's Terrace! These halls contain untold amounts of knowledge and arcane power. We cannot lose any of it to our enemy.

Clear the voidspawns and their masters. You'll likely have to solve the terrace's defenses as well, which are designed to prevent and shutdown unauthorized access at any cost.
93753.progress: If the Void gains access to Silvermoon's most exclusive repository of magic... Rommath will throw a fit of epic proportions.
93753.completion: That was a close call. As for Rommath and Umbric, that's a puzzle for another day.

93754.title: Maisara Caverns
93754.objectives: Complete the Maisara Caverns dungeon on any difficulty.
93754.description:
While Lady Liadrin was in Zul'Aman, she took note of one tribe, the Vilebranch, brutalizing the other forest trolls and their loa. They live up to their name by wanton use of necromancy.

Enter their caverns and put a stop to their black magic!
93754.progress: The Vilebranch usage of magic reeks of undead teachings... and I know that never ends well.
93754.completion: Never thought I'd feel good about saving trolls. The Witherbark better remember this act.

93755.title: Den of Nalorakk
93755.objectives: Complete the Den of Nalorakk dungeon on any difficulty.
93755.description:
A trial of skill and strength... I'd go myself if I wasn't needed in Silvermoon.

Good luck, champion. I look forward to hearing about your victory against the Amani Loa of War.
93755.progress: Didn't chicken out, did you? It's okay, your fear is not unfounded. Bears are the kings of nature. They'll mess you up.
93755.completion: An incredible feat. You have my respect, champion.

93756.title: The Blinding Vale
93756.objectives: Complete The Blinding Vale dungeon on any difficulty.
93756.description:
This place in Harandar is the Lightbloom's epicenter. Orweyna did what she could, which was much, but we must strike at the taproot of all roots for the plant to die.

Be on your guard, even if you think yourself experienced with the Lightbloom by now. The vale is different from the rampant, but ultimately wild growth in Eversong. It's a calculated force of nature led by a Rootwarden who seeks to strangle you and everything else it desires.
93756.progress: Learn what you can from the Lightbloom in Eversong, but beware this may be an entirely different set of problems. The Rootwarden will be expecting intruders such as yourself.
93756.completion: Does this victory spell the death of the Lightbloom? Only time will tell. But in my experience, life always finds a way.

93757.title: Voidscar Arena
93757.objectives: Complete the Voidscar Arena dungeon on any difficulty.
93757.description:
If I didn't know that the domanaar thirst for battle, and all the pain and strife that comes with it, I'd say this is trap. Either way, I suppose it's an invitation to get yourself killed.

If you insist on participating in the Void's fighting games, I can't stop you. Just don't hesitate to kill as many voidspawn as possible while you're there, okay?
93757.progress: May your arrows strike true, champion.
93757.completion: You've bested them all! Well done, champion. Maybe I'll sign up next time! It sounded like fun.

93758.title: Nexus-Point Xenas
93758.objectives: Complete the Nexus-Point Xenas dungeon on any difficulty.
93758.description:
We must continue to keep an eye on this overpowered facility. If breached, disaster will spread beyond the Voidstorm. Unfortunately this magical and mechanical complex is beyond my area of expertise.

Prepare yourself, and ensure that the Nexus-Point Xenas remains dormant.
93758.progress:
If the Nexus-Point is overloaded, it'll be a very quick death for many.

Let's not entertain that thought any further. Secure the facility!
93758.completion: Swift work, champion. It seems like we'll have to continue our routine inspections, but for now, we can rest.

93792.title: Blessings of the Loa
93792.description:
My name is Du'gal. And you are hash'ura.

Kinduru has ordered me to train you in de ways of loa worship. Take honor in it. Very few gokinye have earned de right as you have.

Beside me is de Altar of Blessings. You may use it to worship any of our loa, and you shall receive a sliver of power in thanks.

Go ahead now, if ya be so kind.
93792.progress: De loa are quite generous indeed.
93792.completion:
Ya spirit is flowing with strength!

You may use de altar as often as ya wish. But ya can only hold one blessing on ya self at a time.

93850.title: Windrunner Spire: Haunting Melodies
93850.objectives: Quell the restless spirits inside Windrunner Spire.
93850.description:
So much grief... So much pain. It binds us to this place.

His melodies once soothed us, but now they are drowned out by the din of violence.

Please help us. Follow the sound of the lyre. He will guide you.
93850.completion:
The pain, the fear... I can feel that music washing it all away.

Thank you, friend.

93904.title: Defying Gravity
93904.objectives: Gather Void energy within the Lair of Predaxas.
93904.description:
Now, we descend. The Void energy below is unlike any I've felt before, as if gravity itself yields to the Void. Once you enter the cave, its influence will be upon you.

Kalgorg has already slain and claimed power from the creatures within. Their violent deaths have left behind some kind of cursed terrain. But we must proceed and claim the power within. Fill the reliquary to the brim. 

I know not what to expect from my voidwalker. We will need all the power we can manage.

93905.title: Ongoing Stoppage
93905.objectives: Slay Shadowguard and disrupt the Manaforge at the Ethereum Refinery.
93905.description:
The Shadowguard may once have defied Xal'atath, but they're part of her army now. Whatever they're doing with the energies gathered here must be stopped.

Put down their soldiers, harvesters, and machines. I'll do the same, and meet you deeper within.

94361.title: The Abundant Life
94361.objectives: Complete each Abundance event once. They are located in Eversong, Zul'Aman, Harandar, and Voidstorm.
94361.description:
You are ready, acolyte! Ready to spread your wings or what have you?

I have projected my presence into today's most active and tumultuous lands, rummaging about their natures and environs for areas ripe with abundance. With a little provocation from me, these forgotten corners are blooming bright with glorious harvestables!

Seek me out! A crypt of phantasms in Eversong! A grove of verdant flora in Harandar! Even a quarry of living rock in Voidstorm! And, of course, right here too!
94361.progress:
Temperance, acolyte.

There is still more abundance to be collected yet.
94361.completion:
Well done, fellow acolyte!

Let our harvests be bountiful, our rewards glorious, and our lives abundant!

94385.title: Void Assaults: Eversong Woods
94385.objectives: Disrupt the Void Strikes around Eversong Woods.
94385.description: We are seeing a Void Assault in Eversong. We need you to head out immediately to counter these threats. I will mark the strikes on your map as our scouts identify them and direct your efforts from here.
94385.completion:
I knew you were key to our efforts and the right person to counter these threats! We face a diverse group of enemies, so someone who can react to new situations will continue to excel among our ranks.

I look forward to working with you on our next assignment, but stay vigilant! These threats do not show signs of waning.

94386.title: Void Assaults: Zul'Aman
94386.objectives: Disrupt the Void Strikes around Zul'Aman.
94386.description:
My scouts report a Void Assault in Zul'Aman. We need your help to counter these threats. 

I will direct you, and my scouts will continue to mark new activities on your map.
94386.progress: We will triumph over these foes!
94386.completion:
The Ranger Captain's faith in you is well earned. My people are also indebted to you for your assistance. 

I look forward to working with you again. My scouts do say that strikes still continue, so stay vigilant out there.

94417.title: Crests of the Dawn
94417.description:
Using what I've learned from Silvermoon's artisans, Cuzolth and I can infuse your gear with additional power!

Powerful equipment requires Dawncrests to upgrade it to its full potential. These crests are rewarded through many different activities. Dawncrests have five tiers, and more dangerous tasks reward you with higher-tier crests. Adventurer Dawncrests are the lowest tier, but still quite powerful!

Bring me thirty Adventurer Dawncrests and we can help you upgrade your gear further.
94417.progress: If you're having a hard time finding Adventurer Dawncrests, you can search for hidden treasures around Eversong, Zul'Aman, Harandar, and Voidstorm. There's no shortage of those treasures!
94417.completion:
This is wonderful. I'm excited for you to grow in power!

And to advance my research, of course. But yes, your power is my top priority!

94418.title: Crest Transmutation
94418.objectives: Bring 10 Veteran Dawncrests to Vaskarn in Silvermoon, then trade them for a Bundle of Adventurer Dawncrests.
94418.description:
Did you know that crests can be transmuted into different tiers?

If you find yourself with crests that are too powerful for the gear you've acquired, I can help you transmute those crests into lower tiers that you can use.

And once all of your gear is sufficiently powerful, I'll be able to transmute your spare lower crests into higher ones!

Let's practice the transmutation process. Here's a few Veteran Dawncrests. Speak to me and I can transform them into Adventurer Dawncrests for you.
94418.progress: If you lose those Veteran Dawncrests, you can find more from powerful creatures around Eversong, Zul'Aman, Harandar, and Voidstorm. I've heard there's quite a variety of them!
94418.completion:
Remarkable!

Keep in mind I can only transmute crests into a higher tier when you have outgrown their usefulness, and it will be a costly process. Thank you for all of your help, {NAME}!

94430.title: Adventuring Gear
94430.objectives: Obtain a piece of Adventurer track gear, then return to Vaskarn in Silvermoon.
94430.description:
{NAME}, you're just in time! I was exchanging research notes with the artisans here in Silvermoon all day. Did you know they can infuse weapons and armor with the power of the dawn itself? Fascinating!

I've been itching to put some of these new techniques to the test. Bring me a piece of Adventurer equipment and I'll let you know what we need to make it more powerful.

There should be plenty of people in Silvermoon and beyond willing to reward you with some Adventurer equipment in exchange for your aid.
94430.completion:
This piece of equipment will be perfect!

I can help you make this more powerful, but we'll need some reagents.

94432.title: Veteran Equipment
94432.description:
We have only just begun to scratch the surface of how powerful your gear can become!

However, every piece of equipment has a limit to how much it can be upgraded. The more powerful an item is at its baseline, the more powerful it will become as we upgrade it. An item's upgrade track determines which crests we must use to upgrade it.

Bring me a piece of Veteran equipment this time along with some Veteran Dawncrests. Just like before, Cuzolth will help you upgrade the item using those crests.
94432.progress: If you're having trouble finding a piece of Veteran equipment, try completing a Heroic dungeon or a challenging weekly activity in Eversong, Zul'Aman, Harandar, or Voidstorm. You can find more powerful gear this way!
94432.completion:
You're a natural! It looks like you have a handle on things already.

Every time you want to upgrade a piece of equipment, the process works the same way. Bring us the item and the crests that go with it, then Cuzolth will help you upgrade it.

94474.title: The Great Vault
94474.objectives: Obtain a piece of loot from the Great Vault.
94474.description:
In wake of recent events, the Vanguard of the Light has recovered and preserved relics of exceptional power and craftsmanship. To safeguard these treasures from prying eyes, the Magisters of Silvermoon have conjured a vault within Silvermoon's bank.

Only the most proven of champions may earn the right to draw from its splendor. If the Light deems you worthy, you may be bestowed an artifact of great power.
94474.progress: The Light favors you, and so too does the vault. Look within.
94474.completion:
Has the vault bestowed a fine relic upon you? Excellent!

The vault's splendor is often replenished. Keep your visits frequent, {NAME}. Fortune favors those who return.

94623.title: Building the Voidforge
94623.description:
I have been considering how I may offer you greater strength, my friend. I've come up with something, but I need your help building a proper Voidforge.

What? Oh, fear not, all my ulterior motives are still aligned with your cause. For now.

To begin, I need one Elementary Voidcore. You will be able to find shards from the more powerful foes you habitually encounter. Inflict your usual violence, return the shards, and I can weave them back into a true Voidcore to serve as the forge's foundation.
94623.progress: Back already, {NAME}? Pick up any fresh scars?
94623.completion: Ah, the nascent Voidforge is ready! Oh the things I... I mean we, will be able to do with this...

94625.title: An Elementary Voidcore
94625.description:
The work continues. Find enough shards and we can fuse them back into an Elemental Voidcore.

I have acquired sufficient reagents to transmute $30474w cores in total thus far. The nascent Voidforge will require $30506W before it is fully formed, and you have generously contributed $3409cur so far.

Go out and indulge in a bit more violence, will you?
94625.progress: You certainly weren't in any rush with this one, {NAME}. I suppose the gates of time can't be rushed, can they?
94625.completion: Excellent. One more Elemental Voidcore for the Voidforge!

94675.title: Voidforge Reforged
94675.completion: After all this time, the nascent Voidforge is humming with power!

94790.title: Research Console: Exploring the Void
94790.objectives: Complete 3 World Quests for Void Researcher Anomander in Howling Ridge.
94790.description:
No rest for the researchers, as they say.

As much as I would love to go traipsing around this blasted voidscape, I need to remain at this post. But you! You can be our eyes and ears in the abyss.

Go and explore the Voidstorm, maybe we can find some additional samples to feed into the console.
94790.completion: More samples, excellent! The console hungers...

95175.title: Anchoring the Defense
95175.description:
We need your help to activate the Singularity Anchor. 

With proper defenses we can counter enemy assaults long enough to activate the device. If the Anchor is destroyed our efforts will be halted.

Do what you can to help us.
95175.progress: Have you helped us activate the Singularity Anchor?
95175.completion: We've neutralized numerous anomalies, but the additonal ones remain. We will prepare for additonal activations.

95268.title: New Tools, New Heights
95268.description:
There is another sort of Void power I know you will be interested in. An Ascendant Voidcore is difficult to come by, and even more difficult to work. With the Voidforge completed, I can now weave a magnificent Nilhammer capable of such things. Of course, I will need you to help with the materials. It will take time.

Take this chunk of Hungering Oblivium. It can devour moments of extreme violence to be catalyzed to new heights of power, but I don't think you'll have any trouble managing that, will you?
95268.progress: Have you fed your pet rock yet, {NAME}? I would not suggest leaving Oblivium on your person for extended periods of time...
95268.completion: I can feel the Hungering Oblivium radiating power! Well done, {NAME}. We have taken the first step towards even greater power. It will take me some time to prepare more Oblivium to continue our work here.

95269.title: Feeding the Nilhammer
95269.description: Our nascent Nilhammer coalesces! But I will need to weave the Void energies from more Hungering Oblivium into it before it can fully take form. Luckily I have prepared another piece for you to catalyze. Extreme violence, remember?
95269.completion: Ah, well done. Another successful Oblivium catalyzation. The Nilhammer grows stronger!

95271.title: The Ascendant Nilhammer
95271.completion: The Ascendant Netherhammer! A tool truly worthy of an artisan of my skill. The things I will be able to create... Of course, you will be rewarded for your efforts. Take this Ascendant Voidshard. You will need several more before you can coalesce them into an Ascendant Voidcore. I will help you transfer its energies into your most powerful equipment at the Voidforge.

95279.title: Nebulous Voidcores: Gold
95279.progress:
Back for more Nebulous Voidcores? I have them prepared, but I do expect you to share the burden of my expenses. And then some. Why shouldn't your delightful affinity for violence pay dividends, after all?

Even in the Voidstorm we can find uses for the gold. It has the most interesting properties when subjected to a touch of Void energy under the right conditions!
 Required money: 5,000 (1)
95279.completion: I knew you couldn't say no. I trust you'll put these Nebulous Voidcores to good use, {NAME}.

95290.title: Nebulous Voidcores: Voidlight Marl
95290.progress:
Back for more Nebulous Voidcores? I have them prepared, but I do expect you to share the burden of my expenses. And then some. Why shouldn't your delightful affinity for violence pay dividends, after all?

Voidlight Marl is a fascinating substance! I am always happy to have more to experiment with. It is usually difficult to come by such Light-touched reagents in the Voidstorm.
Collect: Voidlight Marl (2000)
95290.completion: I knew you couldn't say no. I trust you'll put these Nebulous Voidcores to good use, {NAME}.

95304.title: Nebulous Voidcores: Veteran Dawncrest
95304.progress:
Back for more Nebulous Voidcores? I have them prepared, but I do expect you to share the burden of my expenses. And then some. Why shouldn't your delightful affinity for violence pay dividends, after all?

Those crests you use to empower equipment could be put to great use in my workshop. I can always use new materials to experiment with.
Collect: Veteran Dawncrest (80)
95304.completion: I knew you couldn't say no. I trust you'll put these Nebulous Voidcores to good use, {NAME}.

95324.title: The War Beyond the Roots
95324.objectives: Bring word to Lor'themar in the Sanctum of Light.
95324.description:
