Your actions in Harandar caused quite an uproar. The elders are up in arms. The rootwardens are worried. It's really quite exhausting.

But there is good news as well. Orweyna has heard rumblings from every corner of the roots. She tells me of haranir who wish to see the world as she does--who feel compelled to seek the goddess beyond the boughs of Harandar.

I will handle things in Harandar. Go to your leaders. Tell them that the haranir are ready to join the fight.

95373.title: A Nebulous Endeavour
95373.description:
With the Voidforge completed, I can now weave Nebulous Voidcores for you out of the power it accumulates. Of course, I'll need you to cover certain expenses.

You'll have to engage in a bit more delightful bloodshed to transmute them into weapons and armor. The most dangerous foes will require two. Each Nebulous Voidcore will capture a bit of your... victims' particular essence in order to become the sort of shiny knicknack I know you can't resist chasing after.
95373.progress: Back already, {NAME}? Were you able to transmute the Nebulous Voidcore?
95373.completion: Ah, looks like you found something shiny after all! The Voidforge will provide me with additional reagents to weave more Nebulous Voidcores over time, so be sure to check back later.

95413.title: Community Engagement
95413.objectives: Purchase an item from an endeavor trader found in your neighborhood.
95413.description:
Ah hello, {NAME}. I have a flier for you.

<Vaeli hands you a glossy piece of paper.>

DON'T MISS OUT!!!

Don't miss this amazing deal available only to you! Present this coupon on your next purchase from your neighborhood endeavor trader, and get bonus items for free!

Coupon valid for one week. Terms and conditions apply.

95416.title: Going Postal
95416.description:
With so many new residents, mail in the neighborhoods is really starting to pile up. So many routes and just one of me! If only I could deputize an assistant mail carrier...

Say, {NAME}, would you be willing to help out? I've got some juicy parcels from the dead letter office I could offer in thanks.
95416.progress: Neither scourge nor fel nor void nor dragon's flame shall stay we couriers from the swift delivery of our entrusted missives!
95416.completion: You're a lifesaver! And we're certain none of those letters or packages ended up in a ditch somewhere, right?

95438.title: Lost Animals
95438.objectives: Find 10 Lost Animals in the neighborhood and bring them to Kara Meldansen.
95438.description:
{NAME}, I am so glad to see you.

A good friend of mine has sent a letter informing me she lost track of some of her tiny pets throughout the neighborhood! She's asking for assistance from anyone who can help!

Help find her lost animals right away!
95438.progress:
Oh please do hurry!

I'm sure they are off having the most grand adventures but I worry so!
95438.completion: Thank you so much! I am so glad to have all my babies back!

95440.title: Housewarming
95440.objectives: Gather with at least four other players inside a player home while the homeowner is present.
95440.description:
Kirin Tor scholars have argued for centuries over the semantics of a "gathering".

How many people are required? For how long must they remain? Who is bringing the beverages?

Debates have raged into the night. Papers written. Research grants awarded.

Consensus yet eludes the scholars, but they still meet often to deliberate. They take turns bringing beverages.

95549.title: Raising Magical Alarms
95549.objectives: Use Lady Darkglen's device in a Ritual Site.
95549.description:
I have a request.

These Ritual Sites invoke some interesting magic. I would like you to obtain some sample readings.

You don't need to concern yourself with the details. Just visit the area I will mark on your map and press the button.

You may end up garnering some extra attention when you do so.
95549.progress: That is the look of success.
95549.completion: Such delightful data. Now the real work begins.

95550.title: Thin Their Ranks
95550.objectives: Defeat enemies in a Ritual Site.
95550.description:
I don't like it.

We have far too many scouts returning wounded from these so-called ritual sites.

Thin out the ranks of these cultists.
95550.completion:
Good.

For far too long we have been beset by threats. Striking back will send a message.

95552.title: Dark Obelisk Investigation
95552.objectives: Investigate the sources of the malevolent boons in a Ritual Site.
95552.description:
{race}, we have reports that the leaders of the Ritual Sites are using dark obelisks to bolster their forces with malevolent boons.

I need you to investigate the objects they are using to gain these boons.
95552.progress: What do you have to report?
95552.completion:
Now that we are aware of how they are getting the boons, I will identify these dark obelisks' weaknesses. I should soon have the information you need to destroy them when they are active.

Good work, {race}!

95553.title: Manifested Density
95553.description:
I'm hearing strange murmurings from my scouts.

Some are claiming that strange manifestations are appearing and cursing intruders.

Could I ask you to investigate and see if there is any truth to these rumors?
95553.completion:
Astounding.

I don't know what these cultists will do next, but at least now we can be better prepared for their current monstrosities.

95933.title: Traces in the Dark
95933.objectives: Speak to Riftblade Maella in Silvermoon City.
95933.description:
Champion, Riftblade Maella would like to speak with you again.

The dark particles you have brought us, the information you've been gathering on our enemies and the countless victories you have bought for Quel'Thalas have not gone unnoticed.

It seems Maella has a plan. Seek her out when you can.
95933.progress: Your efforts against these void and ethereal threats has, yet again, been invaluable. But our work is not yet over.
95933.completion:
For now, continue your efforts in protecting Eversong and Zul'Aman.

These threats, be it void, ethereal or other, are unlikely to simply give up and slink away.

Rout them at every turn you can while I gather allies and prepare for our next move.

I will be in touch in due time.

96048.title: The Time to Strike
96048.objectives: Meet Riftblade Maella overlooking the Bazaar in Silvermoon.
96048.description:
<A void-touched missive materializes before you.>

{NAME},

Your efforts against the recent void and ethereal incursions have paid off. It's time we take the fight to them.

Meet me at the Ranger-Captain's strike station in Silvermoon.

Do not delay.

Riftblade Maella
96048.completion:
Shortly after Xal'atath disappeared, rogue void forces and ethereals attacked our lands.

We discovered they're operating from former Legion-controlled worlds, giving my Riftwardens a trail to follow.

With Quel'Thalas still under threat from these attacks, large scale support from Silvermoon is out of the question.

Luckily, I've found like-minded allies to join our assault.

96223.title: The Magisters' Call
96223.description:
<A floating missive hangs before you, written in a flowing magical script. At first, it appears to be nonsense.

As you approach the parchment, the words shift and change, and a message forms.>

The Magisters request your presence at Thalassian University. Please proceed to the upper levels overlooking the harbor.

This concerns a private matter of minor urgency.
96223.completion:
Ah, {NAME}. I see you received my message. Your timely response is most appreciated.

We have much to discuss and we are short on time, unfortunately.

96388.title: Joining the Abyss Anglers
96388.description:
Ya ever heard of de Abyss Anglers?

Forest tribes have been hunting de land as well as de waters for generations.

Don't be shy, hash'ura. Grab a suit and go for a dive!
96388.completion:
Ya a natural diver, hash'ura!

Here are a few Angler Pearls too. Collect enough and bring them back to me or Tu'nakit to prove ya ready for better gear!

96472.title: The Nexus-Captain
96472.description:
The Hal'hadar may not know we are here yet, but they still hold the advantage.

Nexus-Captain Leth'ir and his associate, Mertei, are just over this ridge and surrounded by a small army.

If you can rally enough allies and catch their leaders off guard, we will deal a devastating blow before they know what hit them.

Proceed with caution, {NAME}, and make sure you are not alone.
96472.completion:
You were successful? Leth'ir is dead?

<Riftblade Maella offers a rare smirk.>

The Hal'hadar may know we are here now, but the death of their Captain will have them scurrying through the swamp.

Your deeds have bought us, and Azeroth, a chance to breathe.

Take a moment to rest while you can. The threat here is far from finished.

96496.title: The Road Not Taken Twice
96496.objectives: Place Rift Slippers in the Forgotten Chamber and Void Acropolis.
96496.description:
During our surveys of this iced desert, our scouts identified two areas worth keeping an eye on, but with a major problem: they're only accessible through single points of entry.

Before I'm comfortable sending out more forces, we need to secure their exits.

We've been working on teleportation crystals for faster local travel that leverage the domanaar's existing portal network, and we're close to a solution. You just need to field test them.

Set up these prototype rift slippers and report back.
96496.progress: We need those rift slippers in place to expand our operations through Val safely, and to prove the first step of our local teleportation network.
96496.completion: Excellent work returning in one piece. Now our scouts can move more freely without risk of being cornered.

96497.title: Spatial Reasoning
96497.description:
The domanaar are more entrenched here than we thought and these storms refuse to relent even for a moment.

We've finally figured out how to hijack their portal network for short range traversal thanks to your efforts setting up the rift slippers. Now we just need help setting up our portal bridges.

Here are four strategic locations, including this outpost, for you to set up the portal bridges. Once active, you'll be able to more swiftly respond to threats as they arise.

Time to get to work.

96725.title: Sparks of War: Val
96725.objectives: Collect 100 Otherworldly Sparks of War in Val, while in War Mode.
96725.description:
The mysterious world of Val has been made accessible to us with a host of new creatures present.

Go and see what you can find out about them.
96725.completion: That provides some answers, many thanks.

96726.title: Sparks of War: Naigtal
96726.objectives: Collect 100 Otherworldly Sparks of War in Naigtal, while in War Mode.
96726.description:
The mysterious world of Naigtal has been made accessible to us with a host of new creatures present.

Go and see what you can find out about this world and what the ethereals are up to.
96726.completion: That provides some answers, many thanks.

96746.title: Sporefall: Rotmire
96746.description:
Need help! End of Harandar! End of world!

Spore Storm making something new for Grudge Pit, but too much. Too much! Can't control. Will break free! Destroy pit. Destroy us all!

Must go to Sporefall, destroy Rotmire before they lose control!

For Harandar! For Azeroth! For Grudge Pit!
96746.completion:
You save us all. Fungaria! Harandar! World! Grudge Pit!

But world, mostly world.

96809.title: Exterior Manaforge Translocator
96809.description:
Maneuvering through this spore-infested rock is quickly becoming a chore, I'm sure you would agree.

Thankfully, I've figured out a way to make use of the existing Manaforge Translocator network that was so thoughtfully built prior to our arrival.

I can show you how to "activate" them for our use. You can start with the one we... translocated to camp.

97031.title: Vilaldoun Valediction
97031.objectives: Deliver the Hologem to Archmage Y'mera in the Umbral Base Camp.
97031.description:
<A brief glint sparkling in the shadows catches your eye.

As you pick up the object, the gem in its center flickers briefly, strange alien runes flashing across its surface.

For a moment, you see a flickering recorded projection of a male draenei mouthing silent words.

Y'mera will definitely be interested in this object.>

97215.title: A Secondary Strike
97215.objectives: Meet Riftblade Maella in the Voidstorm.
97215.description:
We have struck a major blow against our enemies. Still, they continue their assaults.

Decimus and my riftwardens have targeted another world from which they launch these attacks.

The bulk of our forces have temporarily withdrawn to the Voidstorm so that we may begin our assault on this second world.

Our strike team awaits us at the Howling Ridge.
97215.completion:
Our enemies have each established their strongholds on different worlds, forcing us to split our attention.

If we are to truly route their forces, we must strike at both and fortify our entry points.

Ready to breach another rift?

97256.title: Knocking Off the Top (Heroic)
97256.objectives: Collect 4 Void Commander's Emblems from Nexus-Captain Leth'ir or Imperator Pertinax while in the Heroic world tier of Val and Naigtal.
97256.description:
Even the most ruthless of creatures falter when they see their greatest champions crumble to ash.

Remind our enemies here just how quickly their leaders fall!

Let them know just how unrelenting and vicious you monsters of Azeroth really are! Bring me the Void Commander's Emblems and I will reward you accordingly.

90094.title: Echo of the Hunt
90094.objectives: Complete the second trial at the Den of Echoes.
90094.description:
Haranir are fierce and ferocious--cunning and canny. In time, we became the most feared beasts upon the mountain.

A great many wise and powerful beasts roamed the hills of our old mountain. But in time, we came to master them all.

Today, you shall hunt as we once did.
90094.completion: You have proven yourself a capable hunter like our ancestors of old. But simply being the strongest did not prove succor enough for the minds of our people.

90095.title: Echo of the Call
90095.objectives: Complete the third trial at the Den of Echoes.
90095.description:
When the haranir began to grow restless, they looked to new sources of purpose. Some cast their gazes upward, toward the stars and the moon. Others, such as the Hara'ti, heard a call from deep within the world.

The moment the first of the Hara'ti heard the Song echoing from the roots, we knew that we had found a new purpose. We would seek out the source of the Song, and discover the truth of it for ourselves.

But it would be a difficult road. Strange stone monsters sought to block our path.
90095.completion:
Now you know how the Hara'ti came to walk amongst the roots.

One final trial remains--the most difficult, but most important, of them all.

Hagar awaits you, and will guide you through the next challenge.

90468.title: Ugh, Chores!
90468.objectives: Collect 8 Intact Saptor Fronds from the saptors of the Harandar Cascades.
90468.description:
Okay, so I may have a DIFFERENT thing that I'm supposed to be doing in the Cascades, too. It's my turn to gather saptor fronds for stew. It's such a pain. Not only are saptor fronds horribly bitter, but the saptors are barely even fun to hunt! They don't even make your blood flow that fast before they die.

But hey! You probably don't get to fight saptors as often as I do. Maybe while you're looking for skyglass, you could gather some up for me? You know... while you're in the area.
90468.completion: Kuri is as imaginative as she is fierce, but she also has a bad habit of neglecting her chores. I appreciate your contribution to our community, though I shall have to give Kuri a scolding once she returns.

90469.title: Carry On, Wayward Kuri
90469.description:
Oh, that Kuri. She holds tightly to our ancient traditions and tales... perhaps too tightly.

There is a difference between holding reverence for our ancient ways and chasing them into dangerous caves. I fear she might bite off more than she can chew in her search for Aln'sharan.

Won't you go after her? She seems to trust you, now that she sees you as her co-conspirator in this quest. Please bring her home safely.
90469.progress: I'm certain Kuri will be fine. She's got her head in the roots, but she's made of tough stuff. But with Harandar as volatile as it has been of late, I would rather be safe than sorry.
90469.completion:
O-Okay... so maybe I'm a bit afraid of the dark. But that doesn't mean I'm not going in there!

You'll be there with me too, right? There are probably tons of skyshards to be found inside!

90470.title: Skyglass Scavenging
90470.objectives: Gather as much Skyglass as Kuri can carry from Dreth'amar Cavern in Harandar.
90470.description:
The adults find all sorts of stuff in the caves around here that we use back at the village. A lot of the critters that live in the caves like to gather skyglass, in particular. I guess they think it's shiny.

That's good for us, though! It means we can go and get a bunch of skyglass. Go in there and make sure the coast is clear, and then I'll come in and gather up as much as I can carry!

At this rate, we'll be able to summon Aln'sharan in no time.
90470.progress: Come onnn! We've gotta hurry before mom gets TOO worried.
90470.completion:
Yes! Yes, yes, yes! This is soooo much!

Aln'sharan will notice for sure. He probably wants all of his skyglass back!

90474.title: The Legend of Aln'sharan
90474.description:
This is it! We have all the skyglass we can carry.

The legends say that Aln'sharan cries crystal tears to mourn the missing Goddess. Maybe if we give the crystals back to him, he won't be so sad? Maybe then he'll appear for us!

Meet me back at the village. I think I know the perfect place to make our offering.
90474.progress: Come on! We don't wanna miss our chance! Also all of this skyglass is heavy. Can't you carry some?!
90474.completion:
You know... I thought I would be sad if this didn't work, but I actually feel okay!

I still believe. There's so much magic in the world. And even if Aln'sharan isn't exactly what I think he is... his story still exists for a reason. And that's important to me, I think.

90481.title: I Have a Permit
90481.objectives: Find Elder Ren'zen in Witherbark Village.
90481.description:
These Witherbark youths are telling us we can't stay here.

But I've been talking to one of their elders for months to be sure we'd have permission to set up camp and explore. I even have copies of all the letters!

Can you find Elder Ren'zen in Witherbark Village and show him his letter of approval?
90481.progress: Elder Ren'zen seemed so pleasant in his letters. Why all the hostility now?
90481.completion:
He confirmed what he'd sent was a letter of approval? Good! I'm glad that's cleared up.

Maybe now we can get a more pleasant introduction to Zul'Aman.

90482.title: Cuisine Connection
90482.objectives: Collect 6 Zapgut Eel Stomachs and 60 Blisterskin Kelp.
90482.description:
Dis "seeker" has been askin' a lot of questions about de foods we eat.

It sounds like these tortollans like to eat poisonous foods. De Witherbark do as well. There are many foods we eat that could kill us if not treated properly.

Go collect zapgut eel stomachs and blisterskin kelp. I'd like to test dis turtle's tongue.
90482.progress:
We ingest some poisons to make ourselves resistant to potential threats.

Some just taste good or provide a good thrill.

90483.title: A Witherbark Story
90483.description:
The Witherbark say they have a lot of stories to tell, but I've heard two and BOTH involved a sparring match!

Please, can you ask the Witherbark here for stories? My old bones can't take another reenactment!
90483.progress:
What's wrong with a gentle story about falling asleep at an inopportune time?

Tortollan folklore is full of those. Do trolls not sleep?
90483.completion: I see. They keep clear records of all these battles at least. Their storytelling is quite strenuous!

90484.title: Sightseeing Stegadon
90484.objectives: Find Steggy and defeat Hidegorger the Everburning in Zul'Aman.
90484.description:
Wow, your armor is sooooo cool!

<Trishe stares, slack-jawed.>

Oh, have you seen my friend Steggy? She was here with me, but then there were all these pretty bugs and things, and she ran off after them, and I was too slow to follow her.

<Trishe pouts.>

I'm s'posed to watch Steggy. I'm response-able! And now you're response-able for finding her, okay?
90484.progress:
Have you seen how big the trolls are? Steggy is going to be bigger than the trolls, but she's still little like me.

Steggy needs to eat so she can get bigger. Please find her so I can feed her!
90484.completion: Steggy is back! You really are response-able.

90485.title: Afterthought Artifacts
90485.objectives: Find artifacts in the lake near Camp Stonewash in Zul'Aman.
90485.description:
This location is ideal for finding artifacts. Searching through the rubble at the bottom of that lake could reveal many treasures.

If you have a moment, you're welcome to take a look around yourself. Bring me anything you find and we'll see if it's valuable.
90485.completion:
My my, what an interesting find!

There's a lot to be learned from an old pot: how the ancient Amani might have prepared food, the kinds of food they ate, and what they valued most in a meal.

I'll work on analyzing this. You can place those other items to the side. They're far younger than this beauty.

90486.title: Dangerous Delicacies
90486.objectives: Cook Blistereel Boar in Camp Stonewash.
90486.description:
A Witherbark troll could survive eatin' each of these ingredients raw, but dey would need aid.

Together, de ingredients would be deadly. We're going to cook dem into one dish.

Don't worry. I'll show you how to take out enough poison so it tastes good AND has paralytic effects.
90486.progress: What do you think this is going to taste like? Amaxi says it's absolutely arresting and could kill a stegodon!
90486.completion: I suppose now we try it. Right, {NAME}?

90493.title: The Heart of Tranquillien
90493.description:
We can't let the Twilight's Blade get away with this. There are innocent citizens all over town who had nothing to do with this cult. You heard the governor: anyone who doesn't join will be executed.

I won't stand for that.

Go--aid any civilians you can find. Get them out of harm's way. If they're being attacked, take their attacker down. Tranquillien will not fall under my watch.
90493.completion: You're safe, and so are the weary citizens of Tranquillien. Thank the Light.

90494.title: The Missing Magister
90494.description:
Umbric went to chase down Antenorian when the fighting broke out, but nobody has seen him since. 

I trust him to hold his own, but between Kasiea's death and Antenorian's betrayal, I worry he may be so set on revenge that he won't see an attack if one happens. Can you find him for me?

I'll stay here and make sure these civilians remain safe.
90494.progress: I will not allow them to get away with this.
90494.completion: A map of Eversong? With multiple villages marked by the Twilight's Blade!

90509.title: The Traitors of Tranquillien
90509.objectives: Slay Ranger Lethvalin, Matron Narsilla, and Guard Captain Leonic.
90509.description:
Some of the town's most respected citizens, traitors?

How long has the Twilight's Blade been here? How many scouts have gone missing? Crimes gone unreported? Innocents recruited by those they thought they could trust?

They must be stopped. Cut down the traitors. Show them that Tranquillien is no home for cultists.
90509.progress: We cannot allow these traitors to escape!
90509.completion: We'll need to do more to reverse the damage done here, but this was a good first step. Thank you.

90534.title: The Home of the Haranir
90534.objectives: Accompany Orweyna and Gazlowe around the Cradle and the Den.
90534.description:
I am eager to show Monte my home, but I know it is very different from what he is used to.

Come with us as he meets my people.
90534.completion:
Can't say I've ever seen a place like this before. But I like it. I can see how the haranir were drawn here. How Orweyna grew up here and learned all she learned.

Bah, look at me getting sentimental. What's next?

90535.title: Leave Your Mark
90535.objectives: Paint your mark on the wall of the Den.
90535.description:
One thing that is very important to the haranir is our past. Some may remove their ability to hear the Goddess, but we are all connected to who came before us.

You and Gazlowe are a part of our history now. You have earned the right to leave your mark here in the Den, for as long as the Den remains.

Go, touch the wall with your painted hand, and know that you touch the same stone as generations before you.
90535.progress: We are continually making ourselves new, even as we hold to what came before. I should remember this more often.
90535.completion: There. Now you are part of Harandar.

90537.title: Late Bloomers
90537.objectives: Look for the missing company of rutaani and haranir.
90537.description:
It is good to see you again, {NAME}. Orweyna told me that you might be able to help me with something.

A group of rutaani were due to arrive here earlier today, but they're late. They're coming up from Blooming Terrace with my mentor, Ru'gar, and I am worried they've had trouble on the road.

Will you scout along the road from here down to the Terrace? I'll come up from there and we can meet on the way if we find nothing.
90537.progress: Quietly now. The enemy is close.
90537.completion:
Welcome to Fungal Cleft, {NAME}. The local fungarians here are more volatile than those at Har'mara.

They have no concept of balance and strive to spread their spores far and wide, overcrowding the nearby rutaani of Blooming Terrace and threatening to spill out into the rest of Harandar.

The captured rutaani must be within the settlement.

90540.title: Rutaani Rescue
90540.description:
Over the hill north of here is a fungarian village, Fungal Cleft. I believe the missing rutaani have been taken there.

The fate that awaits them is a brutal one if we do not get them back quickly. Usually, fungarians favor hosts that are already dead for their reproductive purposes. The ones here are strangely vicious, however. I have seen some mushroom-covered animals and rutaani who are still moving around! It is unnatural.

Go to Fungal Cleft and see if you can rescue the missing travelers.
90540.completion:
Good work, {NAME}. I saw the freed rutaani rushing toward Har'mara.

These fungarians were in pursuit, but I got the jump on them.

90546.title: Missing Paladins
90546.objectives: Meet Taelia at the Sanctum of the Moon.
90546.description:
Some of our brothers and sisters in the Light were responding to a request for help by the Magisters at the Sanctum of the Moon. Apparently the Twilight's Blade has been seen lurking in the area.

We expected to hear back from them awhile ago, but we've heard nothing.

Given the strength of the party that went, Salandria and I wanted some additional backup before we looked into the issue. Care to lend a hand?
90546.completion: Well, the cultists don't seem to be hiding now. But I don't see any of our missing paladins.

90547.title: Missing Paladins
90547.objectives: Meet Salandria at the Sanctum of the Moon.
90547.description:
Some of our brothers and sisters in the Light--including my friend Dawnheart--were responding to a request for help by the Magisters at the Sanctum of the Moon. Apparently the Twilight's Blade has been seen lurking in the area.

We expected to hear back from them awhile ago, but we've heard nothing.

Given the strength of the party that went, Taelia and I wanted some additional backup before we looked into the issue. Care to lend a hand?
90547.completion: The cultists are boldly showing themselves, but I don't see Dawnheart and the others.

90548.title: Twilight Missive
90548.description:
We need to figure out what the Twilight's Blade is trying to do here. We also need to get rid of these cultists so the Magisters can get back to their work building runestones.

Take out as many cultists as you can. See if any of them are carrying information we can use.
90548.completion: Good job out there. We'll need to find more if we're going to find our missing friends.

90549.title: Signs of the Struggle
90549.objectives: Look for signs of the lost paladins.
90549.description:
The Twilight's Blade are acting boldly in their takeover here. None of these Magisters have any information for us.

We'll hold this end of the bridge and protect any Magisters who escape. You get in there and look for signs of the missing paladins. Were they taken? Did they put up a fight, or were they ambushed? Are they still armed?

I have a bad feeling we are running out of time.
90549.progress: Have you found sign of the missing paladins?
90549.completion: Well, we know more. They were here at one point but they've been taken, unarmed. Now we need to find out where to.

90550.title: A Somber Sun
90550.description:
<The corpse of this Blood Knight has been horribly mangled and tainted by Void magic. He put up a fight, but was unable to survive.

Salandria will want to know of this.>
90550.completion: Those bastards... They'll pay for Sombersun's death!

90551.title: Captured Information
90551.objectives: Capture and bring an isolated cultist to the Hollow Grove.
90551.description:
We need to find out where the paladins were taken. Easiest way to do that is ask... under a bit of duress.

Find an isolated target, beat them down, and then drag them to the hollow on the other side of the Sanctum. Taelia and I will get the civilians to safety and meet you there.
90551.completion: Good. Now we can force some answers.

90552.title: Interrogation
90552.description: We need to know where Dawnheart and the others were taken. This one doesn't seem to want to talk... but we can fix that.
90552.progress: Are you sure we don't need to use a little more force?
90552.completion: The Ruins of Deatholme. They better be alive when we get there!

90553.title: Executing the Blades
90553.description:
Those monsters will pay for what they have done!

Take out any Twilight's Blade cultists you see. We'll scour them from Eversong for good!
90553.completion: We have wiped Eversong clean of their filth.

90554.title: Leave Ashes in Your Wake
90554.objectives: Wreck the Twilight's Blade camp in Deatholme.
90554.description:
We need to make it clear to these cultists that they aren't welcome.

Tear down their banners, and destroy their books and supplies. Do whatever you can to wreck their camp!
90554.completion: Good work. Even if they come crawling back, they won't find much.

90555.title: Blessing of Freedom
90555.objectives: Free paladins in the Ruins of Deatholme.
90555.description:
Our friends are being held in this area. I have no idea what state we'll find them in, but I pray they are at least alive.

Help me find and free our missing paladins in the Ruins of Deatholme.
90555.completion: All things considered, this was a good result. I wish... well. We couldn't save everyone, but we did save most of them. I guess that's as much as anyone can ask for in a situation like this.

90556.title: Cutting off the Head
90556.description: We'll crush their leader! For justice and the Light!
90556.progress: May their ilk never come around here again!
90556.completion: We'll mourn the lost and celebrate those who survived. Thank you, {NAME}.

90568.title: Unlikely Friends
90568.objectives: Speak with Elder Ren'zen in Witherbark Village.
90568.description:
This old Witherbark pot you found is quite interesting.

I've made a series of notes on its construction and use, but now it's time we speak to Elder Ren'zen. The pot should be returned to him. And he can fill in the gaps in the pot's story!

Let's speak with him in the village.
90568.completion: Seeker Crikkash says he wanted to wait for you to arrive before showing me what he's found.

90569.title: Back in the Bag
90569.description:
What a mess this is. The sack you found was supposed to be filled with seeds. They're part of an important cultivation project that Ru'gar was working on.

It appears the fungarians made off with the seeds when they captured the rutaani.

While you're looking for the rutaani, see if you can recover the seeds that were stolen.
90569.progress:
I can't bear to think of what the fungarians will do to the seeds that Ru'gar has been carefully cultivating. He had been working with the rutaani on plants that were more hardy and produced greater yield. 

His work should not be lost.
90569.completion:
You found so many! Thank you.

These seeds were very important to Ru'gar. I don't know much about gardening, but maybe I can give it a try.

90570.title: To the Ruins of Deatholme
90570.objectives: Meet Taelia and Salandria at Deatholme.
90570.description:
Thanks to our "friend" here, we know the missing paladins were taken to Deatholme. We have to find them before it's too late! 

Salandria and I will meet you there.
90570.completion: Good--you made it. Now let's save those paladins.

90571.title: The Lay of the Beast
90571.objectives: Use Decimus's pet to scout the Voidspire.
90571.description:
Your friend's scheme to blow up the Nexus-Point was adorable. You all looked so determined, I didn't have the heart to tell you how simple the solution really is.

The Mantle of Predation will allow you to enter the Nexus-Points and weaken the storm. Alas, it's claiming the Mantle that will truly test you.

Borrow my pet--see through his eyes. I'll show you who you'll steal the Mantle from.
90571.completion:
There you have it--simply steal the Mantle from Terminas. I'd recommend acting quickly. Who knows when Terminas will return to the Obscurion Citadel.

A shame about Ciphus. I was planning to devour him myself once I'd fattened him up.

90573.title: Fortify the Runestones: Magisters
90573.description:
We placed a number of runestones throughout Eversong Woods, each one charged with protective arcane magic intended to ward off the Lightbloom.

While highly effective, the runestones require an immense amount of power to function. They must be regularly fed with latent arcana lest they weaken.

As Magisters, it is our duty to maintain the runestones--especially when the eyes of this Haven are upon us. Recharge their arcane power and defend them from those who would threaten us.
90573.progress: We must ensure the runestones are charged and defended.
90573.completion: Your strength is matched only by your acuity, my dear. I will ensure everyone knows how marvelously you have performed today.

90574.title: Fortify the Runestones: Blood Knights
90574.description:
The Magisters placed a number of runestones throughout Eversong Woods, each one charged with protective arcane magic intended to ward off the Lightbloom.

Naturally, the runestones require an immense amount of power to function. They can be fed with latent arcana, but that power draws enemies seeking to claim it.

As Blood Knights, it is our duty to defend the runestones--especially when the eyes of this Haven are upon us. Recharge their arcane power and defend them from those who would threaten us.
90574.progress: Maintaining the safety of Eversong is of utmost importance.
90574.completion: Your deeds honor us, {NAME}. You have fought well this day.

90575.title: Fortify the Runestones: Farstriders
90575.description:
The Magisters placed a handful of runestones across Eversong, each one charged with arcane magic that wards off the Lightbloom.

As you might guess, the runestones require a huge amount of power to function. The Magisters feed them with latent arcana, but that kind of power draws a lot of attention. Bad attention.

As Farstriders, it's our duty to defend Eversong from those kinds of threats--especially when the Haven is looking at us. Go recharge the runestones and fight off whatever tries to stop you.
90575.progress: We need to keep those runestones safe.
90575.completion: Nice work. You know how to see a mission through smoothly. I have a few ranger recruits who could learn a thing or two from you.

90576.title: Fortify the Runestones: Shades of the Row
90576.description:
Have you seen the runestones out in Eversong? Huge rocks full of arcane magic that ward off the Lightbloom.

I'm not the magic type, but I know an opportunity when I see one. Those runestones need a lot of power to work. If we help keep them charged, there are a lot of people who would owe us favors--and favors are even better than gold.

Here's the plan: I help you get some latent arcana, you drop it into the runestones, beat up whatever tries to stop you, then we bask in the accolades. Deal?
90576.progress: Those runestones aren't going to charge themselves.
90576.completion:
Ha! I shouldn't be surprised you pulled that off so well, but here we are. We've already got people looking at us like we're miracle workers.

All thanks to you, {NAME}.

90601.title: Gathering Glowshrooms
90601.description:
Ru'gar used to tell me about how he'd sneak into the nearby cave to harvest glowshrooms. They seemed to be integral to the development of the tla'tak seeds he was cultivating. Will you collect some of the mushrooms within?

Oh, and Ru'gar mentioned that the mushrooms have strange properties when harvested. I'm not sure what he meant by that, but maybe stay on your toes.
90601.progress:
Ru'gar mentioned that the glowshrooms helped create a more robust harvest when they were mixed into the dirt he'd planted crops in. How he even figured that out, I'll never know.

I would like to carry on Ru'gar's work. Since we're already here, we might as well gather what we can.
90601.completion:
Ah, you return! And with so many glowshrooms. Excellent. I hope you didn't have anything strange happen.

Thank you for collecting all of these. It will take me some time to reproduce Ru'gar's methods, but I have hope now that we can continue his work.

90602.title: Gomphusta
90602.description:
I would ask one last thing of you. I've heard quite a few of the fungarians mention their leader, Gomphusta. It seems he's behind the uptick in their violence and the reason they're stealing the seeds.

While you're in the cave, find him and take him out. Without Gomphusta pulling the strings, the other fungarians will be thrown into chaos and won't be able to organize ambushes as well.
90602.progress:
The fungarians aren't always this violent and aggressive. Gomphusta must be the force driving them. He seems to be the one infecting living creatures with spores.

With him gone, the fungarians may return to a more balanced state.
90602.completion:
What is this? Ru'gar's notes on his cultivation efforts!

This is fantastic. I can try to reproduce his work now.

Good work taking out Gomphusta, also. May this throw the fungarians into disarray and keep travelers on the roads safer.

90615.title: Be Grudge You
90615.objectives: Speak with Boletus at the Grudge Pit.
90615.description:
You look... different! Ever be to Grudge Pit?

Grudge Pit is great place! Full of fighting and cheering and fungarians. Also decaying!

Boletus is always look for strong creatures to be kill in Grudge Pit. Or for making others be kill.

Are strong creature? Should go to Pit!
90615.completion:
You look like could put up strong fight before start decay.

Would be very interesting!

90616.title: You Strong?
90616.objectives: Kill enemies in the Grudge Pit.
90616.description:
You look strong.

Should test yourself in our arena.

See how you compare to strong fungarians.
90616.progress:
Many fungarians watch the fighting.

Always so exciting!
90616.completion:
We, uh... you are so strong.

How, er...? You very different.

Teach fungarians, to be different like you?

90617.title: A Few Fun Guys
90617.description:
You are very strong, $p.

Will teach fungarians to fight?

Much we could learn from you.

Many fungarians watch battle.

Ask if they want to be strong in Pit.
90617.completion:
You found ones to teach?

First step is to fight, see what can do!

90619.title: What Doesn't Kill Them
90619.description:
Have team, now are ready to fight.

Take your team to empty area. Practice fight, and see what can do.
90619.progress:
We fighting you?

You are strong.

Fight together is good practice for be strong.
90619.completion:
Eyes are open, {NAME}! We can be strong, too.

We will be strong, like you!

When hurt, fungarians grow stronger. You hurt lot, we grow stronger lot.

Must go tell Boletus we ready!

90620.title: To the Ring
90620.description:
TeamName? Not bad. I like!

You and the TeamName head on down, and we say words.

You fight Spore Storm. If beat, fight Cap Clash.

If beat, fight Fungus Force.

Always-winners are Glow Guard. You won't beat.

No run out! Run out is big, big lose.
90620.completion:
Was sure Brakko was strong enough. Was train with strong {NAME}!

But Brakko is scared of sporegliders. Will eat cap!

Brakko so sad to fail {NAME}.

Ziny and Tuktuk too. All run out.

We run out, and Fungal Fellosh were lose.

But how can not run out, when sporegliders attack?

90621.title: Tiny Heroes' Journeys
90621.objectives: Help each member of the team overcome their challenges.
90621.description:
You taught them. Why did they run out?

All fungarians were excited to see if a {race} could teach fungarians for be strong.

You try one more time, okay?

First do what need to get them ready.
90621.completion: Done teaching, now? Let's see what Fungal Fellowship can do.

90622.title: Not-Yet Defeated Champions
90622.objectives: Enter the Grudge Pit and defeat the Glow Guard.
90622.description:
$p, the PHTeamname look stronger now! More ready. Hope they won't run again.

Next fight is against Glow Guard. Glow Guard always never lose.

Hope your training makes fight better, before TEAMNAME lose.

Will be fun for watch!
90622.progress: The Grudge Pit is always looking for new champions, {NAME}. Until now, we've just been finding the old ones again.
90622.completion:
Wow, shocked! Sporesworn beat Glow Guard!

I knew {NAME} strong. But did not know if training could be enough.

Not one fungarian was bet on Sporesworn. We did not think Glow Guard could be defeat. 

Now every fungarian know {NAME} is best teacher of strong!

90669.title: Gold is Gold
90669.objectives: Speak to Magister Aradis in his study near the Silvermoon Harbor.
90669.description:
Hey! You there.

<Sarvi beckons you closer and lowers her voice.>

You looking for work? A Magister gave me five gold to find an adventuring type to do some sort of job for him. He said if the person gets it done, I get five more. That'll feed me for months.

You fit the bill. If you want to try to get paid too, he has a study over by the harbor. Real fancy place--you can't miss it. The guy's name is Aradis.
90669.completion:
Ah, so the ruffian was successful.

You do certainly look capable. Let us speak, shall we?

90735.title: The Stolen Staff
90735.objectives: Speak to Aksem in the Den.
90735.description:
This time, I do not have a story for you. 

Instead, Aksem has asked that you meet with him to help recover the next of the relics. Go to speak with him, and he will tell you more of what you must do.
90735.completion:
Good. You return. 

Something important has been stolen, and I wish for you to retrieve and return it to Kassameh. Are you ready?

90736.title: That's Not Yours
90736.objectives: Retrieve 8 Stolen Belongings from the Blossoming Terrace.
90736.description:
The rutaani in the Blossoming Terrace are crafty. They've trained their petalwings to search and grab anything shiny that rolls down from the Den.

And, I suspect, sometimes they grab things that haven't naturally fallen.

So we want to get those things back. That's where you come in.

Go into the terrace, and don't hesitate to use force to send a message. That's a language we all understand.
90736.progress: Have you found those missing things?
90736.completion:
You found quite a few things. Including...

... Wait, that's mine. I thought I'd lost that.

<Seila mutters foul words about thieving birds.>

90737.title: Nested Clues
90737.objectives: Uncover clues about where the stolen rootstaff could be.
90737.description:
You're looking for a staff called the Root of the World. It's a powerful twist of woven roots, back from before the haranir traveled deep into the mountain.

It's irreplaceable, as Aksem knows. So if a rutaani petalwing stole it, that's embarrassing. The only way for everyone to save face is to get it back.

Search the nests of the bigger birds. They've been trained to look for more valuable items.
90737.progress: Have you found where the staff might be?
90737.completion:
You found nothing?

Shame.

Maybe you're not looking in the right place.

<Seila looks at you intently.>

90738.title: To the Blossoming Terrace
90738.objectives: Meet Shul'ka Seila outside the Blossoming Terrace.
90738.description:
When the haranir first arrived in Harandar, they brought with them a staff formed of the roots of a great tree. That tree has since gone away, but the roots remain.

It has been our duty to protect that staff and pass it on through the generations, but now it has been stolen.

Your task is to find it and return it to Zur'Ashar Kassameh.

Go into the mists below the Den and seek out the Shul'ka. They will guide you on your search.
90738.completion:
I greet you, student of the Cradle.

Aksem sent word that he'd toss someone down here to help find the missing staff. I don't often see others from the Den, other than the foolish ones who wander down.

You're not one of the foolish ones, are you?

90739.title: The Root of Things
90739.objectives: Follow Shul'ka Seila and recover the missing staff.
90739.description:
Looks like you didn't find any sign of the rootstaff among all the thiever's nests. That's a good thing, honestly.

But there's more to this test than just recovering stolen goods. Yes, it's a test. You're seeking secret knowledge. That means something here doesn't add up, and the real answer is waiting to be found.

So, come find me when you're ready to get that answer.
90739.completion:
Well done. Yes, I asked Seila to take the staff in order to test your dedication.

You've proven yourself. You have earned the right to learn more about it, and about our history.

90740.title: A Legend to Know
90740.description:
I am entrusted with many secrets, and the benefit of that is not having to explain myself often.

You have recovered the Root of the World, as I asked. Now, take it to Zur'ashar Kassemeh, and learn more about it.

There will be more for you, later.
90740.completion:
The Root of the World! I'm glad to see it returned to its rightful place.

Come, let's unlock its history and learn more about how the roots have shaped Harandar.

90742.title: Shrouded by Aln'hara
90742.objectives: Collect water and defeat creatures in the Rift of Aln.
90742.description:
As you know well by now, the creatures in the rift are infused with the essence of Aln'hara. What we need is that essence mixed with water.

Aksem wants us to collect water here and then infuse the essence of Aln'hara into it. I can only imagine what it might be used for.
90742.progress: The voice is as strong as ever here.
90742.completion:
It's done. But I swear... I can hear the goddess' voice mixed with pain, now. 

What are we about to learn?

90743.title: Ritual Reinforcement
90743.objectives: Place Ritual Offerings in the Rift of Aln.
90743.description:
You know the dangers of the Rift of Aln, but this is the best place to prepare for the kind of ritual Aksem wants to perform.

Go about the rift and place offerings to prepare yourself.
90743.completion:
You handle the power of Aln'hara well.

I'm beginning to think it was foolish to make you challenge me.

90744.title: The Dreamrift: Malformed Mystery
90744.description:
We have prepared ourselves as best we can for the next stage. Now, we must venture into the deepest part of the Rift of Aln.

Into the Dreamrift.

It's a place so dangerous that even the Shul'ka hesitate to go, but we must. Aksem needs us to collect the most powerful infusion of Aln there is.

Are you ready?
90744.completion:
You've survived the Rift of Aln on a number of occasions, but what walks the Dreamrift is a horror of its own category.

Now you have everything you need for the ritual. I might say that the hard part is done, but that would be a lie.

The hard part is knowing the truth of the Cradle of Aln'hara.

90745.title: The Empty Cradle
90745.objectives: Speak to Aksem in the Den.
90745.description:
You have ventured far, fought deep, and learned many things about our history to be here.

Now it's time to know the truth. Prepare yourself.
90745.completion:
Now you know.

The goddess' loss is felt most keenly here, and you understand why. It's a pain that is etched in the very land, in the water, and in the manifestations of Aln.

This is a truth that you and Orweyna will need to bear.

I only hope that one day we can bring Aln'hara our comfort, to soothe her agony and her grief. This is the vow I have sworn, as have many haranir.

We will bring our goddess home.

90749.title: Our Mutual Enemy
90749.description:
<Liadrin lowers her voice, speaking only to you.>

We have two choices. We can either continue to talk to the Amani or fight our way inside.

I would still prefer to negotiate passage with Zul'jarra, but if our diplomacy goes awry, be ready.

For now, follow my lead.
90749.completion:
I must say I am... surprised that Zul'jarra allowed us passage. It has been many years since I or anyone from Eversong has stepped foot on this side of the border.

Stay sharp. This is a volatile situation. We may have to do more to engender their trust.

But don't turn your back on the Amani.

90772.title: The Flames Rise Higher
90772.description:
De coal... it's white-hot now. And I feel like there is somethin' inside it?

Brek said dis was de last trial. But Jan'alai is not here.

What do we do now?

<Zul'jarra looks at Brek and scowls.>

Talk to Brek and see if he's got anything to say we can understand.
90772.progress: If I cannot commune with Jan'alai, de path of de hash'ey stops at dis temple.
90772.completion:
We did it, hash'ura.

Jan'alai is reborn! And we have her blessin'.

<Zul'jarra closes her eyes and briefly enjoys the feeling of the flame against her face.>

90782.title: The Nethersent
90782.objectives: Free the draenei and meet with him at the base of Masters' Perch.
90782.description:
<The draenei first tries to speak to you in his native tongue, adapting after you fail to respond.>

Men of Void take us to here. Come from sky. Fighting, killing. Want to go back. Help brothers and sisters.

Show you.
90782.completion:
<The woman seems wary of you, but nonetheless bows at your approach.>

Friend? Hope of us.

90818.title: Murder Row: Loose Lips
90818.objectives: Listen in on 3 conversations near the Royal Exchange.
90818.description:
It is not unexpected to sense some fel magic here. There are still warlocks in the city and old fel siphoning chambers. But the evidence I've found so far is more than could be explained by just that. It feels... different. Chaotic.

This practice has to be widespread, which means someone must be talking about it.

I've been rooting around too long to go unnoticed, but perhaps you could covertly listen in on some idle banter around the city. If you learn anything useful, report back to me.
90818.progress:
People let many things slip when they assume they're unheard.

Never assume you're unheard.
90818.completion:
<Belath's expression sours more than usual.>

Fear drives people to desperate measures, but fel magic isn't a weapon to be wielded lightly.

The power comes at a cost they do not understand--nor are they trained to withstand those dangers.

90819.title: Murder Row: Acting the Part
90819.objectives: Take the Cracked Wyrm Core, then investigate Murder Row to discover the source of the smuggled fel wyrms.
90819.description:
Based on what we discovered, I believe the fel is coming from Murder Row. Someone there is breaking down Legion relics and infusing the magic into mana wyrms for covert siphoning--and people are buying it up in droves.

We need to figure out who that someone is.

Take this wyrm core with you into the Row and look for more of them. The promise of coin should get you in front of the right person.
90819.progress: The denizens of Murder Row are tight-lipped, but any information we manage to uncover will be invaluable.
90819.completion:
They mentioned someone named Zaen?

He's a well-known thug in the Row. Smuggling fel through the Silvermoon Harbor sounds exactly like his style. He doesn't want anyone watching him.

Good work pocketing that shipping manifest.

90821.title: Murder Row: Harbored Secrets
90821.objectives: Talk to the dockmaster at the Silvermoon Harbor to collect Zaen's fel relic shipment.
90821.description:
That manifest is stamped by the Silvermoon Harbor. It looks like Zaen has his smugglers working there to push his fel relic shipments through inspections.

If we cut off their supply line at the harbor, we can halt the fel operation until we track down Zaen and end it for good. No sense going after the middlemen until then.

Subterfuge got us this far, so let's keep at it. Head to the harbor and tell them you're picking up Zaen's shipment. We'll work from there.
90821.progress:
Zaen is the mastermind here, or at least he seems to be. We'll need to deal with him to truly end this scheme.

Taking out their fel supply line at the harbor will stop the situation from getting any worse while we find him.
90821.completion:
The "Illicit Rain?" Zaen's base of operations, perhaps.

That receipt mentions Suramar. The fel relics must be getting pilfered from the Broken Isles, then routed into Silvermoon through a trade line no one would suspect.

Clever.

90824.title: My Brother's Alive!
90824.objectives: Find En'liahn at the Ahl'ua Wetland.
90824.description:
En'liahn saved me from the Rift of Aln. He's my older brother. I know it was stupid to go there, but it wasn't my fault!

We all thought En'liahn was dead, but I saw him earlier at the wetland. When he saw me, he ran away.

<Chua looks sad.>

No one here believes me and now I can't go. Will you help me find him again?
90824.completion:
Chua sent you? He's not out here again is he?

Mind lending me a hand?

90826.title: The Healing Waters of Ahl'ua
90826.description:
I'd hoped Chua hadn't seen me. Better he thinks I died. Instead, I'm self-exiling.

I was trapped in the Rift of Aln while saving him. Being in there for so long corrupted my connection to the goddess--if I don't sever it soon, it'll drive me mad, or worse.

The Shul'ka who saved me has agreed to mentor me through the process. He told me to come here and gather some things for a ritual to sever the connection.

I must collect the nearby healing waters. Will you help me fill this jug?
90826.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}.



I hope the water is as powerful as my mentor says it is. The strong poison of these creatures suggests I'm going to need it to survive the ritual.

90827.title: Only the Poisonous Parts
90827.description:
My Shul'ka mentor instructed me to collect the toxic glands from the creatures here. He said they were crucial to the Ritual of Severing in order to break my connection with the goddess.

<En'liahn shakes his head in pain.>

I'm not looking forward to whatever this ritual is, but her disjointed song in my head is getting stronger and making it hard to focus.
90827.progress: Be careful handling that poison. These creatures are some of the deadliest in all of Harandar.
90827.completion:
This should be more than enough.

I'll be careful with them. I wouldn't want to poison myself prematurely.

90829.title: Meeting My Mentor
90829.objectives: Rejoin En'liahn on the cliffside above the Rift of Aln.
90829.description:
I'm in your debt, {NAME}. I didn't think I'd get any help. My mentor only provides guidance. He says that is the way of the Shul'ka.

Thanks to you, I have everything I need for the ritual. Will you continue on with me? I'm heading for the cliffside overlooking the Rift of Aln to the northeast.
90829.completion:
I'm glad you came. Amarakk is my Shul'ka mentor. He says your help is not strictly forbidden.

I can use all I can get.

90830.title: The Path Will Reveal Itself
90830.objectives: Travel with En'liahn to discover the ritual site within the Rift of Aln.
90830.description:
The next step is to locate the ritual site. It's different for each potential Shul'ka.

Amarakk says that I must open myself to the power of the rift--that some part of myself tied to this place will guide the way.

All I can tell you is it hurts.

Are you still with me?
90830.completion: Now it is time to see if young En'liahn will survive the ritual or be consumed by the rift.

90831.title: Doing Is Becoming
90831.objectives: Disrupt the manifestations within the Rift of Aln.
90831.description:
If En'liahn is to succeed as a Shul'ka, he must learn to disrupt the manifestations in the rift. Sometimes that means closing small tears as they open. Most of the time, we simply slay the manifestations where we find them so they do not become so numerous as to threaten the rest of Harandar.

It is a never-ending responsibility each of us bears. It is why we are Shul'ka.

This, of course, assumes that he survives the ritual, or even survives to find the ritual site.
90831.completion:
You have done well for one who is not Shul'ka.

Unfortunately, the Rift of Aln never rests. I think you'll be back.

90832.title: As Her Voice Goes Silent
90832.objectives: Protect En'liahn while he endures the Ritual of Severing.
90832.description:
En'liahn is about to drink the mixture of the poison and healing waters to begin the ritual. He will be unconscious and fighting for his life.

The manifestations of the rift can sense this, and they are gathering.

{NAME}, you must place the wards and use their power to defend him while he severs his final connection to the goddess before her song drives him to madness.
90832.progress: Whatever happens next, you've proven you can be trusted.
90832.completion:
It is done. There is but one thing left to do once En'liahn has recovered.

But first, we should leave the rift immediately. This is no place to linger.

90833.title: The Final Rite
90833.objectives: Help En'liahn to slay the manifestation known as Morta'ka the Sundered Echo inside the Shadow Cleft.
90833.description:
Foolish. En'liahn is still weak from the ritual and not prepared.

He has run off to confront Morta'ka the Sundered Echo. This is the final rite of all who would become Shul'ka, but it is usually only attempted after years of preparation.

En'liahn will not survive, and in dying will only make Morta'ka more powerful. Will you save him, {NAME}?
90833.completion:
I know it was stupid and I should be dead. I feel confused about surviving the ritual but no longer being able to hear the goddess. I'm sorry, {NAME}. I shouldn't have done that.

At least it's over. Now to apologize to Amarakk. He's probably done with me.

90834.title: From This Point Forward
90834.objectives: Return to En'liahn and Amarakk on the cliff overlooking the Rift of Aln.
90834.description:
I don't know how to feel about losing my connection with Aln'hara. There's no more pain... I'm not going mad, but there's a hole inside. Does that make sense?

Will you rejoin us back up on the cliff?
90834.completion:
I owe you a great debt, {NAME}. At least now I can protect my people as I learn the ways of the Shul'ka.

My only regret is being separated from Chua.

90835.title: Murder Row: Rumors Abound
90835.objectives: Find Belath Dawnblade in the terraces above the Bazaar.
90835.description:
I would advise exploring the city with caution. Not all is what it seems in Silvermoon.

The Illidari are performing an investigation which need not be spoken of openly. But you appear formidable... Perhaps you can aid us.

My commander, Belath Dawnblade, is heading the investigation. The last I heard, he was surveying the upper terraces of the Bazaar.

Seek him out, if you would make use of yourself.
90835.completion:
Your arrival is timely.

I will be brief: I believe there is a widespread resurgence of fel magic use happening in Silvermoon, and it must be stopped.

90837.title: Murder Row: Traces of Fel
90837.objectives: Discover 5 sources of fel magic near the Royal Exchange.
90837.description:
I have been sensing powerful fel magic throughout Silvermoon, but this is the first origin point I could locate. The rest were too faint, or perhaps deliberately hidden. Fortunately, this means we now have a specific area to comb through more closely.

We need to gather more evidence. Go around this area and see if you can find more hidden sources of fel. I will grant you a temporary portion of my sight so that even the slightest hint of fel magic will be obvious to you.
90837.progress: Were you able to locate anything?
90837.completion:
Hm... Legion scraps, fel dust, and evidence that both might be getting moved around the city covertly. A sanctioned fel trade would not be resorting to such measures.

Then there are the mana wyrm cores we both found. Siphoned dry, but fel still clings to them.

90838.title: Oaths and Heirlooms
90838.objectives: Meet Kifaan outside of the Ethereum Overcroft.
90838.description:
You, stranger... do you know of the Shadowguard that left K'aresh in ruins?

My sister was lost in the conflict, her heart forcibly turned to the Void, but I swore oaths to my family... to cherish them no matter their transgressions.

My sister, Veraan, is surely lost, but if I were to recover her necklace, at least then my oaths would be upheld in spirit.

I am a simple tinkerer. I've tuned this device to track the Shadowguard, but I cannot face them alone.

Would you help me?
90838.completion: Keep yourself out of sight. I would rather not risk a bleak fate.

90844.title: Fits of Lucidity
90844.objectives: Slay ethereals in the Ethereum Overcroft and collect 8 Interrogated Data.
90844.description:
While I've been lurking, I've been listening.

These Shadowguard appear to have a minor rebellion on their hands. Some of the ethereals are acting erratically. They're being rounded up and questioned.

What's going on here?

Dispatch some of these Shadowguard and intercept their intel. I'll decode anything you bring back to me.
90844.progress:
I thought the Void coursing through these ethereals was all-consuming.

And yet, there seem to be some able to resist its infinite darkness.
90844.completion:
Something has sparked a rebellious fire in some of the Shadowguard.

Let us see what more we can find.

90845.title: Distant Memories
90845.objectives: Collect 8 K'areshi Keepsakes found at the Ethereum Overcroft.
90845.description:
I swore an oath to honor my family... difficult when my sister was converted to the Shadowguard. She may not be here, but tracking the Shadowguard has led me to this place. 

I'm looking for a necklace that belonged to my sister Veraan. It's odd... I've noticed many K'areshi heirlooms discarded around here. It seems the Shadowguard wish to destroy any reminders of our home world.

If you bring some of these trinkets and baubles to me, we can see if there are any I recognize.
90845.progress:
These keepsakes are some of the last remnants of our home world.

The memories they contain are powerful. The Shadowguard is right to fear them.
90845.completion:
I do recognize some of these items! They belonged to close friends and family.

If my sister's necklace is to be found, it will be here.

90847.title: Truth From Power
90847.objectives: Slay Questioner Xen'daan at the Ethereum Overcroft to discover the rebels' whereabouts.
90847.description:
Thanks to your intel, we have learned that the rebels are being interrogated by Questioner Xen'daan.

It is said that after being questioned, the rebel ethereals are being taken somewhere to be "dealt with."

The head questioner is sure to know more. If we can find where they've taken the rebels, there may still be hope for them.
90847.progress:
At the risk of getting my hopes up... do you think Veraan could be among them?

Could I face her now? After the atrocities she's committed in the name of the Void?
90847.completion: {NAME}! This necklace belongs to Veraan! Veraan IS Sombersong!

90848.title: She Started the Fire
90848.description:
Veraan is sure to be amongst the rebels taken to Shadowguard Point.

Her fiery spirit fills me with great pride!

I came here expecting to say a farewell of sorts. I did not come here expecting to find my sister.

Perhaps it's not too late, {NAME}!
90848.completion:
Veraan's essence may have been twisted by the Shadowguard, but the rebellion gives me hope.

Can the dissidents be snatched from the Void's grip entirely?

90851.title: Eating Their Own
90851.objectives: Slay 12 Shadowguard Engineers and Infusers at Shadowguard Point.
90851.description:
The Shadowguard seem to have no qualms caging and torturing their own kind.

The last thing I want is more violence amongst the people of K'aresh, but better them than us.

Disrupt their operation by subduing some of the Shadowguard.
90851.progress:
Degrees of evil is not a question I expected to be pondering.

Let us save who we can and agonize over merits later.
90851.completion: Violence is rarely an occasion for celebration, but I am glad we have at least slowed the deeds occurring here.

90852.title: Techno-Magnetic Pulse
90852.objectives: Throw Crackling Energy Vessels at arcane prisons to free the Caged Betrayers.
90852.description:
The betrayers are being held in stasis chambers.

I've seen these cages before. Their design is efficient but fragile. They will fail with the slightest energy variation.

Find crackling energy vessels strewn about and heave them at the stasis chambers. With true aim, you will disable them and free the betrayers.
90852.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. You helped me see my sister again. For that, I can never repay you.

Veraan is changed. Angry. Tormented by despair. Let us tread delicately.

90858.title: Repress the Oppressors
90858.objectives: Disrupt the operation by slaying ethereals, destroying Fragile Energy Piping, and detonating Volatile Energy Reservoirs.
90858.description:
We were brought here to face the wrath of Soulbinder D'zaar. She commands the Shadowguard here. She leverages the power of the Voidstorm to convert souls to energy that she consumes.

She and her loyalists are traitors to our kind!

<Veraan grimaces in pain as the Void courses through her.>

They must be stopped... their devices dismantled... their will ended...

{NAME}... destroy them all!
90858.progress:
<Veraan trembles with rage.>

These kinslayers were willing to sacrifice their own. And in service of what? Xal'atath's will?
90858.completion: I can feel Kifaan's hesitation every time our gaze meets. He is afraid of me...

90860.title: Shedding the Yoke
90860.objectives: Slay Soulbinder D'zaar at Shadowguard Point.
90860.description:
Rebels like us are brought to Soulbinder D'zaar. She suffers no betrayers.

Our fate was to be sacrificed--our souls converted to energy. D'zaar works the conduit with arcane mastery to absorb these souls!

We don't have much time. I can feel the Void pressing from within. If we are to leave this life violently, D'zaar and her conduit are coming with us!
90860.progress:
The pressure is building... it's almost time...

And besides, do I even deserve to live? What will they say of me, a member of the Shadowguard, when all is said and done?

Do you think Kifaan could ever forgive me?
90860.completion:
The Shadowguard got what they deserved.

But I am not blameless, {NAME}. Even now, shadows linger inside me.

For the safety of everyone, I should go.

90866.title: Universal Language
90866.objectives: Collect blood from the beasts north of the Night Trench.
90866.description:
To go home, water of life. Need.

<Tul'amar attempts to discern if you understand what she's talking about with a look. After a pause, she opts to stab her own fingertip with the end of her staff and then displays a bead of her blood to you.>

This. Of here. Is of fight. Of fight is Void. Void is power. With power, go home.

<She shows her fangs with an exaggerated snarl before pantomiming a claw swipe.>

Water of life. Of beast. Much. Yes?
90866.completion:
Blood! Is blood. Yes?

<She looks to one of her kin, who assures her that she's got the right word this time.>

Good. Now see.

90872.title: Drenched In It
90872.objectives: Mark 8 Offworld Refugees with Predator Blood to empower the portal in Exiles' Hovel.
90872.description:
<Tul'amar looks away from the blood-soaked and mortified Juras, and toward the portal as it flickers to life. She reads it with her powers of the arcane.>

Good. Blood is vio... violent? Violent is power. Need more. Now, brothers and sisters.

<She gestures to the blood in your possession, and then to her people. Many of them return wary looks your way.>

You can. I say. 

Then, go out. See of me.
90872.completion:
Good. Now, more. Brothers and sisters, help.

And men of Void, kill.

90873.title: These Violent Delights
90873.objectives: Use the Relic of Liberation to free 10 Master's Prospects and 3 Unwilling Summons.
90873.description:
Brothers and sisters. Here. Help.

<Tul'amar connects her thumb and index finger on both hands to make a chain. Then, she breaks the link with a sharp gesture.>

How? Show.

<She then produces a glimmering relic and holds it over her gauntlet. She spends a portion of her arcane energy into it. Its newly activated magic forces the straps holding her glove in place loose.>

Use.
90873.progress: <Tul'amar holds still, even as you approach.>
90873.completion:
<Tul'amar tilts her head at the freed draenei hiding behind her.>

I see. Good. You good.

90874.title: Their Violent Ends
90874.objectives: Collect 8 Abductor's Marks from the voidwalkers of Masters' Perch.
90874.description:
Go home. How?

<She offers a dramatic flourish with her fingertips, producing some arcane sparks. Then, she makes an X with her index fingers.>

Of me? No. Of they.

<Tul'amar gestures to a group of voidwalkers up ahead. She then draws her thumb across her neck.>

Kill. And.

<She reaches into a pouch on her hip and retrieves a cracked stone of domanaar make. It looks like a spell reagent of some kind.>

As this. Need.
90874.progress: <Tul'amar holds still, even as you approach.>
90874.completion:
<She counts out the portal runes in your possession and nods in approval.>

Yes. Good.

90875.title: Across Worlds
90875.objectives: Kill Snaerius and recover his Lodestar of the Great Dark.
90875.description:
Man of Void. Have key. Need. Key to home.

<Tul'amar gestures down the way to the northwest. She grimaces back at her injured kin.>

Go back, we. Wait. Hope. For you.
90875.completion:
Stay. I must. Men of Void, cannot find brothers and sisters. Finish, must. Only I.

You, good. Friend. But. Trust, can't. Trust, only when brothers and sisters safe.

<She then holds her staff forward, offering it to Juras. Though he seems reluctant to take it, Tul'amar does not waver.>

90907.title: The First to Know
90907.objectives: Inform Lord Antenorian, governor of Tranquillien, of your investigation results.
90907.description:
Notes speaking of fear, of uncertainty--of some mysterious truth? This is not good, $p. By all accounts, it sounds as if a cult has managed to infiltrate Tranquillien. 

If that journal entry was true, Kasiea was attempting to leave it. 

We must tell Antenorian. He'll want to secure the town and make sure his people are safe.
90907.progress: I hope our fair town is treating you well. If you have any concerns at all, bring them to me.
90907.completion: It is heartening that you trust me with these serious concerns.

90910.title: Overwhelming Darkness
90910.objectives: Sacrifice Kalgorg and then meet Lucia Nightbreaker in the Den of Predaxes.
90910.description:
A dreadful presence calls from the den just to the southeast of here. Many of the dazed ren'dorei you see in camp were overwhelmed by its raw power on a scouting mission.

Let us go together and see if whatever dwells within can be put to use. We cannot afford to spurn power in the fight against Xal'atath.

Before that: we have little need of Kalgorg. The Voidstorm has made my voidwalker unruly and disobedient. Assist me in sacrificing it. We will need all of the Void energy we can muster.
90910.completion:
Kalgorg descended here, but I won't confront it unprepared.

That disobedient little monster. It thinks it can simply walk away after two decades?

90914.title: A Born Killer
90914.objectives: Collect 15 Void Essence from monsters around Voidstorm.
90914.description:
Ah, {NAME}. I have so enjoyed our time together. I hunger for more. 

I wish you knew more of me than my predilection for the taste of mortal suffering. One of my greatest joys is in crafting Void power into various objects and structures. It is my passion--my art.

Here, I would like to show you. First, we will need power. You already know how to get it, of course: kill, kill, kill.
90914.progress: What an odd feeling. I feel almost... drawn to you. It must be your mesmerizing presence.
90914.completion:
My, what delightfully gruesome success. 

I am interested to work together with you. You should know more of our people, and see more of my abilities.

90915.title: Artifice of Aggression
90915.description:
While we domanaar are best known for leading armies and savoring battles, there is more to us. 

Many, like myself, enjoy using our mastery over the Void to shape it into the buildings and objects you see around you. 

How do you think Xal'atath learned to create that great tower of hers? She's a quick study. 

Come now, and I will show you my work.
90915.progress: How excellent to spend some time together. You mortals are so very interesting... you most of all.
90915.completion: Consider this blade my gift to you. We shall work together to make you into a true weapon of destruction.

90916.title: Seek to Destroy
90916.description:
It's no easy thing, intertwining Light and Void together. The result is unstable, so we must continue to temper it. 

We shall quench this blade in the blood of our enemies. 

Some domanaar attempt to reclaim and re-power Nexus-Point Xenas. That won't be good for your people. I'll assume you want to stop it. 

What is it you mortals say? Two birds, one stone?
90916.completion:
These Nexus-Points used to be fonts of power for us domanaar to enjoy, long before Xal'atath overthrew us. 

Someday, they shall be so again.

90917.title: Harvester of Savagery
90917.objectives: Use the Nascent Blade on corpses in Nexus-Point Xenas.
90917.description:
The blade hungers! The blood of our enemies will help stabilize and hone our nascent weapon. 

You'll need to drench the blade inside some corpses. So, you'll need to make corpses. 

<Decimus's smile grows broader.> 

You're good at that, right?
90917.progress: The monsters native to this land are fierce and violent. Their bloodlust drew the Void here, so naturally... we feel quite at home here.
90917.completion:
Very good. 

I understand you mortals fret over things like ecological balance and culling of species. 

Fear not: the monsters here are as endless as they are brutal.

90920.title: Warmth for the Soul
90920.objectives: Enjoy a pleasant conversation with Decimus.
90920.description:
Enjoying the view? 

The blade is stronger now, but it is not yet complete. A weapon worthy of you deserves nothing less than perfection. 

But let us relax for a moment. I understand you mortals enjoy a... casual exchange of conversation to get to know each other better.

I am familiar with the concept, but am curious to see it in action. Indulge me?
90920.completion:
Fascinating, how freely you give up delicate information about yourself.

I choose to believe you would not lie to me, of course. We are friends now, you and I. Such a mortal concept intrigues me.

90922.title: The Fallen Wake
90922.objectives: Dispel spirits in the Gnawing Reach.
90922.description:
<The shade flickers. You can barely make out its whisper.>

You... left me... to die...

<Its arm reaches toward you, then dissipates. Somehow, the presence is a familiar one. You feel that you know this spirit. 

You see more flickers in the distance. What are these shades?>
90922.progress: Such a strange and terrible place. Fear not--if you wish to converse more to settle your nerves... I am here for you.
90922.completion:
I'm terribly sorry you had to go through that. The words of these spirits have upset you, correct?

<Decimus peers at you.>

90923.title: Shepherd of Fear
90923.objectives: Slay monsters and gather Void Essence in the Gnawing Reach.
90923.description:
Our journey continues... one final battlefield. There are vicious beasts aplenty here. Their Void shall fuel the blade even more.

And the blade's newfound power shall draw their Void into itself by mere proximity!

Though, this place is different. You may find things you don't expect.

Keep an eye out.
90923.progress: Don't get distracted, now. This will all be worth it when you have a mighty weapon to hold.

90924.title: The Wicked End
90924.objectives: Complete the forging of the blade.
90924.description:
The time has come. The final step. 

<Decimus pauses, savoring something.>

Let us create the greatest weapon your kind has ever seen.
90924.completion:
The blade, as promised. See? I never meant to keep it for myself. I will even shape it into whichever form suits you best.

The taste of your suffering was all I desired.

90963.title: Caves of the Cleft
90963.objectives: Meet Ney'leia near the northeastern cave in Fungal Cleft.
90963.description:
Good work freeing the captured rutaani. With the seeds you recovered, I can try to carry on Ru'gar's work.

I did some scouting and gathering while you were keeping the fungarians distracted, and could use your help with another task. Meet me at the cave northeast of here.
90963.completion: This seems to be a safe location from which to plan our next moves, and one of the plants Ru'gar mentioned to me grows in this area as well.

91001.title: Clear de Way
91001.objectives: Regroup with Zul'jarra, Zul'jan, and Lady Liadrin at the foot of Conquerer's Sanctum in Broken Throne.
91001.description:
With dey magic and dey line broken, de Twilight's Blade is losin' ground.

We must take advantage of dey turned backs.

I will lead de charge through de ravine to de Conquerer's Sanctum beyond. Mor'duun is there, keepin' his coward-body safe from our spears and axes.

He won't be safe much longer.
91001.completion:
Mor'duun may laugh now, holed up in de Sanctum.

But we will get de last laugh.

91062.title: Broken Bridges
91062.objectives: Seek out Zul'jan upon the Skybridge.
91062.description:
I make one last request of you before you return with Liadrin to Silvermoon, hash'ura.

Find Zul'jan. None have seen him since returnin' to Amani'Zar.

On de way back here, I confronted him about takin' our soldiers to Broken Throne against my orders.

People died dat shouldn't have. I asked him what he don't understand about dat.

He didn't argue. He was blank. His body was there, but his mind?

Sometimes he seeks peace in de sound of ocean waves.

You might find him on de Skybridge.
91062.completion:
Glad I found you. Zul'jarra let me know you would be searching this area for Zul'jan, but this land is still so unfamiliar to me.

If you have found him and are finished enjoying the party, we should return to Silvermoon.

91063.title: The Blooming Lattice
91063.description:
