You're that stranger I've been hearing about, aren't you? I'm Su'meera, apprentice painter to Ja'kul. You heard of him? No? Maybe his work hasn't made it to your lands. That makes sense, I guess.

Anyhow, I heard you like helping people out. Well, a few important things went missing when Ja'kul was attacked and killed. I want them back.

Will you meet me near Blooming Lattice?
91063.completion:
Thanks for coming. I wasn't sure you would. Up the hill that way is Blooming Lattice--a settlement of rutaani who are quite vicious.

Their leaders killed Ja'kul, and took his things. I want them back!

91065.title: Purloining Petals
91065.objectives: Recover stolen objects from Blooming Terrace.
91065.description:
A couple of days ago, a group of rutaani attacked and killed my mentor, Ja'kul. When they did, their stupid birds stole a few things from him. Those petals-for-brains will make off with anything shiny that isn't thorned down.

Will you recover Ja'kul's things for me? I'm a painter, not a fighter. I wouldn't last very long in there on my own.
91065.progress:
Those birds would steal your head if it wasn't attached to your shoulders. Especially if you were wearing a shiny hat or helm. Right off your shoulders!

<She pauses for a moment as if picturing this, then turns slightly green and shudders.>
91065.completion:
You did it! I knew they had these, those rotten weed-for-brains scavengers!

I know it's silly to be upset about things like a favorite spoon, but they took Ja'kul's life. I won't let them take anything else from him.

You're the best, {NAME}.

91069.title: Vengeance for Tolbani
91069.description:
Me and Tolbani had loaded de skiff with medicine, steel, and food to bring upriver to de forward camp.

It was meant to be a quiet run: no trouble, and no eyes on us.

But in de shallows, de murlocs came swarmin' out of de reeds all foam and teeth. Dey hit us hard--too fast to fight back proper. We tipped and lost de cargo. I barely made it to shore.

Tolbani didn't. I dragged his dart-riddled body here.

De murlocs must pay for what dey have done.
91069.progress: Bleed de mindless beasts. Make dem suffer for killin' Tolbani.
91069.completion:
Do you hear dat?

It's quiet.

Dat is de sound of vengeance.

91070.title: Reclaim the Goods
91070.objectives: Find 6 stolen Food Provisions in Atal'Abasi.
91070.description:
While I was limping back from de river, I spotted a few of de murlocs dragging our food bags through de mud. They weren't working together either--kept snapping at each other, trying to snatch de best pieces for themselves.

I saw one of them stash a whole satchel behind a fallen tree. Another buried something under a pile of rocks. Greedy little monsters think they can steal from us and get away with it.

91071.title: The Menace of Atal'Abasi
91071.objectives: Find and slay Mrruk the Musclefin in Atal'Abasi.
91071.description:
Our boat didn't ground on its own.

We were fightin' de murlocs, and then suddenly we were in de air.

Dats when I saw him--one dat wasn't like de rest. Bigger. Stronger. When he attacked, de other murlocs scattered.

He picked up our boat like it weighed nothin' and hurled it on de rocks. I've never seen a murloc do somethin' like that.

We're gonna keep losin' people and supplies if dat muscle-bound murloc is watchin' de river.
91071.progress: De river's dangerous. We must reclaim it.
91071.completion: I saw de small ones run away in terror. Well done, {class}.

91084.title: Looming Shadows
91084.objectives: Return to Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon City.
91084.description:
Though we've triumphed over Ruia and the Lightbloom for now, more remains to be done. The elders will want to convene regarding the Hara'ti's new place in the world, now that we have stepped out from the shadows of our past.

Our reticence and fear will not vanish overnight. But this is an important first step.

We will be fine, {NAME}. Let Orweyna and I deal with the elders. When the time comes, the Hara'ti shall be at your side. For now, though, I'd imagine you have more pressing matters to attend to.
91084.completion:
When Halduron burst into a war council shouting about hidden worlds and ancient warriors, I thought he had gone mad. But now that I've seen the haranir with my own eyes...

We are lucky to have them as potential allies. And lucky to have you, I'd say, in brokering that relationship.

There is more for us to do. But I've no doubt that the Hara'ti will prove vital allies to Silvermoon in the days to come.

91085.title: Petal Bristles
91085.description:
Ja'kul was out hunting petalwings when the rutaani came upon him and killed him. We use their feathers for some of our paintbrushes. They are especially useful in helping the young sprouts learn how to be more precise and delicate. 

While you're up there, will you bring me back some of their plumes?
91085.progress: Have you gathered the petalwing plumes I asked for? They're essential for the lessons of the younger haranir.
91085.completion:
Thank you for bringing me these feathers! I will use one of them to paint a special memorial for Ja'kul. The rest will go to the children. 

I suppose it will fall to me now to teach them.

91086.title: Nipping the Buds
91086.objectives: Kill rutaani and the Prime Bloomwarden in Blooming Lattice.
91086.description:
The rutaani of Blooming Lattice were behind the attack on Ja'kul. They're led by a Prime Bloomwarden who's even more vicious. I hate them and they're all terrible!

How about you go prune the overgrowth and make the rest of us safer?
91086.completion: Is it done? Thanks. It won't bring Ja'kul back, but now they won't be hurting anyone else.

91087.title: Reports Returned
91087.objectives: Report to Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.
91087.description:
I will go to Silvermoon but... I will return here to advise Zul'jarra.

I feel I let my past and my prejudices get in the way of my judgement regarding the Amani. You could say that being a hash'ura is a befitting atonement but... I feel drawn to stay, perhaps to help Zul'jarra in guiding her people back to the loa.

I will go to Silvermoon with you to bear the report--and Lor'themar's reaction.

If we go now, we may return to... party.

<A small smile cracks Liadrin's usually stoic face.>
91087.completion:
<Lor'themar raises an eyebrow and frowns slightly. You can tell he is fighting back exasperation and anger.>

This is a... very unexpected turn of events. Yet still more will unfold in front of us, I'm sure.

91088.title: Behind the Falls
91088.objectives: Meet Su'meera in the cave behind the waterfall in Blooming Lattice.
91088.description:
The scroll you brought back was left behind for me by my mentor, Ja'kul. I didn't even have a chance to read it before it was stolen away! 

Ja'kul left directions in the scroll to a cave that's behind a waterfall in Blooming Lattice. I'm not sure what we'll find there, but I would really appreciate if you came along while I check it out. Will you meet me there?
91088.completion: This is incredible! I can't believe there's a whole cave back here. And Ja'kul left behind a vision stone for me.

91136.title: Memories in Stone
91136.objectives: Defend Su'meera while she vision walks.
91136.description:
Ja'kul was killed before he could finish my training, but I would recognize his work anywhere! He must have painted this vision stone for me!

The rutaani will catch on pretty soon that we're up here, and I won't be able to defend myself. Will you keep watch while I journey into the memory he left me?
91136.completion:
Thank you so much, {NAME}. You gave me a way to say goodbye to my mentor. Now that I have seen what he wanted me to, I can continue my training.

It means so much that Ja'kul left this here for me. I miss him, but I will honor his memory.

91145.title: The Conquered Heroes
91145.description:
A domanaar was harrying our back lines. It was... different than the other void beasts--like it was playing rather than fighting. My partner, Callum, led a squad to hunt it down. They never came back.

Callum's an Arathi through and through. He wouldn't fall here--I know it.

Commander Lightblood refused to send a search party. He said there's a difference between personal and important. Well, the Vanguard can have their war, but I'm going after Cal. I know the route he took, but I can't search alone.
91145.completion:
Imperia's beasts swarmed me. I lost track of them.

I shouldn't have left you behind, but seeing that monster control Callum... I'm not losing him. Not while I still breathe.

91146.title: Flickering Light
91146.description:
I feel traces of Light here--dim, scattered across the plain, but unmistakable. It's Callum. I know his Light like I know my own.

That domanaar is a monster: using others like toys, smashing them together until they break. We'll find them, $p, and then I will turn that void beast to ash.

<Anais grips her spear.>

One thing at a time. Find the Light, and we find Callum.
91146.completion:
She's hurting him, throwing him into fight after fight. We don't have time to search this whole blasted plain.

I can't concentrate. The Void magic here is too chaotic and volatile.

90918.title: The Unforgiven
90918.objectives: Slay Noxian, Averus, and Tenebre around Nexus-Point Xenas.
90918.description:
Since even before our little misadventure, Nexus-Point Xenas has always been the weakest link. The beasts here are stubborn and powerful, always pushing deeper and deeper in. 

Some domanaar seek to reclaim the Nexus-Point. They are known to me: weaklings, fighting for scraps. Let's ensure they fail.
90918.progress:
Noxian, Averus, and Tenebre... all lackeys of Xal'atath, just like the majority of my kin. I wonder how long each would wait before attempting their betrayal of her.

Shame we'll never get to see their attempts.
90918.completion:
Ah, how quaint, to catch up with old enemies. 

We domanaar once had intricate structures of power. Each domanaar fights for their own sake alone, but it is often advantageous to align oneself with others. Temporarily, of course. 

The most powerful among us were the High Lords. When Xal'atath arrived... she made an example of them all. The spectacle was so moving, it drew not only fear but something closer to loyalty from us domanaar. 

Some, though not all.

90919.title: The Fiend That Failed
90919.description:
The blade squirms. It is ready for its next transformation.

There is only the leader, Vortensiun, left. 

He is known to me. Once, we formed a pact together to defeat a rival. When the time came for him to betray me, he did so clumsily. 

I let him live, so I could savor the taste of his regret. 

I wonder how well that pain has marinated by now? Let's find out. When the blade is tempered in his essence, it shall grow new power.
90919.completion:
Pay no mind to Vortensiun's comment about food. 

We are becoming good friends, are we not?

91147.title: Cut Her Strings
91147.objectives: Subdue creatures while Anais removes their Shadowgrafts.
91147.description:
Revik, Riandron, Danna... that domanaar made them kill each other. The creatures here are bound with the same shadowgrafts: the same twisted magic.

If this is how Imperia controls her victims, we have to find a way to remove it.

Restrain the beasts and I'll attempt to break their bonds. If it's forged by the Void, the Light must be able to overcome it.
91147.completion: Removing the Shadowgrafts kills them... What good is the Light if it can't save one man?

91148.title: Strung Along
91148.objectives: Help Knight Anais find and subdue Callum Ashvow.
91148.description:
When the Light called, it called both of us. Why? So Callum could die on some void-scarred rock?

I can't think here. All I can picture is Callum bleeding out. Come, we'll return to camp. With his belongings, I should be able to find him. 

Then... I don't know. If we can't break the shadowgrafts, we'll subdue him and drag him back to Silvermoon if we must. I'm not losing him.
91148.completion:
I had him. One spear thrust and I could have ended it... but he's still Cal--even with that monster controlling him.

<Anais clutches at ragged cut in her side. Blood and foul Void magic flow from the wound in equal measure.>

Look what chasing after him again got me.

91149.title: Bury Me Not
91149.objectives: Take Callum's Tinder Box and defeat Imperia.
91149.description:
I knew we'd never grow old together, but I thought we'd have more time.

<Anais coughs, blood pooling beneath her. Flecks of the Void shimmer in the spreading crimson.>

Don't worry. I'm not afraid. I promised myself I wouldn't go home without him... wouldn't spend a night in an empty bed. I'm just keeping that promise.

Don't let her have him. Take his tinder box. You'll know what to do.
91149.progress:
My parents always said falling in love with a human would end in heartbreak.

<She doesn't lift her head.>

There's never enough time, is there?
91149.completion:
I felt it. When you--when he--thank you. Sorry. Getting hard to think.

<She accepts the tinder box and holds it to her chest. Her eyes seem to focus on something you can't see.>

Cal...? I'm so tired. Let's go home.

<Anais slumps over, her hand falling away from the wound at her side. She is at peace.>

91197.title: Collecting Remains
91197.progress: The domanaar need void-tainted remains to fuel their war effort. Scavenge the area or slay fellow adventurers across Slayer's Rise to obtain this resource.

91206.title: Loa Disturbance
91206.objectives: Find Loa Speaker Sij'ta at the Shrine of Kulzi.
91206.description:
Now dat we are tryin' to contact all de loa, my mind turns to Kulzi, de loa of medicine--and the madness that surrounds his shrine.

His loa speaker, Sij'ta, was a good friend. He healed many war parties of their injuries. But somethin' happened at Kulzi's shrine, and it is full of angry spirits.

Dey attack anybody dat tries to get through to dem, and de loa is silent.

Perhaps you can finally reach out to de loa and find his speaker!
91206.completion:
What do you mean, you don't have de medicine? I sent you for it ages ago!

We must help him... even if de loa won't!

91270.title: The Most Important Thing
91270.objectives: Speak to each of your teammates to choose a name.
91270.description:
We will be strong for the Pit!

But Boletus right. Another thing needed. Must have great name.

Best teams all have good name. Fungus Force. Spore Storm. Cap Clash. And champions, Glow Guard!

All good names.

We need amazing name. Best name. So will be best team.

You help choose?
91270.completion:
Fungal Fell...owship, ok. Now we ready.

Will run into pit together, shout the Fungal Fello...sip, eh...

Crowd will cheer, then will be new champions!

91274.title: Severing the Void
91274.objectives: Activate 5 Quel'Danas Sentinels to destroy the Void Pylons.
91274.description:
The High Exarch has formed an impressive defensive line. It will hold the Devouring Host's current numbers. But I can see void pylons behind the lines. Those will call forth more Devouring Host and overwhelm the Vanguard of Light.

Their power is too dangerous for us to destroy directly, but if we can re-activate the sentinels that fell in the initial assault, they could destroy the pylons for us.
91274.progress: We need to activate all the sentinels if we want to destroy the void pylons.
91274.completion: With those void pylons destroyed, the Devouring Host has weakened. We may have a chance of winning this.

91339.title: Smothered in the Crib
91339.objectives: Drain 9 juvenile wildlife with the Reliquary of Darkness.
91339.description:
I summoned my first imp in a dirty, haze-filled lounge beneath Murder Row after a dozen failed attempts. Each time, I reached further for what made so-called greater powers submit to mortals. I finally managed it after wetting my hands with the hot blood of a young rabbit. Bloodthistle never satisfied me again.

I have matured my technique since then. Seek the whelps of these beasts. Siphon their energy into my reliquary of darkness. From their sacrifice, we will draw the power to defeat Kalgorg.
91339.progress: Don't fear power, {NAME}: fear those who wield it.
91339.completion: This too is the natural order of things.

91340.title: For Violence's Sake
91340.objectives: Kill wildlife on the surface of the Den of Predaxas.
91340.description:
Like many warlocks, I bind my demons with terms of a contract. I should have realized the Void and violence of this world could affect the rules I took for granted. Kalgorg used that power to break its bindings and end our arrangement. 

When we confront Kalgorg, the scent of blood and violence must be upon us. Slay the beasts you find to demonstrate to Kalgorg we are willing to do the same to it. Control over the Void is found and lost within the blink of an eye.
91340.completion:
<Lucia looks you over and then rewards you with a cruel smile.>

Splendid. You are as capable as you look.

91341.title: Unlimited
91341.objectives: Gather Void Power within the Lair of Predaxas.
91341.description:
Now, we descend. The Void energy below is unlike any I've felt before, as if gravity itself yields to the Void. Once you enter the cave, its influence will be upon you.

Kalgorg has already slain and claimed power from the creatures within. Their violent deaths have left behind some kind of cursed terrain, but we must proceed and claim the power within. Fill the reliquary to the brim. 

I know not what to expect from my voidwalker. We will need all the power we can manage.
91341.progress: The trail of carnage it left behind... I'm almost proud.
91341.completion: Kalgorg waits before us. Now we spend the power you've been collecting reclaim it.

91342.title: If You Want It Done Right
91342.description:
With all the problems facing Eversong, the Farstriders have their hands full!

I'm a capable arcanist. I've always admired the Farstriders--why not lend my talents to their cause? They do so much work by hand, when a bit of magic would allow them so much more time for adventuring!

Alas, my enchanted broom idea has not quite gone as I'd hoped. They're so ornery, they end up attacking the recruits instead of cleaning!

Perhaps this is a problem for elbow grease after all.
91342.progress: Captain Dawnrunner warned me about trying to solve all my problems with magic... Clearly I have much yet to learn.
91342.completion: The sweeping will still need to get done, but at least now no one will be attacked.

91343.title: Ambition's Reward
91343.description:
You have filled the reliquary with power I can draw on. Now, we reap the reward of our preparations.

Kalgorg waits just ahead, draining the beast that once made this cave its lair. Weaken Kalgorg, and I will bind it as I first did years ago.
91343.completion:
Kalgorg consumed much of the Void energy within that cave, which means its influence is less likely to overwhelm my kin. I suppose some good was done.

I must pay Kalgorg the slightest compliment. Were I a subdued void beast, I'd also try to escape. For that, it has my respect.

<Lucia turns to Kalgorg with a sharp smile.>

91345.title: To the North Tower
91345.objectives: Meet Ranger Valsarin at the North Tower.
91345.description:
Ranger Valsarin is a chef at Farstrider Hold. He's decent in a kitchen, but his passion is field cooking.

There was a time when you could wander any path in Eversong and find the ingredients for a good meal. A Farstrider's dream! With enough hard work, we can help the forest recover, and it starts with rehabilitating the soil.

Meet Valsarin at the North Tower and he can tell you more.
91345.completion: Hope you like getting your hands dirty.

91346.title: Supplicants to the Goddess
91346.objectives: Cleanse yourself in the Waters of Har'kuai.
91346.description:
We have long tended to the roots with the help of the creatures who live and grow here. Think of it as a symbiotic relationship from which we, the creatures, and the roots all benefit. That said, my partner Riverscale isn't contributing very much lately!

Please help me find a way to motivate him again.

First, you must cleanse off the essence of the outside. Cleanse yourself in the waters of Har'kuai.
91346.completion: This may seem inconsequential, but it's all a part of the process.

91347.title: Strider Stampede
91347.objectives: Mount up the Saddled Hawkstrider and prepare the Tranquil Repose for gardening.
91347.description:
It's hard to believe this used to be the Dead Scar.

Up here, close to the city, the land has almost completely recovered. Which is good, because we've got a lot of mouths to feed.

Hawkstriders are the perfect helpers for preparing the soil. Their tough claws can easily spread seeds and squash bugs!

Meet me down in the Tranquil Repose and I'll saddle one up for you.
91347.completion: I don't know what to make of those big blooms... but whatever we're doing, the land seems pleased.

91348.title: See a Mana 'bout a Wyrm
91348.objectives: Aggressively assist 8 Agitated Wyrms with their molting.
91348.description:
Mana wyrms may not be as glamorous as lynxes or hawkstriders, but they're crucial to keeping magic flowing through the forest.

They congregate on the ley lines to molt, but sometimes they get a little agitated. And we have to help them out! Aggressively!

I've set up some ley channels to get things started. Find wyrms that look like they could use a little help, and beat them up until they shed their arcane carapace. Don't worry--all that mana returns to the forest eventually!
91348.progress: Don't worry! They bounce right back.
91348.completion: Another successful molt... We'll be out here in a few weeks to do it all again!

91349.title: The Dark Part of the Woods
91349.objectives: Test 8 creatures for corruption, and deal with the consequences.
91349.description:
Much of the forest has recovered, but to the south... Everything that Eversong has faced--the Scourge, the fel, and now the Twilight's Blade--all that magic leaches into the soil. It builds up in the creatures until they're completely overwhelmed...

My instruments can detect corruption in these animals. We can cull the ones that are too far gone and save the ones that aren't. It isn't fun... but it's for the good of Eversong!
91349.progress: It's hard work, but it will bring peace eventually.
91349.completion:
These poor cubs... They survived only by the grace of that strange magic!

I know better than to believe in the old tales... but what else could it be?

91350.title: A Real Assignment
91350.objectives: Find Captain Dawnrunner at Farstrider Enclave.
91350.description:
Captain Dawnrunner was supposed to check on the Enclave and then meet us here. She's as capable a ranger as any! It's a bad sign if she's been detained.

Farstrider Enclave is usually where they do wilderness training. With all the trouble however, everyone's been dispatched elsewhere. She could be up there alone, in serious danger!

There's no time to lose. I'm going to save my Captain and prove myself as a Farstrider!
91350.completion:
This is what happens when there's no one around to sweep up!

Everyone wants to adventure, but no one wants to sweep.

91359.title: Fungal Lashers B Gone
91359.objectives: Collect 6 Harmonious Fronds in the outskirts of Har'kuai.
91359.description:
We are blessed to live in Harandar, but this is also our responsibility. The roots of the World Trees wind through these lands. We tend them, and they thrive. That is why it is so important for Riverscale to be back on duty.

We need to keep these grounds clear of these fungal lashers before they leach off the roots. As a plus, Riverscale really loves lasher fronds. Can you find and bring some back for him?
91359.progress:
It's important that we keep the lashers from sapping important nutrients from the World Tree.

...and I like spoiling my obstinate little boy.
91359.completion:
I wish that I didn't have the laziest helper in the history of helpers, but such is life!

If his favorite treats won't get him up, nothing will.

91360.title: Weeding Out the Unwanted
91360.objectives: Pull 8 Allergenic Weeds in the outskirts of Har'kuai.
91360.description:
The roots of the World Trees are infused with both nutrients and the magic of Harandar. As the large vessels that they are, they will draw to them unwanted fauna and flora. Some of them are harmless, but we want to keep the roots clear.

Haranir can often be allergic to the green weeds that flourish beside the roots of the World Trees. If you rip them out by the root, you would be saving us a lot of time--and hives!

91361.title: Back on Duty?
91361.objectives: Help Riverscale gain his confidence by killing 8 Potatoads and Petalwings by the outskirts of Har'kuai.
91361.description:
Finally! I knew the little guy could do it.

No, that is a bald-faced lie. If this grovecrawler could somehow find a way back into his cocoon, he would already be there.

<Cyenna sighs.>

His second favorite treat is the potatoad. If that doesn't work, his third favorite treat is the petalwing. That should get him back onto his mite-hunting duties.

...I have the backbone of a wet frond.
91361.completion:
I knew you could do it, Riverscale! Who's a good grovecrawler? Who's the best crawler of them all?

Who's a big strong grovecrawler who knows how to teach strangers how to care for World Trees?

<Cyenna looks up at you.>

You knocked him out of his laziness, {NAME}. I can't thank you enough for your help.

91363.title: Harvest of Darkness
91363.objectives: Collect 10 Void-Infused Morsels and 6 Glaring Glowcaps outside of the Howling Ridge.
91363.description:
You... make yourself useful.

As a master of terrible beasts, it is my job to mold these hatchlings into dreaded beasts. I pit them against each other and they grow ever more violent.

But the elves here insist that I will yield better results with just a bit of... tender loving care. Let us put this to the test.

This runt is Fidoficus. You will show him tenderness and affection, and then we will see how ferocious he becomes.

Collect some delicious dietary treats for him and return to me.
91363.progress: These ingredients will make for a highly nutritious and equally delectable meal.
91363.completion:
Fidoficus will be renowned for his ferocity.

I can see the violence growing in him.

One day, he will be a worthy pet for a domanaar such as myself.

91376.title: Little Monsters
91376.objectives: Collect 10 samples of Strange Mycelium from the former denizens of Fungara Village.
91376.description:
When I sent a request for aid from Har'alnor, I did not expect them to send me an outsider. No matter.

The denizens of Fungara Village have gone quiet. Normally, I would be thrilled: they're horribly screechy. But the way they are shambling about... it is like they have forgotten that they yet live.

<Ghikal shudders.>

I tried to get close, but they attacked me on sight.

I will need samples of their flesh. Go and bring them to me, so I can see what has happened here.
91376.progress: I do not know what is going on, but to err on the side of caution... do not let them bite you, hrm? Whatever plagues them may be infectious.
91376.completion:
Goddess forfend. This is not fungarian flesh at all.

What ARE they?

91377.title: Spawn of the Dead
91377.objectives: Investigate 5 Blooming Corpses in Fungara Village.
91377.description:
It is obvious that something terrible has happened in the village. I can see the corpses of their largest specimens strewn across the southern reaches from here, but something is off about them too. Fungarians don't usually just leave the corpses of their kin lying about.

And though I am watching from afar, I swear that some of them are... twitching.

Investigate. Find out what you can, and report back to me.
91377.completion:
This is so much worse than I thought.

We have to find the source of this and destroy it before it infects something bigger and more dangerous than a fungarian.

91378.title: You Are Legend
91378.objectives: Kill 15 Decanimated fungarians in the northern reaches of Fungara Village.
91378.description:
Whatever these things are, they're not fungarians. Not anymore. 

Har'alnor has enough to worry about with the Lightbloom as it is. It cannot afford to be trapped between its forces and these... things.

Do what must be done. Destroy as many of them as you can.
91378.progress: Do not feel regret. These things are not alive anymore. Not in any way that matters.
91378.completion: You are quite the accomplished slayer of aberrations. Perhaps you should consider a vocation in monster-hunting.

91379.title: Decayed Land
91379.objectives: Destroy 8 growths of Fruiting Mycelium in Fungara Village.
91379.description:
As far as I can tell, these fungarians are all already dead. Something is animating their corpses from within, like puppets attached to unseen vines.

This fungal matter that's infesting them must be coming from somewhere... and judging from the size of the ones further north, we'll find plenty of it there. Find it, get rid of it, but for Aln'hara's sake don't breathe it in.
91379.completion:
We've culled the worst of the growths to the north... but there are smaller ones already beginning to sprout. Where are they coming from?

There must be a source, and we'll have to find it if we mean to solve this thing.

91380.title: Belly of the Beast
91380.objectives: Feed and walk Fidoficus around the Howling Ridge to promote its growth and savagery.
91380.description:
I normally raise my beasts on a diet of raw, bloody carcasses and souls ripped asunder by the Void.

But we shall try your mortal ways.

I hear you... cook? And that makes the treat better?

Do this. Then, take him on a walk around the Howling Ridge. Even I know exercise is good for digestion.

Only the most ferocious of creatures is worthy of serving me. I hope neither you nor Fido disappoint me.
91380.progress: He is still small, but one day, he will grow to be a terrible foe.
91380.completion:
Is the beast's savagery growing?

I'm sure I will begin to hear of his violence from those around the Howling Ridge.

91381.title: Reticent Evil
91381.description:
I do not understand. We've searched high and low, north and south. Everywhere we go, we find animated corpses and small fruiting fungus, but where is the central body? Where is--

Oh, goddess. Of course.

The water, {class}. Check the water.
91381.completion:
It is done, then.

You did well to survive untainted. The wilds are a dangerous place, and survival is never a guarantee.

Now go. I must remain and ensure that these abominations cannot spread any further.

91382.title: Mighty and Superior
91382.objectives: Bear witness to Fidoficus's savagery as it slays Den-Gorger Zitoc.
91382.description:
The beast is fed and exercised. Imagine, mortal... one day his maw will grow to fit you inside it a thousand times over. 

Now, we will test his potential for true violence. 

There is a beast that has laid claim to a den south of the Howling Ridge. 

Fidoficus trusts you now. Go with him and bear witness to his might.
91382.progress: Fidoficus has grown fearsome, and perhaps you have claim to some of his growth.
91382.completion:
Fidoficus will grow so terribly large, that it is he who will be walking you. 

Only then will he be worthy of joining me as my attack behemoth.

91383.title: Tidy Up
91383.objectives: Clear out 5 Messy Nests and sweep up 5 Dusty Webs.
91383.description:
Captain Dawnrunner is fine, thank the sun. The only danger was... we didn't keep up on our chores.

It's not heroic, it's not romantic, but we can't go on with Farstrider Enclave in this state. The rangers here are overwhelmed. We can all pitch in to help them get it cleaned up again.

I can't believe it all comes back to sweeping. That's what being a Farstrider is really about.
91383.completion: My rangers are earning their keep today, that's for certain.

91384.title: Recovery Mission
91384.objectives: Retrieve 12 Scattered Supplies from around Farstrider Enclave.
91384.description:
We've been deploying Farstriders across the forest to fight the Amani, the Lightbloom, the Void... but for all our heroics, there's no one left to tend to the wildlife! Or maintain the building! Or keep track of supplies!

And now our beloved Enclave looks like a hawkstrider pen. I've had enough!

I may not be able to help, but I trust you all can gather anything that was taken and get this place looking respectable again.
91384.progress: If we want to be of any use to the rest of Eversong, first we must pick up after ourselves.
91384.completion: This is a good start. All it takes is a handful of us putting in a little effort.

91385.title: A Ranger's Spirit
91385.description:
Taemin has proved himself as capable as any Farstrider today. But I'm afraid he might not see it that way.

He came to us with such lofty ideas about the rangers--all those swashbuckling adventure stories, all the romantic old legends. But at the end of the day, being a ranger is mostly... chores. Difficult, boring, important chores.

Why don't you go talk to him, and make sure he's not too disappointed?
91385.progress: The beauty of the forest? It never gets old.
91385.completion: The legends are real... Eversong must be pleased with us!

91386.title: Mad to Measure
91386.objectives: Assist Solwin Brightstitch with making clothes for Pushy Paladins.
91386.description:
These... tourists! These uncultured, ungrateful slobs!

This Vanguard of Light has brought a lot of business to Silvermoon, to be certain. But none of them actually appreciate what Thalassian craftsmanship means. They have no respect for the elven arts--they just want shiny, glittery souvenirs!

I am no spring runner dancing for their amusement... but I can hardly turn them away, can I? Perhaps an assistant would make this atrocious task easier.
91386.progress: If only a single soul among these brutes showed any appreciation... alas, it seems even this small ask is too great.
91386.completion:
All right... but only because I'm curious about the craftsmanship.

It'll take more than a little politeness to change my mind about these pernicious paladins.

91388.title: Uncommon Threads
91388.objectives: Siphon 8 Full Bobbins of Manasilk from weakened wyrms in the North Sanctum.
91388.description:
Our patron--Gaari, I suppose--should count himself lucky. These mana wyrms produce the finest silk in Eversong. I know Magisters who would kill to have a robe trimmed in this, and yet here we are, using it for a mending job. Ah well.

Once the wyrms have eaten their fill of arcane energy, you can siphon the silk from them onto these bobbins.

If they are reluctant to release their silk, you may have to, ah... beat it out of them. But I've been assured it's entirely ethical.
91388.progress: This is the easy part, of course.
91388.completion: Ah... beautiful, glittering manasilk. So ripe with potential.

91389.title: Clothes Make the Man
91389.objectives: Meet Solwin inside, then fend off any manifestations as he mends the cloak.
91389.description:
It is not merely the material that makes an arcanoweave cloak so fine, but the weaving process itself.

To mend one, particularly one that has built up so much history and latent arcane energy... I am about to embark on a very dangerous bit of tailoring indeed. Finally, a real testament to my skills.

I am excited. I hope nothing explodes. Meet me inside when you're prepared.
91389.completion: It is a thing of beauty... I am glad to know it is in the hands of someone who loves it so.

91398.title: Tomes of Terror
91398.objectives: Kill ogres in Atal'Kaldan and collect 4 tomes.
91398.description:
Knowledge is power, and de ogres been reading.

Bring me dey tomes so dey never grow dis powah again.
91398.completion: Thank ya. Dese are going straight into de fire.

91399.title: Ashes of the Void
91399.objectives: Kill void elementals and collect their ashes.
91399.description:
De void elementals have one use.

De dust dey drop is useful for shadow magic rituals.

Collect some for our tribe.
91399.progress: Don't worry, we been doin' dese rituals for centuries.
91399.completion: Our hunters gonna make good use of de powder. Thank ya.

91400.title: Blades of the Fallen
91400.description:
After de battle we left a lot of our weapons behind.

Please go collect dem so de Twilight's Blade doesn't get dem.
91400.completion: Thanks for collecting dem. Now our foes won't get de advantage of fine Amani crafting.

91401.title: Dead by Dusk
91401.objectives: Collect 20 femurs from Twilight's Blade cultists in Atal'Kaldan.
91401.description: De Twilight's Blade cultists have de audacity to try and take back our temple. Kill de peons and bring me their femurs.
91401.progress: Why femurs? None of ya business.
91401.completion: I got a plan for de bones. Thanks.

91402.title: Ultra Deadly Ultradon
91402.objectives: Kill the Eminent Ultradon in the center of Atal'Kaldan.
91402.description:
I saw some of de void elementals doing a sketchy ritual in de center of the battlefield. It looked like dey were summoning some void creatures.

Make sure whatever dey summon is dealt with.
91402.progress: If dey start bringing the void here we're gonna be in a whole heap o' trouble.
91402.completion: Never seen one of dem before and hope I don't see dem again. Nicely done.

91403.title: Probable Paralytic
91403.objectives: Collect 8 Venomous Horns from Horned Frogs.
91403.description:
Halazzi says dat de Vilebranch have made a new venom dat para... parliz--makes its victims not move--so they can drag them off to be sacrificed. He says it's frog venom.

I said that doesn't make sense. Frogs are poison, right? Halazzi said frogs are normally poisonous, not venomous. But these have sharp horn bits on them, so maybe they have venom! I didn't know frogs could have venom, did you?

Let's find out if these do--then de Witherbark can make an anti-venom!
91403.progress: Halazzi says venomous is when dey bite or stab you, and poisonous is when you bite or eat dem! Isn't dat interestin'?
91403.completion: Look at all de samples you found! De chief will know who can make anti-venom for sure.

91404.title: A Most Vile Venom
91404.objectives: Kill Venomhexxer Raxxis and find the fang Tobui described.
91404.description:
De Vilebranch are cookin' up more bad things. You should go to de source and make dem stop!

Halazzi has smelled their venom-mixin' place someplace to de southeast, and he thinks it's more den just frog venom.

...Oh, Halazzi also said to bring back some kind of huge fang. Frogs don't have fangs, though. Well, find it anyway!
91404.progress: Did you look for de big fang?
91404.completion: Hey, dat's a spider fang. Dat must have been one huge spider!

91405.title: Validating the Venom
91405.objectives: Speak to the Witherbark Chief and locate an anti-venom alchemist in the village.
91405.description:
This means there are both frog and spider venoms in de mixtures. Halazzi says he senses somebody beseeched Shadra with dat fang. Dey must be a really big spider if their fang is dat big!

Halazzi doesn't like that de Vilebranch had it. I can tell. He's unhappy. His ears get all flat like de wings of a kite.

So we gotta help out. Take de samples and de fang to de Witherbark Chief. We Witherbark have alchemists dat can brew anti-venoms for both spiders and frogs.
91405.completion:
De Vilebranch are de ones doin' somethin' with Shadra?

Could de spiders be workin' against de Witherbark? This doesn't make sense.

91406.title: Far from the Hinterlands
91406.objectives: Investigate the Witherbark from the Hinterlands for signs of Shadra.
91406.description:
As a Torntusk of de Revantusk tribe, I am cautious of Witherbark because of our history with dem in de Hinterlands. My family moved here because of dem.

The Witherbark here in Zul'Aman seem to respect us, but de Witherbark I remember in de Hinterlands killed and backstabbed their allies for power.

They worshipped de spider loa, Shadra.

When de Hinterlands's Witherbark temple Shadra'Alor fell, de Witherbark must have fled somewhere. Look around for evidence of Hinterlands Witherbark and of Shadra.
91406.completion:
All de places dey mentioned are right next door to Shadra'Alor! Dey probably worshipped Shadra.

We can't trust dem. Dey are like de venoms dey use. Dey will poison de rest of de tribe against de Revatusk--against us all!

91407.title: The Eye of the Loa
91407.objectives: Find evidence of Shadra in the Witherbark Bluffs with Halazzi's aid.
91407.description:
I lost friends to venoms made from Shadra's spiders in de Hinterlands. I gotta know if Shadra's lurkin' around here, twistin' de minds of these Witherbark. No Revantusk will be safe in Zul'Aman with Shadra-worshippin' Witherbark around!

Maybe I seem paranoid, but I have my reasons. And you have Halazzi's ear. You could ask him to reveal to you any hidden spiders, yes? I know those long ears can hear dem skitterin'!

There is a shrine behind me. Stand in front of it and see if he'll grant you a boon.
91407.progress: Did Halazzi help you? He can hear anything, but he also can see what's hidden in shadow.
91407.completion:
De spiders fled? I thought dey would put up more of a fight. And you said dey were small? Hm.

Well, it doesn't matter. Halazzi has set us on this hunt now. We need to see it through.

91408.title: Seeking Shadra
91408.objectives: Follow the spiders to find where they lead.
91408.description:
We will untangle dis mess about Witherbark and Vilebranch soon enough. De loa Shadra and her schemes must be our first priority.

I watched the spiders run in terror from you, and somethin' struck me. De spiders are not just running in panic--they're going somewhere... somewhere dey feel safe, and even I can see dem now. 

Dey are not hiding anymore. Dey are on de run! Our hunt continues.

Let's follow dem.
91408.progress: Where dis trail leads, we follow.
91408.completion: Let's hear him out, but keep your hand on your weapon.

91409.title: Dreaming of Spiders
91409.objectives: Attempt the ritual with the fang and eye to speak to Shadra.
91409.description:
There are three relics of Shadra. I only had two. I had de fang in de village and de eye hidden here. Dey musta stolen de fang somehow, then came for de eye!

We never had de Shell of Shadra--it was lost when we left Shadra'Alor. It's possible de Vilebranch have de shell.

De fang and de eye should let us talk to Shadra briefly, even if we lack de last ritual relic to summon her.

Come with me. I will show you how.
91409.progress: De two artifacts should be enough to speak to a vision of Shadra.
91409.completion:
This is de Shadra I remember from Shadra'Alor. She will assist us if we help her.

She keeps her promises.

91410.title: Shared Loa
91410.objectives: Speak to the Witherbark Chief about Shadra.
91410.description:
De Witherbark Chief knows many of us came from de Hinterlands with our worship of Shadra'Alor, but believed Shadra was long dead.

We should let him know how Halazzi helped us to find and restore Shadra, and of Shadra's presence in de Witherbark crypt. He also must learn of de rapport with de Revantusk.

I will stay with Shadra for now. Will you carry de message?
91410.completion: With Shadra aligned with us against de Vilebranch, we will punish dem grievously for their evil acts.

91411.title: Maisara Caverns: Deep in Maisara
91411.objectives: Recover the Shell of Shadra from within Maisara Caverns.
91411.description:
Shadra has asked dat we recover de third piece of Mixer Jamanga's ritual, de Shell of Shadra. With it, maybe we can bring her back.

She recognized both de Witherbark and Revantusk as her allies. I felt her approval upon all of us. I believe this is de right choice.

Halazzi set us on dis path, and we each got our roles to see it through. Gather your allies and go into Maisara Caverns! I would expect one of their leaders to hold de shell. Kill dem and take it back.
91411.progress: I think dat Shadra will honor her word.
91411.completion: I can't imagine dat was easy. Halazzi must have blessed your hunt.

91412.title: Return of the Venom Queen
91412.objectives: Follow Mixer Jamanga's ritual to restore Shadra.
91412.description:
It is time to bring Shadra to her proper place as a loa of de Witherbark and Revantusk. She will be small at first, but one day could be great like Halazzi and Nalorakk!

Even a small loa will be a good ally against de Vilebranch venoms. She is de Loa of Spies, and will block their thievery of our people and relics, just as Halazzi hides them in the mists.

Hold de Shell of Shadra in de center of de room, and we will call de loa to us!
91412.progress: This is more than de return of a loa--it is a bridge between tribes.
91412.completion:
This journey has been... eye-opening. 

Had you asked me at the start if we would be allies with Shadra, I would have laughed in your face!

91450.title: We Ready Now
91450.description:
Thank you, $p! We ready for Pit.

We trained to be strong. You hurt us. Now we more strong.

You tell Boletus we ready now.
91450.completion:
Already trained for the ring?

Was very fast. Much impress.

What is team's name?

Need name to shout when run into the Pit.

And crowd needs name to shout when you beat other teams.

Or if...

91452.title: Range of Knowledge
91452.objectives: Retrieve 3 overdue books from around Farstrider Hold and return them to the library.
91452.description:
I've always dreamed of being a Farstrider--the adventure! The romance! The beauty of nature! When they put out a call for help, I knew I had to join.

Captain Dawnrunner assigned me to the library initially, but with everything going on, we all have to be flexible.

I don't mind, but I had hoped to collect all the overdue books before being sent on a real assignment. If you find any, would you bring them to the library for me?

And feel free to give them a read! There are some interesting volumes!
91452.progress: It really takes everyone to get through times like these.
91452.completion: It might seem like a small thing, but the small things add up.

91462.title: To the Central Tower
91462.objectives: Meet Ranger Asterae at the Central Tower.
91462.description:
Ranger Asterae is one of our veterinarians. She usually cares for our lynxes, but the mana wyrm molt is too crucial to the health of the forest to go unmonitored.

The wyrms regulate the flow of magic from the ley lines to the rest of the woods. When the ley lines were disrupted, so was their molting season. It's not so dire as it once was, but they still need help from time to time.

Meet Asterae at the Central Tower. She can tell you more.
91462.completion: It's a good thing we came. There are more mana wyrms here than usual.

91463.title: To the South Tower
91463.objectives: Meet Arcanist Taemin at the South Tower.
91463.description:
Despite being new to the Farstriders, Taemin has the hardest assignment. Eversong Woods has mostly recovered, but the further south you go, the more dangerous things get.

He's a capable mage, though. And we need his nose for magic.

We'll meet you down there once things are wrapped up here. Captain Dawnrunner was going to provide backup. She should be there by now.
91463.completion: I-I'm not worried. This is what being a Farstrider is all about!

91493.title: Not What I Ordered
91493.description:
<A bite wound wrecks Hathvelion's forearm.>

Snapdragons... cruel creatures made to kill and feed. Their poison moves as you move. The naga bred the perfect pet.

I'm here on a tip from Lyssara Duskmourne. Sunsail Anchorage's shipping routes have been sabotaged by the naga, and those routes converge... here.

I intercepted a few shipments. Could you help me search them? My team is still out in the field, but they should report back soon.
91493.progress:
The blood elves could just use magic to trade. But there's something dependable about a sturdy wooden box.

<Hathvelion thumps the table beside him and smiles.>

Plus, I hear food and drink aren't as tasty after being transported by magic.
91493.completion: Lyssara's suspicions proved correct. The naga must be collecting arcane magic from sources all around Eversong. We must put a stop to it, immediately.

91494.title: One Elf's Trash, Another Elf's Treasure
91494.objectives: Test the Discarded Wand on the Container of Unstable Arcana. Then, empower the wand in Daggerspine Landing.
91494.description:
The arcane arts are not my specialty. I'm more versed in tangible magic--herbs, mixtures, distillation, topical applications, extraction, suture, painkilling...

Regardless--that wand. To my uneducated eyes, it looks usable. Why don't you test it on the arcana container? Maybe it could help us against the naga. If it's truly broken, no harm done.
91494.progress: Maybe the wand was too weak for its original owner. Whatever the case, we can try to put it to good use.
91494.completion:
You can just say I had a hunch about that wand.

...although, be careful. It's powered up now. Don't accidentally drop it.

91495.title: Familiar Faces in Peril
91495.objectives: Find Apothecary Enith, Apprentice Varnis, and Ranger Vedoran in Daggerspine Landing.
91495.description:
Fair winds guide your steps. My wish has come true--Eversong flourishes. But like before, evil threatens all that is good.

Two townsfolk are unaccounted for since the naga arrived: Enith--Goldenmist's most curious apothecary, and Varnis--he's a student visiting from the city. It is my charge to find them.

My fellow ranger, Vedoran, must still be in the field. I wonder if he's found something important. Will you keep an eye out for him?
91495.progress: The Farstriders are grateful for your assistance.
91495.completion:
It is a relief to know they are safe and sound. I hope Varnis will be all right. I saw him scamper back, face as white as a ghost, refusing to speak. He gathered his things and left.

Thank you, {NAME}. I hope no other villagers will be tempted to enter the naga's base!

91504.title: Arcane Amassing
91504.objectives: Slay Princess Naz'jena in Daggerspine Point.
91504.description:
Well, you heard Numia. She'll have my bow split in two if I don't rest.

Ranger Vedoran reported activity at the lighthouse. A swarm of mana wyrms are gathered there, and of course, more naga.

If that's where the head of the snake lives, chop it off! My rangers Vedoran and Krann'an will accompany you. And take the wand with you. It proved its worth. Powered up, it should pack a punch against whatever you face.
91504.completion:
The lighthouse itself was coming apart due to the increasing arcane energies, both latent and collected. How ominous indeed. I'll deliver a report to Regent Lord Lor'themar straight away.

Thanks to you, my rangers and the town are saved. For that, please rest and drink.

...the wand exploded?! I suppose we now know why it was thrown away.

You know, a bow would never spontaneously combust.

91505.title: Daggers in My Spine
91505.objectives: Slay 12 Daggerspine naga in Daggerspine Landing.
91505.description:
The naga have a history of abusing arcane magic. I bet my boots this is no different--arcane is their lifeblood and source of power. They are clever to operate now while Eversong is besieged by other threats.

Since I became a Farstrider, I have safeguarded Eversong's western coast. My strike team set up watch on Goldenmist's perimeter already. Fortunately, the naga do not seem interested in the town yet, but they are far too close for comfort.

Our course of action is simple: clear them out!
91505.progress: We can't let the naga get any closer to Goldenmist.
91505.completion:
You've struck fear and death into their water-spawned hearts! Well done.

We'll keep an eye on their base and prevent them from rebuilding.

91533.title: What We Leave Behind
91533.objectives: Deliver Hieron's journal to Riftblade Astre at Locus Point.
91533.description:
Lothraxion deserved to pay for his arrogance with his life. Hieron didn't. Without him, I'd be dead. I know that Maella and Darkglen feel the same way.

Hieron's journal, the one you recovered for us, ended up with me. I knew Hieron, but Astre knew him better. The two of them had found a closeness I admired. Astre deserves to hold onto it.

Last I saw Astre, Hieron was tending to their wounds back at Locus Point.

You were there when Hieron passed. They should know of his heroism and sacrifice.
91533.progress:
I've recovered some since we last parted ways here, but the whispers continue to plague me. They're insidious, torturing me with what I lack, how I've failed. And--

Wait. Is that...? Where did you get that?
91533.completion: <Astre accepts Hieron's journal and the letter with an empty and distant expression.>

91535.title: Home Sweet Grave
91535.objectives: Collect 8 Ghostflower Leaves around the base of Locus Point.
91535.description:
<Astre spends a long time in silence, thumbing through Hieron's journal.>

Killed on another world, defending a city that didn't want him. There was so much we planned to do. Now...

<Astre trails off, their eyes focusing on the journal's pages.>

Oh. The tea recipe that Hieron was telling me about. He was excited for its properties--called it a purgative for the soul. He never had a chance to brew it.

I know it seems stupid, {NAME}. I just want to taste Hieron's tea. The leaves should be nearby.
91535.progress: <Astre thumbs through Hieron's journal with a detached expression.>

91536.title: Like a Weed
91536.description:
<Astre looks from Hieron's journal to the worn letter. Their expression flickers with anger.>

Blood elves. They were our people until we embraced the Void. In their ignorance, they exiled us. Yet they are happy to ask us to fight their battles for them.

They say we threaten the Sunwell. The truth is, they are afraid of us.

Let's protect something of actual value. Kill any beasts that threaten those flowers for Hieron's tea. Silvermoon can save itself.
91536.completion: I'm not exactly sure how this tea is supposed to help. But I trust Hieron's notes.

91537.title: Confronting It
91537.objectives: Brew the Ghostflower Tea for Astre.
91537.description:
I've put the kettle on. I trust you to brew it, if you wouldn't mind. It shouldn't take more than a moment before the tea is ready to drink.

Let me try it first, just in case it's poisonous. I'm the one that asked to try it.
91537.completion:
I thought I could spare myself this pain by pushing it down.

You barely even know me. But you've already done so much for me. Thank you.

91541.title: Unchecked Emotions
91541.objectives: Meet with Riftblade Astre at the Howling Ridge.
91541.description:
Ren'dorei learn early to check our emotions. That by controlling ourselves, we can control the Void. Otherwise, our unsuppressed feelings can lead us to ruin.

But I felt just now the powers of facing my feelings head-on. Maybe I could have done it on my own... But the tea, and your aid, made it easier.

We should share Hieron's recipe with the others. I'll retrieve the kettle you brewed.
91541.completion: I was never the best at magic, but my cantrips can at least keep tea warm.

91542.title: The Town Inside Me
91542.objectives: Serve Ghostflower tea to Umbric, Maella, and Sideras in the Howling Ridge.
91542.description:
I can't say that drinking the tea is a pleasant experience. But it helps. I want the others to experience that too.

That Hieron left us with a gift like this is so... him. He was always doing little things like that for others. For me.

Share the tea with the others, then join me at Obscurion Citadel. I know better than to be alone in a place like that.
91542.completion:
So this is where it happened.

I came here simply to mourn. But... there's something else.

91543.title: Retaking Control
91543.objectives: Kill flying Harrowers and Siphoids in Obscurion Citadel.
91543.description:
This world is violent and dangerous, but it has an order to things. After you and the others took down the domanaar that ran this citadel and its arena, the food chain must have fallen to disarray.

Harrowers swarm the skies and darken the horizon. I worry they'll seek new hunting grounds closer to our settlements if they aren't dealt with.

Point them out for me and I'll use my grappling hook to pull them to the ground. Hieron's survival gear proves its use when we need it, as always.
91543.completion: Perhaps some new class of beast will grow strong without these flying monsters to hunt them. Let's hope they threaten the domanaar instead of us.

91544.title: Familiar Energies
91544.objectives: Scry Void Rifts with Riftblade Astre in Obscurion Citadel.
91544.description: I know that Hieron died here, but I feel echoes of someone else--of a great clash, where Void met Void. Hieron must have crossed blades with someone... something else. Something that's still out there.
91544.completion: That domanaar is trying to open a portal to Silvermoon! How is this possible?

91545.title: Stronger Than Before
91545.description:
That must be the monster that killed Hieron. It's tearing open a backdoor for the Void's forces to pour into Silvermoon.

This damn city. I'm not doing this for them.

Signal Umbric. Let's do this. Together.
91545.completion:
A violent alien world can be home, so long as it's got the right people.

I've got mine right here.

91546.title: To Be Changed
91546.objectives: Speak to Umbric about meeting with Astre in Silvermoon City.
91546.description:
There is one unresolved matter...

<Astre reaches into their pocket and reveals the worn letter you had unpackaged alongside Hieron's journal. They run their fingers over it with a pensive expression.>

Hieron wanted her to have it. She should know what happened to him.

This is on me. Silvermoon again... Guess I'll see you when I'm back, {NAME}.
91546.progress: At least I'm not visiting my parents.
91546.completion:
I'm glad I went through with this. Thanks for coming with me.

Let's get back to the others in the Voidstorm, {NAME}.

91550.title: A Game of Silence and Shadow
91550.description:
You're different! That makes you kinda cool... and kinda really suspicious. We wanna see what you're made of!

So here's the game: we hide, and you try to find us. If you do, well... guess we'll have to train more for next time. But if you don't? Then maybe our parents will finally let us go on our first solo hunt!

This isn't just a silly game, okay? It's a trial called Silence and Shadow. It's serious. Very, very serious.

Are you ready?
91550.completion:
That monstrous petalwing took him! And we stood there... frozen like fungus! 

<Ilomai shakes her head and gathers her resolve.>

We don't have time to be scared. We move. Now.

91551.title: De-nest-stration
91551.objectives: Search 5 Petalwing Nests for Shao'mal in Harandar.
91551.description:
If mom and dad find out, we are going to be stuck on fish gutting duty for the rest of our lives! 

The elders keep telling us that fear is only useful if it sharpens the mind. Right now, we need clarity, not panic.

We have to get rid of those nests. Maybe if they are gone, we can eventually find the one they took Shao'mal to. And this way, we can finally drive off those stupid birds!

We're going to find him. Will you help us?
91551.completion: Great job! Those petalwings might think twice now before settling down in our pla--I mean hunting area!

91552.title: Feathered Fury
91552.description:
This would have never happened if those stupid petalwings weren't here!

Scare them off, chase them, whatever it takes--we just can't let them stay here. If they stay, they'll just keep hurting people. We can't let that happen.
91552.completion:
You did it? Great! That's really great!

With more of those petalwings gone, we can finally focus on helping Shao'mal!

91553.title: Haranir Never Say Die!
91553.objectives: Defeat the Behemoth Petalwing in Harandar.
91553.description:
That's the one! The big one! The one that took him!

We didn't stop it before. But this time, we will. We are haranir. And haranir never back down. Haranir never give up.

We're bringing him back. And we're ending this. Are you with me?
91553.completion:
Thank you so much for rescuing me... not that I needed it of course. Anyway, you seem to be pretty good yourself. So after talking with everyone, we all agreed to make you a part of our group! 

Be proud. This is an honor only few have received, but you've earned every bit. You are officially one of us! Be proud, stand tall, and never give up!

91556.title: Loa's Flame
91556.objectives: Prepare the funeral pyre for Tolbani in Atal'Abasi.
91556.description:
I will have to take what's left of de supplies back on foot.

De boat... it's no good now. De hull's cracked, and de frame's split. Won't carry another soul across de water.

But it'll still serve one final purpose.

It can be his pyre. We will burn it, de weapons, de armor he wore--everything with him.

Vengeance is done. Now we let de fire take him to de loa and to his rest.
91556.completion: I hope it brings his spirit peace. And mine.

91557.title: Message to the Molt
91557.objectives: Find Lady Darkglen in the Molt.
91557.description:
Ah, champion! There are so many unique specimens to identify and catalogue here that I can't keep up.

Speaking of which, Lady Darkglen took time out of her busy schedule and coordinated an expedition to a particularly dangerous region north of here. I trust in her power, but I've not heard from her or her team in a while and am growing concerned. With any luck, they are simply caught up in their own research.

That being said, would you please find Lady Darkglen in the Molt and check in on her?
91557.completion: Verigien sent you? Good timing. Our expedition has run into an unforeseen problem.

91558.title: Pestilent Petals
91558.objectives: Collect 10 Mature Blood Petals in the Molt.
91558.description:
A strange pathogenic presence has infected my fellow ren'dorei.

When we arrived, I was awestruck by the colorful vibrancy of this decay-filled valley and its many blood-stained flowers. I had hoped to gather some for my collection... to study of course, but this pathogen was living in the same pestilent pools these blood petals thrive in. Are they naturally resilient, or do they have purifying qualities we can harness for a cure?

Dear {NAME}, please, cautiously gather blood petals for my research.
91558.completion: Absolutely beautiful! I only hope these flowers can provide a clue to cure my brethren.

91559.title: Virulent Vermin
91559.objectives: Gather 6 Specialized Livers from creatures within the Molt.
91559.description:
The pathogen appears to spread unevenly among the Molt's wildlife.

When my fellow ren'dorei were infected, they grew confused and unresponsive. The local fauna appear more resistant. I suspect some of the Molt's denizens have a stronger resistance than others. Perhaps by examining these beasts we can extract elements for a curative elixir.

Could you gather livers from the creatures nearby?
91559.progress: How goes the hunt? Have you gathered what we need?
91559.completion: Marvelous. Let us dissect these immediately, before they spoil.

91560.title: Expunging Explorers
91560.objectives: Craft an antidote and cure the infected ren'dorei in the Molt.
91560.description:
Let us hope we are able to concoct a cure from the reagents you acquired.

I have already prepared the base potion, but now we need to carefully mix in the blood petals and livers you procured. With some calculated determination and a bit of luck, we should be able to craft an antidote and administer it to the afflicted ren'dorei scouts nearby.

{NAME}, assist Blocciniux by mixing in the gathered ingredients.
91560.progress: Were you successful? Did the antidote work?
91560.completion:
Riftwalker Lorn is dead? This is troubling news. 

You have my gratitude for saving as many of the ren'dorei as you did.

91561.title: Bloodborne Pathogen
91561.objectives: Destroy the Mutated Pathogen in the Molt.
91561.description:
The bloodborne pathogen has mutated!

The ooze-like carriers of this pathogen usually die quickly, but this new variant is stable even without a host. If it escapes from here, it could infect more ren'dorei and spread across Voidstorm, or worse yet, Azeroth. Our entire operation is at risk.

We must stop this mutated variant before it spreads!
91561.progress: Have you contained the spread of this deadly pathogen?
91561.completion: With the mutated pathogen dealt with and the antidote in hand, we should be safe from further outbreaks. Thank you for your assistance, {NAME}.

91563.title: Halazzi's Hunt
91563.objectives: Seek out the Loa Speaker in Halazzi's Temple.
91563.description:
All of these spiders... 

There must be someting dat we are missing. Halazzi knew exactly how to reveal them, though.

Go to Halazzi's temple. I have no doubt that there is more to dis. Seek out his loa speaker.
91563.completion: Halazzi says he called you here to help. Is dat true, hash'ura?

91565.title: Voidscar Arena: The Grief Spire
91565.objectives: Use the portal to the Grief Spire and report to Vidious.
91565.description:
You, hero!

Vidious here wars with his nemesis, Ziadan, who has brought the most cutthroat, volatile members of the Horde here to fight for her. Murderers and traitors!

The leaders of the Alliance do not listen to our calls for action and vengeance! We must take matters into our own hands and support Vidious.

<Amari looks you up and down and raises an eyebrow.>

And if it is not hatred of the Horde that drives you, consider what valuable information you may glean by helping a powerful domanaar.
91565.completion:
Ah, another {class} of the Alliance. What is it that drives you, I wonder?

I've heard so many sordid tales! Did the Horde butcher your family? Destroy your home? Betray you on the battlefield?

Or are you one of the soft-hearted ones? Here merely for knowledge and power to benefit your home, not vengeance?

It matters not to me, so long as you fight in my name.

91566.title: Voidscar Arena: The Hate Spire
91566.objectives: Use the portal to the Hate Spire and report to Ziadan.
91566.description:
Lok'tar ogar, {class}.

This domanaar, Ziadan, wars her old foe, Vidious, who has brought the most bloodthirsty, vengeful members of the Alliance here to Slayer's Rise to fight in his name.

Ziadan now gives the Horde a chance to stand up for our honor. Our leaders may not sanction this conflict, but when have we let anyone keep us from fighting the good fight?

Even if you have no grievance with the Alliance, Ziadan's efforts keep Vidious from turning his eye on Azeroth. Report to her for your orders.
91566.completion:
You. You look ready for a battle.

Your Horde is noble. You fight for honor. For glory. Sometimes, for the joy of it.

Your eternal conflict with the Alliance is delicious. I shall savor it.

91583.title: Voidscar Arena: The Bastion of Valor
91583.objectives: Collect 12 Spiteful Shadowgraft from wild creatures in the Bastion of Valor.
91583.description:
Ziadan recently added your great foes, the Horde, to her ranks. However, it is not your fellow mortals that I see sieging my home.

No, I see monsters of Voidstorm, twisted and empowered, instead. Something is afoot. Has Ziadan added yet another new force to her army?

Go and fight these monsters. Bring me any clues you find as to the source of their newfound power.
91583.completion:
Ah, of course! Shadowgraft.

This metal sends a creature surging with power, driving them into a blind, violent frenzy. It cannot be removed without killing the beasts.

91585.title: Fresh from the Garden
91585.objectives: Collect 6 Frillfish Fillet and 4 Root Drift Jelly in Harandar.
91585.description:
Age has caught up with me this morning and I have pulled something. 

<Yu'relen clutches his back.>

Still, our village meal must be prepared. Otherwise, it will mean the loss of much more than just an empty stomach.

If you would gather some ingredients for the meal, your aid would not go unappreciated.
91585.progress: I hope you brought back a good harvest.
91585.completion: Excellent. Even an old cook can work wonders with good hands beside him.

91586.title: Soil-Based Alternatives
91586.description:
This meal is more than tradition--it is a promise.

The haranir, rutaani, and fungarians share no love, but in Har'mara they share this table. To honor that pact, each must be fed in their own way. That is what this meal means.

For the rutaani, they will need nutrient-rich soil as they draw sustenance through their roots. A few bags of it should do.
91586.progress: I hope you bring news of good soil.
91586.completion: Good. The rutaani will accept this without complaint. Peace rests on gestures such as these.

91587.title: Carcass Cuisine
91587.objectives: Defeat the Sporeglider Bloomterror in Harandar.
91587.description:
The fungarians are caretakers of decay, transforming death into life's renewal. 

They require a sporeglider carcass to sustain their vast community. There is one--larger than most--that has taken to warding off the root drifters we need to sustain our village.

Its end will feed many, and ease our burden. Balance, in more ways than one.
91587.completion: This carcass breathes new sustenance into the fungarians and the peace we uphold.

91588.title: Harandar's Kitchen
91588.objectives: Prepare and cook the meal in Harandar.
91588.description:
Now comes the true work: preparing what's been gathered. 

The vegetables must be washed, the bones removed, and the fish roasted. A shared meal is only worthy if made with care. Only then may the meal carry the weight of peace.
91588.progress: How is the preparation coming along?
91588.completion: All is ready. Let those who share in this meal remember that unity is not ease--it is effort.

91589.title: Root Dash Delivery
91589.objectives: Set up the communal meal in Harandar.
91589.description:
It's simple fare, but made with care and meaning. Please, take it to the gathering place. I am sure the villagers will show up when the food comes.

Despite the simplicity, if it brings quiet among them, it has done its part.
91589.progress: Once the meal is set, our job will be done for today.
91589.completion: You have done more than fill bowls--you have upheld something fragile and vital. For the peace of Har'mara, we thank you.

91597.title: Voidscar Arena: For My Alliance
91597.objectives: Empower 8 Griefbound forces at the Bastion of Valor in Slayer's Rise.
91597.description:
My bastion is besieged by Ziadan once more!

You Alliance have proven to me you are strong. I am eager to see you in action upon the battlefield. 

My own forces could use a taste of your courage. Take this Voidclarion and embolden the void underlings that fight for me. Let them know they have your backing. Let them feel the glory of your Alliance!
91597.completion: Excellent. The battle is only truly balanced when it tips toward my favor.

91598.title: Voidscar Arena: Pre-Provoked Violence
91598.objectives: Slay Void creatures or players in the Bastion of Might in Slayer's Rise.
91598.description:
So, Ziadan would stoop so low as to use shadowgraft? Can she not adequately stir the bloodlust of her Horde minions? She's lost her touch.

I need no such army to overpower her. I have you.

Show her how it's done. Decimate her forces before they reach beyond the bounds of Slayer's Rise. They could threaten your precious mission here, after all.
91598.completion:
What?! If Ziadan is also besieged by shadowgrafted creatures, that means...

An interloper.

91599.title: Voidscar Arena: A Familiar Grudge
91599.objectives: Slay Manus Deathwake at the Bastion of Might in Slayer's Rise.
91599.description:
It is time to take the fight to Ziadan.

She undoubtedly has her own favorite pet--someone from your world who takes this conflict personally. She is particularly fond of the flavors of rage.

I prefer aching, heart-wrenching grief, myself, and we shall prove which fuels you mortals with greater strength.

Among their forces is a dark warlock that has slain many of your kind. I've tasted their rage in the air.

Go. Savor the fight.
91599.completion: Very good. The Horde is filled with such hateful, violent souls.

91600.title: Voidscar Arena: Setting It Aside
91600.objectives: Meet the domanaar at the Voidscar Arena in Slayer's Rise.
91600.description:
I knew shadowgrafting was beneath Ziadan. I would not spend eons locked in conflict with one so uncouth.

Therefore, our little game has an uninvited guest. Not you, of course. We love watching you kill for us.

To the far north is the Voidscar Arena. The last time another domanaar tried to come between us, they built that citadel. It has laid empty for ages.

If another domanaar intends to challenge us, they will have staged their forces there.
91600.completion:
Who is our enemy, then? Who seeks to rise and claim more power while Xal'atath's back is turned?

Tenebre? Chrysalius? Decimus?

91603.title: Voidscar Arena: Two Against One
91603.objectives: Drain the Shadowgraft Graftnodes atop the Voidscar Arena in Slayer's Rise.
91603.description:
You. Alliance weakling.

Shadowgraft requires a potent font to power it--likely more than one, given this many creatures. They will be nearby. Destroy the power sources, then meet us on the next ridge.

Remember: if this domanaar succeeds, their conquest will not end in Slayer's Rise. They will find a way to your homeworld. They would shadowgraft Azeroth herself. Put an end to this.

Meanwhile, I suppose I shall relish in this opportunity to observe Vidious's weaknesses up close.
91603.completion:
This will prevent further spread of the grafting. However, we must still deal with what remains ourselves. 

How troublesome.

91605.title: Voidscar Arena: The Wrong Side
91605.description:
Indeed, the Voidscar Arena is crawling with Void once again. A domanaar rules here, I have no doubt.

They have not yet emerged to parlay. Our mysterious interloper must not be present. That is well.

Let's have you put an end to this charade. Destroy their forces. Destroy their resources. And turn their tools against them. Make them feel the disdain I feel for them.

Ziadan and I shall investigate this interloper.
91605.completion: We shall find glory in a battle yet.

91606.title: Voidscar Arena: Clearing House
91606.objectives: Slay Trelus the Grafter at the top of the Voidscar Arena in Slayer's Rise.
91606.description:
A waste of a great monstrosity. Imagine its cunning were it not frenzied! It would have made a fine addition to my collection.

The shadowgrafting must end. I doubt this domanaar is doing the work himself. There must be a grafter nearby. 

While Ziadan and I weaken this monster, find and slay the grafter. Then these shadowgrafted monsters will never breach your precious world.

If nothing else, that will finally draw out our enemy.
91606.completion:
Charonus. Weak. Fickle. One of the first domanaar to bow to Xal'atath. 

Unsurprising. Still, let's hear if his offer is of any interest. Premature murder is so boring.

91628.title: Honored Guests
91628.objectives: Deliver Lord Saltheril's invitations to the Magisters, Blood Knights, Farstriders, and "traders" in Silvermoon.
91628.description:
I am pleased you could join us. Today marks the start of a very special occasion.

The sin'dorei are no strangers to the war table, but its aristocracy prefers to play more coy. In wartime, the crown sends representatives to curry favor with the nobles. If they are pleased, they might lend gold to the war effort.

It is very much like courting a lover, with all the jealous games you might imagine.

So let us play the game, shall we? Deliver these invitations while we finish preparations here.
91628.progress: Your presence is already turning heads. This will be quite the spectacle.
91628.completion:
Ah, so the rumors are true about your efficiency.

Excellent. Now we can begin the game.

91629.title: High Esteem
91629.description:
Invitations to my Haven are highly exclusive, especially at a time like this. Extending an offer, even a temporary one, is a great honor.

My favor carries quite a bit of weight amongst the aristocracy. If I invite an ally of one of our representatives, it suggests I think highly of them--and if I think highly of them, so too will our noble guests.

But is it not terribly fun if I let you choose an invitation instead?

Go peruse any enticements they may offer, then make your selection.
91629.completion: I will have my valet send for them at once.

91630.title: Stolen Sight
91630.objectives: Defeat the Vilebranch leading the attack on Shadra's children and recover the Eye of Shadra.
91630.description:
I can explain, I swear it!

I concealed my knowledge of Shadra before because so many people assume she is an evil force. Our lady is merciless, but only to her enemies. 

When de Witherbark left de Hinterlands, we had to leave our temple of Shadra'Alor. I brought two of her relics with me: de eye and de fang.

De Vilebranch stole de fang. Dey are near where I hid the Eye of Shadra, collectin' venom from her children! Please kill de Vilebranch trespassing in the crypt. We can't let dem find de eye.
91630.progress: I can understand why dey want de venom, but de artifacts are just for communin' with Shadra. What would dey need with them?
91630.completion: They must mean to weaken us and our ability to commune with Shadra.

91693.title: The Subtle Game
91693.objectives: Hand out 3 tokens of Saltheril's Favor to the factions you wish to aid this week.
91693.description:
Appearances are everything. If the court sees that I favor a certain group, they will follow suit.

Take these tokens of my favor and hand them out to our honored guests as you see fit. I suspect they may invite you to partake in their plans and share in the profits, if you choose to align yourself with their cause.
91693.progress: Do endeavor not to keep our guests waiting in suspense.
91693.completion:
Splendid.

I dearly hope you find some time to enjoy yourself while court is in season. While I do appreciate the sullen, results-driven sort, you could stand to smile.

91747.title: Not Quite Nalorakk
91747.objectives: Remove 8 Nalorakk Trinkets from the furbolgs in Spiritpaw Village.
91747.description:
Were you the one we saw enter Nalorakk's temple with Zul'jarra?

I thought so! Zul'jarra spoke to him, didn't she?

<Furgh growls in an unsettling way from deep in his throat.>

That doesn't make sense. The new Voice of Nalorakk says Nalorakk won't speak to anyone but him.

He gave some of the tribe trinkets to feel closer to Nalorakk. But the tribe now fights over them. The ursas think it's unfair they don't get any. But the chosen cling to them.

We must take them before more blood is spilled.
91747.progress: I don't want them. We'll toss them on the fire.
91747.completion:
I think the trinkets were corrupted too.

I'm glad the trinkets are out of my tribe's claws.

91748.title: Too Much Twilight
91748.objectives: Destroy 4 corrupted totems in Spiritpaw Village.
91748.description:
This big bear called himself the Voice of Nalorakk and has "chosen" some of our tribe as his favorites. He doesn't know, but I saw him put dark, glowing lodestones in the totems around the village to give his chosen power.

Dark power radiates from them. The power smells wrong. Not like Nalorakk.

Our guardian bears get agitated and upset near them. They can smell it too!

We must cleanse the camp. Get rid of those totems!
91748.completion:
I don't know what this fake bear is planning.

But it's better that his lodestones are destroyed.

91749.title: It's Just Not Right
91749.objectives: Stop the Chief and recover the false gifts.
91749.description:
