A shame the tools didn't survive. Our researchers could have used them to improve our Singularity Anchor.

92694.title: Dusk Among Pigments
92694.objectives: Speak with Orn'shan in Amirdrassil Roots.
92694.description:
As Zur'ashar, our oath is to safeguard the harmony within the visions and the histories we preserve.

Yet Orn'shan's crude strokes are reckless. Their creative impulses lack refinement, disturbing the balance we are sworn to protect. In a misguided attempt at creativity, they've created uncontrollable chaos and are distorting the very truths they sought to record.

Perhaps they will heed the words of an outsider before their reputation collapses entirely.
92694.completion: Are you here to ridicule me as well?

92695.title: The Stroke of Storms
92695.objectives: Use the visionstone to enter the painting and restore harmony.
92695.description:
I... I don't think I can mend this. The Zur'ashar were right. I am no true paintmaker. I cannot even capture history properly within my own memories... how could I ever hope to honor it in moments that matter?

I thought I could create something beautiful... something worthy. I was foolish to try.

Can you... can you help me clean this mess? I... I have no hope left to do it myself.
92695.progress:
I fear I ruined everything.

Have you been able to undo the destruction I brought upon this vision?
92695.completion: You actually did it? If an outsider can clean up my chaos, perhaps my work isn't a lost cause after all.

92696.title: Colors Born Anew
92696.objectives: Collect ingredients for Orn'shan from the Shrouded Grove.
92696.description:
Outsider... thank you. I'm still shaken... but I can feel a small spark returning. I'd nearly abandoned my work entirely, yet your kindness... it has steadied me.

I think I finally see what I'm meant to create: something meaningful that honors the Zur'ashar tradition through my voice, but to begin, I need the raw essence of color itself.

Will you help me collect the ingredients I need? I'd be looking for anything I can use to turn into paint.
92696.progress: Have you collected the ingredients I need?
92696.completion: Every pigment, every scrap of inspiration, will bring this idea to life, and I couldn't do it without you.

92697.title: Hues of Tomorrow
92697.objectives: Paint Pictures for Orn'Shan in Amirdrassil Roots.
92697.description:
I... never expected to feel this again. Your help has given me hope. These ingredients feel right, and maybe even enough.

I want you to be the first to paint. Do not fret over perfection. Paint what you feel, and I'll capture its essence into the memory I preserve.

I look forward to see what you create.
92697.progress: Have you put paint to stone and watched your creativity flow?
92697.completion:
You've reminded me that creation isn't just about skill: it's about daring to try, imagination, and expression. Even though my work differs from the other Zur'ashar painters, it still has worth.

I need to learn to believe in myself again, and to slowly hone my craft.

Thank you.. for helping me see possibility where I only saw failure.

I am eager, yet cautious, to begin my next piece. Perhaps this time, it will be something worthy of the name I carry.

92713.title: Echoes Rekindled
92713.objectives: Select a relic to experience once again.
92713.description:
The relics you restored still hum with the visions you once walked.

Their stories yearn to be lived again, and each retelling leaves the world just a little richer than before.

Return them to the shrines, let the memories flow, and I shall place in your hands a reward for one who walks the paths of legend.

92716.title: The Story of Wey'nan's Ward
92716.objectives: Travel to the indicated shrine in Harandar to meditate and experience the history of Wey'nan's Ward.
92716.description:
You have walked this path before, {NAME}, yet the Vale of Secrets stirs anew.

The Visionstone awaits, its sacred paintings familiar to your eyes, the handprint at its heart calling for you again.
Press your hand upon it once more and let your spirit be known. The trance will take you as before, carrying your soul through visions whose truths still shift with every telling.

Return to me with what new wisdom the echoes grant you.
92716.progress: Tell me, {NAME},  what new truths did the past reveal this time?
92716.completion:
Once again you bring me a tale, and even in its retelling I find colors I had not seen before. I will set it into paint beside the first, so that our people may witness every shade of the legend.

Accept this, in gratitude for tending the flame of our history.

I will keep searching the archives, listening for relics whose stories call out to be walked again. Return when the whispers reach you.

92719.title: The Story of the Cauldron of Echoes
92719.objectives: Travel to the Glade of Walking Memories in Harandar to learn the history of the Cauldron of Echoes.
92719.description:
Once more, the Cauldron of Echoes stirs.

When I first walked the path of the Zur'Ashar, my master spoke of its place at our beginning. Even they could not grasp its full meaning. Now, it beckons again.

Step into its quiet and draw forth what the ages have hidden. Bring me the truth as it speaks to you this time.
92719.completion:
Again, Sai'alyo's shadow takes on new form in your telling, and our history bends toward clarity.

Take this token, as thanks for walking the spiral with me once more.

I will keep listening in the archives for relics whose silence is ready to break. When the world whispers again, find your way back to me.

92720.title: The Story of Aln'hara's Bloom
92720.objectives: Travel to Veilroot Clearing and uncover the truth behind Aln'hara's Bloom.
92720.description:
The bloom still waits, its stillness carrying the same quiet call you once followed.

Yet the bloom's story deepens with each telling. Walk its path again, let the stillness speak anew, and see what more the goddess chooses to share.
92720.completion:
Again you return with a truth wrapped in gentleness. Aln'hara's voice lingers in the pause between heartbeats, and each time you listen, a new note enters the song.

Accept this, in thanks for tending the quiet places where memory grows.

92721.title: The Story of the Echoless Flame
92721.objectives: Travel to the Verdant Sepulcher in Harandar to learn the history of the Echoless Flame.
92721.description:
The Echoless Flame rests as you left it, yet the air around it stirs once more.

You have walked Obayo's path before, felt the echo of that first Shul'ka's purpose. But the past is a shifting thing, and the Flame's silence may yet hide verses you have not heard.

Return to its vigil. Follow Obayo's steps again, and let the vision show you what remains untold.
92721.progress: Tell me, {NAME}, what new light did the flame cast for you this time?
92721.completion:
Again the Flame yields its truth to you, and again the tale twists in the telling. Morta'ka the Sundered Echo looms no less large, yet fresh details sharpen the memory and deepen the weight of what was lost.

Take this with my thanks for stoking the embers of a story long gone cold. When next the silence breaks, we will be ready to listen together.

92722.title: The Story of Russula's Outreach
92722.objectives: Travel to the Verdant Sepulcher to learn the history of Russula's Outreach.
92722.description:
The spear still waits where you last left it, pale threads of mushroom slowly weaving new patterns into its grain.

The culling grounds draw you again. Walk their softened paths, follow what spores still rise, and let the visions show what time has chosen to reveal this season.
92722.progress: What shape did the tale take this time? Tell me, and we will fold this telling into the many before it.
92722.completion:
You have tended the memory well, {NAME}.

Take this token of thanks. When the land calls -- as it always does -- return. Even mercy has layers yet to be uncovered.

92724.title: The Story of the Root of the World
92724.objectives: Travel to the Vale of Secrets to learn the history of the Root of the World.
92724.description:
The Root of the World stands as it did before--ancient, unbowed--yet the soil breathes differently today. Beneath your feet, the pulse of Harandar quickens, as though eager to share another verse of its oldest story.

You have seen through Ruilla the Huntress's eyes once before. But the Rootways are never walked the same way twice. Go again, and let the land decide which truths it will show you now.
92724.progress: And so the Root yielded another fragment? Tell me, what shade of truth did it whisper this time?
92724.completion:
Once more the Root speaks through Ruilla's memory, and once more the lesson comes wrapped in both pride and sorrow. She remains the first Rootwarden, the first to walk those hidden ways, but fresh details now cling to her legend like moss to stone.

Your return is a gift to the land as much as to me, {NAME}. When the soil shifts again beneath your steps, we will listen together.

92725.title: The Story of Sky's Hope
92725.objectives: Travel to the Shrouded Grove in Harandar to learn the history of Sky's Hope.
92725.description:
Sky's Hope rests in its cradle as before, yet the heavens above seem sharper tonight.

You have traced Awe'ohna's path once, but the tale shifts with every telling. Walk the path again, and perhaps the sky will tilt just so, revealing a truth you missed before.
92725.completion:
Again the sky has turned in your favor, {NAME}, and again Awe'ohna's story greets you with both clarity and mystery.

When the firmament stirs once more, I trust you'll be ready to walk under it with me again.

92728.title: Dogged Disturbances
92728.objectives: Kill 8 Rowdy Elementals in Thalassian University.
92728.description:
That dog! It ran through here and disrupted every lesson on the schedule. Now there are fire elementals everywhere and my students are ill-prepared to handle this mess. How am I supposed to teach in all of this chaos?

You look capable--would you clear out some of these rowdy little elementals? The sooner we get this situation under control, the better!
92728.progress: Have you gotten those rowdy little sparks under control?
92728.completion: Thank you for your assistance! My students should be able to handle the rest of them after a few quick lessons. We'll just call this a learning opportunity.

92729.title: Hounded and Hassled
92729.objectives: Speak to Magistrix Zaedana in Thalassian University.
92729.description:
Gilneas and Kul Tiras are both known for their hunting hounds. With the resurgence of elfhounds in Silvermoon, I thought perhaps they could be similarly utilized. They're dogs, after all. How hard could training possibly be?

Long story short, that dog made a mess and dashed off. I have to clean this up. 

Would you please find that creature and bring him back to me before the local canine cafe has my head? I only borrowed him for the day!
92729.completion: A dog? Yes I've seen a dog--look at this place! Just look at what he's done!

92732.title: Light Disturbance
92732.objectives: Go to the disturbance Hannan's scout found.
92732.description:
We have had victories against the Lightbloom, but Alndust is rare. Until we can gather more, the Lightbloom continues its spread. Our forces are stretched too thin to watch their every movement.

A scout spotted a strange corpse by the road to the east, along with a report of a general disturbance of the light-cursed creatures. I can't look into both at once. Could you find that corpse while I investigate deeper into the Encroaching Bloom?
92732.completion: <This corpse appears to be covered with Lightbloom spores and was fighting recently. It must be what the scout saw.>

92736.title: Light Stroll
92736.description: <These potatoad creatures are seldom seen near the Lightbloom. It is covered in spores and looks like it was trying to escape. You should search for more clues.>
92736.completion:
This herd was seized recently--the signs you discovered make that clear. This encroachment is pressing into untainted lands, and the herds could be depleted beyond recovery.

I appreciate your help, but there is more that must be done.

92737.title: Light Carnage
92737.description:
The Lightbloom has infected many of these potatoads and spurred them into a frenzy. They spread the spores and reproduce at a dangerous rate.

If we don't act, we will be overrun. Will you cull this heard while I search for the source of the corruption?
92737.progress: We must protect Harandar's natural species from this invasive growth.
92737.completion: It is a shame to destroy the creatures of Harandar, but sometimes it must be done to protect the land.

92738.title: Potatoad Tots
92738.objectives: Collect 8 Lightspored Potadpoles and bring them to Hannan.
92738.description:
It is too late for the adults, but the young may still be saved. If you can capture them, we can remove the spores before they take root.

Gather up the spore covered potadpoles and bring them to me. I will take them to Har'alnor myself to purge this Lightbloom.

Do not let their first breaths be their last. Please, {NAME}: save the babies.
92738.completion: You have saved so many. The balance of the land may still stand thanks to your efforts.

92739.title: O.K. Bloomer
92739.objectives: Kill the creature spreading these spores.
92739.description:
I have discovered the lair of a cunning creature I call Adzikel. With luck, this name will soon be forgotten. 

Adzikel sneaks into the potatoad nests to steal their young, and plants the Lightbloom spores to accelerate their growth into the frenzied toads, which spread more spores.

For the little ones to have a chance, I must return to Har'alnor, but you have earned the right to slay this beast. Go with honor, and finish the hunt!
92739.completion:
The Lightbloom is persistent, but so are you. Aln'hara's lands and creatures remain thanks to your efforts.

The young are being restored to their natural habitat, freed of the spores--all of them except this one. It is too small for the wild.

It will need a caregiver, and I think it has bonded to you.

92864.title: Drift Them Away
92864.objectives: Slay 8 Cascade Drifters and remove 5 Drifter Egg Sacks from the cascades at Nordrassil Roots.
92864.description:
With the hydras hunted out of the area, the drifter population in the cascades to the west is on the rise. Egg sacks are making the water murky and undrinkable, and the drifters are becoming very territorial.

We must ensure that the reintroduction of the hydras will succeed. We need to cull the number of drifters and clear some of their egg sacks.

You look like someone capable of doing this task. Will you help me?
92864.completion: It pains me to cull the drifter population. However, if left unchecked, their numbers would have led to the collapse of the ecosystem.

92865.title: Feeding the Buds
92865.objectives: Collect 4 Chloroceros Buds from the Violet Chloroceros, then feed them to the Hydra Budlings in Har'athir.
92865.description:
The orchid hydra's favorite food is the violet chloroceros--especially the buds on the bull's back.

With the hydras gone for so long, the violet chloroceros grazed too much of the fauna. Soon, there will only be mud in that once lush and beautiful part of Harandar.

I want to introduce my hydras to their primary source of food, and I would appreciate it if you could bring me four of those buds.
92865.progress: The precious budlings will be very happy with their first taste of the chloroceros buds.
92865.completion: The budlings seem to be satiated for now. I am comfortable moving to the second phase of reintroducing them to their natural habitat.

92866.title: Re-Hydra-ted
92866.objectives: Place the budlings in the marked areas.
92866.description:
With the previous tasks done, it is time to reintroduce the budlings to the wilds.

I have marked suitable locations to place the budlings. The little hydras will be an easy pick, so expect predators to attack you.

I am sad to see them go. However, I know it is for the ecosystem's and their own good.
92866.progress: How are my budlings doing? Precious babies that they are.
92866.completion:
You are back, and the feeling is bittersweet. On one hand, I have lost my babies, but on the other, I know it is for the best. I could go and visit them... or maybe I shouldn't, considering they would be unruly and four times my size.

Regardless, thank you for your help. I will never forget this kindness.

92868.title: He Went Thataway
92868.objectives: Speak to Drathen in the Bazaar.
92868.description:
You've been invaluable, {NAME}. As for that little menace, after he was done wreaking havoc here, I didn't really pay attention to where he went next. I'm sure you'll find him eventually. 

Let's hope you do before he wrecks half the city, hmm?
92868.completion: A dog? Yes I've seen a dog, just look at what that monster's done to the pond!

92869.title: Fishy Dis-pondencies
92869.objectives: Return 8 Coy Sunwhisker to the pond in the Bazaar.
92869.description: That dog tore right through the pond and sent half the sunwhiskers flying right out of the water! Quickly, get them back in the pond before they perish!
92869.completion: Your methods were... interesting, but I cannot deny the results. The sunwhiskers may be a little shaken up, but they'll recover soon enough now that they're back in the water where they belong. My thanks.

92870.title: Scoot Along Now
92870.objectives: Catch Lil' Scoots and return him to Ranger Telenus.
92870.description:
That dog! The last I saw he was tearing through the pond. I didn't see where he went, but he has to be nearby!

His barks... they haunt me...
92870.completion:
Lil' Scoots! Welcome back, you fuzzy menace. Thank you, champion. I'll return him to the cafe posthaste.

As for training... I think I shall stick to the local lynx. Far better manners.

92882.title: A Hunter's Plight
92882.objectives: Ketan wants you to talk to Elder Akazi about the Ka'dani trials.
92882.description:
I am desperate enough to ask an outsider for help.

To join the Ka'dani, the elite hunters of Har'athir, you must complete a ritual under the guidance of an experienced Ka'dani. However, there are none left to guide me, so I cannot take the trial.

But I have heard words of your actions. Maybe Akazi, the Ka'dani Elder, would let you stand as my guide. You may not know the ritual, but you know the hunt.

Please, let us speak to Elder Akazi. We must try.
92882.progress: Ketan tells me that you wish to mentor him. Is this true?
92882.completion:
I will give you my blessing, {NAME}. Although you are not a Ka'dani, tales of your prowess precede you. Your skills in the hunt need no introduction.

I know that you will be able to give Ketan the guidance he needs.

You will both take part in the Ka'dani trials: you as an honorary Ka'dani, and Ketan as your trainee.

92883.title: A Hunter's Duty
92883.objectives: Hunt down beasts around Har'athir and collect materials to forge a Ka'dani weapon.
92883.description:
At the start of the trial, the mentor and trainee gather materials to forge a hunting weapon.

The weapon is more than an extension of the Ka'dani-- it's part of their being. There is no other weapon like it, as each is unique.

You will help Ketan hunt and gather the materials and decorations, as well as a gift for the weaponsmith.
92883.progress: Were you able to get everything? I know some of the required materials can be hard to gather.
92883.completion:
These look pristine.

Thank you for doing this for me. Maybe one day I will be able to do the same for someone else.

92884.title: A Hunter's Weapon
92884.objectives: Help Al'yaat forge the Ka'dani weapon, then deliver it to Elder Akazi.
92884.description:
Forging the Ka'dani weapon is a crucial moment in the trial. We will have to follow Al'yaat's instructions.

Once Al'yaat forges the weapon, you will bring it to Elder Akazi.

There will be a short ceremony where he will hand me the weapon. The ceremony concludes with the elder announcing our final task.

I shouldn't let the excitement take the better of me, but one thing at a time. We must be patient and calculated as if we were on a hunt.
92884.progress: Forging a Ka'dani weapon is not an easy feat. A master craftsman must use the very best materials brought by the mentor and trainee.
92884.completion:
<Elder Akazi inspects the Ka'dani spear and nods.>

{NAME}, you have proven to be a worthy mentor. Ketan deserves this weapon as much as it deserves Ketan.

The two of you have one more task before this journey comes to an end.

92885.title: A Hunter's Prey
92885.objectives: Hunt down the great Radooni, then return to Elder Akazi.
92885.description:
The last trial stands before you. Together, you have forged a weapon that will fell any beast, but the weapon is nothing without the hunter.

Since you are not a Ka'dani, I present you with a difficult hunt. Ketan and you will hunt down and slay a prey known to all Har'athir hunters: the great Radooni. The beast ventured too close to Har'athir and should be a suitable hunt.

Return to me once your hunt is complete and Radooni's sap is on the spear.
92885.completion: I see now that your presence here and Ketan's perseverance were set by the goddess herself. I am impressed by your actions and resolve. Thanks to you, Ketan's path is clear.

92890.title: A Handful of Voidlight Marl
92890.objectives: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.
92890.completion: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.

92891.title: A Cluster of Voidlight Marl
92891.objectives: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.
92891.completion: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.

92892.title: A Trove of Voidlight Marl
92892.objectives: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.
92892.completion: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.

92939.title: It's Not Just a Rock!
92939.objectives: Collect 6 Ancient Rubble from monsters in the Storm Fields.
92939.description:
$p, I have something strange, here.

While scouting in the Storm Fields, I found this rock a beast was chewing. Look at it! Could these be runes? Writing?

But so ancient? Here? What could it mean?

Strangely, I think I've been hearing a voice in my head since I found this thing...

We must investigate further. Maybe we can find more of this rubble in the bellies of those beasts?
92939.progress: Why are these beasts even eating these rocks?
92939.completion:
Yes, you found more rubble!

Have you noticed the runes carved on these rocks emanate Void? Creatures of Voidstorm seem to have an endless hunger for that magic.

So, I think these beasts are eating the Void in these runes. At least, that makes the most sense.

92944.title: Sifting Through Void
92944.objectives: Jump in the Stellar Vortexes in the Storm Fields and collect 10 Anomalous Residue.
92944.description:
There's no rubble on the surface. The beasts are burrowing, so they must be finding it in a cavern underground.

I've been thinking of how to get there.

You've noticed the vortexes that dot the Storm Fields? They twist space, moving things from place to place.

Step through one and I can reveal the anomalous residue that surrounds them.

Collect the residue and I can make a spell to redirect the portal to where the source of the rubble is!
92944.progress: I had some suspicion about these runes not being domanaar or ethereal. The specter all but confirms my thoughts. This could be something different. Maybe even a civilization!
92944.completion:
Did you hear that? This world was called Predacea!

What a revelation!

92946.title: Buried in the Dark
92946.objectives: Jump into the northernmost Stellar Vortex in the Storm Fields and investigate the cave beyond.
92946.description:
We're at the brink of a monumental discovery! Hurry, there's no time to even call for backup. We must find this strange spirit!

With this residue, I can make a spell to adjust the vortex. It'll lead us to the source of this engraved rubble.

Based on the specter's guidance, I believe we'll find an entire cave.

Be ready, $p.
92946.completion:
If this specter and his tablets are to be believed, this world was once thriving with multiple civilizations.

Just like on Azeroth, they fought endless wars. They asked Akintunde for a weapon to end all wars, and he delivered... by making one that ended everything.

92948.title: In Over My Head
92948.objectives: Step into the Northernmost Stellar Vortex in the Stormfields to confront Akitunde the Unstoppable.
92948.description:
Akintunde created a weapon to end all intelligent life on this world, eons and eons ago?

I hardly believe it.

But truth or lie, we can't leave this spirit be. He's clearly dangerous.

If he truly knows how to create such a weapon, we can't let him contact anyone from Azeroth. We both know a few warmongers who would do anything for that kind of power...

I think I can realign the vortex again to take us directly to Akintunde. Ready yourself for a fight, $p.
92948.progress: I sensed no remorse at all from him. How could that be?
92948.completion:
Forgive me, {NAME}. That all happened so quickly.

Was any of it even true? But what else could that spirit have been?

An entire world... civilizations that used to thrive right where we stand? Could that really be?

I can tell you only one thing for certain. 

This will haunt me for the rest of my days.

93093.title: Gnarldin Trophies
93093.objectives: Recover 35 trophies from gnarldin and their allies.
93093.description:
I was sent here to prove dat I am ready to be an Amani warrior. All dat want de honor must prove demselves.

I chose de gnarldin since dey are close now, and I heard Zul'jarra softened dem up a little.

Looks like I wasn't de only one who thought dat and was wrong.

But I still need to collect as many trophies from de gnarldin as possible.

If I have de bigshot hash'ura helpin' me, there's no way I can lose, no?

You get de trophies. I will stay behind to watch our backs.
93093.progress: Did you get de trophies? De gnarldin have plenty of dem from all their fightin'.
93093.completion: Dat... dat is a lot of trophies there, hash'ura.

93094.title: Scavenged Victory
93094.objectives: Recover 6 Hunter's Tablets from fallen Amani.
93094.description:
Many warriors have chosen to face de gnarldin since dey came to Zul'Aman, but many have failed.

Dey thought now dat de gnarldin are in our territory and weakened, dey would be easier...

De gnarldin hunters have collected tablets from de Amani hunters dat fell here.

But with you at my side, we can get "vengeance" for those dat lost their lives here--no killin' or life riskin' required.

We don't have to kill de gnarldin. We just have to get close enough to gather de tablets. What do you say?
93094.progress: With those tablets, no one can question our strength!
93094.completion:
Dis is plenty!

All of dem were actually dead... right?

93095.title: Bitter Fury
93095.objectives: Steal Tusk Taker's Taken Tusk Trophy to lure her out, then defeat her.
93095.description:
De leader of de gnarldin here is known as Tusk Taker. Take a wild guess why she's named dat.

There is a trophy dis one has in a cave. Take it, and she will run out rarin' for a fight.

Defeat her for me, and no one can challenge my right to be an Amani warrior.
93095.progress: Did you kill Tusk Taker yet?
93095.completion:
Hah! Tusk Taker is dead!

De others will see me as a true Amani warrior now--when I tell them I took all de trophies that killed Tusk Taker.

93096.title: Amani Honor
93096.objectives: Meet Kel'vujo at the meeting point to receive your reward from Huntmaster Jinki.
93096.description:
Dat is all de trophies we need.

I'll take dem to de meetin' point nearby. All we gotta do is wait there for Huntmaster Jinki to show up.

Come!
93096.completion:
Dis is a shameful fate for Kel'vujo, but one dat he chose.

You, hash'ura, have proven once again to be strong. 

Take dis as thanks for helpin' to weed out de weak and unfit from our warriors.

93171.title: Calling All Combatants!
93171.objectives: Follow up on the advertisement with Mirvedon at Falconwing Square in Silvermoon City.
93171.description:
<You read a nearby advertisement...>

Run, don't walk!

The Artisan's Consortium has teamed up with local Silvermoon artisans in Falconwing Square to offer a new selection of heraldries and crafted equipment. These are certified for use in arenas and battlegrounds, guaranteed!

Head on down and look for Mirvedon to receive your free sample today.

Act now while supplies last! Terms and conditions apply.

-Aisha
93171.completion:
<Mirvedon clears his throat.>

Take these heraldries straight over to the Crafting Order station to get a custom piece. Anything you make with these will keep you safe while crossing swords in the battlegrounds. If you ever want more heraldies I've got what you need.

For a price this time, of course.

93178.title: A Quiet Walk Interrupted
93178.objectives: Help Nerunda find Kanza's whereabouts in Zul'Aman.
93178.description:
It is de hash'ura! De favored of our wily loa! Maybe you can help...

My father, Oban, is ill and I have been givin' him all my attention.

When I turned my back an hour ago, my daughter, Kanza, had run off!

I searched de village, but I can't go further and leave my father behind.

Please, find where she went? She can be on her own, but she's a sensitive girl, and I don't want her goin' far.

Dat fool boy Haz'kel wouldn't come down, but he may have seen her leave. Ask him first.
93178.progress:
I'm so worried about Kanza!

She shouldn't be on her own.
93178.completion:
What was she doin' out past de log bridge? I told her not to go there.

And with my basket and our best tea kettle?

Oh... oh, no. She wouldn't! And alone?

93179.title: Childlike Devotion
93179.objectives: Find Kanza at the Shrine of Filo.
93179.description:
She's goin' to Filo's shrine. She's too old for dat. She's almost thirteen--an adult.

Filo is de Loa of Childhood and protects children. Parents pray to Filo for healthy children.

It is even said if a child dies, Filo waits with a child in de afterlife until their parents claim dem.

Dat is superstition, but dat's why she's goin'.

We lost her twin, Janaka. She must think she's with Filo.

The way to Filo's shrine is dangerous, and dat loa won't speak to her. Do what you can to bring her home!
93179.completion:
<You do not want to take the child back by force, but perhaps you can persuade her by to listen to you by helping her with what she is trying to accomplish here.

Judging by the items arrayed before Filo's shrine, she is preparing some sort of ritual.

Perhaps if you help her with the ritual, she may go with you--or go home on her own.>

93180.title: Shrine Preparations
93180.objectives: Follow Kanza and help her by killing 4 Stinger Matriarchs, 6 Stinger Hatchlings, and by collecting 20 Thorncaps.
93180.description:
<Kanza makes no sound but briefly meets your gaze. She points off toward the hot spring pools.

Maybe she wants you to do something there?>
93180.progress: <Kanza shifts her weight from foot to foot, swaying impatiently.>
93180.completion:
<Kanza claps and jumps up and down excitedly.

But she pulls at your sleeve and makes an arcing motion with her hand, pointing into the far distance.

There is something else she wants you to do.>

93181.title: Temple and a Teapot
93181.objectives: Buy a teapot from a vendor in nearby Camp Stonewash and help Kanza start the ritual.
93181.description:
<Kanza is dancing with excitement.

She holds her small hand with one finger up.

One last thing to do.

You must almost be ready for the ritual to summon Filo--if that is indeed what she is asking for your help to do.

She fishes in her tunic for something and presents an object to you: the broken handle of a teapot, presumably from the one she dropped on the way here.

Perhaps she needs a substitute?>
93181.completion:
I had to see her.

Just one more time.

93182.title: Healing Homeward
93182.objectives: Return to Nerunda in Witherbark Bluffs and check if Kanza returned home.
93182.completion:
I don't know what you did or what de loa did, but I got my Kanza back and more.

She is talkin' again like she used to. More even. She never talked a lot.

And I'm goin' to make her a place where she feels safe to keep talkin' to me.

93257.title: Revantusk at Risk
93257.description:
Fishers of de forest tribes constantly talk to each other about our hauls, and none are more legendary than de river-walking Revantusk and their crabs! But...

I've heard they've fallen on hard times. First, de Twilight's Blade ransacked their city. Now, their cages aren't bringing in enough meat for de refugees.

De Revantusk have a new head river-walker, Kahanea, who could use an extra set of hands in taking care of dis crab problem.

You up to de task, outsider?
93257.completion:
So word of our famine has spread?

<Kahanea grimaces.>

There is no denying it.

93258.title: Crab Clues
93258.objectives: Investigate the lakeshore for causes of the food shortage.
93258.description:
De rumors are true. No matter what we try, we aren't netting as many crabs as before. And de ones we do catch taste wrong, even making some of my people sick!

I succeeded my mother's position as head river-walker after losing her to de Twilight's Blade. Dealing with dis famine, my new duties, and my grief... It's so much for me to bear.

Dis is de area where we first noticed an issue with our crabs. Can you investigate for me while I make more traps?
93258.progress: I must make dis right--for my people. For my mother. I wish she could give us guidance.
93258.completion:
Void-tainted bodies and baskets? And some crazed crabs ambushed you? Dis is getting worse!

Nak'tek found de Void polluting baskets upriver, just like what you found down here along de lakeshore. De Void ties all of our clues together! Let's follow that lead.

93259.title: Clobbering Crawlers
93259.objectives: Harvest 10 pieces of Mouthwatering Crab Meat from the crabs upriver.
93259.description:
While I continue to scout de area for causes of dis famine, please harvest crab meat for our refugees. Their hunger only gets worse as our investigation goes on.

Since de traps aren't working, you have to hunt those crabs yourself and get food straight from de source!

Make sure you're getting healthy meat, though. I'm worried about some of those crabs being infected with de Void.
93259.progress: My people have been through so much. Everyone deserves a warm home to return to, and a hearty meal to restore their strength and spirit.
93259.completion: Dis is more meat than we've seen in a week! My people will be grateful for an actual meal. You have my gratitude.

93260.title: Caging Crawlers
93260.description:
Our traps being mucked up with de Void would explain why we've been catching fewer crabs! And why some of de crabs have made our people sick.

Please clean our traps upriver! Based on Nak'tek's report, de infected crabs sound dangerous... so be careful approaching those traps.

You can find de baskets nestled among de sticks or by bases of waterfalls--dey provide a natural disguise! Crabs are easily tricked dat way.
93260.progress: Were you able to clean any of de traps? Or find a source of de filth gumming them up?
93260.completion:
Those shards you found must've caused de Void pollution clogging our traps. I'm glad you removed them! De river looks much cleaner, and our trap count is back to normal... for now.

May these baskets receive Nalorakk's blessing and provide for de Revantusk once more.

93261.title: A Crab of Unusual Size
93261.objectives: Defeat the Mania-Crab and remove the source of its corruption.
93261.description:
I followed de Void pollution trail upriver and spotted a beast before it ran off to its cave: an enormous, void-addled crab. It was shedding those shards dat were polluting de river!

As long as dis beast lives, it'll keep spreading pollution and infecting crabs with de Void. It must be stopped!

I'd stay and fight, but I must warn everyone at de Overlook.

Please, {NAME}. Slay dat crab and remove de source of its corruption before it can hurt more of my people!
93261.progress: I don't know if de Twilight's Blade created dat beast or not, but it needs to GO!
93261.completion:
So de Twilight's Blade hasn't just hurt de Revantusk, but our wildlife as well? We must keep an eye on de cultists and protect Nalorakk's Prowl from their pollution!

De health of our people and our crabs is my top priority. Seeing my people starve under my watch filled me with rage, and guilt... like I was tarnishing my mother's memory as head river-walker.

Your aid has helped me become de leader my river-walkers need.

Thank you, {NAME}. You're forever welcome with de Revantusk.

93372.title: Delver's Call: Shadow Enclave
93372.objectives: Complete the Shadow Enclave delve on any difficulty.
93372.description: The perfidious cultists of the Twilight's Blade have infiltrated Eversong and set up their horrid operations in a nearby cavern. Clear them out before they spread any further!

93384.title: Delver's Call: Collegiate Calamity
93384.objectives: Complete the Collegiate Calamity delve on any difficulty.
93384.description:
The arcane tome, clearly agitated by something, bears the mark of Silvermoon's Thalassian University.

It could be worth investigating.
93384.progress: Is something amiss at the university?
93384.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. The situation was hardly conducive to study.

93385.title: Delver's Call: The Darkway
93385.objectives: Complete The Darkway delve on any difficulty.
93385.description:
Remnants of the Twilight's Blade scurry like rats through the Arcway tunnels beneath Suramar.

Exterminate the vermin before they spread.
93385.completion: Thank you for that, {NAME}. Such magic is not for their kind.

93386.title: Delver's Call: Parhelion Plaza
93386.objectives: Complete the Parhelion Plaza delve on any difficulty.
93386.description: Adventurers! Quel'Danas is once more under attack by the Void, and any who are able to provide assistance should head to the battlements of Parhelion Plaza to help stem the tide.
93386.progress: The Void is relentless. Be cautious.
93386.completion: Perhaps one day Silvermoon will know peace again.

93396.title: Bursting at the Seams
93396.objectives: Help Kifaan check on his sister's well-being.
93396.description:
Veraan... alive...

<Kifaan shakes his head in disbelief.>

I've spent countless hours running this moment through my head, but now that it's here, I find myself grasping for words...

The Shadowguard attempted to raise Dimensius to power... they've sworn fealty to Xal'atath as she wages war on worlds. Am I supposed to just... pretend none of that happened? Is THAT what my oaths to family require?

And what of Veraan? Does she regret her involvement?

I should check on her.
93396.completion:
I've been focusing on my own feelings so much that I never stopped to think about how Veraan might feel.

I may not have fared any better had they pumped ME full of Void.

93409.title: Delver's Call: Atal'Aman
93409.objectives: Complete the Atal'Aman delve on any difficulty.
93409.description: <The fallen scout's body bears terrible wounds, but still clutches tightly to a report detailing an imminent Vilebranch attack on Atal'Aman.>
93409.completion: Good. They should learn to stay in their holes.

93410.title: Delver's Call: Twilight Crypts
93410.objectives: Complete the Twilight Crypts delve on any difficulty.
93410.description:
The ancient Amani crypts near the Broken Throne have been overrun.

Clear them of interlopers before the dead within can be defiled further.
93410.completion: One day Zul'Aman will be free of their taint.

93416.title: Delver's Call: The Gulf of Memory
93416.objectives: Complete the Gulf of Memory delve on any difficulty.
93416.description:
Rumors of disturbances in the Gulf of Memory have begun to spread.

Deal with the issue before it can take root.
93416.completion: Thank you, {NAME}, for nipping that in the bud.

93421.title: Delver's Call: The Grudge Pit
93421.objectives: Complete The Grudge Pit delve on any difficulty.
93421.description:
<This moldy hanging has been crudely painted over to depict one fungarian hitting another with what looks to be a chair.>

See big fight. Best fight!

Grudge Pit. Be there!
93421.completion:
Good fight? Yes.

Best fight? Maybe!

93427.title: Delver's Call: Sunkiller Sanctum
93427.objectives: Complete the Sunkiller Sanctum delve on any difficulty.
93427.description:
<A note is pinned to the slain voidwalker.>

Sunkiller Sanctum is a den of Xal'atath's most pathetic sycophants.

I encourage any mercenaries, adventurers, or general do-gooders who happen upon this bounty to pay it a visit and dispense the justice you are all so happy to talk on and on about.

 - Perodius
93427.completion:
Your fee, {class}.

That will teach them to rebuff a perfectly good bribe in the future.

93428.title: Delver's Call: Shadowguard Point
93428.objectives: Complete the Shadowguard Point delve on any difficulty.
93428.description:
Witness the fates of those who bend their neck to Xal'atath.

I issue a challenge to any creature of Void or flesh. Pursue the nearby ethereals and dispatch anyone who serves the so-called Harbinger.

 - Perodius
93428.progress: Have you come to me for a reason, {class}?
93428.completion:
For services rendered.

If only all mortals were as helpful as you.

93499.title: Enshrouded in Arenas
93499.objectives: Obtain Honor in Rated Arenas while in a Party.
93499.description: An important test to being a strong warrior is coordinating with others in combat. Find fellow combatants to join you in battle in the arena.

93502.title: Enshrouded Solo
93502.description: Independence is key to excel in battle. Display your solo capabilities in then come back to me.

93503.title: Enshrouded in Teamwork
93503.objectives: Obtain Honor in Rated Battleground Blitz or in Rated Battlegrounds.
93503.description: The ability to work with a group to take objectives is key in training. Practice this on the battlefield.
93503.completion: Great work! You have earned these.

93504.title: Enshrouded in Skirmishes
93504.description: Practice makers perfect. A great place to practice is with others like yourself looking to practice. Set off and find others like yourself to practice small-scale skirmishes, then return to me.

93505.title: Enshrouded in War
93505.description: Large conflicts get you to take a look at the larger picture. Give it a try then come back to me.

93506.title: Enshrouded in Battle
93506.description: You can learn a lot on the battlefield on your own. Go ahead and see what you observe.
93506.completion: It pays off to have an open mind! Take this for your time.

93519.title: Midnight Delves!
93519.description:
Things are starting to get interesting in Delves.

Come see me in Silvermoon.
93519.completion: We've got a lot to discuss.

93586.title: Conditional - Multiple Objectives, Non Sequenced
93586.objectives: Recover 1 trophies from gnarldin and their allies.
93586.description:
I be sent out here ta prove dat I can be an amani warrior.

Dis trial needs me ta collect as many trophies from dese gnarldin as possible. 

De two of us should work together! I be helpin' you get recognized as an amani warrior, yeah?

Just go out dere and get as many trophies from de gnarldin as possible. 

I be stayin' behind ta watch our backs, eh?

93667.title: Camp Stonewash
93667.objectives: Find Amaxi outside Camp Stonewash in Zul'Aman.
93667.description:
You're not the first strange thing I've seen today.

<Scout Zel'kanra shakes her head.>

Saw a big, shelled creature along the path to Jan'Alor. Amaxi took a bunch of scouts and went after it.

They've been gone a while. Think you could check in on them?
93667.completion:
Who are you? What are you doing here?

<Amaxi tenses, but relaxes after a moment.>

Shadebasin sent you. Yes, we're fine. But these tortollan should not be here!

93697.title: Shimmering Melodies
93697.objectives: Collect 20 Eversinging Dust and deliver it to Dolothos in Silvermoon.
93697.description:
Have you heard it? The magic of Eversong. It emanates a subtle melody, if you listen closely enough. The complex interwoven strands of magic move against each other and create a beautiful harmony.

The dust distilled from such magic is exceptionally potent. Bring some to me and I will show you its uses.
93697.completion: This dust is of exceptional quality! Come, I will show you some techniques that make use of it.

93698.title: Splintered Radiance
93698.objectives: Collect 10 Radiant Shards and deliver it to Dolothos in Silvermoon.
93698.description:
When captured at just the right moment, the power exuding from an object can be crystallized into splinters of raw magical energy. The result is dazzling, like beams of sunlight splitting as they stream through a window.

Bring me some of these shards. My work cannot continue without them.
93698.progress: A few shards should be sufficient.
93698.completion: Oh, they glow with such wonderful power! These should do nicely.

93699.title: A Ray of Sunlight
93699.objectives: Collect 1 Dawn Crystal and deliver it to Dolothos in Silvermoon.
93699.description:
There is great magic in the dawn. It illuminates and awakens all it falls upon, rousing the land to action. It is potential in its purest form.

As enchanters, we can crystallize that potential. Bring a parcel of the dawn to me.
93699.completion: This will make many fine and powerful enchantments.

93700.title: Experience Tranquility
93700.objectives: Collect 20 Tranquility Bloom and deliver it to Botanist Nathera in Silvermoon.
93700.description:
Are you an herbalist? Oh, thank goodness.

I've found myself in need of an exorbitant amount of tranquility bloom. The orders from the alchemists keep piling up and I only just finished restocking our argentleaf and--

<Nathera stops to take a deep breath.>

Could you please bring me as much tranquility bloom as you can carry? I'd be in your debt.
93700.progress: Have you found any tranquility bloom?
93700.completion: Bless you. This will give me some extra time to catch up on orders.

93701.title: Brittle and Brilliant
93701.objectives: Collect 20 Argentleaf and deliver it to Botanist Nathera in Silvermoon.
93701.description:
Argentleaf is always in high demand whenever war draws near.

It practically falls apart when you dry it out, but that powder can be used in a variety of medicines. It calms the nerves, focuses the mind, and can even work as a mild anesthetic in a pinch.

If you find any out in the field, please bring it to me.

93702.title: The Root of Life
93702.objectives: Collect 3 Azeroot and deliver it to Botanist Nathera in Silvermoon.
93702.description:
Most tuberous roots have some sort of healing potential, but azeroot is by far the most potent and versatile.

Just a small amount, juiced or powdered, can stave off infections, promote healing, and soothe both body and mind. I've even seen it used to keep lumber from rotting!

If you could bring me a few bushels, I'll put it to good use.
93702.progress: Were you able to track down any azeroot?
93702.completion: Oh, I love the scent of fresh azeroot. Perhaps I should see how it would do in a perfume...

93703.title: Sin'dorei Vices
93703.objectives: Collect 5 Mana Lilies and 2 Sanguithorn and deliver it to Botanist Nathera in Silvermoon.
93703.description:
While most of our harvests supply the scribes and alchemists in the city, we do occasionally receive orders from the public.

Lord Saltheril is one of our most prolific customers. He has an estate in western Eversong that he keeps well-supplied with offerings for guests at his soirees.

He has requested a large quantity of mana lilies and sanguithorn this week. Could you help us fulfill the order?
93703.progress: Lord Saltheril's business is always welcome, even if a bit eccentric.
93703.completion: Excellent. With your help and what we already have in stock, this should cover his order.

93704.title: Traditional Harvests
93704.objectives: Collect 10 Tranquility Blooms and 5 Argentleaf and deliver it to Botanist Nathera in Silvermoon.
93704.description:
Tranquility bloom and argentleaf are the backbone of countless potions, elixirs, inks, and so much more.

It never hurts to keep a surplus around. If you find yourself with any extra, we would gladly take it off your hands.
93704.progress: We'll take whatever you can offer.
93704.completion: Sometimes a simple blend is the best blend. No shame in sticking to the basics.

93705.title: Copper for Your Thoughts?
93705.objectives: Collect 20 Refulgent Copper Ore and deliver it to Belil in Silvermoon.
93705.description:
It's easy to overlook in favor of more extravagant materials, but copper is an extremely reliable and versatile material. Weapons, armor, wiring, jewelry, and of course the humble copper coin--it does it all!

Naturally, copper is always in high demand across the city and beyond. If you happen across any extra ore, I would gladly take it off your hands.
93705.progress: You know, I wrote my thesis on the uses of copper. Have you read it?
93705.completion: This is even more than I expected! Wonderful. I'll see this put to use immediately.

93706.title: Aggressive Tin-dencies
93706.objectives: Collect 10 Umbral Tin Ore and deliver it to Belil in Silvermoon.
93706.description:
There's been an influx of newly recruited soldiers lately. Marvelous fighters in the making, but a little too enthusiastic. They've already done a number on the stock of training weapons.

We usually make training weapons out of tin or other soft metals. They keep the recruits from doing real damage to the training dummies or each other, but they don't last long.

We'll need a lot more tin than what we have in stock to keep up. Bring us some more!
93706.progress: Anything you can contribute will be appreciated.
93706.completion:
Excellent! This will make a fine assortment of weapons.

I'm sure we'll get another order soon enough, so keep some spare tin around.

93707.title: It's Called Silvermoon
93707.objectives: Collect 10 Brilliant Silver Ore and deliver it to Belil in Silvermoon.
93707.description:
Elegant gold filigree may be a favorite of the sin'dorei, but our city also boasts some of the finest silversmiths in Azeroth.

They have been receiving a particularly high number of orders with all of the new visitors passing through. If you come across any high-quality silver, they can put it to good use.
93707.progress: I have a certain fondness for silver myself, truth be told.
93707.completion: What remarkable quality! I'll have this shipped over to the jewelers at once. Thank you.

93708.title: Conductive Metals
93708.objectives: Collect 5 Umbral Tin Ore and 5 Brilliant Silver Ore and deliver it to Belil in Silvermoon.
93708.description:
Our arcane constructs might look purely magical, but there's quite a bit of advanced wiring going on beneath the surface. Silvermoon's engineers truly are spell-workers in their own right.

They've been ramping up production lately to help fortify our defenses. Naturally, they look to us for supplies. I have most of the materials they ordered, but I'm low on tin and silver.

Could you help me fulfill the order?
93708.progress: Tin and silver are both remarkably conductive. I could elaborate, if you have a few hours?
93708.completion: Ah, yes. This quantity should be sufficient. I'll have it packaged up for the engineers.

93709.title: Stocking the Staples
93709.objectives: Collect 10 Refulgent Copper Ore and 2 Dazzling Thorium and deliver it to Belil in Silvermoon.
93709.description:
One can never have too much copper and thorium on hand. Even with all the new miners we brought on, we still nearly deplete our stocks every week.

At this rate, we'll have to start importing--and I do not want the headache that sort of paperwork brings.

If you could help us replenish our stock of copper and thorium, I would be in your debt.
93709.progress: I suppose I could bring on a few more apprentices, if I have to...
93709.completion:
You are one of the most reliable miners I've ever had the pleasure of meeting.

Thank you. Truly.

93710.title: Tempered in Darkness
93710.objectives: Collect 20 Void-Tempered Leather and deliver it to Tyn in Silvermoon.
93710.description:
The beasts of Quel'Thalas produce leather of unparalleled quality, but the Void has been doing something strange to it.

Normally, we harden leather by heating it under specific conditions. But the darkness clinging to these hides seems to be tempering the leather on its own. I have no idea how this is possible, but we can make use of it.

Bring me as much as you can gather. We have an army to supply.
93710.progress: We'll find a use for any leather you can bring us.
93710.completion: What strange properties... I'll keep a sample for study. In the meantime, this leather will make fine armor for our Farstriders.

93711.title: The Chill of the Void
93711.objectives: Collect 5 Fantastic Fur and 2 Void-Tempered Plating and deliver it to Tyn in Silvermoon.
93711.description:
When we mobilized troops to Northrend many years ago, we had to outfit our soldiers to withstand the icy chill of the frozen wastes. The secret is lining the inside of the armor with fur and plating it securely to trap warmth inside.

We kept detailed records of those techniques. The Void may not be as cold as Northrend, but I'd rather be prepared for the worst.

Bring me a supply of fur and plating and I'll see you compensated.
93711.progress: As an added benefit, the fur prevents quite a bit of chafing.
93711.completion: Our leatherworkers should be able to use these materials. Nicely done.

93712.title: Style and Skill
93712.objectives: Collect 5 Carving Canines and 5 Peerless Plumage and deliver it to Tyn in Silvermoon.
93712.description:
In battle, appearances are nearly as important as raw skill. If you can intimidate your foe before you've even drawn your sword, you're already that much closer to victory.

Our fletchers take this a step further and insist that beautiful feathers make our Farstriders' arrows do more damage. I'm... not certain about that, but I can appreciate the aesthetic.

Here's a list of what they need for this week's batch of arrows. Supply whatever you can and I'll handle the rest.
93712.progress: You can ignore the note about whether the feathers should be crimson or scarlet.
93712.completion: Ah, these should make excellent arrows.

93713.title: Essential Materials
93713.objectives: Collect 5 Carving Canines and 2 Void-Tempered Hides and deliver it to Tyn in Silvermoon.
93713.description:
The Horde's penchant for teeth and animal pelts has worn off on some sin'dorei. It's not uncommon in recent years to receive bulk orders for both.

This is one of those times. If you have any spare hides, or come across any particularly sharp teeth in your hunts, I'd gladly trade you for them.
93713.completion:
Well, this should be enough to cover the most recent order. I'll try to restock in preparation for the next one.

Pleasure working with you.

93714.title: Minor Scales
93714.objectives: Collect 20 Void-Tempered Scales and deliver it to Tyn in Silvermoon.
93714.description:
A well-made suit of scalemail is a sight to behold. It requires quite a bit of patience and attention to fine detail, but Silvermoon's leatherworkers are masters of the craft.

If you happen to hunt any scaled beasts, we could use those materials. A large quantity of smaller sized ones, if you could--they layer more nicely in the armor.
93714.progress: Scales are a bit harder to come by than regular leather, but the end result is well worth it.
93714.completion: Oh, these are wonderful. Look at iridescence! I'll send these over at once.

93723.title: Crafters Needed
93723.objectives: Talk to Mar'nah in the Bazaar.
93723.description:
Greetings. Come to lend a hand?

The war effort has been taxing on Silvermoon's resources. We need to keep our soldiers armed and supplied, but even our seasoned crafters have been overwhelmed. To keep up with demand, we have struck a deal with the Artisan's Consortium.

If you have your own skills to offer, speak to Mar'nah. She can help you view and place crafting orders.
93723.completion: Fulfilling these work orders is imperative to the war effort. Your services are greatly appreciated.

93724.title: Crafting Orders: Alchemy
93724.objectives: Find Camberon in the Bazaar and use his Alchemist's Lab Bench.
93724.description:
Ah, you're an alchemist?

You should speak with Camberon. He's a skilled alchemist who runs a shop here in Silvermoon.

Camberon has a work table at his shop where you can review, craft, and deliver work orders from public lists and personal contacts like friends and guildmates. If you're lucky, you might come across an order from a renowned person offering a special commission.

Seek him out and see what work is available for you.
93724.progress: The work orders never stop piling up. I'd be glad to have some extra help.
93724.completion: It is ever an honor to meet a fellow alchemist. Clean up your spills and we'll be well on our way to friendship.

93726.title: Crafting Orders: Blacksmithing
93726.objectives: Find Bemarrin in the Bazaar and use his Blacksmith's Table.
93726.description:
Ah, you're a blacksmith?

You should speak with Bemarrin. He's a skilled blacksmith who runs a shop here in Silvermoon.

Bemarrin has a work table at his shop where you can review, craft, and deliver work orders from public lists and personal contacts like friends and guildmates. If you're lucky, you might come across an order from a renowned person offering a special commission.

Seek him out and see what work is available for you.
93726.progress: The work orders never stop piling up. I'd be glad to have some extra help.
93726.completion: A pleasure meeting you. But if you misplace my good pair of tongs, I'll have you thrown right out.

93727.title: Crafting Orders: Engineering
93727.objectives: Find Danwe in the Bazaar and use her Tinker's Workbench.
93727.description:
Ah, you're an engineer?

You should speak with Danwe. She's a skilled engineer who runs a shop here in Silvermoon.

Danwe has a work table at her shop where you can review, craft, and deliver work orders from public lists and personal contacts like friends and guildmates. If you're lucky, you might come across an order from a renowned person offering a special commission.

Seek her out and see what work is available for you.
93727.progress: The work orders never stop piling up. I'd be glad to have some extra help.
93727.completion: Good engineers are hard to come by. Get a handle on those arcane constructs and you'll be drowning in work from the Magisters alone.

93728.title: Crafting Orders: Inscription
93728.objectives: Find Zantasia in the Bazaar and use her Scribe's Drafting Table.
93728.description:
Ah, you're a scribe?

You should speak with Zantasia. She's a skilled scribe who runs a shop here in Silvermoon.

Zantasia has a work table at her shop where you can review, craft, and deliver work orders from public lists and personal contacts like friends and guildmates. If you're lucky, you might come across an order from a renowned person offering a special commission.

Seek her out and see what work is available for you.
93728.progress: The work orders never stop piling up. I'd be glad to have some extra help.
93728.completion: You have a fine and steady hand, {NAME}. I look forward to seeing what you can create.

93729.title: Crafting Orders: Jewelcrafting
93729.objectives: Find Amin in the Bazaar and use his Jeweler's Bench.
93729.description:
Ah, you're a jewelcrafter?

You should speak with Amin. He's a skilled alchemist who runs a shop here in Silvermoon.

Amin has a work table at his shop where you can review, craft, and deliver work orders from public lists and personal contacts like friends and guildmates. If you're lucky, you might come across an order from a renowned person offering a special commission.

Seek him out and see what work is available for you.
93729.progress: The work orders never stop piling up. I'd be glad to have some extra help.
93729.completion: It seems like every set of armor these days needs a dozen gems inlaid. Not that I am complaining, especially not with your aid whittling down the work orders.

93730.title: Crafting Orders: Tailoring
93730.objectives: Find Galana in the Bazaar and use her Tailor's Work Table.
93730.description:
Ah, you're a tailor?

You should speak with Galana. She's a skilled tailor who runs a shop here in Silvermoon.

Galana has a work table at her shop where you can review, craft, and deliver work orders from public lists and personal contacts like friends and guildmates. If you're lucky, you might come across an order from a renowned person offering a special commission.

Seek her out and see what work is available for you.
93730.progress: The work orders never stop piling up. I'd be glad to have some extra help.
93730.completion: Fine spellcasters demand fine robes, but their high standards keep our skills sharp. Perhaps you and I can share techniques.

93731.title: Crafting Orders: Leatherworking
93731.objectives: Find Talmar in the Bazaar and use his Leatherworker's Tool Bench.
93731.description:
Ah, you're a leatherworker?

You should speak with Talmar. He's a skilled leatherworker who runs a shop here in Silvermoon.

Talmar has a work table at his shop where you can review, craft, and deliver work orders from public lists and personal contacts like friends and guildmates. If you're lucky, you might come across an order from a renowned person offering a special commission.

Seek him out and see what work is available for you.
93731.progress: The work orders never stop piling up. I'd be glad to have some extra help.
93731.completion: The beasts of Quel'thalas have the finest leather you will ever work with. I look forward to seeing what you make of it.

93734.title: Precious Trinkets
93734.objectives: Keep Furgh safe and investigate the treasures.
93734.description:
Finally we get to see what treasures Groffa was hoarding.

<Furgh's eyes go black as he looks at the bag. The drool on his jowls turns to foam and his claws dig into the sides of the bag as his grip on it tightens.>

Maybe the loa speaker's gifts aren't so bad. We should not be so hasty. I'll take a look. You watch and keep me safe.
93734.progress: Whatever Groffa had is bad. Right?
93734.completion: You didn't need to burn my things...

93745.title: Har'athir, Village of Memory
93745.description:
You have been permitted to range about beneath our Goddess' light. But that doesn't mean we trust you out of hand.

If you wish to prove yourself a friend to the haranir, make yourself useful in Har'athir. It is there that we make the paints for our murals and watch over the newest roots to seek the Goddess' light.
93745.completion:
So you survived your meeting with the elders. I am surprised, but also pleased.

You aided the children of Har'athir without hesitation. For that, I welcome you and offer you the hospitality of Amirdrassil's roots.

93771.title: Har'kuai, Village of Rain
93771.description:
All waters in Harandar are sacred. They feed the roots of the world and Aln'hara's myriad creations in equal measure. Perhaps none are more spectacular than those that fall from the roots of the tree called Nordrassil.

To the north, you will find Har'kuai. The rains that fall from the sky there carry a remarkable vitality. If you wish to witness all of Aln'hara's majesties, then a trek to Har'kuai would serve you well.
93771.completion:
I have heard of your travels, outsider. I am Kamari, Rootwarden of Nordrassil.

The mists of Har'kuai hold many mysteries. I hope you will find them enlightening, during your stay here.

93775.title: Har'mara, Village of Balance
93775.description:
Ah! The outsider who saved Har'mara. Word travels fast through Aln'hara's roots. No doubt Elder Hagar was grateful for your aid.

She would never admit it, but things have been difficult since the roots above her village burned. The rutaani and fungarians each grow bolder in their eccentricities. And the lingering flare-ups on Teldrassil's roots present a constant threat.

If your travels afford another trip to Har'mara, I do not doubt she would benefit from additional help.
93775.completion:
Ah! {NAME}. Welcome back. As you can see, our hands are full as ever, here.

I assure you, I have things well in hand. But if you do wish to explore a bit further afield, I am sure some of the others could benefit from your assistance.

93776.title: Har'alnor, Village of Twilight
93776.description:
Our efforts in the Blinding Bloom have halted the Lightbloom's encroachment for now. But with Rootwarden Ruia gone, there are scarce few who remain to handle the rest of the village's troubles.

I'm going back to Har'alnor to help out where I can. If you have the time and the inclination, your further assistance would be most appreciated.
93776.completion:
Thank the goddess you returned.

As you can see, we're still in fairly dire straits here. Though we quelled its spread beneath Shaladrassil's roots, the Lightbloom remains a threat. There are rumors of fungarians acting erratically in Fungara Village. And there is no Rootwarden in Har'alnor to deal with either.

Thankfully, we have the next best thing: an intrepid outsider with a habit of helping others.

93782.title: Conditional - Multiple Objectives, Sequenced
93782.objectives: Recover 1 trophies from gnarldin and their allies.
93782.description:
I be sent out here ta prove dat I can be an amani warrior.

Dis trial needs me ta collect as many trophies from dese gnarldin as possible. 

De two of us should work together! I be helpin' you get recognized as an amani warrior, yeah?

Just go out dere and get as many trophies from de gnarldin as possible. 

I be stayin' behind ta watch our backs, eh?

93783.title: Conditional - Just One Objective
93783.objectives: Recover 1 trophies from gnarldin and their allies.
93783.description:
I be sent out here ta prove dat I can be an amani warrior.

Dis trial needs me ta collect as many trophies from dese gnarldin as possible. 

De two of us should work together! I be helpin' you get recognized as an amani warrior, yeah?

Just go out dere and get as many trophies from de gnarldin as possible. 

I be stayin' behind ta watch our backs, eh?

93801.title: Calculated Culling
93801.objectives: Cull creatures endemic to the Molt.
93801.description:
This pathogen is spreading rapidly among the denizens of the Molt.

A swarm of netherwasp hatched shortly after our arrival. The infection spread throughout the region as they fought over territory. If their numbers continue to grow, they could carry the pathogen to the rest of Voidstorm.

{NAME}, can I ask you to reduce the number of infected creatures in the Molt?
93801.progress: This place has such vitality. It's no wonder the pathogen has spread so easily.
93801.completion: Your efforts and assistance are both noted and appreciated.

93810.title: Masters' Perch
93810.objectives: Seek void elf allies in Masters' Perch.
93810.description:
Not every creature of the Void serves Xal'atath's whims. Conquest was our way long before her arrival.

To the north, you find Slayer's Rise. It is the vast battleground where three domanaar vie for power. And I hear your ren'dorei allies have set up in Masters' Perch, the main citadel, as well.

I am certain great battles await you there. Go forth.
93810.completion: Good, we need more capable arms.

93865.title: Carve Your Way
93865.objectives: Win a duel against another player or the Masters' Champion.
93865.description:
We permit the presence of your kind for one reason. Your willingness to fight. Show us the skills of mortal duelists.

Go, find others of your kind. The pit below is an ideal site for demonstrations of combat prowess.
93865.completion:
Good. But one victory proves nothing. The path to supremacy requires sustained practice.

Return tomorrow and demonstrate your skills further.

93930.title: Courting Success
93930.objectives: Participate in Saltheril's Soiree and empower Eversong's runestones.
93930.description:
You seek an audience with Saltheril? And you're wearing... that? Excuse me for a moment while I laugh into my handkerchief.

<Caeris laughs lightly behind his handkerchief.>

Now, let me be professional. You are cordially invited to attend Saltheril's soiree.

Don't embarrass yourself, {NAME}. The best of Silvermoon are watching.
93930.completion: I half expected you to run back home in tears! I hope you had a stunning time.

93931.title: An Abundance of Wealth
93931.objectives: Harvest wealth for the Loa of Abundance.
93931.description:
De Loa of Abundance may not be one of de four great ones, but his worshippers are certainly de most devout.

Seek him out yaself. You can find him in northern Zul'Aman near Halazzi's Temple, but I also hear he's established harvest sites in Eversong Woods, Harandar, and even de land of Void through de gargantuan skymouth.

If nothing else, de rewards he grants are glorious--to de worthy, at least.
93931.progress: Did you find de loa, hash'ura?
93931.completion:
Heh! So ya finally met Dundun.

Even de smallest are some of de greatest among de loa!

93932.title: Legendary Prosperity
93932.objectives: Discover a legend of the Haranir.
93932.description: Harandar hides wisdom in every annal of its history, {NAME}. You would do well to seek out its legends for yourself. I suspect you may learn something of this world and our places in it.
93932.completion: I wonder what it is that the stones showed you. I hope you found it enlightening, {NAME}. But remember: there is always more to learn.

93933.title: Guarded Treasures
93933.objectives: Defend the Singularity Anchor in Stormarion Citadel.
93933.description:
Our sojourn to this world has brought the ren'dorei an even deeper understanding of the Void than before. The domanaar with whom we share a common enemy are almost strangely generous with their knowledge. I believe they want us to become as fearsome as they are.

There is a Singularity Anchor in Stormarion Citadel. I have learned how to draw upon some of its power to craft you a powerful item.

But first, we must ensure it does not fall into the hands of our enemies.
93933.progress: Have you defended the anchor from the encroaching void forces?

93942.title: Spark of Radiance
93942.objectives: Speak to Eldara Dawnrunner in Silvermoon.
93942.description:
A vision of radiance permeates your mind.

Eldara Dawnrunner might have more information regarding these Sparks of Radiance.
93942.completion:
This is a Spark of Radiance.

Every week, one of these sparks will appear while on your adventures. In its current state, it's rather useless, but acquiring more will allow you to craft powerful items. Reagents like these are malleable, robust, and the prize for many crafters.

This is a unique crafting material that can help an item achieve expertise beyond that of mortal ability.

93965.title: Pet Wranglin'
93965.objectives: Capture a Wild Pet in any Midnight zone.
93965.description:
Seems like you've got the spurs for this ride. Just takes a little gettin' used to is all.

Critters of all kind are crawling around Eversong and beyond. Cute, cuddly, creepy--whatever strikes your fancy.

You look tough enough to nab your own. Why don't ya give it a try?
93965.completion:
You're back. Hope you found a critter you fancy.

There are plenty more where that came from. Reckon you'll wrangle 'em all? I leave that up to you.

93969.title: Call Shot
93969.objectives: Capture a Wild Pet in any Midnight zone.
93969.description:
Critters of all kind are crawling around Eversong and beyond. Cute, cuddly, creepy--whatever strikes your fancy.

Ya might be used to havin' varmints bash heads until one was weak enough to nab. Got a new way to try. All you need is a crate. You've got one, yeah?

Just throw the crate from the start. It's mighty effective, I tell ya.

You look tough enough to nab your own. Why don't ya give it a try?

93970.title: Researching the Storm
93970.objectives: Help Anomander unlock the Research Console in Howling Ridge.
93970.description:
The urgent nature of our mission to these lands should not preclude us from embarking on new and meaningful research. Long have my people studied the void, and any opportunity to break new ground must be seized. 

Our scouts have been finding peculiar void manifestations throughout Voidstorm. If my hypothesis is correct, I believe we can use our host's facilities to further refine and understand these samples.
93970.progress: Please do not drop the sample.
93970.completion:
Did you hear that? It most certainly did something! 

Huzzah!

93997.title: Void Post Control
93997.objectives: Enter War Mode and seize full control of each of the Void Posts in Slayer's Rise.
93997.description:
Vidious is moving to claim Slayer's Rise, sending his proxies to occupy the Void Posts. I shall not be outmaneuvered.

Seize full control of each of the Void Posts and eliminate any of Vidious's forces that try to stop you.
93997.progress: Have you seized control of each of the Void Posts?
93997.completion: You have done well. Your loyalty has earned you a great prize.

93999.title: Void Post Control
93999.objectives: Enter War Mode and seize full control of each of the Void Posts in Slayer's Rise.
93999.description:
Ziadan vies for control of Slayer's Rise, sending her proxies out to seize the Void Posts. Show her two can play at this game.

Strike quickly: seize control of the Void Posts, slaying any who stand in your way.
93999.completion: A difficult task, completed with skill. Your loyalty deserves a reward.

94012.title: Lost Lil' Strider
94012.objectives: Capture Tiff in the Gardens of Remembrance in Silvermoon City.
94012.description:
Howdy, pardner. Folks at this here pet store asked for my help straighten' out this place. But while I was distracted, a hawkstrider chick I've been rearin' slipped out the front door. Prettiest purple plumes you ever did see.

Would you do me the kindness of finding her and bringing her back for me? I take her for a stroll in the garden every so often. I'll betcha that's where you'll find her.
94012.completion: Fine work. Even some of these handlers wouldn't have been able to track down that wily bird.

94052.title: The Domanaar's Plan
94052.objectives: Enter War Mode and collect 6 Ziadan's Battleplans from chests or slain guards.
94052.description:
If I am to defeat Ziadan, I need information.

Maps, strategy scrolls, battle reports, anything that gives me an edge!

Scour the Hate Spire and nearby grounds. Search every chest and cut down guards to find the information I need.
94052.progress: Have you obtained the battle plans?
94052.completion: This information shall give me the edge in the upcoming battles.

94055.title: The Domanaar's Plan
94055.objectives: Enter War Mode and collect 6 Vidious' Battleplans from chests or slain guards.
94055.description:
To counter Vidious' foul plans, I need information.

Maps, strategy scrolls, battle reports, anything that turns the battle in my favor!

Scour the Grief Spire and nearby grounds. Search every chest and cut down guards to find the information I need.
94055.progress: Have you obtained the battle plans?
94055.completion: This information shall give me the edge in the upcoming battles.

94056.title: A Golden Pull
94056.objectives: Enter War Mode and collect the Golden Vidious Card from a War Supply Crate in Slayer's Rise.
94056.description:
A unique and valuable gift has been sent to me, hidden in the supply crates that drop upon Slayer's Rise. 

Should Ziadan obtain this gift instead, her insufferable gloating would never cease!

Enter War Mode, and seize control of a supply crate. Then recover the gift for me!
94056.completion: This gift honors me, I knew you would succeed in obtaining it.

94057.title: A Golden Pull
94057.objectives: Enter War Mode and collect the Golden Ziadan Card from a War Supply Crate in Slayer's Rise.
94057.description:
A unique and valuable gift has been sent to me, hidden in the supply crates that drop upon Slayer's Rise.

Should Vidious obtain this gift instead, his taunts would be incessant.

Enter War Mode, and seize control of a supply crate. Then recover the gift for me!
94057.completion: This gift honors me, I knew you would succeed in obtaining it.

94370.title: Slithering Closer
94370.objectives: Find Numia Golden in Goldenmist Village.
94370.description:
Do you bring tidings from Numia? She was supposed to be here and help me assess these fair flowers.

She must be occupied. The naga have encroached on my town and hers... they have kept to the beach so far, but that could change quickly.

Will you check on my friend?
94370.completion:
I will make it up to Fern. Thanks for speaking with her.

And now, will you help me subdue this typical Farstrider? Nearly decapitated by a snapdragon, and he's acting like he just finished lunch!

94371.title: A Ranger's Dream
94371.objectives: Check in on Arcanist Taemin at Farstrider Hold.
94371.description:
Apprentices! Who can keep them tied down?

Taemin was a particularly talented arcanist, but his head was always in the clouds. Or in the woods, really.

Instead of studying, he buried his nose in storybooks! The legends of Eversong! The Rangers of old! Heroes of the Sin'dorei! He couldn't get enough, the dreaming fool!

And now... no, he's not dead. Did I imply that?

He's just run off to join the Farstriders. Check in on him, won't you? See if he's come to his senses?
94371.completion: It was good of you to check on me, but I'm committed to the Farstriders!

94380.title: Ranger Captain's Summons
94380.objectives: Report to Ranger Captain Lilatha in Silvermoon City.
94380.description:
Pardon the intrusion, {NAME}!

I'm delivering a summons from Ranger Captain Lilatha. She's requested your presence at her staging grounds overlooking the Bazaar near the north gate of Silvermoon.

Our lands are once again under threat and we'll need all the support we can get.

Report to her when you can!
94380.completion:
One threat may be dealt with, but dangers from all sides continue to stir within our borders.

A domanaar highlord rallies the minions of the Void to fill the vacuum of power.

Strange ethereals and their machines encroach on our settlements.

Even the remnants of the Twilight's Blade and local naga tribes have been emboldened by the chaos.

We could use your expertise in dealing with these threats, and I have just the task to get you started.

94381.title: Outfitting and Allies
94381.objectives: Speak with Maren Silverwing and Kul'amara the Fierce.
94381.description:
Halduron Brightwing has made sure that our task force is well equipped to handle any threat. I want you to check in with our quartermaster, Maren Silverwing. She will help you get outfitted. 

I also want you to talk with our "liaison." She is the troll with the guards. You may already know we are not alone in being targeted. 

Brightwing has reminded us that these enemies do not respect borders, so threats to Zul'Aman require our attention just as much as Eversong. We must deal with the troll.
94381.progress: When you have time continue to talk with others in our task force. We are prepared to support all of your efforts!
94381.completion:
What did you think of our troll ally? It galls me to work with forces who attacked our lands in the past to defend them now. The enemy of my enemy I suppose.
