I will respect her prowess though--she looks like she can hold her own in a fight. Time will tell if she is worthy of my admiration or my ire.

94382.title: Ritual Problems
94382.objectives: Investigate the Ritual Site Reports and then disrupt a Ritual Site in Eversong Woods or Zul'Aman.
94382.description:
To get right to it, I have laid out some lessons and some scout objectives for us as we approach the various dangers we might see in these ritual sites.

I have also marked on your map the location of one of these rituals. Take care, as the magics we have seen woven at these sites can overwhelm even the most stalwart warrior.
94382.completion:
I hope you now respect the dangers posed by great rituals. 

I fear though that these sites have the potential to be an even greater danger as we investigate them more and new challenges present themselves.

94383.title: Ritual Interest
94383.description:
I am here at the behest of the great Zul'jarra! May she lead her people to greatness.

We face dire threats. Your Captain General is focused on the martial stakes, but the terrible magics unleashed recently pose an even greater danger. Our scouts have discovered rituals that risk ruin for us all.

Your Ranger Captain has recruited the Lady Darkglen, who appears to be a knowledgeable and capable ritual expert.

Seek her out in the tent nearby to find out how best to approach these ritual sites.
94383.completion:
Kul'amara is such a fascinating individual. Did you know she fights on the front lines while also studying a multitude of rituals? It's such an incongruity and I love it.

Are you ready to stop these rituals that Kul'amara has warned us about?

94388.title: Second Time's a Choice
94388.objectives: Remind Magister Meledor in the West Sanctum.
94388.description:
A little lesson. Trying to fool me twice is a grave error.

My dim-witted pupil has yet to return from their rendezvous with their acquaintance. Normally I would not bat an eye, but he has a journal of mine. I want that journal back.

Would you be a dear and remind him?
94388.completion: <Magister Meledor appears to be lost in thought...>

94393.title: Career Counseling
94393.objectives: Check in on Kyltus Bloodburn in the Sunstrider Isle.
94393.description:
How good are you at teaching, {NAME}?

One of my pupils, Kyltus, has been having particular trouble with deciding what path along the road of life he wants to pursue. 

Perhaps a talk with you will aid his tumultuous heart?
94393.completion:
Instructor Thalendir sent you?! I will have to give him my apologies.

But I am glad you are here. Could you lend me an ear?

94402.title: Old War Grudge
94402.objectives: Enter War Mode, slay Gar'chak Skullcleave and bring me his Head.
94402.description:
Ziadan has allied with some of the most die-hard Horde champions. The kind who despise peace and fight on whenever and wherever possible.

Show them that Vidious also commands mighty champions!
94402.completion: You make the Alliance proud! Vidious has authorized me to grant you a reward.

94403.title: Old War Grudge
94403.objectives: Enter War Mode, slay Hardin Steellock and bring me his Head.
94403.description:
Vidious has allied with some of the  most die-hard Alliance champions. The kind who despise peace and fight on whenever and wherever possible.

Show them that Ziadan also commands mighty champions!
94403.completion: You make the Horde proud! Ziadan has authorized me to grant you a reward.

94408.title: Contract of Service
94408.objectives: Collect 10 Contracts of Service off slain players in War Mode.
94408.description:
It is not honor or glory that drives your kind to war...it is gold. You and your enemies are always paid for the blood you spill upon the battlefield.

Every enemy you slay in Slayer's Rise carries a contract from Ziadan. Bring me those contracts, and I will pay you what their loyalty once cost her.
94408.progress: Are you here to deliver their contracts?
94408.completion: See I was correct. In the end the price of blood is always in gold.

94409.title: Contract of Service
94409.objectives: Collect 10 Contracts of Service off slain players in War Mode.
94409.description:
It is not honor or glory that drives your kind to war...it is gold. You and your enemies are always paid for the blood you spill upon the battlefield.

Every enemy you slay in Slayer's Rise carries a contract from Vidious. Bring me those contracts, and I will pay you what their loyalty once cost her
94409.progress: Are you here to deliver their contracts?
94409.completion: See I was correct. In the end the price of blood is always in gold.

94423.title: Sanctum Secure
94423.description:
Our control here is only the beginning. Xal'atath has left other pockets of anomalies across the land. The defenses we've devised here can be used to secure those areas as well.

Travel to Sunkiller Sanctum and construct five additional defenses to solidify our hold on that location.

I will supply the Stormarion Core necessary to activate those defenses.

94469.title: A Handful of Voidlight Marl
94469.objectives: Thanks to you, the singularity anchor survived another assault. Take this as a sign of our appreciation.
94469.completion: Thanks to you, the singularity anchor survived another assault. Take this as a sign of our appreciation.

94470.title: A Cluster of Voidlight Marl
94470.objectives: Thanks to you, the singularity anchor survived another assault. Take this as a sign of our appreciation.
94470.completion: Thanks to you, the singularity anchor survived another assault. Take this as a sign of our appreciation.

94471.title: A Trove of Voidlight Marl
94471.objectives: Thanks to you, the singularity anchor survived another assault. Take this as a sign of our appreciation.
94471.completion: Thanks to you, the singularity anchor survived another assault. Take this as a sign of our appreciation.

94671.title: Finery Funds
94671.objectives: Thanks to you, the singularity anchor survived another assault. Take this as a sign of our appreciation.
94671.completion: Thanks to you, the singularity anchor survived another assault. Take this as a sign of our appreciation.

94677.title: The Missing Rootwarden
94677.description:
Something keeps troubling me about this, $p. Where is the Rootwarden?

Ruia has a solemn duty to watch over the World Tree and the land around it. He should be here, with his people in need. So where could he be when they are in crisis? What is he thinking?

I am sure that we can find clues to where he has gone if we search his town. Perhaps we can learn more about his state of mind along the way.
94677.progress: The Rootwarden should be here. We must find out what would be so pressing that would take him away from his responsibilities.
94677.completion:
This is troubling news. The Lightbloom hasn't seemed to affect any haranir thus far. Has it somehow infested the Rootwarden? Or is this his pride speaking? He's always been a zealous one, but...

We must move quickly.

94794.title: Fine Fashion Funding
94794.objectives: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept this token as thanks.
94794.completion: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept this token as thanks.

94834.title: Blessings of Abundance
94834.objectives: Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar.
94834.description:
<This idol proves the depth of your bond with abundance.

Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar to begin worshipping Dundun.>
94834.completion:
Ah, an Idol of Abundance.

De lord of glory and plentitude must favor you highly above his many other acolytes.

94835.title: Early Morning Training
94835.objectives: Win Battlegrounds in Training Grounds or against players.
94835.description:
Interested in enrolling in a training program? Some of the strongest warriors have emerged from hard work and dedication. 

With some practice, {NAME}, you surely can join their ranks. Begin today!
94835.progress: You have yet to finish your training for the week.
94835.completion: Great effort. Return next week for your continued training.

94836.title: Late Night Training: Week 1 of 3
94836.objectives: Win Battlegrounds in Training Grounds or against players.
94836.description: Welcome back to this multi-course training - only a few weeks left! Let's put into practice what you learned last week. Go and participate in Battlegrounds in the Training Grounds or against other combatants, then return back to me.
94836.progress: You have yet to finish your training for the week.
94836.completion: The hard work is paying off I see - great job! Return back to me next week.

94837.title: Midnight Training: Week 2 of 3
94837.objectives: Win Battlegrounds in Training Grounds or against players.
94837.description: You're over half way done with your training! Again, let's take some of the lessons you have learned previously and apply them in the battle fields. Enter Training Grounds or Battlegrounds then return to me.
94837.progress: You have yet to finish your training for the week.
94837.completion: Take note of what you've learned and prepare for your final training.

94838.title: Final Training: Week 3 of 3
94838.objectives: Win Battlegrounds in Training Grounds or against players.
94838.description: This is the final week of training. Take all of the lessons you've learned and put them into practice in the Training Grounds or against other players. Once complete, speak with Captain Dawnrunner in Falconwing Square.
94838.completion: Well done completing the training program. For your hard work, take this! As you continue your journeys in battle, you can return back to me to become better equipped.

94839.title: Blessings of Peril
94839.objectives: Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar.
94839.description:
<This idol proves the depth of your bond with peril.

Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar to begin worshipping Puul.>
94839.completion:
An Idol of Peril...

Many shy away from de realm of perils. There is much danger surroundin' de immense power Puul blesses their worshippers with.

Will you risk your life for it?

94840.title: Blessings of The Depths
94840.objectives: Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar.
94840.description:
<This idol proves the depth of your bond with the Depths.

Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar to begin worshipping Pahk.>
94840.completion:
Jeju passed his Idol of de Depths on, did he?

There are not many souls willin' to brave de world beneath our ocean waves. But Pahk watches over all who surrender themselves to de currents--alive or otherwise.

94844.title: Voidscar Arena: For My Horde
94844.objectives: Empower 8 Hatebound forces at the Bastion of Might in Slayer's Rise.
94844.description:
We must repel this attack.

Your Horde is strong. You do not give in to the hypocritical claims of the Alliance. You do not let them besmirch your honor.

I want my forces to learn from you. Go, take this Voidclarion. Use it to inspire my void minions.

Let them see the power of the Horde.
94844.completion: Good. My minions must grow stronger.

94845.title: Voidscar Arena: The Bastion of Might
94845.objectives: Collect 12 Spiteful Shadowgraft from wild creatures in the Bastion of Might.
94845.description:
Vidious presses an attack. I do not see this Alliance he recruited, but monsters.

Illogical. Vidious would not recruit another force until we had our fun with the recent additions.

Fight these monsters. Find out what they are. Bring me evidence.

Perhaps you need a cause to fight for beyond amusement? If Vidious tires of me, he will turn his conquest to Azeroth next. You'll want to stop that, right?

Then aid me.
94845.completion:
Shadowgraft? Pathetic.

Only domanaar with less skill and intelligence use it. It empowers creatures--makes them blind with violent urges.

But the creatures lose all cunning. All interest. It is a single flavor, not the complex notes of heartache and betrayal. It is boring.

94848.title: Voidscar Arena: Pre-Provoked Violence
94848.objectives: Slay Void creatures or players in the Bastion of Valor in Slayer's Rise.
94848.description:
Vidious, using shadowgraft? Unbelievable. He is better than this.

How dare he disappoint me.

I need no shadowgraft to convince mighty {class}s like you to fight for me.

Show him the error of his ways before he disappoints me further and abandons this conflict in favor of helping Xal'atath conquer Azeroth.

Take the fight to him. Siege his bastion. And if you do not wish to stain your hands with Alliance blood, there are many void minions awaiting your prowess.
94848.progress: Do you possess what it takes to survive in these lands, {race}?
94848.completion:
So, Vidious is also under attack by shadowgrafted monsters? 

I see. 

<Ziadan almost smiles.> 

So, he did not betray my expectations after all. Perhaps we keep him alive a little longer. 

But there is a third. An interloper.

94849.title: Voidscar Arena: A Familiar Grudge
94849.objectives: Slay Emrin Sparkpox at the Bastion of Valor in Slayer's Rise.
94849.description:
Vidious will have a favorite, much like I do: a mortal from your world filled with grief turned to violence.

They do not have the support of your leaders, but they will always have support from us domanaar.

Find this favorite. I hear of a warlock that has slain many Horde. I feel their grief wafting in the air. They are so lost in it, they would give up the war to save Azeroth for a chance to kill your people.

Go. Savor the fight.
94849.completion:
Good work. The mortal was blinded by their pain, so they never would have listened to reason. 

All they cared for anymore was the fight.

94855.title: Voidscar Arena: Setting It Aside
94855.objectives: Meet the domanaar at the Voidscar Arena in Slayer's Rise.
94855.description:
So, we have another enemy? One who would get in between me and Vidious?

<Ziadan tightens her fist around her weapon.>

Unacceptable.

The Voidscar Arena to the north is the most strategic position outside of our bastions. An interloping domanaar will have staged their forces there, I guarantee it.

I can set aside my quarrel with Vidious long enough to deal with this shared threat. Fortunately for you, he hasn't brought his Alliance forces with him.
94855.completion:
Who dares stage forces here? Without announcing themselves?

Noxian? Decimus? We will root them out and make them pay.

94867.title: Lost in Atal'Abasi
94867.objectives: Find Tolbani and Jehnira in Atal'Abasi.
94867.description:
Tolbani and Jehnira have been missin' for some time. Last I heard, dey were scoutin' Atal'Abasi for supplies.

That area is covered in murlocs. Too many of 'em is dangerous even for an Amani.

Find dem and make sure dey alright!
94867.completion: Vakala sent you? She was right to think dis place was dangerous.

94871.title: Eversong
94871.description:
Magistrix Landra Dawnstrider has sent a request for aid in dealing with the local Lightbloom. While typically harmless, it has recently begun to grow at an incredible rate.

Meet up with Arator in Fairbreeze Village to investigate the threat and provide what assistance you can.
94871.completion: The wildlife is going out of control!

94909.title: Blessings of Pestilence
94909.objectives: Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar.
94909.description:
<This idol proves the depth of your bond with pestilence.

Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar to begin worshipping Mot'amra.>
94909.completion:
Many dread Mot'amra. And they aren't wrong to.

But pestilence, disease, death--these are natural occurrences. Those dat brave their own fear unlock de powerful understandin' of how to cure--or manipulate--these forces.

94910.title: Blessings of Growth
94910.objectives: Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar.
94910.description:
<This idol proves the depth of your bond with growth.

Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar to begin worshipping Oe.>
94910.completion:
My, my... is dis de idol of growth?

Oe is a loa very few know of or worship. They do not form their presence. Instead, they communicate through their domain of de forests, de plants, de world beneath our feet.

Tales from our first ancestors make it seem dat Oe followed de Amani from ancient Zandalar. Dat it chose us from all de other tribes when we were still young.

94920.title: Hal'hadar Battery Core
94920.objectives: Learn more about the Hal'hadar and their technology.
94920.description:
<The Hal'hadar battery core has been damaged, exposing its inner workings.

Amidst the thin energy wires and familiar metalwork seen in K'areshi technology, you spot gleaming yellow crystals fitted into a golden frame. Small runic letters on the metal are inscribed under it.

Perhaps one of the ethereals in the Howling Ridge in the Voidstorm could help identify this.>
94920.progress:
I may not have fought these ethereals like Baraat has, but I am quite familiar with their technology. I decoded many of their encrypted schematics taken from the field.

Their use of technomancy and arcanic formula is quite advanced.
94920.completion:
What troubles me is the timing of these attacks. Why now?

Are they allied with the Void... or simply taking advantage of the chaos left in the smoldering wake of Xal'atath's assault?

I cannot say for sure but perhaps there are others who can.

94957.title: War of Light and Shadow
94957.objectives: Speak to Liadrin at the Sunwell.
94957.description:
The Vanguard has begun to rally its forces to confront the Devouring Host.

Report to Lady Liadrin at the Sunwell to join the offensive.
94957.progress: The Devouring Host tried to break us. Soon, they will face the combined might of the Vanguard.
94957.completion: We have held the line with blood and Light. Now, we strike back.

95069.title: Torn Twilight Missive
95069.objectives: Take the Twilight Missive to Silvermoon.
95069.description:
<The Twilight Missive reads:

"Our search presses on yet we remain as divided as ever. If we don't unite, then we truly deserved to be abandoned by her!

Of our surviving Speakers, two refuse my missives.

Lazaar rallies survivors in the ruins of Deatholme, while Ger'lock amasses a host at the Broken Throne.

The others have yet to declare for them, which buys us time to continue our search.

We may yet salvage our broken cause."

The Ranger Captain will want to see this.>
95069.progress: How fares your fight against the void assaults?
95069.completion:
The Twilight's Blade may be a minor thorn compared to the rampant domanaar or the ethereals attacking Quel'Thalas, but they are still dangerous.

If we can cut the heads off these snakes, then perhaps what little remains of them can finally dissipate into oblivion.

Continue the fight and keep up the good work, {NAME}.

95070.title: Permafrosted Keystone
95070.objectives: Show the Keystone to someone familiar with Domanaar relics.
95070.description:
<Several void-touched runes flicker across the keystone's surface before dissipating one by one. As the last rune fades, so does the faint hum of power within, leaving nothing but a painfully cold sphere of dark green metal.> 

Although it doesn't resemble other domanaar artifacts, there was no mistaking the cold, dark magic.

Perhaps Decimus in the Howling Ridge can provide you with more information.>
95070.completion:
A keystone for a Burning Legion world in the possession of the domanaar is... concerning to say the least.

Until we know which world this once connected to, there's not much we can do.

Perhaps Allari and her new pupil will be able to reveal more about this void relic. I will send word to her and share what you have found.

Thank you, {NAME}.

95071.title: Enchanted Naga Scroll
95071.objectives: Take the Enchanted Naga Missive to someone in Silvermoon City.
95071.description:
<The enchanted scroll shimmers with an arcane glint, the text vaguely resembling the elven language.

You presume it is written in the language of the naga, though the arcane-laced ink appears to move the letters around the scroll.

Perhaps a mage in Silvermoon can help you translate it.>
95071.completion:
You were wise to bring this scroll to me.

I have more questions than answers... who sent this? And who is Nar'jira?

These new Deeplurk naga will only amplify the Daggerspine threat.

I will ensure the Ranger General is made aware of their presence.

Thank you, {NAME}.

95245.title: Midnight: World Tour
95245.objectives: Complete faction features in Midnight zones.
95245.description:
The immediate danger has passed, but there is still much to be done.

Go out and work with our allies to secure what ground we have made against the darkness. Whether it is in Azeroth or beyond, there is still much to be done.

95547.title: Ritual Site Challenge Report: Tendrils
95547.objectives: Return your report to Lady Darkglen in Silvermoon City.
95547.description: <The information in the scrolls speaks of a mysterious vine attracted to the high levels of magic at Ritual Sites. This is the type of information Lady Darkglen needs to be told to better prepare for countering future Ritual Sites.>
95547.completion:
Ah, I have seen this before, but it is good to know that these tendrils are present in this region. It is common at Ritual Sites, and if you stay aware of your surroundings you can easily sidestep them.

If you find any information on other challenges we might face in Ritual Sites, be sure to bring them to me! Many challenges will be tougher to identify. We have our work cut out for us, {race}.

95548.title: Tainted Sample
95548.objectives: Return the tainted sample to Lady Darkglen.
95548.description:
<This sample is tainted and reeks of unknown scents.

Perhaps Lady Darkglen would be interested in studying it further.>

95551.title: Misappropriated Treasures
95551.objectives: Return the stolen treasures to Rae'ana.
95551.description:
<It seems the cultists have added theft to their repertoire.

You should reclaim the stolen treasures from the Ritual Site and return them to Rae'ana.>
95551.progress: Oh? What do you have there?
95551.completion: Such wonderful artifacts. I shall make sure these are cataloged immediately.

95554.description:
<This creature was being enhanced by an unknown magic.

Perhaps you should gather more of these fragments.>
95554.completion:
Curious.

I wonder what they hope to achieve with such enchantments?

I guess time will tell.

96080.title: Void Strike
96080.description:
We have reports of new void strikes occurring around Eversong Forest and Zul'Aman. 

We need you to head out immediately to investigate one of these strikes. I will mark your map with the latest location from our scouts.
96080.progress: What do you have to report?
96080.completion:
I knew you were the right one for this mission. Your info has been critical on what we are now calling Void Assaults. Void forces, Twilight's Blade, Ethereals, and Naga have been striking us across the region.

It is unclear but early reports state the groups are not coordinating. 

We need to outfit you and get you back out there!

96245.title: You've Seen it All Before
96245.objectives: Visit Soridormi at the Wayfarer's Rest in Silvermoon City.
96245.description: <A fine parchment materializes in a shower of bronze dust. It is an invitation from Soridormi to visit her at the Wayfarer's Rest in Silvermoon City.>
96245.completion: Ah, good to see you again. Or perhaps this is the first time we've met? Sorry, timelines get rather tangled in times of crisis. Let me know if you'd like me to sort yours out.

90081.title: Arcane Runed Sigil
90081.objectives: Enter the Archival Assault delve and collect 24 Etched Fragments.
90081.description:
An Arcane Runed Sigil is essential in proving an item's authenticity as a true masterpiece of Azure artisans. Of course, they can be affixed to any object, turning a flea market trinket into something that appears to be a priceless work of art.

I could create something like that, and it might turn a great profit. If you travel to the Azure Vault and gather the parts I need, we can use them to craft a Sigil.

Bring me enough parts for two, and I shall keep one as my fee for the service.
90081.completion: Excellent, this is more than enough to construct what you require.

90096.title: Infinite Research: Worldly Deeds
90096.description:
All across the Broken Isles there are people in need. They search for hope but are hard pressed to find any. You can be that hope.

Seek out those in peril in the Broken Isles and be the champion they so desperately need.

It is through such acts that legends are made.
90096.progress: Somewhere, someone is in need. All they need is a champion to save them.
90096.completion: A single heroic act can turn the tide. A single whisper of hope can turn back despair. This is what gives legends their power.

90097.title: Infinite Research: Invasion Points
90097.description:
The Legion does not fight conventionally. They deceive, manipulate, and undermine their opposition at every turn.

There are no battle lines against the Legion. They will open rifts at a weak point and then spill out of it sowing death and destruction. When they invade, it is on their terms.

However, this strategy is not invincible. Potent champions, able to move and react swiftly, can stop these invasions at their source. Stop the Legion Invasion. Show people that the Legion can be defeated.
90097.completion: The power you and your artifact possess were able to halt a Legion invasion. But was it you, or the artifact you wield, that is responsible? On that I will require more information.

90098.title: Infinite Research: Greater Invasion Points
90098.objectives: Complete a greater Legion invasion point.
90098.description:
Once the Legion has sown confusion and chaos, then they will begin their real assault. Huge invasion rifts will open and the Legion will march forth in great numbers. The defenders, scattered to protect against smaller rifts, will lack sufficient strength anywhere to stop them.

That is when champions like you are most needed.

Seek out one of the Legion's major invasions and throw everything you have at it. 

Show the people that with enough determination you can cancel the apocalypse.
90098.completion: Just as I predicted. You were able to stop a massive Legion invasion. It was not you, or your artifact that did this. Rather it was the combination of both that won the day.

90099.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Rare
90099.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a rare study, so focus on fighting rare opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
90099.progress: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.
90099.completion: Well done, {NAME}. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

90100.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Rare Elites
90100.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a rare elite study, so focus on fighting rare elite opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
90100.progress: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.
90100.completion: Well done, {NAME}. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

90101.title: Infinite Research: Terrors of the Broken Isles
90101.description:
It is time to put both you and your artifact to the test.

Seek out a Terror of the Broken Isles and defeat them.

I am certain that, no matter the outcome, you will provide us with much to think about. I will be watching with great interest.
90101.completion: A fascinating outcome, {NAME}. This will shed some much needed light on our research.

90102.title: Infinite Research: Champion of the Broken Isles
90102.objectives: Complete any Legion zone campaign chapter.
90102.description:
Our research suggests that power is only part of the equation--what one does with it is also of great importance.

The people of the Broken Isles need a champion. Come to their aid and drive the Legion from their shores and your legend will grow.

Where you choose to start is up to you--the Legion is everywhere, so one place is just as good as another.
90102.completion: Your legend has grown, {NAME}. The timeline reverberates with not just the substance of your deeds, but it compounds as it impacts those around you. This has been a most fruitful addition to our research.

90103.title: Infinite Research: Champion of the Order Hall
90103.objectives: Complete a chapter of your Order Hall campaign.
90103.description:
Your legend will not be satisfied with just being another $pc--you must prove yourself to be more.

Prove yourself within your Order Hall. Gain the respect of your peers, and become the first among equals.

In this way we may yet determine what limits you have and whether it is a person, or their artifact, that defines the legend.
90103.completion: You have gained the respect due to a true {class}. You are a leader. All that remains to be answered is where you are going.

90108.title: Infinite Research: Artifact Collector
90108.description:
As we study this timeline and your effect upon it, a question has been raised--what would be different if you had a different artifact?

Seek out a new artifact and let us see whether the first choice you made was good, or great.
90108.completion: You have quite the collection now, {NAME}. All that remains to be seen is whether you prefer one artifact over the other.

90109.title: Infinite Research: Clear the Skies
90109.objectives: Collect 50 residual time motes while flying.
90109.description:
Manipulating time is not without its risks or its rewards.

The strain on this timeline has produced numerous residual time motes through the Broken Isles. It would be irresponsible not to clean them up.

However, there is opportunity here. If you were to gather these motes, then their latent infinite power would be bestowed upon you instead.

We can clean up the timeline and enhance our research at the same time.
90109.progress: This timeline is pockmarked with time motes. Gather as many as you can.
90109.completion: Good. Nothing dramatic occured when you gathered the residual time motes. If you start to feel anything strange, do let us know though.

90110.title: Infinite Research: Gather Timewarped Samples
90110.description:
The fraying of this timeline has had some interesting effects on plants and stone. We would like to study them.

Gather samples of timewarped herbs and ores from around the Broken Isles and being them back for analysis.
90110.completion: Moratari will be elated to see so many test samples. Thank you for your diligence.

90111.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Demonology
90111.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a demonology study, so focus on fighting demonic opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
90111.progress: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.
90111.completion: Well done, {NAME}. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

90112.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Elite
90112.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be an elite study, so focus on fighting elite opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
90112.progress: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.
90112.completion: Well done, {NAME}. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

90113.title: Infinite Research: Self Improvement, Basic
90113.objectives: Complete various activities on the Broken Isles.
90113.description:
By improving yourself we can compare your power to that of your artifact. Only then will we be able to determine if it is the artifact, or its wielder, that is most important.

Go forth and grow stronger, more focused, more experienced--then return to me so we may record your improvements.

The road to self improvement is a long one, so pace yourself.
90113.progress: Remember to pace yourself, the journey is just as important as the destination.
90113.completion: Impressive. I can sense your power. This is a most critical addition to our research.

90114.title: Infinite Research: Self Improvement, Advanced
90114.objectives: Complete various activities in Heroic World Tier.
90114.description:
By improving yourself we can compare your power to that of your artifact. Only then will we be able to determine if it is the artifact, or its wielder, that is most important.

Go forth and grow stronger, more focused, more experienced--then return to me so we may record your improvements.

The road to self improvement is a long one, so pace yourself.
90114.completion: Impressive. I can sense your power. This is a most critical addition to our research.

90115.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Groverunner
90115.objectives: Kill 100 enemies while Call of the Forest is your active artifact ability.
90115.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of your attunement to the forest, so focus on fighting opponents using the power of nature.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
90115.completion: Impressive. I can sense your power. This is a most critical addition to our research.

90122.title: Eliminate Xy'vox the Twisted
90122.description: <Use the Xy'vox Refuge Dampener to reveal and eliminate Xy'vox the Twisted.>
90122.completion: Excellent work, I will issue a reward for eliminating this warrant target.

90123.title: Eliminate Hollowbane
90123.description: <Use the Hollowbane Portal Key to reveal and eliminate Hollowbane.>
90123.completion: Excellent work, I will issue a reward for eliminating this warrant target.

90124.title: Eliminate Shatterpulse
90124.description: <Use the Shatterpulse Cell Key to reveal and eliminate Shatterpulse.>
90124.completion: Excellent work, I will issue a reward for eliminating this warrant target.

90125.title: Eliminate Purple Peat
90125.description: <Use the Purple Peat Cell Key to reveal and eliminate Purple Peat.>
90125.completion: Excellent work, I will issue a reward for eliminating this warrant target.

90126.title: Eliminate Grubber
90126.description: <Use the Grubber Lure to reveal and eliminate Grubber.>
90126.completion: Excellent work, I will issue a reward for eliminating this warrant target.

90127.title: Eliminate Arcana-Monger So'zer
90127.description: <Use the Arcane Lure to reveal and eliminate Arcana-Monger So'zer.>
90127.completion: Excellent work, I will issue a reward for eliminating this warrant target.

90517.title: My Part of the Deal
90517.description:
The threat of the Shadowguard to Eco-Dome: Primus is over. My Reshii Ribbon is no longer needed to protect this asset. Take it. Use it wisely. Protect the greatest investment of all--our existence.

Stay focused! The Harbinger has already driven off one member of your team. Once you get enough Reshii Ribbons, you still need to fight Dimensius. Find allies who will stand with us, in addition to artifacts.
90517.progress: The Reshii Ribbons are a means to get you and your allies to Dimensius. You will need at least two more if this plan is going to work.
90517.completion: You have my ribbon. Go--track down the rest. Have Locus-Walker contact the other members of the Ravel. Ask the Harbinger if she knows any ancient horrors that have acquired one. Remember rule twelve--it's who you know.

90544.title: Thief at Bark
90544.description:
<Luma stands in front of you, ears perked, thankful for your help.

She lets out a short bark, tail wagging once before trotting a few steps forward, then pausing.

Glancing back, Luma waits expectantly. Her body language pleads, "Come on, follow me!">
90544.progress: <Luma appears to be waiting for your approval.>
90544.completion:
<Luma nudges a small reward into your hand, as if in appreciation for your help.

Perhaps there is no reason to be concerned over the amount of stolen items in the treasure pile after all.>

90545.title: A Reel Problem
90545.description:
An essential component of the Oasis ecosystem is the aquatic life within our small lake. 

It appears that artificial organisms known as Hyrobites are in the lake. Originally introduced to remove toxins in the water, their continued presence threatens the equilibrium of the water.

Please remove these mechanical fish immediately!
90545.completion: Fine work. I am most pleased to not have to handle those nasty fish myself.

90630.title: A Small Bundle of Crystals
90630.objectives: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.
90630.completion: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.

90634.title: A Small Bundle of Crystals
90634.objectives: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.
90634.completion: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.

90638.title: A Bundle of Crystals
90638.objectives: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.
90638.completion: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.

90659.title: Something Borrowed
90659.description:
Now that you have your infinite bronze, we just need to select the right artifact for you, shape the bronze into a suitable simulacrum of the weapon, and then reach through a temporal knot and swap them.

No one will be the wiser.

All we have to do is remember to reclaim the simulacrum in this timeline and everything will work itself out.

Let's start by selecting your specialization, that'll determine which artifact we'll be borrowing.
90659.progress: Every artifacts needs a mighty hero to wield it.
90659.completion:
Intriguing. This artifact's potential has been deepened, perhaps by the fraying of this timeline. It can harness more power than any incarnation of it that I have yet encountered.

Let me record that data point for Moratari.

Oh, important reminder--don't forget to recover the bronze simulacrum later or things might get... funky.

And lastly, maybe don't mention to people how you got that. It could ruin the experiment.

90663.title: Stealing What is Ours
90663.objectives: Speak with Xy'dax and recover the Missing Imports.
90663.description:
Ve'nari has called in a lot of favors to get the Oasis reclamation effort off the ground. Plenty of Tazavesh merchants have donated to the cause, though some have seen fit to help themselves instead.

A large shipment of stasis-sealed items was stolen from the docks by an untrustworthy importer. I could use someone of your skill to recover the shipment.
90663.progress: Have you recovered my missing items?
90663.completion:
I wasn't expecting quite so much! Perhaps this is not all my imports? 

Still, it's good to see these items. I have a little something for your troubles.

90666.title: A Bundle of Crystals
90666.objectives: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.
90666.completion: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.

90667.title: Enchanted Runed Ethereal Crest
90667.objectives: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.
90667.completion: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.

90690.title: Charge of the Vanguard
90690.objectives: Meet with Turalyon in the Voidstorm.
90690.description:
Turalyon reports the Vanguard of the Light is prepared to march on Xal'atath's stronghold.

Would that I could join you for the charge. I will keep my retainer of forces here to maintain the defense of the Sunwell and Silvermoon while you take the fight to our enemy. 

Muster in the Voidstorm, take the fight to the Voidspire, and bring an end to this great enemy. Good hunting.
90690.completion: Good, {NAME}! You have made it for our charge.

90701.title: Cowardly Cheery Bombs
90701.description:
Goblins love bombs, I get that. But does EVERYTHING have to blow up?

Do me a favor: In the next Dastardly Duos match you enter, find a cheery bomb inside one of the wooden tree and planter props.

After you find the bomb, but before it  "blows up"... smack it for me. Don't worry, they're cowards.
90701.progress: Those cheery bombs are asking for it, {NAME}. Find one in a Dastardly Duos match and smack it!
90701.completion: Way to go, {NAME}. You have to show those bombs who's boss, you know?

90705.title: Lorewalking
90705.objectives: Find Li Li Stormstout in Silvermoon, Dornogal, Stormwind, or Orgrimmar.
90705.description:
Are you curious about your world's history? Would you like to learn more?

Li Li Stormstout has started her Lorewalking apprenticeship. With all her travels, she has gathered many stories of important events and figures across Azeroth and beyond and is eager to share them!

Pay her a visit in your capital city!
90705.completion:
Oh? Lali is sending vistors my way, now? 

<Lorewalker Cho laughs a deep, belly laugh.> 

Of course she is! 

Ah, but she is correct. The only thing I love more than gathering stories is telling them! Sit down, let me share a tale with you.

90718.title: Request of the Arcantina
90718.objectives: Deliver Telemancer's Request to Archmage Khadgar at the Arcantina.
90718.description:
Ah, {NAME}!

I hear you have a standing invitation to Archmage Khadgar's... Arcantina?

Can you go there for me and bring this missive to the Archmage? I need to source reagents for the sheer volume of telemancy spells I have been asked to conjure.

Magister's Terrace has been an excellent source up until recent events but really I need the Kirin Tor to loan me some of their harder to find ingredients.
90718.progress: Champion? Do you have something for me?
90718.completion:
Hmm. Let's see here.

Warpstalker eyes, an astral sieve-

Jormungar bile?! How does he plan to use that? And I am down to my last few vials. 

Well, it can't be helped. I will send these on to Oculeth as soon as they are gathered. In the meantime, enjoy yourself around the tavern, Champion.

90719.title: Borrowing Corruption
90719.objectives: Find Black Blood Residue and Displaced Corrupted Mementos from the bosses of the Corrupted and Lost areas of the Horrific Visions.
90719.description:
Adventurer, I have made an amazing discovery. 

Analyzing the memories from the time I have discovered that I might be able to recreate the corruption effects that have been wielded in the past. Albeit in a much more controlled way. 

I will need you gather some black blood residue from defeating the bosses of the Corrupted or Lost areas of the map and a few more of the displaced corrupted mementos.
90719.completion:
Yes, by combining this residue with the displaced corrupted mementos I can... yeah just like so... and then with a bit of my bronze magic... there. Done.

Now that I have a working knowledge I can also make more if you bring me additional displaced corrupted mementos. I will see if I can refine the process anymore. Check back with me later.

90724.title: The Broken Sky
90724.objectives: Report to Lor'themar in Silvermoon City.
90724.description:
All those people. Our army. Our heroes. Our leaders.

Gone.

We are exposed here. Umbric's tether saved us, but we need to ensure we survive this. Report to Lor'themar and tell him what transpired in the Voidspire. I will get Umbric to safety and learn what I can here.
90724.completion:
This is a dark day. 

I am deploying my scouts to learn more of what is transpiring in the world while we use our remaining forces to defend Silvermoon City. 

Be ready, champion. We will have need of you soon.

90729.title: Win-Win Situation
90729.description:
Not everything you recovered yesterday was mine, but let's be honest--we're going to keep it anyway!

Xy'daz has been ripping people off for years. It's his turn to take a loss!

Now, this can work in both our favors. You sell off half of the leftover goods for me, and I'll let you keep the rest!
90729.completion: You did so well! I may have to employ you more often!

90731.title: Enhancing Corruption
90731.objectives: Find Black Blood Coagulate and Displaced Corrupted Mementos from the bosses of the Lost areas of the Horrific Visions.
90731.description:
Welcome back adventurer. I have made a new discovery but I need to test it out. 

Hidden in the Lost areas of the Horrific Visions I believe is a rare black blood coagulate. This might be the key to increasing the power of the corruption effects... in a safe way. 

If you can go into these areas and find this item and also bring me back more displaced corrupted mementos I should be able to increase the potency of the corruption effects.
90731.completion:
Ok, this is promising... the coagulate catalyzes slower so the increased corruption is more contained... yes, this allows a higher yield of corrupted material without any negative side effects.

Alas, I cannot keep it stable for long. These effects will not last. I am sorry adventurer but we should take advantage of the effects while we can. 

Again, if you bring me additional displaced corrupted mementos I can make you more of these greater corruptions.

90746.title: The Elves Assemble
90746.objectives: Speak to Arator at the war table.
90746.description:
The time for preparations have passed. Xal'atath's forces are upon us.

Join us, champion, as we must rebuff this assault and then press our attack on the Darkwell.

90747.title: The Wrong Bluecephalus
90747.description:
We may have gotten off on the wrong foot, but there's something you should know.

That old slateback you used to haul all those imports? I thought it was just another worn-out nag, but it turns out it was the real treasure all along.

A rare bluecephalus, worth a fortune!

You might want to figure out where it went, and why Ba'eth isn't exactly rushing to share the profits!
90747.completion: Good. This will be a profitable venture... for me.

90748.title: Quel'Danas
90748.objectives: Meet with Arator before the gates of Quel'Danas.
90748.description:
Champion, the time has come to see an end to the Darkwell.

I do not know what awaits us beyond the gates of Quel'Danas, but we cannot tarry any longer. The Void continues to pour into the Darkwell, transforming it. 

Arator is at the head of our combined armies. He has asked you and your strongest allies join him at his side. 

It is time to end this and take back our well.
90748.completion: Here we stand. Here we fight.

90754.title: Skyriding
90754.objectives: Take Moratari's portal to Lord Andestrasz.
90754.description:
This land is more vast than I remember. However, a good scholar is always prepared.

To cover more ground, you will need a winged mount and the skill to ride it swiftly.

I recall Lord Andestrasz helping us with this in the past, near the Timeless Isle in Pandaria. Let's send you back to that moment in time, so you can learn from him.

Don't wander too far in distant lands, you're still needed back here. Return via the portal when you have finished your instructions.
90754.completion:
Let us get started. We will focus on the basics.

Do not worry, the fancy maneuvers will come later.

90755.title: Time Flies
90755.description:
That should suffice for now. Remember the basics and you will improve in time.

Speaking of time, you had best be on your way. The portal there will take you back to Moratari.
90755.completion: Excellent. This should expedite our research.

90759.title: The Cult Within
90759.description:
<A missive written on shimmering vellum unfurls before you.>

$p,

Rumors suggest that Xal'atath's cult, the Twilight's Blade, has been recruiting in Alliance cities. Meet me in Stormwind to investigate these rumors. If the cult is there, then we must stamp it out at once.

Magister Umbric
90759.completion: Thank you for coming, {NAME}. The Twilight's Blade cannot be allowed to roam our cities.

90760.title: Avoiding Blame
90760.description:
Apocalyptic threats have taken many forms in Azeroth's history, but today we face Xal'atath and her Twilight's Blade.

I fear that people are falling into hopelessness as the Radiant Song cries a warning. The Twilight's Blade could use that despair to draw them into their ranks.

My mages have identified this district as housing a peculiar amount of void energy. Investigate and stop any cultists you may find.
90760.progress: I understand the comfort the void can provide. But surrendering to it completely is not the peace many are led to believe.
90760.completion:
There are Twilight's Blade in the city. If they are here, they are certainly recruiting elsewhere.

We have more work to do.

90761.title: Avoiding Blame
90761.description:
The cult of twilight has long been dedicated to ending Azeroth. That they ally with Xal'atath is no surprise.

If the Twilight's Blade are indoctrinating citizens, we must stop them. We cannot permit the weak to fall to the Void's dark designs.

The Cleft of Shadow is home to many practitioners of unsavory magic. Identify and end any cultists you may find there.
90761.progress:
<Rommath sneers at you.>

The calm and comfort the Void offers is a lie. You would do well to abandon it.
90761.completion:
The Radiant Song casts a long, dark shadow on Azeroth. The Twilight's Blade are taking advantage of it.

We have work to do.

90762.title: The Twilight Highlands
90762.objectives: Meet Grand Magister Rommath in the Twilight Highlands.
90762.description:
I've spoken with Grand Magister Rommath. Despite our differences, it seems we are aligned in purpose.

We have both found evidence that Twilight's Blade cultists are convening in the Twilight Highlands. It's a place long scarred by the cult's misdeeds. And it's a suitable staging ground for an attack.

Meet us there so we may continue our investigation.
90762.completion:
Well. It seems we are to be working together to investigate the Twilight's Blade.

I do hope you're prepared.

90763.title: The Twilight Highlands
90763.objectives: Meet Grand Magister Rommath in the Twilight Highlands.
90763.description:
I've received word from Magister Umbric. He has found similar evidence that the Twilight's Blade are recruiting in Stormwind.

The Void poses an existential threat to all of Azeroth. We must stop the cult at its source.

We've agreed to meet in the cult's homeland, the Twilight Highlands. Find me there so we may continue our investigation.
90763.completion:
Good, you've arrived. 

Keep an eye on our allies. We may be working with them to stop the Twilight's Blade, but the Void is insidious. 

They cannot be fully trusted.

90764.title: The Cult Within
90764.objectives: Meet Grand Magister Rommath in Orgrimmar.
90764.description:
<A missive written on fine parchment unfurls before you.>

$p,

I have heard unsettling rumors that Xal'atath's cult, the Twilight's Blade, is recruiting within Horde cities. Meet me in Orgrimmar so we may root out this evil. We cannot suffer a single cultist within our walls.

Grand Magister Rommath
90764.completion: Good, you're here. We cannot let the Twilight's Blade gain ground in the city.

90765.title: Midnight Dress
90765.objectives: Find a Twilight's Blade disguise and infiltrate the Twilight's Blade.
90765.description:
Cult activity in the area has risen significantly. While we are gathering troops, you secure a cultist disguise and infiltrate their nearby training grounds.

Find out anything you can about the Twilight's Blade and their goals. I will keep this area secure.
90765.progress: You look lost, fledgling. Isn't there somewhere you should be?
90765.completion: You hardly seem prepared to serve Xal'atath. We shall fix that.

90766.title: Xal'atath's Proven Faithful
90766.objectives: Train to become a Twilight's Blade cultist.
90766.description:
It takes more than blistering desperation for the apocalypse to be part of the Cult of Twilight.

We are Xal'atath's Twilight's Blade. Our purpose is greater than it has ever been before. And thus, we must become her strongest allies.

Go and train with my associates in the field. Educate yourself on our rituals and rhetoric. Only then will I allow you to go through the initiation ceremony.
90766.completion: Excellent. You have the bearing of a true acolyte of the Twilight's Blade.

90767.title: More Doom
90767.description:
Having completed your training, you have earned full membership with the Twilight's Blade.

<Harrowtongue pauses a moment, appearing self-satisfied.>

As a member of the cult, you will now join your fellow acolytes in an initiation ceremony. They are in the basement of this building receiving instructions from our great leader, Mor'duun.

Allow his words to fill you with zeal for the cause. The end is near!
90767.progress: Have you discovered more about the cult's plans?
90767.completion: I suppose aligning with yet another being hellbent on ending the world is only fitting for the Cult of Twilight.

90768.title: Cult It Out
90768.objectives: Kill Gehl Harrowtongue and 12 Twilight's Blade cultists.
90768.description:
Mor'duun and his Twilight's Blade cultists are directly supporting the Harbinger's dark designs for our world.

And that is all we need to know. Kill as many as you can, then meet us back at our base of operations.

The cult and its leaders must be eliminated.
90768.completion: Their nefarious alliance with Xal'atath is clear. Good work. Now we take them down.

90769.title: A Blue for You
90769.description:
Why you want such a strange beast? 

I save many better items just for you. What about some soap?

But, I not deny $p heart's desire.
90769.completion: May the spirits protect you mon, and your new blue friend!

90770.title: The Grift
90770.objectives: Enter Untethered Space and recover the items Griftah requires.
90770.description:
Dey say you want the blue beast. Was a great bargain I stumbled upon. Da bazaar full of opportunities. 

Many more bargains to find in spots where treasures lie waiting. 

You know where to look?

Go to dis special place and find treasures, I give the blue beast to you.
90770.completion: Good work, mon. Griftah be smiling today.

90773.title: Meat My Business
90773.objectives: Collect 12 Dustback Flank, 5 Siltwing Tail, and 5 Swoopwing Eggs.
90773.description:
Since I am helping you, I'm sure you won't mind returning the favor.

I have a constant need for fresh, untainted meat, which is quite hard to come by. The Oasis is off limits, but the wildlife roaming these sands?

I've got a list of what I need. Bring me those items, and I'll tell you what you need to know.
90773.completion:
Now as I promised.

I sold the blue slateback to an outsider like yourself. Not some great hero, but more of an awkward sort.

Come back tomorrow. He usually stops by here for a meal. And he doesn't merely smell it, he eats!

90776.title: Ancient Curiosity: Combat
90776.objectives: Use and equip a Combat Curio to Brann Bronzebeard.
90776.description: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important. The Explorers' League would be interested in this.>

90777.title: Feeding the Flame
90777.objectives: Speak to Liadrin at the Sunwell.
90777.description:
Champion, the Sunwell holds for now, but the Vanguard has begun to deploy the bulk of its forces to Voidstorm.

Lady Liadrin has requested your assistance at the Sunwell.
90777.progress: It's heartening to see our commanders so eager to bring the fight to the enemy.
90777.completion: We persevere for now, {NAME}. The quicker we face Xal'atath at the Voidspire, the quicker this can all be behind us.

90778.title: Ancient Curiosity: Utility
90778.objectives: Use and equip a Utility Curio to Brann Bronzebeard.
90778.description: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important. The Explorers' League would be interested in this.>

90779.title: Cracked Keystone
90779.objectives: Complete any dungeon on Mythic 2 or higher difficulty.
90779.description:
Fragmentary images of heroic deeds flash though your mind as you touch the stone, but they fade as fast as they arrive.

Perhaps performing a suitably impressive task will stabilize the stone's magic once more?

90822.title: Murder Row: One Fel Swoop
90822.objectives: Dismantle the fel smuggling operation inside Murder Row.
90822.description:
We have all the puzzle pieces. Zaen smuggles fel relics from the Broken Isles by stacking the Silvermoon Harbor with his own smugglers. The relics are processed in Murder Row, then fel magic is infused into mana wyrms for sale and siphoning.

Such a convoluted operation might be impressive, if the goals weren't so reckless. Zaen is preying on people's fear. He doesn't care who he helps or hurts as long as he rakes in the gold.

Let us end it. We'll find the Illicit Rain in Murder Row and clear it out.
90822.progress:
Something seems to have happened in Murder Row since we left. A crowd is forming.

Proceed with caution. I'm with you.
90822.completion:
With no one left to run it, this fel operation should be done with... for now, at least.

It was a pleasure working with you, {NAME}.

90840.title: What's Your Specialty?
90840.description:
The Dragon Isles is a dangerous and uncharted place. We'll need to get you prepared.

You're strong enough now that you should choose a combat specialization.

This will unlock a new array of abilities for you to face the dangers within the Dragon Isles.

Go ahead and choose your combat specialization.
90840.progress: Having trouble? You can find your combat specialization beside your spellbook.
90840.completion:
Excellent choice! I'm looking forward to what you do next.

Take this riding mount. It'll help you get around here faster.

90842.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
90842.objectives: Ride your mount, then speak with Sil'nori Crestshade to get a Hearthstone bound to the Wild Coast.
90842.description:
Before you head off, you'll want to get yourself a Hearthstone. 

This little stone will return you to the inn where you last bound it to.

It's not much of an "inn", but the explorers have a tent set up. 

Test out that new mount of yours and ride over to Sil'nori Crestshade. He'll get you sorted out with a Hearthstone.
90842.progress: Sil'nori Crestshade nearby can get you set up with a Hearthstone.
90842.completion: If you ever find yourself lost, use your Hearthstone to get yourself back to where you should be.

90843.title: Aiding the Dragon Isles
90843.objectives: Meet  Naleidea Rivergleam to begin your adventure in the Dragon Isles.
90843.description:
It's time for us to part ways. I have pressing business further within the Dragon Isles in a place called the Azure Span.

Naleidea Rivergleam of the Dragonscale Expedition could use your help.

Safe travels, {NAME}. I look forward to our next meeting!
90843.completion: How are you? We could use more hands to help us explore the Dragon Isles!

90861.title: Those Left Behind
90861.objectives: Seek out Arator at the Darkwell.
90861.description:
In the wake of Xal'atath's destruction, what remains of our forces are gathering at the Darkwell to determine what we can do about the remnants of the Void.

We cannot abide the presence of so much dark energy. Some of our greatest casters and most knowledgeable scholars believe they might have a solution, but we could use your aid.

Please, join Arator at the Darkwell at your earliest convenience.
90861.completion: Thank you for coming. It is fitting we have you here for this day.

90862.title: In Times of Need
90862.objectives: Speak with each of the elven leaders.
90862.description:
The last of the other elven leaders have returned with powers from their homeland that will help us in cleansing the Darkwell. 

While the Voidstorm no longer barrages the Darkwell, it still needs healing. 

Please meet with the other leaders and let them know we are ready for them.
90862.completion: Elves of all nations have spent ages upon ages drawing upon wells for magic, for life, and for identity. Not even the dragon aspects could surpass our knowledge in this hour.

90867.title: From Darkness, Light
90867.objectives: Conduct the ritual to cleanse the Darkwell.
90867.description:
We will not let the Sunwell be corrupted again. This Darkwell must change, but it must change to something that we are no longer bound to with such dependency. We do not need this well to be the bait for so many other world-corrupting forces.

No, today we heal the Darkwell, and make it something new. Let me know when you are ready.
90867.completion: Behold the Dawnwell. May its waters never know corruption. May it stand as a reminder of all that we have lost, and an inspiration for what we can become.

90869.title: It's All in the Image
90869.objectives: Speak to Sassy Hardwrench to select a "marketing partner.".
90869.description:
So, the higher-ups in the marketing department say you need a good partner to soften your aesthetic of... you know, "murder everyone around me for gold."

We've got two focus group approved goblins over there ready to go, so go take your pick. Sassy will handle the paperwork.

Oh, don't give me that look. You only gotta forever-love each other in front of the public. Once the cameras are off, no one cares. It'll be great for your reputation!
90869.progress: C'mon, this ain't rocket surgery. Pick whoever you wanna pose on some magazine covers with.
90869.completion:
There we go! Nice and artificial, just like all the best marketing should be.

And I just finished the paperwork for your other big image upgrade. I think you're really going like this!

90870.title: Gathering the Grub
90870.objectives: Collect Bags of Brewfest Ingredients and deposit them at the wagon.
90870.description:
Ah, ye're here! Brewfest is here and we've got a small problem. We can't have a proper feast without the food, but some pesky hozen thought it'd be fun to steal our bags of grub. I'm sure they're just lookin' to fill their own bellies, but it's messin' up our plans!

So here's what I need ye to do: hunt down those hozen and take back the bags they've snatched. There's a good chance ye'll find a few bags just sittin' on the ground too. When ye return, just add the recovered bags to that wagon back there.
90870.progress: The feast won't come together without those ingredients!
90870.completion: Ah, ye've done it! The cooks will be pleased.

90871.title: The Silversun Compact
90871.objectives: Assist in the formalization of The Silversun Compact.
90871.description:
Champion. 

After much discussion, negotiation, and even some screaming and three duels, the Sunreavers and the Silver Covenant have decided on a course of action to define both of our futures.

Given your aid in getting us to this day, we would like you here to act as a witness as we formalize and sign our peace accords. Will you do us the honor of igniting the Flames of Remembrance?
90871.completion: It is done. Today marks the first day of the Silversun Compact. May the oaths we sign ourselves to today bind us in trying times to do the right thing.

90876.title: Reluctant Hand
90876.objectives: Assist in preparing the Umbral Atrium.
90876.description:
Champion, I felt it was important to have you here for this moment so that neither I nor my wayward former peer get off topic with his many failings.

I also want a witness in case he turns to evil. 

Would you be so kind as to unpack a few items so that I do not have to touch them?
90876.progress:
I am not so filled with pride that I cannot admit to some... mild nostalgia for the banter I once enjoyed with my former peer. 

Magister Umbric was once quite the source of counterpoints and suggestions that went beyond expectations, and helped push our knowledge of magic further and further.
90876.completion:
So, we help save the city and in return, I'm allowed to have my old things back.

From anyone else, that would be an insult. From Rommath? The highest of praise.

Oh, he even kept my old alembic... how thoughtful.

90879.title: Brewmaster's Kitchen
90879.objectives: Follow the steps to cook Brewfest food and a delicious Brew.
90879.description:
Now that ye've gathered the materials, we can get to cookin'! We'll need plenty o' food for the whole crowd.

We've got a short but sweet menu: Barley Soup, Pretzels, and of course a good ol' brew!

Are ye ready to learn the ropes?
90879.completion: Ah, I can smell the pretzels from here. Ye've cooked up a spread that'll keep even the pickiest dwarves satisfied!

90880.title: Serving with Style
90880.objectives: Take the customer's order and serve the food to them.
90880.description:
Ye've done well in the kitchen, now it's time to learn how to serve! Brewfest isn't just about food--it's about makin' sure everyone has a good time.

Ye'll be takin' orders, deliverin' dishes, and pourin' drinks with a smile.

Get out there and show 'em how it's done. Brewfest won't run without good service!
90880.progress: Remember to serve with a smile!
90880.completion: I'd say ye've earned yerself a nice break and a brew after all of yer hard work. But don't get too relaxed! There's still plenty to do to keep Brewfest runnin'!

90882.title: Gnoll Way
90882.progress: Handle those gnolls while we figure out our next move.
90882.completion:
Excellent job. However, we cannot rest.

We have word of more chaos in the highlands.

90883.title: To Go'shek Farm
90883.progress: Find Farmer Bruvk outside of Go'Shek Farm.
90883.completion: I never thought I'd get this much help! Please, you have to stop them!

90885.title: My Beautiful Pumpkins
90885.description:
The kobolds and ogres appeared out of nowhere and kicked us out of the farm!

I thought this was some Alliance plot until you all showed up. Maybe the Alliance is here to help us after all.

You have to help me get my precious pumpkins back. I've spent the entire harvest cultivating them!

You lead the way. I'll grab the pumpkins when you find them.
90885.progress: Return to Thrall with Farmer Bruvk and his pumpkins
90885.completion:
That's... quite a lot of pumpkins.

I think our farmer friend should take them back to Hammerfall. Horde reinforcements should be there by now.

90886.title: Best Laid Plans of Kobolds and Ogres
90886.description:
The kobolds and ogres here seem to be carrying some sort of plan for their attack.

I don't think they're particularly well written, so I'll need several of them to figure out what the ogres are planning.
90886.progress: Did you recover the plans? They should be on most of the foes within the farm.
90886.completion:
Just as I thought.

I can barely read any of this.

90887.title: Farmer's Nemesis
90887.description:
Farmer Bruvk mentioned an ogre named Runk was leading the group here.

These creatures won't leave this place as long as that ogre is commanding them.
90887.progress: We'll stay here and guard the remaining farmers while you handle Runk.
90887.completion: This should help disperse the creatures. Without a leader they'll flee when Alliance and Horde reinforcements show up.

90888.title: Saving Stromgarde Keep
90888.description:
The plans you found indicate the ogres are trying to get food to supply a massive attack on Stromgarde Keep!

Or they're trying to use the crops to keep guarding an object named a storm. The translation was loose. 

It's safe to assume our problem is the former. Let's go!
90888.completion: This looks bad, but it's nothing we can't handle.

90892.title: Clearing the Skies: A Fel of a Time
90892.objectives: Collect bronze by flying through 10 Lost Legion demons and 25 Motes of Bronze.
90892.description:
<The skies are full of residual time energy and demons pouring in from other timelines.

I should help Eternus by cleaning up the skies. The extra bronze energy would be nice too.>
90892.completion: <The skies are a little clearer now. The infinites might be interested in trading with this extra bronze I've collected.>

90893.title: Repelling the Siege
90893.objectives: Repel the Ogre Siege outside of Stromgarde keep.
90893.description:
We must do everything possible to stop this siege on Stromgarde. 

Make your way into the battle and weaken the ogre forces.

Stromgarde should be able to rally if they can gain the upper hand.
90893.completion: The siege is at an end. We've got their leader cornered.

90895.title: Catapult Bombardment
90895.description:
These catapults are relentless. They must be destroyed.

Place these rune stones at their base. It'll unleash arcane magic to turn the catapults to dust.

I'll take out a few as well as I make my way across the battlefield.
90895.completion: With the catapults gone the soldiers of Stromgarde should be able to gain the upperhand.

90896.title: One Last Ogre
90896.description:
The head of the siege is still cowering within the former Horde encampment. 

He managed to hide from Jaina's spell behind several of his cohorts.

You can have the honors to confront of him. Jaina and I will stay here to ensure any remnants of the siege do not return.

End this.
90896.progress: Defeat Ro'grok and end this siege.
90896.completion: The siege is over. Arathi Highlands will hopefully return to a somewhat peaceful state now.

90897.title: Back to Stromgarde
90897.objectives: Meet Jaina Proudmoore within Stromgarde Keep.
90897.description:
I think we can count ourselves lucky there was no bigger threat here beyond a group of overambitious ogres. 

The same can't be said of other threats that are looming throughout Azeroth.

Come. Let's return to Stromgarde to discuss matters further.
90897.completion: It's good to see the people here in high spirits.

90898.title: Back to Hammerfall
90898.description:
We're not always so lucky that a plan such as this is ended so swiftly and without a surprise portal or two.

That being said, more dangers lurk throughout Azeroth. I know you can be of help to some.

Let us return to Hammerfall to see how they're recovering.
90898.completion: Hammerfall will recover in time and become stronger than it was before.

90901.title: As A Matter of Artifact
90901.objectives: Unlock artifacts traits using Infinite Power gained from looting Epoch Mementos from any enemy.
90901.description:
There's more to artifacts than meets the eye, {NAME}.

Simply using an artifact allows its legend to grow, and as that legend grows, so too does its power.

In order to unlock the full potential of that power, however, you'll need to focus infinite power into the artifact's traits. As more traits are empowered the artifact's true potential will be unlocked, and its legend will be undeniable.

Let's get started.
90901.progress: Unlocking the full potential of your artifact will be key to understanding their impact on this timeline.
90901.completion:
As you gather infinite power do not forget to focus it into your artifact.

The more power you invest, the swifter you will gather more infinite power and grow your artifact's legend--and your own.

90938.title: A Skip Through the Void
90938.description:
Fleshling, do you know about Untethered Space? I am sure you know someone who has encountered it. 
 
Previously we assumed that only beings of energy such as those from K'aresh could Phase Dive. Since the Harbinger's return, she has created a means for solid creatures to become energy using Reshii Wraps.
 
My name is Hashim, and I have some Reshii Wraps in my possession. We are in desperate need of adventurers powerful enough to brave the lucrative depths of Untethered Space.
90938.completion: I can provide you with everything you need to explore Untethered Space.

90957.title: Initiation Day
90957.objectives: Elder Hagar is asking you to kill 6 Invasive drifters from around the roots of Teldrassil, and then meet with Root Tender Dalnir.
90957.description:
{NAME}, today is when you find your proper place among the haranir.

Root Tender Dalnir will guide you. His path is one of tradition and humility, so don't expect excitement. By the end of the day, you will make your mark in the Den of Remembrance. The story you begin now will build on those that came before, like the roots themselves, growing the foundations of Harandar.

Dalnir was clearing invasive drifters from the roots. Before you go to him, aid Dalnir by removing some of the pests yourself.
90957.completion:
The time has come to take your place among our people, and give up childish adventures. Follow my guidance and Aln'hara bless this day.

Remember, our traditions show us the way.

90958.title: Roots Above All
90958.objectives: Root Tender Dalnir wants you to pull weeds, remove mud skippers and invasive fungi from the area.
90958.description:
Some say the great trees grow, and Harandar will remain even if we do not tend them. Our traditions say, it does not matter. We remain here to protect, tend and serve. We do this with dedication and humility.

Keeping the environment around the roots clean and free of pests reflects upon this duty. Return to me once you are done. You will represent our ways well, {NAME}.
90958.progress: Have you performed the tasks that I have asked for?
90958.completion:
Is that an outsider's gear? You were aiding Orweyna with these--distractions, instead of your duties. How will you maintain our traditions if you can not follow my guidance through the ceremony?

I will speak to Elder Hagar. Remember the importance of this day and your duty.

90959.title: Traditional Duties
90959.objectives: An inner voice is telling you to search for the outsider in Har'mara.
90959.description:
Dalnir has a point about the ceremony, but we should not focus too narrowly. I still hold the values of our people, but sometimes we must look beyond.

Do not worry. You should be focusing on the ceremony. I will search for the outsiders later.

I am sure you could join me once the initiation ceremony is done.
90959.progress: Hello, {NAME}. Hagar offered that I will remain as a witness to your ceremony.
90959.completion:
The outsider told us of your actions. 

You must understand, {NAME}, though it was courageous, it was dangerous, even for you.

I know Dalnir is furious, but Hagar understands your desire to help.

90960.title: My Story, My Legacy
90960.objectives: Elder Hagar asked you to commune with the three murals, and then paint your own story.
90960.description:
{NAME}, the final part of the ceremony is ahead of you, though you've put it at risk with your digressions.

The first mural will show you a vision of your true self, the one that resonates from within you.

The second mural will show you a vision of where you are needed.

The third mural, tradition tells us, breaks the barrier between us and the Goddess herself.

The ceremony will conclude with you painting your story in the Den.
90960.progress: Take your time, {NAME}. The ceremony is not about how fast you do it, but about what you learn from it.
90960.completion:
In all my years of initiations, this has to be a first. It seems that the Goddess herself has noticed you.

I am sensing a mysterious and bountiful journey ahead of you.

90961.title: Stranger in a New Land
90961.objectives: With the conclusion of the ceremony, it is now time to start your journey.
90961.description:
{NAME}, I see you now for who you are. You are dedicated not just to our people, but to the world.

The goddess has acknowledged you as well, and I can not recall such an event--not even Orweyna's ceremony was so eventful.

This is where your story begins. It is time for you to take the first steps of your journey.
90961.completion:
So you are {NAME}? 

I never thought a {race} would show up in the city. With that, Your actions precede you. 

I have arranged some basic gear for you. It is the least I can do for saving one of us.

90968.title: Titanic Rumblings
90968.objectives: Seek out Dagran Thaurissan II at the Delver's Headquarters in Dornogal.
90968.description: Rumors are abuzz of titan forces being sighted around Khaz Algar. Brann has asked Dagran Thaurissan II for assistance in looking into these rumors.
90968.completion: If these rumors are true, we must investigate.

90969.title: Titan Consoles
90969.objectives: Seek out one of Dagran's Titan Consoles in an Overcharged Delve.
90969.description:
Adventurer, the rumors are true. I've seen the titan forces and they are nae friendly. We must try tae discover why they are emergin' now and try and stop 'em from doin' too much damage.

Confront and stop these renegade constructs. To help ye, I've procured some Titan Consoles. I was able to set them up in the affected areas. I can use them to communicate with ye in the field. I am thinkin' we can use them to counter these titan forces as well.
90969.completion: {NAME}, these consoles are bein' overloaded by the titan's presence. If we can defeat them and secure titan discs, I think we can use 'em to empower the console to grant ye boons within the space. The boons can aid you in pushing back these rogue titan constructs.

90970.title: Titan Disc-Count
90970.objectives: Secure Titan Disc Shards and dispatch Titan Constructs within the delve.
90970.description:
We need tae secure more titan discs. Venture deeper into this area, seek out the Titan Constructs, and defeat them. Ye should find disc shards. This console can reassemble them and access their data. 

Make sure tae search for any treasure rooms as well. The constructs appear to be assistin' the local denizens. Some of those locals might've secured additional titan discs with their other treasures.
90970.completion: Did ye find the shards? While ye were away, I remembered I'd found some on my visit to that location. Ye should find them in a pouch I hid next to the console.

90971.title: Overcharged Console
90971.objectives: Restore a Titan Disc and then spend it to unlock one of the starting nodes in the Overcharged Console Tech Tree.
90971.description:
With the shards ye found, we can use the console tae restore the titan discs and use them to access powerful boons. 

Use the console's disc repair feature to create a titan disc, then use that disc to select a starting node in the overcharge console's interface.
90971.completion:
My remote console shows that there was a change. The overcharged console is funnelin' excess energy to a new node. This should grant ye that node's power when venturin' intae other areas where the titan constructs have emerged.

We'll use the titan force's own energy against 'em!

90972.title: A Common Cause
90972.description:
