{NAME}! I heard you were here on K'aresh. Good. I need help.
 
My apprentice Leona has been researching novel means of harnessing the power of the Void. She's approached a Demon Hunter named Adarus to see if the Illidari's methods could offer any insights.
 
To be honest, I'm not sure I trust Adarus. He's not... studious. Unlike Leona.
 
Leona was just going to observe him as he sought to master the Void. But she's disappeared. Please find her. Talk with Adarus--he knows something.
90972.progress: Have you spoken to Adarus yet, {NAME}? It's clear that the Illidari's apotheosis has stripped them of their manners.
90972.completion:
Adarus sent you? 

His lack of faith in my abilities and desire to delegate speak volumes.

90993.title: Take the Darkwell!
90993.description:
We have our army but what lies behind these walls are the most powerful, most vile, and most empowered foes Xal'atath has in her arsenal. 

Gather your strongest allies, {NAME}, and meet us within. It is time to end this and take back our well.

90995.title: The Future of The Fel Hammer
90995.description:
Oh wait! Of course, right when I send you off I remember the most important thing!

The you-of-this-timeline made a critical choice for the future of all demon hunters. The follower they chose to be their personal champion created two diverging timelines for the fate of the Illidari.

You will need to choose which of these diverging timelines to explore. What rings true to you?
90995.completion: Very well, we will study this version of the timeline. Let us see what the Illidari hold in their future--err, past.

91009.title: Durable Information Storage Container
91009.objectives: Complete a Delve to charge the device.
91009.description:
Adventurer, can you hear me? I've discovered a smaller titan device, the Durable Information Storage Container, which can fit on yer belt. I've deduced they'll be able tae play smaller titan discs, granting ye boons ye can use anywhere. 

Each of these devices need a jump start. If ye kick up enough dust in these delves it should generate a spark that the device will detect and collect. It should be enough tae power it for yer lifetime.
91009.completion:
Attach the device. Yes! The device is powered on. 

Okay... If I just start the initialization sequence... and it's up. There are already two discs inside. And the menu will list areas where other miniature titan discs can be found. I'm thinkin' I can improve the device, but I need time. Find me later and see.

91026.title: Gathering an Upgrade
91026.description:
Hello? Hello? You're back! Perfect!

I was studying the titan console and gathering a bunch of new information from the overcharged areas including the faulty directives that were found. This might be the key to this unexpected behavior, but I'll need more time tae know for sure.

Return to the delves and we can check the results of the faulty directives, I can use the information to create an upgrade for yer belt!
91026.completion:
Here, yes... With that information I can make some final tweaks. And adding this directive...

Ah! That should do it. If you insert this into yer durable information storage container, it should update the effectiveness of the device's, um... effects.

91030.title: New Titan Directives
91030.description:
My calculations need a lot more data. I've got another upgrade card nearly finished, but I'm not sure if it will integrate properly.

But if ye go back into the delve spaces and defeat more of the enemies, I can see how they react. Based on their reactions, I can put the final touches on this upgrade for yer belt.
91030.progress: I can't wait to see the data!
91030.completion:
Hmm, as I suspected. Yes... I need to adjust this here... done.

The good news is that this upgrade will nae make yer belt explode! I thought there was a small chance, but no longer. Yer data proved that I set the power too high. So... good thing I had ye do tha' extra check, right?

91031.title: Pushing it to the Limit
91031.description:
I realized after ye left last time that I might have worried ye a wee bit with the whole exploding belt upgrade possibility. I'm sorry. I get a bit excited sometimes.

I do think I can get even more power out o' the belt. At least a bit more. Safely of course! In yer data, I've seen that you've encountered many enemies as ye entered many delves. That's the key, return one more time for this last upgrade for yer belt.
91031.progress: I cannae wait to see if I was correct!
91031.completion:
The data from that last excursion provided what I needed for another upgrade. But this is the last upgrade we can do for the belt, unless we want a major meltdown. Of course a meltdown would tell us a lot about the design...

Ma always said, "Dagran! If yer gonna destroy ancient, irreplaceable artifacts, destroy yer own." So this is the last upgrade.

Here is the last upgrade card. Thank ye for yer help. I hope we get a chance to experiment more in the future!

91033.title: Monitoring 'Construct'ing
91033.description:
Welcome back, adventurer. I have a simple request for ye. I need ye tae continue monitorin' these titan constructs. 

We have seen them moving around Azeroth in different locations, but I've not yet figured out their end goal or what instructions they might have. Perhaps if ye can gather more information, an insight will present itself.
91033.completion:
Their behavior seems mostly unchanged. This is very frustrating. Also if yer data is correct, it looks like they might be calmin' down. 

We will have tae see if this observation is true. And here is some additional gear that we have collected. I hope it has served ye well over the course of our scientific endeavors!

91035.title: Construct De-Escalation
91035.objectives: Defeat 5 constructs and complete an Overcharged Delve.
91035.description:
Yer previous results showed a reduction in the overcharge present in the constructs. We must see if that was a one-off or if the reduction is escalatin'...

Head back into these overcharged areas and test out the charge on the constructs, then report back.
91035.completion:
Wow! Tha' drop off is huge. If this holds steady, these constructs could be gone soon! 

We still don't know what prompted them to come out! What if we never know? I hope that they return.

Oh, no! I don't want them tae mess things up. I just hate tae leave this unsolved. 

At least we will be more prepared if we do see them again. Thank ye for yer help, {NAME}. I've checked the numbers and yer belt should still work, even if the constructs do retreat. 

And one last box of supplies for yer help.

91038.title: Hellhunters Wanted
91038.objectives: Bring the missive to Baranar in Dornogal.
91038.description:
<A scorch-marked missive has been nailed to this wall.>

HELL COMES FOR YOU!

Now that we have your attention, please be warned that shards of brimstone have entered this world. They are warm to the touch and should not, under any circumstances, be stabbed into your head, the head of anyone else, or any other vital organ of you or anyone near you.

Please bring any shards you find IMMEDIATELY to us in Dornogal.

And if you see any tiny little minions carrying a bag of treasures, KILL THEM ON SIGHT.
91038.completion:
We appreciate your interest in aiding us.

Shards of our timeline have made their way into your world. It is a place more grim and dark than your own, where some villains became heroes and some heroes never had the chance.

Help us locate these hellish fragments out of time and return them to their rightful place, and we will provide you with armors tempered by the fires of our world.

And should you find any Treasure Goblins that lurk in your world, we implore you to slay the abominations.

91039.title: Faerin's Request
91039.objectives: Speak to Faerin Lothar in Dornogal.
91039.description:
{NAME},

Geya'rah and Danath have arrived in Dornogal. They both seem upset about rising tensions in the Arathi Highlands. It sounds serious.

Can you come to Dornogal? I believe your presence can help the situation.

Faerin

91041.title: A Gently Shaken Gift
91041.objectives: This present looks like it has been shaken a few times. The tag on it reads:To a very special <race> <class>.
91041.completion:
This present looks like it has been shaken a few times. The tag on it reads:

To a very special {race} {class}.

91042.title: A Winter Veil Gift
91042.completion:
A small tag on this present reads:

Happy holidays, {NAME}!

91044.title: Hunger of the Void
91044.objectives: Reconvene with Magister Umbric and Leona back in Shan'dorah.
91044.description:
I did all I could to prevent this outcome. If you hadn't pushed him through the portal the unrestrained void energy would've collapsed the cave around us.

He was strong. In a way, I think that worked against him.

Meet me back in Shan'dorah. I need to report to Umbric and let him know what happened here.
91044.progress: I could feel the void energies roiling from here, {class}. What exactly happened?
91044.completion:
I sincerely hope that Adarus is well, and that he doesn't blame us. The ren'dorei have enough enemies as it is.

I am excited that Leona has made a breakthrough. Though she never would have succeeded without your help.

91052.title: Worldsoul: Overcharged Delves
91052.objectives: Complete an Overcharged War Within Delve at any difficulty.
91052.description: Something has caused hostile titan constructs to activate and enter various caverns and spaces around Khaz Algar. Venture to these locations and investigate and eliminate the threat they pose.
91052.completion: It is unnerving to not know what has forced these hostile titan units to surface. But due to your efforts their threat is at an end.

91061.title: Infinite Chaos
91061.description:
You may think this ironic, but our time is running short, {NAME}. Great forces threaten more than one world's future.

Nozdormu won't like it, but I must hasten our study with experimentation. I have isolated a fractured timeline for you to explore. But be warned--this realm is devoid of all hope. It is the only way I can truly prepare us for what is to come.

I have established a research console by the fel monument behind you. Use it to enter this forbidden future so that we may learn the unknowable.
91061.progress: Have you seen the dark times that could have been?
91061.completion:
You are braver than I thought, {NAME}.

Please continue to experiment. I will not let us enter dangerous futures unprepared.

91066.title: Brewmaster's Kitchen
91066.objectives: Follow the steps to cook Brewfest food and a delicious Brew.
91066.description:
Good, you've brought the supplies. Now, we begin the feast. We'll need plenty of food to keep up our strength.

The menu's simple, but worthy: Barley Stew, Stone-baked Pretzels, and a strong brew to fuel the Horde!

Are you prepared to learn?
91066.progress: Start the fire and get to work!
91066.completion: Hah! I can smell those pretzels from here. You've cooked up a feast fit to silence even the grumbling of dwarves!

91067.title: Gathering the Grub
91067.objectives: Collect Bags of Brewfest Ingredients and deposit them at the wagon.
91067.description:
Ah, you're here. Brewfest has begun-but we've got a problem. Can't have a proper feast without food, and some thieving hozen thought it'd be clever to snatch our grub.

Here's what you'll do: track down those hozen and take back what's ours. You might find a few bags just lying around too-grab those. Once you've got the goods, toss them in the wagon behind me.
91067.progress: The feast won't come together without those ingredients!
91067.completion: You've done it! The cooks will be pleased.

91068.title: Serving with Style
91068.objectives: Take the customer's order and serve the food to them.
91068.description:
You've proven your strength at cooking, now it's time to prove it on the floor! Brewfest isn't just about feastin-it's about bringing the revelry to every corner of the camp.

You'll be taking orders, hauling plates, and pouring ale like a true warrior of celebration.

Now get out there and show them what real service looks like! Brewfest don't run on empty mugs!
91068.progress: Remember to serve with a smile!
91068.completion: I'd say you've earned yourself a break and a strong brew after all that work. But don't go getting soft on me! Brewfest isn't over, and there's still plenty of work to be done.

91089.title: Defeating Ky'veza
91089.objectives: Increase your item level to challenge Ky'veza in her tier 8 delve on K'aresh.
91089.description:
So she's here to collect a bounty, eh?

Did nae one tell her it's rude to try and kill a Champion of Azeroth? Or a Bronzebeard, for that matter?
91089.completion:
Whew! Good riddance.

I cannae stand all tha skulking around and teleportin' about tha place.

Might be time for a wee bit of vacation after all this excitement.

91090.title: Pesky Pests
91090.objectives: Kill 10 Sungrubs and fly to chase away 10 Persistent Butterflies.
91090.description:
Nearby creatures are suffering an infection of Light, and are being drawn to the Sunbath. Our guests find it disturbing. That is a problem, when one is trying to enjoy a tranquil escape from the world.

I confess, having one run into your leg while you are swimming can be unnerving.

Please, dissuade the invading sungrubs from joining us, and take to the sky to chase off those persistent butterflies.
91090.progress: Are the insects giving you trouble?
91090.completion:
That wasn't so bad, was it? 

Val does get a bit dramatic, but you performed wonderfully.

91093.title: More Than Just a Phase
91093.objectives: Complete activities while phase diving in Untethered Space on K'aresh.
91093.description:
Untethered Space represents an ongoing danger to our people on K'aresh. It is infested with banished souls, broken technology, and monsters of all kinds.

Aid the K'aresh Trust and defeat our foes in Untethered Space. You may use the Phase Conduits to navigate between the remnants of K'aresh while phase diving.
91093.progress: I dream of a day when we K'areshi can roam these lands freely and without fear.
91093.completion: Your assistance is most appreciated, {race}. The Trust was wise in appointing you to aid our efforts.

91095.title: Prey: Magister Sunbreaker (Normal)
91095.description:
Once a noble Magister of Silvermoon, sworn to protect Quel'Thalas at any cost, he has broken away from the order and now seeks vengeance on his own terms.

I see something of myself in him.

Kill it for me.

91096.title: Prey: Magistrix Emberlash (Normal)
91096.description:
Alas, you can only catch so many innocent bystanders in your fireballs before you find yourself ostracized from polite society. Emberlash was always more interested in flame than friends...

She has burned one too many mutual acquaintances. 

If she will not control her power, we will gladly take it for our own.

91097.title: Prey: Senior Tinker Ozwold (Normal)
91097.description:
Rumor has it that Ozwold single-handedly raised insurance premiums in Gnomeregan before their little exodus. Be that as it may, he's consistently taken to perfecting his gadgetry regardless of the cost to others.

His ambition is admirable, but his methods are irredeemable. 

Go and see that his inventing days come to an end.

91098.title: Prey: L-N-0R the Recycler (Normal)
91098.description:
Do you know why they call her the Recycler, $p? I don't. And given her history of "disappearing" shop assistants, I'm not really inclined to ask her.

That being said, watch your step. I understand that she likes to incorporate her victims into her gadgetry. We wouldn't want you becoming a pocket watch or some such thing.

91099.title: Prey: Mordril Shadowfell (Normal)
91099.description:
The Void is a perfidious thing, like water. The wise keep it at a respectful distance, never dancing too close to the edge. The foolish dive in, and in so doing, drown.

Mordril is a danger to himself and everyone around him, so lost is he in his own obsession.

See to it that he no longer poses a threat to this realm.

91100.title: Prey: Deliah Gloomsong (Normal)
91100.description:
In a previous life, Deliah Gloomsong was a prodigious student--truly a marvel of ambition, talent, and unrelenting curiosity. 

It was the latter that got the best of her.

Put an end to her murderous spree.

91101.title: Prey: Phaseblade Talasha (Normal)
91101.description:
Ethereals... they make my skin crawl. Esoteric. Unknowable. I don't trust anything I can't look in the eyes while it grovels before me.

My scouts report that a particularly dangerous ethereal is active in a nearby region. We would do well to nip this in the bud while we still can.

91102.title: Prey: Nexus-Edge Hadim (Normal)
91102.description:
Our activities are drawing unwanted attention. I have heard whispers that a powerful ethereal assassin is on my... on our trail. It would be very difficult indeed to defend our city as twin piles of bloody ribbons.

Go out there and show this "assassin" the true art of the kill.

91103.title: Prey: Jo'zolo the Breaker (Normal)
91103.description:
Jo'zolo the Breaker is a troll who abides by his name. Long has he been the bane of our scouts, but no more! 

Kill him. Feed his anguish to the defenses of our beloved city.

91104.title: Prey: Zadu, Fist of Nalorakk (Normal)
91104.description:
Our neighbors produce some of the most skilled hunters in all of Azeroth. It is a shame they are so difficult to reason with. 
 
There is one named Zadu. Her anguish would make for a most excellent trophy...

91105.title: Prey: The Talon of Jan'alai (Normal)
91105.description:
There is a powerful troll shaman who calls himself the Talon of Jan'alai. Long has he confounded our city's Farstriders, sowing confusion and death in his wake.

See to it that he joins the spirits he so ardently venerates.

91106.title: Prey: The Wing of Akil'zon (Normal)
91106.description:
Do you smell that? There is death on the air. This can only mean one thing. The Wing of Akil'zon is near. Go out and slay her.

Oh, and be careful. She's responsible for more than one lost Farstrider patrol.

91107.title: Prey: Ranger Swiftglade (Normal)
91107.description:
It is a difficult thing, to hunt one of our own. Ranger Swiftglade is beyond redemption. His bloodlust could not be sated against our foes, and he has since turned his martial prowess upon his own people.

End his sadistic killing spree and put his anguish to better use.

91108.title: Prey: Lieutenant Blazewing (Normal)
91108.description:
I do not know what to make of Lieutenant Blazewing. Her entire patrol disappeared during a reconnaissance mission into Zul'Aman. She was the sole survivor, but she returned with a fiery bloodlust and a complete disregard for the lives of others. 

Whether this is possession or sedition I am unsure, but she must be dealt with.

91109.title: Prey: Petyoll the Razorleaf (Normal)
91109.description:
Reports are coming in of shredded Farstriders adorned with petals and berries--entire patrols found strung up by razor-vines. There are more gruesome details, but they chafe even my... refined sensibilities. 

Hunt whatever manner of creature is embarking on this horrific killing spree, and see to it that its anguish is added to our crystals.

91110.title: Prey: Lamyne of the Undercroft (Normal)
91110.description:
Do you garden, $p? I've been known to dabble. It seems the plants in our realm are becoming somewhat overbearing these days, sprouting legs and arms and running around murdering our brave soldiers. 

Let's give them a bit of a pruning, shall we?

91111.title: Prey: High Vindicator Vureem (Normal)
91111.description:
High Vindicator Vureem is a victim of his own unyielding faith in the Light and the superiority it gives him. His crusade continues unabated and unresolved. He exists in a constant state of fury at the imperfectness of the world and those within it.

In the absence of total purity, Vureem sees only violence and the shadows of his own dogma. 

What say we put his worldview to the test?

91112.title: Prey: Crusader Luxia Maxwell (Normal)
91112.description:
We are not sure if Luxia Maxwell is a deserter or has simply decided to embark on her own personal crusade. Regardless, reports are coming in of her attacking both friend and foe alike, yelling aphorisms of purity and duty.

She has become a liability to the defense of Silvermoon. 

Go and harvest her anguish.

91113.title: Prey: Praetor Singularis (Normal)
91113.description:
The domanaar...

<Astalor shudders.>

I do not profess to know much about them, other than their proclivity for subterfuge, guile, and the absolute destruction of anything that stands before them. Praetor Singularis is no exception. They have been confounding our forces at every turn.

Go and put an end to their games.

91114.title: Prey: Consul Nebulor (Normal)
91114.description:
I have heard that there is one under Xal'atath's command who takes particular delight in dominating their foes. Whispers of a domanaar that taunts its victims with whispers and riddles before annihilating their mortal coil with void magic.
  
Consul Nebulor is their name.

Go and show them the limits of their power.

91115.title: Prey: Executor Kaenius (Normal)
91115.description:
The domanaar have a reputation for guile and cunning, but there are brutes among them: those who seek to dominate their victims through sheer power and force of will.

Executor Kaenius is one such domanaar.

They stalk the battlefield, singling out our strongest soldiers and viciously cutting them down.

Put an end to their rampage.

91116.title: Prey: Imperator Enigmalia (Normal)
91116.description:
Imperator Enigmalia is personally responsible for the deaths of at least a dozen Farstriders. I say "at least" because this particular domanaar makes it somewhat difficult to identify the bodies, so utterly destroyed are they.

Go and avenge our fallen soldiers.

91117.title: Prey: Knight-Errant Bloodshatter (Normal)
91117.description:
Death knights are unstable killing machines at the best of times. Knight-Errant Bloodshatter has forsaken any oath or promise that would ostensibly bind one of his kind to the bottom rungs of civilized society, and has gone completely rogue.
 
He is starting to become a liability. 

Recoup his anguish so that we can make the best of such an unfortunate situation.

91118.title: Prey: Vylenna the Defector (Normal)
91118.description:
Vylenna the Defector lives up to her name. After a recent engagement on the field of battle, she became so preoccupied with profaning the dead that she completely abandoned the duties ascribed to her.

Then her dereliction turned violent.

A veritable font of anguish if you ask me...

91119.title: Prey: Lost Theldrin (Normal)
91119.description:
Those of us who succumbed to our base desire for mana were slowly weeded out of civil society, if they survived at all. Theldrin is one such example, only it is a testament to his cunning and will to live that he has made it as long as he has.

He accepts no aid, choosing instead to stalk careless students and idle Magisters. His sole obsession is the mana that others possess...

See to it that he never harms another elf again.

91120.title: Prey: Neydra the Starving (Normal)
91120.description:
Poor Neydra... I knew her, in a previous life. She was full of vitality. Full of ambition. Unfortunately, she let that ambition get the best of her. She grew too enamored with the raw power of the arcane. She became resentful of all other things. Of all other people...

And now she is a murderous creature who beheads rats and attacks innocents in a desperate attempt to garner enough arcane energy to slake her unquenchable thirst.

It's funny, the paths life takes us...

91121.title: Prey: Thornspeaker Edgath (Normal)
91121.description:
This one presents a prickly problem indeed. Thornspeaker Edgath has made a name for himself by using his druidic powers not to preserve Azeroth, but to twist its strength both against his enemies and innocent bystanders alike. He has no regard for anything that is not a beast or growing in the ground.

It is time we clip this thorn.

91122.title: Prey: Thorn-Witch Liset (Normal)
91122.description:
Thorn-Witch Liset is a curse upon civilization and a blight upon the land itself. She twists the very trees and beasts, communing with the dark, evil things that live on the very edges of the natural realm.

I despise the natural realm.

91123.title: Prey: Grothoz, the Burning Shadow (Normal)
91123.description:
The Twilight's Blade are an embarrassing band of mediocre cultists and uninspired conspirators. Grothoz is the brains of a particularly stupid cabal that has been active in a nearby region. 

As his stupidity prevents him from using his whole brain, let us unlock his potential for him...

91124.title: Prey: Dengzag, the Darkened Blaze (Normal)
91124.description:
Do you know why the Twilight's Blade call Dengzag the "Darkened Blaze?" It is because they are stupid, small-minded, and utterly bereft of imagination. What a silly name indeed. 

I, however, am not small-minded. I have quite the prodigious mind, and it is currently intent on putting an end to Dengzag and whatever his tiny brain is up to. 

Get to it.

91137.title: Lost in Light
91137.objectives: Kill Liya Waterbloom and send the hikers home.
91137.description:
It seems some of our more adventurous guests have not returned from their hike. Val said he saw a rutaani skulking about earlier, but I was certain he was just trying to add some drama to our day.

The Lightbloom infiltrated the Sanctum to the north and has been spilling residual issues our way.

Our guests are here to escape the troubles of the world... This all could become a bit too real for them.

If you'll take care of that situation, I'll make sure Val keeps the guests distracted.
91137.completion:
Tormenting our guests was a step too far.

She encroached on the sunbath and has paid the price for her actions.

Thank you, new friend of the Solaar family!

91138.title: I am the Creator and Destroyer
91138.objectives: Demonstrate your mastery over life and death.
91138.description:
Such a small thing, really. And devoid of any of the power T'uure once nurtured. But a relic of inestimable value nonetheless.

Did you know, {class}, that to T'uure, the dark and the light were inseparable aspects of a greater truth?

What creates, has the power to destroy in equal measure. Demonstrate this lesson and you will reach a new understanding of yourself, and of the great Naaru whose sacrifice was able to halt the annihilation of an entire planet.
91138.completion:
Ah yes. I can sense the change in you. The growth that comes with meting out death in one hand, while nuturing life in the other.

Perhaps this small token will serve as a reminder of T'uure and his role in Dimensius' ultimate fate.

91140.title: A Piece of the Past
91140.objectives: Show the fragment to Om'en in Tazavesh.
91140.description:
<This crystalline fragment has lost any luster it once had. Now finally extricated from Dimensius's dread form and in the hands of the devout, a brief glimmer revives in its depths.

Perhaps someone in Tazavesh will know more.>
91140.progress: What is this? Ah, I see now. You were right to come to me.
91140.completion:
A fragment of the lost naaru T'uure? And lodged in the form of Dimensius?

Now this is something I never thought I'd see.

91142.title: Tabard for the Trusted
91142.objectives: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.
91142.completion: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.

91173.title: The Flame Burns Eternal
91173.description:
These Sureki sure are a persistent bunch! We need to match their persistence with our blades.

Can we count on your continued support in the battles ahead?
91173.progress: Ready yourself soldier, the battle is still to come.
91173.completion:
You've bought us a moment of peace.

Rest well, but always keep your blade sharp.

91210.title: Prey: Magister Sunbreaker (Hard)
91210.description:
Once a noble Magister of Silvermoon, sworn to protect Quel'Thalas at any cost, he has broken away from the order and now seeks vengeance on his own terms.

I see something of myself in him.

Kill it for me.

91211.title: Prey: Magister Sunbreaker (Nightmare)
91211.description:
Once a noble Magister of Silvermoon, sworn to protect Quel'Thalas at any cost, he has broken away from the order and now seeks vengeance on his own terms.

I see something of myself in him.

Kill it for me.

91212.title: Prey: Magistrix Emberlash (Hard)
91212.description:
Alas, you can only catch so many innocent bystanders in your fireballs before you find yourself ostracized from polite society. Emberlash was always more interested in flame than friends...

She has burned one too many mutual acquaintances. 

If she will not control her power, we will gladly take it for our own.

91213.title: Prey: Magistrix Emberlash (Nightmare)
91213.description:
Alas, you can only catch so many innocent bystanders in your fireballs before you find yourself ostracized from polite society. Emberlash was always more interested in flame than friends...

She has burned one too many mutual acquaintances. 

If she will not control her power, we will gladly take it for our own.

91214.title: Prey: Senior Tinker Ozwold (Hard)
91214.description:
Rumor has it that Ozwold single-handedly raised insurance premiums in Gnomeregan before their little exodus. Be that as it may, he's consistently taken to perfecting his gadgetry regardless of the cost to others.

His ambition is admirable, but his methods are irredeemable. 

Go and see that his inventing days come to an end.

91215.title: Prey: Senior Tinker Ozwold (Nightmare)
91215.description:
Rumor has it that Ozwold single-handedly raised insurance premiums in Gnomeregan before their little exodus. Be that as it may, he's consistently taken to perfecting his gadgetry regardless of the cost to others.

His ambition is admirable, but his methods are irredeemable. 

Go and see that his inventing days come to an end.

91216.title: Prey: L-N-0R the Recycler (Hard)
91216.description:
Do you know why they call her the Recycler, $p? I don't. And given her history of "disappearing" shop assistants, I'm not really inclined to ask her.

That being said, watch your step. I understand that she likes to incorporate her victims into her gadgetry. We wouldn't want you becoming a pocket watch or some such thing.

91217.title: Prey: L-N-0R the Recycler (Nightmare)
91217.description:
Do you know why they call her the Recycler, $p? I don't. And given her history of "disappearing" shop assistants, I'm not really inclined to ask her.

That being said, watch your step. I understand that she likes to incorporate her victims into her gadgetry. We wouldn't want you becoming a pocket watch or some such thing.

91218.title: Prey: Mordril Shadowfell (Hard)
91218.description:
The Void is a perfidious thing, like water. The wise keep it at a respectful distance, never dancing too close to the edge. The foolish dive in, and in so doing, drown.
 
Mordril is a danger to himself and everyone around him, so lost is he in his own obsession.

See to it that he no longer poses a threat to this realm.

91219.title: Prey: Mordril Shadowfell (Nightmare)
91219.description:
The Void is a perfidious thing, like water. The wise keep it at a respectful distance, never dancing too close to the edge. The foolish dive in, and in so doing, drown.
 
Mordril is a danger to himself and everyone around him, so lost is he in his own obsession.

See to it that he no longer poses a threat to this realm.

91220.title: Prey: Deliah Gloomsong (Hard)
91220.description:
In a previous life, Deliah Gloomsong was a prodigious student--truly a marvel of ambition, talent, and unrelenting curiosity. 

It was the latter that got the best of her.

Put an end to her murderous spree.

91221.title: Prey: Deliah Gloomsong (Nightmare)
91221.description:
In a previous life, Deliah Gloomsong was a prodigious student--truly a marvel of ambition, talent, and unrelenting curiosity. 

It was the latter that got the best of her.

Put an end to her murderous spree.

91222.title: Prey: Phaseblade Talasha (Hard)
91222.description:
Ethereals... they make my skin crawl. Esoteric. Unknowable. I don't trust anything I can't look in the eyes while it grovels before me.

My scouts report that a particularly dangerous ethereal is active in a nearby region. We would do well to nip this in the bud while we still can.
91222.completion: It looks like your limbs are intact and there's nary a knife in your back. Well done, {NAME}.

91223.title: Prey: Phaseblade Talasha (Nightmare)
91223.description:
Ethereals... they make my skin crawl. Esoteric. Unknowable. I don't trust anything I can't look in the eyes while it grovels before me.

My scouts report that a particularly dangerous ethereal is active in a nearby region. We would do well to nip this in the bud while we still can.

91224.title: Prey: Nexus-Edge Hadim (Hard)
91224.description:
Our activities are drawing unwanted attention. I have heard whispers that a powerful ethereal assassin is on my... on our trail. It would be very difficult indeed to defend our city as twin piles of bloody ribbons.

Go out there and show this "assassin" the true art of the kill.

91225.title: Prey: Nexus-Edge Hadim (Nightmare)
91225.description:
Our activities are drawing unwanted attention. I have heard whispers that a powerful ethereal assassin is on my... on our trail. It would be very difficult indeed to defend our city as twin piles of bloody ribbons.

Go out there and show this "assassin" the true art of the kill.

91226.title: Prey: Jo'zolo the Breaker (Hard)
91226.description:
Jo'zolo the Breaker is a troll who abides by his name. Long has he been the bane of our scouts, but no more! 

Kill him. Feed his anguish to the defenses of our beloved city.

91227.title: Prey: Jo'zolo the Breaker (Nightmare)
91227.description:
Jo'zolo the Breaker is a troll who abides by his name. Long has he been the bane of our scouts, but no more! 

Kill him. Feed his anguish to the defenses of our beloved city.

91228.title: Prey: Zadu, Fist of Nalorakk (Hard)
91228.description:
Our neighbors produce some of the most skilled hunters in all of Azeroth. It is a shame they are so difficult to reason with. 
 
There is one named Zadu. Her anguish would make for a most excellent trophy...

91229.title: Prey: Zadu, Fist of Nalorakk (Nightmare)
91229.description:
Our neighbors produce some of the most skilled hunters in all of Azeroth. It is a shame they are so difficult to reason with.

There is one named Zadu. Her anguish would make for a most excellent trophy...

91230.title: Prey: The Talon of Jan'alai (Hard)
91230.description:
There is a powerful troll shaman who calls himself the Talon of Jan'alai. Long has he confounded our city's Farstriders, sowing confusion and death in his wake.

See to it that he joins the spirits he so ardently venerates.

91231.title: Prey: The Talon of Jan'alai (Nightmare)
91231.description:
There is a powerful troll shaman who calls himself the Talon of Jan'alai. Long has he confounded our city's Farstriders, sowing confusion and death in his wake.

See to it that he joins the spirits he so ardently venerates.

91232.title: Prey: The Wing of Akil'zon (Hard)
91232.description:
Do you smell that? There is death on the air. This can only mean one thing. The Wing of Akil'zon is near. Go out and slay her.

Oh, and be careful. She's responsible for more than one lost Farstrider patrol.

91233.title: Prey: The Wing of Akil'zon (Nightmare)
91233.description:
Do you smell that? There is death on the air. This can only mean one thing. The Wing of Akil'zon is near. Go out and slay her.

Oh, and be careful. She's responsible for more than one lost Farstrider patrol.

91234.title: Prey: Ranger Swiftglade (Hard)
91234.description:
It is a difficult thing, to hunt one of our own. Ranger Swiftglade is beyond redemption. His bloodlust could not be sated against our foes, and he has since turned his martial prowess upon his own people.

End his sadistic killing spree and put his anguish to better use.

91235.title: Prey: Ranger Swiftglade (Nightmare)
91235.description:
It is a difficult thing, to hunt one of our own. Ranger Swiftglade is beyond redemption. His bloodlust could not be sated against our foes, and he has since turned his martial prowess upon his own people.

End his sadistic killing spree and put his anguish to better use.

91236.title: Prey: Lieutenant Blazewing (Hard)
91236.description:
I do not know what to make of Lieutenant Blazewing. Her entire patrol disappeared during a reconnaissance mission into Zul'Aman. She was the sole survivor, but she returned with a fiery bloodlust and a complete disregard for the lives of others. 

Whether this is possession or sedition I am unsure, but she must be dealt with.

91237.title: Prey: Lieutenant Blazewing (Nightmare)
91237.description:
I do not know what to make of Lieutenant Blazewing. Her entire patrol disappeared during a reconnaissance mission into Zul'Aman. She was the sole survivor, but she returned with a fiery bloodlust and a complete disregard for the lives of others. 

Whether this is possession or sedition I am unsure, but she must be dealt with.

91238.title: Prey: Petyoll the Razorleaf (Hard)
91238.description:
Reports are coming in of shredded Farstriders adorned with petals and berries--entire patrols found strung up by razor-vines. There are more gruesome details, but they chafe even my... refined sensibilities. 

Hunt whatever manner of creature is embarking on this horrific killing spree, and see to it that its anguish is added to our crystals.

91239.title: Prey: Petyoll the Razorleaf (Nightmare)
91239.description:
Reports are coming in of shredded Farstriders adorned with petals and berries--entire patrols found strung up by razor-vines. There are more gruesome details, but they chafe even my... refined sensibilities. 

Hunt whatever manner of creature is embarking on this horrific killing spree, and see to it that its anguish is added to our crystals.

91240.title: Prey: Lamyne of the Undercroft (Hard)
91240.description:
Do you garden, $p? I've been known to dabble. It seems the plants in our realm are becoming somewhat overbearing these days, sprouting legs and arms and running around murdering our brave soldiers. 

Let's give them a bit of a pruning, shall we?

91267.title: Prey: Thorn-Witch Liset (Nightmare)
91267.description:
Thorn-Witch Liset is a curse upon civilization and a blight upon the land itself. She twists the very trees and beasts, communing with the dark, evil things that live on the very edges of the natural realm.

I despise the natural realm.

91268.title: Prey: Grothoz, the Burning Shadow (Nightmare)
91268.description:
The Twilight's Blade are an embarrassing band of mediocre cultists and uninspired conspirators. Grothoz is the brains of a particularly stupid cabal that has been active in a nearby region. 

As his stupidity prevents him from using his whole brain, let us unlock his potential for him...

91269.title: Prey: Dengzag, the Darkened Blaze (Nightmare)
91269.description:
Do you know why the Twilight's Blade call Dengzag the "Darkened Blaze?" It is because they are stupid, small-minded, and utterly bereft of imagination. What a silly name indeed. 

I, however, am not small-minded. I have quite the prodigious mind, and it is currently intent on putting an end to Dengzag and whatever his tiny brain is up to. 

Get to it.

91271.title: A Fish!
91271.objectives: Catch the best fish for the dish.
91271.description:
There is a deliciously delectable dish that I am dying to share with my guests. We start with just the right fish, then chop it up, drop it in a blend of citrus and our special savory seasonings, and let it bask in the glorious flavors.

In the shake of a tail feather, it becomes a magical delight for the senses!

We are the talk of the town, you know. Could you please procure for us the perfect fish?
91271.progress: I have a great feeling about this one!
91271.completion:
Excellent work, {NAME}! You have procured a perfectly, pleasingly, plumply proportioned pescatarian prize!

Joyous day!

91277.title: Prey: Preferential Killing
91277.objectives: Speak to Astalor to select a customized Prey target, zone, and difficulty.
91277.description:
The anguish you've brought me has been... impeccable. As potent and complex as a finely aged wine.

Normally, scrying the rough whereabouts of our targets takes me time and power. But using these overflowing stores of anguish, I can find anyone you desire to slaughter.

You have done well, my champion. You deserve to reap this bounty. Tell me what you want.
91277.progress:
Consider your choices with relish.

I know I do.

91284.title: A Path Not Yet Chosen
91284.objectives: Collect Recommendations from the Farstrider, Blood Knight, and Magister trainers.
91284.description:
I'm trying to figure out what career path to follow, but I keep second-guessing myself. The Farstriders, the Blood Knights, the Magisters... they all seem so incredible that I can't decide.

I was hoping if I spoke to each and earned a recommendation, I might finally understand where I'm meant to be. Would you help me?
91284.progress: I really hope I find where I belong...
91284.completion:
Wow... I can't believe I actually got all three recommendations. They all said such kind things, but now I feel even more torn than before!

Do you think... perhaps you could help me choose?

91288.title: A Test of the Hunt
91288.objectives: Gather 8 Invasive Lynx Pelts in the Sunstrider Isle.
91288.description:
So, you want a Farstrider recommendation? We don't hand those out like festival ribbons.

If you want to earn it, then you'll need to do what every other recruit does. Bring me lynx pelts, clean and proper.

No shortcuts, no excuses. Let's see if you've got the spine for it.
91288.progress: Have you gotten those pelts yet or are you quitting already?
91288.completion:
Well now, look at that. Clean cuts, no mess... maybe the kid's got more fire than I thought.

Here, take this recommendation. Tell them a Farstrider never forgets who earns their place--and to keep their aim sharp. We'll be watching.

91291.title: A Test of Blood
91291.objectives: Defeat Jesthenis Sunstriker in the Sunstrider Isle.
91291.description:
Ah, you seek a Blood Knight's recommendation, do you? In that case, you'll need to prove your worth... against me. 

Only those with true strength and honor may join our ranks! Prepare yourself. This won't be a simple challenge, but if you can best me, I'll gladly offer my recommendation!
91291.completion:
Impressive! You've got more in you than I expected.

You've proven your strength, honor, and determination--qualities every Blood Knight must possess.

Take this recommendation and wear it with pride. The order is always looking for those who are worthy.

91292.title: A Test of the Arcane
91292.objectives: Charge the Arcane Transfer Staff 4 times in Sunstrider Isle.
91292.description:
Ah, you seek a recommendation from a Magister, do you? Very well... but first, you must prove your understanding of the arcane.

Go to the nearby crystals we have for training, extract their energy, and channel it into this staff. Show me that you can harness the arcane, and I will see you worthy of my recommendation.

Should you fail, don't bother returning. My time is too valuable for such trivial matters.
91292.progress: Well? Is the staff charged, or are you wasting both our lives?
91292.completion:
Hmm, it seems you have a bit more talent than I anticipated.

This staff is properly charged. Well done, though I'm sure you barely broke a sweat.

Take this recommendation, and remember--the arcane demands respect, not just power.

91301.title: How to Train Your Protege
91301.objectives: Turn in the chosen recommendation to Instructor Thalendir in Silvermoon City.
91301.description:
I did everything they asked--the trials, the lessons--and they all said I did well... but I still don't know where I truly belong.

Each path felt right in its own way, and now my heart feels pulled in three directions.

Please... could you help me decide?
91301.completion:
Ah... so the boy has chosen at last. He has heart--too much perhaps.

Yes. This will be recorded and honored. You've done more than deliver a message--you've helped shape a life. Thank you.

91314.title: Untethered Potential
91314.objectives: Collect 5 Phase-Altered essence in Untethered Space.
91314.description:
{class}--I heard you have explored Untethered Space? That place is soaked with pristine void energy. I would like to explore it myself, but the last who have ventured into were consumed by the Void.

I need help with my research. There are Phase-Lost creatures in the Voidscar Cavern that I could use to examine their essence. If you could collect that for me, I would be grateful. 

Go carefully.
91314.progress: Were you able to collect the Phase-Altered essence?
91314.completion:
This will provide a lot to forward my research on Untethered Space. I thank you.

I can't imagine what discoveries we can begin to unravel about K'aresh.

91328.title: Secret Ingredients
91328.objectives: Collect 6 Belanise Blossoms and 5 Sinara Berries for the Solaarian Sintalia.
91328.description:
Our gregarious guests have partaken so much from our stores that we are running dangerously low of our special Solaarian sintalia.

The rich taste of belanise, with its intoxicating scent, contrasts perfectly with the sharp tartness of the local berries. Carefully prepared then soaked in our special blend of spirits, then served--it's to die for!

Just between us, if the berries are not handled just right, the infusion can be quite deadly. Otherwise... delicious, invigorating, purifying, glorious!
91328.completion:
Magic! Perfection! You could not be more skilled if I had wished you into existence.

That is an interesting thought. Could I have?

91413.title: A Twilight Oath's End
91413.objectives: Bring the Mark of the Twilight Oath to Ve'nari in the Oasis on K'aresh.
91413.description:
<The ancient runes on the page seem to twist under your gaze. Their power seems to be rapidly fading.>

<Ve'nari would be interested in this.>
91413.completion:
Salhadaar cheated death to revive Dimensius, and cheated death again by escaping your wrath.

<Ve'nari pauses for a moment.>

A pity he escaped, but the All-Devouring has perished. Thank you.

91417.title: Seek out Arator
91417.objectives: Speak to Arator over by the wounded Vanguard.
91417.description: I see that my son is spending his time with the wounded. Do a father a simple favor and see if he could use your assistance.
91417.completion: Those people fight so hard for us. We must do all we can to protect them.

91420.title: Swap Meet
91420.objectives: Bring your discovery to Om'myuz in Tazavesh.
91420.description: <The mysterious mineral thrums in your hand. Someone in Tazavesh will find a use for this. Look around the Veiled Market for an interested party.>
91420.completion:
<Om'myuz takes a closer look at the ore.>

That is quite the intriguing rock you've found. I would like to inspect it further, and any others you find. What say you to a trade?

Other Cartel Om members in the Veiled Market may also be interested in trading wares, should you come across them.

91426.title: The People's Champion
91426.objectives: Return to the muster point with Arator.
91426.description: I think we've done all we can for the moment, {NAME}. Let's return to the muster point.
91426.completion: We did good work out there, {NAME}. That's all we can ever hope for.

91437.title: Call for Participants
91437.objectives: Speak with Eternus at the Infinite Bazaar near Dalaran.
91437.description:
<You find a scroll in your pocket that was not there before.>

Hey, it's Nostwin! You doing anything? No? Come help us do TIME SCIENCE!

Eternus can tell you more.

Okay thanks bye!

91438.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Worldly Deeds
91438.objectives: Complete 3 world quests in Heroic World Tier.
91438.description:
All across the Broken Isles there are people in need. They search for hope but are hard pressed to find any. You can be that hope.

Seek out those in peril in the Broken Isles and be the champion they so desperately need.

It is through such acts that legends are made.
91438.completion: A single heroic act can turn the tide. A single whisper of hope can turn back despair. This is what gives legends their power.

91439.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Invasion Points
91439.objectives: Complete a Legion invasion point in Heroic World Tier.
91439.description:
The Legion does not fight conventionally. They deceive, manipulate, and undermine their opposition at every turn.

There are no battle lines against the Legion. They will open rifts at a weak point and then spill out of it sowing death and destruction. When they invade, it is on their terms.

However, this strategy is not invincible. Potent champions, able to move and react swiftly, can stop these invasions at their source. Stop the Legion Invasion. Show people that the Legion can be defeated.
91439.completion: The power you and your artifact possess were able to halt a Legion invasion. But was it you, or the artifact you wield, that is responsible? On that I will require more information.

91440.title: Infinite Research: Hero of the Broken Isles
91440.objectives: Complete 5 quests in Heroic World Tier.
91440.description:
Heroic deeds are a matter of perspective. What may seem trivial to a mighty hero such as you, could mean the world to another.

Seek out those in need and aid them in whatever task they deem important. In doing so your legend will grow.
91440.completion: Your name is on the minds of the people, and is shared around the fire. The greater your legend becomes, the more powerful your name will be. But does the power of one's name eclipse that of the artifact they wield? This is the burning question.

91441.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Greater Invasion Points
91441.objectives: Complete a greater Legion invasion point in Heroic World Tier.
91441.description:
Once the Legion has sown confusion and chaos, then they will begin their real assault. Huge invasion rifts will open and the Legion will march forth in great numbers. The defenders, scattered to protect against smaller rifts, will lack sufficient strength anywhere to stop them.

That is when champions like you are most needed.

Seek out one of the Legion's major invasions and throw everything you have at it. 

Show the people that with enough determination you can cancel the apocalypse.
91441.completion: Just as I predicted. You were able to stop a massive Legion invasion. It was not you, or your artifact that did this. Rather it was the combination of both that won the day.

91442.title: Eco-Dome Al'dani
91442.objectives: Biergoth wants you to confront Soul-Scribe within Eco-Dome Al'Dani.
91442.description:
We have received word from Ve'nari that the Wastelanders continue to stand in the way of progress on K'aresh. They threaten the most promising eco-dome.

The restoration directive of K'aresh must not be interrupted.

Put an end to these inefficiencies.
91442.progress: Have you put an end to their efforts?
91442.completion:
This is a promising beginning to our new relationship with K'aresh.

Good work, outlander.

91443.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Rare
91443.objectives: Kill 4 rare enemies in Heroic World Tier.
91443.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a rare study, so focus on fighting rare opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
91443.progress: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.
91443.completion: Well done, {NAME}. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

91444.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Elite
91444.objectives: Kill 5 elite enemies in Heroic World Tier.
91444.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be an elite study, so focus on fighting elite opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
91444.completion: Well done, {NAME}. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

91445.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Comprehensive
91445.objectives: Kill 75 enemies in Heroic World Tier.
91445.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a comprehensive study, so feel free to fight whatever you wish so that we can get a baseline understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
91445.progress: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.
91445.completion: Well done, {NAME}. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

91446.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Rare Elites
91446.objectives: Kill a rare elite enemy in Heroic World Tier.
91446.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a rare elite study, so focus on fighting rare elite opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
91446.completion: Well done, {NAME}. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

91447.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Demonology
91447.objectives: Kill 30 demons in Heroic World Tier.
91447.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a demonology study, so focus on fighting demonic opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
91447.progress: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.
91447.completion: Well done, {NAME}. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

91448.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Terrors of the Broken Isles
91448.objectives: Kill a world boss in Heroic World Tier.
91448.description:
It is time to put both you and your artifact to the test.

Seek out a Terror of the Broken Isles and defeat them.

I am certain that, no matter the outcome, you will provide us with much to think about. I will be watching with great interest.
91448.completion: A fascinating outcome, {NAME}. This will shed some much needed light on our research.

91449.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Empowerment
91449.objectives: Kill 10 empowered enemies in Heroic World Tier.
91449.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of the empowered enemies in the experimental, fractured timeline. We need to understand how your abilities fare in the face of terrifying change. 

And remember, this is for the greater good.
91449.completion: Well done, {NAME}. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

91451.title: Stalk Market
91451.objectives: Bring your discovery to Om'mit in Tazavesh.
91451.description: <The mysterious plant thrums in your hand. Someone in Tazavesh will know what to do with it. Look around the Veiled Market for an interested party.>
91451.completion:
<Om'mit turns the plant over in his hands.>

A void-infused stalk from a dead wasteland? This is utterly useless to you. In fact, let me take it off your hands in exchange for plants with more... familiar properties.

Other Cartel Om members in the Veiled Market may also be interested in trading wares, should you come across them.

91454.title: Phase-Lost Adventurer
91454.objectives: Take the journal to Researcher Essarae in Shan'dorah.
91454.description:
Covered in slime and saliva, the journal bears a partial entry of a previous Phase Diver.

<Day 27

Untethered Space is much more vast than I expected, with monsters stronger than I have seen on K'aresh. 

There is a nearby cave I will explore tomorrow. It is brimming with Phase-Altered Essence. This could bode useful for better understanding the ecology out here.>

Researcher Essarae would be very interested in this.
91454.completion:
<Essarae flips to a random page in the journal.>

This is brimming with knowledge of Untethered Space. I would like to read it further. 

Thank you for aiding my research.

91459.title: Manaforge Omega: A Walking Shadow
91459.objectives: Defeat Nexus-King Salhadaar within Manaforge Omega on Normal difficulty or higher.
91459.description:
Hero, can you hear me? There's a translocator the Shadowguard uses to send cargo to their reserves that can carry you directly to their post beneath the Manaforge. An ambush they'll never see coming!

There is of course, a catch. We do not have clearance to use their supply lines... so we need you to procure some for us. Take down the highest-ranking member of the Shadowguard you can find, return with identification, and we'll forge you a one-way ticket to the front lines.
91459.completion: That certainly qualifies as high-ranking, {NAME}! After I work my magic, that translocator is as good as ours. Next stop, enemy territory!

91460.title: Manaforge Omega: A Walking Shadow
91460.objectives: Defeat Nexus-King Salhadaar within Manaforge Omega on Heroic difficulty or higher.
91460.description:
Hero, can you hear me? There's a translocator the Shadowguard uses to send cargo to their reserves that can carry you directly to their post beneath the Manaforge. An ambush they'll never see coming!

There is of course, a catch. We do not have clearance to use their supply lines... so we need you to procure some for us. Take down the highest-ranking member of the Shadowguard you can find, return with identification, and we'll forge you a one-way ticket to the front lines.
91460.completion: That certainly qualifies as high-ranking, {NAME}! After I work my magic, that translocator is as good as ours. Next stop, enemy territory!

91461.title: Manaforge Omega: A Walking Shadow
91461.objectives: Defeat Nexus-King Salhadaar within Manaforge Omega on Mythic difficulty.
91461.description:
Hero, can you hear me? There's a translocator the Shadowguard uses to send cargo to their reserves that can carry you directly to their post beneath the Manaforge. An ambush they'll never see coming!

There is of course, a catch. We do not have clearance to use their supply lines... so we need you to procure some for us. Take down the highest-ranking member of the Shadowguard you can find, return with identification, and we'll forge you a one-way ticket to the front lines.
91461.completion: That certainly qualifies as high-ranking, {NAME}! After I work my magic, that translocator is as good as ours. Next stop, enemy territory!

91466.title: Aiding the Green Dragons
91466.objectives: Speak to Merithra at Merithra's Watch in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
91466.description:
Nozdormu and Queen Alexstrasza believe the best path forward is to aid the Green Dragons.

Like the Black Dragons, the Greens lack a true aspect to lead them. 

Merithra is currently hosting guests within the Emerald Gardens. Meet with her to see if you can aid her.

I will continue tracking the incarnates and the other dracthyr.
91466.completion:
Thank you for coming, {NAME}. My guests are eager to see the Emerald Gardens, and I am pleased to host them.

Shall we get started?

91467.title: Incarnates on the Move
91467.objectives: Speak with Emberthal to find out about the Incarnates.
91467.description:
{NAME}, I thought I'd find you here. I bring word from the other aspects and my scouts.

The incarnates are on the move. I know not what they're planning, but you should be aware of their actions.
91467.completion: The incarnates are looking for something. It's imperative we get more of the flights empowered to stop them.

91476.title: Behind Enemy Lines
91476.objectives: Report to Zo'turu at Shadow Point.
91476.description: My friend, we've finished working on some new tools to ensure you'll do some real damage to the Shadowguard. Come by and let's sort it out together.
91476.completion: My friend! Thanks to our informants inside the Manaforge, we've uncovered some technology that can help you bring it down. This translocator has been calibrated to project your soul back here for a few moments, allowing you to access whatever you may need--but be warned. The pull of Omega's energy fields are strong, and will rip your essence back to your body's position in short order. I'm told it's... quite painful. Still, any advantage is a good advantage. Make haste!

91477.title: Behind Enemy Lines II
91477.objectives: Report to Zo'turu at Shadow Point.
91477.description: Our knowledge of technomancy deepens. Let's improve your weaponry inside the Manaforge.
91477.completion: My friend! We've secured new technology to help you bring down the Shadowguard - put it to good use!

91478.title: Behind Enemy Lines III
91478.objectives: Report to Zo'turu at Shadow Point.
91478.description: Our knowledge of technomancy deepens. Let's improve your weaponry inside the Manaforge.
91478.completion: My friend! We've secured new technology to help you bring down the Shadowguard - put it to good use!

91479.title: Behind Enemy Lines IV
91479.objectives: Report to Zo'turu at Shadow Point.
91479.description: Our knowledge of technomancy deepens. Let's improve your weaponry inside the Manaforge.
91479.completion: My friend! We've secured new technology to help you bring down the Shadowguard - put it to good use!

91480.title: Behind Enemy Lines V
91480.objectives: Report to Zo'turu at Shadow Point.
91480.description: We've got one last upgrade to give, my friend. Come by for one last tune-up and we'll make you the strongest you've ever been!
91480.completion: With this, you are as powerful as our humble band of soundrels can make you. May it serve you well against Dimensius!

91481.title: Speed Siphoner
91481.objectives: Report to Zo'ropo at Shadow Point.
91481.description: Great work so far! We've finished some tech that should be useful during your assault on the Manaforge.
91481.completion: Zo'ropo brings you a new weapon. Use this to feed off of the Manaforge's arcane radiation and turn their energies against them.

91482.title: Speed Siphoner II
91482.objectives: Report to Zo'ropo at Shadow Point.
91482.description: We've found a way to optimize the Speed Siphoner. Come back to HQ and let me give you a boost.
91482.completion: Twice as fast, twice as stable. Hunt them down.

91483.title: Hacking the Mainframe
91483.objectives: Report to Zo'ropo at Shadow Point.
91483.description: Our saboteurs have made great progress on hacking Omega's security systems; swing by and let me tell you about what we've learned.
91483.completion: There are consoles inside the Manaforge that keep the flow of energy running smoothly within the facility. We've cracked security on the first set of them, allowing you to turn the tables on enemies near Loom'ithar and Soulbinder Naazindrhi. You'll only be able to use one, but sabotaging them should allow you an edge in battle. Good luck in there.

91484.title: Hacking the Forgeweaver
91484.objectives: Report to Zo'ropo at Shadow Point.
91484.description: We've progressed further in our infiltration of the Manaforge's defenses. Return to HQ and I'll clear you for access.
91484.completion: We found a weakness in Forgeweaver Araz's engineering bay that should allow you access to another console nearby. Keep up the pressure, and we'll let you know once the whole facility is ours. Happy hunting.

91485.title: Hacking the Planet
91485.objectives: Report to Zo'ropo at Shadow Point.
91485.description: Hero... we're in. We have full control of Manaforge Omega's security. I'll brief you on your next trip back.
91485.completion: Manaforge Omega's security systems are under our direct control. Thanks to the damage you've done in there, we can get you access to consoles extending all the way to Salhadaar, and whatever lies beyond. We've also ensured you can use every console you come across. That's all I can do for you. Get in there and finish the fight.

91486.title: Attuned to the Aether
91486.objectives: Report to Ba'choso at Shadow Point.
91486.description: Hello! I've learned valuable information about how exposure to Omega's manaflow is impacting you - let us discuss back at Shadow Point when you have a moment.
91486.completion: My research shows that due to the Reshii Wraps' influence on your physical form, the powerful manasurges and reactors inside Omega can be used to your benefit! While this is only a fraction of your power, it seems that arcane enhancements made to your armaments are made ever more powerful while in their vicinity. This warrants further testing...

91487.title: Welcome to the Team
91487.completion: My friend, we have made much progress together in bringing down the Shadowguard. For your sacrifices and efforts, my colleagues and I consider you one of us. Please, take this modified Gearglider as a show of our gratitiude - may it carry you safely to your next mission.

91489.title: A Curious Companion
91489.completion: <The purrkin looks at you warmly. For the first time since you've arrived in K'aresh, it seems to actually *enjoy* your attention. As it pushes closer, its soft mew confirms your suspicions - she seems to want to join you. At least for now.>

91522.title: Order from Chaos
91522.objectives: Talk to Moratari and answer her questions.
91522.description:
Thank you for coming to speak with me, $p. I know you are very busy these days.

But it is that very demand on your time that I wish to speak with you about. With all you have accomplished of late, I feel that there is bound to be some valuable data to be gleaned from your experience.

 As a {class} without equal, I would like to ask you about your deeds of late. Can you spare a moment for Moratari?
91522.progress: Once I record this data point you can return to your busy schedule.
91522.completion:
What an intriguing insight into those events.

I watched them from afar, but it is so much more fascinating to hear the version of the events as you experienced them.

Thank you for sharing that.

91525.title: Head Hunting: Loom'ithar
91525.objectives: Defeat Loom'ithar within Manaforge Omega on any difficulty.
91525.description: Our intelligence describes a colossal beast within the Manaforge, responsible for producing the fabric that gives the Shadowguard their very form. Take it down and we'll hinder their ability to produce reinforcements. Oh, and Ba'choso says to bring some of the silk back with you - he may be able to fashion it into something useful.
91525.completion: Its quality is unlike anything I've ever seen! I'll get to work right away. Now, let's discuss your payment.

91526.title: Head Hunting: Forgeweaver Araz
91526.objectives: Defeat Forgeweaver Araz inside Manaforge Omega on any difficulty.
91526.description: My friend, I hope your assault is going well. It's time for you to dispatch the Forgeweaver; using his mastery of technomancy he oversees both the Manaforge's production pipelines... as well as the ritual to return Dimensius to this plane. His workshop will be further in and heavily guarded, but cutting him down should stop their plans of resurrection for good.
91526.completion: {NAME}... I should have seen that coming. His devotion to Dimensius knew no bounds, and he certainly had contingencies in place to make sure the ritual would be completed. We'll have to attack from another angle. We found some debris from his inner sanctum that made its way here - if you have the skill, we can teach you how to use it for your own ends.

91527.title: Head Hunting: The Soul Hunters
91527.objectives: Defeat The Soul Hunters within Manaforge Omega on any difficulty.
91527.description: Careful in the wastes, my friend. Scouts report that a trio of Demon Hunters are training south of the Manaforge - with one of them exhibiting power like we've never seen. You can avoid their path if you wish, but ignoring them could open you up to being flanked should they decide to engage. I recommend taking them out if you can, as well as providing us some samples of their newfound strength.
91527.completion: Soul energy like I've never seen it. While we cannot return them to the way they were, I believe you can use these runes to empower yourself even *through* death. Take them with you, and use them wisely.

91528.title: Head Hunting: Horrors of the Forge
91528.objectives: Defeat powerful Elite enemies within Manaforge Omega on any difficulty.
91528.description: By now no doubt you've seen some of the Manaforge's Elite coming to Salhadaar's aid. I'm sending you a list of names now - focus on these targets, and you may uncover spoils to aid your assault.
91528.completion: Nicely done, champion. The resources they were hoarding will find a much better home with your companions.

91529.title: Head Hunting: Nexus-King Salhadaar
91529.objectives: Defeat Nexus-King Salhadaar within Manaforge Omega on any difficulty.
91529.description: The hour of Salhadaar's demise is upon us. While he may posture upon his Voidwing, he grows desperate at the feet of the All-Devouring. The army he commands is not enough for your might - strike him down.
91529.completion: Though not the end he deserved, we will celebrate his defeat nonetheless. See Zo'ropo to trade for a well-deserved reward. You have my eternal gratitude for deposing him.

91530.title: Seeing Eye to Eye
91530.completion:
My friend, this little creature arrived at our hideout saying things like 'you killed my father, prepare to die'. We're not exactly privy to everything happening within the Manaforge, but surely you and this... young man can settle it like adults? Ideally away from our headquarters, and while using inside voices? 

I'm sure it's all a misunderstanding. Good luck working it out!

91539.title: A Radiant Echo
91539.objectives: Bring the Radiant Echo to a Worldsoul Memory, then release it.
91539.description: <Within your hand, you hold a small Azerite sphere. Its light is steady and bright, but the sound it emits is plaintive and longing. It tugs at you, ever so slightly.>

91613.title: Infinite Research Promotion: Timely Assistant
91613.completion:
{NAME}, you have been an excellent assistant with our research. I think you deserve a promotion.

From now on, you will be able to take on more research assignments simultaneously.

It's ironic, isn't it, that we never seem to have enough time. Make good use of your time here. Don't make me regret granting you this power.

91614.title: Focusing the Energies
91614.description:
In addition to shards of nightmare, we need Blood of Sargeras to reactivate the portal to the Rift of Aln.

This rare reagent can be obtained from around the Broken Isles. Rumor has it that emissaries are in search of hardened adventurers, and may offer these in reward.
91614.completion: Excellent, Archdruid. These will do nicely.

91615.title: A Thirst For Blood
91615.completion:
At last, I have enough Blood of Sargeras to fuel my creations! You will see, Deathlord, what my genius is truly capable of creating...

Now, I must ask that you leave me to my work... there is much to do, and we have little time to waste!

91616.title: Required Reagents
91616.description:
The Sentinels know of a trusted and talented enchanter who specializes in enchantments that affect demons.

She provides her services for free to the Sentinels, but she does require specific reagents to perform her enchantments.

91618.title: A Few Things First
91618.objectives: Obtain 1 Leystone Ore and a Suramarian Sapphire.
91618.description:
Lately I've been working with the ore of this land, leystone it's called. I've found its qualities to hold remarkable strength and durability. We'll need a lot of it for this.

There is felslate, but that's probably too tainted for what you're looking to do with this barding.

You know, I also like to adorn my pieces with something sparkly, like a jewel. I've heard that the elves of Suramar have particularly beautiful ones. Perhaps you could acquire one for this project.
91618.progress: I doubt you'll have a problem getting the leystone, but the sapphire might be a bit harder to acquire.
91618.completion:
You got them! Now to upgrade your barding.

Never say a blacksmith can't improve on a leatherworker's work, I always say. I mean never. I mean... well you know what I mean.

91619.title: Blood of Sargeras
91619.description:
We will require a powerful reagent to bind the magic in our weapons and armor. A rare material that will do just the trick is Blood of Sargeras.

We will need a plentiful quantity. Bring me whatever you can muster.
91619.completion: Yes, this is just what we need to complete our preparations. These must have been difficult to come by. Thank you, Highlord.

91620.title: Noggenfogger's Reasonable Request
91620.description:
Oh, the gall of that little green twerp! Marin Noggenfogger is blackmailing us. He says that if we do not meet his "very reasonable requisition request", he is going to close off access to the crucible.

Marin's asking for a hefty amount of Aethril. He said something about you recently holding a blade to his throat and that he's simply returning the favor.

Of course, if you would rather, I can eliminate him.
91620.completion:
No hard feelings, right? Business is business, baby, and business is good. I saw an opportunity and I took it, just like you.

To show my continued allegiance with your little organization, and as a gesture of goodwill, here's a little sample of the product. It's magic. Bottoms up!

91621.title: A Taste For Blood
91621.completion:
<Ma'haat the Indomitable guzzles the Blood of Sargeras down his throat as he speaks.>

Yesh... thish ish... just what I wanted. The egg ish... yoursh!

91624.title: Spark of Starlight
91624.objectives: Speak to Custodian Khubon in Dornogal.
91624.description:
A vision of starlight permeates your mind.

Custodian Khubon might have more information regarding these Fractured Sparks of Starlight.
91624.completion:
This is a fractured spark of starlight.

Every week, one of these fragments will appear while on your adventures. In its current state it's rather useless, but combining it with another fragment will grant it power. Reagents like these are malleable, robust, and the prize for many crafters.

Combining two of these fractured fragments will create a unique crafting material that can help an item achieve expertise beyond that of mortal ability.

91631.title: Epoch Progress
91631.completion:
Your power grows stronger, {NAME}.

Please, take this token of our gratitude for your assistance with our research. Let it echo with every you that exists in the fractures of this timeline.

91632.title: The End of an Epoch Journey
91632.completion:
You have reached your full potential, {NAME}. Or have you? Perhaps this is only the beginning of your journey through this epoch.

Please, take this token of our gratitude for your assistance with our research. Let it echo with every you that exists in the fractures of this timeline.

91639.title: Embrace Your Own Legend
91639.objectives: Talk to Eternus at the Infinite Bazaar in Dalaran once you have embraced your own legend.
91639.description:
I will keep a close eye on your progress and watch your exploits with that artifact unfold with great interest.

Once you have embraced the power of your own legend, I would like to hear your perspective on how important the artifact you wield has been on your journey.
91639.progress: We are on a journey of learning and discovery. Let us walk it together.
91639.completion:
You have grown stronger, but your artifact is stronger yet.

It would appear that my hypothesis holds true--artifacts appear to be the key to protecting Azeroth.

91691.title: The Vanishing of Iridikron
91691.objectives: See Nozdormu's vision of the conflict with Iridikron.
91691.description:
As you traveled through Zaralek caverns, Chronormu and I confronted Iridikron and the Infinite Dragonflight.

While we defeated the Infinite Dragonflight's champion, Chrono-Lord Deios, I fear Iridikron escaped.

Allow me to show you what happened, for it gives us a clue of what must be done next.
91691.completion:
What Iridikron plans to do with that artifact is beyond my vision.

We must focus on Vyrakk and Vyranoth for now.

91694.title: Voidscar Arena: Breaking the Triad
91694.objectives: Enter the Voidscar Arena and defeat Charonus.
91694.description:
That glint in your eye! You've already identified me as an enemy and are thinking about how to slay me, yes? Good. 

I sent my forces to Ziadan and Vidious's bastions to overthrow them. Then, Xal'atath's bidding pulled me away and I missed all the action.

Fortunately, you are here now. You seem like even greater entertainment than watching these two smitten fools refuse to actually end one another.

Come, then! I will prepare my arena and we will put on a real show! Slay me, if you can!
91694.completion:
What did Charonus bolster their army with? Azerothian captives? Figures. 

He only would have taken the most bloodthirsty he could find, if that knowledge helps you sleep at night.

Good work. Charonus will come between Vidious and I no longer.

You have been helpful. I will ensure you benefit from this aid rendered.

91721.title: Surpass Your Own Legend
91721.objectives: Talk to Eternus at the Infinite Bazaar in Dalaran once you have surpassed your own legend.
91721.description:
While artifacts are key, we must not dismiss the power of the individuals who wield them.

Continue in your fight against the Legion. Grow strong, stronger than you ever thought possible.

Then we will compare the might of your legend against that of the artifact.
91721.progress:
The person wielding an artifact is of some importance. But how much? Which legend is the greater?

Let us find out together.
91721.completion: I admit. I am pleasantly surprised to be proven wrong. Your power has grown and I cannot say with certainty which is the greater. You, or the weapon you wield.

91722.title: Shape a New Legend
91722.objectives: Talk to Eternus at the Infinite Bazaar in Dalaran once you have shaped a new legend.
91722.description:
It is clear now that the person is at least as important as the artifact they wield.

Perhaps it is the quality of mortality that diminishes the importance of the individual through the lens of history. While an artifact is eternal, the people wielding them are fleeting.

But no flame that burns brightly burns forever.

I want you to burn as brightly as you can. Empower your artifact and carve a new legend into the world for all to see.
91722.progress: An artifact cannot empower itself. Its power grows only when its wielder performs great deeds with it.
