91722.completion:
Humbling.

It is the very nature of finite existence that is the answer.

Mortality is the flame that shines brightest because it is free to choose a single moment of glory, rather than be burdened by the weight of eternity.

Choose your moment well, {NAME}, and nothing, not even time, will be able to stop you.

91728.title: Suramar Liberated
91728.objectives: Talk to Moratari and answer her question.
91728.description:
You have come a long way, $p. I never seem to tire of following your exploits. Even from afar, as a silent observer, I find myself absolutely invested in what you will do next.

I do have one question though.
91728.completion:
Very intriguing.

I will, of course, record that as a data point.

Knowing how you decide on a course of action will inform further hypothesis.

91729.title: Armies Gathered
91729.objectives: Talk to Moratari and answer her question.
91729.description:
The stakes have never been higher than now, $p.

I would very much like to know what you are thinking right now.
91729.completion:
Fresh insights are invaluable in our efforts here, {NAME}.

Thank you for sharing yours.

91730.title: Azeroth Saved
91730.objectives: Talk to Moratari and answer her question.
91730.description:
$p.

You have done it! Sargeras is gone and Azeroth is saved.

I can only imagine what must be going through your mind at this moment.

Let us remedy that.

Allow me to record your thoughts and your words. Not as written by a historian who you never met, but by a friend who wished nothing more than to listen.
91730.completion: Too many histories are written about the WHAT, the WHY, the HOW, and the WHEN. Other than names, however, we so rarely get to truly know the WHO.

91757.title: Until Our Next Hello
91757.objectives: Say goodbye to the infinites at the Infinite Bazaar.
91757.description:
Well, the moment is fast approaching now.

<Moratari subtly nods in the direction of the raging temporal storm overhead.>

You would think after so many goodbyes I would be better at this, but alas, I simply prefer hello over goodbye. I know a lot of people around here are going to miss you too.

You should go say goodbye to them while there is still time.
91757.completion:
There. That was not so bad after all.

This is not goodbye. It is just a pause until our next hello.

I look forward to it, {NAME}.

91780.title: Ethereal Delves
91780.description:
There's even more tae do in delves, {NAME}! 

Meet me in Dornogal. There's loads to discuss!
91780.completion: Good tae see ye! We've got plenty tae discuss.

91781.title: Seasonal Reminder
91781.objectives: Learn about Season 3 of Delves from the Delver's Documents, then purchase supplies from Reno Jackson and Sir Finley Mrrgglton.
91781.description:
We're back tae uncovering even more things within delves! 

Let's get ye up to speed on what's new first.

After that I'll need your help with a wee problem of my own...
91781.completion: Right, on to that wee problem I mentioned.

91782.title: Repossessed!
91782.description:
I think ye may have guessed what my problem is by now, {NAME}.

My clothes, my tools, my curios! Everything but my boots and hat, which I'm nae giving up again.

All repossessed by some cartel thug who said I was delinquent on my void storage payments, if ye can believe it.

Would ye be willing to help Ol' Brann out of this pickle? I'm sure if ye just explain that this is all some sort of mistake, they'll give back all my hard earned gear.

Or at least me britches.
91782.progress: Has it always been this breezy in Dornogal?
91782.completion:
I can't believe it was a ruse all along.

A shame about the curios, but at least ye got me britches back!

91795.title: Disrupt the Call
91795.objectives: Defeat 3 Twilight's Blade rares in the Twilight Highlands.
91795.description:
We do not know where they intend to strike, but we do know they aim to summon more to their cause.

Destroy the Twilight's Blade before they complete their rituals. We must not let a single champion of the void remain to inspire the new recruits.
91795.progress: There is much to do. Do not dawdle.
91795.completion: These champions of the Twilight's Blade are just as foolhardy as the other members of the cult. We will cut them all down, in time.

91821.title: Out of Time
91821.objectives: Slay a Lost Legion Infernal on the Broken Isles.
91821.description:
There you are, {NAME}. This timeline is collapsing!

Presumably you have noticed the great rift tearing through reality above us. We don't have much time remaining before we must retreat from this timeline.

To make matters worse, infernals from other timelines are starting to pour in. Send them back from when they came.
91821.completion:
Hmm, burning that pamphlet produced a very peculiar reaction from the flames.

<Moratari begins taking notes, completely ignoring you.>

91834.title: Guardians Must Go
91834.objectives: Kill the Dark Hex Guardian and meet me below.

91842.title: Disarm the Dark Horde
91842.description:
The Dark Horde have no love fer their equipment. Look at their weapons! Cracked, rusted, blunt, and bent. Ach!

The only way they function is by making more shoddy tools to constantly replace the ones they've broken.

If ye see any of their weapon racks, destroy 'em. Let's see how well they fight without their rusty blades.

A bare-fisted orc is nothing to sneeze at, but it'll further delay any daft plans they've got.
91842.completion:
Did ye destroy their weapons racks?

Aye, that'll do. We've bought everyone nearby a few months of peace while they resupply.

91843.title: Recap: The Harbinger
91843.objectives: Read along with the Tome of History and learn about the events which sparked The War Within.
91843.description: To understand the story of The War Within, one must first begin with the mysterious entity known as the Harbinger, and how the heroes of Azeroth uncovered the truth...
91843.progress: Xal'atath was a mysterious foe with ties to the Void. Her presence portended dire things for Azeroth...

91844.title: Infinite Research Promotion: Honorary Chronographer
91844.completion:
{NAME}, you have been an excellent assistant with our research. I think you deserve a promotion.

From now on, you will be able to take on more research assignments simultaneously.

It's ironic, isn't it, that we never seem to have enough time. Make good use of your time here. Don't make me regret granting you this power.

91845.title: Infinite Research Promotion: Senior Executive Chronographer
91845.completion:
{NAME}, you have been an excellent assistant with our research. I think you deserve a promotion.

From now on, you will be able to take on more research assignments simultaneously.

It's ironic, isn't it, that we never seem to have enough time. Make good use of your time here. Don't make me regret granting you this power.

91846.title: Infinite Research Promotion: Principal Chronoquery Investigator
91846.completion:
{NAME}, you have been an excellent assistant with our research. I think you deserve a promotion.

From now on, you will be able to take on more research assignments simultaneously.

It's ironic, isn't it, that we never seem to have enough time. Make good use of your time here. Don't make me regret granting you this power.

91855.title: Worldsoul: K'aresh World Quests
91855.description:
I know now that the heroes of Azeroth venture wherever help is needed. K'aresh is a strange, faraway place, but our allies there need us.

Go there and help them. See what you can do to bring respite to the ethereals and brokers.
91855.progress: Our allies resist valiantly on a dead and shattered world. I admire them.
91855.completion: You are a credit to heroes everywhere. Thank you.

91863.title: My First Home
91863.description:
Welcome to the neighborhood! Feel free to explore and have a look at the plots available.

Speak to the steward to learn more about the process of becoming a homeowner or if you wish to create your own neighborhood.
91863.progress: Have you found your forever home?
91863.completion: Congratulations on acquiring your new house. We know you'll be very happy here and we look forward to seeing you around the neighborhood.

91864.title: Recap: Fractured Visions
91864.objectives: Consult the Tome of History to learn about the fate of Dalaran in The War Within.
91864.description: All across Azeroth, many were having visions of a Radiant Song. Efforts to understand what seemed to be a warning centered on the heroes in Dalaran.
91864.completion: The island of Khaz Algar figured into Xal'atath's plans, and it was up to the champions of Azeroth to thwart them.

91865.title: Catch Up: Khaz Algar
91865.objectives: Consult the Tome of History to learn about the events in Khaz Algar in The War Within.

91866.title: Catch Up: The Ringing Deeps
91866.objectives: Consult the Tome of History to learn about the events in the Ringing Deeps in The War Within.

91867.title: Catch Up: Hallowfall
91867.objectives: Consult the Tome of History to learn about the events in Hallowfall in The War Within.

91868.title: Recap: Shadowy Pursuits
91868.objectives: Consult the Tome of History to learn about the events in Hallowfall and Azj-Kahet in The War Within.
91868.description: King Anduin Wrynn, Alleria, and the champions travel deeper into Azeroth, arriving at a place known as Hallowfall. It quickly becomes apparent that this place has also been touched by the machinations of Xal'atath.
91868.completion: With a few select allies, Anduin, Alleria, and the champions escaped Xal'atath's clutches, but this would not be the last encounter with her...

91869.title: Catch Up: A Light in the Dark
91869.objectives: Consult the Tome of History to learn about the events in The War Within.

91871.title: Recap: The Dark Heart
91871.objectives: Consult the Tome of History to learn about the events in Undermine and K'aresh in The War Within.
91871.description: The champions and Alleria were invited to Undermine by Gazlowe as the peoples of Khaz Algar and beyond began to unite against Xal'atath and her Dark Heart.
91871.progress: Dimensius was defeated and Azeroth was saved from his threat, yet there was a cost.
91871.completion: This is the conclusion of The War Within, but it is not the last time we'll see Xal'atath or the Dark Heart...

91918.title: Delves: Measure Once, Cut Twice
91918.objectives: Rescue the remaining Twilight's Blade Deserters from the Twilight Crypts delve on any difficulty.
91918.description:
We've done well to see those deserters to safety, but don't fool yourself into thinking we've freed them all.

I've heard whispers of a place they use to break those whose loyalty is in question. The location isn't common knowledge, but I know where to start looking.

If we're quick, we might find others before the cult decides they're too great a risk to keep alive.

Meet me near the site. Keep your blades sharp and your steps light.
91918.completion: That's all of them. Good work.

91954.title: Freezing Over
91954.completion: We noticed this large creeper tracking you out in the wastes, but when it emerged it made no aggressive moves whatsoever. Judging by its reaction to your arrival, I believe you're the one its been looking for. You're becoming quite popular, no?

91955.title: Just Between Us
91955.description:
The artifact we snatched from the timeline earlier was replaced with a simulacrum so none would notice the true artifact's absence.

Such a wealth of infinite energy should not be abandoned so readily. You should seek it out and reclaim it.

Once you have recovered the simulacrum you can scrap it for an embarassing sum of bronze and infinite power.
91955.completion:
Success!

It's almost a shame to destroy such a beautiful replica.

But you have the real thing, so I say scrap it and rejoice at the bounty of beautiful bronze!

91958.title: Den of Nalorakk: Unforgiven
91958.objectives: Complete the Den of Nalorakk dungeon.
91958.description:
Nalorakk is de Loa of War. His trial must be a battle!

There would be no greater death for an Amani than to die in combat against de Loa of War. No greater thrill than fightin' him.

Does it not make your blood pump faster and harder in your veins, hash'ura?

<Zul'jarra lets out a feral howl and laughs.>

Come. Meet me at Nalorakk's Prowl and we will sit at his fire and face our last trial--together.
91958.progress: De final trial is at hand.
91958.completion:
Heh.

We won against Nalorakk. We passed de last trial.

My tribe will sing songs and tell stories of dis day for generations.

91968.title: Welcome Home
91968.description:
What a mess! Perhaps the previous owners left in a hurry. Best tidy up!

The items removed will be sent to the house chest. They can always be placed down again, if cobwebs are your thing.

91969.title: Time to Decorate
91969.description:
Now that we've got this place tidied up, let's decorate!

The community has chipped in with donations to make sure you have plenty of options to work with.

Let's have a look!

92028.title: Pardon the Interruption
92028.objectives: Activate Fightbot 11.2.7, then interrupt its abilities 3 times.
92028.description:
{NAME}! Glad to see you. The defenders in the fortress could use your help.

One of the gnomes built a robot to try to help defend the keep. However, it goes haywire every time it turns on.

She needs the help of someone who can properly interrupt the robot's attacks so it can be repaired.

Do you have a moment to help?
92028.progress: Some help! Hopefully you can find a way to interrupt this bot's abilities.
92028.completion:
Great work! Now I should have time to fix whatever bug actually caused this in the first place.

Maybe I can just say it's a feature and call it a day!

92030.title: A New Tradition
92030.objectives: Meet Chon Po in Wu-Song Village.
92030.description:
Chon was just looking for you. You can find him at his house, serving drinks with Chen.

<Lorewalker Cho laughs--a deep, warm rumble.>

Go on, $p! I won't be leaving anytime soon, that's for sure.
92030.completion:
Ah, {NAME}... you have traveled far, but returned. You have reminded all who live here that the Spirit Festival is not just for the elemental spirits, but the spirits of all {race} who call this place home... even if they leave for a time. 

In thanks, our tailors have crafted these for you. The maker's design celebrates your adventures, but also honors your origins... just as you have today.

Master Shang Xi would be so, so proud.



To you, my friend. To home.

92031.title: Meet the Vandals
92031.objectives: Report to Zo'turu at Shadow Point.
92031.description: <The Manaforge Vandals at Shadow Point are eager to see the Shadowguard and their allies removed from Manaforge Omega. It's probably a good time to pay them a visit.>

92078.title: A New Recipe!
92078.completion: You're back already! I believe I've found a use for the Manaforged Instruments you may have found within Araz's possession. Each are pieces of machinery that, if extracted properly, would yield a unique energy signal not dissimilar to the magic used to bind Ethereals. If you or anyone you know are particularly well-versed in Enchantmenting or Inscription, take these! They may hold secrets, or at the very least a novel experience for you. Good luck!

92082.title: Someone Like Me
92082.completion: Hero... far be it from me to question your methods in taking down the All-Devouring, but I've noticed your snooping while inside Omega. Those cyphers you discovered are how we communicate with our contacts inside. I don't even know how you activated them - they were supposed to be heavily encrypted! Still... this is the kind of mischief I love to encourage. I'm not sure what use you'll get out of this disguise, but for all you've done for us, you've earned a treat. Just don't say you got it from me.

92177.title: One Hero's Prey
92177.objectives: Hunt a Prey target and return the crystalline vessel to Astalor Bloodsworn.
92177.description:
Again, we sin'dorei find our city under assault. And again, it is up to the finer minds among us to come to Silvermoon's aid.

Mortal anguish, it seems, is a powerful reflection of the soul. When contained and manipulated, anguish acts as a form of magic that we can wield to protect this great city.

I've located a number of anguish-filled targets across Azeroth.

Select and hunt one such target, storing their anguish in this crystalline vessel. Then return to me.
92177.completion: While you collect more anguish, I will experiment with this power's potential.

92178.title: Practical Magic
92178.objectives: Accompany Astalor into the chambers below and imbue objects with the power of anguish.
92178.description:
While you've been out pursuing targets, I've been developing various applications for anguish.

The power these raw emotions contain is unfathomable. For now, our applications might seem quaint, but given enough time, I'm certain my discoveries will further Silvermoon's aims.

Let me show you. Take the crystalline vessel and meet me below.
92178.completion:
For so many years, I've dedicated my life to these magical pursuits.

This next chapter will be something to behold.

92179.title: Dark Mending
92179.objectives: Follow Astalor into his lower chambers and assist in his discoveries.
92179.description:
So far, anguish has been invaluable in bolstering our forces. Our weaponry and golems are all the more hardy and potent thanks to this newfound power.

I've also been developing ways to shape anguish into robust enchantments that can strengthen us elves.

Meet me downstairs. I will show you what I've found.
92179.completion: Unfortunate side effects are expected when we're on the bleeding edge of magical discoveries.

92180.title: Precious Jewels
92180.objectives: Check in with the elves that have accepted Astalor's trinkets.
92180.description:
{NAME}...

While you've been away, I've been refining our work.

<He produces a jeweled ring in the palm of his hand.>

Small trinkets and jewelry that contain crystallized anguish.

I've discretely gifted these to a few willing Silvermoon citizens. I wish to observe the effect of a controlled concentration of anguish over time.

I've shaped the magic to lend the bearer health and strength. Seek our volunteers out and check up on them.
92180.progress: My work here will make the world fear Silvermoon's might.
92180.completion:
Aggression is simply an expression of strength.

So long as we are the predator, not the prey.

92181.title: Garden Variety Sacrifices
92181.objectives: Rescue elves and reclaim Coalesced Anguish in the Gardens of Remembrance.
92181.description:
{NAME}... I need you to attend to a matter in the city.

I've received word from Knight Captain Solara that there's been an incident in the Gardens of Remembrance. She reports elves have begun acting out violently, causing coalesced anguish to manifest and terrorize the residents.

You can use the crystalline vessel to reclaim the coalesced anguish and soothe the elves whose minds have crumbled.

So much of the magic will weigh heavy upon you, but I'm confident you have the strength.
92181.progress: In all of my endeavors, there are always some who seek to impede my progress.
92181.completion: There will always be some who resist progress, but no matter the cost, my studies in anguish are for the people of Silvermoon.

92182.title: The Sheep or the Wolf
92182.objectives: Meet with Astalor below his chambers in Silvermoon City.
92182.description:
I heard word of your heroics in the garden. Silvermoon thanks you for quelling the chaos.

And I thank you for recovering so much anguish.

The crystalline vessel may be the conduit, but the body must be robust to handle so much power... Like me, you have the strength to withstand the torrent of anguish inside you, at least for a short while.

Come, let me relieve you of the burden.
92182.completion:
Anguish is power, and power is predation.

Would you rather that we be the sheep or the wolf?

92319.title: A Favor to Axe
92319.description:
Kurdran and I spent twenty years in Outland on the other side of the Dark Portal, after we'd pushed the Horde back with Khadgar, Turalyon, and Alleria.

There were some good times, but any day I don't wake up in Honor Hold is already a good day.

That whole time, Kurdran led our scouts with his gryphon, Sky'ree. And on his way out of Honor Hold, he would fly low and fast, dodging everything the orcs threw at him. I think it'd be hilarious if you could go find him some mementos!
92319.progress: What is it, {NAME}? You have something for me?
92319.completion:
Why are ye bringing me these old, rusty axes?

They look like the ones orcs used to throw at me back in Hellfire...

Surprising, how far an orc can throw an axe! We had tae stay on our toes, or lose 'em.

Wait, did Danath put ye up to... of course he did.

The one thing worse than being away from home so long was dealing with Danath's sense of "humor" all that time.

Not sure which was more off target--the axes or his jokes!

But he does hit the mark as a friend...

92320.title: Still Behind Enemy Portals
92320.objectives: Journey to the Broken Shore and recover the artifact of great evil. Optionally, acquire the Corrupted Lantern as well.
92320.description:
In our reminiscing of past events, we were reminded of an artifact that we did not recover during our war with the Burning Legion.

This item is a vessel of great evil, and should not stay in the clutches of the remaining demonic forces.

To reach this item, we must journey to the Broken Shore where Tehd has a portal he has repurposed for our use. Will you join us on this hunt?
92320.progress: We should have recovered this the first time.
92320.completion: You found the vessel, I see. Good. We will take it and make sure it gets into the right hands.

92321.title: A Frostbitten Tally
92321.objectives: Find 8 Frostbitten Tabards in Icecrown Citadel. Optionally, acquire the Ebon Banner from Icecrown Citadel as well.
92321.description:
Tarenar and I heard stories about the invasion of Icecrown Citadel from all the way out in the Plaguelands.

But he's got it all wrong!

The elf thinks there were more Ebon Blade commanders than Argent Crusade in the Ashen Verdict. He's completely daft. Obviously there were more paladins!

Would you go poke around Icecrown Citadel and find me some proof? I'm sick of arguing with him!
92321.progress: You find anything yet? Just need something to prove to Tarenar that I'm right.
92321.completion:
Och, these tabards are looking worse for wear. I guess it's hard to say who showed up in greater force from some old relics.

Anyway, we're on to arguing which of us slept the least while on the Broken Shore.

Looks like you managed to snag an Ebon Blade banner and are still alive to tell the tale. There is a spot nearby to hang that up in the Arcantina.

92322.title: Timear Foresees a Proof of Demise!
92322.description:
Hello, {NAME}. Do you have a moment?

There's something important I lost during the assault on the Isle of Thunder: a pocket watch gifted to me by my old friend, Archmage Timear. Yes, that Timear... the one that can foresee the future. He told me this day would come and that you would assist me.

The watch was taken by the Council of Elders, specifically by High Priestess Mar'li. If you would go to the island and retrieve it from the Throne of Thunder, and we both know you will, I can get you there.
92322.progress:
Was Timear's prognostication correct? Have you retrieved my pocket watch?

Or have you simply returned to enjoy my scintillating company?
92322.completion:
Of course you were successful. Timear's insufferably always correct about these things. And, he has returned to rub my nose in it.

You have my gratitude.

It appears you've also found an Ancient Zandalari Scroll. Timear has already foresaw it being displayed in the Arcantina. Take a look around for where to put it.

92323.title: Where the Fire Once Burned
92323.objectives: Journey to Mount Hyjal and enter the Firelands. Inside, retrieve 8 Luciferns. Optionally, acquire the Evergreen Vine as well.
92323.description:
Hard to believe, isn't it? Horde and Alliance, same room, no stabbing.

I was reminiscing about my days in the Firelands, gathering luciferns. They had such a distinctive smell... somewhere between smoke and something long dead. It's been a while, and I almost miss it.

Grab a few for Zen'tabra and me, will you? She deserves the full experience.
92323.progress: I hope you found those luciferns--because if not, I get stabby. Very stabby.
92323.completion:
It's strange how a single scent can bring back so many memories. Thank you for letting me share this.

And... apologies to everyone else. Some memories are meant to linger.

You found an evergreen vine in the Firelands? If that isn't a sign of hope, I don't know what is.

Stick it in the Arcantina--it might be the first plant in here that doesn't immediately give up.

92324.title: Uncrowned's Cold Case
92324.objectives: Journey to Feralas and collect 8 Lost Pages from Nostro's Compendium. Optionally, acquire the Pylon Fragment from Dire Maul as well.
92324.description:
We are lucky the Uncrowned survived, and its archives, thanks to Taoshi. We've been reading them...

Have you heard of the great highborne city Dire Maul? The Uncrowned kept tabs on the dangerous prince, Tortheldrin, but since he died, the case was shelved.

These notes say there might be objects of interest in the city ruins, with a notable mention of Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying. That book was retrieved some time ago, but few know that several chapters were missing.

Let's reopen the case.
92324.progress:
Surrounded by hearth and friends, it's hard to believe Dalaran is truly gone... 

<Kelsey looks at Taoshi with deep sincerity.>

The Uncrowned wastes no time picking up its affairs. Have you found anything of interest?
92324.completion:
What a surprise! I thought anything like this would have been thoroughly scavenged and carried far, far away by now.

I'll find someone to work on those pages. Many scribes would be delighted to have the opportunity to translate ancient magic.

And you came back with the Pylon Fragment too? So you went into Dire Maul. What a fine memento for future visitors to inquire about. 

Consider putting it somewhere in the Arcantina.

92325.title: Hellscream's Heritage
92325.objectives: Go to Nagrand and discover who Garrosh was in his youth. Optionally, acquire the Weathered Tome as well.
92325.description:
My sister Krenna was once a Conqueror in the Horde's armies. Ruthless. Brutal. Some said a tyrant. But she was different when we were young. Scared, but always kind to me. Warm to those she would let in. Did power change her? 

And if it changed her into a tyrant, did it change Garrosh Hellscream as well? I know who Krenna was. I do not know who Garrosh was. 

Travel to Nagrand and find out.
92325.progress: I would know who the previous leader of the Warsong really was.
92325.completion:
Hellscream had no strength, so he built it. He had no pride, until it was given to him. Yet... he was this way, strong-willed and resilient, all along.

Then perhaps power does not change a person--it simply reveals who they really are, deep within. 

This Greatmother Geyah is wise. I should visit her someday.

You also brought back a tome that looks like it has seen better days. I can imagine the vast knowledge within it. 

Its rightful place is here in the Arcantina. Please find a safe location for it.

92326.title: The Fragrance of the Dunes
92326.description:
I miss the smell of the desert. It is the fragrance of freedom in a wild land. I would love to refresh that scent memory.

While you're there, grab something from the caravans. This place could use some nomad personality.

Maybe hop over to Shatterstone Harbor and get something for the big guy. Maybe an anchor? That would be perfect! Imagine watching him lug that around.
92326.completion:
Ah! Just breathe that in, {NAME}. 

Thank you for taking me back to another time... and home.

Hang up that tapestry, would you? I would like to introduce my friends in the Arcantina to the finest of vulpera weaving.

92327.title: A Generational Moment
92327.description:
It's always good to see someone with your history continue to speak to us old dogs, $p.

Eitrigg and I have been talking about legacy recently. Did you know we both fought with the Valarjar against the Legion? Interesting how long histories can intertwine.

But our real legacy is our children. I wonder if you would have time to check in with them both. While you're there, make sure they're keeping their skills sharp.
92327.progress: Were you able to find Lorna? What of Eitrigg's son Ariok?
92327.completion:
I can tell by the look on your face that our children gave a proper account for themselves.

It's good to know that, should they face further danger, their skills are still sharp.

Looks like you found a clefthoof hide while you were in the Blasted Lands. 

Eitrigg would know better than I, but that must have came through the Dark Portal from Draenor.

That's something to display, and I can't think of a better place than right here in the Arcantina.

92331.title: Turbo-Boost: Trade Must Flow
92331.objectives: Defeat any four bosses within the Manaforge Omega raid on Normal difficulty or higher, or complete any four Mythic Dungeons.
92331.description:
<The Trust is under pressure from the cartels to keep markets open. We seek associates capable of removing certain... obstacles. Cartel So has been authorized to distribute substantial riches if you are successful.

Complete the task, and collect a special reward from Fixer So'kir outside of the Dornogal Treasury. Parties shall remain unbound by any implied oaths arising in the course of trade. Uniform Broker Code standard terms apply.>
92331.completion:
The Trust thanks you for your assistance, {NAME}. 

As promised, here is your reward. 

To celebrate the success of our new partnership, we are including a small performance bonus. Please return later for more work!

92332.title: Turbo-Boost: Infinite Growth
92332.objectives: Defeat any four bosses within the Manaforge Omega raid on Normal difficulty or higher, or complete any four Mythic Dungeons.
92332.description:
<The Trust always has more work to be done if we are to ensure continued growth for our trade. Once again, Cartel So has been authorized to distribute substantial riches if you are successful.

Complete the task, and collect a special reward from Fixer So'kir outside of the Dornogal Treasury. Parties shall remain unbound by any implied oaths arising in the course of trade. Uniform Broker Code standard terms apply.>
92332.progress: Again, you prove yourself a friend of the cartels! Well done.
92332.completion:
The Trust thanks you for your assistance, {NAME}. 

As promised, here is your reward.

92386.title: A Handful of Voidlight Marl
92386.objectives: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.
92386.completion: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.

92387.title: A Cluster of Voidlight Marl
92387.objectives: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.
92387.completion: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.

92388.title: A Trove of Voidlight Marl
92388.objectives: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.
92388.completion: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept these as thanks.

92397.title: Dawnstar Defense
92397.objectives: Build up defenses before the impending Lightbloom attack.
92397.description:
The nearby runestone has gone dark, and the Lightbloom is on its way. I can't hold this ground alone. Help me set the weapons, line up the potions, and get our supplies in order.

We'll meet that growth with discipline and precision and send it back in pieces.
92397.completion: Good work. Now for the hard part.

92398.title: And Then They Came
92398.description:
Brace yourself--the time is upon us!

Hold the line and keep them from reaching the runestone at all costs. I'll focus on restoring its power, but I need you to protect me and everyone here.

Are you ready?
92398.completion: The runestone hums with power again thanks to you. You have my appreciation.

92402.title: Magical Touch
92402.objectives: Collect 15 Slightly Magical Crystals in your neighborhood.
92402.description:
Oh hey, just the person I was looking for!

Some of your neighbors are looking to get into enchanting. They aren't quite ready for prime time yet, but I have an idea to get them started.

It looks like there's an area in your neighborhood that has slight magical energy. Can you take this locator and find some crystals for them?

They only need to be slightly magical. We don't want them to cause an accident!
92402.progress: Did you get a chance to pick up those crystals yet?
92402.completion:
Oh nice! Yeah this is perfect.

Thank you so much!

92405.title: Meet Arator
92405.objectives: Seek out Arator and Vereesa Windrunner on Oztan Isle off the Isle of Dorn coast.
92405.description: Greetings, champion. I have an urgent message for you from Arator. He asks that you join him and his aunt Vereesa on Oztan Isle, off the coast to the west.
92405.completion: My aunt has been having terrible visions and they are getting worse.

92417.title: Farm to Table
92417.objectives: Collect enough ingredients to form a good stew and return to Yolan Hidor within the neighborhood.
92417.description:
Hey, it's {NAME}!

I'm in a bit of a pickle here. I'm making food for everyone, but underestimated how many people would turn up!

I can whip up a quick stew and the local farmers said I could use their produce, but the other dishes are at a vital point, I can't leave them unattended!

Could you gather some ripe ingredients, and bring them back?
92417.progress: Please hurry back with the ingredients!
92417.completion:
Thank you so much!

I can get the rest of this food ready now, you really are the best!

92429.title: Alternative Skinning
92429.objectives: Use the Biological Vacuum to collect samples from large animals around the neighborhood.
92429.description:
Hey there!

I'm working on a new method for making leather, but without harming animals.

I just need small samples, fur, saliva, that sort of thing. Nothing invasive.

I have this handy device that should help out!
92429.progress: Thanks for your help on this. I'm really excited to see if I can make this work.
92429.completion: Let's see what we can do with it!

92430.title: Embracing the Infinite Chaos
92430.objectives: Speak with Eternus at the Infinite Bazaar near Dalaran.
92430.description: $p, make haste to the Infinite Bazaar. I believe you are ready for a new kind of experiment.

92437.title: Decor Treasure Hunt
92437.description:
Are you ready for today's challenge? I've hidden a piece from my collection here in the neighborhood. To find it, you must merely solve this simple riddle:

Stone laid by lost hands.
Bridging the mountain runoff.
Look where lilies listen.

Good luck!

92439.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Felrunner
92439.objectives: Kill 100 enemies while Twisted Crusade is your active artifact ability.
92439.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of fighting the Legion with their own power, so focus on using demonic fel energy to slay your foes.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
92439.progress: Remember to pace yourself, the journey is just as important as the destination.
92439.completion: Impressive. I can sense your power. This is a most critical addition to our research.

92440.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Stormrunner
92440.objectives: Kill 100 enemies while Tempest Wrath is your active artifact ability.
92440.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of your attunement to the storm, so focus on fighting opponents by turning the tides quite literally.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
92440.progress: Remember to pace yourself, the journey is just as important as the destination.
92440.completion: Impressive. I can sense your power. This is a most critical addition to our research.

92441.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Magerunner
92441.objectives: Kill 100 enemies while Naran's Everdisc is your active artifact ability.
92441.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of your attunement to the arcane, so focus on fighting opponents with powerful magic.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
92441.completion: Impressive. I can sense your power. This is a most critical addition to our research.

92442.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Lightrunner
92442.objectives: Kill 100 enemies while Vindicator's Judgment is your active artifact ability.
92442.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of your attunement to the Light, so focus on wielding holy justice to smite your enemies.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
92442.progress: Remember to pace yourself, the journey is just as important as the destination.
92442.completion: Impressive. I can sense your power. This is a most critical addition to our research.

92443.title: Reverse Herb Farming
92443.description:
Hey there, I was collecting herbs around your neighborhood, and I kind of zoned out, and lost track of time. It's so pretty here!

I think I may have picked too many herbs. I have an enchanted watering can that should help new ones grow back in, if you have the time to help them grow back?
92443.progress: I feel really bad, I'm so sorry.
92443.completion:
Thanks for helping me out, {NAME}. 

I just had a really good route and got into the zone!

92445.title: Smelting for Two
92445.objectives: Assist Jaren with smelting in the neighborhood.
92445.description:
People keep coming up to me and asking me about mining, I'm not a miner, I'm a smelter!

I'm looking to teach some people about smelting, but I've been struggling with getting a crowd.

Could you help me out while I talk you through smelting?

92520.title: Wake of the Darkwell
92520.objectives: Search for Survivors on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
92520.description:
The Sunwell--no... the Darkwell is overrun. 

Void-spawned creatures swarm the regions where our greatest champions of the Light held their ground to the very last.

Champion, can you survey Quel'Danas? Find any survivors? If you tag them with these tokens, our mages here will be able to teleport the individuals back. We must try to save as many as we can.
92520.progress: This is a truly dark day.
92520.completion: So few. But the ones you saved are more than I had hoped for.

92563.title: Awoken by Accessory
92563.objectives: Speak with Moratari at the Infinite Bazaar near Dalaran.
92563.description:
<As you equip the jewelry, you feel it surge with power, flowing through you and into your artifact weapon.

The jewelry has unlocked hidden potential of your artifact weapon, enabling and empowering one of its traits.

Moratari will want to record this data.>
92563.completion:
Fascinating, it seems as though the magic of your new accessory is capable of awakening otherwise inaccessible powers of your artifact weapon, or even enhancing them beyond their limits!

I wonder if all jewelry has this same connection to your artifact weapon. Please do keep me informed of any more anomalies.

92572.title: Furniture Favor
92572.objectives: Purchase a Storage Crate in Dornogal, Stormwind, or Orgimmar, and return to a Pawdo sibling.
92572.description:
Greetings! I see you are eyeing our fine furniture.

My siblings and I were sent on a mission to find only the finest Decor in the land.

Decor is more than furniture, you see. Crafting a truly great decoration requires attention to so many different details.

Come, friend, let us go on that journey together! Starting today. Today, we find a crate. Not just a normal crate, one that is fantastic. A great crate.

I hear they may sell them nearby, actually...
92572.progress: How is your day going? Is it fantastic?
92572.completion:
Oh my, the crate you describe does indeed seem quite great. The joy of placing them will know no bounds.

Thank you for finding this! For your time, might I present you with this rare piece from our collection.

It is no ordinary barrel, to be sure! I hope that you enjoy it thoroughly.

92577.title: Dreamy Inspiration
92577.objectives: Purchase a Filigree Moon Lamp in Bel'ameth in the Dragon Isles, then return to a Pawdo sibling in Dornogal, Stormwind, or Orgimmar.
92577.description:
A crate is nothing more than a box in the dark without lighting. 

Today, we go in search of the tiny suns that light our spaces. 

Not just any light will suffice. As you can clearly see from my chandelier, we have many lights of varying quality already.

We seek a unique shape, a unique feel. 

The crafters of Bel'ameth in the Dragon Isles are well-known for their dream-inspired designs. Travel through the Dragon Isles and you will find them at the far end of the plains.
92577.progress: You never really know a cabinet until you've checked the hinges.
92577.completion:
Your new magical light is quite astonishing! The accents of the finely-curved metal... 

In terms of metal balls, I have seen few of its quality. I would place it on a desk or end table. I can see it now! 

Though I will have no place to put my scrolls, I must provide something in return. Take my bookshelf, it has served me well.

92578.title: Draconic Decor
92578.objectives: Purchase a Draconic Sconce in Valdrakken in the Dragon Isles, then return to Pawdo in Dornogal, Stormwind, or Orgimmar.
92578.description:
The chandelier I showed you? You must think it so fancy. 

But here I am without the matching sconces!

What room lighting can I create without matching sconces? It will be woefully incomplete!

Head over to the Dragon Isles and see if you can find one from the vendors of Valdrakken.
92578.completion:
Ah! You have located the sconces, then. I shall head over and purchase some myself at once, thank you! 

Just as soon as you are not looking.

92580.title: Spare A Chair
92580.objectives: Purchase a Bolt Chair in Rustbolt in Mechagon, then return to Pawdo in Dornogal, Stormwind, or Orgimmar.
92580.description:
We cannot enjoy our Decor designs without a place to enjoy them from. 

Behold, the chair.

What better way to enjoy Decor than on Decor itself?

I cannot imagine something more appropriate.

Find me a chair to match this coil. The gearcrafters of Mechagon know the style.
92580.completion:
Ah, the chair that you found, it is quite appropriate indeed.

For you, this coil. 

I hope that you do not shock yourself! Sometimes we must sacrifice for art.

92581.title: Last Light
92581.objectives: Purchase a Nightborne Lantern in Suramar in the Broken Isles, then return to Pawdo in Dornogal, Stormwind, or Orgimmar.
92581.description:
I have sat in the chair and looked at the lights, and yet I am still not satisfied. 

The Decor still does not strike the dramatic tone that we require.

I must trouble you for another source of the light's rays. 

Travel to Suramar and speak to the crafters there. They are masters of the art of soft lighting.
92581.completion:
You have found the requested Decor once more! 

You are quite talented at this. I hope that you continue your adventure into the world of Decor, for there is no limit to it beyond your creativity. 

You may take the table in front of me, for I have no more need of it. Perhaps we shall meet again!

Until then, farewell!

92600.title: Cracked Keystone
92600.objectives: Complete any dungeon on Mythic 2 or higher difficulty.
92600.description:
Fragmentary images of heroic deeds flash though your mind as you touch the stone, but they fade as fast as they arrive.

Perhaps performing a suitably impressive task will stabilize the stone's magic once more?

92608.title: Landscape Photography
92608.objectives: Take enough photos of your neighborhood to inspire Corlen Hordralin.
92608.description:
I'm having just the best time in your lovely village, it's so quaint!

I'm feeling inspired. I would like to paint a landscape picture to commemorate the occasion. But you know the area better than I.

Could you provide me with some pictures of the landscape I can use for inspiration? You can use my camera. It's top of the line, of course.

I'm sure the perfect spots will just beam at you.
92608.progress: This place is such a delight, so laid back and rustic.
92608.completion: Oh my, these photos are just exquisite!

92630.title: The Pursuit Continues
92630.objectives: Find Leona and Allari in K'aresh.
92630.description:
I bring word from Magister Umbric!

His apprentice, Leona, has been preoccupied with a desire to learn how the ways of the Illidari.

She apparently found another demon hunter willing to train her, should she prove herself worthy. But after what happened the last time she sought such a mentor, Umbric is concerned for her safety.

Umbric requests you join Leona for this trial. Make sure she is not getting involved in something she is not prepared to handle.
92630.completion: Allari seeks to test my resolve. Nothing will deter me from this pursuit.

92631.title: Abhorrent Gauntlet
92631.objectives: Harvest 24 undamaged parts from aberrations in the Tempest Fields.
92631.description:
Leona must demonstrate mastery of her weapons--and of her own enmity--by retrieving undamaged pieces of her kills.

I will observe from here.

You, {NAME}, will go with her.
92631.progress: A demon hunter wields their ire, but is never ruled by it.
92631.completion: These parts are pristine. Well done, both of you.

92632.title: Trial of Wrath
92632.description:
Cutting through scores of lesser foes is a simple task for any demon hunter. It's when we face a large, singular threat that our skills are truly tested.

That will be Leona's trial. You will act as her second.

Let us see how she vanquishes a particularly dangerous opponent.
92632.completion:
The same fire I see in Leona is what brought me where I am today.

She fights well. But more importantly, she has shown me the potential that the void elves possess.

92647.title: A Shadowed Journey Through Time
92647.description:
Champion! The curiosities hidden within the Shadowlands are numerous, as are the dangers. I could use some assistance clearing a path, so to speak.

There is much wealth to be gained should you choose to seek it.
92647.completion: Another prosperous arrangement. You have my thanks.

92650.title: The Flickering Anima
92650.objectives: Bring the Flickering Anima to Ta'steld in Oribos.
92650.description:
The strange anima shimmers with a gentle hum, barely larger than a candle. As your hand draws near it erupts, flooding your mind with a torrent of visions. Triumphs earned through blood, regrets etched in grief, serene stillness all too fleeting, the bitter taste of betrayal. The unbearable cascade threatens to shatter your mind like glass. 

Then, silence. The visions end leaving an image Oribos seared into your mind.
92650.completion:
<Ta'steld takes the curious anima, studying the wisp as it dances in his hand.>

You were right to bring this to me. As a purveyor of lost curiosities, I know just what to do with this. My thanks, Champion.

92688.title: Bronze Simulacrum
92688.objectives: Give the Bronze Simulacrum to Erus at the Infinite Bazaar near Dalaran.
92688.description: <Erus will be delighted to scrap this for you for a heaping sum of bronze.>

92689.title: A Path Forward
92689.objectives: Assist Aethas Sunstrider and Grand Magister Rommath.
92689.description:
{NAME}, today will be a day of ceremonies and great magic.

Before we begin to cleanse the Darkwell, agreements must be made. 

We have two events that have requested your presence, both as a mediator and as a witness. What we lay down today will have lasting ramifications, and it is important to all of us that we have you at the center of it all. 

Meet with Aethas and Rommath for their respective events. Once you are done, return here and we shall continue to the Darkwell together.
92689.completion: You have fought by our side through our darkest hour and during our greatest triumphs. It is only fitting you join us on this day.

92692.title: Hero's Call: Test!
92692.objectives: Speak with Foreman Eksos in Talador.
92692.description:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Foreman Eksos in Talador.

The Iron Horde seek to control Talador. The area is perfect to send reinforcements to any other part of Draenor quickly and without resistance.

Foreman Eksos is currently establishing an outpost in Talador. Travel there and stop the Iron Horde.

Glory to the Alliance!

92715.title: By Invitation Only?
92715.objectives: Talk to Alton Philips near the Brawl'gar Arena.
92715.description:
Fancy yourself a Brawl'gar contender do you, {class}? They don't let just anyone in there, you know. Certainly not without an invitation.

That said... just between you and me, if you know where to look and you've the means they say anyone can have their moment in the spotlight these days.
92715.completion:
Looking for a Brawler's Guild invitation are you?

Very hard to come by those, or expensive, or both!

But maybe you and I can work out a deal.

92740.objectives: Purchase an extremely genuine Brawler's Guild Invitation from Alton Philips.
92740.description:
Well {class}, it's your lucky day. I just happen to have an extremely genuine Brawler's Guild Invitation right here in my stockpile.

That said I'll need a moment to process the paperwork. That requires my complete concentration without your prying eyes on me. So do please give me a moment.
92740.progress:
Here's your extremely genuine Brawler's Guild Invitation.

Please note all sales are final.

There will be no refunds, or receipts.
92740.completion: Some of the lines look a little crooked.

92816.title: A Letter for Adventure
92816.description:
<You look down to see a rough looking letter with your name on it.

Why not open it up to see what's inside?>

92855.title: Make Haste, Not Waste
92855.completion:
What, you think I'm just going to give you my crafts for free?

<Lidamorrutu grumbles.>

I suppose that's exactly what I'm going to do. Eternus's orders, something about speeding up the experiment.

Just don't lose it or, worse, let Erus anywhere near it.

92857.title: Ta'readon's Mount Voucher
92857.objectives: Bring Ta'readon's Mount Voucher to Overseer Ta'readon in Oribos.
92857.description: This token bears the seal of Overseer Ta'readon in Oribos. They would be interested in seeing this.
92857.completion: I see you have served our merchants admirably. Accept one of our finest steeds as a reward.

92875.title: Understanding the War Within
92875.objectives: Consult the Tome of History within Valdrakken to learn about the War Within saga.
92875.description:
I fear your time in Valdrakken must come to an end.

Dark forces gather to threaten other parts of Azeroth. We will do what we can to uncover Iridikron's schemes.

You must learn more of what has unfolded.
92875.completion: <The tome floats in front of you. Its pages are filled with knowledge of all that has happened.>

92926.title: Prey: Astalor's Initiative
92926.objectives: Meet Astalor Bloodsworn near the harbor in Silvermoon.
92926.description:
Ah, {NAME}. I am glad to see you here in our city, even if the times are trying.

We are once again beset on all sides by uncertain friends and dangerous foes, but I am not unprepared. I have a... guest, housed nearby. They may hold the key to our city's survival. 

Meet me near the harbor if you have the strength to do what must be done.
92926.completion:
I see your interest has been piqued. 

Excellent.

Our friend here will be more than willing to demonstrate, I am sure...
93043.progress: Speak with Astalor Bloodsworn to continue.
93043.completion: I can assure you that it will seldom be this easy.

93055.title: Extracurriculars
93055.objectives: Speak with Khadgar in Dalaran and Eternus at the Infinite Bazaar.
93055.description:
$p, how fares your journey through this timeline?

Should you wish to explore history further, Khadgar and Eternus may be able to show you more quests that the champions of Azeroth previously experienced.
93055.progress: Back so soon? Perhaps I miscalculated how long you would spend procrastinating.
93055.completion: Hopefully this diversion has been enlightening.

93056.title: A Lesson in Alacrity
93056.description:
You are exceeding expectations, $p.

Even still, let us not tarry. I will teach you what I know so that we may expedite your journey.

However, all good things come with time. You are not yet ready for my strongest blessings.

93057.title: A House For You
93057.description:
<A glowing parchment appears in front of you with the symbol of a home in front of it.>

Greetings, {NAME}!

Have you ever wanted to own a home? Have a place to call your own? Now you can!

Join us in Founder's Point, the new Housing Neighborhood. Get your very own slice of Azeroth!

93200.objectives: We're grateful for your help. Take these supplies as a gesture of thanks.

93382.title: Pardon the Interruption
93382.objectives: Activate Fightbot 11.2.7, then interrupt its abilities with your Felguard or Felhunter 3 times.
93382.description:
{NAME}! Glad to see you. The defenders in the fortress could use your help.

One of the gnomes built a robot to try to help defend the keep. However, it goes haywire every time it turns on.

She needs the help of someone who can properly disrupt the robot's attacks so it can be repaired.

Do you have a moment to help?
93382.progress: Some help! Hopefully you can find a way to interrupt this bot's abilities.
93382.completion:

Maybe I can just say it's a feature and call it a day!

93452.title: Retrieved Crumpled Present

93452.description:
<It seems the minions of the Greench have fled, leaving behind a small mangled, but still salvageable present.

Perhaps one of the Winter Festivities planners would be able to help return it to the original intended recipient.>

93453.title: A Grave Concern
93453.objectives: Meet with Nelthius Shadestone in Silvermoon.
93453.description:
Dearly Departed,

Having just tasted the bitter sting of mortality, there seems no better time to discuss with you the oft ignored subject of death and memorialization. Of what you leave behind in a real, physical sense.

Leave discussion of love and other such frivolities to the philosophers and dandies. I speak of cold, hard stone and the deeds carved upon it.

Find me in Silvermoon.
93453.completion:
Excellent. Feel free to make new arrangements whenever you would like.

I, like death, am a patient man.

93548.title: A Trove of Voidlight Marl

93549.completion: You've earned this. Take these supplies, and my sincere thanks.

93581.title: Against Overwhelming Odds
93581.objectives: Slay 25 Level 90 Horde anywhere within Midnight.

93582.title: Against Overwhelming Odds
93582.objectives: Slay 25 Level 90 Alliance anywhere within Midnight.

93611.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
93611.description:
The Cataclysm was terrifying for all of Azeroth. The existential threat of Deathwing echoes down through the ages. Isn't it interesting that no matter how things change, such threats return time and time again, but in different forms?

Go back and face those threats again. See if there's something new to learn from the past.
93611.progress: I... would not relive those times. Some memories are best left behind.
93611.completion: You have more courage than I, champion. Let us hope any lessons you have learned will be carried forward in earnest.

93612.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
93612.description:
My memories of Pandaria are... complicated, {class}. Many lessons were learned during that tumultuous period of time--some good, some painful. 

The world has changed a great deal since then. We've all changed--I hope for the better.

Travel back through the mists of time. Relearn what lessons you can.
93612.completion: Have you returned enlightened or embittered by the decisions of the past? I hope your lessons were easier to learn than my own.

93613.title: A Savage Path Through Time
93613.description:
Perhaps you can untangle the depth of knowledge to be found in Draenor--not the shattered remains of Outland, but the Draenor of the Iron Horde. It is, in its own ways, just as harsh if not harsher than Outland ever was. 

See what wisdom you can find there.

93614.title: A Fel Path Through Time
93614.description:
I have faced many enemies, but the Burning Legion was perhaps the greatest threat our world ever faced. At least... until now.

Of course, there are our inner demons to contend with as well.

Do you still have what it takes to defeat the Burning Legion?
93614.completion: You do indeed still have what it takes. May the Legion never return.

93641.title: Against Overwhelming Odds
93641.objectives: Slay 25 Level 90 Horde anywhere within Midnight.

93642.title: Against Overwhelming Odds
93642.objectives: Slay 25 Level 90 Alliance anywhere within Midnight.

93647.title: Lumber For You
93647.completion:
Ye look like someone who could learn the art of bein' a lumberjack!

I can teach ye real quick how to identify which trees are prime for gettin' some lumber.

Lumber has all sorts of uses when crafting stuff for yer house. Or other folks' houses, if you care to sell your goods. Might want to visit some o' your old craftin' teachers to brush up while you're at it. They've got some new things to teach, I'd wager!

So get what ye can and see what ye can make of it!

Bring back proof of completed orders and I'll see that you're adequately compensated.

93716.title: Learning the Cloaks - Part 1
93716.description:
In this game of Decor Duel, one side uses illusion to disguise themselves as, and hide amongst, everyday objects in the area.

The other side uses pre-approved lists of illusion-piercing abilities to find and then capture those hiding cloaked in disguise.

At the end of the round, the teams switch roles, so each side has a chance to hide and seek. 

Time for you to try! This armchair has been enchanted to cloak you with its disguise. Don its appearance, then change your disguise a few times.
93716.progress: Touch this armchair, to don its disguise...

93717.title: Learning the Cloaks - Part 2
93717.description:
When disguised, you will have the ability to magically teleport yourself to a nearby piece of decor.

Pick up the chair's disguise again, and this time try swapping your location a few times. Feel free to change your disguise between swaps if you'd like.
93717.progress: Use the disguise chair to swap with other decor, then return to me.

93719.title: Nothing Captured, Nothing Gained
93719.description:
There are three Seeker classes in Decor Duel, but everyone starts off with the Spellbreaker kit. Don't worry--you can earn access to the others.

Some fundamentals: you can break the shield of a disguised hider's illusion by using Dispel Magic. Once the hider has been marked as Found, you'll have a brief window to Tag them, taking them out of the match.

My statue has been enchanted to outfit you with a Spellbreaker kit. Once outfitted, use Dispel Magic to find and tag decoys hiding around here.
93719.progress: Use my statue, then find and tag hiders with the Spellbreaker's Dispel Magic and Tag.

93766.title: Midnight: World Quests
93766.description:
The Void seeks to divide us, to drive a wedge between kin and kingdom alike. We cannot allow it.

Everywhere I turn, I hear of those struggling--families displaced, defenders overwhelmed, healers stretched thin. No blade nor spell alone will turn this tide, but the strength of many hearts united can.

Go forth and lend your aid where it is needed most.
93766.progress: With your aid, will can bring all our people closer together.
93766.completion: Well done. Together, our light will outshine the darkness the Void brings.

93767.title: Midnight: Arcantina
93767.objectives: Visit the Arcantina and have a toasting brew with three players.
93767.description:
The Arcantina welcomes all who seek respite.

Step inside its lively halls, share a brew, and trade stories with friends old and new.

Where the Void brings chill and silence, here you'll find warmth, laughter, and the spark of fellowship.
93767.progress: We all need a moment away from the battle now and again.
93767.completion: Ah, you've returned. I am glad you allowed yourself that well-earned moment of peace.

93769.title: Midnight: Housing
93769.objectives: Participate in neighborhood Endeavors and collect Community Coupons.
93769.description:
A strong community is built not by walls, but by the hands and hearts of those within it. 

Lend your voice, your time, and your spirit to the neighborhood. Help your fellows, share in their burdens, and take your place as an active part of the home we build together.
93769.completion: You've given your heart. That is what truly unites us.

93774.title: When is a Chair not for Sitting?
93774.description:
Aethas Sunreaver, Riftblade Maella, and Auric Sunchaser have recently revitalized an old arcane twist on hide and seek called Decor Duel.

They're looking for new participants to help spread the entertainment.

You should meet them over in Falconwing Square.

93784.title: A Gnawing Void of Curiosity
93784.objectives: Report your discovery to Naleidea Rivergleam in Silvermoon City.
93784.description: <The artifact crumbles in your hand, leaving only a faint but distinctly ancient arcane footprint. Naleidea Rivergleam will want to hear about this.>
93784.completion:
An extraordinary find. The arcane energies emanating from your discovery clearly predate the Shattering... We could learn much from such artifacts.

Champion! Fantastic work! If you happen upon any more during your expeditions, please bring your findings back to me.

93816.title: Putting it Together
93816.description:
You have the basics now. All that's left is to experience the Arcane Propagator for yourself in a match of Decor Duel!

What is the Arcane Propagator, you ask? A mystic relic wrought from glamours. It lets players cloak themselves in the guise of enchanted objects.

We've partially recreated it with the chair for training, as you've seen, but the real thing is much better. Why not play a match for real right now?
93816.progress:
{NAME}? No, I do not see your name on any of the game rosters.

\Speak with Gamemaster Fleurian to join a game of Decor Duel.

93870.title: The Ephemeron Masquerade
93870.objectives: Speak with Fieldweaver Amolenne to play Decor Duel.
93870.description:
The deeds of today becomes the tales of dusk!

Seekers and Hiders, alike, make their mark through thrilling game play and strategic out maneuvering.

The sun shines its light on a new day, shattering the illusions of yesterday, and elongating the shadows of today. Are you ready?

Don you disguise, secure your kit, and show your peers no one can hold a candle to you ... literally!
93870.completion: Ah, well done! I watched you out there, and it was quite thrilling!

93889.title: Midnight: Saltheril's Soiree
93889.objectives: Participate in Saltheril's Soiree and earn favor with one of the Silvermoon factions.
93889.description:
Champion, you would do well to attend Saltheril's Soiree.

There, amidst Silvermoon's intricate politics and quiet struggles for influence, our most distinguished military orders each have matters they wish to see addressed.

Prove your worth to these factions, and you may find their gratitude and favor richly rewarded.
93889.completion: You've done well to navigate the Court without being swallowed by its politics. Silvermoon needs those who can act with purpose, not those lost in the machinery of ambition.

93890.title: Midnight: Abundance
93890.objectives: Participate in Zul'Aman's Abundance Harvest and gain Loa's favor.
93890.description:
The trolls of Zul'Aman draw their strength from the loa: ancient spirits that grant power to those who honor them. These boons can be wondrous or perilous, depending on the loa's nature and the devotion of its followers.

There are whispers of a Loa of Abundance dwelling within Zul'Aman, its blessings said to bring prosperity to those deemed worthy.

Seek it out, learn what drives it, and see if its favor would serve our cause.
93890.completion: You have met the Loa of Abundance. May its gifts serve you well.

93892.title: Midnight: Stormarion Assault
93892.objectives: Participate in the Stormarion Assault event.
93892.description:
The fight against Xal'atath tests our resolve, but it will not break us.

Void anomalies twist the halls of Stormarion Citadel, but they will find no weakness here. The Void Elves stand as our allies. Prove to our enemies that our strength when united is beyond the reach of even the Void.

Go, {NAME}--aid them, and see the Citadel cleansed of corruption.
93892.completion:
The Citadel stands as proof of what we can achieve together. 

Against unity, even the Void itself must yield.

93899.title: Slayer's Rise
93899.description: We've received reports of escalated troubles between some domanaar. Go investigate the battle in Slayer's Rise, then report to Deminos Darktrance in Masters' Perch.
93899.completion: {NAME}, you made it through. Well done.

93907.title: Edification of the Worthy
93907.description:
When you acquire a new Seeker kit, it always starts off relatively lean.

But you'll earn Illusionary Coins as you play, and may trade them in with Gamemaster Fleurian for expanded abilities, and even additional kits!

Take these. Add them to what you earned and demonstrate your shopping prowess.
93907.progress: Those coins were a one-time gift, {NAME}. If you have mislaid them, or have suffered the misfortune of thievery, then I suppose you will have to enter the games to collect more.

93909.title: Midnight: Delves
93909.description:
Many have ventured into the delves' depths, but few have returned with more than dust and bruises.

Valeera Sanguinar has taken a keen interest in these ventures. She leaves no stone unturned and has a remarkable talent for getting in to places others cannot.

Seek her out, and see what fortune or danger awaits beneath the surface.
93909.completion:
You've braved the delves and returned stronger for it.

Valeera was right--opportunity favors the bold.

93910.title: Midnight: Prey
93910.objectives: Complete Prey Hunts for Astalor Bloodsworn in Silvermoon.
93910.description:
Silvermoon is beset on all sides by threats both known and unknown. There are those who seek to track these threats and put an end to the strife and chaos they create.

Speak with Magister Astalor Bloodsworn in Murder Row. He will guide you toward the urgent threats.
93910.completion: Astalor serves Silvermoon's cause, though his path to that end is rarely a straight one.

93911.title: Midnight: Dungeons
93911.objectives: Complete any Seasonal Dungeon at Normal difficulty or higher.
93911.description:
The dungeons of Azeroth hold great challenges and even greater rewards. Within them lay treasures that may aid you in battles yet to pass, and powerful foes to overcome.

Enter the dungeon, and see what awaits you there.
93911.progress: Be ready for anything. Fortune often walks hand in hand with peril.
93911.completion:
You've proven your mettle once more. 

May your victories within strengthen you for what lies ahead.

93912.title: Midnight: Raid
93912.objectives: Defeat any 2 raid bosses in Midnight on any difficulty.
93912.description:
Gather your allies, you will face the great trials ahead. 

The rewards are vast, and can aid you in the battles ahead. You and your allies need only vanquish a small number of these terrible foes.
93912.completion:
You've faced the darkness and emerged stronger.

Well done, {NAME}.

93913.title: Midnight: World Boss
93913.objectives: Defeat a World Boss in Midnight.
93913.description:
Powerful enemies roam Azeroth, their strength growing with each passing battle.

Only through courage and unity will you emerge victorious.
93913.completion: May your victories light the path for all who follow.

93922.title: A Singular Focus Unleashed
93922.completion: The Singularity stands behind you in your assault on the Voidspire. We know better than most what is at stake here today. What power we can grant you is yours to take.

93923.title: Tenacity of the Shul'ka
93923.objectives: It is strange for a Shul'ka to ask for aid. It is even stranger to receive it.
93923.completion: It is strange for a Shul'ka to ask for aid. It is even stranger to receive it.

93924.title: An Unrelenting March
93924.completion: We must reclaim the Darkwell from Xal'atath's forces before all is lost to the Void. We will lend you what strength we can to aid you in the struggles ahead. Do not give up, champion!

93929.title: The War Within Recap
93929.objectives: Consult the Tome of History to learn about the War Within saga.
93929.description:
<A parchment reaches you from an unknown sender.>

<It speaks of perusing a tome to catch up on current events, and how it is vital to understand a looming threat.>

<Perhaps you should seek out this tome to understand more when you are ready.>
93929.completion: <The tome floats in front of you. Its pages are filled with knowledge of all that has happened.>

93943.title: Ancient Curiosity: Combat
93943.objectives: Use and equip a Combat Curio to your delve companion.
93943.description: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important.>

93945.title: Ancient Curiosity: Utility
93945.objectives: Use and equip a Utility Curio to your delve companion.
93945.description: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important.>

93979.title: Lingering Memories
93979.objectives: Meet Alleria and Locus-Walker at the docks.
93979.description:
Dimensius threatens us once more. There is no one who knows his methods better than his former Harbinger, Xal'atath. I would not say we can trust her, but we can work with her. She fears the All-Devouring's wrath after her betrayal.

We can't afford to turn away any potential ally. Think how many we will save from the Void Lord's hunger. Get your bearings in this city the four of us saved together. I will convince Alleria.
93979.completion: This is what we are fighting for, {NAME}. We can only save fragments of K'aresh, but we can prevent other worlds from sharing our dreadful fate.

94210.title: Feathering the Nest
94210.description: A house isn't quite a home without the perfect furnishings. It looked like there were some vendors in town. Perhaps it would be worth checking what they have in stock.
94210.progress: Have you met all the local vendors? They have some great furnishings available.
94210.completion: Did you find any good pieces for your house? We hope to have more vendors visit in the future, so be sure to check back often!

94363.title: The Gloves Are Off
94363.objectives: Talk to a Bouncer in Bizmo's Brawlpub in the Deeprun Tram after using your Blood-Soaked Invitation.
94363.description:
If you've found yourself an invite you'll be wanting to put it to good use, no?

Use your Blood-Soaked Invitation first then talk to a Bouncer in the Brawlpub and get to brawling!

94372.title: The Gloves Are Off
94372.objectives: Talk to a Grunt in the Brawl'gar Arena in Orgrimmar after using your Blood-Soaked Invitation.
94372.description:
If you've found yourself an invite you'll be wanting to put it to good use, no?

Use your Blood-Soaked Invitation first then talk to a Grunt in the Brawl'gar Arena and get to brawling!

94379.title: This Old Hearth
94379.description:
It looks like your house is ready for an upgrade. This doesn't normally happen so fast, but you've really made an impression around here.

Head on over to our general contractor for next steps.
94379.progress: Did you get your house upgraded?
94379.completion:
Did the renovation go well? I hope it gives you a little more room for all the treasures you find in your adventures.

Be sure to visit the general contractor again when you're next ready for an upgrade.

Oh, and a letter arrived for you while you were away.

94396.title: Down a Peg
94396.objectives: Check in on Tytalor Goldenblade in the Sunstrider Isle.
94396.description:
There seems to be a problem student at the academy.

I have heard reports that a student, Tytalor Goldenblade, is stirring up trouble in Sunstrider Isle. I'd go myself but I have my hands full running practice here already.

Could you go check on him and... educate him of his misgivings?
94396.completion:
Truly, I am incredibly talented!

<Tytalor appears to be lost within his own thoughts.>

94415.title: Plumbing the Void
94415.objectives: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.
94415.completion: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has set aside a fund to encourage such initiative.

94416.title: Rehoming Technology
94416.completion: Another task completed. The Trust thanks you for your efforts. The founder has allowed you to take a small selection of our technology back to your world, if you choose.

94444.title: Choose a Path
94444.description:
Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.

I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar, {race}.

<He smiles unconvincingly.>

As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...

You know what? I've been saying this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.

Talk to Chromie on top of the hourglass, then talk to your emissary. Run along.
94444.progress: Greetings, {NAME}. Has Orgrimmar been to your liking so far?
94444.completion:
Carry your traditions with pride, for their roots intertwine within you.

Aln'hara bless your path.

94445.title: Choose a Path
94445.objectives: Talk to Chromie in Stormwind City.
94445.description:
Welcome to Stormwind, {race}. I invite you to explore our fair city. Say, you look like someone who appreciates the great outdoors! Elwynn is lovely this time of year.

Ah, but that can wait, a bronze dragon has asked to talk to you. She is sitting under the nearby tree, on an hourglass of all things!

After that, an emissary of yours is waiting to welcome you to the city. Sounds like a busy day for you!

Have a pleasant stay, {NAME}!
94445.completion:
Carry your traditions with pride, for their roots intertwine within you.

Aln'hara bless your path.

94446.title: A Nightmarish Task
94446.description:
Excellent work so far, $p. 

But there is always more to be done.

Go out and hunt the most powerful targets available to us with all the fury our magic has to offer.

94450.title: Twenty Five Percent Completed
94450.description:
We're still getting things setup for rewarding endeavors. This is a temporary quest to grant you community coupons.

community coupons will normally be earned by completing endeavor tasks, not via a quest like this.

94451.title: Fifty Percent Completed
94451.description:
We're still getting things setup for rewarding endeavors. This is a temporary quest to grant you community coupons. 

community coupons will normally be earned by completing endeavor tasks, not via a quest like this.

94452.title: Seventy Five Percent Completed
94452.description:
We're still getting things setup for rewarding endeavors. This is a temporary quest to grant you community coupons. 

community coupons will normally be earned by completing endeavor tasks, not via a quest like this.

94453.title: One Hundred Percent Completed
94453.description:
We're still getting things setup for rewarding endeavors. This is a temporary quest to grant you community coupons. 

community coupons will normally be earned by completing endeavor tasks, not via a quest like this.

94457.title: Midnight: Battlegrounds
94457.description:
Battlegrounds stand as crucible where soldiers clash for honor, resources, and glory.

Each victory hones your skill and strengthens your resolve.

Go, test yourself against worthy foes and bring pride to your banner.
94457.completion: You've returned with the fire of battle in your eyes.

94464.title: Heritage of the Haranir
94464.objectives: Tell Orweyna of your travels at the Den in Harandar.
94464.description:
You have travelled far and learned much of Aln'hara's grace.

It is time to return home and share the wisdom you have earned with your people.
94464.completion:
You have seen many battles and met many peoples. Your journeys continue to bring us closer to the wisdom and grace of Aln'hara. 

Since you left, roots and vines began to rapidly grow within your old home. Eventually, their purpose became clear: armor, grown for you from the roots of the great trees as a blessing from Aln'hara herself!

Wear it with pride as you continue your journey, {NAME}. Thank you.

94475.title: The Voidspire: Flicker in the Hollow
94475.objectives: Collect 3 Echoes of Radiance within The Voidspire on Normal difficulty.
94475.description:
There's little light in these lands. What remains is fractured, hidden, or fading.

Fetch me Echoes of Radiance and I will grant you passage where no path should exist.
94475.completion: Do not stray into the shadows, {NAME}--I cannot guarantee your safety.

94476.title: The Voidspire: Flicker in the Hollow
94476.objectives: Collect 3 Echoes of Radiance within The Voidspire on Heroic difficulty.
94476.description:
There's little light in these lands. What remains is fractured, hidden, or fading.

Fetch me Echoes of Radiance and I will grant you passage where no path should exist.
94476.completion: Do not stray into the shadows, {NAME}--I cannot guarantee your safety.

94477.title: The Voidspire: Flicker in the Hollow
94477.objectives: Collect 3 Echoes of Radiance within The Voidspire on Mythic difficulty.
94477.description:
There's little light in these lands. What remains is fractured, hidden, or fading.

Fetch me Echoes of Radiance and I will grant you passage where no path should exist.

94622.title: Work It
94622.description:
The Trial of Style gives us the opportunity to look good, {class}.

The camera makes sure we keep looking good. 

So focus on me and my camera, follow my directions and I'll make sure you look fantastic!
94622.progress:
Focus on me and follow my directions.

I'll make sure you look great.
94622.completion:
The camera doesn't lie, {NAME}. 

You are one stylish {class}.
