94813.title: Fine Fashion Funding
94813.objectives: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept this token as thanks.
94813.completion: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept this token as thanks.

94816.title: Fine Fashion Funding
94816.objectives: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept this token as thanks.
94816.completion: Thank you for your assistance. Please accept this token as thanks.

94831.title: An Idol in Hand
94831.objectives: Return the Idol of Ohn'ahra to Preservationist Kathos in Valdrakken.

94847.title: Preparations Underway
94847.description:
As you may or may not recall, I once helped young paladins obtain their first armored mount.

It was a tedious task that involved months of obtaining materials and sending them all over Azeroth.

Thankfully, times have changed and we now have most of those materials at hand. That being said, I wish to help you obtain a new mount, something worthy of your title as Highlord.

In order for us to begin, I only require that you obtain a barding for us. Something strong, thick, and heavy.
94847.completion:
<Grayson examines the barding.>

This is... well, a good start, Highlord. But I think it will have to be strengthened a bit.

94850.title: If You Build It
94850.description:
If we wish to achieve a sustained connection to Xoroth, we'll need a particularly resilient portal. Unfortunately, we can't just summon this one up from the ground.

I will need you to gather the requisite materials. Once we have them, I will have the mo'arg begin construction at once. 

Here's the list of what you'll need.
94850.completion:
Excellent. This Unbending Potion should shore up the Felslate enough to hold the portal's structure, and these Chaotic Spinel crystals should focus the portal's magic nicely.

I will set the mo'arg to work posthaste.

94868.title: It Takes Two
94868.objectives: Find Shaja by the shoreline southwest of the Temple of Jan'alai.
94868.description:
Jan'alai is a hen! And dat means eggs!

De eggs of de loa are volatile! Dey must be hatched carefully. My family carried dis honor for generations, but de tradition died when my older brothers followed de false promises of Zul'jin. Sadly, I am de only brother left, and we need two hatchers for de ritual!

Find my niece, Shaja, down by de shore. She is too young to know de ritual, but de loa's favor flows through her veins as it did my brothers'. It is time for her to know this honor.
94868.completion:
It was a dangerous trek back, but I made it in one piece.

I've been tellin' my uncle about our adventure. He loves a good story.

94869.title: Hungry Hungry Hatchlings
94869.objectives: Collect 100 Pungent Crab Tomalley from the crabs southwest of the Temple of Jan'alai.
94869.description:
We will soon be blessed with eggs! Jan'alai has told me so. And once dem eggs hatch, we'll have many hungry mouths to feed! Dey will crave somethin' soft, delicate, and pungent.

<Brek eyes you up and down.>

Ya best scurry down to de shore and find somethin' to tempt de hatchlings with or dey may take a nibble out of you!

<Brek laughs.>
94869.progress: <It's going to take ages to get this smell out of your armor.>
94869.completion: <Hopefully this will be enough food for the hatchlings.>

94870.title: Eggstra Protection Never Hurts
94870.objectives: Gather 3 Feathers of Jan'alai from the cliffs behind the Temple of Jan'alai.
94870.description:
De eggs are nearly ready!

<Brek glances eagerly at both clutches of eggs.>

Ya may know somethin' about dis, eh? Jan'alai tells me so. What ya lack in blood, ya make up for in spirit. Help me teach Shaja! Ya spirit alone is not enough for dis ritual. De eggs are imbued with de power of de loa herself and will burst with fiery energy!

We can protect ya from dis, but first we need feathers. Loa feathers! Collect dem from around de temple... unless ya dare ask de loa herself!
94870.progress: Ya got de feathers? Or are ya gonna melt?
94870.completion:
Ah ha! De feathers!

Dey will protect ya during de hatchin' ritual, but we must work a little magic on ya first. I taught Shaja the protection blessin' while you were runnin' about.

Do not worry! She is a natural.

<Brek grins wildly.>

94882.title: Perfect Timing
94882.objectives: Assist Brek and Shaja in hatching the eggs of Jan'alai.
94882.description:
All is ready! I will now guide ya both through de hatchin' ceremony!

Talk to Shaja and she will use de feathers to protect ya from dem powerful loa energies.
94882.progress: Hurry! Dem eggs are ready to pop!
94882.completion:
The hatchin' is complete! Hopefully de first of many clutches to come. Jan'alai be praised!

Shaja and I will carry on dis legacy and welcome many new hatchlings to our land.

94883.title: Like Dragonhawks to a Flame
94883.objectives: Investigate what's going on with the new hatchlings.
94883.description:
I know my uncle can seem... off at times. His talk of de loa always felt like childhood stories to me.

But ever since Jan'alai returned, I feel her energy too! She flickers, she smolders, she burns red hot. She also brings warmth, light, and life!

But what I feel from her right now is distress--dat of a mother hen counting her chicks but comin' up short.

Let's check on de hatchlings. We can cover more ground if we split up.
94883.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. And Jan'alai thanks ya too.

I know dis is my path. By blood and by my own heart. I may never follow my mother into battle, but she will understand I serve de Amani--and Jan'alai--in my own way.

94932.title: Bindings of the Windlord
94932.objectives: Retrieve both Bindings of the Windlord and 10 Infernal Brimstone.
94932.description:
With Thunderaan risen again as the lord of Skywall, there may indeed be an arrangement you can make in exchange for those wretched implements. But one binding is of no use on its own.

Return to me with both bindings, and with powerful enough ore to bind them, and I will arrange your audience with Thunderaan the Windlord.
94932.completion: And so you return with the bindings in hand. The Firelord shall be very displeased to have lost these.

94933.title: Lessons in the Void
94933.objectives: Meet up with Umbric in Shand'orah in K'aresh.
94933.description:
Ah, you're there!

Our esteemed Magister Umbric has tasked me with wrangling an able-bodied champion to assist him. An apprentice of his, Leona Darkstrider, is investigating the techniques and methods of the illidari.

It appears her inquiries may have put her in a bit of trouble.

The Magister can fill you in. He's in K'aresh now, and he's allowed me to open the way for you if you require transportation.
94933.completion: I'm glad you've chosen to join me here, {NAME}.

94954.title: Darkspear Dash
94954.description:
Today, celebrate da Darkspear footrunners. 

Long ago, our footrunners ran 'round all da troll empire deliverin' important messages. Dey carried their messages through battle an' storm an' were famous for dey courage. 

Today we be celebratin' not dey courage in war, but da courage of some of da messages dey carried--messages of peace an' hope for a better world.

Help us send a message of hope by joinin' our symbolic run ta Silvermoon. 

Ya be ready? Well go, mon!
94954.completion:
You made it {NAME}! Ya feel all right, mon?

Time ta celebrate. We all be here together now!

94993.title: Adventuring in Midnight
94993.objectives: Review the Scouting Map and choose where to begin the Midnight campaign.
94993.description: The Void encroaches on Azeroth from all sides. Visit the Scouting Map in the Sanctum of Light and choose where you will make your stand.
94993.completion: You have embarked on a campaign chapter using the Scouting Map. You may return to the Sanctum of Light to make another selection.

94995.title: To Dye For
94995.completion:
I have something for you, neighbor. Just between you and me, these decor vendors don't always have the greatest palette sensibilities. I hope yours are better. If you're going to put those... things in your house? Try recoloring them with these dyes. Each dye can be used just once, so make sure you like what you're doing before you apply them.

But if you want more, any scribe or alchemist can grind up herbs to create pigments, then use those pigments at this station to make more dyes.

95008.title: Adventuring in Midnight
95008.objectives: Review the Scouting Map and choose where to begin the Midnight campaign.
95008.description:
It's rare that we get to choose our paths in life, but you seem like someone who's seen it all before.

<Soridormi winks.>

Don't dally, this war won't win itself. Go to the Sanctum of Light. Choose where you'll make your first stand.

95009.title: Doing the Dash
95009.description:
Have you heard about the race today?

Thousands of trolls are gathering to run to Silvermoon City for a celebration!

Kalaya could tell you more. They're setting up at the Echo Isles now!
95009.completion:
You're welcome here, {class}.

Come celebrate with us for de race. You not gonna wanna miss it!

95114.title: Prey: A Crimson Summons
95114.objectives: Meet with Astalor Bloodsworn in Murder Row.
95114.description:
Ah, $p. I have been looking for you. My... contacts have told me much regarding your continued attempts to defend our beloved city.

But there is another way.

Come, join me in Murder Row and we can get to work.
95114.completion:
Look at you.... following directions already. 

Excellent.

95215.title: A New Direction
95215.description:
<Your hand burns with felfire as a scroll materializes within your grasp. The seal bears the mark of the Illidari.>

{NAME}, as leader of the Illidari in Lord Illidan's absence, you must choose your second-in-command.

Kayn or Altruis. You can only choose one.

The chosen shall become your personal champion, and their ideology will color our decisions for the Illidari going forward. No matter who is chosen, our mission remains unchanged.

-Kor'vas Bloodthorn
95215.completion:
I'm glad you selected your second-in-command, {NAME}.

But Stormwind mourns today, and we must act.

95276.title: The Last Push
95276.description:
Our forces are starting to move out to take the fight to Xal'atath. 

I've received word there are many areas that you've visited that could still use some aid. 

We must focus our attention on the counter offensive. Can you help those that are in need?
95276.progress: There's plenty out there that can be done.
95276.completion:
Fine work {NAME}. 

There's plenty to do now that you've taken care of those issues.

95406.title: Lost Animals
95406.description:
Oh thank goodness you are here!

Some of my precious orange kitties were so eager to play in the neighborhood they've all run off to explore. Please help me find them!

95468.title: Hope in the Darkest Corners
95468.objectives: Complete various activities in Midnight zones.
95468.description:
I can't imagine what will happen to Quel'Thalas if the Sunwell falls to the forces of the Void.

We need you out on the battlefield, {NAME}. Bring hope and heroism to the people across these lands.

95842.title: Midnight: Void Assaults
95842.objectives: Complete Void Strikes and Void Incursions in Midnight.
95842.description:
Both Void forces and old enemies press us in this turbulent time. We must stay vigilant and let no faction gain a foothold.

You must put a stop to these Void assaults! Stay alert, our scouts report some factions may be using the smaller strikes to prepare for a major incursion. 

If so, I know you will help with the defense.
95842.completion: Thank you {class}, our enemies once again are thwarted. With defenders like yourself we shall not fail.

95843.title: Midnight: Ritual Sites
95843.description:
There have been many enemies that seek to use dark rituals to send horrors our way. The rangers have always risen to challenge and dealt with them. 

With the pressure on our forces, I must ask you to take up this mission. There are dangerous Ritual Sites that must be disrupted. 

Our enemies will most likely try again, so you must be dogged and continue to thwart them each time they make the attempt.
95843.completion: These Ritual Sites are one more threat we now must face. Your diligence in protecting our lands is not going unnoticed, and we are in your debt.

96114.title: A Small Pouch of Crystals
96114.objectives: Thanks for helping get Undermine back on track. Here's somethin' for your trouble.

96116.completion:
The work of the Severed Threads proceeds apace. As such, our patrons have decided to reward your continued dedication.

Now take this and begone. You're drawing suspicious eyes.

96242.title: An Easy Path to Trickery
96242.description:
You can always speak to me to enter a game of Decor Duel, but did you know there's an easier way?

If there's a group you want to find, we have "magic" to help!
96242.progress:
You're on the easy path to Trickery? Good luck!

<use Group Finder to play a PvP Decor Duel match.>

<If you abandon her quest, or complete it, you may re-enter Decor Duel through Amolene again>

96936.title: Accolades for the Umbral Contender
96936.objectives: Speak with Lindormi regarding your deeds in Mythic Keystone dungeons.
96936.description:
{NAME}, you continue to impress me with your martial prowess!

You've done such an incredible job defeating the forces of evil. I've got something from my coffers that I'd love to give you.
96936.completion:
You're incredible, {NAME}!

Please have this saddle as a token of my appreciation.

92555.title: Honor the Flame
92555.description:
The time of Dawnsummer Festal has long been a cherished season for our people.

Even during the years under the cold grasp of the Ghostlands, the people of Tranquillien strived to maintain this ancient celebration and bring a little light to these once-cold lands.

Now, warmth yourself by the bonfire and honor the flames of summer!

92556.title: Honor the Flame
92556.description:
A joyous Midsummer and Dawnsummer Festal upon you, {race}!

While celebrating around the bonfire, it is important to pause for a moment of reflection.

Much has happened here in Silvermoon in recent times and while we cannot dwell upon the darkness of the past, we must look towards the rising Dawn.

Take a moment, while you honor the bonfire, and reflect upon its warmth!
92556.completion: Honor and reflect upon the Silvermoon flame.

92557.title: Honor the Flame
92557.description:
Fetna Alai-nazdo is upon us once again!

Although her trample may be dark, her flame burns brightly in all of us! 

May this turn of the Season burn bright and bring good fortune to you and all who celebrate Fetna Alai-nazdo!
92557.completion: Honor the Zul'Aman flame in honor of Jan'alai!

92558.title: Honor the Flame
92558.description:
I remember the Dawnsummer Festal celebrations back in Eversong and thought 'why not light my own bonfire here in the Howling Ridge?'

Thankfully, the local denizens didn't need much convincing.

I told them the bonfires were sacrificial wells for vessels of esoteric magic and... well, that's one way to describe midsummer blossoms, right?

Will you take a moment and honor the voidflame?

92559.title: Honor the Flame
92559.description:
The season of Midsummer may be unfamiliar to us, but telling stories by the glow of our root flames is not.

Take a moment to reflect by the bonfire, friend, and listen to those around you.

Ponder that which has come before you and that which has yet to unfurl.

94586.title: Snail Mail - Earthroot and Mage Royal

94649.title: Snail Mail - Seven Day Old Sweat

94658.title: Snail Mail - Scent of the Wind

92106.title: Ignite the Skies: Northern Kalimdor
92106.description:
Midsummer is the time to reflect and a time to tell stories by the bonfire.

One such story is the tale of the sun blossom ritual and how this offering to An'she first came to be.

Our journey will take us through Northern Kalimdor, into territories beyond the lands of the shu'halo.

If you wish, take to the skies of Kalimdor and ignite the blossoms as I tell the tale.

Our story begins in the Western Barrens...
92106.completion:
This important journey would soon become a yearly pilgrimage for the tribes of Central Kalimdor.

As the summer season approached, and the tribes began to gather near Stonetalon, a chosen few would journey to the highest peak and make offerings to the sun.

An'she was pleased by this act, and the offering of sun blossoms became pivotal to Midsummer celebration.

92185.title: The Tale of the Frost Lord
92185.description:
Midsummer is the time to reflect on the past and share stories by the fireside.

One such tale is the defeat of Frost Lord Ahune!

But this is a story you must witness for yourself so you may share it around the bonfire with others!
92185.completion:
Now that, my friend, is a story worth telling.

It is a tale we shaman often reflect upon during this time.

The stirring of the Frost Lord during the season of fire was an imbalance of nature. A flame that never should have sparked.

It is a cautionary tale of passion and conflict that we would all do well to remember.

Thank you for this reminder.

92420.title: Ignite the Skies: Southern Kalimdor
92420.description:
Each year, as tribes from southern and central Kalimdor journeyed to Stonetalon to spend the summer season, the rite of the sun blossoms became common practice.

Many saw it as a way to give back to An'she, who worked tirelessly during this long season.

The rite became especially important towards the end of Midsummer, as the southern tribes journeyed back home.

If you're up for another journey, take to the skies once more, my friend, and listen close...
92420.completion:
As summer came to an end, the final offering of sun blossoms were uplifted to the skies.

Just as the southern tribes returned to their lands, these offerings served as torches to guide An'she home into his season of rest.

Thank you for partaking in these long-forgotten traditions, {NAME}.

92435.title: Ignite the Skies: Orgrimmar
92435.description:
Midsummer is a time to reflect on the past and future. As old traditions fade, new traditions are born. 

One old tradition, practiced long ago, involved the offering of sun blossoms to An'she. As summer winds took them upwards, the blossoms would burn bright blue and orange.

But faded traditions need not remain lost.


Will you take to the skies to ignite the sun blossoms and help rekindle this old tradition?
92435.completion:
You have done our festival a great honor.

It has been many generations since the skies above have been filled with Sun blossoms.

But our celebrations need not be restricted to just the skies of Orgrimmar. All of Kalimdor awaits!

92503.title: Ignite the Skies: Northern Eastern Kingdoms
92503.description:
Have you heard the tale of the wildsages and their summer star?

No? Well, you're in for quite the treat!

This story will take you on a journey that follows the path the Wildhammer elders once travelled many moons ago.

Take to the skies and ignite the blossom lights as I tell the tale.

Our journey begins here in the hills of Loch Modan...
92503.completion:
"Like a northbound torch across the dark summer sky."

Quite the journey, wasn't it? Now imagine that same path on foot... every summer!

It is quite the popular story for young Wildhammer children.

Some say this tale was what inspired Khardros to settle our people in the Hinterlands after Grim Batol.

Now you too can share this Wildhammer tale by the fireside!

92504.title: Ignite the Skies: Southern Eastern Kingdoms
92504.description:
The fire festival is a time for people to come together and share stories around the fire.

One such tale tells of a celebration of Midsummer and the elemental chaos it wrought for the humans of Stormwind.

Our story will take us over the skies of the surrounding regions into lands now scarred by flame and ash.

Take to the skies and ignite the blossom lights as I tell you the story.

It begins in the Burning Steppes...
92504.progress: Have you ever wondered why the blossoms of midsummer burn blue and orange? Curious, isn't it?
92504.completion:
For many generations, Midsummer bonfires have ignited the summer skies throughout the human lands and beyond.

But even before the kingdom of Stormwind was founded, we dwarves dotted these hills with our festivals of fire.

It is said our first united Midsummer happened by sheer wandering chance during one particularly hot summer long, long ago.

But that, my friend, is another tale. Care for another flight?

92634.title: Midsummer's Journey to Loch Modan
92634.description:
While Midsummer may be sacred to the tauren, we are not the only people to pay respects to the spirits of fire during the summer months.

The Wildhammer, for example, have shared their own customs with us over the years. It seems this time of year has long been important to the dwarves and denizens of the Eastern Kingdoms.

Journey to their celebration grounds across the sea in Loch Modan and visit with the Wildhammer. 

Perhaps they too will tell you a tale...
92634.completion:
Elder Sunhorn sent you, did he? Well then welcome, {race}, to our Midsummer celebrations!

Care to hear about the origins of the Firefall festival and how the dwarves have celebrated Midsummer?

92635.title: Midsummer's Journey to the Barrens
92635.description:
Although we have our own traditions during this time, we are not the only ones who pay respects to the spirits of fire during the summer months.

If you wish to hear the origins of the tauren traditions, travel to Kalimdor to continue your journey.
92635.completion:
Did Aedh Firebeard send you? Well then welcome, {race}, to our Midsummer celebrations!

Care to hear our tale?

92667.title: UNUSED
92667.description:
Thrall's parents had lost their life while he was an infant - the start of a rough upbringing. Found by humans, he was raised within the internment camps from the Second War. The one in charge, a man named Blackmoore, was a terribly cruel taskmaster.

A rare friend during that time, Taretha Foxton, promised to help Thrall escape from his shackles.

92671.title: Lorewalking: Rise of the Horde
92671.description:
Let us keep the focus on Thrall, yes?

The Horde's history is expansive - and fascinating. Perhaps we can learn about it another time.

This period denotes the beginning of our hero's restlessness. His time as warchief now over by his own reckoning. Clinging to something he had learned in his journeys, he sought out the Earthen Ring and continued his studies of shamanism. But the life he left behind shadowed him every step of the way...

92672.title: UNUSED
92672.description:
The Cataclysm upended both Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. But it is from these wounds where Thrall showed Azeroth what he was truly capable of.

Azeroth needed a Shaman to take care of Deathwing, and they got one.

92673.title: Lorewalking: In Pride's Wake
92673.description:
Thrall left the Horde behind with the hope that the foundation he had laid would lead them towards the future.

Unfortunately turmoil quickly followed - Garrosh, the young orc Thrall had named as warchief, had a very different idea on what the Horde should be. One that left a major scar on Azeroth.

92675.title: Lorewalking: The Weight of Doubt
92675.objectives: Talk with Cho about Thrall's actions against Sylvanas.
92675.description:
After Garrosh's death, Thrall found himself doubting his abilities. And so he made a choice - his new path would be his family.

They retreated back into Outland, where his ancestors once lived, and found personal peace. All the while, Azeroth was facing a new war - one that could burn everything he had once fought for to the ground.

92676.title: Lorewalking: In Another's Footsteps
92676.objectives: Speak with Cho about the Shadowlands.
92676.description:
Thrall was at a crossroads, stuck between what he once was and what he should be.

And his hesitation affected more than just his mental state. The elements he once commanded effortlessly barely whispered a response to his call. The hero was held down by his own perception of the past.

But an answer that helped him push forward would come - amusingly, from the same past that haunted him.

92677.title: Lorewalking: Paths Ever Onward
92677.objectives: Close out the story with Cho.
92677.description:
We have just about reached the end of my tale, despite Thrall's story continuing.

It is hard to tell a story that hasn't been finished yet.

But I have no doubt we will continue to see great things from Thrall. Warchief, shaman, hero of Azeroth, Go'el. May he forge forward with all of his names in pride.

92711.title: Ignite the Skies: Stormwind
92711.description:
Welcome to the Midsummer Festival of Fire, friend!

Have you come to toss a few torches? Or maybe dance around the maypole?

Ah, you must be here to ignite the blossom lights over the skies of Stormwind, aren't you? It is an old tradition, long forgotten but newly rekindled!

Well, come on then. Take to the skies and fly!
92711.completion:
It warms me to see the blossoms take to the sky once more.

Stormwind is not the only place you'll see this tradition taking place, of course.

All over the Eastern Kingdoms, blossom lights are floating upwards, waiting to be ignited!

Care for another flight?

92821.title: Ignite the Skies: Silvermoon
92821.description:
The season of Midsummer is celebrated by many cultures across Azeroth.

Even now, bonfires across the land are ignited in honor of the spirits of fire.

To share our customs with all who dwell under the sun's warmth, I've had crates of sun blossoms brought to Silvermoon.

Take to the skies and ignite the blossoms above, {NAME}!
92821.completion:
The citizens of Silvermoon were quite enthused by your aerial display over the city.

Even the dragonhawks seemed to enjoy the glow of the blossoms overhead.

Thank you for bringing joy to so many during this summer festival.

The spirits of fire and An'she himself will be pleased.

92826.title: Lorewalking: The Loa of Kings
92826.objectives: Follow Li Li's guidance to learn about the loa.
92826.description:
Where to begin? There's so much to say!

There's a great story from the Zandalari about the connection between troll and loa. Let's start there!
92826.completion: With Rezan defeated, King Rastakhan was in big trouble. He was wounded far deeper than any physical strike, as his connection to health and longevity were both ripped away.

92829.title: Lorewalking: Death of the Drakkari Loa
92829.objectives: Follow Li Li's guidance to learn about the Drakkari.
92829.description:
The Drakkari of Zul'Drak are well known for massacring their loa. The prophets of the Drakkari loa decided to take the full power of the loa by force.

The loa were blind-sided by this betrayal. They never dreamed rituals existed that could permanently kill them and steal their essence.
92829.completion: The Drakkari empire crumbled after Gundrak fell. It couldn't recover from the turn into darkness and the aftermath that followed.

92831.title: Lorewalking: The Blood Loa
92831.objectives: Follow Li Li's guidance to learn about Hakkar.
92831.description:
Not every loa is a protector and companion to trolls. There are loa that eat their followers, like the blood loa, Hakkar. In trade for sacrifices, Hakkar grants dark blood powers to his followers. But he always takes more than he gives.

Hakkar the Soulflayer has absorbed so much blood from his cultists that he's become almost a perpetual threat to the world.

92832.title: Lorewalking: The Hash'ey
92832.objectives: Follow Li Li's guidance to learn about Mueh'zala.
92832.description:
The last story I want to share is about the Darkspear trolls... and Mueh'zala.

Mueh'zala is a mighty Loa of Death. Highly manipulative, he puts his plans into motion by using others as his pawns.

He's used a hash'ey in the past. A hash'ey is a troll imbued with the full power of the loa.
92832.completion:
Both loa and troll have tried to force the bond of the hash'ey, but the strongest bonds are when they work together.

There's so much to learn about the loa. I'm still collecting their stories, but this was a good start!

92836.title: Reignite the Skies: Stormwind
92836.description:
Welcome to the Midsummer Festival of Fire, friend! 

Have you come to toss a few torches? Or maybe dance around the maypole?

Ah, you must be here to ignite the blossom lights over the skies of Stormwind, aren't you? It is an old tradition, long forgotten but newly rekindled!

Well, come on then, take to the skies and fly!
92836.completion:
It warms me to see the blossoms take to the sky once more.

Stormwind is not the only place you'll see this tradition taking place, of course.

All over the Eastern Kingdoms, blossom lights are floating upwards, waiting to be ignited!

92839.title: Reignite the Skies: Orgrimmar
92839.description:
Midsummer is a time to reflect on the past and future. As old traditions fade, new traditions are born. 

One old tradition, practiced long ago, involved the offering of sun blossoms to An'she. As summer winds took them upwards, the blossoms would burn bright blue and orange.

But faded traditions need not remain lost.


Will you take to the skies to ignite the sun blossoms and help rekindle this old tradition?
92839.completion:
You have done our festival a great honor.

It has been many generations since the skies above have been filled with Sun blossoms.

But our celebrations need not be restricted to just the skies of Orgrimmar. All of Kalimdor awaits!

92895.title: Hagar's Invitation
92895.objectives: Attend Hagar's meeting at the Den in Harandar.
92895.description:
Hagar has a message she believes the elves and trolls of Azeroth must all hear. She has sent a call to leaders from the elven and troll tribes to come to Harandar.

I have come here to ask the blood elves to join us, but you should be there as well. You have been with us through so much of this.

The Rootways from Silvermoon would be the fastest way.

92897.title: The Preparations Are Complete
92897.objectives: Speak to Orweyna in Silvermoon City.
92897.description:
{NAME},

I bear an important message from Hagar. You are invited to a special meeting in Harandar. Please meet me in Silvermoon to discuss it.

Orweyna

92899.title: History Lesson
92899.objectives: Speak to the other delegates, then check back in with Orweyna.
92899.description:
Hagar requested that we invite to this meeting all of the troll and elven leaders we know.

It was not easy to convince them to come. There are some... past grievances between these groups. Hagar hopes to overcome these divisions.

As we wait for the others to arrive, feel free to speak to the other delegates. The wait is making them restless, so try not to inflame tensions.

92900.title: A Favor for Kinduru
92900.objectives: Meet up with Zul'jan, Kinduru, and Orweyna in Harandar.
92900.description:
Zul'jarra could not leave Zul'Aman as the Amani still recover. She sent Zul'jan in her stead.

She hoped showing trust and giving him dis responsibility would bring him out of her shadow. Make use of his talents. But dis news...

I am an old troll. I have a hard time reining Zul'jan in, but he may listen to you.

Would you join us? Zul'jarra and I would be grateful if Zul'jan stayed out of trouble.

92901.title: Revisionist History
92901.objectives: Experience the Amani vision in the Den of Echoes.
92901.description:
Not all of the visions in this place were clear to us. Some of them were... strange.

One in particular seemed to revolve around an unfamiliar people: a people that we learned are the Amani trolls.

The magic used to create the painting, to pull the memories from the past, are tied to the haranir and those close to us. If there was no connection, the Zur'ashar--who create the paintings--could not have recalled troll history.

I can show you and Zul'jan, and you can judge for yourselves.

92904.title: Return to Zul'Aman
92904.objectives: Return to Zul'Aman with Zul'jan and Loa Speaker Kinduru.
92904.description:
I have heard de story since I was a child! De Amani were outnumbered and still dey fought on! Dey claimed victory through sheer will!

Orweyna says de visions cannot lie. Uncle thinks details of de battle could have been lost. Dey would question everything it means to be Amani.

<Zul'jan scowls.>

I must find de truth of dis. Uncle says if anyone would know, it would be de loa. De loa have said nothing of dis before, but we must start somewhere.

It's time to go home.

92907.title: Amani Answers
92907.objectives: Help Zul'jan search through the boxes for information about Ula'tek.
92907.description:
My uncle has already started communin' with de loa to find information on dis Ula'tek. Meanwhile, we gonna dig through his boxes to see what we can find.

<Zul'jan points to all the boxes scattered around the terrace.>

My uncle has de biggest collection of histories among de Amani. I used to read through dem when I was a boy.

Look for anything about Ula'tek, snakes, or early Amani history. I'll take these, you search de others.

92951.title: Digging Deeper
92951.objectives: Collect 8 Vilebranch Scrolls from Maisara Deeps.
92951.description:
De mask says we are lookin' for de scrolls of Malacrass. While we are in Maisara, try to find any scrolls de Vilebranch have left around.

Maisara is a dangerous place, so don't bother sortin' through dem--just grab 'em and we can check later.

Even if dey don't mention Ula'tek, we might find information about their plans or intentions against de Amani.

92952.title: Mission to Maisara
92952.objectives: Meet the Befuddled Amani Mask outside Maisara Deeps.
92952.description:
De magic helped, but... not enough. I still don't remember my name or past life. Dat knowledge may be lost forever...

I do remember more about Ula'tek--or rather, where we might find more information!

I was forced into dis form by de Vilebranch trolls. Dey kept dark knowledge secret from de other tribes, includin' knowledge of Ula'tek.

If we are to know more, we must go to de Maisara Deeps.

92953.title: Memories of Malacrass
92953.objectives: Eliminate the Vilebranch Hex Masters and interrogate their spirits.
92953.description:
While I was a servant of de Vilebranch, I remember discussions about Malacrass's research into Ula'tek.

Malacrass recorded his knowledge in scrolls that he kept with him. Now that he's dead, we need to find out what happened to dem.

De Vilebranch hex masters won't talk willingly... but if you slay dem, I can use their own necromantic magic against dem to compel dem to speak.

92955.title: The Tablets of Numazon
92955.description:
De ancestors did not bow to a loa--dey claimed a weapon! A weapon dat led to our victory.

I must know more.

You said de tablets at Numazon are de oldest in Zul'Aman. We can continue de search there. Perhaps de ancient Amani left behind clues for us.

Uncle says we should bring de mask. A stray memory might be de key to unlocking dis mystery.

92957.title: There's the Rub
92957.objectives: Take 6 rubbings of the Ancient Amani Tablets within Numazon.
92957.description:
If de tablets were made when de Amani first arrived in Zul'Aman, den there must be some clue about Ula'tek here.

De tablets are too heavy to carry, so Uncle suggested dat we take rubbings of de inscriptions.

I scouted ahead and gathered a few, but I ran into de Vilebranch. I came back here to make sure Uncle was safe.

Enter Numazon and collect more of de rubbings while I watch over Uncle. Watch out for de Vilebranch.

92958.title: Brain Drain
92958.objectives: Collect 6 Vilebranch Hex Fetishes from the Vilebranch trolls in Numazon.
92958.description:
I wish I could be more help but... de gaps in my memory. Due to de damage de mask has sustained, dat magic has leaked out for who knows how long.

You repaired de physical parts of de mask, but de magic within is still weak.

Zul'jan says Vilebranch trolls occupy this crypt. De magic dat binds me together is like de magic they use.

You might be able to help. Retrieve their hex fetishes--I should be able to drain the magic from them.

93010.title: The Serpent Shrine
93010.objectives: Meet Zul'jan at the Warlord's Stair within Atal'Aman.
93010.description:
Here! De note says Ula'tek was sealed away by de Amani. To break de seal, one needs a "key."

<Zul'jan flips through the notes.>

De key was hidden within a shrine and protected with ancient magic. But which shrine... 

<Zul'jan looks up.>

Didn't de tablets at Numazon mention a shrine bein' "dedicated to de serpent's victory?" We know from de visions in Harandar dat Ula'tek was a serpent. 

Dat must be it! De key is hidden at de serpent shrine in Atal'Aman!

93011.title: Legacy of the Amani
93011.objectives: Protect Zul'jan as he dismantles the serpent shrine.
93011.description:
If Malacrass was right, de key to Ula'tek should be right here.

<Zul'jan's heavy hammer thumps onto the shrine for emphasis.>

It may take me some time to break through de stone to find it.

I don't know what kind of protection de ancestors have in place, but you will have to deal with dem while I work.

I admit, I did not believe de visions in Harandar. I don't fully trust Malacrass's notes either.

But if de key is here, dat would be undeniable proof dat what we are chasing is real.

93012.title: Dead End
93012.objectives: Speak to Zul'jarra at Amani'Zar Village.
93012.description:
After the meeting in Harandar, I came here to speak with Zul'jarra about the vision you witnessed. Zul'jan had seemed upset when you left and it was not my intent to make him so.

But all of that can wait. Now that you're awake, you should go speak to Zul'jarra. She wants to know what happened at Atal'Aman.

93495.title: A Soaring Journey Through Time
93495.description:
The sands of time flow back and forth like ocean waves.

Journey once more through the timeways, to the time of Dragon Aspects and Primal Incarnates.

Bring me tales of victory in an era of great adventure and danger.

93852.title: Lost Iridescent Flightstone
93852.objectives: Bring the Lost Iridescent Flightstone to Xydan in Valdrakken.
93852.description:
The flightstone glimmers with the colors of all aspects. Within the glittering light you have visions of noble dragon houses locked in battle against Primal Incarnates. A vicious cacophony of roars as Shadowflame consumes swaths of land. And the soothing sounds of nature as a world tree blooms.

The soaring skies of Valdrakken call.

96049.title: Stalkers of the Stars
96049.objectives: Recruit Belath and his Illidari in Murder Row for Maella's expedition.
96049.description:
With the help of Belath Dawnblade and Decimus, we've learned our enemies orchestrate their attacks from former Legion worlds.

I've requested the demon hunter's aid in navigating these worlds and fortifying our defenses.

Seek them out and lend them any assistance they need. Inform Belath we mobilize soon.
96049.progress:
I've come to learn much about demon hunters recently. 

Allari the Soul Eater has overseen the training of Leona Darkstrider and other ren'dorei following her path.

I've seen how they fight... how they hunt. This and their expertise with Legion worlds will be critical in this mission.
96049.completion:
So, Leona is joining us?

Good. I had hoped to see her in the field.

Allari and Belath's knowledge of Legion worlds will help us navigate the terrain when we arrive... wherever it is our enemies are holed up.

Let's just hope our enemies are inhabiting a world the demon hunters have information on.

96051.title: Through the Cold Rift
96051.objectives: Take up the Cynosure of Twilight and open the Rift.
96051.description:
The Legion keystone and the dark particles you found gave us a needle in the endless, vast haystack of the Twisting Nether.

With the Cynosure of Twilight, the artifact used to open the way to the Voidstorm, we can thread this needle and open a rift to our enemy's doorstep.

With the components in place, my riftwardens stand at the ready.

Take up the Cynosure and point and be ready, {NAME}.
96051.completion:
<Maella shields herself from the cold gust of howling wind.>

Our location is convenient but the weather is not.

At least this area is clear. We can break ground here.

While Y'mera works to bring in the remainder of our forces and supplies, let's gather our bearings.

96052.title: Through the Mana Rift
96052.objectives: Take up the Cynosure of Twilight and open the Rift.
96052.description:
The energy from the Hal'hadar battery core and dark particles allowed us to piece together a faint trail of nether energy.

With the Cynosure of Twilight, we can illuminate and ignite this trail, taking us directly to our enemy's doorstep.

The anchors are in place and my riftwalkers await your move.

Take up the Cynosure and point. Let us see what awaits us on the other side.
96052.completion:
<Maella squints, her eyes narrowing at the heavy fog and plumes of arcane energy in the distance.>

This is definitely the right place. I can smell the stench of burning mana from here.

Our landing spot has given us a place to carve out a holdout for our forces.

While Y'mera transports the rest of our forces, let's gather our bearings and see what awaits us on this world.

96053.title: Surveying the Frozen Wastes
96053.objectives: Meet with the Scouts in the field and activate the Surveillance Beacons.
96053.description:
We still hold the element of surprise, which gives us a moment to fortify our position.

While Y'mera opens a more stable travel network for the rest of our forces, our scouts have gone ahead to survey the terrain.

Meet with them in the field and activate our surveillance beacons.

I will remain here to cover the arrival of our reinforcements.
96053.progress:
Imperator Pertinax's fortress spans deep under the ice. 

It would seem his forces are not recent arrivals on this hellscape.
96053.completion:
These beacons will allow us to observe our enemies closely and keep tabs on threats around the region.

After all, not everyone on our strike team is blessed with spectral sight like mine.

Now that we've got eyes on the enemy, we have a new opportunity to sow chaos across this wretched wasteland.

96054.title: Surveying the Mana-Bog
96054.objectives: Gather Scouting Reports from Baraat, Belath, and Tala'saan.
96054.description:
Our sudden arrival allows us a brief moment to fortify our hold here.

While Y'mera works on bringing the rest of our forces through a more stable network, our scouts have gone ahead to survey the terrain and the enemy.

Meet with them in the field and activate our surveillance beacons.

I will remain here with Y'mera and Decimus should any of those skiffs overhead decide to pay us a visit.
96054.progress: Our enemy has fortified their position here, {NAME}. This won't be a quick operation.
96054.completion:
These cloaked beacons allow us to observe our enemies from afar and keep tabs on their movements.

They're not as effective as real scouts, but they'll do for now.

Now, let's see how well organized they are.

Knowing the Hal'hadar, they likely presume they are safe and out of reach from any threat.

A mistake they will regret in time.

96224.title: The Magisters' Conundrum
96224.objectives: Join Magister Umbric and Grand Magister Rommath in Magisters' Terrace.
96224.description:
Magisters' Terrace is home to many mysterious artifacts.

Among them is a relic once central to our pursuit of magical knowledge. A few years ago, the relic fell into a state of dormancy.

After the Dawnwell reignited, this artifact began to stir. Upon returning it to the Lycaneum for study, the relic unleashed chaos upon the library.

I believe your unique expertise may be helpful in quelling this chaos.
96224.completion:
<Rommath eyes you up and down for a moment.>

So, you're the outside help Magister Umbric summoned, are you? So be it.

You may very well be the first member of the Alliance to look upon the Sunstrider Omnium... even if it's seen better days.

Years of dormancy and silence before suddenly awakening in a fit of arcane chaos.

There is much to do and many questions to answer.

96225.title: The Magisters' Conundrum
96225.objectives: Join Magister Umbric and Grand Magister Rommath in Magisters' Terrace.
96225.description:
For the last few decades, a dormant artifact laid beneath the halls of Magisters' Terrace.

Once serving as a beacon of knowledge to the Magisters, the artifact abruptly fell silent some decades ago.

After the Dawnwell's rebirth, the artifact reawakened. When we returned it to the Lycaneum for study, it unleashed chaos upon the library.

Your assistance, and discretion, would be most appreciated.
96225.completion:
Ah, {NAME}. It seems the Grand Magister has become predictable with his choice of help. Very good.

Before you stands the Sunstrider Omnium. A once-silent, lifeless artifact for the last two decades... before its abrupt awakening not long ago.

The chaos it has unleashed poses a threat to all of Magisters' Terrace and perhaps beyond.

With your help, perhaps we can contain it.

96226.title: Omnium Anomalies
96226.objectives: Confront the Arcane Anomalies around the Lycaneum.
96226.description:
Shortly after the Omnium awoke, it began manifesting arcane anomalies around the Lycaneum.

We believe these anomalies to be malfunctioning security protocols--the hostile projections they conjure can be quite lethal.

If we do not dispatch them quickly, they will continue to manifest.

As you deal with them, keep an eye out for anything peculiar that can help us understand the Omnium's current state.
96226.progress:
These arcane anomalies are appearing all over the Terrace but thankfully, we've contained most of them.

Do be careful, {NAME}. The ones here in the Lycaneum appear to be the most volatile.
96226.completion:
The anomalies projected an image of Dar'Khan? Are you sure?

We knew that traitor came to the Magisters' Terrace to slaughter the convocation before disarming the Sunwell.

There was never any indication he damaged the Omnium. Not a mark, or scar on it.

Perhaps Dar'Khan's damage was caused before Anasterian fell, resulting in the Omnium's abrupt silence...

96227.title: Lycaneum Chaos
96227.objectives: Quell the arcane-induced chaos in the Lycaneum.
96227.description:
When the Omnium began to stir in its vault, we thought to move it here for observation. Evidently, this was a bad idea.

The arcane magics seeping out are causing chaos.

Folios casting all sorts of incomplete spells, arcane sparks running amok--even the candle flames have sprung to life!

But we cannot simply destroy them, as the magics here are too volatile. I have procured a ward-lance from the arsenal of the spellbreakers. It will dispel the volatile magic.

Here, take it. And do be careful.
96227.progress: If one more folio explodes in my face, I may just torch every flying tome in this place.
96227.completion:
<Rommath exhales a sigh of relief.>

The chaos may seem silly and the incantations harmless, but be reassured that if we hadn't contained it to the library, the entire building would be an academic uproar.

For the sake of all the Magisters here, I thank you.

96228.title: The Shadowed Spire
96228.objectives: Meet up with Umbric at Dawnstar Spire.
96228.description:
Time and time again, Dar'Khan continues to haunt us in some form.

To think the Omnium also fell prey to his madness...

If he really severed the Void Magicule from the Omnium, then I have no doubt he would have hidden it well.

I have a suspicion I know where to start looking.

Meet me at Dawnstar Spire in Eversong Woods.
96228.progress: To think that amidst the slaughter and bloodshed he unleashed that day, Dar'Khan took to desecrating an artifact even he sought to study...
96228.completion:
With the anchors connected and stabilized, I can safely attune to the faint pulse we feel around us.

With enough luck, the void will reveal exactly where this pulse originates from.

And knowing Dar'Khan, there is no doubt he left some sort of secondary ward or protective measure in place.

Ready yourself, {NAME}.

96229.title: The Void Reveals
96229.description:
After reclaiming Silvermoon, the Magisters torched Dar'Khan's personal study and dwellings within the city walls.

I had thought I had found everything I needed the first time I searched this place, but now...

It seems that Dar'Khan left some secrets.

This portal will take us to them. I do not know what we will find on the other side. Be on your guard.
96229.progress: I had thought every possible secret had been scoured from this cursed place. Leave it to Dar'Khan to conceal one last grim discovery for us...
96229.completion:
<Umbric examines the Void Magicule in his palm, his lip curled slightly.>

There was a time when I would've rejoiced finding this relic... a time where I longed to peer into the secrets locked away within.

But knowing Dar'Khan recovered it while slaughtering the convocation of Silvermoon?

A grim discovery, as are most things when it comes to that monster.

96230.title: Unraveling the Wards
96230.objectives: Meet Grand Magister Rommath at his study on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
96230.description:
The Magicules, the orbs you see on the relic, were never meant to be severed from the Omnium. By tearing one out, Dar'Khan likely sent the artifact into a frenzied state before it shut down. 

Even if the Void Magicule is restored, the Omnium will need recalibrating. We will need Belo'vir's key-cipher, now my key-cipher, to do this.

I will meet you at my study and we can recover it.
96230.progress: Leave it to Belo'vir Salonar to flaunt his mastery over the arcane one last time...
96230.completion:
Belo'vir Salonar's mastery over the mirror image spell was known by many. His arcane thesis on 'Mirror Triplication' led to his first contribution into the Omnium's Arcane Magicule. 

It was also his favorite spell to prank his apprentices with. I can't help but wonder if he knew how unamused I'd be at this attempt at one last joke.

Regardless, excellent work. One last ward to go.

96231.title: The Grand Magister's Key-Cipher
96231.objectives: Assist Grand Magister Rommath in unraveling Belo'vir's final safeguard.
96231.description:
After Belo'vir's death, I contemplated opening this vault. I talked myself out of it.

A key for a shattered lock serves no purpose.

And yet, even as Kael'thas tried to open it with his key, I couldn't help but wonder...

It doesn't matter, {NAME}. I am nearly done with the master ward on the upper floor. Meet me there.

No doubt, Belo'vir took extra steps to safeguard his vault.
96231.completion:
When I was an apprentice, Belo'vir gave a lecture on the Omnium's key-ciphers.

To protect the keys, each cipher took on the form known only to its owner.

Kael'thas had his key, now lost, and Belo'vir had his... sealed away in his vault.

I wonder what shape Kael'thas used for his.

<Rommath trails off as he stares at the key in his palm, its shifting image making it impossible to decipher.>

96232.title: Return to the Omnium
96232.objectives: Return to the Sunstrider Omnium in the Magisters' Terrace.
96232.description:
Well, now that we've recovered the piece Dar'Khan stole, we are one step closer to restoring the Omnium.

Hopefully your endeavor with Rommath was a little less troublesome?

When you're ready, return to the Magisters' Terrace. I will clean up anything left behind here and join you shortly.
96232.progress: Without the missing lattice and the key-cipher, the Omnium will continue to spiral out of control.
96232.completion:
I suppose we should be thankful that Dar'Khan decided to bury so many of his secrets within that accursed place.

I shudder to think what might have happened had he hid the Void Magicule within Deathholme and allowed it to fall into the hands of the Scourge or the Twilight's Blade.

Only one task yet remains, {NAME}.

96233.title: The Omnium Reawakens
96233.objectives: Speak with Grand Magister Rommath to begin.
96233.description:
For years, as Silvermoon and its people changed, this relic sat in a vault beneath the Terrace, unresponsive and dormant.

We may never truly understand why the relic fell silent when it did or why it refused the prince's call, but perhaps in time, we might.

Let us hope the missing Magicule and the key-cipher will be enough to restore it.

Are you ready, {NAME}?
96233.completion:
Most Magisters--myself included-- had simply given up hope we would ever see it restored.

Was it the Void's assault on the Sunwell that stirred it? Or the Dawnwell? Perhaps we'll never know.

What I do know is that we stand in its presence thanks to you, {NAME}.

Normally I'd bid you farewell with a handsome reward, but perhaps there is more you can help us with.

With, of course, an even greater reward...

96238.title: Return to the Omnium
96238.objectives: Return to the Sunstrider Omnium in the Magisters' Terrace.
96238.description:
With Belo'vir's key-cipher recovered and Umbric in possession of the Void Magicule, we should return to the Lycaneum.

Hopefully we have all that we need to recalibrate the Sunstrider Omnium.

I will meet you back in the Magisters' Terrace when I am done here.
96238.completion:
When I took up the mantle of Grand Magister, there was much to account for in such a chaotic time.

The Key-Cipher I inherited seemed unimportant at the time, especially when the Prince's own key was ineffective.

I pray that whatever interfered with the Sunstrider Key-Cipher doesn't interfere today.

We have but one task remaining.

96310.title: Disrupting the Order
96310.objectives: Slay 3 domanaar Umbrawardens and any of their forces around Val.
96310.description:
Great work defeating their forces. Every step we take will keep Azeroth safe.

But usurpers are still trying to seize control. Baraat has already spotted high ranking domanaar looking at the remaining resources.

We need to defeat the Umbrawardens and any of their forces along the way.
96310.progress: We will not allow them to regain their foothold.
96310.completion:
With their forces hindered and leaders slain, this base is further degraded. 

Great work, {NAME}.

96338.title: Port of Entry
96338.objectives: Travel to the Transit Platform and destroy the primary transport portal.
96338.description:
{NAME}, take a look at that platform above. What do you think they use that for?

The void creatures steal wildlife from Azeroth and move them here to be broken, then added to their forces. That platform must be where creatures are first brought in.

Let's force our way through any defenses up there and destroy that portal!
96338.progress: Their supply chain must be severed. If we can do that, we may be able to end the threat here for good.
96338.completion: The domanaar operation has been severely stifled, but we will find no peace while these wicked creatures persist.

96382.title: A New Approach
96382.objectives: Observe the new domanaar Umbrawardens and select a proper candidate for the plan.
96382.description:
For this threat, you'll need to think more like the domanaar. Luckily, I can do just that.

What we need is a puppet. Someone we can give the reins who has no aspirations for your precious Azeroth. Those new domanaar you saw will need evaluation.

Take this veil. You'll be able to blend in and observe them. I understand your urge to strike, but be patient. The time will come to eliminate all in your path, as your kind seems to enjoy.

See if you can find a proper candidate.

96389.title: A Place to Negotiate
96389.objectives: Meet with Leona Darkstrider in the Steam Ravine.
96389.description:
While you were attuning the gem to the Void, I managed to acquire one of Impotus's projection devices. 

We're going to use it to lure him to us, then prevent him from escaping with the gem. 

Not here, though. Let us find somewhere more discrete.

96410.title: Seeking Knowledge Week 1 of 5: The Omnium Folio
96410.objectives: Retrieve your Omnium Folio from Grand Magister Rommath and empower your first rune.
96410.description:
Those who sought to learn from the Omnium had to contribute to it.

While most Magisters studied within the Terrace, a select few were appointed as "Seekers of Wisdom."

Seekers would search for new and foreign magic to contribute to the Omnium's vast index for study.

Given your... adventurous experience, I think you'd make an excellent seeker.

If you're interested, the Grand Magister will explain more.
96410.progress: Whether it was magical theories, complicated rune-work, or harvested samples of magic, the Omnium was built to preserve knowledge so that future Magisters could learn, harness, and master the work of those that came before them.
96410.completion:
While we don't expect you to master the very secrets of the void or fire, we have chosen some beneficial runes to assist you in battle.

With each weekly research assignment you contribute, Umbric and I will select another series of runes for your Omnium Folio.

For now, test out your new rune while Umbric and I prepare the next assignment for you.

96440.title: Victory Within Hindsight
96440.objectives: Meet Baraat at the Glacial Reservoir portal.
96440.description:
Great work, {NAME}! I can already picture the walls of the Acropolis crumbling.

In fact, why don't we head there now and press our advantage? The Light can shine through the tiniest of cracks.

I'll scout ahead and meet you on the way there.
96440.completion:
It seems we're back to where we began. 

These covetous monsters won't hesitate to steal whatever power they can find, even from each other. 

We'll need a new plan.

96441.title: Seeking Knowledge Week 2 of 5: Ritualized Arcana
96441.description:
The nature of the Dawnwell has sparked a question among the minds of Magisters' Terrace:

If magic can corrupt and suffuse other magics, how will the Dawnwell affect the ley lines branching out from it?

With inquiry, comes experiment.

The Ritual Sites in Quel'Thalas use the ley lines to fuel their magic.

Disrupt these sites and retrieve samples of the arcana you find.
96441.progress:
We've all been asking what sort of effects the Dawnwell will have on the ley lines of Quel'Thalas.

The byproduct of these ritual sites may indicate just how deep these external magics go.
96441.completion:
It appears Magister Umbric's theory was correct. The rituals have seared the very fabric of the arcana, both overcharging yet depleting it entirely.

Perhaps similar accounts have been recorded within the Omnium.

The Magisters assigned to studying these samples have quite the work cut out for them.

While you wait, take a look at the new runes we've outlined for you.

96442.title: Seeking Knowledge Week 3 of 5: Ley Line Assaults
96442.objectives: Collect 5 Dark-Ley Coalescence by completing any Void Assault in Eversong or Zul'Aman.
96442.description:
Unfortunately, most of the measurable samples were expunged by the Ritual Site's excessive energy.

If we are to accurately measure the various magics seeping into the ley lines, we'll need samples from a broader, less concentrated source.

I am told the Farstriders continue to route the void strikes across Quel'Thalas.

Bring me coalesced ley energy from any of the assaulting forces.

96443.title: Seeking Knowledge Week 4 of 5: Magical Primessence
96443.objectives: Collect 1 Primessence of Magic from any final dungeon or delve boss, Illustrious Contender's Strongbox, or the Sporefall raid.
96443.description:
Thanks to your efforts, we've isolated the effects of trace amounts of foreign magic coalescing with the ley lines.

Our next phase is to compare these results against a pure sample of magic coalescing with the same energy.

Your task is to track down a primessence of magic--be it arcane, Void, Light, or other--and acquire it from its deadly source.

Good luck, {NAME}.

96444.title: Seeking Knowledge Week 5 of 5: Off-World Magic
96444.objectives: Recover 1 fragment of alien magic from either Imperator Pertinax on Val or Nexus-Captain Leth'ir on Naigtal.
96444.description:
Although it made an excellent catalyst, the primessence you retrieved revealed a factor we did not account for.

The alien nature of the Void and ethereal magic used in their assaults proved incompatible with the experiment.

We need a sample of their magic if we are to make any progress--not from the assaults here in Quel'Thalas, but from the source of their attacks.

I am told these enemies strike from off-world staging grounds. Good luck, {NAME}.

96473.title: Imperator Pertinax
96473.objectives: Defeat Imperator Pertinax in the Void Acropolis.
96473.description:
Like all domanaar, Imperator Pertinax sees himself only as a predator and never the prey.

Unfortunately, our prey is well-guarded in his Void Acropolis.

If you manage to gather enough allies and catch the imperator off guard, we'll deal a crushing blow to our enemies.

Move swiftly and cautiously, {NAME}, and ensure you have backup before engaging Pertinax.
96473.progress: Yes, my delightful little mortal? What fascinating news do you have for me?
96473.completion:
The mighty imperator has fallen?

Oh, Pertinax... caught off guard in your own fortress?

How deliciously embarrassing!

You have dealt a considerable blow to a formidable enemy and we've only just arrived! Well done!

There will be more chaos to unleash soon enough...

96475.title: Captivating Science
96475.objectives: Infuse the soul gem with void essence by defeating enemy forces in the Void Acropolis.
96475.description:
The domanaar Impotus sounds like he can be persuaded to set his sights elsewhere. 

Speaking with them directly will be challenging. They are distrustful, even of one another, as you can see from their projection devices. 

We must set a trap.

Take this soul gem and hunt the beings that inhabit the Acropolis. We will use the Void energy of this place against them.

96498.objectives: Thank you for gathering these beautiful moths. Please accept this as thanks.
96498.completion: Thank you for gathering these beautiful moths. Please accept this as thanks.

96510.objectives: Thank you for gathering these beautiful moths. Please accept this as thanks.
96510.completion: Thank you for gathering these beautiful moths. Please accept this as thanks.

96534.title: Preparing for Threats
96534.objectives: Purchase the Ethereal Bandages from Kifaan.
96534.description:
My brother has always been the creative one, his hands busy on some intricate side project or some device he's working on. 

His enthusiasm will benefit this operation greatly, especially when it comes to thwarting the threats we face on this world.

See what he's been working on and give one of his new experiments a trial run.

I'm sure he'll be thrilled at the opportunity to contribute.

96567.title: Data Decryption Disaster
96567.objectives: Recover 3 Decrypted Data Records from the Hal'hadar Data Collators.
96567.description:
To understand the Hal'hadar's intentions with this world, we will need to secure information.

Knowing how they operate, they've restricted their data consoles with security measures in place.

<Y'mera smiles as she hands you a rune-carved crystal.>

This decrypter will automatically navigate their security. If you choose, you can engage the manual option to hasten the protocol.

Just remember to ignore any security warnings. My device can and will bypass it.
96567.progress:
In the past, the Hal'hadar never stayed in one location for long, leaving whatever world they scavenged from just as quickly as they arrived.

For whatever reason, their intent with this world appears to be different.
96567.completion:
One moment, there is much to glean from this data...

<Y'mera murmurs under her breath as she works.>

Interesting. They found a tomb of some kind under the swamp and...

Oh, what's this? Intercepted transcripts!

It seems Leth'ir's attacks on Azeroth were unsanctioned. Hal'hadar leadership is not pleased.

This information is most useful, {NAME}.

Good work.

96568.title: Hal'hadon't You Dare!
96568.description:
Y'mera's plan to intercept their data consoles will no doubt trigger heightened security protocols.

Normally, no-contact reconnaissance would be advised in this situation, but I think sowing chaos will be more beneficial.

The Hal'hadar won't be aware of their stolen data if their entire manaforge is under attack.

Dispatch any Hal'hadar agents you find.
96568.completion:
For every Hal'hadar slain, paranoia grows like a sickness through their ranks.

When distrust and fear is all that remains, their structure weakens and their operation falls.

My scouts will take advantage of the chaos you have created.

Good work, {NAME}.

96569.title: Conductive Crystals
96569.objectives: Collect 6 Energized Crystal Conductors from around Manaforge: Arcvein.
96569.description:
<The glowing rune-marked crystal atop the Hal'hadar's device seems to be siphoning arcane spores out of the air.

Although you're not quite sure what the device is, you get the feeling the crystal isn't quite ethereal in origin.

Y'mera would definitely be interested in examining some of these crystals.>
96569.completion:
How fascinating!

My understanding of draenic might be a bit rusty but I believe these markings along the crystals matrices suggest they are used as a type of self-powered battery!

It seems the Hal'hadar are leveraging new ways to siphon arcane energy from this world!

But where did they get these crystals, I wonder?

Curious find!

96570.title: Technological Transference
96570.objectives: Use the Lightveil Translocator to recover stolen technology from the Hal'hadar.
96570.description:
The Hal'hadar are notorious for looting and stealing technology from any world they descend upon.

Thanks to the intel you helped retrieve, we know they are using the manaforge east of us to experiment on whatever salvage they found.

Take this translocator with you and mark anything that doesn't resemble ethereal technology.

I will transport it back here for further study.

96571.title: The Node Knows
96571.objectives: Recover Logistical Intel from the ethereals at the Eastern Manaforge.
96571.description:
The manaforge to the east serves as both a research site and military compound, making it a valuable target.

Much of their research, including holoprint schematics, lays around the forge.

The Hal'hadar stationed here also carry nodes containing experimental and logistical data.

Take advantage of this accessible intel and bring back what you can find.

96572.title: Malfunctioning Nullframe
96572.objectives: Use Y'mera's Translocator to intercept the Nullframe at the Transit Hub.
96572.description:
<From the runic communicator, you see a projection of a winged mechanical suit piloted by an ethereal. A voice emits from the device:

"Nullframe Soul-Fuse unsuccessful. Deployment from the Nexus Port halted. Troubleshooting in progress."

Whatever weapon the Hal'hadar created seems to be malfunctioning at the Transit Hub.

Intercepting and translocating the weapon back to Y'mera would deprive the ethereals of another weapon.>

96573.title: Soul Lattice Revealed
96573.objectives: Speak with Y'mera about their plan.
96573.description:
It took some work, but we've cracked their ciphers.

The Hal'hadar seek to power their Nullframes using draenei vigilant technology.

The "Soul Lattice" is a heart for the Nullframe using a vigilant's core.

With it, they can bind their unwrapped energy into the core and wear the frame like armor.

The Hal'hadar must not succeed in finishing this prototype.

Y'mera is planning the next move. Speak with her.

96574.title: Cryptside Rendezvous
96574.objectives: Slay 12 Hal'hadar on the Extraction Shores.
96574.description:
The tomb is called Vilaldoun. It means "island of the restful." Its entrance lies on the northern coast.

We know the Hal'hadar have established an extraction site outside the crypt, harvesting the local flora there to fuel their research.

As you approach, you will be met with heavy resistance.

Cut a path through their ranks while we establish a footing inside and meet us within.

96575.title: Cages of the Soul
96575.objectives: Free 15 Draenei Spirits from Ethereal Cages.
96575.description:
Without the tomb's defenses, the souls of the dead were easy targets for the Hal'hadar.

The ethereals intend to use the spirits to fuel the Soul Lattices for the Nullframe.

We must not let that happen.

Take my scepter and use it to repair the defense wards and shatter the energy cages binding the dead.

Once you've finished, regroup with Tala'saan in the lower chambers.

96576.title: Mementos of the Dead
96576.description:
Defiling tombs... harnessing innocent souls as fuel...

The Hal'hadar are no better than demons.

If left unchecked, the ethereals will pilfer every grave and altar down here.

I may bear the title of "Souleater," but it doesn't mean I can't honor the dead in this forgotten place.

Recover the tributes the ethereals have stolen. Bring them to Tala'saan in the lower chamber.

96577.title: The Soul Architect
96577.objectives: Defeat the Null Architect and recover the Soul Lattice Prototype.
96577.description:
The architect leading their operation has found a single vigilant with an intact construct core.

The other vigilants in this chamber appear to be depleted.

If she succeeds in creating the Soul Lattice, the Hal'hadar will possess the means to turn our warframes into new armored bodies for their soldiers.

We must stop her now and recover the Soul Lattice prototype.

96578.title: Cryptic Departure
96578.objectives: Return to the Umbral Base Camp.
96578.description:
Although she escaped, we have denied the architect her prototype... for now.

This Soul Lattice is fractured, but the core within still hums with a faint energy.

Perhaps this vigilant's soul yet remains...

If we hurry, perhaps Veraan and her brother can help stabilize the damage to preserve it.

I will regroup with Y'mera and Allari and meet you back at camp.

96703.title: Veterans of the Great Dark
96703.objectives: Recruit Commander Tala'saan and the Lightforged for Maella's expedition.
96703.description:
When the Hal'hadar attacked, we quickly learned about their history with the Army of the Light.

Commander Tala'saan has been providing us information on these ethereals. His soldiers stand ready to join our cause.

I've requested their expertise in establishing a forward camp for our mission.

Aid them in their preparations and inform the commander we mobilize soon.
96703.progress:
I'll admit, after the events of the Voidspire, I remain cautious about relying on allies so... dedicated to the Light.

But personal reservations aside, I cannot deny their expertise in fighting the void and the Hal'hadar.
96703.completion:
Tala'saan did forewarn me only a few Lightforged could be spared. The attack on the Voidspire left their forces decimated.

Many wounded, many more slain or missing.

Any support we can muster from the Army of the Light will go a long way in this operation.

96708.title: To the Voidstorm and Beyond!
96708.objectives: Meet Maella and the Strike Team at the Howling Ridge in the Voidstorm.
96708.description:
It may not seem like many, but the allies we've secured will have to be enough.

It's time we move out.

Our forces are gathering at the Howling Ridge. The energies of the Voidstorm will allow us to open the way to these worlds.

I will meet you there. There is something here I still require for our mission.
96708.progress: Our enemies will not be expecting our assault. We must strike fast and true.
96708.completion:
This may be an unusual coalition of allies, but each one leverages expertise we can use against our enemies.

Even Decimus cannot deny that.

I've secured the last component we need, the Cynosure of Twilight, to open the rift to where these ethereals and void forces operate from.

Are you ready, {NAME}?

96709.title: The Nexus-Captain (Heroic)
96709.objectives: Defeat Nexus-Captain Leth'ir in Heroic World Tier.

96711.title: Imperator Pertinax (Heroic)
96711.objectives: Defeat Imperator Pertinax in Heroic World Tier.

96713.title: Showdown on Val
96713.objectives: Disrupt the domanaar forces on Val by completing World Quests, slaying rare creatures, completing events, and looting treasures.
96713.description:
Our enemy's hold on Val may be strong, but it is not unbreakable.

For every monstrosity we cut down, we deny them another soldier to use against our world.

Venture out into the frozen landscape and lay waste to their strongholds.

Show them no mercy, {NAME}.
96713.completion:
By disrupting the domanaar's operation, you divert their attention away from Azeroth.

You have my thanks, {NAME}.

96714.description:

96717.title: Showdown on Naigtal
96717.objectives: Disrupt the Hal'hadar on Naigtal by completing World Quests, slaying rare creatures, completing events, and looting treasures.
96717.description:
Now this is quite a strange world, isn't it?

The Hal'hadar must have found something of note.

The stench of forges indicates they are plundering the riches and resources this remote rock has to offer.

If you can disrupt the operations here, you can buy your precious world a moment of respite.

Do what you do best, my little monster.
96717.progress: I trust you bring tales of wanton destruction to share with me?
96717.completion:
My, you have been quite the busy engine of chaos, haven't you?

I always delight in your dramatic tales of... heroism. Take a moment to bask in the glow of the destruction you created.

Don't wander too far now. We are not quite done with this little fungal-world.

96718.title: Showdown on Naigtal (Heroic)
96718.objectives: Disrupt the Hal'hadar on Naigtal by completing World Quests, slaying rare creatures, completing events, and looting treasures.
96718.description:
