96727.title: Midnight: Offworld Showdowns
96727.objectives: Disrupt either the enemy base on Val or Naigtal in Midnight.
96727.description:
Our effort to thwart the Void Assaults in Eversong and Zul'Aman have seen much success, but if we do not find a way to stop our aggressors from coming to our lands, they will bleed us until we can no longer stand.

Riftblade Maella has recently discovered the location of two of our enemies' bases. She seeks to take the fight to them. Will you aid her strike team?

Your efforts will not go unnoticed in these dark times!

96728.title: Ritual Site Studies: Week 1 of 3
96728.objectives: Disrupt two Tier 6 Ritual Sites while the Reinforcements challenge is active.
96728.description:
After you reported thinning out their ranks I got to thinking. 

What do they use to recruit members? Are they just as fanatical as their leaders?

I wonder if we can break their will to fight by destroying a greater number of their ranks. I fear it will take more than one example to know for sure.
96728.completion:
The second ritual was just as protected as the first?

Well, I cannot say I am surprised. Our own people wouldn't be easily deterred and well their leaders are very persuasive. We also have set back the ambitions of these groups again and again.

I will study what you have brought me and have a new assignment for you soon.

96729.title: Ritual Site Studies: Week 2 of 3
96729.objectives: Disrupt two Tier 6 Ritual Sites while the Malevolent Boons challenge is active.
96729.description:
I have your next assignment, {race}. I need you to study the resilience of these malevolent boons and their dark obelisks.

They focus magic so well and the variety of boons is interesting. I need more data though.

When you disrupt the next ritual site I need you to do so with these malevolent boons present.
96729.completion:
This time consistency is in our favor. Well my favor at least. 

Your report fills in a few gaps I had in understanding how the obelisks interact and connect with their forces.

Thank you again, I will prepare a new lesson for you.

96730.title: Ritual Site Studies: Week 3 of 3
96730.objectives: Disrupt two Tier 6 Ritual Sites while the Embers challenge is active.
96730.description:
I think I am on the brink of a big discovery. These latest rituals involve a magic I had not previously heard of in the form of powerful embers that use the energy of their own forces to bolster their leader.

If you disrupt these rituals and report your findings to me, I might be able to put this magic to use for us. Do not look at me that way. On my own demon minions of course. Did you think I meant troops like you?

We are much too early for trials like that. Report back with your findings!

96731.title: Advanced Ritual Site Studies: Week 4 of 6
96731.objectives: Disrupt two Tier 6 Ritual Sites while the Reinforcements and Magic Alarm Bells challenges are active.
96731.description:
I had an idea right after you left. 

We have thinned out their ranks, we have also seen that they can summon additional reinforcements.

I want to test the limits of their reserves.

If you take on this set of challenges, I promise you another key for the vault.

96732.title: Advanced Ritual Site Studies: Week 5 of 6
96732.objectives: Disrupt two Tier 6 Ritual Sites while the Malevolent Boons and Patrols challenges are active.
96732.description:
Now that we have tested their troop reserves, our focus will be the dark obelisks and these boons they give.

This requires close scrutiny and will surely entail you facing increased patrols while you explore the site. Not too difficult for someone like yourself.

Just avoid them... or deal with them if you must.

96744.title: Bouncy Mushrooms
96744.objectives: Gather Canopy Specimens from creatures on and around the tops of giant mushrooms. Bring them to Kifaan in Naigtal Outpost.
96744.description:
Hello! Here's a trick to help you bounce on the purple mushrooms around here. You'll need it, because...

I want some canopy specimens from the sporerays above us. Bounce up there, get some specimens, then come back down and I'll teach you how to ALWAYS bounce on those mushrooms.
96744.progress: I need those specimens. Bounce on the mushrooms and look for Sporerays.
96744.completion: Thank you. I'll put these to good use. Now you can jump on those mushrooms all the time.

96745.title: Aerospores
96745.objectives: Pass through the spores floating above the giant mushrooms, then return to Kifaan.
96745.description:
Now, practice using aerospores. They're up there too if you know where to look. Use them to shoot through the air!

You'll need to bounce on mushrooms to get up to the spores and see them. Once you're up there, pass through some aerospores and find out what they do!
96745.completion:
Well done. You did the hard part, now let me tell you the trick to it.

<He tells you the trick to using aerospores.>

96845.title: The Grappler
96845.objectives: Use your Lightforge Hookshot on purple mushrooms and aerospores.
96845.description: You have to try this Lightforge Hookshot! Here, take this loaner one. To learn the ropes, use it on some mushrooms and aerospores around here. Come back and I'll give you a Hookshot for keeps.
96845.progress: Get out there, {NAME}. Grapple onto those mushrooms and aerospores. And don't forget to have fun!
96845.completion: What did you think? Useful here, yes? Here's one for you to keep. Watch yourself out there!

97034.title: Vanquish the Warmonger
97034.objectives: Defeat the void forces within the Void Acropolis to draw out Ignedus, then defeat him and take his armor.
97034.description:
Poor Impotus doesn't seem to believe we can seize control from his nefarious kin. He's tragically unimaginative.

We'll just need to show him an example of our combined strength. Slay that brute of a newcomer, Ignedus. I think his armor would look nice on our new savior.

Ignedus seems to be quite careful in showing his face, but clearly quick to anger. Get in there and make some noise, as you're so comfortable doing. I expect him to respond in kind.

97036.title: Umbral Title Bout
97036.objectives: Travel to the platform via the Glacial Reservoir and defeat Gladius Reginax.
97036.description:
Well then, it seems our goals are more aligned than before. You've impressed me. With Ignedus and Periculus dealt with, all that remains is my former associate.

You will find Gladius Reginax atop that high platform, observing her quarry. She already knows you're coming, so don't aim to surprise her. There's only one way up there for you anyway: through that portal in the Glacial Reservoir.

I will play my part and join you. A symbol of our... collaboration.

97071.title: A Frigid Welcome to Val
97071.objectives: Use the Lightveil Recall Beacon to return to the Umbral Base Camp on Val.
97071.description:
Even with the element of surprise, we are at a disadvantage without allies.

Storming Pertinax's stronghold alone would be a death sentence.

Take this beacon Tala'saan gave us and return to our entry point.

I will meet you there and deliver my report to Maella.

Let us hope we have some sort of shelter awaiting us.
97071.completion:
At least the cold didn't kill you.

Thanks to Y'mera, we have a more stable entry point into this frozen world.

Her beacon also connects back to Silvermoon, giving us a quick evacuation point should we need it.

With the surveillance beacons in place and our foothold established, we can get to work.

Welcome to Val, {NAME}.

97072.title: A Swampy Welcome to Naigtal
97072.objectives: Use the Lightveil Recall Beacon to return to the Umbral Base Camp on Naigtal.
97072.description:
The Nexus-Captain is just over that hill, unaware of our arrival.

Attacking now would catch his army off guard... and likely result in our demise.

No matter what, we will need allies if we are to succeed.

Use this beacon to return to our invasion point.

By now, Y'mera has likely brought in the rest of our forces to support us.

Speak with Maella when you arrive.
97072.completion:
Glad to see the swamp didn't swallow you whole.

Y'mera's efforts have provided a more stable entry point into this world.

Her beacon also connects back to Silvermoon, allowing us a quick fallback point if needed.

With the surveillance beacons in place and our foothold established, we can get to work.

Welcome to Naigtal, {NAME}.

97077.title: A Shot at the Dark
97077.objectives: Interact with the projection device to lure out Impotus.
97077.description:
Now that our trap is attuned, we just need to lure our prey out into the open.

I have strategically... dismantled... certain parts of the projection device I obtained. Impotus should have difficulty seeing and hearing you clearly.

Claim to be one of his allies and demand a meeting at once. We will hope his curiosity gets the better of him.

And then... 

<Leona holds up the void-infused gem, glances at it for a moment, then nods at you.>

97080.title: More Disruptions: Val
97080.objectives: Disrupt the domanaar forces on Val by completing World Quests, Events, or Treasures.
97080.description:
We must not let up the pressure.

Even now they are rebuilding from our attacks.

Venture out again and show them no mercy!
97080.completion: I knew we could rely on you, {NAME}.

97081.title: More Disruptions: Val (Heroic)
97081.objectives: Disrupt the domanaar forces on Val by completing World Quests, Events, or Treasures.
97081.description:
We must not let up the pressure. Even now they are rebuilding from our attacks. 

Venture out again and again show them no mercy!
97081.completion: I knew I could count on you for this task, {NAME}.

97082.title: Dangerous Enemies: Val
97082.objectives: Take out Rare and Elite enemies on Val.
97082.description:
Our scouts have reported seeing dangerous elite creatures that are hampering our efforts. 

I need you to dispatch them so we can continue our primary objective.
97082.completion: I knew I could count on you for this task, {NAME}.

97083.title: Dangerous Enemies: Val (Heroic)
97083.objectives: Take out Rare and Elite enemies on Val.
97083.description:
Our scouts have reported seeing dangerous elite creatures that are hampering our efforts. 

I need you to dispatch them so we can continue our primary objective.
97083.completion: I knew I could count on you for this task, {NAME}.

97084.title: More Disruption: Naigtal
97084.objectives: Disrupt the Hal'hadar on Naigtal by completing World Quests, Events, or Treasures.
97084.description:
The stench of their forges still lingers. This means they are rebuilding. 

You must keep at it if you hope to disrupt their operations enough to end their threat.

Now you can go. Wreak havoc.
97084.completion:
Oh you are back, was that explosion your doing?

It appears your efforts are taking a toll, the smell of smoke is replacing that wretched smell from their operation.

97085.title: Dangerous Enemies: Naigtal
97085.objectives: Take out Rare and Elite enemies on Naigtal.
97085.description:
I hear your scouts talk of dangerous creatures and foes they have faced. 

It makes me wonder if you could defeat them? Why don't you go and try? It will certainly help your efforts here.

I hope to see you return mostly intact.
97085.completion:
You did it? Oh, I am not surprised. You do seem to be rather lucky.

Maybe in time I will see enough evidence to attribute it to skill. 

Do you not have something else you should be about?

97086.title: Dangerous Enemies: Naigtal (Heroic)
97086.objectives: Take out Rare and Elite enemies on Naigtal.
97086.description:

97087.completion:

It appears your efforts are taking a toll, the smell of smoke is replacing that wretched smell from their operation.

76280.title: New Moon
76280.objectives: Speak with Tyrande Whisperwind in the Central Encampment to begin the ritual.
76280.description:
With these offerings and water from the Well of Eternity, we have all that we need.

Speak with me when you are ready to begin the ritual.
76280.completion: Amirdrassil... at last. It feels as if I have let go of a breath I did not realize I was holding. {NAME}, I cannot thank you enough for your aid.

76281.title: Something Worth Celebrating
76281.objectives: Serve tables at the celebration in Bel'ameth.
76281.description:
At long last... let us celebrate all that we have overcome, and the hope that burns brightly amongst these gathered kaldorei.

Come, join the festivities.
76281.progress: Have you thoroughly enjoyed yourself, Champion?
76281.completion: So much life and joy resides here beneath these branches. May it always be so.

76282.title: A Disquieting Feeling
76282.objectives: Bring Khadgar a drink in Bel'ameth.
76282.description:
Ah, {NAME}! You're just the person I was looking for. I'm a little concerned about Khadgar. I don't think it's anything dire, but he doesn't seem to be enjoying himself like everyone else--he just seems... distracted. 

I don't want to pry, but perhaps you could bring him a drink for me? He may open up to you.
76282.progress: Were you able to cheer up Khadgar, {NAME}?
76282.completion:
Thank you, friend. I knew he'd speak to you.

Maybe now we can both relax.

76283.title: Andu-falah-dor
76283.description:
My mother asked for us all to meet her by the moonwell.

It has been long enough. We should not keep her waiting.

Speak with me there.
76283.completion:
As Amirdrassil blooms into Azeroth beyond the Dream, my sister takes on the mantle of a new Aspect.

<Alexstrasza glances at where the portal was and smiles.>

And you, {NAME}, have drawn all these events to a happy conclusion.

76284.title: Work It
76284.description:
The Trial of Style gives us the opportunity to look good, {class}.

The camera makes sure we keep looking good. 

So focus on me and my camera, follow my directions and I'll make sure you look fantastic!
76284.progress:
Focus on me and follow my directions. 

I'll make sure you look great.
76284.completion:
The camera doesn't lie, {NAME}. 

You are one stylish {class}.

76290.title: Omarion's Second Handbook
76290.objectives: Return the handbook to Master Craftsman Omarion at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
76290.description:
Wilhelm,

If you are reading this, the first adventurer I sent to you has perished. As have I, finally. I want you to know that my dying thoughts revolved around you and your ineptitude in tradeskills.

About the book: These are the rest of my recipes. Please share them with someone more capable. Alas, I am sure you will keep them for yourself and charge a hefty fee for your services because you are, after all, a bastard.

In Disdain,
Omarion
76290.completion:
Ah. My book of recipes, sans all the recipes.

<Omarion opens the book, flips its single page, and promptly closes it again.>

I hope you're interested in learning how to stitch cloaks.

76308.title: The Trial of Style
76308.description:
Well, that's certainly an... interesting look, {class}.

Me? Judgmental? Certainly not. However, I'm curious what others would think of it.

You should speak to the Transmogrifier over there and enter the Trial of Style.

We'll see what public opinion says about your choice in garb.
76308.progress:
Ugh, I'm so bored.

Did you complete the Trial of Style yet?
76308.completion:
That's mildly impressive.

Mildly.

Off with you now. I'm tired of looking at you.

76317.title: Call of the Dream
76317.objectives: Meet Merithra within the Ancient Bough in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
76317.description:
A great tree grows within the Dream. Soon, it will emerge in Azeroth.

But before it does, we must protect it from Fyrakk's forces. We must band together and see it through its verdant birth.

Join me and the others in the Ancient Bough. Together, we will travel into the Emerald Dream.
76317.completion:
Not so long ago, the World Tree was planted within the Emerald Dream. There, we have kept it safe.

Now our enemies have found their own way into the Dream. We must unite and protect it. The tree has so much promise... and potential.

76318.title: Emerald Welcome
76318.objectives: Enter the Emerald Dream through the portal in Ancient Bough.
76318.description:
We protected the tree by guarding all entrances to the Emerald Dream. Now Fyrakk has found allies to open the way for him.

I will do the same for you and our allies. The green dragonflight cannot do this alone.

Through this portal, we will enter the Dream together. We must protect that realm and all that grows within it.
76318.progress: There is much to be done.
76318.completion: Fyrakk's power threatens the fabric of the Dream. We must hurry to save the realm. This drake will aid you.

76319.title: Feast or Flaming
76319.objectives: Dragonride or ride the Faerie Drake to consume fiery patches in the Dream.
76319.description:
Already Fyrakk damages the fabric of the Dream. I can feel it burning, as if flames were consuming my scales.

And I know that simmering agony is only a fraction of what my son felt when Fyrakk tormented him. 

But we have a potent weapon against this fire. Our faerie drakes and dragons consume what does not belong here. They are excellent allies, if a bit difficult to manage.

Now they need our help. Use this. Clear the skies of encroaching flame.
76319.progress: The Dream is my home and the home of my flight. I will not let it fall to fire.
76319.completion: Fyrakk may attack the tree at any moment. We will need the help of the other Wild Gods.

76320.title: Wild Gods in Our Midst
76320.objectives: Seek out Wild Gods and allies within the Emerald Dream.
76320.description:
The Emerald Dream is the home of nature's Wild Gods. We will need their strength and their power to counteract the damage that Fyrakk has brought to this realm.

The first to seek out is Goldrinn. The ancient wolf has a fondness for Azeroth and mortals, so he is sure to aid us.

Others may need more convincing. 

I will meet you nearby in the Fields of Reverie, where dryads and keepers reside.
76320.completion: We are too late. Fyrakk's forces have already begun their attack on the Dream!

76321.title: Burning Assault
76321.objectives: Slay Primalists, Djaradin, and Druids of the Flame.
76321.description:
The Druids of the Flame are opening a way into the Dream for Fyrakk's forces. Every moment, more of them enter.

We must stop this rising tide before it becomes a flood.
76321.progress: Fyrakk's forces must be cut down before they can establish a hold on the Dream.
76321.completion: You fought well, though I fear there is no stopping these forces now. They may forever reshape the Dream.

76322.title: The Face of Our Enemies
76322.objectives: Defeat Fyrakk's powerful lieutenants and secure the battlefield.
76322.description:
Powerful foes lurk among the enemies Fyrakk summoned into the Emerald Dream.

I have not seen Cassaphine since she came up out of the barrows. 

Find her, and assist our allies by striking down these leaders.
76322.progress: It saddens me to see the children of the Dream so twisted.
76322.completion:
This is far worse than I thought. Every time we close a portal, Druids of the Flame open more.

I fear greater dangers are waiting to come through.

76323.title: Amirdrassil
76323.objectives: Meet Merithra at the base of Amirdrassil.
76323.description:
This tree has grown peacefully in the Emerald Dream since it was planted here. We have watched over it and nurtured it.

And now, just when it is about to leave the cradle of this realm and enter Azeroth, our enemies see it as a means to further their own plans.

It is so much more.

Come. Let us go to Amirdrassil.
76323.completion: We arrived just in time. We must intercept Cassaphine before she can do any harm to the tree... or to us.

76324.title: Lost to the Flame
76324.objectives: Defeat Elder Cassaphine at the base of Amirdrassil.
76324.description:
The Druids of the Flame pose more of a threat than I realized. Not only do they let Fyrakk and his forces pour into the Dream, but they also tempt the Dream's denizens to the flame!

We cannot dwell on how this happened. It pains me greatly, but Elder Cassaphine must be stopped. 

Go with Tyrande and... end the dryad.
76324.completion:
The Emerald Dream is a place of wild nature, magic, and life.

It saddens me to see one of ours come to this end. I hope that she is not the first of many.

Wait... do you hear that?

76325.title: Between Fyrakk and a Hard Place
76325.objectives: Speak to Merithra and prepare for Fyrakk's attack.
76325.description:
I hear approaching wings and smell shadowflame.

Fyrakk is here.

<Merithra's anger is quiet but terrible.>

Gerithus' pain will not go unanswered.
76325.completion:
He left the tree alone?

Does he have another objective?

And why is he listening to that Druid of the Flame?

76326.title: Home in the Dream
76326.objectives: Meet Merithra at the central encampment beneath Amirdrassil.
76326.description:
Fyrakk has withdrawn from Amirdrassil, but that only increases my concern. He must have another target within the Emerald Dream.

We must convene with the others at the base of the tree. Tyrande and the kaldorei have established a camp. 

I need to speak with Alexstrasza to determine our next step.
76326.completion:
Now that we have a moment to breathe, we can begin to think about what we will do next.

And I know that we are stronger with you on our side.

76327.title: Eye of Ysera
76327.objectives: Take the portal from Amirdrassil into the Eye of Ysera.
76327.description:
Galenori's report is deeply troubling.

The Eye's temple is my seat of power here in the Dream. From it, I commune with the Eye's energies and monitor the health of the Dream and its denizens. The Eye's power flows throughout the Dream, and helps Amirdrassil grow.

If the djaradin take control of it, they could pervert its nature and stunt the growth of the tree.

My daughter knows the Eye's importance. I will follow her lead--and so should you.
76327.completion: So, this is Igira's new general? I am not impressed. We will prevail over this monster.

76328.title: A New Brute
76328.objectives: Use The Dreamer's Essence on 5 Emerald Preservers. Then, meet Ysera inside the temple in the Eye of Ysera.
76328.description:
Galok is but another one of Fyrakk's minions. I will not be baited by his bluster.

The fire orb must be his doing. Its magic threatens to overwhelm the Eye. Ysera is channeling a shield from inside the temple, but it doesn't seem to be as effective as we expected.

Now, I must confront Galok. Use my magic to bolster our casters if they weaken. The defense must not fall!
76328.progress: With haste, {NAME}! Our defenders are in pain.

76329.title: In and Out Scout
76329.objectives: Spy on the djaradin leaders in Slagfell Hold.
76329.description:
Bodwin reports that Galok is not the only new threat to the Eye. The djaradin forces below are led by two others--a warrior and a mage.

It is unwise to engage them directly in their own, well-established base. But I am certain they are a part of Galok's plan of attack.

Please gather more information from these djaradin leaders. We need to know how best to counteract their attacks.  Bodwin can grant you stealth so that you may move unseen in the camp.
76329.completion:
<Merithra is very still. Only her eyes betray unspeakable rage.>

We will avenge our kin.

76330.title: Disarm Specialist
76330.objectives: Kill 6 Suffusion Shapers and destroy 8 Suffused Supplies.
76330.description:
Bodwin's scouting sortie returned more key information. The djaradin plan to use suffused weapons to turn the tide of the battle.

We must dispatch their smiths and destroy their weapons. Targeting both will weaken and slow them. Then we will have time to consider our next move.

You will be in great danger on this mission. Take this. 

Throwing it onto enemies will temporarily put them to sleep. Use it so that you may avoid becoming overwhelmed in combat.

Good luck, $p.
76330.progress: Tread carefully, {NAME}. Igira will have your head if you are caught.
76330.completion: That will hamper their forces significantly.

76331.title: Merithra's Gambit
76331.objectives: Tell Ysera to drop the magical defense.
76331.description:
We are ready as we can be. Our guard is in place, and our trap ripe to spring.

The emerald preservers' magic is linked to Ysera's. Upon your signal, they will simultaneously drop the magical defense. This is what Galok's been waiting for. His forces will swoop in like carrion birds.

We await your word, {NAME}.
76331.completion: I must trust her--and myself. It is time to fight.

76332.title: Putting Roots Down
76332.objectives: Plant seeds in 8 Tilled Soil and speak to Kiya Featherpaw. Then, speak with Somnikus.
76332.description:
Our trap is many-layered.

Plant these seeds around town. Our gardeners have already prepared the soil. These plants will be effective tools to poisoning our enemy. Handle them carefully, for some may sprout sooner than later.

Also, Kiya Featherpaw, our umbraclaw keeper, has an idea to mobilize the very strong creatures. Go speak with her.

Finally, meet with Somnikus to give everyone the signal that battle is imminent.
76332.progress:
Our trap will work, I know it.

Make haste, {NAME}. Even with my mother's and my strength...It is like some part of her is holding back her attunement. I dare not dwell on it.

76333.title: Triple Threat
76333.objectives: Slay Galok Wingslicer and his djaradin lieutenants The Anvil and Moltenbinder.
76333.description:
Galok is here. All is going according to plan then.

We will put an end to him and any of his lieutenants.
76333.progress: We may have the stronger ground, but don't underestimate any of them.
76333.completion: We almost have Galok routed. Keep up the pressure!

76334.title: Good Counsel
76334.objectives: Discuss Merithra's plan with the green dragonflight.
76334.description:
Galok is a coward. He refuses to engage us directly until he is sure of success.

We do not have the resources to attack his base. But if we cannot go to him, maybe we can entangle him in our own territory.

I am confident we can prepare a trap here for Galok and his forces. My plan is not without risks, and controlling the playing field will be our key advantage.

The question remains... how do we lure them here?
76334.progress: I must understand everyone's perspectives, especially for a maneuver this big.
76334.completion:
<Merithra solemnly nods at our allies.>

That settles it then. Let us begin preparations.

76335.title: Might of the Forest
76335.objectives: Eliminate the djaradin threat in the Eye of Ysera. Activate traps to help you in battle.
76335.description: Use the traps you have laid to your advantage, {NAME}. Defeat every monster that dares threaten us!
76335.completion: The tides are turning! Push the advantage.

76336.title: Flight and Fight
76336.objectives: Slay 25 Fireswarm Shalewings flying above the Eye of Ysera by striking them with your dragonriding mount.
76336.description:
We have secured the land beneath our feet... now for the skies.

Galok flies from us, but he is weakened. The time to strike is now.

76337.title: The Ember Still Smolders
76337.description:
I... almost cannot believe this worked. I am ever grateful for everyone's trust and faith. We could not have won this battle without the help of our allies and the flight.

But the fight is far from over. Based on the intel we have gathered, Fyrakk and his minions are preparing an even greater assault. Their bases stand strong and terrifyingly close to the Dream's Hope, bastion of Amirdrassil.

The Eye might have only been a distraction. We will regroup at Amirdrassil with the rest of our allies.

76342.title: Light 'Em Up!
76342.objectives: Weaken the Primalist encampment in the Primalist Stronghold.
76342.description:
After Vyranoth left, Fyrakk put all four of the Claws of Vyranoth on different tasks.

He left me in charge of this camp and told me to keep the portals open at all costs. The Druids of the Flame are empowering the portals for the Primalist's reinforcements to come through. 

We should close those portals and thin out their ranks.
76342.progress: The Primalists will only multiply in numbers if we do not hinder them.
76342.completion: Disrupting their forces should protect the Dream for now.

76343.title: Best Laid Plans
76343.objectives: Collect 4 clues in the Primalist Stronghold.
76343.description:
Fyrakk may be brash, but he is not a fool. If we are to save the Dream, we must undermine his plans as quickly as possible.

At their core, the Primalists are unorganized. Infiltrate their camp and search for any clues or information.

The more information we have, the sooner we can take down Fyrakk once and for all.

76344.title: Primalist Directive
76344.objectives: Convince 5 of Terro's Primalists to side with Vyranoth.
76344.description:
Terro was another one of Vyranoth's claws. He never wanted to attack the Dream, and some of the Primalists who served him may feel the same. See if you can convince them to join our side. 

I can put a mark of Vyranoth on you so Terro's troops will not attack you... right away.
76344.progress: Terro never wanted to attack the Dream. It was against his nature.
76344.completion: Terro was always protective of those he commanded. He would have wanted us to save who we can.

76345.title: Finding Terro
76345.objectives: Uncover more information about Fyrakk's plan in the Emerald Dream.
76345.description:
I had no idea my old guard would be willing to return to my side. I am... I am happy to see them. When I chose to go to Alexstrasza, I told no one. I simply left.

But we must learn more about Fyrakk's plan before pursuing personal matters. Let us see what else Buri can tell us.
76345.progress: If we could just find the other Claws...
76345.completion: Vyranoth will not rest until Terro is avenged.

76347.title: Power, Eruption, and Lies
76347.description:
Buri told me that Lethka plans to ignite Cinder Summit, and Vyranoth pursued her.

Lethka revealed herself because she knew that Vyranoth would go after her. The power in Cinder Summit can destroy this barrier, or Vyranoth.

We have to go after them.
76347.completion: I cannot celebrate the loss of a friend, but it had to be done.

76348.title: Big Bright Beautiful Barrier
76348.objectives: Collect 6 Barrier Fragments in the Emerald Dream.
76348.description:
Buri? Vyranoth?

Once she left us at the mercy of Fyrakk, we had no choice but to follow him. I do not know what his plan is, but he ordered me and these Primalists to bring down this barrier.

We have made little progress, but Vyranoth will want us to slow him down.

Some fragments of the barrier have chipped away. If you collect them, we can channel their energy back into the shield.

Can I trust you to undo the damage that I have done?
76348.completion: Thank you for preventing his onslaught.

76350.title: The Chronosmith
76350.objectives: Seek out Ironormu at the forge in Eon's Fringe.
76350.description:
Are you here to aid us? As you can see, the time anomaly around Eon's Fringe has dissipated and there is no shortage of work to be done.

We've called in for help from one our best chronosmiths, a bronze dragon by the name of Ironormu. The problem, amongst all this chaos, is that he's nowhere to be found. He should have been back from setting up his workshop by now.

<Tempo sighs in agitation.>

Can you go find him?
76350.completion:
As you can see, I'm in a bit of a predicament. Not only is me forge sealed with a timelock, it's filled to the brim with fire elementals!

To make things worse, young Finduin here is in DIRE need of a talented chronosmith to repair his blade, Seashellamayne. And I can't exactly do much when me forge is...

<Ironus gestures wildly in frustration.>

I'd be mighty appreciative if you could help me out.

76351.title: Titanic Beasts
76351.objectives: After completing a Time Rift, return to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76351.description:
<This small device rolled out of the mouth of a beast you defeated.

It appears to be a titan information device, but it's more compact than devices you've seen on Azeroth.

Soridormi will want to see this.>
76351.completion:
<Soridormi turns the device over in her hands.>

You said this came from the mouth of a large beast?

Well, I hope the end was quick for its last owner.

I'll put it on one of the tables behind me, in case you want to view it later. Maybe it will be cleaner by then.

76352.title: Chronohammer Time!
76352.objectives: Kill time-displaced creatures and destroy rifts in the Passage of Time to resync Ironus's Chronohammer.
76352.description:
If I'm to repair young Finduin's blade here, then we need to crack open this timelock on me forge. And if a hammer can break a lock, then I'm betting a chronohammer can break a timelock.

Unfortunately, my hammer's a wee bit out of sync. But we're in the prime sort of mishap to fix that. Nearby rifts are tearing into our timeline just outside the Temporal Conflux and out-of-time uglies are pouring through.

Head out of Eon's Fringe, clear the area, and recharge my hammer.
76352.completion:
You found WHAT coming out those time rifts? Well, that ain't good!

I'll be sure to flag Tempo down and let her know. I shudder to think what would happen if we allowed more of those creatures to run rampant into our timeline.

Looks like you handled them nicely, though. I can feel temporal energies radiating off my hammer from here!

76354.title: For the Hoard!
76354.description:
I have a storage vault in the Passage of Time chock-full of chronomatic crates. They contain timelost artifacts from various timelines.

Unfortunately, me safeguard protocols on the vault itself were damaged by those blasted time rifts. I did a quick fly-about and saw those infernal looters scattering my crates everywhere!

Since you're heading that way, can you grab some of my possessions as you go? Not all of them, of course! Just the important stuff.
76354.progress:
I swear by the heat of me forge, if any of those retched looters broke into me crates and took anything, I'm going to...

Well, we bronze dragons have all sorts of techniques, don't we?
76354.completion:
Oh, thank the timeways. You found me stuff!

<Ironus hurriedly examines his possessions.>

To some these relics may seem like rubbish, but to me? They're all treasures.

Oh and don't worry about the rest of the crates. Once these time rifts are dealt with, I'll head on over and get them back in the vault.

76355.title: If a Hammer Can Break a Lock...
76355.objectives: Shatter the time-lock with the Chronoforged Hammer.
76355.description:
Now that the hammer is all charged up, all we need is to take one big swing at the time-lock and BOOM! Nothing breaks a temporally-crafted anomaly like a temporally-charged hammer.

We'd just need to account for a possible sundering of time and...

<Ironus hesitates for a moment as he makes a few calculations under his breath before he looks at you with a not-so-confident smile.>

Tell you what? You earned this! You do the honors.
76355.completion:
Well, that certainly went according to plan, didn't it? Shattered without a blip or quiver in time! I had zero doubts.

Unfortunately, it seems those elementals were a wee bit restless and took off  the first chance they got.

One problem extinguished, a dozen ignited.

76356.title: Sword Stealing Searers
76356.description:
Those grubby forgespawns knocked Finduin right over and took Seashellamayne! They must've sensed the temporal energies lingering on the sword.

Can't imagine what they'd want with it, but there's no time to wait and see.

Everything you've done won't mean much if I don't have Finduin's blade to fix. Could you fetch it for me? After all, the fate of Azmerloth depends on it!
76356.progress:
Like time-moths to the chrono-flame, those wee elementals were drawn to Seashellamayne!

I can only hope the damage done to it is minimal.
76356.completion:
Thank the timeways you retrieved Seashellamayne before those fiery creeps could cause lasting damage! The blade is a bit burnt, but nothing I can't hammer out

Glad you're in one piece as well. A few char marks, I see, but nothing you couldn't handle.

Wear that soot like the badge of pride it is.

76361.title: Fashion Week
76361.description:
Ah, the Trial of Style is upon us, {class}. 

The outfits, the creativity, the elegance of the Trial are truly a sight to see.

Speak to a Trial of Style Envoy to learn more about the event.

A word of warning, those envoys can be... challenging to deal with.
76361.completion:
You really think you're ready for the Trial of Style?

In that?

76362.title: An Antlered Skull
76362.objectives: Bring the Antlered Skull to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76362.description:
<Despite its surroundings, this skull does not appear to be fel-corrupted.

As you move your hand closer, you feel a sense of calm emanating from it. 

Soridormi will want to see this.>
76362.completion:
<Soridormi gingerly raises the skull to eye level.>

You said you found this by a fel-corrupted Illidan?

I assume this is Malfurion.

And we thought their family problems in our timeline were bad.

76379.title: A Murloc and a Dragon Walk into a Time Rift...
76379.objectives: Bring the Azmerlothian Hourglass to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76379.description:
Grurguglg.

Guuglrllghulgrgl grugll gur. Murgllgllrugl guglrllg murgu gruggullgl. Murglgurrrr gurgll Gurlgul, guruuuurllgr gurgull gurgllglrl  .

Argurgulul?

<You aren't certain what's being said. This world's version of Alexstrasza is handing you an hourglass and miming flipping it. It is probably of interest to Soridormi.>
76379.completion:
<Soridormi looks at the hourglass you carry.>

This hourglass is of bronze dragon manufacture. It allows someone to temporarily leap to a different timeway. 

You said that this was given to you by that timeway's iteration of Alexstrasza? 

<Soridormi glances at Alexstrasza.>

Well, this should prove interesting.

<Soridormi turns the hourglass over.>

76384.title: The Bloom Begins
76384.description:
I sense a change on the wind. Like the dawning rays of the sun. Like petals before they unfurl. A great swelling energy, right at the heart of the Emerald Dream.

The Bloom. It has begun.
76384.progress: A bloom so beautiful, yet it brings such dread. Can we truly prevail?
76384.completion:
Amirdrassil is now at its most vulnerable. Whether it shall bloom within Azeroth as a beacon of hope... Or if it shall become a harbinger of doom.

Its fate is ours to protect. And protect it we must.

76385.title: Hazardous Horticulture
76385.objectives: Plant 6 Dream Seeds across Wildfire Canyon.
76385.description:
We may be outnumbered, but this is my domain. And I have a way of evening our odds.

Take this pouch of seeds. Plant them throughout Wildfire Canyon and the Dream's faerie dragons will transform them into treants.

With luck, they will draw attention from our front lines and bolster our ground forces.
76385.progress: Hopefully the faerie dragons are small enough to go unnoticed by Fyrakk's forces.
76385.completion: I did not expect the Prophet of the Flame to join the fray himself. We may have less time than I thought.

76386.title: A Clash of Ice and Fire
76386.objectives: Slay Calderamor, Ignarion, and 15 Wildfire enemies.
76386.description:
The Primalists have erected great flame wards throughout their encampment. Yet we know not why. I have asked our ground forces to investigate, but they are blocked at every turn.

Two fire elementals in particular stand against us, empowered by Fyrakk's shadowflame.

You must clear the area of enemies. I have imbued this scale with my magic. Use it to weaken the elementals and any other who stands in your way.
76386.progress: Even in the heat of battle, the Primalists continue to empower those flame wards. But to what end? We must clear the way so that our forces can investigate.
76386.completion:
I am glad my scale was of use to you. Though I cannot take to the field, I can at least empower you to fight on my behalf.

I will tell our ground forces to begin their investigations. We must find out why those flame wards are being empowered.

76387.title: Defense of the Ancients
76387.objectives: Free the Ancients at Skystone Falls.
76387.description:
Fyrakk's forces at Skystone Falls are already threatening to overwhelm us. I fear not even the combined might of the Sentinels and Ancients can hold out against them.

The Ancients are bearing the brunt of the offensive. We have reports of djaradin attempting to capture them for some unknown purpose.

We cannot allow Igira to succeed in whatever nefarious plan she has in mind. You must seek out the Ancients on the battlefield and free any who are captured.
76387.progress: The Ancients may be few, but they battle fiercely for our cause. Go, {NAME}. Help them.
76387.completion:
Your aid has helped the Ancients stand against the djaradin, but for how long? How many more will be lost before this battle is done?

So much sacrificed for this war. So many fallen. Too many.

76388.title: Fighting Fire With Fire
76388.objectives: Clear out Skyfire Turrets and mark Primalist Flame Wards.
76388.description:
The notes you found, combined with Merithra's reconnaissance, have revealed Ashendir's plan. The flame wards that surround the Wellspring Temple are blocking our reinforcements.

Our allies will distract Fyrakk while you and I slip behind enemy lines to destroy the wards.

The skies are filled with drakes, and I must fend them off. Once you find a flame ward and thin out its defenses, signal me to destroy it.
76388.completion:
Fyrakk may have retreated, but he still aims to destroy the barrier protecting the Wellspring Temple. We must break through the enemy's ranks and stop him.

It is there we will put an end to his machinations, once and for all.

76389.title: The Age of Mortals
76389.objectives: Blow the Horn of Cenarius while next to heroes of Azeroth and slay Fyrakk's forces.
76389.description:
Once again, the mortal races have come together to defend a World Tree. It is only fitting then that we bolster their efforts with a relic from that past battle. The Horn of Cenarius.

I entrust the horn to you, {NAME}. Use it to bestow the blessings of Cenarius to our allies. With luck, it will allow us to break through Fyrakk's forces and open a path to the temple.

And do not forget to lend your strength as well. Every enemy felled is one fewer between us and Fyrakk.
76389.completion: Our allies fight with the blessing of Cenarius! It is only a matter of time until Fyrakk's forces break their ranks and flee before us.

76390.title: Inconvenience Fee
76390.objectives: Zackett Skullsmash in the rafters of Naxxramas has offered to overlook your transgression in exchange for a variety of items.
76390.description:
I have no idea how you managed to find me or what possessed you to douse a dead guy with holy water, but we can both agree that you owe me. That stuff hurts!

Fortunately for you, I like bribes more than my naps. I will happily overlook this horrible first impression you gave so you and I can be best pals; scratch my back and I'll scratch yours.

What do you say?
76390.progress: Hey, that was quick! What did you forget?
76390.completion:
Whoa, look at this haul! You even remembered my coffee. Nobody remembers the coffee...

I like you. We're going to accomplish great things together. By that, I mean you are going to bring me Scourgestones, and I am going to trade you all of the spoils that dungeon delvers of old left behind when they ate dirt. Should have stood back up when they had the chance, like me!

I'll pack my things and meet you in the center ring.

76394.title: Shadows of Flavor
76394.objectives: Collect 10 Shadowblind Grouper, 5 Dark-Nurtured Scallions, and a Vial of Twilight Spice.
76394.description:
I've set out to create a meal that transcends the ordinary, one that even the emperor wouldn't turn away.

I require ingredients from the darkest of shadows to craft this extraordinary meal. Many consider these ingredients forbidden, but they will become a harmony of light and shadow in my hands.

Please assist me by harvesting the following ingredients: Shadowblind Grouper, Dark-Nurtured Scallions, and a Vial of Twilight Spice.
76394.progress: Have you found all of the ingredients?
76394.completion: Now the magic happens. Please sample this creation for yourself.

76395.title: Corruptor's Scourgestones
76395.progress:
I doubt I need to give you the entire spiel about scourgestones, {NAME}, so I will cut to the chase. I am VERY interested in growing my collection, and you are VERY interested in what I have to offer.

Corruptor's Scourgestones are by far the most powerful, so we can talk business if you only have a few.

And don't tell the Argent Dawn about this! It's our little secret, right pal?
Corruptor's Scourgestone (1)
76395.completion:
Another batch of scourgestones from my best buddy, {NAME}! Thanks as always, these will go great with the rest of my hoard. Keep this up, and I will need to find a new place to stash them!

Here's a token for your trouble. I like this little back and forth trading game we got going on here. Let's keep it up.

But no, I am still not telling you what they're for.

76396.title: Invader's Scourgestones
76396.progress:
I doubt I need to give you the entire spiel about scourgestones, {NAME}, so I will cut to the chase. I am VERY interested in growing my collection, and you are VERY interested in what I have to offer.

Invader's Scourgestones are rather common, so I ask you bring a decent haul.

And don't tell the Argent Dawn about this! It's our little secret, right pal?
Invader's Scourgestone (10)
76396.completion:
Another batch of scourgestones from my best buddy, {NAME}! Thanks as always, these will go great with the rest of my hoard. Keep this up, and I will need to find a new place to stash them!

Here's a token for your trouble. I like this little back and forth trading game we got going on here. Let's keep it up.

But no, I am still not telling you what they're for.

76398.title: Aerial Supremacy
76398.objectives: Slay 15 enemy proto-drakes flying above the Field of Flames by striking them with your dragonriding mount.
76398.description:
The dragonflights have arrived. The skies are ours to reclaim! And you shall help us tip the scales.

Mount your drake and target the enemies above. You need only swoop in and take their forces by surprise. Your drake shall handle the rest.
76398.progress: The faster we can take down Fyrakk's aerial forces, the faster we can make our way to the temple and put a stop to this madness.
76398.completion:
Excellent. Fyrakk's forces are reeling from our assault.

Let us dragons handle the rest, {NAME}. This is our Dream, and I will not suffer these invaders any longer.

76401.title: Echo of the Firelands
76401.objectives: Defeat the Prophet of the Flame.
76401.description:
We have finally broken through the enemy's ranks, yet the Prophet of the Flame now bars our path. And he has unleashed his full power.

The Prophet must be defeated if we have any hope of making our way to the temple. I ask you to face him, champion. We shall hold back his forces as you do so.

The end is in sight. Let us finally finish this war.
76401.completion: Fyrakk has broken through the barrier! He must have become desperate once he saw our forces closing in. To use that much shadowflame all at once...

76402.title: Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope: Fyrakk
76402.objectives: Enter Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope, and defeat Fyrakk.
76402.description:
Fyrakk may have entered the temple, but our fight has not ended. Thanks to your efforts, we have broken through his forces. There is still time to stop him.

You must gather your allies and follow Fyrakk into the Wellspring Temple. We will cover your flank.

Know that it is not only Amirdrassil that you protect this day, {NAME}. All of Azeroth will burn if Fyrakk claims the World Tree. He must be stopped, here and now. This is our final stand.
76402.progress:
Once, Fyrakk sought to free dragonkind. He raged a war against us for that very ideal. What drove him to seek domination instead? Was it the need for revenge? The desire for power?

The same fire that burns can also renew. Yet Fyrakk's flames would swallow the whole world.
76402.completion:
Amirdrassil is saved, and with it all of Azeroth. Fyrakk's defeat has ensured that.

From the champion of the Dragon Isles to the savior of the Emerald Dream. All the dragonflights owe you a great debt, {NAME}. And we shall not soon forget it.

76403.title: Mayhem Incarnate
76403.objectives: Speak with Vyranoth near the Primalist encampment.
76403.description:
We need to uncover exactly what Fyrakk's plan is. He is holding his forces away from the tree, but we do not know why.

I can do some scouting, but direct conflict with Fyrakk would not help our cause right now.

Follow me further into the Dream. There is a Primalist encampment to the north. Let us start there, so we can put an end to this madness.

76404.title: Cogs in a Machine
76404.objectives: After completing a Time Rift, return to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76404.description:
<This cog spiraled out of a mechanized creature as you sent it back to its timeway.

While its design is similar to Mechagnome technology, it's sleeker and more refined.

It bears a small inscription.

Soridormi will want to see this.>
76404.progress: Hello again, {NAME}. What do you have there?
76404.completion:
<Soridormi reads the inscription on the cog.>

"Mechanization is the only way to true peace".

An interesting sentiment, but also a lie. This timeway clearly continued to develop weapons for war.

I can't help but wonder: if they weren't fighting each other, what were they fighting?

I'll put this on the tables if you want to look at it later.

76406.title: The Sins of the Ashbringer
76406.objectives: After completing a Time Rift, return to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76406.description:
<As you near this blade, you can feel necromantic power thrumming from it.

Perhaps you should wrap the sword in cloth and avoid touching it directly.

Soridormi will want to see this.>
76406.completion:
<As you hold the item to Soridormi, she leans backwards.>

I do not need to get a closer look at that, thank you very much.

We will put it with the rest of the items. The Ebon Blade can siphon off necromantic energy. That should make it easier to handle.

76407.title: Not Today, Fate
76407.objectives: Enter the Time Rift to witness the past.
76407.description:
Eternus intends to show us what happened. I think she also seeks to change the past.

Normally, I would not entertain this idea, but understanding the infinites is the only way forward.
76407.progress: Eternus has something to show us--I expect we will learn a great deal about her.
76407.completion:
Could it be possible to help Moraidormi? On the surface, it may seem like we can.

But I sense something is... off here. Why was Vexemia chasing her? What will happen if Vexemia does not move on?

I fell like we are missing something.

76410.title: A Dark Summons
76410.objectives: Talk to Assistant Phineas in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind.
76410.description:
Denizens of Azeroth,

Do you thirst for power? Do you wish to change your circumstances, to become... more? 

More free.

More respected.

More feared.

Do you wish to become a Warlock?

If your response to any of the above is "yes", then meet with my humble servant Phineas.

In temptation,

Madam Shadow
76410.completion:
Another taker, but wait! {NAME}? Well now...

... you're just the {class} we've been looking for!

76416.title: Forward Unto Fire
76416.objectives: Meet Alexstrasza at the Verdant Pass.
76416.description:
Amirdrassil draws power from the Wellspring Temple in preparation for its bloom. The barrier protecting the temple will not last much longer under Fyrakk's assault.

I have sent messengers all across Azeroth asking for reinforcements, but none have yet arrived. Something blocks their path into the Dream. For now, we must rely on the forces we have.

I ask you to travel to the Verdant Pass. If there is anyone I would have by my side, it is you.
76416.completion:
We are thankful for your arrival, {NAME}.

Our forces have assembled, but the odds are against us. We will only be able to hold on for so long without reinforcements. Let us hope we can draw Fyrakk's attention until the Bloom is complete.

76419.title: Violence Will Solve It
76419.objectives: Rewind time and defend Moraidormi from Vexemia's attack.
76419.description:
Do you not agree that Moraidormi can be saved? We infinites often save those we think suffered needlessly--worthy or not.

Supposedly, Mori died too close to the Caverns of Time just east of us. Using too much time magic here could have... consequences.

But this should be quick. Chrono-Lord Deios was in possession of artifacts that could forcefully rewind time. The bronze dragonflight has them now. 

We will rewind time and then destroy Vexemia.

Simple.
76419.progress: This will be easy. Which makes one wonder why the bronze dragonflight did not do it before!
76419.completion:
That... did not go as I had planned.

But I will not give up! We can just rewind again until we get it right.

76420.title: Butterfly Effects
76420.objectives: After rewinding time, create defenses for Moraidormi and test them.
76420.description:
We were overwhelmed by her companions. Moraidormi was still killed.

I need another strategy, one that will actually protect her. She is what matters. Go rewind time, including our actions.

After the rewind, I will hold time in place. Then we can try to make defenses for her.
76420.completion:
That was not any better.

It--it was clearly even worse...

I am trying not to lose focus. What if we attacked again or...

76421.title: The Fate We Make
76421.objectives: Rewind history again and see what Nozdormu has to say.
76421.description:
We just need to be stronger and faster!

We cannot leave it like this, not with the eggs also destroyed.

I will come up with another idea. Restart time, and...

<Eternus sighs.>

Perhaps I will listen to Nozdormu. He keeps telling me I have "missed" something...
76421.progress: Doing nothing makes no sense to me, but I will be patient. For now.
76421.completion: Moraidormi. The whelp. I see now.

76422.title: Infinity and Beyond
76422.objectives: Return to the present to check in with Chromie.
76422.description:
If we continue to look into the past, we miss out on the present--or even the future.

Let us return to Thaldraszus.

Do not worry about these time fracture elementals. They too will heal with time.

As we all do.
76422.progress: I hope this experience can bring us together.
76422.completion:
We all learned something new today.

Myself included.

Time never stops teaching. It falls to all of us to always listen and learn.

76423.title: No Limits
76423.description:
After confronting the infinites and, well, myself--we have had a lot to think about.

Eternus, one of the infinites, has apparently been thinking a lot too.

The infinites want to change Nozdormu into his infinite form, Murozond. We don't want that. And after learning about Nozdormu, I think Eternus may be persuaded to not want that either.

I've set up a meeting between Nozdormu and Eternus to get them talking. But I want someone else there... in case something goes wrong.
76423.completion: This will be a... delicate meeting. Allow me to do the talking.

76426.title: The Kalimdor Cup Circuit
76426.objectives: Fly through the Kalimdor Cup courses.
76426.description:
The Riders of Azeroth have learned much from us, and now we test their mettle, as well as yours, skyrider!

My bronze colleagues have traveled to Kalimdor to create new challenges. They await you with many races across the continent.

Are you up to the task?
76426.completion: You lead the way among your fellow dragonriders! As the Kalimdor Cup continues, find other races there and prove you are a cut above the rest.

76427.title: A Dark Summons
76427.objectives: Talk to Assistant Phineas in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
76427.description:
Denizens of Azeroth,

Do you thirst for power? Do you wish to change your circumstances, to become... more? 

More free.

More respected.

More feared.

Do you wish to become a Warlock?

If your response to any of the above is "yes", then meet with my humble servant Phineas.

In temptation,

Madam Shadow
76427.completion:
Another taker, but wait! {NAME}? Well now...

... you're just the {class} we've been looking for!

76429.title: The Kalimdor Cup Begins
76429.description: Skyrider! You just missed Lord Andestrasz. He's looking for capable skyriders like yourself to compete in new races!

76430.title: Beginning Impositions
76430.description:
Darkest greetings, {race}. Ahem, yes. Yes! Darkest greetings indeed.

<The lanky man seems to suddenly remember where he is.>

On behalf of my patron, I bid you travel to the Darkmoon Faire. The Faire! Who doesn't love it? Yes. Yes!

Ahem.

She requires your presence, she does! Our Lady of the Midnight Moon. The Damsel of Darkness! The Mother of Crows...

...Madam Shadow.
76430.progress: Everyone knows the way to the Faire...

76433.title: Ashen Soil
76433.objectives: Find and excise the source of the barrow den's flame corruption.
76433.description:
It seems the Druids of the Flame wasted no time in seeking to expand their influence. 

Deep within these barrow dens, some manner of corruption has taken root. It will spread if left unchecked, consuming the entire den before expanding outwards to threaten the rest of the dream.

Time is short, {NAME}. Delve into the barrow, seek out the sources of the spreading flame, and excise them before the smoldering embers can grow and spread.
76433.progress: Make haste. These flames grow brighter by the moment.
76433.completion:
<Tyrande's expression wavers between sadness and conviction.>

These are not Fandral Staghelm's Druids of the Flame. To think that someone as kind and compassionate as Norana would count herself amongst them...

We may never truly understand the depth of the scars left by the fallen boughs of Teldrassil.

76434.title: Not Yet Lost
76434.objectives: Rescue the denizens of the Sor'theril Barrow Den.
76434.description:
The flame did not take root here on a whim. 

No doubt there are servants of the Firelands cloistered within, trying to spread their flame to the creatures that reside within these barrows. We must do what we can to save those who can still be saved, and mete out swift justice to the heretics that lurk within.
76434.progress: If even one soul remains languishing within these dens, we must do everything we can to save them.
76434.completion:
Not a day goes by where I do not mark the memories of those that fell at Teldrassil, consumed by a fire that I could not quell. 

Be they Kaldorei or Dryad, I will never again let the cries of the anguished go unanswered. Not while I still draw breath.

76435.title: The Smoldering Copse
76435.description:
Andi'thur tells me of smoke rising from a grove to the west. Norana's new allies are not exactly the subtle sort.

I do not care what her motivations are. I will not allow her to set another inch of this land ablaze. Ride for the western groves. However the Druids of the Flame plan to seek their so-called rebirth, we will do all we can to stop them.
76435.completion:
Norana... You were always such a kind and quiet soul. To think that you would help spur something so foul.

<Tyrande sighs.>

There is much to be done.

76436.title: A Scrap of Hope
76436.objectives: Collect 8 Scraps of Parchment from Fyrakk's forces at Skystone Falls.
76436.description:
It is only a matter of time before Fyrakk's forces decimate our own. And then there will be nothing stopping him from entering the Wellspring Temple.

If the Prophet of the Flame is responsible for blocking our reinforcements from entering the Dream, there must be some record or communication of his plan. We just have to find it.

Search for any communications amongst Fyrakk's forces at Skystone Falls. If we can disrupt their efforts in some way, we might have a chance to turn the tide.
76436.progress: If Fyrakk enters the Wellspring Temple, it is not just Amirdrassil that will burn. All of Azeroth will burn with it.
76436.completion:
Let us hope some knowledge can be gained from the communications you collected.

<Alexstrasza pores over the notes you handed her. Her expression slowly changes from grim to hopeful.>

You might have just saved us all, {NAME}.

76437.title: Burning Ground
76437.description:
We allowed ourselves to be distracted. We thought the Druids of the Flame had followed us into the Dream, when clearly they arrived before we did.

With Amirdrassil so close at hand, we cannot allow them to plant their ashen roots here. Release their prisoners. Ransack their supplies. Do whatever you can to ensure that this burning corruption does not spread further.
76437.progress: We must act quickly. The further this flame-blighted ground spreads, the more danger our allies will face in the days to come.
76437.completion:
Even as warped by flame as they are, these druids have not forgotten the way to the dream. It will be difficult to keep them out entirely.

Still, without a proper base of operations, they will struggle to expand their influence. Your deeds today will help ensure Amirdrassil's safety against this spreading fire.

76441.title: Grim Reprisal
76441.description:
The Druids of the Flame will not allow you to proceed unfettered once your intentions here become clear.

They are my kin, my brothers and sisters under Elune... But they seek to undo all that we have toiled for. Their machinations would condemn countless lives to an all-consuming inferno.

I won't allow it. We cannot allow it.

Disrupt their rituals. Destroy their supplies. If they raise their blades against you, cut them down.
76441.progress: Take heed. These druids' zealotry fuels their reckless ends. Should they identify you as an enemy, they will not show mercy.
76441.completion:
To think, after all we have been through, that any druid would dare try to warp the Dream in such a way.

<Tyrande scowls.>

These 'druids' are an affront to the suffering that the Kaldorei have endured.

76442.title: Forlorn Hope
76442.description:
You've arrived just in time. Norana lurks just beyond the ridge. She appears to be taking part in some manner of ritual - alongside a man who appears to be their leader.

These are powerful druids, and their strength is amplified by their ties to the Firelands. Taking the blade to all of them at once would be foolish.

Still, the least we can do is disrupt their ritual. If we send them scattering, we buy ourselves time - and an opportunity to press the advance elsewhere.
76442.completion:
This so-called Prophet purports to represent the interests of the Kaldorei, but I see him plain enough. He craves power, and he exploits the fear and suffering of the Kaldorei to claim it.

His work must not continue. Not while I yet draw breath.

We've done all that we can here, for now. We must return to Amirdrassil.

76443.title: The Looming Cinder
76443.description:
The Druids of the Flame are nothing more than allies of convenience to Fyrakk and his ilk. Nevertheless, they present a dire threat to the well-being of Amirdrassil, to say nothing of the rest of the Dream.

The victory we earned here today was hard-fought, but it only served to stem the tide. No doubt the Prophet and the Priestess have already reunited with their erstwhile allies.

We should return to Merithra. She needs to know of this.
76443.completion:
I am glad to see you return, {class}. Would that I could bid you a moment to rest for all of the hard work that you have done.

Unfortunately, we've no such luxury. Where one flame falters, another flares in response. Amirdrassil remains in danger.

76448.title: The Fate of Scalecommander Abereth
76448.description:
According to our colleagues, this cave was used to test prospective scalecommanders.

Excuse me. It either tested them or housed their remains. The trials were so difficult that it usually amounted to the same thing.

We're searching for an ancient scalecommander referenced in our records as "The Cleaving Blade": a promising young dracthyr whose future ended abruptly somewhere near this cave. Perhaps we'll discover how their story ends.
76448.progress: Without those attunement relics we won't be able to solve this mystery, {NAME}.
76448.completion: Ah ha! Give them here and I'll calibrate your goggles.

76449.title: The Endless Conflict
76449.objectives: Bring the Oil-Soaked Log Book to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76449.description:
<You notice a book beside the body of a Great Glorious Alliance soldier.

Quickly flicking through the pages, you see that it's some type of journal. 

Parts of it were ruined by a puddle of oil.

Soridormi will want to see this.>
76449.completion:
<As you hold the book out to Soridormi, she picks it up gingerly between two fingers as oil continues to leak from the book.>

I'm not sure I want to look inside. You said there was legible text still left in this?

Well... I suppose we can put it on the rest of the pile.

After it has been cleaned.

76453.title: A Stony Reception
76453.objectives: Bring the Chipped Stone Tablet to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76453.description:
<This chipped stone tablet stands out from its surroundings.

As you go to pick it up, it weighs quite a lot more than you expected.

Soridormi will want to see this.>
76453.completion:
<As you hold the item out to Soridormi, she nearly drops it, as the weight takes her by surprise.>

This is from the Black Empire? 

It... does not look corrupted. Perhaps we should be careful nonetheless.

I'll have someone come by and cleanse it, just to be sure.

76456.title: Using the Idol
76456.description:
Ah, the Idol of Ohn'ahra! Let's use it to find gems. I've hidden three gems nearby in Valdrakken, all outside.

The idol will reveal the gems when you're near.

Come back when you've tracked them down.

76459.title: The Resistance
76459.objectives: After completing a Time Rift, return to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76459.description:
<The person in front of you is clearly an uncorrupted night elf, albeit significantly more feral and malnourished than usual.>

Nice world. No Legion. No fel.

If you can, send help. Suramar, ask for Tyrande.

<Soridormi may want to see this.>
76459.progress: Hello again, {NAME}. What do you have there?
76459.completion:
<Soridormi looks at you in a perplexed manner as you hand her a map to Suramar. Her expression changes as you explain the circumstances.>

Incredible. This world has been under the rule of the Legion for ten thousand years, yet still there is a resistance. 

I wish we could help them, but we cannot interfere with another timeway.

A horrible answer, I know.

76460.title: A Dragon in Hand is Worth Two in the Roost
76460.objectives: Talk to Wrathion about his potential allies.
76460.description:
Ah, {NAME}, so wonderful to see you!

You have arrived just in time. I was tasked with seeking out potential allies to aid with the protection of the world tree.

Your accomplishments speak for themselves--your help in this matter would be greatly appreciated.

What do you say, up for some diplomacy?
76460.progress: I'm quite excited to meet these new dragons.
76460.completion:
Well then! We should go meet the representative of the netherwing. 

Mordenaku is his name. Apparently, he is also a prince.

76461.title: Draconic Diplomacy
76461.objectives: Talk to Prince Mordenaku at the Petitioners Concourse in Valdrakken.
76461.description:
I suspect Vyranoth might also be interested in recruiting new dragons to our cause... but she'll need a little convincing. 

I just so happen to be very good at convincing. 

I'll speak with Vyranoth, and we'll meet you in Valdrakken once she's decided to join us.
76461.progress: The netherwing are a fascinating flight.
76461.completion:
These seem like very reasonable requests. Nothing obscure, nothing secretive. 

I'm almost disappointed.

I can handle one, but I may need your help with the rest.

76462.title: Cavern Cleaning
76462.objectives: Clean out the spiders in the cave above the Sand-Lost Sanctum in Thaldraszus.
76462.description:
This cave is adequate. It has a commanding view of the surrounding land, and is highly defensible.

But the state of it is not acceptable. 

I will place an enchantment upon you. When you draw near to the smaller spiders, it will freeze them, allowing us to relocate them. The sacs and larger spider will need to be addressed with more... finality. 

See that it is done.
76462.completion: Excellent, {class}. We can clean up the remainder and relocate them to another cave.

76463.title: Delectable Delicacies
76463.objectives: Retrieve 10 Juicy Beetle Bits from Juicy Beetles in the Ruby Lifepools in Waking Shores.
76463.description:
Of course we will take care of the netherwhelps.

However, we might run low on snacks. The beetles close by are a delicious treat for the little ones. 

Can you bring me back some juicy beetle bits? Only the best for the little darlings!
76463.progress: The whelps just love to gobble up those beetle bits.
76463.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. The young ones will love these!

My goodness. First the obsidian whelps, now this?

I cannot believe I am lucky enough to see this!

76464.title: The Thorignir
76464.description:
The Thorignir of Stormheim have the strength and power to greatly aid us in defending Amirdrassil, but they have yet to come to the Dragon Isles. I suspect this... Odyn has interfered with their journey.

We will go and speak with their matriarch. Wrathion tells me her brood is amenable to your kind, and to assisting others. 

We will investigate.
76464.progress: We will find out why this brood of storm drakes did not heed the call of the Isles.
76464.completion: How dare he deny any dragons the right to go anywhere!

76465.title: Dragon Keeping
76465.objectives: Speak to Vyranoth and complete the Storm the Halls of Valor scenario.
76465.description:
First he opposes dragonkind, then he enslaves them, denying them their birthrights.

We shall visit these so-called "Halls of Valor," defeat any who oppose us, and liberate the storm drakes from that which binds them.

Come along.
76465.completion: The Thorignir are free of that wretched keeper's influence for now--and hopefully for good.

76504.title: The Tricked-Out Thinking Cap
76504.description:
The cap has an amazing function: Put it on, and you'll know where you're going! Let's practice!

The arrow above me has a clue on it, to another arrow somewhere in Valdrakken. And THAT arrow leads to another...

Follow the arrows until you find them all, and the prize at the end!
76504.progress: You must wear your cap at all times while contemplating secrets. You never know what frequencies you might tap into, or who might tapping into yours.

76509.title: Into the Sands
76509.completion:
The Idol of Ohn'ahra has interesting properties. I believe it can help recover another object I've been seeking.

Take it south of Azim in the Shifting Sands and use it to search for fragments of the Time-Lost Tablet. 

If fortune favors us, you will find all its pieces and make it whole.

76521.title: Buzzing Boffins
76521.objectives: After completing a Time Rift, return to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76521.description:
<After running up to you with great speed, this robotic creature does not attack you.

It is persistent in its desire to be close to you.

It has the word "Boffins" etched into its side.

Soridormi will want to see this.>
76521.progress: Hello again, {NAME}. What do you have there?
76521.completion:
<Soridormi sighs.>

It can stay here... for now.

<Soridormi stares at Boffins.>

I am not in the habit of caring for stray pets.

<Soridormi looks at you, then absent-mindedly pats Boffins on its head.>

I do not have the time, but you can leave it here. Thank you for bringing this to my attention.

76530.title: Unliving Summons
76530.objectives: Report to Lilian Voss in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
76530.description:
We need you in Tirisfal, {NAME}. Come quickly.

There's a new situation brewing just outside the Ruins of Lordaeron, and it's not looking pretty. I'll get you up to speed when you arrive.
76530.completion: Thanks for being here. We've got a new problem.

76532.title: Assault on the Wellspring
76532.objectives: Spy on the Wellspring of Life with Buri.
76532.description:
Terro gave his life to protect the Dream. Which means we must see it through.

Vyranoth should be able to handle Lethka, we must find Suzska.

I hope Lethka did not attack her first. We should start looking near the Wellspring. 

Meet me there so we can continue our search.
76532.progress: Come on, let's head to the Wellspring.

76533.title: Dangerous Documentation
76533.objectives: Return to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76533.description:
<The flickering of a hologram stands out among the surrounding greenery.>

A quick investigation of the item reveals this is some sort of catalog left by a Watcher in its timeway. It details observations of the yaungol, ancestors of the tauren.

<Soridormi will want to see this.>
76533.completion:
<Soridormi swipes her hand through the holographic projection of the yaungol as you hand over the Watcher's Log up.>

Fascinating technology! So similar to that of our titans.

I'm sure the log entries in it are interesting to read. I'll put it on the tables if you want to review them.

76544.title: Wasteland Warriors
76544.objectives: After completing a Time Rift, return to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76544.description:
<This book has what appears to be a modified Horde symbol on it. You recognize it as the Blood Horde symbol you have seen from timeway incursions.

It is odd it is still here, after the incursion has ended. 

The book has been soaked in blood, though it has long since dried off.

Soridormi might be interested in this.>
76544.progress: Hello again, {NAME}. What do you have there?
76544.completion:
<Soridormi flips through the book after you hand it to her.>

Our world has been at war for such a long time against one aggressor or another. 

So has theirs, but they just fight each other, over and over again.

It would be easy to judge them, but our worlds are both drowned in blood.

<Soridormi looks pensive.>

I will put the book on the table in case you want to read it.

76545.title: Brewfest in Valdrakken
76545.description: Have you heard? Brewfest has made its way here! You should speak to Bragdur Battlebrew in the Artisan's Market--he can tell you all about it.

76546.title: Mantid Methodology
76546.objectives: After completing a Time Rift, return to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76546.description:
<This amber sword was left behind as you knocked one of the Mantid back through a time rift.

You take a moment to ensure it's safe, then place it in your pack.

Perhaps Soridormi would be interested in it.>
76546.progress: Hello again, {NAME}. What do you have there?
76546.completion:
<Soridormi turns the blade over in her hands and holds it up to the light.>

This is the first time I've seen a blade made of pure amber.

It's a lot sturdier than I expected, and quite dense.

Good find, {NAME}. I will put it on the table, in case you want to look at it later.

76547.title: All That Glitters...
76547.objectives: Return to Soridormi in the Tyrhold Reservoir.
76547.description:
<Having recently defeated the Time Anomaly in this timeway, you notice this golden vase glittering.

It is extremely worn, be it by time or something else. You can't make out the details of its carvings along the edges.

Battered as it is, it still manages to give off a warm light, contrasting the chill here. 

It looks very out of place. Soridormi may be interested in it.>
76547.completion:
<Soridormi hefts the vase in her hands.>

You found this on the top of Icecrown?

That is... odd.

Our Lich King, at least, was not known for his golden aesthetic, at least not in death.

I will put it on the tables. Thank you, {NAME}.

76552.title: In Sync
76552.description:
While Pedgi had you out killing slimes, I asked the investigators here how we can actually help.

Seems quite a few of them are stuck in time anomalies. Luckily, I've just finished giving the metronographer a few temporal upgrades. It should now help the investigators get back in sync.

But we need to test it out first. Looks like there's someone nearby who will do the trick.
76552.progress:
Oh, I saw that Pedgi had you collect time slime grime for me. I did not ask for it and I do not need it.

<Melly sighs a long suffering sigh.>

At least he's trying to be helpful.
76552.completion:
Seems the metronographer worked just as intended! 

How interesting that temporal energies are so similar to music. I wonder if the bronze dragonflight has ever conducted research on the subject...

Sorry, rambling. Let's get back to helping Tempo. My next paycheck depends on it.

76557.title: Without Honor
76557.objectives: Observe the Scene from the past.
76557.description: Ok, the goggles should be calibrated. Looks like the confluence point is right here on the ledge. I wonder what happened to him?
76557.completion:
<Zenata frowns somberly into the distance.> 

The Earth Warder's forces, going after one of their own... what do you think they meant by that?

76564.title: The Tools of the Dragonkillers
76564.description:
If you're going to go after a dragon, who better to employ than the Djaradin?

Let's see what we can find, {NAME}.
76564.progress: Without those attunement relics we won't be able to solve this mystery, {NAME}.
76564.completion: Ah ha! Give them here and I'll calibrate your goggles.

76566.title: The Dryad Garden
76566.objectives: Speak with Ethidris Creekward in the Root-Bound Sanctuary.
76566.description:
$p, there is a situation I am personally concerned about. 

A garden cared for by my kin, the dryads, has suffered from growing pains amidst Amirdrassil's growth.

An overwrought druid currently tends the garden, but I suspect he will need more assistance than he has requested. 

Please assist him in his task on my behalf.
76566.completion:
Cenarius himself sent you? Wonderful. We need the help.

We must find that dryad acorn!

76567.title: Grousing Garden
76567.objectives: Tire out 8 wildlife in the Root-Bound Sanctuary.
76567.description:
The sanctuary has been overrun!

The roots of the World Tree have grown alongside this garden, but it seems the wildlife have grown uncomfortable with the change.

Please help them get out their restless energy. Perhaps tired out, they will relax in this space again.
76567.progress:
<Ethidris winces and rubs his shoulder.>

You would think being a bear would lend oneself resistance to being knocked around by deer.
76567.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. I can see you've calmed them down for now.

This is not the first time this has happened, and likely will not be the last. Is it simply the roots of Amirdrassil? This behavior is so strange...

76568.title: Pineshrew Panic
76568.objectives: Shake out 20 Pineshrew seeds in the Root-Bound Sanctuary.
76568.description:
With the garden in such disarray, the pineshrews here are hoarding seeds. Important seeds. Seeds we've spent a lot of time caring for and teaching.

A gentle shake will release the seeds properly. Please hurry before they run off with any more!
76568.progress:
Ordinarily, pineshrews shake out collected seeds across the Dream to promote variety and growth. It's a beautiful cycle.

If you have a few hours, I have a lesson prepared about pineshrew migration habits.
