76568.completion:
It seems Dionaessa has chosen you to train her. 

<Ethidris's face tightens.>

Splendid. Just perfect.

76569.title: Druid-Guardian Conference
76569.objectives: Speak with Ethidris Creekward about raising a dryad in the Root-Bound Sanctuary.
76569.description:
Typically, the druid assigned to a dryad sanctuary would guide a newborn dryad until they were ready to take on a position of their own.

Unfortunately, it is difficult to separate a dryad from whoever she imprints on.

<Ethidris sighs and rubs his eyes.>

Which she has made very clear. Regardless, tell me about yourself. Perhaps you will be just as apt a caretaker as I would have been.
76569.progress:
<Ethidris furrows his brow at Dionaessa.>

Among so many other things happening right now, there's a new dryad to raise.
76569.completion:
You regularly engage in combat and you solve problems. Sometimes for yourself, sometimes for others.

That honestly does not sound too far off from my experience with dryads.

I think Dionaessa will be fine.

76570.title: The Family Business
76570.objectives: Collect 6 Lasher Hearts in the Twisting Wood near the Root-Bound Sanctuary.
76570.description:
I was charged with imparting knowledge on every dryad seed. Dionaessa will have retained all of my teachings, but she will be unpracticed in implementing them.

Since it seems you are practiced at completing tasks, you will show Dionaessa the ropes.

A group of lashers have grown strangely restless in the Twisting Wood just outside the garden. Collect some of their hearts so we can discern what has happened.
76570.progress:
The druid Creekward told me lashers tend to lie in wait for their prey.

I'm glad these are not. Makes the fight more interesting!
76570.completion: These hearts smell awful! Almost as awful as those podlings with the sharp little teeth...

76571.title: Growth Experience
76571.objectives: Have Dionaessa grow 3 flowers in the Twisting Wood.
76571.description:
Dionaessa's connection to Cenarius gives her the ability to grow plants, but she needs space to practice.

The stirred-up wildlife here will be in your way. The Twisting Wood nearby will have plenty of space with far fewer hooves.

<Melyrine smiles. Her eyes shine with intensity.>

If she gets poisoned by a podling, don't worry. Dryads are immune to poison. You are not.
76571.progress:
Do you smell that?

<Dionaessa scrunches up her face.>

The druid Creekward did not describe lashers and podlings as smelling so foul. I have been misled!
76571.completion: Guardian. If the podlings are poisoning the ground here, then that large growth with the incredible stench over there needs pruning!

76572.title: A Poisonous Promotion
76572.objectives: Defeat the Sickened Growth in the Twisting Wood.
76572.description:
Guardian! These podlings have been poisoning the lashers, and now they have twisted that mandragora!

If we do not stop it, it will spread the poison to the garden. This must be what had the wildlife in the garden so disturbed. They were on the verge of invasion!

Let us kill it. This is what you have prepared me for--a dire quest!
76572.completion:
Hey-ah, Guardian! I have never felt more alive than with a spear in hand!

<Dionaessa smiles in a way that bares all of her teeth.>

Thank you for your guardianship!

76576.title: An Unlikely Proposal
76576.objectives: Observe the Scene from the past.
76576.description:
Tuskarr artifacts, underground, deep in Djaradin territory?

If we didn't find it ourselves I wouldn't believe it. What do you think they were doing down here?

Ok looks like the nexus point is right here in this cave. Let's get to the bottom of this!
76576.completion: Tuskarr and Djaradin trading? I wonder how long that lasted.

76577.title: Brewfest in Valdrakken
76577.description: We've sent some Brewfest shipments off to the Dragon Isles. I've heard they've started some of their own celebrations! Of course ye can't beat the festivities here, but it may be worth paying the dragons a visit!

76579.title: Brewfest in Valdrakken
76579.description: Seems the dracthyr have decided to host their own Brewfest festivities this year! Once you've finished celebrating here, you should venture to the Dragon Isles and see what they've put together.

76588.title: Defender of the Flame
76588.objectives: Eliminate two rare creatures within the areas controlled by the keyflames.
76588.description:
The Expedition forces face formidable adversaries.

Drawn like moths to our keyflames, creatures of all types are intent on snuffing out the light and thwarting our rebuilding efforts.

Please help us defeat two of the most menacing denizens that threaten our keyflames. Together, we can drive back this darkness.
76588.completion: Excellent work, that is two less threats to deal with!

76591.title: Bubbling Brews
76591.description:
Drat! I might've made a mistake asking the dracthyr to help with these deliveries. They've been rolling barrels of brews through the city and crashing 'em all over the place! Well, we shouldn't let the brew go to waste if we can help it!

Take a barrel an' take to the skies! Try to collect and save as much of the brew as you can by collecting the bubbles.
76591.progress: Have ye filled up the barrel?
76591.completion: Thank ye kindly for the help. Now if I can just convince the dracthyr to simply fly the barrels here instead of rolling 'em...

76592.title: A Single Wing
76592.objectives: Look for Marithos in the Azure Span.
76592.description:
Amythora has returned with grave news. The Sundered Flame live on!

We have been trying to locate and repatriate independent bands of dracthyr here in Valdrakken. I sent Amythora and Marithos to talk to the last of them, but Amythora reports they are a remnant of the Sundered Flame. 

And they have captured Marithos!

Given that he used to be one of them, Marithos could be in grave danger. We must investigate and ensure his safety.
76592.completion: He is badly injured. {NAME}, we must help him!

76593.title: The Best Intentions
76593.objectives: Look for a key to Marithos's shackles in the Lonely Falls.
76593.description:
Not only did they beat him--they put him in shackles too!

What's worse is... I probably would have done the same...

We will not be able to carry Marithos out of here with this weight chained to him. The key must be around the camp somewhere. Try to find it, {NAME}, while I keep him comfortable.
76593.progress: We must free Marithos from his bonds.
76593.completion: Is that the key, {NAME}? Good. Let's get these shackles off of Marithos. Then we can start thinking about what to do next.

76594.title: Dracthyr Down
76594.objectives: Look for Wingfoil herbs in the Lonely Falls.
76594.description:
What was done to Marithos goes beyond what simple healing can fix. If we expect him to fly out of here, he will need extra care.

Thankfully, there are herbs nearby that may give his healing a boost--enough to get him standing, anyway.

Look around and collect some of the Wingfoil nearby, {NAME}.
76594.progress: Have you found that Wingfoil? Marithos cannot fly without it.
76594.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Now let's hope for the best...

76595.title: Urgent Exfiltration
76595.objectives: Keep the Sundered Flame away from Amythora and Marithos.
76595.description:
The Sundered Flame here are not going to take Quartermaster Doros's death well...

They are going to come looking for me. Marithos and Amythora are vulnerable. We cannot let them find us.

Secure the perimeter and keep the Sundered Flame away from Amythora and Marithos.
76595.progress: If they find us, I do not think the Sundered Flame loyalists will take prisoners.
76595.completion: I think they are gone. We need to get out of here--now.

76597.title: On New Wings
76597.description:
I am glad that Winglord Dezran arrived when he did. If he had not, this would have gone... very differently.

We must take Marithos back to Valdrakken so he can recuperate, but once I have debriefed Dezran, we will send an envoy to help re-introduce them to our people.

They have suffered. We have suffered. Perhaps now we can all heal.

Follow me back to Valdrakken. We have much to discuss.
76597.completion: Thank you for your help, {NAME}. Now that Dezran has returned, we can work to finally bring the dracthyr together.

76598.title: Rough Edges
76598.objectives: Find Alexstrasza and check on her.
76598.description:
I apologize for not meeting you in person, {NAME}, but this method seemed most timely.

Our war against the Primalists has always troubled our queen, but recently she has grown increasingly upset. Something weighs on her. I know how heavy the burdens of the mind can become.

She left Valdrakken some time ago, saying she needed to find a quiet place to think, but... I am concerned.

Please--seek her out, and make sure she is all right. She does not need to know I sent you.

76600.title: Right Between the Gyro-Optics
76600.objectives: With Auebry's help, eliminate 8 Dark-Crazed Harvesters.
76600.description:
My husband Ezgi loves those harvesters, but I don't trust them, and now you can see why!

The lights go out, and they all start trying to kill us!

You want to help me sort this out?

I'm a crack shot with a rifle. You mark the target, and I'll start shooting!
76600.completion: Ezgi is going to be upset, but you and I did what needed to be done.

76733.title: Tater Trawl
76733.objectives: Light 5 Harvest Torches and gather 15 Firelight Spuds.
76733.description:
Harvesting in this area has become a challenge, with crazed Harvesters destroying most of our crops. There are potatoes to be found if you look closely.

If you light the harvest torches, you might uncover some potatoes hiding in the shadows. 

Using those lights, gather as many potatoes as you can. Every bit helps in these trying times.
76733.completion: This is perfect. We love fried potato fingers, we're going to cook up some of those tonight!

76735.title: Rise in Relic Theft
76735.completion:
The inns are abuzz with rumors of aspiring criminals pilfering sacred relics.

I'm overseeing the return of stolen goods to their rightful owners. I hear you can be trusted to help.

Please take this ceremonial tuskarr spear back to Iskaara. And watch out for looters!

76997.title: Lost in Shadows
76997.objectives: Find and rally 3 Demoralized Recruits using the Patrol Torch.
76997.description:
Greetings, {NAME}. I find myself in a dire situation. 

Some fresh recruits and I were on patrol in these lands when our torches went out, leaving us utterly lost and disoriented.

I found safety in this house, but most of the recruits fled, confused into the darkness. 

Will you help me locate them? I have a spare Patrol Torch. The mere sight of it should rally them to your side.
76997.completion: The time spent with you is much greater training than I could ever provide these recruits. One of them will remain here to aid you further.

77093.title: The Shadowflame Axe
77093.objectives: Visit the Azerothian Archives to find an expert on Shadowflame.
77093.description:
The moment you attempted to wield  Fyrakk's axe, Fyr'alath, its flames consumed you. Clearly the weapon's shadowflame was too intense.

Perhaps you should consult an expert on shadowflame and ancient artifacts. Maybe one of the scholars at the Azerothian Archives can deduce a method for handling it safely.
77093.completion:
I say! What do we have here? How curious!

Wait a minute...

77098.title: Getting to Ground
77098.objectives: Get Marithos to safety in the Azure Span.
77098.description:
He needs to be healed--now. 

We're too out in the open here. Sundered Flame loyalists could ambush us at any time. 

Let's find cover somewhere so we can assess his wounds.

Cover me!
77098.completion:
You moved Marithos on your own?

That was very risky.

But you were right. Marithos is gravely injured, and we do not have much time.

77100.title: Surveying the Cliffside
77100.objectives: Speak with Roska to start the dig then excavate artifacts from the cliffside.
77100.description:
Nothing like brisk ocean air to get you in the mood to dig!

We're standing in the rubble of an ancient dragonkin fishing village. These dragonkin were ancestors of the blue dragonkin that live on the island today. Humble as it is, the remote location means it's gone relatively undisturbed by treasure hunters.

If there's anything left that hasn't fallen into the sea, we'll find it!
77100.completion:
<Roska lets out a low whistle.>

We got to this bad boy just in time, huh? Another hundred years, and it woulda been fish food!

77101.title: Ingredient Quest Template
77101.objectives: Help Rocket-Chief Fuselage build the perfect weapon.
77101.description:
Ricket sent word that she was here in Mechagon, so I came right away to help with the uh... research.

I had the peons scour the island for any technology they could find. With da stuff we got here, we gonna make some amazing weapons to fight King Mechagon. Then afterwards, we get rich selling 'em!

Help me wrangle everyone's ideas into one perfect weapon!

77151.title: The Cache in the Crag
77151.objectives: Speak to Roska to begin carefully excavating the dragonkin cache.
77151.description:
<This barrel is salt-encrusted and buried amongst the rubble but remarkably intact.

It looks like the sort of mundane cache that villagers would use to store goods, but no one has lived here for thousands of years. Could there still be something inside?

Roska will want to have a look at this!>
77151.progress: Nothing like a crag, eh {NAME}? Never know what you'll find!
77151.completion:
Wow, {NAME}! Not only is this cache intact, but it's full of something other than seawater!

Imagine finding great-great-great grandma's jam recipe that'd been lost for thousands of years. Yep, the locals are gonna love this!

77154.title: A Taste of the Past
77154.objectives: Find Atrenosh Hailstone and see if she would like to open the cache with you.
77154.description:
Usually, we go to great lengths to avoid busting artifacts open, but I think in this case we'll learn more about the past from what's inside than just staring at a sealed barrel.

That said, there's someone we should get permission from first. It's her history, after all. In fact, I think she's the only person still around who might have a personal stake in this find.

I'll see to getting this up the cliff. Ask if Atrenosh Hailstone wants to watch us crack 'er open, eh?
77154.progress: <Roska looks proud of your hard work.>
77154.completion:
That's what this is all about, eh?

Connecting folks with their pasts, making them feel like they're a part of something. It's easier to know where you're going when you know where you came from.

77163.title: Seeing Reason
77163.objectives: Confront Quartermaster Doros in the Lonely Falls.
77163.description:
They seem to know that Sarkareth is gone, but because their missions were so far from Zaralek Cavern, it looks like they never heard how he met his demise. 

We should talk to them. Maybe if they knew why so many of their brethren now follow me they would become Ebon Scales again. Or not...

<Emberthal sighs.>

This could backfire catastrophically, but I feel like we must try. Quartermaster Doros seems to be in command here. Go and speak to him, {NAME}. I do not think he would listen to me...
77163.progress: Find Quartermaster Doros. If you can talk to him, we might be able to avoid a conflict.
77163.completion: That... did not go as I had hoped.

77165.title: A Secretive Contact
77165.completion:
Hey there, I'm a reporter for the Eye of Azeroth.

I'm investigating some strange activity in Valdrakken. Want to help?

I've got a source, but they'll only speak to someone wearing a 'Thinking Cap'. It's supposed to focus thoughts or some such. Anyway, I made a list of the components needed and who you can get them from. 

Track them down, then we'll talk more.

77166.title: A Practical Test
77166.objectives: Use the Technoscryers to find the hidden object.
77166.description:
Now that you know how to use the device, we will put your skills to the test.

I have attuned your Technoscryers to a valuable item hidden somewhere on this island. Provided you can find it, we will use it to view a scene from the past and deduce how it got there.

It is time for science! Put... the goggles... on! Resume your scrying!
77166.progress: Have you found that hidden object, {NAME}?
77166.completion:
Eureka! Success! 

Quickly, hand the Technoscryers back to me. We will readjust them for the next test.

77176.title: I Can See Through Time!
77176.description:
Okay, the Technoscryers should be calibrated. I have made the same adjustments to my own pair, so we can view the same phenomena.

Are you ready? Put... them on... again! This time, we will use the Observation mode.
77176.progress: I wonder what we will find?
77176.completion:
Oh, my. Ha ha ha ha ha! 

I... conveniently forgot about that. You are not going to tell Nirobin about this, are you?

Academic rivalry takes many forms. It is all perfectly innocent, I assure you!

77178.title: Tactical Withdrawal
77178.objectives: Return to Alexstrasza in the Central Encampment.
77178.description:
We have stopped this attack on the barrier, but Fyrakk will find a way through.

$p, we need to return to Alexstrasza and Merithra and tell them his plans for the Wellspring.

Return as soon as possible. It is more urgent than ever to stop Fyrakk.
77178.completion: So Fyrakk is after the Wellspring.

77191.title: Handling It
77191.objectives: Obtain a Symbiotic Glowspore Grip, a Rune of Shadowbinding, and a Concentrated Sophic Vellum.
77191.description:
If you want to wield Fyr'alath safely, you'll need to modify the weapon's haft with three components.

First, you'll need a fireproof hide that can handle intense heat. Next, acquire enchanted vellum that can contain the weapon's volatile magic. Finally, a scribe must apply the proper runes, so you can bind the first two materials to the axe.

My journal over there includes a few recommendations of crafters who can help you. You might also know a few!
77191.progress: Please collect the necessary materials quickly. I'm excited to begin.
77191.completion:
Excellent! I knew my instructions would prove sufficient!

Oh, and congratulations to you, as well. I commend your diligence.

77192.title: An Axe Tempered
77192.objectives: Head to the Obsidian Citadel and ask the smith to forge the handle onto the axe.
77192.description:
Exemplary. Some of the components can be wrapped and attached by hand, but for the last step, you'll need a powerful forge to unify all three in flame.

I've been speaking to Wrathion. He can direct you to a suitable forge in the Obsidian Citadel. I'll meet you both there! I can't wait to see what happens as a result of my ingenious plan!
77192.progress: We need to attach the modified handle to the axe head. That's more perilous than it sounds...
77192.completion:
Let's prove you can withstand your weapon's corruption.

The ritual awaits. I can lead you into Aberrus. Are you ready to go?

77193.title: The Power of Temptation
77193.objectives: Talk to Wrathion to travel to Aberrus, and complete the scenario "A Hero's Resolve.".
77193.description:
Just to be clear: if the axe defeats you, I will be obligated to step in. 

But that's not going to happen, is it? You're not going to be corrupted by shadowflame. You won't devolve into a monstrous, murderous shadow of your former self. I'm not going to have to... intervene.

As long as we're clear on this, no one is going to have to kill anyone. All right, let's get this done.
77193.completion:
We now have something in common: we both share the burden of making something positive out of my father's legacy.

Lucky you. Misery loves company. Wield that axe wisely.

77194.title: Free Knot!
77194.progress:
It's called the Gordok Shackle Key - well, that's what these "tons o' fun" keep calling it. I think any of the ogres might have it, but I'm not sure if any specific ones do. Maybe the guards have a better chance of having one...

What am I talking about - you have it already, don't you?! Is that it there??!
Gordok Shackle Key (1)
77194.completion:
Oh, thank you for freeing me! You - ranked number one. Everyone else - ranked number two or lower.

I knew my life was destined for more than just being an appetizer to some ogre!

77195.title: A Dragon's Eye View
77195.objectives: Travel to the cave above the Sand-Lost Sanctum in Thaldraszus.
77195.description:
I believe I know just the location for the Netherwing to roost.

It has a wonderful view and is quite secluded.

I'd like to show our guest some of the sights of Valdrakken before we go. Meet you there?
77195.progress: Really, the view from the cave is quite remarkable.
77195.completion:
There seem to be far more spiders here than the last time I visited.

But it seems as if Vyranoth has a plan of action.

77197.title: A Whelping Hand
77197.objectives: Meet Mother Elion at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores.
77197.description:
Well done, {NAME}.

Now we must ensure the whelps of the netherwing have the best opportunities to grow and flourish. 

Let us speak to Mother Elion. I know she would relish the opportunity to care for the young of a new flight. 

Can you meet us at the Ruby Lifeshrine?
77197.completion:
Wrathion says there are new whelps on the way?

Of a new flight? Are you certain this is not a joke?

Very well. Let us get started.

77198.title: Home in Time for Tea
77198.objectives: Meet Wrathion, Mordenaku, and Vyranoth in the Roasted Ram Inn in Valdrakken.
77198.description:
I must admit, I did not expect to be altering the future of my flight when I arrived. But it feels as though we belong here. Perhaps this is the call they spoke of...

Regardless, I am looking forward to some rest. 

Wrathion mentioned retiring to the Roasted Ram Inn. 

Can you meet us there?
77198.progress: I am looking forward to some rest.
77198.completion:
Thanks to you, my flight's safety and future has been secured.

Traveling from Outland to Azeroth has been overwhelming, but in the best of ways.

The netherwing look forward to exploring this world.

77200.title: Offerings for the Well
77200.objectives: Gather offerings from night elves in the Central Encampment.
77200.description:
Amirdrassil has been ushered into this world by the denizens of the Dream. Now we must ensure its roots are bathed in the waters of Elune by creating a new moonwell.

So many of my people have brought us to this moment. Each should have a part in this dedication. 

Go, speak to the kaldorei gathered here, and see if they have offerings for the ceremony.
77200.progress: Have you collected all the offerings for the ceremony?
77200.completion:
Every kaldorei understands the grief and elation of a moment such as this. The pain we have endured and the hope we have for the future.

These offerings are profound and appreciated.

77201.title: A Personal Offering
77201.objectives: Speak with Tyrande Whisperwind in Central Encampment to choose an offering.
77201.description:
$p. You have done so much for our people. I would have you participate in this ceremony and provide an offering of your own, should you wish it.

Let me know what it is that you would like to put forward and it will be done.
77201.progress: Are you certain of your offering?
77201.completion: An admirable choice. May Elune light your path, {NAME}.

77202.title: The Preservationists
77202.description:
Welcome, adventurer. Have you heard the news?

There's been a rash of artifact thefts as rumors of treasures and secret locations are being exposed.

If you'd like to learn more, seek out Preservationist Kathos. Your skills at deciphering secrets might help reveal who's behind this chaos.

77203.title: Preserving Rarities
77203.description:
Let's unravel a secret! Prepare your mind for puzzles...

Speak to me again when you're ready to start down the path of the preservationists.
77203.progress: That mystery isn't going to solve itself!

77208.title: Barreling Down
77208.description:
If it's ale ye be looking for, we've plenty to sample! Or at least we would if the Valdrakken folk would hurry up and bring the rest of the barrels down here.

We've shipped our Brewfest brews here so they can celebrate--and wouldn't ye know it, they've already started their own traditions! Rolling barrels through the city? That's no way to treat a good brew!

Mind lending a hand to bring those barrels down here? And try not to break 'em!
77208.progress: Careful with the barrels! Ye shouldn't jostle a good ale.
77208.completion: Glad to see that delivery in one piece!

77209.title: Seed Legacy
77209.objectives: Plant a seed at each of the Dreamsoil patches.
77209.description:
For years I worked with Denalan in Teldrassil. His research will be the foundation of how we will restore these seeds.

The first step: we must coax them back to life, allowing them to grow into vibrant blossoming plants. I have located suitable patches of soil where the plants can take root and grow, revealing their true potential. 

We will plant one small, one plump, and one gigantic seed to observe how the quality of the seed can sprout different growth.
77209.completion: Denalan would be proud to see his work continued by one such as you!

77231.title: Technoscrying 101
77231.description:
Through a near-perfect blend of technology and arcane enchantment, I have developed a way to analyze the psychometric properties of objects. Wearing these goggles, you can see the data as dynamic simulacra!

Simple, yes? I call it... the Psychometric Visuo-Auditory Discrete Waveform Analysis and Viewing Device! For the layperson, we're calling them "Technoscryers." Trademark and patent pending.

Here, try them on!
77231.progress: I have given you the Technoscryers. Please! Put them on!
77231.completion:
Well done! 

I admit, the bar for putting on a pair of goggles is super low, but still! You did it!

77237.title: Unfinished Thinking Cap
77237.objectives: Take the Unfinished Thinking Cap to Fangli Hoot in Valdrakken.
77237.description: <Take the Unfinished Thinking Cap to Fangli Hoot near the Barber Shop in Valdrakken.>
77237.progress: <Fangli looks at you, but doesn't speak.>
77237.completion:
<Fangli points to your head, then to hers. She gestures for your Unfinished Thinking Cap.

She uses an arclight spanner to adjust some wires and lenses, then flips a switch. The Thinking Cap whirs to life.

Fangli hands it back to you.>

77241.title: A Foreseeable Friendship
77241.objectives: I expect great things from you. In fact, I know you have greatness in you.Keep up the good work.
77241.completion:
I expect great things from you. In fact, I know you have greatness in you.

Keep up the good work.

77242.title: Many Invader's Scourgestones
77242.progress:
An Invader's Scourgestone was the insignia of the Scourge's elite troops. These were sometimes found on the stronger of the troops positioned in Stratholme and Scholomance.

I formerly exchanged valor tokens for these. While I doubt you will ever find more, please bring any others back to me immediately so I can see to their destruction.
Invader's Scourgestone (50)
77242.completion:
More and more scourgestones pile up by the day, {NAME}, from yourself and a growing number of other adventurers.

Fortunately, none of our soldiers have mysteriously disappeared nor have I heard more bloodcurdling screams than what is normal for this region.

I would rather not ask questions. Here is your reward.

77243.title: Many Corruptor's Scourgestones
77243.progress:
A Corruptor's Scourgestone was the insignia of the Scourge's overlords. Powerful beings that once held a position of authority over the Scourge always possessed one.

I formerly exchanged valor tokens for these. While I doubt you will ever find more, please bring any others back to me immediately so I can see to their destruction.
Corruptor's Scourgestone (5)
77243.completion:
More and more scourgestones pile up by the day, {NAME}, from yourself and a growing number of other adventurers.

Fortunately, none of our soldiers have mysteriously disappeared nor have I heard more bloodcurdling screams than what is normal for this region.

I would rather not ask questions. Here is your reward.

77244.title: Many Corruptor's Scourgestones
77244.progress:
I doubt I need to give you the entire spiel about scourgestones, {NAME}, so I will cut to the chase. I am VERY interested in growing my collection, and you are VERY interested in what I have to offer.

Corruptor's Scourgestones are by far the most powerful, so we can talk business if you only have a few.

And don't tell the Argent Dawn about this! It's our little secret, right pal?
Corruptor's Scourgestone (5)
77244.completion:
Another batch of scourgestones from my best buddy, {NAME}! Thanks as always, these will go great with the rest of my hoard. Keep this up, and I will need to find a new place to stash them!

Here's a token for your trouble. I like this little back and forth trading game we got going on here. Let's keep it up.

But no, I am still not telling you what they're for.

77245.title: Many Invader's Scourgestones
77245.progress:
I doubt I need to give you the entire spiel about scourgestones, {NAME}, so I will cut to the chase. I am VERY interested in growing my collection, and you are VERY interested in what I have to offer.

Invader's Scourgestones are rather common, so I ask you bring a decent haul.

And don't tell the Argent Dawn about this! It's our little secret, right pal?
Invader's Scourgestone (50)
77245.completion:
Another batch of scourgestones from my best buddy, {NAME}! Thanks as always, these will go great with the rest of my hoard. Keep this up, and I will need to find a new place to stash them!

Here's a token for your trouble. I like this little back and forth trading game we got going on here. Let's keep it up.

But no, I am still not telling you what they're for.

77248.title: A Recognition of Skill
77248.completion:
Your accomplishments are impressive. 

Please take this as a token of our esteem. Don our colors as you continue mending the timeways.

77249.title: One of Us
77249.completion:
Perhaps you can now see the big picture. Reckless time travel can have consequences, and the damage to the timeways is extensive. 

As you can see, time is a tangled skein. You've untangled many threads, and we all benefit from your diligence. You've proven you're a hero, not just on this world but on many others.

77251.title: Shaping the Dreamsurge
77251.objectives: Gather Dreamsurge Coalescence from around the Dreamsurge.
77251.description:
The Emerald Dream is thrumming with energies not felt in ages. 

Some of that energy is even slipping through the barrier between the dream and Azeroth, coalescing into a glimmering, pollen-like powder. 

Gather as much as you can. This is not like any event we have seen before!
77251.progress: The winds sparkle with motes of dreaming essence, spreading it over the land.
77251.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. This will aid us greatly in understanding what marvels we are witnessing.

77254.title: Aiding the Accord: Time Rift
77254.description:
The Bronze Dragonflight have long labored in secret, dealing with temporal anomalies nearly as quickly as they're able to manifest. It would appear, however, that the anomalies have gotten a bit too big as of late.

That's where you come in.

You can find Soridormi leading an effort against a particularly nasty set of Time Rifts just to the east of Valdrakken. Aid her in whatever way she deems necessary.
77254.progress: Do you bring news of your success?
77254.completion:
The work of the Bronze is never complete, is it?

Please accept this humble gift, along with our gratitude.

77263.title: The Torch of Pyrreth
77263.description:
Let's begin with a simple test.

I have hidden an artifact somewhere in the Ruby Enclave.

If you have the torch out, it should illuminate when you get close to the target. And if my theory is correct, it should interact with a lock I put on the artifact.

Bring me back what's inside. Got it?
77263.progress: Return when you have retrieved what I ask.

77267.title: Excavation 101
77267.objectives: Meet with Roska outside to learn about excavation.
77267.description:
So, you want to learn how to excavate artifacts? You came to the right orc!

Turns out being able to shape the earth is useful when you're trying to get stuff out of the ground. And given how much the elements affect our work, it helps having an elemental to lend a hand.

But you don't have to be a shaman to master excavation. I've got the elements covered. I'll just walk you through the detail work.
77267.progress: What do you think? Having fun yet?
77267.completion: That's a find, all right! Look at you. You're a natural at this!

77268.title: Hands-On Experience
77268.objectives: Unearth the major find, then speak to Roska to begin excavating it.
77268.description:
Great job on that small find! Now, are you ready for something big?

More often than not, shaking up the small stuff will shake up something even BIGGER just below the surface. Another little rumble, and we'll have a major find on our hands, I can feel it.

A major find works almost the same as the smaller ones with a couple extra steps. Why don't you tackle this one too? It'll be good practice for ya.

Don't worry! I can guide you through it.
77268.progress: Rare to find big stuff like that up here! Zenata might be up to her tricks again.
77268.completion:
Look at you, master excavator! I reckon you're about ready to get into the field.

See you out in the dirt!

77276.title: An Inside Job?
77276.objectives: Speak with Fangli Hoot near the Valdrakken Barber Shop.
77276.description:
Fangli Hoot says they have a theory on who might be stealing the artifacts.

Seek her out again near the Barber Shop.
77276.completion:
I have a theory. What if this so-called "Preservationist" is stealing the artifacts, then having you return fakes instead?

I'll give you the location of a box where the Preservationist is keeping artifacts. Grab one, then follow these coordinates to an appraiser who can verify if what you find is legit.

77277.title: Preservationist Cleared
77277.objectives: Return the Burial Banner to the Preservationist's Locker in the Roasted Ram.
77277.description:
Ya better return the item before the Preservationist notices it's missing.

Then let Fangli know that her theory didn't pan out.

77281.title: Securing an Artifact
77281.completion:
One of the Preservationist's colleagues left this note.  

It says the Primalists are threatening the Life-Binder Conservatory and an important artifact is at risk. I need you to locate and secure it before the looters do. 

The coordinates on the note should work with that funny looking "Thinking Cap" you have.

77282.title: Artifact Secured
77282.objectives: Return the Torch of Pyrreth to Preservationist Kathos in Valdrakken.
77282.description: <Returning the torch to Preservationist Kathos might give insight into how it was used.>
77282.progress: Welcome back adventurer, have you found something?
77282.completion:
You found the Torch of Pyrreth! There are stories about this in the archives. You say the Preservationists sent a dispatch on it? 

It's said that the torch can enable ancient devices and illuminates when near other artifacts. I have a way for us to test it out.

Here, you take the torch and keep it safe.

77283.title: A Multi-Front Battle
77283.objectives: Meet Saelienne in the Central Encampment.
77283.description:
The kaldorei have set up a temporary base beneath the boughs of Amirdrassil.

With hope and hard work, this encampment will become permanent when the tree enters our world. 

Feel free to acquaint yourself with the provisions available. Then return to me.
77283.progress: Have you found what you needed here in camp?
77283.completion:
Tyrande has gone to investigate the Druids of the Flame, learn more about their purpose in the Emerald Dream, and identify their leaders.

How could night elves and Dream denizens turn to the flame?

I am confident that you and Tyrande can find the answer.

77284.title: A Chilling Ascent
77284.completion:
There's a clerk at General Supplies who's been one of my sources for juicy rumors.

They told me about an expedition to Vakthros in the Azure Span. Sounds like someone was looking for that torch you found.

The clerk saw their map and wrote down some coordinates. Hopefully they'll get you close.

77286.title: A Knowledgeable Descent
77286.objectives: Take the Unveiled Tablet Rubbing to Bobby Carlisle in Valdrakken.
77286.description: <The rubbing is in an ancient language. Perhaps Bobby Carlisle can get the text translated.>

77303.title: Idol Searching
77303.completion:
Another note from Kathos' order just arrived.

It says that a Maruuk artifact hidden within one of the burial mounds of the Eternal Kurgans is at risk. The note mentions ancient incense concealing the artifact from outsiders.

The rest of the info is in this note. Best of luck, adventurer!

77304.title: An Idol in Hand
77304.objectives: Return the Idol of Ohn'ahra to Preservationist Kathos in Valdrakken.
77304.description:
<The idol appears to be a figure of Ohn'ahra carved from serevite, an ore used in many titan temples.

Preservationist Kathos would surely be interested in this.>
77304.completion:
You found the Idol of Ohn'ahra! I suppose I shouldn't be surprised.

We need to get artifacts like this back to their rightful places. But if my superiors are right, we can't risk letting them fall into the wrong hands. 

Let me examine the idol.

77305.title: Out of the Sands
77305.description:
<The Time-Lost fragments are now joined to form a stone tablet, but many of its inscriptions are worn and incomplete.

Preservationist Kathos will want to see this.>
77305.progress: XENO! How was your luck in the Shifting Sands? Did you find the tablet fragments?

77310.title: Memory of the Dreamer
77310.objectives: Rest at the Eye of Ysera.
77310.description:
In the Dream, memories can live on in unusual ways. Memories are not always linear. And memories that are not of your own can become yours.

Perhaps you were drawn to this place by the presence of the once-Dreamer. Or perhaps you were drawn to this place because of my great friend. Come, won't you see?

Rest here and let the magic of the Dream wash over you.
77310.completion: Good that you are here, {NAME}. Perhaps you can lend your assistance?

77311.title: Healing Helper
77311.objectives: Use the Root Restoration Fruit to help heal Gracus.
77311.description:
Gracus sent word for Ysera to come and see him. We arrived and found him in a dire condition. 

Our efforts to heal him so far have proved fruitless. But now that you are here, you can assist.

Gracus is of the Dream. Perhaps infusing his roots with something grown here will be the final thing we need to restore him.
77311.progress: Gracus' condition is dire. We must do what we can to try to help.
77311.completion:
I was so certain we could help.

Ysera seems to be sensing something here that I cannot. After all she has been through, it seems her magic has indeed changed beyond my recognition.

77312.title: Nature Persists
77312.objectives: Collect 6 Sprouted Seedlings from Sneaky Podlings.
77312.description:
Admittedly, I do not know what to do next.

If he is to rest here... flowers would be lovely.

The podlings in this area have been hiding among the flowers. Retrieve seeds from them, Champion, and I will make them bloom.

I think Gracus will like the flowers.
77312.progress:
There must be something more that we...

No. Ysera seems certain.
77312.completion: Encouraging new growth on an occasion such as this feels right.

77313.title: A Solemn Summons
77313.description:
It is as I feared. It is Gracus' time. 

Healing him would never have worked. The world beyond already calls to him. 

Although he has such peace, those that care for him will still grieve. He will still be dearly missed. 

Not everyone is granted a chance to say goodbye. 

We must ensure that in this case, they are.
77313.progress: I am grateful we can give them this opportunity to say goodbye.
77313.completion:
There is a sense of peace in this place.

Gracus summoned me here for a reason. He knew.

77314.title: Requiem in a Dream
77314.description:
As one life ends so too will a life begin. 

We must remind those that love Gracus of this, {NAME}. 

Plant seeds around Gracus. My sister can handle the rest. 

This place will not only represent an end but also a beginning of new life.
77314.progress: These flowers will bloom around Gracus and serve as a reminder of all he helped to grow during his life.
77314.completion: Those memories... Gracus suffers. We should aid him.

77315.title: Ancient Memories
77315.description:
Those dark memories cannot be allowed to fester in the Dream.

Unleashing them was necessary. Gracus needed to let go. But if they linger, they may become malevolent.

Defeat the memory that haunts him most so that Gracus can slumber at last.
77315.progress: Грак не может в полной мере обрести покой, пока его терзают воспоминания.
77315.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. Gracus will be at peace now.

As will those who cared for him, it seems. It is not often people get a second chance to say goodbye.

77316.title: Trouble at the Tree
77316.objectives: Retrieve 6 Very Important Tree Supplies from Spriggans.
77316.description:
{NAME}! Merithra needs your help. 

Some nasty trickster spriggans followed us into the Dream and now they're causing all sorts of havoc!

Like the most important thing of all, stealing top secret super important supplies. 

It's urgent you stop them and get the supplies back.
77316.progress: If we don't get those supplies back from those pesky spriggans, we'll be so behind schedule!
77316.completion:
What a relief!

Now that we got those very important supplies back, we can get back to work around here.

77317.title: Hatted Hibernation
77317.objectives: Put 6 silly hats on Dreaming Druids.
77317.description:
I'll let you in on a secret, these crates? They're prank supplies! 

People are so serious around here. What's better than a little prank to lift everyone's spirits?

You could put some of these fun hats on some of the sleeping druids because what's more fun than a surprise hat?

Be careful though, their connection to the dream could make anything happen!
77317.progress: Napping in the Dream... I wonder what they're dreaming about!
77317.completion:
I'm impressed. I thought I was pranking you too!

But looks like you're better at this than I expected... 

Maybe it's time for a real challenge.

77318.title: Merithra Says
77318.objectives: Give instructions to 5 druids while disguised as Merithra.
77318.description:
Some druids are volunteering to help tend to the tree and set up camp.  

But they're so sad! 

<Lady Moonberry grows a mischievous grin.> 

We have to give them a reason to smile. You can give them some orders that remind them to have fun. 

But there's no way they'll take orders from you. 

That's why I got this costume for you. With this and a little spell they'll for sure listen to you!
77318.progress:
You're clearly a master prankster but you'll have to be a master actor as well.  

A costume and a spell can only do so much.
77318.completion:
Your performance as Merithra was unmatched.

<Lady Moonberry bursts into laughter.> 

I can hardly tell you two apart!

77325.title: To the Archives!
77325.objectives: Speak with Lead Archivist Eadweard Dalyngrigge at Algeth'ar Academy.
77325.description:
Are you a scholar, historian, or a high-minded intellectual? Do you enjoy heavy, mindless labor in exchange for gold?

Then take hold of your future, and join the newly budding ranks of the Azerothian Archives!*

<Your eyes move to the fine print near the parchment's edge.>

*Temporary offices are located at the Algeth'ar Academy in northern Thaldraszus.
77325.completion:
Finally! The delivery {class} is here with our meal orders!

Oh... you're here to join the Archives? Of course! My mistake.

But if you do see a delivery person around, please point them my way, would you?

77327.title: Nirobin and the Office
77327.objectives: Speak with Nirobin at his office in Thaldraszus.
77327.description:
Perhaps there is more to investigate, but I need time to go over our findings here first.

Our colleague, Nirobin, the one arcane projecting himself into the headquarters, should be ready for your assistance by now. He's got his own office at the Academy in Thaldraszus that he tends to squirrel himself away in.

I'm positive he'll be there... Mostly because he never leaves it.
77327.completion:
Are you the new recruit? 

Since you're late, I simply assumed you had been swallowed up by the outside... like I am in my ever-reoccurring nightmares.

It's nice to meet you in person, I suppose.

77328.title: Back to Headquarters!
77328.objectives: Meet with Eadweard Dalyngrigge at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
77328.description:
Eadweard called for your return to the main office after I'd finished with you... er, this experiment, I mean.

I'm sure it has to do with pomp, circumstance, reward, and what have you. If any of that entices you, then best hurry before his bag of goodies runs dry to all the other recent recruits.
77328.completion:
Good show, {NAME}!

I had heard high praise of you from Roska and Zenata, but hearing from Nirobin as well... Well! You must be truly exceptional. He has, shall we say, discerning taste!

But enough about that. You've done more than enough to consider yourself a premier Azerothian Archivist.

Welcome to the team!

77329.title: Auspicious Gathering
77329.objectives: Speak with Tyrande Whisperwind in the Central Encampment.
77329.description:
As you know, Amirdrassil is no ordinary tree. Tyrande Whisperwind and the rest of the kaldorei have been preparing to properly welcome it with a ceremony of their own, and establish a new moonwell. 

I am certain that Tyrande would want you there for the dedication.

Let us join them at the Central Encampment.
77329.completion: Amirdrassil is everything we had hoped for. Let us properly honor its arrival.

77331.title: Graduation Day
77331.objectives: Receive congratulations from your Azerothian Archivist peers.
77331.description:
You've turned out to be quite a fine member of our high-skilled crew of rag tags and diggers of dirt.

Between the sites you've broken ground on with Roska, Zenata, and Nirobin, as well as the larger one in Traitor's Rest, the varied histories collected by these Dragon Isles have never been more ripe for the harvest.

There will always be work and companionship here when you desire it. We hope you'll join us on other continents as well.

...When we receive appropriate funding, that is.
77331.progress: Worry not. I've already written to our benefactors of your efforts.
77331.completion:
To you, {NAME}! 

To your supportive efforts, to your spirit of discovery, and to your care for history!

May all those with joyfully voracious appetites for learning find homes and friends like these!

77339.title: Data Recovery
77339.objectives: Meet Travard at the Tyr's Guard headquarters.
77339.description:
After a lot of rigorous training, the time has come! Travard believes the Tyr's Guard is ready to recover the disc of Tyr from the Nighthold. 

Meet us at Tyr's Rest, the new Tyr's Guard headquarters. It's just south of Tyrhold. 

We will finally make Tyr whole again!
77339.completion: There you are, {NAME}. Ready to finally get that disc?

77340.title: Infiltrating the Nighthold
77340.objectives: Retrieve the Disc of Tyr from Elisande in the Nighthold.
77340.description:
The information from our beacons suggests that Elisande has locked the disc away in Astromancer's Rise.

It is a place of learning, and the inside will have minimal protection. I have opened a portal where you and the Tyr's Guard will have the least resistance... except for Elisande and whatever guards are under her employ.

All of you are on your own once you get there, so try not to muck it up.
77340.progress: I wonder what Tyr is like? I bet he's super nice!
77340.completion: Glad everyone made it, {NAME}! We have the disc, the Silver Scale, and Tyr is reforged. Amazing, let's bring Tyr back!

77341.title: Logotyrapy
77341.objectives: Speak with Tyr at Tyr's Rest.
77341.description:
Dear $p,

It seems wrong to say this of someone as mighty as Tyr, but I am worried about him. When he arrived at Tyr's Rest, he spent many days talking with us. We all asked him many questions, learning about the titans, ancient history, and his philosophy.

But recently, Tyr has been speaking less, and the answers he does give are shorter and some have an edge to them.

I'm not sure what's wrong, but something is different. Will you come speak with him?

For Tyr,
Valunei
77341.progress: Tyr seems restless. Perhaps you could talk to him, {NAME}?
77341.completion:
I hope, {NAME}, that we can find the greater purpose for which we've been reforged. For both Tyr, and the Tyr's Guard.

Perhaps that search is the next step of our journey.

77342.title: Disc Delivery
77342.objectives: Insert the Disc of Tyr into the titan console.
77342.description:
You have recovered the disc? 

Good. At last, we can awake Tyr.

The disc must be placed in the console so it can attune to the Silver Scale and pass on to Tyr.

I believe you should do the honors, $p.
77342.progress: Did you place the disc in the titan console?
77342.completion: Tyr is with us once more. I can hardly believe it. Thank you, {NAME}.

77343.title: A Tyrful Reunion
77343.objectives: Listen to the Aspects' conversation with Tyr.
77343.description:
This is incredible, seeing our friend back after so many thousands of years. So much has happened since we last spoke.

The world has changed. Our loss of Tyr was before even the Sundering. But there will be time to discuss all those things later. For now, it's simply good to be with our friend. Stay with us, will you, $p, while we reconnect?
77343.progress: One moment, {NAME}--I want to hear what Tyr and the aspects are saying!
77343.completion: I almost can't believe we've arrived at this moment, {NAME}. So many years spent serving the Tyr's Guard, seeing those watching Tyr's tomb die out--and now both he and the Guard are alive again!

77344.title: Time to Process
77344.objectives: Invite Tyr to join the Tyr's Guard at Tyr's Rest.
77344.description:
Tyr is back after thousands of years. I don't even know how many thousands. His world has changed more than we can even imagine. He's going to have many questions and need answers. 

Meanwhile, there's nothing any of the Tyr's Guard would rather do than talk with Tyr. Tyr's Rest seems like the perfect place to give him time, answer questions, and process those answers. Would you ask him to join us there?
77344.progress: We certainly live in interesting times, {NAME}...
77344.completion:
It is so good to be able to talk with Tyr directly. We have so much to tell him, and I know we all want to ask him questions. 

Thank you for making this possible, {NAME}!

77345.title: The Need For Higher Velocities
77345.objectives: Fly through the rings and land in the target area.
77345.description:
Sometimes you'll need to travel longer distances.

If you don't need to travel up and over any obstacles using Surge Forward is the easiest way to maintain a good forward speed to prevent yourself from plummeting out of the sky.

Follow the rings again to your destination and use Surge Forward when prompted to maintain your speed.

If you find yourself stuck, use the Bronze Timepiece and Celormu will reset you.
77345.completion: Well done. The rest is now a matter of practice.

77377.title: To Tyrhold! For Tyr!
77377.description:
We recovered. We trained. And now it's time to face Elisande. 

Come with us to Tyrhold where Nozdormu, Chromie, and Eternus are waiting to send us to the Nighthold.

We will get that disc, and Tyr will finally be with us once more.
77377.completion:
Are you sure you are ready to go to the Nighthold?

Are you sure you know what you are up against with this "Elisande"?

77408.title: Prophecy Stirs
77408.objectives: Use the Teleportation Crystal to meet Prophet Velen aboard the Vindicaar.
77408.description:
Prophet Velen has roused from meditation and he requests your immediate presence.

A matter of great import has come to his attention. He would value both your wisdom and strength in addressing it.

The Prophet awaits you aboard the Vindicaar.

Take this crystal. Our artificers have attuned it to the ship's teleportation matrix.
77408.progress: I am thankful that you could make this journey.
77408.completion:
Fear not, {NAME}. For once, the situation is not dire.

In fact, I am... tentatively hopeful. Though that hope is tempered with concern.

77409.title: Uncertainty
77409.objectives: Speak to Chieftain Hatuun in Krokuun.
77409.description:
Scattered visions came to me as I meditated. Yellow and red. Shattering glass. A rush of warmth. I see my own hand, but I am afraid to grasp it. The scent of fel--of Argus.

When I awoke, a message had been delivered. Hatuun wishes to meet.

After the defeat of the Legion, I offered to help Hatuun and his people rejoin us. However, they chose to remain on Argus. 

Hatuun has seldom reached out to us since then. Perhaps he has reconsidered.

I will make the journey to Krokuun. Please, join me.
77409.progress: I did not expect Velen to come. He has surprised me.
77409.completion:
Let us see if Velen delivers the aid he once promised.

There is nothing preventing him this time.

77410.title: Opening Wounds
77410.objectives: Speak to Arzal'kal and listen to what he has to say.
77410.description:
My hunters were the ones who found Arzal'kal. They said he helped them fight off several Legion ambushes.

During our endless vigil on Argus, we had seen nothing like it. He was not as powerful as some demons, but he was persistent.

He said he wished to speak with Velen and knew that we had been in contact with him. So, I have fulfilled his request.

If Velen is all he claims to be, then he would not turn away even the least worthy of his people.

We will see. I expect little.
77410.progress:
If Hatuun called me here to listen, then I will.

I owe Hatuun that respect.
77410.completion:
Whatever it is that Arzal'kal wishes to show you, please accompany him.

I must stay here and speak with Hatuun in private.

77411.title: Contrition
77411.objectives: Meet Arzal'kal in the Grove of Naroua, then slay Speaker Nalridun and retrieve the ancient draenic relic.
77411.description:
The man'ari have grown desperate since the Legion fell. Some grasp for power. Some isolate themselves. Others have formed cults awaiting the return of Sargeras. They have faith that he will lead them again one day.

Nalridun is the leader of one such cult. They are reclusive, but it is rumored that he has seized an ancient relic that Kil'jaeden kept until his death. Nalridun claims to use it to commune with Sargeras.

I believe I know what this relic is. If I am correct, it must be returned to Velen.
77411.progress: Even if I die here, at least it will not be at the Legion's whim.
77411.completion:
It is done. 

One evil rectified. 

It is all I allowed myself to hope for.

77412.title: Proof and Promise
77412.objectives: Deliver the Brilliant Star to Prophet Velen in Krokuun.
77412.description:
Reinforcements are unlikely, but the relic is too important to risk. You should return to Prophet Velen with it immediately.

There is a teleporter just ahead that I can attune to a sigil of my own. It will provide you swift passage.

I will rejoin you later.
77412.progress:
I sense something of great power in your possession.

It feels... familiar. But placing the memory feels like grasping at sunlight.

Did Arzal'kal lead you to something?

77414.title: Dreamsurge Investigation
77414.description:
The Emerald Dream bleeding over into Azeroth is unprecedented, {NAME}. We need to understand exactly what is being affected by this phenomenon if we're to prepare ourselves for what is to come.

Perhaps we can even turn this to our advantage.

Head out into the affected area and see what you can learn. Bring back anything of interest and we will see what can be done.
77414.completion: With this information, {NAME}, we should be able to shape the Dreamsurge to our advantage. Thank you.

77415.title: The Hidden Hand
77415.objectives: Search hornswog treasure piles for Neltharion agent items.
77415.description:
Catching him at the very moment he's alone? They must've been watching somewhere nearby but just out of sight. Can you check that cave across the water?

Those hornswogs are known hoarders. If those drakonid left something behind, it may still be there.

77417.title: What Makes an Infinite
77417.objectives: See what Eternus has to reveal.
77417.description:
Eternus clearly has something she wishes to impart to us. I am unsure where this conversation will lead. 

But I trust Chromie. If she believes that Eternus can be swayed, I trust her judgment.

When you are ready, I will see what she has to say.
77417.progress: I am interested in learning what Eternus wishes to say.
77417.completion: So the loss of her sister, Moraidormi, is at the root of everything...

77423.title: Surging Dreams
77423.objectives: Meet the druids investigating the Dreamsurge.
77423.description:
Change is coming, {NAME}. Those attuned to the Emerald Dream can feel it on the wind.

We need your aid in uncovering what this change entails.

Let us reconvene in the affected area and formulate a plan.
77423.completion: This nascent "Dreamsurge" is affecting us all. We have much to investigate.

77425.title: The Scale of it All
77425.objectives: Search near the Zaqali Quartermaster for any record of Tuskarr trading.
77425.description:
The Djaradin were trading harpoons with the Tuskarr? I suppose fish harpoons don't cut it when you're dealing with a dragon.

How big was this shipment do you think? Check around the Zaqali Quartermaster and see if they held onto any ancestral records.
77425.progress: I know Djaradin aren't normally known for their record-keeping, but there must be something...
77425.completion: You're back! With good news, I hope?

77426.title: Practice Makes Perfect: Rusziona
77426.objectives: Help Rusziona glide through the rings.

77427.title: Practice Makes Perfect: Zhusadormu
77427.objectives: Help Zhusadormu glide through the rings.

77429.title: Practice Makes Perfect: Posidriss
77429.objectives: Help Posidriss glide through the rings.

93811.title: Renowned with the Silvermoon Court
93811.objectives: Speak with Caeris Fairdawn at Saltheril's Haven.
93811.description:
The people of Quel'thalas appreciate your continued support. With threats on all sides, it is good to know we can rely on champions such as yourself to protect us.

The Court wishes to reward you for your efforts.
93811.completion: The Sunwell stands another day because of you. Go with the blessings of the Sin'dorei.

93566.title: Renowned with the Amani Tribe
93566.objectives: Speak with Magovu in Amani'Zar Village.
93566.description:
You continue to prove yourself to de Amani and de other forest tribes alike.

Speak to me when next you are in Amani'Zar. Zul'jarra asked me to put a few items aside as our way of sayin' thanks.
93566.completion:
Take this, hash'ura. 

Continue provin' your strength, and we'll continue to show you our honor.

95391.title: Ritual Site Renowned
95391.objectives: Speak with Lady Darkglen in Silvermoon City.
95391.description:
Adventurer you have shown a flair for dealing with these Ritual Sites. 

It is only appropriate that we should reward you for your continued assistance.
95391.completion:
My have you been busy. I again applaud your efforts. I fear some day you may not need any assistance in dealing with these Rituals. 

Alas, that is not today, but take this reward it will help you continue to hone your skills and tactics out there.

94492.title: Paragon of the Slayer's Duellum
94492.objectives: Speak with Thraxadar in Masters' Perch.
94492.completion:
{NAME}, your contributions to the Slayer's Duellum have not gone unnoticed.

Take this reward for your efforts.

77430.title: Practice Makes Perfect: Belastrasza
77430.objectives: Help Belastrasza glide through the rings.

77432.title: Pedgi the Parched
77432.objectives: Get Pedgi a drink from the inn's bartender.
77432.description:
Pedgi's being dramatic. Again.

I know it seems childish, and that's because it is childish, but he responds well to little treats when he's in a mood.

Could you get him a coffee from the bar downstairs?
77432.progress: Pedgi's treat should get him to stop moping. By the titans, I can't believe I had to say that...
77432.completion: I knew musicians were a temperamental sort, but this is ridiculous. At least he's up.

77433.title: Excavation: Riverbed
77433.objectives: Meet Roska Rocktooth at the Riverbed dig site in Ohn'ahran Plains.
77433.description:
There's a Riverbed near Maruukai in Ohn'ahran Plains that's teeming with local lore about a lost caravan!

Meet me there as quick as you can! And wear your best, old, mud-ready boots!
77433.completion: We'll shake up the centaur world with this find!

77434.title: Technoscrying: Observatory
77434.objectives: Meet Zenata at the Concord Observatory in Waking Shores.
77434.description:
My dowsing rods have been pointing towards a set of Drakonid ruins atop a cliff in Waking Shores.

I know not what we'll find, but it's never wise to question the whims of my inventions. They're always 97% correct. 

Always.
77434.completion: Shall we peek into the past of these crumbling stones?

77436.title: The Burning Barrow
77436.objectives: Find Tyrande near the Sor'theril Barrow Den.
77436.description:
Fyrakk's forces have already set their plans in motion. We are one step behind, and we need to catch up quickly if we are to properly protect Amirdrassil.

While you were on your way here, we received word of suspicious-looking figures entering one of the nearby barrow dens. Tyrande already went to investigate. Seek her out and lend her your aid.
77436.completion: Your arrival is timely, {class}. I require another set of hands.

77437.title: Eon's Fringe
77437.objectives: Find Bartender Bob in Eon's Fringe.
77437.description:
Timewalker Tempo and their team finally unfroze Eon's Fringe!

Er... mostly. The Timewalkers have things more or less under control but Eon's Fringe has some problems the people of the town wouldn't mind a hand with. 

Tell Bob I sent ya!

77483.title: Technoscrying: Dragonskull Island
77483.objectives: Meet Zenata at Dragonskull Cave in Forbidden Reach.
77483.description:
I tuned my various sensors for Dracthyr relics, and they've triangulated a new location for us to investigate off the eastern coast of the Forbidden Reach.

The local Drakonid tell me it's named Dragonskull Island. Ominous, no?  You're not easily frightened, are you?
77483.completion: My preliminary sensors are peaking when near the cave entrances. What we're looking for is most certainly inside.

77484.title: Technoscrying: Igira's Watch
77484.objectives: Meet Zenata at Igira's Watch in Zaralek Cavern.
77484.description:
Of all places, my sensors are indicating a site of interest beneath the surface in Zaralek Cavern. 

Best bring a weapon for this excursion. My preliminary scouting indicated a elevated  presence of both lava and djaradin.
77484.completion: They seem willing to leave this cave well enough alone, don't they...

77485.title: Technoscrying: Back to Eadweard!
77485.objectives: Meet Eadweard Dalyngrigge at the Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
77485.description:
Thanks for all your help!

Let's head back to Eadward and the others back at the Academy to go over all the new information we've uncovered.

77486.title: Excavation: Gaze of Neltharion
77486.objectives: Meet Roska Rocktooth at the Gaze of Neltharion in Zaralek Cavern.
77486.description:
A Niffen colleague of mine gave me the underground info about an underground tower. It's decrepit and smack-dab in the middle of Zaralek between Loamm, the Djaradin, and that ghastly lab of Neltharion's.

Grab your favorite shovel and meet me there!
77486.completion: Let's do as the Niffen do and sniff out these hidden histories.

77487.title: Excavation: Winglord's Perch
77487.objectives: Meet Roska Rocktooth at Winglord's Perch in Forbidden Reach.
77487.description:
We've discovered an ancient fishing village in the Forbidden Reach! It's this humble isle off the northwest coast with its own crumbling bridge and everything!

I'll be there if you're looking for more dirt to dig up!
77487.completion:
{NAME}! You made it!

That sea air really wakes you up!

77488.title: Excavation: Back to Eadweard!
77488.objectives: Meet Eadweard Dalyngrigge at the Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
77488.description:
Great job, {NAME}!

We've got plenty of history to report back to Eadweard with. Let's meet back at the Academy!

77644.title: The Scarlet Key
77644.objectives: <Though dirt and rust have accumulated on these keys, the one you currently possess looks no different otherwise.>.
77644.progress:
<Though dirt and rust have accumulated on these keys, the one you currently possess looks no different otherwise.>
The Scarlet Key (1)
77644.completion: <As you return the key to its rightful place, it may prove difficult to ignore the passing curiosity of what it may unlock. Given the evident abandonment of those already present, surely no one would be the wiser if you chose to borrow it in the future.>

77653.title: A Key Story
77653.objectives: Seek out Weaponsmith Koref and interview him about the key.
77653.description:
Here for the latest? Well, have I got news for you.

A weaponsmith was just here visiting Tithris. Koref, I think? Couldn't help but overhear their discussion about some sort of ancient key. Might be of interest to you, what with all your artifact hunting.

Weaponsmith Koref was headed back to the Obsidian Enclave. You should head there and get the scoop about this ancient key.
77653.completion:
Have you ever heard of the Titan Key? Tall as a dwarf, magically imbued. The titans used a special mold to forge the key, but it's been lost for ages. 

However, as fortune would have it, Tithris found a book that he believes leads to that very mold! Problem is, the text isn't exactly straightforward. And I'm terrible at reading between the lines.

But hey, with all your experience finding artifacts, maybe you could give it a shot! I'd be happy to forge the key if you find the mold.

77662.title: A Call to Aid
77662.objectives: Meet with Shandris and Lilian in the Lushdream Crags.
77662.description:
Ah, so you are $p?

Hm, I suppose Lilian consorts with heroes of all sorts now...

Lilian sent me with a message. She and Shandris have been tasked with tracking a powerful Druid of the Flame.

He continues to elude them, but with your assistance, they believe they can corner him and his dryad conspirators.

Seek them out if you are able to aid them.
77662.completion:
{NAME}. Good.

We have cornered our quarry. Let me brief you on our mission.

77664.title: One Last Step
77664.description:
This operation would not have come this far without Lilian's aid. 

We may not have much in common, but Lillian is a... dependable ally. After fighting side-by-side in the Dream, we have an odd kinship that was forged by this mission.

Together, we will finish this. With the stones in our hands, it is now safe to take out Raelas and end his little crusade.

Onward.
77664.completion:
That was a... 

<Shandris's gaze is locked on something else and she seems deep in thought. She then shakes her head as if to clear it.>

I... Shae'lune would probably like to take a look at these... stones.

77665.title: Bound to You
77665.objectives: Ask Shae'lune about the cleansing the stones.
77665.description:
I haven't worked with Shandris long, but... it's unusual for her to act like that.

But it doesn't matter.

While she deals with logistics, you and I should go ahead and find a way to cleanse these stones.

Maybe Shae'lune knows what to do next.
77665.completion: It will be hard to deal with these stones if Shandris is off somewhere.

77673.title: Under the Surface
77673.description:
I knew coming into this that Shandris likes to work alone, but letting us know where she's going would be nice.

Not a great turn in our professional relationship.

Keeper Sillas won't speak to me...

We should take a look around the camp. Maybe she left a note or some clue... maybe in her mission log?

Take a look, and see if you can get anything out of Sillas. 

I'll wait here in case she comes back.
77673.completion:
I haven't known Shandris for long, but her behavior is out of line.

And out of character.

I wonder...

77674.title: Wounds of the Past
77674.objectives: Talk to Shandris and help her back to the camp.
77674.description:
It's all making sense now. I believe the missing dream spirit bonded with her--like Cyanthesa said.

It's making Shandris relive traumatic moments from her life. 

It's not malicious, but the spirit and Shandris are feeding off each others' fears. We have to bring her back to the camp. Shae'lune might be able to help her.

Talk to her. I look like the enemy right now. But maybe she'll talk to you.
77674.completion:
I thought that Shandris was venting her anger on me because I am Forsaken. 

I thought now that we had finished the task, she was done with me.

Wouldn't be the first time.

But I'm glad I was wrong. I have come to have... a great respect for her and her abilities.

We have to help her.

77675.title: A Better Future, Together
77675.objectives: Help Shae'lune perform the separation ritual on Shandris.
77675.description:
{NAME}, we need to work with Shae'lune and help her perform the purification ritual on Shandris.

Shae'lune says she's only done it on objects before--not people. There is some... risk involved.

But I've come to know Shandris. She'd do the same for me.

Talk to Shae'lune and follow her instructions.
77675.progress: I will help Shandris as best I can. It's the least I can do for another soldier.
77675.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}, for helping us with Raelas and with the spirit stones.

I will take care of Shandris for now and help her back to Amirdrassil soon.

77679.title: To Soridormi's Aid
77679.objectives: Speak with Soridormi in Tyrhold Reservoir.
77679.description:
Have you heard? Time rifts are opening in Tyrhold Reservoir! It's a catastrophe! Folks have seen portals to other timeways randomly appearing. Now all kinds of fantastic creatures are swarming into Azeroth.

Thank goodness for Soridormi. I heard she's getting everyone organized to make a stand. If you can offer any assistance, I'm sure she could use it.

They say she's still stationed in Tyrhold Reservoir. Do it for Valdrakken. Do it for Azeroth!
77679.completion:
We're facing dangerous anomalies called "time rifts." We've been a little too reckless with our time travel. Now creatures from alternate timeways are entering our world, and we need to push them back.

The situation is quickly getting out of hand. We could use any help we can get. Do what I say when I say it, and we can all prevent the fabric of reality from unraveling.

You look like you can handle the challenge. Get out there and fight!

77681.title: Alerting all Adversaries!
77681.objectives: Deliver the leaflet to Calderax in the Gladiator's Refuge of Valdrakken.
77681.description:
The Artisan's Consortium has struck another deal with the quartermasters of the Gladiator's Refuge!

In addition to the usual selection of powerful combat equipment they offer, worthy combatants can purchase tokens that can be used in Crafting Orders or one's own crafts to certify the equipment for use in battlegrounds and arenas!

Present this leaflet to Calderax to receive two complimentary Trophies of Conquest, on us!

- Rabul
77681.completion:
Wait... is this what I think it is? Are we doing this promotion AGAIN? You have no idea how many of these fliers I got last time.

Well, here are your trophies, as promised. Use them when crafting your own equipment or submitting Crafting Orders and the gear will be comparable in power to what I offer. It is perfect if you are looking for something highly specific or imbued with a certain embellishment... and are willing to put in some extra work.

Questions? Take them to the Artisan's Market.

77697.title: The Right Food...
77697.objectives: Bring some fertilizer for the plant.
77697.description:
<The plant is now a promising sapling and has thrived with the attention you've given.

Peering closely at the plant's leaves, you see its exterior brimming with dew. Perhaps the right food will help the plant even further.>
77697.progress: <The plant is hydrated, but remains severely underfed.>
77697.completion: <The soil around the sapling glows faintly.>

77711.title: And a Pinch of Magic
77711.objectives: Defeat Roottenders while they are under the effects of the Druidic Totem.
77711.description:
The diligence you've shown here is astounding, {NAME}. I never suspected that someone who couldn't even find their own bucket, could do something like this.

I think the sapling is almost there, and with my help we can bring it the rest of the way.

Take this totem and place it near some of the weakened, flame-corrupted Roottenders found in the Singing Fen. This should siphon the unstable magical energies out of their bodies and transform it into something we can use.
77711.completion:
Perfect!

Hand it here and I'll release the stored energy into the surrounding soil.

77739.title: Smother the Flames
77739.objectives: Help Shandris and Lilian retrieve the spirit stones from the Sisters of Flame dryads.
77739.description:
Lilian and I have been shadowing Raelas Firewind and have uncovered his plan. He has manipulated the Sisters of the Flame to bind spirits from the Dream to magical spirit stones.

With Raelas's blessing, these stones became powerful tools of corruption, allowing these fallen dryads to twist the Dream and its denizens.

We will start our purge with the dryads--they have the stones. Then we will end Raelas.

The hunt begins, $p.
77739.progress: Bring me all four spirit stones. We must keep them close so they do not fall into the wrong hands.
77739.completion:
Good!

<Shandris stashes the spirit stones in a small, leather pouch.>

Now, let us put an end to Raelas's madness.

77760.title: Curious Find: Dragonhorn Flute
77760.objectives: Bring the Dragonhorn Flute to Eadweard Dalyngrigge at the Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
77760.description:
<This flute is inexpertly hewn out of the horn of a dragon. The cracking around the base suggests the dragon was long gone by the time the flute was made.

The mouthpiece is strange. It's almost like it isn't designed to be played with the mouth at all but the nose. Could this flute have been crafted by the niffen?

Eadweard would know how to preserve this find and figure out whom it might belong to.>
77760.completion: Aha! A curious find. I shall reach out to the appropriate parties immediately, and we can have it documented and returned to its home post-haste.

77762.title: A Little Hope is Never Without Worth
77762.description:
The plant has matured and is thriving. And with this little corner of our ecosystem restored, we've seen something I've been wishing for since I learned what you were up to: the dreamtalons have returned with their kits!

One of the grateful mature dreamtalons has offered their services to you, if you wish it.
77762.completion: If you treat this Dreamtalon like you've treated this plant, they're very lucky indeed.

77763.title: Curious Find: Waterlogged Ledger
77763.objectives: Bring the Waterlogged Ledger to Eadweard Dalyngrigge at the Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
77763.description:
<This leather-bound ledger is so waterlogged it's nearly falling apart.

Most of it is illegible, but the text that has survived is in an ancient draconic dialect. It appears to be lists and lists of ordinary items, with numbers assigned to them-- perhaps a household accounting book?

Eadweard would know how to preserve this find and figure out whom it might belong to.>
77763.completion: Aha! A curious find. I shall reach out to the appropriate parties immediately, and we can have it documented and returned to its home post-haste.

77766.title: Curious Find: Hole-Punched Bakar Tooth
77766.objectives: Bring the Hole-Punched Bakar Tooth to Eadweard Dalyngrigge at the Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
77766.description:
<This milk-tooth came from a young bakar, though the way the bone has yellowed suggests it's thousands of years old.

Someone has carefully drilled a hole at the top of this tooth to turn it into a bead. Upon closer examination, the tattered remains of a woolen cord can still be seen threaded through it.

Eadweard would know how to preserve this find and figure out whom it might belong to.>
77766.completion: Aha! A curious find. I shall reach out to the appropriate parties immediately, and we can have it documented and returned to its home post-haste.

77779.title: The Tale of Sir Thomas
77779.description:
Suzannah... I never thought I would find her. Now we can return to our children, and rest at last. All thanks to you, {NAME}.

Do you still have my tome? My story has reached its end, and I would see it penned by my own hand.

<Thomas glides his finger across a blank page, spectral ink marking his words.>

Please return this to the Orphan Matron. And... please apologize on my behalf for frightening her, would you?
77779.completion:
It is over, then? The Headless Horseman is defeated once more, and the fallen paladin is free and at rest.

What happened to the people of Lordaeron was horrifying. The least they deserve is peace in death. The tale of Sir Thomas is a harrowing one--a reminder and a warning of what horrors blind zealotry brings. 

I am glad that you helped him find his peace, {NAME}.

77780.title: A Blossom Witnessed
77780.objectives: Speak with Merithra at the Ancient Bough in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
77780.description:
Amirdrassil has bloomed beyond the confines of the Dream.

Let us venture to the Dragon Isles and see where this new World Tree has taken root.
77780.completion:
<Merithra's face lights up.>

Champion, we are among the very first to see Amirdrassil here on Azeroth. This is truly a precious moment.

77781.title: A Different Enthusiasm
77781.description:
I noticed the festivities have drawn the attention of a few spriggans from Ardenweald. They are curious creatures with... interesting tastes.

Their pranks have been more than disruptive. Please root them out so the celebration may continue in peace.
77781.progress: Have you discovered all of them? I have already heard a middling rumor that I suspect they spun up.
77781.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. I appreciate their liveliness, but they are not on our guest list tonight.

77788.title: Ashphodel Research Notes
77788.description:
<You find some singed research notes on the slain druid. 
 
The notes detail experiments being carried out by the Druids of the Flame.  

You learn that they have created an unusual pollen capable of infusing dream flora with their flame-imbued magic. The next stage targets the local wildlife with the same pollen. 
 
Q'onzu would definitely be interested in a sample of the pollen and these notes.>
77788.progress: <Q'onzu blinks slowly as they stare down at you.>
77788.completion:
That...was devastatingly mundane. Soot and ash, forever unchanged? 
 
<Q'onzu shakes their enormous head.> 
 
No. I do not like.

77789.title: Severing Ties
