77789.objectives: Slay 10 man'ari cultists and overload 5 Sargerei Conduits.
77789.description:
Nalridun has recruited a small army of cultists. They believe he speaks for Sargeras through the relic, clinging to every word he says. The same way we clung to our leaders when Sargeras came to Argus. It was a comfort. A hope.

And, in the end, empty deception.

But his followers do not believe they are deceived. They have constructed their own conduits in the area to try to tap into the relic's power. To hear the voice themselves.

They will try to stop us. We must cut a path through them.
77789.progress:
May their delusions die with them.

We cannot risk any power they might be adding to Nalridun's rituals.
77789.completion:
I know what it is to be scared. But they had a choice, and they chose to stay on the path that we built atop the smoldering remains of countless worlds. 

Why, when our home was the first of the worlds we destroyed?

77791.title: Handling It: Symbiotic Glowspore Grip
77791.objectives: Seek out Erden in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
77791.description:
I know a crafter who could help temper Fyr'alath. Erden of Clan Shikaar is extremely resourceful. He's performed many experiments with various reagents throughout the Dragon Isles.

Hunters are only as good as their weapons. Erden is known for crafting exquisite weaponry with exotic materials. His expertise in various flora and fauna should prove quite informative.
77791.completion:
I see. 

That axe would certainly be painful to wield. Let me think for a moment.

77802.title: What Do I Call You?
77802.objectives: Speak with Dionaessa to choose a title in the Root-Bound Sanctuary.
77802.description:
Guardian! Or... teacher! Parent?

I want you to tell me what to call you. The other dryads will ask me who my druid is now that I am working in the garden on my own.

I want to tell them that I do not have a druid. I have you!

Tell me what title you prefer.
77802.progress: I have heard so many titles from the druid Creekward. I am certain we can come up with something far more interesting.
77802.completion:
What an excellent title! I will use it as often as I can.

Thank you.

77813.title: Lightning Strikes
77813.objectives: Meet Lord Andestrasz at the Skytop Observatory.
77813.description:
<Flaps does a spin and deposits a drool-soaked note into your hand.>

Ah, {NAME}. I am told you have acquired a fine new mount. A gryphon that soars upon the very storm itself!

I would very much like to see how this wondrous creature flies. I will await you at Skytop Observatory.
77813.completion: Hello again, {NAME}. Now, let us see about this gryphon!

77815.title: The Storm Race Tour
77815.objectives: Fly each of the Storm Race courses around the Dragon Isles.
77815.description:
This storm gryphon is intriguing! Whatever land gave rise to such a creature merits further exploration.

But since you are here, let us test its training--and your riding skills.

My colleagues in the bronze flight have laid out new courses to put the mount through its paces. When a timekeeper sees you upon your gryphon, they will offer you the chance to fly these "storm races".

Fortune favors the bold, $p. Good luck!
77815.completion:
Well done! This storm gryphon is indeed an impressive creature. May you share many wondrous adventures!

Fair skies and strong winds, {NAME}.

77818.title: The Cruel
77818.objectives: Help Merithra close the flaming portal.
77818.description:
Primalists, djaradin, and Druids of the Flame all work together against us.

But I can sense that this is not the last of them. Something powerful is trying to come through this portal. Let us try to seal them out for as long as we can.
77818.completion:
I am glad you made it out. We have no choice but to retreat to the tree, before Fyrakk's forces arrive.

And Elder Cassaphine... I fear that she has already been lost to this prophecy of flame.

77822.title: A Titanic Mold
77822.objectives: Return the Titan Key Mold to Weaponsmith Koref in Valdrakken.
77822.description: <The Titan Key Mold was at the location referenced in the story. Weaponsmith Koref will be so excited to see the mold!>
77822.progress: By the forge, did you actually do it? Did you find the Titan Key mold?

77829.title: Reforging a Legend
77829.objectives: Seek out Weaponsmith Koref in the Obsidian Enclave.
77829.description:
There you are! Weaponsmith Koref was just looking for you. Left me with a note asking you to meet him in the Obsidian Conclave.

Sounds like you're helping him reforge an ancient titan key? Let me know how it goes! That's headline news if I ever heard it.
77829.completion:
We'll need rare materials for the key. Some special gold dust and flux. You'll find them both in the Waking Shores.

After you find the materials, meet me at the Earth-Warder's Forge in the Obsidian Citadel. That's where I'll forge the Titan Key. And take my place amongst blacksmith legends, should my anvil strike true.

Here, this note that has all the details. We're so close, {class}!

77831.title: A Key To Reforg(ing)
77831.objectives: Assist Weaponsmith Koref in reforging the Titan Key.
77831.description:
You have the final materials! Perfect.

I prepared the forge and the mold. I just need you to add the ingredients when I say.

Oh, and be ready to use that Torch of Pyrreth. Seems the relic is crucial to the forging process. I'll tell you when!
77831.progress: The Titan Key. By the forge... Let me have a look.
77831.completion:
This is amazing! And it's already cool to the touch? What incredible magic.

Hmm. There's writing on the shaft. I don't recognize most of it, but this is Tyr's symbol. I'll create a quick sketch of the rest of the entire message and see what I can find out.

I'd say the key is safest with you. Besides, what's a key without a lock? And if anyone can find a titan lock in need of opening, it would be you.

77833.title: Handling It: Concentrated Sophic Vellum
77833.objectives: Seek out Shalasar Glimmerdusk in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
77833.description:
I know of a sage who can help temper Fyr'alath. Shalasar Glimmerdusk is an expert in intellectual matters, often pondering theories for controlling volatile magics. Few understand sophic matters as well as she does.

Seek her guidance in managing shadowflame. I suspect her solution may include a sprinkle of Chromatic Dust!
77833.completion:
Ah, yes! Thank you for making the journey here. 

Others warned me not to isolate myself from academia, but I knew being sequestered in this remote natural locale would come in handy someday.

77835.title: Handling It: Rune of Shadowbinding
77835.objectives: Seek out Lydiara Whisperfeather in the Azure Span.
77835.description:
Lydiara Whisperfeather is an academic who recognizes the rigidity of the rules that govern our world. She also likes bending them.

If there is anyone who can assist in binding Fyr'alath's power, it's her.
77835.completion:
You want to bind shadowflame? How dangerous! How daring! Let's do it.

I've been studying flora in the Emerald Dream. Studying the realm's exotic and dreamlike plants is quite distracting, but I've seen one in particular that could help us find some answers.

77838.title: Tattered Dreamleaf
77838.description:
The properties of Dreamleaf are foreign to you. 

Completing events during the Superbloom will give you the knowledge necessary to help your ally.
77838.completion: Shadowed Dreamleaf still remains perplexing but hopefully your ally could still use this knowledge.

77839.title: The Eastern Kingdoms Cup Circuit
77839.objectives: Fly through the introductory Eastern Kingdoms Cup courses.
77839.description:
It is once again time to test your mettle.

My bronze colleagues have traveled to the Eastern Kingdoms to create new racing challenges. Many racecourses await you across the continent.

Are you up to the task?
77839.completion: You lead the way among your fellow skyriders! As the Eastern Kingdom Cup continues, find other races there and prove you are a cut above the rest.

77840.title: The Eastern Kingdoms Cup Begins
77840.description: Skyrider! You just missed Lord Andestrasz. He's looking for capable skyriders like yourself to compete in new races!

77865.title: A Proper Burial
77865.completion:
Today you'll be returning a Maruuk Burial Banner. Truth be told, I almost feared that someone had stolen it. Again! But after searching the entire tavern, I went to double-check my locker and found it safe and sound!

The stress of these recent events seem to be getting to me... 

Please, speak with Sansok Khan in Maruukai and return the banner to where it belongs.

77869.title: Return to the Echo Isles
77869.objectives: Meet with Rokhan in the Echo Isles.
77869.description:
{NAME}, there appears to be trouble in the Echo Isles.

Rokhan has requested your help.
77869.completion: It is good you be here, {NAME}. Trouble is brewin'.

77871.title: De Old Loa
77871.objectives: Hear Bwonsamdi's message to the Darkspear trolls and find a solution.
77871.description:
Bwonsamdi does not be visiting in person without a good reason. Listen to all he has to say. 

Den we think, den we act.
77871.progress: What Bwonsamdi be saying is very serious. Mueh'zala worship is a bloody one.
77871.completion:
De Darkspear always be worshipping multiple loa, but Mueh'zala? We can do better.

Our path is obvious.

77874.title: De Loa of de Past
77874.objectives: Find a guide to one of the lost loa by making a proper effigy, and follow the guide.
77874.description:
We need to be findin' de old loa and call dem back. There must be a way to find where dey went. 

If we can find de old loa, we can host a Trial of the Loa to reconnect with their power.

Bwonsamdi said dey are still out there. I think he be dropping a hint for us...
77874.completion:
I be feelin' somethings eyes on us. Judgin'. Dis loa be clever, but so are we.

Let's continue.

77877.title: One with the Loa
77877.objectives: Talk to Kevo to be taken inside the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound.
77877.description:
Pieces of Lukou be scattered.

But her heart be deep inside the ogre mound.

De shadows can take us there. Quietly. Quickly. Speak to me when you are ready.
77877.progress: Kevo ya Siti wants to bring us inside the mound.
77877.completion:
Dat was... somethin' else. Feels like my stomach still be outside!

But we be having work to do.

77879.title: Stalking the Stalker
77879.objectives: Collect 6 Offerings to Hakkar to attract the loa.
77879.description:
If dis loa be huntin' here, he may have seen us already. Since we don't know for sure, let's split up.

I be hunting for him, while ya get his attention. Jani says the loa has been taking the offerings meant for Hakkar, the loa of blood. 

But we don't know WHY. Collect some and see if he wants them. If his motive is something else... we be knowin' soon enough.
77879.completion:
<Kevo ya Siti accepts the offerings silently.>

I don't be wanting dese offerings myself. Slowing Hakkar's return benefits us all.

It will take more than just remembering. Your hunt is just beginning.

77880.title: Looking for Lukou
77880.objectives: Ask about Lukou and follow the trail to find her.
77880.description:
Dis be the last place Kevo ya Siti sensed Lukou.

We be needing to ask around, see who knows where she might have gone.
77880.progress: With enough information, we can track Lukou down.
77880.completion: It be time to find Lukou.

77881.title: There is Another
77881.objectives: Go to Bambala to seek out Lukou.
77881.description:
If Mueh'zala be involved... I will help. But for a loa trial fit to push Mueh'zala out, we will need another.

Our sister loa is also lost. We were a team, her and I, until disagreement pushed us apart. Lukou is the loa of regeneration. She be the ideal loa to balance against death.

I owe her an apology. You are here, and it be time.

I last sensed her presence near the small settlement of Bambala. I be meeting you there.
77881.completion:
This place is not how I remember it.

And I do not feel our sister. I will need to get closer to where she is.

77882.title: Stolen but Not Forgotten
77882.objectives: Collect 8 altar fragments from around the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound.
77882.description: There be many pieces missin' from dis altar. We be needing to repair it so dat Lukou is not angered when she returns, Lukou must see dat we are on her side.
77882.progress: We need all the pieces you can find.

77886.title: Handling It: Shadowed Dreamleaf
77886.objectives: Collect Shadowed Dreamleaf from completing objectives in the Superbloom.
77886.description:
When Fyr'alath's power is at its limit, you will need a grip that can cool itself. It is like standing your ground when a beast charges you: as the battle heats up, you need a way to stay focused.

Various leathers throughout the Dragon Isles have that cooling property, but I know of something better. Foliage that is routinely exposed to shadowflame would be the best choice for binding the components together. Let us gather what you need.
77886.progress: Did you find what we need?
77886.completion:
Excellent.

You hunt for something long enough, you will always find it. I am glad we found precisely what you needed.

77889.title: A Fiery Proposal
77889.objectives: Collect 10 Fiery Essence from fire elementals in the Emerald Dream.
77889.description:
Ah hello!

I have been working with some inscribers recently. We've been making a new type of ink. It's like fire ink, but even fierier! 

We need fiery essence from fire elementals, and fire elementals are currently attacking the dream. I believe this is what is called a "win win" scenario.

Please drop their essence off at my associate in Amirdrassil.
77889.progress: New knowledge can come from the strangest sources!
77889.completion:
Ah, wonderful. I will pass these on. 

Thank you, {NAME}.

77891.title: Fixing The Dream
77891.description:
Engineering is an exact science! When something explodes, engineers plan it that way. 

Dreams are not exact, especially emerald ones! Someday, someone will want engineers to fix the Dream, and we won't know how to do it. We need a lot more information to understand what we're dealing with!

Go to the Dream and place research beacons at my designated points. They will gather the information needed for any future repairs. Use this handy teleport device if you want to find the locations quickly.
77891.progress: I wonder if we'll ever truly understand the dream.
77891.completion: So much useful data about the dream, it will keep the engineers busy for years.

77892.title: Pearls Of Great Value
77892.description:
When Amirdrassil's roots spread to the water, many rare creatures arose from the ocean's depths and now flourish around the dreams.

One such rare creature is the Sandsparkle Clam, which can contain magical pearls!

See if you can locate these clams and find some pearls within.
77892.completion: Fascinating, {NAME}, there is great potential in the power of these pearls.

77894.title: Heart of Lukou
77894.objectives: Summon and speak with Lukou at the altar.
77894.description:
I was hoping we'd be getting more pieces than dis, but we make do with what we got, eh?

Call Lukou to de altar. Hopefully she will answer.
77894.completion: Thanks for the help, {NAME}. I was not harmed badly.

77896.title: A Sleepy Search
77896.objectives: Check up with the sleeping druids.
77896.description:
In our fight against Fyrakk's forces, a group of my fellow druids went out in search for a quiet and safe place to rest. But with Fyrakk's forces closing in on their location...

I have to start planning for another assault, I can't split my time as much as I wish. 

I last saw them heading south to a cave by the shore. Please, I just need to make sure they're safe.
77896.completion:
Have Fyrakk's forces attacked us? 

As you can see, there is no issue with that here. 

However, I do have a much bigger problem on my hands.

77898.title: Honor and Tribute
77898.objectives: Set up the loa altars at Darkspear Hold.
77898.description:
It be time to return home. Let us welcome dese loa to the Echo Isles. Their positive influence should make short work of Mueh'zala's presence.

Go ahead, I be right behind ya.
77898.progress: The offerings need to be set exactly right.
77898.completion: All de offerings be set. Let's do de next step.

77899.title: The Rush'kah
77899.description:
When we make de rush'kah, we recreate de shape of the loa as we be seein' dem in our mind. By knowing the shape of de loa, we better understand who dey are. But de mask be shaped by our hands, so when de loa sees it, dey know what we expect dem to be. 

If the loa don't bless the mask, we expect dem to be something dey will not be. If de loa bless de mask, dey like what we see in dem and a bargain can be struck. 

We could just write a contract, but it is easier to lie with words than with your hands.
77899.progress: De rush'kah be important in bonding with the loa.
77899.completion:
Good work, {NAME}!

Almost done with mine here.

77900.title: The Loa Trials
77900.objectives: Start the trial at the Altar of Darkspear Loa.
77900.description:
When de loa bless the rush'kah, de trials will begin. Loa be giving tasks to teach us. Once de trials start, dey don't stop for nobody!

Let's go to de altar together. Witch Doctor Tzadah will lead us in de ritual. She be Master Gadrin's apprentice, but be showin' real initiative in helping out on the trial.
77900.progress: It is time to begin de trial.
77900.completion:
Dis trial be... something different, now. Normally, de loa grant visions or give tasks to teach and connect with us.

Instead, we work together to stop Mueh'zala.

77901.title: Retraining the Trainees
77901.objectives: Extract 8 shadows from Lost Trainees after weakening them.
77901.description:
Your witch doctor is trying to twist the trial to empower Mueh'zala. Many will be enthralled by this power, but we still stand with the Darkspear.

I had a different trial in mind. Now, we adapt. Free your fellow trolls from his sacrificial magic. Dis charm will help them, but you must weaken them first.

Try not to sacrifice dem.
77901.progress: Use the charm on the trainees after you weaken them!
77901.completion: This will reduce the ritual's power. Mueh'zala does not get to claim more Darkspear!

77902.title: Ritual Recovery
77902.objectives: Remove 3 Ritual Circles with Lukou's aid.
77902.description:
Dat witch doctor has stolen de trial. She mocks us, trying to eat de life of living things to free Mueh'zala. We still have influence over it, though. 

Together, we will overwhelm her evil circles. When you find a circle, call upon me, and we will push death aside.
77902.completion: When you are fighting death, Lukou is a good ally.

77903.title: De Power of Death
77903.description:
De trial can't be stopped after it starts, but we won't let Tzadah use our people or our loa to aid Mueh'zala.

If we be doing nothing, even more Darkspear could be swayed to find power in Mueh'zala. I'll look for a way to breach Tzadah's protective energy, you stop the spirits from taking over our home!
77903.completion: Good work with those minions. Dat will keep them off our backs for what be ahead.

77905.title: Avatar of Mueh'zala
77905.objectives: Collect Jani's blessing and then travel with Lukou to the top of the pillars to defeat Tzadah's protection totems.
77905.description:
It be down to dis moment: working with our loa to save de soul of de Darkspear.

See if Jani has found anything. Hopefully, his item will let you get close enough to Tzadah's effigies to destroy dem. That should give us a chance to strike the Witch Doctor herself. I'll occupy her attention with Kevo ya Siti's aid, but watch out for her guardians. Dey won't let you destroy her effigies without a fight.
77905.progress: Tzadah is a disgrace to the Darkspear.
77905.completion:
We defeated Tzadah. She can no longer aid Mueh'zala's attempts to escape his prison. 

We could not have done this without de aid of de loa. Lukou, Kevo ya Siti, and even Jani.

77906.title: De Darkspear Loa
77906.objectives: Destroy Mueh'zala's altar and add Jani's.
77906.description:
Dat was not a traditional trial, but we only keep tradition if it be helping de tribe.

It be our strength: to adapt to what comes.

It be time to shed de past and honor those most important to us. De Darkspear was never de largest tribe, nor de strongest. We endure because we choose our path, and our allies, well.

Dese loa and you all worked and sacrificed not just to help Bwonsamdi, but to protect de souls of de Darkspear. Dat be why we honor our loa... and you.
77906.progress: The effigies need to reflect our favored loa.
77906.completion:
De Darkspear don't just serve a loa because dat loa be strong. De Darkspear serve loa who serve de tribe. 
Dat be what Lukou, Kevo ya Siti, and Jani did. So we honor them now.

De mask you made was not just for de ceremony. Take it, and de raiment of our tribe. 

Wear them and know you are Darkspear.

77908.title: A Legacy of Secrets
77908.objectives: Return the book, Tyr's Legacy, to Bobby Carlisle in Valdrakken.
77908.description: <Return the book to Bobby Carlisle in Valdrakken to assist with deciphering the tablet text!>
77908.progress: Was my source any good? Were you able to find the book?

77910.title: Enchanted Shrubbery
77910.objectives: Use the Watering Pot on 12 Enchanted Shrubs.
77910.description:
Certain plants from the Emerald Dream could contain ingredients that would be helpful in our work here, but we need a lot of them, and I'm not hiring some herbalist to collect them.

I've enchanted a water pot to help solve the problem. 
Travel to the Emerald Dream and use it on the plants I require. The plants should then deliver themselves.
77910.completion: Excellent work, these plants certainly do spruce up the place!

77911.title: Build-a-Blanket
77911.objectives: Collect 6 Velvety Lasher Leaves from lashers.
77911.description:
I am unable to rest! I have spent all my energy in battle, but there is too much noise and the ground is too hard for me to sleep...

I know! It pains me to ask this, but I need to rest so I can go back out and fight.

Could you feed two birds with one seed for me? Take out the enraged lashers and retrieve their leaves so I can make a blanket to rest on.
77911.progress: For the Emerald Dream, it sure is quite chaotic here.
77911.completion: Thanks for the leaves. Hopefully this will help me fall asleep.

77912.title: Unmodern Jewelry
77912.description:
Some of the local Jewelcrafters are looking to study examples of the Zaqali tribes adornments.

Given they are currently attacking my home, we may take advantage of the situation.

I thought you might take them violently, yes?

Argonax waits once you have collected them.
77912.progress: New knowledge can come from the strangest sources.
77912.completion:
I was not expecting these so soon. 

You do work fast, {NAME}.

77914.title: Burning Runes
77914.objectives: Collect 10 Burning Runes from druids of the flame in the Emerald Dream.
77914.description:
I am told that the Druids of the Flame help to stabilize their portals into the dream through the use of a unique sort of inscription! While their ends are abhorrent, I cannot help but be curious as to their means.

If we can better understand their methods, then perhaps we can better equip our allies to stem the tide of their arrival. If you get your hands on any burning runes, could you bring them to my colleague for further study?
77914.progress: Take care, friend. I doubt the Druids of the Flame will part with their runework willingly.
77914.completion:
You have my thanks. We will endeavor to decipher these forthwith.

Thank you, {NAME}.

77922.title: Fluffy Filler Retrieval
77922.description:
There is no way I could rest without something soft to sleep on. Luckily, the dream has some sage so plush, that it would even put roc feathers to shame! It would be a perfect filling! 

Could you collect some sage around the area for me to rest on?
77922.progress: The sage should be soft enough to make a comfortable place to sleep. Thank you for your assistance.
77922.completion: Thanks for bringing back the bed filling.

77928.title: They Are Always Listening
77928.objectives: Speak with Fangli Hoot near the Valdrakken barber shop.
77928.description:
Remember my contact, Fangli Hoot? Seems she has another theory about the one behind these artifact thefts.

I'm a bit weary after the last tip went nowhere, but we can't turn down a lead. Journalistic integrity demands we at least hear her out.

You'll find her by the barber shop.
77928.completion:
Ok, this time I'm sure. I tracked everyone, yes everyone, even you.

Tithris is behind everything. He's been meeting with shady characters all over the city to secure supplies for something big. My guess is an expedition. 

You need to investigate several caches of his purchases. I noted coordinates for the general locations. Put that thinking cap to work! And that idol of yours can help you narrow in on their exact location.

77932.title: Warmth of Life
77932.objectives: Collect eight samples of Metamorphic Ash from Druids of the Flame in the Smoldering Copse.
77932.description:
The Druids of the Flame practice virulent magics that warp and burn all they touch. They do, however, have excellent taste in alchemical reagents.

If you should happen across any of their metamorphic ash, could you gather it up for me? One of my contacts within the Dream has been asking after the stuff.
77932.progress: Ah, there you are! Have you managed to get your hands on any of that ash, yet? Its alchemical properties are truly wondrous.
77932.completion: Ah, wonderful! The things I will be able to accomplish with this... One does not simply walk into the Firelands, after all!

77933.title: Bubbling Discoveries
77933.description:
The rise of Amirdrassil has unlocked various geological wonders in the dream. Among these are a variety of magical springs, bubbling water from deep within Azeroth.

Travel the dream and gather samples from these springs.
77933.completion: I shall share these with the others here, after sampling them myself.

77934.title: A Complete Inventory
77934.objectives: Report your findings to Fangli Hoot near the barber shop in Valdrakken.
77934.description: <Compile your notes on the caches for Fangli Hoot in Valdrakken.>

77935.title: A-Sword-ed Needs
77935.objectives: Deliver 3 Draconium Swords to Cylania in the Emerald Dream.
77935.description:
Swords!

Sorry, I saw you and I did not want to forget.

Yes. We need swords. In the Dream. You can provide, yes?

Please deliver them to Cylania.
77935.completion:
We will put these to good use. 

Thank you, {NAME}.

77936.title: A Warm Harvest
77936.objectives: Collect 10 Essence of Endless Flame in the Emerald Dream.
77936.description:
Everyone knows heat plays a critical role in blacksmithing.

I hear the Emerald Dream is still heavily under attack by allies of the flame. There must be a way to harvest fuel from those eternally fiery creatures.

If you do secure anything, I'm sure one of the local blacksmiths in the Dream will be very interested.
77936.completion: You've faced dangerous enemies to acquire these materials. Thank you. This will prove mightily useful for crafting our own devices.

77937.title: Forbidden Sugar
77937.objectives: Collect 8 Glowdrop Sugar from Shaded Glowdrops in the Emerald Dream.
77937.description:
During this very unique time of bloom, a new flower has been discovered in the Dream. These stunning flowers produce a marvelous pollen. Its aroma is a delight, just like fresh baked cookies.

To the dismay of chefs, even eating a tiny bit will result in rapid, severe poisoning of the liver.

However, it is an incredible all-purpose addition to enchanting. Early tests demonstrate potency as high as quadruple that of Chromatic Dust. Traders from Valdrakken are very interested in its acquisition.
77937.progress: The enchanters would love to have more for testing. They must use and test it wisely. We hope the flower will persist even after the great bloom, but no one can know for sure.
77937.completion: Ahh--I thought you had brought me fresh baked cookies! But this is even better.

77938.title: An Unlikely Engineer
77938.objectives: Collect 8 Whiteburr Morels for Nyla Bushtail in the Emerald Dream.
77938.description:
I hear there is a legendary engineer in the Dream who crafts the most beautiful dream catchers.

This engineer, Nyla Bushtail, enjoys acorn-flavored morels and relies on them to fuel her work. Acorn-flavored mushrooms... certainly strange, but perhaps not unheard of.

There's a coastal area close to the Eye of Ysera where these morels grow abundantly. Do tread carefully around any wildlife in the area. If these morels are as tasty as I hear, they will be guarded greedily.
77938.completion:
<Nyla Bushtail, a fluffy, bright-eyed Fol'ya, accepts the morels with small paws. She tucks them away into a stash nearby, her movements fluid and tidy.

This must be the legendary engineer who loves acorn-flavored mushrooms. It all makes sense now.>

77945.title: Boots on the Ground
77945.objectives: Deliver 3 Pioneer's Leather Boots to Cylania in the Emerald Dream.
77945.description:
Just who I wanted to see.

I have a requisition script for items of leather from some of the denizens of the Dream. Shoes, of course. Bipeds tend to go through them like a bird through the forest, yes?

Once you have acquired them, please take them to Cylania.
77945.completion:
Wonderful, thank you, {NAME}. 

You can never have enough boots.

77946.title: Fibrous Thread
77946.objectives: Bring 1 Emerald Fiber from Enchanted Thickets in the Emerald Dream.
77946.description:
Fine thread may conjure images of tailory, but it can serve a vital role in leatherwork as well.

Some of the Dream's hardier flora can be processed into a thread strong enough to secure even the thickest of hides and scales. If you happen upon any dense fiber during your travels, you would be well-served by bringing it to my colleague in the Dream.
77946.progress: You needn't worry about the plants themselves. They are nigh impossible to harm, and so long as they are treated respectfully, they will be more than happy to share their bounty with you.
77946.completion: Ah! This is precisely what I needed. You have my thanks, {NAME}.

77947.title: Primalist Fashion
77947.objectives: Collect 10 Intact Primalist Garb from the Emerald Dream.
77947.description:
Ah, {NAME}, there you are!

The robes of the primalists make for interesting study for the local tailors. If you could retrieve some from the primalists assaulting the dream, I would be pleased, yes?

No rips or tears please. Blood stains optional. They can be washed out.
77947.completion:
Magnolia mentioned you would be dropping off some robes.

Ah, she also mentioned they may need to be washed.

Thank you, {NAME}.

77948.title: Burning Out
77948.objectives: Find Solarys's siblings in the Smoldering Copse.
77948.description:
Please, I know how this looks, but we are on the same side!

My siblings and I intended to defect from the Flame together. However, none of them have escaped or met up with me since I left, and it's been days! I fear the worst.

Do you think I would be begging for aid, alone and unarmed, if I was not honest? Please, find them. They are all I have left.
77948.completion:
<Solarys's face falls, clouding with grief at your explanation.> 

Finite moments with my family are worth more than an eternity of regrets. Life itself is worth more than that, but my pleas fell on deaf ears.

Thank you for saving what little of my family is left.

One of the little creatures Kery'nael helped saved seems to have taken a liking to you. Please take them. It's the least we can offer the poor thing.

77949.title: Fashion Feathers
77949.objectives: Collect 10 Shed Great Feathers in the Emerald Dream.
77949.description:
Much of the Dream's wildlife is feathered or furred. Their shed, whether it be down fur or feathers, is reputed to be extremely durable, soft, and fashionable.

The great somnowls' feathers are particularly desirable. They don't shed often, and feathers are quickly retrieved by local wildlife for nest building.

I've heard that your best chance is scouring the Meandering Rootlands in the Dream.
77949.progress: Have you found any feathers? They're easy to identify. As large as two hands lengthwise, often snowy in color, and buttery soft.
77949.completion: Tailors from all over the world will be delighted to have these!

77953.title: A Sphere in Danger
77953.completion:
Here's the note they sent. Something to do with an orb? 

Kathos had to run out to check on something, so you can bring the orb back to me. I'll make sure to hand it over upon her return.

Stay safe out there. Oh, and don't forget all of your useful tools!

77954.title: A Curious Orb
77954.objectives: Return the Orb of Rathmus to Tithris in Valdrakken.
77954.description: <Tithris told you to return the orb to him in Valdrakken. He will pass it to Preservationist Kathos.>
77954.progress: You got that orb for me? For Kathos, I mean.

77955.title: Heated Hearthstone Hustle
77955.objectives: Retrieve the Heated Hearthstone from the Stonewarmer.
77955.description:
Wait, my hearthstone! I can't sleep without my hearthstone. 

A djaradin stole it during our last battle. It stays warm perpetually and I always sleep with it. 

I hate that I must ask more of you, but could you get my hearthstone? 

The djaradin that stole it should be near Fyrakk's army, just north of here.
77955.progress: My eyes grow tired, but my body is still awake...
77955.completion: Gah! I still can not fall asleep! I am embarrassed to ask but there is only one option left.

77957.title: A Treacherous Race
77957.completion:
Bobby and I finally deciphered the tablets. They tell of an artifact of immense power that was locked away in Tyrhold. And I fear Tithris is after whatever that artifact is. 

You must secure whatever the tablets speak of before Tithris. Bobby and I will find a guard and join you as soon as we can.

Take our notes. There are many safeguards that you will need to get through to find the artifact's vault.

77958.title: Sleepy Druid in Emerald Dream
77958.objectives: Sing a lullaby for sleepy druid.
77958.description:
Why can I still not fall asleep, even with a heated blanket? 

<Thaalean curses the air then sighs.>

This is embarrassing to request, but my mother used to sing me a lullaby before I slept back in Teldrassil, may I ask you to do the same?

Any lullaby will do, I just want to rest peacefully.
77958.completion:
Thank you so much for checking on my friends. 

When they reawake, we will be ready to fight Fyrakk's forces once more.

77976.title: Aiding the Accord: Dreamsurge
77976.description:
A group of druids from across Azeroth have gathered to investigate a sudden surge in energies coming from the Emerald Dream.

This has the potential to affect us all, {NAME}. Please aid them in their endeavor to understand this new phenomena.
77976.completion: Thank you, {NAME}, for your assistance. We will have to keep a close eye on this Dreamsurge as it develops.

77977.title: An Ominous Artifact
77977.objectives: Secure the Orb of Rathmus as well as the artifact it is hiding.
77977.description: <An orb would fit perfectly atop the console.>
77977.progress: A chest! Locked away in Tyrhold all this time. Can I examine it?

77978.title: A Passed Torch
77978.objectives: Collect documents and kill Druids of the Flame within the Smoldering Copse.
77978.description:
<Strategic documents are scattered around Lyandris. Notes detailing experiments and future assault locations covering many of them.> 

<It would be of great use to your allies to find more of these documents. Thinning out the Flame's numbers wouldn't hurt either.>
77978.completion:
Lyandris saved all this? And you... you finished what she started.

Thank you for returning her journal to me. Keep the documents. They will provide valuable information to you and your allies. 

They would only be a grim reminder to me.

77988.title: Test
77988.objectives: Help Zhusadormu glide through the rings.
77988.description:
Bronze whelps can be careless when trying to win, so be careful with the timeways!

[Growth Spurt]: Tranform into an adult and gain improved speed.
[Bedtime Rewind]: Restore 1 Vigor until all Vigor has been recovered.
[Sacred Timeline]: Resets cooldowns.

78002.title: To The Test: Concentrated Sophic Vellum
78002.objectives: Return the excess Order magic to Shalasar's Sophic Vellum.
78002.description:
The Order and shadowflame magics are competing with each other. The enchantment will never be able to funnel Fyr'alath's power if we can't channel the excess Order magic being forced away from it.

If you can channel the enchantment, your allies can catch any excess Order magic.
78002.progress: Don't give up. I know this is tough, but keep your goal in mind.
78002.completion: Hard work, but well worth it. Use this vellum well.

78003.title: Handling It: Taut Tethercoil
78003.objectives: Collect Taut Tethercoil from powerful foes throughout the Emerald Dream.
78003.description:
I've read of a root in the Emerald Dream known for its defensive qualities. It binds its tendrils to powerful foes as a way to protect surrounding flora and fauna. A friendly scribe might be able to help you adapt its properties.

If I could just get my hands on some of that root, I'm sure I could dissect its properties and mold it into something capable of harnessing Fyr'alath's power.

Here are my notes. You should be able to find powerful creatures guarding patches of wild tethercoil. Good hunting.
78003.progress: Ah, thank you for bringing these to me.
78003.completion:
I'm impressed! You're certainly tenacious.

Now we can craft the base of our binding rune.

78040.title: The Outland Cup Begins
78040.description: Skyrider! You just missed Lord Andestrasz. He's looking for capable skyriders like yourself to compete in new races!

78041.title: Sky Mother's Ire
78041.description:
We received reports that the Druids of the Flame have established another staging ground just south of the Eye of Ysera.

Unfortunately for them, their incursion point has disrupted the local winged wildlife and drawn the ire of the Mother of Flight.

Speak with Aviana and lend her your aid. We will need her eyes and wings in the battle to come.
78041.completion:
I expected Cenarius would send some support eventually.
 
But this foolish, ground dwelling loa?

<Aviana taps her talon in annoyance as she gives Q'onzu a side-eyed glare.>

78042.title: Aviana's Assessment
78042.description:
<Aviana's eyes narrow as she watches the Druids of the Flame far below.>

Q'onzu may be content with letting these heretics destroy the very fabric of the Dream, but I am not.

Bring me scraps of their armor stained with blood as proof of your deed.

Do not hold back, {NAME}. Remember what these heathens are capable of.
78042.progress: Every minute they are left uncontested, another portion of the Dream is lost to their heinous acts.
78042.completion:
Actions speak louder than inquiries, champion.  

Remember that the next time your prey invades your homeland.  

<Aviana shoots a cruel side-eye towards Q'onzu. >

78043.title: Q'onzu's Quandary
78043.objectives: Speak to the Flame-Disguised Dreamkin to gather intel on the Druids of the Flame.
78043.description:
You again! Well, you must be here to help, correct? 

Absolutely you are. Why would you not? This development is so exciting. What could these desolating druids be up to?

Fortunately, a few of my friends have infiltrated the druids. I'm sure they have quite the story to tell. 

Go forth, my curious companion and bring back exciting news!
78043.progress:
Change has come to the dream and yet we are so quick to snuff it out.

How unnaturally boring.
78043.completion:
Well now, this IS interesting, isn't it?

<Q'onzu shudders as they tap their feet rapidly in excitement.>

You must be fascinated by this too, {NAME}? 

Oh, how silly of me. Of course you are!

78044.title: Appalling Pollen
78044.description:
This cinder pollen doesn't evoke interesting change. It consumes all until nothing, but ash remains. It brings... uniformity.  

And I find that to be tragically stale. 

I'm all for change, no matter the origin. But if THIS change stymies all future possibilities for further change, then it must be stopped. 
  
If creatures of the dream have been infected by this pollen, then they must be extinguished. This is not a flame that can be allowed to grow.
78044.progress:
Bringing about change to the dream through fire is a fascinating concept - life and fire can coexist! 

<Q'onzu's expression hardens as they shudder.> 

But this change is not that.
78044.completion:
Imagine the lengths these agents of monotony had to go to in order to get me -- ME, THE LOA OF CHANGE -- to interfere with their dream-changing plot? 
 
The absolute gall!

78045.title: Uproot the Cause
78045.description:
<Aviana's gaze remains locked on Q'onzu for a moment, her brow furrowed.> 
 
While I don't see eye to eye with Q'onzu's fascination for change, their incessant inquiry has unveiled a more deep-seated plot than originally suspected. 

Putting down the wildlife won't mean much if we don't tear out the root of the cause.  
 
Locate the burning ashphodels in the glade below and tear them out.
78045.progress:
If the ashphodels are allowed to spread their foul pollen unchecked, then the rest of the dream is in grave danger. 
 
<Aviana grimaces.>
78045.completion:
Well done, {NAME}.  
 
I'll ensure Cenarius is made aware of the damage these weeds have inflicted. A few dryads should be able to clear up any remaining pollen or flowers you might have missed. 
 
 
 
All but one task remains now, Champion.

78046.title: Overseer Oversight
78046.description:
Those research notes you brought Q'onzu made mention of the ones behind these foul experiments.  
 
The overseer, the one named Chardryn, has been under our noses this whole time. 

He oversees their research station below us.  
 
If we are to permanently end their terrible experiments and disrupt their progress, then he must be made an example of.
78046.progress:
If Chardryn and his insane herbologists are allowed to carry out biological warfare here in the dream, then Amirdrassil and all of Azeroth is at risk.

We cannot allow these sycophants of fire to remain alive.
78046.completion:
Their overseer is dead then? 
 
<Aviana gives you a curt nod of approval.> 
 
Good. 

With Chardryn gone, their experiments destroyed and their research brought to a halt, let us hope this is the end of their twisted schemes.

78047.title: The Outland Cup Circuit
78047.description:
It is time once again to test your mettle.

My bronze colleagues have traveled to Outland to create more new challenges. We would like to see if any daring skyriders will complete the entire circuit!

Are you up to the task?
78047.completion: You lead the way among your fellow dragonriders! If you haven't already, see if you can improve your times in the Outland Cup and earn the colors of the Riders of Azeroth.

78064.title: Q'onzu's Perception
78064.objectives: Find and confront the interloper in Q'onzu's nest.
78064.description:
You have many questions and I have many worries. 

Such pressing worries. An interloper, a rude disrupter of our joyous day. How I worry so. If only someone could confront this trespasser.

Wait, you could do it for me! It's a win-win, you go confront the trespasser and I answer your questions. I've tracked them down to a cave in the north. Surely you can handle them.
78064.progress: I can sense the interloper causing a disturbance in my nest!
78064.completion: Ha! Oh, come now. That was funny. Don't look so cross.

78065.title: The Q'onzu Query
78065.objectives: Approach Q'onzu again and ask what they've been up to.
78065.description:
Champion, I understand we were unable to convince Q'onzu to join us. However, we need all the aid we can gather.   

You must discover why they refuse to aid us and convince them of the right path. Q'onzu and I have a rather strained relationship. Your efforts could bear more fruit. 

I hear Q'onzu has built a nest near Shiversnap Grove. Would you go and approach them?
78065.completion: Q'onzu said a visitor would come. Baring offerings, I hope?

78066.title: The Answers You've Earned
78066.description:
Ah, that's much better. Now I can think.

What did you want, again? Oh yes! Questions. 

Ask away, if you must.
78066.completion:
<Q'onzu and their followers have gone. This must be the answer they deemed you deserved.

For now, at least.>

78068.title: An Artificer's Appeal
78068.objectives: Meet Grand Artificer Romuul in the Exodar.
78068.description:
{NAME}, I received an item for you from Grand Artificer Romuul.

Romuul wished for you to listen to the message before proceeding to the Exodar.
78068.completion:
My apologies for bringing you here on such short notice, {NAME}, but your help right now would be most appreciated.

I have found myself with many surprise deadlines.

"Surprise" and "deadlines" are not words I like together in the same sentence.

78069.title: Reviving Tradition
78069.objectives: Help Romuul finish repairing the Holographic Emitter.
78069.description:
The Prophet wished to personally ask for your help with the Tishamaat. But since he is working elsewhere, I asked you first to jumpstart our task.

My colleague and I have been working on a special project. And since the Prophet has declared today the Tishamaat, we will unveil it at the celebration!

For this, I need the emitter, but it needs an overhaul. We only have time for a hot wiring.

Get some filament and a soldering tool from the crates nearby, {NAME}. Then maybe I can wire it to an array.
78069.progress: I regret not having apprentices in times like this.
78069.completion:
<Romuul gives the newly seated crystal a test wiggle.>

Not my finest work, but it will do.

Light willing, it will remain functional until our project is revealed and the celebration is over.

78070.title: Pressing Deadlines
78070.objectives: Speak to Ataanya in Shattrath City.
78070.description:
During this Tishamaat, Ataanya and I will present our project's schematics.

Ataanya is High Artificer of Shattrath. Her father was my late mentor, the famed Exarch Hataaru.

Hataaru's hoofplates are hard to fill, but Ataanya has more than done so.

She has the schematics, and she should be here when they are presented. But she is not responding to my messages.

Ataanya seldom leaves the city, but surely she can make an exception for the Tishamaat. Perhaps you can reason with her.
78070.completion:
I have a data crystal prepared. The schematics are on it.

My apprentice can find it for you.

I have no time to leave Shattrath.

78071.title: Rush Order
78071.objectives: Speak to Beruun. Perhaps he knows a way to convince Ataanya to leave Shattrath.
78071.description:
My schematics speak for themselves.

Each calculation has been verified. It is respectful of all building codes. I even included a layout of the channels that the power grid must follow.

Romuul knows the project. He already signed off on everything. He can explain it to the masses himself.

I do not need to waste my valuable time traveling to the Exodar for this ridiculous holiday.

My apprentice will give you the schematics on a data crystal. Take it and leave.
78071.progress: We will do what we can for Ataanya.
78071.completion:
Hm, it was worth a try.

It seems it will be difficult to get her to the Tishamaat...

But I have another idea.

78072.title: An Old Wound
78072.objectives: Speak to the soulpriests at Auchindoun.
78072.description:
<Beruun whispers to you.>

There are ways, I'm sure you know, for the draenei to speak to the dead.

It's not the same as having a loved one back but...

Hataaru's ashes were taken to Auchindoun after the soulpriests reclaimed the temple. Maybe they might know a way to help Ataanya with her loss?
78072.completion:
It is good to have visitors!

The honored dead here are well-cared for, but not many travel to commune with them.

Their deaths can be a painful reminder of what the {race} have endured.

78073.title: Lingering Scars
78073.objectives: Help Exarch Maladaar commune and soothe the spirits of Auchindoun.
78073.description:
I believe we may be able to help.

But perhaps you could aid me first...

When we received word that the Tishamaat was upon us, we hurried to prepare our most tortured spirits for the journey to the Exodar. The celebration's sacraments may help them rest peacefully.

However, they must consent to being moved. So, we must commune with and soothe them first.

Will you help calm these spirits? Afterward, I will take you to where Hataaru is entombed and give you what you seek.
78073.progress: Your kindness may help these spirits find peace in death.
78073.completion:
Thank you for what you have done, {NAME}.

Moving a spirit's remains can disturb them greatly, so they must be calmed as much as possible so the journey can be made safely.

78074.title: To See Clearly
78074.objectives: Visit Exarch Hataaru's tomb and then return to Ataanya in Shattrath.
78074.description:
Fortunately, not all of the fallen entombed here in Auchindoun suffer as these three do. Some ease gracefully into death, like soil settling after a rainfall.

Exarch Hataaru is one such soul. Thanks be to the Light that he rests easy.

Come, I will show you to his tomb.
78074.progress: <Ataanya crosses her arms tightly, not looking at you or Beruun.>
78074.completion:
... Fine.

<For a moment, she looks like she might snatch the lens from you. Instead, she takes it from you gently.>

78075.title: Moving Past
78075.objectives: Return to Grand Artificer Romuul in the Exodar.
78075.description:
My mother died on a colony planet. My father and I helped each other move past that, but when he died in the siege of Shattrath, watching the walls of his greatest accomplishment crumble to dust... 

There was no one left for me.

So I worked. And now I have the schematics of my own Shattrath. A better Shattrath.

<Ataanya clenches the lens in her fist then exhales in resignation.>

I'll go to the Exodar--but if Romuul says one word about it, I will make him eat his soldering tool.
78075.completion:
In some ways, getting Ataanya here was a more difficult victory than the fall of Antorus.

Levity aside, I am glad she is here. I knew the Tishamaat would be hard for her. Her father was a great man, and we all mourn his passing.

This Tishamaat is gearing up to be one for our holo-records! 

<Romuul lowers his voice confidingly.>

Even Hatuun is here!

78076.title: Emergency Efforts
78076.objectives: Use the Argussian Mana Ray to fly to Bloodmyst Isle with Chieftain Hatuun.
78076.description:
{NAME}! Velen told me I may find you here. He needs your assistance.

The satyr that infest a nearby island have been ambushing draenei traveling for the Tishamaat.

Velen and I have been attempting to solve the problem quietly. He does not wish to mobilize the vindicators and alarm his people on a day of sacrament.

But, despite our efforts, the attacks have continued. The event may need to be canceled if we cannot get the demons under control.

Come with me so we may end this threat.
78076.completion:
I was hoping to resolve the sudden satyr attacks before I formally announced the Tishamaat to all...

Alas, I am grateful Romuul called you to the Exodar early.

I assume Hatuun has explained the situation to you?

78077.title: Beneath the Skin
78077.objectives: Collect 8 Pitted Bones from corrupted wildlife.
78077.description:
Arzaal and I are of the same mind. We must know the strength of these satyr before we attempt to drive them back with force. Else we may be walking into a fight we cannot win.

I can learn much about my enemies by observing what damage they leave in their wake. 

The wildlife here was corrupted by the Exodar's lingering energies, but I suspect the demons' presence made it worse.

Collect bones from the local wildlife for me. Studying them may give us some clues.
78077.progress: Remember, you are putting them out of their misery.
78077.completion:
<Hatuun snaps one of the bones, then sniffs the frothing marrow tentatively and frowns.>

Lesser demons do not corrupt creatures this deeply. Their fel disease can barely spread beneath the skin, much less the bones or the soul.

These are no weak imps we are dealing with.

78078.title: Assessing the Enemy
78078.description:
The Legion may be one entity, but it is vast. The demons that comprise it are as varied as the innumerable worlds they have conquered.

But I have had no dealings with satyr. From what the Prophet has told me, they seem disorganized. Intelligent certainly, but feral in their malevolence.

I am inclined to believe their recent attacks are random, but perhaps not. Bring me the totems they have scattered across Bloodmyst. I may be able to ascertain what, if anything, their end goal is.
78078.progress: I would prefer to know the capabilities of the satyr before engaging them.
78078.completion:
Curious.

These crystals appear similar to the others erupting from Bloodmyst, but their placement on these totems seems deliberate.

I will study them further.

78079.title: Excision
78079.objectives: Meet Velen and Hatuun in Nazzivian to search for signs of man'ari presence in the area.
78079.description:
I cannot in good conscience gather the draenei for the Tishamaat if we are threatened this close to home.

If one of the man'ari is using the satyr to orchestrate these attacks, or to distract us from some larger foul purpose, then they must be rooted out immediately.

We will divide our efforts to look for signs of the enemy. Arzaal will search the northern satyr camp. You, Hatuun, and myself will search the closer camp.
78079.completion: We did not find the man'ari responsible. But when we do, they will pay.

78080.title: At the Source
78080.objectives: Discover the source of the fel concentration in Axxarien and destroy it.
78080.description:
Can you hear that? The silence? 

The area is empty. Not even the rabid wildlife dare approach the camp.

I do not see any immediate cause, but the fel resonance here is overwhelming. I sense it was woven by man'ari hands, but I'm being blocked from probing more deeply.

Something is being hidden.

It must be the cloaking magic Hatuun reported from the other camp that hinders me. I can dispel it, but I cannot guarantee what we will find when I do.
78080.completion:
It is done.

I could not have imagined the threat in Bloodmyst had grown this dangerous.

Thank the Light that I chose to bring Hatuun and Arzaal here. This could not have been done without them--without all of us.

78081.title: Pain Recedes
78081.objectives: Meet with Prophet Velen in the Exodar.
78081.description:
With Sironas slain once again, Bloodmyst will finally be able to heal. Her influence was no doubt anchoring the corruption to the land.

It is another reason to celebrate today. But it is not the true reason I called Hatuun and Arzaal to Azeroth.

I would have them attend the Tishamaat with us.

The sacrament asks us to reflect on the past and commit to a better future. The unity of our efforts epitomizes that.

I will bring them to the Exodar. Please join us when you are ready.
78081.completion: It brings me great joy to see the eredar gathered together at last.

78082.title: A Burden Shared
78082.objectives: Collect 10 Memory Stones, create your own Memory Stone, and then dissolve the stones in the Flame of Reprieve.
78082.description:
The Tishamaat was once a solitary holiday. Each eredar would inscribe a stone with a painful memory we carried. We would reflect on what that memory could teach us then commit to moving forward with that wisdom.

At last, the stones are dissolved in the Flame of Reprieve, symbolically removing the weight from our souls.

Today, the Tishamaat will be celebrated not in solitude, but as a community.

Gather the stones of those who would trust you with them then take them to the flame.
78082.progress: For many, this is the first Tishamaat they have participated in. For others, it is a distant memory.
78082.completion:
The {race} have suffered, scattered and solitary, for too long.

Today, we allow ourselves to rely on each other.

78083.title: Our Path Forward
78083.objectives: Speak to Prophet Velen to begin the ceremony.
78083.description:
Ah, I believe I hear the Prophet calling the attendants before the stage.

I am curious to see what he and Romuul plan to announce now that everyone is gathered.

We should make haste, yes?
78083.completion:
Today marks the beginning of a new age for the eredar.

We are one people united in purpose.

And we will never be broken apart again.

78113.title: The Challenge Tour
78113.objectives: Complete a challenge course in every Dragon Isles area.
78113.description:
Hello again adventurer!

Do you like a challenge? I hope so as my bronze colleagues have a new set of challenge courses for you to fly.

Make no mistake, these will be more difficult than the previous courses. All the obstacles remain but there none of the boons waiting for you along the route.

Are you up to the challenge?
78113.completion: Well done! You are truly mastering the art of dragonriding.

78153.title: Handling It: Prototype Rune
78153.objectives: Craft or obtain Lydiara's Binding Rune.
78153.description:
Ah, I see! We're in uncharted territory here, but I've got a plan.

You'll need some Cosmic Ink, Runed Writhebark, and Shadowflame Essence.

Sharing this recipe with a friendly scribe should allow them to complete a Crafting Order for you. Let me update my notes with a recipe for the Rune of Shadowbinding.
78153.progress: Is it ready? Shall we proceed?
78153.completion: Perfect! Of course, we aren't finished yet. We'll need to strengthen the binding if we're to have any hope in making Fyr'alath accept our modifications.

78154.title: To the Test: Rune of Shadowbinding
78154.objectives: Defeat Gnarlroot, Igira the Cruel, and Volocross in Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope.
78154.description:
We need to finalize the binding. We can attune the components properly by testing them in combat against Fyrakk's most powerful lieutenants. Then we can bind the attuned materials to Fyr'alath.

If you can defeat Gnarlroot, Igira the Cruel, and Volcoross while this rune is bound to them, you'll be ready to fully attune the Rune of Shadowbinding.
78154.progress: A hero never backs down from a challenge. You've got this.
78154.completion: How exciting! I'm more of a crafter than a fighter, but your martial skills are quite impressive!

78155.title: Handling It: Radiant Fleck of Ash
78155.objectives: Collect Radiant Flecks of Ash from powerful pieces of gear throughout the Emerald Dream.
78155.description:
I've heard that in the Emerald Dream, a coarse ash with strong properties of shadowflame tends to cling to powerful pieces of equipment. The only way to harvest that powerful dust is by disassembling the equipment. 

Here, use this rod I've enchanted. It should allow you to siphon off the dust you need.
78155.progress: Don't give up! This process doesn't just help with crafting. It builds character! Remember that!
78155.completion: I hope the dowsing rod helped! Now for our next step...

78156.title: Handling It: Radiant Vellum
78156.objectives: Craft or obtain Shalasar's Sophic Vellum.
78156.description:
We can refine my creation by embedding the enchantment with Order magic. 

Here are my notes on Concentrated Sophic Vellum. Sharing this with another friendly enchanter should give them enough info to complete a Crafting Order for you.
78156.progress:
I've seen students become... disenchanted... with this type of task, but I know you're made of sterner stuff.

Sorry. I've been in isolation for a long time, and I don't get to use that "joke" very often.
78156.completion: We're almost there. Now we just need to coax the competing shadowflame and Order magic to cooperate.

78159.title: Handling It: Glowspore Grip
78159.objectives: Craft or obtain Erden's Glowspore Grip.
78159.description:
To craft something workable, we'll need a substantial amount of Zaralek Glowspores and some leather.

Here are my notes on the Symbiotic Glowspore Grip. Sharing this with a friendly leatherworker should give them enough info to complete a Crafting Order for you.
78159.progress: Tracking this down is a lot of work, but the quarry is worth the hunt.
78159.completion: Time for the final step. This might be a little... unpleasant.

78160.title: To the Test: Symbiotic Glowspore Grip
78160.objectives: Empower the grip while surviving its union with Fyr'alath.
78160.description:
You will have to trust me. We need to activate the reagents embedded in the grip.

Wrapping the grip around Fyr'alath's haft should work, as long as you can survive the onslaught that follows. You're going to need to make adjustments as you go, and you won't get it the first time. The spores need to adapt to the axe.
78160.progress: Keep at it. All this hard work is going to pay off.
78160.completion: Good work. This grip should serve you well.

78162.title: Q'onzu's Distraction
78162.objectives: Weaken 8 podlings, then use Q'onzu's Faerie Feather to change them into Faerie Dragons.
78162.description:
Truly your questions are important to me. Alas, I am simply too distracted. 

These podlings--nasty little ones. I'm sure you've seen them. They're encroaching upon my nest and just a total nuisance. 

Bothering myself and my friends? The nerve! Here's my feather. Why don't you go change these nuisances into something less bothersome.
78162.progress: I can still hear the annoying sounds of those podlings. It's torture.
78162.completion: You again? You did what? Oh, yes. That's fine.

78163.title: Q'onzu's Qualification
78163.description:
You seek an audience with Q'onzu but bring no offerings? 

One does not just walk up and speak to the loa of Change, I'm afraid. You must first prove you are worth their time.

The friends of Q'onzu have been granted one hundred questions by the loa themself! You must prove your wit and answer each of them true.

Return to me if you answer all one hundred. Then perhaps you'll earn an audience.
78163.completion:
You were actually going to answer a hundred questions? I just assumed that would make you go away.

Next time, I'll raise it to a thousand questions.

78170.title: Nurturing Ageless Seeds
78170.objectives: Nurture each of the seed we planted with Ageless Dewdrops.
78170.description:
The growth of these seeds is a delicate balance, requiring constant nurturing.

I've found that Ageless Dewdrops, gathered from around this area, hold a special energy that can awaken the dormant potential within these seeds. 

If you could collect some dewdrops and apply them to the plants, we can unlock their full potential.
78170.progress: Have you given the Ageless Dewdrops to the blossoming seeds?
78170.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Your willingness to aid in the nurturing of these ancient seeds warms my heart.

78171.title: Blossoms of the Past
78171.description:
With your help, these seeds have grown into magnificent plants. However, the most exciting part is yet to come.

Each of these plant's blossoms contain a treasure trove of information about their history and the magic that binds them to the world tree. By studying these blossoms, we can better understand the lineage of each plant.

Gently collect the blossoms that have fallen and return them to me.
78171.progress: Have you collected the three blossoms?
78171.completion: You have done fine work. This may guide you to help restore other plant species from any seeds you may find.

78172.title: Mysterious Seeds
78172.objectives: Deliver the seeds to Sylvia Whisperbloom at the Wildling Garden.
78172.description: <These mysterious seeds might be of interest to Sylvia Whisperbloom.>
78172.completion: These seeds hold the key to unlocking the legacy of much of the strange flora that was lost in the fires that consumed Teldrassil.

78177.title: To Gilneas
78177.objectives: Travel to Keel Harbor in the Ruins of Gilneas.
78177.description:
The time has come to reclaim my kingdom, champion. The Forsaken have left the land, as promised.

However, in their absence it seems the Scarlet Crusade have decided to move in and use the city as their own personal stronghold. I mean to move them out. 

Join me in retaking Gilneas.
78177.progress: Gilneas will be ours once more.
78177.completion:
Well then, looks like I'm in charge now.

A bit unexpected, but not unwelcome.

Very well. Let's do this.

78178.title: To Gilneas
78178.objectives: Travel to Gilneas in Eastern Kingdoms to assist with retaking Gilneas City for the Gilneans.
78178.description:
{NAME}, we've received word of an offensive occurring soon in Gilneas. 

We have been working with the Alliance to return Gilneas to the Gilneans. Unfortunately, the Scarlet Crusade have taken up residence in the city.

We wish to provide assistance in purging the Scarlet's and return the Gilneans lands to them. 

Lilian and I want you to join us in this operation.
78178.progress: Thank you for coming to help, {NAME}.
78178.completion:
Huh.

I did not expect to be given command.

Very well. Let's do this.

78180.title: A Crusade of Red
78180.objectives: Kill 10 Scarlet Crusade Members in Aderic's Repose.
78180.description:
Calia will lead the Forsaken army in a distracting assault to the North.

I'd like you to meet up with Lilian and me in the city. There's a secret tunnel that will give us access to the south. From there, we can open the south gate and let our forces in while the Scarlets are distracted with Calia's troops.

There's a group of Scarlet Crusade currently skulking about the entrance to that secret tunnel. Care to take them out?
78180.progress: These Scarlets are a blight upon the land.
78180.completion: The first blow to the Scarlet Crusade was well struck, thanks to you.

78181.title: Aderic's Retort
78181.objectives: Slay Consecrator Hennas in Aderic's Repose.
78181.description:
The scouts report that the Scarlet Crusade at Aderic's Repose are being encouraged to tamper with the graves of my people by one Scarlet in particular. 

Too many Gilneans gave their lives defending this land. I will not let their sacrifice be... defiled in this manner!

Take out their leader, and send them a message they won't soon forget.

78182.title: Knee-High
78182.objectives: Make your way through the secret tunnel in Aderic's Repose to Gilneas City.
78182.description:
Tess and Voss are waiting for you at the end of the tunnel. Once you arrive, the three of you will open the south gate from the inside, and let our forces into the city.

Head through the tunnel to meet them. Take this torch, the way is infested with vermin. 

I'll ready our forces to storm the gate the moment it is opened.
78182.completion:
{NAME}, right on time.

Are you ready for the next phase of our attack?

78183.title: Scarlet Blood
78183.description:
Looks like they've filled the city with their most experienced forces. Don't worry, I have plenty of experience taking them down... personally. 

We'll whittle their numbers down one by one.
78183.completion: They're all too far gone to be reasoned with. Such a waste of life.

78184.title: Smokepowder and Mirrors
78184.description:
Opening the gate is all well and good, but we'll need to clear a way for our forces to advance first. Our scouts reported that the Crusade has explosives that they've stashed in the area.

Surely they won't mind if we borrow some?
78184.completion: No use squandering perfectly good explosives.

78185.title: Hounds of War
78185.objectives: Open the gates to Gilneas City.
78185.description:
I think we've had enough fun on our own, yes? 

The Scarlets stationed near the city's chapel seem to be the most elite of their forces. I believe we'll find whoever is leading them there, but going alone is unnecessarily dangerous.

Time to bring the true might of Gilneas and take our city back. My forces stand ready to charge!

78186.title: Crushing the Crusade
78186.objectives: Kill 12 Scarlet Crusade members in the Gilneas City chapel courtyard.
78186.description:
The most powerful members of the Scarlet Crusade will be defending the nest of their leader, {NAME}. That's where I come in. 

Nothing like a little distraction to take an enemy down swiftly. Just let me know where and when to strike.
78186.completion: Good. My troops will clear out the rest of them.

78187.title: Artillerist Arsonist
78187.description:
The chapel seems to be their base, and it is well defended--they've set up multiple defenses throughout the courtyard. The troops would have an easier time sieging if we could get some of them out of the way.

Remember those explosives we gathered? Now is when they come in handy.
78187.completion: That should give our forces some breathing room.

78188.title: Righteous Fire, Righteous Fury
78188.objectives: Slay the leader of the Scarlet Crusade.
78188.description: Only one person remains standing between us and our city. Ready yourself--this won't be an easy fight.
78188.completion:
We've done it--it will take time to rebuild of course, but Gilneas is ours again! 

I can scarcely believe it.

78189.title: Beginning a New Dawn
78189.objectives: Listen to Genn Greymane's conversation with Tess.
78189.description:
Much has changed since we had to leave this city. Both the land, and my people.

Bear witness, {NAME}, to the future of Gilneas.
78189.completion: I... I don't know what to say. Thank you, {NAME}. For everything.

78190.title: What We Left Behind
78190.objectives: Follow King Greymane and keep an eye on him.
78190.description:
He just... handed me the kingdom.

Me!

This is going to take a bit to process. But... look, {NAME}. I know my father's a strong man, but there are times he holds himself so rigid that I fear he'll break. I'm not about to coddle him, but if you could just follow along, make sure he's all right? Soothe a daughter's heart? 

A queen's heart?
78190.completion:
Tess sent you, didn't she? That girl... she's clever, determined, and loves just as fiercely as she defends. It's why she is in charge now. 

Do not worry over me, {NAME}. My role in the world is far from over. The Alliance still needs my expertise--and with Gilneas in good hands, I find myself free to fully take on that challenge. Thank you for your concern.

And thank you for everything you've done for my kingdom over the years. You are a shining example of skills I am still learning to master myself.

78206.title: Emerald Bounty
78206.objectives: Partake in the Emerald Frenzy to earn Emerald Dewdrops and contribute a Dreamseed to sprout new growths.
78206.description:
There are so many more species to locate and study. As you explore the Dream, you will find more seeds known as Dreamseeds. Please, nurture them to continue our studies, and enjoy the bounty they share with you!

You will find Dreamseeds all over, but many are hoarded by powerful creatures around the Dream.

Additionally, you should keep an eye out for the surge of life energy we call an Emerald Frenzy. It will be a source of many Emerald Dewdrops, which will help in nurturing Dreamseeds.
78206.progress: Have you helped further our research?
78206.completion: Your efforts are most appreciated. With your help, these plant species may someday be able to return to Azeroth.

78226.title: A Most Intriguing Invitation
78226.objectives: Meet the 'Vizier' in the Burrows of Azj-Kahet's City of Threads.
78226.description:
We've received an invitation. Or rather, you have, {NAME}.

It's a request to meet with the Vizier. That name rattles even the most wealthy and powerful figures in the City of Threads.

Gaining this individual as an ally could seal our victory against Ansurek's horrid little shadow for good.

You're to meet them in the Burrows. Use the pheromone dispenser here in my lair to mask yourself enough to enter safely.
78226.completion:
It surprises me little to see that you've made allies amongst the Kaheti, {NAME}.

And, yes. I'm alive and well. 



Not too much of a shock, I hope?

78228.title: Into a Skittering City
78228.objectives: Tell the Vizier of the Weaver's plan, and apply Pheromones for access to the Umbral Bazaar.
78228.description:
I sent these 'invitations' to you and Alleria, both. I'd have bet my father's sword you wouldn't let such a unique opportunity pass you by--it's what sets you apart from us all. Alleria, however...

Nevermind. She's as cautious as she is assertive. I suppose I was hoping for the latter, but it's the former that's kept her alive.

Perhaps she'll find us later on. For now, it's time you and my new acquaintance properly meet.
78228.progress:
For being so young, I find Master Anduin is practically bursting with the grand experiences of a much more traveled sort.

Impressive. At least from the perspective of a humble Kaheti.
78228.completion:
Quite the entrance. I should replicate it in the next cabinet meeting.

<Nizrek emits a cough you imagine might be a chuckle.>

Perhaps we should give them a private moment. Whilst we let them have it, would you hear out a small request of mine?

78231.title: Like a Spider on the Wall
78231.description:
Inviting Alleria was a risk... but even at this moment, I feel it was worth taking. I know it was.

I will speak with her on my own. In the meantime, I'd like you to venture into the city above. The pheromones Nizrek gifted you will allow access into the Umbral Bazaar. Observe the merchants, listen to the conversations, purchase their goods.

This city is as vibrant as Stormwind. And its people are as worthy of freeing from abuse as our own. Experience for yourself how similar we all are.
78231.progress: Enjoy yourself? And no trouble with the pheromones, I hope.
78231.completion:
A vibrant people, such as any other we've encountered together over the decades.

They deserve that same peace and protection that we seek for our own. 

Let us vow that, when forced to fight, it will always be against the source of strife. Never the victims of it.

78232.title: Rewriting the Rewritten
78232.description:
We called you here today because it is "Ascendance Day". Queen Ansurek has deigned declare it a day to revel in our newfound, void-infused evolution--our "Ascendance". Please note my satirical nuance.

While the streets are alive with festivity and joyous citizens, the Shadecasters planted through the Bazaar will be drowning the air with Ansurek's vile propaganda.

Take this invention of mine. Use it to overwrite them with more... illuminating information for the public.
78232.progress:
Anduin has me worried.

I've always known him to lean towards diplomacy, but does he have the conviction to draw his sword?

If he does not, he may never be able to end this war.
78232.completion:
Yes. The Vizier asked the same of me in the other city districts.

I'll admit that my reluctance to trust Anduin's new ally has waned slightly. No more than a little finger's length, but even that is more than I anticipated.

78233.title: The Weaver's Gift
78233.objectives: Find the friends the Weaver has revealed to you as a gift.
78233.description:
A little weave-rat tells me that an intriguing series of events are playing out to the north. It seems there has been a remarkably coincidental waterfall of failures marring the military efforts there.

I want to know who is responsible. Look into it for me, and see if your curiously binary eyes can pluck out any potential allies.

Some of your little friends are among the escapees drawing the ire of one "Zev'kall." Do go catch up. Tell them the Weaver bids them... greetings.
78233.completion:
We thought we were well hidden.

Clearly, not as hidden as we would have liked. But I am grateful to see you, nonetheless.

78234.title: Force Your Way
78234.description:
Even with the general gone, it's not going to be easy getting out of here. This place is infested.

I know I'm hiding it well, but I'm not exactly feeling my best. I'm not sure I'll be much help in this state.

You're going to have to clear a path for us.
78234.progress: Say what you will, but you do meet the most interesting company while imprisoned.
78234.completion:
In my defense, they disarmed me. And envenomed me. Also, does this look infected to you?

Anyway, if not for all that, I would have helped. You have my word.

78236.title: Scrappy Straggler
78236.description:
If someone got left behind, we need to do something about that.

I hate to say it, but these people need someone to protect them here. I have to stay.

Find this straggler. And while you're at it, take a peek behind enemy lines. See if you can find anything useful.
78236.progress: The others all made it to safety, right?
78236.completion:
I definitely had everything under control.

<Flynn winces.>

But... I'll admit, this venom is dulling my otherwise lightning-quick reflexes, {NAME}.

78237.title: Let Fly!
78237.objectives: Stow away into a box to be carried into Siegehold.
78237.description:
Hm. This Anub'azal gave the orders that led to the prisoners' escape. Zev'kall here didn't seem very pleased with that.

So how about this--you sneak into Siegehold, and make best friends with Anub'azal. Easy.

I've noticed a lot of cargo being ferried over, I'm sure no one would notice if we just swapped out the contents of a particular crate.

In the meantime, I'll share our discoveries with the Weaver. I'd love to come with you, but I'd rather not tempt more Flynn stabbings today.
78237.completion:
What an interesting "delivery" you are.

I have use for you.

78240.title: [DNT] DEPRECATED
78240.objectives: Steal the pheromones from the delayed convoy.
78240.description:
<The little spider holds out a new note for you.>

Siegehold is dangerous, but you have made it this far already.

Bring me the pheromones. Then we will be ready to set our sights on bigger goals.

78244.title: Kaheti Hospitality
78244.objectives: Speak to Anduin when you're ready to observe the Ascendance Day speech, and exit the city quietly after.
78244.description:
That stage in the distance is where Ansurek will give her Ascendance Day speech.

You, Alleria, and I shall make our way up one of the nearby towers and observe. If we are to turn her own citizens against her, then we must also gain as much first hand experience with her tactics as we can manage.

I've already told Alleria as much, but we cannot make our presence known. If we do run into any trouble, the Vizier has arranged for a set of getaway fliers at the edge of the Burrows where we first met.
78244.progress:
The Vizier has made special accommodations for us to reach the tower we'll be observing from.

Sticking to the plan will mean we all get out safely.
78244.completion: We made it. Perhaps not as quietly as intended, but alive.

78248.title: What We Still Have
78248.description:
I went into the city prepared--prepared to end this war even if I was ended with it.

But I am alive. As are you. As is Anduin. We have new allies and a new way forward. I realize at this moment that my vision may have been obscured by my guilt.

Part of me feels those words are Anduin's, not mine. Perhaps he's rubbing off on me.

Let us return to your Weaver's Lair. I wish to see yours and Anduin's efforts to save these people as well as our own through.
78248.progress: I do believe my suggestion was to stay quiet while in the city, was it not?
78248.completion:
How many times were my suspicions diverted from Executor Nizrek's true identity as the "Vizier?" Perhaps I've lost my step. Me! A master of spycraft.
