Hah--far more likely, it is that he's simply much better than I give him credit for.

I find myself quite stirred by the knowledge that someone's gift for subterfuge may rival my own. We shall work together quite nicely.

78249.title: Specific Personages
78249.objectives: Kill Zev'kall's minions for General Anub'azal.
78249.description:
Zev'kall has recently placed his own loyal lackeys in key positions around Siegehold. Killing them will force replacements, which will cause chaos and re-training.

All of which will make Zev'kall struggle. Get rid of all three.
78249.progress: All three must be removed from office.
78249.completion:
Zev'kall knows that I am involved. I wanted him to know. But he can say nothing, because he is unable to make his own pheromone marks. I have used mine for his needs, so far. 

If he admits he can't, everyone would question his authority... not to mention his status as a nerubian.

It is quite a scandal.

78250.title: General Admission
78250.objectives: Find some useful blackmail material for the General.
78250.description:
It isn't enough to inconvenience Zev'kall. He should be humiliated. I already have some information, but I need more.

He stores military logs in a room that is too tiny for me to access. See what information he's hiding. I'm sure there's potential blackmail material in there somewhere.
78250.progress: There should be something I can use.
78250.completion:
Let me see!

This... is not blackmail material. But it is far worse.

78251.title: Dalaran's Most Distressed
78251.objectives: Free prisoners for the fake prisoner convoy.
78251.description:
I don't trust this big bug at all. He let me lay there ages without saying anything!

But if he wants to give us access to Siegehold, let's use it. I saw some other people dragged away into other parts of the base. I don't think they're eating them. It looks more like they're transporting them somewhere.

Let's gather them up, make a prisoner convoy, and roll on out. Find me outside!
78251.completion:
Wow... this is a LOT of people.

But they're all miserable. Fortunately, that's just the flavor we need to sell my idea.

This could work.

78254.title: Stolen Influence
78254.objectives: Steal the pheromones and prepare to sneak them out of Siegehold.
78254.description:
These logs of Zev'kall's... he is wasting numerous nerubian lives. Throwing them away like some rabid mantid.

We must act. As I said, Zev'kall doesn't produce his own pheromone marks anymore due to this 'Ascension' process. He's been forced to use mine. His alchemist is trying to concoct some for him... but once they do, what of me?

Take those false pheromones and sneak them out of Siegehold. Expose Zev'kall, use them... you're creative, aren't you? Just make it messy.
78254.progress: What did the General ask you to do?
78254.completion:
Smuggle these out? Hmm.

I bet we can use these later, but... if we need to, we'll use them to escape.

Hopefully it won't come to that.

78255.title: Just Act Casual
78255.objectives: Help the convoy to exit Siegehold by speaking to the gatekeeper.
78255.description:
It's time to get outta here with the prisoners and those pheromones. I've found some convincing chains, since we have such a big group. Long as everybody stays in character, our chances look good. 

We've only got General Anub'azal's marker scent goop for you and I, so we'll be the drones with permission. You do all the talkin', while I mind the cart. I hope this works.

Lead us through the gate, {NAME}!
78255.progress: We just need to make it out of the entrance. I'll figure it out from there.
78255.completion: Let's take a quick breath. We didn't lose anyone, did we?

78256.title: The General's Consensus
78256.objectives: Take Zev'kall's pheromones to someone that has a use for them.
78256.description:
We got lucky here. That General Anub'azal is so interested in sabotaging Zev'kall that it's an "enemy of our enemy is our friend" situation for today.

I feel like this is gonna be a theme: spiders tryin' to use us against each other. Ah, well.

You're gonna want to take those pheromones somewhere useful, huh? You do that. I'll take these folks safely out of harm's way.
78256.progress: What do you have for me?
78256.completion:
What a beautiful gift!

General Anub'azal could be an excellent ally. I'm pleased with your work, morsel.

78262.title: It Starts With a Stone
78262.description:
This land holds so many secrets. And even more power!

And you... we both know you enjoy unraveling secrets and collecting marvelous gear. And when you're ready to unlock the power of gear you find in this new land, come visit Cuzolth and me. We are experimenting and will be able to upgrade your gear by the time you come back.

Please bring me some Flightstones and a new item so I can show you how these upgrades work.
78262.progress: Can you feel the power? The excitement of knowing you can now take on even more daring adventures?
78262.completion:
Now look at all that shine and glitter! 

Please accept these gifts.

78271.title: Dreaming of Crests
78271.description:
Now that you've learned the fundamentals, you can easily upgrade lower-level gear.

Sooner than later, though, you will find better gear that requires various types of Dreaming Crests to upgrade. Much like Flightstones, these Crests are rewarded through many different activities. Dreaming Crests have four tiers, and more dangerous tasks reward you with higher-tier crests.

Go and help with tasks, down formidable foes, find treasures, and bring me a few handfuls of Whelpling's Dreaming Crests!
78271.progress: I foresee great results with these Dreaming Crests.
78271.completion: Yes, yes! These crests hold magnificent power. And now so will you.

78274.title: Quacking Down
78274.description: Here they go again. Do you mind scaring off those ducks again? I need to stay here and keep an eye on my golden egg.

78289.title: To Rambleshire
78289.description:
There's word of troubles in the village of Rambleshire, at the base of Thunderhead Peak. 

Can't abide the place myself. Always wet and rumbling.

But Rooktender Lufsela thought it worth a look, however, seeing as how the birds fancy the moss that the village produces. She's still green though, and might just need a hand.
78289.completion:
Otwin sent you? Probably misses my help brushing out the rooks. But there's something amiss here in Rambleshire.

There should be a storm overhead. Been visible from Dornogal for as long as I can remember. Without that storm, I fear the local mosswool operation is in trouble.

78290.title: Sleepy Sheep
78290.objectives: Use an Energized Lodestone to rouse 8 Lethargic Mosswools near Rambleshire.
78290.description:
The energized moss that these flocks produce is a favorite treat for the storm rooks. But with the storm gone, the rams are lethargic, vulnerable, and no longer producing.

We may not be able to conjure a storm, but we could offer the mosswools a motivating zap. See if you can find a lodestone that will hold a charge. Then bring it here to Shraubendre so she can get it loaded up.
78290.progress: The lodestone should hold just enough of a charge to give the mosswools the motivation they need to return to their corrals. It won't hurt them.
78290.completion:
The mosswools look like they have a bit more pep. Hopefully they'll start producing again soon, if the storm comes back, that is.

Rancher Stenspor believes he knows why the storm is missing. He claims two legendary ram brothers re-energize the storm once a year. Just not this year, for some reason.

78291.title: Power Predators
78291.description:
Thunderhead Peak normally boasts a perpetual storm from which the local mosswools draw energy. Without it, the poor dears look to be listless and near dead on their feet. That makes them easy pickings for predators.

To get moss production back on track, we'll need to get to the bottom of the missing storm. But first we need to beat back these predators before they turn the mosswools to gravel.
78291.progress: Please do what you can for the poor mosswools.
78291.completion:
That should buy the ranchers and their flocks some time while we figure out what's going on with the missing storm. No storm means no moss, which means grumpy storm rooks.

According to the locals, the storm is born of two legendary rams butting heads atop Thunderhead Peak. They think one of them went missing, if you can believe that.

78292.title: Lost Lord of the Storm
78292.description:
Listen well, stranger. Once a year, the great ram Durzan, Lord of the Southern Storm, crosses the isle to meet his brother Belzt on Thunderhead Peak. The clash of their horns heralds the storm and brings prosperity for another year.

But something is wrong. Durzan has not come and the skies have cleared. The Stormrider may not believe, but I sense you have seen wilder things.

Ask around if you still have doubts. Just please help us find Durzan.
78292.progress: Pray Durzan is still with us. If the brothers don't meet at the summit, the storm and our livelihoods will be lost.
78292.completion: You found him! But why hasn't he gone to the mountain? And why does he look so forlorn?

78293.title: Their Moss, Our Gain
78293.objectives: Harvest moss from Rambleshire Mosswools and feed it to Durzan.
78293.description:
You say nerubians had him? Not sure what they wanted with old Durzan, but he looks weakened by the ordeal. We can't have that if he's to challenge his brother Belzt on the mountain.

The moss harvested from our flocks gives the storm rooks a kick, so Durzan might benefit from it as well. Collect a bushel's worth and make an offering.

And if the mosswools get ornery, be sure to put them in their place.
78293.progress: That moss captures and contains the power of the storm. It ought to give Durzan the boost he needs to get back up on that mountain.
78293.completion: That seemed to do the trick. I think he's ready to return to his brother on Thunderhead Peak.

78294.title: Thunderhead Butt
78294.objectives: Accompany Durzan to Belzt on Thunderhead Peak.
78294.description:
Durzan looks hale and hearty again. That moss packs a real punch.

I have a sense that he's ready to go. I just wish we had more time. I have so many questions. But the greatest of those questions will be answered when he reaches the peak.

We shouldn't send him up there alone. But I think he trusts you to take him.
78294.progress: We'll be watching from here. I truly hope Belzt is up there waiting.
78294.completion:
The legends were true. The storms, the rooks, and these rams. They're all connected.

I have so much more to learn. But thank you for setting me on this path.

78328.title: Take a Look Around
78328.description:
The Gala of Gifts is here to showcase the many wonderful artisans carefully crafting gifts just for you and your loved ones.

You should see what they have to offer, and talk to the other attendees. Who knows, you might just find the perfect gift for someone you care about!
78328.progress: Have you seen all of the wares available?
78328.completion:
Aren't the wares just marvelous? I find myself just a little jealous of the talent--and I find it hard to resist picking up everything they've made!

Did anything catch your eye?

78329.title: Love is in the Air
78329.description:
Smell these roses! My partner got them for me at the Gala of Gifts.

Interested in seeing things yourself? Head to the gates of Stormwind. There are gifts, and food, and you should taste the chocolate, it's delicious!
78329.completion:
Welcome to the Gala of Gifts, friend!

Would you like to hear more about our specialty chocolates?

78332.title: I Smell Trouble
78332.description:
You smell that funny odor too? Smells like smoke, cheap cologne, and alchemical nonsense. You ask me, I think the Crown Chemical Co. is up to something. Want to help me get to the bottom of it?

Well, take a look at my pal here. Sure, he looks like a pooch, but this is O.D.I.E.! The Olfactory Detection and Inspection Engine! With this little fella, you and I can sniff out whatever the Crown is plotting from a mile away!

Are you in? I could use a good partner to solve this.
78332.progress: Sure, O.D.I.E. can sniff out the clues, but you still gotta piece 'em together.
78332.completion:
Poisonous perfumes? Revenge for kicking 'em out of the city?

Seems like Apothecary Hummel is cooking up something sinister again. But deadly poisons? Sheesh, this could get ugly.

78337.title: An Unwelcome Gift
78337.description:
I have a sinking suspicion there are spies from the Crown Chemical Co. among us. But I know that you know that O.D.I.E. here knows how to latch onto their scent!

But let's not bother anybody just here to have a good time, all right? Keep your nose peeled for chemicals, and make sure we're hitting the right targets.
78337.progress: Follow your nose, pal! Anyone who stinks could be a suspect.
78337.completion:
Yeesh, {NAME}, you reek!



Even worse! I reek!

Well at least we've given some peace to the gala. I'd hate to have the Crown ruining the celebrations.

78350.title: Heroes Never Die
78350.description:
Damn it all! We were too hasty, and now my people are paying the price.

We were fools to think the nerubians wouldn't be prepared for an incursion. Arathi soldiers are made of stern stuff, but even they will struggle to walk off an airship crash.

I will keep everyone here safe. Please, go into the field and rescue as many people as you can.
78350.progress: Make haste, {class}. Time is of the essence.
78350.completion: I thank you, {NAME}, on behalf of those you saved. No one deserves to die alone in the dark, least of all in a place like this.

78354.title: A Guiding Thread
78354.description:
<The words on the parchment appear burned, not written. A venomous tang singes your nose.>

Blind and alone, you stumble in the dark. I offer you a thread to cling to.

Follow it, should you wish to find your allies.
78354.progress: State your business, lest I get peckish.
78354.completion:
So you followed my guiding line to its terminus. 

For both of our sakes, I am glad that your zeal outpaces your survival instinct.

78355.title: Essence of a Broken Dream
78355.objectives: Find Merithra in Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope, and show her the Twisted Dreaming Essence.
78355.description: <You feel an echo of ancient sorrow, fear, and rage as you gaze into the swirling depths of this strange sphere. Maybe Merithra will know more about it?>
78355.completion: Interesting... I sense poor Gnarlroot's ancient hopes and dreams within, but darkened and twisted by Igira's depraved cruelties. It's as if the Dream itself tried to isolate her efforts in this essence.

78363.title: The Tabard of Your Dreams
78363.objectives: Talk to Keeper Amrymn at the Central Encampment.
78363.description:
<Melsysra drops a slightly damp note into your hand.>

{NAME}, we are immensely grateful for all you've done to help us. Please meet me at Central Encampment so we can properly reward you for your efforts!

- Amrymn
78363.completion: You have more than earned this tabard. Is it all that you have dreamed it would be?

78369.title: Crushing the Crown
78369.description:
Looks like Hummel's got some security. But don't worry, I came with some special gifts to deliver.

<Snagglebolt points to the unmarked box.>

Bombs. I got bombs.

Playtime's over. Take those bombs and toss 'em at the Crown and their supplies. Let's give them a look at what genuine craftsmanship can do. Once we've cleared out their operations, we can move in on Hummel.
78369.progress: We need to put a stop to this before the Crown pulls off their smelly sabotage.
78369.completion:
Man, I love a good fireworks show! Great job, {NAME}. That oughta slow them down.

Now there's just Hummel to deal with.

78373.title: The Dream Thanks You
78373.objectives: Talk to Amrymn in the Central Encampment.
78373.description:
<Melsysra drops a slightly damp note into your hand.>

{NAME}, your contributions to the dream are immeasurable. Please meet me at the Central Encampment, we have a reward we're excited to give you.

- Amrymn

78379.title: The Stench of Revenge
78379.description:
We're never gonna see an end to this unless we take on the boss himself.

Look, Apothecary Hummel is holed up in Shadowfang Keep with his cronies. He's working on a new batch of poisonous perfumes, and they'll knock out all of Stormwind if we let him finish his research.

You go do what you do best, pal. Get in there and foil his schemes before we're all lavender-scented corpses.
78379.progress: You ready to see what Hummel is cooking? I guarantee you it's not as pretty as it smells.
78379.completion:
Sounds like you got there just in time--great work.

This would have gotten real ugly if Hummel poisoned the entire gala.

Let's just call this our gift to them, eh?

78381.title: Dreams Unified
78381.objectives: Find another Splintered Spark of Dreams.
78381.description:
Another incredible find, {NAME}!

This half of a Spark of Dreams could prove useful in your crafting endeavors if you could unite it with a sister piece.

Set out in search of another Splintered Spark of Dreams and combine them.
78381.progress: Have you located another Splintered Spark of Dreams?
78381.completion: That's great news! As you find more you can continue to combine them to benefit your crafted gear.

78383.title: Strategic Edge
78383.objectives: Find Flynn's Blades and 3 nerubian intel from Kaheti forces in Rak-Zakaz.
78383.description:
To add insult to injury, they disarmed me. I'm not leaving without those blades!

While we're looking, keep an eye out for any evidence of what's going on here. Anything that could give us an advantage against the nerubians.

Something strange happened that provided us the opening to escape. I have a feeling that could be something we can exploit.
78383.progress: There must be something around here of value to the Weaver...
78383.completion:
This seems like enough to trade to the Weaver for that antidote. Anub'azal is a good lead to investigate. Maybe he'll barter like the Weaver did, and we'll get something even better from him.

It sounds like a good risk to me.

78384.title: Chasing the Light
78384.objectives: Search for clues of Anduin's survival.
78384.description:
Anduin survived that swarm. I do not doubt that for a moment. Even so, the nerubians are everywhere and he is just one man.

Wherever he goes, wherever he is taken, I will find him. Find me any sign that he yet lives. That is all I need to follow him to Azeroth's end.
78384.progress:
You've returned.

I trust you have news.
78384.completion:
A shattered gauntlet and some scraps of cloth... but no corpse. That's good, at least. He's alive, and he fought back.

Still, it's not much to go on. Most rangers would be understandably stumped.

Luckily, I am not most rangers.

78385.title: Small Dreamseeds
78385.description:
<Melsysra drops a slightly damp note into your hand.>

{NAME}, we've noticed an increase of fertile dirt within the Dream. It's the perfect opportunity for new plants! Come talk to me so we can start planting some seeds.

- [NPC]
78385.completion: Please accept these Dreamseeds as a thank you for all you've done.

78386.title: Emerald Reawakening
78386.objectives: Talk to Elianna in the Central Encampment.
78386.description:
<Melsysra drops a slightly damp note into your hand.>

{NAME}, we found a way to bring creatures into the dream. Speak to me if you'd like to know more!

- Elianna

78387.title: Plump Dreamseeds
78387.description:
<Melsysra drops a slightly damp note into your hand.>

{NAME}, we've noticed an increase of fertile dirt within the Dream. It's the perfect opportunity for new plants! Come talk to me so we can start planting some seeds.

- [NPC]
78387.completion: Please accept these dreamseeds as a thank you for all you've done.

78388.title: Gigantic Dreamseeds
78388.description:
<Melsysra drops a slightly damp note into your hand.>

{NAME}, we've noticed an increase of fertile dirt within the Dream. It's the perfect opportunity for new plants! Come talk to me so we can start planting some seeds.

- [NPC]
78388.completion: Please accept these dreamseeds as a thank you for all you've done.

78392.title: The Tangled Web
78392.description:
Make no mistake--I have no intention of sending you off to skitter about in the dark like a freshly-hatched beetle. It wouldn't do to have my little morsel snatched up by a starving cave borer.

You must educate yourself, my dear. Your allies have found themselves ensconced in a torrid tapestry. Only by familiarizing yourself with its erstwhile architects can you hope to reclaim them.

Luckily for you, I have made some of my personal resources available to you.
78392.progress: Haven't you finished yet? Really, the archives' design is quite elegant. Just tap and listen. Even a spindly thing like you can figure it out, I am sure.
78392.completion: Now you see how the stage has been set. You have arrived in the middle of the play, I fear--but you needn't worry! You've time yet to play a most vital role.

78393.title: A Seeming Respite
78393.objectives: Explore the Lair of the Weaver.
78393.description:
You have endured quite the evening since your ill-fated little ship ride, haven't you? Worry not, little morsel. You will find that my friends here are most accommodating, even to someone with your predilections--as strange as they may be.

Please, take a moment to explore. Avail yourself of my many amenities. With luck, you will find some sorely-needed rest.

...Oh, but do take care not to move about too quickly. Sudden movements, I'm sure you understand.
78393.progress: There is no need to be afraid! I am almost certain my companions will not eat you.
78393.completion: Well? Are you not impressed with my hospitality?

78427.title: Great Crates!
78427.objectives: Pack 1 Shipment of Goods with Vashonir in the Central Encampment.
78427.description:
The assault on the Dream grows ever stronger.

We are in desperate need of trade goods and supplies to support the defense effort. Even just one crate could make the difference on the front line.

Vashonir can assist you with packing the shipments. Then bring the shipment to me.

Elune watch over you, defender of the Dream.
78427.progress: Vashonir will assist in preparing the shipments for you.
78427.completion: We are ever more grateful for your contributions.

78428.title: Crate of the Art
78428.objectives: Pack 5 Shipments of Goods with Vashonir in the Central Encampment.
78428.description:
Our stockpiles have taken a grave hit, $p. 

We need to replenish our reserves as soon as possible, lest the enemy gain the upper hand. We will need far more supplies than we previously envisioned.

Once again, Vashonir can assist you with packing the shipments. Please return to me with five crates of goods.

Elune, watch over you.
78428.progress: Be sure to ask Vashonir to help you prepare the shipments!
78428.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. We are ever in your debt.

78429.title: The Power of Dreams, Awoken
78429.objectives: Awaken the power within the Fused Essence.
78429.description: Are you ready, {NAME}? I will fuse the essences of their fiery dreams together for you. Focus the Echoed Ephemera you have collected to awaken the latent power within. Show Fyrakk that even he should fear the power of the Dream!

78430.title: Mean Green Infusion Machine
78430.objectives: Kill 6 podlings and lashers in the Emerald Dream.
78430.description:
Pleased to meet you. I am Elianna, a Dream Researcher.

A strange phenomenon has recently been detected in the Dream. Fragments of dream magic are being left behind by the creatures here.

I'm curious to know the effects of such magic in concentrated doses. But I need someone to extract it for me.

There are some problematic lashers and podlings to the south of here. 

Several of them should be enough for a lesser infusion.
78430.progress: Have you brought me enough Dream energy?
78430.completion: Excellent! We should be able to perform the infusion!

78431.title: Green Dream Team
78431.description:
Most interesting! 

I was able to concentrate the Dream energy you brought me. 

With this, we can perform the infusion!

Go ahead, I'll watch.
78431.progress: Go on! I want to see you infuse Rithro.

78446.title: Aiding the Accord: Superbloom
78446.description:
As life blooms within the Emerald Dream, the budding World Tree Amirdrassil blooms with it. 

The Ancient Sprucecrown's ritual empowers mighty life energies all around the tree, encouraging its growth. The more hands there to help protect and nourish Amirdrassil, the better its bloom will be! 

Please lend your aid to Sprucecrown on his journey.
78446.progress: I do hope you don't suffer from allergies.
78446.completion:
Ah, I can almost smell the flowers on the wind from here!

Please accept this humble gift, along with our gratitude.

78447.title: Aiding the Accord: Emerald Bounty
78447.description:
The Emerald Dream suffers at the forces of the Incarnate Fyrakk. In its turmoil, some of its seeds have trouble taking root. 

In exploring the Dream, I am certain you shall collect some special seeds. Plant them in soil and nourish them into a bloom, and I hear they will share bountiful gifts with you.

Go forth and help life blossom in the Emerald Dream!
78447.progress: I wonder what gifts a flower can bestow?
78447.completion:
The Dream is such a strange place!

Please accept this humble gift, along with our gratitude.

78457.title: Stones of Dornogal
78457.objectives: Meet with various earthen citizens in Dornogal.
78457.description:
I am Merrix, Councilward of Dornogal.

I appreciate your aid--especially in light of the fraught nature of your arrival. You must forgive Stormward Baelgrim. Being suspicious is part of his directive. 

A formal discussion of our situation is warranted. If you wish to strike back at the nerubians, as we do, meet us at the Foundation Hall. Baelgrim and I need to review the data so far.

In the meantime, you are my guest. Take my ring. It will allow you to access Dornogal's amenities.
78457.progress: The attack seems concentrated on the Coreway. The rest of the city is secure, but we should ready ourselves for anything.
78457.completion: Baelgrim's vigilance has kept us safe all these years, but today we need help.

78460.title: Hypocenter
78460.objectives: Clear debris and rescue earthen on the way to the Archive.
78460.description:
I have failed my people. The Coreway is impassible. Dornogal's lifeline to the Ringing Deeps has been severed as has the path beyond.

The nerubians will get their comeuppance. It is my edict as it is my will.

I will ascertain if the Councilward yet functions and bring him to the Archive. Speaker Brinthe should be there, titans willing.

But Oathsworn citizens are still in peril. If you wish to ally with us, clear the debris here and help our survivors. 

I will meet you at the Archive.
78460.progress: The Archive looks intact, fortunately. We must keep it that way at all costs.
78460.completion:
You made it.

Good.

Is that a memory gem? You should not have disturbed our dead.

But... you have brought it to the right place.

78463.title: Building Blocks
78463.objectives: Collect 20 Glittering Ore in The Orecreg.
78463.description:
The quarry is overrun with fungarians, all of the mining tunnels are collapsed, and we do not have time to clear them out and rebuild!

However, I did spy a good amount of ore on the ground on the way here. It would be a start at repairing the Coreway but...

<Baelgrim sighs and grimly looks at the injured Unbound earthen.>

I am needed here. With Adelgonn's people. My people. Will you gather the ore in my stead?
78463.progress: Collect as much ore as you can. The Coreway is still my priority, but these injured need immediate help.
78463.completion:
It is not much, but this ore should help stabilize the Coreway.

With Adelgonn's help, we will be able to reclaim the quarry and its mines and establish a supply line with Dornogal.

78464.title: Delve into the Earth
78464.objectives: Complete the Earthcrawl Mines delve near Freywold Village.
78464.description:
The nerubian attack, your meteoric fall...

And now Baelgrim is here?

Baelgrim needs more hands for his Coreway, but I couldn't help even if I wanted to. My people are dying as we speak. Some were abducted by the nerubians during the attack.

You're not the first outlander I've met. A small fellow, like Moira, arrived here earlier and wasted no time following the nerubians. He took the path west to a nearby cave.

I would be in your debt if you found my people.
78464.progress: The mines were always dangerous even when the Stonebound worked them. Be careful.
78464.completion: Thank you for saving my people from the nerubians.

78465.title: Golgrin's Reach
78465.objectives: Meet Dagran at Golgrin's Reach in the Isle of Dorn.
78465.description:
Now that we have the opals, we can meet Brinthe in Golgrin's Reach.

She said there's a project she's workin' on there she wants me tae help with.

I wonder what it is?
78465.completion:
An archaeological site? A titan vault?

Brinthe didna tell me about this!

78467.title: Charge for a Charge
78467.objectives: Collect 3 Power Cells in Golgrin's Reach.
78467.description:
I am pleased Dagran has brought you here. I need help with a dangerous task.

I used Dagran's opals to repair the titan console we recently recovered from this site.

The Oathsworn have long wanted to learn more about the titans and restore records unreachable in the Archive--or from before its construction.

This console may hold some answers if we can bring it back online.

Take this device I have made. It will lead you to titan power cells we can use to power it on now that it is restored.
78467.progress: Without power, we will not be able to bring the console online.
78467.completion:
Well executed, {NAME}.

Now, I will need Dagran's help.

78468.title: The Archive
78468.objectives: Use the Prismatic Codex to view the Memory Gem. Then, return the Memory Gem to the Archival Repository in The Archive.
78468.description:
The memory gem you recovered is what its name suggests. It contains an earthen's memories, directives, and a hard coding of our Edicts.

This building, the Archive, is the nexus of our civilization. Here, memories are cycled, catalogued, and stored at the end of an earthen's scheduled rotation.

With the codex I have invented, we can access one or two memories from a memory gem. Take it, and read the memory gem you found.
78468.progress: The operating instructions are simple: insert the gem into the device, and a memory will play.
78468.completion: It is... comforting that Odon will be preserved in the Archive.

78469.title: Prairie Fever
78469.objectives: Examine and then deliver Hreka's pottery jars to Kodun in Freywold Village.
78469.description:
I was supposed to see Kodun earlier, but I'm as petrified as unliving stone. The attack on the village was... paralyzing.

<Hreka takes a deep breath and focuses on the shape of another jar.> 

Could you do me a favor and deliver those jars to Kodun? He's a stone's throw away in the village pottery shop. I must finish this piece before the clay dries.
78469.progress: Are you one of the newcomers from the beach crash?
78469.completion:
<Kodun turns the pottery over carefully.>

Perfectly rounded, no cracks, a smooth lip... Hreka's done it again. She's our best crafter in town.

78470.title: The Proscenium
78470.objectives: Journey to the Proscenium in the Isle of Dorn.
78470.description:
The nerubians are attackin' the earthen again. We must follow that swarm!

I fear we are outnumbered, but if the earthen can come together and stand with us...

We may just have a chance.
78470.completion:
The wounded! The nerubians are kickin' the earthen when they're down.

<Moira suddenly points to the center of the battlefield.>

There! In the middle... Is that Zirix? Again? And.. Alleria?

Oh, mountain's strength be with me... We've got tae help them, {NAME}!

78471.title: Convergence
78471.objectives: Return to Foundation Hall in Dornogal.
78471.description:
We know the nerubians are in league with Xal'atath. An' we have a fair idea why they attacked us--and Dalaran.

They seem bent on destroying the earthen--even kickin' 'em when they're down.

But why? Is it because the Coreway is the key an' destroyin' it was nae enough? Maybe what we're doin' here, repairin' the Coreway, is just what they dunnae want us to do.

We should go back to Dornogal an try to piece this together.
78471.completion:
The earthen Council is reunited. Hopefully they can put the past aside an' get the Coreway repaired.

Then hopefully they'll help us with the nerubians--an' Xal'atath.

78473.title: The Power of Dreams, Lost
78473.objectives: Awaken the power within the Fused Essence.
78473.description: You lost the Incandescent Essence? To be so careless with such a precious thing... I can grant you another.

78529.title: Violent Impact
78529.objectives: Climb out of the rubble and find your surviving leaders.
78529.description:
<Your vision swims as you slowly regain consciousness. Distant shouts and screams echo in your ringing ears.

The last thing you remember is Dalaran, the great, floating city of magic, plummeting to the earth--then nothing but darkness.

Mixed in with sounds of shouting and battle, you hear a strange, insectoid chittering.

The nerubians were waiting for you.

You must rejoin the fight, but first you need to free yourself from the crushing weight of the rubble piled atop you.>
78529.completion:
{NAME}! You survived!

Good.

Keep your weapons at the ready. This battle is just beginning.

78534.title: To Dornogal
78534.description:
You have brought death and destruction to our shores the likes of which has not been seen in millennia.

But you have nerubian blood on your hands and a thraegar at your side. This is enough to earn my trust--for now.

My Stormriders and I must return to our capital, Dornogal, and investigate what is likely an ongoing attack there. Fly with us. Our slipstream will allow you to soar through the skies with ease.

I will send other Stormriders to collect your allies once it is safe for them to land.
78534.completion: What have the nerubians wrought? And why?

78535.title: They Come from Below
78535.description:
I do not yet know why you have come here, outlander. But you seem... efficient in killing nerubians.

As are we, the Stormriders, vanguards of this isle.

The nerubians are an ancient enemy. I would not be surprised if this Zirix knows and fears me, the Stormward.

Even so, we could use your skill to help us protect Dornogal.

I have a stormrook for you to ride. Mount up and help us rid our city of these insects!
78535.completion:
I do not know why the nerubians have returned...

Or why they would attack Dornogal.

For now I must focus on assessing the damage to the Coreway.

Our brethren the Machine Speakers may need our aid, and it is the titans' will that the way to the center of Azeroth be kept open.

78536.title: Impossible Odds
78536.description:
By the titans... The Coreway appears completely destroyed! It will take years, perhaps centuries, to remove the rubble and repair the damage the nerubians did to its inner structure, much less traverse to the world's core.

More than that with the Stonebound gone...

I must take a moment to decide what to do.

Your friends have safely arrived. Speak to them, and stay out of my way. 

If we need you, I will let you know.
78536.progress: The Council must be appraised. There will be much to do...
78536.completion: My directive does not account for you, outlander.

78538.title: Group Effort
78538.objectives: Distribute Merrix's orders to 10 Unbound Workers around the Coreway.
78538.description:
The Unbound have arrived with the equipment and resources needed to begin repairing the Coreway.

This is a momentous occasion. One for the Archive! I would not say this to Adelgonn, but I see the titans' hands in it...

And now it is time for me to exercise my directive! I have devised a plan for how to organize our workers most efficiently--and have also allocated supplies to welcome them.

Take these orders to Adelgonn's workers so that they can begin in earnest. We will meet you there shortly.
78538.progress: We must begin work at once.
78538.completion:
Even with this many workers, the Coreway's repairs will take time.

We need to decide what to do in the meantime.

78539.title: Lasting Repairs
78539.objectives: Discuss the plan to attack the nerubians with Baelgrim.
78539.description:
With my Stormriders... inactive, Dornogal is undefended, save a handful of lay peacekeepers. If the nerubians attack us here again, Dornogal will fall--and all of us with it.

It is imperative we draw them away from the city and take out their commander. 

We can and will make our own web and capture Zirix in it.

I have a plan.
78539.progress: We cannot remain on the defense.
78539.completion:
Then it is settled.

We will make our stand at the Cinderbrew Meadery.

78540.title: To the Meadery
78540.objectives: Meet Baelgrim at the Cinderbrew Meadery.
78540.description:
Your archer friend is right. We must eliminate Zirix and his forces if the Coreway is to remain safe.

Let us head to the Cinderbrew Meadery at once.
78540.completion: Thank the titans! The nerubians have not made their move to take the mead yet.

78541.title: Lay the Trap
78541.objectives: Connect 4 Rope Fuses to Sizzling Kegs.
78541.description:
With all these cinderbrew kegs here, this meadery would burn hotter than the Forgegrounds if they were all ignited.

I surmise that's why Wenbrandt's kegs are made out of stout and strong ironwood--they do not break or catch fire easily. 

Luckily, we can start a reaction from the inside if we lead fuses into each of them.

Those ropes the workers left around should work in a pinch.
78541.progress: We need to get the cinderbrew kegs prepared.
78541.completion: Zirix will fall by my hand. It is my directive. It is my will.

78542.title: Evacuation Area
78542.description:
Look, you can blow up my life's work if it is our only choice, but I will not put my workers in danger.

This was the path we all chose, but I won't have them sacrifice themselves to fire or nerubians for it. Tell them that I said they need to get out of here immediately. 

And if a single one of them gets so much as chipped, the Council will have a lot to answer for!
78542.progress: If my workers cannot be kept safe, I am putting a stop to this plan.
78542.completion: I am glad to hear they had the sense to clear out without much of a fuss.

78543.title: Poking the Spider Nest
78543.objectives: Throw a Keg of Cinderbrew Mead into the nerubian burrow and then return to the Meadyard.
78543.description:
The meadery is evacuated and the explosives are primed. It is time to bait the nerubians into our trap.

Your compatriot is by the nerubian burrow north of here. She told me her directive is to keep watch over it in case the nerubians make a move before we are ready.

So far they have not made a move and may now need... coaxing. Take a keg of cinderbrew to the burrow. Tossing it in should stir their "nest."

Rendezvous with us back at the Meadyard--quickly--after.
78543.completion:
The nerubian swarm is on its way.

Prepare yourself.

78555.title: Underground and Overwhelmed
78555.objectives: Help Machine Speakers secure Ironhaul Station.
78555.description:
I've been away too long. The Machine Speakers are clearly not faring well here. Does the High Speaker know about this?

Nerubian sabotage and gross negligence are a devastating combination. We need to get Ironhaul Station up and running as soon as possible. It's a vital link between the Ringing Deeps and the city up above.

Please, $p, help our injured workers, collect any salvageable cargo, and restore safety to Ironhaul Station.
78555.progress: Dead nerubian skitterlings, unexploded bombs, injured workers... what a mess.
78555.completion:
Thank you for getting the workers on their feet. You've restored order, or at least enough for us to get back to work.

The best way to impress Foreman Uzjax is by getting work done, and you're doing that.

*whispers* ... but tread carefully. He's loyal to the powers that be, so we should watch what we say.

78557.title: Getting Off Track
78557.objectives: Investigate the derailed mine cart in Ironhaul Station.
78557.description:
Speaker Brinthe acknowledged. Outlanders, there is work to do.

One of our larger mine carts has derailed. It's blocking the station's main junction. 

My workers' productivity is impaired, and their functioning is suboptimal. The titans put us here to work, but my workers aren't all working. Could you go and get us back on track?

Be careful. I can see you're made of flesh and bone. I don't want you to be crushed.
78557.progress:
As long as we stay loyal, hit our deadlines, and meet our quotas, everything will be fine. 

The gears keep grinding, and we keep working.

Praise the Machine.
78557.completion:
Report requested. Did you find anything? 

It's a what? A "skar-dyn"? 

This information is irrelevant to my assignment. Focusing on work.

78562.title: Discarded and Broken
78562.description:
You there! You're here to help, aren't you?

The humming melody of the machines is changing, and I... I admit I am not ready. For so many years I served faithfully, and then...

Well the important thing is that I'm ready to get to work again. But you see, my tools have all been broken and scattered about. 

If you could keep an eye out for them and bring them back to me, I would be in your debt.
78562.progress: A machinist is nothing without the tools of office.
78562.completion:
My gauge! My calipers! My wrench!

It feels good to have them in my hands again. Though, I have to admit, I have not been entirely honest with you.

78563.title: The Weight of a World
78563.description:
My tools didn't randomly end up where you found them. They were placed there. By me.

I had reached a point so low that I saw no alternative. The machines, the great work of my people, were never going to sing again. So why should I bother to keep them repaired?

But now I see, and now, I understand!

The last tool I need, I dropped it into the water, and it was eaten by a giant creature. I think that one might need a bit more force to return it to me.
78563.progress: Once I have all my tools back, I know that things will be right again.
78563.completion:
<Kittrin doesn't seem bothered at all by the intestinal goo that coats the calibrated weight.>

You found it! Now let me get this cleaned up, and the rest of the tools repaired. Then, I will be ready to serve once again.

78564.title: Reforged Purpose
78564.objectives: Help Machinist Kittrin reforge and rededicate the tools.
78564.description: That's all of them! Now, it's time to do my duty and recast these tools. Reforge them, and myself, into what I was meant to be: a proud machinist of the Ringing Deeps.
78564.progress: I'm ready to do my part once again. I just need to reforge these old tools.
78564.completion:
I can't thank you enough for all of your help. I lost my faith, but now, I have both my faith and my tools back.

I'm forever grateful to you.

78565.title: Getaway to Scenic Grizzly Hills!
78565.description:
Today's special is a magical getaway to the majestic forests of Northrend!

Say, you're one of those adventurers, right? Listen, I need a favor.

Could you pick me a few flowers from Grizzly Hills? I've got my hands full here, but there's someone I'd really like to give a bouquet to.
78565.progress: My partner would really appreciate these flowers.
78565.completion:
Thanks a bucket, {NAME}!

I hope you enjoyed your trip in the hills! Everywhere you look, there's something new to discover.

78570.title: Frayed Legacy
78570.objectives: Meet Igris at the Boskroot Basin on the Isle of Dorn.
78570.description:
Keep true, {race}t.

We of the Woldguard uphold an ancient promise to Freya to tend to these lands. Our edict is older than those wielded by the demagogues in Dornogal. Older than Dornogal itself.

However, not all lands have been tended equally. The leader of our order was to care for the basin nearby but we've not heard from them in many cycles.

I have sent a novice to investigate. Aid them and my order will be in your favor.
78570.completion: This is not as this basin should be. We have much work to do.

78571.title: Mycomayhem
78571.objectives: Collect 30 Boskroot Spores from fungarians in Boskroot Basin.
78571.description:
Freydrin was the leader of my order. I was sent here to assist them. I was too late.

There is a darkness that haunts these woods, {race}s.

These woods were Freydrin's home. It was her charge to tend to them, so given by the Keeper herself. And now she is gone and her woods run amok.

Bring me the spores of these mayhemic menaces. Perhaps there is a way to cleanse this land yet.
78571.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. I will take a close look at them. The fungarians of these woods pose a greater danger than any of us anticipated.

We must be prevent their spread.

78572.title: Wold Memories
78572.objectives: Search Freydrin's home for help against the fungarians in Boskroot Basin.
78572.description:
Freydrin must have had some way of fending off the fungarians.

Although there are few left in the countryside who still follow the Edicts, Freydrin was long a true believer. She would never have allowed these woods to reach this state while she held faith.

We should take a look at her home in the woods. Perhaps there is something that may prove useful inside.
78572.progress: Looking through the Woldkeeper's things unnerves me. So many untold stories.
78572.completion: This staff holds a familiar magic I had hoped to forget. Oh Freydrin, what happened here?

78573.title: Keeper's Aid
78573.objectives: Use Freydrin's Shilelagh to purify Boskroot Basin.
78573.description:
Magical staff? Wards? What were you doing, Freydrin?

<Igris ruminates briefly, her brow crinkling and eyes aglow. After a moment, she turns to you with a smile carved into her face.>

I've got it! 

The life energy in this staff should overcome any mycotic corruptions in the wildlife here. Then you return them to the natural cycle and the land will heal on its own in time.

And if you see any wards, take them down. Take her memory gem just in case. It may yield more information yet.
78573.progress: There is much latent magic buried within this staff. It may be our only hope to bring these fungarians to heel.

78574.title: Boss of the Bosk
78574.objectives: Defeat Rotbark the Unfelled in Boskroot Basin.
78574.description:
There is one final thing I must ask of you.

There is a great monster that roams these woods. I am certain you've sensed it. It must be felled.

Rotbark was Freydrin's final means to control this basin, but even this was too great for any individual earthen. Ours is not to control, but to tend to its needs.

Use the staff once more and bring an end to Rotbark's reign.
78574.progress: If we are to restore this place, we must do so a different way. We must carve a new path.
78574.completion:
Rotbark's demise will mark the ending of this basin's deterioration.

Thank you, {race}. Your assistance has been most invaluable.

78589.title: Invasive Cuisine
78589.objectives: Deliver the Umbral Eggplant to Chef Dinaire at the Fungal Fields.
78589.description: <This rarely seen plant may be of use to Chef Dinaire.>
78589.completion: Umbral Eggplant might not be everyone's idea of a delicious food, but when I prepare it, it is a crowd favorite!

78591.title: Getaway to Scenic Nagrand!
78591.description:
Today's special is a magical getaway to the great plains of Nagrand!

If you're headed there, would you mind shooting a few animals? Oh, not like that! Here, borrow my camera.

My friend Beatrice has been roaming around there lately. She would really appreciate some photographs, but I've got portals to attend to.
78591.progress: There are so many places in Azeroth to escape to! Everywhere you look, there's something new to discover.
78591.completion:
I knew Beatrice would appreciate your photographs.

Thank you for your kindness, {NAME}.

78594.title: Getaway to Scenic Feralas!
78594.description:
Today's special is a magical getaway to the sunny beaches of Feralas! The Steam Pools resort is having a lovely celebration and all are invited!

Unfortunately, some of the partygoers who took this portal earlier left their gifts here at the gala.

Could you help me return them? Meet me at the beach and we'll figure out which gifts belong to whom.
78594.progress: There are so many places in Azeroth to escape to! Everywhere you look, there's something new to discover.
78594.completion:
Thanks for the assistance, {NAME}! You've made a lot of people happy by getting their gifts back to them.

And what an array of gifts they were! Maybe the language of love looks different to everyone.

78595.title: Dream Infused
78595.objectives: Talk to Elianna in the Central Encampment.
78595.description:
<Melsysra drops a slightly damp note into your hand.>

{NAME}, your deeds have helped garner enough strength for a dream infusion! Meet me at the Central Encampment so I can get it to you.

- Elianna

78596.title: Summons to Lord Greymane
78596.objectives: Meet with Genn Greymane at Stormwind Harbor.
78596.description:
Greetings, 

Lord Greymane has requested your presence at Stormwind Harbor to assist him with a matter regarding Gilneas.

That is all I am able to say.

Good luck, {NAME}.
78596.completion:
{NAME}, thank you for coming.

Let me brief you on the mission.

78597.title: Clandestine Movements
78597.objectives: Meet with Lilian and Calia in Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest.
78597.description:
{NAME},

Lilian Voss and Calia Menethil have requested your presence for a clandestine operation involving Gilneas.

They will brief you in full when you arrive.
78597.progress: Excellent, we've been waiting for you.
78597.completion:
{NAME}, thank you for coming.

Let me brief you on the mission.

78600.title: Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope: Up in Smoke
78600.objectives: Collect 3 Fragments of Emberscar from Smolderon within Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope on Normal difficulty.
78600.description: Smolderon appears to be aiding Fyrakk's assault on the Dream! If you collect some fragments of Emberscar, his legendary weapon, we may be able to attune with his energy and assault his throne directly.
78600.progress: The energy found within these fragments will allow us to quickly access the Throne of the Firelord.
78600.completion: These should grant us access to Smolderon's throne more easily.

78601.title: Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope: Up in Smoke
78601.objectives: Collect 3 Fragments of Emberscar from Smolderon within Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope on Heroic difficulty.
78601.description: Smolderon appears to be aiding Fyrakk's assault on the Dream! If you collect some fragments of Emberscar, his legendary weapon, we may be able to attune with his energy and assault his throne directly.
78601.progress: The energy found within these fragments will allow us to quickly access the Throne of the Firelord.
78601.completion: These should grant us access to Smolderon's throne more easily.

78602.title: Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope: Up in Smoke
78602.objectives: Collect 3 Fragments of Emberscar from Smolderon within Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope on Mythic difficulty.
78602.description: Smolderon appears to be aiding Fyrakk's assault on the Dream! If you collect some fragments of Emberscar, his legendary weapon, we may be able to attune with his energy and assault his throne directly.
78602.progress: The energy found within these fragments will allow us to quickly access the Throne of the Firelord.
78602.completion: These should grant us access to Smolderon's throne more easily.

78607.title: To Mereldar
78607.objectives: Travel to Mereldar and meet with General Steelstrike.
78607.description:
We must get to Mereldar and let General Steelstrike know what the Order of Night tried here.

Thank the Sacred Flame we stopped them before they could do any worse.

78613.title: The Bastion of Hallowfall
78613.description:
I have to admit, I did not think that the first visitors we'd have in Mereldar would have been outsiders. I thought the Empire... Well, nevermind.

You have been more than helpful to my people, and that deserves recognition. Mereldar is the bastion of the Arathi in Hallowfall. Take some time, rest.
78613.progress: This city has much to see.
78613.completion: It's been good to sit down and breathe for a bit.

78614.title: Mereldar's Light
78614.description:
I still need more time with Alleria to learn about Xal'atath. What I have learned is very worrying.

Faerin sent word that she was going to the orphanage, and asked you to meet her there. 

She often entertains the children while she is in Mereldar, I don't doubt she would appreciate you doing the same.
78614.progress: It's great to see how happy these kids are, after what they have gone through.
78614.completion:
I love coming here whenever I visit Mereldar. The kids always bring a smile to my face, and I hope I do to them as well. 

After everything they have been though, they deserve happiness.

78615.title: The Bell Tolls
78615.objectives: Go to the main gates of Mereldar in Hallowfall.
78615.description:
Those bells mean Mereldar is under attack! 

Let's get to the gates and find out what is going on.
78615.completion:
We will make them pay for this, {NAME}. 

We will hit them so hard they never come back.

78626.title: Spar Day
78626.description:
Your skills in combat are impressive, {NAME}. 

We are rotating our next round of reserves into active duty, and they need to sharpen their skills. 

While Alleria fills me in on Xal'atath, I would appreciate it if you could help with their training.
78626.progress: The tricks they learn from you today will help them survive a difficult encounter later.
78626.completion:
Thank you.

What they learnt from you will no doubt save their lives later.

78627.title: The Final Front
78627.objectives: Travel to Light's Redoubt in Hallowfall.
78627.description:
Just before the kobyss attacked, we received word of a disturbance near Livia's Patience. Now we know the cause.

We... Light... We can't survive fighting on two fronts, {NAME}. We have to stop this, now.
78627.completion:
Flames, they tunnelled up through the lake bed.

Livia's Patience has already fallen.

78628.title: Trapdoor Sprung
78628.objectives: Kill 15 nerubians in Livia's Patience in Hallowfall.
78628.description:
We need time to get the Reckoning ready. Take your friends and hold back the nerubians for as long as you can.

They deserve nothing but death for what they have done to our people.
78628.completion: Good job, {NAME}. I'm surprised the nerubians aren't fleeing already!

78629.title: Running on Reserves
78629.objectives: Assist 5 Arathi Reserves in Livia's Patience in Hallowfall.
78629.description:
We have to try to save any of our people left alive in Livia's Patience. 

Every Arathi is or was a member of the military. If you can help them, they'll be able to help themselves.
78629.progress: I managed to rescue a few, did you find people to rescue?
78629.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. Between myself, Alleria, Anduin, and you, I think we managed to save quite a few. 

The nerubians abducted many of the rest. We need to help them!

78631.title: Speaking to the Speakers
78631.objectives: Reassure Gundargaz' defenders on the way to the Lost Mines.
78631.description:
I've heard about a problem nearby, and I think I know what's wrong.

We used to have a mining operation northeast of Gundargaz. When we moved out, kobolds moved in.

We haven't heard from those kobolds in a long time, but it sounds like they're raiding us now! And the High Speaker is doing nothing about it.

Someone has to do something. If we can solve this, more Machine Speakers will listen to us. If the High Speaker doesn't get results, we will.
78631.completion: It's good to see some of the kobolds are not so keen on this war.

78634.title: Leave No Stone Behind
78634.objectives: Recover Identification Plaques from fallen earthen in the Lost Mines.
78634.description:
Many earthen fell when the kobolds took this mine.

Worse, those who fell were left to crumble where they dropped. There was no attempt to recover them. We couldn't provide closure or respect their memories. Why? Why did we forsake the fallen?

We will not fail them again, {NAME}. Gather the identification plaques of those we lost, so we may commemorate them properly.
78634.completion:
Thank you, {NAME}. The fallen will be remembered.

The earthen above us have their own rituals of remembrance, and the Machine Speakers have procedures in place. 

There's a plinth in the town square with the plaques of the fallen. Jurlax will ensure that the proper observances are performed... along with process checks and a recalculation of worker allocation. Work never stops here.

78635.title: Death and Waxes
78635.objectives: Recover Flickerflame Candles from around the Lost Mines.
78635.description:
Kobolds take candles seriously. Wax, even more. More important than gold. More important than freedom!

We steal candles from Candle King. We make him look weak. Bully that looks weak loses control. Gets dead!

Also means we not have to wait out here in dark until get eaten. Hurry!
78635.completion:
<Skitter visibly relaxes in the presence of the candles.>

Ah, good. Now get me out of this!

78636.title: Retaking the Mines
78636.objectives: Unlock the gate to the Lost Mines.
78636.description:
Now that we have the keys, it is time to take the fight to the Candle King.

Get that gate open. Once we're inside, we'll move on to the next step.
78636.completion:
That...did not go as expected.

Our new kobold friend might have some better ideas.

78637.title: Cracking Cogchewer
78637.objectives: Kill Cogchewer in the Lost Mines and recover his keys.
78637.description:
Cogchewer is muscle for Candle King. So mean! Rebuilds earthen gears for wars. Also in charge of mine's defenses. 

Need his keys to get in the mines... and get me out of this thing!
78637.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. Never thought I walk free again.

78638.title: Engineering Destruction
78638.objectives: Destroy mining rigs in the Lost Mines.
78638.description:
Some of the kobolds are retrofitting equipment left behind when the mines fell.

Please, destroy the rigs before they're used against us. I'd rather they be scrap than in the hands of an enemy.

There was a storage depot on the western edge of the lowest level of the mine. Start there.
78638.completion: Thank you. Our enemy now has one less advantage.

78639.title: Ko-boldening
78639.objectives: Free oppressed kobolds in the Warrens by defeating their captors.
78639.description:
Bullies everywhere!

Innocent kobolds kept down by Candle King's thugs all across Warrens.

Give bullies taste of own medicine!

Once bullies beaten, innocent have chance to run. Be free!
78639.progress: Now they will see what it feels like!
78639.completion: Is start, friend. Is start. Thank you.

78640.title: Manifesto Destiny
78640.objectives: Scout out and distribute pamphlets across the Warrens from the air.
78640.description:
Before take mines, my people live in great city. Stoneheads call it the Warrens.

Candle King's bullies run it now. We need see what we are fighting. Let kobolds know we here to help! Better choices than Candle King.

What better way than pamphlets? Everyone love pamphlet! We draw real good!

Brinthe say you have some sort of flying dragon-bird-thing? Perfect for scout! Perfect for dropping pamphlets!

<Skitter looks at you expectantly, making small flapping motions as she waits.>
78640.completion:
Sad to see home in such state.

But we fix!

78641.title: Tackling Torchsnarl
78641.description:
Torchsnarl runs Warrens for Candle King. Nothing but big bully! Very, very big bully.

We show everyone. Bullies can be beaten!
78641.progress: Torchsnarl is big one. Don't know why hiding behind flunkies. Still, can't miss him!
78641.completion:
Sad he got away, but everyone else? See him as coward! Just as good.

I'm tall, so I use words good. He's huge! He should use words gooder! Not very smart.

78642.title: New Candle, New Hope
78642.objectives: Recover the Candle Crown from the Darkflame Cleft.
78642.description:
We weaken Candle King's grasp. Still need symbol, rally my people.

King has ancient relic: symbol of hope. Called Candle Crown. Heart of my people. Candle King threw away! Found new prize: Darkflame Candle.

That crown? Still in hoard. Candle King should come out now. See what we did here!

While he looks, we sneak in! Use old tunnels! Take what's ours! We smart.
78642.completion: Ha! We did it! Everyone knows now: Candle King is not only way.

78643.title: Fair Skies and Strong Winds
78643.objectives: Speak with Alexstrasza at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken.
78643.description:
It has been a long road for us all, $p.

But after persevering through hardship and strife, dragonkind stands poised to enter a new age.

Before you leave for your next adventure, my fellow Aspects and I wish to thank you for all you have done for us.
78643.progress: The Dragon Isles stand in your debt.
78643.completion: Fair skies and strong winds to you, {NAME}.

78646.title: Fire Watch
78646.objectives: Regroup with Merithra at the edge of Eye of Ysera, overlooking Slagfell Hold.
78646.description:
My mother seems unable to fully attune with the Eye. Perhaps it senses her ties to Ardenweald...

Her shield is but a fraction of the Eye's power. If she was fully attuned, she could completely quench our foes' flames.

But we cannot idly wait. We still need more information about Galok and his plan of attack. Bodwin indicates there is new flurry of activity in Igira's base of operations. With Bodwin's help, we can investigate without being seen.

78655.title: Adaptive Cooling Salve
78655.objectives: Bring Erden Zaralek Glowspores, Awakened Frost, and a Dreaming Essence for the Adaptive Cooling Salve.
78655.description:
Should you need my assistance, I can craft you an ointment that should prove helpful in your attunement with Fyr'alath.

Bring me the materials I don't have, and I'm sure I can put something together.
78655.progress: Keep at it. All this hard work is going to pay off.

78656.title: Hose It Down
78656.objectives: Activate Baeny the Barrel and use the hose to wash away 40 Contaminating Goo.
78656.description:
With the flame restored, you can see the extent of contamination to the fishing hole. Kobyss and frogs have left heaps of strange goo that pollutes the shoreline.

We need your help to clean up this gooey blight! 

I have a specially modified harvester equipped with a water barrel. Use this device to spray water on the goo piles and clean the shore of this contamination.
78656.progress: Have you cleaned up the shoreline?
78656.completion: Great work {NAME}, things will be a lot less messy around here now!

78664.title: The Gift of Self-Care
78664.description:
The eyes of a tired adventurer.

A {class} that does many great deeds for many people. When was the last time you did a kind gesture for yourself? 

Perhaps now is the time. Look into your heart. 

What do YOU desire?
78664.progress: Love is a blessing, especially if it comes from within.
78664.completion: Let us begin your journey to self-love.

78665.title: Tunnel Trouble
78665.description:
It's good to have new allies here. Together, we have much better chances of protecting this tower.

The nerubians have overwhelmed us. If we're going to have any chance against them, we need to destroy the burrows they're using to come under the Wall.

If you can handle that, we will survey the field from the top of the wall and meet you there.
78665.progress: Were you able to stop the nerubians from coming under the ground?
78665.completion: Excellent, {NAME}--if we don't have to worry about the nerubians stabbing us in the back, we can deal with those pouring through below.

78666.title: The Only Good Spider
78666.description:
$p, if we don't stem the tide of nerubians climbing up to us, nothing else will matter.

Their numbers are just too great.

We need to delay their onslaught to buy the people of Hallowfall time to prepare. The wall still serves as a very effective chokepoint.

Do what you can to thin their numbers.
78666.progress: {NAME}, every nerubian you kill here could mean a life saved in Hallowfall, and aids the chances of our own success.
78666.completion: This is a good start. There are still many more nerubians coming from below, but we must turn our attention to those already inside Hallowfall.

78667.title: Rekindled Memories
78667.objectives: Recover 6 Arathi tinderboxes from fallen soldiers and burn their bodies.
78667.description:
Good people died here today, $p--a lot of them.

Every Arathi soldier carries a tinderbox. It represents their devotion to the Sacred Flame. Many use it as a focus to bring forth the Flame's light. In the dark places beyond the light of Beledar, the Sacred Flame brings hope.

With the nerubian attack, we can't recover their bodies. So we must retrieve these symbols, to venerate their sacrifice. Then use this torch to burn their bodies. It's the best funeral we can offer.
78667.progress: Have you recovered their tinderboxes? Every life deserves to be remembered in the Sacred Flame.
78667.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. You've helped to honor their sacrifice as well as we can.

78668.title: Rally on the Dawnbreaker
78668.objectives: Meet Faerin at Tenir's Ascent aboard the Dawnbreaker.
78668.description:
It's critical, with so many nerubians pouring through the Aegis Wall, that we defend our airships docked at Tenir's Ascent.

The nerubians have always outnumbered us, but our fleet allows us to concentrate our defenders where they are attacking, as well as allowing us to bombard them from the safety of the skies.

If we lose our armada, our hopes fade dramatically. Meet us there when you can.
78668.completion:
I'm glad you're with us, {NAME}. 

Without our airships, we have little chance of holding back the nerubians in the long run. 

To say nothing of our dockworkers, who are safe below deck.

Let's see to the defense.

78669.title: For Their Eyes Only
78669.objectives: Gather 3 nerubian Shadecasters to learn their plans.
78669.description:
We've fought the nerubians since we arrived, $p. Their attacks have not risen to this level in a long time.

These airship docks are clearly a target, but do they have any others? Is there a larger goal?

The nerubians carry shadecasters with orders from their queen. We need to learn what we can of their plans and intentions, and recovering a few of those shadecasters is the best way we can do so.
78669.progress: Have you found any of those shadecasters yet, {NAME}?
78669.completion: Final war? Ascension? Not as many answers as questions, {NAME}. But we at least have some pieces of the puzzle.

78670.title: Siege Weapon Sabotage
78670.objectives: Destroy 4 siege weapons below Tenir's Ascent.
78670.description:
$p, if we're going to hold the nerubians back, we have to deal with their siege weapons. 

Around Tenir's Ascent, there are kegs of black powder to supply our ships for combat. Since the nerubians have caught these ships on the ground, let's put that powder to work.

Gather some barrels, and take them down to the nerubian siege weapons.
78670.progress: Were you able to destroy their siege weapons, {NAME}?
78670.completion: With those siege weapons destroyed, we're in much better shape. Faerin went ahead to light the Dawntower with Great Kyron. She asked that we meet them there.

78672.title: A Lamplighter's Duty
78672.objectives: Take the Lamplighter Skiff to Lorel's Crossing.
78672.description:
Darkness has fallen. We can't rest yet. 

<Faerin gives you a weary smile, but there is a light in her eyes.>

The light from the tower will hold the worst dangers in the darkness at bay. It's my duty, as a Lamplighter, to keep all the towers blazing. 

My patrol takes me to Lorel's Crossing by air next. I would welcome you and Anduin at my side, for all our sakes.
78672.completion:
The kobyss have already been dragging innocent villagers to the shore! They'll drown them and eat them!

We have to save them!

78674.title: The Gift of Relief
78674.description:
You adventurers are known to carry heavy burdens. There will be no better time to confront them than now. 

I saw a veteran somewhere around here. There is a chance he may know what it means to cope with stress. 

Perhaps he has insight to teach you.
78674.progress: I've seen men die of stress. You don't want to bottle it up every day.
78674.completion:
Feeling better?

You must take care of yourself after a tough day. If you're good to your body and brain, they'll be good to you.

78679.title: The Gift of Relaxation
78679.description:
Self-love can take many different forms. And on occasion it can take the form of relaxing. 

The night elf by the fireworks seems particularly relaxed. 

Perhaps you could ask him for his insights on relaxation.
78679.progress: True love is letting your guard down. Let yourself relax, you will see what I mean.
78679.completion:
You feel renewed, don't you? Personally, I love petting the turtles.

Did you discover your favorite relaxation technique?

78685.title: The Tunnel's End
78685.description:
So we're hearing more rumors about Taelloch. 

The town and its mine are responsible for ore production. Apparently, we haven't received shipments in weeks, and the town's foreman has disappeared. Now the High Speaker is discouraging anyone from traveling there.

That tells me we should investigate. And of course, if people are hurting, then we should help them.
78685.progress: We have to find out what happened here.
78685.completion:
Beasts inside?

The residents of Taelloch might need our help.

Help me keep an eye on Dagran, {NAME}. He's read a lot of stories about thrilling adventures, but he hasn't seen what we've seen. 

And something seems... off.

78686.title: Lights Out
78686.objectives: Meet Taenar and Aemyra near Velhan's Claim.
78686.description:
Name's Aegor. I try to keep tabs on Lamplighters in the field and assess what areas of Hallowfall may be in need of their aid.

The dawntower fell dark at Velhan's Claim a few weeks ago. Based on what's been happening around Hallowfall, it's probably because of the rising tide of kobyss.

Lamplighters Taenar and Aemyra are heading there, but this might be more than even two Lamplighters together can handle. Will you meet them there and help them restore the light at Velhan's Claim?
78686.completion:
Pleased to meet you, {NAME}. I'm Taenar, and this is Aemyra.

The dawntower at Velhan's Claim went dark a while ago, and with all that's been happening, we're only just getting here to help.

We did some scouting, and it seems the area is overrun with kobyss. I imagine Velhan's holed up inside, instead of fighting them off.

Good thing for his people that we're here. And it's better still to have you along helping.

78687.title: Crash Recovery
78687.objectives: Retrieve 4 Recovered Tinderboxes from the Indomitable's stalwarts.
78687.description:
A lot of things went wrong when the Indomitable crashed, $p. But the most upsetting one is that--when the order was finally given to make our way back to Mereldar, we couldn't honor our fallen comrades.

It seems the kobyss reanimated our fallen stalwarts, who now wander the Indomitable in a ghastly skeletal form.

Take back their tinderboxes. If we can deliver those to the Sacred Flame, they'll finally be free after all these years.
78687.completion:
The flame burns for us all, {NAME}. I wish I could have saved them that night, but I'm glad we'll be able to honor their memories.

It's what we all would want, if it happened to us.

78688.title: Cage, Match
78688.objectives: Burn 10 kobyss cages with Aemyra's Holy Flame.
78688.description:
When we were scouting before you arrived, we saw a lot of cages set up around Velhan's Claim. Typically, the kobyss use these to hold their victims until they're needed for a ritual sacrifice.

Those sacrifices lead to... lots of other dark activities. Not the least of which is eating the victims.

Let's get ahead of all that. Take my torch, and destroy the cages, so we don't have to see that happen to anyone from Velhan's Claim.
78688.progress: Have you dealt with those cages yet? The citizens of Velhan's Claim won't be safe until you do.
78688.completion:
Good work, {NAME}. Without their cages, the kobyss won't be able to take prisoners.

No prisoners means no foul rituals, and preventing those gives us a much better chance of saving the people at Velhan's Claim.

78689.title: If It Leads, It Bleeds
78689.objectives: Defeat the kobyss leaders besieging Velhan's Claim.
78689.description:
Everything rises and falls on leadership, $p. With a good leader, a unit can achieve almost anything. With a bad leader, chaos ensues and success moves out of reach. I've seen that first-hand.

Without leaders, the kobyss siege will break like a wave and everything else we do here becomes easier. I've seen three kobyss who seem to be leading the others--let me mark their locations on your map.

Deal with them, and we'll be much more able to help Velhan's Claim.
78689.progress: Did you find their leaders? They look strong, but I'm sure you're up to the task.
78689.completion:
Excellent. That will put us and the kobyss on a more even footing. At least in terms of leadership.

They still outnumber us by a lot, but one thing at a time.

78690.title: Situational Awareness
78690.objectives: Speak with 10 citizens of Velhan's Claim.
78690.description:
Regardless of what history Taenar and Velhan have between them, we need to take care of the people here at Velhan's Claim.

$p, will you please check in with the families here? Let them know we're here to help.

See if they're worried or need anything. And reassure them that the Lamplighters will drive back the kobyss.
78690.progress: It's so important to reassure the citizens of Velhan's Claim, {NAME}, that they'll get through this. Hope is everything in dark times.
78690.completion:
We're here to help. But I've learned in the past, that there are times hope and reassurance can be the most urgent need.

While you were talking with the residents, Taenar and I have determined what our next steps are going to be. 

We need to give the people room to breathe, but we also need to prepare them to fight.

78691.title: The One That Got Away
78691.objectives: Rescue Maximillian at the crash of the Indomitable.
78691.description:
$p, my son is out with the kobyss. He convinced the other kids they should sneak out with him to fight. Said they should, "be brave like my dad". 

When they met a kobyss, the others all ran back here, while he ran toward the crashed ship, to lead it away.

I have not handled myself bravely, $p. The story of the Indomitable says I was a hero; those lies were my report. 

If there was ever a time to step up, it's now. But I'm no match for the kobyss alone. Come with me, $p--help me save Maximillian.
78691.progress: Stay focused, {NAME}--we have to find my son.
78691.completion:
I know it sounds trite, {NAME}, but I could never thank you enough for getting Max home safely.

Through all this, you've also shown me I need to be out front, leading the way for my people. I've seen there are outcomes worse than death. 

I can't undo the mistakes I've made in the past, but I can be certain not to repeat the pattern.

78692.title: Teach a Man to Fish
78692.objectives: Distribute 8 spears to the residents of Velhan's Claim.
78692.description:
$p, the people of Velhan's Claim have been locked up inside, afraid of the dark, for too long. 

And there's plenty to fear out there, but these are capable, strong people. They should be driving the kobyss away, not hiding behind their walls. 

Get these spears to the people of Velhan's Claim. They've learned to hide from their problems, but we'll give them the means to take their lives back!
78692.progress: Have you handed out those spears yet? The people need them to remind them what they're capable of.
78692.completion:
I think now we'll see them acting very differently, now that they're armed, {NAME}.

There's something about knowing you can take care of yourself, that you can handle your own problems, and you don't need anyone to rescue you.

Of course, we Lamplighters will always be there to help, but it's very likely that we won't be needed next time.

78693.title: Spears for Fears
78693.objectives: Gather 8 Kobyss Spears for the people of Velhan's Claim.
78693.description:
It seems Velhan and his followers hoped they could live in peace here. They were so sure they could, in fact, that they didn't bring any weapons with them.

This is a problem, with the kobyss attacking now, but the kobyss can actually solve it for us. They've brought plenty of spears for their siege on Velhan's Claim, and a spear will skewer a kobyss just as well as a human.

Head out there and gather some spears for the people, $p, and they won't have to be so afraid.
78693.progress: Kobyss giving you trouble? Soon, the people of Velhan's Claim will be the ones giving them trouble.
78693.completion: Good work, {NAME}, this is exactly what we need to not just drive the kobyss back today, but to make sure the people of Velhan's Claim can defend themselves in the future.

78694.title: Reclaiming Velhan's Claim
78694.objectives: Kill 12 Kobyss warriors around Velhan's Claim.
78694.description:
The problem I see, $p, is the kobyss. There's just so many of them.

Everyone here was serving in the Empire's military when we arrived in Hallowfall. They may be rusty now, but they've all trained before, and know how to be dangerous.

But we need to eliminate every disadvantage, including the kobyss numbers. So head out there and even up the numbers. Aemyra and I will keep everyone safe here.
78694.progress: How's it going out there, {NAME}? You sending those creatures of darkness back to the deeps?
78694.completion:
You know, I've hated the kobyss ever since they were dragging my fellow stalwarts into the night as dinner guests.

Hopefully because of the work you've done, that won't happen to any of the citizens of Velhan's Claim, {NAME}.

78695.title: Lamp Lit
78695.objectives: Place 8 torches around the perimeter of Velhan's Claim, then observe the re-lighting of the dawntower.
78695.description:
The kobyss normally live deep underwater, $p. When Beledar is at its brightest, they don't bother us. Other sources of bright light will usually keep them away, but definitely weaken them.

As Lamplighters, we not only go into the dark to protect those in need, but we provide them the light that will keep them safe. Go set up these torches along the perimeter, then meet us up at the dawntower behind Velhan's Claim.
78695.progress: Did you get those torches set, {NAME}? The people will be able to quickly light them whenever Beledar fades.
78695.completion:
You saved my son, {NAME}. You broke the spine of the attack on our home, gave us what we need to fight. 

You helped me to be the leader I'd pretended I was. Thank you.

The Lamplighters will always have allies in Velhan's Claim.

78696.title: We Don't Go to Taelloch
78696.objectives: Clear the entrance to Taelloch of encroaching beasts.
78696.description:
This troubled Machine Speaker was here to do something. But what? It looks like something really did some damage to him.

We shouldn't dally.
