We need to head into Taelloch and look for the foreman. Can you clear the entryway into the town? Someone could get hurt!
78696.completion: There's not much to see in the foreman's office. If we want answers, we'll need to search the town.

78697.title: Ghost of a Company Town
78697.objectives: Use the Investigate ability to find clues about what happened in Taelloch.
78697.description:
The foreman isn't here. Obviously. But the evidence points to her being here recently. So perhaps she's still nearby!

We should go further into town and see if anyone has any idea where she might be.

Or maybe someone else can give us the answers we need. Maybe we'll find out on our own! Maybe it was some sort of attack or some kind of... sorry. I'm getting ahead of myself. Let's go investigate!
78697.completion: Well... there's one question answered perhaps. Only to unearth a dozen more.

78700.title: Controlled Demolition
78700.description:
I know we've fought skardyn before, champion, but this... this is worse. 

I knew that skardyn were turning earthen into more skardyn, but I didn't expect... the crystals... the spikes... the roiling blue energy... that smell! Anyway, not what I expected at all. 

If we must venture out there, I'm taking down some of those abominations along the way.
78700.progress: There's more to be done. We can't let this corruption spread.
78700.completion: Maybe we've only killed a few skardyn from a much larger swarm. But we have to start somewhere.

78701.title: The Truth in Chalk
78701.objectives: Search for messages in Taelloch Mine.
78701.description:
So the people of Taelloch use chalk on slate to leave messages to each other. So many clues! But what does it all mean....

I'm seeing a pattern, and I think it points to the mines. If the workers haven't already been lost, I'd expect them to be in the mines.

And I know the foreman is the key. She has to be.
78701.progress: There's more to learn here. I'm sure of it.
78701.completion: I think I know where we need to go next.

78703.title: Buried in Stone
78703.objectives: Investigate the cave at the back of the Taelloch Mine.
78703.description: We need to go into the cave, the one mentioned near the last slate. It's not signed, but I think that's the foreman's handwriting... and we've looked everywhere else. We have to investigate.
78703.progress: We're missing something... There must be something in that cave!
78703.completion: I knew it! I was right! There's something in here. Something someone was trying to hide.

78714.title: A Poor Reception
78714.objectives: Go to the Heart Chamber to ask Magni for help deciphering the Radiant Song.
78714.description:
There's strong evidence that the Radiant Song is a warning from Azeroth herself. A cry for help.

That's why we're here. If this vision truly is Azeroth's message, Magni will know what she's trying to tell us.

He should be in the Chamber of the Heart. Let's go.
78714.completion:
I know why you're here. It's the visions. Azeroth's voice, heard all across the lands. Ye thought I would know what she's trying to tell us. 

Well, ye thought wrong.

78715.title: Azeroth's Voice
78715.description:
I haven't spoken with Azeroth for years. At first I just didn't feel the need. Then I realized I had started to resent her. For leaving me like... this. And now I'm not sure if I can.

But I know the stakes. This Radiant Song of hers foretells something dire. And we need to know what.

First, we need to prepare the Heart Chamber. Can ye start up the consoles nearby?
78715.progress: I understand Magni's concerns, but we have no other choice. The future of our world is at stake. We must try everything we can to understand what Azeroth is trying to warn us of.
78715.completion: This has never happened before. Magni is the Speaker of Azeroth. Why would communing with her cause him to collapse?

78716.title: Painful Lessons
78716.description:
Magni appears stable for now, but he's still not responsive. We need to get him treatment quickly. I'll open a portal to Dalaran.

Follow us when you can.
78716.completion:
I'm unsure why the Speaker of Azeroth would end up in such a state after attempting to... well, speak with Azeroth.

All we can do is wait for Magni to recover.

78717.title: A Mysterious Warning
78717.objectives: Discuss the next steps, then follow up with Khadgar.
78717.description:
Well, that was quite the nap. I wasn't expecting Azeroth to be so... loud. To normal folk, she's gently calling out. But with our connection, it felt like she was screaming. Directly into my crystal noggin.

I saw it though. Khaz Algar, an island of earthen, bathed in fire and smoke. That's where Azeroth is trying to lead us.

That's what we need to protect.
78717.completion:
The council has decided. We travel to Khaz Algar.

Dalaran will teleport as soon as we're able. Will you lend us your aid in our preparations?

78718.title: Strengthen the Wards
78718.description:
Magni's vision foretells that Khaz Algar may be enduring some... turbulent times. And so it is best to ensure that Dalaran is ready for the worst.

Here, take this wand. It's been attuned with Dalaran's defense magics.

Just wave it near strategic parts of the city to strengthen our magical defenses.
78718.progress: We will be hard pressed to save Khaz Algar if our own defenses aren't strong enough to withstand attack.
78718.completion:
Well done, champion.

Let's just hope it's enough. I would hate for anything to happen to our city right as the world needs us most.

78719.title: Citizens of Dalaran
78719.objectives: Help the citizens of Dalaran prepare for the teleportation.
78719.description:
Our citizens must be prepared for Dalaran's departure. Can you ask around the city and see if anyone requires aid?

I'd also like for you to speak with Brann and Archmage Drenden. They both had concerns that would be best to address before we depart for Khaz Algar.
78719.progress: Dalaran is always ready to defend the world, but that doesn't mean we can do so on a whim. Preparations are key to a smooth transportation.
78719.completion: Thank you for your help. It's important that the citizens of Dalaran are ready for whatever may come.

78721.title: Meet the Team
78721.objectives: Check in on the Algari Expedition.
78721.description:
If we're going tae be exploring new lands in Khaz Algar, then we'll be needing help from the Explorers' League. But they won't be alone in this adventure. The League is teaming up with the Reliquary again, just like on the Dragon Isles. 

They're calling themselves the Algari Expedition this time around.

I'm just a wee bit worried if they're still getting along. Exploring can tear folks apart just as easily as it binds them together. Can you check in on the lot?
78721.progress: A league and an expedition walk into a tavern... Nope, nothing's coming to me.
78721.completion:
They're getting along? Well I'll be a goat's uncle. Ach, no offense to Dagran.

Well, that certainly makes my job easier. Thanks for checking in on them, all the same!

78722.title: To Khaz Algar!
78722.objectives: Tell Khadgar you're ready to depart.
78722.description:
From what Magni has seen, Khaz Algar may not be the safest of destinations. We'll be relying on your aid, should a fight break out.

Let me know when you're ready to depart.
78722.completion:
She was Archmage Drenden. All along, Xal'atath has been watching, plotting, right in front of me. How could I be so blind? 

And now she's invading Dalaran with an army of nerubians. 

Xal'atath planned this. All of this. She wanted us to come to Khaz Algar.

78724.title: Loving Yourself, Your Way
78724.description:
If it's a challenge you're after, I think I have an idea.

I saw a boastful champion heading toward Goldshire. You could challenge him to a duel.

This would satisfy your desire and perhaps teach him a valuable lesson in humility.
78724.completion:
On any other day, you do great deeds for others.

Today you have done something great for yourself. And that is the best gift of all.

78726.title: Loving Yourself, Your Way
78726.description:
A full belly is a happy belly!

There is plenty of good food and drink right here at the gala. Why don't you buy yourself something nice?
78726.progress: Have you had your fill of treats? I love the fruits, myself.
78726.completion:
On any other day, you do great deeds for others.

Today you have done something great for yourself. And that is the best gift of all.

78727.title: Loving Yourself, Your Way
78727.description:
While visiting this gala, I am staying at the Lion's Pride Inn at Goldshire.

I hear they have some extra beds upstairs. Why not see if you can sleep there for a while?

I think I will have a bit of a rest too... Right... here...
78727.completion:
...Huh? Oh! Welcome back, did you enjoy your rest?

On any other day, you do great deeds for others.

Today you have done something great for yourself. And that is the best gift of all.

78729.title: Raising a Stink
78729.description:
Those clues add up to an ugly story, {NAME}.

That map shows the Crown's got a heavily guarded base of operations in Silverpine Forest. And between that memo and formula, it looks like they're cooking up something intoxicatingly toxic.

I've got a guy that can get us some... artisanal goods... to deal with the Crown. I'll go talk to him and meet you outside Shadowfang Keep.
78729.completion:
There you are, right on time.

I've got a plan to deal with this chemical conspiracy.

78738.title: Absent Speaker
78738.objectives: Meet Speaker Brinthe in the Earthenworks.
78738.description:
It is a dark day for the Ringing Deeps, $p.

I always knew there was something about the High Speaker that wasn't quite right. Now we have proof.

And we need justice. If he has plans for the Awakening Machine, then we've got to stop him.
78738.completion: The High Speaker and his followers will answer for their crimes.

78741.title: Sympathetic Speakers
78741.objectives: Look for Machine Speaker Foremen in the Earthenworks with Speaker Brinthe.
78741.description:
I have to stop the High Speaker from making more skardyn.

Machine Speaker protocol dictates that one of the foremen in this area should have a key to the Hall of Awakening. Come with me, and we'll track it down!
78741.completion: This should get us into the Hall of Awakening...

78742.title: Battle of the Earthenworks
78742.description:
$p! There's a battle afoot! We need to assist Machine Speakers loyal to our cause and move against anyone defending the High Speaker.

I'm going to remain and make plans with Adelgonn. I need you to lead our forces while we're containing consequences of the High Speaker's actions in the Earthenworks. This is our first step in deposing him. We're putting a stop to his horrendous crimes once and for all. 

What do you say, $p? Up for a scrap?
78742.progress: I'll admit: the ability to acquire an army at the drop of a hat has gotten me fairly far in life.
78742.completion:
You've managed to drive out some of the High Speaker's most devoted disciples... and you've cracked some heads.

That's a fine start. But there's so many... too many...

78743.title: Before I Depart
78743.objectives: Meet Urtago at the Mourning Rise memorial site.
78743.description:
I can feel my energy reserves depleting.

I will soon not be able to execute my duties. That is why I have Urtago here to take over.

Before my systems grind to a halt, I must make sure Mourning Rise is free of kobolds. They have invaded the memorial site I tend and plunder the Unbound shrines and bodies that are there.

Maybe it is good you are here. You may have the strength to help us.

Please, help Urtago rid the site of kobolds.
78743.completion:
Korgran still calls himself the caretaker, but I'm the one who has been taking care of Mourning Rise for some time.

I don't mind. Korgran is very kind. 

But the situation here has gotten away from me. We have some work ahead of us.

78744.title: Honor Their Memories
78744.objectives: Eliminate the kobold infestation and place gifts near the shut-down, past caretakers.
78744.description:
Take these gifts and place them by the past caretakers. Each is a gift honoring their memory.

I'd also like us to perform some light groundskeeping to at least maintain the site. Unfortunately, what these kobolds are doing to the memorials will take us weeks to fix.

Please do what you can about the kobolds. It would be unwise to leave the gifts unguarded while they are still roaming the area.
78744.progress:
The kobolds cannot be left to desecrate Mourning Rise.

The Unbound that rest here are here because they do not want to be disturbed or moved. While they do not wish to be revived, taking their armor and possessions is an insult to earthen culture.

We must do something.
78744.completion:
I am amazed how much damage the kobolds have done to the site. So many shut-down earthen desecrated!

I know that I am not yet the head caretaker, but I take full responsibility for this. I should have asked for the mantle of caretaker long ago when Korgran started to show the first signs of memory overwrite and stasis lock.

78745.title: You No Take Plunder!
78745.objectives: Recover earthen belongings from piles of plunder.
78745.description:
It looks like the kobolds have taken gems and other... body parts off these shutdown earthen. 

Abominable.

Find where the kobolds are holding their plunder, and bring it back to me so I can return it to its rightful place later.

This vandalism will not go unchecked!
78745.progress: Were you able to find their plunder?
78745.completion:
Thank you for doing this.

<Urtago nods to herself with confirmation as she examines the items.>

I am relieved, but there is much more work to do.

78746.title: Laws Apply to All
78746.objectives: Slay kobold invaders in Mourning Rise.
78746.description:
Desecrating a memorial site is one of our greatest taboos in earthen society. This site is a window to our past, into our memories, and a place of self-reflection where we can commune with those who are no longer here.

Still, so many of these kobolds infest Mourning Rise. For their crimes, the kobolds deserve the harshest punishment. They must be culled even further.
78746.progress: So many of them still infest Mourning Rise.
78746.completion:
I was not made as an earthen of the sword, nor as one who calls for violence. That is the domain of the Stormriders. 

What these kobolds did is frowned upon not just by us, the Unbound, but by everyone in earthen society. I am not proud that we had to kill them, but we had to stop them by any means.

78747.title: The Great Collapse
78747.objectives: Use the Explosive sticks to destroy Kobold tunnels.
78747.description:
Now that we landed a mighty blow, it is time to make sure that we block their tunnels so they cannot come back.

Remember the stuff that Korgran asked about? Explosive sticks--his recipe. I have brought enough to shake a mountain! More than enough for the kobolds.

Help me show these kobolds that we will fight for what is ours so they will never come back!
78747.progress: Is it done? Were the tunnels dealt with?
78747.completion: Ha ha! What did I tell you? I felt the tremors from back here!

78748.title: Cutting the Wick
78748.objectives: Find and slay the kobold workmasters.
78748.description:
Knowing kobolds, they will have several workmasters, or leaders, running this raid.

Find and eliminate these so-called "workmasters." The rest of them will get disorganized, forget why they are here, and hopefully leave us alone.
78748.progress: Were you able to slay all three of them? Their deaths will strike a significant blow to this kobold operation.
78748.completion:
Eliminating the minds behind this operation will only buy us more time if and when the kobolds decide to do this again.

Unfortunately, there is still one more kobold brain that we have missed. Until now.

78749.title: Who Runs This Fine Establishment?
78749.description:
While you were dealing with the tunnels and the workmasters, I saw a peculiar kobold go into a cave to the northwest. The kobolds seemed to respect him more than the others, calling him Grand-Heister Bokk and offering him the food you call "cheese." This makes me think he is the real mastermind.

If that kobold is in fact the real Ward of this operation, then we should take the opportunity to strike him down.

I will meet you at this cave.
78749.completion:
I am happy to see you, {NAME}.

I feel my inner workings grinding--that's a sign of anxiety. Korgran nears his shutdown with every passing moment, and then this place will be under my care. 

It is a lot of responsibility. But I believe that I am ready for it.

78754.title: Lost Delivery
78754.objectives: Deliver the Abandoned Package to Harvester Farnee at Durgaz Cabin.
78754.description:
<You find a small yet heavy leather-bound package on the road with an attached label.>

Gundargaz Courier Express

EXPEDITED

To: 
Harvester Farnee
Durgaz Cabin

OPEN WITH CARE: Contains volatile elemental minerals.
78754.completion:
Well, smoke the hive... you found it! I still can't believe the courier just lost my package...

We've been waiting on this to help with Shalehoof's leg. 

Mixed with fire honey, this stuff should patch him up quickly!

78755.title: Playing in the Mud
78755.objectives: Gather 20 handfuls of Elementally Charged Silt.
78755.description:
Remember when we used that clay and the fire honey to patch up Shalehoof? Let's do that again but bigger!

Problem is we've run out of clay. But fortunately, with all the recent seismic activity, a whole avalanche of elementals has been roused out of torpor and are clashing on the eastern beach!

Bring me wet, elementally charged silt to use as our restorative substrate!
78755.progress:
By combining living sand and water, we can create an elemental silt that mimics the underclay's healing properties. Or at least something that comes close to it!

Isn't elemental fusion fascinating?
78755.completion:
Can you feel the energy in the silt between your fingers, {NAME}? The charge that hums through it?

Isn't it exhilarating? Doesn't it make you feel one with the earth and the mountains?

78756.title: Lots and Lots of Fire Honey
78756.objectives: Find a lot of Fire Honey.
78756.description:
If Harmot wants to patch this sleeping boulder up and get him out of my pond, I'm all for it. 

Unfortunately, we used the last of my store of fire honey on Shalehoof's wound. I haven't had time to harvest any from the Cinderwold with all these elementals running amok. 

Head on down to the wold's edge and bring us some honey. You're going to need a lot.
78756.progress: Mind yourself in my forest. Cinderbees are dangerous, but we rely on them for the honey they produce for our mead.
78756.completion:
You found this off of WHAT? A living honey e--

<Farnee stops her sentence before lowering her voice.>

Let's keep all mention of living fire honey between us. Harmot might get distracted and run off into danger if we tell him...

78757.title: Honey and Clay the Pain Away
78757.description:
Ramoliths! Magnificent, aren't they? One of the finest elemental beasts on the isle. 

The bad news is they're not immune to injury. Poor Shalehoof here was attacked by awakened elementals in Farnee's pond.

The good news is that we have all we need to tend to him.

We just have to mix that clay you found with some fire honey and slap it up on ol' Shalehoof's hock! 

Ready?
78757.progress:
Much like us earthen, healing something made from rock and stone is no easy task.

But the unique properties of the clay you've brought, combined with the fusing properties of the honey makes for an excellent restorative!
78757.completion:
Well, aren't you just a natural with the elements. Ever thought about making a career out of it?

Say, since you're not afraid of getting messy, why don't you help us with Farnee's problem?

78758.title: Pulse Within the Earth
78758.objectives: Place 4 Tremor Stones around the pond.
78758.description:
Before we go and wake up a slumbering mountain giant, it's probably best we get an idea for how deeply asleep he is. 

Though, if the nerubians burrowing up didn't wake him up, I'm not sure what will.

Take these earth shards and plant them on the waterfalls and hills around the lake. 

Once we've got them set up, I'll be able to get a reading on the giant's health.
78758.progress: Once you've got the shards set up, I can drop the final one here to get a proper read.
78758.completion:
The mountain giant's got a weak heartbeat.

Poor lad's likely been disturbed from a deep slumber with all of these elementals breaking off from the falls.

Fortunately, the pair of us are experts in healing elemental and elemental-adjacent's life forms, aren't we? 

If the salve can work on earthen and rock rams, it can work on mountain giants!

78759.title: To Wake a Giant
78759.objectives: Apply elemental salve to the mountain giant for Harmot.
78759.description:
By the Coreway, this stuff packs a punch!

Combining healing silt with the molten fusion properties of fire honey has given us a salve that could wake a whole mountain!

Which is exactly what you'll do. Take the mixture over to our wounded friend in Farnee's pond, and slap it on his hide!

It should be enough to wake him up and alleviate any soreness.

Hopefully, anyways.
78759.progress:
This will either wake the giant and patch him up good as new or...

Well, let's not talk about the other possibility. Have some faith in the process!
78759.completion:
Well, would you look at that! 

Thousands of years slumbering at the base of a waterfall and he wakes up without even a roar or a foot-stomp.

Hah! And Farnee was worried!

You did great with making that salve, {NAME}. Both Farnee and I owe you a big thanks. 

Our new friend looks thankful too!

78760.title: Dark Iron from Above
78760.objectives: Defeat Supervisor Varric and his forces within the Earthenworks.
78760.description:
We've done our best to contain the High Speaker's followers. We've hampered their efforts at destroying or looting anything they can take with them into Hall of Awakening.

Now, we just need to deal with the leader of their forces before they can coordinate a more unified resistance.

Are you ready to do this, {NAME}?
78760.completion:
The Ringing Deeps should be safe... for now. But the High Speaker...

We need to follow Speaker Brinthe into the Hall of Awakening.

78762.title: Your First Find
78762.objectives: Practice excavating on the Outdated Geology Textbook.
78762.description:
We've got a find on our hands! Looks like this might be one of my books from undergrad. Hah!

Now, your job is to get all that dirt off of it, but you have to be careful. The artifacts we handle are very fragile, and the only thing worse than them staying in the ground is them breaking on the way out.

Empowering your elemental will only get you halfway. You'll need to use your environment to keep things in balance so that it's safe to excavate.
78762.progress: What do you think? Having fun yet?
78762.completion:
There you go! Your first artifact... of a kind anyway.

The stuff we find out in the field is usually more exciting. But at least this one you can keep as a souvenir!

78827.title: Go Take Candle!
78827.objectives: Steal candles for the suspicious vent in the Gundargaz Inn.
78827.description:
Ksk, ksk! You there! Yes, you!

<You hear the sound of jostling behind the vent and a new, even scratchier voice emerges.>

We, er, I have job for you! You look sharp. Look quick. Fast hands, just like us--me! Quick hands just like me.

Bring us, me, bring me candles! Yes! 

No ask question, just go get candles. 

We are, er, I am professional, yes. Professionals do not ask questions. 

Only get candles.
78827.completion:
<Exuberant chanting can be heard from within the vent.>

Candle! Candle! Candle!

Hush! Shh! Don't let the stone ones hear...

78838.title: Cogs in the Machine
78838.objectives: Accompany Brinthe as they talk to earthen in Gundargaz.
78838.description:
Gundargaz is my home. Or at least, it was before the High Speaker saw fit to reassign me above ground. I've missed my home, but it's... changed.

As the number of Machine Speakers decreases, we're in a race against time. 

Lately, we've been especially weary of our assigned tasks, but as always, we must bear our burdens.

Let me show you around the area. There are some earthen I would like you to meet.
78838.progress: This is not how I remember my home.
78838.completion:
Problems are increasing, and our numbers are dwindling.

The High Speaker is distracted, kobolds are attacking, shipments are missing from Taelloch, and earthen aren't returning from their shifts.

Where to begin? Looks like our work is cut out for us.

78839.title: Kobold Shoulder
78839.objectives: Kill invading kobolds in the Lost Mines.
78839.description:
The first step to stemming our losses and retaking the mines is straightforward, if unpleasant. Without minions, this Candle King will be less of a threat to Gundargaz.

See if you can reduce the swarm, {NAME}, before hostilities escalate further.

78860.title: More Candles!
78860.objectives: Steal more candles for the suspicious vent in the Gundargaz Inn.
78860.description:
I, er, we...no, no, I! I have new deal for you, oh shadowy one. 

More candles! 

In return, you get... er...

<Frantic shuffling reveals a new voice.>

You get more candles! Then you give to us! To me! 

candles! candles! candles!

<The excitedly whispered chanting continues for some time.>
78860.completion:
Ksk! You did it!

More candles...

...unlimited candles.

<A somber awe emanates from the vent.>

78863.title: A Place Beneath the Boughs
78863.objectives: Meet Tyrande and Shandris in Amirdrassil.
78863.description:
Thanks to you and all the mortals who defended the Emerald Dream, a new World Tree now grows in the Dragon Isles.

Amirdrassil's boughs will be a haven of peace and tranquility, and a place of respite for the kaldorei souls lost at Teldrassil.

Tyrande Whisperwind and Shandris Feathermoon are at the tree now. They would share words with you.

78864.title: The Returning
78864.description:
It is a time of reflection and change, $p. For the world, and for my people.

My mother and I have been discussing the roads that led us here... and where those roads will lead in the years to come.

Come, let us speak.
78864.completion: My father has returned to us at last, {NAME}!

78865.title: Siblings Until the End
78865.objectives: Speak with Vyranoth to hear about her meeting with Iridikron.
78865.description:
Some time ago, Vyranoth received an unexpected summons... from Iridikron.

You will want to hear what he had to say.
78865.completion: I know not what Iridikron intends to do next. But I can no longer call him "brother."

78874.title: Conjured Help
78874.objectives: Summon food for Innkeeper Brax in the Gundargaz Inn.
78874.description:
If you're looking for food--softy food--I'm afraid we're clean out. Nothing but good ol' rocks and gems here at the moment.

It's starting to become a problem, actually.

Say... you wouldn't be able to do anything about that, would you? Rustle us up some victuals for the fleshy folk?
78874.progress: You don't want to try a nibble of cobalt?
78874.completion: Strike me with a hammer and call me an anvil--that's a lot of food!

78875.title: The Unkillable
78875.objectives: Recover the altar centerpiece from Mai'Zoth.
78875.description:
I'm bettin' dat ogre Mai'Zoth is behind all dis. He should have died long ago, but his magics still be strong. 

He be using the altar's centerpiece as a conduit to drain Lukou's power.

Recover the centerpiece and prove he's not so unkillable when he doesn't have a loa hostage.
78875.progress: Did you prove Mai'Zoth isn't unkillable?
78875.completion: That centerpiece be critical. It was being used to drain Lukou directly.

78876.title: A Glowing Memento
78876.objectives: Bring the Everglowing Ember to Vyranoth in Amirdrassil or the Central Encampment in the Emerald Dream.
78876.description:
<An unusually persistent ember draws your eye. It glows with a pure, primal heat.> 

<Vyranoth would be interested in this.>
78876.completion:
An ember of primal flame, somehow untouched by the shadowflame of that wretched cavern... 

Thank you. It is a warm reminder of the brother I had long, long ago.

78877.title: Bless These Homes
78877.description:
Divine presence acknowledged.

Every day for as long as my memory serves me, I have walked the routes and lit the incense around our homes. It has ground my joints to dust, but is it an important task. 

A sacred task. 

These are dark times we live in--perhaps you could add your own beatitudes to our little rituals?
78877.progress: You do us an honor, bringing your faith into these caverns. Let it bless these machines and those who work with them, just as they bless us in turn.
78877.completion:
We are all cogs in the machine. We turn, and turn, and turn... 

There is a beauty there. 

A quietude.

78879.title: Evoking the Forge
78879.objectives: Find a way to stoke the forge outside of Gundargaz.
78879.description:
Harumph! This blasted forge is on its last legs. We'd repair it, but Stonemason Itsak picked up a shift at Ironhaul Station when the Coreway collapsed, and well...

There's no one to fix it anymore.

If you can figure out a way of getting it running hot again, Gundargaz would be in your debt!
78879.progress: I'm going to miss Itsak. He made the best end-of-shift rock roasts...
78879.completion:
Whoa! I've never seen anything like that! You just... keep fire in your throat?

Now that's a trick I'd been keen on learning!

78880.title: The Eastern Kingdoms Cup Begins
78880.description: Skyrider! Lord Andestrasz has left the Dragon Isles and is visiting Stormwind. He's looking for capable skyriders like yourself to compete in new races!

78881.title: The Eastern Kingdoms Cup Begins
78881.description: Skyrider! Lord Andestrasz has left the Dragon Isles and is visiting Orgrimmar. He's looking for capable skyriders like yourself to compete in new races!

78893.title: A Scrap of Bronze
78893.description:
The vendors of Pandaria do not want the equipment you will find in this timeline.

You can convert unwanted equipment into Bronze using the magic of the infinite dragonflight.

Use the Unraveling Sands ability and scrap the Unraveling Tunic.
78893.progress: You can place unwanted equipment into the Unraveling Sands to obtain additional Bronze for your journey.
78893.completion: Bronze can be spent at infinite bazaars to upgrade your equipment, acquire gems, or expand your collections.

78895.title: A Shadow Over Gundargaz
78895.objectives: Track down whatever is hunting the earthen in Gundargaz.
78895.description:
You look dangerous.

<Toki spits on the ground.>

That's good. We need dangerous. Something is stalking Gundargaz. 

Something mean. 

Something... recent. 

Just before the Coreway collapsed I started getting reports of workers going missing mid-shift. Only thing we've been able to find have been the odd chunk of rock.

Fingers, mostly. 

If you could sniff out what's stalking my town, I'd be in your debt.
78895.progress: Life didn't always used to be this exciting.
78895.completion:
A demon? Escaped from the crashed ruins of a flying magical city?

If you say so. 

I'm just glad it's sorted.

78897.title: Boom or Blight
78897.description:
This place is infested with cave borers. They pose a threat to the great roots that stretch through this place.

Yes, the tree provides sustenance for many living things, but this is not some small band of bugs nibbling on a leaf. This is a blight. Their numbers must be culled for the good of the whole. 

By my oath I am unable to raise a hand to interfere. However... you have sworn no such oath. Will you do what must be done?

78898.title: Intention vs Instinct
78898.objectives: Collect a Singing Stone from Wormcaller Iz'tikrine.
78898.description:
Cave borers are not social creatures as a rule. Seeing this many gather in one place speaks to intention.

A wormcaller of the nerubians must be present.

Find them and recover the tool they use to call these worms here. With it we can lead them away in time.
78898.progress: I can sense more worms coming. As if they are drawn to this place.
78898.completion:
What a strange gem. 

The song within must be what is drawing the worms to this place.

78900.title: On Cold, Dark Wings
78900.objectives: Track down the Ringing Death in Gundargaz.
78900.description:
You came down the Coreway, right? From up top?

<Toki chuckles.>

They have it easy, those city earthen. Down here, death comes for you from all around. 

From below. From above.

You look like you've killed a fair few beasts in your time. Care to add another to the list?
78900.completion:
The monstrous bat wasn't quite so monstrous after all, eh?

Welcome to Gundargaz.

78902.title: Delegated Dig
78902.description:
Okay, I know when I'm beat. So I want to hire you as my Champion of Coin... or coinchamp.

This is all a part of my brilliant enterprising venture. See, these worms here are great at rooting out rich minerals like a niffen sniffing out high-quality mushrooms. 

I'm willing to bet all of my money--and your life--that they found a vein of sivstone. Great stuff, though I doubt a {class} would know how to use it. 

Tell you what, you bring me a shipment's worth and I'll go halfsies on the profits with ya!
78902.completion:
Nice haul! This should get us started back in Mmarl and show those goons who's who. 

Here's your cut.

78915.title: Squashing the Threat
78915.objectives: Remove 8 Shadow-Sour Squash and slay 10 Shadow-Sour Mites.
78915.description:
I need your help!

The massive Shadow-Soured squash have begun to grow all over the place. They're stinky and crawling with nasty mites.

Mom and Dad brought in some airships to help us yank them out, but it's risky business with all those bugs.

Can you attach ropes to these Shadow-Soured Squash, and the airships can then haul them away without making a mess?
78915.progress: Have you removed all the Squash?
78915.completion: You did it! I heard stories of one time the squash was so heavy the airship crashed! Glad that didn't happen.

78918.title: Brax's Brass Knuckles
78918.objectives: Kill creatures around Gundargaz to find Brax's Brass Knuckles.
78918.description:
I have a proposition for you.

We get some rowdy patrons here from time to time. Nothing sinister, but our folk work hard and things can get out of hand faster than a dropped hammer. 

Usually I'd give 'em a considerate knock upside the head to remind them what's what, but I lost my brass knuckles while helping Watcher Toki clear monsters on the town's skirts.

Mind fetching my knuckles and administering some love taps?
78918.progress: Now which beasts did I punch with those knuckles last...
78918.completion: That's the genius of the knuckles. They keep your hands intact!

78929.title: Tricks of the Dark
78929.description:
Kobyss lurk in the shallows of murky water and snatch any who come near, faster than a viper!

And that's just when they hunt alone. In numbers, they are a swarm to be reckoned with. They've been a plague on our outskirt villages since the day we arrived. 

They eat victims alive, given the chance. We must rescue the villagers that have already been dragged to the water!
78929.completion: Thank you, {NAME}. These people are badly hurt, but I think they will make it. Some seem to have some skill in healing of their own.

78932.title: Fickle Fiendish Fish
78932.description:
Judging by the glint in your eye, you wish to join Faerin in this madness?

To push into the kobyss waters? In the darkness?

You are a fool with a death wish. 

Take as many of those damnable fish out as you can, before they drag you into the depths for their dinner.
78932.progress: We can't abandon the villagers here!

78933.title: The Sweet Eclipse
78933.objectives: Collect 8 Darkroot Persimmon, 30 Frog-Kissed Caviar, and 1 Ethereal Sugar.
78933.description:
I've set out to create a dessert that transcends the ordinary, one that even the most devout followers of the light would savor!

To balance the flavors of the desert, between light and shadow, I require ingredients from several areas within the darkness.

Please assist me in harvesting the following ingredients: Frog-Kissed Caviar, Darkroot Persimmon and Ethereal Sugar.
78933.progress: Have you found all of the ingredients?
78933.completion: Now the magic happens. Please sample this creation for yourself.

78934.title: Blades of the Arathi
78934.objectives: Light a torch with the Sacred Flame, then rally 6 groups of Arathi in Sina's Yearning.
78934.description:
I trust in your strength. I must ask you to go ahead to reinforce Sina's Yearning. Anduin and I can see my people to safety in Lorel's Crossing.

With the darkness and the kobyss, the hearts of my people in Sina's Yearning will be faltering to fear. We can't let them wallow.

Light a torch with the Sacred Flame in the center of town and use it to inspire my people's valor. Remind them of their strength.

We will catch up with you. May the Flame guide you, my friend.
78934.completion: The Arathi are strong. Proud. The kobyss may be vile but they will not win this day.

78936.title: Something's Fishy
78936.objectives: Slay Deepsludger, The Abominable Wavecrasher, and Tidelord Teethwretch in Sina's Yearning.
78936.description:
So you outsiders and Faerin managed to both survive and save the villagers at the beach? 

<Steelstrike breathes a quick prayer in relief.> 

We're in trouble, here. The kobyss brought some of their strongest forces to the doorsteps of villagers. 

We have our hands full just holding the line. If you can take out those monsters, we might be able to turn the tide.
78936.progress: When we first encountered the kobyss, there were those among us who tried to establish peace with them. But it quickly became apparent that they only see us as food.
78936.completion:
Every Arathi has killed more kobyss than I care to count. We've also lost more Arathi to kobyss than I want to count. 

I don't know what underwater cavern they hail from... but I shudder to think of it.

78937.title: Shadow upon Shadow
78937.description:
<Faerin's wide eyes dart around in surprise.>

What just happened? Did you see that shadow? And the oil well... it's gone dark? 

I've never seen anything like this before. 

Could it be the nearby dawntower? Hurry!
78937.completion: The fear and shame of these people lingers in the air like a fog.

78938.title: Champion of the Waterlords
78938.objectives: Defeat Remembered Ragnaros during a Radiant Echoes event.
78938.description:
I regret to inform you that a horrific threat awaits your kind within this mortal realm. An Elemental Lord of Fire, Ragnaros, bides his time waiting to strike and burn your Azeroth to its core. We, the elements of water, have waged war eternal with those beings of the lesser elementals. Trust that our warning is no small thing.

Prove your conviction! Slay Ragnaros, once and for all!
78938.progress: Ragnaros yet remains, mortal. His foul heat emanates from nearby.
78938.completion:
You have done what most of your kind would think impossible. You have faced Ragnaros and triumphed!

For so small a creature, you have displayed great resource.

Some day, perhaps we might strike a true allegiance between your kind and the Waterlords.

78939.title: The Darkened Flame
78939.description:
This... Order of Night, as they call themselves, did some foul ritual to turn the tower's flame to darkness. I know not what.

We should investigate.
78939.progress:
My own people... how could they? 

<Faerin shakes her head in disbelief.>
78939.completion:
So, they killed Kelther, too? 

<Faerin squeezes her eyes shut and mouths a prayer and a curse at the same time.>

We'll make sure he gets a proper funeral. The Order of Night will pay for this.

We sealed off Gloomcrag, the nearby cave, years ago. They must have dug their way in so they could target this dawntower. 

How long have they been planning this? How long has the Order of Night been among our ranks?

78941.title: A Tide Needing Turned
78941.objectives: Meet with General Steelstrike in Hallowfall.
78941.description:
Xal'atath's army has been capable of striking at us for a while now. So what caused her to choose this moment?

Something is wrong here. She waited for us to build an army in response, and then attacks openly. We're playing into her hands.

Report to the Arathi general. I'll head to the battlefield directly.
78941.completion: Good, you're here. I'll keep it brief.

78942.title: The Might of Khaz Algar
78942.description:
The Harbinger thinks she can catch us off guard, but she's a fool if she expects to win this fight.

The Algari Offensive stands at your back, {NAME}. Spare no enemy.
78942.completion: Your Horde and Alliance make a formidable army. I don't think there's much we could have done without them.

78943.title: Steel and Flames
78943.description:
Our forces may be able to hold their own, but seeing you in the fray may help their spirits. 

Take this warhorn. Let it ring out and fill our foes with terror. Once you're done rallying our troops, make your way to your commanders.

78948.title: A Light in the Dark
78948.objectives: Speak with Anduin and chase down Xal'atath.
78948.description:
Something is very wrong. As the battle continues, each side has become more aggressive.

Alleria seems to know something - she ran off at one point during the battle. We've been giving chase, but I cannot leave these soldiers to die. She's just ahead, we can reconvene with her together.
78948.completion: Khadgar will need immediate help. We will have time for celebrations later.

78950.title: Cutting Off the Legs
78950.description:
While we've yet to locate Xal'atath, we've received reports from deeper in the field of certain nerubians giving orders. It won't buy us too much but every action is critical.

Take them out. Hopefully that will allow us some breathing room. 

Speak with Anduin after you are done. He and the Arathi girl went after Alleria.
78950.progress: Speak with Anduin within the Sanguine Grasps.

78951.title: Ever Deeper Shadow
78951.objectives: Slay 10 Order of Night cultists in the cave beneath the Cliffside Beacon.
78951.description:
When I reached for the Flame, I felt the overwhelming hopelessness and despair that had been poured into it. 

It pains me, but... my light alone is not enough to banish these shadows. 

And so, we take a more direct path. If the remaining cultists have withdrawn to Gloomcrag Bower, their combined power must be what's keeping the Flame dark. 

We must stop them before this darkness spreads.
78951.progress:
These were once my people. My allies. My mentors. 

I once tried to reason with them. Tried to make them see the Light... see that the Light is still within us all.

<Faerin's face flickers between sadness and anger.>

They wouldn't listen. And they're killing innocents. 

I can't hesitate. Not anymore.
78951.completion:
<Faerin's jaw is firm.> 

They made their choice.

78952.title: The Final Resistance
78952.description:
<Faerin speaks in a hushed, furious whisper.>

Good work. But before we can leave, there's something else. 

Down this way are some powerful priests. I think they are summoning something-- something big. No doubt to strike at us above and drive us from the tower itself.

It will be dangerous, but we must stop them. Are you with me?
78952.completion:
<Faerin's eyes are dark with weariness.> 

It never ends, does it?

78954.title: Restore the Flame
78954.objectives: Help Faerin restore the Holy Flame at the Cliffside Beacon.
78954.description:
Do you feel it? Hope, returning? 

Thank you for your help, {NAME}.

The dawntower's flame remains dark. But this time, I think we'll be able to restore it. 

Let's meet at the tower.
78954.progress: I only hope that together, we can kindle a little more light in our little world.
78954.completion:
<Faerin gives a warm, tired smile.> 

Thank you. Thank the Light you all arrived when you did. I'm glad we can help each other.

78972.title: Harvest Havoc
78972.objectives: Control Harvestbot Remy to load 4 Cabbage and 4 Carrots into carts. In addition slay 12 Invasive Beetles.
78972.description:
Our parents went off to fight the monsters that invaded our farm. While they are gone, we try to keep the farm running. 

We have a harvestbot to help with chores, but I keep crashing it into the river. We could finish our chores if you could help us drive the harvestbot!
78972.completion: You were really good at controlling Remy.  Maybe you can come back and help next week as well!

78978.title: Raising a Stink
78978.description:
Those clues add up to an ugly story, {NAME}.

That map shows the Crown's got a heavily guarded base of operations in Silverpine Forest. And between that memo and formula, it looks like they're cooking up something intoxicatingly toxic.

I've got a gal that can get us some... artisanal goods... to deal with the Crown. I'll go talk to him and meet you outside Shadowfang Keep.
78978.completion:
There you are, right on time.

I've got a plan to deal with this chemical conspiracy.

78979.title: Loving Yourself, Your Way
78979.description:
While visiting this gala, I am staying at the Razor Hill inn. It may not look like much, but it is surprisingly comfortable!

Why don't you see if they have any extra beds you could use?

I think I will have a bit of a rest too... Right... here...
78979.completion:
...Huh? Oh! Welcome back, did you enjoy your rest?

On any other day, you do great deeds for others.

Today you have done something great for yourself. And that is the best gift of all.

78980.title: Take a Look Around
78980.description:
Here at the Gala of Gifts, we have many wonderful artisans crafting gifts just for you and your loved ones. But don't take my word for it--there are plenty of attendees enjoying the festivities as well!

Go, speak to the visitors, and see what the artisans have to offer. Maybe you will find the perfect gift!
78980.progress: Are you having a good time?
78980.completion:
As you can see, there are plenty of gifts to be given!

Go get a gift for someone you care about!

78981.title: Love is in the Air
78981.description:
Smell these roses! My partner got them for me at the Gala of Gifts.

Interested in seeing things yourself? Head to Durotar. There are gifts, and food, and you should taste the chocolate, it's delicious!
78981.completion:
Welcome to the Gala, friend!

Would you like to hear more about our specialty chocolates?

78982.title: I Smell Trouble
78982.description:
You smell that funny odor too? Smells like smoke, cheap cologne, and alchemical nonsense. You ask me, I think the Crown Chemical Co. is up to something. Want to help me get to the bottom of it?

Well, take a look at my pal here. Sure, he looks like a pooch, but this is O.D.I.E.! The Olfactory Detection and Inspection Engine! With this little fella, you and I can sniff out whatever the Crown is plotting from a mile away!

Are you in? I could use a good partner to solve this.
78982.progress: Sure, O.D.I.E. can sniff out the clues, but you still gotta piece 'em together.
78982.completion:
Poisonous perfumes? Revenge for kicking 'em out of the city?

Seems like Apothecary Hummel is cooking up something sinister. This could get ugly.

78983.title: An Unwelcome Gift
78983.description:
I have a sinking suspicion there are spies from the Crown Chemical Co. among us. But I know that you know that O.D.I.E. here knows how to latch onto their scent!

But let's not bother anybody just here to have a good time, all right? Keep your nose peeled for chemicals, and make sure we're hitting the right targets.
78983.progress: Follow your nose, pal! Anyone who stinks could be a suspect.
78983.completion:
Yeesh, {NAME}, you reek!



Even worse! I reek!

Well at least we've given some peace to the gala. I'd hate to have the Crown ruining the celebrations.

78984.title: Crushing the Crown
78984.description:
Looks like Hummel's got some security. But don't worry, I came with some special gifts to deliver.

<Snagglebolt points to the unmarked box.>

Bombs. I got bombs.

Playtime's over. Take those bombs and toss 'em at the Crown and their supplies. Let's give them a look at what genuine craftsmanship can do. Once we've cleared out their operations, we can move in on Hummel.
78984.progress: We need to put a stop to this before the Crown pulls off their smelly sabotage.
78984.completion:
Man, I love a good fireworks show! Great job, {NAME}. That oughta slow them down.

Now there's just Hummel to deal with.

78985.title: The Stench of Revenge
78985.description:
We're never gonna see an end to this unless we take on the boss himself.

Look, Apothecary Hummel is holed up in Shadowfang Keep with his cronies. He's working on a new batch of poisonous perfumes, and they'll knock out all of Orgrimmar if we let him finish his research.

You go do what you do best, pal. Get in there and foil his schemes before we're all lavender-scented corpses.
78985.progress: You ready to see what Hummel is cooking? I guarantee you it's not as pretty as it smells.
78985.completion:
Sounds like you got there just in time--great work.

This would have gotten real ugly if Hummel poisoned the entire gala.

Let's just call this our gift to them, eh?

78986.title: Getaway to Scenic Grizzly Hills!
78986.description:
Good morrow! Today's special portal is a magical getaway to the majestic forests of Northrend!

Although perhaps I could beg you for a favor. You seem the adventurous type. 

I could use your help in delivering some flowers from Grizzly hills to a beautiful woman named Laverne. 

I would do it myself but... Well, you see, she is rather intimidating in her beauty.
78986.progress:
The mage conjuring portals?

<Laverne giggles.>

Let me see.
78986.completion:
This gala is quite marvelous for making new discoveries...

<Laverne idly picks at the flowers while staring in the direction of Aurora.>

78987.title: Getaway to Scenic Nagrand!
78987.description:
Good morrow! Today's special portal is a magical getaway to the great plains of Nagrand!

Would you, perchance, be interested in a proposition? I will lend you my camera if you could deliver any photographs you take to my dear friend Karn.

He has been adrift in Nagrand as of late, lost in his own thoughts. As stubborn as he is, I'm sure he will appreciate the company. I would do it myself, but I must maintain the portals here.
78987.progress: How is Karn? When last I saw him, he seemed drowned in regrets and loneliness.
78987.completion:
He asked you to do WHAT?

He knows that Laverne is--ARGGH! This is my justice, I suppose, for not acting sooner on matters of my own heart.

No matter. Everything is fine, Aurora, this is fine...

Erm, thank you regardless, {NAME}. The thorns of my roses need not rest in your hands. I will find another way to gain Laverne's attention.

78988.title: Getaway to Scenic Feralas!
78988.description:
Good morrow! Today's special portal is a magical getaway to the sunny beaches of Feralas! The Steam Pools resort is having a lovely celebration and all are invited!

Unfortunately, some of our festival attendees who took this portal earlier left their gifts here at the gala.

Could you perchance help me return them? I will meet you at the beach and together we shall be able to determine which gifts belong to whom.
78988.progress: There are so many places in Azeroth to escape to! Everywhere you look, there's something new to discover.
78988.completion:
You are wonderfully helpful, {NAME}. You have brightened the spirits of many people by returning their gifts to them.

And what an array of gifts they were! Perhaps the language of love looks different to everyone.

78989.title: The Gift of Self-Care
78989.description:
The eyes of a tired adventurer.

A {class} that does many great deeds for many people. When was the last time you did a kind gesture for yourself? 

Perhaps now is the time. Look into your heart. 

What do YOU desire?
78989.progress: Love is a blessing, especially if it comes from within.
78989.completion: Let us begin your journey to self-love.

78990.title: The Gift of Relief
78990.description:
You adventurers are known to carry heavy burdens. There will be no better time to confront them than now. 

I saw a veteran somewhere around here. There is a chance he may know what it means to cope with stress.

Perhaps he has insight to teach you.
78990.progress: I've seen men die of stress, you don't want to bottle it up every day.
78990.completion:
Feeling better? 

You must take care of your body after a tough day. Be good to your head and heart and they'll be good to you.

78991.title: The Gift of Relaxation
78991.description:
Love is a gift, yes. But it is also a gift that you can give yourself.

Sometimes, the best way to love yourself is simply to relax.

I met a troll across the Southfury River who seems particularly wise in this regard. Perhaps you could ask her for insights in the art of relaxation.
78991.progress: True love is letting ya guard down. Let yourself relax, you'll see what I mean.
78991.completion:
Ya feel renewed, don't ya? We all got ta relax from da problems in our lives.

Relaxin' has helped me re-discover who I was. Changed my whole life! I used to have tusks out to here and a mohawk, bwahaha! What a stupid boy I was.

Did ya discover anyting about yourself?

78992.title: Loving Yourself, Your Way
78992.description:
If it's a challenge you're after, I think I have an idea.

I saw a boastful champion heading toward Razor Hill. You could challenge him to a duel.

This would satisfy your desire and perhaps teach him a valuable lesson in humility.
78992.completion:
On any other day, you do great deeds for others.

Today you have done something great for yourself. And that is the best gift of all.

78993.title: Loving Yourself, Your Way
78993.description:
A full belly is a happy belly!

There is plenty of good food and drink right here at the gala. Why don't you buy yourself something nice?
78993.progress: Have you had your fill of treats? I love the fruits, myself.
78993.completion:
On any other day, you do great deeds for others.

Today you have done something great for yourself. And that is the best gift of all.

78996.title: Weapons and Warriors
78996.objectives: Collect 3 weapon crates and recruit 5 warriors from Freywold Village and Dhar Durgaz.
78996.description:
Gorloc raiders have been slaughtering these farmers and stealing their pearls. They seek our protection, but we may not be enough.

I know of others nearby who can help. Seek them out and request their aid. If they are hesitant, offer them the promise of pearls as payment.

We will also need to arm these farmers so they can defend themselves. Search for spare weapons and equipment that they might be able to use.

I will go with the farmers and train them as best I can.
78996.completion: Good work. I'm glad you were able to recruit some fighters. It is worse than I expected, and we will need every one we have.

78997.title: Pilfered Pearls
78997.objectives: Retrieve 8 Pilfered Pearls from gorlocs at the Glimmering Shore.
78997.description:
The pearls that these farmers harvest are their only source of livelihood. Some of these earthen even look at pearl farming as their primary reason for existing.

The gorlocs continue to pilfer pearls at every opportunity. As you eliminate the gorlocs, search them for stolen pearls. Let us recover as many as we can.
78997.progress: We need to return these pearls to the farmers.
78997.completion: Thank you {NAME}. Eliminating the gorloc threat was just one of our objectives here. Giving the farmers their lives back is another.

78998.title: Frontline Farmers
78998.objectives: Distribute 3 weapon crates to the pearl farmers at Glimmering Shore.
78998.description:
Most of the farmers are already out in the field, defending their positions. I have trained them as best I could given the circumstances, but they are still wielding farming tools. 

I need you to distribute the weapons you gathered to those on the frontlines. While it may not markedly improve their combat ability, at least it will boost their confidence that they are not alone in this fight.
78998.completion: Excellent. As long as they fight together and for each other, I believe we will be victorious.

89385.title: First Step Into Parenthood
89385.completion:
Not everyone would go to such lengths for these creatures.

I'd like to give you something special, as thanks for your help. I think you have more than proven you can be entrusted with this.

A hawkstrider egg. Not yet hatched, but there is a little one in there--wiggling, curious, and eager to meet the one who will raise it with love. Take care of it, and it will take good care of you in return.

26191.title: The Culmination of Our Efforts
26191.completion:
With every day, more warriors arrive at Azshara's command. Soon, Neptulon the Tidehunter will hear of our preparations, but too late to stop what we have set in motion. Our numbers will be too great and our allies too powerful. Victory is only a matter of time.

In Azshara's name.

84025.title: Repurposed, Restored
84025.completion:
The machine is complete anew, its purpose restored.

You who have staunched its suffering are charged with carrying on this purpose.

May its metal never yield.

84220.title: Passage to the Ringing Deeps
84220.completion:
You have our thanks for everything you did in the Isle of Dorn.

Councildward Merrix ordered the restoration of this elevator unit to further support our allies and ensure we are not fully cut off again. 

Use it to quickly travel back and forth to the Ringing Deeps.

Candle for you! No better reward than that!

No, this candle not made from earwax. Made from beeswax! Smells so nice! You like nice smells, yes? If not, might want to step away from me, ha ha ha. Sorry.

85827.objectives: Thanks for helping get the Undermine back on track. Here's somethin' for your trouble.
85827.completion: Thanks for helping get the Undermine back on track. Here's somethin' for your trouble.

85929.title: Archivist Rubbleglint
85929.completion:
The Freysworn have always observed the lunar cycles and the celestial bodies in the sky. Perhaps, in time, we can adopt their beliefs and celebrate this holiday in the cycles to come.

As is your customs I bid you well, {NAME}, and offer you this token...

85930.title: Archivist Coppermoss
85930.completion:
As you pay homage to me, remember all the great things I have done for the earthen.

I, Togdhar the Brave will accept your homage and offer in return a token. 

How was that? Did you think I was Togdhar?

85931.title: Archivist Farolt
85931.completion:
To think there were other earthen who played a role in the events that led to this 'Lunar Festival' celebration intrigues me. I am eager to learn more.

As is customary I bid you well, outlander, and offer you this token...

85932.title: Archivist Silsigra
85932.completion:
After listening to the Kobolds tell stories of their past to their younglings...I'm starting to see the wisdom in this holiday after all.

 I bid you well, outlander, and offer you this token...

85933.title: Elder Knythall
85933.completion:
This reminds me of an old holiday we had in the empire. I barely remember it, but I do remember how my parents loved celebrating this time of year. Moments like these make me think of my kids... 

I wonder if they have forgotten about me. I know I haven't forgotten about them. 

I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token... May the Flame protect you.

85934.title: Elder Swornvow
85934.completion:
This holiday vaguely reminds me of one from home. I'm sure if I did some digging I could find it. What are the chances they are related? Hmm, much to think of. 

May the flame guide you. I bid you well, {NAME}, and offer you this token... As the custom goes.

85935.title: Elder Ikk'zivan
85935.completion:
I carry the threads of history, overcrawler. It is a weighty burden, but a noble one. You honor those of your past by visiting them--we honor those of ours by ensuring they are never forgotten.

Here, take this token to remember the lesson you have learned today.

85936.title: Elder Ikk'xataz
85936.completion:
Our threads seem like a burden to some. Each one carries the weight of thousands of lifetimes of history. Some strands that date back to the very beginning of our time here. 

But I am honored to carry it. Through me, every life lives on. 

Here, take this token to remember the lesson you have learned today.

86555.objectives: Thanks for helping get Undermine back on track. Here's somethin' for your trouble.

89493.title: Welcome to the Field
89493.completion:
Welcome, cadet! Glad to have you here. 

No time like the present to get in there. Fight the Sureki with everything you've got--we're counting on you.

89494.title: A Frocking Good Job
89494.completion:
{NAME}! Glad you could make it. I wanted to formally congratulate you on your new position within our ranks.

You've more than earned this, demonstrating courage and traits that show great promise as you continue serving Flame's Radiance.

On that note, please accept and don this tabard in your future endeavors. We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield.

89496.title: Defender of the Sacred Flame
89496.completion:
You've certainly proven yourself in our fight against the Sureki, {NAME}.

Your courage and willingness to defend the Sacred Flame is remarkable, and your martial prowess has helped turn the tide of battle more times than I've been able to count.

For that, I award you this tabard. Please accept it as an emblem and acknowledgement of your undying persistence.

64169.title: Champion: Ella
64169.objectives: Ella has been reunited with her grub. You should probably give them a good home.
64169.completion: Ella has been reunited with her grub. You should probably give them a good home.

64458.completion:
Your devotion to Ardenweald is unquestionable, {NAME}.

Sulanoom was especially impressed by your unshakable spirit, so much so that they wish to join our fight here.

Let's make good use of their services!

64459.title: Adventurer: Elwyn
64459.completion:
The forest blesses us, {NAME}. Your interest in the wellbeing of Ardenweald has not gone unnoticed.

The venerable Elwyn has agreed to join our fight.

Together we shall protect the realm.

64460.title: Adventurer: Yanlar
64460.completion:
{NAME}, you have fought many valiant battles for Ardenweald.

Yanlar has joined you for many fights across the Shadowlands and has been continually impressed with your valor. 

I am delighted to say that they have asked to permanently fight with you.

64461.title: Adventurer: Hermestes
64461.completion:
Your faith in Bastion is inspiring, {NAME}.

Hermestes has seen your unflagging dedication to our cause.

It has inspired them to join us in a different capacity at the Hold, so that they may contribute further to the greater needs of the Shadowlands.

64462.title: Adventurer: Cromas the Mystic
64462.completion:
Greetings, my mortal friend! I have good tidings.

Cromas the Mystic has watched your progress with Kyrian with great interest for quite some time.

Now he wishes to join you and lend his courage and skills to our cause.

64463.title: Adventurer: Auric Spiritguide
64463.completion:
It seems we have another recruit, {NAME}.

I am honored to say that the Auric Spiritguide has decided to lend their wisdom and skills to our cause.

She will make a wonderful ally!

64464.title: Adventurer: Lyra Hailstorm
64464.completion:
We've got an exciting development today, {NAME}!

Lyra Hailstorm wants join our ranks here at the Seat! Her expertise will be a welcome addition.

Now go fight together for the good of Maldraxxus!

64465.title: Adventurer: Enceladus
64465.completion:

Me an' me shovel are at your disposal.

61219.completion:

I would like to join you and bring terror to your enemies Maw Walker.

61221.title: Champion: Stonehuck
