61221.completion:
My Sinstone ain't been gettin' a lot of use lately.

I reckon if I follow ya I might get a chance to put it to good use.

61222.title: Champion: Kaletar the Mender
61222.objectives: Thank you for freeing me Maw Walker.Allow me to repay your kindness by assisting you.
61222.completion:
Thank you for freeing me Maw Walker.

Allow me to repay your kindness by assisting you.

61223.title: Champion: Ayeleth the Deprived
61223.completion:
More! 

Let me drink from your enemies! 

Unleash me upon them!

61313.title: Champion: Kythekios
61313.completion: I can fight once more! Allow me to test my mettle against your enemies!

61317.title: Champion: Teliah
61317.objectives: This new weapon is lacking one thing, the blood of my enemies! Allow me to rectify that.
61317.completion: This new weapon is lacking one thing, the blood of my enemies! Allow me to rectify that.

61318.title: Champion: Telethakas
61318.objectives: Honor has been satisfied. Now I require a new master to serve. I would like that to be you.
61318.completion: Honor has been satisfied. Now I require a new master to serve. I would like that to be you.

61319.title: Champion: Hala
61319.objectives: You have returned my sword to me. I am indebted to you Maw Walker. Allow me to assist you further.
61319.completion: You have returned my sword to me. I am indebted to you Maw Walker. Allow me to assist you further.

61320.title: Champion: Molako
61320.objectives: I cannot thank you enough for my freedom. I would like to help you further in your tasks.
61320.completion: I cannot thank you enough for my freedom. I would like to help you further in your tasks.

61321.title: Champion: Ispiron
61321.objectives: I am whole once more. I would be nothing if it were not for you. I shall dedicate my power to your cause.
61321.completion: I am whole once more. I would be nothing if it were not for you. I shall dedicate my power to your cause.

61421.title: Champion: Blisswing
61421.objectives: You have rescued both Enothia and myself. Allow me to repay your kindness and join you on your quest.
61421.completion: You have rescued both Enothia and myself. Allow me to repay your kindness and join you on your quest.

61422.title: Champion: Duskleaf
61422.objectives: Finally revenge is served. Or is that justice? Something has been served for me, and maybe now I can serve you.
61422.completion: Finally revenge is served. Or is that justice? Something has been served for me, and maybe now I can serve you.

61423.title: Champion: Karynmwylyann
61423.objectives: My memories have been restored and now I need a new path. I shall join you along yours for a time if you wish.
61423.completion: My memories have been restored and now I need a new path. I shall join you along yours for a time if you wish.

61424.title: Champion: Chalkyth
61424.completion: Allow me and my saber to thrash your enemies once more!

61425.title: Champion: Lloth'wellyn
61425.objectives: Thank you for the help, I made a note of it. I believe I may also be able to help you further as well.
61425.completion: Thank you for the help, I made a note of it. I believe I may also be able to help you further as well.

61426.title: Champion: Yira'lya
61426.objectives: Please take me back to Ardenweald. I can do nothing to help from here.
61426.completion: Please take me back to Ardenweald. I can do nothing to help from here.

61729.title: Adventurer: Rahel
61729.completion:
Rahel has arrived from Darkhaven to assist us with, and I quote, "killing anybody." She is quite eager to enter the fray.

She seemed rather upbeat at the prospect of working with you again, {NAME}.

61786.title: Adventurer: Stonehead
61786.completion:
Your "good bud" Stonehead insists on fighting for the cause, {NAME}.

I'm sure we can find a use for his skills. Nothing too complicated, of course.

61788.title: Adventurer: Simone
61788.completion:
Your actions on behalf of Revendreth are garnering quite a lot of attention, {NAME}.

Simone has offered to lend her expertise with the mirrors of the Ember Ward to the cause.

61789.title: Adventurer: Lost Sybille
61789.completion:
Lost Sybille comes highly recommended by Theotar.

Plus, she dropped a bag of Stone Legion heads and two canisters of anima on our doorstep when she arrived. So I guess she's fighting for us already.

Let's see what she can do with some allies.

61790.title: Adventurer: Vulca
61790.completion:
Anyone that survives in the Ember Ward as long as Vulca did is tough as stone.

She'll have an unexpected trick or two to help us take down the enemy.

61792.title: Adventurer: Bogdan
61792.completion:
Your loyalty to Revendreth is unquestionable, {NAME}.

Bogdan has offered to take a leave of absence from Theotar's service, and will assist you however he can.

61852.title: Adventurer: Guardian Kota
61852.completion:
Hello again, {NAME}. It is good to see you taking such an active interest in the affairs of Ardenweald.

The honorable Guardian Kota has agreed to work with us, as part of her duties to protect the grove of Tirna Vaal.

Together, you will ensure the forest's continued security.

61853.title: Adventurer: Te'zan
61853.completion:
The forest is ever in need, {NAME}.

Te'zan is as spirited as ever, and perhaps a healthy dose of responsibility will lend him some direction and meaning to his afterlife.

Where should we send him first?

61854.title: Adventurer: Master Sha'lor
61854.completion:
The forest blesses us today, {NAME}.

Master Sha'lor says he has sufficiently recovered from his ordeal with the gorm, and would like to be of assistance however he can. He seems especially eager to learn new things.

I guess a little taste of adventure goes a long way.

61855.title: Adventurer: Qadarin
61855.completion:
Good to see you again, {NAME}.

Your continued dedication to the well-being of Ardenweald has not gone unnoticed.

Qadarin has expressed interest in taking a more active role. Let's put his skills to use, shall we?

61856.title: Adventurer: Watcher Vesperbloom
61856.completion:
I have a particularly special boon for you, o' champion of Ardenweald. Are you ready?

The individual joining our Hunt today is... me!

<Vesperbloom rubs her hands together, grinning.>

It will be nice to get in some field work!

61857.title: Adventurer: Groonoomcrooek
61857.completion:
{NAME}, your devotion to Ardenweald, and to the Queen, is unquestionable.

Something you've done seems to have satisfied Groonoomcrooek. I'm not sure exactly what it was, though.

It took them a while just to tell me they would be joining us here.

61859.title: Adventurer: Nemea
61859.completion:
It is good to see you again, {NAME}.

A friend of yours has kindly offered to assist in our endeavors here: Nemea, the larion master. She will be a powerful ally.

61860.title: Adventurer: Pelodis
61860.completion:
It is good to see you again, {NAME}.

A friend of yours has kindly offered to assist in our endeavors here: Pelodis, the phalynx master. He will be a powerful ally.

61861.title: Adventurer: Sika
61861.completion:
It seems we have another recruit, {NAME}.

Sika has asked to aid us here whenever she is not tending to her duties at the Eternal Forge.

Do not underestimate her worth as an ally!

61862.title: Adventurer: Clora
61862.completion:
{NAME}, I would ask for a moment of your time.

One of the recently ascended, Clora, feels that her fierce combat skills would be best put to use tackling the matters laid out before us. I am inclined to agree.

61863.title: Adventurer: Apolon
61863.completion:
Hello there, my mortal friend! I have good news for you today.

Apolon has told me with great certainty that the path he follows is intertwined with yours.

Though he has duties to the Path of Ascension, his courage will be of great aid to us here as well.

61864.title: Adventurer: Bron
61864.completion:
Mikanikos has made a sensible suggestion, {NAME}.

When Bron is not directly assisting you in the field, he could be of service elsewhere throughout the Shadowlands.

I am sure Bron will not mind.

61865.title: Adventurer: Disciple Kosmas
61865.completion:
Your dedication to Bastion is inspiring, {NAME}.

With the anima you have returned to us, Disciple Kosmas feels he can be away from the Temple of Purity for a time.

He has offered to join us here at the Hold, and contribute to the greater needs of the Shadowlands.

61943.title: Court Influencer
61943.completion:
Your investments into the Ember Court have allowed me to compile this list of potential new guests we could invite.

Please, browse them at your convenience and inform me who we should extend an invitation to first.

61944.title: Discerning Taste
61944.completion:
Your investments into the Ember Court have attracted the attention of some very powerful individuals, {NAME}.

I have compiled a list of these exclusive guests. Review them at your convenience and inform me who you wish to extend an invitation to first.

Fair warning, these discerning individuals will not be as easy to please.

61957.title: Champion: Ashraka
61957.objectives: My services are now yours Maw Walker.
61957.completion: My services are now yours Maw Walker.

61959.title: Champion: Talethi
61959.objectives: I shall pay my debt to my Maw Walker.Direct my power against your enemies.
61959.completion:
I shall pay my debt to my Maw Walker.

Direct my power against your enemies.

61960.title: Champion: Xertora
61960.completion:
Do you happen to have a spare leg lying around? Surely you don't need two. I'll put it to good use, kicking your enemies!

No? I can probably still help anyway.

61961.title: Champion: Rattlebag
61961.objectives: I am prepared for combat!Put me in the front line, I will be your shield.
61961.completion:
I am prepared for combat!

Put me in the front line, I will be your shield.

61962.title: Champion: Velkein
61962.completion:
I shall wield my blade with purpose once more!

Death to your enemies!

62309.title: Adventurer: Secutor Mevix
62309.completion:
{NAME}, it is good to see you again!

Following your success against the House of Constructs, Secutor Mevix is eager for more action on the battlefield.

Don't leave an eager soldier to wallow here. Give him purpose!

62312.title: Adventurer: Gunn Gorgebone
62312.completion:
We've got an exciting development today, {NAME}!

You must have made quite an impression. Gunn Gorgebone, one of the champions of the Theater of Pain, is demanding to join our ranks here. Demanding it!

62313.title: Adventurer: Rencissa the Dynamo
62313.completion:
{NAME}! Step closer, come, come!

I've just received word that none other than Rencissa the Dynamo is on her way here to fight for you. Rencissa! The Dynamo!

Who should we have her kill first?

62314.title: Adventurer: Khaliiq
62314.completion:
Listen up, {NAME}. We need more eyes out there on the battlefield.

There's too many threats, and not enough information flowing our way.

See if Khaliiq is up to the task. You heard me right, I said more Eyes!

62315.title: Adventurer: Plaguey
62315.completion:
We've got a strange one today, {NAME}.

Marileth stopped by to say that his slime Plaguey is feeling more blue than usual, and asked if we could keep him entertained.

What does this look like, a kennel? Plaguey can earn his keep like the rest of us! Get him out there, soldier!

62316.title: Adventurer: Rathan
62316.completion:
Your dedication to Maldraxxus is inspiring, {NAME}.

Rathan has requested to join our ranks here at the Seat, for the good of Maldraxxus. His expertise will be a welcome addition!

I suspect he wants to keep an eye on Emeni as well, but you didn't hear that from me.

62999.title: Champion: Croman
62999.objectives: Even if it doesn't bleed, we can still kill it.
62999.completion: Even if it doesn't bleed, we can still kill it.

63685.title: Cryptkeeper Kassir's Best Friend
63685.completion:
{NAME}, you must forgive me another expression of my gratitude for being included in the Ember Court.

It has been the honor of my existence, and I am humbled to have played any small part in our prince's success there.

Please, do not hesitate to call on me if I can ever be of service, my most dear friend.

63686.title: Baroness Vashj's Best Friend
63686.completion:
<Baroness Vashj smiles at you.>

{NAME}, you have proven to be a welcome diversion from my current endeavors.

I do not regret my skepticism when you first approached me regarding your Ember Court, but I am pleased you have proven them to be unnecessary.

You and Prince Renathal hold court well. And I am pleased to have spent more time with you.

Until the next court, my little {NAME}.

63687.title: Lady Moonberry's Best Friend
63687.completion:
<Lady Moonberry stifles a laugh.>

{NAME}! I was just telling Goji about our very first Ember Court together. Do you remember? I made the illusions and tried to hit Prince Renathal with my very own-- well, I don't need to tell you again. You were there!

Oh, we are kindred spirits, you and I...

63688.title: Mikanikos's Best Friend
63688.completion:
I like you, {NAME}.

Strong {NAME}.
Clever {NAME}.
Adventurous {NAME}.

Like Bron, but smaller... Also better?



Yes, better!

{NAME} best friend.

63689.title: The Countess's Best Friend
63689.completion:
Redelav Tower basks in the joy of your every footstep here, {NAME}.

I wish you were able to visit more often, but it is always so with best friends. Do you not agree?



I have nothing to ask of you today, my dear. I covet your friendship alone.

I trust you appreciate how rare it is to find true, genuine friendship among the lemmings of court.

But of course you do. You are the host of the finest court in all of Revendreth!

63690.title: Alexandros Mograine's Best Friend
63690.completion:
It has been an honor to fight alongside you, {NAME}. Perhaps an even greater honor to work alongside you to unite Revendreth.

Until our time here shall pass, you will always be my brother in arms.

63691.title: Hunt-Captain Korayn's Best Friend
63691.completion:
<Hunt-Captain Korayn sheathes her weapon with a smile.>

Ah, I can finally let down my guard. {NAME} is here!

Nothing bad shall befall us while the mighty Maw Walker walks among us. Even the gorm have learned to tremble at his name.

{NAME}, our bond has grown through the many battles and courts we have conquered together.

Wherever the hunt takes us next, I hope we travel together.

63692.title: Polemarch Adrestes's Best Friend
63692.completion:
<Polemarch Adrestes stifles a laugh, unaccustomed to its unfamiliar sensation.>

{NAME}, I was just daydreaming about the first time you invited me to the Ember Court. Do you remember?

I attempted to pass off the responsibility to one better suited for the challenge, but Chyrus thought it would be good for me to grow.

And he was right! What accomplishments we have made together... and even a bit of fun.



You have bettered me in many ways, my dear friend. Thank you.

63693.title: Rendle and Cudgelface's Best Friend
63693.completion:
Me and Rendle was just talking about you, {NAME}.

He's been telling all the dredgers dat you're HIS best friend, but I know you're MY best friend. And Rendle's always been my best friend too. So that's all really confusing me.

I says we all be best friends together, yeah?

And our friendship is made of strong muck. Best friends forever, I say. BFFs, I calls it.

And BFFs always helps each others outta jams. You just let ol' Rendle and me know wheres we needed!

63694.title: Choofa's Best Friend
63694.completion:
It's official, {NAME}. Rury, Slanknen, Awool, me -- the whole crew, we've been chatting about our best friend, YOU! And we think you're ready to join.

So welcome to the crew, best friend! Let's have some fun!

63695.title: Droman Aliothe's Best Friend
63695.completion:
I have seen many things in my time, {NAME}. But after so many Ember Courts, I can confidently say that I have not witnessed anything, or anyone, quite like you.

You and your prince have asked me to ponder both my purpose and my destiny. I do not know how this adventure that we embark upon will ultimately end, but if I should fall, I would hope that I shall fall by your side.

Call upon me whenever you have need of me.

63696.title: Grandmaster Vole's Best Friend
63696.completion:
I've got a real eye for talent. I said it to myself the first time I saw you walking up to the arena, "This kid's going places!"

And here I am, going there with you.

<Grandmaster Vole flashes a genuine smile as he relaxes for a moment.>

I owe you one, kid.

You know, despite what you may think, not a lot of quality friend material comes shuffling through here.

Any future bookings you need are on the house. I've always got time for my best friend.

63697.title: Kleia and Pelagos's Best Friend
63697.completion:
We have been on quite a journey together, {NAME}. Although we are not soulbinds, but I feel that we are bound in a different way.

Bonded together in purpose, in goal, in friendship.



Whatever dangers we face as we confront the Jailer, we face together.

63698.title: Plague Deviser Marileth's Best Friend
63698.completion:
My wonderful, glorious, exceptional, intelligent, witty, creative, resilient, viscous apprentice {NAME}!

I am most pleased to say that you have earned a promotion! I'm honestly not sure what title is above apprentice... none of my apprentices has ever made it this far before.

Your first task as my new best-friend apprentice is to determine a suitably respectable title your new position!

Congratulations! You report directly to Kevin now.

63699.title: Sika's Best Friend
63699.completion:
Thank {NAME}. Show Sika have many friends.

{NAME} is best friend. Show Sika rest and party. Show Sika kindness.

Sika always help {NAME}.

63700.title: Stonehead's Best Friend
63700.completion:
Best bud!

You remember papers you give me lots of times? Sybille help me learn read them!

You know papers say I can go party a lot? Reading is fun! Reading leads to party!

Stonehead always party with best bud!

46034.title: Champion: Aelthalyste
46034.completion:
All these priests? They report to you? It's astonishing, really.

I have only one Roland, and it seems you have hundreds!

I think we will get along well, {NAME}. Very well, indeed.

Allow me to stay, and in return, I will offer you my services.

46043.title: Champion: Aethas Sunreaver
46043.completion:
Archmage, the events of the past have long weighed heavily upon me. While I do not regret my actions, I do regret what happened. If I could go back and change things...

I hope in time the Kirin Tor - indeed, all of Azeroth - will better understand my loyalties. Thanks to you, crisis has been averted. Please accept my enduring gratitude.

46044.title: Champion: Thisalee Crow
46044.completion:
Look, Archdruid, don't get me wrong. I love Aviana. She's my ancient! But she's a little too passive for me to follow around all the time.

You, on the other hand? You're the real deal! I want to be in the fray, ruining some demon's day!

So? Will you take me with you?

46045.title: Champion: Nerus Moonfang
46045.completion:
I know I have much to answer for.

Although you have freed my family from their curse, nothing can take away the pain my mistakes have caused them. 

Delas has done well to devote herself to the Silver Hand. Do not let my past reflect poorly on her.

I'd like to follow her lead, and lend my aid to your order.

46047.title: Champion: Kanrethad Ebonlocke
46047.completion:
Although my recollection of recent events is still a bit hazy, the power you displayed when dispatching Rezara was something I could never forget.

It seems fitting that the council chose you as its leader in my absence.

Rest assured, I have no desire to challenge their decision. I owe you my life.

Let me serve you and the council. There is much we can learn from each other.

46048.title: Champion: Nighthuntress Syrenne
46048.completion:
Tell me, {NAME}, are all those among your ranks as dedicated as their leader?

I've been reluctant to trust outsiders, but you and I aren't so different, are we? We're both willing to go to great lengths to protect the things we care about. Our goals seem to align in that regard.

I would like to lend my aid to you and your hunters, if you'll allow it.

46049.title: A Gift From Your Tadpole
46049.objectives: <Your tadpole has prepared a gift for you. What could be inside?>.
46049.completion: <Your tadpole has prepared a gift for you. What could be inside?>

46050.title: Champion: Minerva Ravensorrow
46050.completion: Look, I may be dead and my lungs may serve no purpose, but raising Daumyr to undeath was like a breath of fresh air for me. I ask that you continue to take me under your guidance. Bring me to the battlefield again! I will scatter the bones of any demon that so much as looks at me.

46057.title: Champion: Magatha Grimtotem
46057.completion:
You are a foolish child. You think you have great power, but you know nothing. The Doomstone should be used for the greatness it can accomplish! It will waste away sitting in the Maelstrom.

Perhaps it was a mistake coming here. Nobundo requests that the Grimtotem stay. I stay for my own reasons, not because he asked. If you need me or my warriors to earn our keep, we will oblige.

But remember your place.

46058.title: Champion: Lilian Voss
46058.completion:
You made quick work of those demons, and I hope you do the same to many more. So long as the Legion extends their influence on our world, they will continue to corrupt our people as well.

I would like to continue to work with you to end this madness. My blades are yours, Shadowblade.

46059.title: Champion: Tess Greymane
46059.completion:
You've proven your expertise to me many times over, Shadowblade. While my colleagues have already pledged their service to you, I took a step back. Though all rogues step in the shadows, it is of vital importance that my status remains truly secret.

However, the threat is too great. We are so close to taking the Legion down... and I want to take on a greater role in it.

46119.title: Boon of the Builder
46119.completion:
{NAME}! Listen. You've been real good to our business. REAL good. Never thought I'd sell so many guns.

We like to reward those that patronize our establishment, so... here. Take this.

Slap this puppy on your shoulderpads and go hunting for engineering supplies. You'd be surprised how many basilisks get sprockets stuck in their gullets!

46128.title: Time for a Recharge
46128.completion:
I been thinkin' more about this whole battery thing, and how the whole process is just so... wasteful.

I ain't goin' green or nothin' like that - I'm just worried about our bottom line!

You know, if one were to supercharge one of these batteries with some Blood of Sargeras, maybe cap it off with some concentrated leystone...

46255.title: X Unstable Portals Disrupted, 1 World Boss Defeated

46316.title: Champion: Kanrethad Ebonlocke
46316.completion:
I remember you, {NAME}. We met long ago within the Black Temple. How could I forget such power?

It seems fitting that the council chose you as its leader in my absence.

Rest assured, I have no desire to challenge their decision. I owe you my life.

Let me serve you and the council. There is much we can learn from each other.

47017.title: Only the Best
47017.objectives: Our traders on the front lines were able to procure items of incredible rarity. Please use this wisely.
47017.completion: Our traders on the front lines were able to procure items of incredible rarity. Please use this wisely.

47040.title: Fate Sealed
47040.completion: I have bent this to my will, I have drained its power, and summoned a Seal. Would you like it?

47045.title: Further Progress
47045.completion: The Disruptor continues to bend to my will! I will be unstoppable!

47054.title: Touched By Fate
47054.objectives: I am... spent. I fear I have gone too far. Here, take this final Seal.
47054.completion: I am... spent. I fear I have gone too far. Here, take this final Seal.

47608.title: I Wish You Could See It

47994.title: Forming a Bond
47994.completion: Now that it has been thoroughly tested, I will direct our artificers to energize the warframe once more so that you may call it into battle. If you wish, you may select it at the Matrix Core at your leisure.

49196.title: Greater Invasion Point: Pit Lord Vilemus

50432.title: Titanic Innovation
50432.completion:
Spectacular! Marvelous! At last, I understand fully, and the titans themselves speak to me! They have shown me how to use the essences to craft the finest armors the world has ever seen, though I think the results may be... somewhat unpredictable.

<Vridiel beams with pride.>

Well, what are you waiting for? Bring me as many Wakening Essence as you can find!

51753.title: Champion: Rexxar
51753.completion:
Through countless wars, I've learned that those who stand alone will fall.

Let us stand as one, {NAME}. Together, we will face anything our foes send our way.

51975.title: Champion: Shadow Hunter Ty'jin
51975.completion:
You be impressin' me wit ya skills in parleyin', boss-mon.

I tink da two of us should be stickin' togetha. Da spirits insist!

Don't be worryin'. I'll get changed.

51987.title: Champion: Hobart Grapplehammer
51987.completion:
Now that everything's all set up around here, I'm out of work!

I bet you're going to need a pretty handy engineer. Why don't you take me along with ya?

52003.title: Champion: Kelsey Steelspark
52003.completion:
You know {NAME}, I've been following your adventure for a while and I just think you're so cool!

I was hoping that maybe I could tag along with you, maybe help you out? I'm not so good in a fight, but nobody can beat my mechanical skill!

52008.title: Champion: Magister Umbric
52008.completion:
I swear, sometimes I don't know how I end up in these situations!

Firstly, there is nothing of interest to me here. Secondly, the heat is absolutely sweltering. I would have understood if I was requested to study the stone that the sethrak held... but alas.

Would you take me out of here and let me get back to doing work of actual import?

52013.title: Champion: John J. Keeshan
52013.completion:
Now that we've settled in here... I aim my sights higher.

You've dealt with Conrad. You've dealt with the blood trolls. What's next for you, I wonder?

Whatever it is, I'm in. You're going to need a hardcore, experienced, tenacious combatant like me if you plan on winning this war!

52061.title: Taptaf the Pig!
52061.objectives: Taptaf looks up at you wide-eyed, after seeing his previous master slain. He seems eager to follow you now.
52061.completion: Taptaf looks up at you wide-eyed, after seeing his previous master slain. He seems eager to follow you now.

52450.title: Uniting Kul Tiras
52450.completion:
The people of Kul Tiras are diverse and capable. With their forces loyal to the Alliance, the Horde has no chance of stopping us.

Now, the real work begins.

52451.title: Uniting Zandalar
52451.completion:
The people of Zandalar are diverse and capable. With their forces loyal to the Horde, the Alliance has no chance of stopping us.

Now, the real work begins.

52861.title: Champion: Lilian Voss
52861.completion:
I have fought alongside you in this campaign for some time now, {NAME}.

We have witnessed firsthand the lengths that the Horde will go to to win. It may not always be pretty, but in the end we have achieved the upper hand.

I am curious to watch what Sylvanas does next. I am also curious to watch you.

You are an honorable man, {NAME}. Allow me to continue this fight by your side.

52965.title: A Winter Veil Gift
52965.completion:
A small tag on this present reads:

Happy holidays, {NAME}!

53011.title: A Gently Shaken Gift
53011.completion:
This present looks like it has been shaken a few times. The tag on it reads:

To a very special {race} {class}.

53098.title: Champion: Shandris Feathermoon
53098.completion:
Champion, it has been an honor to fight by your side. Our battle against the Horde is far from over.

Should you ever need my aid, simply call and I shall be there. Only by working together will we stop Sylvanas.

53121.title: Siege of Boralus
53121.completion:
It really is a shame you missed it, {NAME}. Dwarven gryphon-riders got the jump on us, but I don't think they were counting on us packing so many trained killers onto one boat.

Even Zelling got into the fun!

I found this letter on one of the dwarven corpses. Looks like there's tensions between the Kul Tiran leadership and one of their houses, House Ashvane. This might give us a good opportunity to sow some chaos in Boralus.

53131.completion:
The Horde aren't just here on a san'layn shuttling mission. There are lots of high-ranking Horde figures here. Something's going on.

One perk of dealing with important Horde targets is that they tend to be carrying important information. Look at this map I found on one of the bodies. See the big red circle around "Kings' Rest"? What is Kings' Rest? Why don't the Alliance know about this?

We'll have to look into it as soon as we get back on land.

I will serve you... Commander.

Highlord, so long as the Order of the Silver Hand stands, we will do everything in our power to destroy the Legion's foothold on Azeroth.

To succeed, we will need to enlist the best of our order.

40957.title: A Strong Right Hand

Even with the support of your fellow hunters, the crusade against the Legion will consume much of your time and attention. It is a war you cannot fight alone.

41115.title: Champion: Chen Stormstout
41115.completion:
I am honored to have fought by your side at the Peak of Serenity, {NAME}. Your leadership will help us greatly in the fight against the Legion.

I be keepin' dis place real nice for ya in return for ye help.

41734.title: Champion: Taran Zhu
41734.completion:
Grandmaster, the stories they tell about you are true. I witnessed your fortitude first hand at Tian Monastery.

My life and heart are pledged to the {class} order, and we have many battles ahead of us.

Let me be one of your swords. I would be honored to fight for you.

41735.title: Champion: The Monkey King
41735.completion:
Clever {race}, we fought as one, to defend the temple of the rising sun.

A natural leader, you laid enemies low, I'd much rather be your friend than foe!

Into the ring, my hat I toss! Let me fight with you, new boss!

41736.title: Champion: Angus Ironfist
41736.completion:
It was an honor to see ye in action, Grandmaster {NAME}. I'm more determined than ever to put an end to Lady Keletress and the Legion forces.

I think we could take the vrykul's Storm Brew and make our own recipe, and use their own weapon against them.

Will ye let me fight by your side?

41737.title: Champion: Hiro
41737.completion:
Ahhh, it feels good to be back out of  harm's way.

Now dat I've got a couple brews in me, I feel much better.

I owe you my life, Grandmaster. You have my undying loyalty. Just say da word, and I will do whatever you ask of me.

41738.title: Champion: Sylara Steelsong
41738.completion:
<Sylara gazes out the door at the sky beyond. She seems deep in thought, as if thinking about some other, unfinished task. She heaves a small, barely audible sigh.>

<Then, her steely eyes shift and lock on to you.>

My place is here.

I fight for you.

41739.title: Champion: Aegira
41739.completion:
We have been through quite a lot together, {NAME}.

Without your help, I could not have avenged my master, nor found the courage to make her legendary brew.

Thanks to you, we should have plenty of Storm Brew to supply the entire temple.

Speaking of which, I feel there are many similarities between your fighting style and mine.

Would you accept me as the newest member of your order?

41742.title: Champion: Celestos
41742.completion:
The Windlord has commanded that I shall assist the Earthen Ring in your campaign against the Burning Legion.

Lord Thunderaan sees great potential in you, Farseer. As thanks for your help in securing his return as Windlord, he has granted you my services here in the mortal realm.

When the time for battle approaches, the armies of Skywall will be at your back.

41743.title: Champion: Nobundo
41743.completion:
Your leadership during this time of crisis has been inspiring, Farseer {NAME}. It was truly an honor to journey with you through Skywall.

Although there are many matters here that require my attention, it would be an honor to fight at your side once again.

Should you have need of my aid once again, I will be yours to command.

41744.title: Champion: Rehgar Earthfury
41744.completion:
I have always respected you for your courage in battle, Farseer.

However, the way you have championed the Earthen Ring and united the Elemental Lords... it has been an honor to behold. You truly are a great leader. The leader our order needs!

Though the elements are united against the Burning Legion, our work is not yet done. If you should have need of my abilities, you need only ask.

I live to serve the Earthen Ring!

41745.title: Champion: Scaldius
41745.completion:
The Firelord has commanded me to aid the mortals in their battle against the Burning Legion.

My master has decreed that demon invaders have no place upon this world. I live to destroy the enemies of my master.

I will obey your commands as though they are the Firelord's himself. Who shall I destroy first?

41746.title: Champion: Muln Earthfury
41746.completion:
It was an honor to fight at your side in Deepholm, Farseer. The way you lead our order with courage and determination inspires us all with hope.

Yet, I fear that the worst is still ahead of us. You should not bear this burden alone.

Give me the honor of fighting alongside you once more, and I will not let you down.

41747.title: Champion: Avalanchion
41747.completion:
<The deep, thundering words of Avalanchion rumble out slowly as he speaks>

Stonemother... send me to help Farseer...

Say crush demons... protect {class}.



Avalanchion go with Farseer... make demons cry.

41748.title: Champion: Ritssyn Flamescowl
41748.completion:
Rebuilding the council is our key to defeating the Legion, but it's a task that cannot be completed alone.

You could use someone at your side, someone who's familiar with the burden of leadership.

I would be honored to serve as Second. Through your power and guidance, we can rebuild.

41750.title: Champion: Calydus
41750.completion:
Calydus no longer suffers under the cruel hand of Jagganoth, thanks to friend.

Calydus has a choice who to follow, and he pledges loyalty to the new Overlord!

That is, if friend is willing to let Calydus help?

41751.title: Champion: Kira Iresoul
41751.completion:
Your commitment to rebuilding the council is commendable. You could have left Shinfel to die and found a replacement, but you look out for your own.

I followed blindly once before, trusting my mentor to look out for my best interests. Instead, he left me to lead a council that admonished my way of doing things.

For this, I will never be a follower. Instead, I choose to stand beside you. My power is yours to use as you see fit, if you wish to use it.

41752.title: Champion: Zinnin Smythe
41752.completion: <Zinnin's gaze meets yours while standing in quiet contemplation. His stare remains steady as he places a fisted hand over his chest, making an unspoken oath.>

41753.title: Champion: Jubeka Shadowbreaker
41753.completion:
We have to stop meeting like this, {NAME}. You've saved me more times than I care to admit.

If you in turn ever need saving, I'll be there to return the favor.

41754.title: Champion: Shinfel Blightsworn
41754.completion:
So Ritssyn appointed you First of our council, did he?

It seems much has changed in the short time I've been gone.

The Legion threat is greater than ever. I have witnessed their power firsthand, and know that we cannot defeat them as we are now.

You will unite us, {NAME}, and together we will strip the Legion of their power!

41755.title: Champion: Lulubelle Fizzlebang
41755.completion:
I don't have to hide away in shame anymore, and I have you to thank for that.

It's a debt I doubt I'll ever be able to repay, but I'd like to try.

41756.title: Champion: Eredar Twins
41756.objectives: We live to serve you, <name>.It would please us to do your bidding.
41756.completion:
We live to serve you, {NAME}.

It would please us to do your bidding.

42038.title: Champion: Broll Bearmantle
42038.completion:
I have seen enough of the Nightmare to know that it is not an idle threat. Within its grasp, even the strongest become their own worst enemies.

You, however, have displayed courage and fortitude even in the face of this great danger. I feel faith that you will lead us to victory against our enemy.

{NAME}, I wish to pledge my loyalty in service of you and the druidic order

42039.title: Champion: Sylendra Gladesong
42039.completion:
{NAME}, I owe you my life. Your actions gave me a second chance, and it is a chance I have no intention of squandering.

With your help, we were able to recover the Idol of the Wild. Such a sacred relic would have been a devastating loss had it fallen into the wrong hands.

Now, I will see this journey through to its end.

Let me fight for you. If there is anyone who can defeat the Nightmare, I believe it is you.

42047.title: Champion: Hamuul Runetotem
42047.completion:
I have served the wilds for as long as I can remember, mentoring young druids and watching them grow in knowledge and experience.

There are few who have ascended to the rank of archdruid, but I believe you can become one of our best.

I would be honored to follow your leadership of the grove.

42048.title: Champion: Mylune
42048.completion:
Oh, hi {NAME}! My woodland friends just couldn't stop talking about you after you left, and it was they who convinced me to come find you here!

A noble {class} with your courage and kindness just doesn't come along every day.

This is going to be SO much fun, don't you think?

42056.title: Champion: Remulos
42056.completion:
We have come a long way together, {NAME}. At every step, your choices have led the Dreamgrove to victory.

I would give my life to defend Azeroth, and I know you would do the same.

Great danger still faces us. {NAME}, take my pledge. We must serve and protect the wilds!

42096.title: Champion: Naralex
42096.completion:
I've watched you rise up the ranks for a long time, {NAME}. With you leading our order, I know we are in good hands.

Count me as one of your champions, Archdruid.

42137.title: Champion: Yalia Sagewhisper
42137.completion:
Your willingness to help is admirable, and it gives me insight into what kind of leader you will be.

I know you mean to gather priests from all factions and lead them in a battle against the Burning Legion. It's an extraordinary task, but one that you will not have to embark on alone.

42138.title: Champion: Zabra Hexx
42138.completion:
I have a good feelin' about ya, {NAME}. Dis terrible day really started to turn around when ya showed up.

Some might call it luck, but I think it's fate. We were meant to cross paths.

Dis could be da beginnin' a somethin' great.

42197.title: Champion: Duke Hydraxis
42197.completion:
Lord Neptulon has sent me to aid the Earthen Ring in the defense of Azeroth.

I have been commanded to serve the Farseer of the Earthen Ring with the same loyalty I give to the Lord of Tides. I will fulfill this duty until the Burning Legion is driven from this world and the future of Azeroth is secured.

I am yours to command, Farseer.

42198.title: Champion: Stormcaller Mylra
42198.completion:
Uniting the elements won't be easy, Farseer {NAME}. You'll be needin' all the help you can get!

Aye, These are dark times indeed... but we'll face 'em t'gether, don't you worry.

Ol' Mylra has yer back, Farseer.

Now, let's get a move on then! There ain't no time to waste!

42409.title: Champion: Loren Stormhoof
42409.completion:
I've been expecting you, {NAME}. Ohn'ahra's presence told me that change would be coming.

The Highmountain tribes have long been allies of the Unseen Path.

My ancestors welcomed Namuria and her hunters to our land, and together, they helped build the lodge you stand in today.

I am honored to serve at your side.

42410.title: Champion: Rexxar
42410.completion:
An old threat has resurfaced, stronger than ever. Azeroth needs hunters like you who are willing to survive at all costs.

As the leader of the Unseen Path, many will look to you for guidance. Show them that they can survive.

I will stand beside you, and together we will send a message that we can endure, even in the face of an enemy as great as the Burning Legion.

42411.title: Champion: Beastmaster Hilaire
42411.completion:
I knew it was only a matter of time before us scouts would be called home.

My post has been a quiet one over the years, without much to act on. Yet in recent times, I've seen the clans abandon their traditions in favor of following a king who chose to side with the Legion.

The people I sought to protect, allied with my enemy. I will not let others find a similar fate.

42412.title: Champion: Huntsman Blake
42412.completion:
You brought a tear to this old man's eye by bringing Baron back to life. I never thought I'd miss his ear-piercing howls, but I did. It's a wonderful thing to see him working again.

We're happy to help wherever we're needed.

42413.title: Champion: Hemet Nesingwary
42413.completion:
Ya did a fine job takin' down that bird.

Maybe I was wrong about you hunters up in that lodge. Clearly ya know what you're doin'.

I'd be happy to hunt by your side again, as long as you're huntin' big game!

42414.title: Champion: Addie Fizzlebog
42414.completion:
I don't think Hemet himself could have taught me better, but I have to believe there's more to hunting than taking down big game.

Sticking with you, I think I'll be able to learn exactly what it means to be a true {class}.

Here's to you, and the many grand adventures that await us!

42415.title: Champion: Halduron Brightwing
42415.completion:
You faced Hakkar with more strength and courage than I have seen in quite some time.

As Emmarel said, our battle with the Legion has only just begun. You can count on the Farstriders to be there when you need us.

42605.title: Champion: Ragnvald Drakeborn
42605.objectives: Odyn's putting you in charge, eh? Count me in. I find it generally unwise to question the gods.
42605.completion: Odyn's putting you in charge, eh? Count me in. I find it generally unwise to question the gods.

42606.title: Champion: Finna Bjornsdottir
42606.objectives: I will gladly follow you, <name>. I've seen what you're capable of and you have no fear of death.

42614.title: Champion: Svergan Stormcloak
42614.completion: I spent enough time in the afterlife.  Point me at the enemy and I will end them!

42616.title: Champion: Dvalen Ironrune
42616.completion:
I was sworn to protect Ulduar and if it wasn't for yer aid, I would've failed that promise.

Ye can count on me!

42618.title: Champion: Thorim
42618.objectives: You showed bravery in Ulduar, <name>.  I will fulfill my oath and answer the call of the Gjallarhorn.
42618.completion: You showed bravery in Ulduar, {NAME}.  I will fulfill my oath and answer the call of the Gjallarhorn.

42619.title: Champion: Hodir
42619.objectives: I thank you for aiding me, <name>.  I will gladly fight along your side in Odyn's army.
42619.completion: I thank you for aiding me, {NAME}.  I will gladly fight along your side in Odyn's army.

42653.title: Champion: Akama
42653.completion:
I am encouraged that we have come to an understanding. I admired Altruis when he opposed the direction Illidan was taking all those years ago. While the annihilation of the Burning Legion is of paramount importance, in the process, we must not become that which we hope to destroy.

If you would have me as a champion, I will bring all of my knowledge to bear on the task at hand. With time, I believe that we might even come to trust each other.

42662.title: Champion: Archmage Kalec
42662.completion: The blue dragonflight has always represented magic on Azeroth, and it is fitting that we work together against the Burning Legion now more than ever. I would be honored to fight for you as your champion in these dark times.

42664.title: Champion: Shade of Akama
42664.completion:
I have always admired Illidan's singular vision. After all, the annihilation of the Burning Legion is of paramount importance. Nothing else matters. Nothing else can be allowed to stand in our way.

You will take me as your champion. In return, I will bring all of my knowledge and power to bear on the task at hand. In time, we will destroy all of our enemies... perhaps even Akama as well?

42673.title: Champion: Kor'vas Bloodthorn
42673.completion:
It's about time, you big lummox. For a while there, when you chose Asha Ravensong first, I started to doubt your sanity.

Not that there's anything wrong with Asha. But, we both know who the better fighter is.

Right?

Anyway, of course, I'd be honored to be your champion. I accept!

42685.title: Champion: Archmage Modera
42685.completion: It is good to see the Tirisgarde rise again, {NAME}. While not everyone on the Council of Six agrees with me, I believe it is imperative for us to work together and defeat the Burning Legion once and for all!

42690.title: Champion: Altruis the Sufferer
42690.completion:
You honor me, {NAME}. Of course I will serve as your champion and right-hand man. How could I refuse?

We have only just begun to change the way in which the Illidari operate, but already, you have made great strides. If we are to defeat the Burning Legion, it must be done in concert with everyone working together. Not just the Illidari standing alone.

And not standing upon the smoking husk of a world that we have carelessly destroyed while trying to save it.

42695.title: Champion: Kayn Sunfury
42695.completion:
An honor, {NAME}. Of course I will serve as your champion and second-in-command. Could it have been any other way?

We have only just begun to move forward with the master's plan, but already, you have made great strides. If we are to defeat the Burning Legion, we must remain vigilant. Any other goal pales in comparison. The fate of everything hangs in the balance.

At the end of the day, we will stand victorious... no matter the cost!

42697.title: Champion: Asha Ravensong
42697.completion:
You want me to be one of your champions?

<Asha thoughtfully ponders your request a moment.>

I accept, but on one condition. I want you to put me into field duty. While I am of use here on the Fel Hammer, my talents will be put to better use back on Azeroth.

Beyond that, I trust that the plan is still to bring the Burning Legion to its knees?

42701.title: Champion: Matron Mother Malevolence
42701.completion:
What a rare honor. To be one of the Illidari, instead of a servant. I must admit, I was worried you wouldn't choose me as one of your champions.

But now you have, and I could just kiss you!

It never made any sense to me that all worlds should be purged in flame when there are so many delicious playthings to have fun with. Sargeras can be such a bore. Together, we will bring the Burning Legion to its knees and make them grovel in the dirt.

42702.title: Champion: Millhouse Manastorm
42702.completion: Your Hall here isn't too shabby, {NAME}. I'm sure there are lots of nifty secrets I can uncover here. I think I'll stay! Er, if you don't mind, of course.

42704.title: Champion: Arcane Destroyer
42704.objectives: <The Arcane Destroyer makes a high pitched, quizzical chirp and looks at you expectantly.>.
42704.completion: <The Arcane Destroyer makes a high pitched, quizzical chirp and looks at you expectantly.>

42705.title: Champion: Ravandwyr
42705.completion: I have been Archmage Vargoth's apprentice for far too long. Perhaps it is time for me to serve a new master. I would be honored if you would accept me as your champion, {NAME}.

42706.title: Champion: Esara Verrinde
42706.completion: You and I have proven to be quite successful together. I'd be happy to lend you my swords and spells against the Burning Legion anytime, {NAME}.

42777.title: Champion: Belath Dawnblade
42777.completion:
You are choosing me as one of your champions?

<Belath looks both surprised and pleased.>

This is a great distinction. I pledge myself to you again, {NAME}. I will see to it that the enemies of the Illidari are dealt with in your name.

42800.title: Champion: Valeera Sanguinar
42800.completion:
Of course I will serve as your champion. In for a copper in for a gold as they say.

We work well together. I bring out the best in you.

42851.title: Champion: Vindicator Boros
42851.completion:
Highlord, I cannot thank you enough for both saving my life, and opening my eyes.

It is true I harbor great hatred against the Burning Legion, but you have reminded me that my choices define the path I take.

I choose to live a path of righteousness, and I will follow your leadership and guidance, Highlord.

42852.title: Champion: Justicar Julia Celeste
42852.completion:
For years I have heard of your deeds, Highlord. Now that I have fought at your side, I can say the stories were true.

Allow me to represent the Order of the Silver Hand as a champion of the light, {NAME}. I will fight justly and bravely, and carry out your orders to the end.

42881.title: Champion: Lady Liadrin
42881.completion:
Good tidings, {NAME}. I am told that you seek to stop the demon's reign of terror. Is this true?

The Legion has hunted our people across countless worlds... taken countless lives. With each of our paladins that falls the Light reels in pain.

I have had enough - I will fight by your side.

42914.title: Champion: Meryl Felstorm
42914.completion: I have been fighting the Burning Legion for an eternity, {NAME}. I would be honored to impart my wisdom to you as you lead the fight against them once again. I believe I have picked up a few tricks they will not expect!

42917.title: Champion: Archmage Vargoth
42917.completion: You have saved my reputation, not to mention my life! Without your persistence, I would still be hanging above the Nexus yet, {NAME}. I hope you will accept my everlasting gratitude.

43184.title: Champion: Allari the Souleater
43184.completion:
Very astute of you to have saved the best for last.

<Allari smirks playfully.>

In all seriousness, I am deeply honored that you have chosen me, {NAME}. Something tells me that the worst is yet to come. We must remain vigilant and bring the Burning Legion to an end.

43185.title: Champion: Jace Darkweaver
43185.completion:
Me? You want me to be one of your champions?

Yes, of course. A million times, yes! Just tell me where you want me to go, what you want me to do, and consider it done.

43261.title: Champion: Vanessa VanCleef
43261.completion:
After all that, you want me as your champion?

<Vanessa gives you a look of disbelief as she takes a moment before replying.>

Fine, but I do things my way. Agreed?

43262.title: Champion: Garona Halforcen
43262.completion:
<Garona spins one of her razor-sharp blades around her fingers before deftly sheathing it at her waist.>

As long as there's a challenge to the kill, I'm game for whatever little missions you have in mind.

43271.title: Champion: Calia Menethil
43271.objectives: Well met, <name>. It's an honor to serve at your side.I'm happy to help in any way I can.
43271.completion:
Well met, {NAME}. It's an honor to serve at your side.

I'm happy to help in any way I can.

43363.title: A Winter Veil Gift
43363.completion:
A small tag on this present reads:

Happy holidays, {NAME}!

43364.title: A Gently Shaken Gift
43364.completion:
This present looks like it has been shaken a few times. The tag on it reads:

To a very special {race} {class}.

43368.title: Champion: Brightwing
43368.completion:
Your heroic efforts within the Emerald Dream were inspiring, {NAME}. The Dream is safe for now, but it remains threatened as long as Xavius lives.

I will lend you my aid. Together, let us keep Azeroth safe from those who would seek its destruction.

43380.title: Champion: Sol
43380.objectives: Born of Light, I fight for Light.
43380.completion: Born of Light, I fight for Light.

43381.title: Champion: Mariella Ward
43381.completion:
I owe you my life, and so much more.

You saw something in me worth saving, and allowed me to eventually believe that as well.

Let me live my life with purpose, {NAME}. Let me fight by your side.

43382.title: Champion: Natalie Seline
43382.completion:
You pulled my spirit from the Void, which is no easy feat. I cannot deny the part of me that would stay there forever, embraced by the shadows.

The Void is filled with many whispers, {NAME}. The kind that should have us all worried.

We cannot afford to be separated by our beliefs. We must come together as priests of both Light and Shadow to face the Burning Legion together.

43398.title: Champion: Alonsus Faol
43398.completion:
I knew from the moment we met in the quiet fields of Tirisfal that you would be the one to unite the priests.

I'd like to take credit for finding our leader, but I really think the truth of it is, you found us.

Our time together has only just begun, {NAME}.

43492.title: Champion: Aponi Brightmane
43492.completion:
Highlord, I owe you my life and my thanks. You live by the Light, as my Sunwalkers believe.

It is an honor to fight by your side, and with your permission, I would like to continue fighting for the Order of the Silver Hand.

43701.title: Champion: Lothraxion
43701.completion:
I am sure you have many questions, Highlord {NAME}. It was fate that our paths crossed that day on Niskara.

I serve High Exarch Turalyon and Lady Alleria Windrunner. When the Legion turned its armies toward Azeroth, I was sent here to help protect it.

How I got to Niskara is a tale for another time, but had it not been for you, I would still be Balnazzar's prisoner.

Now, I can fulfill my original mission. Let me fight for you. Together, we will drive back the Burning Legion!

43723.title: Champion: Taoshi
43723.completion:
I am honored beyond words, {NAME}. I will gladly serve as your champion.

Point me in the right direction. I can sneak anywhere. Find out anything.

43724.title: Champion: Master Mathias Shaw
43724.completion:
Shall we form an alliance, you and I? Of course, I dare not officially become one of the Uncrowned, let alone the Council of Shadows.

I am the leader of SI:7 after all.

But, when you need my assistance or guidance, you need but ask. I will be there. We will work together through back channels to ensure that the Burning Legion is destroyed.

43785.title: Champion: Arator the Redeemer
43785.completion:
Highlord {NAME}, for many years I sought to follow the footsteps of my father, Turalyon.

In you, I see an exemplary leader, one who can still teach me so much. In you, I see a champion rivaling my father himself.

I would gladly lay down my life and fight for the Order of the Silver Hand.

43929.title: Vantus Mastery
43929.completion:
Greetings, {NAME}.

It is my understanding that you have been one of the foremost scribes responsible for equipping our forces with Vantus runes. Do not think that your efforts as an artisan have gone unnoticed.

We noticed.

I would like to present you with this technique. Now go, and use it to help us win this war.

43933.title: Champion: Delas Moonfang
43933.completion:
Highlord, I am proud to begin the first steps of this new journey.

Thank you for taking me under your wing. I vow to follow the guiding principles - to act honorably, to uphold what is righteous, to fight against injustice, and to celebrate with my new brothers and sisters of the Silver Hand.

Under the Light, we stand as one!

44180.title: Champion: Marin Noggenfogger
44180.completion:
Look, {NAME}. I'll level with ya...

Without your thieving prowess I'd be a much poorer goblin than I am today. I think we should keep this gold-en partnership going!

You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours. Together, we'll put an end to this Burning Legion invasion and line our pockets with all the wealth in Azeroth!

44181.title: Champion: Fleet Admiral Tethys
44181.completion:
Aye, matey! We've had some good voyages together! Blood was spilt, rum was drank, n' our search fer clues was a success!

I'll level wit' ye, {NAME}. I be not havin' such an adventure in some years now. Sailin' wit' ye felt like early mornin' on th' poop deck when th' salty ocean rum splashes ye wide awake!

How abouts I come aboard n' join yer crew as first matey?

44183.title: Champion: Lord Jorach Ravenholdt
44183.completion:
This is a dangerous mystery we've stumbled upon, {NAME}. It would not be fair for me to stand idly by as you risk your life to uncover this corruption.

After all, without honor and brotherhood among thieves, none of us will stand to profit!

From this point on, I'll pledge my personal services against the threat of the Burning Legion and the dark mystery we are unraveling. My blade is yours, {NAME}...

44202.title: For the Cause
44202.completion:
{NAME}, I hope you don't mind me dropping by unexpectedly. I was in the area on business.

My people procured what look to be some rather nice armaments for the cause. I'm sure that you know best how to distribute them.

Do not doubt that our continued cooperation, even if it is a bit cloak and dagger, is making a huge difference in the war against the Burning Legion.

44203.title: For the Cause
44203.completion:
Shadowblade {NAME}, always a pleasure. I was in the area on Alliance business and decided to drop in. It looks like our operations are faring well.

My people procured what look to be some rather nice armaments for the cause. I'm sure that you know best how to distribute them.

Though we must continue to cooperate through back channels and behind closed doors, know that for the duration of the war against the Burning Legion, you can count on my support and that of SI:7.

44243.title: Champion: Thoras Trollbane
44243.completion:
These Knights of the Ebon Blade are a powerful order, Deathlord.

That you command such respect amongst their ranks speaks to your strength and leadership.

During my life, I always fought to preserve my kingdom and people. But for my failure as a father, their blood now stains my hands.

So, I will wash the failure from my hands with the blood of demons. The time has come for me to return to the fray. My sword is yours to command.

44244.title: Champion: Koltira Deathweaver
44244.completion:
Words cannot fully express my gratitude for rescuing me, {NAME}. In truth, I always knew that the Ebon Blade would not forsake me.

I do not wish to elaborate on my years in captivity. That time has passed and we are now presented with an imminent danger in the Burning Legion.

My blade is yours, Deathlord. My life and my allegiance are yours to command.

44245.title: Champion: High Inquisitor Whitemane
44245.completion:
There is no greater hatred and scorn in this world than that which exists in my heart.

The Burning Legion will pay for all that they have taken from me.

The day of my judgment awaits, but theirs is at hand and I will be the executioner's blade. I will not rest until every demon lays dead, their corpses paving the very ground I walk!

Command me to the front, Deathlord and I will rain terror upon the armies of the Burning Legion!

44246.title: Champion: Rottgut
44246.completion:
<Rottgut motions in your direction, gurgling and belching the words from its gaping mouth.>

Rottgut!!

ROTT. GUTT. ROTT! Rottgut Rottgut Rottgut!!!

GUT? ROTTGUTT, GUT. ROTT... GUT!

Rottgut??

44247.title: Champion: Amal'thazad
44247.completion:
Deathlord, I have been your humble tutor in the dark arts for some years now. From your birth at the hands of the Lich King, to your ascension as leader of our order, I have taken pride in watching you grow in power and undeath.

I believe the time has passed in which my services as a teacher are necessary. Perhaps I would be of more use to you on the battlefield?

The time has come for me to warm these frozen bones of mine in the blood my enemies. Please, allow me to be of service on the battlefield.

44248.title: Champion: Darion Mograine
44248.completion:
The Four Horsemen of the Ebon Blade are gathered together, but our work has only just begun.

The Burning Legion has come to our world hungering for destruction, but we will feed them their own demise. Apocalypse awaits the demon invaders and we shall bring it to them!

Deathlord, you have triumphed where no others could have succeeded. I shall lead the Four Horsemen like my father before me, and so long as I lead them our loyalty is yours!

The return of the Four Horsemen is at hand!

44581.title: Spicing Things Up
44581.completion:
Hey, {NAME}, it's me, Nomi. You know, from Pandaria?

It's fine if you don't remember, it's been ages since you may have seen me last.

I'm a full-fledged cook now and have been coming up with some of my own creations.

Here, take a sample of some of the recipes and dishes I've been working on.

44583.completion: Desecrate the Horde's Frostfire Ridge bonfire!

45391.title: Champion: Lady S'theno
45391.completion:
You have gone above and beyond to honor our pact, Sslayer {NAME}. You know I'm not one for sappy speechess, but I assure you that I am grateful.

I will take my place by your side if you will have me.

45790.title: Champion: Almai
45790.completion:
I will miss Brewmaster Blanche. She taught me to follow my dreams.

And I have always wanted to study Mistweaving...

Grandmaster {NAME}. If you will have me, I will defend you and our order from all that wish us harm.

45848.title: Fit For a Pirate
45848.completion:
Squawk! Tethys is lame! Bad pirate! bad pirate!

{NAME} better pirate, raaaaawk! Go with you now!

45873.title: Champion: Eitrigg
45873.completion:
I am not one for emotional speeches, Battlelord {NAME}, so I will keep this short. 

I owe you my life. My axes are at your service.

45876.title: Champion: Lord Darius Crowley
45876.completion: You are an inspiring leader, Battlelord {NAME}. I will follow you to Argus and back if you will have me!

28053.title: Lunk Like Your Style
28053.completion:
Lunk heared that you used the stone to banish fire-lizard.  You saved Gorge, and you didn't even kill!

Lunk so proud.  Lunk happy to be {NAME}'s teacher.

Maybe you take this.  Lunk doesn't need it.  Lunk too busy adventuring!

28084.title: Might of the Krom'gar
28084.completion:
You may now make use of the Krom'gar stockpile, {NAME}! For a small fee I will sell you armaments of battle, useful for crushing your enemies! The availability of what I sell depends upon your rank in the army. Visit my shop whenever you earn a new rank.

LOK'TAR OGAR!

36512.title: Together We Are Strong
36512.completion:
Auchindoun would have fallen to the demons if it weren't for you. Even the blood elves would not have been enough. I don't know how I could possibly ever repay you.

<Tuulani's face lights up.>

That's it! We're kindred spirits, {NAME}. I can feel it! How about I stick around with you?

I'll still have to attend to my duties at Auchindoun, but I can handle it. What do you say, {NAME}? It'll be great!

36518.title: The True Path
36518.completion:
Wow... I've never seen anyone fight like that. That was... impressive.

I'm in no shape to join Lady Liadrin and the others at Auchindoun now. You have an entire fortress on this world, though. Could I go there and rest awhile? Maybe repair my armor?

I'll stick around and join your forces as a token of my gratitude. Liadrin won't mind... we're all on the same team, right?

36519.title: The True Path
36519.completion:
I have never seen anyone fight like that, 
.

I am regrettably in no condition now to join the Auchenai in defending Auchindoun. I have heard stories of your fortress in Shadowmoon Valley. Could I go there and repair my armor?

Perhaps... I could stay there a while longer than that? I feel there is much you could teach me.

36522.title: Solidarity in Death
36522.completion:
I may have fallen, but I will not be forgotten.

I implore you to allow me to stay here and serve in your army. Bralok took my life, but my spirit stands strong before you.

I need to stop the Iron Horde, {NAME}, and I know you are the only one that can help me do that.

36617.title: A Winter Veil Gift

Happy holidays, {NAME}!

36633.title: Delvar Ironfist
36633.completion:
Well it's about time ye showed up. I'm done slumming around with these new recruits.

Me blade is sharp, me armor is spit shined and I combed me beard this mornin'.

I've been ready for battle since me grandpa Gygax first put an axe in me wee lil hand.

So whad'ya say, commander?

36702.title: Meatball
36702.completion:
MEATBALL FEELING BETTER NOW!

MEATBALL FIGHT FOR AKIHIKÓ NOW!

MEATBALL FOLLOW AKIHIKÓ WHEREVER AKIHIKÓ GO!!!

36833.completion: You have impressed me greatly, {NAME}. If you will have me, I would like to join you at your garrison.

36864.title: Three Feet Under
36864.completion:
I can honestly say I never thought I'd see the premier Horde commander walking through an Alliance garrison.

Then again, I never thought I'd be caught while performing reconnaissance for the Dark Lady and stuffed in a hole in the ground left for dead.

I'm clearly not going anywhere without your help. If you help me out of this hellhole, I'll serve under your banner. My solo run has been decidedly less than pleasant.

36867.title: Lower Blackrock Spires Bonus Reward Quest

36947.title: New Strength
36947.completion:
I have been training hard since I joined your forces, commander.

Let me prove my new strength to you so that I am worthy to fight by your side. All will tremble at the sight of us on the battlefield!

37047.title: The Light's Gift
37047.completion:
The Light has blessed me with newfound power, commander.

Now none can stand against our conviction!

37070.title: Power of the Nether
37070.completion:
Fighting alongside you has strengthened my connection to the nether like never before, commander.

I will use my new power to rain death down upon your enemies. They will learn to fear you.

37080.title: Glorious Slaughter
37080.objectives: The blood o' our fallen foes has not yet sated my thirst, commander.I have a trick up me sleeve that ought ta help change that.
37080.completion:
The blood o' our fallen foes has not yet sated my thirst, commander.

I have a trick up me sleeve that ought ta help change that.

37081.title: Burning Rage
37081.completion:
We have shown far too much mercy to your enemies, commander.

If you would allow me, I have a spell I've been perfecting that will show them what happens when you stand in our way.

37084.title: The Shadows Call
37084.completion:
The shadows... they have taught me how to slip into the minds of our enemies.

Yes... turn them against their own. Our victory will be swift. Rawk!

37085.title: Fury of the Clan
37085.completion:
Our clan strong. Strongest.

I feed our lust, make us stronger. We win!

37141.title: Talonpriest Ishaal
37141.completion:
My purpose as a Talonpriest has been fulfilled, though Iskar and Zellek must think me a fool for altering the sacred rites.

I care not for their approval, and I am done hiding in the shadows.

Let me fight for you. I should like to improve this world before I fade away from it.

37144.title: Talon Guard Kurekk
37144.objectives: You have done much for us. What can I offer, but my blade?Talon King, let me fight for you.
37144.completion:
You have done much for us. What can I offer, but my blade?

Talon King, let me fight for you.

37168.title: Leorajh, the Enlightened
37168.completion:
<The strangely gentle saberon brings a massive paw to his chest.>

Me Leorajh. Not like others. Was small... weak. Banished from clan. Not Bloodmane anymore...

Leorajh find cave. Find stone of sunlight. Learn much from stone. Want learn more. Want new clan.

You strong. Have clan?

Leorajh join?

37270.title: Alchemy Experiment
37270.completion: I've been experimenting again today, and I've come up with some potion formulations that might suit you, commander. Would you like to try one?

37276.title: Standing United
37276.completion:
The Shattered Hand and their allies are dangerous, commander. No offense, but I don't trust your standing forces to keep a future assassin from slipping in unnoticed.

I would like to volunteer myself to join your forces so I can keep a close watch on enemy movements. We cannot risk your untimely death - too much rests on your shoulders.

37281.title: Standing United
37281.completion:
I mean nae offense, commander, but I don't trust yer forces tae keep ya safe from a Shattered Hand assassination attempt on yer life.

If it's agreeable to ye, I'd like tae join yer garrison and keep a watch on the scoundrels.

37838.title: My Garona
37838.completion:
{class}, I know that I have done little to earn your trust. Until you freed me, my life was not my own.

Your tenacity, and the wisdom of your Archmage, have finally set me free. You had faith in me even when I had no faith in myself. You have given me back my life, and now I freely pledge it to you. I will serve you here on Draenor until my dying day.

Point me at your enemies, and I will deliver unto them a swift and silent end... Commander.

14239.title: Don't Go Into the Light!
14239.completion:
It's up to you now. Are you going to come back to life and be the hero that your fellow survivors need you to be, or are you going to rest for eternity here?

Only you can decide.

Don't go into the Light, {NAME}!

14375.title: Last Chance at Humanity
14375.completion:
I need you to pull through, {NAME}.  This dosage is strong enough to kill a horse.

But I know you.  I know what you're made of.  You will be fine.

Trust me.  I know what you're going through.

Now drink up and close your eyes.

14434.title: Rut'theran Village
14434.completion:
Are you ready to set sail, {NAME}?  Your people have been granted shelter in the lands of the kaldorei.

Do not worry, {race}.  Your people will get a chance to fight for Gilneas again.  This time, with the full strength of the Alliance.

14467.title: Alas, Gilneas!
14467.completion:
Look, {NAME}!  Look at what's become of Duskhaven!

Look at what's become of the last safe place in Gilneas!

24549.title: Shadowmourne...
24549.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to bring him Shadow's Edge.
24549.completion:
Congratulations, {class}.

Against insurmountable odds, you have weathered the storm.

I trust that you shall find your reward proportionate to your conviction...

24743.title: Shadow's Edge
24743.completion:
Listen well, {class}. In accepting this weapon your fate is sealed.

Overcome or succumb.

I have placed your feet upon this path. You are therefore my personal responsibility. Should you failter, I am duty-bound to deliver you from this life.

Remember my words, {race}, and do not fail.

24815.title: Choose Your Path
24815.completion:
To atone for the sins I committed as one of the Lich King's Death Knights, I've dedicated myself to creating rings of great power for our brothers and sisters to use in the struggle.

You've proven yourself as a valuable ally in the fight against the Scourge, {NAME}. As your dedication continues I can improve on the ring's original design.

Choose your path carefully. A change of heart will come at a price.

26936.title: Lower the Boom
26936.completion:
Felstone is cleared and the bombs are set.  I hope you're ready.  I recommend covering your ears.

<Derrington looks down and places his finger on an ignition switch.>

EVERYBODY, PREPARE FOR IGNITION!  IN 3...

2....

1...

27542.title: Taking the Battlefront
27542.completion:
The hour of victory approaches, {NAME}. Godfrey has devised a plan to decimate our enemies. I am sending you into the field with him and his men to bring the rebel insurgents to their knees and seal the fate of the Alliance filth encroaching upon our lands.

Our final march begins when you are ready.

27555.title: Fiona's Lucky Charm
27555.completion:
Fiona has left some of her charms inside the caravan.

As a trader, she seems to be pretty good with money.  Maybe carrying one of her charms will help out with your finances.

27556.title: Gidwin's Weapon Oil
27556.completion:
Gidwin has left several bottles of weapon oil inside the caravan.

He seems to be quite a fierce combatant up close.  Perhaps his weapon oil will help you out as well.

27557.title: Tarenar's Talisman
27557.completion:
Tarenar has laid a few holy talismans inside the caravan.  They appear to be unused.

They appear to be magical in nature.  If Tarenar isn't using them, what's the harm in borrowing one for a while?

27558.title: Pamela's Doll
27558.completion:
You see a small doll sitting in the back corner of the caravan.

Tarenar tells you that it must belong to Gidwin, and Gidwin says that it's probably Tarenar's.

27559.title: Vex'tul's Armbands
27559.completion:
Vex'tul has left some of his wrappings within the caravan.  Surprisingly, he was courteous enough to keep them folded and separate from everyone else's belongings.

Vex'tul values strength over everything else.  Leaning in close, you can sense some of his residual strength emanating from within these armbands.

27560.title: Argus' Journal
27560.completion:
You see a trail-worn journal inside the caravan.  Judging by the Argent Crusade emblem on its spine, it must belong to Argus.

Written within the journal are several accounts of Argus' experiences during his tenure in the Crusade.  It should prove to be an interesting read while on the road.

27561.title: Rimblat's Stone
27561.completion:
You notice a small heap of stones within the caravan.

They do not appear out-of-the-ordinary, yet one of them attracts your attention.  You sense a warmth coming from within it.

27562.title: Beezil's Cog
27562.completion:
It looks like Beezil has already made himself comfortable, and has stuffed several peculiar gizmos into the caravan.

Most of them seem too impractical or dangerous to take with you.  One small cogwheel, however, looks to be fairly well-crafted.

27859.title: The Egg Lives On
27859.objectives: Wait as Rhea retrieves the egg from the Hidden Clutch.
27859.completion:
You were not the only mortal that Rheastrasza confided in.  I too earned the dragon's trust.

I have already moved the real purified egg on to a safer location, away from the Badlands.  It will continue to grow, out of Deathwing's sight.

The red dragonflight is as benevolent as it is powerful.  It was Rheastrasza's final wish that I give this to you.

27957.title: Lunk No Kill

2952.title: The Sparklematic 5200!
2952.completion:
As quickly as it started, the Sparklematic 5200 comes to an abrupt halt.  A simple "ding" is heard from the machine, and the mouth of the machine spirals upward.  Inside the Sparklematic 5200 is a small box wrapped in a little bow.  The machine would appear to wrap an object up after eliminating its grime-encrusted status.  Even if the machine didn't work, at least the item is now wrapped in a pretty box.

3721.title: An OOX of Your Own
3721.completion:
You've recovered three of my OOX homing robots!  You've gone above and beyond what you needed to, so I will give you something special for all your help.  It is a miniature version of the very same robot that you have come to know and love, the OOX!

I normally wouldn't let anyone have such a potentially lethal device, but you've been a real help.  Besides - the combat mechanisms and the homing logic on this one have been disabled.

Other than that, it's an OOX by golly!

11864.title: A Mission Statement
11864.completion:
The demon has many names and each name has held special meaning at one time or another. While the details were sometimes insignificant, the end result was always the same: death.

But it is now, nearly fifty years after it all began, that the details will find the devil and lead to his downfall.

This time, we have him... There will be no escape for Nesingwary.

Northrend will be the battleground for our war. The hunter will become the hunted!

12582.completion:
I know you weren't traitor thing like others said. We hunt together... I know you better than all of them. Thank you for saving me.

May sound funny... I not a big fan of big-tongues... but even I feel little bad for big-tongue dying like that though...they fight good enough they deserve fair fight.

You want to be friends with Frenzyheart again? I think I can convince them that you save me and got the big-tongues good. I no want you to make me look dumb though, so you sure no more big-tongues for you?

12689.title: Hand of the Oracles
12689.completion:
Hi! Really glad see you again!

I knew we friends. I knew it! You good friend. Not just for us, but for all Oracles. Thank you for saving us! Thank you, thank you!

I saw you bonk that puppy-man good! Undead thing said he your friend before? I not know that. You done with puppy-men though, yeah? Just Oracle friend now?

Stop! No agree without thinking - you sure you not want to be friends with puppy-men anymore?

13570.title: Remembrance of Auberdine
13570.completion:
I just want to offer my sincerest thanks for all that you've done for us. In my grief, I'm afraid that I didn't extend the gratitude that you truly deserve. We may not have made it here without you.

Know that you will always have friends here.

And you needn't worry about my loneliness. Grimclaw has taken to keeping me company, and I have to say he's a more comforting companion than I would have expected.

Take this, and go with all our blessings. Until we meet again, {NAME}.

13571.title: Fletcher's Lost and Found
13571.completion:
Above the stale, unwashed stench, you catch a whiff of a familiar smell!  It appears as if this once-mighty adventurer has a real love for kungaloosh.

Peeking through the bars, you can barely make out the recipe written on his arm....

We need to get control of this situation. We thought these docks would be all but abandoned. Instead, Gul'dan has ordered the Iron Horde to retreat to Tanaan, and many are using this harbor to make their getaway.

38876.title: Assault on the Fel Forge
38876.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
38876.description:
The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.

A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

These demons have no honor! Rather than meet us in glorious, open-battle; they hide behind their barricades and siege weapons.
