54613.title: Twice-Exiled
54613.objectives: Kill 12 Burning, Cresting, Rumbling, or Thundering Exiles or Guardians in Arathi Highlands.
54613.description:
Elementals of all sorts are bursting free of their bonds across the Highlands.

Return them to the primordial chaos from whence they came.

54614.title: Executing Exorcisms
54614.description:
Even in death, the Alliance foolishly clings to Horde territory.

Drive their vengeful ghosts from the ruins of Stromgarde before their foulness spreads.

54615.title: The League Will Lose
54615.objectives: Kill 12 League of Arathor at Dabyrie's Farmstead.
54615.description:
Even with the fall of Stromgarde, the League of Arathor continues to operate in the Highlands.

The northern farmland will belong to the Horde. Go, and defeat the humans.

54616.title: Boulderfist Beatdown
54616.objectives: Kill 12 Boulderfist clan ogres in Arathi Highlands.
54616.description:
If the Boulderfist ogres will not join the Horde, there is no place for them in Arathi.

You know what must be done.

54617.title: Sins of the Syndicate
54617.objectives: Kill 12 Syndicate members at Go'Shek Farm.
54617.description:
As if the League of Arathor was not trouble enough, Syndicate agents still slither down from the Alterac mountains to drive off honest Horde laborers.

Punish them.

54619.title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
54619.objectives: Kill 12 Witherbark tribe trolls in Arathi Highlands.
54619.description:
The bloodthirsty Witherbark tribe has always refused to join the Horde... and now that the Horde holds Arathi, we will succeed where the Alliance has failed.

Drive the forest trolls from the Highlands.

54620.title: Death to The Defilers
54620.description:
Even with the destruction of Undercity, the Defilers continue to combat our hold on the Arathi Highlands.

The farmland at Go'Shek will belong to the Alliance once more. Go, and defeat the Forsaken.

54621.title: Twice-Exiled
54621.objectives: Kill 12 Burning, Cresting, Rumbling, or Thundering Exiles or Guardians in Arathi Highlands.
54621.description:
Elementals of all sorts are bursting free of their bonds across the Highlands.

Return them to the primordial chaos from whence they came.

54622.title: Executing Exorcisms
54622.description:
Even in death, the Horde foolishly clings to Alliance territory.

Drive their vengeful ghosts from the ruins of Ar'gorok before their foulness spreads.

54623.title: Boulderfist Beatdown
54623.objectives: Kill 12 Boulderfist clan ogres in Arathi Highlands.
54623.description:
The Boulderfist ogres have plagued Arathi since the Second War, and they still remain.

You know what must be done.

54624.title: Sins of the Syndicate
54624.objectives: Kill 12 Syndicate members at Dabyrie's Farmstead.
54624.description:
As if the Defilers were not trouble enough, Syndicate agents still slither down from the Alterac mountains to drive off honest Alliance farmers.

Punish them.

54625.title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
54625.objectives: Kill 12 Witherbark tribe trolls in Arathi Highlands.
54625.description:
The Witherbark tribe has a long and bloody history in the highlands of Arathi.

Show them how much bloodier it can get.

55350.title: Assault: Amathet Advance
55350.objectives: Drive back the Amathet Assault in Uldum.
55350.description:
The Amathet seek to claim the Forge of Origination for their own. We must not allow it to fall into their hands again!

Our men are defending the entrance, but they will be overwhelmed if the entire might of the Amathet advances upon them. 

Do what you can to route their forces before its too late.
55350.completion:
Hah! You showed those dusty zealots what a true warrior looks like.

Well done.

57008.title: Assault: The Warring Clans
57008.objectives: Drive back the Mogu Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
57008.description:
The opportunistic mogu clans seek to take the Vale while its defenders are recovering from N'Zoth's attack. 

They are both cowardly and foolish.

Show them the error of their ways.
57008.completion:
These pretenders will learn that they must either join the Rajani or be ground to dust.

You have done well to show them that.

57157.title: Assault: The Black Empire
57157.objectives: Drive back the N'Zoth Assault in Uldum.
57157.description:
It is just as the visions fortold. Dark forces have come to claim the Forge of Origination.

They must be stopped, or all of Azeroth will meet its end!
57157.completion:
The voices have stopped. The visions show me the dawn.

We will survive this day, thanks to you.

57205.title: A Few Bumps Along the Way
57205.description:
This territory is strategic to our defense, we can not allow these abominations to force our retreat!

Seize control of two of the locations marked on your map. Defend them from enemy attack till the flag is planted and the location captured.

57650.title: Better Off Dead
57650.description:
Our defense is tenuous at best, but the enemy is still hesitant to attack.

As long as they fear us, they won't be probing our defenses. 

You must keep the pressure on the enemy.  Attack their positions all along our line.

57728.title: Assault: The Endless Swarm
57728.objectives: Drive back the Mantid Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
57728.description:
The mantid swarm is surging! There's no way the Golden Lotus will be able to handle this many of them.

We must do something to drive them back!
57728.completion:
It looks like they're retreating. That was a close one. 

The Vale should be safe, for now.

58437.title: Parts to a Whole
58437.description:
Damien has some great dreams, but without more abominations, this training facility will not succeed! 

I have a plan though!  If we can't recruit more abominations, then we shall make them ourselves!

I need you to make some corpses, then mark them for harvesting with a flag. I will do the rest.

Among all of the raptors in Mandokir's domain, one familiar face stands out. She's grown a little bigger, and she's earned a few scars, but the lashtail hatchling is still here.

35617.title: Fiona
35617.completion:
I have spoken with the rest of my caravan, and we've agreed to rest our wagon for a while while I pledge my service to your garrison.

I think I could be of great use to you. What do you say?

35625.title: Shelly Hamby
35625.completion:
Draenor... even the sound of this place makes me sick.

My husband is gone. I cannot go home while his memory lingers.

Please, let me join you and fight for you. Send me to the frontlines, wherever killing is needed.

With every enemy that I face, perhaps the pain will lessen.

35631.title: Rulkan
35631.completion:
Prophet Velen spoke highly of you, and I can see that your weapons are keen and your intent is just.

I sense great potential within you. If you will allow it, I would warm my hands by your fire for a while.

I would like to follow you and learn from your people. In return, I shall fight for you.

What do you say, traveler?

36353.title: For Old Times' Sake
36353.completion:
{NAME}, we've been through hell and back together more times than I can count. You're the Alliance's best chance at defeating the Iron Horde, and you know it.

How do you feel about me joining your garrison? We can bring the fight to orcish scum together, just like old times.

89032.objectives: Speak with Void Researcher Anomander at the Howling Ridge.
89032.description:
You continue to show us that you are an integral member of our community. 

To honor that bond seek me out in Iskaara as I have prepared a pack of supplies to aid you.
89032.completion: Again, we can only thank you so much and these supplies do not do that thank you justice, but please know your aid means a great deal to us!

65606.title: Renowned with the Maruuk
65606.description:
Your deeds to further the interests of the clan have not gone unnoticed. 

Return to Maruukai, I have prepared some supplies to further assist you in your work with us.
65606.completion: You honor us with your deeds, I will tell the elders of your work. Take these supplies, may they aid you in the hunt!

89035.title: Renowned with the Hara'ti
89035.objectives: Speak with Naynar in the Den.
89035.description:
The Hara'ti are stronger for what you have done.

Go to Naynar. She will see that your deeds are remembered, and present you trophies appropriate for all you have done.
89035.completion:
The Hara'ti recognize what you do for us.

Take this. A boon we hope will strengthen you as greatly as your aid strengthened Harandar.

75290.title: Renowned with the Loamm Niffen
75290.description:
Well hey there!

We want to thank you for all your help. How about you meet me in Loamm, so we get you something nice?

Keep up the good work!
75290.completion:
You're doing great! Thanks for all your help--we appreciate it!

Hopefully this'll be useful for you!

46743.description:
Champion, your help to our people has far exceeded any of our expectations, and has provided us some much needed breathing space.

Please, take these supplies to aid you in the war against the Legion. With your continued aid, we should be able to gather more and prepare them for you.

Take this and continue your work... somewhere less conspicuous.
